english: About the Adventure
zh_tw: 關於冒險

english: Designed for an adventuring party of four to six 1st-level characters, {@i Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus} is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure that begins in the city of Baldur's Gate and ends in Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. By the end of the adventure, the characters should be 13th level or higher. To run this adventure, you need the fifth edition {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, and {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: 《{@i 博德之門：墜入阿弗納斯}》是為一支4至6名1級角色組成的冒險隊伍而設計的D&D冒險，該冒險會從博德之門的城區開始，然後結束於九獄的第一層阿弗納斯。在冒險結束時，角色們應到達13或更高的等級。為了運作這場冒險您還需要第五版的{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}、{@book 城主指南|DMG}和{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}。

english: Use the first session of the game to help your players create their 1st-level characters. As part of this process, the players can choose their party's dark secret (see "{@area Dark Secrets|3ec|x}").
zh_tw: 使用本章來幫助你的玩家們建立他們的1級角色。作為建立過程的一部分，玩家們可以為他們的隊伍選擇一個黑暗秘密（見"{@area 黑暗秘密|3ec|x}"）。

english: Adventure Overview
zh_tw: 冒險概述

english: The holy city of Elturel has disappeared from the Forgotten Realms and descended into Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells. This event came about as the result of an infernal bargain between the archdevil Zariel, who rules Avernus, and the treacherous High Overseer of Elturel, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}. Zariel is capturing cities and using their citizens as fodder in the ongoing conflict between demons and devils known as the Blood War. Next on Zariel's list of cities is Elturel's neighbor, Baldur's Gate. The characters can be the heroes who descend into Avernus, save Elturel from certain destruction, and prevent a similar fate from befalling Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 聖城艾爾托瑞爾從被遺忘的國度消失並墜入了九獄第一層，阿弗納斯。此事為阿弗納斯的統治者，魔鬼大公扎瑞爾與背叛了的艾爾托瑞爾最高監視者，塔維斯·克雷格{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}間的地獄契約所致。扎瑞爾正在捕獲城市，將市民當做飼料撒進魔鬼與惡魔間持續已久的血戰。扎瑞爾清單上的下一個城市便是艾爾托瑞爾的鄰居——博德之門。角色們可以成為進入阿弗納斯的英雄，將艾爾托瑞爾從毀滅的命運中拯救出來，並阻止博德之門陷入同樣的命運。

english: Trouble in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的麻煩

english: {@adventure Chapter 1|BGDIA|1} begins in the independent city of Baldur's Gate, where the characters find themselves trapped behind the city's walls after the gates are sealed to keep out hundreds of refugees from the neighboring land of Elturgard. However, the gates can't hold back news that Elturgard's capital has fallen, and that Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} of Baldur's Gate is missing—lost on a diplomatic mission to Elturel. The fact that Elturel's misfortune coincided with Ravengard's visit has left Baldurians wondering whether Baldur's Gate will suffer Elturel's fate.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1} 開始於獨立都市博德之門，角色們在那裡發現自己被博德之門為了阻擋數以百計的埃爾圖迦德難民而緊閉的大門擋在了城牆外面。然而城門擋不住埃爾圖迦德的首都已然陷落以及在此城中進行外交任務的烏爾德·瑞文嘉德大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}公一同失蹤的訊息的流傳。艾爾托瑞爾的災難恰巧在瑞文加德因訪問而離開博德之門時發生，這令博德之門居民生恐博德之門也遭受與艾爾托瑞爾相同的命運。

english: The characters are drafted by the Flaming Fist, the army of mercenaries tasked with protecting Baldur's Gate. Without Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} to lead them, the Flaming Fist mercenaries are little more than glorified thugs. The characters' orders are to help maintain peace by rooting out and destroying followers of Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul—evil gods collectively known as the Dead Three. These vile priests, assassins, and necromancers are murdering city folk at random, and the Flaming Fist is too distracted and disorganized to hunt them down and find their lair. In the course of their investigation, the characters learn that the Dead Three cultists are secretly being financed by Thalamra Vanthampur, one of three remaining dukes who preside over the government of Baldur's Gate, using money stolen from the hoard of Tiamat, the evil queen of dragons imprisoned in the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 角色們被保護博德之門的僱傭兵焰拳徵召。失去了烏爾德·瑞文加德大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}領導的焰拳不過是衣著光鮮的暴徒。。給角色們的命令是去根除並摧毀城內被稱為死亡三神的巴爾，班恩和米爾寇的追隨者們來幫助維護和平。這些邪惡的牧師、刺客以及死靈法師在隨機的謀殺城市居民，而焰拳因力不從心和內部混亂而無法追捕這些邪教徒以及找到他們的老巢。在角色們調查的過程中會逐漸發現死亡三神的邪教徒正被主持博德之門當局的剩餘三公爵之一的薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵使用從被囚禁在九獄的邪惡龍後提亞馬特的寶庫中偷來的金錢進行資助。

english: With Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} out of the way, Thalamra is paying the Dead Three to shatter confidence in the Flaming Fist so that all payments to the decapitated organization can be cut off. Thalamra, a devout disciple of the archdevil Zariel, has brokered a deal that will enable her to claim the role of grand duke once the Flaming Fist disbands, paving the way for the city's descent into Avernus. To accomplish this last goal, Thalamra needs an artifact called the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}, imprisoned in which is a pit fiend named Gargauth. Until recently, the shield was sealed in a tomb under the city, but Thalamra's sons recently stole it and transported it to the dungeon below their villa. So corrupt is the shield that its mere presence in Baldur's Gate has contributed to the city's moral decay for decades.
zh_tw: 在大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}失蹤期間，薩拉瑪拉付錢給死亡三神教徒來破壞大家對焰拳的信任以便中止所有給這個群龍無首的組織的酬金。薩拉瑪拉是魔鬼大公扎瑞爾的一名虔誠信奉者，她已經談好了一筆交易：在焰拳解散，給把這個城市打入地獄掃除障礙後，扎瑞爾便能助她成為大公。為了達成這個最終的目標，薩拉瑪拉需要一件名為{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}的神器，其內囚禁著名為加葛斯的深獄煉魔。直到不久前這面盾牌還被封印在這座城市的一座地下墓穴裡，但是薩拉瑪拉的兒子們最近把它偷了出來並轉移到了他們別墅下方的地城裡。這面盾牌是如此地汙穢，僅僅是存在於博德之門就造成了市民們數十年來的道德敗壞。

english: To keep Baldur's Gate from falling into Zariel's clutches, the characters must take the shield far away from the city. Reya Mantlemorn, a young knight from Elturel, suspects that the Vanthampurs are sheltering {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} at their estate and offers aid. Characters who storm Duke Vanthampur's villa find Thavius hidden in the dungeon below it. Thavius is helping Thalamra Vanthampur use the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} to bring about the fall of Baldur's Gate, in much the same fashion he used the Companion (see "{@area The Companion|007|x}") to doom Elturel. If the characters slay Thavius, his soul travels to the Nine Hells and re-forms as an amnizu devil on Avernus (see ""{@area Poor Devil: Thavius Kreeg|2b8|x}").
zh_tw: 為了防止博德之門落入扎瑞爾的魔爪，角色們必須帶著盾牌遠離城市。一名來自艾爾托瑞爾的年輕騎士，蕾婭·曼特勒蒙，懷疑範薩姆普爾家族在他們的房子裡庇護塔維斯·克雷格{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}併為其提供幫助。闖入範薩姆普爾公爵別墅的角色們可以在那裡下方的地城裡發現塔維斯。他在協助薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾使用{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}給博德之門帶去墜落，就像他透過伴陽（參見"{@area 伴陽|007|x}"）帶給艾爾托瑞爾末日的那樣。如果角色們殺死了塔維斯，他的靈魂會前往九獄並在阿弗納斯被重塑為一隻安祖魔（參見""{@area 可憐的魔鬼：塔維斯·克雷格|2b8|x}"）。

english: Visit to Candlekeep
zh_tw: 燭堡之旅

english: In the course of dealing with {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} and the Vanthampur family, characters are likely to acquire the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} as well as an {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} that they can't open. They might also liberate a spy imprisoned in Duke Vanthampur's dungeon who works for {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA}, a tiefling expert on the Nine Hells. Determined to thwart devil worshipers in positions of power throughout the Western Heartlands, Sylvira operates out of the library of Candlekeep and has spent years monitoring devil activity in Baldur's Gate, Elturel, and the surrounding region. Her spies are after the puzzle box, which is believed to contain a copy of the fiendish contract Thavius signed to seal Elturel's doom.
zh_tw: 在對付{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}和範薩姆普爾家族的過程中角色們可能會獲得{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}和一隻他們無法開啟的{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}。他們還有可能解救一名被囚禁在範薩姆普爾公爵的地城裡的一名為九獄專家{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}工作的密探。因為決心挫敗西哈特蘭德全境身居要職的魔鬼崇拜者，西爾維拉在燭堡工作並常年監視博德之門，艾爾托瑞爾以及周邊地區的魔鬼活動。她的密探在尋找一個煉獄謎盒，該謎盒被相信裝有一份塔維斯簽署的地獄契約的副本，其確認了艾爾托瑞爾的末日。

english: If the characters wish to help Baldur's Gate further, they must journey to the Nine Hells and rescue {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} from what's left of Elturel. The characters are urged to seek out {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} in Candlekeep. Sylvira knows the secret to unlocking Thavius's puzzle box. She can also facilitate the characters' descent into Avernus and provide them with a map (albeit an unreliable one). Sylvira advises characters to leave the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} in her custody. However, there are benefits to taking the shield with them, for Gargauth can guide them through the Nine Hells in ways others cannot. With or without the shield, the characters depart Candlekeep and visit Sylvira's friend, {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}, a wizard who can use the {@spell plane shift} spell to get them to Elturel. At this wizard's tower, they meet a {@creature hollyphant|BGDIA} named {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要進一步幫助博德之門，他們必須前往九獄在艾爾托瑞爾的廢墟中搜救{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}。角色們被勸說去尋找燭堡的{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}。希爾維婭知道如何解鎖塔維斯的謎盒，她也可以幫助角色們進入阿弗納斯並提供一張地圖（雖然不太準確）。希爾維婭會建議角色將{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}留給她保管，但是對角色們而言留著盾牌更好，因為加葛斯會以無人可比的方式引導角色們穿越九獄。無論有沒有盾牌，角色們都將離開燭堡去拜訪希爾維婭的朋友{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}，一名可以使用法術{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}帶他們前往艾爾托瑞爾的法師。在這位法師的法師塔中，他們將遇到一隻名為{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的{@creature hollyphant|BGDIA|聖飛象}。

english: To the Nine Hells!
zh_tw: 去九獄！

english: {@adventure Chapter 2|BGDIA|2} opens with the characters' arrival in Elturel, which is anchored by enormous chains and trapped under the baleful light of the Companion. If the characters do nothing, the city will be pulled down into the River Styx and bound to the Nine Hells forever. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} tries her best to serve as the party's guide in Avernus, but the hollyphant's memories are fragmented. It becomes clear, however, that {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has a personal connection to Zariel, dating back to the archdevil's former angelic existence.
zh_tw: {@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2} 開場於角色們到達艾爾托瑞爾，這座城市被巨大的鎖鏈固定住，被困於伴陽的惡毒光線之下。如果角色們什麼都不做的話，那麼這座城市將被拉入冥河並永遠地被束縛在九獄。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會盡其所能充當角色們在阿弗納斯的嚮導，但是她的記憶已經支離破碎。不過很明顯的是，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和扎瑞爾之間有某種可以追溯到這名魔鬼大公曾為天使時的私人聯絡。

english: Diagram 0.1: Adventure Flowchart
zh_tw: 圖 0.1: 冒險流程

english: After scouring Elturel for survivors and clashing with the denizens of Avernus, the characters encounter the valiant {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}, who has been placed in the most unusual situation of defending a city he has long opposed. The beleaguered Ravengard urges the characters to do whatever they can to free Elturel and return what's left of it to Faerûn. To do so, they must scour Avernus for the means to destroy the Companion or break the enormous chains that shackle that city, as described in {@adventure chapter 3|BGDIA|3}.
zh_tw: 在搜尋城中的倖存者並與阿弗納斯的原住民戰鬥之後，角色們會遇到英勇的{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}，他如今被置於一個非比尋常的位置——去保衛一座他長期敵對的城市。被圍困的瑞文嘉德力勸角色們去做任何可以解放艾爾托瑞爾，令其殘存之物迴歸費倫的任何事。為了做到這一點，他們必須在阿弗納斯仔細尋找摧毀伴陽或是打破束縛城市的鎖鏈的方法，這些會在{@adventure 第三章|BGDIA|3}描述。

english: Avernus has long been a battlefield in the never-ending Blood War. Apart from clashing demons and devils, petty warlords scour the Avernian wastelands in search of treasure, salvage, and fuel for their infernal war machines. Characters who forge an alliance with one warlord risk alienating the others. By acquiring an infernal war machine, characters can travel quickly across Avernus—a domain rife with tortured souls, warmongers, and devils eager to tempt would-be heroes into soul-corrupting deals.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯長期作為無盡血戰的戰場。但除了撕殺的魔鬼與惡魔之外還有繁多的小軍閥們在阿弗納斯廢土上來回搜刮財寶，可維修的廢品以及他們地獄戰爭機器的燃料。與一名軍閥結成同盟的角色會被其他軍閥疏離。經由獲取一臺地獄戰車，角色們們可以快速的穿越阿弗納斯，這片地域充斥著備受折磨的靈魂，戰爭販子以及渴望著誘惑未來的英雄去達成會腐化其靈魂的交易的魔鬼。

english: The more time she spends with the characters, the more {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} begins to remember long-lost memories of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, an angelic weapon with the power to destroy the Companion. After Zariel's fall from grace, the sword was hidden in a stronghold called the Bleeding Citadel—a celestial sanctuary trapped in Avernus. The quest for the sword forms the crux of {@adventure chapter 4|BGDIA|7}, leading to the revelation that Zariel can be redeemed.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們共度的時間越多，她就越能回想起有關{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，一把力量足以摧毀伴陽的天使武器的記憶。在扎瑞爾從諸神的寵愛中墮落後，這把劍被藏在了一處名為湧血城砦，一處深陷阿弗納斯的天堂庇護所的要塞裡。對聖劍的追尋構成了{@adventure 第四章|BGDIA|7}的關鍵，這揭示了扎瑞爾尚能被救贖這一不可思議的事實。

english: The characters' success doesn't hinge on acquiring the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} or helping Zariel find redemption, as Gargauth is quick to point out should the characters consult with him. There are other ways to free Elturel, but only if the characters are willing to cut deals with Avernus's most evil denizens. The characters might broker a deal with the deposed archdevil {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, who longs to supplant Zariel and regain his title as ruler of Avernus. They might stoke the rage of a horrific demon called {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} and trick it into gnawing through Elturel's chains. They might come to terms with an evil dragonborn paladin named {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}, using him to broker a deal with Tiamat. By returning her stolen treasure, characters can convince Tiamat to break Elturel's chains.
zh_tw: 角色們的成敗並不取決於尋得{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}或是幫助扎瑞爾找尋救贖，加葛斯很快就會指出角色們應當向他請教。解救艾爾托瑞爾還有其他的路，但是隻有角色們願意與阿弗納斯最邪惡的住民交易才行。角色們可以被免職的前任魔鬼大公{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}達成協議，他一直希望擠掉扎瑞爾重新拿回阿弗納斯統治者的頭銜：他們可可以激起一頭名為{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的可怕惡魔的怒火併誘使它咬斷艾爾托瑞爾的鎖鏈：他們可以與一名被稱為{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}的邪惡龍裔聖武士達成協議，透過他去促成一筆與提亞馬特的交易。藉由歸還提亞馬特被偷走的財寶，角色們可以說服提亞馬特去打破艾爾托瑞爾的鎖鏈。

english: As tempting as such pursuits can be, the characters must be careful, for devil deals, demon lords, and Tiamat's rage number among the multiverse's greatest threats. Also, Zariel herself might become cross with the characters for daring to meddle in her diabolical affairs. How the adventure concludes depends on the choices the characters make, the chaos they foment, and the deals they forge, as discussed in {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8}.
zh_tw: 儘管這些目標如此誘人，但是角色們們必須萬分小心，要知道魔鬼的交易，惡魔的領主以及提亞馬特的怒火併稱多元宇宙中最大的威脅。同樣，扎瑞爾也可能對膽敢管她邪惡計劃的閒事的角色們產生怒火。冒險的結局取決於角色們所作出的選擇，角色們所挑動的混亂以及角色們所達成的交易；這些將在{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}進行討論。

english: Adventure Background
zh_tw: 冒險背景

english: On the plane of Mount Celestia, the angel Zariel chastised her peers for not getting involved in the Blood War. She felt that it was the responsibility of the angelic host to destroy evil in the multiverse, rather than stand back and watch demons and devils annihilate one another, destroying vast swaths of the multiverse in the process. In defiance of her superiors, Zariel left Mount Celestia and went to Elturel, where she rallied an army of warriors and trained them to fight in the Blood War. She promised them that when they were ready, she would lead them into battle on Avernus.
zh_tw: 在天界山位面，天使扎瑞爾責怪她的同僚們對血戰無動於衷。她認為天使軍團有責任摧毀多元宇宙間的邪惡而不是袖手旁觀惡魔與魔鬼的互相攻伐，看著它們在這個過程中摧毀多元宇宙的大片土地。出於對她上級的反抗，扎瑞爾離開了天堂山前往艾爾托瑞爾，在那裡她召集了一支戰士們組成軍隊並訓練他們去參加血戰。她向他們許諾當準備萬全的時候，她會領導他們在阿弗納斯奮勇殺敵。

english: Zariel led her army out of Elturel amid a throng of cheering well-wishers and proud citizens in 1354 DR. In an epic charge known as the Ride, Zariel's army entered Avernus and took the fight to the archdevil {@creature Bel|BGDIA} and his infernal legions. Many of Zariel's warriors fought bravely, but for others, the horrors of the Nine Hells proved too great. They fled back through the portal, sealing it behind them and never revealing their shameful retreat and betrayal. The Hellriders, as they were called, would wear this badge of shame to the grave.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾在歡呼的支持者和自豪的市民的注視中帶著她的軍隊在DR1354離開了艾爾托瑞爾。在被稱為呼嘯衝鋒的一次傳奇般的衝鋒中，扎瑞爾的軍隊衝入阿弗納斯與魔鬼大公{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的地獄軍團撕殺。許多扎瑞爾的戰士英勇作戰，然而對其他人來說九獄的可怕遠超想象。他們逃回傳送門，並將其封閉而且從未洩露他們可恥的撤退與背叛。如他們的名字那樣，地獄騎手，將帶著這恥辱的標記進入墳墓。

english: Zariel's Fall
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的墜落

english: Zariel lost more than her army on Avernus. She also lost a hand, which was severed in battle. As her sword fell to the ground, Zariel ordered Yael, her most devoted general, to take the weapon and hide it, so that the devils would not destroy or corrupt it. Yael took the sword and fled, along with Zariel's faithful hollyphant companion, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}. Zariel's other two generals, Olanthius and Haruman, refused to leave Zariel's side. All three were captured and sent to Nessus, the lowest of the Nine Hells. There, Zariel was brought before Asmodeus, who welcomed her with open arms. The Lord of the Nine commended Zariel for her battle prowess and the strength of her convictions. He offered her rulership of Avernus, much to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s chagrin. By swearing fealty to Asmodeus and the Nine Hells, Zariel could bring her rage to bear against the demons and continue to fight in the Blood War, with legions of devils under her command. Zariel accepted Asmodeus's terms, completing her fall from grace. Haruman followed his master into damnation willingly and was transformed into a narzugon devil, while Olanthius, who took his own life rather than bow before Asmodeus, was brought back to serve as a death knight under Zariel's burning gaze.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾在阿弗納斯失去的不只是軍隊；她的一隻手也在戰鬥中被斬斷。長劍落地時，她命令最忠誠的將軍耶爾帶走並藏起這件武器，免得魔鬼將它摧毀或腐化。耶爾帶著劍逃走，同行的還有扎瑞爾忠實的聖飛象夥伴{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}。另外兩位將軍奧蘭蘇斯與哈魯曼拒絕離開扎瑞爾身旁，三人於是一起被俘，押往九獄最底層的奈瑟斯。扎瑞爾被帶到阿斯蒙蒂斯面前，受到他張臂歡迎。九獄之主讚揚她的戰技與堅定信念，提出讓她統治阿弗納斯，令{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}大為惱怒。只要宣誓效忠阿斯蒙蒂斯與九獄，扎瑞爾便能指揮魔鬼軍團，在血戰中繼續向惡魔宣洩怒火。她接受條件，就此徹底墮落。哈魯曼心甘情願地追隨主人走向沉淪，化為魘騎魔；奧蘭蘇斯寧願自盡也不肯向阿斯蒙蒂斯屈膝，卻在扎瑞爾熾熱的凝視下被喚回，成為效忠她的死亡騎士。

english: The Companion
zh_tw: 伴陽

english: Zariel never forgot her betrayers—those who ran from the battlefield. She kept a close eye on Elturel, waiting for the day when she could enact her revenge. That day came in 1444 DR, when Elturel was conquered by a vampire lord. A priest of Torm named {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} appealed to any power to help him save his holy city. In that instant, Zariel emerged from a pillar of fire and offered him a deal, which Thavius readily accepted.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾從未忘記那些逃離戰場的背叛者。她密切關注著艾爾托瑞爾，等待她能報仇雪恨的那天到來。那一天在DR1444來臨，那時艾爾托瑞爾為一名吸血鬼領主所征服。一名叫做{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的託姆牧師向任何能幫助他拯救他的聖城的力量祈求，就在那時扎瑞爾以一道火焰之柱的形象出現，並向他提出了一份交易，而塔維斯毫不猶豫的接受了。

english: In the sky over Elturel, a radiant sphere called the Companion appeared, blazing like a second sun. Powered by a planetar imprisoned within it, the Companion bathed Elturel and the surrounding countryside in holy light which sent the vampire lord scrambling for the shadows and laid waste to his undead army. {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, who took credit for summoning the Companion, was hailed as the savior of the city and rose to become its high overseer. Under Kreeg's decades-long rule, Elturel embarked on a path to becoming not just a holy city but the holy nation of Elturgard.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的天空上，被稱為伴陽的一隻光芒四射的球體出現，耀眼得彷彿第二個太陽。一名異界神侍被囚禁其中以提供能量，伴陽使得艾爾托瑞爾及其周遭沐浴在神聖之光中，這讓吸血鬼領主倉皇的逃回暗影並摧毀了他的不死軍隊。{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}因召喚伴陽而名聲大噪，並稱呼為這座城市的拯救者並一躍成為它的最高監視者。在克雷格數十年的統治下，艾爾托瑞爾不僅走上了成為聖城之路，還成為了神國埃爾圖迦德。

english: Thavius's Betrayal
zh_tw: 塔維斯的背叛

english: Thavius was told the exact time when the Companion would cease to protect Elturel. In the weeks leading up to this fateful hour, Thavius urged Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} of Baldur's Gate to visit Elturel, to help settle some longstanding disputes between the two cities. Facing political pressure at home, Ravengard reluctantly acceded. After greeting Ravengard's delegation, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} fled Elturel in secret and watched from a safe distance as the Companion transformed from a radiant sun into a black orb awash with crackling energy. It ripped Elturel from the Material Plane, transporting it and all its inhabitants to Avernus. A few other city folk managed to escape before Elturel disappeared. Where it once stood, only a crater remains.
zh_tw: 塔維斯被告知了伴陽停止保護艾爾托瑞爾的確切時間。在命定之刻到來的前幾周，他慫恿博德之門大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}拜訪艾爾托瑞爾以幫助解決一些兩座城市間的長期爭端。在家鄉的政治壓力之下，瑞文嘉德不情願的接受了。在迎接了瑞文嘉德的代表團之後，{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}便秘密逃離了艾爾托瑞爾，他在一個安全距離上觀看伴陽從一個光彩奪目的太陽變成一隻不斷爆發能量的黑球。它把艾爾托瑞爾從物質位面撕下，把它和它所有的居民一同傳送到了阿弗納斯。在其曾經屹立的地方，如今僅餘巨坑。

english: Disguised as a refugee, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} was one of the first of his people to arrive at Baldur's Gate with news of Elturel's "destruction." He slipped through the city's gates with the help of his influential friend, Duke Vanthampur, and took refuge in her home.
zh_tw: {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}化妝成難民，成為他的人民中第一個到達博德之門的人，還帶著艾爾托瑞爾"毀滅"的訊息。他在自己大權在握的朋友範薩姆普爾公爵的幫助下溜進城門，並在她的家裡避難。

english: Roleplaying Devils
zh_tw: 扮演魔鬼

english: As the DM, you can play devils as humorous, aloof, bombastic, conniving, or scatterbrained, but a general rule to follow is this: devils have no desire to do good. When dealing with mortals, devils are constantly figuring out how to exploit and corrupt them, often behind thin smiles of feigned concern and false charm.
zh_tw: 作為DM，你可以以幽默，冷淡，浮誇，縱容或浮躁的風格扮演魔鬼，但是都有一條通用規則：魔鬼毫無善心。當與凡人交易時，在那用虛偽的關心和虛假的魅力組成的偽劣微笑的後面，魔鬼們一直在計算如何利用和腐化凡人。

english: A devil that successfully corrupts a mortal gets the infernal equivalent of a gold star and can eagerly expect a superior to take notice and give it the promotion it so richly deserves. Meanwhile, when that mortal dies, its soul will find itself condemned to the Nine Hells where it twists into the form of a {@creature lemure} (unless it's used for some other morbid purpose). The devil doesn't care what becomes of the souls it corrupts; it just wants to be promoted to a superior form of devil. That's how, over ages, a {@creature lemure} might become a {@creature pit fiend}.
zh_tw: 一隻成功腐化一名凡人的魔鬼會得到同樣數量的地獄等價物——一顆金星，並會熱切期待一隻上級魔鬼的注意並給予它一次理所當然的晉升。同時，當那名凡人死去，它的靈魂會發現自己被判往九獄，在那裡它的形態會被扭曲成一隻{@creature lemure||劣魔}（除非它被用於其他病態的目的）。魔鬼從不在乎他們腐化的靈魂會變成什麼；它一心只想晉升成高階魔鬼。這就是為何隨著時間流逝，一隻{@creature lemure||劣魔}可能成為{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}。

english: But devils do more than corrupt. They also fight in the Blood War. Asmodeus attests that serving in his infernal legion is a holy honor, for in so doing a devil helps protect the multiverse from demonic destruction. While that sounds impressive, most devils partake in the Blood War only to distinguish themselves among their peers and move up the chain of command. Endlessly fighting demons isn't what most devils signed up for.
zh_tw: 但魔鬼可不僅僅只會腐化，他們還要在血戰中戰鬥。阿斯蒙蒂斯證明在他的地獄軍團服役是一種神聖的榮譽，一名魔鬼可以透過此舉來從惡魔的破壞中保護多元宇宙。雖然這聽起來十分令人敬佩，但大多數魔鬼應召參加血戰不過是為了讓自己比其他同僚更亮眼並在指揮序列中獲得晉升。多數魔鬼們服役可不是為了與惡魔進行無休止的戰鬥。

english: If a devil dies somewhere other than the Nine Hells, it re-forms in the Nine Hells and is therefore not truly killed. However, a devil that is killed in the Nine Hells is dead forever; not surprisingly, that's why devils tend to be more cautious in their dealings at home than abroad.
zh_tw: 如果一名魔鬼死於九獄之外，那麼它會在九獄中重塑身形而非真正死去。但是，如果一隻魔鬼在九獄中被殺那就會永久的死去：這不足為怪，這就是為什麼魔鬼在故鄉交易時遠比在外面更謹慎。

english: Important References
zh_tw: 重要參考

english: This adventure features the Nine Hells, which is described in {@book chapter 2|DMG|2|The Nine Hells} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Devils, being the primary inhabitants of the Nine Hells, play prominent roles in this story. Before running the adventure, it's worth taking the time to familiarize yourself with the "Devils" entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, which not only describes the most common types of devils but also explains their hierarchy, how they behave in accordance with their lawful evil alignment, what pleases and enrages them, and why they're scared of dying on their home plane.
zh_tw: 本冒險的重點在於九獄，那裡在{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@book 第二章|DMG|2|The Nine Hells}詳述。魔鬼是九獄的原住民，在這個故事裡扮演重要角色。在進行這個冒險前，你值得去熟悉一下{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}裡的魔鬼條目，那裡不僅描述了常見的魔鬼型別還解釋了它們的階級，以及它們是如何做出與其守序邪惡的陣型一致的行為，什麼會使它們愉悅或憤怒，又是為什麼魔鬼如此懼怕在自己的家園位面死去。

english: Stat Blocks
zh_tw: 資料卡

english: The {@book Monster Manual|MM} contains stat blocks for most of the monsters and nonplayer characters (NPCs) found in this adventure. Whenever this adventure presents a new monster or NPC, you'll find its stat block near the encounter in which it appears, or in {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13}. When a creature's name appears in {@b bold} type, that's a visual cue pointing you to the creature's stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}. If the stat block appears elsewhere, the adventure's text tells you where to find it.
zh_tw: 《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》包含了這個冒險裡大部分的怪物和非玩家角色的資料面板。當這個冒險出現了一個新怪物或非玩家角色時，你都能在該遭遇附近或{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}中找到它的資料面板。當一個生物用{@b 粗體}寫出名字時，那代表一個可見提示，表示你可以在{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中找到該生物的屬性面板。如果屬性面板在另外之處，那麼冒險文字將告訴你去哪裡尋找。

english: Spells and Magic Items
zh_tw: 法術與魔法物品

english: Spells and nonmagical equipment mentioned in the adventure are described in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Magic items are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, unless the adventure's text directs you to an item's description in {@adventure appendix C|BGDIA|12}.
zh_tw: 冒險中寫到的法術和非魔法裝備都在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}裡包含。除了冒險文字表明某魔法物品在{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}中詳述的魔法物品外，其他魔法物品都在{@book 城主指南|DMG}詳述。

english: Devil Traits
zh_tw: 魔鬼特質

english: Common traits among devils include the following:
zh_tw: 魔鬼的通用特性包含如下：

english: {@b Charm}. Devils are consummate charmers. Like humans, some are better at it than others. The good ones savor the exchange of pleasantries, speaking in measured sentences or noticing pleasant details about the environment or a character's clothing.
zh_tw: {@b 魅惑}。魔鬼是完美的誘惑者，就像人類一樣，某些魔鬼比同類更擅此道。優秀的魔鬼會細品寒暄，字句斟酌或留意玩家衣著或環境中令人愉悅的細節。

english: {@b Patience}. Devils are rarely in a rush to make a deal or sign a contract. As masters of the long con, devils make genuinely good deals with mortals to buy appreciation and trust that can be leveraged during more consequential dealings later on.
zh_tw: {@b 耐心}。魔鬼很少急著達成交易或簽訂契約。牠們擅長長期佈局的騙局，會先與凡人做出確實有利的交易，贏得對方的感激與信任，再於日後更重大的交易中利用這些關係。

english: {@b Civility}. Devils like to pretend that they run by the same rules and obey the same social conventions as mortals. Devils have no problem appearing and acting in whatever manner they need to achieve their end goal—usually a contract for services or a soul. They've learned that more can be gained from behaving in a civilized manner than reacting angrily or violently.
zh_tw: {@b 禮貌}。魔鬼喜歡假裝他們與凡人遵守執行一樣的社會規則並遵守相同的社交習慣。魔鬼在任何需要達成目標——通常是一份服務或靈魂契約的時候都有著無可挑剔的外表和行為。他們知道以文明的行為遠比憤怒或暴力的回應收穫的更多。

english: {@b Deviousness}. Devils don't age, so there's rarely a sense of urgency with a devil as it plots its conquest or corruption of a soul. This allows for winding schemes that are rarely what they seem on the surface. For minor devils, a simple acceptance of an evil gift is enough, while greater devils enjoy tangling up characters in choices that compromise their values.
zh_tw: {@b 迂迴}。魔鬼不會衰老，所以當他們密謀征服或腐化一個靈魂時很少有緊迫感。這讓他們用迂迴的計劃使自己隱於幕後。對弱小的魔鬼來說，送出一份邪惡的贈禮就已足夠，但強大的魔鬼享受玩家們糾結各種選擇而妥協自己的價值觀。

english: {@b Unscrupulousness}. Being evil and soulless, a devil cannot be embarrassed or shamed, doesn't feel guilt or remorse, and is prepared to do the most heinous acts to get what it wants.
zh_tw: {@b 不擇手段}。作為邪惡與卑劣的存在，魔鬼毫無愧疚與羞恥，不會感到內疚或懊悔，而且準備好了用最令人髮指的手段得到它想要的。

english: {@b Fear of Demotion}. A devil that disappoints a superior can be demoted, whereupon it's instantly transformed into a lesser form of devil. The greater the devil, the more it fears demotion and the loss of its power. Thus, a devil takes great pains to hide its failures or pin them on someone else.
zh_tw: {@b 懼怕降格}。一隻魔鬼如果令其上級感到失望那麼就可能被降格，它會因此立刻轉化成魔鬼的一種低等形態。越強大的魔鬼越害怕降格和失去力量。因此，一隻魔鬼會拼命掩蓋失敗或嫁禍他人。

english: Life in the Nine Hells
zh_tw: 九獄生活

english: Much of the adventure takes place on the first layer of the Nine Hells. This is not, to put it mildly, your run-of-the-mill D&D setting. The following tips and tricks can help you make the characters' stay in Avernus a remarkable one.
zh_tw: 這場冒險的大部分會在九獄的第一層展開。說的婉轉些，這不是普通的D&D設定。以下要訣與技巧可以幫助您使玩家們在阿弗納斯的經歷成為令人難忘的經歷。

english: Everyone's Unhappy
zh_tw: 諸人不幸

english: The Nine Hells is a place of abject misery where no one is happy. Weaker devils are exploited and tormented by their superiors. Stronger devils live in constant fear of being passed over for promotion or demoted. Even when something seems to go right, joy is fleeting and only fuels suspicion that things are about to get much worse. Such inescapable pessimism leads many creatures to become apathetic and spiteful. They take perverse delight in spreading their unhappiness like a contagion.
zh_tw: 九獄是悲慘絕望之地，此處無人喜樂。弱小的魔鬼被他們的上級剝削和利用，強大的魔鬼生活在被晉升者超越或被降格的恐懼中。就算有時某些事情進展順利，歡樂也不過轉瞬即逝，不過激其對事情可能變糟的懷疑。這種不可避免的悲觀情緒令許多生物變得冷漠而心懷惡意。他們帶著異常的愉悅像疾病一樣去散播他們的不幸。

english: You can remind players that the Nine Hells is a place of misery and suffering in the following ways:
zh_tw: 你可以透過以下方式來提醒玩家九獄是個充滿痛苦與折磨的地方：

english: In conversations with the characters, natives of the Nine Hells like to bemoan their misfortune and blame others for their horrible lives.
zh_tw: 在與角色們的交談中，九獄原住民喜歡悲嘆他們的不幸並將他們痛恨的生活歸咎他人。

english: When a character accomplishes something, you can undercut that success in some small way. For example, the character's belt might snap, or a hellish insect might sting the character on the neck and leave a welt.
zh_tw: 當一名角色完成某事時，你可透過某些小手段削弱成功感。例如玩家的腰帶可能斷裂，或者可能一隻地獄昆蟲刺中了這名角色的脖子留下了疤痕。

english: If a character rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll made with a nonmagical weapon, you can decide that the weapon breaks.
zh_tw: 如果一名角色在使用非魔法武器進行攻擊檢定而擲出天然1時，你可以認定這把武器因此毀壞了。

english: Everything's Awful
zh_tw: 萬物可憎

english: Avernus is insidious in the way it fosters greed and makes visitors pay or barter for the things they need to survive. Most of the wildlife on Avernus is not edible to mortals, and most sources of water are poisonous or otherwise tainted. The rarity of edible food and drinkable water encourages hoarding behavior.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯以隱晦的方式培育貪婪，讓遊客購買或交換他們賴以生存的事物。阿弗納斯的野生動植物大部分對凡人來說不可食用，而多數水源不是有毒就是已被汙染。珍稀的可食用食物和可飲用水助長了囤積行為。

english: You can remind players about the awfulness of Avernus in the following ways:
zh_tw: 你可以透過以下方法來提醒玩家們阿弗納斯的可憎：

english: Any food or drink the characters bring with them or conjure by magic retains its nutritional value but tastes awful when eaten or imbibed on Avernus. The food tastes like ash, the water tastes like bile, and the wine tastes like spoiled milk.
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯任何角色攜帶或用魔法召喚的食物都保留著它的營養價值但是食用或飲用的味道卻十分糟糕。食物嚐起來像灰燼，飲用水味道像是膽汁，而酒喝起來就像變質的牛奶。

english: If the characters want something that tastes good, they must buy it from licensed sellers such as {@creature Mahadi the rakshasa|BGDIA}, who runs a restaurant called Infernal Rapture (see "{@area Infernal Rapture|2a1|x}"). The price of a good-tasting meal is always a bit too high.
zh_tw: 如果角色想要品嚐美味的事物，他們必須從有經營執照的賣家那裡購買，比如{@creature Mahadi the rakshasa|BGDIA|羅剎馬哈迪}經營的地獄銷魂飯店（請參閱{@area 地獄極樂|2a1|x}）。但美味的食物價格總是昂貴。

english: If a character commits a selfish act, you can reward that selfishness by granting that character inspiration (as described in {@book chapter 4|PHB|4|Inspiration} of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}). Unlike regular inspiration, the benefit can't be transferred to another creature.
zh_tw: 當一名角色做出自私的行為時，你可以給予該角色激勵（如{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中{@book 第四章|PHB|4|Inspiration}所述）來獎勵這種自利行為。不像通常的激勵，這種益處無法被轉移到其他生物身上。

english: Paradise Lost
zh_tw: 失落樂園

english: Before the Blood War reduced it to a blasted wasteland, Avernus was a honey trap created by Asmodeus, a paradise of infinite delights designed to lure and enrapture mortals. Fragments of this lost paradise still plunge from Avernus's sky as burning meteors, and the land is dotted with the ruins of palaces and idyllic gardens that were obscenely beautiful in eons past.
zh_tw: 在在血戰將此地夷為荒蕪廢土之前，阿弗納斯曾是阿斯蒙蒂斯的甜蜜陷阱，是用無限快感誘惑和迷住凡人的極樂天堂。這片失樂園的一些碎片還在從阿弗納斯的天空上破碎劃過，就宛如燃燒的流星，而陸地上棋佈著宮殿和如詩般的花園的廢墟，過往萬年間它們曾是如此淫褻地美麗。

english: Fleeting reminders of this ancient paradise can come to the characters in the following ways:
zh_tw: 可以透過以下方式讓玩家們認識到這片古老樂園的吉光片羽：

english: While traveling across Avernus, the characters glimpse a fantastic mirage: a grand palace or garden oasis that vanishes when they get within 100 feet of it.
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯中跋涉時，角色們會瞥見美妙的幻象：一座壯觀的宮殿或花園綠洲，在他們靠近它 100 尺內的時候消失。

english: A random character hears beautiful music or laughter, catches the scent of flowers or perfume, or experiences a gentle caress. The sensation has no discernible source and fades after a few moments.
zh_tw: 一名隨機角色聽到悅耳的樂聲或笑聲，捉到一縷花朵或香水的香味，或感受到一陣溫柔的愛撫。這種感覺無法辨明來源並在幾個呼吸後消逝。

english: The characters find a relic that survived the fall of paradise, such as a beautiful vase or toppled statue. The first character to touch the relic experiences a fleeting moment of pure joy.
zh_tw: 角色們找到一件從極樂園隕落中倖存下來的衣物，比如一隻漂亮的花瓶或倒塌的雕像。第一位觸控遺物的玩家會感受到一陣純粹的快感。

english: Anywhere is Everywhere
zh_tw: 此即彼處

english: Geography warps at the whims of the Nine Hells. One of the liberating aspects of this planar feature is that you don't need to be fastidious about keeping track of where locations are in relation to one another.
zh_tw: 九層地獄的無常導致了地理的扭曲。這個位面的自由之處其一便是你不必苛求記錄某地與其他地方的位置關係。

english: While the spatial distortion can be unsettling to visitors, it affords you the following benefits as a DM:
zh_tw: 空間畸變會讓玩家無所適從，但這給身為DM的您提供瞭如下好處：

english: You can decide how long it takes for characters to get from one place to the next. For example, the characters might need to travel 6 miles to get from Fort Knucklebone to Haruman's Hill, and 60 miles to get from Haruman's Hill back to Fort Knucklebone.
zh_tw: 你可以決定角色們從一處到達下一處耗費的時間。例如角色可能需要前行 6 裡從指節骨要塞到達哈魯曼之丘，而從哈魯曼之丘回到指節骨要塞則要 60 裡。

english: If the characters are in a rush to get somewhere, an {@creature imp} could appear out of nowhere and, for the price of a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} or other valuable item, show them a shortcut that halves the distance the characters must travel to reach their destination.
zh_tw: 如果角色們急著去某地，一隻{@creature imp||小魔鬼}可以從不知何處出現，以一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}或其他貴重物的價格向角色們指明一條可以讓角色們必須前去之處縮短一半旅程的捷徑。

english: The Wandering Emporium (see "{@area The Wandering Emporium|297|x}") can show up almost anywhere in the Nine Hells, at any time. If the players don't know where to go or what to do next, or if you want to surprise them with fun roleplaying opportunities, have the Wandering Emporium arrive at the party's location, regardless of where they saw it last.
zh_tw: 流浪市集（請參閱{@area 流浪商城|297|x}）可以在任何時候出現在任何地點。如果角色們不知道下一步去哪兒或是你想用一次有趣的扮演機會給他們一個驚喜的話，讓流浪市集出現在角色們隊伍的位置吧，不管他們上一次見到它是在哪兒。

english: That Personal Touch
zh_tw: 個人心魔

english: There are simple ways in which you can tailor the adventure to make Avernus an even more hellish place for your particular band of adventurers. Consider using the following methods to customize your party's experience:
zh_tw: 你可以用幾個簡單的方法來調整冒險，使阿弗納斯對你的特定冒險小隊更加惡劣。考慮使用以下方法定製你的隊伍經歷：

english: Learn what scares the characters. At the start of the adventure, ask each player to provide you with a note of three things their character fears. Save these until the party reaches the Nine Hells, then use them to customize the terrors that populate Avernus.
zh_tw: 瞭解到你的角色們害怕什麼。在冒險開始時讓每個玩家給你一張寫著他們的角色最害怕的三件事的便條。把它們儲存到隊伍到達九層地獄時，然後使用它們來定製居於阿弗納斯的詭異。

english: Keep a list of the flaws that the players selected when they first created their characters, so that you can remind the players of these faults when situations arise to test them. For example, a character with the Folk Hero background might have the flaw, "I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me." Let the player wrestle with this flaw during negotiations with devils and other denizens of Avernus.
zh_tw: 列張玩家在第一次建立他們的角色時選擇的缺點的表，這樣當某種局面在考驗玩家的角色時，你可以提醒玩家們這些缺點。例如，一名有著平民英雄背景的角色可能有這樣的缺點"我很容易假定有人想要騙我。"就讓這名玩家在與魔鬼以及阿弗納斯住民的談判過程中全力應對自己的缺點吧。

english: Chapter 1: A Tale of Two Cities
zh_tw: 第1章：雙城記

english: Baldur's Gate began as a harbor town where traders would meet with "ghost lighters"—folk along the Sword Coast who used lights to lure fogbound ships to shore. When those ships ran aground, the ghost lighters would scavenge the wrecks and haul their plundered goods to Baldur's Gate, nestled on the north shore of a bend in the River Chionthar, and sell their booty. In the years since, Baldur's Gate has grown into a walled city. Today, its foggy streets run red with the blood of unfortunates who fall prey to evil opportunists, many of whom count themselves as nobles, traders, pirates, and assassins. An army of mercenary soldiers called the Flaming Fist keeps order in the city, and these soldiers answer to Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}. The members of the Flaming Fist don't care about justice; they crave power and coin, nothing else. But despite the Fist's reputation for cruelty, the Grand Duke is widely regarded as an honorable and reasonable man.
zh_tw: 博德之門原本是一個小港口，商人們在那裡和一群被稱為"幽靈之燈"的人們進行貿易。"幽靈之燈"則是透過在劍灣沿岸透過燈光來引誘那些在迷霧中迷失了的船隻來到岸邊，當那些船擱淺後，幽靈之燈的成員就會搜尋殘骸，把搶來的貨物拖上岸送往坐落於劍灣北岸，依偎著衝薩河的博德之門，在那裡賣掉他們的贓物。年復一年，博德之門開始築起了城牆。現在，它那瀰漫著濃霧的街道被邪惡投機分子的受害者的鮮紅血液覆蓋，這些邪惡的傢伙通常把自己當成貴族，商人，海盜，刺客。一幫叫做焰拳的傭兵們負責維護城裡的治安，這些人聽命於大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}。這些焰拳的成員們從來不在乎正義，他們渴望權力和金幣。不過雖然焰拳殘暴的名聲在外，但是大公被廣泛地認為是一名高貴且明理的人。

english: The city of Elturel, capital of Elturgard, is located much farther inland along the River Chionthar. Whereas Baldur's Gate has a well-earned reputation for being a nest of vipers, Elturel is seen as a beacon of faith, order, and high culture. The two cities have endured a long, bitter rivalry that originated when Baldur's Gate began stealing cargo and coin from ships heading to and from Elturel, stifling that city's sea trade. Though the conflicts between Baldur's Gate and Elturel have always fallen short of open warfare, relations between the cities have been tense for a long time—too long, some would say.
zh_tw: 埃爾圖迦德的首都，艾爾托瑞爾，坐落於更深的內陸，同樣緊鄰著衝薩河。與博德之門它那滿是邪祟的糟糕評價截然相反，艾爾托瑞爾被視作希望的燈塔，那裡充滿了信仰，秩序和高雅文化。這兩座城市有著長久的恩怨歷史，雙方的敵對關係始於博德之門開始掠奪那些進出艾爾托瑞爾的船隻，這嚴重影響了這座城的海上貿易。儘管雙方的衝突很多時候都只是一些小打小鬧，但是雙方的敵對關係已經持續了很長的時間了——對某些人來說，太長了。

english: Fall of Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的隕落

english: A tenday ago, Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} left Baldur's Gate with a company of Flaming Fist soldiers on a diplomatic mission to Elturel, accepting a formal invitation from Elturel's High Overseer, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}. Ravengard did not go eagerly, however. It took months of persuasion by his fellow dukes—the other three members of Baldur's Gate's ruling Council of Four—to convince him to accept Elturel's invitation and leave the city in their capable hands. {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} was especially convincing, having gathered petitions from the nobility as well as leaders of the common rabble.
zh_tw: 十天前，{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}大公帶著一隊焰拳的士兵趕往艾爾托瑞爾進行一項外交任務，這是由艾爾托瑞爾的最高監視者{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}發出的一個正式邀請。但是瑞文嘉德並不太想去。他的三位公爵，博德之門四人統治議會的其他三位成員，花了幾個月的時間才說服他接受邀請前往艾爾托瑞爾並把博德之門交給他們管理。{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}尤其有說服力，她像下層平民領袖一樣收集了貴族們的請願書。

english: Not long after Ravengard arrived in Elturel, the city was dragged down into the Nine Hells—wiped off the map. Given the distance between the two cities, it's no surprise that the residents of Baldur's Gate didn't hear of Elturel's fate until refugees from Elturgard starting arriving in droves. Rumors concerning Elturel's disappearance spread like wildfire, stoking fears that Baldur's Gate might be next. At the same time, panic swept through the ranks of the Flaming Fist, which suddenly found itself without a strong leader.
zh_tw: 就在瑞文嘉德抵艾爾托瑞爾不久後，整個城市就被拖到了九獄，完全從地圖上被抹除。介於兩城之間的距離，博德之門的民眾們直到艾爾托瑞爾的難民零零散散地抵達之後才知道艾爾托瑞爾的命運。艾爾托瑞爾消失的流言馬上像野火燎原一般散播出來，並相傳博德之門就會成為下一個受害者。與此同時，恐慌也充斥於焰拳的隊伍中，他們發現自己失去了那位強大的領袖。

english: In the grand duke's absence, the government of Baldur's Gate continues to function under the three remaining dukes—Belynne Stelmane, Dillard Portyr, and Thalamra Vanthampur. Duke Portyr has gone so far as to recall his niece, Liara Portyr, from her post as commander of the Flaming Fist at Fort Beluarian in Chult, in the hopes that she can keep the Flaming Fist in check. However, it will take time for her ship to arrive. Meanwhile, refugees from Elturgard continue to arrive with dire claims that nothing remains of Elturel except a crater in the ground.
zh_tw: 在大公失蹤的這段時間，博德之門在三位公爵，貝琳·斯泰爾曼，迪拉德·波提爾以及薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾的管理下繼續運作。波提爾公爵甚至已經從楚爾特的博拉倫要塞召回了自己曾在該地擔任焰拳指揮官的侄女，莉爾阿·波提爾，寄希望於她可以使焰拳處於掌控之中。但是，距離她的船抵達還有一段時間。同時，難民從埃爾託加德帶著可怕的訊息不斷湧入城鎮，他們都說艾爾托瑞爾的土地上除了一個洞以外什麼都沒剩下。

english: Among those fleeing Elturgard are several Hellriders—paladins who have sworn oaths to defend Elturel. Those warriors escaped the city's fate only because they weren't in Elturel when it fell, and the Flaming Fist has taken to arresting them on sight, lest they try to stir up trouble in Baldur's Gate. The Hellriders are not going quietly, however, leading to violence and bloodshed.
zh_tw: 在埃爾託加德的難民隊伍裡混雜著一些"地獄騎手"，那些曾宣誓保衛艾爾托瑞爾的聖武士們。他們能夠從艾爾托瑞爾的慘劇中逃脫僅僅是因為他們當時恰好不在城中。而焰拳的成員會一看到這些人就全部逮捕，以避免他們在博德之門中興風作浪。地獄騎手們當然不會默默離開，無論如何，這導致了暴力與流血。

english: Evil in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的邪惡

english: Diagram 1.1: Chapter 1 Flowchart
zh_tw: 圖1.1：第一章流程圖

english: Without {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} to stay their hand, Flaming Fist captains are brutally exercising their autonomy under the veneer of maintaining order. They've closed the outer gates to keep Baldur's Gate safe from the refugee "threat," effectively trapping Baldurians behind their own walls. With the Flaming Fist distracted by the refugee crisis, city folk are being hunted and murdered in the streets by cultists of the Dead Three—the evil gods Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul. Without the Flaming Fist to curtail them, these cultists have grown bold and now move freely within the city, their activities financed and supported in secret by {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 失去了{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的控制，焰拳的隊長們在維持秩序的外衣下野蠻的使用他們的權利。他們關閉了外門，以讓博德之門遠離難民的"威脅"，成功地把博德之門困在它自己的城牆後面。因為焰拳的傭兵被難民危機分心，市民們開始在城鎮中遭到死亡三神（班恩，巴爾和米爾寇）教徒的獵殺和謀殺。失去了焰拳的限制，這些教徒們現在開始變得肆意妄為，公然行走於城市中，他們的行動都是由{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}公爵秘密資助和支援的。

english: Among the first refugees to arrive at Baldur's Gate was none other than {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, the architect of Elturel's doom. Duke Vanthampur is sheltering Kreeg in the dungeon beneath her villa until such time as Baldur's Gate suffers the same fate as Elturel. Like Kreeg, the Vanthampur family is firmly in debt to Zariel, the archdevil of Avernus. Using money purloined from Tiamat's hoard by Zariel's minions on Avernus, Duke Vanthampur hired Dead Three cultists to stir up trouble while her sons stole the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} from a tomb beneath the city. Using the power of this magic shield, Duke Vanthampur and {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} believe they can bring about the downfall of Baldur's Gate in much the same way the Companion was used against Elturel. The shield binds the essence of a powerful devil named Gargauth, whose presence in Baldur's Gate has fomented much of the evil that lurks in the hearts of the city's residents.
zh_tw: 最先到達博德之門的難民不是別人，正是{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，艾爾托瑞爾末日的罪魁禍首。範薩姆普爾公爵將他藏在了她別墅的地城裡，直到博德之門遭受了和艾爾托瑞爾同樣的命運為止。像克雷格一樣，範薩姆普爾家族也虧欠於阿弗納斯的魔鬼大公扎瑞爾。透過讓扎瑞爾的僕從盜取提亞馬特的寶庫，範薩姆普爾公爵一面僱傭死亡三神的信徒們在鎮子上興風作浪，一邊讓她的兒子去城市下的墓穴中偷取{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}。透過這個魔法盾牌的力量，範薩姆普爾公爵和{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}相信他們可以將博德之門也拖下地獄，就像用伴陽對付艾爾托瑞爾那一樣。這個盾牌封印著一個名叫加葛斯的強大魔鬼，單單存在於博德之門中就勾出了許多市民心中潛藏惡念。

english: To save Baldur's Gate, the adventurers must defeat the Dead Three cultists, track down their evil financiers, wrest the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} from Duke Vanthampur, and pursue Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} into the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 為了拯救博德之門，冒險者們必須擊敗死亡三神的教徒們，追蹤到他們的邪惡資助者，從範薩姆普爾公爵手中奪取{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，並且在九獄中找到{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}大公。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: {@adventure Diagram 1.1|BGDIA|1|Evil in Baldur's Gate} is a flowchart that presents the key events of this chapter in sequence. The adventurers begin as 1st-level characters, advancing to 2nd level if they survive the encounter in {@area Elfsong Tavern|01d|x} and 3rd level after conquering the {@area dungeon of the Dead Three|03a|x}. The challenges they must overcome at the {@area Low Lantern|080|x} and {@area Vanthampur Villa|096|x} are great enough to advance them to 4th level. After conquering the sewer complex {@area below the villa|0be|x} and obtaining valuable information at {@area Candlekeep|0f1|x}, the characters advance to 5th level before entering the Nine Hells in {@adventure chapter 2|BGDIA|2}.
zh_tw: {@adventure 圖 1.1|BGDIA|1|Evil in Baldur's Gate}顯示了這一章節的關鍵事件序列。角色們從 1 級開始；如果他們活過了{@area 精靈之歌酒館|01d|x}的遭遇，他們將提升至 2 級；在他們征服了{@area 死亡三神地城|03a|x}後，他們將提升至 3 級。而他們需要跨越{@area 矮提燈|080|x}和{@area 範薩姆普爾別墅|096|x}並且得完成的足夠好才能升至 4 級。在征服了別墅下的下水道設施{@area 別墅之下|0be|x}並在{@area 燭堡|0f1|x}獲得重要資訊後，角色們在進入{@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2}之前升級至 5 級

english: The Basilisk Gate
zh_tw: 石化蜥蜴之門

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to your players to begin the adventure:
zh_tw: 請在開始冒險之前向您的玩家朗讀或意譯下列文字：

english: Welcome to Baldur's Gate, a veritable nest of rats and vipers clinging to the rocky slopes overlooking the Chionthar River. From their high perches in the Upper City, the local nobles—known as patriars—gaze down with veiled contempt upon the common rabble in the grimy Lower City, which hugs the foggy harbor. The whole of Baldur's Gate reeks of blood, crime, and opportunity. One can easily fathom why pirates and traders are drawn to this place like flies to a carcass.
zh_tw: 歡迎來到博德之門，一個名副其實的蛇穴鼠巢，那些毒蛇惡鼠趴在岩石上俯瞰著衝薩河。他們的高處的棲息地位於上城區，那些本地的貴族們，他們通常被稱作宗貴，帶著隱約的鄙夷高高在上地看居住在環靠著霧氣瀰漫的港口的骯髒下城區的普羅大眾。博德之門遍地都散發著血腥，犯罪和機遇的臭味。是個人都能輕易地明白為什麼海盜和商人會像屍體之於飛蠅一樣被吸引來此。

english: Following the river farther east would eventually lead you to Elturel, capital of the holy land of Elturgard—or at least that was the case until a few days ago. The flood of refugees from Elturel has gotten worse since news first arrived that the city has fallen. Everyone is saying Baldur's Gate is next, but no one truly knows who or what has claimed Elturel.
zh_tw: 沿河向東會最終將你引向艾爾托瑞爾，神聖之地埃爾圖迦德的首都，或者說在幾天之前還是這樣。隨著來自艾爾托瑞爾的大量難民不斷湧入，艾爾托瑞爾已經淪陷的訊息也早已不脛而走。大家都說博德之門將是下一個，但是沒有人知道究竟是誰，或者什麼東西造成了艾爾托瑞爾的慘案。

english: The patriars pay a mercenary army called the Flaming Fist to protect their interests in Baldur's Gate, and by extension, the city itself. The Flaming Fist has gained even more power since their charismatic leader, {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}, claimed the title of Grand Duke a few years ago. Apparently, Ravengard is missing. In his absence, the Flaming Fist has sealed the city's gates to staunch the flow of refugees. No one is allowed in or out.
zh_tw: 元老們僱了一隊叫做焰拳的僱傭兵來保護他們在博德之門的財產，並進而保護城市本身。焰拳在他們那強大的領袖{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}於幾年前獲得大公頭銜後變得更加強盛。眾所周知，瑞文嘉德現在已經失蹤了。在他失蹤期間，焰拳已經關閉了城市的大門以阻擋難民的大潮，沒人可以進出這個城。

english: All of this was brought to your attention shortly after you were drafted by the Flaming Fist to help defend the city. Your orders are to speak to Captain Zodge at the Basilisk Gate, which pierces the city's eastern wall and takes its name from the various statues that rest in its niches and perch atop its battlements. Unseen beyond the sealed Basilisk Gate, a dirt road stretches through the Outer City slums to the bridge known as Wyrm's Crossing, then to distant realms beyond.
zh_tw: 這一切都在你被焰拳徵召去幫忙防禦城鎮後開始。你們收到的命令是去和石蜥門的佐迪隊長報到，石蜥門縱穿城市的東牆，因其門上壁龕內和城垛上的各種雕像而得名。在關閉的石蜥門之外看不到的地方，一條泥土小路穿過外城區的貧民窟通向一座名為飛龍渡的橋，再之後就是無盡的遠方了。

english: Dozens of Flaming Fist soldiers are trying to control an angry mob of commoners eager to leave the city. Armed with only a vague description of Captain Zodge—a tall man with long black hair and a leather eye patch—it takes you a while to find him. A fight breaks out between soldiers and commoners, and you finally spot the one-eyed captain as he wades into the fray and begins throwing punches. Just another day in the City of Blood.
zh_tw: 一隊焰拳的傭兵正在嘗試阻止一大群憤怒的民眾離開城市。你們僅僅得到了一個關於佐迪隊長的模糊的描述——一個高大的留著黑色長髮並戴著一個皮革眼罩的男人，這導致你們花了一些時間才找到他。平民和士兵們爆發了一場衝突，你們終於在那裡發現了那個獨眼隊長，他加入了衝突，在人群裡揮舞著拳頭，而這不過是這座血腥之城的日常罷了。

english: An influx of Elturgardian refugees coupled with uncertainty regarding the fate of Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} has convinced Captain Darmin Zodge, a lawful evil human {@creature veteran}, to prove himself worthy of leading the Flaming Fist—lest some rival seize the opportunity in the days ahead. Zodge also knows that Liara Portyr, who commands the Flaming Fist stronghold of Fort Beluarian in Chult, has been recalled to Baldur's Gate by her uncle, Duke Dillard Portyr. Zodge hopes to impress Commander Portyr with his ability to maintain the peace in Baldur's Gate until her arrival.
zh_tw: 隨著一大堆難民一起湧入的是{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}生死未卜的訊息，這使達明·佐迪隊長，一名守序邪惡的人類{@creature veteran||老兵}，嘗試去證明自己有能力領導焰拳傭兵團——以免某些競爭對手在接下來幾天裡抓住這個機會。佐迪也知道楚爾特的博拉倫堡要塞的指揮官莉爾阿·波提爾已經被她的叔叔迪拉德·波提爾公爵召回。但佐迪希望在波提爾回來之前維持住博德之門的治安以給她留下一個良好的印象。

english: Flaming Fist Coat of Arms
zh_tw: 焰拳紋章

english: Although Zodge lacks common decency, he cares for the well-being of the soldiers who serve under his command. Angry mobs can be dangerous, and Zodge is quick to take out the instigators so that the mob's anger turns to fear quickly. No one is arrested during the fracas the characters observe, but several commoners are beaten and robbed of their money pouches after a brief skirmish with Zodge and his soldiers. Express to the players that their characters would not be surprised by Zodge's handling of the situation. Flaming Fist captains have tremendous latitude when it comes to keeping the peace in Baldur's Gate, especially in the Lower City.
zh_tw: 儘管佐迪缺乏一些基本禮儀，但是他十分關心他指揮下的士兵們的安全。憤怒的暴民可能會變得很危險，於是佐迪迅速地打倒了煽動者以此威懾住了暴民。雖然在這場角色們所看到的打鬥中沒有人被逮捕，但是有一些平民遭到了毆打併且在和佐迪發生短暫的小規模衝突之後被搶走了錢包。請告知玩家們，他們的角色並不會對佐迪的處理方式感到什麼驚訝。焰拳的隊長們在博德之門維持治安時有很大的自由處置範圍，在下城區尤為如此。

english: It's widely known that the best way to deal with Flaming Fist soldiers is to bribe them. Those who can afford to pay a bribe of 10 gp or more (instead of the usual gate fee of 2 cp) are allowed passage through a gate after a bit of haggling.
zh_tw: 眾所周知，對付焰拳士兵的最佳方式就是賄賂他們。付得起10GP或者更高的賄資的人（而不是付正常的2CP的入城稅）可以在討價還價一番之後透過大門。

english: Map 1.1: Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 地圖 1.1: 博德之門

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Meeting Captain Zodge
zh_tw: 與佐迪隊長見面

english: Captain Zodge is expecting the characters. If they choose not to speak with him, he tracks them down eventually. The Flaming Fist has contacts throughout the city, so hiding from Zodge is difficult unless the characters know someone who can shelter them. Zodge keeps six Flaming Fist soldiers (human {@creature Veteran||veterans}) near him at all times. Their names are Issio, Minaqua, Nelestree, Oliver, Soltus, and Thalkara.
zh_tw: 佐迪隊長正在等待著角色們。如果角色們選擇不去搭理他的話，佐迪他最終也會找上他們。焰拳的眼線遍佈全城，所以除非角色們認識某個可以庇護他們的人，否則他們很難躲開佐迪。佐迪隨時都帶著六個焰拳的士兵（人類{@creature Veteran||老兵}）保護他。他們的名字是吉索，米娜奎，奈萊斯特，奧利弗，索爾斯塔，塔卡拉。

english: When he's not flexing his military muscle or taking bribes, Captain Zodge presents himself as a forthright, level-headed man who treats others with the respect he demands in return. When the characters are ready to hear what he has to say, read the following boxed text aloud to the players:
zh_tw: 在他沒有在炫耀武力或者受賄時，佐迪會展現出他是一個直率，穩健，尊重他人但是也要求別人同樣對待自己的人。當角色們準備好聽取他的發言時，請將下列框內文字大聲地朗讀給他們：

english: "The refugee crisis," says Captain Zodge, "has stoked fears that Baldur's Gate might suffer the same fate as Elturel, of which nothing remains but a hole in the ground, apparently. Our grand duke, {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}, was visiting Elturel on a diplomatic mission when the city was destroyed. Coincidence? I think not.
zh_tw: "那些難民，"佐迪隊長說道，"他們使得博德之門現在充滿恐懼，恐懼他們也會變成艾爾托瑞爾那樣，除了一個洞之外什麼都不剩。而我們的大公，{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}在艾爾托瑞爾被毀滅的時候恰好由於外交任務在拜訪那座城市。巧合？我可不這麼認為。"

english: "The knights of Elturgard call themselves Hellriders. A few of them escaped the destruction and think we're somehow to blame for Elturel's downfall. What a bunch of self-righteous rabble-rousers! We're arresting them on sight, but that's left us shorthanded to deal with another problem. For that, I need your help."
zh_tw: "那些艾爾托瑞爾的騎士自稱為地獄騎手。他們中的一小部分人逃過了與城市共同毀滅的命運，他們竟然認為我們某種意義上應當為艾爾托瑞爾的墜落負責。真是一幫自以為是的煽動者！我們一看到他們就會把他們逮捕起來，但是這讓我們在處理別的問題時人手短缺。因此，我需要諸位的幫助。"

english: Captain Zodge won't accept any refusal of his offer. The Flaming Fist is empowered to draft adventurers in times of emergency. He can execute them on the spot for refusing to help, though he would rather they accept. He gives each character a copper badge that bears the Flaming Fist's coat of arms. These badges give the characters license to act in Zodge's name.
zh_tw: 佐迪隊長不會接受任何拒絕他的提案的言語。焰拳被賦予了在緊急情況下強徵冒險者的權力。因此他有權處決那些拒絕提供幫助的人，當然他更願意他們接受提案。他會給協助者每人一個帶有焰拳盾徽的銅製徽章。這些徽章會給予角色們以佐迪的名義進行行動的許可。

english: Read the following boxed text aloud when the characters are ready to hear more:
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好去了解更多的時候，請朗讀以下框內文字：

english: "Baldur's Gate has long been plagued by followers of the Dead Three—the gods Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul. I thought we had wiped them out, but apparently not. These purveyors of fear and death are taking advantage of the current crisis to commit murder sprees throughout the city. As my appointed deputies in this matter, you'll have license to kill these wretches on sight. Find their lair, and wipe it out. Eliminate anyone who gets in your way, and don't worry about collateral damage.
zh_tw: "博德之門已經飽受死亡三神——班恩，巴爾和米爾寇的追隨者們的毒害很久了。我曾以為我們已經把他們消滅乾淨了的，但現在看來很明顯沒有。這些恐懼和死亡的傳播者利用當前的危機在全城進行他們的謀殺狂歡。作為我所指定的在此事上的協助者，你們擁有見到這些邪教徒就格殺勿論的權力。去找到他們的巢穴，把他們清理乾淨。幹掉任何阻礙了你們的人，你們不用擔心這過程中所附帶的必要損害。"

english: "If you do what I say, I'll see that you each receive two hundred gold pieces in addition to my gratitude, which is worth considerably more.
zh_tw: 「只要你們照我的話做，我就會確保你們每人拿到兩百枚金幣，還有我的感激——後者可值錢多了。

english: "A few blocks from the Basilisk Gate is Elfsong Tavern. A spy named Tarina hangs out there, gathering rumors for the Guild. She owes me a favor, so tell her you work for me. Ask her what she knows about the Dead Three. And, for the love of Balduran, be nice. Tarina has dangerous friends."
zh_tw: "距離這個石蜥門幾個街區之外的精靈之歌酒館，那裡有個叫做塔麗娜的密探，她負責從工會中收集各種流言。她欠我一個人情，所以告訴她你們是為我工作的就行了，問問她她對死亡三神有什麼瞭解。還有，看在博德安的份上，對她好點，塔麗娜有不少危險的朋友。"

english: When a tenday passes without any reports of attacks by followers of the Dead Three, Zodge secures the funds to pay the characters, upholding his end of the agreement. He collects their badges before paying them.
zh_tw: 如果有持續十天沒有任何死亡三神的追隨者造成的襲擊報告的話，佐迪會得到用以支付角色報酬的撥款，使他可以完成協議。他會在付錢之前收回那些徽章。

english: When the fog clears, Baldur's Gate shines on the shores of the Chionthar River
zh_tw: 當霧氣散去，博德之門在衝薩河畔閃耀

english: Elfsong Tavern
zh_tw: 精靈之歌酒館

english: The characters can either visit Elfsong Tavern in accordance with Captain Zodge's wishes or do whatever else they please. Their goals at the tavern are to make contact with a spy named Tarina and find out what she knows about the Dead Three.
zh_tw: 角色們可以按照佐迪隊長的命令前往精靈之歌酒館或者幹其他任何事情。如果去酒館的話他們的目標是找到一個名叫塔麗娜的密探並且瞭解到她所知道的關於死亡三神的一切。

english: Zodge has spies who keep him informed on the characters' progress. If the characters don't visit Elfsong Tavern within forty-eight hours of receiving their orders, Zodge sends a squad of six Flaming Fist {@creature Veteran||veterans} and one {@creature flameskull} to escort the characters to the tavern, kill anyone who refuses to go, and report back to him. If the characters destroy or escape this squad, Zodge mobilizes two more squads to hunt them down.
zh_tw: 佐迪有耳目會隨時向他彙報角色們的進展。如果角色們在收到命令後的48小時內不去拜訪精靈之歌酒館的話，佐迪會派遣一支由六名焰拳{@creature Veteran||老兵}和一隻{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}組成的小隊去將他們護送前往精靈之歌酒館，殺掉那些不願意前往酒館的人，並隨後向他報告。如果角色們消滅或逃離了這支小隊，佐迪會再派遣兩個小隊去獵殺他們。

english: About the Tavern
zh_tw: 關於酒館

english: Elfsong Tavern's location is marked on {@area map 1.1|1a8|x}, while {@area map 1.2|329|x} shows its interior.
zh_tw: 精靈之歌酒館的位置已經標記在了{@area 地圖 1.1|1a8|x}，而{@area 地圖 1.2|329|x}則會展示它的內部。

english: From time to time, the disembodied voice of a female elf fills the tavern with a melancholy song, giving the establishment its name. The ballad isn't loud enough to disrupt conversation, but most patrons stop speaking when the elfsong begins, then resume only after it ends. Many customers frequent the tavern in the hopes of hearing it. Those who speak Elvish can understand the lyrics, which lament an unnamed lover lost at sea. No one is sure how the spirit came to haunt the tavern, just as no one can predict when it will sing again.
zh_tw: 時不時地，一個空靈的女性精靈的悲傷歌聲會迴盪在酒館之中，這個酒館也因此得名。雖然歌聲不足以大到打斷人們聊天，但是大部分客人都會在歌聲響起時停止聊天，並且在歌聲停止後繼續他們的對話。許多酒館的常客都是來此聆聽這個歌聲的。那些懂得精靈語的人可以理解歌詞的含義，那是對迷失于海洋的無名戀人的哀悼。沒有人知道這個精靈幽魂是何時開始棲居於這個酒館，就像沒有人知道她何時會再度歌唱。

english: Alan Alyth, the tavern's current owner and proprietor, is a neutral half-elf {@creature commoner} with {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. Alan recently turned seventy-five years old and has run the establishment for decades. His elven blood through his half-elf mother has kept him alive this long, and keeps him looking better than most full-blooded humans his age. He runs a moneylending business on the side, offering loans to customers he trusts. He rarely gives loans to adventurers, knowing how flighty they can be, but he might offer them a free glass of {@recipe Elverquisst|HFFotM} wine if he thinks it'll keep their swords sheathed (see the "Taverns in Baldur's Gate" sidebar).
zh_tw: 阿蘭·艾莉絲，酒館的現任所有者與經營者，他是一名絕對中立的半精靈{@creature commoner||平民}，他具有 60 尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。阿蘭最近剛剛過了自己的七十五歲生日並且他已經經營這個酒館數十年了。他的半精靈母親所給他的半精靈血脈使得他如此的長壽，並且讓他看起來比其他同年齡的純種人類精神得多。他同時還在這裡運營著一些借貸業務，向他信得過的顧客提供貸款。他很少把錢借給冒險者，因為他知道這幫人是有多麼反覆無常。但他可能會願意給他們送上一杯免費的{@recipe Elverquisst|HFFotM|精靈奎斯特酒}，如果他覺得這能讓這些人的劍停留在劍鞘裡的話（請參閱"博德之門的酒館"）。

english: Taverns in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的酒館

english: No wise person walks the streets of Baldur's Gate or enters one of its taverns without a weapon or an armed escort. Anyone who has lived in the city for more than a tenday knows this from experience. Taverns might appear safe at a glance, but they are among the most dangerous places in Baldur's Gate—full of alcohol, tempting coin, and unscrupulous people. Volothamp Geddarm, a notorious raconteur known for his tavern reviews, encapsulates his Baldur's Gate experience as "hard on the stomach, especially when someone sticks a knife in there." Customers are expected to look after themselves when fights break out, and one shouldn't expect any help or sympathy from the Flaming Fist. Tavern murders are common, and usually end with the poor victim being dragged away and either left in an alley (to be picked clean by urchins, then eaten by rats) or tossed in the harbor.
zh_tw: 聰明人都不會在行走於博德之門的街道或者進出於酒館時不帶任何武器或者護衛。但凡在這個城市裡生活超過 10 天的人都有這種經驗。酒館也許乍一看是一個安全的地方，但是它實際上是博德之門最危險的地方，滿是酒精，誘人的錢幣，粗鄙之人。瓦羅譚普·哲達，一個以其酒館評價而臭名昭著的故事大王將其在博德之門的經歷概述為"傷胃，特別是當有人把刀刺在那兒的時候"。當打鬥爆發時顧客最好靠他自己，而不該指望焰拳的同情。酒館謀殺是很常見的，而被拖出去的可憐受害者的下場要麼是被丟棄在小巷裡（被頑童扒光之後再成為鼠食）要麼被拋進海港。

english: Baldur's Bones
zh_tw: 博德之骨

english: Baldur's Bones is a popular dice game in the taverns of Baldur's Gate. Each player requires several six-sided dice. The rules are as follows:
zh_tw: 博德之骨是一個流行於博德之門酒館中的一個骰子游戲，每個參與者都會持有幾個六面骰，遊戲規則如下：

english: Each player puts the agreed ante in the pot.
zh_tw: 每個參與者都先把賭注放入罐子裡。

english: Each player rolls three dice. Play then proceeds clockwise around the table, with the host of the game going last.
zh_tw: 每個參與者骰三枚骰子，按照順時針順序進行遊戲，莊家最後行動。

english: On their turn, a player can choose to "stand" or "roll." If the player stands, the next player can take a turn. A player who rolls takes an additional die and rolls it. If the total of their dice exceeds 21, they "bust" and are out of the game. Otherwise they can keep rolling additional dice until they either stand or break.
zh_tw: 每一回合，參與者可以選擇"骰"或者"停"，如果他們選擇停，則下一位參與者行動，如果參與者選擇"骰"則加入一枚骰子並且骰那枚骰子。如果他們的骰子點數大於21，則他們"爆炸"了並且出局。不然他們就可以繼續加入骰子或者叫停。

english: After everyone has had a turn, the highest point total (excluding players who busted) wins the game and takes the pot.
zh_tw: 當所有人擲完一輪後，點數最高的（不算出局的那些）人贏得遊戲並拿走罐子裡的賭金。

english: Tavern Patrons
zh_tw: 酒館顧客

english: If the characters come to Elfsong Tavern in search of Captain Zodge's contact, Tarina, they find her playing cards upstairs in {@area area E7|029|x}. Among the dozens of other patrons, they notice a few rats scurrying around as well as the following noteworthy NPCs, who play no part in the adventure but can be brought into the story as you see fit:
zh_tw: 如果角色們抵達精靈之歌酒館並且尋找佐迪隊長的老關係塔麗娜的話，他們會發現她正在樓上的{@area 區域E7|029|x}和一些人玩。在酒館的其他那堆客人裡，他們會注意到有幾隻老鼠在亂竄的同時還有幾個值得關注的非玩家角色，他們在這場冒險裡沒有戲份，但如果您需要的話可以把他們加入故事中：

english: Skrawldar Fane (neutral human {@creature commoner}), a punch-drunk shipwright with no eyebrows
zh_tw: 斯卡瓦達爾·法恩，絕對中立的人類{@creature commoner||平民}，一個沒有眉毛而且喝的七葷八素的造船工。

english: Lala Stout (neutral evil lightfoot halfling {@creature spy}), a scar-faced burglar flipping a coin
zh_tw: 拉拉·斯塔特，中立邪惡的輕足半身人{@creature spy||間諜}，一個臉上帶著傷疤，玩弄著硬幣的竊賊。

english: Oloric Witmirth (neutral good human {@creature commoner}), an impoverished playwright who scribbles his private thoughts and observations in a small book
zh_tw: 奧羅裡克·維特米爾，中立善良的人類{@creature commoner||平民}，一個將自己的想法和觀察寫入一本小書中的貧窮劇作家。

english: Whaul Nightley (neutral half-orc {@creature thug} with {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet), a jovial, strong-jawed rat-catcher with a bellowing laugh
zh_tw: 沃爾·奈特莉，具有 60 尺的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}的絕對中立半獸人{@creature thug||暴徒}，一個快活的大下巴的捕鼠人，有著風箱一樣的笑聲。

english: Rahima Sajiressa (lawful neutral human {@creature acolyte} of Savras, god of divination and fate), a gregarious astrologer who loves to gamble
zh_tw: 拉西馬·薩吉雷薩，守序中立的人類薩弗拉斯{@creature acolyte||侍僧}，一個喜歡交際的占星家，熱愛賭博。

english: Willow Brownbug (neutral good strongheart halfling {@creature druid}), a snooty apothecary wearing a colorful cape
zh_tw: 威洛特里·灰蟲，中立善良的強心半身人{@creature druid||德魯伊}，一個穿著鮮豔披肩的傲慢的藥劑師。

english: If the characters need help finding Tarina, a tavern regular, they are directed to the second floor (see "{@area Dealing with Tarina|032|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色需要侍者幫助以尋找塔麗娜，這位酒館常客，那麼他們會被帶去二樓（請參閱"{@area 和塔麗娜打交道|032|x}"）。

english: Map 1.2: Elfsong Tavern
zh_tw: 地圖1.2：精靈之歌酒館

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Tavern Locations
zh_tw: 酒館地點

english: The following area descriptions are keyed to map 1.2.
zh_tw: 以下區域的描述請對照地圖1.2。

english: E1. Taproom
zh_tw: E1. 酒吧間

english: Alan Alyth tends bar while two young men (human {@creature Commoner||commoners}) named Falten and Yimiur take orders, deliver drinks and food to tables, and joke with the clientele. Flanking the entrance are two bouncers: a suit of {@creature animated armor} called Klank and a gruff female {@creature Half-Ogre (Ogrillon)||half-ogre} named Skoona. Both are here to protect the other staff members, not the patrons, and won't break up a fight unless a staff member is involved.
zh_tw: 阿蘭·艾莉絲正照料著吧檯，這兒有兩名叫做法兒騰和依米爾年輕侍者（人類{@creature Commoner||平民}）聽從吩咐，他們上菜倒酒，順便給顧客逗個樂子。入口的兩側有兩名酒館的保安，一個叫做克蘭克的{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}和一名叫做斯科納的粗魯的女性{@creature Half-Ogre (Ogrillon)||半食人魔}。他們在這裡是保護這裡的工作人員而非客人們的，除非有工作人員被捲進了打鬥，否則他們不會介入。

english: Well-armed patrons ({@creature Commoner||commoners} and {@creature Thug||thugs} mostly) huddle around tables in the main room and in private booths. Three padded chairs are angled toward a fireplace on the east wall, underneath the creaky wooden staircase that climbs to the second floor. Some drunk is usually passed out on the couch against the north wall. Next to the couch sits a wooden sea chest that contains an assortment of games (Dragonchess boards, well-used decks of Three-Dragon Ante cards, and so on).
zh_tw: 全副武裝的客人們（大部分都是{@creature Commoner||平民}或者{@creature Thug||暴徒}）圍聚在大廳的桌子邊或待在包間裡。在通往二樓的那嘎吱作響的木頭樓梯的下面附近的東牆上有著一個壁爐，對著壁爐擺有三張軟墊椅。你們常常會看到有一些醉鬼會醉倒在對著北牆的長沙發上。沙發旁邊放著的是一個水手儲物箱，裡面放滿了各種各樣的遊戲（龍棋板，一疊用了很久的三龍牌等）。

english: E2. Lounge
zh_tw: E2. 休息室

english: Although smoking is allowed anywhere in Elfsong Tavern, this lounge is a favorite hangout for members of a local smokers' club called the Puffer Fishers. Most of the club members are local fishers and crab catchers.
zh_tw: 雖然精靈之歌酒館各處都允許吸菸，但這個休息室是一個名為"吐霧漁夫"的菸民俱樂部最愛逗留的地方，他們大部分人都是本地的漁夫和捕蟹人。

english: E3. Private Dining Room
zh_tw: E3. 私人餐廳

english: This room is called the Green Dragon Room for the mounted head of a young green dragon that hangs on the south wall.
zh_tw: 這個房間被叫做綠龍之間，因為它南面的牆上掛著一個幼年綠龍頭。

english: E4. Storage Alcove
zh_tw: E4. 儲藏凹室

english: Crates of fruit, barrels of fresh water, and casks of syrup and oil are kept here.
zh_tw: 成箱的水果，大桶的飲用水，桶裝的糖漿和油被儲藏在這裡。

english: E5. Storeroom
zh_tw: E5. 儲藏室

english: This room contains crates of foodstuffs and spices, in addition to cleaning rags, brooms, broken chairs, and tools for repairing furniture.
zh_tw: 這個房間儲藏了幾箱食物和香料，還有乾淨的抹布，掃把，損壞的椅子和修理傢俱的工具。

english: E6. Kitchen
zh_tw: E6. 廚房

english: Alan Alyth employs three cooks ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) to prepare meals: a cheery strongheart halfling executive chef named Chenna Fatrabbit, a testy human sous chef named Azar Valsheem, and a blind human pastry chef named Klav Martilmur. They work from highsun to midnight. Their specialties are fish cakes, crab cakes, a thick cheese-and-potato soup, and loaf pudding soaked in syrup and decorated with lightly salted almonds.
zh_tw: 阿蘭·艾莉斯僱了三個廚師（{@creature Commoner||平民}）來準備食物，一個總是興高采烈的叫做齊納·胖兔的強心半身人主廚，一個名為阿茲爾·瓦什姆的暴躁人類副廚以及一個叫克拉夫·馬爾蒂穆爾的盲人點心師。他們從正午工作至午夜。這兒的特色菜有魚糕，蟹糕，番茄起司濃湯和撒有鹹杏仁的糖漿麵包布丁。

english: E7. Upstairs Dining Room
zh_tw: E7. 上層餐廳

english: Lit lanterns hang from the rafters in this windowless room. Rugs cover the wooden floor and help dampen the noise from drunken patrons gathered around two large tables, eating and playing games of Baldur's Bones (see the "{@area Taverns in Baldur's Gate|01f|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 點亮的燈籠懸掛在屋樑上，照亮了這間完全沒有窗戶的樓上餐廳。醉酒的顧客圍坐在兩張大桌旁吃飯、玩"博德之骨"（參見 "{@area 博德之門的酒館|01f|x}" 邊欄），木地板上的地毯減緩了他們的喧鬧聲。

english: One of the individuals seated at the table nearest the stairs is Tarina, the NPC whom the characters seek (see "{@area Dealing with Tarina|032|x}").
zh_tw: 其中一位坐在樓梯附近桌子旁的人，正在玩家要尋找的塔麗娜(見"{@area 和塔麗娜打交道|032|x}")。

english: E8. Private Dining Room
zh_tw: E8. 私人餐廳

english: This room is called the Umber Hulk Room after the mounted head of an umber hulk hanging on the east wall.
zh_tw: 這間房被稱為"掘土巨怪之廳"，其名源於懸掛在東牆上的一顆掘土巨怪頭顱標本。

english: E9. Fancy Guest Suite
zh_tw: E9. 夢幻套房

english: This room is currently unoccupied, and its door is locked. In addition to a key he loans to guests, Alan has a master key that unlocks the door. Picking the lock requires {@item thieves' tools|phb} and a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 這間屋子目前沒有人住，因此它的門是鎖上了的。除了交給客人的鑰匙外，阿蘭還有一把總鑰匙可以開啟這扇房門。嘗試開鎖則需要使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}並進行一次{@dc 10}的敏捷檢定。

english: The richly appointed room contains velvet curtains, framed paintings of ships, a canopied bed, a night table, a sea chest, and a wardrobe. The door to the west opens up to a private dining room.
zh_tw: 這個富麗堂皇的房間有著天鵝絨窗簾，一幅鑲框的船隻繪畫，一張四柱床，一個床頭櫃，一個水手箱和一個衣櫃。西側的門通向一個私人餐間。

english: E10. Private Dining Room
zh_tw: E10. 私人餐廳

english: The mounted head of a displacer beast hangs on the east wall near a small armoire to inspire this area's name: the Displacer Beast Room.
zh_tw: 一隻移位獸的頭顱標本懸掛在東牆上，靠近一座小衣櫃，這也是該區域名稱"移位獸之廳"的由來。

english: E11. Large Guest Room
zh_tw: E11. 大客房

english: This room contains an unusual guest: a {@creature sahuagin priestess} named Oshalla. She wears a cloak made from fishing nets, and speaks Common and Sahuagin. She was exiled from the depths for plotting a coup against her king.
zh_tw: 這個房間住著一位不尋常的客人：一位名叫奧沙拉的{@creature sahuagin priestess||鯊華女祭司}。她身穿由漁網製成的斗篷，會說通用語和鯊華魚人語。她因策劃反對她國王的政變而被從深海流放。

english: Oshalla keeps to herself and has her meals brought to her three times per day. The door to her room is locked, and she wears the key on a cord around her neck. Alan has a master key that also unlocks the door. Picking the lock requires {@item thieves' tools|phb} and a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 奧沙拉獨來獨往，一日三餐都由人送到她的房間。她房間的門是鎖著的，鑰匙用繩子掛在她的脖子上。艾倫有一把能開啟這扇門的總鑰匙。撬鎖需要 {@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具} 併成功透過 {@dc 10} 的敏捷檢定。

english: In addition to a bed, night table, and chest, this room contains a desk, a chair, several paintings of coastal and underwater scenes, a portable bathtub, and a ten-foot-long, eight-foot tall bookcase that holds Oshalla's collection of trinkets collected from the ocean (shells, barnacle-covered skulls, and the like). Oshalla doesn't allow the tavern staff to clean her room or refresh the water in the tub, so both are filthy.
zh_tw: 除了床、床頭櫃和箱子，這個房間還包含一張桌子、一把椅子、幾幅沿海和水下場景的畫作、一個行動式浴缸，以及一個十尺長、八尺高的書架，書架上放著奧莎拉從海洋收集的各種小玩意兒（貝殼、長滿藤壺的頭骨等）。奧莎拉不允許酒館的員工打掃她的房間或更換浴缸的水，因此房間與浴缸都髒得不堪入目。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the desk drawer find a sharkskin pouch containing 66 gp and 49 sp, which Oshalla uses to pay for food and shelter. Resting against the south wall is a small wooden chest that contains a shrine to Sekolah, the shark god worshiped by sahuagin. The chest's interior is lined with shark teeth and contains a 5-pound coral sculpture of Sekolah with red pearls for eyes (worth 250 gp as an art object).
zh_tw: 搜尋桌子抽屜的冒險者們會找到一個鯊魚皮製成的小包，裡面裝有 66 GP和 49 SP，這是奧沙拉用來購買食物和支付房費的錢款。靠著南牆有一個裝著瑟寇拉神龕小木頭箱子，箱子的內部用鯊魚牙齒襯託著一個 5 磅重的有著紅寶石眼睛的珊瑚瑟寇拉雕像（該物品視為一件價值 250 GP 的藝術品）。

english: E12. Plain Guest Rooms
zh_tw: E12. 普通客房

english: The doors to these two rooms are locked. In addition to keys he loans to guests, Alan has a master key that unlocks both doors. Picking either lock requires {@item thieves' tools|phb} and a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 這兩個房間的門是鎖著的，除了交給客人的鑰匙，阿蘭的總鑰匙可以開啟這兩扇門。嘗試開鎖則需要使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}並進行一次{@dc 10}的敏捷檢定。

english: Each room contains a cozy bed, an empty wooden chest, and curtains on the window.
zh_tw: 每個房間都有一張舒適的床、一隻空木箱，以及能遮光並保持隱私的窗簾。

english: E13. Alan's Bedroom
zh_tw: E13. 艾倫的臥室

english: Alan carries a master key that unlocks the door to his private bedroom. Picking the lock requires {@item thieves' tools|phb} and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 阿蘭帶著的總鑰匙可以開啟他自己的私人臥室，撬開鎖則需要使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}併成功透過一次{@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定。

english: Alan's room contains a bed with an ornate iron frame, a claw-footed chest, a night table, and a wardrobe. Splayed out on the floor in front of the wardrobe is a {@creature rug of smothering} that attacks anyone other than Alan who steps on it or opens the chest.
zh_tw: 阿蘭的房間有著一張精緻的鐵架床，一個爪足箱子，一個床頭櫃和衣櫃。衣櫃前的地板上攤著一隻{@creature rug of smothering||悶人毯}，它會攻擊任何除阿蘭以外踏上去的人或者開啟箱子的人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest's interior is divided into three equal-sized compartments containing 91 gp, 176 sp, and 288 cp, respectively. Alan uses this money to pay his staff and maintain the tavern.
zh_tw: 箱子裡有一個三個等大的格子分別裝有 91 GP，176 SP，288 CP，這是阿蘭用來運營酒館和發放薪水的錢。

english: Dealing with Tarina
zh_tw: 和塔麗娜打交道

english: Tarina is a chaotic evil human {@creature bandit} with a conniving mind. She plays regular games of Baldur's Bones (see the "{@area Taverns in Baldur's Gate|01f|x}" sidebar) with a coterie of local dimwits at a table in {@area area E7|029|x}. Her fellow gamblers don't realize she cheats.
zh_tw: 塔麗娜是一個心懷鬼胎的混亂邪惡人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}，她在{@area 區域E7|029|x}和本地的一些傻子們玩著博德之骨（見"{@area 博德之門的酒館|01f|x}"邊欄），而她的賭友們完全沒有發現她在作弊。

english: "Tarina" is not a real name, of course. Before retiring to Baldur's Gate, Tarina was a pirate known as Rhonda Thunderbell (also not her real name). After serving Captain Murosko Sessprin of the {@i Uncivil Serpent} faithfully for months, she stole loot from her fellow pirates and fled before they could stop her. Most of that loot has been spent in recent years, though Tarina has enough squirreled away to ensure she never goes hungry. She's also in good standing with Nine-Fingers, guildmaster of the local thieves' guild, who gives her occasional work.
zh_tw: "塔麗娜"當然並不是她的真名，在塔麗娜退休住到博德之門前，她以朗達·雷鳴（當然這也不是她的真名）為名當海盜。在她給穆羅斯科·賽斯普林船長的{@i 狂野大蛇號}上忠誠地服務了幾個月之後，她從那些海盜同伴手中偷走了戰利品並且在他們攔住她之前逃離了那裡。大部分的贓物都在近些年被她花掉了，但是塔麗娜有足夠的餘財保證她不會淪落到吃不上飯。她同時也和本地的盜賊公會九指的公會首領保持著良好的關係，他偶爾也會給塔麗娜一些活幹。

english: Tarina recently heard a rumor that her former shipmates had tracked her to Baldur's Gate. She agrees to help the characters if they stay at Elfsong Tavern to see if the pirates to show up, then kill them all.
zh_tw: 塔麗娜最近打聽到她的前船員同伴們已經追著她來到了博德之門。她答應角色們如果他們能待在精靈之歌酒館看看有沒有海盜出現，並幫她把出現在的海盜都殺掉的話就與他們合作。

english: Killing Time in the Tavern
zh_tw: 在酒館消磨時間

english: Exactly when Tarina's former associates arrive is up to you, but the characters should have a bit of free time before they appear (as described in "{@area With Friends Like These|035|x}"). Characters who loiter in the tavern can overhear patrons talking about the current happenings in Baldur's Gate and the rumors from Elturel:
zh_tw: 塔麗娜的那些前同伴什麼時候到達完全取決於您，但在他們出現（詳情請參閱"{@area 有像這樣的朋友|035|x}"）前，角色們應該在酒館中有一些閒暇的時間。在酒館中閒逛的角色們可以聽到一些現在發生於博德之門地區的事情和來自艾爾托瑞爾的謠言：

english: "I'll bet my last copper piece that those so-called refugees are advanced scouts for an army that's preparing to attack Baldur's Gate!"
zh_tw: "我用我的最後一枚銅幣打賭，那些所謂的難民一定是為了攻打博德之門的探子"

english: "The Flaming Fist is decapitated. The captains have already started bickering over who should be in charge with {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} gone."
zh_tw: "焰拳現在群龍無首，而那些隊長現在為了誰該為{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的失蹤負責吵翻天了。"

english: "With Ravengard out of the way, who'll be the next grand duke, I wonder? My money's on Thalamra Vanthampur. Practically born in the sewers, she was, and more vicious than a swarm of rats."
zh_tw: "現在瑞文嘉德沒了，誰將會是下一個大公呢？我賭是薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾。差不多都是在陰溝裡出生的她，比鼠群還要惡毒。"

english: Elfsong
zh_tw: 精靈之歌

english: At some point before Tarina's associates arrive, the tavern is filled with the ghostly lamentation of the elf spirit known to haunt the place. However, on this one occasion, the spirit sings not of a long-lost lover but of Elturel. This surprises everyone, including Alan Alyth, who has never heard the spirit change its tune. Characters who understand Elvish can translate the lyrics:
zh_tw: 在塔麗娜的"朋友"們到達之前的某個時間點，酒館裡會響起精靈幽魂的悲歌。但是，這一次，這個幽魂唱的並非關於其早已逝去的愛人而是關於艾爾托瑞爾。這使得在座的所有人都震驚不已，包括阿蘭·艾莉斯。連他都沒有聽過幽魂唱過這首歌。能理解精靈語的角色可以翻譯這首歌的歌詞：

english: {@i O sing a song of Elturel}
zh_tw: {@i 唱一曲艾爾托瑞爾之歌}

english: {@i Of water, woods, and hill}
zh_tw: {@i 歌唱它的流水，樹木與山丘}

english: {@i The sun dawns on her ruddy cliffs}
zh_tw: {@i 朝陽出赤崖，}

english: {@i And fields green and still}.
zh_tw: {@i 田野永長青。}.

english: {@i This land of long-abiding joy}
zh_tw: {@i 此地長歡樂，}

english: {@i Home of the strong and brave}
zh_tw: {@i 力勇以為家。}

english: {@i Renowned by all, across the realms},
zh_tw: {@i 名聲揚寰宇，},

english: {@i And never once a slave}.
zh_tw: {@i 從無奴役者。}.

english: {@i O sing a song of Elturel}
zh_tw: {@i 唱一曲艾爾托瑞爾之歌}

english: {@i When foes are at her door}
zh_tw: {@i 惡敵已兵臨城下}

english: {@i Her fields torn by cloven feet}
zh_tw: {@i 良田萬頃偶蹄裂，}

english: {@i From some infernal shore}.
zh_tw: {@i 地獄之國魔影來。}.

english: {@i Arise the mighty Hellriders}
zh_tw: {@i 地獄騎手為砥柱，}

english: {@i Take up your swift, keen swords}
zh_tw: {@i 手持利劍揮如電。}

english: {@i Then charge into the hellish fray}
zh_tw: {@i 高呼衝鋒入血戰，}

english: {@i And scatter devil hordes}.
zh_tw: {@i 魔鬼軍勢頓消散。}.

english: {@i O sing a song of Elturel}
zh_tw: {@i 唱一曲艾爾托瑞爾之歌}

english: {@i And when the night does fall}
zh_tw: {@i 日落夜幕降}

english: {@i Sleep safe beneath Companion's light}
zh_tw: {@i 伴陽照安眠，}

english: {@i Until the dawn does call}.
zh_tw: {@i 直至朝陽升。}.

english: {@i We're bound by mortal covenant}
zh_tw: {@i 吾等縛凡軀，}

english: {@i That only ends with death}
zh_tw: {@i 人生必一死。}

english: {@i And so we'll sing of Elturel}
zh_tw: {@i 然亦歌埃城，}

english: {@i Until our final breath}.
zh_tw: {@i 直至此命絕。}.

english: Any character who has been to Elturel or who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check knows that "the Companion" referred to in the song is the name given to the artificial sun that burns over Elturel, protecting the city and its surrounding lands against undead.
zh_tw: 任何到過艾爾托瑞爾或者成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 的智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定的人可以知道所謂的伴陽指的是該城上空燃燒的人造太陽，它一直保護著該城及其周遭地區免受亡靈襲擾。

english: Characters who speak to Alan after hearing the song can ask him about it, since he speaks Elvish in addition to Common. However, he was so surprised by the change in lyrics that he remembers only parts of it. The spirit will sing the song a second time, but only if an elf or half-elf pleads with it to do so and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: 在聽完這首歌后與阿蘭交談的角色可以向他詢問這首歌，因為阿蘭除了通用語外還會說精靈語。阿蘭會對歌詞的變化表現得十分驚訝，以至於他甚至沒有記清楚全部的歌詞。精靈幽魂會再度唱起這首歌，但這需要一名精靈或者半精靈發出了懇求並且成功透過一次的 {@dc 10} 的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。

english: One word from the song sticks in Alan's memory: "Hellriders." Characters might recall Captain Zodge using the term to describe the knights of Elturel. Alan and most other residents of Baldur's Gate use the word similarly. Any character who has been to Elturel or who succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recalls that the Hellriders were so-named long ago when they descended into the Nine Hells on horseback to fight devils. Most of them never returned. It's possible that one of Alan's other patrons knows this bit of history.
zh_tw: 這首歌有一個詞可以勾起阿蘭的回憶："地獄騎手"。角色們可能會想起來佐迪曾用這個詞來形容那些艾爾托瑞爾的騎士們。阿蘭和大多數博德之門的其他住民似乎也是這麼使用這個詞的。任何一個曾到過艾爾托瑞爾或者透過一次 {@dc 20} 的智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定的角色可以想起，地獄騎手是在很久以前曾騎著戰馬走下九獄與魔鬼作戰而因此得名的。他們中的絕大部分人沒能回來。阿蘭的其他客人們中的某位有可能會知道一些相關的歷史。

english: With Friends Like These
zh_tw: 有像這樣的朋友

english: Characters who wait for Tarina's pirate friends find their patience rewarded in due time. Read the following to the players when it's time for the pirates to arrive:
zh_tw: 等待著塔麗娜的海盜朋友的角色們會合適的時間得到他們自己耐心的回報。當海盜到達時，請向玩家們朗讀下列框內文字：

english: Eight motley humans saunter into the tavern. The leader is a brawny man with a cloudy right eye, a cruel sneer, and a pirate's swagger. The others are an unsavory, rowdy bunch who act as if they own the place.
zh_tw: 八個形色各異的人悠悠地走進了酒館，他們領頭的是一個強壯的男人，他右眼渾濁不堪，帶著殘忍的微笑和海盜的味道。其他的人則令人生厭，喧譁吵鬧，好像這裡是他們的地盤一樣。

english: "We're looking for an old friend of ours," says the dead-eyed man. He sniffs the air. "Goes by the name 'Tarina,' or so I'm told. Loves to cheat at Baldur's Bones."
zh_tw: "我們在找一個老朋友"那個獨眼男人說到。他嗅了嗅空氣，"她現在被稱作'塔麗娜'，至少別人是這麼告訴我的。哦對了，她特別喜歡在玩博德之骨時出老千。"

english: Captain Murosko Sessprin was killed during a mutiny six months ago, leaving his ship—the {@i Uncivil Serpent}—under the command of Sessprin's treacherous first mate, a scoundrel named Lekard "Dead-Eye" Cadavrus. Dead-Eye is a neutral evil {@creature bandit captain} whose cataract-clouded right eye inspires his nickname. He doesn't like to bathe, and his breath smells like rotting fish. He's joined by a gang of seven {@creature Bandit||bandits} who share his evil disposition.
zh_tw: 穆羅斯科·賽斯普林船長在六個月前的一場譁變中被殺，而他的船{@i 狂野大蛇號}現在歸於他那奸詐的大副，名為勒卡德·"死眼"·卡達維魯斯的惡棍指揮。死眼是一位中立邪惡的{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}，他那渾濁的白內障右眼就是他外號的來源。他不喜歡洗澡，而他的口氣聞起來像是臭魚。他和一幫共七個性情與他同樣邪惡的{@creature Bandit||匪徒}同行。

english: Dead-Eye offers a tall glass of ale to anyone with information on Tarina's location, and several tavern patrons are quick to accept the offer. Characters can confront the pirates if they wish, but Dead-Eye won't let them stand between him and his revenge. Two pirates watch the exit to make sure Tarina can't escape while the others attack anyone who gets in Dead-Eye's way.
zh_tw: 死眼開價一大杯麥芽酒來換取塔麗娜位置的情報，一些酒館客人很快就接受了他的出價。如果角色願意，他們可以對抗海盜們，但死眼不會允許任何人阻擋他的復仇。兩個海盜看守著出口以保證塔麗娜無法逃跑，其他人會攻擊任何擋了死眼路的人。

english: Dead-Eye tries to kill Tarina on sight. Neither Alan nor the bouncers intervene in the fight unless one or more staff members become involved in it. Other patrons stay out of the fight as much as possible, though a character can attempt to bribe one friendly or indifferent NPC to join in as an action. With a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check—or a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check if the offer is not genuine—the NPC accepts the bribe, rolls initiative, and joins the fray on its next turn, siding with the characters until the fight ends. The check is made with advantage if the promised payment is worth 10 gp or more. Dead-Eye can use the same tactic, swaying tavern patrons to his side with coin.
