zh_tw: 一旦死眼看到塔麗娜，他就會嘗試殺死她。阿蘭和保安們都不會介入戰鬥除非有員工被捲了進去。其他的客人則儘可能的遠離戰鬥，但角色們也可以使用一個動作來嘗試賄賂一名或友好或冷漠的NPC去加入戰鬥。成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，或者如果報酬不夠豐厚的話則是一次魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定，NPC就會接受賄賂，投擲先攻，並在他的下一回合加入戰鬥，他們將和角色們並肩作戰直至戰鬥結束。如果承諾支付的錢財大於或等於 10 GP，則該檢定具有優勢。死眼也會嘗試使用同樣的戰術，用錢財將酒館顧客拉向自己一邊。

english: The characters can try to bribe Dead-Eye into leaving the Elfsong Tavern without his vengeance satisfied, but he demands 5,000 gp in coins or goods for his trouble. If characters claim to have the money or goods elsewhere, he laughs at them and says he doesn't place any stock in their words. He's far too suspicious to be fooled by so obvious a deception, and he can't bring himself to believe that anyone would value Tarina's life so highly.
zh_tw: 角色們也可以嘗試賄賂死眼讓他離開精靈之歌酒館而不執著於復仇，但是他會提出價值 5000 GP的錢財或者貨物作為代價。如果角色聲稱錢財在其他地方，他會嗤笑著告訴他們他不相信他們的話。他相當多疑，才不會被如此明顯的騙術愚弄；同時他也不相信有人會願意為了塔麗娜付那麼多錢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Tucked in Dead-Eye's vest is a pouch containing 32 gp and 15 sp. He also wears two gold necklaces (25 gp each) and a blackened gold ring with a white pearl set in it (125 gp). Each of the other pirates carries a pouch containing {@dice 1d6} sp.
zh_tw: 塞在死眼的背心裡的錢包裝著 32 GP和 15 SP。他還帶著兩個金項鍊（每個價值 25 GP），一個鑲嵌著珍珠的發黑的金戒指（價值 125 GP）。其他每個海盜的錢包裡都有 {@dice 1d6} SP。

english: Dead-Eye's ship, the {@i Uncivil Serpent}, is moored at the end of a dock on the east side of the harbor. Eleven {@creature Bandit||bandits} guard it, and no treasure is kept aboard. If the characters dispose of all the pirates, the ship is theirs for the taking, though it requires a crew of twenty to sail, and half or more of the crew must have proficiency with water vehicles.
zh_tw: 死眼的船，{@i 狂野大蛇號}，停靠在東部港口的一個船塢盡頭。11 個{@creature Bandit||匪徒}守衛著那裡，而且船上沒有任何的寶藏。如果角色解決掉了所有的海盜，那麼他們就可以奪取那艘船，但是它需要 20 個船員才能起航，並且其中一半的人需要具有水運載具的熟練項。

english: The {@i Uncivil Serpent} has the statistics of a {@vehicle sailing ship} (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). If you need a deck plan, use the ship map in {@book appendix C|DMG|12} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Although the ship is worth 10,000 gp intact, no one in Baldur's Gate wants to buy it because of its infamous reputation.
zh_tw: {@i 狂野大蛇號}使用{@vehicle sailing ship||帆船}的資料面板（請參閱《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》中{@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||第五章}）。如果你需要船隻的甲板平面圖，請使用《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》{@book 附錄C|DMG|12}的船隻地圖。儘管船值 10000 GP，但是由於這船的名聲是如此地臭名昭著以至博德之門沒人會想買這艘船。

english: What Tarina Knows
zh_tw: 塔麗娜所知道的事情

english: Once her pirate friends are dealt with, Tarina shares the following information with the characters:
zh_tw: 當塔麗娜的海盜朋友都被處理乾淨之後，她就會和角色分享以下的資訊：

english: "Several blocks northwest of here is a public bathhouse with a walled garden and frolicking nymphs carved into its front gates. Followers of the Dead Three have been seen coming and going from the bathhouse, and I'm told there's a secret door inside that leads to a dungeon. That's where the killers are hiding."
zh_tw: "從這裡向西北幾個街區的地方有一個公共浴室，那裡有一個被牆圍住的花園，正門上還雕刻著嬉戲的仙女。有人目擊到死亡三神的信徒們進出那裡，而且據說那裡面有一個密門會通向一個地城。那些殺手們就藏在那裡。"

english: If Tarina is killed, the characters can deliver her body to Captain Zodge, who makes arrangements with a priest to cast {@spell speak with dead} on the corpse. Once the corpse reveals what it knows, Zodge gives that information to the characters.
zh_tw: 如果塔麗娜被殺，角色們可以把她的屍體帶去見佐迪隊長，他可以與牧師達成協議去使用法術{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}。當這具屍體把它所知道的說出來之後，佐迪會把這些資訊告訴角色。

english: With the knowledge provided by Tarina or her corpse, the characters can head to the bathhouse and search for the dungeon hidden below it. Make sure the characters advance to 2nd level before continuing the adventure. When the characters arrive at the bathhouse, proceed with the "Dungeon of the Dead Three" section.
zh_tw: 帶著塔麗娜或者是她的屍體所提供的資訊，角色們可以趕往公共浴室並且尋找隱藏的地城。請確保角色們在繼續冒險之前提升到了 2 級。當角色們趕到公共浴室時，請開始推進"死亡三神的地城"一節。

english: Dungeon of the Dead Three
zh_tw: 死亡三神地城

english: Before running this part of the adventure, read the information on the Dead Three in {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13}. Stat blocks for the Dead Three's followers can be found there as well.
zh_tw: 在運作這一部分冒險前，請閱讀{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}中死亡三神的相關資訊。死亡三神信徒的相關資料面板也可以在那裡看到。

english: The Dungeon of the Dead Three is hidden below a bathhouse that's secretly owned and operated by the Vanthampur family. One member of the family, {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA}, is in the dungeon helping to coordinate the Dead Three cultists' attacks in the city. These attacks are meant to demonstrate to the citizens of Baldur's Gate that the Flaming Fist can't protect them.
zh_tw: 死亡三神的地城隱藏於一間由範薩姆普爾家族秘密擁有和運營的公共浴室之中。該家族的一位成員，{@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}就在地城中幫助協調死亡三神邪教徒們在城市發動襲擊。這些襲擊旨在使博德之門的民眾相信焰拳已經無法保護他們了。

english: Arrival at the Bathhouse
zh_tw: 到達澡堂

english: When the characters arrive at the bathhouse, read the following boxed text aloud to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們抵達公共浴室的時候，請向玩家們大聲朗讀下列框內文字：

english: The bathhouse is a one-story stuccoed building with stained-glass windows and clay roof tiles. Ten-foot-tall walls enclose a large courtyard outside the southeast corner of the building. The closed wooden doors to the courtyard are engraved with images of smiling nymphs dancing and frolicking in water.
zh_tw: 公共浴室是棟一層粉刷建築物，它有著彩色玻璃窗戶和陶製瓦片。十尺高的牆圍繞著建築物東南角的大庭院。通往庭院緊閉的木門上雕刻著仙女戲水的景象。

english: There's nothing outwardly suspicious about the bathhouse, which features one of the most sophisticated plumbing systems in the city. The doors leading to the courtyard (area D1) are unlocked and unguarded. The bathhouse closes at midnight and reopens at dawn, and city residents come and go here throughout the day and into the evening.
zh_tw: 這座建築從外面看來沒有任何可疑之處，但它是這座城市裡管道系統最為複雜的建築之一。通往庭院的門（區域D1）都未上鎖且無人看守。公共浴室會在午夜關閉，黎明時分再重新開啟，而城市裡的居民們也整日在這裡進進出出。

english: Bathhouse Locations
zh_tw: 澡堂地點

english: The following area descriptions are keyed to {@adventure map 1.3|BGDIA|1|Map 1.3: Dungeon of the Dead Three}.
zh_tw: 以下區域的描述請對照{@adventure 地圖 1.3|BGDIA|1|Map 1.3: Dungeon of the Dead Three}。

english: D1. Courtyard
zh_tw: D1. 庭院

english: Describe this location to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 按照下文為玩家們描述此地點：

english: This L-shaped courtyard features a trimmed lawn and nicely manicured shrubbery. The yard is decorated with white marble benches and stone fountains, each in the form of a smiling nymph tipping a jug that spills water into a circular stone basin.
zh_tw: L 型的庭院中有著平整的草坪和精心修剪的灌木叢。白色大理石長椅和石制噴泉裝飾著庭院，每個噴泉都是微笑的仙女手持水壺向圓形水池裡倒水的形制。

english: An {@condition invisible} {@creature imp} is perched on the southeast fountain. If the characters look as though they intend to cause trouble, the imp observes them quietly until they enter the bathhouse, then flies to {@area Vanthampur Villa|096|x} in the Upper City to alert {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA}, the oldest of {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|Duke Thalamra Vanthampur's} sons. Thurstwell instructs the imp to return to its post but takes no further action, hoping that the characters dispose of his brother, Mortlock.
zh_tw: 一個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}停留在東南部的噴泉上，如果角色們看上去像是想找麻煩的樣子的話，小魔鬼會安靜地觀察直到他們進入公共浴室，之後便會飛到位於上城區的{@area 範薩姆普爾別墅|096|x}中警示{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}，這位{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}的長子。瑟斯維爾會命令小魔鬼返回但不採取進一步的行動，他希望角色們能夠解決掉他的兄弟，摩特洛克。

english: D2. Baths
zh_tw: D2. 浴室

english: From dawn to midnight, characters can expect to find {@dice 1d6} human {@creature Commoner||commoners} bathing here at any given time. From midnight to dawn, three female human {@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|night blades} stand guard near the pools and attack trespassers on sight. If a fight breaks out here, the {@creature necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA} in {@adventure area D4|BGDIA|1|D4. North Massage Room} joins the fray in the second round of combat.
zh_tw: 從黎明到午夜之間的任何給定時間，冒險者們可以在裡面找到 {@dice 1d6} 名人類{@creature Commoner||平民}在那裡泡澡。而從午夜到黎明之間，三個女性人類{@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|夜刃}會守衛在澡池附近並且攻擊任何他們看到的入侵者。如果這裡發生戰鬥，位於{@adventure 區域D4|BGDIA|1|D4. North Massage Room}的{@creature necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|米爾寇之屍從}就會在戰鬥的第二輪加入打鬥。

english: Describe this location to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 按照下文為玩家們描述此地點：

english: The walls of this twenty-foot-high pillared chamber are adorned with frescoes of bathing royalty. Natural light streams through stained-glass windows, creating colorful patterns on the tiles of polished blue marble that cover the floor. Three shallow, sunken pools contain scintillating perfume-scented water. White marble benches bearing stacks of dry towels are situated near the pools, each of which comes equipped with a pair of brass faucets.
zh_tw: 這個有二十尺高的由立柱支撐的房間的牆用王族入浴的畫裝飾著，天然的光線透過彩色玻璃，在藍色的大理石地板上對映出五顏六色的的色塊。三個深淺合適的澡池填滿了氣味芳香且閃爍著波光的熱水。澡池旁邊的白色大理石長椅上堆放著乾淨的浴巾，並且每個都配備了一對黃銅水龍頭。

english: The faucets draw warm and cold water from pipes that run underneath the floor. A tight-fitting stone plug at the bottom of each pool keeps its water from draining out. Numerous tiny drain holes near the tops of the sunken pools prevent them from overflowing.
zh_tw: 水龍頭的冷水和熱水都是從地板下面的管道里抽出來的。每個池子下面都有一個石質的塞子堵住了放水口。池壁上端有一些小小的洞以防止池子裡的水溢滿出來。

english: D3. South Massage Room
zh_tw: D3. 南部按摩室

english: This room contains a massage table draped in clean towels. Bottles of perfume stored under the table are used to scent the pools in area D2. Natural light enters through a stained-glass window set into the south wall.
zh_tw: 房間裡擺著一個推拿桌，上面疊著不少乾淨的毛巾。桌子下面儲存著大量香水，用以給區域 D2 的水池增添香味。自然光從南牆上的彩色玻璃中照入。

english: During the hours in which the bathhouse is open, an androgynous human masseuse (neutral good {@creature commoner}) named Jabaz works here. Jabaz knows that the bathhouse is owned by {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} and run by her brutish son, Mortlock.
zh_tw: 在浴室開放的時間段裡面，一位雙性同體的人類按摩師（中立善良的人類{@creature commoner||平民}）在這裡工作，她叫雅巴茲。雅巴茲知道這個浴室是的老闆是{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}，以及浴室的運營是交給了她粗暴的兒子，摩特洛克。

english: Mortlock has given Jabaz strict orders not to hang around the bathhouse after hours. Jabaz suspects that Mortlock is running some sort of shady business on the side, and that he's using the establishment as a front to conceal his dark dealings without the duke's knowledge. Jabaz knows the location of the secret door in area D4 but won't volunteer that information, fearing Mortlock's retaliation. Jabaz doesn't know what lies beyond the secret door.
zh_tw: 摩特洛克責令雅巴茲不能在下班之後在浴室中逗留。雅巴茲懷疑摩特洛克把這座建築作為掩護隱藏他經營的某些不可告人且公爵不知情的黑暗生意。雅巴茲雖然知道區域的D4的密門的位置，但因為擔心被摩特洛克報復而不會主動告訴角色。雅巴茲不知道密門後面有什麼。

english: D4. North Massage Room
zh_tw: D4. 北部按摩室

english: From midnight to dawn, a male human {@creature necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA} guards this room unless he's drawn to {@adventure area D2|BGDIA|1|D2. Baths} by sounds of battle there. During the hours in which the bathhouse is open, a female human masseuse (neutral good {@creature commoner}) named Qurmilah works here. She knows the same information as Jabaz in area D3 and behaves similarly.
zh_tw: 在午夜到黎明間的時段，一個人類男性{@creature necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|米爾寇之屍從}會看守這個區域，除非他被{@adventure 區域D2|BGDIA|1|D2. Baths}的戰鬥聲響所吸引過去。在公共浴室營業的時間裡，一個叫做古拉密佈女性人類推拿師（中立善良{@creature commoner||平民}）在這裡工作。她和區域 D3 的雅巴茲知道的東西差不多，行為也差不多。

english: This room is furnished in the same fashion as area D3, with the additional feature of a secret door in the north wall. A character who searches the north wall and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door, which swings inward when pushed. A foul, sewer-like stench greets anyone who opens the secret door. Behind the door, a staircase descends 20 feet to {@adventure area D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}, featuring smooth stone steps and brick walls. Two sputtering torches in wall sconces illuminate the staircase, but the dungeon below is dark.
zh_tw: 這個房間的陳設與區域 D3 相同，北牆另外設有一扇密門。搜尋北牆並成功透過 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現密門；推門時，它會向內開啟。任何開啟密門的人都會聞到一股下水道般的惡臭。門後的樓梯沿著光滑的石階與磚牆向下延伸 20 尺，通往{@adventure 區域 D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}。牆上兩支噼啪作響的火把照亮了樓梯，下方的地城卻一片漆黑。

english: Map 1.3: Dungeon of the Dead Three
zh_tw: 地圖1.3：死亡三神的地城

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: D5. Welcome to the Dungeon
zh_tw: D5. 歡迎來到地下城

english: Duke Vanthampur became aware of this ancient dungeon while she was managing the city's water utilities and sewer system. She built the bathhouse to hide it.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾公爵在她管理公共供水設施和城市下水道系統時無意間發現了這個古代地下城，於是她就建立了一個公共浴室來掩飾該地城。

english: The chamber at the bottom of the staircase is empty, unlit, and flooded with foul-smelling water to a depth of 2 feet (see "Dungeon Features" below for more information).
zh_tw: 樓梯底部的房間是空蕩蕩而無光照的，並且被深約兩尺的臭烘烘的汙水所淹沒（請參閱下面的"地城特性"以獲取更多資訊）。

english: Dungeon Features
zh_tw: 地下城特徵物

english: The Dungeon of the Dead Three has the following recurring features:
zh_tw: 死亡三神的地城有著以下通用特徵：

english: The dungeon's rooms, corridors, and staircases are hewn from limestone and unlit unless the text states otherwise. (Followers of the Dead Three carry torches or rely on {@sense darkvision} to see in the dungeon.)
zh_tw: 地城裡的房間，走廊，樓梯都是用石灰岩做成的，並且如果沒有註明，則都是黑暗環境（死亡三神的信徒都會帶著火把或者依靠他們的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}來在地城中行動）

english: The 5-foot-wide corridors throughout the dungeon have 8-foot-high ceilings. Rooms have 9-foot-high ceilings, often braced with wooden beams. Each beam is a Large object with AC 15, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying all the beams in an area has a {@chance 25} chance of triggering a roof collapse. Each creature under the collapsing roof must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The area remains open but is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} thereafter.
zh_tw: 聯通地城的走廊都是 5 尺寬，8 尺高。房間則都是9 尺高，通常都由木樑支撐，每個房梁都是一個免疫毒素和心靈傷害擁，擁有 AC15 和 10HP 的大型物件。如果摧毀一個區域的所有房梁就會有 {@chance 25} 的機率觸發頂板崩落。每個在崩塌的屋頂下的生物都必須進行一次{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗則會受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）點鈍擊傷害，成功則傷害減半。整個區域在這之後視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: Regular doors are made of soft, rotting wood. Each door is a Medium object with AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Secret doors are carved to look like the surrounding limestone walls and require a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to locate. Once located, a secret door pushes open easily.
zh_tw: 常規的門都由鬆軟而腐爛的木頭製成。每個門都是一個免疫毒素和心靈傷害擁，擁有 AC15 和 5HP 的中型物件。密門看起來和周圍的石灰岩牆壁差不多，角色需要成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以確認密門的位置。而一旦被發現，密門就可以很輕鬆地推開。

english: Certain areas of the dungeon (as shown on {@adventure map 1.3|BGDIA|1|Map 1.3: Dungeon of the Dead Three}) are flooded with murky water to a depth of 2 feet to make them {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The water seeps into the dungeon from nearby sewers through cracks in the limestone. It carries a foul stench and is undrinkable.
zh_tw: 某些區域（如{@adventure 地圖 1.3|BGDIA|1|Map 1.3: Dungeon of the Dead Three}所示）被汙濁的水所淹沒，這些水有 2 尺深並使這些區域變為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。這些水是從附近的下水道透過石灰岩牆壁的縫隙滲透下來的。這水帶著一股惡臭並且不可飲用。

english: D6. Bloated Corpse
zh_tw: D6. 腫脹的屍體

english: Floating face-down in the middle of this flooded room is the bloated corpse of a shirtless male human with knife wounds in his back. The corpse was once a Bhaal worshiper named Hiskaal, who was killed by his cultist peers for allowing a target to escape during a recent attack in the city. Any character who inspects the corpse and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check concludes that the man has been dead for two days.
zh_tw: 這個被水淹沒的房間中漂浮著一具腫脹的赤膊男性屍體，在它的背後有著刀傷。這具屍體來自一個叫做黑斯卡爾的巴爾信徒，他在最近一次對城市的襲擊中讓他的目標逃走了，而他在之後則因此被他的教徒同僚所殺。任何檢視屍體並且成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 的感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定的角色可以發現這個男人死於兩天前。

english: D7. Bhaal's Altar
zh_tw: D7. 巴爾的祭壇

english: Describe this location to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 按照下文為玩家們描述此地點：

english: Three wooden beams brace the ceiling of this flooded chamber, which features a stone altar covered with entrails in the northeast corner. Hanging on the wall above the altar is a three-foot-tall steel mask cast in the form of a frowning human skull.
zh_tw: 三根木樑支撐著這個沒水房間的天花板，其最引人注目的是東北角那鋪滿了內臟的石質祭壇。祭壇上方三尺高的牆上掛著一個緊皺眉頭的鋼鐵骷髏面具。

english: The steel skull mask represents the visage of Bhaal and has no magical properties.
zh_tw: 這個金屬的骷髏面具代表著巴爾的面容，但沒有任何的魔法特性。

english: The humanoid entrails were left on the altar as an offering to the god of murder. Pouring a {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|vial of holy water} on the entrails causes them to melt away and also causes the altar to smolder.
zh_tw: 類人生物的內臟被留在祭壇上，作為獻給謀殺之神的祭品。將一瓶{@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|小聖水瓶}聖水倒在祭品上會使它們融化，並導致祭壇悶燒。

english: D8. Moldy Tapestry
zh_tw: D8. 發黴的掛毯

english: The back wall of this dry alcove is hung with a 5-foot-wide, 7-foot-tall tapestry. It depicts a grisly scene of four faceless figures ripping apart a fifth figure, who is screaming. Characters who inspect the tapestry without touching it notice yellow mold growing around its edges. In fact, a 5-foot-square patch of {@hazard yellow mold} (see {@hazard yellow mold||chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide}) clings to the back of the tapestry and releases its deadly spores if the tapestry is disturbed.
zh_tw: 這個乾燥凹室的後壁上掛著一張寬五尺長七尺的掛毯。掛毯上描繪著個四個無麵人將第五個慘叫的人四分五裂的可怕場景。嘗試觀察掛毯的角色可以在不觸控掛毯的情況下發現它邊緣的黃色黴菌。實際上一片覆蓋五尺的{@hazard yellow mold||黃黴菌}（請參閱{@hazard yellow mold||《城主指南》第五章}）依附在掛毯的背面，並且如果掛毯被弄亂，它就會釋放出致命的孢子。

english: D9. The Dead Three Doors
zh_tw: D9. 死亡三神之門

english: This chamber is empty but not bereft of decor. Carved into each of its three doors is a full-figure depiction of one of the Dead Three. A character recognizes all the figures with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check.
zh_tw: 這個房間雖然是空的但是並非完全沒有裝潢。三扇門上分別刻著死亡三神中的一位的全身像。成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 的智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定的角色可以辨識出所有的形象。

english: East Door
zh_tw: 東門

english: The face of this door bears a carving of Bane, the lawful evil god of tyranny, who is depicted as a tall, armored man wearing a bucket helm. His right gauntlet is painted black and clutches a set of shackles.
zh_tw: 這個門上雕刻著班恩，守序邪惡的暴政之神，他被描繪成一個高大、全身著甲頭戴桶盔的男人。他右手的鐵手套被塗成了黑色，並且手裡握著一副鐐銬。

english: North Door
zh_tw: 北門

english: This door bears a carving of Bhaal, the chaotic evil god of murder. He's depicted as a powerfully built, skull-headed man with long, curved blades where his hands should be.
zh_tw: 這個門上雕刻著巴爾，混亂邪惡的謀殺之神。他被描繪成一個有著強壯身體卻是骷髏頭顱的男人，而他本應是雙手的部位則是兩把長彎刀。

english: South Door
zh_tw: 南門

english: This door bears a carving of Myrkul, the neutral evil Lord of Bones. He is portrayed as a cloaked figure whose face is hidden under a cowl. In his skeletal hands, he clutches a screaming human skull.
zh_tw: 這個門上雕刻著米爾寇，中立邪惡的骸骨之主。他被描繪成一個披著斗篷，臉部隱藏在兜帽中的形象。他的骷髏手掌中抓著一個尖叫的人類頭骨。

english: D10. Necromites' Room
zh_tw: D10. 屍從房間

english: The creatures here watch area D9 through a crack in the door, and any sign of the characters approaching lets them set up an ambush of sorts. Read the following boxed text to describe the room to the players:
zh_tw: 這裡的生物一直透過門上的縫隙觀察著區域D9，有任何角色靠近的跡象都會使他們展開埋伏。請向玩家們朗讀以下框內文字來對該房間進行描述：

english: Lying on the floor of this otherwise empty room are the pale bodies of three humans in filthy black robes, arranged in a triangular formation. A lit torch lies between them. A rough-hewn staircase to the left leads down to another torchlit chamber.
zh_tw: 在這個空曠的房間裡躺著三具蒼白的人類屍體，他們穿著骯髒的黑色長袍，擺成一個三角形，中間倒著一個燃燒的火把。它左邊有一條看起來很粗糙的樓梯，向下是另外一個點著火把的房間。

english: These three {@creature Necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|necromites of Myrkul} are playing dead. They conceal their skull-headed flails underneath their robes. Any character who watches the bodies carefully can determine that they're alive with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.
zh_tw: 這三個{@creature Necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|米爾寇的屍從}正在裝死。他們把他們的骷髏連枷藏在長袍之下。任何仔細觀察他們並且成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色可以察覺到他們在裝死。

english: The necromites leap to their feet and attack when any character enters the room, or if they are attacked first. They fight to the death to guard the treasure in area D11.
zh_tw: 當任意角色進入房間或屍從被先攻擊時，屍從就會跳起來發動攻擊。他們會奮戰至死以保護區域D11 的寶藏。

english: D11. Partially Collapsed Crypt
zh_tw: D11. 部分坍塌的墓穴

english: This chamber has partially collapsed around a stone sarcophagus that was opened and looted long ago.
zh_tw: 這個房間已經部分地坍塌，坍塌物環繞著一具石棺，該石棺很久之前就被開啟並被掠奪過了。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The necromites in area D10 hid three spellbooks beneath the dust and humanoid bones in the sarcophagus, having stolen the books from murder victims.
zh_tw: 區域D10的屍從們在石棺的灰塵和人形骨骸下藏了三本從被謀殺的受害者那裡偷來的法術書。

english: Spellbook 1 is bound in red leather and contains the following spells: {@spell burning hands}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell fog cloud}, {@spell ray of sickness}, {@spell silent image}.
zh_tw: 法術書 1。這本書這本書用紅色皮革做封面，這本書中記有以下法術：{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell disguise self||易容術}，{@spell fog cloud||雲霧術}，{@spell ray of sickness||致病射線}，{@spell silent image||無聲幻影}。

english: Spellbook 2 has the personal rune of its previous owner burned into its umber cover. This book contains the following spells: {@spell charm person}, {@spell find familiar}, {@spell identify}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell sleep}.
zh_tw: 法術書2。這本法術書的褐色封面上印有這本書原來的主人的私人符文，這本書記有以下法術：{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}，{@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵}，{@spell identify||鑑定術}，{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}，{@spell sleep||睡眠術}。

english: Spellbook 3 is bound in scaly black reptile hide and contains the following spells: {@spell cloud of daggers}, {@spell darkvision}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell feather fall}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell Tasha's hideous laughter}.
zh_tw: 法術書3。這本書用黑色帶鱗的爬行動物皮裝訂，這本書記有以下魔法：{@spell cloud of daggers||匕首之雲}，{@spell darkvision||黑暗視覺}，{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，{@spell feather fall||羽落術}，{@spell mage armor||法師護甲}，{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}，{@spell Tasha's hideous laughter||塔莎狂笑術}。

english: D12. Bane's Altar
zh_tw: D12. 班恩的祭壇

english: Unless the characters take special care to approach quietly and without light sources, they alert the room's occupants. Describe this area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 除非角色們特別小心地安安靜靜且不持有光源地靠近，否則他們都將會驚動這個房間裡面的人。請向玩家們進行如下描述：

english: The eastern part of this room is unlit, flooded, and braced with floor-to-ceiling wooden beams. Rough-hewn steps rise out of the murky water to the western portion of the room, which is dry and lit by two torches in sconces that flank a stone altar. Shackled to the wall behind the altar is a sickly man in a loincloth with a burlap sack over his head. An alcove in the north wall contains a freestanding suit of plate armor missing its helm.
zh_tw: 房間的東部無光，浸水，並且被落地木樑柱所支撐著。粗製的階梯從渾濁的水中露出，通往乾燥的房間西部，那裡有著一個石制祭壇，其被兩支壁臺火把照亮著。祭壇後面的牆上銬著一個病弱的男人，他僅僅裹著遮羞布，而頭上套著麻袋。北牆的壁龕裡站著一套沒有頭盔的板甲。

english: Standing before the altar are two grim figures: a powerfully built woman clutching a mace, and an even bigger man wearing a bucket helm. The helmed man is jabbing the prisoner with a spear, causing him to twitch. Both figures are clad in chain mail, and the woman carries a wooden shield with a leering skull painted on it.
zh_tw: 有兩個形象殘忍的人站在祭壇面前：一個體格強壯的緊握著硬頭錘的女人，另一個是個更高大的戴著一個桶盔的男人。戴頭盔的男人正在用矛戳著那個囚徒，這使那個囚徒痛苦地抽搐。兩個人都身著鍊甲，並且那個女人還拿著一個木製盾牌，其上繪有一顆獰笑的骷髏頭。

english: The two armored figures are Kazzira, a female human {@creature fist of Bane|BGDIA}, and Yignath, a male human {@creature iron consul|BGDIA}. Yignath is torturing the prisoner for fun while Kazzira watches. Both attack intruders but prefer to remain on dry ground. The skull on Kazzira's shield has been painted in fresh blood. Hanging from Yignath's belt is an iron key ring with seven keys—one for the shackles above the altar, two for the shackles in {@adventure area D22|BGDIA|1|D22. Torture Chamber}, and four that unlock the chests in {@adventure area D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}.
zh_tw: 這兩個全副武裝的人分別是卡其拉，一位人類女性{@creature fist of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之拳}以及伊格納特，一位人類男性{@creature iron consul|BGDIA|鋼鐵領事}。伊格納特正在折磨犯人取樂而卡其拉正在觀看。他們都會攻擊入侵者但是他們傾向於留在乾燥的地帶。卡其拉的盾牌上的圖案是用鮮血繪製的。伊格納特的腰帶上有著一個鐵質的鑰匙環，上面掛著七把鑰匙——一把是用來解鎖祭壇旁的鐐銬的，另外兩把是用來解鎖{@adventure 區域D22|BGDIA|1|D22. Torture Chamber}的鐐銬的，剩下四把是用來開啟{@adventure 區域D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}的箱子的。

english: The prisoner hanging on the west wall is Klim Jhasso, a male human noble captured in the Lower City two days ago after his bodyguard was slain. Klim is a neutral evil {@creature noble} with 1 hit point remaining. He is unarmored (AC 10) and weaponless. He speaks Common and Elvish, but has no useful information to share. Klim guarantees that his family will pay a generous reward for his safe return to their estate in the Upper City—but the noble is lying. His mother is dead, his patriar father is ailing, and his three younger siblings crave their inheritance, which they would rather split three ways than four. The trading coster that the family part-owns is struggling and can't afford to pay any large reward or ransom.
zh_tw: 被鎖在西牆上的犯人是克里姆·賈斯索，一位人類男性貴族，兩天前他在下城區當自己的保鏢被殺後就被擄到了這裡。克里姆是一箇中立邪惡的{@creature noble||貴族}，他只剩下1HP。他沒有穿著任何護甲（AC10）且同時手無寸鐵。他會說通用語和精靈語，但是他沒有任何有用的資訊提供給角色。克里姆會保證如果角色們可以將他安全送回上城區的家族莊園的的話，他的家人能夠給予他們一筆豐厚的報酬——但這個貴族實際上是在撒謊。他的母親已逝，而身為宗貴的父親重病，他的三名弟妹們都渴求遺產並認為遺產被分割成三份總比四份好。而這個家族所部分擁有的貿易商隊都在艱難維持而根本無力支付大額的報酬或贖金。

english: Klim's shackles have AC 19, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 拷住克里姆的鐐銬有 AC 19，10 HP，並且免疫毒素和心靈傷害。

english: The suit of armor is welded together and is harmless, but its gauntlets are detachable. Both gauntlets are animated objects statistically identical to {@creature Flying Sword||flying swords}, except they deal bludgeoning damage instead of slashing damage. The gauntlets detach from the armor and attack anyone who disturbs them or frees the prisoner from his shackles.
zh_tw: 那套盔甲被焊到一起，並且使無害的，不過它的護手可以拆卸。這兩個護手都是活化物品，除了造成的是鈍擊傷害而非揮砍傷害外，資料與{@creature Flying Sword||凌空劍}完全相同。這雙護手會從盔甲中飛出攻擊任何碰了它們或從鐐銬中解救囚徒的人。

english: D13. Morgue
zh_tw: D13. 停屍房

english: Unless the characters approach this room quietly and without light sources, they alert the occupants here. Describe the area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 除非角色安靜且不持有光源地靠近,否則他們將會驚動這個房間裡面的人。向角色進行如下描述：

english: This partially collapsed room has three wooden beams bracing its ceiling. Situated between the beams is a scorched wooden table with a human cadaver resting atop it. A frighteningly thin woman in a black robe is studying the corpse, her face largely hidden under a cowl. Around her feet creep a swarm of {@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 這個部分坍塌的房間由三根木柱支撐，木柱之間擺放著一個燒焦的木桌，上面放著一具人類屍體。一個面容可怖的瘦女人穿著黑色長袍在那裡研究屍體。她的臉隱藏在兜帽之下，她的腳下圍繞著一群{@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA|骷髏鼠}。

english: The necromancer looming over the corpse is Flennis, a female human {@creature master of souls|BGDIA} and the highest-ranking follower of Myrkul in the dungeon. Use the {@creature swarm of rats} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} to represent Flennis' {@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA}, which are undead instead of beasts. The swarm can be turned by any character with the Turn Undead feature, but spells that target beasts have no effect on it.
zh_tw: 這個一直在研究屍體的死靈法師叫福尼斯，她是一個人類女性{@creature master of souls|BGDIA|馭魂者}，她同時是這個地城裡最高等階的米爾寇信徒。對於福尼斯的{@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA|骷髏鼠}採用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature swarm of rats||鼠群}資料面板，但將野獸詞條替換成不死生物。任何具有驅散不死生物能力的角色都能驅散這群骷髏鼠，但是任何目標為野獸的法術無法在它們身上生效。

english: Flennis is preparing to make a zombie out of the corpse on the table, but the {@spell animate dead} spell takes 1 minute to cast, which means she must deal with the characters first. Her {@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA} attack the nearest foe, and she casts spells while using the table for cover.
zh_tw: 福尼斯正準備將桌子上的屍體轉換成殭屍，但是{@spell animate dead||活化死屍}需要一分鐘的時間來施展，所以她必須得先解決角色們。她的{@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA|骷髏鼠}會攻擊最近的敵人而她自己則會依靠桌子為掩體進行施法。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to her robe and her flail, Flennis carries a dusty spellbook that contains all the spells she has prepared. The book has black leather covers and sports a tiny, skull-shaped locking mechanism. Flennis has the key to the lock stuck in her hair. A character can also pick the lock with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check made with {@item thieves' tools|phb}.
zh_tw: 除了她的長袍和連枷之外，福尼斯還帶著一本沾滿塵土的法術書，上面記載了所有她已經準備的魔法。這本書有一個黑色的皮革封面並被一個小的頭骨形狀的機械裝置鎖住了。福尼斯把鑰匙藏在了她的頭髮裡。角色也可以透過使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}透過一次 {@dc 10} 的敏捷檢定開啟這個鎖。

english: The first time a creature other than Flennis opens the book, a wisp of black smoke rises from its pages and coalesces into a skull that cackles madly for a few seconds before dissipating. The creature holding the book when the smoke appears must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be cursed for 24 hours, during which time the creature has vulnerability to necrotic damage. A {@spell remove curse} spell or similar effect ends the curse on the creature.
zh_tw: 如果有除了福尼斯以外的生物首次開啟這本書，書頁中會湧出一股黑煙然後凝聚成一股骷髏頭併發出咯咯的瘋狂大笑幾秒鐘，然後消失。拿書的生物在黑煙出現時必須進行一次 {@dc 14} 的體質豁免，否則將被詛咒 24 小時，在這段時間內該生物將對暗蝕傷害具有易傷。法術{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或者類似的效應可以提前結束這個詛咒。

english: D14. Hungry Rat
zh_tw: D14. 飢餓的老鼠

english: An ordinary {@creature rat} scurries around this room, looking for scraps of food. If the characters use a {@spell speak with animals} spell or similar magic to communicate with the rat, it can share its knowledge of the dungeon with them. It warms to characters who offer it food.
zh_tw: 一隻普通的{@creature rat||老鼠}正在這個房間裡亂竄，尋找著食物的碎屑。如果角色們使用法術{@spell speak with animals||動物交談}或者任何類似效果的能力與老鼠交流的話，它會把它所知知道與地城相關的資訊告訴角色。它會對向他提供食物的角色更加友好一些。

english: The rat's knowledge is limited to places it has visited—specifically {@adventure areas D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon} through {@adventure D26|BGDIA|1|D26. Bhaal's Rest}. It doesn't know the location of secret doors, so it's unaware of {@adventure areas D27|BGDIA|1|D27. Echoes of Battle} through {@adventure D33|BGDIA|1|D33. Covenant of the Dead Three}, which are hidden behind the secret door in {@adventure area D23|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}.
zh_tw: 老鼠所知道的資訊僅於他去過的地方，具體一點來說是從{@adventure 區域D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}到{@adventure D26|BGDIA|1|D26. Bhaal's Rest}的區域，它不知道密門的位置，所以他也不會知道{@adventure 區域D23|BGDIA|1|D27. Echoes of Battle}密門後的的區域，即{@adventure 區域D27|BGDIA|1|D33. Covenant of the Dead Three}到{@adventure D33|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}。

english: D15. Flooded Room
zh_tw: D15. 被水淹沒的房間

english: The flooded, rubble-strewn tunnels leading to and from this room narrow to a width of 2½ feet in places. Four rotting wooden beams rise from the murky water to brace the ceiling here. Rubble piled in the northwest corner contains nothing of interest.
zh_tw: 通往這個房間的隧道積滿汙水、散落碎石，部分位置窄至 2½ 尺。四根腐朽的木樑從混濁水中豎起，支撐著天花板。西北角的碎石堆裡沒有值得留意的東西。

english: D16. Flooded Crypt
zh_tw: D16. 被水淹沒的墓穴

english: Murky, foul-smelling water surrounds an open stone sarcophagus resting in the middle of this crypt, its stone lid lying broken in three pieces under the water north of it. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of evocation magic around the sarcophagus. Characters who pull the lid fragments out of the water see that the lid was carved in the likeness of a screaming, axe-wielding barbarian.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡滿是渾濁不堪的臭水中間放著一個開啟的石棺，它的棺材板被碎成了三塊落在了北側的水裡，使用法術{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}可以偵測出石棺周邊有散發著塑能魔法的靈光。從水中拉出棺材板碎片的角色可以會看到上面刻著一名正在怒吼的持斧野蠻人。

english: Exposure to the dampness has rotted the bones in the sarcophagus, reducing them to black sludge.
zh_tw: 因暴露在潮溼的空氣中，石棺中的骨頭已經降解了一團黑色的爛泥。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: If the contents of the sarcophagus are disturbed, a ghostly battleaxe appears above the sarcophagus. The battleaxe is created by magic similar to a {@spell spiritual weapon} spell and is treated as a 2nd-level spell effect for the purpose of dispelling it. The ghostly battleaxe can't be harmed, can't leave the room, and targets only creatures, acting on initiative count 20. On each of its turns, it moves up to 10 feet and makes a melee spell attack ({@hit 5} to hit) against an available target, dealing 6 ({@dice 1d8 + 2}) force damage on a hit. The effect ends when there are no longer any creatures in the room, and the trap resets after 24 hours.
zh_tw: 如果石棺內的物品被擾動，一把幽體戰斧會出現在石棺上方。這把戰斧由與{@spell spiritual weapon||靈體武器}法術相似的魔法創造，並且在解除魔法時被視為2環法術效應。幽體戰斧無法被傷害，無法離開房間，並且只以生物為目標，在先攻值20時行動。在它的每個回合，它可以移動最多10尺並對一個可用目標進行一次近戰法術攻擊（命中{@hit 5}），命中時造成6（{@dice 1d8 + 2}）力場傷害。當房間內不再有生物時，效應結束，陷阱會在24小時後重置。

english: D17. Myrkul's Altar
zh_tw: D17. 米爾寇的祭壇

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players when their characters first enter the room:
zh_tw: 當角色第一次進入這個房間時，請向玩家們朗讀或意譯以下框內文字：

english: This dry, partially collapsed room contains a stone altar with humanoid skulls and bones piled around it. The top of the altar is covered with dozens of half-melted candles made of black wax, all currently unlit.
zh_tw: 這個地方沒有積水，還有部分地方發生了坍塌，裡面祭壇的四周堆滿了人類的顱骨和各種骨頭。祭壇的上面擺放著很多燒了一半的黑色蠟燭，現在都是滅著的。

english: If one or more of the black candles on the altar are lit, they shed a green light that reveals black writing on the walls. The writing, which is not visible otherwise, says in Common, "RISE AND BE COUNTED!" If these words are spoken aloud within 5 feet of the altar, the words vanish as bones hidden under the debris at the north end of the room rise up and knit together, forming three animated human {@creature Skeleton||skeletons}. The skeletons are evil undead, but they obey the commands of whoever spoke the words that raised them, serving that individual until they're destroyed or their master is killed.
zh_tw: 如果祭壇上有任何一隻或者超過一隻蠟燭被點燃了，它們會發出綠光並且照亮牆上所書寫的黑色文字。牆上的文字除此之外在任何情況下都不可見。文字是通用語寫的"甦醒，現身！"如果有人在距離祭壇五尺之內大聲說出這些話，北側廢墟下埋藏的白骨就會飛出並排列組合形成三具活動的人類{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}，之後文字會消失。這些骷髏是邪惡的不死生物，但他們會聽從那個將他們召喚出來的人的命令，他們會在被摧毀或者主人死亡前一直服務於他。

english: D18. Gas Buildup
zh_tw: D18. 瓦斯匯聚

english: The ceiling of this flooded room is supported by numerous wooden beams. The air here smells like rotten eggs, a putrid stench that carries beyond the room. Any character approaching this area who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check realizes that the stench is an indicator of flammable gas in the room. This gas disperses before reaching other areas of the dungeon, and the Dead Three cultists extinguish their torches before moving through this area.
zh_tw: 這個淹水的房間被很多根木質的柱子支撐著，這裡的空氣聞起來像是臭雞蛋，整個房間都被一股噁心的惡臭所籠罩。任何靠近這個區域併成功透過進行一次 {@dc 10} 的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定的角色可以發現這股臭味表示房間裡充滿了易燃瓦斯。瓦斯在飄進其他區域前就已逸散。而那些死亡三神的教徒們則會在進入這個區域前熄滅他們的火把。

english: Bringing a lit torch or other open flame into the gas-filled room triggers an explosion that fills the chamber. Creatures fully immersed in the water take no damage, but all others must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. All the wooden beams that support the ceiling are destroyed in the explosion, which could cause a roof collapse (see "{@area Dungeon Features|044|x}" in {@adventure area D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}). The explosion also burns away the gas, which builds up slowly and becomes dangerous again after 24 hours.
zh_tw: 攜帶任何點燃的火把或者是其他明火進入這個瓦斯聚集的區域都會引發整個房間的爆炸。完全浸入在水中的生物不會受到任何傷害，其他生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則遭受 14（{@dice 4d6}）點火焰傷害，成功則傷害減半。所有支撐著天花板的柱子將在爆炸中被摧毀，並且可能造成房間的塌方（請參閱{@adventure 區域D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}的"{@area 地下城特徵物|044|x}"）。爆炸同樣會燃盡瓦斯氣體，而瓦斯會緩慢地重新湧入房間並且在 24 小時後重新充滿整個房間。

english: D19. Partially Collapsed Crypt
zh_tw: D19. 部分坍塌的墓穴

english: Much of this room has fallen in, with the debris field mostly burying a stone sarcophagus that was looted years ago. Nothing of interest remains.
zh_tw: 這個房間的大部分區域都已經坍塌了，廢墟遮住了石棺的大部分區域，石棺也在多年前被掠奪乾淨了，這個區域沒有任何有用的東西。

english: D20. Half-Plundered Crypt
zh_tw: D20. 被掠奪過的墓穴

english: An open sarcophagus stands at the back of this dusty crypt, its heavy stone lid lying on its side between the sarcophagus and the south wall. The north-facing side of the sarcophagus bears faded frescoes of spear-wielding warriors charging across golden plains on horseback.
zh_tw: 一個被開啟的石棺放置在這個這滿是灰塵的墓穴中，它那厚重的棺材板被放在了石棺和南牆之間的地板上。石棺的朝北的一面有副已經褪色的壁畫，繪有一個持矛戰士正坐在馬鞍上衝過金色的平原。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A casual search of the sarcophagus turns up nothing but dust and a few scattered humanoid bones. Any character who conducts a thorough search realizes that the sarcophagus has a false bottom made of inch-thick plaster. Smashing through this plaster layer reveals a cavity below that contains a human mummy floating in a shallow pool of red brine. The mummy has two moonstones (50 gp each) embedded in its eye sockets and a {@item bag of beans} where its heart would normally be. Characters must intentionally tear open the mummy's chest to find the hidden bag. The mummy is inanimate and doesn't protest the theft.
zh_tw: 如果僅僅是對石棺進行一次粗略的搜尋則除了弄一手灰和發現一堆零散的人類骸骨之外什麼都發現不了。任何進行了一次細緻搜查的角色就會發現石棺底部有一個幾寸厚的石膏假底。砸開石膏板會發現一個人類木乃伊漂浮在下面一個裝有紅色鹽水的池子中。木乃伊的眼睛上是兩個月長石（每個 50 GP），在本應是心臟處的是{@item bag of beans||魔豆之袋}。角色們只有在刻意開啟木乃伊胸腔的情況下才能找到隱藏的袋子。這具木乃伊沒有被活化也抵抗不了盜賊。

english: D21. Zombie Crypt
zh_tw: D21. 殭屍墓穴

english: Characters who listen at the door to this room hear faint humanoid moans in the room beyond. Describe the area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 如果有角色靠著門偷聽的話，他們會聽到有微弱的類人生物的呻吟聲從房間裡面傳來。請向玩家們對房間進行如下描述：

english: Six moaning humans with rotting flesh shamble about this dusty crypt, which reeks of death. An open stone sarcophagus rests against the back wall, its shattered lid lying in pieces on the floor around it.
zh_tw: 六個低聲呻吟，長滿腐肉的人類在這個滿是塵土的墓穴中蹣跚而行，散發出死亡的氣味，一個被開啟的石棺背靠著後牆放著，它那碎裂的棺材板零零散散地落在附近的地板上。

english: The shambling corpses are six {@creature Zombie||zombies} created by Flennis (see {@adventure area D13|BGDIA|1|D13. Morgue}) from the remains of the Dead Three cultists' murder victims. The zombies obey only their creator and attack all others, including other members of the Dead Three cult.
zh_tw: 這些蹣跚的屍體是 6 具{@creature Zombie||喪屍}，他們是福尼斯（詳見{@adventure 區域D13|BGDIA|1|D13. Morgue}）用死亡三神教徒所謀殺的受害者的屍體製造的。這些殭屍只聽命於他們的創造者，並且會攻擊其他任何人，就算是其他死亡三神的教徒也不例外。

english: Carved into the north-facing side of the sarcophagus are ghastly images of human cannibalism. The sarcophagus was plundered long ago, and a search of its interior yields up only a jawless human skull and a few bone fragments.
zh_tw: 石棺朝北的一面雕著人類相食的恐怖景象。這個石棺在很久之前就被掠奪了，搜尋它的內部只會發現一個沒有下巴的人類頭骨和一些骨架。

english: D22. Torture Chamber
zh_tw: D22. 拷問室

english: Followers of Bane torture and interrogate prisoners here. Describe this room to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 班恩的教徒們在這裡拷問和折磨囚犯。請向玩家們對該房間進行以下描述：

english: The walls and floor of this room are covered with streaks and splashes of dried blood. Two dangling bodies are shackled to the east and south walls. One is an elderly male human; the other, a young female tiefling. Both are covered in bloody gashes, and neither is moving. In the middle of the room is a sturdy wooden chair with a bloody whip draped over it. A bucket half filled with salt sits on the floor nearby.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆和地板上滿是條條點點的乾涸血跡。有兩個人分別被懸掛著拷在東牆和南牆上。一個是中年人類男性，而另一個是個年輕的女性提夫林。他們都傷痕累累，無法行動。房間的正中間放著一個堅固的木製椅子，上面放著一根染血的鞭子。旁邊地板上還放了半桶鹽。

english: The followers of Bane rub salt into the wounds of the prisoners they torture here. Yignath the iron consul (see {@adventure area D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}) carries the keys to both sets of shackles, which have AC 19, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A character with {@item thieves' tools|phb} can unlock a set of shackles with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 這裡的班恩信徒們透過給囚犯的傷口抹鹽來折磨他們，鋼鐵執政官伊格納特（請參閱{@adventure 區域D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}）的鑰匙可以用來開啟這兩套枷鎖，這些枷鎖持有AC19，10HP，並免疫毒素和心靈傷害。持有{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}的角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定開啟一套枷鎖。

english: The male human is dead. He was Effinax Zalbor, a caravan coordinator employed by the Jhasso patriar family, which is part-owner of a trading coster that operates throughout the Western Heartlands (see {@adventure area D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}).
zh_tw: 人類男性已經死亡，他叫艾菲納克斯·扎爾波爾，他是一支遍及西哈特蘭德的商隊的股東賈斯索元老家族（請參閱{@adventure 區域D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}）所僱來的商隊協調員。

english: The female tiefling has 0 hit points, and is {@condition unconscious} but stable. She is Vendetta Kress, a neutral {@creature commoner} who speaks Common and Infernal. She has resistance to fire damage and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. Vendetta distributes wine and spirits for the Oathoon patriar family of Baldur's Gate, and was attacked in the Lower City, knocked {@condition unconscious}, and brought here to be tortured. Under interrogation, she gave her captors information regarding the Oathoons and their security arrangements. She also witnessed the interrogation and death of Effinax, who was questioned at length about the Jhasso family.
zh_tw: 女性提夫林擁有 0 HP，她處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}但傷勢穩定的狀態。她叫溫達特·克雷斯，一位絕對中立的{@creature commoner||平民}，她會說通用語和煉獄語。她擁有火焰傷害的抗性和 60 尺的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。溫達特負責幫博德之門的奧申元老家族銷售葡萄酒和烈酒，她在下城區遭到了襲擊被打暈{@condition unconscious||昏迷}並被送到這裡來遭受折磨。在審訊中，她交代了奧申元老家族的安保措施。她也見證了對艾菲納克斯的審訊和他的死亡，艾菲納克斯被詳細的詢問了有關賈斯索元老家族的問題。

english: If set free, Vendetta stays with the characters until an opportunity to escape presents itself. Before that, though, she shares the following piece of information with her liberators. During her incarceration, she heard what sounded like a heavy stone door scraping open and closed from time to time, accompanied by the sound of splashing footsteps. The noise came from the north. This information might lead characters to search for a secret door in that direction (see area D23).
zh_tw: 如果她被釋放了，溫達特會一直跟隨角色直到出現逃離的機會。在那之前，她會和釋放她的人分享情報。在被囚禁期間，她總是聽到像是有厚重的石門摩擦著開開關關的聲音，同時伴隨涉水的腳步聲。這個聲音是北方傳來的。這條資訊可能會引導角色們去搜尋那個方向的密門（請參閱區域D23）。

english: If Vendetta survives her ordeal in the dungeon, she spreads tales of her harrowing escape through her web of contacts in Baldur's Gate, which includes just about every tavern proprietor in the city.
zh_tw: 如果溫達特可以活著離開地城，她會把自己逃脫的恐怖經歷分享給她在博德之門的那些生意夥伴，也就是這座城市的每個酒館老闆。

english: D23. Secret Door and Sentry
zh_tw: D23. 密門和崗哨

english: This flooded tunnel has a secret door in the north wall that swings open into {@adventure area D27|BGDIA|1|D27. Echoes of Battle}. Standing in the water south of the secret door, holding a lit torch and watching the west stairway, is a male {@creature fist of Bane|BGDIA}. On his first turn after seeing the characters, he withdraws to {@adventure area D25|BGDIA|1|D25. Bane's Rest} and pounds on the door to wake his fellow cultists, yelling "Intruders!" at the top of his lungs to alert the occupant of {@adventure area D26|BGDIA|1|D26. Bhaal's Rest}.
zh_tw: 這個淹水的通道的北牆有一扇通往{@adventure 區域D27|BGDIA|1|D27. Echoes of Battle}的密門。站在密門南側的是一個打著火把看守著西側樓梯的男性{@creature fist of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之拳}。在他發現角色們後的其第一個回合，他會立刻撤向{@adventure 區域D25|BGDIA|1|D25. Bane's Rest}砸門喚醒他的教徒同伴們，並用盡氣力的大喊："入侵者！"來警告{@adventure 區域D26|BGDIA|1|D26. Bhaal's Rest}的人。

english: D24. Myrkul's Rest
zh_tw: D24. 米爾寇信徒休息區

english: Followers of Myrkul use this plundered crypt as a place to rest. Describe it to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 米爾寇的信徒們在這個被掠奪了的墓室裡面休息。請向玩家們對該地區進行以下描述：

english: Four flickering torches in wall sconces illuminate this crypt, the middle of which is occupied by an open stone sarcophagus. The sarcophagus bears no carvings or other ornamentation, but is full of humanoid skulls and bones. Six dusty bedrolls lie on the floor around it.
zh_tw: 四支明暗閃爍的火把插在牆上點亮了整個墓穴，墓穴的中間放著一個被開啟的石棺。石棺上沒有任何的雕刻或者裝飾，但裡面裝滿了人形骨骸。地上擺放著六個髒兮兮的鋪蓋。

english: The Myrkulites filled the sarcophagus with skulls and bones found throughout the dungeon, creating an altar of sorts to the Lord of Bones.
zh_tw: 米爾寇的信徒們用從地城中搜集過來的骸骨堆滿了這個石棺上，造出一個骸骨之主的祭壇。

english: D25. Bane's Rest
zh_tw: D25. 班恩信徒休息區

english: Slumped against the walls of this plundered, partially collapsed crypt are four sleeping {@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|fists of Bane}. All are fully armored and have their weapons nearby. If awakened by loud noises or the guard in {@adventure area D23|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}, they grab their weapons and quickly mobilize to repel any intrusion.
zh_tw: 在這個部分坍塌且被洗劫一空的墓穴裡，四個{@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之拳}正耷拉著靠在牆邊坐著睡覺。他們都穿著盔甲，同時他們的武器就在手邊。如果他們被{@adventure 區域D23|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}的守衛或者巨大的噪聲吵醒，他們會撿起武器並且迅速集合起來擊退入侵者。

english: The room is lit by two sputtering torches in sconces on the north and west walls. A stone sarcophagus in the middle of the room stands empty, its lid half buried under rubble on the floor behind it.
zh_tw: 這個房間被西牆和北牆上的兩個明暗不定的火把照亮，中間有一個空空如也的石棺，它的棺材板被碎石堆半埋在了後面。

english: D26. Bhaal's Rest
zh_tw: D26. 巴爾信徒休息區

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text when the characters enter this area for the first time:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次進入該區域時，請朗讀或意譯以下框內文字：

english: Four flickering torches in wall sconces light this partially collapsed crypt. An open sarcophagus in the middle of the area is filled to the rim with blood, with spillage streaking the sides of the sarcophagus and pooling around its base. The sarcophagus lid lies half buried under rubble behind it.
zh_tw: 牆上的四支閃爍的火把點亮了這個部分塌方了的墓穴，中間被開啟的石棺裡為鮮血所充滿，溢位的血液在石棺上流下一道道血痕。石棺的棺材板被半埋在後面的廢墟中。

english: Bhaal worshipers like to bathe in the human blood that fills the sarcophagus. A female {@creature reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA} lurks behind the sarcophagus, drenched in blood from head to toe. At the first sign of intruders, she uses a {@spell disguise self} spell to appear as a frail old woman named Nebra. In this guise, she claims to be a florist who was captured by the Dead Three and brought to the dungeon as a slave. If the characters fall for the act and bring Nebra with them, she claims to know the location of a secret door ({@adventure area D23|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}) and tries to lead them through it to {@adventure area D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}, where she hopes to find reinforcements. If she leads the party to a location occupied by other cultists, she drops the disguise and attacks. She also attacks if her spell ends before then.
zh_tw: 巴爾的信徒們喜歡用這個石棺中的人血泡澡。一個女性{@creature reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的收割者}正躲在石棺後面，讓血液浸透她的全身。一有入侵者的跡象，她就會馬上給自己使用法術{@spell disguise self||易容術}來偽裝成一個叫做尼布拉的憔悴老女人。在偽裝時，她會聲稱自己以前是一個花農，被死亡三神綁過來後成為了奴隸。如果角色們沒有識破她的偽裝的話，她會聲稱自己知道暗門的位置（{@adventure 區域D23|BGDIA|1|D23. Secret Door and Sentry}），並且嘗試帶著角色們透過密門到達{@adventure 區域D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}，她希望在那裡能夠找到援兵。如果她把小隊帶到其他有教徒聚集的地方的話，她就會解除偽裝並且攻擊角色。她同樣也會在自己的法術失效前就對角色發起攻擊。

english: D27. Echoes of Battle
zh_tw: D27. 戰鬥迴響

english: This ten-foot-wide flooded passage is braced at regular intervals by wooden beams. Old torch stubs float on the murky water. At the point where the tunnel bends west toward {@adventure area D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}, the characters hear echoes of a battle unfolding in that location.
zh_tw: 這個 10 尺寬的淹水通道是由幾根間隔的木樑所支撐的。破舊的火把頭漂浮在汙水上。當角色們到達通向{@adventure 區域D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}的西向拐角時，他們會聽到那邊傳過來戰鬥的聲音。

english: D28. Old Cellar
zh_tw: D28. 舊地窖

english: This flooded room was once a cellar, with the collapsed eastern passage marking a staircase that formerly led up to a residence in the city. Hidden under the murky water are four animated human {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} that rise up and attack anyone who crosses the room.
zh_tw: 這個淹水的房間曾經是一個地窖，東側已經坍塌的通道中露出了幾節樓梯，表明以前這裡是和外界連線的通道。在汙水下有四具被活化的的{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}會爬起來並攻擊任何穿越這個房間的人。

english: D29. Mortlock Vanthampur
zh_tw: D29. 摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾

english: The sounds of combat intensify as the characters approach this area. Describe the scene to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 當角色們逐漸靠近這個區域的時候，戰鬥的聲響會逐漸增強。請向玩家們如下描述這個場景：

english: Beyond the hall, a flooded chamber opens up with rough-hewn steps climbing to the south, north, and northeast. The floor buckles up above the water line in the middle of the room, forming a small island. Corpses and doused torches float in the water around the island, atop which two men circle each other with weapons bared. One of the men—a tall, unarmored brute with a greatclub and a scarred face—towers above his opponent but is gravely wounded. The smaller figure is muscular and bare-chested. He clutches a bloody dagger in one hand and a torch in the other, and has no flesh covering his skull.
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭外的是一個漫水的房間，在房間的南邊，北邊和東北方各有階梯向上攀升延伸。房間中間的地板從水中隆起了一小塊，形成了一個小島。屍體和浸水的火把在這個小島的四周漂浮著，在小島上站著兩個手持武器，兵鋒相對的男人。其中一個男人，一個高大無甲、臉上滿布傷疤的兇獸，手裡拿著巨棒，居高臨下面對著他的對手，但是他已經傷痕累累。另一個矮小些的身影則是渾身肌肉，袒胸露背。他一隻手緊握著一個滴血的匕首，另一隻手握著一個火把，而他的頭顱上沒有任何血肉。

english: The man with the greatclub is twenty-nine-year-old {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA}, who has 30 hit points left. His opponent is an uninjured {@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA} named Vaaz. Four other Dead Three cultists lie dead in the water, their skulls caved in by Mortlock.
zh_tw: 拿著大棒的男人是正是 29 歲的{@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}，他只剩下 30 HP了。而他的對手卻是一名沒有受傷的{@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的死神之首}，他的名字叫做瓦茲。還有其他四個死亡三神的教徒的屍體漂浮在水裡，他們的腦袋都被摩特洛克砸扁了。

english: Mortlock is tolerated by his mother, {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}, and despised by his older brothers, Thurstwell and Amrik, who view him as a simpleton and an abomination. Half of Mortlock's face was scarred by fire when he was a child, and his disfigurement gives him a fearsome countenance. He was sent to the bathhouse dungeon by his mother to help the followers of the Dead Three coordinate attacks against the city. When it became clear that the Dead Three cultists could function without Mortlock's support, Thurstwell and Amrik conspired with several Bhaal cultists to assassinate Mortlock without their mother's knowledge.
zh_tw: 摩特洛克雖然被他的母親{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}所容忍；但是他其他的哥哥們，瑟斯維爾和阿姆利克卻都很鄙視他，他們覺得他只是一個可惡的蠢貨。摩特洛克的半張臉因為小時候的燒傷留下了傷疤，這也使他有著一張可怕的臉。他被他母親派到公共浴室來負責幫助和協調死亡三神的信徒的襲擊。當意識到死亡三神的信徒們完全可以在沒有摩特洛克的幫助下運作後，瑟斯維爾和阿姆利克便派遣了幾個巴爾的教徒來刺殺他，當然，他們的母親對此並不知情。

english: Mortlock and Vaaz stop fighting when the characters arrive. Believing them to be Mortlock's associates, Vaaz disengages from the fight on his next turn and withdraws to {@adventure area D33|BGDIA|1|D33. Covenant of the Dead Three}, where he makes his final stand. Vaaz takes his torch with him. Rather than pursuing, Mortlock tries to forge an alliance with the characters. If they come to terms with Mortlock, he gives them the following information in exchange for a promise of amnesty:
zh_tw: 摩特洛克和瓦茲會在角色們到達後停止戰鬥，瓦茲會誤認為角色們是來幫助摩特洛克的所以會在他的下一回合停止戰鬥並且撤退到{@adventure 區域D33|BGDIA|1|D33. Covenant of the Dead Three}，他將在那裡進行他的最後抵抗。瓦茲會帶著他的火把一起。摩特洛克則會暫時停止追擊，嘗試和角色們結盟。如果雙方談妥了的話，摩特洛克則會給角色們以下資訊以此來換取讓自己活命的承諾：

english: "I was betrayed. These assassins conspired with my brothers to kill me. If you hadn't come along, I'd be dead. I owe you my life."
zh_tw: "我被背叛了，這些刺客被我的哥哥們派來殺我。如果不是你們趕到，我估計我就得死了。我欠你們一條命。"

english: "My family is paying the Dead Three cultists to murder people in the city. Our goal is to prove that the Flaming Fist can't do its job. Once the city stops paying them, the Flaming Fist will have less of a reason to stay in Baldur's Gate. With them gone, no one can stand in the way of my mother becoming the city's next grand duke. If she gets her way, Baldur's Gate will share Elturel's fate and get dragged down into the Nine Hells."
zh_tw: "我的家族正在付錢給死亡三神信徒讓他們來謀殺城市裡的人。其目的是為了證明焰拳無法恪盡職守。一旦城市不再給他們付錢，焰拳就會失去留在博德之門的理由。一旦他們走了，就沒有人能夠阻止我母親成為下一任大公。一旦她得償所願，她就會讓博德之門遭受與艾爾托瑞爾同樣的厄運，被送到九層地獄去。"

english: "My mother is one of the three remaining members of the Council of Four, which governs Baldur's Gate. She was instrumental in convincing {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} to travel to Elturel and meet with its high overseer, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}. With Ravengard gone, the Flaming Fist is leaderless and vulnerable."
zh_tw: "我的母親是四人統議會剩下的三人中的一人，他們現在正在管理著博德之門。她同時也在說服{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}大公前往艾爾托瑞爾去會晤最高監視者{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}這事裡起了重要作用。現在瑞文嘉德失蹤了，焰拳也就變得群龍無首不堪一擊了。"

english: "The Dead Three cultists receive regular payments from my brother, Amrik, who runs his own moneylending business out of a tavern called the Low Lantern. My mother doesn't expect much of me, but she thinks the world of Amrik. He's always been her favorite."
zh_tw: "死亡三神的教徒們會定期得到我兄弟阿姆利克的資助，他在一個叫做矮提燈的酒館經營著借貸生意。我母親對我沒什麼期望，但是她很喜歡阿姆利克，他一直都是母親的最愛。"

english: "My oldest brother, Thurstwell, uses imps as spies throughout the city. He has the bathhouse under surveillance and probably knows you're here. He's very sickly and seldom leaves our mother's estate."
zh_tw: "我的大哥，瑟斯維爾，他一直使用小魔鬼在整個城市裡來作為探子。他同樣也監視著公共浴室，所以他多半知道你們來到這了。他非常地病弱，很少會離開我們母親的房子。"

english: "If you've made it this far, you've killed most of the leaders of the Dead Three cult. Without them, the cult will break up. The cultists keep their treasure nearby." (Mortlock points toward {@adventure area D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}.)
zh_tw: "既然你們已經能夠走到這兒，說明你們已經殺掉了絕大部分的死亡三神教會的領導者。而沒有了他們，這個教會也就將瓦解了。而這些教徒的寶藏就藏在了那裡。"（摩特洛克指向{@adventure 區域D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}。）

english: If the characters let him go, Mortlock hides in the city until he can book passage on a ship and leave Baldur's Gate. He has no intention of ever returning.
zh_tw: 如果角色讓他離開的話，摩特洛克會藏匿在城市中直到他有辦法弄到一艘船離開博德之門，同時他也再也不打算回來了。

english: Mortlock is afraid to confront his mother or his brothers. That said, a successful {@dc 14} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check can convince him to help the characters capture or kill Amrik at the {@area Low Lantern|080|x}. After doing so, Mortlock leaves the city as quickly as possible to escape his mother's wrath.
zh_tw: 摩特洛克害怕與他的母親和兄弟發生衝突。成功透過一次 {@dc 14} 的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可以讓他協助角色們活捉或者擊殺{@area 矮提燈|080|x}的阿姆利克。如果他這麼做了，摩特洛克會用最快的速度逃離他母親的怒火。

english: {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}

english: D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure
zh_tw: D30. 被盜的提亞馬特寶藏

english: A short flight of stairs climbs to a circular chamber with four padlocked wooden chests piled in the middle of it. The chests are locked, but characters might have wrested the keys from the iron consul in {@adventure area D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}. A character can also use {@item thieves' tools|phb} to pick a padlock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 一小截向上的樓梯通向了一個圓形的房間，房間的中間放著四個上鎖的帶著掛鎖的木箱。這些箱子都是鎖上了的，但是角色可以從{@adventure 區域D12|BGDIA|1|D12. Bane's Altar}的鋼鐵執政官那裡奪得鑰匙。角色同樣可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}進行一次 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定來開啟鎖。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each chest weighs 25 pounds empty, and all four contain loot stolen from Tiamat's hoard on Avernus. This treasure was brought to Baldur's Gate by devils in league with Zariel, and was given to the Dead Three cultists by {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA} on behalf of his mother, {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}. The contents of each chest are described below.
zh_tw: 每個箱子的空重都是 25 磅。每個箱子中都裝著從提亞馬特在阿弗納斯那裡囤積的財寶。這些財寶都是與扎瑞爾同盟的魔鬼送到博德之門來的。現在這些寶物是{@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}代表他的母親{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}送給邪教徒的。各箱子中的寶藏描述如下。

english: Chest 1 holds 4,500 cp and two red crystal vials with gold stoppers (25 gp each). Each vial contains a {@item potion of fire breath}. With the coins and vials inside, the chest weighs 70 pounds.
zh_tw: 1號箱子中裝有 4500CP 和兩個金質瓶塞的水晶小瓶子（每個瓶子 25GP）。每個小瓶裝有一份{@item potion of fire breath||火焰吐息藥水}，整個箱子和裡面的財寶一起重 70 磅。

english: Chest 2 contains ten eye agates (10 gp each) scattered amid 1,250 sp. With the coins and gemstones inside, the chest weighs 37 pounds.
zh_tw: 2 號箱子裡有十個眼紋瑪瑙石（每個 10GP）散落在 1250SP 裡。整個箱子和裡面的財寶共重 37 磅。

english: Chest 3 contains a delicate porcelain dragon mask (25 gp) resting on a bed of 2,400 cp and 500 sp. With the coins inside, the chest weighs 55 pounds. The mask weighs 1 pound.
zh_tw: 3 號箱子中有一個躺在 2400CP 和 500SP 上的精緻陶瓷龍面具（25GP），包括錢幣在內箱子中 55 磅，面具重 1 磅。

english: Chest 4 contains a bronze crown with five spires (250 gp). Each spire is shaped and painted to resemble one of the five kinds of chromatic dragons (black, blue, green, red, and white). The crown weighs 2½ pounds.
zh_tw: 4 號箱子有一個銅製的五尖頂頭冠（250GP），每個尖頂都被雕刻並且塗成了五種色彩龍（黑，藍，綠，紅和白）的樣子，頭冠重 2.5 磅。

english: D31. Torches
zh_tw: D31. 火把

english: A wooden crate is stored in this otherwise empty alcove. The crate can hold sixty torches, but is in need of restocking. Only five torches remain.
zh_tw: 一個木箱被放在這個空空如也的房間裡，裡面可以裝下六個火把，但是裡面實際只有五個火把了。

english: D32. Stolen Goods
zh_tw: D32. 失竊的貨物

english: Nine wooden crates are scattered throughout this room. Scurrying among them are six harmless {@creature Rat||rats} like the one encountered in {@adventure area D14|BGDIA|1|D14. Hungry Rat}.
zh_tw: 九個木箱被分散放在房間的各處。裡面有六隻無害的{@creature Rat||老鼠}在房間中亂竄。這些老鼠和{@adventure 區域D14|BGDIA|1|D14. Hungry Rat}所遭遇的沒有什麼區別。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Six of the crates are empty except for packing straw. The other three contain stolen goods that the cultists have not yet disbursed, including ten days' worth of rations, a {@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|PHB|bag of twenty caltrops}, three {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|flasks of alchemist's fire}, six sets of {@item manacles|PHB}, four {@item Tinderbox|PHB|tinderboxes}, nine {@item Dagger|PHB|daggers}, and four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} in glass vials.
zh_tw: 其中六個箱子裡除了稻草外一無所有，剩下三個裡面放著那些教徒還沒有來得及分贓的貨物，包括 10 天的口糧，一包共{@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|PHB|裝有二十個鐵蒺藜的小包}，三瓶{@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|熾火膠}，六套{@item manacles|PHB|鐐銬}，四個{@item Tinderbox|PHB|火絨盒}，九把{@item Dagger|PHB|匕首}和四瓶裝在玻璃瓶的{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

english: D33. Covenant of the Dead Three
zh_tw: D33. 死亡三神的契約

english: If Vaaz fled {@adventure area D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}, he's standing in front of the statues in the west section of the room, his sputtering torch lying on the floor near his feet. Describe the room to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 如果瓦茲從{@adventure 區域D29|BGDIA|1|D29. Mortlock Vanthampur}逃脫了，他會站在這個房間西側的雕像下，噼裡啪啦的火把被他扔在了附近的地上。請向玩家們對該地區進行如下描述：

english: Burned torch stubs litter the floor of this hall, the western end of which is occupied by three six-foot-tall, painted wooden statues. Each statue stands atop a two-foot-high block of red stone, making it look taller and foreboding.
zh_tw: 燃燒的火把被丟在了這個大廳的地板上，西側盡頭則是三個六尺高的彩色木質雕像。每個雕像都被放在一個兩尺高的紅色石臺上，這使得它們看起來更加的高大和不詳。

english: The center statue resembles a heavily armored man whose face is hidden behind the fearsome visor of his helmet. He's painted red except for his right gauntlet, which is black. Clutched in this gauntlet is a blood-red spear, pointed upward. The statue to the north depicts a purple-garbed male noble wearing a harlequin mask and holding a dagger behind his back. The statue to the south portrays a black-robed skeleton with its jaw opened wide and its bony hands outstretched.
zh_tw: 中間的雕像是一個穿著重甲的人，他那令人生畏的臉藏在了他的頭盔的可怖面甲裡。他全身除了右手的鐵手套是黑色外其他都是紅色的。他的鐵手套中緊握著一柄血紅的矛，矛尖朝上。北側的雕像是一個身披紫袍臉帶小丑面具的男人，其背後藏著他緊握的匕首。南面的雕像是一個穿著黑色長袍的骷髏，它的下巴大張，骨手張開。

english: Banites, Bhaalites, and Myrkulites convene in this room to plan attacks against the city above. These meetings are often contentious, though the followers of Bhaal and Myrkul usually bend to the whims of the more strategically minded Bane worshipers.
zh_tw: 班恩信徒，巴爾信徒以及米爾寇信徒會在這個房間裡開會計劃攻擊頭頂上的城市。會議總是充滿了爭吵，不過巴爾和米爾寇的信徒往往會屈從於更有戰術頭腦的班恩信徒的突發奇想。

english: Each statue is solid wood and weighs 150 pounds. A statue can be knocked off its pedestal with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 每個雕像都是硬木製成，重 150 磅，並且都可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來推倒。

english: Bane Statue
zh_tw: 班恩雕像

english: The statue of the armored man represents Bane. Its spear is real but nonmagical. The first time any humanoid comes within 5 feet of this statue, it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw or be compelled to kneel. While kneeling before the statue, the creature can't move or take actions or reactions. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 這個全身覆甲的男人代表著班恩。他手中的矛是真的但是非魔法武器。任何類人生物第一次靠近這個雕像 5 尺範圍內就必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的魅力豁免，否則被迫屈膝下跪。當下跪於此的時候，這個生物不能移動並不能執行任何行動或反應。該生物可以在他的回合結束時繼續重複豁免，豁免成功則結束效應。

english: Bhaal Statue
zh_tw: 巴爾雕像

english: This statue's harlequin mask is a separate piece that can be unhinged and removed, revealing Bhaal's ghastly, skull-like visage underneath.
zh_tw: 這個小丑的面具是獨立的一塊並且可以被拆下來，顯露出其下巴爾的可怖的骷髏面容。

english: Myrkul Statue
zh_tw: 米爾寇雕像

english: Anyone who desecrates this statue is cursed by the Lord of Bones. Until the curse is ended with a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic, the offender gains no benefit from magical healing.
zh_tw: 任何膽敢褻瀆這個雕像的人都會被骸骨之主所詛咒，在被法術{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或類似魔法結束詛咒之前，瀆神者無法從任何魔法治療中獲得益處。

english: Surprise! Dragon Cultists!
zh_tw: 驚喜！龍巫教徒！

english: If the characters rid the dungeon of the worshipers of Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul, any remaining followers of the Dead Three avoid the dungeon and the bathhouse once they realize those locations are no longer safe.
zh_tw: 如果角色們離開了班恩，巴爾和米爾寇的信徒的地城，那麼其餘殘存的死亡三神信徒一旦意識到地城和公共浴室不再安全就將會會避開這些地方。

english: Ultiss, cultist of Tiamat
zh_tw: 烏爾提斯，提亞瑪特的信徒

english: As the characters exit the dungeon and leave the bathhouse, they have one final encounter in the courtyard ({@adventure area D1|BGDIA|1|D1. Courtyard}). Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to set the scene:
zh_tw: 當角色們離開地城和公共浴室後，他們會在庭院（{@adventure 區域D1|BGDIA|1|D1. Courtyard}）迎接最後一個遭遇。請朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字以描述場景：

english: As you emerge from the bathhouse, five figures leap down from the top of the courtyard wall to confront you. In addition to their black leather armor, they wear strange masks and cloaks that give each of them a vaguely dragon-like appearance. All five brandish curved steel blades reminiscent of dragon claws.
zh_tw: 當你們從公共浴室中出現的時候，5 個黑影從庭院的牆上躍下，來到了你們的面前。他們都穿著黑色的皮甲，帶著奇怪的面具和披風，這些東西使他們看起來有些龍類的影子。這五個人都揮舞著讓人想起龍爪的彎曲的鋼刀。

english: The figures are four human {@creature Cultist||cultists} of Tiamat led by a male human {@creature cult fanatic} named Ultiss. These chaotic evil worshipers of Tiamat have been sent by {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} (see {@area chapter 3|247|x}) to retrieve the treasure stolen from the dragon queen's hoard on Avernus by agents of Zariel—treasure given to Duke Vanthampur and her sons to buy the loyalty of the Dead Three followers.
zh_tw: 這些人分別是四個提亞馬特的人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，領導他們的是一個叫做烏爾提斯的男性人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}。這些混亂邪惡的提亞馬特信徒是被{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}（請參閱{@area 第三章|247|x}）派來回收被扎瑞爾的代理人從龍後在阿弗納斯的寶庫偷走的寶藏，這些寶藏被給予了範薩姆普爾公爵並且她的兒子們用這些寶藏來購買死亡三神信徒的忠誠。

english: Guided by visions sent to them by Tiamat, the cultists know when they're within 1,000 feet of her stolen loot. If the characters took any of the treasure from {@adventure area D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}, the cultists attack them to get it back. Otherwise, the cultists demand that the characters stand aside and not meddle in their business. Once they secure the dragon queen's lost treasure, the cultists plan to hunt down and kill the Vanthampurs and anyone else in Baldur's Gate considered to be an agent of Zariel. Cultists who survive this encounter can show up at a later time to help or hinder the characters, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 由提亞馬特傳達的幻象指引，他們知道自己處在被偷走的財寶的 1000 尺範圍內。如果角色從{@adventure 區域D30|BGDIA|1|D30. Tiamat's Stolen Treasure}拿了任何寶藏，這些邪教徒就會攻擊他們並且把寶藏奪回來。否則，他們只會要求角色不要阻擋他們。一旦他們成功地回收了龍後丟失的寶藏後，這些教徒就會計劃去博德之門獵殺範薩姆普爾家族的人和任何他們認為是扎瑞爾的僕從的人。活過這個遭遇的邪教徒可以在一段時間後出現並幫助或者阻礙角色們，當然，這是由您決定的事情。

english: If it's present when the cultists of Tiamat confront the characters, the {@condition invisible} {@creature imp} in {@adventure area D1|BGDIA|1|D1. Courtyard} quietly observes the interaction before reporting back to {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} at his family's villa.
zh_tw: 如果角色們和提亞馬特的邪教徒們遭遇了的話，位於{@adventure 區域D1|BGDIA|1|D1. Courtyard}的{@condition invisible||隱形}{@creature imp||小魔鬼}會在安靜地觀察完一切後回去向位於範薩姆普爾別墅的{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}彙報。

english: Where Next?
zh_tw: 下一步去哪裡？

english: Convinced that his two older brothers conspired to kill him, {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA} urges the characters to capture or kill Amrik at a dockside tavern called the Low Lantern. The adventure assumes that the characters visit this location next. If the characters require an additional incentive to go after Amrik, Mortlock assures them that his mother values Amrik's well-being enough to negotiate for his release if the characters capture him. He suggests that it would be most unwise to oppose a duke of Baldur's Gate without leverage. If the characters decide to attack Vanthampur Villa instead, skip to the "{@area Vanthampur Villa|096|x}" section.
zh_tw: 堅信是他的兩個哥哥想要刺殺他，{@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}催促著角色們去捉住或者殺死身處港口區的矮提燈酒館的阿姆利克。這場冒險應該是角色們接下來該做的事情。如果說角色們需要更多的動機追捕阿姆利克的話，摩特洛克會保證如果角色捉到了阿姆利克，憑他母親對阿姆利克的安全的重視，這足以讓她為瞭解救阿姆利克而展開談判。他認為在博德之門這裡不用手段而盲目地去反對一個公爵並不是什麼好主意。如果角色們決定去攻擊範薩姆普爾的別墅，則直接跳至"{@area 範薩姆普爾別墅|096|x}"一節。

english: Having conquered the Dungeon of the Dead Three, the characters should advance to 3rd level before they head off to the Low Lantern or Vanthampur Villa.
zh_tw: 在征服了死亡三神的地城後，在他們前往矮提燈酒館或者範薩姆普爾的別墅之前，角色們應當提升至 3 級。

english: More Dead Three Encounters
zh_tw: 更多死亡三神的遭遇

english: Characters who clear out the Dungeon of the Dead Three might encounter more servants of Bane, Bhaal, or Myrkul in other parts of Baldur's Gate. These villains (see {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13}) usually operate as mixed groups of Banites, Bhaalites, and Myrkulites. Here are a few appropriate encounters for a party of four or five characters of 3rd to 5th level:
zh_tw: 角色們在清理完的地牢後，可能在博德之門的其他區域遭遇到這些教徒們。這些惡黨（請參閱{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}），通常都是由班恩，巴爾，米爾寇的信徒們混合而成。以下是幾個適合一支 4 到 5 人，3 至 5 級的小隊的遭遇：

english: Abduction Squad (for 3rd-level characters)
zh_tw: 綁架小隊（適合3級角色）

english: Four {@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|fists of Bane}, three {@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|night blades}, and two {@creature Necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|necromites of Myrkul} try to capture one or more city residents, in the hopes of torturing or ransoming them.
zh_tw: 四名{@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之拳}，三名{@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|夜刃}，兩名{@creature Necromite of Myrkul|BGDIA|米爾寇的屍從}會嘗試去綁架一名或者更多的市民，並希望折磨他們或獲得贖金。

english: Murder Squad (for 4th-level characters)
zh_tw: 謀殺小隊（適合4級角色）

english: An {@creature iron consul|BGDIA} with two {@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|fists of Bane} as bodyguards uses three {@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|night blades} as scouts and assassins to pick off random passersby. A {@creature skull lasher of Myrkul|BGDIA} provides magical support, casting {@spell darkness} spells to confound foes and facilitate escape.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature iron consul|BGDIA|鋼鐵領事}和兩名{@creature Fist of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之拳}作為其保鏢，派遣三名{@creature Night Blade|BGDIA|夜刃}作為哨兵或者去隨機刺殺路人，一個{@creature skull lasher of Myrkul|BGDIA|米爾寇之笞顱者}提供法術支援，釋放{@spell darkness||黑暗術}來混淆敵人，方便撤退。

english: Revenge Squad (for 5th-level characters)
zh_tw: 復仇小隊（適合5級角色）

english: A {@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA} comes after the characters with two {@creature Reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA|reapers of Bhaal} and a {@creature master of souls|BGDIA}, who commands an undead force of six {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} or four {@creature Zombie||zombies}.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之黑手}和兩名{@creature Reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的收割者}會尾隨著角色們，還有一名指揮著六個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}或四個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}的{@creature master of souls|BGDIA|馭魂者}。

english: Low Lantern
zh_tw: 矮提燈

english: The Low Lantern is an aging, three-masted merchant ship permanently docked on the east side of the harbor. Far past the point of being seaworthy, the vessel was converted into a tavern and gambling house that is open all day and night. The dice game Baldur's Bones is just as popular here as in other taverns throughout Baldur's Gate (see the "{@area Taverns in Baldur's Gate|01f|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 矮提燈酒館曾是一條老舊的三桅商船，它現在永久地停靠在港口的東側。不過在它很久之前尚能航海的時候，這艘船就被改造成了一個全天開放的酒館和賭場。就和博德之門其他的酒館一樣，骰子游戲博德之骨在這裡同樣也十分熱門（請參閱邊欄"{@area 博德之門的酒館|01f|x}"）。

english: About the Tavern
zh_tw: 關於酒館

english: The Low Lantern's location is marked on {@adventure map 1.1|BGDIA|1|Map 1.1: Baldur's Gate}, while {@adventure map 1.4|BGDIA|1|Map 1.4: The Low Lantern} shows its interior. Describe the tavern to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 矮提燈酒館的位置已標明於{@adventure 地圖 1.1|BGDIA|1|Map 1.1: Baldur's Gate}，而{@adventure 地圖 1.4|BGDIA|1|Map 1.4: The Low Lantern}則展現了它的內部結構。請向玩家們對酒館進行如下描述：

english: Fog obscures the Low Lantern until you get within a hundred feet of it, whereupon its tall masts and creaking bulk come into view. The converted ship has rigging but no sails, and is anchored to the wharf by thick chains. A wooden staircase climbs from the wharf's edge to the main deck. A lantern at the bow casts an eerie green light to signify that the tavern is open for business.
zh_tw: 當你們離它僅有 100 尺時，你們才發現了這間被濃霧所籠罩的矮提燈酒館，它高聳的桅杆和嘎吱作響的巨大船體隨之映入眼簾。這艘被改造的船留著索具但是已經沒有帆了，粗大的鐵鏈將它錨定在停泊處。一個木質樓梯從港口通向它的主甲板。船首的提燈散發出詭異的綠光來表示著這個酒館正在營業中。

english: The Low Lantern is quiet during the day, with just a few patrons drinking and gambling below decks. The place comes alive at night, and is a popular site for conducting clandestine meetings with some of the city's least scrupulous inhabitants, including pirates and off-duty Flaming Fist mercenaries.
zh_tw: 矮提燈在白天的時候都十分安靜，只有幾名顧客在甲板下飲酒或者賭博。而在夜晚這個地方則會重煥活力，這裡也是城市裡某些最道德敗壞的居民喜歡進行秘密會面的地方，當然也包括元老們和不當值的焰拳傭兵們。

english: The owner and proprietor is Laraelra Thundreth, a middle-aged female human {@creature mage} known as "the Captain" to her staff and regular patrons. Laraelra is neutral and doesn't concern herself with the private affairs of her clientele, nor does she mind when visitors get rowdy or turn violent—as long as they're willing to pay for damages afterward. In public, Laraelra is often seen with her {@creature crab} familiar perched on one shoulder. From dawn till noon, she retires to her cabin ({@area area L4|089|x}) to eat, rest, and read her spellbook.
zh_tw: 這個酒館的所有者與經營者是拉瑞娜·桑德雷斯，一位中年女性人類{@creature mage||魔法師}，她的店員和常客們都管她叫"船長"。拉瑞娜是絕對中立陣營，所以她從來不會關心客人的私事，也不在乎她的客人在這裡發生口角或者暴力衝突——只要他們願意在事後賠付損失的話。在公開場合，經常能看到拉瑞娜的{@creature crab||蟹}魔寵停在她的一邊肩膀上。從黎明到正午時分，拉瑞娜會在她的船艙中（{@area 區域L4|089|x}）吃飯，休息以及讀她的法術書。

english: The Low Lantern serves drinks and snacks, but no meals. At any given time, the staff includes two {@creature kenku} bartenders and six bouncers (human {@creature Thug||thugs}). The staff operates in three eight-hour shifts, with one group leaving as the next shift arrives.
zh_tw: 矮提燈酒館會販賣酒水和零食，但不提供正餐。任何時候，它都有著兩名{@creature kenku||天狗}作為酒保和六個保鏢（人類{@creature Thug||暴徒}）。員工們會按照八小時一班的方式三班倒，在上一班的人離開的時候，下一班的人會過來接班。

english: Tavern Patrons
zh_tw: 酒館顧客

english: The Low Lantern attracts the city's least affluent residents, as well as foreign merchants and sailors with coin to lose. Patrons who are present during the characters' initial visit include the following:
zh_tw: 矮提燈酒館非常吸引城市中的窮光蛋，或是那些外地商人以及有錢可輸的水手們。當角色初次到訪酒館時，以下客人會處於酒館當中：

english: Grimboot (lawful evil {@creature duergar}), a gruff, cross-eyed leg breaker who collects debts for the local thieves' guild
zh_tw: 格里姆伯特（守序邪惡{@creature duergar||灰矮人}），一個粗魯的，長著鬥雞眼並且瘸腿的收債人，他正在為本地盜賊工會收債。

english: Hitoshi Jade (neutral human {@creature commoner}), a drunken sailor from a merchant ship called the {@i Golden Gull}, owned by the Irlentree patriar family
zh_tw: 玉均（絕對中立人類的{@creature commoner||平民}）：一個伶仃大醉的水手，他來自於一艘叫做{@i 金鷗號}的商船，這一艘商船是伊萊特里特家族所持有的。

english: Jorunn Nighbury (neutral human {@creature commoner}), a shy horse breeder employed by the Belt patriar family but burdened by gambling debt
zh_tw: 約倫·尼伯格里（絕對中立人類{@creature commoner||平民}），一個羞澀的養馬人，他受僱於貝爾特家族，不過他現在深陷賭債危機。

english: Skadric Salakar (neutral evil human {@creature veteran}), a lazy Flaming Fist soldier who was suspended for a tenday without pay for dereliction of duty
zh_tw: 斯卡德里·克薩拉卡（中立邪惡人類{@creature veteran||老兵}），一個懶散的焰拳老兵，他現在因為翫忽職守被停職十天。

english: Prynn Derringwhistle (lawful neutral strongheart halfling {@creature commoner}), a spectacles-wearing barnacle scraper who likes to belt out old sea shanties
zh_tw: 普林·德林惠斯（守序中立強心半身人{@creature commoner||平民}）一個戴著眼鏡的藤壺清理人，他特別喜歡唱高歌那些老舊的船歌號子。

english: Aerith and Beldan (chaotic good {@creature drow}), awkward and inseparable twins who left the Underdark in search of adventure on the surface
zh_tw: 艾麗絲和貝爾丹（混亂善良的{@creature drow||卓爾}），這兩名難以應付而又形影不離的雙胞胎剛剛從幽暗地域出來，在地表尋求著冒險。

english: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA} runs his own business out of the Low Lantern with Laraelra's consent. Characters looking for him are directed to {@area area L6|08e|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}在拉瑞娜的允許下於此經營著自己的生意。如果角色們去找他，他們就會被指引去{@area 區域L6|08e|x}。

english: Map 1.4: The Low Lantern
zh_tw: 地圖 1.4：矮提燈酒館

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Tavern Locations
zh_tw: 酒館地點

english: The following area descriptions are keyed to map 1.4.
zh_tw: 以下區域的描述請對照地圖1.4。

english: L1. Main Deck
zh_tw: L1. 主甲板

english: Describe this area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 向角色對本地區做出如下描述：

english: The main deck of the old ship features wooden steps that climb to the forecastle and aftcastle, and another set of stairs descending into the ship. A padlocked wooden hatch fitted with windows acts as a skylight for the deck below—the tavern proper, visible through the hatch's glass panes. Four dead seagulls lie on the deck and two ravens squawk at you from the crow's nest, a forty-foot climb up the ship's rigging.
zh_tw: 這艘老船的主甲板，木質樓梯連線著前後甲板，還有一組樓梯通向船的內部。一個裝有窗戶帶著掛鎖的木質甲板貨艙口被用作下層甲板的天窗，從視窗的玻璃可以清楚的看到酒館下面的情況。四隻死海鷗躺在甲板上，而兩隻渡鴉在索具上四十尺高的巢穴裡對著你們刺耳的尖叫。

english: The ravens are two {@creature Imp||imps} in shapechanged form. {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} uses the imps to keep an eye on his brother, {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|Amrik}. The imps take malevolent delight in killing any seagulls that happen by, and the tavern staff can't figure out why the decks are always littered with seagull carcasses. A character who examines a dead seagull and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check ascertains that the bird was stung to death.
zh_tw: 這兩隻渡鴉是兩隻{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}變形而成的。{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}透過這些小惡魔密切注視著他的兄弟，{@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克}。這些小惡魔會惡意殺害那些剛好經過的海鷗來取樂，酒館的員工們一直不明白為什麼甲板上總是有海鷗的屍體。角色們可以透過一個 {@dc 13} 的感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定來發現這些海鷗是被刺蟄死的。

english: If the imps see Amrik leave the ship, they trail him to make sure he isn't being followed. If they realize Amrik is in danger, they swoop down to attack whoever appears to be threatening him. The imps otherwise avoid combat and turn {@condition invisible} to avoid capture or death.
zh_tw: 如果小魔鬼發現阿姆利克離開了船，他們會一直跟著他以確保他沒有被其他人跟蹤。如果他們意識到阿姆利克陷入了危險，他們會衝下去攻擊任何威脅他的人。除此之外，小魔鬼都會進入{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態並且避免戰鬥以防止自身被抓或死亡。

english: L2. Forecastle
zh_tw: L2. 前甲板

english: This deck is littered with the corpses of {@dice 1d4} dead seagulls (see area L1 for more information). Hanging off the end of the ship's bow is the green-paned lantern that indicates the tavern is open for business. A staff member crawls to the end of the bow to douse the lantern, refill it with oil, and relight it at highsun every day.
zh_tw: 這個甲板上丟著{@dice 1d4}只海鷗的屍體（請參閱區域L1）。掛在船頭的是一個嵌有綠色玻璃的提燈，這表示酒館現在正在營業。每天正午會有一名員工爬上船頭熄滅提燈，然後灌滿燈油重新點燃。

english: On warm, clear nights, Laraelra moves tables, chairs, and lanterns onto this deck so that clients can drink and gamble under the stars.
zh_tw: 在溫暖無雲的夜晚，拉瑞娜會把桌子，椅子和提燈都搬到這個甲板上來，這樣客人們就可以在星光之下暢飲和賭博。

english: L3. Aftcastle
zh_tw: L3. 後甲板

english: The captain's wheel and rudder are gone, leaving holes and empty fixtures where they used to be. As with {@area area L2|087|x}, Laraelra sometimes moves tables, chairs, and lanterns onto this deck so that clients can be outdoors on nights when the weather is nice.
zh_tw: 這裡的船舵已經被移除了，原來的位置上現在只剩下了空洞和閒置的固定臺。就和{@area 區域L2|087|x}一樣，拉瑞娜有時也會搬一些桌子，椅子和提燈到這個甲板上，這樣客人們可以在這裡享受氣候適宜的夜晚。

english: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}

english: L4. Laraelra's Cabin
zh_tw: L4. 拉瑞娜的艙房

english: The lock on Laraelra's cabin door has rusted to the point of being useless, and she hasn't bothered to replace it. Consequently, her cabin is unlocked. One of the bouncers in {@area area L5|08c|x} keeps an eye on the door and roughs up anyone other than Laraelra who tries to open it.
zh_tw: 拉瑞娜艙房上的鎖已經鏽跡斑斑無法使用，但是她也不打算花心思去更換它。因此，她的艙房根本沒有上鎖。{@area 區域L5|08c|x}會有一名保安一直盯著這裡並且粗暴地驅趕任何除了拉瑞娜外嘗試開啟它的人。

english: Describe the cabin's features to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 請向玩家們對艙房進行如下描述：

english: This cabin is full of mismatched wooden furniture, including a bed with posts carved to resemble mermaids, a nightstand, a wardrobe, a writing desk with a fur-draped chair, and a small dining table surrounded by four plain chairs. Near the foot of the bed rests an ornately carved sea chest sealed with a padlock.
zh_tw: 艙房裡裡滿是格調不搭的木質傢俱，一張床柱上雕刻著美人魚的柱床，一個床頭櫃，一個衣櫃，一張書桌和一把用毛皮覆蓋著的椅子，一張圍著四把樸素椅子的小餐桌。床腳邊上放著一個精雕細琢帶著掛鎖的水手箱。

english: Laraelra hides the key to the chest in the adjacent bedpost, whose top unscrews to reveal the hidden compartment where the key is sequestered. The chest's padlock can otherwise be picked with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made with {@item thieves' tools|phb}.
zh_tw: 拉瑞娜將掛鎖的鑰匙藏在了旁邊的床柱裡，擰開床柱的螺絲會發現一個暗格，鑰匙就藏在那裡面。角色們也可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}並透過一個{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定來開啟箱子上的掛鎖。

english: In addition to the items described under "Treasure" below, the chest contains four flying daggers that attack anyone other than Laraelra who opens the chest. Use the {@creature flying sword} stat block to represent the daggers, but make these changes:
zh_tw: 除下文所描述的"寶藏"外，箱子中還藏有四把飛空匕首，他們會攻擊任何除了拉瑞娜以外開啟箱子的人。它們使用{@creature flying sword||凌空劍}的資料面板，但做出以下調整：

english: Each {@creature flying dagger|BGDIA} is a Tiny construct with 7 ({@dice 3d4}) hit points and a challenge rating of 1/8 (25 XP).
zh_tw: 每一把{@creature flying dagger|BGDIA|凌空匕首}都是一個微型物件，同時具有 7（{@dice 3d4}）的HP和 1/8（25XP）的挑戰等級。

english: Each {@creature flying dagger|BGDIA} deals 3 ({@dice 1d4 + 1}) piercing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 每一把{@creature flying dagger|BGDIA|凌空匕首}會在命中時造成 3（{@dice 1d4 + 1}）的穿刺傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest contains a nice pair of boots, a bottle of fine wine (10 gp), a bundle of letters from an unnamed admirer, and Laraelra's spellbook, which contains all the spells she has prepared plus {@spell identify}, {@spell gust of wind}, {@spell magic weapon}, {@spell sending}, {@spell sleep}, and {@spell tongues}.
zh_tw: 箱子裡裝有一雙精美的鞋子，一瓶美酒（10GP），一打來自於一個不知名追求者的書信，以及拉瑞娜的法術書，其上記載了她所有的已準備法術以及{@spell identify||鑑定術}，{@spell gust of wind||造風術}，{@spell magic weapon||魔化武器}，{@spell sending||短訊術}，{@spell sleep||睡眠術}，和{@spell tongues||巧言術}。

english: L5. Taproom and Gambling Hall
zh_tw: L5. 酒吧與賭場

english: This is the busiest and noisiest part of the ship, and it reeks of sweat, cheap ale, rotting timbers, and old vomit. Three bouncers ({@creature Thug||thugs}) position themselves so they can see everything that happens here. If Laraelra is not in her cabin (area L4), she is seated at the short end of the bar with her crab familiar on her shoulder.
zh_tw: 這裡是整艘船最忙碌也是最嘈雜的區域，混雜著廉價麥芽酒的甜膩氣息以及朽木和過去的嘔吐物的味道。三名保安（{@creature Thug||暴徒}）會各自站在可以看到這裡所發生的一切的位置。如果拉瑞娜不在她的艙房（區域L4），她就會帶著趴她肩膀上的蟹魔寵坐在吧檯的一端。

english: Laraelra greets newcomers with a rehearsed speech:
zh_tw: 拉瑞娜會用同樣的話歡迎新顧客：

english: "Well met! My name is Laraelra Thundreth, but folks around here call me the Captain. If you're thirsting for a beverage or looking to gamble, you've come to the right place, but watch your step. Things can get pretty messy around here."
zh_tw: "幸會，我的名字叫拉瑞娜·桑德雷斯，但這裡的人們都管我叫船長。如果你想小酌一杯或者怡情小賭，那你可就來對地方了，但是最好小心一點。這裡有時候會變得蠻混亂的。"

english: Use the "Tavern Patrons" section earlier to flesh out the occupants of this area as needed. There's always someone eager to play Baldur's Bones here.
zh_tw: 根據前文"酒館裡的客人"一節根據需要增加這個區域中的人物。這裡總有人會想玩一玩博德之骨。

english: The tavern is lit by hanging oil lanterns and whatever natural light slips through the glass hatch and the ship's grimy portholes. Those portholes are 1½ feet in diameter, with rusty latches on the inside that hold them shut.
