zh_tw: 這個酒館是用掛著的油提燈和任何從落塵的舷窗或玻璃艙口照進來的自然光所照亮的。這些舷窗直徑都是 1.5 尺，它們裡面都有鏽跡斑斑的栓鎖來保證它們保持關閉。

english: L6. Tavern Lounge
zh_tw: L6. 酒館休息室

english: This tavern lounge fills an entire deck and is lit by oil lanterns hanging from the 8-foot-high ceiling by 1-foot-long chains. The windowless deck contains a bar, couches, coffee tables, and tables where patrons can socialize and gamble. Three of Laraelra's bouncers ({@creature Thug||thugs}) stand in plain view across the deck.
zh_tw: 這一整層船艙都是酒館休息室，八尺高的天花板上用一尺長的鐵鏈吊著著照明用的油燈，這層無窗的船艙裡有著一個吧檯，許多沙發和咖啡桌，還有給客人們用來社交和賭博的桌子。拉瑞娜的三個保鏢（{@creature Thug||暴徒}）會站在可以清楚看見整個甲板的地方。

english: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA} has turned a pair of couches and a coffee table near the aft wall into his personal office. He runs a moneylending business from this location, and many of his regular clients are down-on-their-luck gamblers who can't cover their debts. In exchange for this space, Amrik pays for the wine that is delivered to the Low Lantern, making Laraelra's business profitable.
zh_tw: {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}在艦尾處將一對沙發和一個咖啡桌變成了他的私人辦公室。他在這裡經營著他的放貸生意，他的老客戶都是那些運氣不好沒法還清賭債的賭客們。作為交換，阿姆利克會為矮提燈所有買入的酒付錢，這樣拉瑞娜的生意也可獲利。

english: Thirty-three-year-old Amrik sits alone on the starboard couch, his feet on the table and his eyes on the room. He keeps the port couch open for clients and employs two bodyguards. Kasharra, a {@creature spined devil}, perches on the back of Amrik's couch. Vhaltus, a sleepy-eyed lawful evil human {@creature thug} with red hair in a ponytail, sits at the closest end of the bar. Vhaltus carries a small sack containing 150 gp, which Amrik loans to clients. If he thinks his life is in real danger, Amrik detonates a concealed smoke bomb before fleeing up the stairs, leaving his bodyguards to cover his escape.
zh_tw: 三十三歲的阿姆利克獨自坐在右舷的沙發上，他的雙腳擺搭在了桌子上，他的眼睛看著房間。他把左邊的沙發留給了他的客戶和並僱了兩名保鏢。卡薩拉，一隻{@creature spined devil||棘魔}，坐在阿姆利克沙發的靠背上。瓦爾圖斯，一個睡眼朦朧的有著一頭紅髮綁著馬尾的守序邪惡人類{@creature thug||暴徒}，坐在離阿姆利克近的吧檯一端。瓦爾圖斯帶著一個裝有 150GP 的麻袋，這是阿姆利克給他客戶的貸款。如果阿姆利克認為自己的生命遭到了威脅，他就會引爆藏起來的煙霧彈然後從樓梯往上逃跑，留下保鏢來掩護他撤離。

english: Amrik loves to exchange pleasantries over drinks before conducting business. He has trained Laraelra's staff to recognize a variety of innocuous hand gestures that signal them to deliver drinks to the table. If he wants poison added to his clients' drinks, he has a secret sign for that. Hidden behind the bar is a small bottle containing four doses of {@item Torpor} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}), which the kenku bartender can use to spike drinks when Amrik gives the signal.
zh_tw: 阿姆利克喜歡在生意前和他的客戶喝上幾杯，寒暄一下。他已經訓練拉瑞娜的員工認識了好幾種無惡意的手勢，都是讓他們送酒過來的意思。如果他想在他的客戶的飲料裡下毒的話，他會打一個特殊的手勢。吧檯的後面藏了一個小瓶子裡面裝有四人份的{@item Torpor||蒙汗藥}（請參閱{@book 城主指南|DMG}第8章的{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}一節），在那裡的天狗酒保只要看到阿姆利克的手勢就會立刻下毒。

english: L7. Guest Cabin
zh_tw: L7. 客房

english: This guest cabin is not currently occupied. Its furnishings include a bed, a wardrobe, an empty desk, and a chair. An oil lantern hangs from a rusty hook bolted to the mast.
zh_tw: 這個房間目前沒有人住，它裡面的傢俱包括一張床，一個衣櫃，一個空桌子，一把椅子。桅杆上拴住了一個生鏽的鉤子，掛著一盞油燈。

english: The lock on the cabin door has rusted to the point of being useless, but the desk chair can be wedged under the doorknob to keep the door from being opened. If the chair is so used, opening the door requires a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check and makes a lot of noise.
zh_tw: 客房上的門鎖已經鏽跡斑斑根本沒有任何作用，但是桌子和椅子可以用來將門堵住，如果這麼做了，開門者將需要透過一次 {@dc 13} 的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來開啟這扇門，同時這會製造出大量的噪音。

english: L8. Sleeping Quarters
zh_tw: L8. 睡眠區

english: This area is prone to leaks, as the ship's hull is mostly submerged at this level. Puddles of water collect in areas where the floor has bowed, and the whole space reeks of vomit and urine.
zh_tw: 這個區塊很容易漏水，因為船體的這個部分大部分都處於水中，地板上的凹槽裡滿是積水，整個區域都散發著嘔吐物和排洩物的臭味。

english: Four alcoves here are set with cheap cots where drunks can sleep off their hangovers. In the bow are four hammocks that serve a similar purpose. At any given time, {@dice 1d4} {@condition unconscious} {@creature Commoner||commoners} can be found throughout this area, sleeping off the effects of a too-wild night. If the characters wish to rob them, each commoner has a belt pouch containing {@dice 1d6} sp and {@dice 2d6} cp.
zh_tw: 四個凹槽裡都放著廉價簡易床，醉漢們在這裡睡覺以接觸宿醉。這裡的四張吊床也是用來幹同樣的事情的。在任何時間內，這個區域都可以發現 {@dice 1d4} 個{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的{@creature Commoner||平民}因為之前的狂歡在這裡昏睡。如果角色們想洗劫他們的話，他們每個人都擁有一個裝有 {@dice 1d6}SP 和 {@dice 2d6}CP 的錢包。

english: Dealing with Amrik
zh_tw: 和阿姆利克打交道

english: Unless the characters attack him at once, Amrik assumes they've come to him for a loan. He is more than happy to provide one, up to a limit of 150 gp (the amount currently carried by his bodyguard Vhaltus). Amrik's terms are simple: he expects repayment in a tenday and charges 25 percent interest on the loan. As a member of the influential Vanthampur family, Amrik has plenty of muscle he can bring to bear against anyone who defaults on a loan, and his family's influence extends beyond Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 除非角色們在一開始就攻擊阿姆利克，否則他會認為角色們是來找他借貸的，他會很高興的提供一筆不超過 150GP 的貸款（他的保鏢瓦爾圖斯目前所攜帶的金額）。阿姆利克的條件十分簡單：他要在 10 天內收回這筆錢同時收取 25% 的利息。作為位高權重的範薩姆普爾家族中的一員，阿姆利克有充足的勢力對付那些不願意還錢的人，而他家族的影響力也遠遠不僅限於博德之門內。

english: The characters might try to secure a loan, with or without the intention of paying it back. Characters who plan to rip off Amrik must succeed on a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check contested by Amrik's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check, as described under "{@book Contests|PHB|7|Contests}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
zh_tw: 角色們也許會去想要一筆貸款，不管他們打不打算還錢。想要詐騙阿姆利克的角色需要成功透過一次魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）和阿姆利克的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）的對抗，詳情請見在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}的第 7 章的"{@book 對抗|PHB|7|Contests}"部分。

english: Characters can try to interrogate Amrik for information, but he's a practiced liar who won't incriminate himself or any family member he fears, including his mother and older brother. If the characters mention Mortlock, Amrik accuses that "scar-faced hulk" of consorting with the lowest of the low in Baldur's Gate to bring ruin to their family. Amrik's utter disdain for his younger brother is palpable, though he won't admit to his participation in a conspiracy to assassinate Mortlock. If the characters level accusations against him, Amrik tries to shift the blame to Mortlock. Failing that, he invokes his mother's name and reputation as a shield, hoping the characters will think twice about offending or harming the favored son of {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 角色們也許會嘗試審問阿姆利克，但他是一個老練的騙子，他不會出賣自己或者任何他畏懼的家庭成員，包括他的母親和大哥。如果角色們提到了摩特洛克，他會指責他是 "疤臉傻大個"， 與博德之門最底層的賤民廝混，並給家族帶來毀滅。阿姆利克顯而易見完全地鄙夷自己的弟弟，但是他不會承認參與了對摩特洛克的暗殺行動。如果說角色羅列他的罪名的話，他會嘗試把這一切都怪罪到摩特洛克頭上。如果他的嘗試失敗了，他會亮出他母親的名號作為擋箭牌，希望角色們在冒犯或傷害{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}最寵愛的兒子前三思而後行。

english: Amrik never battles to the death, and he surrenders if he can't fight, talk, or slither his way out of a perilous situation. If the characters defeat Amrik's bodyguards and take him prisoner, he does what he's told until an opportunity to escape presents itself. The staff of the Low Lantern do not intervene.
zh_tw: 阿姆利克絕對不會奮戰至死，一旦失去戰鬥能力，他就會投降，交涉，使用各種手段讓他遠離危險的境地。如果角色們擊敗了他的保鏢並且將他抓獲的話，他會照做一切要求直到有逃跑機會出現在他面前。矮提燈酒館的員工不會介入這些事。

english: If the characters kill Amrik aboard the Low Lantern, Laraelra warns them that his death will incur the wrath of {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}. She suggests that they flee Baldur's Gate at once—before they end up as fish food at the bottom of the harbor.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在矮提燈殺死了阿姆利克的話，拉瑞娜會警告角色們，阿姆利克的死會激怒{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}。她會建議他們儘快離開博德之門——在他們死後被扔進港口海底成為魚食之前。

english: Reya Mantlemorn
zh_tw: 蕾婭·曼特勒蒙

english: Before the characters leave the Low Lantern, a new arrival greets them. Read the following to the players:
zh_tw: 在角色們準備離開矮提燈的時候，一個剛來的人會走向他們並打招呼。請向玩家們朗讀以下文字：

english: A cloaked figure approaches, armor clanking with each step. One gloved hand rests on the hilt of a longsword. The other pulls back a cowl to reveal the face of a teenager with brown skin, red hair, and a haunting gaze.
zh_tw: 一名身披斗篷的人正在靠近，每一步都帶著盔甲鏗鏘碰撞的聲音。一隻手戴著手套扶著佩劍劍柄，另一隻手拉下兜帽，露出一張有著棕色皮膚，火紅秀髮和攝人眼神的少女面孔。

english: The cloaked figure is Reya Mantlemorn, a lawful good female human Hellrider (use the {@creature veteran} stat block). Reya speaks Common.
zh_tw: 這個穿著披風的人是蕾婭·曼特莫恩，一個守序善良的女性人類地獄騎手（使用{@creature veteran||老兵}的資料面板）。蕾婭說通用語。

english: Born in the land of Turmish, Reya came to the holy city of Elturel to train as a Hellrider when she was twelve. As a faithful follower of Torm, Reya is prepared and has trained to sacrifice herself for the greater good.
zh_tw: 蕾婭出生於圖米斯，然後她在 12 歲的時候來到了聖城艾爾托瑞爾接受成為地獄騎手的訓練。作為託姆的虔誠信徒，蕾婭早已準備並接受訓練來為更偉大的事業而犧牲自己。

english: Reya's Tale
zh_tw: 蕾婭的故事

english: Reya was training a few miles north of Elturel when the city vanished. She watched in disbelief as the Companion's light went out, turning black as the city appeared to crumble and sink below the horizon—a horrific image that Reya has been unable to get out of her mind. She returned to Elturel to find a crater where the city once stood, then took it upon herself to lead a group of fearful refugees west to Baldur's Gate. Before the Flaming Fist closed the city gates, Reya and a handful of others managed to sneak inside, but they didn't get far before a group of Flaming Fist soldiers confronted them. The refugees scattered, and Reya soon found herself cornered by a Flaming Fist thug. She wounded the soldier with her longsword, fled down an alley, and stole a cloak to better conceal her armor and weapons. She's been a wanted fugitive ever since.
zh_tw: 當城市消失的時候，蕾婭正在艾爾托瑞爾以北的幾裡處接受訓練。她難以置信的看著伴陽的光線消失，變黑，城市輪廓開始崩解並沉入地平線以下——這幅恐怖的景象再也不能從蕾婭的腦海中消除。她回到艾爾托瑞爾卻發現只有一個巨坑留在了城市曾經存在的地方，隨後她領導著一群恐慌的難民西行前往博德之門。在焰拳關閉城門前，她和其他人想辦法進入了城內，但是沒走多遠就遭遇了一群焰拳士兵。難民們被打散了，而蕾婭自己也很快被一名焰拳逼入死角。她使劍擊傷了士兵，竄入小巷，為隱藏盔甲和武器而偷了一件斗篷。於是從那時起她成了一名被通緝的逃犯。

english: Reya hasn't been in Baldur's Gate long, but she's quickly concluded that the city is a cesspool of corruption with death lurking around every foggy corner. She's investigating a rumor that {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, the high overseer of Elturel, is in the city. Reya hasn't confirmed whether the rumor is true, but reports say that Kreeg was seen in the company of four guards employed by the Vanthampur family. The Vanthampur estate is located in the Upper City, beyond her reach, but she has learned that {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA} runs a business out of the Low Lantern. She aims to question him about the veracity of the rumor.
zh_tw: 蕾婭在博德之門呆的時間不長，但是她迅速的斷定這座城市是一個裝滿了腐化物的糞坑，死亡潛伏在每個迷霧籠罩的角落。她正在調查{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，艾爾托瑞爾的最高監視者，而他就在這座城市裡。蕾婭尚未確認流言的真實性，但是據說克雷格曾被發現被四名範薩姆普爾家族的僱傭的保鏢保護著。然而範薩姆普爾家族的房子在她無法到達的上城區，不過她知道了{@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}在矮提燈裡經營生意。她正準備去找他證實流言。

english: Reya knows nothing of {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s treachery. She simply wants answers regarding what happened to Elturel. If it's possible to save the city, the Hellrider is prepared to do whatever it takes to do so. As for Baldur's Gate, she could care less what happens to it. "I hope the rats eat it," she says scornfully.
zh_tw: 蕾婭對{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的背叛一無所知。她只是單純地想知道艾爾托瑞爾到底發生了什麼。如果尚有一絲希望可以拯救城市，地獄騎手將不惜一切代價去拯救它。至於博德之門，她並不關心，"我甚至希望老鼠把這裡啃乾淨"，她輕蔑的說道。

english: If the characters appear valiant and forthright, Reya takes a liking to them immediately. Once she realizes that her quest parallels theirs, she asks to join them as they prepare to visit Vanthampur Villa.
zh_tw: 如果角色表現得英勇和果敢，蕾婭馬上就會喜歡上他們。一旦她意識到他們雙方的目的一致，她會要求加入角色們，並和他們一起前往範薩姆普爾的別墅。

english: If the characters reveal that they're working for the Flaming Fist, Reya draws her longsword in a panic, expecting to have to defend herself. Characters can allay her fears by saying they have no intention of arresting her. In the interests of full disclosure, Reya admits that she's being hunted by the Flaming Fist for an "unfortunate altercation" that wasn't entirely her fault.
zh_tw: 如果角色們表明他們在為焰拳傭兵團做事的話，蕾婭會馬上驚恐地拔出她的長劍，準備保護自己。角色們可以透過表明他們絲毫沒有興趣逮捕她以緩解她的恐懼。如果要追究到底，她會表明她正在被焰拳傭兵團因為一場"不幸的爭吵"而追捕，而那並不全是她的錯。

english: If Reya Joins the Party
zh_tw: 如果蕾婭加入隊伍

english: Reya is willing to join the adventuring party if the characters let her. She has no friends in Baldur's Gate, and she can't reach Vanthampur Villa in the heavily guarded Upper City without help. She does her best to aid the party, as long as the characters' actions and decisions lead her closer to discovering the truth of what happened to Elturel. Once the city's fate becomes known to her, Reya leaps at any chance to rescue the city from the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓她加入的話，蕾婭會願意加入冒險者小隊。她在博德之門沒有朋友，她無法在沒有任何幫助的情況下抵達位於上城區且擁有重兵把守的範薩姆普爾別墅。她會一直盡力去幫助角色，只要他們的所作所為都還是在努力查明艾爾托瑞爾的真相。一旦她知曉了城市所遭遇的厄運，蕾婭將會竭盡所能地從九獄解救艾爾托瑞爾。

english: As an NPC, Reya falls under the DM's control. But if running her becomes too much of a burden for you, see if one of the players wants to run Reya as a secondary character. You can provide the consenting player with a copy of the {@creature veteran} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: 作為一個NPC，蕾婭歸於DM操控。但如果操作她對你而已是一個過重的負擔的話，你可以詢問是否有玩家願意將蕾婭作為第二角色來扮演，你可以向願意的玩家展示{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature veteran||老兵}的資料。

english: Vanthampur Villa
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾別墅

english: Vanthampur Villa is located in the Upper City, which is populated by the wealthiest residents of Baldur's Gate and heavily patrolled by the Watch. The villa's location is marked on {@adventure map 1.1|BGDIA|1|Map 1.1: Baldur's Gate}, while {@adventure map 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa} shows its interior. The villa connects with the dungeon and sewer complex shown on {@adventure map 1.6|BGDIA|1|Map 1.6: Under the Villa}.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾的別墅位於博德之門的上城區，那裡居住著這個城市最富裕的人，也為警備隊所重兵把守。別墅的位置已經標記於{@adventure 地圖 1.1|BGDIA|1|Map 1.1: Baldur's Gate}中，而{@adventure 地圖 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}則展示了別墅的內部構造，而別墅所連線的地城和下水道系統則將在{@adventure 地圖 1.6|BGDIA|1|Map 1.6: Under the Villa}中顯示。

english: The characters might want to visit Vanthampur Villa after leaving the Dungeon of the Dead Three or paying a visit to {@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA} at the Low Lantern. If they take Amrik prisoner, they can count on Reya Mantlemorn to keep a close eye on him.
zh_tw: 角色們可能會在離開了死亡三神地城後或者在拜訪完矮提燈酒館的{@creature Amrik Vanthampur|BGDIA|阿姆利克·範薩姆普爾}後前往範薩姆普爾別墅。如果他們挾持了阿姆利克的話，他們可以讓蕾婭·曼特莫恩來看住他。

english: Getting to the Villa
zh_tw: 前往別墅

english: Twenty {@creature Guard||guards} of the Watch vigilantly are posted at every gate to the Upper City. If the characters present the badges given to them by Captain Zodge, the Watch members let them pass through the gates, even if they are accompanied by a prisoner or a known fugitive such as Reya Mantlemorn. Any character without a badge is questioned and required to pay a gate toll of 2 cp.
zh_tw: 每個通往上城區的城門都有20名戒備的警備隊{@creature Guard||警衛}在那裡進行警戒。如果角色們向他們展示佐迪隊長給他們的徽章的話，警備隊就會讓他們透過，就算他們身邊挾制著囚徒或跟著像蕾婭·曼特莫恩這樣的通緝犯也不例外。任何沒有徽章的角色都會被盤問並要求支付2CP的通行費。

english: If the characters have Amrik as their prisoner, he does nothing to provoke a confrontation with the guards at the gate, fearing he might be hurt.
zh_tw: 如果角色們挾持著阿姆利克同行的話，他不會在城門引發衝突，因為他擔心可能會因此受傷。

english: The Vanthampur Family
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾家族

english: Thalamra Vanthampur is a cunning, devil-worshiping beast of a woman in her late sixties who can stare down a hell hound without flinching. She is barrel-bodied, with strong hands and forearms that speak to her beginnings as a manual laborer. Her youth was spent in the cellars and sewers of Baldur's Gate, repairing pipes and clearing out the city's filth. Thalamra rose from such lowly work to become the minister of the city's sewers and waterworks. Now she dresses in the finery that suits her station as a duke of Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾是個狡詐且崇拜魔鬼的披著女人外表的猛獸，縱使年過花甲她也敢毫無畏懼的與地獄犬對視。她那膀大腰圓的身形和健碩的手臂都說明瞭她的勞工經歷。她的童年是在博德之門的下水道和地下室裡度過的，在那裡修理管道或者並清理這個城市的垃圾。薩拉瑪拉從如此下賤的工作提升至城市地下管道與水利部長，而現在，她穿著華麗的衣服以與她博德之門公爵的地位相稱。

english: Thalamra orchestrated the disappearance of Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} to fulfill her ultimate goal of becoming the new grand duke of Baldur's Gate. When not engaged in political matters, she conducts her most secret business in the dungeon complex below her villa.
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉一手策劃了{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}大公的失蹤，來實現她成為博德之門新任大公的終極目標。當她不去參與政治活動的時候，她會在她別墅下面的地城裡進行她最秘密的活動。

english: Thalamra is a widow three times over, and each of her dead husbands was kind enough to give her a son. Her oldest boy, Thurstwell, is a pale and sullen recluse in his forties. A veritable shut-in, he uses imps to spy on his brothers, Amrik and Mortlock. Thurstwell resents both of them—Amrik for being their mother's favorite, and Mortlock for being a monstrous dolt.
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉已經接連喪偶三次，但她的每一任丈夫都給她留下了一個兒子。她的大兒子，瑟斯維爾，是一個40多歲，面色蒼白又沉悶的隱居者。他是一個十足的孤僻者，他用小魔鬼來監視他的兄弟們，阿姆利克和摩特洛克。瑟斯維爾憎惡他們——阿姆利克是他母親的最愛，而摩特洛克是一個醜惡笨蛋。

english: Thurstwell's real problem is that his mother doesn't see him as her successor, and is grooming Amrik to fill that role. Despite his jealousy, Thurstwell would never visit harm upon Amrik for fear of incurring his mother's wrath. Mortlock is a different matter, as it's been made abundantly clear that Thalamra would disown him had she not agreed to the dying wish of her third husband to look after Mortlock despite his countless imperfections.
zh_tw: 瑟斯維爾最大的憂慮在於，他的母親並沒有把他當成繼承人，而是培養阿姆利克去充當這一角色。就算他充滿了嫉妒，瑟斯維爾也不敢傷害阿姆利克，因為他擔心會招來他母親的怒火。摩特洛克則是完全不同，薩拉瑪拉還沒有與其斷絕關係是因為答應了她第三任丈夫的遺願去照顧他一無是處的孩子。

english: The last member of the Vanthampur family is Slobberchops, a mean-looking {@creature tressym|BGDIA} (winged cat) with a bobtail and numerous battle scars. Characters who encounter Slobberchops can try to befriend it (see {@area area V5|0a3|x}).
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾家族的最後一名成員是一隻長相兇惡的{@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}，名叫"嘴裡流涎 口水怪"。遭遇到他的角色們可以嘗試與他成為朋友（請參閱{@area 區域V5|0a3|x}）。

english: Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa
zh_tw: 地圖1.5: 範薩姆普爾的別墅

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: About the Villa
zh_tw: 關於別墅

english: Vanthampur Villa is a stately stone edifice with a detached stable house. Both buildings have sloped rooftops covered with red clay tiles. A 12-foot-high stone wall encloses the villa. Lanterns hanging along the wall's interior are lit at dusk and extinguished at dawn to illuminate the yard and villa at night. The wall features three wooden gates—the main entrance and a coach gate to the south, and a postern gate to the north.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾的別墅是一座宏偉的石質建築，同時還帶有一個獨立的馬廄。這兩座建築傾斜的屋頂上都鋪著紅瓦。12 尺高的石牆環繞著別墅。牆內側懸掛著的油燈會在黃昏時刻點亮在黎明時分熄滅，以此在晚上為別墅和庭院提供照明。圍牆一共有三個木質大門，在南側有一個主門和一個側門，北側則是一個後門。

english: The villa's wooden doors and lead-framed windows aren't locked, and the Vanthampurs employ guards to patrol the yard (see {@area area V1|09c|x}). The guards live elsewhere and change shifts every six hours.
zh_tw: 別墅裡面的木門和鉛製框架的窗戶都沒有上鎖，範薩姆普爾家族僱了守衛在院子裡巡邏（請參閱{@area 區域V1|09c|x}）。這些守衛住在別的地方並且每 6 小時換一班。

english: Servants
zh_tw: 僕人

english: The Vanthampurs employ four full-time live-in servants (all neutral human {@creature Commoner||commoners}):
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾家族僱傭了 4 名全職的住家僕人（全部都是絕對中立人類{@creature Commoner||平民}）。

english: Fendrick Gray, a decrepit seventy-year-old butler
zh_tw: 芬德里克·格雷，一個 70 歲的男性老管家。

english: Sarvinder Peck, a salty fifty-two-year-old groundskeeper and stable master
zh_tw: 沙文德·佩克，52 歲、說話粗獷的園丁兼馬廄主管

english: Gabourey D'Vaelan, a fussy thirty-five-year-old cook
zh_tw: 加博雷·德'瓦蘭，一個挑剔的 35 歲廚子。

english: Ambra Fallwater, a plainspoken nineteen-year-old maid
zh_tw: 安布拉·費爾沃特，一個大嘴巴的 19 歲女僕。

english: Ambra is a recent hire to replace the previous maid, whom Duke Vanthampur threw down the stairs for breaking a vase.
zh_tw: 安布拉是最近才被僱傭過來代替因為打碎了一個花瓶而被範薩姆普爾公爵扔下了樓梯的前任女僕。

english: Villa Locations
zh_tw: 別墅地點

english: The following area descriptions are keyed to {@adventure map 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}.
zh_tw: 以下區域的描述請對照{@adventure 地圖 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}。

english: V1. Yard
zh_tw: V1. 庭院

english: Nine lawful evil human {@creature Guard||guards} patrol the yard in three groups of three. When the characters first arrive, these groups are located at the points marked "V1" on {@adventure map 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}, and are circling the yard counterclockwise.
zh_tw: 9 名守序邪惡人類{@creature Guard||警衛}分成三個三人組在這個院子裡巡邏。當角色們一開始到達這裡的時候，他們所處的位置正如{@adventure 地圖 1.5|BGDIA|1|Map 1.5: Vanthampur Villa}中的"V1"所示，並且圍繞著院子逆時針巡邏。

english: The guards attack anyone who trespasses onto the estate without the consent or prior notification of Duke Vanthampur or one of her sons. If the characters have Amrik or Mortlock with them, they can convince either of the duke's sons to talk them past the guards. Otherwise, the characters need to kill the guards or sneak past them. The guards are too well paid to accept bribes, and they have no respect for the Flaming Fist. To sneak past a group of guards, each character must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. This check is made with advantage at night or in fog.
zh_tw: 這些守衛們會攻擊那些沒有得到範薩姆普爾公爵或她的兒子之一的同意或提前通知而擅自闖入別墅的人。如果角色們帶著阿姆利克或者摩特洛克，那麼警衛會被任意一人說服而放行。否則，角色們必須選擇擊殺這些警衛或者是潛行透過該區域。這些警衛的工資非常豐厚以至於他們不會接受任何賄賂，同時他們對焰拳也沒有任何的尊重。角色們若要潛行透過警衛守衛的區域，每一個角色都需要成功透過一次 {@dc 13} 的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。當他們在夜晚或者是霧天潛入時，那麼在該檢定上具有優勢。

english: V2. Stable House
zh_tw: V2. 馬廄

english: This stone building contains stables for four {@creature Draft Horse||draft horses}, plus a fully equipped smithy with an anvil and a hearth. Sarvinder Peck (see "{@area Servants|09a|x}" above) can be encountered here, making and fitting new shoes for the horses.
zh_tw: 這個石質建築裡面有4匹{@creature Draft Horse||馱用馬}，裡面還有一個裝置完善的鐵匠鋪，鐵砧熔爐一應俱全。在這裡可以遇到沙文德·佩克（請參閱上文的"{@area 僕人|09a|x}"），他正在給馬打造和安裝新的馬蹄鐵。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: A 3-foot-square flagstone in the southwest corner of the stable doubles as a hidden trapdoor in the floor. Any character who searches the area finds the trapdoor with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The stone covers a brick-walled shaft and a wooden ladder that descends 15 feet to {@area area V27|0cf|x} of the dungeon. If the Vanthampurs need to flee the dungeon, they can use the trapdoor to reach their horses quickly.
zh_tw: 在馬廄西南角有一個三尺見方的石板那是一扇隱藏的門。角色們可以透過一個 {@dc 15} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以找到陷板門。石板掩藏著一口帶著木頭梯子的磚砌深井，下深 15 尺，直到地城的區域{@area 區域V27|0cf|x}。如果範薩姆普爾家族的人想要逃出地城，他們可以透過這個陷板門快速到達馬廄。

english: {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}

english: V3. Foyer
zh_tw: V3. 門廳

english: If the characters knock on the front doors, the butler, Fendrick Gray (see "{@area Servants|09a|x}"), makes his way here from {@area area V10|0ab|x} to greet them. He ushers them in if they are expected, but turns them away otherwise.
zh_tw: 如果角色們敲響屋子正門的話，管家芬德里克·格雷（請參閱"{@area 僕人|09a|x}"）他會從{@area 區域V10|0ab|x}趕過來迎接角色們，如果角色們是應約而來，則他會為他們引路，否則他會把角色們趕走。

english: Describe this area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 向角色對本地區做出如下描述：

english: Apart from the main entrance, this room has two exits. A plaster shelf lined with ornate vases circles the room at a height of nine feet. Spread across the flagstone floor is a ten-foot-wide, fifteen-foot-long rug of exquisite design, depicting a royal coronation. Two tapestries hanging on the walls depict a dragon flying over a ship and pilgrims on camels, respectively.
zh_tw: 除了大門以外，這個房間還有兩個出入口。一條 9 尺高的石膏架環繞著房間，上面陳列著華麗的花瓶。石質的地板上鋪著一個 10 尺寬，15 尺長的精美地毯，上面描繪的是皇室的加冕儀式。牆上掛著兩幅掛毯分別繪著一條巨龍掠過船隻以及朝聖者駝隊的場景。

english: Four {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps} lurk among the vases on the high shelf, one in each corner. The imps swoop down to attack anyone they perceive as intruders, including characters who have Mortlock or Amrik as a prisoner.
zh_tw: 房間四角的高架上的花瓶上分別藏著 4 只{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}。這些小魔鬼會衝下來攻擊任何被他們視作入侵者的人，包括那些挾制摩特洛克和阿姆利克，當他們成犯人對待的角色。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The vases, rug, and tapestries are valuable art objects, though they don't go well together. Each of the sixteen vases weighs 2 pounds and is worth 25 gp. The rug weighs 50 pounds and is worth 250 gp. Each of the two tapestries weighs 5 pounds and is worth 75 gp.
zh_tw: 地毯，花瓶和掛毯都是值錢的藝術品，但它們放在一起看並不怎麼搭。16 個花瓶每個都有兩磅重，值 25 GP。地毯重 50 磅，價值 250 GP，兩個掛毯每個重 5 磅，價值 75 GP。

english: V4. Servants' Quarters
zh_tw: V4. 僕人宿舍

english: This undecorated room contains four single beds and a dining table for the manor's servants. The servants keep spare uniforms and other personal belongings in drawers under their beds. Nothing of value is kept here.
zh_tw: 這個樸素的房間裡，放著 4 張單人床和一張餐桌。僕人們把他們自己的制服和其他的私人物品放在床下的抽屜裡。這裡沒有什麼值錢的東西。

english: V5. Kitchen
zh_tw: V5. 廚房

english: Pleasant aromas fill this area throughout the day as cook Gabourey D'Vaelan (see "{@area Servants|09a|x}") prepares meals for the Vanthampurs and their staff. Gabourey doesn't like other people in the kitchen while she works.
zh_tw: 這個房間在白天的時候充滿著誘人的香味，因為廚子加博雷·德.瓦蘭（請參閱"{@area 僕人|09a|x}"）在這裡為範薩姆普爾家族的人和他們的僕人準備三餐。加博雷不喜歡別人在她工作的時候進入廚房。

english: Pots, pans, and cooking utensils dangle above three wooden preparation tables in the middle of the room, and shelves are lined with bowls, platters, herbs, spices, and dried goods. A dumbwaiter with a manually operated rope-and-pulley system allows meals to be delivered to Duke Vanthampur's bedroom ({@area area V17|0b6|x}). A tiny bell near the dumbwaiter rings whenever the duke wants food sent up to her.
zh_tw: 廚房中央的三個備餐桌上掛著盆鍋鏟勺等烹飪用具，架子上擺著草藥香料，碗盤匙叉還有乾貨。一個手搖滑輪輪組送餐升降機可以把餐食送往範薩姆普爾公爵的臥室（{@area 區域V17|0b6|x}）。送餐機旁邊有個小鈴鐺，當公爵想要吃飯時便會搖響它。

english: Slobberchops the {@creature tressym|BGDIA} prowls the kitchen, killing rats and eating whatever Gabourey drops on the floor. Slobberchops has no loyalty to the Vanthampur family, and detests Thurstwell and his imp spies. The {@creature tressym|BGDIA} befriends any character who feeds it, following that character around the house and using its Detect Invisibility trait to warn of {@condition invisible} imps nearby.
zh_tw: {@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}"嘴裡流涎"，在廚房裡徘徊，捕食老鼠並吃掉任何加博雷丟在地上的東西。嘴裡流涎對範薩姆普爾家族沒有任何忠誠可言，而且他十分憎恨瑟斯維爾和他的小魔鬼間諜。這隻{@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}會與任何給它餵食的角色成為朋友，它會在房子裡跟隨他們並使用特性偵測隱形來警告他們附近有{@condition invisible||隱形}的小魔鬼。

english: V6. Pantry
zh_tw: V6. 食品儲藏室

english: Food and drink is stored on shelves in this musty room.
zh_tw: 這個有黴味的房間架子上儲存著各種食物和飲品。

english: V7. Stairs Down
zh_tw: V7. 向下的樓梯

english: This room contains a barrel of fresh water and a brick-walled staircase that descends 15 feet to {@area area V20|0c1|x}.
zh_tw: 這個房間有一桶清水和一個向下 15 尺的磚砌樓梯，這個樓梯通向{@area 區域V20|0c1|x}。

english: V8. Parlor
zh_tw: V8. 客廳

english: While entertaining visitors in this room, the duke likes to sit in an austere, high-backed chair facing a pair of padded couches and a coffee table. A hidden compartment in the left armrest of the duke's chair contains a {@item silvered dagger|PHB}. A character who examines the chair can locate the hidden compartment with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 公爵在此房間招待訪客時，喜歡坐在一張樸素的高背椅上，朝向一對軟墊沙發和一張咖啡桌。公爵座椅的左扶手中有一個暗格，裡面藏著一把{@item silvered dagger|PHB|鍍銀匕首}。一個角色若檢查這把椅子，可以透過一次成功的{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定來找到這個暗格。

english: Thin drapes cover the windows to diffuse the natural light, and the walls are lined with framed paintings of the duke, her three dead husbands, her three sons, and the family's winged cat, Slobberchops.
zh_tw: 窗戶上掛著薄薄的窗簾把陽光散射，牆上陳列著鑲邊的的畫像，內容是公爵和她的三個亡夫還有這個家族的翼貓成員"嘴裡流涎"。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A tapestry hanging on the north wall depicts burning angels falling from the sky into a pit of fire. The tapestry weighs 5 pounds and is worth 150 gp.
zh_tw: 北牆上有一幅掛毯，上面描繪著一位燃燒的天使從空中墜入火坑的場景。這個掛毯重 5 磅價值 150 GP。

english: V9. Dining Room
zh_tw: V9. 餐廳

english: Thalamra Vanthampur and her sons gather here once a tenday for an always-tense family dinner. Read the following when the characters can see this area:
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾和她的兒子們每隔 10 天會聚在這裡進行一次氣氛總是很緊張的家庭晚宴，當角色抵達該區域時做出以下描述：

english: An iron-wrought chandelier hangs above a black oak dining table surrounded by eight high-backed chairs carved to look like devils. A fireplace dominates one wall, flanked by red-curtained windows. A handsome, glass-doored wine cabinet stands against one wall.
zh_tw: 一盞鐵製枝形吊燈懸掛在圍著八個高背椅的黑色橡木餐桌上方，椅子都被雕成了魔鬼模樣。壁爐突出牆面，兩邊是掛著紅窗簾的窗戶。一個漂亮的玻璃門酒櫃靠牆而立。

english: Perched on the chandelier are three {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps} that behave like the imps in {@area area V3|09f|x}. A rope-and-pulley mechanism allows the chandelier to be lowered and raised. The rope is tied around a hook mounted on the east wall near the wine cabinet.
zh_tw: 在吊燈上站著三個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}，他們的行動方式和{@area 區域V3|09f|x}的小魔鬼一樣。吊燈透過一套滑輪組來升降。繩索被綁在在東牆酒櫃附近的一個鉤子上。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The cabinet contains a set of eight red crystal goblets (25 gp each) and sixteen bottles of wine. Fifteen of the bottles contain fine wine (10 gp each). The last bottle is laced with {@item Midnight Tears}, a tasteless poison (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). This tainted bottle is set aside for guests whom the duke intends to eliminate.
zh_tw: 酒櫃裡放著一套 8 個水晶高腳杯（每個 25 GP）和16瓶酒。其中的 15 瓶都是佳釀（每個 10 GP）剩下一個繫著花邊的瓶子裡面裝的是{@item Midnight Tears||午夜之淚}，一種無味的毒藥（詳情請見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第8章{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}），這瓶毒酒是公爵為那些她想要除掉的客人而準備的。

english: V10. Gallery
zh_tw: V10. 陳列室

english: Black curtains are drawn over the windows to the south, keeping this hall dark and cool. Unless otherwise occupied, Fendrick Gray, the venerable butler, paces the hall with a lantern while the maid, Ambra Fallwater, dusts (see "{@area Servants|09a|x}"). A wooden staircase at the north end of the hall climbs 15 feet to {@area area V11|0ad|x}.
zh_tw: 南面的窗戶上掛著黑色的窗簾以保持整個房間黑暗且涼爽。除非有他人使用，莊嚴的管家芬德里克·格雷，會在這裡拿著提燈來回巡邏踱步，而女僕安布拉·費爾沃特（請參閱"{@area 僕人|09a|x}"）則會在這裡打掃。在房間北側盡頭的樓梯向上 15 尺通向{@area 區域V11|0ad|x}。

english: This gallery contains an eclectic collection of tapestries, paintings, and alabaster busts on pedestals meant to impress guests. The duke bought the pieces thinking them to be valuable art objects, but all are knockoffs acquired from dubious sources. The haphazardly assembled collection is a testament to bad taste.
zh_tw: 這間陳列室為了給客人留下深刻印象而收藏著五花八門的掛毯、畫作和放在底座上的石膏半身像。公爵買下了這些她認為有價值的物件，但事實上這些全都是來源可疑的贗品。而隨意擺放的收藏品也說明瞭其主人的庸俗品味。

english: Wax Statue
zh_tw: 蠟像

english: A 6-foot-tall wax statue in one corner depicts {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} cradling the family pet, Slobberchops, in her arms. The {@creature tressym|BGDIA} has a wax rat in its mouth. Visitors who enter the gallery from the foyer ({@area area V3|09f|x}) are often startled by the statue because of its location just inside the door and its lifelike appearance.
zh_tw: 角落裡擺著一尊 6 尺高的蠟像，造型是{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}抱著家庭寵物"嘴裡流涎"的蠟像，{@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}嘴裡還叼著一隻蠟製老鼠。從前廳（{@area 區域V3|09f|x}）進入陳列室的客人通常都會被嚇一跳，因為蠟像就放在門後而又那麼逼真。

english: V11. Upstairs Hall
zh_tw: V11. 上層大廳

english: Lanterns hang from the rafters of this drafty hall. The staircase to the north descends 15 feet to area V10.
zh_tw: 油燈懸掛在這個通風良好的大廳的椽子上。北側的樓梯下降 15 尺通向區域 V10。

english: Five lawful evil human {@creature Guard||guards} stand watch here—one by each door. They attack anyone not accompanied by a Vanthampur family member. If they hear trouble elsewhere, the guards can't be {@status surprised}, but they stay put unless ordered to move by a member of the family. Combat here alerts {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA} in {@area area V13|0af|x}.
zh_tw: 5 名守序邪惡人類{@creature Guard||警衛}看守著這裡，他們分別站在每扇門邊。他們會攻擊任何在沒有範薩姆普爾家族成員陪伴而進入該區域的人。如果他們聽到別的地方發生了麻煩，那麼警衛就不會被{@status surprised||突襲}，但他們也不會在沒有其他範薩姆普爾家族成員命令下離開這裡。這裡發生的戰鬥會讓{@area 區域V13|0af|x}的{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}警惕。

english: V12. Balcony
zh_tw: V12. 陽臺

english: A crenelated stone battlement encloses this balcony overlooking the front yard. It's a 15-foot drop from the balcony to the ground.
zh_tw: 鋸齒狀石垛牆圍住了這個離地 15 尺可以俯瞰前院的陽臺。

english: V13. Thurstwell's Bedroom
zh_tw: V13. 瑟斯維爾的臥室

english: Drab curtains cover the windows of this plain room, which contains a bed, a padlocked iron chest, a claw-footed iron bathtub, and a fireplace. Standing in the middle of the room is {@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA}, a frail and hateful forty-two-year-old man clutching an {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} (see "Treasure" below). If alerted to intruders, Thurstwell has locked the puzzle box in the iron chest and tucked the key into his robe pocket.
zh_tw: 淡褐色窗簾覆蓋著這個樸素房間所有的窗戶，房間裡擺了一張床，一個帶有掛鎖的鐵箱子，一口爪足鐵浴缸，和一座壁爐。房間中間站著的就是{@creature Thurstwell Vanthampur|BGDIA|瑟斯維爾·範薩姆普爾}，一個瘦弱且令人生厭的 42 歲男子，手裡拿著一個{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}（詳情請見下文）。如果他察覺到有入侵者，瑟斯維爾會把謎盒鎖到鐵箱子裡去，然後把鑰匙放到自己長袍的口袋裡。

english: Thurstwell commands several imp spies who enter and leave his room through the chimney, but only one such creature is present when the characters arrive. This {@creature imp} is {@condition invisible}, lurks in the fireplace, and attacks anyone who threatens Thurstwell.
zh_tw: 瑟斯維爾指揮著數只小魔鬼密探從他房間的煙囪進進出出，但是當角色們趕到的時候，這裡只會有一個這樣的生物。這個{@creature imp||小魔鬼}是{@condition invisible||隱形}的，他潛伏在壁爐裡並且會攻擊任何企圖傷害瑟斯維爾的人。

english: Thurstwell greets intruders in the most uncivil fashion—by casting {@spell sacred flame} at the nearest one. On the same turn, he casts {@spell sanctuary} on himself as a bonus action and uses his movement to cower behind the bed while the imp defends him. If taken prisoner, he whines about the failure of his guards to protect him and bides his time, hoping his captors get in over their heads and afford him a chance to escape. If interrogated, he offers the following information in exchange for his release:
zh_tw: 瑟斯維爾會用最野蠻的方式向角色們打招呼——向離他最近的人釋放{@spell sacred flame||聖火術}。在同一回合裡，他會使用附贈動作對自己釋放{@spell sanctuary||庇護術}。然後會跑到床後面用床做掩護，並且讓小魔鬼掩護他。如果他被抓獲，他會哭訴他的保鏢沒能成功保護他，並且等待時機，希望趁角色無暇自顧時逃脫。如果角色審問他，他會以釋放自己為條件提供以下資訊：

english: His mother, the duke, is in the dungeon below the villa with {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}. She and the former high overseer of Elturel are plotting to seize control of Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 他的母親，公爵，正和{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}一起待在別墅下面的地城裡。她和這位艾爾托瑞爾的前任至高監督正合謀打算奪取博德之門統治權。

english: He and his brothers recently stole the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} from a crypt under the city. A powerful devil named Gargauth is trapped in the shield, and has vowed to help the Vanthampurs conquer Baldur's Gate if released. {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} is confident that he can devise a way to release Gargauth from the shield.
zh_tw: 他和他的兄弟們最近從城市底下的一個墓穴中偷到了{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}。一個名叫加葛斯的強大魔鬼被封印在了這個盾牌中，並且他發誓會在被釋放後幫助範薩姆普爾奪取博德之門。{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}確信自己有方法把他從這面盾裡給弄出來。

english: Thavius arrived in the city a few days ago with the puzzle box. The duke insisted that Thavius let the family safeguard the item while he studies the shield.
zh_tw: 塔維斯是前幾天才到的城市，同時還攜帶著一個謎盒。公爵堅持讓塔維斯在研究盾牌的時候把盒子留給他們來保護。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} is a new magic item described in {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|12}. Each puzzle box is unique in its design. This particular box belongs to {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} and was entrusted to Duke Vanthampur for safekeeping. Curious to know what's inside the box, the duke gave it to Thurstwell—supposedly her smartest son—to see if he could open it, but he's had no luck so far. Thurstwell can be threatened into relinquishing the box, or it can easily be taken from him. However, opening the box is beyond the ability of any of the characters. Falaster Fisk, a spy imprisoned in the dungeon ({@area area V29|0d3|x}), can advise the characters that taking the box to {@area Candlekeep|0f1|x} is their best bet for learning what it contains. The box holds a copy of the contract Thavius forged with Zariel to doom the city of Elturel.
zh_tw: {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}是一個全新的魔法道具，詳情請見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}。每一個謎盒都有獨特的設計。這個盒子屬於{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}並且交由範薩姆普爾公爵保管。因為公爵十分好奇盒子裡到底有什麼，所以公爵把它交給了最她聰明的兒子瑟斯維爾來看看他能不能開啟它，但他目前還沒有。角色們可以威脅他交出盒子，或者直接把盒子搶走。但是沒有任何角色有能力開啟這個盒子。福萊斯特·菲斯克，一個被關押在地城中的密探（{@area 區域V29|0d3|x}），會建議角色若是想知道盒中之物最可靠的方法便是帶著它去{@area 燭堡|0f1|x}。這個盒子裡裝著塔維斯與扎瑞爾為毀滅艾爾托瑞爾而訂立的契約的備份。

english: The padlock on the chest can be picked by a character with {@item thieves' tools|phb} who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The chest weighs 50 pounds and contains a jumble of wrinkled garments, red wax candles, quills, blank sheets of parchment, and jars of ink. It also holds an unlocked wooden coffer containing 73 gp, 120 sp, and a {@item potion of healing}, as well as a black-covered tome titled {@i Apocalypto}—a poetic prophecy by an unknown author envisioning the end of the multiverse (worth 50 gp).
zh_tw: 箱子上的掛鎖可以由一名角色使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定以開啟。箱子重 50 磅，裡面堆放著起皺的衣服，紅色的蠟燭，羽毛筆，一堆空白羊皮紙，和幾瓶墨水。裡面還有一個沒鎖的木質保險盒，裡面裝著 73 GP和 120 SP，還有一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}，一本黑色封面標題為{@i 啟示錄}的書——一位不知名作家據對多元宇宙末日之刻的想象而寫成的詩體預言（價值 50 GP）。

english: V14. Mortlock's Bedroom
zh_tw: V14. 摩特洛克的臥室

english: This dark room contains a bed, a wooden chest with clawed feet, and a night table. The chest weighs 25 pounds and contains a few drab garments made for a man of Mortlock's size, a few worthless personal effects, and a stuffed troll doll from Mortlock's childhood.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗的房間裡放著一張床，一個爪足木箱和一個床頭櫃。箱子重 25 磅，裡面放著幾件專門為摩特洛克的身形設計的樸素的衣服，還有一個摩特洛克童年時玩的巨魔娃娃。

english: V15. Amrik's Bedroom
zh_tw: V15. 阿姆利克的臥室

english: This tastefully appointed room contains a bed, a side table, a claw-footed iron bathtub, a fireplace, and an iron-banded wooden chest. A three-foot-wide, six-foot-tall mirror is mounted to the east wall opposite the fireplace. The mirror's varnished wooden frame is carved with images of rats, ravens, and spiders.
zh_tw: 這個雅緻的房間裡放著一張床，一張邊桌，一口爪足鐵浴缸，一座壁爐，和一個帶鐵箍的木箱，一面 3 尺寬 6 尺高的落地鏡固定在壁爐對面的東牆上。這個鏡子的漆木邊框上雕刻著老鼠，烏鴉，和蜘蛛的圖案。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Amrik's chest contains neatly folded and tailored apparel to fit a slender noble, and a jewelry box carved from bone (10 gp). This tiny box contains a gold signet ring (5 gp) bearing the Vanthampur motto, "Stone hearts never bleed."
zh_tw: 阿姆利克的箱子裡放著一名苗條貴族疊放整齊的量身定製禮服。一個骨雕首飾盒（10 GP）。這個小盒子裡裝著一個印有範薩姆普爾家訓的金璽潔（5 GP），家訓是："石心不流血"

english: V16. Duke's Powder Room
zh_tw: V16. 公爵的化妝間

english: This room contains a vanity topped with a framed oval mirror, bottles of perfume, brushes, cosmetics, needles, and spools of thread. Other furnishings in the room include a folding wooden partition adorned with a bird of prey rendered in gold leaf, a tall black wardrobe filled with corsets and fine clothes, and a decorative gold rug laid out in front of three unlocked wooden chests. One chest is full of shoes, another contains three old bridal gowns, and the third contains seasonal hats.
zh_tw: 這個房間擺了一張帶著鑲邊橢圓鏡的梳妝檯，上面放著幾瓶香水、數把刷子、一些化妝品、幾根針和成卷絲線。這個房間的其他傢俱包括一張貼金猛禽畫木折屏，一隻黑色高衣櫃，裡面放滿了束腰和高檔服裝，一張金地毯鋪在三隻沒鎖的木箱前。一隻箱子裡滿是鞋子，另一隻裡面放了三件舊婚紗，第三個裡是各季的帽子。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The vanity holds six bottles of fine perfume (20 gp each), a silver hairbrush inlaid with lapis lazuli (100 gp), and a wooden jewelry box with electrum filigree (75 gp) holding a pearl necklace (250 gp), a platinum cameo shaped like a winged cat (50 gp), and two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} in thin crystal vials.
zh_tw: 這裡有 6 瓶優質的香水（每瓶 20 GP），一把鑲青金石銀髮刷（100 GP），一個盤琥珀金絲木首飾盒（75 GP）裡面放著一串珍珠項鍊（250 GP），一個翼貓白金浮雕（50 GP），兩瓶水晶瓶裝的{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

english: V17. Master Bedroom
zh_tw: V17. 主臥室

english: Duke Vanthampur retires to this chamber when she needs to rest or shake off a headache. She also takes most of her meals here. Food is delivered via a dumbwaiter in the southwest corner (see {@area area V5|0a3|x} for details), which has a cord that rings a bell in the kitchen. Other features of the room include a canopied bed with a gossamer shroud for keeping insects at bay, a freestanding wooden privacy screen, a cast-iron bathtub with clawed feet, a fireplace, and a padlocked iron chest. The padlock is cast in the shape of a horned devil's scowling visage. Thalamra Vanthampur carries the key to the padlock (see {@area area V28|0d0|x}), which can be picked by a character with {@item thieves' tools|phb} who succeeds on a {@dc 17} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾公爵會在她想要休息或者是擺脫頭疼的時候待在這裡。她通常也在這裡吃飯，食物從西南角的升降機那裡送上來（詳情請見{@area 區域V5|0a3|x}），那裡還綁著一根繩子用以搖響廚房的鈴鐺。這個房間裡還放有一張蓬床，掛著薄紗幕布用以隔絕蚊蟲，一張獨立的木屏風，一口爪足鑄鐵浴缸，一座壁爐，和一個帶有掛鎖的鐵箱，掛鎖被鑄成一張長角魔鬼的怒容。薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾帶著掛鎖的鑰匙（詳情請見{@area 區域V28|0d0|x}）一名角色可以透過使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的 {@dc 17} 敏捷檢定以開鎖。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest weighs 65 pounds and is trapped (see "Trap" below). It contains three thin, black-covered ledgers with entries written in Infernal (records of Duke Vanthampur's legitimate business dealings), a set of {@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB} (15 gp), a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB} (50 gp), a coin pouch made from a sheep's bladder (containing 22 pp, 85 gp, and 113 sp), and {@item pipes of the sewers}.
zh_tw: 箱子重 65 磅同時設有陷阱（詳情請見下文）。裡面裝有三本黑色封皮的薄賬本，上面使用煉獄語記錄了範薩姆普爾公爵的合法交易。一套{@item calligrapher's supplies|PHB|書法工具}（15 GP），一套{@item poisoner's kit|PHB|毒藥工具}（50 GP），一個由羊的膀胱做成的錢包（裡面裝有22 PP，85 GP和 113 SP）和{@item pipes of the sewers||喚鼠樂笙}。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The chest has a false bottom underlaid with metal springs. The combined weight of the items in the chest holds the false bottom down, but if three or more items are removed, the false bottom rises and pulls the cork out of a thin glass vial hidden underneath it. The uncorked vial releases a cloud of poisonous gas that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the chest. The cloud is stationary and lasts for 1 minute, or until it's dispersed by a strong wind. Any creature that starts its turn in the cloud must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 11 ({@dice 2d10}) poison damage.
zh_tw: 箱子的底部有一個活板，下面有一個金屬彈簧。這個活板承擔箱內所有物品的重量，但如果有三件或者更多的物件被拿出來的話，活板會彈出來同時拉掉藏在活板下的細玻璃瓶的木塞，被開啟的玻璃瓶會以木箱為中心釋放一個十尺半徑的毒霧，毒霧會持續一分鐘，或直到被強風吹散。任何在毒霧中開始回合的生物必須透過一次{@dc 13}的體質豁免，豁免失敗則遭受 11（{@dice 2d10}）的毒素傷害。

english: V18. Duke's Study
zh_tw: V18. 公爵的書房

english: An oak writing desk angled to face the middle of the room has a matching chair behind it and two black candlesticks atop it. Other furnishings include three bookcases and a freestanding suit of black plate armor topped with a bucket helm and equipped with a longsword and a shield. A wrought-iron spiral staircase leads up to {@area area V19|0bb|x}.
zh_tw: 一張橡木製成的書桌斜對房間的正中心，桌後襬著一把配套的椅子，桌上放著兩盞黑色燭臺。房間裡還有三個書架和一套獨立黑色板甲，帶著桶盔，裝備長劍和盾牌。一段鍛鐵螺旋樓梯通向{@area 區域V19|0bb|x}。

english: The suit of armor is a {@creature helmed horror} that was fashioned on Avernus. The construct understands Infernal but can't speak, and it is immune to the following spells: {@spell fire bolt}, {@spell sacred flame}, and {@spell shocking grasp}. The only creatures permitted in this area are Duke Vanthampur and her sons. If any other creature enters the room unescorted, a fiery orange light fills the helmed horror's hollow interior as it attacks. The helmed horror pursues intruders beyond the room, returning here only after the trespassers leave the villa or are hacked to pieces.
zh_tw: 這套盔甲是造於阿弗納斯的{@creature helmed horror||恐怖鎧甲}。這個構裝體能聽懂煉獄語，但不能說話，並且他對以下法術免疫：{@spell fire bolt||火焰箭}，{@spell sacred flame||聖火術}，{@spell shocking grasp||電爪}。唯一被允許進入這個區域的生物是範薩姆普爾公爵和她的兒子們。如果有任何沒有他們陪伴而進入此房間的其他生物，一道強烈的橘紅光芒便會充斥於這個恐怖鎧甲的中空內部並且攻擊他們。恐怖鎧甲會追趕逃出逃離房間的入侵者，直到他們離開別墅或被砍成碎片。

english: Bookcases
zh_tw: 書架

english: Duke Vanthampur abhors reading but keeps a modest library of fine literature for the sake of appearances. Her study contains two hundred books. A character who spends 1 hour sifting through the collection can find twenty rare first editions (25 gp each). The remaining books are worth 5 gp each to interested buyers, except for a worthless book titled {@i Last Charge of the Hellriders}. A cavity cut into its pages holds a small iron ring with two keys hanging from it. These keys unlock the cages in area V19.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾公爵雖然十分討厭讀書，但是擁有一個不大但是有優質藏書的閱覽室有助於塑造形象。她的書房裡藏有兩百多本書，如果角色在這裡消耗一個小時搜尋的話，他們可以發現 20 本稀有的初版書籍（每本 25 GP），剩下的書可以以每本 5 GP的價格被感興趣的買家收購。除此之外還有一本無價之寶，標題是{@i 地獄騎手的最後衝鋒}。書本被打了一個洞，裡面套著一個鐵環，上面掛著兩把鑰匙。這兩把鑰匙可以用來開啟區域 V19 的籠子。

english: V19. Tower Peak
zh_tw: V19. 塔頂

english: If the characters climb the wrought-iron spiral staircase from area V18, describe this room as follows:
zh_tw: 如果角色們從區域 V18 攀爬螺旋鐵樓梯抵達這裡，向他們對此區域作出如下描述：

english: The spiral staircase climbs fifteen feet to a square room with crisscrossing rafters ten feet overhead and a peaked roof above that. An empty bookcase dominates the west wall, and two filthy padlocked cages stand on the floor. Each cage holds a human prisoner and a chamberpot.
zh_tw: 螺旋狀的樓梯升高 15 尺到達了這個小房間，頭頂 10 尺便是交錯的屋椽和屋脊。西牆被一個空著的書架所佔據，兩個骯髒的掛鎖籠子立在地板上，每個裡面都關了一個人類囚犯和一個尿壺。

english: The keys to open the cages' padlocks can be found in {@area area V18|0b9|x}. A character with {@item thieves' tools|phb} can also pick a lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The locks can't be picked from inside the cages.
zh_tw: 籠子上的掛鎖可以透過在{@area 區域V18|0b9|x}找到的鑰匙開啟，角色也可以透過使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}，並且成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定開啟籠子，在籠子內側無法開啟鎖具。

english: Perched atop the cages are two {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps}. When no one else is around, the imps torment the prisoners with idle threats and taunts, and the prisoners know not to speak or cry out lest the imps sting them. The imps avoid combat with well-armed intruders. If anyone tries to free a prisoner, the {@condition invisible} imp closest to that prisoner slips through the bars of the cage and stings the prisoner to death, turning visible as it does so. On its next turn, the imp turns {@condition invisible} and takes refuge above the rafters.
zh_tw: 在籠子頂端待著兩隻{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}，當沒有人在附近的時候，這些小魔鬼會透過虛聲恫嚇和嘲諷奚落來折磨囚犯，這些囚犯們不會說話或者喊叫，以防止小魔鬼扎他們。小魔鬼會避免與全副武裝的入侵者戰鬥。如果有任何人嘗試釋放囚犯，{@condition invisible||隱形}的小魔鬼鑽進籠子的欄杆裡刺死囚犯，一旦它們這樣做了，就會變得可見。在他們的下一回合他們會重新{@condition invisible||隱形}，並且躲到上面的椽子裡去。

english: Prisoners
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: The prisoner in the northern cage is Shaleen Zoraz (neutral female human {@creature commoner}), a sewer maintenance supervisor who was backing an effort to extend the Lower City's sewer system into the underground space occupied by the {@area Dungeon of the Dead Three|03a|x}. Duke Vanthampur plans to hold Shaleen for a few days before letting her go. The imps have so terrorized Shaleen that, if freed, she intends to abandon her expansion plans and never say an unkind word about the Vanthampurs for the rest of her life.
zh_tw: 北側籠子裡面的囚犯是沙林·佐拉茲（中立人類女性{@creature commoner||平民}），她是下水道維護主管，正在推動下城區下水道系統擴張至{@area 死亡三神地城|03a|x}所在的區域。範薩姆普爾公爵打算在囚禁沙林幾天就放她離開，但小魔鬼們把她嚇壞了，一旦被釋放，她打算放棄她的擴張計劃並在餘生中再也不對範薩姆普爾家族說半個不善的詞。

english: The prisoner in the southern cage is Kaejil Orûnmar (neutral evil male human {@creature commoner}), a tax collector who has been giving the Vanthampurs a hard time. Once Duke Vanthampur is satisfied that no one important will miss him, she plans to kill Kaejil and feed his remains to the rats in the city sewers. If freed, Kaejil plans to leave Baldur's Gate and never return.
zh_tw: 南面籠子裡關的囚犯是卡吉爾·奧魯瑪爾（中立邪惡人類男性{@creature commoner||平民}）這個收稅人曾讓範薩姆普爾家艱難度日。一旦範薩姆普爾公爵意識到沒有什麼大人物會關心他的話，她就會把他殺了丟進下水道喂老鼠。如果他被釋放，卡吉爾打算永遠的離開博德之門。

english: Under the Villa
zh_tw: 別墅之下

english: Map 1.6: Under the Villa
zh_tw: 地圖 1.6：別墅之下

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: As the minister responsible for the city's sewer system, Thalamra Vanthampur cordoned off the sewers beneath her villa, creating a private dungeon complex where she could conduct religious ceremonies and harbor guests who share her devotion to the archdevil Zariel.
zh_tw: 作為城市下水道系統的負責人，薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾封鎖了她別墅下面的下水道，在那裡建造了一個秘密地城，在此她可以進行宗教儀式並庇護和她同樣獻身於魔鬼大公扎瑞爾的人。

english: Dungeon Features
zh_tw: 地下城特徵物

english: The dungeon is remarkably clean and kept in excellent condition. Its common features are summarized here.
zh_tw: 這個地城異常乾淨，維護狀況極佳。它的通用特徵包括以下內容：

english: {@b Lit Tunnels}. Tunnels are 9 feet high and have curved ceilings. Oil lanterns fitted with thick panes of green-tinted glass hang at regular intervals on 1-foot-long iron chains. Each lantern sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} in a 10-foot radius.
zh_tw: {@b 亮燈的隧道}。隧道高9尺，擁有弧形天花板。裝有厚綠色玻璃板的燃油提燈以1尺長的鐵鏈懸掛，間隔固定。每盞提燈在10尺半徑內提供{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。

english: {@b Iron Doors}. Doors are made of riveted iron plates, with iron handles and well-oiled hinges. Some doors have locks or barred windows set into them, as noted in the text. A character can use {@item thieves' tools|phb} to pick a door's lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check, or force open a locked door with a successful {@dc 24} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: {@b 鐵門}。這裡的門都是由鉚接鐵板做成的，上面還有鐵質把手和保養良好的鉸鏈。有些門上有鎖或者帶柵欄的窗戶，如文中所述。一名角色可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來開啟門鎖，或者透過一次 {@dc 24} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定以撞開這扇門。

english: {@b Surfaces and Secret Doors}. The dungeon has brick walls and stone-tiled floors. Rooms have 10-foot-high plaster ceilings. Secret doors blend in with the surrounding walls, but a character with {@sense darkvision} or sufficient light can find a secret door with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: {@b 地板和密門}。 地城擁有磚砌牆壁和鋪石地板。房間裡面都擁有 10 尺高的石膏天花板。密門都與牆融為一體，但是一名擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}的角色或者在擁有足夠光照的情況下可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以找到密門。

english: {@b Smell of Incense}. Pairs of black-robed human {@creature Cultist||cultists} march through the corridors with censers, constantly perfuming the sewers with incense to counteract what would otherwise be a mildly nauseating stench.
zh_tw: {@b 薰香氣息}。穿黑袍的人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}會成對的提著香爐行經走廊，持續的焚香薰染下水道，不然就會有令人作嘔的輕微臭氣。

english: {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}

english: Dungeon Locations
zh_tw: 地下城地區

english: Before the characters descend into the dungeon, allow them to advance to 4th level.
zh_tw: 在角色們進入地城之前，請使他們升到4級。

english: The following area descriptions are keyed to {@adventure map 1.6|BGDIA|1|Map 1.6: Under the Villa}.
zh_tw: 下文中的區域描述的是{@adventure 地圖 1.6|BGDIA|1|Map 1.6: Under the Villa}。

english: V20. Cellar
zh_tw: V20. 地下室

english: The characters might enter this cellar by descending the stairs from {@area area V7|0a5|x}, or they might enter through the eastern door. Read the following boxed text to establish what they see from either direction:
zh_tw: 角色們也許會透過{@area 區域V7|0a5|x}的樓梯進入這個區域,也可能從東側的門進入該區域。不管他們從哪個方向進入，向他們對該區域做出以下描述。

english: Four stone pillars brace the ten-foot-high vaulted ceiling of this dry cellar, the walls of which are lined by a dozen barrels on wooden braces. Half the barrels have brass spigots tapped into them. The room also contains two stacks of wooden crates—one in the middle of the room and another by the south wall.
zh_tw: 四根石柱支撐著這個房間十尺高的的拱形天花板，牆邊的木架子上排列著一打木桶。一半的桶子上插著黃銅水龍頭。房間裡還放著兩堆木箱，一堆在房間的中間，另一堆在南牆邊。

english: The topmost crate in the middle of the room contains three {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} that spy on this area through knotholes in the crate's sides. These devils burst forth and attack intruders on sight. The other crates in the middle of the cellar contain dried meat, loaves of bread, wheels of cheese, and other assorted foodstuffs—enough to sustain the Vanthampurs and the cultists in the dungeon for a month. The crates by the south wall contain candles, oil flasks, incense, and rat traps.
zh_tw: 房子中間最上方的箱子裡放著三隻{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}，他們藏在箱子中使用箱子上的節孔來監視這個房間。這些魔鬼會從箱中突然殺出襲擊看到的入侵者。中間其他的箱子裡放著乾肉，長條麵包，乳酪輪和其他型別的食物——這些食物足夠範薩姆普爾和那些教徒們在這個地城中生活一個月。南面的箱子裡則放著蠟燭，瓶裝燈油，薰香和捕鼠夾。

english: Six of the barrels contain drinking water, and six contain ale.
zh_tw: 有 6 個桶裝了飲用水，而另外的 6 個則裝著麥酒。

english: V21. Wine Cellar
zh_tw: V21. 酒窖

english: More than two hundred corked bottles of wine are displayed in seven-foot-tall wooden racks that span the west and south walls. Empty wooden crates are stacked in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 七尺高的木架橫跨西牆和南牆，上面陳列著超過 200 瓶塞著木塞的葡萄酒。房子的中間堆著空木箱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Seventeen of the bottles contain fine wine (10 gp per bottle). The remaining wines on display are common vintages (1 sp per bottle).
zh_tw: 有 17 瓶上等葡萄酒（10 GP每瓶），剩下的都是普通葡萄酒（1 SP每瓶）。

english: V22. Sewer Tunnels
zh_tw: V22. 汙水管道

english: The dungeon's denizens make frequent use of these lit tunnels. The thick smell of incense hangs in the air (see "{@area Dungeon Features|0bf|x}" above).
zh_tw: 因為地城中的居民會頻繁的使用這些隧道，所以這裡的空氣中瀰漫著濃厚的薰香味（詳情請見上文"{@area 地下城特徵物|0bf|x}"）

english: Smooth stone trenches cut into the floors channel water and waste toward {@area area V30|0d7|x}. These trenches are 4 feet wide and 3 feet deep, with arching stone bridges spanning them at irregular intervals. The ledge on either side of a trench is 3 feet wide.
zh_tw: 光滑的石頭水溝分開地板，將水和汙物排入{@area 區域V30|0d7|x}。水溝寬 4 尺深 3 尺，不定間距的石質拱橋會橫跨水溝。水溝兩側的窄道各寬 3 尺。

english: Wandering Monsters
zh_tw: 遊蕩怪物

english: Ordinary rats occasionally enter the dungeon through the open pipes in the walls. The cultists lay traps to catch and kill these rats while they perfume the dungeon with incense. As the characters make their way through the tunnels, they might encounter these cultists.
zh_tw: 偶爾會有一些普通老鼠透過牆上開口的管道進入地城。教徒們會在焚香薰染地城的同時放置一些捕鼠夾來捕殺那些老鼠。當角色們在隧道里行走的時候，他們可能會遇上這些邪教徒。

english: A typical encounter consists of two lawful evil human {@creature Cultist||cultists} dressed in black robes, each carrying a censer and wearing a thin, golden mask shaped like a devil's face (and worth 25 gp to an interested buyer). The censers contain burning incense. A devil mask covers its wearer's whole face except for the eyes, nostrils, and mouth. No two masks look exactly alike.
zh_tw: 典型遭遇由兩名守序邪惡人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}組成，他們身著黑色長袍，都拿著一個香爐，戴著一張黃金魔鬼薄面具（對感興趣的買家來說每張面具價值 25 GP），香爐裡放著一塊燃燒著的薰香。面具擋住了穿戴者的整張臉，只露出眼睛，鼻孔和嘴巴。沒有兩張面具看著完全一樣。

english: If this encounter occurs in a tunnel that has a sewer trench running down the middle of it, the two cultists are walking on opposite sides of the trench, moving in the same direction while swinging their censers gently. You can make the encounter harder by replacing the cultists with {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics}, or adding one or more {@condition invisible} {@creature Imp||imps} as escorts.
zh_tw: 如果遭遇發生在中間有水溝延伸的隧道里，兩名邪教徒會沿相同的方向走在水溝的兩邊，同時輕輕搖擺香爐。你可以透過將邪教徒替換成{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}或是增加一隻或更多{@condition invisible||隱形}{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}來加強這個遭遇。

english: If any wandering cultists are defeated, reduce the number of cultists encountered in {@area area V33|0db|x} accordingly. If the characters make no effort to hide the bodies of the cultists they defeat, someone stumbles upon them eventually and warns the {@creature barbed devil} in {@area area V26|0ca|x}. Assuming it hasn't been defeated already, the devil scours the dungeon for trespassers once notified of their presence.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了任意數量的邪教徒，將{@area 區域V33|0db|x}遭遇的教徒的數量進行相應的減少。如果角色們沒有嘗試去隱藏那些邪教徒的屍體，將會有人無意發現這些屍體同時將此事報告給{@area 區域V26|0ca|x}的{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}，前提是他還沒有被擊敗。一旦這個魔鬼被告知出現入侵者，他就會開始搜尋入侵者。

english: V23. Cold Storage
zh_tw: V23. 冷藏室

english: The Vanthampurs store animal carcasses and other fresh meat in this room. Hanging in the middle of the room from the 10-foot-high ceiling are six 3-foot-long chains, each ending in a hook. Flayed boar carcasses hang from four of the hooks, while the remaining two hooks are bare.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾家族將動物的屍體和其他新鮮肉類儲存在這個房間。這個房間中間 10 尺高的天花板上，掛著 6 根三尺長的鐵鏈，每一根的末尾都有一個鐵鉤。其中 4 根鐵鉤掛著一個被剝皮的野豬屍體，剩下兩根鉤子則什麼都沒有掛。

english: V24. Dining Room
zh_tw: V24. 餐廳

english: The cultists dine here, though none are present when the characters first arrive. Two wooden trestle tables with benches stand in the middle of the room, which is brightly lit by six tall wrought-iron candlesticks spaced along the walls. Each candlestick stands six feet high and has nine lit candles at the top of it.
zh_tw: 教徒們會在這裡用餐，但是當角色們第一次抵達時，這裡不會有任何人。房子的中間放著兩張帶長椅的擱板桌，沿著牆還放著 6 個鍛鐵高燭臺。每個燭臺都有 6 尺高，上面點著 9 根蠟燭。

english: V25. Kitchen
zh_tw: V25. 廚房

english: The cultists prepare their meals here, though no cultists are present when the characters first arrive. The kitchen is uncomfortably warm and contains a pair of brightly burning cast-iron stoves with piles of wood next to them. Other furnishings include a wooden trestle table where food is prepared, as well as shelves lined with plates, mugs, pots, utensils, and jars of ingredients and spices.
zh_tw: 教徒們會在這裡準備食物，但是當角色們第一次抵達時，這裡不會有任何人。整個廚房熱的令人不適，裡面放著兩座正在熊熊燃燒的鑄鐵爐灶，旁邊還放著成堆的木柴。房間裡的其他陳設包括一張擺著做好的食物的木桌，上面擺滿了盤子，杯子，鍋，其他用具和還有裝有幾罐調料與香料的架子。

english: V26. Temple of Zariel
zh_tw: V26. 扎瑞爾的神殿

english: The iron double door leading to this room has Infernal runes carved into its arched door frame. A character who understands Infernal can translate these runes as follows: "That which falls can rise again."
zh_tw: 通向這個房間的鐵質雙開門的拱形鐵門框上刻有煉獄語銘文。理解煉獄語的角色可以翻譯出符文上的內容"那墜落者亦將歸來"。

english: Disguised Characters
zh_tw: 偽裝的角色

english: Characters can disguise themselves using masks and robes taken from defeated cultists. While disguised in this fashion, characters have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks made to fool devils and cult members in the dungeon under Vanthampur Villa.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過使用那些被擊敗的教徒的長袍和麵具偽裝他們自己。如果他們這麼做了，則他們在這個範薩姆普爾別墅地下區域中對那些愚蠢的魔鬼和教徒進行的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定具有優勢。

english: A character who listens at the double door or one of the secret doors leading to this room hears a half dozen humanoid voices chanting in Infernal. Characters who listen to the chants and understand that language can discern praise heaped upon the archdevil Zariel for her tireless effort to win the Blood War.
zh_tw: 如果有角色在大門或者是另一扇通往這個房間的密門上偷聽的話，他可以聽到大概有 6 個類人生物的聲音正在使用煉獄語進行禱告。如果角色進行了竊聽且理解這門語言的話，他們可以聽出這是對魔鬼大公扎瑞爾為贏得血戰而付出的不懈努力的讚美。

english: When the characters enter the room, set the scene by reading aloud the following boxed text:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個房間時，向他們對該區域作出如下描述：

english: Two rows of tall wrought-iron candlesticks light this vaulted chamber, each one bearing nine flickering candles. A seven-foot-tall statue of an angel with white glowing eyes and a longsword stands atop a dais to the south. A six-foot-tall fiend bristling with spines stands west of the statue, glaring at four black-robed cultists who kneel and chant in the middle of the room, their faces hidden behind golden devil masks. Nine tapestries depicting the layers of the Nine Hells adorn the walls.
zh_tw: 兩排鍛鐵高燭臺照亮了這個房間，每個燭臺上都有 9 根燃燒的蠟燭。房間南端的高臺上矗立著一尊手持長劍眼放白光高達七尺的天使雕像。在雕像的西側站著的是一個 6 尺高，渾身尖刺豎立的魔鬼，他正瞪著跪在房間中間禱告的 4 名黑袍教徒，他們的臉為黃金面具所遮蓋。牆上裝飾著 9 張描繪著九獄各層景象的掛毯。

english: The spined fiend is a {@creature barbed devil} named Odious. Sent by Zariel to serve Duke Vanthampur, the devil answers only to those two. The chanting figures are four lawful evil human {@creature Cultist||cultists} wearing black robes and golden devil masks similar to those worn by the cultists in {@area area V22|0c5|x}. The devil and the cultists attack intruders on sight, but can be duped by characters wearing disguises (see the "{@area Disguised Characters|0cb|x}" sidebar).
zh_tw: 這個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}名叫歐迪沃斯，他是扎瑞爾派來服侍範薩姆普爾公爵的，這個魔鬼只聽命於他們兩個人。在進行禱告的是 4 名人類守序邪惡{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，他們穿著黑袍，戴著金色面具和{@area 區域V22|0c5|x}中的教徒十分相似。魔鬼和教徒會攻擊他們看到的入侵者，但是角色們可以透過偽裝來矇混過關（詳情請見{@area 偽裝的角色|0cb|x}）。

english: Statue
zh_tw: 雕像

english: The statue represents Zariel in her angelic form. It's a Large object with AC 17, 33 hit points, and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. Toppling the statue with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check causes it to shatter on the floor.
zh_tw: 這個雕像展現的是扎瑞爾的天使形態，它是一個大型物體同時具有AC 17，HP 33，免疫火焰，毒素和心靈傷害。將這個雕像推倒，摔碎在地板上，需要一次成功的 {@dc 20} 的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The statue's head and neck are hollow. Lodged in this cavity is a {@item +1 mace} that can be removed only if the statue is destroyed. The head of the mace sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 5-foot-radius and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 5 feet. The wielder of the mace can extinguish or ignite its light as an action. (This light is what causes the statue's eyes to glow.)
zh_tw: 雕像的頭部和頸部是空心的。在這個空腔中卡著一把{@item +1 mace||+1 硬頭錘}，只有摧毀雕像才能將其取出。這把硬頭錘的頭部會散發出半徑5尺的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}和額外5尺的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。硬頭錘的持有者可以用一個動作熄滅或點燃它的光亮。（正是這種光亮導致了雕像的眼睛發光。）

english: V27. Escape Tunnel
zh_tw: V27. 撤離通道

english: Hidden behind a secret door, this tunnel has a wooden ladder at its north end. The ladder climbs a 15-foot-high shaft to a trapdoor that opens into {@area area V2|09d|x}.
zh_tw: 藏在密門後面的這個通道在北部有一個木梯子，這個梯子向上 15 尺通到{@area 區域V2|09d|x}。

english: V28. Secret Shrine
zh_tw: V28. 秘密神殿

english: This room is hidden behind secret doors (see "{@area Dungeon Features|0bf|x}"). The scraping noise either door makes when opened is loud enough to alert the room's occupant. Read the following when the characters enter:
zh_tw: 這個房間隱藏在密門之後（詳情請見{@area 地下城特徵物|0bf|x}）。不管哪一扇門開啟，門發出的刮擦聲都會驚動房間裡的人。當角色們進入該區域時對該區域做出如下描述：

english: This room is lit by a pair of tall wrought-iron candlesticks in the northeast and southeast corners. Nine candles burn atop each one, casting flickering light across a claw-footed altar carved from a single block of obsidian, and which has a small angel-shaped flame erupting from its top. A gray-haired woman kneels before the altar.
zh_tw: 這個房間被東南角和東北角的兩隻鍛鐵燭臺所照亮。每個燭臺上都有 9 根蠟燭，閃爍的燭光灑在一座用整塊黑曜石雕琢而成的爪足祭壇上，祭壇頂端冒出天使形狀的火焰。一名灰髮女人跪在祭壇前方。

english: {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} kneels before the altar. She wears fine clothing fit for a noble of her stature and carries no weapons. However, she possesses magical powers bestowed upon her by Zariel, her infernal patron. Any intrusion is greeted with hostility, and the duke is not squeamish about smashing foes with her bare hands if she finds herself in melee. Don't forget her Hellish Rebuke reaction, which she can use twice per day (but only once before her next turn).
zh_tw: {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}正跪在這個祭壇前。她穿著一身與她貴族身份相匹配的高檔服裝同時沒有攜帶任何武器。但是她擁有她的地獄宗主扎瑞爾賜予她的魔法力量。任何入侵行為都會招致公爵的攻擊，而她也並非花瓶，一旦陷入近戰就會赤手空拳的進行猛擊。不要忘記她的煉獄叱喝反應動作，她每天可以施展兩次這種法術（但是在她的下一回合開始之前只能使用一次。）

english: If she is reduced to fewer than half her hit points, Thalamra tries to escape through the nearest secret door that isn't blocked. She either moves to {@area area V36|0e1|x} or attempts to flee via {@area area V27|0cf|x}. Proud to a fault, she would rather die than surrender or be taken prisoner—and she happily watches any of her sons die before consenting to ransom demands. When death finally takes her, Thalamra's dying words to her killers are, "See you in hell."
zh_tw: 如果她的生命值低於一半，薩拉瑪拉會嘗試從最近的可以通行的密道逃脫。她會選擇前往{@area 區域V36|0e1|x}，或者透過{@area 區域V27|0cf|x}逃跑。因為太過驕傲，她寧死不降，或者是被俘虜。而她也樂於見到自己的任意一名子嗣在自己接受贖金勒索之前死掉。當她死的時候，她會把遺言告訴擊殺她的人"地獄再見。"

english: Thalamra keeps two keys in a pocket of her dress. One key unlocks the chest in her bedroom ({@area area V17|0b6|x}); the other key unlocks the door to the vault ({@area area V36|0e1|x}).
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉的裙子口袋裡，放著兩把鑰匙，一把是用來開啟她臥室裡的箱子（{@area 區域V17|0b6|x}），另一把是用來開啟前往寶庫的門（{@area 區域V36|0e1|x}）。

english: Obsidian Altar
zh_tw: 黑曜石祭壇

english: The black altar weighs 800 pounds and has tiny Infernal runes carved in a ring around the nine-inch-tall, angel-shaped flame erupting from its top. This flame bears only a vague resemblance to Zariel. Defacing any of the altar's runes extinguishes the flame and causes the altar to crack in two.
zh_tw: 這個黑色的祭壇中重 800 磅，一圈細小的煉獄符文圍著其頂端噴出的九寸高天使形火焰。這火焰與扎瑞爾僅有模糊的相似性。損壞任意的符文會導致火焰熄滅而導致祭壇破碎成兩半。

english: V29. Prison
zh_tw: V29. 監獄

english: Read the following boxed text when the characters open the door to this room:
zh_tw: 當角色進入該區域時，對該區域做出如下描述：

english: A broad-shouldered figure with purple skin and a beard of writhing snakelike tentacles stands in the middle of a room lined by iron doors, tightening its grip on a glaive as it glares at you through the darkness. Each door is set with a small barred window, and a ring of keys hangs from the creature's belt.
zh_tw: 一名寬肩膀，紫皮膚，有著扭動的蛇形鬍鬚的身影正站在有一排鐵門的房間中間，它在黑暗中緊緊盯著你們，且握緊了手中的長柄刀。每扇鐵門都有一扇裝了欄杆的小窗戶，而鑰匙環就掛在這個生物的腰帶上。

english: The prison guard is a {@creature bearded devil} named Thoss, which attacks anyone it perceives as an intruder or a threat. Characters disguised as cultists can try to dupe Thoss into allowing them to interrogate or release prisoners (see the "{@area Disguised Characters|0cb|x}"). The keys dangling from the devil's belt unlock the cell doors.
zh_tw: 這個獄警是一個名叫託斯的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}，他會攻擊任何他認為是入侵者或者有威脅的人。如果角色進行了偽裝的話，角色可以嘗試唬騙他審訊或者釋放囚犯（詳情請見"{@area 偽裝的角色|0cb|x}"）。魔鬼腰上的鑰匙就是用來解開牢房的門的。

english: Two of the cells (your choice) contain prisoners. The other four cells are empty, though captured characters might end up here (see the "{@area Imprisoned Characters|0d8|x}" sidebar). If you need to introduce a new party member to replace one who died, that character can begin the adventure locked in one of the empty cells.
zh_tw: 有兩個牢房（由你選擇）裝有犯人，剩下的4個則是空的，而那些被逮捕的角色，也可能被關在這裡（詳情請見"{@area 被囚禁的角色|0d8|x}"）。如果你需要引入一位新的角色，來替代那些死亡的角色，這個角色可以從其中一個空的牢房裡開始新的冒險。

english: Falaster Fisk
zh_tw: 福萊斯特·菲斯克

english: The first prisoner is a short, lean, erudite male human in his fifties named Falaster Fisk. Originally from Calimshan, Falaster is a neutral {@creature spy} with no weapons. He speaks Common and Infernal, wears an ankle-length caftan, and has dark hair. His neatly trimmed goatee beard is dyed crimson.
zh_tw: 第1位囚犯是一名矮小，精瘦，博學，五十多歲的人類男性，他叫福萊斯特·菲斯克。他出生於卡林珊，福萊斯特是一名中立{@creature spy||間諜}，沒有攜帶任何武器。他會說通用語和煉獄語，穿著一件及踝束腰長袍，有著黑色頭髮。他修剪整齊的黑色山羊鬍被染成了深紅色。

english: Falaster works for {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA}, a tiefling expert on the Nine Hells currently based in Candlekeep. When {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} arrived in Baldur's Gate a few days ago, it didn't take Falaster long to hear rumors that the Vanthampurs were sheltering him. Falaster tried to find out why and was caught. He can provide his rescuers with the following useful information:
zh_tw: 福萊斯特為{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}工作，西爾維拉是一名九獄方面的提夫林專家，現在正以燭堡為據點進行活動。在{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}幾天之前抵達博德之門後，福萊斯特很快就打聽到了範薩姆普爾公爵正在為他提供庇護的訊息。福萊斯特在準備查明原因的時候被抓獲，他可以為救他的人提供以下有用的資訊：

english: "{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} is a sage who operates out of Candlekeep. A good friend of mine! She's been monitoring devil activity in Baldur's Gate and Elturel for months."
zh_tw: "{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}是一位在燭堡工作的智者，她同時也是我的好朋友。他已經監視博德之門地區和艾爾托瑞爾地區的魔鬼活動好幾個月了。"

english: "Sylvira is convinced that {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} struck a bargain with an archdevil, and that a copy of the contract he signed is hidden inside a magic puzzle box. She asked me to help her obtain proof of Kreeg's crimes."
zh_tw: "西爾維拉確信{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}和某位魔鬼大公達成了契約，而帶有他簽名的契約副本就藏在一個魔法謎盒中。她要我幫忙搜尋克雷格的犯罪證據。"

english: "Sylvira is no friend of {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s. She thinks she can open his puzzle box, and is willing to pay for it—in gold or magic items."
zh_tw: "西爾維拉對{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}並無好感。她認為自己能開啟他的謎盒，並願意為此支付報酬——不論黃金還是魔法物品。"

english: If released, Falaster helps the characters as best he can while staying out of harm's way. Expecting that he might be caught, he obtained and memorized a floor plan of the dungeon under Vanthampur Villa. He can thus lead his rescuers to secret rooms ({@area areas V28|0d0|x} and {@area V34|0dc|x}) and the Vanthampurs' vault ({@area area V36|0e1|x}).
zh_tw: 如果他被釋放了，福萊斯特會努力在遠離傷害的情況下幫助角色。因為他預料到自己可能會被抓住，所以他已經將這個地城的地圖熟記於胸，他可以將角色帶到密室（{@area 區域V28|0d0|x}和{@area V34|0dc|x}）和範薩姆普爾的寶庫（{@area 區域V36|0e1|x}）。

english: Satiir Thione-Hhune
zh_tw: 薩蒂爾·席歐妮·胡妮

english: The second prisoner is a fit, aristocratic human woman in her seventies named Lady Satiir Thione-Hhune. Born into the rich and politically powerful Hhune patriar family, Satiir is a neutral evil {@creature noble} with no weapons or armor (AC 11). She was kidnapped by the Vanthampurs to be used as leverage in the event that the Hhunes find out who stole the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} from their family's crypt.
zh_tw: 第 2 位囚犯是一位 70 多歲，身體健康，有貴族氣質的人類女性，被稱為薩蒂爾•席歐尼•胡內夫人。她出生於富有而且權傾朝野的胡內宗貴家族，薩蒂爾是一名中立邪惡{@creature noble||貴族}，沒有攜帶任何的武器或護甲（AC 11）。範薩姆普爾家族綁架她來用作當胡內家族發現是誰從他們的家族墓地裡偷出{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}時的籌碼。

english: Unknown to the Vanthampurs, Satiir is a member of a secret evil order whose members call themselves the Knights of the Shield, and who are the self-appointed guardians of the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}. Satiir doesn't speak of the shield. Instead, she tells her rescuers that the Vanthampurs were planning to use her to keep the Hhunes from opposing Duke Vanthampur's bid to become the new grand duke. If Satiir is allowed to escape, she informs her family and associates that the Vanthampurs stole the shield, destroying Duke Vanthampur's political future in Baldur's Gate. The characters might encounter more of Satiir's friends on the way to Candlekeep (see "{@area Knights of the Shield|0ed|x}").
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾家族不知道的是，薩蒂爾也是一個自稱為堅盾騎士團的秘密邪惡騎士團的成員，他們自稱為{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}的守護人。薩蒂爾不會談論關於盾牌的事情，她會告訴她的解救者範薩姆普爾家族計劃透過綁架她來防止胡內家族阻撓範薩姆普爾公爵成為新任大公的努力。如果薩迪爾逃離了這裡，她會通知她的家人和同僚範薩姆普爾家族偷走了盾牌一事，並將範薩姆普爾公爵的政治生涯徹底摧毀。角色們可能會在前往燭堡的路上，遇到更多薩蒂爾的朋友（詳情請見"{@area 堅盾騎士團|0ed|x}"）。

english: V30. Barrier of Iron Bars
zh_tw: V30. 鐵柵欄

english: This sewer tunnel slopes down gradually toward the south, channeling water and sewage into the city's sewer system. The tunnel is blocked by a 10-foot-square barrier composed of vertical iron bars with 6-inch gaps between them—enough room for a rat to saunter through, but too narrow for normal-sized characters to squeeze through. The bars are embedded deep into the stone of the floor and ceiling.
zh_tw: 這裡的下水管道向著南部緩慢下降，將這裡的汙水和廢物衝入城市的下水管道。這個隧道有 10 尺長的縱向的鐵柵欄所封閉，柵欄之間的 6 寸間隙足夠那些老鼠悠閒的爬進來，但對於正常體型的角色來說非常太過狹窄，以致不能擠過。這些鐵條深深的嵌入了地板和天花板。

english: A character can bend the bars with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, creating a gap wide enough for a Medium or smaller humanoid to squeeze through.
zh_tw: 角色可以成功的透過一次 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定以掰彎鐵管，創造一個足夠中型或者小型類人生物穿過的縫隙。

english: Imprisoned Characters
zh_tw: 被囚禁的角色

english: If the characters are defeated in Vanthampur Villa or the dungeon below, you can have the bad guys stabilize dying party members, strip them of their gear (which is stored in {@area area V28|0d0|x}), and lock them in the prison ({@area area V29|0d3|x}). This alternative to a "total party kill" scenario affords {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} and her cultists the opportunity to interrogate the characters and find out what they know. It also sets up the possibility of a prison break.
zh_tw: 如果有角色在範薩姆普爾別墅或者是下面的地城中被擊敗的話，你可以讓敵人穩定瀕死隊員的傷勢，卸下他的裝備（這些東西會被存放在{@area 區域V28|0d0|x}），將他們鎖在牢房裡（{@area 區域V29|0d3|x}）。這個選項也可以用來處理"團滅"的情況，在這種情境下{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}和她的邪教徒會有機會審問角色搞清他們所知道的事，這同樣也給角色們也創造了一次越獄的機會。

english: V31. Vestry
zh_tw: V31. 祭衣室

english: Four wooden wardrobes stand against the walls in this area. The cultists store their robes and masks in these wardrobes before leaving the dungeon and returning to the city above. The wardrobes along the west wall stand empty. Characters who search the wardrobe on the south wall find four sets of black robes and four gold devil masks, as worn by the cultists encountered elsewhere in the dungeon.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆邊立著 4 個木質衣櫃，教徒們會在他們離開地城返回上方的城市之前，將他們的長袍和麵具放在這些衣櫃裡。西牆邊的衣櫃是空著的，如果角色們搜尋南邊的衣櫃的話，他們會發現 4 套長袍和 4 個金魔鬼薄面具，這些東西和地城其他地方遇到的教徒們穿的是一樣的。

english: V32. Connecting Tunnel
zh_tw: V32. 連線隧道

english: The {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} from two of the cultists' green-glass lanterns doesn't reach the ends of this corridor, creating pools of darkness there. Two lawful evil human {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics} guard the tunnel, one at each end. Characters with {@sense darkvision} or their own light sources spot the fanatics. Otherwise, the fanatics surprise the characters. Each fanatic wears a black robe and a thin gold devil mask similar to those worn by cultists in other areas.
zh_tw: 兩名邪教徒的綠玻璃提燈發出的{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}無法觸及這條走廊的兩端，在那裡形成了黑暗區域。兩名守序邪惡的人類{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}守衛著這條隧道，兩端各有一名。擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或自帶光源的角色可以發現這些狂信者。否則，狂信者將突襲角色。每名狂信者都穿著一件黑色法袍，戴著一個薄金魔鬼面具，與在其他區域活動的邪教徒所戴的面具相似。

english: Sounds of combat here alert the cultists in area V33, who arm themselves but stay where they are.
zh_tw: 在這裡發生的打鬥會被 V33 區域的教徒所察覺，他們會馬上武裝自己但是會待在原地。

english: V33. Cultists' Quarters
zh_tw: V33. 教徒大廳宿舍

english: This room is lit by two tall wrought-iron candlesticks each topped with nine flickering candles. Around the room's perimeter are ten wooden bunk beds, next to which are unlocked footlockers containing ordinary clothes belonging to the cultists.
zh_tw: 這個房間被兩個高大的鍛鐵燭臺所照亮，每個燭臺上都擺有九根蠟燭。房間裡貼邊擺放了十張木質雙人床，床邊擺放著沒上鎖的私人物品箱，裡面裝的是教徒們平常的衣物。

english: Ten {@creature Cultist||cultists} gather here, minus any cultists defeated in {@area area V22|0c5|x}. These cult members are lawful evil humans wearing black robes and thin gold devil masks. Some have dozed off, while others are sitting on their beds, sharing rumors regarding {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s hand in the fall of Elturel and Duke Vanthampur's plans for Baldur's Gate. These cultists show intruders no quarter.
zh_tw: 這裡一共聚集了 10 名{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}，但是要減去在{@area 區域V22|0c5|x}所擊敗的教徒數量。這些教徒都是守序邪惡人類，穿著黑色的長袍戴著金色的面具。他們中的有些人正在打盹，其他人還坐在他們的床邊討論著關於{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}在艾爾托瑞爾的隕落和範薩姆普爾公爵的計劃中的作用的流言。這些教徒會毫不留情的攻擊入侵者。

english: Sounds of combat here alert the cult fanatics in {@area area V32|0da|x}, who investigate immediately.
zh_tw: 這裡的戰鬥聲音會驚動{@area 區域V32|0da|x}的邪教狂信者，並且他們會馬上過來調查。

english: V34. Ritual Chamber
zh_tw: V34. 儀式室

english: This room is hidden behind secret doors (see "{@area Dungeon Features|0bf|x}"), and its features are as follows:
zh_tw: 這個房間隱藏在密門之後（詳情請見"{@area 地下城特徵物|0bf|x}"），同時它的特徵如下文所描述：

english: This ten-foot-high vaulted chamber has a plaster ceiling painted with images of terrifying winged devils looking down on a symbol embedded in the room's floor: a circular disk of black stone inscribed with a nine-pointed gold star. Four wrought-iron candlesticks bristling with unlit, half-melted red candles surround the circle.
zh_tw: 這間十尺高的拱形房間有一面石膏天花板，其上畫著若干駭人的帶翼魔鬼，這些魔鬼看向下方地板上嵌入的符號：一刻著金色九芒星的黑石圓盤。四隻未點燃的鐵燭臺豎在周圍，半融的紅蠟燭圍在圓盤周圍。

english: The cultists use this chamber to perform diabolical rituals that duplicate the effect of a {@spell divination} spell, except that the spell's contact is a devil that manifests as a pillar of smoke above the symbol on the floor. The images on the ceiling are pit fiends, recognizable by any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check.
zh_tw: 邪教徒們在這裡透過一種魔鬼儀式來複制{@spell divination||預言}的效果，不同的是這道法術聯絡的是一名以煙柱形象出現在地板符號上方的魔鬼。天花板上畫著的是深獄煉魔，角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）來瞭解到這件事。

english: V35. Thavius Kreeg's Quarters
zh_tw: V35. 塔維斯·克雷格的房間

english: Describe this room to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 向角色對該區域做出以下描述：

english: Wrought-iron candlesticks topped with flickering candles light this room, which is heated by a cast-iron stove with clawed feet. Across from the crackling stove is a modest desk with a matching chair. Other furnishings include a small table and chair for dining, a bed, an iron chest resting at the foot of the bed, and two tapestries: one showing spirits rising as lemure devils from the River Styx, and another depicting a dead man dangling like a marionette from hooked chains.
zh_tw: 鐵燭臺上搖曳的燭光照亮了這個被鐵質爪足火爐溫暖的房間。劈啪作響的火爐對面是一套樸素的桌椅。除此之外還有一張帶椅子的小餐桌，一張床，床角處放著一口鐵箱子和兩幅掛畫：一幅展示了靈魂從冥河中蛻變為劣魔的過程，另一幅描繪了一個像是提線木偶般被帶鉤鐵鏈懸吊著的死人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Thavius keeps a holy symbol of Torm (a silver pendant shaped like a right-handed gauntlet on the end of a silver chain) in the chest. The holy symbol is worth 25 gp. The chest contains nothing else.
zh_tw: 塔維斯將一個託姆的聖徽（一條穿著右手護手外形掛飾的銀鏈）放在了箱子裡。這個聖徽價值 25 GP，箱子裡沒有放其他東西了。

english: V36. Vanthampur Vault
zh_tw: V36. 範薩姆普爾的寶庫

english: The door to this room is locked (see "{@area Dungeon Features|0bf|x}"), and Duke Vanthampur has the only key. The door can be unlocked from the inside without the key. When the characters open the door to the vault, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to set the scene:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是被鎖著的（詳情請見"{@area 地下城特徵物|0bf|x}"），而範薩姆普爾公爵擁有唯一的鑰匙。如果從內部解鎖這扇門的話將不會需要鑰匙。當角色們進入寶庫的時候，向他們對該地區作出以下描述：

english: This room contains four wooden tables with two small wooden coffers atop each one. Hanging on the wall opposite the door is a beautiful golden shield. Standing in front of the shield is an old man in plain garments, carrying a lit candlestick. As he turns to face the door, you see that his shadow on the far wall doesn't match his form, but appears to be the shadow of a pudgy, horned fiend with small wings.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡放著 4 張木桌，每張桌子上放著兩個木質的保險箱。門對面的牆上掛著一面華麗的金色盾牌。盾牌前面站著一個穿著普通衣服的老年男性，手裡拿著一盞點亮的燭臺。當他轉身看一下門的時候，你會發現他映在遠處牆上的影子並不符合他的身型，那個陰影看上去更像一個矮胖帶翼的長角魔鬼。

english: The man is {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, the former high overseer of Elturel. Formerly a priest of Torm (god of courage and self-sacrifice), he lost his spellcasting ability when he abandoned his faith and now only pretends to worship that deity. The shield hanging on the wall behind him is the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}, which is depicted and described in {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|12}. Thavius has been speaking to Gargauth, the fiend imprisoned in the shield, and has concluded that the shield is responsible for much of the rampant avarice and malice in Baldur's Gate. Given time, Thavius thinks he can use the shield to drag Baldur's Gate down into Avernus.
zh_tw: 這個男人就是{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，他是艾爾托瑞爾的至高監督。他表面上是一位託姆（勇氣和自我犧牲之神）的牧師，但他在背棄他的信仰時，便失去了施法能力，現在不過是假裝信仰這名神祗罷了。他背後牆上掛著的那面盾牌就是{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，這個盾牌的資料在{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}中有詳細的描述。塔維斯已經和盾牌中的魔鬼加葛斯交流過幾次，並且認為這面盾牌是博德之門中貪婪與怨憎氾濫的原因。塔維斯認為它可以用盾牌的力量將博德之門拖入阿弗納斯。

english: Thavius craves power and the appreciation of his hellish masters. However, he abhors violence and avoids combat whenever possible. He sheds crocodile tears for Elturel, claiming that he was visiting a parish a few miles outside the city when it disappeared, and expressing horror in response to the city's fall. Neither story holds up under scrutiny.
zh_tw: 塔維斯渴望力量與他的地獄主人的欣賞，但是他無論何時都十分的厭惡暴力，並且拒絕衝突。塔維斯會為艾爾托瑞爾流下鱷魚眼淚，聲稱在艾爾托瑞爾消失的時候他正在城外幾英里的教區訪問，並且對城市的淪陷表現的十分害怕。任何一個故事都經不起推敲。

english: Thavius also lies about his relationship with Duke Vanthampur. He claims the duke's guards captured him shortly after his arrival in Baldur's Gate, and that the duke needs his help to ascertain the magical properties of the celestial shield, which her family "acquired" from a crypt under the city. Despite being a practiced liar, Thavius has no lie to explain his diabolical shadow.
zh_tw: 塔維斯同時也會對他和範薩姆普爾公爵的關係撒謊。他聲稱他是在到達博德之門不久之後被公爵的守衛抓過來的，因為公爵需要他的協助來弄清楚這面天界盾牌的魔法特性，公爵說這是他們家族從城市底下的某個墓穴裡"獲取"的。雖然他是一個老練的騙子，但是他對於他那魔鬼般的影子卻無從解釋。

english: If she's with the party, Reya Mantlemorn is awestruck in the presence of the high overseer, and won't allow the characters to harm Thavius as long as she believes he's innocent of wrongdoing. His altered shadow is not damning enough evidence. Convincing Reya that Thavius is corrupt can be accomplished by forcing a confession out of him with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, or by proving that he has lost his spellcasting abilities. If the characters kill Thavius, they can encounter him again in {@area chapter 3|2b8|x}, after his soul is turned into a devil.
zh_tw: 如果蕾婭·曼特莫恩和角色們在一起的話，她會驚歎於高階督查竟然出現在這裡，同時只要她依然相信塔維斯是無辜的，她就不會允許角色傷害他。塔維斯那奇怪的影子並不能夠成為決定性的證據。角色可以透過強迫塔維斯認罪，這需要角色成功透過一次{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定，或者透過證明他已經失去了他的施法能力來說服蕾婭。如果角色們將塔維斯擊殺的話，他們會在之後的{@area 第三章|2b8|x}中再次遇到已經變成魔鬼的他。

english: Shield of the Hidden Lord
