zh_tw: 隱藏領主的盾牌

english: The devil Gargauth is bound into the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} and wants to escape from it. The fiend believes it can break out once the shield is taken to the Nine Hells—and it needs the characters' help to get there.
zh_tw: 魔鬼加葛斯被封印在{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}中，同時他一直在嘗試逃離這裡。這個魔鬼相信只要盾牌帶到九獄他就能逃離這個盾牌，但是這需要角色們的幫助。

english: Gargauth senses the presence of the characters when they enter the room and telepathically contacts one of them at random. Referring to itself as the Hidden Lord, the devil claims to be a celestial being and vows to help the characters rescue Elturel, provided they take the shield with them into the Nine Hells. The Hidden Lord also warns that a secret society is after the shield, and that it's only a matter of time before its evil members find it. Gargauth claims that this secret society doesn't want the shield's powers to be used for good, which is the truth.
zh_tw: 加葛斯會在角色們進入房間時，立刻發現他們，同時透過心靈感應，隨機聯絡他們中的任意一人。他將自稱為隱藏領主，這個魔鬼會自稱是一個天界生物，並且願意發誓幫助角色拯救艾爾托瑞爾，前提是角色願意把他送到九獄。隱藏領主同時也會提醒角色有一個正在追尋這面盾牌的秘密組織，對於這些邪惡的傢伙而言，找到這面盾牌只是個時間問題。加葛斯聲稱這個秘密組織並不希望這面盾牌被用作幫助正義的事，這一點倒是真的。

english: Duke Vanthampur and {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} have promised to help Gargauth break out of the shield, provided the fiend spreads corruption throughout the city by uniting the patriars behind the duke—and, by extension, behind the archdevil Zariel. Only then can Baldur's Gate suffer the same fate as Elturel. However, Gargauth is happy to take advantage of a more expedient means of returning to the Nine Hells if the characters offer it one. The Hidden Lord has no loyalty to anyone but itself.
zh_tw: 範薩姆普爾公爵和{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}已經承諾會幫助加葛斯逃出這面盾牌，要求是這名魔鬼要腐化整個城市從而將宗貴們聚在公爵麾下——即魔鬼大公扎瑞爾的麾下。在那之後博德之門就會遭受與艾爾托瑞爾相同的命運。然而，如果角色能提供更便利的方法回到九獄的話，加葛斯就會更樂於利用他們。隱藏領主除了自己不忠於任何人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The eight coffers are unlocked and contain money belonging to the Vanthampur family, as well as treasure stolen from Tiamat's hoard on Avernus. Duke Vanthampur plans to use this combined treasure to bribe the city's patriars and government officials into supporting her bid to become the new grand duke.
zh_tw: 8 個保險箱都並未上鎖，裡面裝著範薩姆普爾家族的財富，也包括他們從阿弗納斯的提亞馬特寶藏中偷來的財物。範薩姆普爾公爵打算使用這些寶藏來賄賂城市中的宗貴和政府官員來支援她成為下一任大公。

english: Coffer 1 contains 30 electrum ingots (10 gp each) belonging to the Vanthampur family.
zh_tw: 1 號保險箱裡裝著 30 個琥珀金錠（每個 10 GP），這些是屬於範薩姆普爾家族的。

english: Coffers 2, 3, and 4 each contain 100 gp belonging to the Vanthampur family.
zh_tw: 2、3、4 號保險櫃裡分別裝著 100 GP，這些是屬於範薩姆普爾家族的。

english: Coffer 5 contains two pieces of a broken ceremonial dagger stolen from Tiamat's hoard: a curved ivory blade bearing Draconic runes that spell out "Fang," along with a bone hilt wrapped in leather strips and studded with gemstones. A {@spell mending} cantrip can make the nonmagical dagger whole again, restoring its value (250 gp).
zh_tw: 5 號保險櫃裡裝著從提亞馬特那裡偷來的一個斷成兩半的儀式匕首：一段刻著含義為"獠牙"的龍語符文的彎曲象牙白刀刃，和一個佈滿寶石並纏繞著皮帶的骨質刀柄。使用戲法{@spell mending||修復術}可以將匕首復原，恢復它本來的價值（250 GP）

english: Coffers 6 and 7 each contain 100 pp belonging to the Vanthampur family.
zh_tw: 6 號和 7 號保險箱分別放著 100 PP，這些屬於範薩姆普爾家族。

english: Coffer 8 contains twenty azurite gemstones (10 gp each) stolen from Tiamat's hoard.
zh_tw: 8 號保險箱放著 20 個石青寶石（10 GP），這些是從提亞馬特寶藏那裡偷來的。

english: Final Encounters in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的最終遭遇

english: If the characters fail to locate {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} (see {@area area V13|0af|x}) or the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} (see {@area area V36|0e1|x}), an NPC such as Reya Mantlemorn or Falaster Fisk recommends a more thorough search of the Vanthampur estate. As a Hellrider, Reya might be able to sense the presence of the celestial shield and urge the characters to retrieve it, lest it fall into evil hands. Similarly, Falaster loathes to leave the puzzle box behind for someone else to snatch up.
zh_tw: 如果角色沒能找到了{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}（詳情請見{@area 區域V13|0af|x}）或{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}（詳情請見{@area 區域V36|0e1|x}）的話，蕾婭·曼特莫恩或者福萊斯特·菲斯克這樣的NPC可以建議他們對範薩姆普爾的豪宅再進行一次更徹底的搜尋。作為一名地獄騎手，蕾婭或許可以感受到這個天界盾牌，同時催促角色去回收這件神器，以避免這件物品落入惡人的手中。同樣，福萊斯特不希望把謎盒丟給別人得到 。

english: If Slobberchops the {@creature tressym|BGDIA} (see {@area area V5|0a3|x}) is with the party, it can lead characters to the puzzle box. Captured villains can also lead characters to the puzzle box or the shield, as needed. Once these items are found, Falaster strongly urges the characters to deliver them to {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} at Candlekeep.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}（見{@area 區域V5|0a3|x}）嘴裡流涎在隊伍裡的話，它會帶著角色們找到謎盒。如果有需要，被抓的惡人們也會帶著角色去尋找謎語盒或者盾牌。一旦這兩件道具都被找到，福萊斯特會強烈建議角色們把這些東西送給在燭堡的{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}。

english: If invited to join the characters on their journey to Candlekeep, Reya and Falaster readily accept. Falaster has a modest dwelling in Little Calimshan, a walled neighborhood in the Outer City, and suggests making a brief stop there so he can equip himself with weapons before continuing the journey to Candlekeep.
zh_tw: 如果角色們邀請蕾婭或者福萊斯特與他們共同前往燭堡的話，他們會立刻答應。福萊斯特在外城區有圍牆的街區小卡林珊裡面有一套普通住宅，他會建議角色在那裡休息片刻，這樣他便可以在前往燭堡之前裝備上自己的武器。

english: Reporting to Captain Zodge
zh_tw: 向佐迪隊長報告

english: Once the characters wipe out the Vanthampur family and its devil-worshiping cult, they can return to Captain Zodge to deliver their report, surrender their Flaming Fist badges, and receive any payment owed to them.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們清除了範薩姆普爾家族和他們的魔鬼崇拜邪教的話，他們可以返回佐迪隊長那裡向他報告，交出焰拳的徽章，並且收到所有的報酬。

english: Zodge is gratified to learn that the Vanthampurs are no longer his concern. If the characters report that one or more family members are still alive, Zodge promises to hunt them down and punish them for their crimes.
zh_tw: 佐迪會很樂於知道不用再留意範薩姆普爾家族了。如果角色們的報告裡說範薩姆普爾家族還有一名或者更多家族成員存活的話，佐迪隊長保證會繼續追捕他們，讓他們得到應有的懲罰。

english: Commander Portyr
zh_tw: 波提爾指揮官

english: As the characters conclude their business with Captain Zodge, the meeting is interrupted by the arrival of a higher-ranking member of the Flaming Fist. Read or paraphrase the following text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們和佐迪隊長報告的時候，他們的會面會被一個焰拳傭兵團的高階成員的到來而打斷。向角色們對此事作出如下描述：

english: Your meeting with Captain Zodge is interrupted by the arrival of several Flaming Fist soldiers clad in plate armor. From behind this wall of swords and steel steps an armored woman with a white cloak and graying hair.
zh_tw: 你們與佐迪隊長的會面被幾位身著板甲的焰拳傭兵團的成員的到來所打斷。一位身著白色披風，灰白頭髮的著甲女人從這堵劍與鐵之牆後面走了出來。

english: "Are these the maniacs who've stirred up every nest of rats in this gods-forsaken city?"
zh_tw: "這幾個瘋子就是把這個眾神遺棄的城市裡每個鼠窩都攪亂的人嗎？"

english: "Commander Portyr!" says Zodge. "I was told you wouldn't be in Baldur's Gate for at least another tenday."
zh_tw: "波提爾指揮官！"佐迪說道，"我聽說您至少 10 天之內都不會出現在博德之門。"

english: "That's what the city's government wanted you to think, captain," she replies. Turning to you, she says, "I trust you've been adequately compensated?"
zh_tw: "這就是那幫政府的人想讓你這麼認為的，隊長。"她回答道，隨後轉身看向你們，說道，"我相信你們已經拿到了足夠的報酬，對吧？"

english: Until recently, {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} commanded a Flaming Fist outpost called Fort Beluarian on the distant tropical peninsula of Chult. Her uncle is Duke Dillard Portyr of Baldur's Gate, one of the city's two remaining government leaders (assuming Duke Vanthampur did not survive). Duke Portyr summoned his niece to take command of the Flaming Fist in Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}'s absence. Her trip home was expedited by magic.
zh_tw: 直到最近，{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}一直都在遙遠的熱帶半島楚爾特上的擔任焰拳哨站貝路利安堡的指揮官。莉爾阿·波提爾的叔叔，博德之門公爵迪拉德·波提爾，殘存的兩位政府首腦中的一員（假如範薩姆普爾公爵死了的話）。波提爾公爵將他的侄女召回，以接管失去了{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的焰拳傭兵團。她透過魔法來加快歸家旅途。

english: Liara aims to assert herself as {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}'s natural successor but clings to the hope that he's still alive. If the characters think they have any chance to rescue Elturel—and Ravengard along with it—Liara strongly urges them to pursue that quest. Her experiences in Chult have taught her to respect adventurers and their ability to get things done.
zh_tw: 莉爾阿雖然認為自己是{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的正統繼承人，但是她依然相信瑞文嘉德還活著。如果角色們認為他們有機會拯救艾爾托瑞爾——還有城中的瑞文嘉德——莉爾阿會強烈支援他們踏上冒險旅途。她在楚爾特的工作經驗告訴要尊重這些冒險者同時相信他們完成任務的能力。

english: If the characters didn't find Falaster Fisk in the dungeon under Vanthampur Villa, Liara Portyr can be the one who urges them to travel to Candlekeep and seek out {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA}, a renowned expert on the Nine Hells. Sylvira can help them unlock the {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA} and the mysteries of the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在範薩姆普爾別墅下的地城裡沒有找到福萊斯特·菲斯克，莉爾阿·波提爾可以成為引導他們前往燭堡並且讓他們尋找九獄專家{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}的那個人。西爾維拉可以幫助他們開啟{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}並且揭示{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}的秘密。

english: After making sure the characters receive their promised reward, Liara thanks them for doing their part to help Baldur's Gate. Although she must focus her efforts on various threats to the city's security, she makes it possible for the characters to leave Baldur's Gate when they're ready, going as far as to secure a riding horse or pony for each party member to expedite their journey to Candlekeep. She can also provide a mule-drawn cart laden with food, drink, and other supplies.
zh_tw: 在確認冒險者收下了他們應得的報酬後，莉爾阿會感謝他們為博德之門所做的貢獻。儘管她還需要去面對來自於博德之門的各種威脅，但她還能是讓角色在準備好了的時候可以離開博德之門，甚至為每位角色提供一匹乘用馬或者是一匹矮種馬來讓他們加速到達燭堡。她同時可以提供一頭騾車，滿載食物，飲水和各種其他補給。

english: {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}
zh_tw: {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}

english: Journey to Candlekeep
zh_tw: 燭堡之旅

english: When the characters are ready to leave for Candlekeep, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好前往燭堡後，向他們做出以下描述：

english: As the Basilisk Gate opens, Flaming Fist soldiers hold back the tide of Elturgardian refugees. You cut a path through these wretched souls, whose wails intensify as the Basilisk Gate closes behind you. The dirt road cuts through the slums of the Outer City, past the walled neighborhood of Little Calimshan, to the great span of Wyrm's Crossing.
zh_tw: 當石蜴門開啟後，焰拳士兵擋住了埃爾託瑞爾的難民潮。你穿過這些可憐人，他們看著你身後的石蜴門關閉後嚎啕大哭。骯髒的道路穿過城外的貧民窟，經過圍著牆的小卡林珊街區，直到跨度極大的飛龍渡。

english: If Falaster Fisk is with the party, he leads them to his residence in Little Calimshan. In addition to grabbing weapons, he also brings along an old book of Calishite recipes to trade for admittance into the great library of Candlekeep (see "{@area Entering Candlekeep|0f5|x}").
zh_tw: 如果福萊斯特·菲斯克在隊伍中的話，他會把角色們帶到小卡林珊的住宅，並且換上他的裝備，他還會帶上一本古老的卡林珊人菜譜，他希望用這本書來換取進入燭堡的大圖書館的資格（詳情請見"{@area 進入燭堡|0f5|x}"）。

english: Wyrm's Crossing
zh_tw: 飛龍渡

english: The characters must cross this landmark to reach the Coast Way, which heads south to Candlekeep. Read the following to describe the scene:
zh_tw: 角色們需要穿過這個地標來到達灣岸公路 ，一路向南抵達燭堡。向角色對該場景做出以下描述：

english: Two great bridges meet at a tall, rocky island that rises from the middle of the Chionthar River. Buildings and merchant stalls line the sides of both bridges, making it impossible to see the river from the narrow, congested roadway that cuts between those structures.
zh_tw: 兩座宏偉的大橋在衝薩河中心突起的石頭小島上交匯在一起。建築物與攤販沿橋兩邊排列，從這些建築物中間狹窄擁擠的道路上幾乎無法看見河水。

english: Wooden drawbridges connect the two bridges to a keep situated atop the island. The flags of Baldur's Gate and the Flaming Fist wave proudly above this fortress.
zh_tw: 木質吊橋將兩條橋與島上坐落的要塞相連。堡壘上方驕傲飄揚的是博德之門與焰拳的旗幟。

english: Wyrm's Crossing is a cutpurse's paradise, and every traveler here runs the risk of being pickpocketed. As the characters make their way from one end of Wyrm's Crossing to the other, have each player roll a {@dice d20}. (Don't roll for NPCs traveling with the party.) The character or characters with the lowest roll are targeted by a pickpocket (use the {@creature bandit} stat block).
zh_tw: 飛龍渡是一個扒手的天堂，所有途經這裡的人，都承受著被扒竊的風險。當角色們穿過飛龍渡的時候，讓他們每個人投一個{@dice d20}（不要為隊伍中的NPC投這個骰子。）數值最低的角色會成為扒手的目標（使用{@creature bandit||匪徒}資料）。

english: Use a character's passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score to determine whether a theft made against that character is successful. If the character's score is 11 or higher, the theft is detected and thwarted. Otherwise, the thief makes off with one item weighing 1 pound or less (such as a coin pouch or potion) and disappears into the crowd before the theft is noticed. If a character is robbed, ask the player what small items the character is carrying, then decide which of those items was stolen.
zh_tw: 使用角色的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）來決定針對這名角色的扒竊是否成功，如果角色的檢定結果等於或高於11，那麼小偷就會被發現並被阻止。否則這名小偷會偷走一件重量為一磅或者更少的東西（比如錢包或者是藥水）並且在被發現前消失在擁擠的街道中。如果角色被偷了的話，詢問問角色手裡有哪些小物件，然後決定哪一個東西被偷了。

english: Knights of the Shield
zh_tw: 堅盾騎士團

english: The following encounter occurs only if the characters have the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}. Otherwise, skip ahead to the "Tale of the Hellriders" section. Read the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: 以下遭遇只有在角色持有{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}時會觸發，否則跳過該遭遇直接前往"地獄騎手的傳說"，向角色做出以下描述：

english: As Wyrm's Crossing and Baldur's Gate disappear from view, you find yourselves heading down the Coast Way, a dirt road that leads to such distant lands as Tethyr, Amn, and Calimshan. Candlekeep lies some one hundred and fifty miles south and west—a five-day journey.
zh_tw: 當飛龍渡和博德之門逐漸消失在你們視野裡的時候，你們發現自己已經走上了灣岸公路，這條泥濘的道路會通向遙遠的泰瑟爾、安姆、卡林珊。燭堡就坐落於大約西南方向 150 英里的地方——這大概會需要花上 5 天。

english: Coming up the road toward you is a human farmer riding on the front of a hay-filled wagon pulled by two draft horses. The farmer gives you a friendly wave as the wagon draws near.
zh_tw: 當你們走在路上的時候發現對面迎面走來一個人類農夫，他駕駛著一輛兩匹馱用馬拉著的裝滿稻草的四輪貨車。當馬車靠近你們的時候，這個農夫友善的對你們招了招手。

english: The farmer is Kaddrus, a lawful evil {@creature cambion} using the {@spell alter self} spell to conceal his true form. Hiding under the hay are the cambion's evil accomplices: three human {@creature Veteran||veterans} who speak Common and Infernal. Their names are Falar and Zaroud al'Ryshal, and Nulra Blacksaddle. When the cambion gives the order in Infernal, the veterans leap out of the hay and attack. Meanwhile, the cambion assumes his true form, flies up into the air, and targets creatures with his Fire Ray attack. The two {@creature Draft Horse||draft horses} are ordinary beasts but don't spook easily.
zh_tw: 這個農夫名叫卡德魯斯，他是一個守序邪魔{@creature cambion||坎比翁}，他使用了{@spell alter self||變身術}來掩蓋自己的真實面貌。在稻草下藏著的是這個坎比翁的邪惡同伴：三個會說通用語和煉獄語的人類{@creature Veteran||老兵}。他們的名字分別是法拉爾，扎魯德·雷沙爾，努拉·黑安。到坎比翁使用煉獄語給老兵下達命令後，這些老兵會從稻草裡跳出來發起攻擊，同時這位坎比翁會亮出自己的真身，飛到空中使用火焰射線攻擊角色。那兩匹{@creature Draft Horse||馱用馬}是一般的動物但是不會輕易受驚。

english: Kaddrus and the veterans are members of a secret society known as the Knights of the Shield (see {@area area V29|0d3|x}). Their goals are to kill the characters and take the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} back to the Hhune patriar family in Baldur's Gate. If the veterans are killed or {@condition incapacitated}, Kaddrus flies back to Baldur's Gate to report to his superiors. If the cambion escapes, the characters might encounter him again in Candlekeep, in the guise of a monk. The next time he encounters the party, Kaddrus fights to the death to claim the shield.
zh_tw: 卡德魯斯和老兵們都是秘密結社堅盾騎士團的成員（詳情請見{@area 區域V29|0d3|x}）。他們的目標是殺掉角色並且奪回{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，將盾牌送回到博德之門的胡內家族手中。如果老兵們全部被殺或者陷入{@condition incapacitated||無力}，卡德魯斯會飛回博德之門向他的上級報告。如果這個坎比翁逃走了的話，角色可能會在燭堡再次遇到他，他會把自己打扮成一個僧侶。當他再次遇到角色們的時候，他會奮戰至死，以奪回盾牌。

english: Tale of the Hellriders
zh_tw: 地獄騎士的傳說

english: If Reya Mantlemorn is with the characters, she shares the following tale over a campfire at some point during the characters' five-day journey to Candlekeep:
zh_tw: 如果蕾婭·曼特莫恩，在角色隊伍中，她會在這 5 天旅途中的某個時間點上角色們介紹地獄騎手的故事：

english: "It was over a century past that the great troubles began. Fiends roamed the lands to the north and west of Elturel. Fields were despoiled, livestock slaughtered, homes razed, and people dragged off to a terrible and unknowable fate. Terror gripped the hearts of all.
zh_tw: "那個大麻煩開始於一個多世紀以前，魔鬼們遊蕩於艾爾托瑞爾的北部和西部。人們的土地遭到掠奪，牲畜遭到殺戮，家園遭到摧毀，人們被拉向恐怖未知的命運。恐懼抓住了所有人的心。"

english: "The city's cavalry rode across the land, striking down fiends wherever they found them and suffering fearful losses. But it was never enough. For every fiend they destroyed, it seemed as though two more appeared elsewhere. The ruler of Elturel, the High Rider, asked his people to pray to the gods for aid. To everyone's astonishment, a mighty angel entered the city the next day. Her name was Zariel, which means Companion of Light. The prayers of Elturel had been heard, and help had come.
zh_tw: "城裡的騎兵們騎著馬穿梭於各處，以高昂的代價去擊敗他們發現的所有魔鬼。但這遠遠不夠，就好像他們每次擊敗了一個魔鬼，又會長出兩個魔鬼一樣。艾爾托瑞爾的統治者，至高騎士，組織人們向眾神祈求幫助。令眾人驚訝的是，第二天便有一位強大的天使來到了城中。她的名字叫扎瑞爾，意思是庇護光之伴 。艾爾托瑞爾的祈禱已經被眾神所得知，而他們的援兵已經到來。"

english: "Zariel located the gate through which the fiends were entering the natural world, on the Fields of the Dead west of the city. Zariel declared that she would lead the cavalry into Avernus, destroying the infernal host that was amassing there, and striking a great blow against the forces of darkness.
zh_tw: "扎瑞爾在城市的西側荒野找到了魔鬼進入凡世的傳送門。扎瑞爾宣稱她會帶著騎士們進入阿弗納斯，摧毀那裡聚集的地獄軍團，痛擊黑暗爪牙。"

english: "The High Rider sent out the riders of Elturel, now numbering many thousands, with Zariel at their head, riding a golden mastodon. With a great cry, Zariel and her army charged through the gate. The legions of Avernus trembled and buckled, but did not crumble. Zariel was defeated, and the remnants of her army returned to Elturel, overcome with grief at the loss of their glorious general but confident that the lords of the Nine Hells would think twice about threatening Elturel again.
zh_tw: "至高騎手派遣了數千名艾爾托瑞爾的騎士與她同行，扎瑞爾騎著一匹黃金的乳齒象，帶領著他們出發了。在巨大的戰呼中，扎瑞爾和她的部隊衝入了門中。阿弗納斯的魔鬼軍團戰慄後撤，但它們並沒有崩潰。扎瑞爾戰敗了，她的軍隊殘部撤回了艾爾托瑞爾，克服失去那光榮的主帥的悲傷的同時也相信，九獄的魔鬼領主們不會再來找艾爾托瑞爾的麻煩了。"

english: "There were great celebrations to honor the valiant knights of the cavalry, who became known as Hellriders from that day on."
zh_tw: "他們當時為了紀念那些勇敢的騎士們，舉辦了一場盛大的典禮，而這些騎士們現在以地獄騎手的名稱為人所知。"

english: Candlekeep
zh_tw: 燭堡

english: Candlekeep is a fortress perched on a spur of rock overlooking the Sea of Swords. It is reached by a single road, the Way of the Lion, which branches west off the Coast Way.
zh_tw: 燭堡是一座坐落於岩石山嘴上的堡壘，在那裡可以俯瞰整個劍灣。只有一條路可以通向那裡，獅之路，灣岸公路的西向支路。

english: Candlekeep is always open to visitors and boasts one of the finest libraries in Faerûn. The monks of Candlekeep also preserve the predictions of Alaundo the Seer, a singular sage whose prophecies have proved correct over long years. Upon the seer's death, Candlekeep became a haven for both the veneration of his prophecies and the accumulation of all knowledge. If there's a secret to be learned, the clues to finding it can probably be found in Candlekeep.
zh_tw: 燭堡一直都是一個對外開放的地方，同時也自詡為整個費倫最好的圖書館之一。燭堡的僧侶們也一直保護著阿蘭多先知的預言，阿蘭多是一位非凡的智者，其預言長年以來被證明準確無誤。在他死後，燭堡就成為了敬拜他的預言和蒐集所有知識的聖所。如果有人想知道一個秘密，那麼多半可以在燭堡找到線索。

english: The encounters in Candlekeep focus on social interaction and exploration. The following events unfold here:
zh_tw: 在燭堡的遭遇主要是關於社交和探索的，以下事件在此提及：

english: The characters arrive at Candlekeep, where the price of admittance is a book—specifically one not already contained in the monks' library.
zh_tw: 到達燭堡的角色，需要提供一本書作為通行費——準確的說是僧侶的圖書館中沒有的書。

english: The characters meet with {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA}, a tiefling sage who knows the secret to unlocking {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 角色們會在這裡遇到{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}，她是一位提夫林智者，知道解鎖{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}的秘法。

english: Sylvira advises the characters to leave the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} in her custody, but Gargauth makes a good case for taking the shield with them.
zh_tw: 西爾維拉會提議角色們將{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}留給她研究，但是加葛斯會開出一個好條件，讓角色們帶著他。

english: Sylvira makes arrangements to send the characters to Elturel, and gives them an unreliable map of Avernus. Reya Mantlemorn offers to go with the characters, while Falaster Fisk chooses to stay behind.
zh_tw: 西爾維拉會協助安排將角色們送往艾爾托瑞爾，並給角色們一張不準確的阿弗納斯地圖，蕾婭·曼特莫恩會提出與角色一同前往，而福萊斯特·菲斯克則會選擇留在這裡。

english: The Way of the Lion
zh_tw: 雄獅小徑

english: Read the following boxed text to describe the characters' final day of travel to Candlekeep:
zh_tw: 當角色們最終抵達燭堡的時候，向他們做出以上描述：

english: Over the past four days, the weather on the Coast Way has gradually worsened. Dark clouds release heavy rain until the road runs thick with mud, yet you trudge on, passing by friendly merchant caravans heading north.
zh_tw: 過去四天中，灣岸公路的天氣逐漸開始惡化，黑雲傾大雨，道路滿泥濘，而你們艱難前行，與友善的商隊擦肩而過向北而行。

english: On the morning of the fifth day, the rain subsides but the dark clouds remain. Ahead, you see a path branch from the wider road, heading to the sea. A raven perches solemnly on a leaning post bearing two signs that point like arms toward the west. One says "The Way of the Lion." The other says "Candlekeep."
zh_tw: 在你們旅途第五天的清晨，雨雖然停了，但是烏雲依然密佈。你們看到在前方一條小路從大路分出，延伸向大海的方向。一直烏鴉莊嚴的站在一根有兩張手臂形路牌的傾斜木杆上，一個寫著"獅之路"，另一個寫著"燭堡"。

english: Characters who head west along the Way of the Lion arrive at Candlekeep by mid-afternoon. You can show the players the illustration of Candlekeep, and can describe the view to them by reading the following:
zh_tw: 角色們如果沿著獅之路前進的話，他們在中午邊能夠抵達燭堡。你可以向角色們展現燭堡的景象，做出如下描述：

english: The afternoon sun shines through the clouds to illuminate the gray walls and pale spires of a timeworn fortress that stands majestically atop a rocky promontory overlooking the sea. The trail leads straight to it.
zh_tw: 午後的陽光穿透烏雲照亮了這座古老城堡的灰色城牆和蒼白的尖塔，它威嚴的立於海岬頂端俯瞰著大海。你們所行走的小路筆直通向那裡。

english: Entering Candlekeep
zh_tw: 進入燭堡

english: Although some visitors travel to Candlekeep by air, most arrive on foot or on horseback. When the characters arrive at the gatehouse, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 儘管有些訪客是自天空來到燭堡的，但絕大部分人還是透過步行或者騎馬抵達的。當角色們抵達門樓的時候，向他們作出如下描述：

english: At the gatehouse, you are greeted by three monks in purple robes: a human, a shield dwarf, and a sun elf. Around their necks hang holy symbols of Deneir, god of writing, whose symbol is a lit candle above an open eye.
zh_tw: 門樓下，三名紫袍僧侶前來迎接你們：一名人類，一名盾矮人和一名日精靈。他們脖子上掛著寫作之神的聖徽：一隻張開的眼睛上方有一隻燃燒的蠟燭。

english: "Welcome to Candlekeep," says the elf in Common. "A gift is required from those seeking admittance. You must donate a book or scroll that isn't already in the library's archives. Please present your gift for inspection."
zh_tw: "歡迎來到燭堡。"精靈用通用語說道，"希望進入燭堡的人都需要獻上一份禮物。你必須捐贈一本書或者是一個卷軸，且不能是我們圖書館檔案室中已有的。請將展示您的禮物交給我們檢查。"

english: All three monks are neutral good {@creature Priest||priests} of Deneir. (Apply racial traits to their statistics as needed.) The monks study any book or scroll that's handed to them, the holy symbols around their necks glowing faintly as they do.
zh_tw: 這三位僧侶都是中立善良的迪尼爾{@creature Priest||祭司}（如果有需要的話，請參考他們各自的種族特性）。這些僧侶會檢查他們所收到的所有的書本或者是卷軸，當他們檢查的時候，他們脖子上的聖徽會微微發亮。

english: The monks are happy to accept either {@i Apocalypto} (the black-covered tome found in Vanthampur Villa; see {@area area V13|0af|x}), Falaster Fisk's book of Calishite recipes, or a spellbook for admittance to Candlekeep. One such gift is enough for the whole party to be able to enter the library. If a character wants to offer up some other book or scroll, you decide whether the monks accept it as a gift.
zh_tw: 這些僧侶們會十分樂意收下{@i 啟示錄}（在範薩姆普爾別墅中找到的黑皮書。詳情請見{@area 區域V13|0af|x}），福萊斯特·菲斯克的卡林珊食譜，或者是一本法術書。如果角色們希望提供一本其他的書或者卷軸，將由你來決定，這些僧侶是否願意接受這份禮物。

english: If the characters try to sneak or force their way into Candlekeep, the fortress's defenses are brought to bear as described in the "{@area Candlekeep Defenses|0fb|x}" sidebar.
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要透過潛行或者是武力進入燭堡的話，城堡的防禦措施會如"{@area 燭堡防禦|0fb|x}"中描述的起效。

english: Once allowed inside, the characters are free to go where they please and stay as long as they wish. The outermost buildings include private dormitories for the monks and public quarters for visitors, as well as amenities one would expect to find in a self-sufficient settlement (bathhouses, clothiers, granaries, gardens, and so forth). Candlekeep even has a pub called the Hearth.
zh_tw: 如果角色們被允許進入之後，他們可以在裡面去到任何他們想去的地方，並且沒有停留的時限。最外層的建築有僧侶們的宿舍和給訪客用的客房，以及一個自給自足的定居點中預期可以找到的生活設施（比如澡堂，裁縫鋪，糧倉，花園等等）。在燭堡甚至有一個叫做壁爐堂的酒館。

english: The Hearth
zh_tw: 爐邊

english: In Candlekeep's pub, guests and monks can enjoy each other's company and a good meal. Read the following boxed text to describe the Hearth:
zh_tw: 在燭堡的酒館裡，來訪者和僧侶們，可以在一起愉快的喝酒聊天，並且享用一頓美餐。對角色們向酒館作出如下描述：

english: The pub has a low ceiling supported by massive wooden crossbeams and narrow, shuttered windows. A large fire pit in the middle of the room is surrounded by a half dozen tables and matching benches.
zh_tw: 這個酒館低矮的天花板被許多的木橫樑支撐，牆上還有不少窄小的百葉窗。酒館的中間是一個巨大的火坑，周邊圍繞著六張的桌子和配套的長椅。

english: Thirty people can dine here comfortably at any time. The Hearth is always open, and the fire is never permitted to go out. A dozen patrons typically occupy the pub during the day, with more during lunch and supper.
zh_tw: 任何時候這裡都可以容納 30 人在這裡舒適的用餐。壁爐堂是全天營業的，而且篝火永遠不會熄滅。通常都會有一打的顧客在酒館裡，而午餐和晚飯時間則會更多。

english: When the characters first show up, one patron stands out among the rest: a chaotic good {@creature ogre} wearing a {@item headband of intellect}. He sits by himself in a corner, reading a book titled {@i The Sum of Theology} by Saint Vetheera, a servant of Oghma (god of knowledge).
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次在酒館露面時，有一名客人如此與眾不同：一個帶著{@item headband of intellect||智力頭帶}的混亂善良{@creature ogre||食人魔}。他正獨自坐在角落裡，閱讀一本名叫{@i 神學概論}的書，由聖維瑟拉所著，他是知識之神歐格瑪的僕從。

english: A few years ago, the ogre was like others of his kind—brutish and cruel. He met a halfling adventurer wearing the shiny gold headband and killed the puny runt for it. When the ogre attuned to it, the headband grew in size, allowing him to don it. As a genius, the ogre felt compelled to learn the error of his ways and seek out a better life. He adopted the name Little One, to honor the poor halfling whose life he cut short.
zh_tw: 幾年前，這個食人魔像他的許多同類一樣——野蠻、殘忍。有一天他遇到了一個戴著閃閃發光的金色頭帶的半身人冒險家，併為搶奪頭帶而殺死了那個小個子。當食人魔與頭帶同調時，頭帶變大了，使他能夠戴上它。隨著推理和思考能力的提高，食人魔明白了他自己目前的生活簡直是一塌糊塗，他犯下了大錯，他想尋求更好的生活。為了贖罪，為了紀念那個被他奪走生命的半身人，他為自己取了"小不點"這個名字。

english: Shunned by polite society, Little One came to Candlekeep hoping to learn as much as he can. He's a quiet but popular fixture in the fortress, and the monks are always saying hello to him and recommending new books for him to read.
zh_tw: 由於他的種族被社會排擠，因此小不點來到燭堡，希望在這裡能獲得更多的知識。在燭堡裡他是一個相當內向但非常受歡迎的人，僧侶們經常和他打招呼，給他推薦新書。

english: Sylvira Savikas
zh_tw: 西爾維拉·薩維卡斯

english: When the characters are ready, they can make their way toward the main keep, a towering edifice housing hundreds of monks and wizards, and thousands of books and scrolls. As they meander through the keep, helpful monks stop to offer them directions. If Falaster Fisk is with the party, he already knows the way to Sylvira's laboratory, located in one of Candlekeep's spires. When the characters arrive there, read the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們準備就緒之後，他們便可以朝主堡進發了，那裡是一座高聳的巨大建築，裡面住著上百名僧侶和學者，同時還存放有上千本的書籍和卷軸。當角色們穿過這裡時，樂於助人的僧侶會停下腳步為他們指明方向。如果福萊斯特·菲斯克在角色的隊伍中，那麼他已經知道了西爾維拉的實驗室的位置，就位於燭堡的某個尖塔中，當角色們到達那裡時，向他們做出以下描述：

english: The walls of this circular tower chamber are punctuated by arched windows that are currently shuttered. Bookcases filled with eldritch volumes stand between the windows, while tables are crowded with specimen jars, alchemical equipment, and other clutter. Engraved into the floor of the chamber is a large, nine-pointed star.
zh_tw: 這個圓形尖塔上點綴的拱形窗戶目前全部關閉。在窗戶之間的書架上擺滿了各種詭異的書籍，而桌上則擺滿了各種標本瓶，鍊金工具，和其他各種雜物。房間地板上雕刻著一個巨大的九芒星。

english: A middle-aged tiefling dressed in wizardly robes stands by one of the windows, caught in a fugue of intense contemplation. Perched on the corner of a table nearby is a spindly little demon with warty green skin, buggy eyes, thin black horns, and a whip-like tail.
zh_tw: 一個穿著巫師法袍的中年提夫林站在窗戶邊上，她陷入沉思中。在桌子的角落上站著一個纖長的綠皮小惡魔，長著有疣子的綠色皮膚，帶著瘋狂的眼睛，黑色的細角，和一條像鞭子一樣的尾巴。

english: "I can't tell you how pleased I am to see you," says the tiefling. "What have you brought me?"
zh_tw: "見到你們的喜悅，真是難以言表，"提夫林說道"你們給我帶來了什麼？"

english: {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA}, a lawful neutral tiefling {@creature archmage}, is one of Candlekeep's foremost sages, and specializes in knowledge pertaining to the Outer Planes. In addition to her other skills, she has {@skill Investigation} +13. She speaks Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, and Primordial. Her {@creature quasit} familiar, Jezebel, adds just the right amount of mischief and chaos to her life. In the unlikely event that Sylvira becomes embroiled in combat, remember that tieflings have resistance to fire damage and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}，一位守序中立提夫林{@creature archmage||大法師}，是燭堡最著名的智者之一，同時也是一位外層位面的專家。除了她已有的技能之外，她還擁有 +13 的{@skill Investigation||調查}技能。她會說通用語，龍語，深淵語，天界語，煉獄語和原初語。她的{@creature quasit||小惡魔}魔寵，耶洗別，用各種惡作劇，為她的生活增添恰到好處的惡作劇和混亂。在不太可能發生的波及西爾維拉的戰鬥中，請記住提夫林對火焰傷害有抗性，並且擁有 60 尺的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: If the characters don't have {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s puzzle box with them, Sylvira is disappointed but tries not to show it. If they present the box to her, she snatches it out of their hands and studies it closely. She takes similar interest in the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} (which she calls "the Shield of Gargauth"), but avoids touching it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有帶來{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的謎盒，西爾維拉會十分失望但是她不會表現出來。如果角色們向她展示了盒子，她會從他們手中一把奪過盒子並近距離地研究。她對{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}（她會管那個叫"加葛斯之盾"）也有同樣的興趣，但她會拒絕觸碰這面盾牌。

english: Candlekeep Defenses
zh_tw: 燭堡防禦

english: Attacking Candlekeep would be foolhardy. Although most of the monks are simple scholars, a few are powerful spellcasters. If any trouble occurs, an {@creature archmage} and {@dice 1d4} {@creature Mage||mages} investigate immediately. If they can't bring the situation under control in short order, an additional {@dice 1d4} {@creature Archmage||archmages} arrive to lend assistance.
zh_tw: 攻擊燭堡是一件愚蠢不堪的事情。儘管絕大部分的僧侶都是的學者，但他們中也不乏有一些強力施法者。如果燭堡裡發生了任何麻煩事，會有一名{@creature archmage||大法師}和 {@dice 1d4} 名{@creature Mage||魔法師}立即趕來調查。如果他們在短時間之內沒能解決麻煩的話，很快又會有 {@dice 1d4} 名{@creature Archmage||大法師}趕來增援。

english: Thavius and the Puzzle Box
zh_tw: 塔維斯和謎語盒

english: Sylvira has this to say about {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} and his {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA}:
zh_tw: 西爾維拉會對{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}和他的{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}做出如下描述：

english: "I've been suspicious of the High Overseer of Elturel for a long time. But no one wanted to hear my concerns, because {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} was widely regarded as a hero who saved his city from an undead scourge, giving rise to the holy nation of Elturgard.
zh_tw: "我早就懷疑艾爾托瑞爾的至高監督很久了。但沒有人會願意聽我的意見。眾所周知{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}是將這個城市從不死生物手中拯救下來的英雄，締造了神聖國度埃爾圖迦德。"

english: "Hailed as a savior, Thavius made all citizens of Elturel swear an oath called the Creed Resolute, which binds them to defend the nation of Elturgard. I met him years ago, and my instincts told me he was a charlatan. Afterward, I grew to suspect that he had cut a deal with one or more powerful devils, using the Creed Resolute to bind all Elturel to his dark deal.
zh_tw: "被譽為救世者的塔維斯讓艾爾托瑞爾的人民們都立下名為堅毅信條的誓言，這使得他們全部加入了埃爾圖迦德的守衛部隊 。我在很多年之前見過他，我的直覺告訴我，他是一個大騙子。後來我懷疑，他可能和一個甚至更多強大的魔鬼做了交易，利用堅毅信條將所有艾爾托瑞爾人與他的黑暗交易綁在一起。"

english: "I wish to prove my theory, and I believe the evidence is locked inside the puzzle box."
zh_tw: "我希望可以證明我自己的假設，並且我也相信我所需要的證據就藏在這個盒子裡。"

english: Sylvira is an expert on magic puzzle boxes, having made and sold a few herself. If the characters give her the {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA}, she examines it, asks Jezebel to fetch her a flask of dark liquid, and pours a small amount into the mazelike troughs carved into the box's surface. She then tips the box so that the liquid flows in certain directions through the mazelike patterns—until the box's horn inlays pop loose and it breaks apart.
zh_tw: 西爾維拉是魔法謎盒方面的專家，她甚至還親自制作並出售過幾個。如果角色們將{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}交給她，在她檢查過這個盒子之後，她會讓耶洗別遞給他一個裝滿黑色液體的燒瓶，並傾倒少許進入盒子表面遍佈的迷宮似的刻紋。然後，她將盒子翻轉，讓液體沿著迷宮樣的圖案向特定的方向流動——直到盒子的角質鑲嵌物突然鬆動，破裂。

english: Inside the box is a stack of nine chain-linked plates, each three inches on a side, cast of dark iron, and stamped with Infernal runes. Anyone who understands Infernal can translate the runes as follows:
zh_tw: 盒子裡面放著的是一堆 9 個用鎖鏈捆住的平板，每個每條邊都有三吋長，由黑鐵鑄成，上面銘刻著煉獄語的符文，任何理解煉獄語的角色可以翻譯符文如下：

english: Be it known to all that I, {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, High Overseer of Elturel, have sworn to my master, Zariel, lord of Avernus, to keep the agreements contained in this oath.
zh_tw: 世人所知之我，{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，艾爾托瑞爾至高監督，向吾主宣誓，扎瑞爾，阿弗納斯之主，遵從本誓約所載之契約。

english: I hereby submit to Zariel in all matters and for all time. I will place Her above all creatures, living and dead. I will obey Her all my days and beyond with fear and servility.
zh_tw: 我任事任時都屈從扎瑞爾。我置她於萬物至上，不論生死。我將帶著卑微與恐懼終生及死後服從她。

english: I recognize the dispensation of the device called the Solar Insidiator, hereafter called the Companion. In my capacity as High Overseer of Elturel and its vassal territories, I acknowledge that all lands falling under the light of the Companion are forfeit to Zariel. All persons bound by oath to defend Elturel are also considered forfeit. I further recognize that this dispensation will last fifty years, after which the Companion will return whence it came, taking Elturel and its oath-bound defenders with it, if that is Zariel's wish.
zh_tw: 我已明瞭這執行處罰之物名為陰謀之陽，下文稱之伴陽。我以艾爾托瑞爾及其所屬領土的至高監督之權利，我承認將伴陽之光照耀下的全土罰沒交於扎瑞爾。所有為誓約所縛而保衛艾爾托瑞爾的人亦一同罰沒。我進而明瞭，這次處罰執行將持續五十年，隨後伴陽將攜艾爾托瑞爾與其誓縛保衛者回歸其前來之處，如若此為扎瑞爾所願。

english: All this is my everlasting pledge.
zh_tw: 上訴全部即我永恆之誓。

english: If Reya Mantlemorn is with the party, she is so stung by the revelation that she collapses onto the floor and weeps for Elturel. Bound to the city by the Creed Resolute, she feels the imperative to return to it. "If Zariel wants my soul," says Reya, "she's welcome to try to take it."
zh_tw: 如果蕾婭·曼特莫恩在隊伍中的話，她會被真相所震驚而癱倒在地上，為艾爾托瑞爾哭泣。因堅毅教條而束縛於城市的她迫切的想要回歸艾爾托瑞爾，"如果扎瑞爾想奪走我的靈魂，"蕾婭說道，"歡迎她來嘗試 。"

english: Gargauth and the Shield
zh_tw: 加葛斯和盾牌

english: Sylvira has this to say about the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} and the devil imprisoned within it:
zh_tw: 西爾維拉會對{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}和裡面所封印的魔鬼作出如下描述：

english: "This shield is a symbol of good's triumph over evil. Gazing at such beauty, one can easily overlook the terrible force bound within it. Gargauth is, I believe, its name, though it calls itself the Hidden Lord. It was a pit fiend sent by Asmodeus to corrupt mortals on the Material Plane, and there it amassed such a following as to rival that of gods. In that way, Gargauth became a sort of demigod, and having worshipers increased its power exponentially. My, how the mighty have fallen!
zh_tw: "這面盾牌是一個正義戰勝邪惡的標誌。凝視這樣的美麗，人們很容易忽視其中蘊含的可怕力量。是加葛斯，我相信這就是他的名字，儘管他會自稱為隱藏領主。他是一個由阿斯蒙蒂斯派來腐化物質位面凡人的魔鬼。所以它以此積累了大量的力量 。透過這種方式，加葛斯進化成了某種半神一般的存在，並且透過他的崇拜者不斷積蓄他的力量。我的天哪，如此強大者竟被已擊敗！"

english: "This shield has the power to corrupt everything around it. The Hhune family of Baldur's Gate has kept it for years now. Doubtless they'll want it back, but this shield should not be taken to any place where thousands of mortals reside. It needs to be locked away in an extradimensional space, away from corruptible souls."
zh_tw: "這邊盾牌擁有著可以腐化周邊一切的力量。博德之門的胡內家族已經保管這面盾很多年了。毫無疑問他們想奪回這邊盾牌，但是這邊盾牌絕對不能回到那種居住著數千平民的地方。它必須被封存在一個異次元空間，遠離那些容易墮落的靈魂。"

english: If the characters consider leaving the shield with Sylvira, Gargauth telepathically contacts the character with the most influence in the party and suggests an alternative course of action:
zh_tw: 如果角色們考慮把盾牌留給西爾維拉，加葛斯會透過心靈感應向隊伍中最有影響力的人提供另一種選擇：

english: "Take me to the Nine Hells, and I'll swear to serve you faithfully as both a guide and an advisor."
zh_tw: "把我帶去九獄，我發誓我會作為忠實的顧問和嚮導幫助你們。"

english: Gargauth's offer is genuine, for the fiend desperately wants the shield taken to the Nine Hells. It believes (incorrectly) that it will be able to escape the shield there. Sylvira leaves it to the characters to decide what to do with the shield. A small part of her is relieved if the characters decide to take it with them, as she knows the evil Knights of the Shield will never stop looking for it.
zh_tw: 加葛斯的提議是貨真價實的，這個魔鬼急切的想讓角色把盾牌帶到九獄去。他相信（雖然不對）他能夠在那裡逃離這面盾牌。西爾維拉會讓角色作出決定是否攜帶這枚盾牌。如果角色決定攜帶盾牌，希爾維拉其實會稍稍鬆一口氣，因為她知道邪惡的堅盾騎士團絕對不會停止搜尋它。

english: Poster Map of Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的地圖

english: If the characters intend to save Elturel, Sylvira can provide them with a map of Avernus—the only such map known to exist in Candlekeep. Unfold the poster map of Avernus at this time and let the players study it. Sylvira then gives the characters a word of caution:
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定去拯救艾爾托瑞爾，西爾維拉會為角色們提供一份阿弗納斯的地圖——這是燭堡中已知的唯一一張這種地圖。她會開啟這份地圖，讓角色們研究一下。西爾維拉會友善的提醒角色：

english: "This map might not be entirely reliable," warns Sylvira. "Its creator went mad making it."
zh_tw: "這張地圖並不是那麼的靠譜，"西爾維拉警告道"畫他的人在製作它的時候瘋掉了。"

english: More information about how to use the poster map can be found in {@area chapter 3|1b0|x}.
zh_tw: 關於如何使用這張海報地圖，詳見{@area 第3章|1b0|x}。

english: The contents of {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s mysterious puzzle box are revealed.
zh_tw: {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}那神秘的煉獄謎盒已被揭示。

english: Getting to Avernus
zh_tw: 前往阿弗納斯

english: Although Sylvira can prepare the {@spell plane shift} spell, there's no point, as magical wards placed on Candlekeep prevent creatures from using such means to go to or from the library. Instead, she presents an alternative plan for sending the characters to the Nine Hells:
zh_tw: 儘管西爾維拉已經準備了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}，但是這並沒有用。因為燭堡內部署了許多魔能守衛以防止有生物利用這些方式進出圖書館。所以他準備了另外一套方案，來把主角們送到九獄：

english: "A wizard named {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} lives in a tower twenty miles from here. I've loaned him a spellbook or two, so he owes me a favor. I can have you delivered safely to his tower, and he can use a {@spell plane shift} spell to take you straight to Elturel. Even more importantly, {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} is looking after an old friend of mine—someone with a history of battling devils in the Nine Hells. I think you'll enjoy her company very much. Her name is {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}."
zh_tw: "在 20 英里外的一個塔裡住著一個叫做{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的法師。我借給了他幾本法術書，所以他欠我一個人情。我可以把你們安全的送到他的塔下，然後他可以使用{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}，把你們送去艾爾托瑞爾。更重要的一點是，{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}那裡還有我的一個老朋友——她曾經在九獄和那些魔鬼們戰鬥過。我相信你們會很樂意有她加入你們的隊伍，她的名字叫{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}。"

english: Characters need not leave for {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}'s tower at once. If they wish to remain in Candlekeep for a while, Sylvira is happy to accommodate them. However, Reya Mantlemorn becomes more impatient the longer they stay. Falaster Fisk parts company with the characters at this time, choosing to remain at Candlekeep for a few days before returning to Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 角色們並不需要急著離開燭堡前往{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的塔，如果他們想在這裡呆上一段時間的話，西爾維拉會很樂意與他們作伴。但是呆的越久蕾婭·曼特莫恩就越焦躁。福萊斯特·菲斯克則會選擇在這裡呆上幾天之後，回到博德之門。

english: Characters can use Candlekeep's library to learn more about the Nine Hells. {@book Chapter 2|DMG|2|The Nine Hells} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} contains lore on all nine layers, which the characters can learn once they've spent a day or two researching the plane. Characters can also research devils to learn everything that's said about them in the "Devils" entry of the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: 角色們可以留在這裡的圖書館瞭解更多關於九獄的事情。如果角色們在這裡呆上一兩天的話，他們可以瞭解到{@book 第二章|DMG|2|The Nine Hells}（出自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）中關於九獄相關的所有事情。角色也可以透過研究魔鬼學到{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中"魔鬼"部分中的全部內容。

english: Once they're ready to leave for {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}'s tower, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們準備前往{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的高塔之後。向他們做出如下描述：

english: Sylvira ushers you to a crescent-shaped landing platform with a stunning view of the sea. Waiting for you atop this platform are several griffons with saddles, their handlers standing nearby to help you. "The griffons have instructions to fly you to {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}'s tower," says Sylvira. "Don't worry, it's safe!"
zh_tw: 西爾維拉把你們帶到了一個可以看到壯麗海景的新月形平臺上。在那裡停著的是幾個裝有鞍的獅鷲，他們的飼養員就站在旁邊協助你們，"這些獅鷲已經被命令送你們去{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的高塔，"西爾維拉說，"別擔心，這很安全的。"

english: The handlers standing ready can help the characters mount the {@creature Griffon||griffons}. Each griffon can carry one rider plus gear. Once all the characters are mounted, read:
zh_tw: 站在旁邊的飼養員可以幫助角色騎上{@creature Griffon||獅鷲}，每隻獅鷲都可以運載一位騎乘者，以及他身上的裝備。當角色們都登上獅鷲之後，向他們做出以下描述：

english: The griffons take flight and head out to sea, flying just below the clouds. Candlekeep looks no less majestic from the air but grows smaller as the griffons soar westward. Large, rocky islands pass below you, and beyond them lies the open sea. After a long journey, you see a windowless, doorless stone tower—which somehow floats in the sky ahead. The griffons pass through jagged holes riddling the tower's conical peak to land on the top floor below, which has a spiral staircase leading down.
zh_tw: 獅鷲們起飛朝著大海飛去，貼著雲層飛行。隨著獅鷲繼續朝西飛行，燭堡依然壯觀，但是在你們的視野中變得越來越小。你們越過巨大的岩石島嶼，其外只有無垠大海。經過一段漫長的旅行，你們看到了一個沒有窗戶也沒有門的石質高塔——它不知怎地漂浮在前方的天空中。獅鷲穿過高塔圓錐形塔尖上鋸齒形的洞口，落在了頂層，在那裡有螺旋的樓梯向下延伸。

english: Traxigor's Tower
zh_tw: 特拉克西哥的高塔

english: Once the griffons land, characters are free to dismount and descend the stairs into {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}'s tower. After delivering the party safely to the tower, the griffons take a short rest before flying back to Candlekeep.
zh_tw: 一旦獅鷲著陸，角色便可自由離開獅鷲，透過樓梯進入{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的高塔，當隊伍安全進塔後，獅鷲們經過一小段的休息之後，便會飛回燭堡。

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players when the characters descend into the tower:
zh_tw: 當角色們沿著樓梯向下，進入高塔時，向他們作出以下描述：

english: One level down, you see a cluttered chamber illuminated by various objects upon which {@spell continual flame} spells have been cast. Scurrying around the room is an otter dressed in a tiny red cassock. The otter mumbles to itself in Common, mentioning something about a tuning fork. Suddenly, it takes notice of you and stands upright. "{@creature Lulu|BGDIA}! Wake up! Our guests have arrived!"
zh_tw: 你們走下一層，便看到了一個亂糟糟的房間，各色物件被釋放了{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}來照亮房間。一隻穿著小號紅色法衣的水獺在房間裡跑來跑去。水獺正使用著通用語喃喃自語，好像是在說著一把音叉的事情。突然它意識到了你們並直起身子："{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}！快醒來！我們的客人到了！"

english: At the sound of her name, a small elephant with golden fur appears from under a pile of blankets near a table strewn with alchemical equipment. The elephant takes to the air on feathery wings and lets out a pleasing trumpet sound.
zh_tw: 一聽到自己的名字，一頭長著金色皮毛的小象便從桌邊一堆撒著鍊金器具的毛毯下鑽了出來。 小象揮動羽翼飛到了空中，發出了悅耳的喇叭聲音。

english: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} was polymorphed into an otter years ago, and decided he preferred the new form to his original one (that of a wizened old man). His otter form was made permanent by a {@spell wish} spell. He uses the {@creature archmage} stat block, but is a Tiny beast with a Strength of 3. His alignment is chaotic good, and he speaks Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Gnomish, Halfling, and Troglodyte. He has the {@spell plane shift} spell prepared instead of {@spell teleport}, and is searching for the tuning fork he needs to cast the spell. What little he knows about the characters has been communicated to him by {@spell sending} spells, sent by {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} in advance of their arrival.
zh_tw: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}在許多年前變成了一隻水獺，並且決定就一直保持這樣了（在那之前他是一個乾瘦的老人）。他用{@spell wish||祈願術}永久變成了水獺形態。他使用的是{@creature archmage||大法師}的資料，但他是一個小型野獸，並且只有力量 3。他的陣營是混亂善良，他會說通用語，龍語，矮人語，侏儒語，半身人語和戰蜥人語。他準備了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}而不是{@spell teleport||傳送術}，而且他正在尋找施展法術所需要的音叉。他對於角色們的瞭解僅限於在之前{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}使用{@spell sending||短訊術}告訴他的。

english: Characters can help {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} search for his missing tuning fork, which is keyed to the Nine Hells. Whoever rolls the highest on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the tuning fork. Whoever rolls the lowest finds a random trinket, determined by rolling on the {@item Trinket|PHB|Trinkets table} in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} doesn't care if the character keeps the trinket or not, and doesn't remember how or when he acquired it.
zh_tw: 角色們可以幫助{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}去尋找他不見的音叉，那是他們前往九獄的關鍵。他們所有人進行一次感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，數值最高的角色將發現音叉。數值最低的角色會發現一個隨機的飾品，這個飾品具體是什麼，將在{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第五章中的{@item Trinket|PHB|飾品表}中投骰決定。{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}不會在乎角色們是否拿走這個飾品，因為他都不記得他是怎麼得到它的了。

english: Lulu the Hollyphant
zh_tw: 聖象露露

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is a {@creature hollyphant|BGDIA} (see {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|13} for her stat block) who has lost most of her memories, as well as her Innate Spellcasting trait. (This has no effect on her challenge rating.) She regains her Innate Spellcasting trait gradually over the course of the adventure, as follows:
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}是一頭{@creature hollyphant|BGDIA|聖飛象}（詳情請見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|13}），露露已經喪失了她自己絕大部分的記憶，同時也包括她的天生施法能力（但這並不會影響她的挑戰等級），她會在隨後的冒險中逐漸恢復她的天生施法能力，具體情況如下：

english: In {@adventure chapter 2|BGDIA|2}, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} regains the at-will ability to cast {@spell light} when she arrives in Elturel for the first time.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2}中，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會在第 1 次抵達艾爾托瑞爾後獲得隨意施展{@spell light||光亮術}的能力。

english: In {@adventure chapter 4|BGDIA|7}, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} regains her 2/day spells ({@spell bless}, {@spell cure wounds}, and {@spell protection from evil and good}) when she arrives at the Bleeding Citadel.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第四章|BGDIA|7}中，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會在抵達湧血城砦後獲得她的 2/每日的施法能力：（{@spell bless||祝福術}，{@spell cure wounds||療傷術}，{@spell protection from evil and good||防護善惡}）

english: In {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8}, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} regains her 1/day spells ({@spell banishment}, {@spell heal}, {@spell raise dead}, {@spell shapechange}, and {@spell teleport}) once she helps reunite Zariel with her sword.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}中，一旦{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}幫助扎瑞爾重鑄了她的劍後，她會重新獲得她的 1/日的施法能力（{@spell banishment||放逐術}，{@spell heal||治癒}，{@spell raise dead||死者復活}，{@spell shapechange||形體變化}，{@spell teleport||傳送術}）。

english: Lulu's Background
zh_tw: 露露的背景

english: While studying a portal to the Nine Hells located in the Fields of the Dead west of Elturel, Sylvira found {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and befriended her. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} stayed with Sylvira at Candlekeep for a while but didn't get along with the tiefling's quasit familiar, Jezebel. Sylvira decided {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} would make a better companion for {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}, given his eccentricity and good nature. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is integral to the characters' future success, though they shouldn't know that yet.
zh_tw: 西爾維拉在艾爾托瑞爾西部的死亡之地研究九獄的傳送門時，希爾維拉找到了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，並且與她成為了朋友。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在燭堡和西爾維拉待了一段時間，但是無法與提夫林的小惡魔魔寵耶洗別相處。西爾維拉覺得讓{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}陪著雖然古怪但是善良的{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}會更好。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會成為角色們將來成功的必須部分，當然他們現在並不知道。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} can speak Celestial but prefers to use telepathy, which allows her to talk to one creature at a time. If a character asks {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} about her history battling devils in the Nine Hells, she shares the following information:
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會說天界語，但是她更喜歡使用心靈感應，這樣她就只需要每次和一個人說話。如果有人詢問{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，關於她與魔鬼戰鬥的故事，她會分享以下資訊：

english: "I was with the angel Zariel when she assembled her army of Hellriders to attack Avernus. Through the gate we went, tearing through devils like a song through air. Victory was within our grasp until some of the Hellriders betrayed us. They retreated through the gate and sealed it behind them.
zh_tw: "當天使扎瑞爾集合地獄騎手的軍隊進攻阿弗納斯時我就陪著她。我們穿過大門，像歌聲飄過空氣一樣撕碎魔鬼的戰線。我們的勝利唾手可得，但是有一些地獄騎手背叛了我們。他們從傳送門撤了出去，並封死了大門。"

english: "Before she was captured, Zariel told me to hide her sword so that it wouldn't fall into evil hands. Someone helped me hide the sword, but I don't remember who. We found a place to hide it, but I don't remember where. I escaped Avernus, but I don't remember how. Most of my memory is gone, and I don't remember why."
zh_tw: "在扎瑞爾被抓之前，她囑咐我將她的劍藏起來以防止落入魔鬼之手。當時有人協助我，藏起了這把劍，但是我不記得他是誰了。我們把它藏在了某個地方，我也不記得那是哪兒。我逃出了阿弗納斯，但我也不記得怎麼做到的。我失去了絕大部分的記憶，但是我不知道為什麼。"

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory was badly damaged by events she can't remember, but a summary of those events is presented here for your benefit.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶因為某些事情而受到了嚴重的破壞，但是為了你的方便，下面有一份關於她的總結。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} was more than Zariel's traveling companion. She was the angel's friend and war mount, with the power to shapechange into a golden-furred mammoth with wings. Their friendship stretches back centuries.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}不僅僅是扎瑞爾的一個旅伴，她同時也是扎瑞爾的朋友和坐騎，她可以將自己變成一個長著翅膀的金毛乳齒象，她們兩人之間的友誼已經持續了數個世紀。

english: When defeat on Avernus appeared inevitable, Zariel entrusted her sword to Yael, her most loyal general, and ordered {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to help Yael find a way to hide the weapon. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Yael blundered into a mob of demons led by the demon lord Yeenoghu, but narrowly escaped. Yeenoghu's pet—an enormous demon named {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}—chased Yael and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} across Avernus. Before it could devour them, Yael plunged Zariel's holy blade into a stone as {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} poured every ounce of her celestial being into it. A fortress sprang up around the sword, hedging out all evil. The effort so taxed {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} that she became disoriented and flew away, leaving Yael behind.
zh_tw: 當敗局已定之後，扎瑞爾將她的劍交給了她最忠誠的將軍，耶爾。並且命令{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}幫助耶爾將劍藏匿起來。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和耶爾雖然不慎進入了由耶諾古帶領著的一批惡魔的包圍中，但他們僥倖得以逃生。但是耶諾古的寵物——一個名叫{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的兇惡惡魔在阿弗納斯中一直追逐著{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和耶爾。在他抓住他們兩人之前，耶爾將扎瑞爾的聖劍猛然插入一塊石頭中，同時{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}將自己的每一分天界本源灌入這塊石頭。一座要塞圍繞聖劍產生，將所有邪敵阻擋在外。但是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}使用了太多的力量令她疲憊不堪，以至於她迷失方向並且飛離了，將耶爾留在了那裡。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} wandered Avernus for months until she came upon a traveling market called the Wandering Emporium. A rakshasa named Mahadi tricked her into thinking he was her friend, only to splash her with a tiny bit of water from the River Styx, leaving her in a feeble mental state and stripping away her spellcasting powers. Mahadi then gave {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to a group of devils as a gift for the archdevil Zariel. Zariel could not abide {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s presence—but nor could she bring herself to harm her former friend. Zariel had {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} sent back to Faerûn with her mental faculties restored. Unfortunately, the damage to {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory was not so easy to repair.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在阿弗納斯漫無目的的遊蕩了好幾個月，直到他來到了一個叫做流浪商城的地方。一個叫做馬哈迪的羅剎欺騙了她，他透過向她身上撒了一點冥河的水，讓露露以為他是露露的朋友，這使得她的精神狀態十分的脆弱，同時也失去了她的施法能力。馬哈迪隨後將{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}作為獻給魔鬼大公扎瑞爾的禮物送給了一群魔鬼。扎瑞爾無法容忍{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的存在，但是她也沒有辦法去傷害她以前的朋友。扎瑞爾在{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}精神好轉之後將她送回了費倫。不幸的是，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶就沒有那麼容易修復了。

english: Lulu's Memories
zh_tw: 露露的記憶

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Memory
zh_tw: 記憶

english: "I used to be able to shapechange into a golden mammoth. In this form, I served as Zariel's war mount."
zh_tw: "我過去曾經有能力可以變成一個金色的乳齒象，我變成那個形態作為扎瑞爾的坐騎。"

english: "Zariel's most loyal Hellrider, Yael, took the sword and plunged it into a rock. I called on every ounce of goodness in my heart to raise a shield around it—a fortress against evil."
zh_tw: "扎瑞爾最忠誠的地獄騎手，耶爾，將扎瑞爾的劍插進了一個石頭當中，我喚起靈魂中所有的善良之力圍繞聖劍升起了一面護盾——一座剋制邪惡的要塞。"

english: "The demon lord Yeenoghu wants to destroy Zariel's sword. He hates it as much as he hates her. We fought him once, but I don't remember where."
zh_tw: "惡魔領主耶諾古一直都想摧毀扎瑞爾的劍，他痛恨那把劍，就像他痛恨扎瑞爾那樣。我們曾經與他交戰過一次，但我不記得在哪兒了。"

english: "I wandered Avernus for a while, then hid in a place called the Wandering Emporium. I made a friend there. His name was Mahadi. Maybe he can help us."
zh_tw: "我在阿弗納斯遊蕩了一段時間，之後我躲到了一個叫做流浪商城的地方。我在那裡認識了一個朋友，他叫馬哈迪，也許他可以幫助我們。"

english: "The Zariel I knew is gone, replaced by a devil with a halo of fire and vengeance. 'This is who I am,' she told me. 'When demons die, they cry out my name in terror.' Those were Zariel's last words to me."
zh_tw: "我所認識的扎瑞爾已經消失了，取而代之的是一個頂著火焰與復仇光環的魔鬼。"這才是我。"她這樣告訴我，"當那些惡魔死的時候，他們在驚恐中叫著我的名字。"這就是扎瑞爾最後對我說的話。"

english: "It was Zariel who sent me back here. I don't know why. Maybe—just maybe—there's a tiny little spark of goodness deep down inside her still."
zh_tw: "是扎瑞爾將我送了回來，但是我不知道為什麼。也許她心中尚存微弱的善良之火。"

english: Restored Memories
zh_tw: 重建記憶

english: Friendship is important to {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} in ways both physical and spiritual. Her growing friendship with the characters causes the hollyphant to remember things long forgotten. For the remainder of the adventure, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} can regain lost memories whenever you wish. Ideally, these memories come back to her one at a time at moments when her friendship with the characters feels important. Any remaining memories return at once when {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} regains all her spellcasting abilities.
zh_tw: 友誼，對於{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的身心而言都是最重要的。她與角色們不斷增長的友誼可以使她回想起那些早已失去的記憶。在之後的冒險中，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}可以在任何你想的時候找到回憶。理想的情況是，每個她覺得自己與角色的牽絆很重要的時候一段失去的記憶就會回到她的腦海中。當{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}恢復她所有的施法能力的時候，她將找回所有的記憶。

english: When the time comes for {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to recall a lost memory, roll a {@dice d6} and consult the {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s Memories table to see which memory comes back to her, or just pick one. If you roll for a memory that has come up before, roll again or choose a different memory.
zh_tw: 當你需要為{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}找回記憶的時候，投擲一枚 {@dice d6} 並且對照{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶表中的結果來決定她找回了哪一段記憶，或者你選擇其中之一。如果你所投擲的記憶已經被找回，你可以重投或者選擇一段不同的記憶。

english: Roleplaying Lulu
zh_tw: 扮演露露

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} doesn't have a mean bone in her little body. She believes in the power of friendship and looks forward to kicking evil's butt with the characters by her side.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}渾身上下沒有絲毫卑劣。她相信友誼的力量，並且期待著和角色們一起痛擊邪惡。

english: If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} becomes too much of a burden for you to run as an NPC, see if one of the players wants to run the hollyphant as a secondary character. Provide the consenting player with a copy of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s stat block, noting that {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has presently lost her Innate Spellcasting trait. As she regains memories and the use of certain spells, notify the player of these changes to her character.
zh_tw: 如果操作{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}給你帶來了太多的負擔，你可以詢問是否有哪位玩家願意將其當做第二角色來扮演這隻聖飛象。將{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的資料表向這名角色展示，但是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}現在並沒有任何施法能力。當她重新獲得記憶並可以使用某些施法能力的時候，請將這些變化告知這位角色。

english: Plane Shift
zh_tw: 位面轉移

english: The characters should advance to 5th level before leaving {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA}'s tower. When they're ready to be sent to Avernus, read the following boxed text aloud:
zh_tw: 在角色們離開{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}的高塔的時候，請確保他們已經升到了 5 級。當他們準備好被送往阿弗納斯之後，向他們做出如下描述：

english: As you stand together in a circle, {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} taps the tuning fork on the floor and casts his {@spell plane shift} spell.
zh_tw: 當你們所有人都站在一個圓圈中之後，{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}輕敲幾次地板上的音叉並釋放了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}。

english: Chapter 2: Elturel Has Fallen
zh_tw: 第2章：艾爾托瑞爾已然墜落

english: Once a holy city whose folk venerated Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr, Elturel is now a site of doom and despair tethered some five hundred feet above the River Styx. Eight great chains bind the city to jagged posts of infernal iron, which stick up out of the ground like gargantuan spikes. (See "{@area Climbing Down|190|x}" at the end of this chapter for a full description of the infernal chains.) The bottoms of those spikes are guarded by scores of devils, making escaping the city by climbing down an arduous task. The Companion, the second sun that provided so much solace and protection to the city for years, now glares down on Elturel like a baleful eye—a black void crackling with lightning.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾曾經是一個神聖的城市，人民主要敬拜洛山達，託姆，海姆和提爾，如今已變為一個末日之地，絕望地被束縛在冥河上方約 500 尺處。八條大鐵鏈把這座城市和從地面伸出來的像巨大的尖峰般的鋸齒狀地獄鐵柱樁綁在一起。 （參見本章末尾的"{@area 爬下|190|x}"）這些尖樁的底部被大量魔鬼保護著，使爬下鐵鏈逃離城市的任務變得艱鉅。伴陽，多年來為這座城市提供無數安慰和保護的第二個太陽，現在像一隻滿懷惡意的眼睛——一個爆發閃電的黑色空洞——凝望下方。

english: One circumstance has saved the city from being overrun by devils: a massive surge of demons attacking the devils' positions on the ground. Forced to fend off these demonic hordes, the devils must bide their time until they have the resources to send troops to subjugate the remaining citizens of Elturel. Even so, random demons, devils, and other creatures have infiltrated the city. The characters have time to learn about Elturel's situation and enact a way to save the city before it is lost.
zh_tw: 這座城市因一種情況而免於被魔鬼侵佔：潮湧而來的大量惡魔正在攻擊魔鬼地面上的據點。迫於抵禦惡魔群落的攻擊，魔鬼們只好等待他們有資源派出部隊去征服艾爾托瑞爾的倖存市民的時機。即便如此，若干零散惡魔，魔鬼和其他生物已經滲透進了這座城市。角色們有時間瞭解艾爾托瑞爾的情況，並制定出在這座城市消失之前拯救它方法。

english: Even as the characters get their bearings, they hear a cacophonous tumult taking place far beneath the city. An endless stream of demons crawls forth from the murky waters of the River Styx, to be met by the ordered forces of Avernus attempting to drive them back. This battle continues for the entirety of the characters' stay in Elturel.
zh_tw: 當角色們搞清自己身處何處時，他們就會聽到發生在城市下方的喧囂騷亂。無盡的惡魔洪流從冥河的陰暗水域中爬出，衝向試圖將他們趕回深淵的阿弗納斯有序魔鬼軍團。這場戰鬥在角色在艾爾托瑞爾停留的整個過程一直持續。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: {@adventure Diagram 2.1|BGDIA|2|Arrival in Elturel} is a flowchart that presents the key events of this chapter in sequence.
zh_tw: {@adventure 圖 2.1|BGDIA|2|Arrival in Elturel}是一個流程圖，按順序顯示了本章的關鍵事件。

english: The adventurers should be 5th level when they arrive in Elturel. They begin on the east side of the city, where the immediate danger is greatest. With or without Reya Mantlemorn to guide them, the characters make their way toward the High Hall cathedral. Once they rid the cathedral and its catacombs of fiends, the adventurers should be 6th level.
zh_tw: 冒險者到達艾爾托瑞爾時應該處於 5 級。他們從城市的東部開始，那裡的危機是最嚴重的。不管有沒有蕾婭·曼特莫恩指引他們，角色們都朝著至高大廳大教堂前進。一旦他們掃除大教堂及其地下墓穴的邪魔，他們應當升到 6 級。

english: NPC survivors cowering in the crypts under the High Hall cathedral urge the characters to locate Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} of Baldur's Gate, who has emerged as Elturel's unlikeliest savior. This quest leads the characters to the chapel in Elturel's grand cemetery, where {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} has fallen into a psychic coma after coming into telepathic contact with the demon lord Baphomet. After seeing Ravengard safely back to the High Hall and ridding him of his malady, the characters should be 7th level and ready to leave Elturel in search of the means to free the city from its chains and return what's left of it to Faerûn.
zh_tw: NPC倖存者龜縮在至高大廳大教堂下的地下墓穴中，懇求角色找到博德之門的大公爵{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}，他已是眾人做夢也未想像過的艾爾托瑞爾救世主。此任務將角色帶到艾爾托瑞爾大墓地的小教堂，在那裡，{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}與惡魔領主巴弗滅進行心靈感應接觸後陷入了心靈昏迷。在和瑞文嘉德一起安全返回至高大廳並擺脫了他的症狀後，角色應該升到 7 級，並準備離開艾爾托瑞爾，去尋找將城市從鏈條中解放出來，並將聖城的殘餘帶回費倫的方法。

english: Arrival in Elturel
zh_tw: 抵達艾爾托瑞爾

english: A {@spell plane shift} spell transports {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} the wizard and up to eight other creatures to Elturel, including {@creature Hollyphant|BGDIA|Lulu the hollyphant} and Reya Mantlemorn if she's still with the party. When the group arrives in Elturel, read the following boxed text aloud to the players:
zh_tw: 一個{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術可運送法師{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}和最多等八個生物到達艾爾托瑞爾，包括{@creature Hollyphant|BGDIA|聖象露露}和蕾婭·曼特莫恩 (如果她還與冒險者們在一起。當小組到達艾爾托瑞爾時，請向玩家大聲朗讀以下框中文字：

english: A hot, stinging air assaults your senses. The city street in which you stand is lined with buildings that are crumbling, if not already collapsed. The ground shudders beneath your feet. In the red, smoky sky, a 400-foot-diameter sphere of darkness discharges strokes of bluish-white lightning that strike the city at irregular intervals. Perched atop a distant bluff, overlooking the rest of the city, is a crumbled fortress.
zh_tw: 灼熱而刺人的空氣襲擊了您的感官。你們所站的城市街道兩旁都是搖搖欲墜，和已經倒塌的建築物。你腳下的地面也正在顫抖。在赤紅而又煙霧瀰漫的天空中，直徑為 400 尺的黑暗球體釋放出藍白色的落雷，以不規則的間隔轟擊城市。一座破碎的堡壘坐落在遠處的斷崖之上，俯瞰著城市的其餘部分。

english: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} gazes up at the black orb nervously, utters a few arcane syllables, and disappears in the blink of an eye.
zh_tw: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}緊張地凝視著黑色的球體，他發出一些奧術音節，然後眨眼間消失了。

english: Diagram 2.1: Chapter 2 Flowchart
zh_tw: 圖表 2.1：第 2 章流程圖

english: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} casts {@spell time stop}, giving him time to flee using his {@spell fly} spell. He's long gone before the {@spell time stop} ends and the characters can react. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 19} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check deduces how {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} made his escape. The party doesn't encounter {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} again unless you want him to reappear later in the adventure. {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA} has no interest in saving Elturel or picking sides in the Blood War. After finishing a long rest, he can cast {@spell plane shift} again and return to his tower on the Material Plane.
zh_tw: {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}施放{@spell time stop||時間停止}，讓他有時間使用{@spell fly||飛行術}逃跑。在{@spell time stop||時間停止}效果結束，角色們可以開始作出反應時，他已經離開很長一段距離了。任何玩家成功透過{@dc 19} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定可推斷出{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}如何逃走。除非您希望他稍後在冒險中重新出現，否則他們不會再遇到{@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}。 {@creature Traxigor|BGDIA|特拉克西哥}對挽救艾爾托瑞爾或在血戰中選擇站邊沒有任何興趣。經過一次長休後，他可以再次進行{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}並返回到他在物質位面上的法師塔。

english: The characters and any remaining NPC companions have a few minutes to acclimate to their new surroundings before facing their first threat in the city (see "{@area Unwelcome Party|116|x}" below). See the "{@area Elturel Hazards|123|x}" sidebar for more information about the earthquakes and other dangers.
zh_tw: 角色和所有剩餘的NPC夥伴有幾分鐘的時間來適應新的環境，然後他們將面對城市中的第一個威脅（請參見下面的" {@area 不受歡迎的聚會|116|x}"）。請參見" {@area 艾爾托瑞爾的威脅|123|x} "側欄查詢更多有關地震和其他危險的資訊。

english: Upon her return to Avernus, {@creature Hollyphant|BGDIA|Lulu the hollyphant} regains her at-will innate spellcasting ability: {@spell light}. In terms of her memories, she can at first only recognize that the surroundings feel familiar, albeit in a terrible way. The sounds and scents of Avernus trigger memories of Zariel's fall and the angel's earliest days as a denizen of the Lower Planes. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s time spent in Avernus and key interactions with specific NPCs slowly trigger the memories that help put the characters on a path to save the city.
zh_tw: 在她的迴歸阿弗納斯後，{@creature Hollyphant|BGDIA|聖象露露}可恢復她的隨意使用的先天施法能力： {@spell light||光亮術}。根據她的記憶，她起初只能覺得周圍的環境很熟悉，儘管是糟糕的那方面。 阿弗納斯的聲音和氣味觸發了她對扎瑞爾墮落以及天使成為下層位面居民的最初日子。 {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}花在阿弗納斯上的時間以及與特定NPC的關鍵互會動慢慢觸發她的記憶恢復，這些記憶有助於幫肋角色們走上拯救城市的道路。

english: Reya Mantlemorn is disheartened by what she sees around her—Elturel in shambles—and is more determined than ever to try to save her city from destruction. She offers to lead the characters to the High Hall cathedral, where she hopes to find someone in charge.
zh_tw: 蕾婭·曼特莫恩對周圍的景象和艾爾托瑞爾一團糟的現況感到沮喪。但同時她比以往任何時候都更加決心要從毀滅的危機中拯救自己的城市。她引領角色們前往至高大廳大教堂，希望在那裡找到領導者。

english: If the characters brought the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} with them, Gargauth the pit fiend tries to escape from its prison and fails miserably. Although characters are unaware of Gargauth's escape attempt, the pit fiend grows increasingly despondent and impatient as they explore Elturel. Gargauth urges the characters not to tarry in the city, lest they get pulled down into the River Styx with it. Secretly, the pit fiend hopes that another means of escape will present itself once the characters leave Elturel and explore Avernus.
zh_tw: 如果角色們帶上了{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，那麼深獄煉魔加葛斯會在來到地獄時試圖從監獄中逃脫，可惜慘痛地失敗了。儘管角色沒有意識到加葛斯企圖逃脫，但是當他們探索艾爾托瑞爾時，深獄煉魔變得越來越沮喪和不耐煩。 加葛斯敦促角色不要在城市裡耽擱，以免他們連同城市一起被拉入冥河。暗地裡，深獄煉魔希望到時候角色們離開艾爾托瑞爾並探索阿弗納斯時，會出現另一種逃脫的方法。

english: Unwelcome Party
zh_tw: 不受歡迎的聚會

english: The characters' first encounter in Elturel is a gruesome one. A number of innocent residents of the city have been in hiding to avoid the devils patrolling their streets, but a lack of food and water has forced one group to abandon their refuge. Spotted by devils, these citizens are about to come under attack, and the characters are their only hope of survival.
zh_tw: 角色們在艾爾托瑞爾中的第一次遭遇是一個令人毛骨悚然的事件。為了躲避在街上巡邏的魔鬼，許多無辜的居民藏起來躲避遊蕩在他們街道上的魔鬼，但是食物和水的短缺迫使一群人放棄了他們的避難所。在角色們來到時，這些居民剛被魔鬼發現，即將受到攻擊，而角色們是他們生存的唯一希望。

english: Read the following boxed text to set the scene as the characters arrive in Elturel:
zh_tw: 閱讀以下框中文字以描繪角色們到達艾爾托瑞爾時的場景：

english: Around the corner of a still-standing structure runs a woman with two toddlers, one on each arm. In her wake amble three infernal monsters with glaives and snakelike beards. The fiends are laughing darkly.
zh_tw: 一座仍未倒下的建築物的拐角處一個女人一手抱著一名幼童在逃跑。三名帶著刀，長著蛇般的鬍鬚的地獄怪物在她後面緩步追隨，這些邪魔陰暗地獰笑著。

english: Three {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} named Blass, Nodd, and Thunn have infiltrated the city and are looking to wreak havoc. {@creature Harkina Hunt|BGDIA} and her young twin boys, Ezo and Brask, were out searching for provisions when the three devils spotted them. The chase has progressed into this street, 30 feet from the location of the characters' arrival.
zh_tw: 三個名叫布拉斯，諾德和圖恩的{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}已經滲透進這座城市，並希望大肆破壞。當三個魔鬼發現她們時，{@creature Harkina Hunt|BGDIA|哈金娜·亨特}和她的年幼雙胞胎男孩伊佐和布拉斯科正在尋找食物。她們被追逐到這條街，距離角色們到達的地點 30 尺。

english: Unless the characters intervene, the bearded devils reach the innocent humans within a few rounds, then quickly capture them. Once captured, all three will be sold into slavery at the Wandering Emporium (see "{@area Wandering Emporium|297|x}"), in exchange for favors or goods that can help the devils advance in power.
zh_tw: 除非角色們出手，否則須魔會在幾輪後追上這些無辜的人類，然後迅速將其捕獲。一旦被捉走，這三個人將被賣給流浪商城（見{@area 流浪商城|297|x}），以換取可以幫助魔鬼提升力量的恩惠或物品。

english: As the characters take in this scene, everyone rolls for initiative. On their turns, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Reya see the three humans about to be attacked by the devils and immediately move to defend them, regardless of what the characters do. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is hesitant to use her trumpet for fear of hurting the family or attracting other fiends, but does so as a last resort.
zh_tw: 隨著角色們進入這個場景，每個人擲先攻。輪到他們時，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和蕾婭看到這三個即將被魔鬼襲擊的人(無論角色如何打算)都會立即採取行動保衛他們。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}猶豫應不應使用她的號角聲波攻擊，以免波及到這一家人或吸引其他邪魔接近，但萬不得已時也會這樣做。

english: Members of the Hunt family reduced to 0 hit points by the devils are knocked {@condition unconscious} rather than killed, as the devils are hoping to take them prisoner. These devils don't offer that same courtesy to the characters or their NPC companions.
zh_tw: 由於魔鬼們希望將他們俘虜，因此被魔鬼降低到 0 生命值的亨特家族成員會陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態，而不是被殺死。這些魔鬼對角色們或其他NPC夥伴就不會如此客氣了。

english: Aftermath
zh_tw: 後續

english: If the characters save the Hunt family, Harkina expresses her undying gratitude. Although a {@creature commoner}, she carries a longbow with which she is proficient. She uses it to protect her family. In addition to her longbow, she carries a quiver with forty arrows, twenty of which are silvered.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拯救了亨特一家，哈金娜會對對眾人的救命之恩沒齒難忘。儘管是{@creature commoner||平民}，但她卻善使長弓。她用它來保護自己的家人。除了長弓，她還攜帶著一個帶有四十支箭的箭袋，其中有二十支是鍍銀的。

english: Harkina can relay the following information regarding the current situation in the city:
zh_tw: 哈金娜可以提供有關該市當前狀況的以下資訊：

english: Many of Elturel's citizens died when the city was drawn to this terrible place. Still more have died in the days since, from the attacks of terrible creatures, a lack of food and water, and the collapse of many of the city's buildings.
zh_tw: 許多市民在艾爾托瑞爾剛被拉到這個可怕的地方時便喪生。那天之後，還有更多的人由於可怕生物的襲擊，食物和水的缺乏以及城市許多建築物的倒塌而死去。

english: Harkina and the boys have been hiding in the basement of a tavern that had enough reserves of food and water to keep them alive for a time. When those provisions ran out, the family was forced to creep from safety to search for more.
zh_tw: 哈金娜和男孩們一直躲在小酒館的地下室裡，那裡有足夠的食物和水，可以使他們存活一段時間。當這些物資用完時，他們被迫從安全的避難所爬出來以尋求更多補給。

english: The city has been split in two. Harkina has heard from other survivors that this side of Elturel (formerly the eastern part of the city) is the worse off. The High Hall—the great castle that is home to Elturel's leaders—is where she was planning to take her boys to find safety.
zh_tw: 這個城市被一分為二。 哈金娜從其他倖存者那裡得知，艾爾托瑞爾的這一側（以前是該市的東部）情況更那一邊糟。至高大廳——這座宏偉的城堡是艾爾托瑞爾領導人的住所，那也是她計劃帶她的男孩去尋找的安全地方。

english: High Overseer {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} is the leader of the city, and Harkina hopes that he is working on a plan to rescue survivors and drive away the devils. If he's still alive, Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} of Baldur's Gate is probably at the High Hall as well.
zh_tw: 至高監督{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}是該市的領導人，哈金娜希望他正在制定營救倖存者並趕走魔鬼的計劃。博德之門的大公爵{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}可能也在至高大廳裡，如果他還活著的話。

english: If the characters capture and interrogate a bearded devil, or any other devil encountered in Elturel, it reveals the following information in response to a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, assuming the characters agree to release it:
zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲並審問須魔或其他在艾爾托瑞爾中遇到的任何魔鬼，則在成功透過{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定並在斷定角色同意釋放它的前提下，它會說出以下資訊：

english: The demon attacks from the River Styx intensified when the city appeared in the sky.
zh_tw: 當城市出現在天空中時，來自冥河的惡魔攻擊同時變得更加猛烈。

english: The demons are trying to climb the binding posts or fly to the city, but the devils constantly push them back. The devils are also trying to figure out how to best use the city to their strategic advantage.
zh_tw: 惡魔們試圖沿著固定城市的鐵柱爬上或直接飛上城市，但魔鬼們不斷地將它們擊退。魔鬼們還試圖找出如何最好地利用這座城市去獲得戰略優勢。

english: Slowly and erratically, the spiked posts that bind Elturel are being drawn into the ground, pulling the city down toward the River Styx. (The devil doesn't know how long that process will take.)
zh_tw: 束縛艾爾托瑞爾的尖刺樁正緩慢而不規律地被拉入地面，將城市拉向冥河。 （魔鬼不知道該過程將花費多長時間。）

english: The only reason the city is not already under the control of devilish forces is the demon attacks. Stemming that abyssal tide is taking all the devils' resources.
zh_tw: 該城市尚未受到魔鬼力量控制的唯一原因是惡魔的攻擊。阻止深淵浪潮的進攻佔用了魔鬼所有的資源。

english: The devil assumes the city was brought here by Zariel, the ruler of Avernus.
zh_tw: 魔鬼認為這座城市是由阿弗納斯的統治者扎瑞爾帶來這裡的。

english: Handling Noncombatants
zh_tw: 處理非戰鬥人員

english: The characters have the opportunity to rescue survivors in the eastern part of Elturel, with all those survivors desperate to have the party escort them to relative safety in the western part of the city. When new fights break out with vulnerable NPCs in tow, it's up to you how you want to handle those NPCs in combat.
zh_tw: 角色們有機會在艾爾托瑞爾的東部營救倖存者，所有倖存者都迫切希望讓冒險者們護送他們到城市相對安全的西部地區。當新的戰鬥爆發而易受傷害的NPC緊跟在附近，由您決定如何在戰鬥中處理這些NPC。

english: The easiest option is to have the NPCs stay back and out of the way, limiting their options to following the characters or hiding from enemies. During fights, you can effectively forget about those NPCs, assuming that the most capable among them are dealing with minor threats in the background while the adventurers handle the potent foes. You can also have combat-worthy NPCs join the fight, if you're up for running them. Have all NPCs act on the same initiative count, and focus their actions on assisting the characters in combat, rather than engaging in side fights of their own.
zh_tw: 最簡單的選擇是讓NPC遠離並遠離它們，將他們的選擇限制為跟隨角色或躲避敵人兩種。在戰鬥中，您可以有效地忘記那些NPC的行動，假設其中最有能力的NPC在背景中處理其他較小的威脅，而冒險者則在對付強大的敵人。如果您希望把他們面對危險，也可以讓最善戰的NPC加入戰鬥。讓所有NPC在相同先攻行動，並集中精力協助角色戰鬥，而不是在一邊獨自作戰。

english: If the characters bring NPCs along, it increases the chances of having an encounter as the party moves from one location to another. Whenever you roll the {@dice d20} to determine random encounters (see "More Encounters in Elturel"), an encounter takes place on a roll of 9 or higher.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攜帶NPC前進，則當他們從一個地點移到另一個地點時，遇上遭遇的機會將會增加。每當您擲{@dice d20}以確定隨機遭遇時（請參閱" 艾爾托瑞爾中的更多遭遇"），在擲出9或更高的數值時遭遇發生。

english: More Encounters in Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾中的更多遭遇

english: After their initial encounter with the Hunt family and the bearded devils, the characters are likely to want to get to the High Hall as quickly as possible to locate Grand Duke Ravengard. If you haven't done so already, unfold the poster map with the Elturel side facing up so players can get a sense of the city's layout and where they must go to reach the High Hall. {@adventure Map 2.1|BGDIA|2|Map 2.1: Elturel} is a shrunk-down version of this side of the poster map.
zh_tw: 在與亨特家族和須魔初次接觸後，角色們很可能希望儘快到達至高大廳，並找到瑞文嘉德大公。如果您尚未這樣做，請展開海報地圖，讓艾爾托瑞爾的一面朝上，以便玩家可以大致瞭解城市的佈局以及到達至高大廳的位置。{@adventure 地圖 2.1|BGDIA|2|Map 2.1: Elturel}是海報地圖這一面的縮小版本。

english: Whenever the party moves from one named location to another, roll a {@dice d20}. A roll of 11 or higher indicates an encounter while the characters travel within the city. For example, as the characters travel to a bridge, make an encounter check. Then after crossing the bridge and moving toward the High Hall, make another check. Also make checks if the characters wander the streets or go off in search of other survivors.
zh_tw: 每當團隊從一個被命名地點移到另一個地點時，請擲{@dice d20}。在擲出 11 或更高的數值時表示角色在城市中旅行時遇上遭遇事件。例如，當角色們前往橋樑時，進行遭遇檢定。然後在過橋並朝至高大廳走去期間，再次進行檢定。還有當角色在街上徘徊或四處尋找其他倖存者時也要進行檢定。

english: If an encounter is indicated, roll on the Encounters in Elturel table or choose an encounter you like. Each encounter can occur only once. If you roll an encounter that has already occurred, reroll on the table or select a different encounter. These encounters are described in the sections that follow the table.
zh_tw: 若檢定結果表明發生了遭遇，請在"艾爾托瑞爾的遭遇"表上擲骰或選擇您喜歡的遭遇。每次遭遇只能發生一次。如果擲出已經發生的遭遇，請在表上重新擲骰或選擇其他遭遇。下表後面的部分中描述了這些遭遇。

english: Encounters in Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: {@area Collapsed building|11b|x}
zh_tw: {@area 倒塌的建築|11b|x}

english: {@area Cry for help|11c|x}
zh_tw: {@area 求救的呼喊|11c|x}

english: {@area Ghastly meal|11d|x}
zh_tw: {@area 恐怖大餐|11d|x}

english: {@area Ghoul pack|11e|x}
zh_tw: {@area 食屍鬼群|11e|x}

english: {@area Hateful patrol|120|x}
zh_tw: {@area 可憎巡邏隊|120|x}

english: {@area Imp sales pitch|121|x}
zh_tw: {@area 小魔鬼推銷|121|x}

english: {@area Narzugon cavalier|127|x}
zh_tw: {@area 魘騎魔騎士|127|x}

english: {@area Spouts of hellfire|128|x}
zh_tw: {@area 地獄火噴發|128|x}

english: {@area Vrock philosophy|12a|x}
zh_tw: {@area 鷲魔哲學|12a|x}

english: {@area Zombie horde|12b|x}
zh_tw: {@area 喪屍群落|12b|x}

english: Collapsed Building
zh_tw: 倒塌的建築

english: A quake rocks the city, and a building collapses in the distance. The characters hear cries for help emerging from the rubble.
zh_tw: 突然的地震撼動了整個城市，在你們遠處的一棟建築物倒塌了。你們聽到從廢墟中傳來求救聲。

english: To keep the trapped victims from suffocating or being crushed, the characters must succeed on a total of six ability checks to rescue them before incurring three failures. The base DC for these checks is 10. Possible checks could include Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to remove debris, Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks to squeeze into tight places, Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks to determine the best place to dig or support the structure, or Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks to notice dangerous areas threatening to collapse further. You might also decide that magic or other abilities could result in automatic successes.
zh_tw: 為防被困的受害者窒息或被壓扁，角色必須在遭受三項檢定失敗之前，完成六項屬性檢定才能成功將其救出。這些檢定的基本DC為 10。可能的檢查包括：力量檢定（{@skill Athletics||運動}）以清除碎屑；敏捷檢定（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）以進入狹窄的地方；智力檢定（{@skill Investigation||調查}）以確定進行挖掘或支撐結構的最佳位置，或感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以發現可能進一步做成崩塌的危險區域。您可以決定一些使用魔法或其他能力可使檢定自動成功。

english: During the rescue, the commotion might attract devils (see "{@area Hateful Patrol|120|x}" below) or other unwelcome attention.
zh_tw: 在營救期間，這種騷動可能會吸引魔鬼（請參閱下面的" {@area 可憎巡邏隊|120|x} "）或其他不受歡迎的注意。

english: If the characters succeed in the rescue attempt, they pull out three lawful good shield dwarves from beneath the collapsed building: Strovin Ironfist, Kartra Boulderstern, and Velkora Ashenwell. Strovin and Kartra are laborers (use the {@creature commoner} stat block), but Velkora is a mason and an {@creature acolyte} of the dwarven god Moradin. Her healing powers would be a welcome resource at the High Hall. All three dwarves speak Common and Dwarvish, and have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. They also have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.
zh_tw: 如果角色營救成功，他們將從倒塌的建築物下面找到三個守序善良的盾矮人：斯特羅文·鐵拳，卡特拉·博爾德斯騰和大維克·阿森威爾。斯特羅文和卡特拉是勞動者（使用{@creature commoner||平民}資料），但是維科拉是矮人神摩拉丁的石匠和{@creature acolyte||侍僧} 。她的治療能力將會是至高大廳必要的資源。三個矮人都說通用語和矮人語，並且有 60 尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。它們還具有毒素傷害的抗性，並且在抵抗{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態時具有優勢。

english: Cry for Help
zh_tw: 求救的呼喊

english: The characters hear a voice shouting for help. If they follow the voice, they find a male human under attack by two {@creature Bulezau|MTF|bulezaus} that slipped past the devils and climbed the infernal binding posts to Elturel.
zh_tw: 角色們聽到大聲呼救的聲音。如果他們跟隨聲音前進，他們會發現一名男子受到兩個{@creature Bulezau|MTF|佈雷祖魔}的攻擊，這兩個佈雷祖魔避開了魔鬼並從困住艾爾托瑞爾的地獄鐵柱爬上來。

english: If the characters save the man, he introduces himself as Orin Ragron, a blacksmith who had a shop in Elturel. Orin is actually an {@creature incubus} in disguise named Faltrax. The incubus is trying to gain information on the defenses of Elturel, which it then plans to sell to the highest fiendish bidder. If the characters discover Faltrax's true nature, the incubus flees.
zh_tw: 如果角色救了那個人，他會介紹自己為鐵匠歐林·拉格隆，他在艾爾托瑞爾有一家店。歐林實際上是一個名為名法爾特拉克斯的{@creature incubus||夢魔}偽裝。他試圖獲取有關艾爾托瑞爾防禦的資訊，然後計劃將其售給出價最高的邪魔。如果角色發現法爾特拉克斯的真面目，他便會逃跑。

english: Ghastly Meal
zh_tw: 恐怖大餐

english: The characters catch of glimpse of four cloaked figures sneaking out of an alleyway and into a residence, as if trying not to be seen. If the characters enter the residence, they see four {@creature Ghast||ghasts} standing around a table eating the remains of a human family that perished here during the trip to Avernus. The ghasts reek of death and decay.
zh_tw: 角色們瞥見四個鬼鬼祟祟的身影從小巷溜進了一間住所，似乎不想被人看見。如果角色進入住所，他們會看到桌子旁邊圍著四個{@creature Ghast||妖鬼}，吃著在城市墜落向阿弗納斯時喪生的一家人類的遺骸。妖鬼散發著死亡和腐爛的臭氣。

english: When the ghasts are dealt with, a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check discerns a faint crying coming from a cupboard. Inside is a young girl called Shorah Hevrun. A noncombatant, she immediately attaches herself to the first character who is kind to her. Shorah insists on accompanying the characters until she feels safe. If they can get her to the High Hall, each character gains inspiration, and the survivors there can see to Shorah's care.
zh_tw: 處理完這些妖鬼之後，透過成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定會發現櫥櫃中發出微弱的哭聲。裡面是一個叫索拉·海弗蘭的小女孩。她是位非戰鬥人員，她會依賴第一個對她友善的角色。 索拉堅持待在他身旁，直到感到安全為止。如果他們能夠將她帶到至高大廳，每個角色都會獲得激勵骰，在那裡的倖存者可以幫忙照看索拉。

english: Ghoul Pack
zh_tw: 食屍鬼群

english: Seven {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} roam the streets of Elturel, looking for their next meal. Their leader, formerly an adventuring rogue, wears magical {@item studded leather armor|PHB} that increases its AC to 13 (see "Treasure" below). These former citizens of the city died when Elturel was drawn into Avernus. Their souls were corrupted by the terrible power of the plane, leaving them in these undead forms.
zh_tw: 七個{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}在艾爾托瑞爾的街道上游蕩，尋找他們的下一餐。他們的頭目死前是一個遊蕩者冒險者，身穿魔法{@item studded leather armor|PHB|鑲釘皮甲}，將其AC提高到 13（請參閱下面的"寶藏"）。這些在城中的前居民在艾爾托瑞爾被拉到阿弗納斯時死亡。他們靈魂被這個位面的力量腐化，留下的殘渣便是這亡靈身軀。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The ghoul leader wears {@item +1 studded leather armor}, carries an {@item explorer's pack|PHB}, and sports a belt pouch holding a {@item potion of invisibility}.
