zh_tw: 這位食屍鬼領袖身穿{@item +1 studded leather armor||+1 鑲釘皮甲}，攜帶一套{@item explorer's pack|PHB|探索套組}，穿戴的腰包裡有一瓶{@item potion of invisibility||隱形藥水}。

english: Hateful Patrol
zh_tw: 可憎巡邏隊

english: A {@creature merregon|MTF} leads three {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} through the streets, looking for mortal survivors or demons that have slipped past the devilish forces below the city. The spined devils grumble in Infernal, unhappy about being up here when they could be fighting demons in the battle below. The merregon takes their insolence in silence.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature merregon|MTF|軍團魔}帶領三個{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}穿過街道，尋找像是漏網之魚的凡人倖存者或是躲過魔鬼軍隊的惡魔。棘魔在用煉獄語發牢騷，對於在城下的戰場中和惡魔廝殺時被調到這裡感到不快。軍團魔對他們無禮的態度保持沉默。

english: Imp Sales Pitch
zh_tw: 小魔鬼推銷

english: As the characters pass an alleyway, they notice an {@creature imp} talking with a halfling. The two are focused on each other, making it easy for characters to get close enough to overhear the conversation in Common. The halfling, a baker ({@creature commoner}) named Pilster Pebblehuck, has been hiding with his family in the basement of their bakery. They are running out of food, so Pilster has braved the streets to search for provisions. The imp, Perchillux, is offering Pilster a month's worth of food for the low price of his soul. Pilster is preparing to sign the contract as the characters come upon the pair.
zh_tw: 當角色們經過一條小巷時，他們注意到一隻{@creature imp||小魔鬼}正在與一名半身人交談。兩者都專注在對方身上，使角色很容易接近，以竊聽他們正使用通用語的對話。這名半身人麵包師皮爾斯特·彭布里胡克（{@creature commoner||平民}），一直和家人一起藏在麵包房的地下室裡。他們的食物已經用吃光了，所以皮爾斯特勇敢地走上街頭尋找食物。小魔鬼波奇拉克斯正打算以提供一個月的食物的低廉價格去獲得皮爾斯特的靈魂。當冒險者接近時皮爾斯特正準備在契約上簽字。

english: The contract is written on parchment made of halfling skin. If any character interrupts the signing and asks to read the contract, the imp tells them this is none of their business. Pilster welcomes the interruption, however, since he is having second thoughts about the deal, and he hands the contract to the characters. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check penetrates the dense and convoluted text of the contract—which will give the imp the souls of Pilster's entire family if Pilster signs it.
zh_tw: 合同寫在用半身人皮製成的人皮紙上。如果有任何角色打斷簽字並要求閱讀合同，則小魔鬼告訴他們這事與他們無關。然而，皮爾斯特對此表示歡迎，因為他在重新考慮這筆交易，他將契約交給了角色。成功的{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定會看透契約繁複且令人費解的文字——如果皮爾斯特簽署合同，這將使皮爾斯特整個家庭的靈魂都被賣給小魔鬼。

english: If the characters attack the imp, it turns {@condition invisible} and attempts to escape as quickly as possible. If the characters save Pilster from selling his soul, he thanks the characters and begs them to get him and his family to safety. His wife, Merrywile, and their three children are nearby.
zh_tw: 如果角色攻擊了小魔鬼，它將會{@condition invisible||隱形}並嘗試儘快逃脫。如果角色防止皮爾斯特出售自己的靈魂，他會感謝角色並乞求他們帶他和他的家人前往安全地方。他的妻子瑪麗維爾及其三個孩子正躲在附近。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to the contract, the imp carries a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} from a previous interaction that it plans to give to its master.
zh_tw: 除契約外，小魔鬼還攜帶了在之前的行動中所得到的{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，他計劃將其上交給他的主人。

english: Elturel Hazards
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的威脅

english: In addition to the threats they'll face from fiendish creatures and undead in Elturel, the characters quickly become aware of the threats presented by the city itself.
zh_tw: 除了要面對邪魔生物和艾爾托瑞爾的亡靈所帶來的威脅外，角色也很快會意識到這座城市本身所帶來的威脅。

english: Falling
zh_tw: 墜落

english: Any creature that falls from Elturel's location high above Avernus plummets 500 feet into the soul-shattering waters of the River Styx, taking 70 ({@dice 20d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall. The memory-wiping effects of the river are described in "{@adventure River Styx|BGDIA|2|River Styx}". However, characters who plunge into the Styx or the battle raging around the river are likely killed immediately, with their bodies beyond recovery.
zh_tw: 任何從艾爾托瑞爾的位置墜落到阿弗納斯上方的生物都會垂直墜落 500 尺，墜入冥河撕裂靈魂的河水中，並從墜落中受到 70（{@dice 20d6}）的傷害。在" {@adventure 冥河|BGDIA|2|River Styx}"中描述了它消除記憶的效果。但是，跳入冥河或在河邊展開激烈戰鬥的角色可能會立即被殺死，其屍體也無法回收。

english: Lightning
zh_tw: 閃電

english: Lightning from the Companion strikes the city every minute or so. The odds of the characters being harmed by the lightning are slim, but you can use it to reinforce a sense of urgency as the lightning damages a rooftop, triggers a building collapse, or strikes the ground nearby.
zh_tw: 伴陽的閃電每分鐘左右就會轟擊城市。人物受到閃電傷害的機率很小，但是您可以讓閃電會損壞屋頂，引起建築物倒塌或落在附近的地面上，來增加緊迫感。

english: Quakes
zh_tw: 地震

english: Every so often, the entire city lurches from side to side as the great posts binding it to Avernus sink farther into the ground. This results in the same kind of damage that would be caused by an earthquake on the Material Plane: loose objects fall, buildings are damaged, cracks form in the ground and the streets, and creatures fall {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 整座城市每隔一段時間便會全城傾晃，因為將其捆綁在阿弗納斯的巨柱越陷越深。這會導致與主物質位面上的地震般強大的破壞：鬆脫的物體從高處掉落，建築物受損，地面和街道形成裂縫而且使生物{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: When Elturel shifts, creatures standing on any surface in the city must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. In addition, you can describe other damage and drama resulting from a shift. Perhaps a building collapses, forcing any creature close enough to be struck by falling debris to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 當艾爾托瑞爾下移時，站在城市任何表面上的生物必須成功透過{@dc 10}敏捷豁免檢定否則進入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。此外，您還可以描述由此造成的其他損害和戲劇性結果。可能是建築物倒塌，使任何靠近建築物的生物被落下的碎片擊中，成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷豁免檢定可以閃開，失敗則受到 7（{@dice 2d6}）鈍擊傷害。

english: Map 2.1: Elturel
zh_tw: 地圖2.1：艾爾托瑞爾

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Narzugon Cavalier
zh_tw: 魘騎魔騎士

english: A {@creature narzugon|MTF} patrols the streets of Elturel on the back of a {@creature nightmare} equipped with {@item infernal tack|MTF}. The devil has orders to hunt down and destroy any demons that might have slipped past the battle on the ground below and gained access to the city.
zh_tw: 一名騎在裝備有{@item infernal tack|MTF|煉獄鞍具}的{@creature nightmare||夢魘}背上的{@creature narzugon|MTF|魘騎魔}在艾爾托瑞爾的街道巡邏。魔鬼下令追捕並消滅所有可能越過下方地面戰場並進入城市的惡魔。

english: When {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} sees the creature, she tells the characters that it is very powerful and should not be confronted.
zh_tw: 當{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}看到這個生物時，她會告訴角色它非常強大，不應該挑戰它。

english: Spouts of Hellfire
zh_tw: 地獄火噴發

english: The characters see a charred humanoid corpse in the middle of the street, clutching a {@item silvered longsword|PHB} in its hand. When any creature moves within 5 feet of the corpse, a gout of hellfire erupts from it. Any creature within 5 feet of the corpse must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 角色在街中央看到一個燒焦的人形屍體，他手中握著{@item silvered longsword|PHB|鍍銀長劍}。當任何生物接近屍體的 5 尺內時，它身上都會爆發出一團地獄之火。距離屍體 5 尺以內的任何生物都必須進行{@dc 12}敏捷豁免檢定，失敗的豁免會造成 14（{@dice 4d6}）火焰傷害，成功則造成一半的傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the corpse is examined further, an intact vial is found in its charred belt pouch. The vial contains a {@item Potion of Frost Giant Strength||potion of giant strength (frost)}.
zh_tw: 如果進一步檢查屍體，則會在燒焦腰帶小袋中找到完好的小瓶子。那是一瓶{@item Potion of Frost Giant Strength||巨人之力藥水（霜巨人）}。

english: Vrock Philosophy
zh_tw: 鷲魔哲學

english: A {@creature vrock} fled the battle and flew up to the city to ponder its role in all things. As long as the characters leave it alone, it doesn't attack. If they approach, it speaks with them, using its telepathy to communicate with one character at a time if none of the characters speaks Abyssal.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature vrock||鷲魔}逃離了戰鬥，飛上城市去沉思它在所有事件中的擔當角色。只要角色不理會它，它就不會發動攻擊。如果他們走近，它會與他們說話，如果每個角色都不會說深淵語，它則使用心靈感應每次與一個角色進行交流。

english: The vrock pontificates on the vagaries and possible meanings of existence. If the characters treat it nicely, indulge it in its ponderings, and succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, they can get it to do them one small favor. If they attack it, the vrock repays their hostility in kind.
zh_tw: 鷲魔大談特談存在的變化無常和意義。如果角色很好地應對它，使鷲魔沉迷於它的迷思之中，並且成功透過{@dc 13}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，他們可以讓它幫點小忙。如果他們發動攻擊，那麼這個鷲魔將以溫和形式回報他們的敵意。

english: Favors from the vrock might include providing information about what's happening beneath the city, about what forces guard the bridges between the city's east and west sections, or about the demons' plan to use a portal to enter the city (see {@area area G12|183|x}), although it doesn't know where that portal is.
zh_tw: 鷲魔的小幫助可包括提供有關城市下方正在發生的事情的情報，或是有關守衛城市東西部之間的橋樑的魔鬼守軍資訊，又或是有關惡魔正打算用傳送門進入城市的計劃（請參閱{@area 區域G12|183|x}）。但是它不知道傳送陣在哪裡開啟。

english: Zombie Horde
zh_tw: 喪屍群落

english: As the characters pass a building, they hear a pounding coming from the front door. The door is stuck but not locked, requiring a successful {@dc 15} Strength check to force it open. If the characters do this, twelve {@creature Zombie||zombies} burst from the building as an avalanche of undead bodies, burying anyone standing near the door in the pile. This leaves those characters and the zombies {@condition prone} at the start of combat.
zh_tw: 當角色經過一棟建築物時，他們聽到前門發出敲打的聲音。門被卡住但未上鎖，需要成功進行{@dc 15}力量檢定才能將其開啟。如果角色這樣做，十二個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}會從建築物中雪崩般湧出，將站在門旁的任何人埋葬在亡靈堆中。這使得那些角色和殭屍在戰鬥開始時處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。

english: If the characters deal with the zombies and search the building, they discover that it was a school. Five casks each holding three gallons of fresh water are stored in the basement.
zh_tw: 如果角色解決完殭屍群並搜尋建築物，他們會發現這是一所學校。在地下室中存放著五個分別裝有三加侖淡水的桶。

english: Anchored by the chains of Avernus, the city of Elturel is doomed to drown in the River Styx unless someone finds a way to save it.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾正被阿弗納斯的鐵鏈所束縛，除非有人找到了拯救它的方法，否則它將被淹沒在冥河中。

english: Torm's Bridges
zh_tw: 託姆之橋

english: Two bridges that once spanned a ravine in the city are now all that connect the east and west sections of Elturel over the great rift that has fallen away beneath them. The north bridge is called Torm's Reach, while the south bridge is named Torm's Blade. Unless the characters can fly or teleport, they must use one of the bridges on their trek toward the High Hall.
zh_tw: 兩座曾經跨越城市河谷的橋現在成為連線著艾爾托瑞爾東西兩區唯二的通道，橫跨它們下方的大裂隙。北橋被稱為" 託姆之臂"，南橋被稱為" 託姆之刃"。除非角色可以飛行或傳送，否則他們必須使用其中一道橋樑通往至高大廳。

english: When the characters approach either bridge, they can make out the initial details of the rift and can see the guards blocking the path. Read the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: 當角色接近任何一道橋時，他們可以對大裂隙得到一個最初印象，並可以看到守衛封鎖了前進的道路。閱讀以下內容以描述場景：

english: A rift in the earth divides Elturel into two sections. The riotous din of the battle taking place far below the city is louder here, echoing up and through the jagged open chasm.
zh_tw: 大地上的裂痕將艾爾托瑞爾分為兩部分。遠在城市下方的喧囂戰鬥聲在這裡更為響亮，穿過鋸齒狀開裂的裂口迴盪在你們耳邊。

english: A bridge twenty feet wide and more than a hundred feet long spans the chasm. Holy runes etched into the stonework of the bridge indicate that the structure has been consecrated in the name of Torm, god of courage and self-sacrifice. Six infernal creatures stand guard at the center of the bridge, scanning in all directions.
zh_tw: 一座二十尺寬，一百多尺長的橋樑橫跨了整個裂谷。刻在橋上石雕上的風化神聖符文表示這條橋以勇氣和自我犧牲之神託姆的名義所建。六個地獄生物守衛在橋的中央，警戒各個方向。

english: Each bridge is guarded by an infernal force tasked with cutting off any assistance between the east and west sides of the city. Each group consists of two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} and four {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils}. Unsubtle brutes, these creatures have parked themselves in the middle of each bridge to maintain a vigilant watch. Taking them on is a tough fight, but the characters might have a trick up their collective sleeves.
zh_tw: 每座橋樑都由一支地獄部隊守衛，他們專責切斷城市東西兩側之間的援助的。每組由兩名{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}和四名{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}組成。這些顯而易見的野獸，保持警惕地守在每座橋樑的中間。對付他們會是一場艱苦的戰鬥，但冒險者們有妙法可以對抗他們。

english: Holy Runes
zh_tw: 神聖符文

english: Any character trained in {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, or {@skill Religion} recognizes that the runes etched into the stonework of each bridge can be activated to produce a radiant energy harmful to fiends and undead. A character touching the bridge who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check as an action can speak the proper prayers to Torm to activate the runes for 1 minute. While the runes are active, any fiend or undead creature that starts its turn in contact with the bridge takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) radiant damage. When this effect ends, the runes cannot be activated again for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 對{@skill Arcana||奧秘}，{@skill History||歷史}或{@skill Religion||宗教}擁有熟練項的任何角色都可以識別出雕刻到每座橋的石料中的符文。這些符文可以啟用對抗邪魔和亡靈的光耀能量。一名角色透過{@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定成功後，可以觸控橋樑並用一個動作正確地訴說對託姆的禱詞，藉此啟用符文 1 分鐘。當符文被啟用時，任何與該橋接觸的邪魔或亡靈在開始它的回合時都會受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）光耀傷害。此效果結束後，符文無法在 1 小時內再次啟用。

english: High Hall
zh_tw: 至高大廳

english: Although the forces of Avernus are occupied driving back the demonic attack from the River Styx, a few teams of devils have been ordered to infiltrate Elturel, sow chaos among the surviving citizenry, reap the souls of any mortals they find, and test the city's defenses. The members of some of those advance teams have noted that the High Hall appears to be the center of the city's defenses and survival efforts. As such, they have decided to mount a quick and decisive strike against it.
zh_tw: 儘管阿弗納斯的部隊忙於驅逐從冥河發起的惡魔襲擊，但還是有一些魔鬼受命滲透至艾爾托瑞爾，在倖存的公民中製造混亂，奪取他們發現的每一個凡人的靈魂，並測試城市的防禦力度。其中一些先遣隊已經察覺到至高大廳似乎是該市的防禦和倖存者活動中心。因此，他們決定對它採取迅速而果斷的打擊。

english: As the characters approach the High Hall, they see that a devilish assault on the fortress's cathedral is underway. The characters can enter the fray, defeat the perpetrators, and help bring temporary stability to the situation. After defeating the devils, the characters learn from the survivors that Grand Duke Ravengard was at the High Hall, but left recently. He took a contingent of soldiers with him to the city's cemetery, hoping that an ancient relic found there might help save the city.
zh_tw: 當角色接近大廳時，他們看到魔鬼正對要塞大教堂展開襲擊。角色可以加入戰鬥，擊敗施惡者，併為局勢帶來暫時的穩定。擊敗魔鬼後，角色們從倖存者那裡得知瑞文嘉德大公曾在至高大廳，但在不久前離開了。他帶著一隊士兵一起去了這座城市的墓地，希望找到在那裡被發現和收藏的古代遺物可以幫助拯救這座城市。

english: High Hall Overview
zh_tw: 至高大廳概述

english: The High Hall is a grand alabaster castle dedicated to Torm, the god of courage and self-sacrifice. It houses many of Elturel's religious and political leaders—or at least it did when the city was in the mortal realm.
zh_tw: 至高大廳是一座獻給勇氣和自我犧牲之神託姆的宏偉漢白玉城堡。其內曾居住著大量艾爾托瑞爾的宗教和政治領導人——至少在這座城市還處於凡人世界時是這樣。

english: Shortly after Elturel was pulled into Avernus, a meteor hurled through the High Hall, collapsing the offices and residences of those who could best organize a defense of the city. Most of the leaders of Elturel were killed by the meteor, but Grand Duke Ravengard of Baldur's Gate and his retinue were spared the devastation. Ravengard immediately took control of the situation, marshaled Elturel's remaining forces, and set out a plan to protect the city. Ravengard's forces couldn't save the eastern part of the city, and more frequent demonic and devilish incursions have worn away at their control of the western portion.
zh_tw: 在艾爾托瑞爾被拉進阿弗納斯之後不久，一顆流星砸穿了至高大廳，摧毀了那些最能組織城市防禦的人的辦公室和住所。 艾爾托瑞爾的大多數領導人都被流星殺死，但博德之門的大公瑞文嘉德和他的隨從這場破壞中倖存。瑞文嘉德立即控制了局勢，集結了艾爾托瑞爾的剩餘力量，並制定了保護該市的計劃。瑞文嘉德的部隊無法挽救該市的東部地區，而且對西部的控制力也因越來越頻繁的惡魔和魔鬼入侵而逐漸消退。

english: The survivors here—including the last of the city's leadership—have taken up residence in the cathedral part of the High Hall, perhaps the most secure and sturdy edifice left in Elturel. Yet even the cathedral is under assault, and without the characters' assistance, its defenders are sure to fall.
zh_tw: 城市的倖存者（包括該市最後一群領導人）已在至高大廳的大教堂區安定了下來，這裡可能是艾爾托瑞爾剩下的最安全，最堅固的建築物。然而，如今大教堂也遭到襲擊，如果沒有玩家的幫助，它的防衛者們一定會敗北。

english: Approaching the High Hall
zh_tw: 接近至高大廳

english: When the characters approach the High Hall, read the following boxed text to describe the scene:
zh_tw: 當角色接近大廳時，請閱讀以下方框文字以描述場景：

english: This clifftop castle was once the crowning architectural jewel of Elturel. Only three of its five watchtowers towers still stand, though they appear abandoned. The wooden gates that once led into the castle grounds have been shattered, leaving a gaping hole in the wall.
zh_tw: 這座懸崖上的城堡曾經是艾爾托瑞爾最珍貴的建築瑰寶。它的五座瞭望塔中只有三座仍然屹立，儘管它們似乎已被廢棄。曾經通向城堡內部的木製大門已經被打碎，城牆上只餘空洞。

english: The west side of the castle has been reduced to a pile of smashed brick and broken wood. The surviving buildings are blackened by soot. At the center of the castle grounds, the High Hall cathedral stands defiant.
zh_tw: 城堡的西側只剩一堆破磚碎木。倖存的建築物也被銷煙燻黑。至高大廳大教堂卻依然昂然聳立在城堡的中心。

english: No threats reveal themselves to the characters as they enter the castle grounds. Once inside, they spot two humans in plate armor lying dead on the ground near the shattered gate, blood still oozing from their bite wounds.
zh_tw: 當角色進入城堡外圍時，他們沒有遇到任何威脅。進入內部後，他們發現兩名身穿板甲的人死在破碎的大門附近的地面上，他們身上的咬傷仍在滲出鮮血。

english: As the characters approach the center of the courtyard, they see two {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} standing guard in front of the cathedral doors. These fiends have been instructed by their devil masters to prevent any mortal creatures from entering or leaving the cathedral.
zh_tw: 在角色們接近庭院的中心時，他們可看到兩個{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}在大教堂門前。這些魔犬被它們的魔鬼主人指示，防止任何凡物進入或離開大教堂。

english: The characters must defeat the hell hounds to gain access to the cathedral. Have them make a {@dc 15} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to find cover amid the rubble as they move. If half or more of the characters succeed on their individual checks, the group check is successful, allowing the characters to reach the base of the cathedral steps without being noticed by the hell hounds. This grants the characters surprise when the fight begins.
zh_tw: 角色們必須擊敗地獄犬才能進入大教堂。讓他們進行{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，以決定他們在移動時能否在瓦礫中找到掩體。如果有一半或更多的角色透過檢定，則團體檢定成功，使角色可以在不被地獄獵犬注意到的情況下到達大教堂的臺階下。他們可以在戰鬥開始時獲得突襲輪。

english: Cathedral Assault
zh_tw: 大教堂突擊

english: Four groups of devils and their allies are moving through the cathedral. These groups are spread out to cause as much havoc as possible, and have orders to kill everyone in their path.
zh_tw: 四組魔鬼及其盟友正在大教堂中肆虐。這些魔鬼分散開來，以造成儘可能多的破壞，並受令殺死沿途所有人。

english: As the DM, you can decide where the characters encounter each of these groups. These encounters are meant to be run separately, although running two encounters back-to-back with no chance for the characters to rest or heal can be a good challenge for a powerful party.
zh_tw: 作為DM，您可以確定角色在哪裡遇到每一隊敵人。這些遭遇應該單獨執行，儘管進行兩次接連發生的遭遇而不給予他們休息或治癒機會對強大的團隊來說是一個很好的挑戰。

english: If you want to keep these encounters simple and straightforward, you can have them take place in locations with no strange effects or hazards. If you want to make an encounter more interesting, have the combat take place during a quake (see the "{@area Elturel Hazards|123|x}" sidebar). If you want a fight to go easier for the characters, have some of the foes withdraw or have some NPC survivors assist the characters.
zh_tw: 如果您想使這些遭遇變得簡單明瞭，可以將它們發生在沒有奇怪影響或危險的地方。如果您想使遭遇更加有趣，可以在地震發生時進行戰鬥（請參閱" {@area 艾爾托瑞爾的威脅|123|x} "邊欄）。如果您想讓角色更輕鬆地戰鬥，請讓某些敵人撤離或讓NPC倖存者協助冒險者。

english: Most of the survivors currently in the cathedral are preparing for a last stand in the main crypts ({@area area H16|159|x}), so that area should be free of devils unless the characters arrive there just as the devils do.
zh_tw: 當前在大教堂中的大部分倖存者正在主墓室（{@area 區域H16|159|x}）中準備背水一戰，因此該區域應該暫時沒有魔鬼，除非玩家在魔鬼還在那裡時到達。

english: Group 1: Abishai and Cultists
zh_tw: 第一組：亞比莎龍魔和邪教徒

english: This group is led by the mastermind behind the raid on the cathedral: Victuusa, a {@creature white abishai|MTF}. Victuusa serves both Tiamat and Zariel in an attempt to gain the most favor, and is presently searching for the leaders of the Elturel resistance. It wants nothing more than to deliver the heads of those leaders to Zariel personally. Victuusa leads six lawful evil human {@creature Cultist||cultists} devoted to Zariel.
zh_tw: 這個小組是由突襲大教堂的策劃人維克託薩，一個{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}親自領導的。維克託薩為提亞馬特和扎瑞爾服務，以爭取最大的嘉獎，他目前正在尋找艾爾托瑞爾抵抗部隊的領導人。它最希望將這些領導人的頭顱親自交給扎瑞爾。維克託薩帶領 6 名忠於扎瑞爾守序邪惡的人類{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}。

english: Group 2: Crab Attack
zh_tw: 第二組：蟹群攻擊

english: A {@creature barbed devil} named Dreb marshals a pack of eight {@creature Giant Crab||giant crabs} through the cathedral. These crabs look and act like normal giant crabs, except for the spines protruding from their shells and the vile brimstone smell they exude. The clacking of the crabs' claws on the marble floors of the cathedral makes it impossible for this group to sneak up on anyone.
zh_tw: 一位名叫德雷布的{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}帶領八隻{@creature Giant Crab||巨蟹}橫行大教堂。這些螃蟹的外觀和行為類似於普通的巨蟹，除了從殼中突出的刺和它們散發出的穢惡硫磺味。螃蟹爪子拍打在大教堂大理石地板上的咔噠作響，這使得該團體無法潛行靠近任何人。

english: Group 3: Devilish Brigands
zh_tw: 第三組：魔鬼強盜

english: A {@creature spined devil} leads three human brigands (use the {@creature bandit captain} stat block to represent them) on a rampage. The brigands were driven mad by the journey to Avernus, and have now pledged themselves to their spined devil master. Their madness causes them to bellow and gibber as they move through the cathedral. The spined devil roars at them as it uses its telepathy to order them to focus. This lack of caution and discipline makes ambushing or sneaking up on the group easy, granting advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to do so.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature spined devil||棘魔}帶著三個人類強盜（使用{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}的屬性來代表他們）橫衝直撞。這些強盜因前往阿弗納斯的旅程而發瘋，將自己賣給了他們的魔鬼主人。他們的瘋狂使他們在穿梭大教堂時大吼大叫和胡言亂語。棘魔同時用他的心靈感應和怒吼命令他們集中注意力工作。由於缺乏警覺和紀律，因此玩家們很容易在敵人前進中進行伏擊或悄悄靠近，玩家在敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定上具有優勢。

english: Group 4: Hellish Hunters
zh_tw: 第四組：地獄獵人

english: A {@creature merregon|MTF} oversees a mangy pair of {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds}. The devil uses the hounds to sniff out survivors who might be hiding.
zh_tw: 一名{@creature merregon|MTF|軍團魔}看管著一對癩皮{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}。這隻魔鬼用他的獵犬嗅出可能在躲藏著的倖存者。

english: High Hall Cathedral
zh_tw: 至高大廳大教堂

english: Three levels make up the High Hall cathedral: the cathedral level (areas H1 through H6), the choir level (areas H7 through H9), and the catacombs level (areas H10 through H17). These locations are keyed to {@adventure map 2.2|BGDIA|2|Map 2.2: High Hall Cathedral}, {@adventure map 2.3|BGDIA|2|Map 2.3: High Hall Cathedral, Choir Level}, and {@adventure map 2.4|BGDIA|2|Map 2.4: High Hall Catacombs}, respectively.
zh_tw: 至高大廳大教堂由三層組成，分為3區:大教堂區（區域H1至H6 ）,聖詩班區(區域H7至H9)和地下墓穴區（區域H10至H17）。這些位置分別顯示在{@adventure 地圖 2.2|BGDIA|2|Map 2.2: High Hall Cathedral}，{@adventure 地圖 2.3|BGDIA|2|Map 2.3: High Hall Cathedral, Choir Level}和{@adventure 地圖 2.4|BGDIA|2|Map 2.4: High Hall Catacombs}。

english: Most of these descriptions highlight what the areas contain if a devil attack has not taken place there. Based on the encounters provided in the "{@area Cathedral Assault|133|x}" section above, you can adjust the text to describe what is happening in an area and what it looks like during or after a devil attack.
zh_tw: 這些描述中大多數都描述該區未被魔鬼攻擊前的狀況，根據上面"{@area 大教堂突擊|133|x}"部分提供的遭遇，您可以調整文字以描述該區域中發生的事情以及在魔鬼襲擊期間或之後的狀態。

english: High Hall Cathedral Features
zh_tw: 至高大廳大教堂特徵

english: Unless otherwise noted, the High Hall cathedral has the following recurring features.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，否則至高大廳大教堂具有以下重複出現的特徵。

english: Art
zh_tw: 藝術品

english: Once decorated with beautiful paintings, statues, and other works that depicted the strength and valor of Elturel's people, the cathedral was magically transformed when Elturel was pulled into Avernus. Now its artwork is a testament to the devils' superiority and strength, showing scenes of mortals succumbing to temptation, dying at the hands of fiends, and suffering eternal torture. When viewed, those images shift and swirl unsettlingly. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the frescoes, mosaics, paintings, and tapestries of the cathedral radiate auras of illusion magic. These effects end if Elturel is freed from the chains of Avernus.
zh_tw: 曾裝飾著精美的畫作，雕像和其他描繪了艾爾托瑞爾人民的力量和英勇的作品。當艾爾托瑞爾被拉進阿弗納斯時，大教堂就被魔法改變了。現在，它的藝術品變成了魔鬼的優越性和力量的證明，展示著一幕幕凡人屈服於誘惑，死於魔鬼之手和遭受永恆折磨的場景。當被觀察時，這些影象會令人不安的移動並旋轉。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了壁畫，馬賽克鑲嵌畫，繪畫和大教堂的掛毯散發著幻術系魔法光環。如果艾爾托瑞爾從阿弗納斯的鎖鏈中解放出來，這些效果就會結束。

english: Dimensions
zh_tw: 尺寸

english: Each of the three levels of the cathedral is set 20 feet higher than the one below it. Rooms in the cathedral are 15 feet high, and have 8-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 大教堂的三層中的每一層都比其下一層高 20 尺。大教堂的房間高 15 尺，並由高 8 尺的走廊連線。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The doors of the cathedral are made of iron. Each door is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If a door in the cathedral is locked, it can be unlocked with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check with {@item thieves' tools|phb}, or forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 大教堂的門都是鐵製的。每扇門都是一個大型物體，具有AC 19、27 生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果大教堂中的一扇門被鎖定，則可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}透過成功的{@dc 17} 敏捷檢定將其解鎖，或者透過成功的{@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定將其強制開啟。

english: Illumination
zh_tw: 照明

english: Areas within the cathedral are brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 大教堂內的區域被牆上的壁式燭臺上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術所照亮。

english: Walls
zh_tw: 牆壁

english: Climbing the outside walls of the cathedral without equipment requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在沒有裝置的情況下攀登大教堂的外牆需要成功進行{@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Windows
zh_tw: 窗戶

english: Most of the cathedral's windows were shattered during the descent into Avernus, but the windows are covered by defensive shutters that are latched from within and swing outward on iron hinges. A successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or {@dc 15} Dexterity check with {@item thieves' tools|phb} opens a shutter from the outside. Each shutter is a Large object with AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 大教堂的大部分窗戶在下降到阿弗納斯的過程中都破碎了，但窗戶被防禦性護窗覆蓋，這些窗板從內部上鎖和並透過鐵鉸鏈向外擺動。使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}成功進行{@dc 15} 敏捷檢定或{@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定可從外面開啟窗板。每扇護窗都是一個大型物體，具有AC 19、27 生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害具有免疫。

english: H1. Hall of Heroes
zh_tw: H1. 英雄大廳

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: At the top of the stairs leading up to the cathedral, an archway opens into a long hall containing eight columns. Some of the columns have been carved to represent Torm, but the infernal magic of Avernus has warped the others to represent likenesses of a winged female devil wielding a luminous sword.
zh_tw: 在通往大教堂的樓梯的頂部，一道拱門通向一個有八條圓柱的長廳。一些圓柱被雕刻以表現託姆的形象，但是阿弗納斯的地獄魔法扭曲了其他圓柱，轉而表現為揮舞著發光長劍的有翼女魔鬼的形象。

english: The devil represented in the magically altered columns is Zariel.
zh_tw: 被魔術影響的石柱表現的魔鬼是扎瑞爾。

english: The wooden doors leading into the grand foyer have been broken open by the invading devils (see "{@area Cathedral Assault|133|x}") and remain ajar. Four guards lie dead in the doorways, eviscerated by one of those devil-led groups.
zh_tw: 通往大門廳的木門都被入侵的魔鬼（見" {@area 大教堂突擊|133|x} "）打破而半開。四名警衛橫屍門口，魔鬼率領的隊伍之一挖出了他們的內臟。

english: H2. Grand Foyer
zh_tw: H2. 大門廳

english: The foyer holds two circular stairwells, each leading up to {@area area H7|14c|x} on the choir level. Decorated pillars here depict symbols and scenes representative of Torm. Curtains, some of them shredded by weapons and claws, separate this area from the heart of the cathedral.
zh_tw: 門廳擁有兩段圓形樓梯，每個都通向聖詩班區的{@area 區域H7|14c|x}。裝飾的支柱描繪了託姆的象徵符號和經典場景。隔開該區域與大教堂的心臟地帶的幔帳部分被武器和爪子撕碎。

english: H3. Central Altar
zh_tw: H3. 中央祭壇

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: An altar rests on a raised dais in this broad hall. Made of beautifully polished teakwood, it takes the shape of a gauntleted hand clenched into a fist. A large lever stands next to the altar, suggesting that it has some sort of mechanical function.
zh_tw: 在這個寬闊的大廳中，一座祭壇被安置在一個升高的講臺上。它由拋光的精美柚木製成，塑成一隻握起拳頭戴著鐵手套的手。祭壇旁立著一根大控制桿，表明它具有某種機械功能。

english: The lever can be pulled to open the hand, so that offerings to Torm or bodies undergoing rituals can be placed upon it.
zh_tw: 可以拉動控制桿以使祭壇的手張開，這樣就可以把獻給託姆的祭品或進行儀式的遺體放置在其上。

english: Activating the Altar
zh_tw: 啟用祭壇

english: Even with all that has happened in the city, this altar remains consecrated to Torm. A creature that touches the altar and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Religion}) check regains all its hit points. This check can be attempted only once for any creature. Though the power of the altar works for any creature, it is specifically attuned to those dedicated to Torm. Clerics and paladins of Torm have advantage on the check.
zh_tw: 即使這座城市已經面目全非，這個祭壇仍然供奉著託姆。一名生物接觸祭壇併成功透過{@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定的生物將恢復所有生命值。任何生物只能嘗試一次此檢定，儘管祭壇的力量對任何生物都有效，但它與那些虔誠信奉託姆之人共鳴，託姆的牧師和聖騎士在該檢定中具有優勢。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who searches the altar while the hand is opened and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check detects a large secret panel in the palm of the hand. The panel opens easily, revealing a concealed staircase descending into the central portion of the catacombs level, just west of {@area area H15|157|x}.
zh_tw: 任何在祭壇張開手時搜尋祭壇併成功透過{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會在手掌中檢測到一塊巨大的秘密嵌板。嵌板可以很容易的開啟，露出下面隱藏的樓梯，該樓梯通到地下墓穴區的中央部分，就在{@area 區域H15|157|x}的西部。

english: Map 2.2: High Hall Cathedral
zh_tw: 地圖 2.2：至高大廳大教堂

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: H4. Private Chapels
zh_tw: H4. 獨立禮拜堂

english: These areas can be curtained off for small private ceremonies. Each of these chapels contains the bodies of dead guards, as well as the foul remains of infernal creatures that died during the initial attack on the cathedral. The columns at the north and south ends of each area have stone altars set before them.
zh_tw: 這些區域被布幕分隔為小型私人儀式場地。這些小教堂中都遍佈守衛的屍體，以及在最初對大教堂的攻擊中死亡的地獄生物的骯髒殘骸。每個被區域北端和南端的柱子前面都擺著石祭壇。

english: Survivor
zh_tw: 生還者

english: Seltern Obranch, a {@creature druid} dedicated to {@deity Silvanus|Faerûnian|SCAG}, was here when the attack took place. After being knocked down in the melee, he feigned his demise to trick his attackers. If the characters search the bodies, they notice Seltern open his eyes.
zh_tw: 襲擊發生時，信仰於{@deity Silvanus|Faerûnian|SCAG|西凡那斯}的{@creature druid||德魯伊}賽爾特恩·歐布蘭馳就在這裡。在混戰中被擊倒後，他裝死騙過了攻擊者。如果角色搜刮屍體，他們會注意到賽爾特恩睜開了他的眼睛。

english: If the characters treat him kindly, Seltern tells of how forces of devils assaulted the cathedral. He knows nothing of the current state of the place, but can tell the characters that all in the cathedral knew to flee to the main crypts ({@area area H16|159|x}) in case of an attack.
zh_tw: 如果角色對他友好的話，賽爾特恩講述了魔鬼部隊是如何襲擊大教堂的。他不知道大教堂的當前狀態，但可以告訴角色大教堂中的所有人都知道在發生襲擊時要逃到主墓室（{@area 區域H16|159|x}）。

english: Seltern has been using the {@spell goodberry} spell to help keep those in the cathedral alive. However, his connection to his beloved nature grows weaker by the day, and he fears he may soon be unable to cast spells at all. Though he is not truly in danger of losing this ability (his resolve is simply shaken), this can provide a roleplaying opportunity for the characters to boost his spirits and strengthen his faith.
zh_tw: 賽爾特恩一直在使用{@spell goodberry||神莓術}來幫助維持大教堂中的人們的生命。但是，他與心愛的自然的聯絡日益減弱，他擔心自己可能很快就無法施展法術。儘管他並沒有真正處於喪失施法能力的危機中（他只是信心動搖了），但這可以為角色提供一個角色扮演機會，以振奮他的精神，堅定他的信仰。

english: H5. Stairs to Residences
zh_tw: H5. 通往住宅的樓梯

english: These circular stairs once led to residences and offices. They are now choked with rubble, as the sections that housed those spaces were destroyed.
zh_tw: 這些圓形樓梯曾經通往住宅和辦公室。現在，它們已被碎石堵塞，而居住區也已經被摧毀了。

english: H6. Desecrated Altar of Torm
zh_tw: H6. 被褻瀆的託姆神壇

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This private chapel holds a desecrated altar with a decidedly fiendish air. Once dedicated to Torm, the altar's features have been defaced with blood, ichor, and torn strips of flesh lashed together with sinew and intestines.
zh_tw: 這個私人小教堂裡有一個被褻瀆的祭壇，散發著毋庸置疑的地獄氛圍。曾經為託姆而設的祭壇現在已被鮮血、膿液和用腸子和經脈系綁的撕裂的血肉所玷汙了。

english: This private chapel is similar to those of {@area area H4|147|x}. The devils currently rampaging through the cathedral defaced the holy altar to Torm. Any creature that doesn't actively worship or swear fealty to Zariel that starts its turn within 20 feet of the profane altar gains vulnerability to all damage, accompanied by the sensation of their bones becoming brittle and their skin feeling dry and cracked.
zh_tw: 這個私人小教堂類似於{@area 區域H4|147|x}的其他小教堂。當前在大教堂中肆虐的魔鬼將託姆聖壇玷汙。任何不是主動崇拜或宣誓效忠扎瑞爾的生物，在褻瀆神壇的 20 尺內開始回合時，就會對所有傷害獲得易傷，同時使他們產生骨頭變脆，皮膚乾燥破裂的感覺。

english: The altar can be restored and its profane effect ended in the following ways:
zh_tw: 祭壇可以透過以下方式恢復並終止它的褻瀆效應：

english: A character who kneels before the altar, prays to Torm for 1 minute, and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check at the end of the prayer causes Torm's power to wash over the altar and wipe clean the blood and other desecrating elements.
zh_tw: 一個角色在祭壇前跪下，向託姆祈禱 1 分鐘，並在祈禱結束時成功透過{@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，引導託姆的力量洗淨祭壇並擦淨血液和其他褻瀆元素。

english: Splashing at least three {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|flasks of holy water} on the altar destroys the desecrating elements and purifies the altar.
zh_tw: 向祭壇上潑灑至少三{@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|聖水瓶}可以摧毀褻瀆的元素並淨化祭壇。

english: Map 2.3: High Hall Cathedral, Choir Level
zh_tw: 地圖 2.3：至高大廳大教堂，聖詩班區

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: H7. Pipe Organ
zh_tw: H7. 管風琴

english: The circular stairs from {@area area H2|142|x} lead up to this area. Read the following boxed text aloud to the players when their characters arrive here for the first time:
zh_tw: 從{@area 區域H2|142|x}開始的圓形樓梯通向這個區域。當玩家的角色首次到達此處時，請向他們朗讀以下方框文字：

english: Situated atop this balcony is a magnificent pipe organ. Its ivory keys practically glow, even as its ebony keys seem to absorb all light.
zh_tw: 樓廳上安置著一架宏偉的管風琴。它的象牙鍵好似在發光，而其烏木鍵看起來吸收了所有光線。

english: The balcony looks out over {@area area H3|143|x}. Any character who sits down at the pipe organ can feel that it is enchanted with powerful magic, and a {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of enchantment magic around it.
zh_tw: 陽臺俯視著{@area 區域H3|143|x}。坐在管風琴上的任何角色都可以感覺到它被強大的魔法所附魔，而{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術察覺到它周圍散發出惑控學派的魔法靈光。

english: A character who plays the organ and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check can play a powerful song that resonates throughout the cathedral. This song grants a bonus die, a {@dice d8}, to every other player character who can hear it. A character can only receive this benefit only once, and the {@dice d8} can be added to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by the character in the next 24 hours.
zh_tw: 彈奏管風琴並透過{@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定成功的角色可以演奏一首飽滿有力的歌曲，在整個大教堂內引起共鳴。這首歌將向其他所有聽到的玩家角色授予{@dice d8} 骰獎勵。一個角色只能獲得一次此好處，並且此{@dice d8} 骰可以在接下來的 24 小時內新增到該角色的一次攻擊檢定，屬性檢定或豁免檢定中。

english: If the Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check fails by 5 or more, a screeching, hellish tune erupts from the organ instead. Inspired by this cacophony, each devil the characters face in the next combat encounter in the cathedral has advantage on attack rolls during its first turn.
zh_tw: 如果魅力（{@skill Performance||表演}）檢定未透過而且低於 5，則管風琴發出刺耳的地獄般的音調。受這種刺耳的聲音影響，在大教堂的下一次戰鬥中，角色面對的每個魔鬼在第一回閤中的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

english: H8. Defenses
zh_tw: H8. 防禦設施

english: Two defensive turrets decorate the front of this area, looking down over the courtyard. Arrow slits in the walls of each turret offer a view of the ground below, but are too narrow for even Small creatures to squeeze through.
zh_tw: 該地區的前方佈置有兩座防禦塔樓俯瞰庭院。每個塔樓的牆壁上都有箭孔，可以看到下面的地表，但是狹窄得小型動物也無法擠過它。

english: The north turret contains a traumatized male human {@creature guard} named Trevick Thantorme. The other guards here ran downstairs when the attack started, only to quickly fall. The panicked Trevick remained here, and now sits curled up and whispering to himself that everything's going to be okay.
zh_tw: 北塔樓中有一名心神被打擊的男性{@creature guard||警衛}，名叫特雷維克·山託姆。當襲擊開始時，這裡的其他警衛跑到樓下，但很快就相繼倒下。驚慌失措的特雷維克捲縮著留在這裡，低聲對自己說"一切都會好起來的"。

english: A successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check restores Trevick's courage, as does a {@spell calm emotions} spell or similar effect. If the characters allow it, Trevick vows to accompany them on their hunt for the devils. However, the first time he takes any damage, he curls up in a ball again, requiring another check made as an action to get him back in the fight.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，{@spell calm emotions||安定心神}法術或類似效果可以恢復特雷維克的勇氣。如果角色允許，特雷維克發誓要跟隨他們擊敗魔鬼。但是，當他第一次受到任何傷害時，他會再次蜷縮成一個球，需要使用一個動作再次進行檢定以使他重新加入戰鬥。

english: H9. Balcony
zh_tw: H9. 陽臺

english: The doors leading out onto this balcony are locked from the inside. The balcony is 30 feet above the outside courtyard below.
zh_tw: 通往該陽臺的門從內被鎖上。陽臺位於外部庭院上方 30 尺。

english: H10. Recessed Mausoleums
zh_tw: H10. 壁龕陵墓

english: These areas are the final resting places of esteemed priests, warriors, and other dedicated servants of Elturel. For each of these areas the characters enter, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 1, the characters discover {@dice 1d4} {@condition frightened} {@creature Commoner||commoners} in hiding (if the devils haven't found them) or a number of mangled bodies (if the devils did).
zh_tw: 這些區域是受人尊敬的牧師，戰士和其他獻身艾爾托瑞爾的奉獻者的最後的安息之所。每次玩家進入這些區域時，請擲{@dice d6}。如果是 1，角色們會發現{@dice 1d4}名 {@condition frightened||恐懼}的{@creature Commoner||平民}藏匿在此處（如果魔鬼尚未找到他們）或一些殘缺不全的屍體（如果魔鬼先來一步）。

english: As the DM, you determine the fates of these commoners. If the characters are dawdling because the players don't appreciate the gravity of the threat to the survivors in the cathedral, coming upon deceased commoners can help underline that threat. Having the players understand that these deaths might have been prevented if they had acted more quickly is a good way to inspire the characters to act with a little more urgency.
zh_tw: 作為DM，您可以確定這些平民的命運。如果玩家們還沒意識到大教堂中倖存者面臨的重大生命威脅而磨磨蹭蹭，那麼這些去世的平民將有助於強調這一威脅。好讓玩家知道，如果他們採取更快的行動，這些死亡可能是可以避免的，這是個好方法去激發角色更加緊急地行動。

english: H11. Vaults
zh_tw: H11. 地窖

english: These vaults are used for holding bodies waiting to be interred in some other part of the cathedral, or in Elturel's cemetery. The only bodies presently here are people who died as the city was drawn to Avernus.
zh_tw: 這些地窖用於存放等待在大教堂其他部分或艾爾托瑞爾墓地中被埋葬的屍體。目前，這裡只有在這座城市被拉到阿弗納斯時死亡的人。

english: H12. Temple of the Highest
zh_tw: H12. 至高神殿

english: This large temple was used for private ceremonies involving the most powerful and respected figures in Elturel. Each of the semicircular alcoves here contains an elaborate, upright sarcophagus holding the body of a former high priest of Torm. A sarcophagus can be opened with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check by a character proficient with {@item thieves' tools|phb}. Eleven of the sarcophagi contain partially decomposed bodies. The twelfth sarcophagus holds a {@creature mummy}, which attacks as soon as its coffin is opened.
zh_tw: 這座大神殿曾被用作涉及艾爾托瑞爾最有影響力和最受尊敬的人物的私人儀式。這裡的每個半圓形凹室都包含一個精緻的，豎立的石棺，每口棺材中安放著一位前託姆大祭司的屍體。熟練使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}的角色可以透過成功的{@dc 20} 敏捷檢定來開啟一個石棺。十一具石棺中包含有部分腐爛的屍體。第十二具石棺中有隻{@creature mummy||木乃伊}，會在棺材被開啟那一刻發動攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each sarcophagus contains personal effects, but the sarcophagus with the mummy also contains {@item bracers of defense} and a {@item Elemental Gem, Yellow Diamond||yellow diamond elemental gem}. (The mummy does not use these items in combat.)
zh_tw: 每具石棺都包含一些個人物品，但帶有木乃伊的石棺還包含{@item bracers of defense||防禦護腕}和一個{@item Elemental Gem, Yellow Diamond||黃鑽元素寶石}。 （木乃伊在戰鬥中不使用這些物品。）

english: Map 2.4: High Hall Catacombs
zh_tw: 地圖 2.4：至高大廳大教堂，地下墓穴區

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: H13. Hall of Scholars
zh_tw: H13. 學者大廳

english: This crypt holds the bones of those who served Torm and Elturel through their knowledge instead of magic or skill at arms: teachers, engineers, sages, and other public servants. Plain stone shelves in the eleven alcoves each hold one set of remains.
zh_tw: 這個墓室儲存著那些透過知識而非魔術或戰鬥技巧為託姆和艾爾托瑞爾服務的人的遺骨：教師，工程師，賢哲和其他公共服務人員。十一間凹室的普通石架上各放置著一組遺骸。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A rogue who worked in the cathedral used this room to hide her stolen goods. Behind the bones on one shelf are nine red amethysts (50 gp each) and a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 一個在大教堂工作的遊蕩者用這個房間收藏她偷來的東西。在其中一個架子上的骨頭後面是九個紅色紫水晶（每個價值 50 gp）和一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: H14. Chamber of Torm's Council
zh_tw: H14. 託姆議會的議事廳

english: A large oval table made of fine red oak fills the center of this room, and is surrounded by forty comfortable chairs. This chamber was used for meetings with individuals chosen to provide counsel to the high priests.
zh_tw: 在這個房間的中央是一張寬敞的橢圓形桌子，它由上等的紅橡木製成，佔了房間中心的大部分，圍繞著它擺放了四十把舒適的椅子。該會議廳被大祭司用來與他親選的顧問們會面來獲得建議。

english: H15. Unknown Hero
zh_tw: H15. 無名英雄

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This small, isolated tomb opens up at the end of a flight of broad stairs off the open central area of this level. The body of a young woman lies on the bier, a gleaming greatsword at her side.
zh_tw: 一座小而孤立的墓室出現在一段寬敞樓梯的盡頭，就在這一層開放區域的中心部。一個年輕女子的屍體躺在靈柩上，在她身旁是一把閃閃發光的巨劍。

english: Years before the Companion appeared in the sky, a young red dragon made life miserable for the residents of Elturel. It ate livestock, burned crops, and demanded tribute. Then one day, a scruffy-looking, unarmored woman wielding a greatsword marched up to the dragon and hacked at the beast with mighty swings. Before the stunned creature could fly away, she slew it. A startled and overwhelmed populace rushed toward the woman to thank and reward her for her bravery. As they approached, however, she fell dead. The unknown woman was laid to rest in this special place in the cathedral, and her body has never decomposed. Her nonmagical greatsword was placed at her side. Rumors suggest that she was an incarnation of Torm, or that Torm's essence filled the woman and inspired her to defeat the threat.
zh_tw: 在伴陽出現在天空中的幾年前，一條青年紅龍使艾爾托瑞爾的居民生活慘痛。它吃掉居民的牲畜，燒燬莊稼，更向居民要求進貢。然後有一天，一位不修邊幅的，不穿甲的女人手持巨劍追上那條龍，用強而有力的揮砍攻擊這頭野獸。在那被驚呆的生物飛走之前，她將其斬殺。震驚和激動得不知所措的平民衝向該女子，想要向她的英勇表達感謝和獎勵。然而，當他們接近時，她卻已經死去。這位無名的女子被帶到大教堂的這個特殊之地安息，至今她的遺體從未腐朽。她那沒有魔法力量的巨劍被放在她的身邊。有傳言稱她是託姆的化身，又或者她被託姆灌輸了神力並激發了她的勇氣戰勝威脅。

english: Any devil that enters the stairs or the alcove leading to this area is struck with intense pain, imposing disadvantage on its attack rolls while it remains in this area.
zh_tw: 任何魔鬼進入樓梯或通往該區域的壁龕都會感受到強烈的痛苦，只要它們還處於這個區域，它們的攻擊骰便獲得劣勢影響。

english: H16. Main Crypts
zh_tw: H16. 主墓穴

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This large crypt area is presently home to over a hundred {@condition frightened} people. They cower behind sarcophagi and in alcoves, their eyes red and their cheeks stained with tears. Standing before a large font is a haggard woman, her gray hair matted with sweat. With one arm, she clutches a leather-bound tome to her breast. In the other hand, she wields a ceremonial mace that would probably shatter if it struck anything harder than a pillow.
zh_tw: 這個巨大的墓穴區域目前是超過一百個{@condition frightened||恐懼}的人的避難所。他們龜縮在石棺後面和壁龕中，眼睛通紅，臉頰上沾滿了眼淚。站在一個大洗禮盆前的是一個憔悴的女人，她灰白的頭髮因汗水而糾纏在一起。她用一隻手將一本皮革繫結的書緊緊夾在胸前。在另一隻手上她持著一根似乎只要打在什麼比枕頭稍硬的東西上就會破碎的儀仗權杖。

english: These crypts house the remains of numerous worshipers and servants of Torm interred over the past century. Currently, more than one hundred {@condition frightened} survivors of the attack on the High Hall are in hiding here, waiting for their doom. Standing between them and death is a lone {@creature acolyte}, Pherria Jynks. With all the cathedral's priests dead and no one of higher authority to help her, she does her best to keep people calm and quiet. A simple sage and an expert on possession and exorcism, she is only just starting her career as a servant of Torm.
zh_tw: 這個地下室容納了整個世紀以來被埋葬於此的眾多託姆信徒和僕人的遺骸。目前，超過一百多名在襲擊中{@condition frightened||恐懼}的倖存者躲在這裡，等待他們的厄運降臨。站在他們與死亡之間的是一個孤單的{@creature acolyte||侍僧}弗裡亞·金克斯。在大教堂的所有牧師都死去的現在，沒有更高階的領導者可以幫助她，她盡了最大的努力使人們保持鎮定和安靜。她是一個單純的賢者，作為一名附身和驅魔的專家，她作為託姆僕人的生涯才剛剛開始。

english: Tome of the Creed Resolute
zh_tw: 堅毅信條名錄

english: Tome of the Creed Resolute
zh_tw: 堅毅信條名錄

english: The book in Pherria's possession is titled {@i Tome of the Creed Resolute}. Written on the first page of this book is the oath that all citizens of Elturgard take when they're old enough to read, swearing to defend Elturel body and soul. The rest of the book is filled with signatures, all of which look like they were written by the same hand. When a citizen of Elturgard places a hand on the book and recites the oath, its name magically appears in the book as a signature. The book can magically gain new pages as needed to accommodate new signatures.
zh_tw: 弗裡亞擁有的這本書的標題為《{@i 堅毅信條名錄}》。本書的第一頁寫著所有埃爾託加德公民在會讀寫後，誓言以血肉和靈魂去捍衛艾爾托瑞爾時所宣誓的誓言。本書的其餘部分充滿了簽名，所有的簽名看起來都是用同一人書寫的。當埃爾託加德的公民把手放在書上並背誦誓言時，其名字就會魔法地簽署在書頁上。這本書可以根據需要用魔法獲得新的頁面，以容納新的簽名。

english: Pherria took the {@i Tome of the Creed Resolute} from the cathedral to safeguard it. The book is merely a record of everyone who has taken the Creed Resolute oath. Its destruction doesn't break the agreements that bind the souls of Elturel's people to Avernus.
zh_tw: 弗裡亞從大教堂中拿到《{@i 堅毅信條名錄}》以保護它。這本書只是記錄下所有立下堅定信條之人的名字。它的毀滅並不會破壞將艾爾托瑞爾人民的靈魂束縛於阿弗納斯的契約。

english: Holy Water Fonts
zh_tw: 聖水盆

english: The two wide fonts here contain water that has been blessed by priests, enough to fill fifty {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|flasks with holy water}.
zh_tw: 這裡的兩個寬盆中盛有被祭司們祝福過的水，足以裝滿五十個{@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|裝有聖水的燒瓶}。

english: A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check notices odd details in the stonework around one of the fonts, which covers a secret tunnel ({@area area H17|15e|x}).
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可發現其中一個洗禮盆邊的石雕中有奇怪的紋路，這些紋路掩蓋了一條秘密通道（{@area 區域H17|15e|x}）。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Pherria tells the characters that Grand Duke Ravengard took a group of guards to the city's grand cemetery to investigate the proliferation of undead in that area. As well, Ravengard was hoping that a holy relic in the cemetery chapel called the Helm of Torm's Sight might provide some awareness into Elturel's dire circumstances and possible salvation.
zh_tw: 弗裡亞告訴角色，瑞文嘉德大公帶了一組守衛前往該市的大墓地，調查該地區不死生物的擴散。同樣，瑞文嘉德希望墓地小教堂裡的聖物——被稱為"託姆之視"的頭盔可以幫助他們得到關於艾爾托瑞爾的嚴峻形勢和可能的救助方法的知識。

english: Pherria and the others expected Ravengard back hours ago. Pherria is now worried that some terrible fate has befallen the duke. If the characters are in rough shape from their trials so far, Pherria suggests that they get a good rest, then go as quickly as possible to the cemetery to search for Ravengard and his retinue.
zh_tw: 弗裡亞和其他人都預計瑞文嘉德應在幾小時前回到這裡。弗裡亞現在擔心大公爵可能已遭受不測。如果到目前為止的考驗使玩家遍體鱗傷，弗裡亞建議他們好好休整一下，然後儘快去墓地尋找瑞文嘉德及他的隨從。

english: H17. Escape Tunnel
zh_tw: H17. 逃生隧道

english: This tunnel, accessible from beneath one of the holy water fonts in {@area area H16|159|x}, leads from under the cathedral catacombs and away from the High Hall. The tunnel now ends at a gaping hole in the floating earthmote to which Elturel clings, some five hundred feet above the River Styx.
zh_tw: 經由其中一個{@area 區域H16|159|x}的洗禮盆下的隧道可從大教堂地下墓穴下方通向至高大廳外。隧道現在的盡頭是艾爾托瑞爾依附著的浮土中的一個隙口，距冥河上方約五百尺。

english: Grand Cemetery
zh_tw: 大墓地

english: Before the characters search for Grand Duke Ravengard in Elturel's cemetery, they should advance to 6th level.
zh_tw: 在角色前往艾爾托瑞爾的大墓地中搜尋瑞文嘉德大公之前，他們應該升級到六級。

english: As the characters approach the cemetery, read the boxed text below to describe its current state:
zh_tw: 當玩家接近墓地時，請閱讀下面的方框文字以描述其當前狀態：

english: The ten-foot-high brass fence that once surrounded Elturel's cemetery has fallen in numerous places, and a wide gate allowing access to the grounds has been torn from its hinges. Severed humanoid body parts adorn the spikes atop the fence posts. Some of the body parts wriggle and writhe as if undead, twitching in concert with the lightning flashes of the Companion.
zh_tw: 曾經包圍著艾爾托瑞爾墓地的 10 尺高黃銅圍欄已有很多處倒塌了，通往內部的寬闊大門也從其門鉸處被撕裂。被切斷的類人生物軀體被裝飾在柵欄柱頂上的尖刺上。其中一些殘軀好像不死生物般蠕動抽搐，隨著伴陽的閃電轟雷而顫抖。

english: Cracked gravestones and crumbling monuments are scattered across the cemetery grounds, whose center is occupied by a chapel dedicated to Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr. That once-holy structure now glows with a fetid purple radiance.
zh_tw: 墓地遍佈著破裂的墓碑和搖搖欲墜的紀念碑，墓地的中心被獻給洛山達，託姆，海姆和提爾的小教堂佔據。這個曾經神聖的建築現在散發出令人反感的紫色光芒。

english: Elturel's grand cemetery was once a beautiful memorial to those who had passed into the realms beyond. Picturesque flowers and grass framed the graves, statues, and mausoleums that were once respectful reminders of the dead.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的大墓地曾經是紀念那些往生的人們的美麗之地。如詩如畫的花朵和青草包圍著墳墓，雕像和陵墓，它們都曾經肅穆的喚起對死者的追憶。

english: When Elturel was pulled into Avernus, the cemetery's flowers wilted and its stone monuments cracked. Then {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA}, a priest loyal to Zariel, used the dark energy of the Companion to raise the city's dead as his minions. At the same time, a magical effect in the ossuary level beneath the cemetery's chapel gave demons access to an intermittently operational portal they could use to enter the city. So far, only a few demons have arrived, but more will come if it's not closed soon.
zh_tw: 當艾爾托瑞爾被拉進阿弗納斯時，墓地的花朵枯萎了，石碑也破裂了。然後，忠於扎瑞爾的牧師{@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA|吉迪恩·萊特沃德}利用伴陽的黑暗能量，喚醒和操控了這座城市的亡魂。同時，在墓地禮拜堂下方的藏骨堂中，惡魔用魔法開啟了一個間歇運作的傳送門便他們可以進入城市。到目前為止，只有少數惡魔到達城中，但是如果不快點關閉傳送門，將會有更多的惡魔到來。

english: Grand Duke Ravengard is one of many people who know of a relic of Torm kept beneath the cemetery chapel. The Helm of Torm's Sight is said to give a worthy soul the ability to commune directly with that noble god. The duke and his guards came to the cemetery to assess the threat of its undead and to search for the relic, but were waylaid by both demons and devils. When the characters find him, Ravengard is locked in a life-and-death struggle with a demonic force in the vault of ascendance ({@area area G12|183|x}).
zh_tw: 瑞文嘉德大公是知道墓地禮拜堂下方儲存著託姆聖物的人之一。據說，託姆之視頭盔賦予了可敬靈魂直接與這位高貴的神交流的能力。大公爵和他的警衛們來到墓地評估亡靈的威脅程度並尋找聖物，但他們被惡魔和魔鬼同時伏擊。當玩家找到他時，瑞文嘉德正在飛昇寶庫（{@area 區域G12|183|x}）和惡魔力量陷入了一場生死搏鬥。

english: Gideon Lightward
zh_tw: 吉迪恩·萊特沃德

english: {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA} was a priest of Lathander who served Elturel and his deity proudly. Zariel saw that his fervor could be an asset to her, so she sent devils to corrupt him in the months leading up to the fall of Elturel. The devils posed as angels, offering Gideon increased power if he would dedicate himself to fighting the ever-present threat of demons.
zh_tw: {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA|吉迪恩·萊特沃德}曾經是洛山達的牧師，他自豪地為艾爾托瑞爾和他的神靈服務。扎瑞爾看中了他的熱情可以為她所用，因此在艾爾托瑞爾墜落的幾個月前，她派出了她手下的魔鬼來腐化他。這些魔鬼冒充成天使，向他應諾如果他能全身心投入到與不斷帶來威脅的惡魔鬥爭，他將獲得更大的力量。

english: Gideon slowly gave up his sanity and free will to the devils, leaving him corrupted by Zariel and fully serving her in the months leading up to Elturel's fall. He died during the destruction wrought as the city was drawn to Avernus, but the priest rose as an undead creature. Even as an undead, Gideon remains his mistress's most loyal servant in Elturel. He sees his cause as a noble one—fighting the demons whose chaos marks the end of all things. But his mind is broken and filled with hatred for those who refuse to follow his commands.
zh_tw: 吉迪恩從魔鬼的引誘中慢慢地失去了理智和自由意志，使他被扎瑞爾腐化，並在艾爾托瑞爾墜落前的幾個月裡全力為她服務。他死於這座城市被拉到阿弗納斯的破壞中，但這名牧師以不死生物的姿態重新站起來。即使成為了亡靈，吉迪恩仍然是他女主人在艾爾托瑞爾最忠實的僕人。他認為自己的事業——與那些標誌著萬物終結的混亂惡魔戰鬥——是崇高的。但是對於那些拒絕遵循他的命令的人來說，他已失去理智，而且充滿了仇恨。

english: Because of his obsession with destroying demons, the characters might be able to temporarily ally with Gideon to deal with the threat posed by the demon portal. Unfortunately, unless they can trick him completely, the undead priest won't let the characters leave the cemetery without a fight.
zh_tw: 由於他對消滅惡魔的痴迷，玩家們也許可以暫時與吉迪恩結盟，以應對惡魔傳送門造成的威脅。不幸的是，除非他們能完全欺騙他，否則這位不死牧師不會讓眾人和平的離開墓地。

english: {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA|吉迪恩·萊特沃德}

english: Demon Portal
zh_tw: 惡魔傳送門

english: Years ago, a wise and humble acolyte of Torm named Opallita the Devout wanted to speak directly to her god. Through decades of constant prayer in the crypts beneath the chapel, she created a direct link between the ossuary and the celestial essence of Torm, as her prayers made the chamber that she prayed in sensitive to psychic connections between mortals and higher powers.
zh_tw: 多年前，一個聰明而謙遜的託姆侍僧虔誠者奧帕利塔想要直接與她的神說話。經過數十年在教堂下方的地下墓室中不間斷的祈禱，她在藏骨堂和託姆的聖魂之間建立了直接聯絡，因為她的祈禱使她所祈禱之地對凡人和高層力量之間的精神連繫變得更敏感。

english: When Elturel was drawn to Avernus, the link between the chamber and Torm was corrupted. This corruption was sensed by the demon lord Baphomet. Seizing upon that link, Baphomet used it as an anchor point to slowly and methodically send demons through to the city. Even now, the demon lord and his minions work to widen and strengthen the connection, hoping to eventually allow entire armies of demons into Avernus by way of Elturel.
zh_tw: 當艾爾托瑞爾被拉到阿弗納斯時，藏骨堂和託姆之間的聯絡被破壞了。惡魔領主巴弗滅意識到了這種變化。巴弗滅利用這種連線，將其用作錨點，以緩慢而有條不紊的地將惡魔送入城市。至今，惡魔領主和他的僕從們仍在努力擴大和加強這種聯絡，希望最終允許整個惡魔大軍透過艾爾托瑞爾進入阿弗納斯。

english: Exploring the Cemetery
zh_tw: 探索墓地

english: The section describes locations in the city's cemetery—both the chapel and the areas around it (areas G1 through G6), and a subterranean ossuary level beneath the chapel (areas G7 through G12). The descriptions of the areas in this section are keyed to {@adventure map 2.5|BGDIA|2|Map 2.5: Grand Cemetery Chapel} and {@adventure map 2.6|BGDIA|2|Map 2.6: Grand Cemetery, Ossuary level}.
zh_tw: 本部分描述了城市墓地中的地點——教堂及其周圍區域（區域G1 至G6），以及教堂下方的地下藏骨堂（區域G7 至G12）。本節中區域的描述標註在{@adventure 地圖 2.5|BGDIA|2|Map 2.5: Grand Cemetery Chapel}和{@adventure 地圖 2.6|BGDIA|2|Map 2.6: Grand Cemetery, Ossuary level}。

english: Several graves have been dug up, leaving pits in the earth that are 6 feet deep, 2 feet wide, and 7 feet long. A number of stone mausoleums stand vacant, their doors hanging open. The interior of a mausoleum is dimly lit when its door is open and shrouded in darkness when the door is closed.
zh_tw: 幾個墳墓被挖開，在地上留下了 6 尺深，2 尺寬和 7 尺長的坑。數個空置的石制陵墓的蓋子敞開著。當陵墓的門開啟時，其內部光線昏暗，而關閉時其內部則被黑暗籠罩。

english: As the characters investigate the cemetery, they observe dozens of {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} and {@creature Zombie||zombies} moving about the grounds. These undead, wandering aimlessly and without direction, pose no threat to the characters on their way into the chapel. However, if the characters fail to deal with Gideon before leaving Elturel, the priest has time to coordinate the efforts of the undead, turning them into a potent threat against the city.
zh_tw: 在角色對墓地進行調查時，他們觀察到成群的{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}和{@creature Zombie||喪屍}在地面上移動。這些亡靈漫無目的地徘徊，對進入教堂的角色沒有威脅。但是，如果角色在離開艾爾托瑞爾之前未能解決吉迪恩，則這名牧師有時間協調不死生物的活動，將他們變成這座城市的巨大威脅。

english: Approaching the Chapel
zh_tw: 接近教堂

english: As the characters draw near the chapel, they are accosted by three {@creature Minotaur Skeleton||minotaur skeletons}—slain servants of Baphomet stripped of flesh and animated by Gideon using the power of the Companion. These skeletons attack any intruders on the cemetery grounds.
zh_tw: 當玩家靠近教堂時，三隻{@creature Minotaur Skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}接近了他們，這些被殺的巴弗滅僕役被撕去血肉，由吉迪恩使用伴陽的力量化為不死僕從。這些骷髏會攻擊墓地上的任何入侵者。

english: When the minotaur skeletons are disposed of and the characters get their first close look at the chapel, read the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: 當牛頭怪骷髏被解決後，在玩家首次接近教堂時，請閱讀以下內容以描述場景：

english: The city's descent into Avernus has taken its toll on this once beautiful chapel. Nearly all the stained glass windows along the outside walls have been smashed, and the main doors hang open. No sign of any other creatures in or around the building can be seen.
zh_tw: 這個曾經美麗的教堂在這座城市被拉到阿弗納斯被嚴重破壞。幾乎所有外牆的彩色玻璃窗都被砸碎了，大門半倒著開啟。在建築物內和四周看不到任何其他生物的跡象。

english: Characters can easily force their way into the chapel through any of its broken stained-glass windows, or can enter through the main entrance at area G1 or the unlocked back door into {@area area G3|16b|x}.
zh_tw: 冒險者們可以輕鬆地透過任何破碎的彩色玻璃窗開出一條路進入教堂，或透過區域G1的主入口，也可透過沒有鎖的後門進入{@area 區域G3|16b|x}。

english: G1. Walk of Bravery
zh_tw: G1. 勇氣步道

english: Read the following as the characters approach this area:
zh_tw: 當玩家接近該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Carved pillars resembling heroes of Elturel's past decorate this white marble patio leading into the main chapel. The dark mahogany doors are ajar, and the remains of the patio's windows have spread shattered stained glass everywhere.
zh_tw: 這座白色大理石露臺通向主禮拜堂，沿途豎立了刻有艾爾托瑞爾過去英雄的雕刻的柱子。深色的桃花心木門半開著，露臺窗戶破碎，到處散佈著碎裂的彩色玻璃。

english: With a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check, a character can remember the name of one of the heroes represented by the carved pillars, with another name remembered for each point by which the check total exceeds 10. The names of the heroes are Agnithar, Zokel of Torm, Bertra Zomes, Yevina Druen, Ca'sar, Xivik Looren, Dopp Hoosser, Whrenk the Bloody, Laveil deNue, and VanLancer Eagletalon.
zh_tw: 透過成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定，角色可以回憶起雕刻在柱子上的英雄之一的名字，檢定總值每超過 10 一點，就能多記起一個名字。英雄的名字分別是艾格尼薩，託爾姆·索克，貝爾特拉·佐姆斯，葉維娜·德魯恩，卡薩爾，希維克·洛倫，多普·霍瑟，血腥的沃林科，拉韋爾·德努埃和範蘭瑟·埃格爾塔隆。

english: A successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check made to study the carved pillars reveals that a pillar can be empowered with radiant energy if the name of the hero it represents is spoken aloud as an action. Any undead creature that moves within 5 feet of an empowered statue for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) radiant damage.
zh_tw: 透過一次成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，可研究出這些雕刻的立柱的特殊之處。如果使用一個動作大聲說出該柱代表的英雄的名字，則可以啟用立柱發出光耀能量。任何不死生物在回合中首次移動至被啟用的雕像柱的5尺內或在該處開始其回合時，會受到5（{@dice 1d10}）光耀傷害。

english: Each pillar is hollow and houses an incorporeal undead creature: four {@creature Shadow||shadows} and four {@creature Specter||specters} in total. Seven of the undead emerge from the pillars to attack any character who attempts to enter the chapel. The specter closest to the priest quarters ({@area area G5|171|x}) instead attempts to move to that area and warn Gideon of the intruders. If warned, Gideon quickly moves to {@area area G4|16e|x} and prepares to defend the chapel, while the specter returns to join the fray.
zh_tw: 每個柱子都是空心的並容納了一個無形的不死生物：總共四個{@creature Shadow||幽影}和四個{@creature Specter||惡靈}。七個亡靈從柱子中冒出來攻擊任何試圖進入教堂的角色。最靠近牧師宿舍（{@area 區域G5|171|x}）的惡靈會試圖移動到該區域並警告吉迪恩入侵者的到來。如果被警告，吉迪恩迅速前往{@area 區域G4|16e|x}並準備保衛教堂，而惡靈則返回並加入戰鬥。

english: G2. Chapel of Light
zh_tw: G2. 光之教堂

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The once-beautiful main area of the chapel is littered with broken furnishings and splintered chairs. The stained-glass windows have all been smashed, though one remains mostly intact where it's fallen whole to the floor. It depicts a representation of the god Torm placing a golden helm on the head of a man kneeling before him.
zh_tw: 曾經美麗的教堂主區現在散落著損壞的傢俱和碎裂的椅子。彩色玻璃窗戶都被砸碎了，不過其中一個窗戶幾乎完整無損，它幾乎完整地掉落在地板上。上面描繪了神明託姆將一頂金色的頭盔放在一名跪在他面前的男人的頭上的場景。

english: Out of the shadows step four minotaur skeletons clutching bloody greataxes.
zh_tw: 四隻牛頭人骷髏緊握流血的巨斧從陰影走出來。

english: A squad of Baphomet's minotaurs attempted to overrun the chapel, but Gideon and his servants slew them. Gideon then turned them into four {@creature Minotaur Skeleton||minotaur skeletons} that attack as soon as any character enters this area. The minotaur skeletons attempt to charge characters, knocking them through the smashed windows. A creature pushed through a smashed window takes an extra 7 ({@dice 2d6}) slashing damage.
zh_tw: 一支巴弗滅的牛頭人小隊試圖攻佔教堂，但吉迪恩和他的僕人將其殺死。吉迪恩其後將它們變成四個{@creature Minotaur Skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}，一旦有任何角色進入該區域，它們就會攻擊。骷髏牛頭怪試圖對角色衝鋒，將他們撞出已粉碎的窗戶。被推出窗戶的生物會額外受到7（{@dice 2d6}）的揮砍傷害。

english: Stained-Glass Window
zh_tw: 彩色玻璃窗

english: The window lying mostly whole on the floor is cracked and has been trodden on, but the scene it shows is still recognizable. A successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History} or {@skill Religion}) check allows a character to recognize the scene as showing Torm presenting the Helm of Torm's Sight to Lannish Fogel, a revered hero of Elturel's past and a dedicated paladin of Torm. The helm pictured in the stained glass is the relic Grand Duke Ravengard came to the chapel in search of.
zh_tw: 整個掉在地板上的彩繪玻璃窗破裂了，且被踐踏過，但是仍然可以辨認出它所顯示的圖案。成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定可以使角色識別該場景，該場景展示了託姆向蘭尼斯·佛吉爾 ── 艾爾托瑞爾過去的可敬英雄和信奉託姆的聖騎士——展示託姆之視頭盔，在這片彩色玻璃中的頭盔正是大公瑞文嘉德來到教堂尋找的聖物。

english: G3. Chapel of Mourning
zh_tw: G3. 哀悼教堂

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The smashed remnants of fine furniture and the remains of stained-glass windows are strewn across this area. Sections of one huge stained-glass window remain intact, enough so that its subject can still be made out. The window once portrayed Lathander standing amid fallen soldiers, holding his hands aloft as the spirits of the dead rise to stand at his side.
zh_tw: 精美的傢俱和彩色玻璃窗的殘骸在該區域四散。一面巨大的彩色玻璃窗的各個部分仍保持完好無損，因此仍然可以辨認出其主題。這扇窗戶曾經刻畫著洛山達站在陣亡的士兵中間，高高舉起雙手，死者的靈魂從軀體中而出站在祂身邊。

english: This area of the chapel was used for funeral services for esteemed political and military leaders of Elturel.
zh_tw: 禮拜堂的這個區域曾被用作舉行艾爾托瑞爾受尊敬的政治和軍事領導人的葬禮。

english: If a creature kneels before the damaged window and says a prayer to Lathander, then succeeds on a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Religion}) check made to determine the sincerity and strength of the prayer, a glowing weapon appears before the supplicant. Devout followers of Lathander succeed on the check automatically.
zh_tw: 如果有生物在受損的窗戶前跪下並向洛山達祈禱，然後成功透過{@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，他祈禱時的誠意和力量使一把發光的武器出現在祈禱者面前。洛山達的虔誠信徒會自動完成檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The weapon that appears is a {@item +2 weapon}. This item takes the form of whatever weapon the character is wielding or wearing at the time, and would be most useful to the supplicant in battle. Only one such weapon can be gained by the characters in this way.
zh_tw: 出現的武器是一件{@item +2 weapon||+2 武器}。該物品的形式為採用角色當時配戴或持握的任何武器和對祈禱者戰鬥最為有用的形式。只能透過這樣方式獲得一把這樣的武器。

english: G4. Vestment Chamber
zh_tw: G4. 聖衣間

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Three curtained archways connect this chamber to the other areas of the chapel. Shattered wardrobes and dressing tables, as well as a number of smashed mirrors, suggest that this was once where priests prepared for their daily services. Spiral stairs leading down are guarded by two creatures with insectoid features. Each one is armed with a wicked trident.
zh_tw: 三個帶窗簾的拱門將這個房間與教堂的其他區域相連。破碎的衣櫃和梳妝檯以及許多砸碎的鏡子表明，這裡曾經是祭司們為日常服務做準備的地方。向下延伸的螺旋樓梯由兩個具有類昆蟲特徵的生物守護。每個生物都持有一把邪惡的三叉戟。

english: The stairs lead down into the workshop ({@area area G7|177|x}) on the ossuary level. Two {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} guard the stairs. {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA} is also present here if one of his undead servants warned him of the characters' intrusion. Otherwise, the characters encounter Gideon in {@area area G5|171|x}.
zh_tw: 樓梯向下進入藏骨堂的作坊（{@area 區域G7|177|x}）。兩個{@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}護衛樓梯。如果{@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA|吉迪恩·萊特沃德}的一位亡靈僕人警告他冒險者的入侵，他也會在這裡現身。否則，角色將在{@area 區域G5|171|x}中遇到他。

english: Map 2.5: Grand Cemetery Chapel
zh_tw: 地圖 2.5：大墓地禮拜堂

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Just as the characters are about to face off against the fiends, a cacophony erupts from below, and six creatures rush up the stairs: a fiendish {@creature giant scorpion} trailed by five {@creature Dretch||dretches}. In response, the mezzoloths (and Gideon, if present) ignore the characters completely, focusing all their attacks on the scorpion and the demons. If Gideon is present and the characters refrain from attacking him after the first round or two, they have advantage on checks to parley with him after the battle. Otherwise, they have disadvantage on those checks.
zh_tw: 正當角色準備與他們對戰時，一陣噪音從下方爆發，六隻生物衝上樓梯：一隻煉獄{@creature giant scorpion||巨蠍}後跟著五隻{@creature Dretch||怯魔}。作為回應，毒蟲羅斯魔（ 以及吉迪恩，如果他在場的話）會完全忽略角色們，將所有攻擊都集中在蠍子和惡魔身上。如果吉迪恩在場，並且角色在第一輪或第二輪之後不攻擊他，那麼他們在戰鬥後與他談判時便有檢定上的優勢。否則，他們在那些檢定上將處於劣勢。

english: Parley
zh_tw: 談判

english: If Gideon is present, he lowers his weapon after all the demonic creatures are dead. If he is not here at the start of the fight, he arrives from his quarters during the battle or after the demons are defeated. He speaks to the characters, thanking them for any assistance in defeating the demonic intruders. He makes it clear that his singular focus is stopping the demonic incursion of Elturel—at all costs.
zh_tw: 如果吉迪恩在場，他會在所有惡魔生物死亡後放下武器。如果戰鬥一開始他不在這裡，那麼他將在戰鬥中或在擊敗惡魔後從他的居所抵達。他與角色對話，感謝他們在擊敗惡魔入侵者方面的幫助。他清楚地表明，他專注於不惜一切代價阻止惡魔入侵艾爾托瑞爾。

english: If the characters ask about Ravengard, Gideon tells them that an armed group of humans entered the ossuary level earlier. Since they were not demons, he allowed them to pass, but with demons now coming from that area, Gideon angrily assumes that the humans are in league with the demons.
zh_tw: 如果角色詢問關於瑞文嘉德的情況，吉迪恩告訴他們，一群武裝人員較早時進入藏骨堂。由於他們不是惡魔，所以他允許他們透過，但是現在惡魔從那地區出現，吉迪恩憤怒地認為那名人類與惡魔是一夥的。

english: A successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check allows the characters to earn Gideon's trust. If they can convince him that they are here only to slay demons, he allows them to enter the crypt—and even provides them with the service of one {@creature mezzoloth} if either of those creatures survived. Gideon doesn't accompany the characters, wanting to guard the chapel against demon attacks.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 12}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可以使角色贏得吉迪恩的信任。如果他們能夠說服他，他們只是來殺死惡魔，他就允許他們進入地下室，甚至如果有幸存下來的{@creature mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}，他會為冒險者們提供一隻服務他們。吉迪恩不打算陪伴角色下去，因為他想留守在小教堂使它免受惡魔的襲擊。

english: G5. Gideon's Quarters
zh_tw: G5. 吉迪恩的住處

english: This small building was {@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA}'s living quarters when he oversaw the chapel and the maintenance of the cemetery. Read the following boxed text aloud when the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 在過去{@creature Gideon Lightward|BGDIA|吉迪恩·萊特沃德}監督教堂和墓地維護工作時，這座小建築物就是他的住所。角色進入該區域時，請大聲閱讀以下方框中的文字：

english: This simple building contains a bed, a desk, a dresser, a table, and chairs. Much of the furniture has been destroyed, with decorations and other items strewn haphazardly around the room, including holy symbols of Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr. A large tome appears to have survived the destruction. It sits open at the center of the partially collapsed desk.
zh_tw: 這個簡單的建築包含一張床，一張桌子，一張食具櫃，一張桌子和椅子。許多傢俱已被破壞，裝飾品和其他雜物胡亂地散佈在房間周圍，包括洛山達，託姆，凱姆和提爾的聖徽，一本書似乎在破壞中倖存了下來。它在在部分塌陷的桌子上攤開。

english: See {@area area G4|16e|x} for information on roleplaying Gideon if the characters first encounter him here.
zh_tw: 如果角色在這裡第一次遇到吉迪恩，請參見{@area 區域G4|16e|x}以獲取有關扮演吉迪恩的資訊。

english: Gideon's Testament
zh_tw: 吉迪恩的遺囑

english: The book is a testament written by Gideon in the months leading up to Elturel's fall. It pontificates about the evil of demons, instructing the reader to be ever vigilant against their incursions, and expounding that the demonic threat must be defeated at all costs. It praises the devils that stoically stand against the unending demonic tide, while chastising Helm, Torm, Tyr, Lathander, and their angelic servitors for not doing the same. Gideon has nothing but praise for Zariel's efforts to end the demonic threat. Any character who spends 10 minutes poring over the tome can conclude, with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check, that it's the work of a madman.
zh_tw: 這本書是吉迪恩在艾爾托瑞爾墜落前幾個月寫的遺囑。它大肆宣揚惡魔的邪惡，指示讀者對惡魔的入侵保持警惕，並闡明必須不惜一切代價擊敗惡魔的威脅。它讚揚那些頑強地抵擋無盡的惡魔潮流的魔鬼，同時譴責海姆，託姆，提爾，洛山達及其天使僕人，因為他們沒有做到同樣的事。吉迪恩對扎瑞爾消除惡魔威脅的努力只有讚賞。任何花費 10 分鐘仔細研究此書的角色都可以透過成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定得出結論── 這本書的作者一定是瘋了。

english: Any character who continues to read the book beyond that basic level of understanding must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed check, the character is cursed with a particularly intense hatred of demons. A creature cursed in this way takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) psychic damage if it can see any demon within 60 feet of it and ends its turn not having attempted to attack a demon. This curse can be removed with a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic. At the end of each long rest, a cursed creature can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 任何想繼續深入閱讀本書的角色，都必須成功進行一次{@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，該角色會被詛咒，對惡魔產生極其強烈的憎恨。如果以此方式受到詛咒的生物在其 60 尺內可以看見任何惡魔，並且在未嘗試攻擊惡魔的情況下結束回合，則對其造成5（{@dice 1d10}）心靈傷害。可以使用{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或類似法術效應移除此詛咒。在每次長休結束時，被詛咒的生物可以進行一次{@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，成功結束對其自身的詛咒。

english: G6. Undead Pit
zh_tw: G6. 亡靈坑窪

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The path around the chapel has been sundered by a deep hole in the ground, filled with a putrid purple mist. The haze filling the hole blocks any sense of how deep it might be, or of what might lie within.
zh_tw: 教堂周圍的小路上被一口深坑分隔，裡面充滿了腐爛的紫色霧氣。充滿坑洞的迷霧阻擋對其中的探知，使玩家不清楚深淺或隱藏了什麼。

english: Gideon creates his undead servants in this 30-foot-deep pit, which was formed when a piece of the meteor that struck the High Hall splintered off.
zh_tw: 吉迪恩在這個 30 尺深的坑中創造他的亡靈僕人，這個坑是由撞上至高大廳的流星碎片撞擊而形成的。

english: Necromantic Mist
zh_tw: 暗蝕迷霧

english: The mist is formed by necromantic energy emitted from the corrupted Companion. A successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check made to study the mist reveals that it pulsates in sync with the crackling energy of the corrupted Companion.
zh_tw: 這片霧是由腐化的伴陽發出的死靈能量形成的。成功進行的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定研究發現迷霧與腐化的伴陽劈啪作響的能量同步脈動。

english: Any creature that enters the mist for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) necrotic damage. Climbing the sides of the pit without equipment requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 任何在回合中首次進入霧氣或在霧氣中開始回合的生物都會受到5（{@dice 1d10}）暗蝕傷害。在沒有裝置的情況下攀爬坑的側面需要成功進行{@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Whenever Gideon directs his minions to toss a dead body into the pit, an undead creature crawls forth one hour later. Newly created undead patiently wander the cemetery grounds until Gideon gives them orders.
zh_tw: 每當吉迪恩指示他的僕從將屍體扔進坑中時，一個亡靈便會在一小時後從坑中爬出。新建立的亡靈不厭其煩地在墓地前徘徊，直到吉迪恩給他們命令。

english: One undead creature appears during the time the characters investigate the pit, and more can appear if they leave this area, then return again while Gideon is still at large. Use the Undead Creation table to determine what kind of undead creature is created.
zh_tw: 在角色調查坑的過程中，會出現一隻亡靈，如果他們離開該區域，並在吉迪恩仍然逍遙法外時再次返回，還會出現更多的亡靈，然後。使用亡靈建立表格來確定要建立哪種亡靈。

english: Undead Creation
zh_tw: 亡靈創造

english: Undead
zh_tw: 亡靈

english: {@creature Skeleton}
zh_tw: {@creature Skeleton||骷髏}

english: {@creature Zombie}
zh_tw: {@creature Zombie||喪屍}

english: {@creature Shadow}
zh_tw: {@creature Shadow||幽影}

english: {@creature Specter}
zh_tw: {@creature Specter||惡靈}

english: {@creature Ghoul}
zh_tw: {@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}

english: {@creature Ghast}
zh_tw: {@creature Ghast||妖鬼}

english: {@creature Wight}
zh_tw: {@creature Wight||屍妖}

english: {@creature Wraith}
zh_tw: {@creature Wraith||邪靈}

english: G7. Workshop
zh_tw: G7. 工作室

english: The stairs from {@area area G4|16e|x} curl down to an unlocked door and a workshop beyond. Read the following boxed text when the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: {@area 區域G4|16e|x}的樓梯向下彎曲到達一道沒上鎖的門前，門後面是作坊。角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下框式文字：

english: This workshop appears to be where priests and acolytes prepared dead bodies for final interment. The place has been ransacked, with knives, saws, piping, and tubes littering the floor. Acid and embalming fluid pool everywhere, amid a field of shattered flasks and jars.
zh_tw: 這作坊似乎是祭司和侍從人員處理屍體進行最後埋葬的地方。這個地方已經被洗劫一空。刀、鋸、管道和管子亂扔在地板上。在一片破碎的長頸瓶和廣口瓶中，灑滿了酸液和防腐液。

english: The double door to the north leads to stairs that descend to areas {@area G8|17a|x}, {@area G9|17c|x}, and {@area G11|180|x}.
zh_tw: 朝北的雙開門通往一條到達{@area G8|17a|x}，{@area G9|17c|x}和{@area G11|180|x}的樓梯。

english: Tracks
zh_tw: 蹤跡

english: A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check reveals the tracks of multiple demons in the detritus spread across the floor. Amid those tracks, signs can be seen of a single group of booted humans moving down the stairs. These bootprints, trailing embalming fluid, lead all the way to {@area area G11|180|x}, then back toward {@area area G12|183|x}.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定可識別出碎屑中遍佈地板的各種個惡魔的蹤跡。在這些痕跡中，可以看到一組穿著靴子的類人足跡走下樓梯的跡象。這些足跡掛著防腐液，一路指向到{@area 區域G11|180|x}，然後折向{@area 區域G12|183|x}。

english: G8. Ossuary of the Faithful
zh_tw: G8. 虔敬藏骨堂

english: Those who could not afford the expense of a cemetery plot above ground were respectfully laid to rest in this area and area G9. Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 那些無力支付地面上墓地位置費用的人的屍體被有尊嚴地安置在這個區域和區域G9。角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The walls of this chamber are lined with funerary shelves, each set with dusty humanoid bones. Relics and holy symbols of Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr have been set prominently on a number of shelves.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁兩旁排滿了埋葬架，每個架上都擺滿了沾滿塵土的人形骨頭。洛山達，託姆，凱姆和提爾的聖物和聖徽放置在許多架子上醒目的地方。

english: The bones marked by holy symbols are the remains of honored priests and acolytes who worked in the chapel, and who requested to take their final rest alongside the poor they served.
zh_tw: 刻有聖徽的骨頭是在教堂裡工作的榮譽牧師和侍僧的遺骸，他們要求與所服務的窮人一起安息。

english: The holy symbols in this area once channeled the blessings of their gods, but that trace magic has been corrupted by the passage of Elturel to Avernus, and by the presence of the abyssal portal in {@area area G12|183|x}. If any holy symbol is touched, or if any creature not a fiend or undead lingers in this area for more than 1 minute, all the holy symbols unleash a pulse of necrotic power. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This hazard resets in 1 hour as long as the portal in {@area area G12|183|x} is active.
zh_tw: 該地區的聖徽曾經傳遞著來自眾神的祝福，但是由於艾爾托瑞爾墜入阿弗納斯以及{@area 區域G12|183|x}的深淵傳送門的存在，這種微弱魔法已被汙染。如果觸碰到任何聖徽，或者任何非邪魔或亡靈在該區域停留超過 1 分鐘，則所有聖徽都會釋放出一股死亡力量。該區域中的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗則受到18（{@dice 4d8}）暗蝕傷害，若成功則僅受到一半的傷害。只要{@area 區域G12|183|x}中的傳送門處於活躍狀態，此危險就會在 1 小時內重置。

english: G9. Main Ossuary
zh_tw: G9. 主藏骨堂

english: Map 2.6: Grand Cemetery, Ossuary level
zh_tw: 地圖 2.6：大墓地，藏骨堂層

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This huge chamber is lined by funerary shelves along the stone walls above six bare daises, creating a display of dusty humanoid bones rising from floor to ceiling.
zh_tw: 這個巨大的房間沿著石牆有六個無遮蔽的石臺，其上列滿了屍骨架，展示著從地板到天花板的塵土飛揚的人骨。

english: A {@creature quasit} named Ophurkh was the first demon to come through the portal in {@area area G12|183|x}, acting as a scout. A steadfast servant of Baphomet, it remains in this area to provide instructions for other demons as they arrive through the portal and prepare to enter Elturel.
zh_tw: 一隻名為歐法爾克的{@creature quasit||小惡魔}是第一隻作為斥侯透過{@area 區域G12|183|x}傳送門的惡魔。作為巴弗滅的忠誠僕人，它仍然留在該地區，為其他透過門戶到達此並準備進入艾爾托瑞爾地表的惡魔提供引導。

english: Ophurkh remains {@condition invisible} and keeps quiet as the characters pass through this area. If it is able to elude notice, it follows the characters, waiting for a chance to use its Scare ability to try to drive them from this level. If unsuccessful, it goes {@condition invisible} again, then waits and attacks alongside the minotaurs that emerge from the portal when the characters reach {@area area G12|183|x}.
zh_tw: 當角色穿過該區域時，歐法爾克保持{@condition invisible||隱形}並保持安靜。如果它能夠躲過探查，它將尾隨角色，等待機會使用其恐嚇能力嘗試將他們從這層驅走。如果不成功，它將再次找機會{@condition invisible||隱形}，然後等待角色到達{@area 區域G12|183|x}時與從傳送門到達的牛頭怪一起進攻。

english: If captured, the self-serving quasit can be coerced into providing information about the portal and the plans of its demonic masters (see "{@area Demon Portal|162|x}") with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check.
zh_tw: 如果被捕獲，則可以透過成功進行{@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定，以強迫這隻自私的小惡魔提供有關傳送門及其惡魔主人計劃的資訊（請參閱" {@area 惡魔傳送門|162|x} "）。

english: G10. Meditation Chamber
zh_tw: G10. 冥想室

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This area is set with cushions and low stools of brown oak. Above an empty dais, the wall is covered with a mosaic shaped from colored chips of bone, artfully arranged to depict scenes of funerals, the migration of souls, and the celestial realms. Lettering along the bottom of the mosaic reads: "Contemplate life. Death comes soon enough."
zh_tw: 該區域設有靠墊和棕色橡木矮凳。在空蕩蕩的教堂上方，牆壁上覆蓋著由彩色的骨頭碎片形成的馬賽克圖案，巧妙地佈置成描繪葬禮，靈魂的轉生以及天國的場景。馬賽克圖案的底部刻有文字："思考生命。因為死亡很快就會來臨。"

english: Any character with proficiency in {@skill Religion} recognizes this area as one in which priests dedicated to dealing with the dead would meditate to help them endure the dark nature of their work.
zh_tw: 任何熟練於{@skill Religion||宗教}的角色都可認出此處是致力於與死者打交道的牧師冥想的地方，以幫助他們忍受工作中的黑暗本質。

english: G11. Vault of Honor
zh_tw: G11. 榮譽寶庫

english: This vault once housed the Helm of Torm's Sight, but no longer. Read the following boxed text to the players as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 這個寶庫曾經收容了託姆之視頭盔，但頭盔現在已不在此。當角色進入該區域時，請向玩家閱讀以下框內文字：

english: This rubble-strewn vault contains five marble statues atop daises. Four of the statues are unrecognizable, as their features have been badly marred by rock fallen from the cracked ceiling. The fifth is a finely carved statue of a kneeling man.
zh_tw: 這個瓦礫遍地的寶庫在平臺上有五個大理石雕像。其中四個雕像無法辨認，因為從破裂的天花板掉落的岩石嚴重破壞了它們的特徵。第五個是一座精雕細刻的描繪著一名下跪男子的雕像。

english: The recognizable statue depicts Lannish Fogel, as seen in the stained-glass window in {@area area G2|168|x}. Any characters who saw the window recognize that the two depictions are the same man. If none of the characters recognized Lannish Fogel in {@area area G2|168|x}, a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History} or {@skill Religion}) check allows a character to recognize the statue.
zh_tw: 可被識別的雕像描繪了蘭尼斯·佛吉爾，如在{@area 區域G2|168|x}的彩色玻璃窗中所見般。任何看過窗戶的角色都會意識到這兩次描繪的是同一個人。如果在{@area 區域G2|168|x}中沒有一個角色認出蘭尼斯·佛吉爾，則成功的{@dc 10}智力（{@skill History||歷史}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定將允許角色認出該雕像。

english: Any inspection of the statue reveals that its head has been sculpted as if it was meant to wear a separate helm, but no such helm is present.
zh_tw: 對雕像的任何檢查都表明其頭部被製成好像曾戴著一具獨立的頭盔的樣子，但是現在沒有找到這具頭盔。

english: Tracks
zh_tw: 蹤跡

english: A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check reveals more demonic tracks passing through this area, as well as the tracks of booted humans leading on to area G12.
zh_tw: 若成功透過{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，則會發現更多穿過此區域的惡魔蹤跡，以及通往G12 區域的穿靴人類足跡。。

english: G12. Vault of Ascendance
zh_tw: G12. 飛昇之室

english: Read the following as the characters enter this area:
zh_tw: 角色進入該區域時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A shallow meditation pool fills this room, set off from a broad landing edged by a low wrought-iron railing. Wondrous frescoes along the walls depict souls gaining the blessings of Lathander, Torm, Helm, and Tyr. The frescoes on one wall have been twisted into abyssal forms surrounding a shimmering portal.
zh_tw: 房間正中設有一池淺水冥想池，與寬闊的平臺相映襯，平臺邊緣設有低矮的鍛鐵欄杆。牆壁上奇異的壁畫描繪了靈魂得到了洛山達，託姆，海姆和提爾的祝福。其中一面牆上的壁畫已扭曲成環繞著一扇閃爍傳送門的深淵模樣。

english: The pool is littered with the mutilated bodies of humans wearing the uniforms of Baldur's Gate and Elturel. The swirling water of the pool roils with shadow, and is shot through with patches of black ichor where demons have fallen here. An armored man with a shield slung over his back crouches among the bodies, writhing in pain. His eyes are closed, and his hands clutch at a gold helm on his head as if trying in vain to claw it off.
