Unintelligible words spill from his lips, some sounding saintly and solemn, while others resonate with a cruel hissing.
zh_tw: 冥想池裡散落著身穿博德之門和艾爾托瑞爾制服的殘破屍體。打旋的池水在陰影中激盪，池中充滿了從惡魔屍體流出的黑色膿液。一名著甲，斜負盾牌的男子蹲在屍海中痛苦地扭動。他緊閉雙眼，雙手緊抓他頭戴的金色頭盔並徒勞地敲擊。他的雙唇吐出難以理解的單詞，有些聽起來聖潔而莊重，而另一些卻引起殘忍的嘶鳴聲。

english: This chamber was a place for the most devout of Torm's followers to touch the mind of their god in search of answers and solace. The water in the pool is only 1 foot deep. A benign magical effect within the pool causes the water to flow slowly in a clockwise direction. Though tainted with abyssal power, the water presents no hazard to creatures that enter it, and is not {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 這個房間曾是一個讓託姆最虔誠的信徒接觸他們神靈的地方，以尋求回應和安慰。池中的水只有 1 尺深。水池中的良性法術效應使水沿順時針方向緩慢流動。儘管受到深淵力量的汙染，但池水對進入其中的生物沒有危險，也不是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: The east wall of this area is a roiling field of abyssal energy, marking the portal where Baphomet has used this area's corrupted link to Torm to connect the Abyss to Avernus, by way of Elturel.
zh_tw: 這區域的東牆是一塊激盪著的深淵能量場，巴弗滅利用此地與託姆的腐化連結，創造了一個傳送門經由艾爾托瑞爾將無底深淵連線至阿弗納斯。

english: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}

english: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} found the Helm of Torm's Sight in {@area area G11|180|x} and donned it. The helm is a nonmagical item through which Torm can send visions. Ravengard was beginning to establish a connection with Torm when a disturbance in this room brought him and his guards into combat with demonic creatures sent through the portal by Baphomet. Ravengard was subjected to a psychic attack that drew his mind into a connection with Baphomet. Now the helm can't be removed, and he is locked in a mental battle with the demon lord. Ravengard is {@condition stunned} until the helm is removed. The helm can't be removed from him while he is alive—at least, not yet.
zh_tw: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}在{@area 區域G11|180|x}區發現了託姆之視頭盔並將其戴上。這是一件非魔法物品，託姆可透過它傳送幻象。當瑞文嘉德開始與託姆建立聯絡時，對這個房間的幹擾將他和他的衛兵與巴弗滅透過傳送門送來的惡魔發生戰鬥。瑞文嘉德遭受了心靈上的攻擊，這使他的心靈與巴弗滅產生了聯絡。現在他無法移除頭盔，而且他被鎖在與惡魔領主的精神戰鬥中。瑞文嘉德處於{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態，直到頭盔被移除為止。在他還活著的時候，頭盔將無法被移除，至少現在不行。

english: As the characters observe the struggle taking place within Ravengard, three wild-eyed {@creature Minotaur||minotaurs} come through the portal. They charge into battle with the characters but avoid Ravengard because of the demonic presence they feel within him.
zh_tw: 當角色們觀察到瑞文嘉德內心發生的鬥爭時，三隻紅眼的{@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}穿過傳送門。他們衝向角色進行戰鬥，但由於感受到了瑞文嘉德體內的惡魔氣息，他們會因此避開瑞文嘉德。

english: Any character who understands Celestial or Abyssal can recognize some of the words escaping Ravengard's lips. He alternates between the two languages as both Torm and Baphomet speak through him. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check reveals that the psychic struggle taking place within Ravengard's mind is between some divine higher power and a terrible, demonic entity. The power of the portal is now tied into the helm, and to Ravengard. The same check also reveals that no simple spell can break this hold—but that a more involved ritual might free Ravengard and shut down the portal by allowing the power of Torm to sanctify this area once more.
zh_tw: 任何瞭解天界語或深淵語的角色都可以理解從瑞文嘉德嘴中說出的某些單詞。由於託姆和巴弗滅都透過他講話，因此他會在兩種語言之間來回切換。成功的{@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定表示，瑞文嘉德內心之中發生的鬥爭是某種更高位的神聖力量與一個可怕的惡魔存在之間產生的。現在，傳送門的力量已牢牢繫結住頭盔和戴著它的瑞文嘉德。相同的檢定還表明，簡單的法術不可能打破這種對峙的狀態，但是一個更多人參與的儀式可以解放瑞文嘉德並透過重注託姆的力量再次使該區域神聖化來關閉傳送門。

english: Characters who spoke to Pherria back at the cathedral remember that she was a sage who specialized in exorcism and possession. As such, she might be able to help.
zh_tw: 在大教堂時曾與弗裡亞交談的人物記得，她是擅長應對附身和驅魔的賢者。因此，她也許可以提供幫助。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Searching the bodies of the fallen guards turns up three wet but usable {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell mass healing word}, {@spell remove curse}, and {@spell tongues}).
zh_tw: 搜尋陣亡的護衛屍體會找到三個沾溼了但仍可用的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell mass healing word||群體治癒真言}、 {@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}，和{@spell tongues||巧言術}）。

english: In addition to the Helm of Torm's Sight, Ravengard wears a bloodied suit of {@item plate armor|phb} emblazoned with the emblem of the Flaming Fist. His {@item shield|phb}, which also bears this emblem, is slung over his back. The grand duke's {@item +1 longsword} is sheathed at his side.
zh_tw: 除了託姆之視頭盔外，瑞文嘉德還穿著沾滿血的{@item plate armor|phb|板甲}，上面印有焰拳的徽記。他背在背上的{@item shield|phb|盾牌}上也掛著這個徽章。大公的{@item +1 longsword||+1 長劍}連鞘掛他的身邊。

english: Leaving the Chapel
zh_tw: 離開教堂

english: Once the characters defeat the minotaurs, they can carry Ravengard back to the High Hall. If Gideon has not been destroyed, he might question the characters as they leave the chapel or the cemetery. See {@area area G4|16e|x} for information on roleplaying Gideon.
zh_tw: 一旦玩家們擊敗牛頭怪，他們就可以將瑞文嘉德帶回至高大廳。如果吉迪恩還沒有被消滅，他可能會在角色們離開教堂或墓地時質問角色。有關角色扮演吉迪恩的資訊，請參見{@area 區域G4|16e|x}。

english: Hearing Ravengard mumbling in Abyssal, Gideon might need convincing that Ravengard is not some sort of demon or demonic ally. A good explanation—that Ravengard is actually a great demon hunter, that he has trapped a demon the characters plan to kill, and so forth—alongside a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check prompts Gideon to let them pass.
zh_tw: 若吉迪恩聽到瑞文嘉德在用深淵語喃喃自語，玩家可能需要說服他瑞文嘉德不是某種惡魔或惡魔的盟友。一個很好的解釋例如──瑞文嘉德實際上是一個偉大的惡魔獵手，他捕獲了一個打算殺死他們的惡魔，諸如此類的──伴隨著成功的{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，吉迪恩會讓他們透過。

english: Escaping the Siege
zh_tw: 逃出圍城

english: When the characters arrive back at the High Hall cathedral with Grand Duke Ravengard in tow, they can consult with Pherria to find a way to remove the Helm of Torm's Sight without killing Ravengard. Doing so involves a ritual that the characters can help carry out. If the ritual is successful, the {@condition stunned} condition ends on Ravengard, and he recalls the visions he experienced that hint at how to return Elturel to Faerûn. These visions trigger some of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories. She sees a path forward, but it involves the characters leaving the city to brave the terrible landscape of Avernus.
zh_tw: 當角色帶著瑞文嘉德大公回到至高大廳大教堂時，他們可以與弗裡亞商量以找到一種在不殺死瑞文嘉德的情況下移除託姆之視頭盔的方法。這樣做需要一種儀式，而玩家可以幫助儀式進行。如果儀式成功，那麼瑞文嘉德的{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態將結束，並回憶起他經歷過的那些幻象，其中暗示著如何將艾爾托瑞爾送回費倫。這些幻象也會觸發{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的回憶。她看到了前進的道路，但其內容包含角色們離開城市勇敢面對阿弗納斯的恐怖景色的畫面。

english: Characters wishing to leave Elturel must find a way to avoid the River Styx and the host of devils and demons waging war below the city. Only then can the characters make their way to the outpost known as Fort Knucklebone, where the next leg of their adventure starts (as described in {@area chapter 3|1b3|x}).
zh_tw: 希望離開艾爾托瑞爾的角色必須找到一種方法來避開冥河以及成群的惡魔和魔鬼在城市下展開的戰爭。只有這樣，冒險者們才能前往被稱為指節骨要塞的哨站，在那裡開始下一場冒險（如{@area 第三章|1b3|x}所述）。

english: Return to the Cathedral
zh_tw: 返回大教堂

english: The characters can make their way back to the relative safety of the cathedral in the High Hall. If they helped defeat the devils that attempted to take the cathedral earlier, the trip should be uneventful. Alternatively, to keep the tension high, you can roll for random encounters in the western portion of the city (see "{@area More Encounters in Elturel|11a|x}"). An encounter or two while the characters protect Duke Ravengard could make for memorable play.
zh_tw: 玩家可以返回相對安全的至高大廳大教堂。如果他們幫助守軍擊敗了試圖佔領大教堂的魔鬼，那麼這次旅途應該平安無事。亦或，為保持緊張局勢，您可以在城市西部擲出隨機遭遇（請參閱" {@area 艾爾托瑞爾中的更多遭遇|11a|x} "）。角色在保護瑞文嘉德大公時遭遇一兩次襲擊，可能會給他們留下深刻的印象。

english: Ritual of Returning
zh_tw: 歸還儀式

english: Upon returning to the High Hall cathedral with {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}, the characters are greeted by Pherria Jynks and the druid Seltern Obranch, who rush to aid them in getting the grand duke to a safe resting place. If the characters failed to save the people in the cathedral, they must find a safe place to rest or forge ahead without assistance. They can search the rest of the city for secure locations, or look for other survivors who might have skills or information that can assist them. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} might also regain memories that grant her insight into where to go next.
zh_tw: 與{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}返回至高大廳大教堂時，弗裡亞·金克斯和德魯伊賽爾特恩·歐布蘭馳匆忙迎接他們。他們協助眾人將大公帶到安全的地方休息。如果玩家之前未能在大教堂中拯救人民，他們必須找到一個安全的地方休息或在沒有幫助的情況下前進。他們可以在城市的其他地區搜尋安全的地點，或者尋找可能有技能或資訊可以幫助他們的其他倖存者。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}也可能會重新回覆記憶，使她對下一步的行動獲得啟示。

english: If the characters failed to ascertain the story behind Ravengard's {@condition stunned} state, Pherria can assist them in putting things together. Working with the acolyte, the characters (especially those who have proficiency in {@skill Arcana} and {@skill Religion}) determine how to move forward. The demonic essence intertwined with Torm's presence by way of the helm can be cast out with the proper ritual.
zh_tw: 如果角色無法確定瑞文嘉德處於{@condition stunned||震懾}的原因，弗裡亞可以幫助他們將事情梳理聯絡起來。與侍僧和還有玩家（尤其是熟練於{@skill Arcana||奧秘}和{@skill Religion||宗教}的角色）一起決定下一步。他們可以透過適當的儀式驅除在透過頭盔與託姆的存在交織在一起的惡魔本源。

english: Ritual Preparations
zh_tw: 儀式準備

english: Pherria outlines what's needed for the ritual:
zh_tw: 弗裡亞概述了該儀式需要什麼：

english: The altar of Torm in {@area area H6|14a|x} must be cleansed and the ritual performed before it. The altar of Torm can be restored as described in {@area area H6|14a|x}. Pherria suggests that the characters splash the altar with holy water taken from the font in {@area area H16|159|x}.
zh_tw: 必須淨化{@area 區域H6|14a|x}的託姆祭壇，並在該處進行儀式。如{@area 區域H6|14a|x}所述的步驟可以使祭壇恢復。弗裡亞建議，冒險者們用從{@area 區域H16|159|x}的洗禮盆取來的聖水灑在祭壇上。

english: A creature standing within 5 feet of the restored altar must recite a special prayer to Torm. Only this prayer can break evil's hold on Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA}'s mind.
zh_tw: 必須有一名生物站在被恢復的祭壇 5 尺內背誦託姆的特殊禱告。只有這樣的祈禱，才能打破惡魔對大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的心靈控制。

english: A powerful symbol of courage and self-sacrifice is needed to empower the ritual. Pherria suggests the greatsword of the Unknown Hero in {@area area H15|157|x}. (The characters can use a different object that symbolizes courage and self-sacrifice, at your discretion.)
zh_tw: 需要一件強大的，代表著勇氣和自我犧牲的象徵來賦予儀式力量。 弗裡亞建議使用在{@area 區域H15|157|x}的無名英雄的巨劍。 （根據您的判斷，角色可以使用其他象徵勇氣和自我犧牲的物品。）

english: Performing the Prayer
zh_tw: 進行禱告

english: Pherria warns the characters that she has never attempted this particular ritual before, and that they should be ready to step in and help her—or to fight off any evil forces that might try to disrupt the process.
zh_tw: 弗裡亞警告冒險者，她以前從未嘗試過這種特殊儀式，他們應該準備好介入來幫助她──或與可能破壞這行動的邪惡勢力對抗。

english: The ritual prayer takes 30 seconds to recite. Pherria knows the prayer by heart, but another creature can invoke a suitable prayer with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check. While the prayer is being spoken, one character must spend the next 5 rounds gently resting the sword of the Unknown Hero on the Helm of Torm's Sight. While the prayer is being spoken, the one holding the sword must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) force damage.
zh_tw: 祈禱儀式需要 30 秒才能朗誦完成。 弗裡亞內心緊記住有祈禱的內容，但是另一個生物可以透過成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定來以合適的祈禱輔助。在祈禱時，一個角色必須在接下來的 5 個回合中輕輕地將無名英雄的巨劍置在託姆之視頭盔上方。在進行祈禱時，持劍者必須在每回合結束時成功透過{@dc 11}體質豁免檢定，否則將受到10（{@dice 3d6}）力場傷害。

english: Immediately after the character holding the sword makes their first saving throw, the potent magic of the ritual attracts demonic spirits loyal to Baphomet, which emerge from the helm as two {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps} that attempt to disrupt the ritual by attacking the individuals reciting the prayer and holding the sword.
zh_tw: 在持劍的角色進行首次豁免後，儀式的強大魔力立即吸引了忠於巴弗滅的惡魔，兩隻{@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}從頭盔中出現，試圖透過攻擊誦禱者和持劍者來破壞祈禱儀式。

english: When the character holding the sword makes the last saving throw, the ritual is complete. The will-o'-wisps are banished, and Ravengard comes to his senses.
zh_tw: 當持劍的角色進行最後一次豁免檢定時，儀式就完成了。未被消滅的鬼火被放逐，而瑞文嘉德也恢復意識。

english: Helm of Torm's Sight
zh_tw: 託姆之視頭盔

english: You can simplify the encounter with {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} by allowing the characters to remove the Helm of Torm's Sight from his head, whereupon Ravengard quickly regains his senses. At that point, he can tell them about his visions, which provide the information they need and trigger {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories. He then lets them plot a path forward in their quest to save Elturel.
zh_tw: 您可以允許角色從其頭部移除託姆之視頭盔來簡化與{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}的遭遇。這樣可使瑞文嘉德迅速恢復其意識。到時，他可以告訴他們自已看到的影像，這些影像可以提供他們所需的資訊並觸發{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶。然後，他讓冒險者們尋求和踏上拯救艾爾托瑞爾的道路。

english: Alternatively, Ravengard can fall {@condition unconscious} when the helm is removed, even as the character who removes it feels an almost overwhelming urge to don it. A character who dons the helm feels at peace and sees visions of troops in gleaming armor marching across a grassy plain with military precision. In the next breath, the character sees massive groups of disfigured monsters loping across a blighted landscape, tearing at screaming enemies. The character wearing the helm can't remove it until they receive a {@spell bless} spell from a worshiper of Torm. (Pherria fits this description.) In the meantime, as the adventuring party travels back to the cathedral with the still-{@condition unconscious} Ravengard, the character wearing the helm experiences the same visions that Ravengard was having, as described in "{@area The Path Forward|18d|x}". Ravengard then awakens after 1 hour, no worse for wear.
zh_tw: 或者，當頭盔被移走時，瑞文嘉德也可能在移除頭盔後會進入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態，移除頭盔的角色感受到一股壓倒性的慾望驅使自己去戴上它。佩戴頭盔的角色會感到平靜，並看到穿著閃閃發光裝甲的軍隊正在前進，精確有序地穿越草地。在下一瞬間，他看到成群的面目猙獰的怪物奔過一片枯萎的土地，撕碎尖叫的敵人。戴上頭盔的角色直到從託姆信徒中得到{@spell bless||祝福術}法術後才能將其移除（弗裡亞符合此條件。）與此同時，冒險隊帶著仍在{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的瑞文嘉德回到大教堂，戴著頭盔的角色經歷了與瑞文嘉德如"{@area 前進的道路|18d|x}"中所述之相同的幻象。瑞文嘉德會在 1 小時後醒來，沒有其他因戴上頭盔造成的影響。

english: The Path Forward
zh_tw: 前進的道路

english: With the forces of evil defeated, Grand Duke Ravengard regains his faculties and can relay the story of the spirit journey he undertook while wearing the Helm of Torm's Sight. Torm has shown him a path forward, but the visions were clouded and warped by the demonic essence channeled through the portal. Ravengard shares the following information:
zh_tw: 隨著邪惡勢力被擊敗，瑞文嘉德大公恢復了他的能力，並且可以講述他戴著託姆之視頭盔時所進行的精神之旅。託姆向他展示了前進的道路，但幻象卻被傳送門傳導的惡魔之力遮蔽和扭曲。瑞文嘉德可分享以下資訊：

english: In his spirit journey, Ravengard saw a bloodied woman in armor—a soldier wearing the colors and crest of Elturel—grasping a longsword fit for an angel. Fresh blood streamed from a nasty cut on the woman's cheek.
zh_tw: 在他的精神之旅中，瑞文嘉德看到一名穿著鎧甲正在流血的女人——一位衣著艾爾托瑞爾服裝配色和紋章的士兵——緊抓住一把為天使而造的長劍。女人臉頰上的一處糟糕的傷口在流淌著新鮮的血液。

english: Flying next to the woman was a small, golden elephant with rapidly fluttering wings. (If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is still with the party, Ravengard identifies her as the creature he saw in his vision.)
zh_tw: 那個女人旁邊有一隻快速拍動翅膀飛行的金色的小象。 （如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}仍在團隊中，瑞文嘉德認出她就是他在幻象中看到的生物。）

english: As an enormous, loping demon threatened to devour the woman, she plunged the sword into the ground while the winged elephant made a trumpet sound with its trunk. The demon was hurled back as an alabaster palace rose up around the sword. The winged elephant fled and took to the red sky of Avernus, where it watched as a bloody scab grew up from the ground to engulf the palace and the enormous demon.
zh_tw: 一頭巨大的惡魔奔跑著追趕著，威脅要吞噬這個女人時，她將劍插入地面，而同時那隻長翅膀的大像用象鼻裡發出象鳴。而惡魔急忙後退，同時一座白玉宮殿在長劍四周升起。這隻有翅膀的大象飛向阿弗納斯的紅色天空，看見一片血痂從地面長出，吞沒了宮殿和巨大的惡魔。

english: The winged elephant fled and wandered in a delirium before coming upon two odd, birdlike humanoids dressed in patchwork armor and standing next to a strange infernal vehicle. The bird creatures were equipped with odd weapons and tools.
zh_tw: 這隻有翅膀的大象在神智不清中逃離並遊蕩，直到遇上兩個穿著拼湊而成的盔甲的奇異鳥形類人生物。他們站在一架奇怪的地獄戰車旁邊。這些鳥形生物裝備著奇特的武器和工具。

english: As Ravengard recounts the vision, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} remembers helping one of the Hellriders plant Zariel's sword in the ground and raise an impenetrable fortress around it. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} remembers the Hellrider's name if that memory has already been unlocked (see the {@area Lulu's Memories table|10d|x}). Both Ravengard and the hollyphant are convinced that the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} is the key to saving Elturel. Any character who dons the Helm of Torm's Sight and experiences Torm's vision feels the same way.
zh_tw: 在瑞文嘉德敘述影像時，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記得曾經幫助過一名地獄騎手在地面上插下扎瑞爾的劍，並在其周圍升起起了堅不可摧的堡壘。如果她的記憶已被解鎖，則{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會記起這位地獄騎手的名字（請參閱{@area 露露的記憶表|10d|x}）。瑞文嘉德和聖飛象都深信{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}是挽救艾爾托瑞爾的關鍵。任何戴上託姆之視頭盔並體驗過託姆幻象的角色都具有相同的感覺。

english: Ravengard remembers nothing more of his vision, but {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} flaps her wings in excitement at the final part of his story as she remembers meeting a pair of "bird folk" named {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA}. Based on descriptions furnished by {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Ravengard, the characters can conclude that {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} are kenku. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} remembers that the kenku took her to a junkyard called Fort Knucklebone, where they built and repaired infernal vehicles designed to move quickly across the blasted wastelands of Avernus. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} doesn't remember who ran the fort or what other creatures she met there.
zh_tw: 瑞文嘉德只記得他看到的一切，但{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在聽到故事的最後時興奮地拍打著翅膀，因為她記得曾遇到了一對叫作{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}的"鳥人"。根據{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和瑞文嘉德提供的描述，角色可以推斷{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}是天狗。 {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記得，天狗們將她帶到一個名為指節骨要塞的垃圾場，在那裡他們建造並維修地獄戰車用於迅速穿越阿弗納斯的枯萎廢土。 {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}不記得是誰經營堡壘或她在那遇到過什麼生物。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} quickly flies to the top of the cathedral and looks out over the blasted landscape of Avernus below Elturel. After trumpeting loudly, she returns to report that she can see Fort Knucklebone, and estimates it to be no more than ten miles away.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}迅速飛到大教堂的頂部，眺望艾爾托瑞爾下方枯萎的阿弗納斯景觀。在高聲鳴叫之後，她返回報告說她可以看見指節骨要塞，而且估計距這裡不超十里。

english: Next Moves
zh_tw: 下一步行動

english: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} insists on remaining in Elturel to help organize survivors to fight off the devils, demons, and undead scouring the city. Though he's willing to die fighting in Elturel's defense, it's up to the characters to help {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} find the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}堅持留在艾爾托瑞爾，以幫助組織倖存者擊退城中四竄的魔鬼、惡魔和亡靈。儘管他做好了為捍衛艾爾托瑞爾的戰鬥而犧牲的準備，但幫助{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}找到{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}一事仍由角色們來肩負。

english: If she's still alive, Reya Mantlemorn decides to stay in Elturel and help Ravengard protect the city, fighting back tears as she bids farewell to the characters.
zh_tw: 如果蕾婭·曼特莫恩還活著，她會決定留在艾爾托瑞爾並幫助瑞文嘉德保護這座城市，並與冒險者們揮淚告別。

english: Leaving Elturel
zh_tw: 離開艾爾托瑞爾

english: Inventive characters have a number of different options to reach the surface of Avernus from Elturel, but none of those options is without risk.
zh_tw: 有創造力的角色可以有很多不同的選擇從艾爾托瑞爾到達阿弗納斯的地表，但是這些選擇都不是沒有風險的。

english: Climbing Down
zh_tw: 爬下

english: The jagged posts and enormous chains of infernal iron that hold Elturel are the only physical connection between the city and the ground. Each chain link is 30 feet long and 20 feet wide, and is formed of a welded loop of infernal iron that is 5 feet thick. See {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|7} for more information on breaking these infernal chains.
zh_tw: 鋸齒狀的樁柱和困住艾爾托瑞爾的巨大地獄鐵鏈是城市與地面之間唯一的物理聯絡。每個鏈節長 30 尺，寬 20 尺，由 5 尺厚的地獄鐵環焊接形成。有關打破這些地獄鐵鏈的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|7}。

english: The chain links are covered in 1-foot-long iron barbs that make them relatively easy to move along. The posts of infernal iron that anchor Elturel to the ground likewise offer numerous handholds for climbing. If the characters navigate the chains and the posts carefully, no ability checks are needed to prevent a fall while climbing across the chains or descending the posts at normal speed. Any character who tries to move or climb more quickly during a turn must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or fall.
zh_tw: 每節鏈子都被 1 尺長的鐵倒鉤覆蓋，使玩家相對容易在上面移動。同樣，將艾爾托瑞爾固定在地面上的地獄鐵樁柱也有許多可攀登之處。如果角色小心地在鏈條和柱子之間移動，則無需進行屬性檢定，就可以防止在攀越鏈條或以正常速度爬下時掉落。任何試圖在回合中更快地移動或攀爬的角色都必須透過{@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定，失敗將會摔落。

english: Fiendish magic within the posts and chains makes prolonged contact with them unbearable. Once per minute, any creature in contact with the infernal iron must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails this saving throw must then succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or slip from the chain or post and fall.
zh_tw: 樁柱和鏈條中的地獄魔法使玩家無法長時間保持接觸。每分鐘一次，任何與地獄鐵接觸的生物都必須進行一次{@dc 10} 體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗則造成10（{@dice 3d6}）暗蝕傷害，成功僅造成一半的傷害。然後，未透過此豁免檢定的生物必須成功透過{@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，失敗會從鏈條或樁柱和鏈條上滑倒然後滑落。

english: Any character within reach of a falling creature can, with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, grab the falling creature and swing it back onto the chain, provided the falling creature is light enough for the character to carry.
zh_tw: 任何可以觸及墜落中生物的角色都可以透過成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定去抓住墜落生物並將其扔回到鏈條上，前提是墜落生物必須足夠輕，而抓人的角色能夠承載。

english: Creatures that fall from Elturel or one of the chains take damage from the fall and land in the Styx (see "{@area River Styx|1a3|x}" for the river's effects). Those that fall off one of the anchoring posts take damage from the fall and land amid clashing devils and demons, where they are brutally killed if they survived the fall.
zh_tw: 從艾爾托瑞爾或其中一條鏈條上墜落的生物會因墜落而受到傷害，並落在冥河中（有關河流的影響，請參閱" {@area 冥河|1a3|x}"）。那些從其中一個樁柱錨點上跌落的人會因墜落而受傷，並掉進魔鬼和惡魔的衝突中，隨後便被殘忍的殺害——如果他們還活著的話。

english: Flying
zh_tw: 飛行

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has the ability to fly, and one or more characters might also be able to do so. Whether they possess wings or have access to magic such as a {@spell fly} spell or a {@item potion of flying}, characters who take to the air can easily get clear of Elturel. However, flying creatures might attract the attention of winged devils and demons in the area, at your discretion.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}具有飛行的能力，一個或多個角色也許也可以做到。無論他們使用翅膀還是使用魔法，例如{@spell fly||飛行術}法術或{@item potion of flying||飛行藥水}，飛上天空的角色都可以輕鬆離開艾爾托瑞爾。但是，根據您的判斷，飛行中的角色可能會吸引該地區的帶翅膀的魔鬼和惡魔注意。

english: Improvised Equipment
zh_tw: 臨時裝置

english: Enterprising and creative players might want their characters to find or create equipment to assist them in their descent. Parachutes, gliders, and hot-air balloons are just a few of the off-the-wall ideas players might come up with. If they do, be prepared to improvise. Raw materials for putting together such equipment can be found in the shops and warehouses of Elturel.
zh_tw: 有進取心和創造力的玩家可能希望他們的角色找到或製造裝備以幫助他們下降到阿弗納斯。降落傘，滑翔機和熱氣球只是其中一些玩家可能想出的方法。如果他們想這樣做，準備即興創作的步驟。用於組裝此類裝置的原材料可在艾爾托瑞爾的商店和倉庫中找到。

english: Once the characters have collected the necessary resources, you can decide which ability checks might come into play as they create their improvised equipment—and to determine how well that equipment works. Use the following guidelines:
zh_tw: 一旦角色收集了必要的資源，您就可以決定在他們製造臨時裝置時需進行哪些能力檢定，並確定該裝置的執行狀況。使用以下準則：

english: A successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check allows a character to figure out the mechanical setup of a piece of equipment.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 10}（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定可以使角色算出裝置需要多少元件。

english: A successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots any flaws in construction.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可以發現構造中的任何缺陷。

english: A successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check and an appropriate tool proficiency can guide the delicate construction or adjustment of a piece of improvised gear.
zh_tw: 成功的{@dc 10} 敏捷檢定並擁有合適的工具熟練，可以指導構建精緻的構造或對機械作調整。

english: Keep in mind any backgrounds or tool proficiencies the characters might have that could be useful in the creation of improvised equipment.
zh_tw: 請記住角色具有的任何背景或工具熟練程度，這對製造臨時裝置很有用。

english: Unless the characters completely botch their ability checks to the point where creating the intended piece of improvised equipment is clearly impossible, you should allow such equipment to work as intended, even if not perfectly. For added drama, allow the characters to get most of the way to safety, then throw in a complication when they are within 50 feet of the ground. Call for more ability checks like the ones above as the characters attempt to quickly spot and fix problems—or call for Dexterity saving throws if their improvised equipment fails and sends them hurtling toward the ground.
zh_tw: 除非角色完全透過不了屬性檢定，以至於顯然無法建立所需的臨時裝置，否則即使這些裝置並非完美無缺，也應允許其如預期的工作。為了增加戲劇性，請讓角色透過大部份的旅程，然後在距離地面 50 尺以內時使事情變得複雜。角色嘗試快速發現並解決問題時像上文一樣要求進行更多的屬性檢定——又或者，他們的裝置失靈將他們高速的扔向地面時，要求進行敏捷豁免檢定。

english: Battle of Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的戰鬥

english: Legions of devils camped on the shores of the River Styx below Elturel are the biggest threats for characters attempting to flee the city. Characters who fly, glide, or balloon over the siege can avoid the main body of the devils' army, but come under attack by forces to the rear. Adjust the boxed text below accordingly as you read it to the players to set the scene:
zh_tw: 在艾爾托瑞爾下方的冥河沿岸住紮的大批魔鬼軍團是企圖逃離這座城市的角色的最大威脅。飛越，滑翔或使用熱汽球的角色可以避開魔鬼軍隊的主體，但會受到從後方部隊而來的攻擊。在設定場景時，相應地調整下面的方框文字並讀出：

english: Armored legions of devils encircle the enormous posts of infernal iron that anchor Elturel to the rocky ground. Squads of demons fighting ten deep in some places hurl themselves into the devils' ranks. Most of those abyssal troops are lowly manes and dretches, who die quickly in vain attempts to drag down devils so that stronger demons behind them can strike killing blows.
zh_tw: 披甲的魔鬼大軍包圍了將艾爾托瑞爾固定在岩石地面上的巨大地獄樁柱。激進的惡魔小隊深陷於魔鬼軍團的陣列中以一敵十。這些深淵部隊中的大多數都是原魔和怯魔，他們在快速被殺死的同時試圖拖住魔鬼，使身後強大的惡魔能夠擊殺敵人。

english: A dark river cuts a path across the blasted landscape and flows directly beneath the city. Floating on the river are demonic barges being assailed by squadrons of winged devils under the command of a terrifying pit fiend wearing an eyeless helm and clutching a battle standard.
zh_tw: 一條黑暗的河流在被摧毀的的土地上開出河道，在城市正下方流動。漂浮在河上的是惡魔的駁船，它們正被一群有翼的魔鬼中隊攻擊，它們被一名握著戰旗的戴著無目孔頭盔的巨大深獄煉魔指揮。

english: The demons and the devils are too focused on one another to concern themselves with adventurers who keep their distance. The devils are commanded by Lucille, Zariel's most loyal {@creature pit fiend}. If the characters come to Lucille's attention, the pit fiend sends twelve {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} to dispose of them.
zh_tw: 惡魔和魔鬼過於專注於彼此，以致於沒有在意與他們保持一定距離的冒險者。魔鬼軍團是由扎瑞爾最忠誠的{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}露西爾指揮的。如果角色引起了露西爾的注意，他會派出十二隻{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}來處置他們。

english: Characters who hurl themselves into the fiendish conflict are as good as dead, but circumstances might necessitate one or more characters moving unseen through the ranks of devils and hordes of demons. Such a plan might include causing a distraction that moves the battle in a different direction, waiting for a demon surge (or creating one) to disturb the stalemate enough to sneak through, or magical disguises that would allow characters to pass themselves off as fiends of a sort. Particularly clever plans should be allowed to automatically succeed. Otherwise, you can call for ability checks to determine how well a plan is executed; use the guidelines in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} to set appropriate DCs for these checks. In the event of total failure, or no plan at all, the characters might end up having to fight their way through the fiendish battle, which is no small task.
zh_tw: 陷入魔鬼和惡魔激烈衝突中的角色和基本上是死定了，但是一些情況可能使一個或多個角色在魔鬼軍團和成群的惡魔中移動而不被發現。這樣的計劃可能包括分散注意力使戰鬥朝著不同的方向繼續，等待惡魔的衝鋒（或製造一次）以致戰場的僵局被打破從而混水摸魚，或者透過魔法偽裝使角色冒充成魔鬼來穿過它們。應該允許特別聰明的計劃自動成功。此外，你可以要求屬性檢定來決定計劃執行得如何；您可以使用《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》中的指引為這些檢定設定適當的DC。萬一徹底失敗或根本沒有計劃，角色們可能最終不得不透過激烈的戰鬥來殺出一條血路，但這絕非易事。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Lucille wears a {@item helm of devil command|BGDIA} and carries a {@item battle standard of infernal power|BGDIA} (see {@adventure appendix C|BGDIA|12} for descriptions of these magic items), neither of which the pit fiend gives up willingly.
zh_tw: 露西爾戴著{@item helm of devil command|BGDIA|魔鬼指揮官頭盔}，擁有{@item battle standard of infernal power|BGDIA|地獄之力戰旗}（關於這些魔法物品的描述，請參見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}），深獄煉魔不會放棄任何一件寶物。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The characters encounter Lucille again at the end of the adventure when they return to liberate Elturel (see "{@adventure Endgame in Elturel|BGDIA|2|Endgame in Elturel}").
zh_tw: 在冒險的結尾之前，玩家們在回程解放艾爾托瑞爾的路上會再次遇上露西爾（請參閱" {@adventure 艾爾托瑞爾的終局|BGDIA|2|Endgame in Elturel} "）。

english: To Fort Knucklebone!
zh_tw: 前往指節骨要塞！

english: Once they escape from Elturel, the characters must begin the ten-mile trek to Fort Knucklebone. If the characters move quickly and carefully, they can make the journey without running into any more trouble. Let them advance to 7th level before beginning {@adventure chapter 3|BGDIA|3}.
zh_tw: 一旦他們從艾爾托瑞爾逃脫，玩家們就必須進行長達十里的旅程，以前往指節骨要塞。如果冒險者迅速而謹慎地移動，他們在旅途上就不會遇到更多麻煩。在{@adventure 第三章|BGDIA|3}開始之前，讓他們升到 7 級。

english: Chapter 3: Avernus
zh_tw: 第3章：阿弗納斯

english: Guided by {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} the hollyphant and discoveries made in Elturel, the characters trek across Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells, to recover the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} and free Elturel from its chains. Navigating the wastelands of Avernus might seem like a difficult proposition, but thankfully the characters have the map given to them by {@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA} in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}. For more information on how to use the Avernus poster map, see "{@area Using the Poster Map|1b0|x}".
zh_tw: 冒險者們在聖飛象{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和在艾爾托瑞爾獲得的新發現的引導下，穿越九層地獄的第一層阿弗納斯，去尋回{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，並將艾爾托瑞爾從鐵索中解放出來。雖然在阿弗納斯的廢土中找到方向是極其困難的，但所幸的是在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中{@creature Sylvira Savikas|BGDIA|西爾維拉·薩維卡斯}給了冒險者們地圖。想要了解更多阿弗納斯海報地圖的資訊可參閱"{@area 使用海報地圖|1b0|x}"。

english: Elturel and Fort Knucklebone aren't marked on the poster map, as Elturel was not present when the map was drawn, and the cartographer who drew the map never encountered Fort Knucklebone. You can situate Elturel anywhere along the River Styx, and Fort Knucklebone anywhere within ten miles of Elturel.
zh_tw: 由於在製作阿弗納斯海報地圖時，艾爾托瑞爾還沒有墜入阿弗納斯，此外繪製了該地圖的製圖師也從來沒有到達或者見過指節骨要塞，所以艾爾托瑞爾和指節骨要塞並沒有標記在地圖上。DM可以選擇在沿冥河任意處為艾爾托瑞爾選址，而指節骨要塞可以坐落在艾爾托瑞爾十里內的任意地點。

english: Running This Chapter
zh_tw: 運作本章

english: This chapter opens with information about Avernus that you need to run the encounters and adventure locations that follow.
zh_tw: 以下是本章中關於阿弗納斯所有的遭遇和冒險的資訊：

english: The story picks up where it left off in {@adventure chapter 2|BGDIA|2}, with the characters embarking on a quest to save Elturel while {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} and Reya Mantlemorn stay behind to organize survivors and defend the city. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} guides the characters to Fort Knucklebone, home to a pair of kenku junk scavengers named {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA}, whom {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} thinks can provide assistance. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, the night hag who runs the fort, oversees the construction and repair of infernal war machines. If the characters agree to make a deal with the night hag, they can acquire one or more of these vehicles. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} can also help {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} unlock some of her forgotten memories.
zh_tw: 故事緊接{@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2}，正當冒險者們離開城市開始尋找拯救艾爾托瑞爾的方法時，{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}和蕾婭·曼特莫恩留守在城裡組織倖存者並守護城市。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會指引冒險者們前往一對天狗拾荒者{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}的家，指節骨要塞，因為{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}覺得他們會為冒險者們提供幫助。掌管指節骨要塞的夜鬼婆{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}負責監管地獄戰爭機器的建造和維修。如果冒險者們同意和夜鬼婆做交易的話，他們能夠獲得一輛或多輛戰爭機器。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}也可以幫助{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}解開她部分被封印記憶。

english: From Fort Knucklebone, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} guides the characters to the place where she thinks the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} is hidden: Haruman's Hill. There, they meet Jander Sunstar, a vampire with some information. They also meet Jander's torturer, Haruman—a fallen Hellrider and one of Zariel's infernal generals. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} eventually realizes she's made a grave mistake and led the characters to the wrong place. She suggests two possible paths going forward: the {@adventure Path of Demons|BGDIA|4} and the {@adventure Path of Devils|BGDIA|5}. Each path features a number of locations across Avernus that the characters must visit in sequence to learn where Zariel's sword is hidden.
zh_tw: 離開指節骨要塞後，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會帶領冒險者們到她認知中{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}所在之地：哈魯曼之丘。冒險者們會在山丘遇到一個掌握了一些情報的吸血鬼詹德·晨星。他們還會遭遇到詹德·晨星的折磨者，哈魯曼——一名墮落地獄騎手與扎瑞爾的地獄將軍。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}終於意識到了她犯了一個巨大的錯誤——帶領冒險者們去了錯誤的地點。她會建議兩條可以繼續前進的路線：{@adventure 惡魔之路|BGDIA|4}和{@adventure 魔鬼之路|BGDIA|5}。無論選擇哪條一條路線，冒險者們都必須以一定的順序造訪一系列阿弗納斯的地點，才能夠瞭解到扎瑞爾之劍的藏寶之地。

english: At any time during their exploration of Avernus, the characters and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} might encounter the Wandering Emporium, a marketplace that wanders Avernus on the backs of giant infernal war machines. The Wandering Emporium provides a good place for the characters to rest and gather supplies that are otherwise hard to find in Avernus.
zh_tw: 在{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和冒險者們探索阿弗納斯時，他們可能會在任意時間點遭遇流浪商城——一個開在巨大地獄戰爭機器上的集市。流浪商城為冒險者們提供了很好的休息場所，並且可以在此處收集到在地獄難以獲得的補給品。

english: At the conclusion of this chapter, the characters learn that the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} is hidden in a place called the Bleeding Citadel. If she's still alive, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} helps them get there. See {@adventure chapter 4|BGDIA|7} for details about the Bleeding Citadel.
zh_tw: 本章總結，冒險者最終會瞭解到{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}被藏在了湧血城砦。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}沒有身亡，她會一路幫助冒險者們抵達那裡。關於湧血城砦的更多資訊，請參閱{@adventure 第四章|BGDIA|7}。

english: What Is Avernus?
zh_tw: 什麼是阿弗納斯？

english: Avernus serves as the front line of the great clash between the evil forces of chaos and law known as the Blood War. Demons from the Abyss use the River Styx to enter Avernus, where they hurl themselves against infernal legions of devils.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯是多元宇宙中混亂與秩序那永不停歇的偉大戰役——血戰中的最前線。自無底深淵的惡魔們透過冥河進入阿弗納斯直面九獄的魔鬼大軍。

english: Avernus was not always the blasted, war-torn battlefield it is today. Long ago, it was a plane of lush gardens and bucolic beauty created by Asmodeus to tempt mortals. The intrusion of the River Styx followed by endless waves of slavering demons destroyed this paradise, leaving layer upon layer of bones, ruins, and shattered war machines. Pieces of cities stolen from other planes, tiny remnants of Avernus's lost beauty, evidence of destroyed celestial armies, and tombs of ancient travelers all dot the Avernian wasteland.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯並非一直是現在這樣戰火紛飛的滿目瘡痍之地。很久以前，阿弗納斯被阿斯摩蒂爾斯所創用來誘惑凡人墮落，有著一片片田園美景和奢華花園。但藉由冥河入侵的無窮流涎的惡魔浪潮摧毀了這個世外桃源，只留下了層層骸骨、廢墟和損毀的戰爭機器。由地獄其他位面中竊取來的城市碎片、阿弗納斯過去美景的些許殘餘、被擊敗的天界軍團的殘骸和無數古代旅行者的墳墓都點綴在阿弗納斯廢土上。

english: Avernus is not a place expressly for the punishment of evil souls; instead, it represents a "next level" for evil souls after the end of their wicked lives as mortals. The Nine Hells allows souls to exist in a concentrated form, where they can work through their spiritual bondage to express their dark desires such as cruelty, covetousness, the need to control, the craving for power, and uncontrolled greed. Hell offers an eternity of fulfillment from the most insignificant desires to the seven deadly sins. Every shred of evil is used in the Nine Hells, and each layer specializes in some way to accommodate and exploit the vices and weaknesses of mortals. The devils of Avernus seek to exploit pride and wrath, promising the aggrieved, enraged, and egotistical the power to fulfill their darkest obsessions. Such fulfillment, however, comes at a price.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯並非是對邪惡靈魂的懲戒之地，相反的，它是那些扭曲的凡人死後，他們邪惡靈魂的"新起點"。九層地獄允許靈魂以一種濃縮的形式存在，在此地他們可以解開靈魂束縛，暢快表達他們的黑暗慾望，例如殘酷，貪婪，控制慾，對權力的無盡渴望和無法抑制的飢渴。從最微不足道的慾望直至七原罪，地獄提供永遠的滿足。每一絲微小的邪惡都被用於九獄，並且每一層都專注於某種方式改造和利用凡人的惡習和弱點。阿弗納斯的魔鬼們更傾向於挖掘傲慢與憤怒，他們向那些處於被侵害、憤怒和自負的凡人承諾去滿足最黑暗的慾望。當然，這種滿足是有代價的。

english: Anyone entering Avernus finds a battlefield unlike anywhere else in existence. Evidence of past carnage, such as the ruins of enormous war machines and fields of bleached bones, stretches across the horizon. Through it all, the River Styx winds its way across the plane as knots of demons and devils skirmish along its fetid banks.
zh_tw: 任何進入阿弗納斯的人都會發現這是與其他任何戰場都不同的戰場。過去的大屠殺的證據，如巨大的戰爭機器的殘骸和鋪滿泛白的骸骨的區域，一直延伸到了地平線的盡頭。沿著冥河蜿蜒而行，流經白骨與廢墟，小規模的魔鬼與惡魔糾纏在一起，在腐臭的河岸上戰鬥。

english: Most devils in Avernus serve Zariel, though other Lords of the Nine send forces here to help repel demonic invaders. Devils who are not part of Zariel's legions serve as emissaries from the other layers or as spies for archdevils seeking signs of weakness that they can exploit to further their dreams of power.
zh_tw: 儘管九層地獄的其他領主會派出他們的軍隊來幫助擊退惡魔的入侵，不過大部分阿弗納斯的魔鬼都侍奉扎瑞爾。那些不屬於扎瑞爾軍團的魔鬼，大都充當其他層面的使者或是魔鬼大公們尋找它們可以利用的虛弱跡象的間諜，藉此來實現自己篡權的夢想。

english: Diagram 3.1: Chapter 3 Flowchart
zh_tw: 圖表3.1：第 3 章流程圖

english: Visitors to Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的訪客

english: Extraplanar travelers come to Avernus from time to time. Such visitors include war profiteers looking to get rich trading weapons and armor, mad wizards who want to test their latest spells, clerics on missions from their gods, treasure hunters searching for lost artifacts, grim-faced merchants who deal in slaves, smugglers of {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, and scholars seeking firsthand knowledge of the machinations of the diabolical realms. Adventurers come here to negotiate with powerful fiends, meddle in the Blood War, and free poor souls trapped in the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 其他層面的旅行者會時不時地造訪阿弗納斯。這樣的訪客包括：那些希望透過交易武器和盔甲發家致富的軍火販子；想測試他們最新咒語的瘋狂法師；執行神授任務的牧師；尋找失落的文物的尋寶者；交易奴隸的冷酷販子；{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的走私者；尋求第一手有關地獄陰謀禁忌知識的學者。冒險者們來這裡與強大的魔鬼們談判、參與到血戰中，並解救被困於九獄的可憐靈魂。。

english: Zariel's War
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的戰爭

english: By bringing Elturel to Avernus and potentially gaining a choke hold on Baldur's Gate, Zariel aims to capture as many evil mortals as she can, turn them into devils, and swell the ranks of her battle-depleted legions. Through {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, Zariel found a way to exploit the gullible nature of mortals by appealing to their need to follow a leader who proclaims spiritual power. Because of Kreeg, the residents of Elturel are bound by the Creed Resolute to fight and die for Zariel in her endless war.
zh_tw: 透過把艾爾托瑞爾拉入地獄，和暗地掌控博德之門，扎瑞爾意圖盡她所能將許多邪惡的凡人變成魔鬼，來擴充她在戰鬥中消耗的魔鬼軍團的人數。藉由{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，扎瑞爾找到了一種利用凡人輕信天性的方法：呼籲他們應當遵循一位宣揚精神力量的領袖。因為克雷格，艾爾托瑞爾的居民受堅毅信條約束，要為扎瑞爾的無盡戰爭戰鬥至死。

english: Zariel's Struggle
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的鬥爭

english: In some ways, Zariel is a jewel in Asmodeus's crown—a former angel, now an archdevil, in his infernal service. Given her origin, Zariel has more than the normal share of devils plotting to overthrow her, the first among them being the pit fiend {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, whom she displaced. By Asmodeus's decree, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} now serves Zariel as an advisor, though the two can barely stand to be in each other's presence.
zh_tw: 某種程度上來說，扎瑞爾都是阿斯蒙蒂斯王冠上的一顆寶珠——一位前天使，現在的魔鬼大公，投身於他的地獄大業。由於扎瑞爾的出身，有遠比正常領主更多魔鬼在密謀推翻她，其中以被她取代的深獄煉魔{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}。現在，在阿斯蒙蒂斯的法令之下，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}以顧問的身份服務於她，儘管這兩人幾乎無法忍受對方的存在。

english: Despite the conflict within the diabolical ranks, Zariel runs a tight ship and instills fear in her legions. Retribution against those who attempt to betray her is swift and terrible.
zh_tw: 雖然在魔鬼階層中有些衝突，扎瑞爾依然高效且緩慢輸入恐懼地把控著她的軍團。對於那些試圖背叛她的魔鬼，報復來的快速而且恐怖。

english: War for Souls
zh_tw: 靈魂戰爭

english: Souls are the most prized commodities in the Nine Hells. The Blood War taxes Zariel's armies, so she must ensure a fresh supply of souls as replacements. To this end, Zariel looks for evildoers in the mortal realms who can deliver more souls to her.
zh_tw: 靈魂是九層地獄最珍貴的商品。扎瑞爾的軍隊要向血戰這個稅吏交稅，因此她必須確保有新鮮的靈魂作為補給。最後，扎瑞爾將目光投向凡間，希冀那些邪惡的凡人可以為她帶來更多的靈魂。

english: Because devils can't simply walk out of Avernus and step onto the Material Plane, they must rely on minions such as cultists and evil wizards, who can contact them and do their bidding in exchange for wealth and power. A select group of devils and mortal followers who seek to cause strife and destabilize harmonious communities serve as Zariel's chief corruptors. By funding evil groups, making and distributing weapons, and causing random acts of violence in the name of some enemy to ignite the spark of war, devils swell the capacity for mortals to commit acts of evil, corrupting souls by the thousands and thus ensuring the legions of devils are full of diabolic soldiers for the Blood War.
zh_tw: 由於魔鬼們無法簡單地離開阿弗納斯來到主物質界，他們必須依靠他們的僕從，例如那些為了換取財富和權力而聯絡並執行他們的吩咐的魔鬼信徒或者邪惡的法師。一群精心挑選的魔鬼和凡人追隨者，透過引發衝突和破壞社群和諧來擔當扎瑞爾的主要腐化者。透過資助邪惡組織、打造並散發武器和以某些敵人的名義來隨機進行暴力行為來點燃戰爭的火花，魔鬼們成倍助長了凡人犯下邪惡罪行的能力，使成千上萬的人腐化，從而確保了魔鬼軍團充滿了投身血戰的地獄士兵。

english: Yoke of Evil
zh_tw: 邪惡枷鎖

english: Under constant pressure from both the Abyss and her infernal peers, Zariel and her high-ranking vassals work to keep her armies constantly in the fight. Zariel's wrath and pride have limits, however, and this offers her an opportunity for redemption. Zariel has, in a twisted way, achieved her dream as an angel—to fight face-to-face against the demon hordes in the Blood War. But the burden is a heavy one, and if given the chance, Zariel could be convinced to set it aside, release Elturel, and return to the light with a completely transformed perspective.
zh_tw: 在同時來自無底深淵和她的地獄同僚不間斷的壓力下，扎瑞爾和她的高階封臣竭力保證她的軍隊能持續戰鬥。然而，扎瑞爾的憤怒和傲慢是有限的，這也給了她贖罪的機會。扎瑞爾以一種扭曲的方式完成了她還是天使的夙願——在血戰中直面惡魔。但這負擔是極為沉重的，也因此如果有機會的話，扎瑞爾是可能被說服，求同存異，釋放艾爾托瑞爾，並以一種被完全改變了的態度重投光明的懷抱。

english: Infernal Order of Battle
zh_tw: 戰爭中的地獄軍團

english: Whereas demons attack in disorganized mobs, relying on shock and overwhelming numbers to carry the day, devils organize into a basic unit called a legion. Each legion contains one thousand devils organized as follows:
zh_tw: 與惡魔們毫無組織地發動攻擊，依靠震懾和壓倒性的數量取勝不同，魔鬼們被組織為一個稱之為軍團的基本單位。每支軍團包含 1000 個魔鬼，組織方式如下：

english: 1 legion = 10 cohorts, commanded by a legate
zh_tw: 1 軍團=10 大隊，由一名軍團特使指揮

english: 1 cohort = 10 lances, commanded by a signifier
zh_tw: 1 大隊=10 班組，由一名掌旗官指揮

english: 1 lance = 10 devils, commanded by an optio
zh_tw: 1 班組=10 魔鬼，由一名副官指揮

english: Ranks of miserable {@creature Lemure||lemures} and {@creature Nupperibo|MTF|nupperibos} compose the base of dreg legions, while {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} and {@creature Merregon|MTF|merregons} make up the bulk of regular legions. Each legion sports a unique name, usually denoting its purpose and numerical designation. Examples include the following:
zh_tw: 悲慘的{@creature Lemure||劣魔}和{@creature Nupperibo|MTF|臃腫魔}的行列構成了渣滓軍團的基礎，而{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}和{@creature Merregon|MTF|軍團魔}組成了常規軍團的主體。每個軍團都有一個特地命名的唯一名字，通常表示其用途和編號。例子包括：

english: 5th Infantry Legion, "Infernal Absolution"
zh_tw: 第五步兵軍團 "地獄赦免"

english: 13th Cavalry Legion, "{@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Fury"
zh_tw: 第十三騎兵軍團 "{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}之怒"

english: 47th Dreg Legion, "Piteous Fodder"
zh_tw: 第四十七渣滓軍團"可憐炮灰"

english: Features of Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的特徵

english: The hellscape of Avernus sits under hideous clouds that obscure the vault of the sky, from which the occasional meteor streaks before crashing into the ground. Ambient light continually swells up from just below the horizon as though lit by nine setting suns, yet no actual celestial bodies fill the sky—no sun, moons, or stars. This constant twilight makes it difficult for the denizens of Avernus to track the passage of time.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯地獄景色藏在昏暗天穹的醜惡雲層之下，偶爾流星劃過，然後轟擊地面。地平線下方不斷漫射環境光源，好像被九個夕陽照亮，但是天空中沒有任何實際的天體——沒有太陽，沒有月亮或星星。不斷的暮色使阿弗納斯居民難以追蹤時間的流逝。

english: The atmosphere reeks of brimstone and burning tar, and hot gusts of wind shriek across the hellscape to scour the land below. Sometimes these winds swirl into immense sandstorms, which can strip flesh from bone and plunge everything into darkness.
zh_tw: 大氣中充滿了硫磺和燃燒的焦油的臭味，陣陣灼熱狂風吹過地獄，呼嘯著沖刷下方的陸地。有時這些風捲起巨大的沙塵暴，甚至可以剝落骨頭上的肉剝落，並使一切陷入黑暗。

english: Biting flies, hellwasps, and blood-sucking stirges patrol the air, hunting for any source of blood to feed on. Swarms of them can grow so large that they blacken the sky and deafen the ears with the sound of their wings. On the ground, wandering bands of nupperibos—blind, bloated castaways of the damned—move in the thousands like living lakes of groaning flesh in their agonizing search for food. Bone fields, quicksand, bubbling tar pits, lakes of lava, canyons of wailing souls, and salt flats made from the tears of the damned all await those who wander the hellscape.
zh_tw: 咬人的蚊蠅、黃泉蜂群和吸血的蚊蝠在空中巡邏，尋找任何血液源頭來飽餐一頓。蟲群的規模可以大到遮天蔽日，翅膀震動時足以震破耳膜。在地面上，成千上萬的臃腫魔——目盲，浮腫，被拋棄的受詛咒者們——在那裡遊蕩，就像呻吟的血肉之湖在忍受著痛苦去尋找食物。骨場、流沙、起泡的焦油坑、熔岩湖、嚎哭靈魂峽谷和因被詛咒者的眼淚而產生的鹽灘，都在等待著在地獄風景中游蕩的人們。

english: River Styx
zh_tw: 冥河

english: The River Styx courses through the Lower Planes, frustrating every attempt to map it or predict its course. Getting lost while sailing the Styx isn't the only danger the river presents. Simply tasting or touching its waters can shatter a creature's intellect and personality, as well as strip away its memories. Certain fiends are immune to the river's effects, but most creatures have no defense against it.
zh_tw: 冥河穿過下層位面，令每次繪製其水道或預測它的路線的嘗試都無疾而終。在冥河上航行時，迷路不是唯一的危險。僅僅是品嚐或觸控河水就會摧毀生物的智力和人格，而且還會剝奪它的記憶。某些邪魔對此免疫，但大多數生物都沒有抵禦冥河的能力。

english: Unless immune to the river's effects, a creature that drinks from the Styx or enters the river is targeted by a {@spell feeblemind} spell (save {@dc 20}). A creature must repeat the saving throw whenever it starts its turn in the river, until it fails the save. A feebleminded creature can drink from the Styx and swim in its waters without suffering any additional deleterious effects.
zh_tw: 除非對河的效果免疫，任何一個飲用了冥河河水的生物如同受到了{@spell feeblemind||弱智術}的效果（豁免{@dc 20}）。處在河水中的生物必須在其回合開始時重複此豁免，直到失敗為止。一個已經具有摧心術效果的生物可以不受影響的飲用河水並裡面游泳，且不會有附加的有害效果。

english: If a creature fails its saving throw and remains under the spell's effect for 30 consecutive days, the effect becomes permanent (no save) and the creature loses all its memories, becoming a near-mindless shell of its former self. At that point, nothing short of a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention can undo the effect.
zh_tw: 如果一個生物豁免失敗，並且連續處在這個效果下 30 天，那麼這個效果將會變為永久性的（無需繼續進行豁免），該生物會失去所有記憶，成為一具行屍走肉。在這種情況下，只有{@spell wish||祈願術}和神祇的幹預才能挽救。

english: Water taken from the River Styx loses its potency after 24 hours, becoming a harmless, foul-tasting liquid. However, {@creature Arcanaloth||arcanaloths}, {@creature Night Hag||night hags}, and other fell creatures might know rituals that can prolong the water's potency, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 從冥河取走的水會在 24 小時內失去使用效果，變成無害的難喝的液體。不過，{@creature Arcanaloth||奧法羅斯魔}、{@creature Night Hag||夜鬼婆}和其他墮落生物也許知道延長水效果持續時間的儀式，這由DM自己決定。

english: Alterations to Magic
zh_tw: 魔法的變化

english: Avernus is the entrance to the Nine Hells, a battlefield drenched in eldritch energy. The magic of the Weave works differently here, manifesting in unusual ways.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯是九層地獄的入口，一個被扭曲能量浸潤的戰場。魔網在這裡以完全不同的方法運作和體現。

english: Cosmetic Spell Modifications
zh_tw: 咒語效果畸變

english: At your discretion, a spell can be modified cosmetically to enhance the corrupting nature of Avernus. Here are some examples:
zh_tw: DM可以自行決定對咒語效果進行表現修改，來增強阿弗納斯的腐化氛圍。以下是些示例：

english: {@spell Bigby's Hand}. The conjured hand is a fiendish claw.
zh_tw: {@spell Bigby's Hand||畢格比之手}：塑成的手是一隻魔爪。

english: {@spell Find Familiar}. The familiar is an {@creature imp}.
zh_tw: {@spell Find Familiar||尋獲魔寵}： 獲得的魔寵是{@creature imp||小魔鬼}

english: {@spell Find Steed}. The steed is a {@creature nightmare}.
zh_tw: {@spell Find Steed||尋獲坐騎}：召喚的坐騎是{@creature nightmare||夢魘}

english: {@spell Find the Path}. An {@creature imp} appears and begrudgingly guides the caster to the desired location while complaining the whole time, disappearing when the destination is reached or the spell ends.
zh_tw: {@spell Find the Path||尋路術}：一個{@creature imp||小魔鬼}出現並不情願地引導施法者到目的地，同時它會在一路上不停地抱怨，直到咒語結束或到達目的地

english: {@spell Fog Cloud}. Moaning faces appear and fade in the yellow fog that smells like sulfur.
zh_tw: {@spell Fog Cloud||雲霧術}：聞起來像硫磺的黃色雲霧，不斷呻吟的霧狀臉龐在其中時隱時現

english: {@spell Hellish Rebuke}. The cackling of imps accompanies the fire unleashed by this spell.
zh_tw: {@spell Hellish Rebuke||煉獄叱喝}：小魔鬼的咯咯笑聲會伴隨著咒語釋放出的火焰

english: {@spell Mage Hand}. The summoned hand is shaped like a claw.
zh_tw: {@spell Mage Hand||法師之手}：被召喚的外形像一隻爪子

english: {@spell Rary's Telepathic Bond}. Characters linked together by the spell can hear vague, infernal whispering in the background, but can't make out what's being said.
zh_tw: {@spell Rary's Telepathic Bond||拉瑞心靈聯結}：被咒語連線的角色可以聽到背景中有模糊不清的地獄低語，但無法真正聽清在說什麼

english: Telepathic Communications
zh_tw: 心靈通訊

english: Archdevils can eavesdrop on communication spells such as {@spell message} and {@spell sending} sent from or within the Nine Hells. Because of this, those engaging in telepathic communication always have the feeling that they are being listened in on or watched by some infernal presence, even if an archdevil isn't eavesdropping on their communication.
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公可以竊聽九層地獄之內通訊咒語，如{@spell message||傳訊術}，{@spell sending||短訊術}之類。因此，即使沒有魔鬼大公竊聽通訊，參與心靈通訊的人也總是感覺自己正在被某種地獄的存在監聽或觀看。

english: Telepathic communications via magic items such as {@item sending stones} or a {@item helm of telepathy} can be overheard by an archdevil as well. Communicating with a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||serpentine owl}, an {@item orb of dragonkind}, or a sentient weapon also runs the risk of being overheard in Avernus. {@item Ring of Mind Shielding||Rings of mind shielding} work the same in Avernus as they do on any other plane and are highly valuable items in the Nine Hells, coveted by all fiends to avoid the prying minds of their masters.
zh_tw: 透過{@item sending stones||短訊石}或者{@item helm of telepathy||心靈感應頭盔}進行通訊也同樣會被魔鬼大公監聽。而藉由{@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl||蛇紋石鴞}、{@item orb of dragonkind||龍珠}或與智慧魔法武器進行的交流也有被竊聽的風險。{@item Ring of Mind Shielding||心靈護盾戒指}則像在其他任何位面一樣可以正常運作，並且在九層地獄中是十分寶貴的，被所有魔鬼垂涎，用以避免被其主人窺探思想。

english: Demon Ichor
zh_tw: 惡魔穢液

english: See the entry on the {@hazard demon ichor|BGDIA|Traps and Hazards} page.
zh_tw: 請參閱{@hazard demon ichor|BGDIA|陷阱和危害}頁面上的條目。

english: Food and Drink
zh_tw: 食物和飲品

english: Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to forage in Avernus are made at disadvantage. Water exists, but it tastes foul and is hard to find. Food can likewise be scrounged, but the flora and fauna taste revolting no matter the manner of preparation. Even rations brought to Avernus taste bitter and ashen.
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯尋找補給進行感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定視作具有劣勢。水源是存在的，但是難喝且難以找到。同理，食物也可以被發現，然而動植物的口味無論如何烹飪都令人反感。即使是帶去阿弗納斯的口糧也會嚐起來苦澀無味。

english: Rests in Avernus
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯休整

english: There are no "days" or "nights" in Avernus, but time should still be tracked in hour increments. Thus, the characters can take long and short rests as they do normally.
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯是沒有"白天"和"黑夜"的概念，但是時間還是會以小時為單位流逝。因此，角色們需要和往常一樣進行長休和短休。

english: Optional Rules
zh_tw: 外層位面選用規則

english: Here are some optional rules that you can use to reinforce the flavor of adventuring in Avernus.
zh_tw: 這裡有些可選規則用來增強在阿弗納斯冒險的氛圍。

english: Commerce
zh_tw: 商業

english: When it comes to the souls of mortals, the Nine Hells is always open for business. In Avernus, the business is war, making sure the front lines of the Blood War are continuously replenished with fresh troops, weapons, armor, and war machines. The main drivers behind this infernal commerce are treasure and {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: 當涉及到人類的靈魂時，九獄永遠在營業狀態。在阿弗納斯，生意就是戰爭，以確保血戰前線不斷有生力軍，武器，裝甲，和戰爭機器補充。這種地獄商業背後的主要驅動力是財富和{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Treasure is only valuable to devils because of its efficacy in tempting and twisting mortals (humans in particular) toward lives of corruption, ultimately leading them to forfeit their souls. Because gold has been used for millennia in the Nine Hells, adventurers can find gold coins from civilizations long lost to history.
zh_tw: 財富之所以對魔鬼有價值，是因為它能引誘和誘騙凡物(尤其是人類)走向墮落的生活，最終導致他們喪失自己的靈魂。因為在九獄裡，黃金已經被使用了幾千年，所以冒險者們可以找到很久以前就消失在歷史文明之中的金幣。

english: Silver is harmful to devils. Nevertheless, devils trade silver to those wishing to eliminate rivals in their path.
zh_tw: 銀對魔鬼有害。儘管如此，魔鬼們還是把銀售賣給那些想要消滅擋了自己路的競爭對手的人。

english: Bargain-Basement Death Saves
zh_tw: 特價起死回生

english: Whenever a character fails a death save in the Nine Hells, an archdevil may contact that character telepathically and offer its assistance. The character must agree to perform a task for the archdevil afterward. The nature of the task is not revealed until the character agrees to these terms.
zh_tw: 每當一名角色在九層地獄中未能透過死亡豁免，一位魔鬼大公可能會透過心靈感應聯絡這名角色並提供幫助。該角色必須先同意之後為魔鬼大公執行一項任務作為回報。直到角色同意協議後，魔鬼大公才會透露任務的細節。

english: A character who agrees to the archdevil's terms automatically rolls a 20 on their next death save. At the same time, the character falls under the effect of a {@spell geas} spell (no saving throw allowed). If this spell ends prematurely, the character immediately drops to 0 hit points and is dying. The task that the character must complete is usually simple and straightforward, and always for the benefit of the archdevil who struck the deal. Sample tasks include delivering a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} to one of the archdevil's minions, refusing to help someone the character is fated to meet in the future, or destroying something the archdevil abhors (such as a holy symbol).
zh_tw: 同意魔鬼大公協議的角色在他們的下一次死亡豁免中自動骰出 20，同時角色受到{@spell geas||指使術}的影響（不可進行豁免檢定）。如果這個法術提前結束，這個角色的生命值會立即下降到 0 並且死亡。角色必須完成的任務一般是簡單而直接的，並且總是有利於達成契約的魔鬼大公。簡單的任務如跑腿送一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}去魔鬼大公的盟友那裡，拒絕幫助一個該角色未來命中註定會遇到的某人，或者是破壞魔鬼大公憎惡的物品（比如聖徽）。

english: Exhaustion
zh_tw: 力竭

english: Avernus's combination of oppressive heat and supernatural malevolence weighs on the bodies and souls of those who are not evil. A non-evil creature treats normal travel through Avernus as a forced march and must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each hour of travel. The DC is 10 + 1 for each hour of travel. On a failed saving throw, a creature suffers one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 在阿弗納斯，難以忍受的酷熱和超自然的惡意相結合，壓迫著那些非邪惡生物的肉體和靈魂。一個非邪惡陣營生物在穿越阿弗納斯時，如同強行軍一般在每小時旅行結束時需要進行體質豁免。豁免DC為10 + 旅行小時數。一旦豁免失敗，這個生物獲得一個{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。

english: Pervasive Evil
zh_tw: 邪惡四溢

english: Evil pervades the Nine Hells, and visitors to this plane feel its influence. At the end of each long rest taken on this plane, a visitor that isn't evil must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's alignment changes to lawful evil. The change becomes permanent if the creature doesn't leave the plane within {@dice 1d4} days. Otherwise, the creature's alignment reverts to normal after one day spent on a plane other than the Nine Hells. Casting the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell on the creature also restores its original alignment.
zh_tw: 邪惡瀰漫著整個九獄，到達這個位面的旅者會清晰的感受到它的影響。每次在這個位面上進行過長休後，一個非邪惡陣營的旅者必須進行一次{@dc 10}的感知豁免。一旦失敗，這個生物的陣營立刻變為守序邪惡。若這個生物沒有在{@dice 1d4}天內離開這個位面，這種變化將會變成永久性的。另一方面，只要該生物在九獄之外的位面中度過一天，這個生物的陣營就會迴歸正常。對該生物施展{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}也可以將其恢復為原來的陣營。

english: Map 3.1: Avernus
zh_tw: 地圖3.1：阿弗納斯

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Using the Poster Map
zh_tw: 使用海報地圖

english: The poster map depicts a region of Avernus, a wasteland of dizzying proportions that has been warped by eons of demonic invasion. Travelers face a hellscape that disorients the senses and defies attempts to map it accurately.
zh_tw: 海報地圖描繪了阿弗納斯的各個區域，一片規模令人頭暈的廢土。旅行者們面對的是混淆感官和無法準確繪製的地獄景象。

english: Standard cartographic methods are useless, since distances in Avernus are impossible to gauge and locations sometimes shift supernaturally. As such, the map shows pictorial impressions of locations that only hint at their distances from one another. It is by no means something that can, or should, be taken literally.
zh_tw: 標準的製圖方法是沒有用的，因為阿弗納斯中的距離無法測量而地標有時也會超自然的移動。因此，這幅地圖展示的對各地點的圖片印象僅代表它們彼此間的距離。絕不能或不應該從字面上理解該地圖。

english: No scale is marked on the map, and the placement of locations is based on the memories of an intrepid yet insane cartographer. Distances and travel times between locations cannot be determined by studying the map and can change with each journey, at your discretion. Your players should never feel like they understand Avernus geographically, providing an unsettled and disorienting feeling as they roam the hellscape.
zh_tw: 地圖上沒有標記比例尺，地點的定位是基於一名勇敢但發了瘋的製圖師的記憶。地點之間的路程和旅行時間無法透過研究地圖來確定，並且可以隨你心意而在每次旅途中都有所改變。你的玩家應該永遠不會認為自己在地理上了解了阿弗納斯，在他們漫遊地獄時提供一種不確定和迷失感。

english: The poster map is riddled with strange imagery and unique iconography. These are the cartographer's artistic impressions of Avernus, and their meanings, for the most part, remain a mystery. While exploring Avernus, the characters discover a peculiar property of the map: it talks! Whenever they arrive at one of the locations described in this chapter, the voice of the cartographer emanates from the map to reveal a clue. The map speaks only to utter its clues, so the characters can't query it or engage it in conversation. The cartographer's mad ramblings precede the description of each adventure location marked on the map. If queried about a location not drawn on the map, the cartographer mumbles incoherently, screams madly, or whimpers in despair.
zh_tw: 海報地圖上充斥著奇怪的意象和獨特的圖解。 這些是製圖師對阿弗納斯的印象的藝術表達，但其大部分含義仍然成謎。探索阿弗納斯時，角色會發現地圖的一項詭異特性：它會說話！ 每當他們到達本章中描述的位置之一時，製圖師的聲音就會從地圖上發出，解說概況。 地圖的言語只是為了說出概況，因此角色無法詢問或讓其參與對話。製圖師的瘋言瘋語會在描述地圖所示的地點之前發出。 如果詢問未在地圖上繪製的位置，則製圖師會紊亂地喃喃自語，發瘋地尖叫或在絕望中嗚咽。

english: Mapping Avernus
zh_tw: 繪製阿弗納斯地圖

english: Celestials and demon lords alike wish for a working map of Avernus, but attempts to map the layer have consistently met with failure.
zh_tw: 天界生物和惡魔領主們都想要一張能正常運作的阿弗納斯地圖，但繪製這一層地圖的嘗試總以失敗告終。

english: If a character attempts to map Avernus, madness begins to set in. After each mapping session, the character must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the character contracts a random form of madness determined by rolling on the {@table short-term madness||Short-Term Madness table} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the character fails this saving throw a second time, roll on the {@table Long-Term Madness} table instead. If the character fails a third time, roll on the {@table Indefinite Madness} table.
zh_tw: 如果一名角色試圖繪製阿弗納斯，瘋狂就會開始出現。每個繪圖過程後，角色必須進行一次{@dc 15}的感知豁免。如果該角色豁免失敗，在《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第 8 章的"{@table short-term madness||短暫性瘋狂}"上進行投擲，從而獲得一種隨機的瘋狂狀態。如果角色第二次豁免失敗，投擲{@table Long-Term Madness||長期性瘋狂}。如果角色第三次失敗，投擲{@table Indefinite Madness||永久性瘋狂}。

english: Charting a Course
zh_tw: 規劃路線

english: Using the map to chart a course from one location to another is unreliable at best. It helps if the characters have visited a destination before, but even that is no guarantee they'll end up where they intended.
zh_tw: 使用地圖制定從一個地點到另一個地點的路線只能說是不靠譜的。如果角色曾經去過目的地，這將有所幫助，但是即便如此也不能保證他們會到達最終想去的地方。

english: When charting a course through Avernus, ask the player whose character is overseeing navigation to roll two dice:
zh_tw: 當制定一條穿越阿弗納斯的路線時。 請讓負責導航的角色的玩家擲兩個骰子：

english: Roll {@dice 2d4} if the characters are traveling to an unvisited destination marked on their map.
zh_tw: 如果角色正前往其地圖上標記的沒訪問過的目的地，擲{@dice 2d4}。

english: Roll {@dice 2d8} if the characters are returning to a destination they've visited previously.
zh_tw: 如果角色返回到他們先前訪問過的目的地，擲{@dice 2d8}。

english: Roll {@dice 2d10} if a native guide is leading the characters to their destination.
zh_tw: 如果一名原住民嚮導正將角色引導到目的地，擲{@dice 2d10}。

english: If the rolls of both dice don't match, the characters arrive at their destination as intended. If the dice match, they wind up somewhere else: pick one of the other locations.
zh_tw: 如果兩個骰子的結果不相同，則角色將按預期到達目的地。如果相同，他們將會被誤導向其他地方：由DM選擇任意位置。

english: Fort Knucklebone
zh_tw: 指節骨要塞

english: After leaving Elturel, the adventurers head to Fort Knucklebone, a junkyard stronghold on the edge of a desolate expanse of Avernus ravaged by rival gangs of scavengers. Fort Knucklebone doesn't appear on the poster map of Avernus, as the map's cartographer never found or visited this location.
zh_tw: 離開艾爾托瑞爾之後，冒險者們前往指節骨要塞，這是一個在阿弗納斯邊緣被劫掠為生的拾荒者們佔據的垃圾場要塞。指節骨要塞沒有出現在阿弗納斯的海報地圖上，因為地圖的製圖師從未發現或訪問過這裡。

english: Fort Knucklebone provides shelter to a gang of wasteland marauders called the Knucklebones, serving as a garage where they build and repair infernal war machines. The Knucklebones answer to {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, a night hag warlord who has an agreement with Zariel: the archduke of Avernus leaves Fort Knucklebone alone as long as {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} keeps the other warlords in the area in check.
zh_tw: 指節骨要塞為一群荒原掠奪者提供了庇護所，這些劫掠者被稱為指節骨，作為車庫用來建造和維修地獄戰爭機器。指節骨們聽令於{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}，一位和扎瑞爾達成協議的夜鬼婆軍閥：只要{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}保證其他領主被限制在這個區域，阿弗納斯大公將不會干涉指節骨要塞。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} believes that the kenku from the visions reside in the fort and may be able to help, which is partially true. They can bring {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the characters to {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, who can in turn provide them with assistance.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}認為，幻想中見到的住在要塞裡的天狗，也許能夠提供幫助，這在一定程度上是正確的。他們可以將{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和冒險者們帶到{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}面前，轉而為他們提供幫助。

english: Areas of Fort Knucklebone
zh_tw: 指節骨要塞區域

english: The main feature of the fort is the hand-shaped hill, between the fingers of which are caves where {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} oversees repairs to several infernal war machines (see {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} for infernal war machine rules and stat blocks). Around this hill is a ring of debris that serves as a crude rampart. This barrier is 15 feet thick, and its height averages 20 feet.
zh_tw: 堡壘的主要特點是手形的山丘，洞穴遍佈在其手指之間，在那裡，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}負責維修幾個地獄戰爭機器(地獄戰爭機器規則和資料見{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11})。這座小山的周圍是一圈殘垣斷壁，充當著簡陋的防禦工事。這道屏障厚 15 尺，平均高度 20 尺。

english: Built into the rampart is a ramshackle gatehouse (see "{@area Entering the Fort|1b8|x}"). One of the redcaps that guards the gatehouse stands next to an iron gong that can be struck to warn of impending attack. A 15-foot high, 20-foot-wide, entryway passes through the gatehouse. A wall of junk on rollers can be pushed in front of the entryway to seal it in case of attack.
zh_tw: 城牆內建有一座搖搖欲墜的門樓(見"{@area 進入要塞|1b8|x}")。守衛警衛室的紅帽子中有一個站在一個鐵鑼旁邊，可以敲擊這個鐵鑼來警告即將到來的襲擊。一條 15 尺高、20 尺寬的入口通道穿過門樓。一旦發生攻擊，可將滾軸上的垃圾牆推到入口通道前面將其封閉。

english: Within the rampart, surrounding the hill, are hovels made of junk and scrap metal. These quarters are mostly empty except for a few cots, since only the kenku require food, drink, and sleep. They are used when members of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s gang need privacy. Amid the hovels are the plundered wrecks of several infernal war machines that have been picked clean for parts.
zh_tw: 在城牆內，山的周圍，是由垃圾和廢金屬製成的棚屋。由於只有天狗需要食物、飲料和睡眠，除了幾張帆布床外，這些宿舍大部分是空的。當{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的幫派成員需要保護隱私時會使用它們。在這些簡陋的小屋中間，有幾架被洗劫一空的地獄戰爭機器的殘骸，它們的零件已經被拆光了。

english: Arrival at the Fort
zh_tw: 抵達要塞

english: When the characters get within sight of Fort Knucklebone, describe the location as follows:
zh_tw: 當玩家可以看到指節骨要塞時，請按以下方式描述該地點：

english: A fortified compound sits atop a low plateau that rises out of a crater-pocked landscape. At the center of the compound is a hill of rust-colored stone that resembles a hand clawing out of the ground, with gaps between the fingers. A jagged wall made of rock, bones, and metal debris surrounds this hand-shaped hill. Other highlights visible from this distance include a gatehouse, atop which stands a half-dozen small figures on watch.
zh_tw: 一座設防的要塞坐落於一個從佈滿彈坑的大地之中隆起的低矮高原之上。要塞中央是一座由鏽色石塊構成的小山丘，它就像一隻手指間有縫隙的手挖出地面。由岩石，骨頭和金屬碎片製成的鋸齒狀牆壁環繞著這座手形的山丘。從這個距離可以看到的其他顯著部分，包括門樓和其頂部的六個在站崗的小人影。

english: When the characters are ready to approach the fortress, see "{@area Entering the Fort|1b8|x}" below. First, however, review the following summary of how to run this scene to maximum effect.
zh_tw: 當角色準備接近堡壘時，請參見下面的"{@area 進入要塞|1b8|x}"。 但是，首先，請檢視以下有關如何執行本場場景的摘要以達到最佳效果。

english: Running the Fort
zh_tw: 執行要塞

english: In this part of the adventure, the characters must carefully tread the social milieu of a night hag and her cadre of crazed followers.
zh_tw: 在冒險的這一部分中，角色們必須小心翼翼的在夜鬼婆和她部下中的瘋狂追隨者的社交環境中游走。

english: This scene resolves around a factor essential in any negotiation: leverage. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} possesses several things the characters could use, including infernal war machines, provisions, temporary shelter, and information. The characters have something {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} desires greatly: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories.
zh_tw: 解決這個場景所需的必須因素和所有的談判一樣：相互利用。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}擁有角色可以使用的幾樣東西，包括：地獄戰爭機器、補給、臨時避難所和資訊。而角色們有{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}所渴望的東西：{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶。

english: One way to run a complex social encounter like this one is to imagine a scale from 1 to 10, with 1 representing the worst possible outcome and 10 the best. The characters start at 5, and as they progress through the scene, they may move up or down the scale. Positive and helpful interactions move them up the scale, and antagonistic or unfriendly exchanges lose them points, as you determine. Where they end determines the consequences of the encounter. For example, if the characters end at a 10 on the scale, they get everything they want from {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}: one or more vehicles to expedite travel across Avernus, all the information they need, monetary or magical gifts, and provisions. If they end at a 1 on the scale, they anger {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} and get nothing. They might even have to fight their way out of Fort Knucklebone. As long as the characters still have a path forward, a spectacular failure can be just as memorable as success.
zh_tw: 進行這樣的複雜的社交型遭遇的一種方法是，去設想一個從 1 到 10 的等級，其中1代表最壞的結果，而 10 代表最好的。角色從 5 開始，隨著他們在場景中的進展，這個數值可能會上下移動。 積極而有益的互動將提高數值，而敵對或不友好的交流則會損失數值，取決於你。他們最終的數值決定了遭遇的後果，比方說，如果角色結束時的數值是 10，他們將從{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}那獲得所需的一切：一輛或更多載具以加速穿越阿弗納斯，他們需要的所有資訊，金錢或魔法物品以及補給品。如果他們以 1 分結束，他們會激怒{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}，並一無所獲。他們甚至可能不得不進行戰鬥才能開出一條離開指節骨要塞的路。只要角色還可以繼續開闢前進道路，一次壯觀的失敗也可以和成功一般令人難忘。

english: The following sections detail the important NPCs and creatures within Fort Knucklebone. Included in these descriptions are the personalities and goals of the NPCs, as well as what they have to offer the characters. These descriptions also allow you, as the DM, to determine how the characters can gain leverage in the negotiations and get what they want or need.
zh_tw: 以下各節詳細介紹了指節骨要塞內的重要NPC和生物。 這些描述中包括NPC的個性和目標，以及它們能為角色們所提供的東西。這些描述也使您作為DM可以確定角色如何在談判中取得優勢並獲得他們想要或需要的東西。

english: Use the 1-to-10 scale as a barometer for rating the overall success of the characters in dealing with the strange, intriguing, and dangerous world of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} and the Knucklebones. Let the characters' decisions, insights, knowledge, roleplaying, successes, and failures move the slider up or down the scale as you see fit.
zh_tw: 使用 1 到 10 的等級作為晴雨表以評估角色在應對{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}和指節骨幫眾們那奇怪，有趣而又危險的場景中綜合成功程度。 讓角色的決定、見解、知識、角色扮演、成功與失敗按照您的意願將數值的滑塊向上或向下移動。

english: Entering the Fort
zh_tw: 進入要塞

english: The gatehouse serves as the entrance to Fort Knucklebone. Six {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps} stand guard atop it. One redcap yells down at the characters as they approach, asking for the password. After a few moments, a different redcap says, "We don't have a password!" All the redcaps fall over in peals of mirth.
zh_tw: 門樓是指節骨要塞的入口。 六個{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}站在其上方。 當角色們接近時，一個紅帽子朝他們吼叫，要求說出口令。 片刻之後，另一個不同的紅帽子說："我們沒有口令！" 所有的紅帽子都笑得前仰後合。

english: The redcaps on guard duty give the characters a difficult time, asking them to do ridiculous things to gain entrance. After a few minutes, when the characters get fed up with the nonsense, the redcaps tell them to quit standing around like idiots and come inside.
zh_tw: 門樓值班的紅帽子會刁難角色們一會兒，要求他們做一些荒唐的事情才能進入。 幾分鐘後，當角色們厭倦了胡說八道時，紅帽子會告訴他們不要像白痴一樣站著，並準許他們進入堡壘。

english: Seeing the Kenku
zh_tw: 與天狗見面

english: When the characters enter, they see the following scene within the fortress:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入要塞時，他們會在要塞中看到以下場景：

english: The area enclosed by the rampart is littered with trash and mechanical parts, some put together in a way that resembles a vehicle. Ramshackle structures, built from the same junk as the outer wall, provide shelter.
zh_tw: 城牆包圍的區域遍地垃圾和機械零件，其中一些用某種方法組合在一起拼出載具的樣子。 用與外牆相同的垃圾建造的搖搖欲墜的建築物提供了庇護所。

english: A platoon of small fey creatures mills about, all looking like feral gnomes. Several them sport tall red caps, some of which drip with vile ichor.
zh_tw: 一群小型妖精生物在四處轉悠，看起來像野生的侏儒。 他們中有幾個戴著高大的紅色帽子，一些帽子會滴下汙穢的膿液。

english: A pair of kenku examine one of the strange vehicles, chattering to each other in high-pitched squawks. These kenku carry an assortment of strange tools. When they see you, they turn and stare in wonder.
zh_tw: 一對天狗檢查著其中一輛奇怪的載具，並用尖銳的叫聲中互相交談。 這些天狗帶著各類奇怪工具。 當他們看到你們時，他們轉過身用驚訝的眼光凝視著你們。

english: The kenku {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} instantly recognize {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, since they've met her previously. Before the characters can act, {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} squawks at them:
zh_tw: 天狗{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}立即認出了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，因為他們以前見過她。在角色們可以行動之前，{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}向他們大叫：

english: One of the kenku waves in your direction as if telling you to remain where you are. "What a deal! Patience is a virtue! Can't keep the boss waiting!" He runs off into one of the trash structures.
zh_tw: 天狗之一朝著你們的方向手，好像在告訴你們要留在原地。"大生意上門！耐心就是美德！不能讓老大等著！"他急匆匆跑進一座由各種垃圾組成的建築。

english: Moments later he returns, leading a tall creature wearing a long, tattered shift covered in mud, blood, mold, and worse. The hag's eyes seem to move independently of each other as she approaches, her straggly brown hair hanging in front of them. Resting on each shoulder are red-eyed ravens that scrutinize your group. Behind her, a hulking creature built of disparate fiendish parts trudges, moaning and hopping as it walks.
zh_tw: 過了一會兒，他回來了，他帶領著一個穿著覆蓋著泥巴，鮮血和黴菌以及其他更糟糕的事物的破爛長連衣裙的高大生物。當鬼婆走近時，她的兩隻眼睛好像互相獨立地轉動著，她那散亂的棕色頭髮垂在雙眼前方。停在她肩膀上的是幾隻紅眼睛烏鴉，仔細檢查著你們的團隊。 在她的身後，一個由完全不同的邪魔身體部位構成的龐大生物，緩慢，沉重並悲鳴著走來。

english: Then both of the hag's eyes focus keenly on your group, and on {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} specifically. "My goodness!" the hag croaks, spittle dribbling from her mouth. "Where did you find such a treasure?"
zh_tw: 鬼婆的兩隻眼睛終於同時銳利地聚焦在你們身上，尤其是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，"我的天啊！"鬼婆聲音沙啞，吐沫橫飛的說"你們在哪裡找到的這個寶貝？"

english: The characters can explain their predicament, and {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} can offer to unlock {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories, joyfully telling the characters about {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s possible relationship to Zariel. Before she does that, however, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} tells the characters she needs to gather supplies for the ritual of memory unlocking. This gives the characters a chance to interact with the other members of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s gang and maybe earn some good will with them as mentioned under their individual descriptions below.
zh_tw: 角色們可以向鬼婆解釋他們的困境，而{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}可以解開{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}被封印的記憶，並樂於歡快地告訴角色們{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與扎瑞爾可能的關係。但是在她這麼做之前，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}會告訴角色們她需要收集解封記憶的儀式所需的物資。這給了角色慢去與{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}幫派中其他成員打交道的機會，並可能贏得一些好感，具體在後文各成員的個人描述部分提及。

english: Mad Maggie
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲

english: While Zariel's attention is focused on the Blood War, power-hungry warlords of the Avernian wastes cobble together heavily armed gangs and lead packs of infernal war machines in brutal combat, carving out vicious fiefdoms for themselves. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is one such warlord.
zh_tw: 在扎瑞爾的注意力集中於血戰上時，阿弗納斯廢土上渴望權利的軍閥們拼湊出全副武裝的幫派，帶領著地獄戰爭機器車隊開進野蠻的爭鬥中，狠毒地開拓出他們自己的封地。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}就是這樣的一位軍閥。

english: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is a {@creature night hag} with the demeanor of a kindly grandmother, but her warm smile masks a cruel cunning. In addition to her {@i heartstone}, the hag carries a black {@i soul bag} (see the "Night Hag" entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for more information on this magic items. The bag contains nine {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, which {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} uses to power her infernal war machines.
zh_tw: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}是一個{@creature night hag||夜鬼婆}，她的言行舉止就像慈祥的老奶奶，但她溫暖的笑容掩蓋了她的殘忍和狡猾。除開她的{@i 心石}之外，她還攜帶著一個黑色的{@i 靈魂袋}（有關此魔法物品的更多資訊，請參閱《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中的"夜鬼婆"條目）。這個袋子裡有九枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，用來驅動{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的戰爭機器。

english: Years ago, a thirst to experience the ultimate misery brought the night hag to the first layer of the Nine Hells. Followed to Avernus by scores of bloodthirsty redcaps, Maggie found pieces of a beautiful tapestry that chronicled the fall of Zariel. It recounted the angel's descent into Avernus, her betrayal at the hands of the Hellriders, and her submission to Asmodeus, which led to her becoming an archdevil worthy to rule Avernus. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is obsessed with Zariel's cataclysmic saga and scours the wastelands of Avernus for more such relics. In the crucible of the Avernian wastelands, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has risen to become a respected warlord.
zh_tw: 多年前，一種想要體驗究極痛苦的渴望驅使著這個夜鬼婆來到了九層地獄的第一層。大量嗜血的紅帽子跟著她一同來到了阿弗納斯，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}找到了一塊記錄了扎瑞爾墮落的美麗掛毯。它記載了天使落入阿弗納斯，被地獄騎手轉手背叛，而後她屈服於阿斯蒙蒂斯，使自己成為一名足以統治阿弗納斯的魔鬼大公。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}痴迷於扎瑞爾那落差巨大的史詩，並在阿弗納斯的廢土上搜尋更多相關的遺物。同時在阿弗納斯廢土的嚴酷環境中，她崛起併成為了一名受人尊敬的軍閥。

english: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} and Mickey
zh_tw: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}和米奇

english: Maggie's Goals
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲的目標

english: Driven by her lust for misery and her delight in the corruption of the valiant, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} seeks to collect more artifacts tied to Zariel's fall from grace. When she becomes aware of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s relationship to Zariel, the night hag tries to dig up {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s lost memories, believing they might hold the most exquisite emotional records of Zariel's descent. As the characters assist Maggie in this endeavor, they gain favor with—and leverage over—the hag.
zh_tw: 在對痛苦的渴望和對勇者墮落的愉悅的驅使下，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}試圖收集更多與扎瑞爾墮落相關的遺物。當她意識到{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與扎瑞爾的關係時，這個夜鬼婆試圖挖掘{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}失去的記憶，認為這些記憶可能含有對扎瑞爾的墮落最精細的情感記錄。若角色們協助瘋喜鵲的這一努力，他們就會獲得鬼婆的青睞和影響力。

english: Maggie's Offers
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲的籌碼

english: Maggie has the means to unlock the memories {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} struggles to remember. Once the memories are retrieved, the characters learn the destination of the next step of their journey.
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲擁有解鎖{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}努力想要回憶起來的記憶的手段。 一旦記憶恢復，角色們便將瞭解到旅程下一站的目的地。

english: Maggie also can furnish the characters with one or more infernal war machines, which would make their trip across the wastelands more manageable. Additionally, if the characters have no means of creating provisions, Maggie can supply them with food and water as well. Maggie could also offer information about the dangers the characters might face in the wasteland, including other gangs, if the characters gain enough leverage and delight Maggie with their offerings.
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲還可以為角色們提供一或多臺地獄戰爭機器，這將使他們穿越荒原的旅程更輕鬆。此外，如果角色無法創造口糧，瘋喜鵲也可以為其提供食物和水。如果角色獲得足夠的影響力並使瘋喜鵲感到高興，瘋喜鵲還可以提供有關角色們在荒原中可能面臨的危險的資訊，包括其他幫派。

english: The Knucklebones Gang
zh_tw: 指節骨幫

english: Maggie's band consists of {@creature Chukka|BGDIA}, {@creature Clonk|BGDIA}, a fiendish flesh golem named Mickey, a pair of conniving imps, a flameskull, and a host of murderous fey creatures.
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲的團夥包括有{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}、{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}、一具叫做米奇的邪魔肉身魔像，兩隻奸詐的小魔鬼，一個燃焰之顱以及一幫兇殘的精類生物。

english: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡} 和 {@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}

english: Chukka and Clonk
zh_tw: 楚卡和克朗克

english: These two {@creature kenku} are loyal, longtime associates of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s. She refers to them as the Magpies. {@creature Clonk|BGDIA}, the bigger of the two kenku, is the strong, silent type who sometimes drives {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s infernal war machine. {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} is animated, irritable, and takes care of repairs around the fort.
zh_tw: 這兩個{@creature kenku||天狗}是{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的忠實老夥伴。她稱他們為喜鵲們。{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}是兩個天狗中體型較大的那一個，它是強壯且沉默的型別，有時會駕駛{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的地獄戰爭機器。而{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}則更具活力且暴躁易怒，它負責堡壘的維修工作。

english: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} lost their weapons and replaced them with the following weapons salvaged from infernal battlefields:
zh_tw: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}丟失了他們的武器，並使用從地獄戰場上獲得的下列武器作為替代：

english: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} wields a {@item silvered pike|PHB} ({@hit 2} to hit) that has a reach of 10 feet and deals 5 ({@dice 1d10}) piercing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡} 揮舞著一把{@item silvered pike|PHB|鍍銀長矛}（{@hit 2} 命中），其觸及範圍為10尺，命中時造成5（{@dice 1d10}）穿刺傷害。

english: {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} wields a {@i hellfire warhammer} ({@hit 2} to hit) that deals 4 ({@dice 1d8}) bludgeoning damage on a hit, or 5 ({@dice 1d10}) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands. For more information on {@i hellfire weapons}, see "{@item Hellfire Weapon|BGDIA}".
zh_tw: {@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}使用{@i 地獄火戰錘}（{@hit 2} 命中），命中時造成 4（{@dice 1d8}）點鈍擊傷害，或雙手持用時造成 5（{@dice 1d10}）點鈍擊傷害。有關{@i 地獄火武器}的更多資訊，請參閱"{@item Hellfire Weapon|BGDIA|地獄火武器}"。

english: Chukka and Clonk's Goal
zh_tw: 楚卡和克朗克的目標

english: The kenku live to build, fix, and drive infernal machines. At some point during their visit, the characters see the kenku angrily hammering on a nonfunctional {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}. It isn't working, and they can't figure out why. They would be very grateful to anyone who could help them discern the problem.
zh_tw: 天狗們以構造，修復和驅動地獄戰車為生。在拜訪期間的某個時刻，角色們會看到天狗們在憤怒地錘擊一臺壞了的{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}。它現在停止執行了，但他們不知道為什麼。他們將非常感謝任何能夠幫助他們發現問題的人。

english: Helping the Kenku
zh_tw: 幫助天狗

english: One of the parts in the {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}—a spiky gear—is disrupting the flow of infernal energy through the vehicle. The gear, comprised of spikes from a hezrou demon, surges with demonic energy to cause the malfunction. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Investigation}) by a character who spends at least 10 minutes examining the vehicle reveals which part is to blame.
zh_tw: {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}的一個部件——一枚尖刺齒輪——正在幹擾地獄能量在車輛中的流動。該齒輪由一隻狂蟾魔的尖刺構成，其惡魔能量激增導致了這次故障。任何花費至少 10 分鐘檢查車輛的角色，若成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，即可找出故障部件。

english: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} appreciate the help in identifying the problem. Characters can further assist by finding a way to remove the demonic essence from the gear. Spells such as {@spell dispel magic} or {@spell protection from evil and good}, or other methods that the characters might imagine, could make the part usable. If the characters help the pair get the infernal machine running, the kenku express their pleasure to {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, who becomes even more likely to help the characters in their quest.
zh_tw: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}會感謝冒險者在發現問題上提供的幫助。冒險者還可以透過找到一種從裝備中移除惡魔精華的方法來進一步提供幫助。諸如法術{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}或{@spell protection from evil and good||防護善惡}，或者其他冒險者可能想象到的任何方法，都可以使得該部分零件可用。如果角色們幫助他們使地獄戰爭機器運轉，天狗們會向{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}傳達他們的喜悅，後者會變得更有可能在角色們的任務中幫助他們。

english: Mickey the Flesh Golem
zh_tw: 血肉魔像米奇
