english: Shortly after arriving in Avernus, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} created Mickey, a {@creature fiendish flesh golem|BGDIA} comprised of fiendish body parts scavenged from the battlefields of Avernus. Mickey is a sweet, dumb brute who follows {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s orders.
zh_tw: 到達阿弗納斯後不久，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}創造了米奇 米奇，這是一種{@creature fiendish flesh golem|BGDIA|邪魔血肉魔像}，由其從阿弗納斯戰場上撿拾到的邪魔的身體部位組成。米奇是個強悍卻失語的兇獸，它遵循著{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的命令。

english: Mickey's Goal
zh_tw: 米奇的目標

english: Unknown to anyone else at Fort Knucklebone, Mickey has a large piece of a destroyed bone devil lodged in his foot, which makes walking difficult for the brute. Unable to speak, he moans as he walks and does a bit of a hopping dance. The madcaps and redcaps think this is wonderful, and they occasionally accompany him in a vile song and dance. Characters who witness this and succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check realize Mickey's plight. They can then attempt to remove the bone fragment without permanently inhibiting Mickey's stride. A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check allows for the successful removal of the bone. After that, Mickey can walk without moaning or hopping, making {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} more amenable to assisting the characters. The redcaps and madcaps, however, become angry that they can no longer "do the Mickey."
zh_tw: 指節骨要塞的其他人都不知道，米奇的腳裡有著一隻魔鬼留下的一大塊被毀的骨頭，這使得這頭兇獸難以行走。由於無法說話，米奇行走時會發出呻吟，並且只能蹦躂著走路，這有點像在跳舞。瘋帽子和紅帽子們則認為這很棒，偶爾還會跟著他惡劣地又唱又跳。見證了這一景象併成功透過一次{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的角色們能夠意識到米奇的困境。然後，他們可以嘗試去除骨頭碎片，而不會永久地影響米奇的行走。成功透過一次{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定可以去除骨頭。在那之後，米奇可以走路而不用呻吟或著跳來跳去地行走，這會使{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}更願意幫助角色們。但是，紅帽子和瘋帽子們會對他們不能再"當米奇"感到生氣。

english: Pins and Needles
zh_tw: 大頭針和細縫針

english: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} cut a deal with a pit fiend to secure the services of two shrewd but lazy {@creature Imp||imps} named Pins and Needles. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} treats them with such kindness that the imps can't imagine wanting to work for anyone else. In {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s presence, the imps usually assume the forms of ravens that nest in her hair or perch on her shoulders.
zh_tw: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}與一位深獄煉魔達成了交易，以獲得兩名叫做大頭針和細縫針的精明但懶惰的{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}的服務。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}對待它們非常友善以至於這兩隻小魔鬼甚至無法想像要為其他任何人服務。在{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的面前，小魔鬼們通常會以烏鴉的形式出現在她的頭髮或肩膀上。

english: When not loitering around Fort Knucklebone, Pins and Needles keep tabs on the Blood War and spy on {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s rivals. Unlike most devils, Pins and Needles aren't gunning for promotions. They shun the infernal hierarchy and crinkle their noses in disgust when anyone tries to foist more responsibility onto them.
zh_tw: 當不在指節骨要塞附近四處遊蕩時，大頭針和細縫針會時刻關注著血戰，並監視著{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的對手。與絕大多數魔鬼不同，大頭針和細縫針並不渴望晉升。他們無視著地獄的等級制度，且當有人試圖給他們施加更多的責任時，他們會厭惡地皺起鼻子。

english: The Imps' Goals
zh_tw: 小魔鬼的目標

english: As much as they love their lives at Fort Knucklebone, the imps have a problem. They foolishly played a prank on one of the madcaps, Wazzik. Now they fear that Wazzik and a small group of his irrational friends are plotting revenge. The imps don't want to tell Maggie because she warned them not to pick on the madcaps, so they see the characters as a potential solution to their situation.
zh_tw: 儘管他們熱愛著他們在指節骨要塞的生活，但小魔鬼們還有著一個麻煩。他們愚蠢地對一個瘋帽子，瓦奇克，進行了一次惡作劇。現在，他們擔心瓦奇克和他的一些非理性的朋友們正在策劃復仇。小魔鬼們不想告訴瘋喜鵲，因為她警告過他們不要招惹瘋帽子，因此他們將角色們視為解決他們麻煩的潛在方案。

english: Helping the Imps
zh_tw: 幫助小魔鬼

english: As events play out in Fort Knucklebone, the characters notice that Pins and Needles lurk about at a distance, whispering to each other and staring at the characters. If confronted, the imps make a big deal of revealing a secret. Of course they lie, telling the characters that a madcap named Wazzik is planning to kill {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and urging them to take care of this threat first.
zh_tw: 隨著在指節骨要塞的事件的發展，角色們會注意到大頭針和細縫針藏在遠處竊竊私語並在凝視著他們。如果角色們與小魔鬼們相遇，小魔鬼們會故弄玄虛地揭露一個秘密。毫無疑問的是他們會撒謊，他們會告訴角色們一個名叫瓦奇克的瘋帽子正計劃殺死{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，並敦促他們首先解決這一威脅。

english: A successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that the imps are lying. If called on the lie, the imps reveal the truth about why they want Wazzik dead. They tell the characters exactly when and where to find Wazzik alone, and they promise to put in a good word with Maggie if the characters kill the madcap.
zh_tw: 成功透過一次{@dc 14}的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定能夠發現小魔鬼在說謊。如果被指出在撒謊，小魔鬼將告知他們為何想要瓦奇剋死的真相。他們會確切地告訴角色們何時何地能夠找到落單的瓦奇克，並承諾如果角色們殺死了瘋帽子，會在瘋喜鵲面前為他們說好話。

english: The imps' information is sound, and the characters can take care of the problem quickly and quietly. However, if anyone witnesses the murder, the characters might have to deal with consequences and complications. Fortunately for the characters, Maggie cares little for the madcaps and ignores the death, although it might lower the characters in her esteem a bit when it comes time to reward them.
zh_tw: 小魔鬼提供的資訊是完善的，角色們可以快速且安靜地解決掉這個問題。但是，如果有人目擊謀殺案，角色們可能不得不得處理其後果。對於角色們來說幸運的是，瘋喜鵲對瘋帽子並不在乎，並且會無視其死亡，儘管在她獎勵他們時，可能會降低一點點對角色們的看法。

english: Barnabas the Flameskull
zh_tw: 燃焰之顱巴納巴斯

english: Barnabas, once a powerful wizard, had his crypt defiled by an evil nemesis who stole his skull and turned it into a {@creature flameskull}. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} struck a bargain with this rival wizard and took Barnabas as payment. Now he's a part of her gang.
zh_tw: 巴納巴斯曾經是一位強大的法師，他的墳墓被一名邪惡的仇敵所褻瀆，這名復仇者偷走了他的頭骨並將其轉化為了{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}與這位復仇的法師達成了某項交易，並拿走了巴納巴斯作為款項。現在他是她幫派的一分子。

english: Barnabas is forgetful and a bit pompous, but every now and then he has amazing ideas and remembers remarkably useful things from his arcane past.
zh_tw: 巴納巴斯丟三落四而且有點自大，但他時不時地會有著驚人的想法並從他神秘的過去回想起非常有用的東西。

english: Barnabas's Goal
zh_tw: 巴納巴斯的目標

english: The redcaps like to hurl things at Barnabas, and after getting hit in the jaw with a loose gear, Barnabas lost one of his teeth. He saw a redcap, Grubba, grab it and run off. Barnabas is too embarrassed to tell {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} about it, though she suspects something is amiss because Barnabas has starting whistling when he speaks.
zh_tw: 紅帽子喜歡向巴納巴斯扔東西，在被用鬆散的裝備砸中下顎後，巴納巴斯失去了一顆牙齒。但他看到一個紅帽子，格魯巴，抓著他的牙齒逃走了。巴納巴斯羞於告訴{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}這件事，儘管她懷疑有些不對勁，因為巴納巴斯說話時開始漏風了。

english: He quietly asks the characters to help him find his missing tooth. He points out Grubba the redcap but admits that all the little sly creatures look similar to him.
zh_tw: 他悄悄地請求角色們幫助他找到他丟失的牙齒。他會指出紅帽子格魯巴，但他也承認所有這些狡猾的小東西看上去都很相似。

english: Helping Barnabas
zh_tw: 幫助巴納巴斯

english: Characters can question the redcaps, starting with Grubba, to find out who has the tooth. Each time they question a redcap, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the redcap gets angry and attacks the characters, backed up by {@dice 1d4} additional redcaps.
zh_tw: 角色們可以從格魯巴開始一個個詢問紅帽子，以找出誰拿著那顆牙齒。每次他們問詢一個紅帽子時，有{@chance 50}的可能這個紅帽子會生氣並攻擊角色，同時會有額外的{@dice 1d4}只紅帽子一起攻擊。

english: The redcaps believe the tooth is a lucky charm, so they frequently pass it from one to the next to keep Barnabas from finding it. Because of this constant transfer of the tooth, there's little hope of the characters finding it by confronting one redcap at a time. However, a character who quietly observes the redcaps for 10 minutes can attempt a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. On a success, the character sees one redcap passing a bloody pouch to another redcap, who tucks it in a pocket. This pouch contains Barnabas's tooth.
zh_tw: 紅帽子們認為這顆牙齒是一種幸運符，因此他們頻繁地把這牙齒從一個紅帽子傳遞給另一個紅帽子，以防止巴納巴斯找到它。由於牙齒的持續移動，因此角色們逐一詢問紅帽子來找到牙齒的希望渺茫。但是，如果角色們靜靜地觀察紅帽子們 10 分鐘，就可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 11}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。成功透過檢定，角色們就會看到一個紅帽子將一個血色的小袋子傳遞給另一個紅帽子，然後將其塞入口袋。這個小袋子裡你裝著巴納巴斯的牙齒。

english: A character who moves within reach of the redcap can attempt to pick its pocket and obtain the pouch without its knowledge, doing so with a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.
zh_tw: 在該紅帽子觸及範圍內移動的角色可以嘗試在紅帽子不察覺的情況下摸開他的口袋並拿走那個小袋子，這需要成功透過一次{@dc 14}的敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。

english: No redcap relinquishes the pouch willingly, though it can be magically {@condition charmed} into doing so. The redcap attacks any character who tries to take it by force, and twelve other redcaps join the fight on the next round. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} won't break up such a fight unless the characters have done something nice for her, although if the dreamscape ritual has not taken place yet, she won't allow the redcaps to kill a character.
zh_tw: 沒有紅帽子會自願放棄小袋子，當然他也可以被魔法{@condition charmed||魅惑}以得到小袋子。紅帽子會攻擊任何試圖強行奪取的角色，其他十二隻紅帽子會在下一輪加入戰鬥。除非角色們已經為她做了一些令她滿意的事情，否則{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}不會打斷這場戰鬥，儘管如果夢境儀式尚未舉行，她也不會允許紅帽子們殺死角色們。

english: Madcap
zh_tw: 瘋帽子

english: Redcaps and Madcaps
zh_tw: 紅帽子和瘋帽子

english: Redcaps are murderous fey creatures that soak their caps in fresh blood. Madcaps are redcaps that drench their caps in demon ichor instead. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} currently commands sixty redcaps and thirty madcaps, although a third of them operate outside the fort, patrolling the areas of the wasteland controlled by {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}. As battles deplete this force, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has new redcaps delivered to her from the Feywild, courtesy of powerful fey with whom she has struck bargains. For this reason, the night hag has no concern for the well-being of her redcap and madcap minions. See {@adventure appendix D|BGDIA|13} for more information about {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps} and {@creature Redcap|VGM|madcaps}.
zh_tw: 紅帽子是嗜殺的精類生物，他們將其帽子浸潤在新鮮血液中。瘋帽子是將自己帽子浸潤在惡魔膿液中而不是血液的紅帽子。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}目前指揮著 60 個紅帽子和 30 個瘋帽子，儘管其中有三分之一在堡壘外{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}控制著的荒原地區巡邏。隨著戰鬥消耗了這支部隊，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}從妖精荒野那裡獲得了新的一些紅帽子，這是與她進行交易的強大妖精所提供的。由於這個原因，夜鬼婆並不關心她的紅帽子和瘋帽子奴隸們過得好不好。有關{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}和{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|BGDIA|13}。

english: Redcap and Madcap Goals
zh_tw: 紅帽子和瘋帽子的目標

english: These creatures don't have many goals, being mad fey creatures that revel in chaos and slaughter. Their interactions with the characters should reflect that. One might offer a character a severed finger as a token of friendship, then accuse the character of stealing it afterward. Only their love and fear of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} keeps the creatures under a loose sort of control.
zh_tw: 這些生物並沒有太多目標，它們是陷入混亂和殺戮的瘋狂妖精生物。他們與角色的互動應該反映出這一點。一個紅帽子可能會給一個角色一根切下的手指來作為友誼的標誌，然後指責該角色偷走了它。只有他們對{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的愛和恐懼，才使這些生物能夠處於一種鬆散的控制之下。

english: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} understands the nature of these beings and she does not hold it against the characters if they kill them, especially when acting in self-defense.
zh_tw: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}理解這些生物的本質，並且，即使角色們殺死了這些生物，她也不會因此反對角色們，特別當角色們是在自衛時。

english: Mad Maggie's Infernal War Machines
zh_tw: 瘋喜鵲的地獄戰爭機器

english: Fort Knucklebone contains the hulks of infernal war machines in varying states of disrepair and cannibalization. Of the lot, two appear relatively intact. The smaller one is a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA}, the bigger one a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA}. The wheels of the Devil's Ride are missing. The Tormentor is missing its harpoon flinger, and its armor plating is corroded as though eaten by acid, reducing the vehicle's AC to 15.
zh_tw: 指節骨要塞有著各種處於失修和拼拆狀態的地獄戰爭機器的殘骸。在大量殘骸中，有兩臺看起來相對完整。較小的那個是一臺{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}。較大的那個是一臺{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}。魔鬼座駕的輪子沒有了。摧殘者的魚叉投射器不見了，並且它的裝甲板像是被酸狠狠地腐蝕了，這導致這臺戰車的AC降至15。

english: If the characters earn enough gratitude from {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, one or both of these war machines might be gifted to them. {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} can attach wheels to the {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and a weapon to the {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA}, if {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} instructs them to. Replacing the armor on the Tormentor can be done as well, but only after efforts are made to salvage scrap metal from the battlefields of Avernus. Any such salvage operation is likely to attract unwanted attention from other warlords (see "{@area Warlords of the Avernian Wastelands|1e0|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們從{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}那裡贏得足夠的感激，那麼這些地獄戰爭機器中的一臺或兩臺都可能會是送給角色們的禮物。如果得到了{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的指示，{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}可以將輪子安裝到{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}上，並將武器加裝到{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}上。當然也可以更換摧殘者的裝甲，但是這只有在努力蒐集阿弗納斯戰場上的廢金屬之後才能完成。任何此類蒐集行動都可能引起其他軍閥的不必要注意（請參見{@area 阿弗納斯廢土上的軍閥們|1e0|x}）。

english: In addition to the war machines described above, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has several infernal war machines in drivable condition that are undergoing regular maintenance and upgrades in her garage under the hill. These vehicles are not for sale or trade, though brazen adventurers might try stealing them. These vehicles include two {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|Devil's Rides}, three {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors}, the aforementioned {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} (which {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} have been trying to repair), and a {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA} that {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} uses for salvage operations.
zh_tw: 除了上述的地獄戰爭機器外，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}還擁有幾臺處於可驅動狀態的地獄戰爭機器，它們正在山下的車庫中進行定期維護和升級。這些戰車不會用於出售或交易，儘管大膽的冒險者可能會嘗試偷走它們。這些戰車包括兩臺{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}，三臺{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}，一臺上文提到的{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}（{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}一直在試圖修理的那臺）和一臺{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}用於進行回收的{@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|拾荒者}。

english: Lulu's Dream Quest
zh_tw: 露露的夢境探索

english: Before they can retrieve the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, the characters must learn the location of the Bleeding Citadel, which is trapped in {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s hidden memories. When {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} becomes aware of the characters' interest in accessing these hidden memories, she offers to perform a ritual that creates a dreamscape in which the hollyphant's memories can be perceived. For {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, the ritual is its own reward, as the hag longs to know everything {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} knows about the fall of Zariel.
zh_tw: 在找回{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}之前，角色們必須瞭解出湧血城砦的位置，該城堡的位置被藏在{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的隱藏記憶中。當{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}意識到角色們對進入這些失落的記憶的興趣時，她會主動提供一種儀式，該儀式會創造一個夢境，使人們能夠感知到聖飛象的記憶。對於{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}來說，儀式本身就是給予她自己的報酬，因為這個鬼婆渴望知曉{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}知道的關於扎瑞爾墮落的一切。

english: After making some preparations, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} creates a fiendish circle on the ground, and arranges several comfortable black cushions at the center. She orders {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to rest on the cushions, which the hollyphant does with a bit of trepidation. Maggie then places two skulls on the circle, noting that she's sure her sisters won't care if she picks their brains about this problem.
zh_tw: 經過一些準備後，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}在地面上構建了一個邪魔法陣，並在中央放了一些舒適的黑色坐墊。她命令{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}坐在坐墊上休息，聖飛象有點不安地坐了上去。然後瘋喜鵲在法陣上放了兩個骷髏頭，並表示她很確定她的姐妹們不會介意她拿著她們的大腦來解決這個問題。

english: The hag instructs {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the characters to take up places within the circle. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} tells the characters to close their eyes and keep them closed, that the ritual should last about ten minutes, and that during the ritual all within the circle will be joined by a telepathic bond. If anyone leaves the circle, the ritual is interrupted and she'll be forced to start over. An incomplete ritual yields no insight into {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories.
zh_tw: 鬼婆指示{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和角色們在法陣中佔據一些位置。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}告訴角色們閉上眼睛並且保持雙眼緊閉，該儀式應持續約 10 分鐘，並且在儀式期間，法陣中的所有人都會被一個心靈感應連結聯絡起來。如果有人離開法陣，儀式將被打斷，她將被迫重新開始。不完整的儀式無法使人們知曉{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶。

english: As the hag initiates the ritual, the characters sense the telepathic bond forming between themselves, the hag, and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}. Their eyes still closed, the characters sense a brilliant flash of light, then darkness. A tingling sensation sweeps over the characters' bodies as vibrant rainbows appear within their minds and they see {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s first dream unfold. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} isn't in the dreamscape with them, though characters can hear the hag's disembodied voice whenever she speaks.
zh_tw: 鬼婆開始儀式時，角色們會感覺到他們自身，鬼婆以及{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}之間形成的心靈感應連結。儘管他們的眼睛仍然閉著，但角色們會感覺到一道明亮的光芒霎時閃過，然後便陷入黑暗。當輕微的刺痛感湧上角色們的身體時，一道鮮亮的彩虹出現在他們的腦海中，並且他們看到了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的第一個夢境正在展開。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}並不在他們的夢境中，儘管當鬼婆每次說話時角色們都能聽到她的聲音。

english: Within this conjured dreamscape, characters can take psychic damage from hostile dream-creatures and other effects. A character reduced to 0 hit points by this psychic damage is {@condition unconscious} but stable, and unable to proceed to the next dream in the sequence. If all the characters fall {@condition unconscious}, the dream quest ends. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} can start over once the characters have regained consciousness and recovered from the ordeal.
zh_tw: 在這個變幻的夢境之中，角色們可能因敵對的夢境生物和其他效應而受到心靈傷害。由於這種心靈傷害而使生命值降至 0 的角色將陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，但處於傷勢穩定，並且無法繼續進行下一個夢境。如果所有的角色都陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，那麼夢境探索就會結束。只要一旦角色們恢復了意識並回復了傷勢，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}就可以重新開始。

english: Dream 1: Rainbow Angels
zh_tw: 夢境1：彩虹天使

english: Read the following boxed text when the characters first enter {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s dreamscape:
zh_tw: 角色們首次進入{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的夢境時，請朗讀下列方框內文字：

english: As the rich, radiant light of a hundred dancing rainbows slowly dissolves, warm sunlight fills the area. Within that space, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} flies lazily in a lush meadow at the shoulder of a beautiful, blindfolded angel. As the pair strolls through the tall green grass, the voice of the hag fills your mind, "Push through this vision. It only represents what {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} wishes was true. We need to see more."
zh_tw: 隨著彷彿一百個舞動的彩虹所散發的閃亮光輝逐漸消散，溫暖的陽光撒滿了整個地方。在那裡，在一片茂密的草地裡，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在一個美麗的蒙著雙眼的天使肩上懶洋洋地飛著。當他們漫步在這高高的綠草地中時，你們的腦海中響起鬼婆的聲音："看穿這個幻象。它只是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}希望能成真的景象。而我們需要看到更多。"

english: Each character must make a {@dc 10} Intelligence saving throw. If one or more of the characters succeed, the sunny meadow fades to black as the dream sequence progresses toward the next dream.
zh_tw: 每個角色必須透過一次{@dc 10}的智力豁免檢定。如果一個及以上的角色成功，則陽光明媚的草地會逐漸變成黑色，而隨之按序列前進至下一個夢境。

english: If all the characters fail the saving throw, each character takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage, and all of them must attempt the saving throw again. If at least one character succeeds the second time, this dream fades and the next one begins. If everyone fails the save again, all the characters take the psychic damage again. This process continues until at least one character succeeds or everyone falls {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: 如果所有角色均未透過豁免檢定，則每個角色會受到 11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。 他們都必須再次進行豁免檢定。如果第二次至少一個角色成功，那麼這個夢境就會消失，下一個夢境就會開始。如果每個人的豁免檢定都再次失敗，你們所有角色都將再次受到心靈傷害。這個過程將一直持續到至少有一個角色成功或所有人都陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}為止。

english: Dream 2: Betrayal!
zh_tw: 夢境2：背叛！

english: Characters who are conscious when the first dream ends proceed to the second dream:
zh_tw: 當第一個夢境結束時仍有意識的角色會進行第二個夢境：

english: A flame-encircled battlefield appears on a barren hellscape. At the center of the circle, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the angel lie {@condition unconscious} and {@condition prone}, horribly injured. You see yourselves standing in defense of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the angel, facing outward as six small, spine-covered devils creep closer. In the distance, a formation of battered and retreating human warriors disappears through a portal.
zh_tw: 一個烈焰環繞的戰場出現在荒蕪的地獄空間中。在戰場的中心，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和一個天使正處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}和{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，受傷十分嚴重。你們會發現自己正在守衛著{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和那名天使，正面對著六隻小型的長滿棘刺的魔鬼，它們正爬著靠近你們。在遠處，遭受重創和撤退中的人類戰士部隊正在透過傳送門消失。

english: "The devils!" hisses the hag's disembodied voice. "You must defeat those devils!"
zh_tw: "魔鬼！"鬼婆的聲音在你們耳邊低聲嘶吼。"你們必須打敗那些魔鬼！"

english: The characters must defend {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Zariel from the six {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils}. At this point, the characters and the devils should roll initiative. The dreamscape combat that follows pits the characters against the dream-devils. The characters begin combat at full hit points, minus any psychic damage taken in the previous dream. All damage dealt by the dream-devils converts to psychic damage. The devils let out dying screams and fall dead when reduced to 0 hit points.
zh_tw: 角色們必須保護{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和扎瑞爾免受 6 只{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}的傷害。此時，角色們和魔鬼應該進行先攻檢定。隨後的夢境戰鬥使角色與夢境魔鬼交戰。角色開始戰鬥時會獲得的生命值為滿值生命值減去在先前夢中所受到的心靈傷害。夢境魔鬼所造成的所有傷害都轉化為心靈傷害。當它們的HP被降到 0 時，魔鬼會發出垂死的尖叫聲然後死亡。

english: This dream ends when half of the {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} are reduced to 0 hit points. When the dream ends, the battlefield fades to black as the dream sequence proceeds with the next dream.
zh_tw: 當有一半的{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}的生命值降至 0 時，這個夢境就會結束了。當這個夢境結束時，這個戰場會逐漸變黑，並隨之進入到下一個夢境。

english: Dream 3: Devil Deal
zh_tw: 夢境3：魔鬼交易

english: Characters who are conscious when the second dream ends proceed to the third dream:
zh_tw: 當第二個夢境結束時仍有意識的角色會進入到第三個夢境：

english: A landscape filled with thick, black smoke and the smells of death and decay expands to encompass everything. The small devils that survived the previous dream kneel before you and offer to serve you if you spare their lives.
zh_tw: 瀰漫著濃濃黑煙，死亡和腐爛氣息的景象佔據了你們的眼前的的一切。 在先前的夢境中倖存下來的魔鬼們在你們的面前跪下，如果你們願意留它們一命，它們會服務於你們。

english: If the characters agree to accept the devils' terms, the devils take the sky and fly away, returning to help the characters in the next dream. Otherwise, the devils fade away into nothingness and don't reappear later on.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意接受魔鬼的條件，那麼魔鬼就會騰空飛走，返回以在下一個夢境中幫助角色們。否則，魔鬼們就會消失成虛無，以後再也不會出現。

english: Once the characters make their choice, this dream ends and fades to black as the dream sequence continues with the next dream.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們做出了選擇，這個夢境就會結束，並隨著下一個夢境的開始而逐漸變成黑色。

english: Dream 4: Desolation
zh_tw: 夢境4：死寂

english: When the fourth dream begins, read:
zh_tw: 當第四個夢境開始時，請朗讀：

english: You wander a vast, barren landscape of utter devastation. Black sludge rises rapidly out of the ground, enveloping your feet and gripping you tightly, overwhelming you with a horrible sense of loss.
zh_tw: 你們在茫茫荒蕪的荒野中游蕩。黑色的汙泥迅速從地面升起，包裹住你們的腳並緊緊抓住你們，一種非常可怕的死寂和失落感湧上你們心頭。

english: "Don't let the sludge consume you!" says {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s disembodied voice. "You must push through her defenses. She must look!"
zh_tw: "不要讓汙泥吞噬你！" {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}的聲音傳來。"你必須突破她的防線。她必須去看！"

english: Have the characters roll initiative for their dream-selves. Each character is {@condition restrained} by the black sludge. On its turn, a character must use its action to try to get free of the sludge, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. If at least one character accepted the devils' terms in the previous dream, {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} swoop down from the sky to help the characters pull free, granting advantage on each character's ability check.
zh_tw: 角色們需要為他們的夢境體進行先攻檢定。每個角色都受到黑色汙泥的{@condition restrained||束縛}。在其回合，該角色必須使用其動作來嘗試從黑泥中逃脫，這需要成功透過一次{@dc 15}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）或敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。如果至少一個角色在上一個夢境中接受了魔鬼的條件，那麼{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}就會從天而降來幫助角色們掙脫，因此所有角色的該屬性檢查獲得優勢。

english: A character who gets free of the sludge rises up into the air and quickly shakes off the sense of horrible loss. For the rest of this dream, the freed character can do nothing except use the {@action Help} action on each of its turns to assist another character still trapped in the sludge.
zh_tw: 擺脫了黑泥的角色會上升到空中，並迅速擺脫了那可怕的失落感。在這個夢境的其餘部分，逃脫的角色除了在每個回合中使用{@action Help||協助}動作來幫助仍困在黑泥中的另一個角色外，什麼也不能做。

english: A character who fails the initial check to escape the sludge must repeat the check at the start of each of its turns. With each failed check after the first, the character takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) psychic damage as the sense of horrible loss intensifies. If a character is reduced to 0 hit points by this psychic damage, its dream-self becomes completely submerged in the sludge and is lost.
zh_tw: 未能成功透過第一次檢定以逃脫黑泥束縛的角色必須在其每個回合開始時重複進行檢定。在第一次檢定失敗之後，每一次失敗的檢定都會使角色受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）點心靈傷害，這是因為那可怕的失落感在增強。如果角色由於這種心靈傷害而導致HP降低到 0，那麼他的夢境體就會完全淹沒於黑泥中並迷失。

english: The dreamscape can continue into the final dream provided at least one character's dream-self escapes from the sludge.
zh_tw: 只要有至少一個角色的夢境體從黑泥中逃脫，那麼夢境空間就可以繼續到最終的夢境。

english: Dream 5: Revelation
zh_tw: 夢境5：啟示

english: Characters who are conscious when the fourth dream ends proceed to the fifth and final dream, which is as follows:
zh_tw: 當第四個夢境結束時有意識的角色會進入到第五個夢境，也就是最終的夢境，如下所示：

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} rests on a black cushion at the center of an inky void. She is {@condition unconscious} and alone, a beam of brilliant white light shining down upon her. Next to {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, a large gleaming brass spyglass rests atop an ornately carved tripod.
zh_tw: 在一個漆黑虛空的中心，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}棲息在一個黑色墊子上。她正處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，並孤身一人，而一束明亮的白光照在她身上。在{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}身旁，一個閃閃發光的大號黃銅望遠鏡放置在裝飾精美的三腳架上。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} awakens and looks peacefully around her. Seeing the spyglass, she approaches it, pressing one eye against the eyepiece. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} then steps back suddenly, eyes wide, mouth open, her face alight with excitement. She cries out, "The sword, the sword! I know where it is!"
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}醒來，安靜地看了一眼她的周圍。她看到了望遠鏡，靠近它，一隻眼睛緊貼目鏡。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}然後突然退後一步，興奮地睜大眼睛，張開嘴，臉頰明媚。她喊道："劍，那把劍！我知道它在哪裡！"

english: As the dream ends, the characters and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} wake up in the ritual space. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} can barely contain her joy at rediscovering what she believes is the location of the Bleeding Citadel, and she impatiently begs the characters to start the next leg of their journey.
zh_tw: 隨著夢境的結束，人物和{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}會從儀式中醒來。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在重新發現她認為是湧血城砦的所在地時幾乎無法壓抑喜悅，她積極地乞求角色們開始下一趟旅程。

english: If none of the characters' dream-selves made it to the end of the dreamscape, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is eager to repeat the ritual. Conversely, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} might regain enough of her memory to lead characters on the next leg of the journey without having to endure the ritual a second time. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is unhappy if she doesn't get to see the whole dream, and is less likely to help the characters get to where they need to go if they refuse to see the dream sequence through to the very end.
zh_tw: 如果沒有一個角色的夢境體走到夢境的盡頭，那麼{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}渴望重複這一儀式。相反，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}可能會重新獲得足夠的記憶來在下一趟旅途中引領角色，因而不必再次忍受這種儀式。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}不看完整個夢境就會很不高興，並且如果角色們拒絕把夢境看到盡頭，那麼她就不太可能幫助角色們到達他們需要去的地方。

english: If the characters made it to the end of the dreamscape, then {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} did as well. Experiencing the agonies of such pure suffering, the hag oozes contentment. As long as the characters have done nothing to displease her during their stay at Fort Knucklebone, {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} provides them with one or more of the available infernal war machines. If they have assisted her troops in other ways, she can provide any or all of the following as well:
zh_tw: 如果角色走到夢境的盡頭，那麼{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}也是如此。體驗瞭如此純粹苦難的痛苦感，鬼婆洋溢著滿足感。只要角色們在指節骨要塞逗留期間沒有做什麼令她不快的事情，{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}就會給他們提供一個或多個可用的地獄戰爭機器。如果他們在其他方面協助了她的部隊，她也可以提供以下任何或所有東西：

english: As many as three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, which the characters need to fuel their infernal war machines
zh_tw: 多達三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，角色們需要用以為其地獄戰爭機器提供燃料。

english: A silvered weapon of the characters' choice, to assist in battles with devils and lycanthropes
zh_tw: 一把角色們選擇的鍍銀武器，用以幫助與魔鬼和獸化人戰鬥。

english: Two weeks of rations per character (the rations taste awful but retain their nutritional value)
zh_tw: 每人兩星期份的口糧（口糧味道不好，但保留了營養價值）

english: Warnings about other warlords (see "{@area Warlords of the Avernian Wastelands|1e0|x}"), plus the name of someone who might help them (see "{@area Roaming Encounter: Smiler the Defiler|2bb|x}")
zh_tw: 有關其他軍閥的警告（請參閱"{@area 阿弗納斯廢土上的軍閥們|1e0|x}"），以及可能幫助他們的人員的姓名（請參閱"{@area 漫遊遭遇：汙化者笑爺|2bb|x}"）

english: Farewell
zh_tw: 告別

english: The manner in which the Knucklebones bid farewell to the characters depends on how pleased {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} is with the characters. This attitude ranges from a near-tearful goodbye if they gave Maggie and her gang everything they wanted, to being chased away by rabid madcaps if everything went wrong.
zh_tw: 指節骨幫告別角色的方式取決於{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}對角色的滿意程度。這種態度的變化範圍，包括如果他們向瘋喜鵲和她的幫派提供了他們想要的一切，那麼就是幾近流淚的告別；如果一切出錯，那就會被瘋狂的瘋帽子趕走。

english: Vengeful Pursuits
zh_tw: 復仇追擊

english: If the characters take one or more infernal war machines from Fort Knucklebone without {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}'s consent, the night hag organizes a posse to run them down and get back what's hers, plus "interest." {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} chases after them in her {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA}, with Mickey in the passenger seat behind her while she drives. Barnabas the flameskull operates the Grappling Claw with his {@spell mage hand} spell, {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} operate the Harpoon Flingers, and six madcaps cling to the outside hull, ready to leap onto enemy vehicles. If {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} got the broken {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} working, that vehicle comes after the characters as well and is manned entirely by redcaps and madcaps.
zh_tw: 如果角色在未經{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}同意的情況下從指節骨要塞拿走了一臺或多臺地獄戰爭機器，夜鬼婆會組織一支部隊將他們擊倒並拿回她的東西，再順便加上一些"利息"。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}會坐在她的{@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|拾荒者}上追擊角色們，米奇在開車時坐在她身後的乘客座位上。 燃焰之顱巴納巴斯會使用法術{@spell mage hand||法師之手}操作鐵爪，{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}操作魚叉投射器，並有六隻瘋帽子緊抓著戰車外甲，隨時準備跳向敵方車輛。如果{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}把{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}修好了，那臺戰車也會追擊角色，並且完全由紅帽子和瘋帽子負責。

english: Raggadragga Attacks!
zh_tw: 拉加德拉格進攻！

english: As the characters reach a half-mile or so away from Fort Knucklebone, trouble comes looking for them in the form of an enemy warlord:
zh_tw: 當角色們離開指節骨要塞半里左右時，麻煩就以敵對軍閥的形式找上門來了：

english: A plume of red dust billows in the distance, created by a large infernal war machine barreling in your direction. Its crew consists of boar-headed and rat-headed humanoids, all wearing goggles.
zh_tw: 遠處一股巨大的紅色塵埃滾滾而來，這是由一臺龐大的地獄戰爭機器向你們的方向疾馳而產生的。它的車組人員由都戴著護目鏡的野豬頭和鼠頭的類人生物組成。

english: {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA|拉加德拉格}

english: The incoming infernal war machine is a gore-spattered {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} with gnashing metal teeth at the front and a wrecking ball swinging behind it. As it moves to intercept the characters, the vehicle is not trying to be stealthy.
zh_tw: 即將到來的地獄戰車是一個滿是血汙的{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}，其前部有著金屬咬齒，而其後部一個粉碎球在擺動著。當它在移動以截奪角色時，該戰車不會嘗試隱匿。

english: If the characters have one or more infernal war machines, they can try to outrun, outmaneuver, or destroy the approaching enemy vehicle. If they are on foot, they must find a way to disable the vehicle and defeat the creatures inside. If they do so, they can claim the {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} for themselves.
zh_tw: 如果角色擁有一個或多個地獄戰爭機器，他們可以嘗試加速逃脫，以機動性甩掉或摧毀這臺正在接近的敵方戰車。如果角色們處於步行狀態，他們必須找到一種方法來停止這臺戰車並擊敗裡面的生物。如果他們這樣做，他們可以擁有這臺{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}。

english: The {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} is driven by the warlord {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA}, a {@creature wereboar} with 120 hit points. He leads the Goreguts Gang, which consists of two other {@creature Wereboar||wereboars} named Jibbs and Oozywog (who operate the vehicle's Chomper and Wrecking Ball stations) and two {@creature Wererat||wererats} named Finnik and Yeegha (who operate the vehicle's Harpoon Flingers). Avernus has no moons, so the Goreguts Gang isn't beholden to lunar cycles. Its members prefer their hybrid forms.
zh_tw: {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}由軍閥{@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA|拉加德拉格}駕駛，一名擁有 120 點生命值的{@creature Wereboar||野豬人}。他領導的血髒幫，由另外兩個名叫吉布斯和烏茲沃格的{@creature wereboar||野豬人}（分別操作這臺戰車的粉碎機和粉碎球）以及兩個分別名為芬尼克和耶加的{@creature Wererat||鼠人}（操作這臺戰車的魚叉投射機）組成。 阿弗納斯沒有月亮，因此血髒幫不受月亮週期的影響。其成員更喜歡半人形態。

english: If he defeats the characters, {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA} gets whatever information he can out of them before attempting to ransom them back to {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}. The night hag may or may not pay for them, depending on her disposition toward the characters when they left Fort Knucklebone.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA|拉加德拉格}擊敗了角色們，那麼他就會先從他們身上獲得他所能得到的一切資訊，然後再讓{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}贖回角色們。夜鬼婆可能會贖回角色們，也可能不會為他們付出代價，這取決於她在角色們離開指節骨要塞時對角色的態度。

english: If the characters defeat the Goreguts Gang, they can take possession of the {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}, which burns through its remaining fuel in 6 hours.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了血髒幫，他們可以擁有{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}，但它會在 6 小時內燒掉剩餘的燃料。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA} carries three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} that he uses to fuel the {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}. He also carries a {@item circlet of blasting}, which he can don and use to make ranged attacks. The other members of the Goreguts Gang have no treasure.
zh_tw: {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA|拉加德拉格}攜帶著三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，以供他為{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}提供燃料。他還帶著一個{@item circlet of blasting||爆裂頭飾}，他可以戴上並用它進行遠端攻擊。血髒幫的其他成員沒有財寶。

english: The warlords of Avernus conquer the hellish wastelands in infernal war machines powered by souls
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的軍閥們駕駛著以靈魂為動力的地獄戰爭機器，征服這片煉獄荒原。

english: Warlords of the Avernian Wastelands
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯廢土上的軍閥們

english: As the characters cross the wastelands of Avernus, they will likely run afoul of petty warlords scavenging for {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and scrap metal to fuel and repair their infernal war machines. {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} and {@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA} are two warlords whom the characters meet early on. The following sections describe three other warlords who prowl the Avernian wastes: a wingless {@creature horned devil} named {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}, a human necromancer named {@creature Feonor|BGDIA}, and a {@creature chain devil} named {@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA}. These warlords are as cruel and merciless as the hell they inhabit. All share a "survival of the fittest" mentality.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿越阿弗納斯的荒原時，他們很可能會碰上那些尋找{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}和廢金屬為他們的地獄戰爭機器提供燃料和維修的小軍閥。{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}和{@creature Raggadragga|BGDIA|拉加德拉格}這兩位會是與角色們最早相遇的軍閥。下述的各小節描繪了其他三名軍閥，這些軍閥徘徊在阿弗納斯廢土上：一個名為{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}的無翼{@creature horned devil||角魔}，一個名為{@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}的人類死靈法師，以及一個名為{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}的{@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA|元首科維克}。這些軍閥就如同他們所居住的地獄一樣殘酷無情。所有人都有著"適者生存"的心態。

english: In Avernus, a warlord's power is measured by the strength and size of its gang, and the threat posed by its infernal war machines. As one warlord bites the dust, another inevitably rises to take its place. {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}, {@creature Feonor|BGDIA}, and {@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA} are merely the latest in a long series of warlords to plague the Avernian expanse. If Zariel wasn't so busy fighting the Blood War, she would rid Avernus of these roaming pests; as things stand, she's content to let the warlords wipe each other out instead.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯中，一名軍閥的力量是由其幫派的實力和規模以及地獄戰爭機器所構成的威脅來衡量的。當一個軍閥戰敗時，就必然會有另一個新的軍閥站出來取代他的位置。{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}，{@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}和{@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA|元首科維克}只不過是這些折磨著阿弗納斯地區的軍閥的那長長名單中的一些最新貨色。如果扎瑞爾沒那麼忙於血戰，她是會著手清除阿弗納斯這些遊蕩的害蟲。就目前情況而言，她很滿意於讓軍閥們互相消滅作為替代。

english: If you need to add some excitement to the adventure, have one of these warlords show up to challenge the characters. One warlord might be after {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} to fuel its infernal war machines, while another might be eager to forge an alliance with a capable band of adventurers against a greater foe. With the exception of {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, these warlords have no lairs, so they can be encountered anywhere at any time.
zh_tw: 如果您需要為這場冒險增添些刺激，那麼可以讓其中一名軍閥出現來給予角色們挑戰。一個軍閥可能在尋找{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}來為其地獄戰車提供燃料。與此同時，另一個軍閥可能渴望與一支有能力的冒險家團隊結成同盟，用以對抗更強大的敵人。除了{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}，這些軍閥沒有巢穴，因此可以隨時隨地遇到他們。

english: Avernus has more warlords than the ones described here. You can create new ones, each with their own gangs and infernal war machines. Don't worry about throwing too many infernal war machines at the characters. You can curtail the characters' reliance on infernal war machines by restricting their access to {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, which the vehicles burn as fuel. A typical warlord has {@dice 2d6} {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and {@dice 2d6} flasks of demon ichor (see "{@area Demon Ichor|1a7|x}") at any given time.
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的軍閥遠比這裡描述的要多。您可以建立一些新的軍閥，每個都有他們自己的幫派和地獄戰爭機器。不必擔心向角色們投放了太多的地獄戰爭機器。您可以透過限制角色們對{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的獲取來減少角色們對地獄戰車的依賴，靈魂幣會被戰車作為燃料燃燒。一名典型的軍閥在任何給定時間都有{@dice 2d6} 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}和{@dice 2d6} 瓶{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}

english: Infernal War Machine Combat
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器戰鬥

english: All the warlords described in this adventure use infernal war machines to strike fear into their rivals, fend off demons and other threats, and flee from Zariel's devil patrols. The rules for infernal war machines in {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} are meant to help you adjudicate situations that arise during encounters, but combat involving infernal war machines works best with "theater of the mind"-style play, where it's more important to capture the emotion of a chase than know the exact location and orientation of every vehicle on the battlefield.
zh_tw: 這次冒險中描述的所有軍閥都使用地獄戰爭機器來向其競爭對手注入恐懼、抵禦惡魔和其他威脅，以及逃離扎瑞爾的魔鬼巡邏隊。{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11}中有關地獄戰爭機器的規則旨在幫助您判斷遭遇中出現的情況，但是涉及地獄戰爭機器的戰鬥最適合"心靈劇場"式的遊戲風格，即捕捉一場有關追逐的情感比知道戰場上每臺戰車的確切位置和方向更為重要。

english: If a situation arises that the vehicle rules don't cover, fall back on the core rules. For example, if a character wants to leap from one moving vehicle to another, determine whether the character succeeds or not with a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, setting the jump's DC based on the distance between the two vehicles (as well as other factors, as appropriate). Keep it fun and fast-paced, and push the rules aside when they get in the way.
zh_tw: 如果出現戰車規則未能涵蓋的情況，則使用基礎規則。例如，如果一名角色想要從一臺移動中的戰車跳到另一臺移動的戰車上，則需要透過一次力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來判斷角色是否成功做到，根據兩臺戰車之間的距離（以及其他適當的因素）來設定這次跳躍的DC。請保持遊戲的樂趣和快節奏，並在規則阻礙你們的遊戲樂趣時將規則推到旁邊。

english: Bitter Breath
zh_tw: 苦痛之息

english: {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA} is a resentful, vindictive warlord that fell prey to the cutthroat politics of Avernus. Formerly a pit fiend named L'zeth, it strove to undermine Zariel while courting {@creature Bel|BGDIA}. Shortly after claiming rulership of Avernus, Zariel demoted L'zeth to a {@creature horned devil}.
zh_tw: {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}是一名憤慨不滿，懷恨在心的軍閥，是阿弗納斯殘酷政治的犧牲品。苦痛之息以前是一名叫做萊澤斯的深獄煉魔，它曾為了取悅{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}而竭力於打擊扎瑞爾。在宣稱了阿弗納斯的統治權後不久，扎瑞爾就將萊澤斯降格為{@creature horned devil||角魔}。

english: For a while, L'zeth nursed its damaged pride. Eventually, the despondent devil reignited its ambitions and became involved in a plot to overthrow Zariel. The archdevil's spies learned of the plot. As further punishment, Zariel removed L'zeth's wings and cursed the horned devil so that it could no longer enter into deals. Any document that L'zeth signs melts away, and any words it utters turn to smoke in its mouth. Thus did L'zeth become known as {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 有一陣子，萊澤斯默默舔舐著自己受損的驕傲。最終，沮喪的魔鬼重新點燃了野心，並參與了一場推翻扎瑞爾的陰謀。而魔鬼大公的間諜得知了這個陰謀。作為進一步的懲罰，扎瑞爾剝奪了萊澤斯的翅膀，並詛咒了這隻角魔，以至於它再也不能參與任何交易中去。萊澤斯簽名的任何檔案都會熔化，並且其說出口的任何單詞都會變成它嘴裡冒出的煙。因此，萊澤斯開始被稱為{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}。

english: Bitter Breath's Marauders
zh_tw: 苦痛之息的掠奪者們

english: Zariel has declared that no other devil may associate with {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}. However, Zariel's decree hasn't stopped the fiendish outcast from joining forces with a gang of marauding hobgoblins under the command of a battle-hardened {@creature hobgoblin warlord} named High Graj Karkajuk.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾已經發布命令宣佈任何魔鬼都不能與{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}合作。然而，扎瑞爾的法令沒有阻止這位邪魔流放者與一個大地精掠奪者幫派合作，這個幫派由一名身經百戰的{@creature hobgoblin warlord||大地精軍閥}指揮，其名為大格拉傑·卡卡朱克。

english: {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA} drives a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} that has an Infernal Screamer (see "{@vehupgrade Infernal Screamer|BGDIA}") instead of a Harpoon Flinger. {@creature Hobgoblin||Hobgoblins} round out the Tormentor's crew. High Graj Karkajuk drives a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and commands a pair of {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|Scavengers} driven by {@creature Hobgoblin Captain||hobgoblin captains} and crewed by ordinary {@creature Hobgoblin||hobgoblins}. See {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} for the vehicles' stat blocks.
zh_tw: {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}駕駛著一臺裝有地獄尖嚎裝置（請參見"{@vehupgrade Infernal Screamer|BGDIA|地獄尖嚎裝置}"）來替代一個魚叉投射機的{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}。車組人員全是{@creature Hobgoblin||大地精}。大格拉傑·卡卡朱克駕駛著一臺{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}並且指揮著兩臺{@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|拾荒者}，清道夫均由{@creature Hobgoblin Captain||大地精長官}駕駛並由{@creature Hobgoblin||大地精}充任車組成員。有關戰車的資料面板，請參閱{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11}。

english: Feonor
zh_tw: 菲奧諾

english: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA} is a willowy, neutral evil {@creature archmage} with milky-white eyes and a parasol made of bones and human flesh. Her rivals know her as a powerful necromancer. They suspect that she fled the Material Plane to escape some horrible fate, but the truth is she was invited to Avernus by Mahadi, the rakshasa master of the Wandering Emporium (see "{@area The Wandering Emporium|297|x}"). During a visit to {@creature Feonor|BGDIA}'s world, Mahadi fell head-over-heels in love with her zombie-like indifference. Not long after arriving in Avernus, {@creature Feonor|BGDIA} grew bored of Mahadi's attempts to impress her. Without so much as a farewell, she took to the Avernian wastes on one of the rakshasa's infernal war machines and never looked back. Years later, Mahadi still refers to her as "the one the got away."
zh_tw: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}是一個有著乳白色雙眼的婀娜多姿的中立邪惡{@creature archmage||大法師}，她拿著一柄由骨頭和人肉製成的陽傘。 她的對手知道她是個強大的死靈法師。他們懷疑她逃離物質位面是為了躲避某些可怕的命運，不過事實是，她被流浪商城的羅剎主人馬哈迪（請參見{@area 流浪商城|297|x}）邀請到了阿弗納斯。在拜訪{@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}所在的世界期間，馬哈迪瘋狂地愛上了她那殭屍般的冷漠。到達阿弗納斯不久後，{@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}就對馬哈迪嘗試打動她的那些行為感到了厭煩。沒有道別，她就使用羅剎的地獄戰爭機器之一到達了阿弗納斯廢土，並且再也沒有回頭。哪怕多年後，馬哈迪仍稱她為"逃跑者"。

english: The scowl on {@creature Feonor|BGDIA}'s face hints at her constant annoyance with the multiverse around her. She prefers not to speak, and when she does, it's typically only in whispers, her short sentences interspersed and punctuated with frustrated sighs.
zh_tw: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}微皺的眉頭暗示著她對周遭多元宇宙的恆常惱怒。她不喜歡說話，當她說話時，通常只是在低聲私語，她的簡短句子往往也散佈著令人沮喪的嘆息。

english: Golden Doom
zh_tw: 黃金厄運

english: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA} rides around in a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA} called {@i Golden Doom}, so named because Mahadi fitted it with gilded death armor (see "{@vehupgrade Gilded Death Armor|BGDIA}"). The vehicle is driven by a {@creature ghast}, and its other stations are operated by {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}. She also commands a force of ten {@creature Crawling Claw||crawling claws}. A pair of {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors} crewed by {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} provide escort.
zh_tw: {@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}坐在一臺名為{@i 黃金厄運}的{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}上，之所以這樣命名是因為馬哈迪給這臺戰車安裝了鍍金死亡裝甲（請參閱"{@vehupgrade Gilded Death Armor|BGDIA|鍍金死亡裝甲}"）。這臺戰車由一隻{@creature ghast||妖鬼}駕駛，其餘部分由{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}操作。她同時也指揮著一支由 10 只{@creature Crawling Claw||蠕行之爪}組成的戰力。兩臺由{@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}作為車組的{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}為她提供護衛。

english: Princeps Kovik
zh_tw: 元首科維克

english: This particularly cruel {@creature chain devil} commanded the Nine Hells' 8th Infantry Legion, "Terror Incarnate," which was crushed on the banks of the River Styx by the demon lord {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}. Blaming its superiors for the defeat, {@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA} gathered the surviving members of its legion and formed the Eighth Remnant, a marauding gang of devils no longer beholden to the infernal hierarchy.
zh_tw: 這位特別殘忍的{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}曾經指揮著九獄的第 8 步兵軍團"恐怖化身"，該軍團在冥河河岸被惡魔領主{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}碾碎掃平。由於此次失敗被其歸咎於其上級，{@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA|元首科維克}召集了尚存的軍團成員，組成了第八殘餘，這是一個不再受制於九獄的階級制度的魔鬼掠奪者幫派。

english: The devils that serve under Kovik do so willingly because the chain devil has earned their trust. Newly disenfranchised devils regularly flock to Kovik's banner. The chain devil's emblem is the numeral 8 made out of iron chain on a crimson field. Kovik aims to gather enough strength and infernal war machines to do what no archdevil has been able to do: drive the demons back to the Abyss for good.
zh_tw: 那些服從於科維克領導的魔鬼之所以願意這樣，是因為這鏈魔贏得了他們的信任。那些新近被剝奪權利的魔鬼經常聚集到科維克的旗幟之下。這名鏈魔的象徵是在赤紅色場地上用鐵鏈製成的數字 8。科維克的目的是聚集足夠的力量和地獄戰爭機器來做那些魔鬼大公無法做到的事情：將惡魔永遠地驅逐回無底深淵。

english: The Eighth Remnant
zh_tw: 第八殘餘

english: The Eighth Remnant chases down any potential source of {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. Targets who give up their {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} freely are allowed to continue on their way without further harassment, provided there are no demons lurking among them.
zh_tw: 第八殘餘追逐任何可能的{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}來源。那些無償放棄了他們的{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的目標就可以繼續他們的路途而不會受到任何進一步的騷擾，只要他們之中沒有惡魔的話。

english: Kovik has a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} and travels with two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on similar vehicles. The rest of the gang consists of four {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils} on a {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} and eight {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} on a {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}. Members of the Eighth Remnant never use demon ichor in their vehicles.
zh_tw: 科維克有著一臺{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}，兩隻{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}騎在類似的戰車上和他一起行進。這個幫派剩下的成員包含了在一臺{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}上的 4 只{@creature Barbed Devil||蝟魔}和在一臺{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}上的 8 只{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}。第八殘餘的成員從來都不在他們的戰車上使用惡魔穢液。

english: Quest for the Sword
zh_tw: 尋劍之旅

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s dreams lead the characters on a wild goose chase to Haruman's Hill in search of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Realizing that the Bleeding Citadel isn't where she remembers it, the hollyphant offers the characters a choice of paths. Both paths eventually lead to the Bleeding Citadel, but only through a combination of deal making, daring, and dumb luck.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的夢境會將角色們帶去哈魯曼之丘去尋找{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，然而這是白費力氣的。當她意識到湧血城砦並不在自己記憶中的位置時，聖飛象為角色提供了兩條道路作為選擇。兩條道路最終都會導向湧血城砦，但這必須是交易、無畏的膽氣和偶然的運氣相結合的成果。

english: {@adventure Diagram 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees} and {@adventure diagram 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper} are flowcharts that show the two paths characters can take through Avernus to reach the Bleeding Citadel: the {@adventure Path of Demons|BGDIA|4} and the {@adventure Path of Devils|BGDIA|5}, respectively. Neither is literally a "path," but rather a sequence of locations that the characters must visit in order. If the characters wander off these paths, use optional encounters to pull them back (see "{@adventure Other Locations|BGDIA|6}," and "{@area Roaming Encounter: Smiler the Defiler|2bb|x}").
zh_tw: {@adventure 圖表 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees}和{@adventure 圖表 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper}是冒險流程圖，顯示了角色們可以透過阿弗納斯到達湧血城砦的兩條道路：分別是"{@adventure 惡魔之路|BGDIA|4}"和"{@adventure 魔鬼之路|BGDIA|5}"。兩者都不是字面意義上的"道路"，而是角色們必須按順序到達的一系列地點。如果角色們偏移了這些路徑，請使用可選的遭遇將其拉回（請參閱"{@adventure 其他地點|BGDIA|6}"和"{@area 漫遊遭遇：汙化者笑爺|2bb|x}"）。

english: Each encounter location tied to a path has a recommended character level, as noted in {@adventure diagram 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees} or {@adventure diagram 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper}. If your group's average character level is lower than the recommended level of their destination, introduce some random encounters or reroute them to another location first to raise their level.
zh_tw: 如{@adventure 圖表 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees}或{@adventure 圖表 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper}所示，每條路徑上的遭遇地點都有建議的冒險者等級。如果您團隊的平均角色等級低於目的地的建議等級，請引入一些隨機遭遇或讓他們先到另一個地方去提高等級。

english: Allow characters the opportunity to explore locations on the poster map of Avernus in any order they please, or let them jump back and forth between the paths as they see fit.
zh_tw: 請允許角色們有機會按照他們喜歡的順序來探索阿弗納斯海報地圖上的地點；或者如果他們認為合適的話，讓他們能夠在路徑之間來回跳躍切換。

english: Haruman's Hill
zh_tw: 哈魯曼之丘

english: {@i Behold! Zariel's dog crucified those who betrayed his mistress in battle}.
zh_tw: {@i 瞧啊！扎瑞爾的狗把那些在戰鬥中背叛了他女主人的傢伙釘在這兒。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: Haruman's Hill is marked on {@adventure map 3.1|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus}. When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 哈魯曼之丘在{@adventure 地圖 3.1|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus}上標出。當角色們到達此地點時，請向玩家們朗讀或意譯下列方框內文字：

english: Wrought iron trees line a trail that leads to the summit of a steep hill. Anguished knights are impaled on the trees' metal branches, their bodies writhing in torment as bloated stirges feast on their blood.
zh_tw: 沿著一條通往這個陡峭山峰峰頂的小路排列著熟鐵鍛成的樹。極度痛苦的騎士們被穿刺在這些樹木的金屬枝杈上，當腫脹的蚊蝠吸食著他們的鮮血時他們的身體在痛苦中扭動著。

english: Haruman, a human paladin of Helm, was one of Zariel's most devoted Hellriders. He crucified deserters to Zariel's cause on "Coward's Way," a line of tortured souls leading to this desolate hill. Each soul is pinned to a barbed, metal tree. Inscriptions above their heads attest that most of them were mortal knights who abandoned Zariel during her assault into Avernus. Flocks of {@creature Stirge||stirges} buzz between the branches, feasting hungrily on the screaming, crucified victims. The stirges attack the characters only if they try to free the captives (see "{@area Haruman's Arrival|1ec|x}" below). Roll {@dice 2d4} to determine the number of attacking stirges.
zh_tw: 哈魯曼，一名信仰海姆的人類聖武士，他曾是扎瑞爾最忠誠的地獄騎手之一。他把那些背離了扎瑞爾事業的逃兵釘在了"懦夫之路"上，那是一排飽受酷刑的靈魂，一直通向這座荒涼的山丘。每個靈魂都被釘在一棵帶刺的金屬樹木上。他們頭上的銘文顯示著他們絕大多數是在扎瑞爾進攻阿弗納斯時拋棄了她的凡人騎士。成群的{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}在枝杈間嗡嗡作響，貪婪地享用著那些被釘在上面痛苦呼嚎的牲品們。只有當角色們嘗試釋放這些俘虜時，這些蚊蝠才會攻擊角色們（請參閱下文"{@area 哈魯曼的到來|1ec|x}"）。投擲{@dice 2d4}以確定發起進攻的蚊蝠的數目。

english: Jander Sunstar
zh_tw: 詹德·日星

english: Near the summit of the hill, the {@creature vampire} Jander Sunstar is impaled on one of the largest iron trees. This elf warrior, cursed to an eternity of undeath, tried to redeem his corrupted soul by swearing to hunt down his own kind. Later, he volunteered to join Zariel on her crusade into the Nine Hells. Stirges now swarm back and forth from Jander's body, preserving his existence by injecting him with the blood of his traitorous companions.
zh_tw: 在山頂附近，{@creature vampire||吸血鬼}詹德·日星被刺穿在最大的鐵樹之一上。這位被永遠詛咒為不死生物的精靈戰士，曾經試圖發誓獵殺他自己的同類，以挽救他墮落的靈魂。後來，他自願加入了扎瑞爾的對九獄發起的聖戰。而現在蚊蝠在詹德的身上來回蠕動，透過向他注入他的叛徒同夥的鮮血來維持他的存在。

english: Jander pleads for the characters to cut him down so that his soul can move on from this accursed place. He reveals the following information:
zh_tw: 詹德懇求角色們將他放下來，讓他的靈魂從這個被詛咒的地方離開。他透露了以下資訊：

english: Jander and Haruman were both part of a host of warriors who joined the angel Zariel in her assault on the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 詹德和哈魯曼都曾是那些和天使扎瑞爾一起進攻九獄的眾多戰士的一員。

english: After charging through the portal into Avernus, Jander panicked and fled back to Elturel. He betrayed his braver comrades by sealing the portal behind them.
zh_tw: 透過傳送門進入阿弗納斯後，詹德驚慌失措並逃回了艾爾托瑞爾。他背叛了他勇敢的戰友們，把背後的傳送門給封閉了。

english: Jander and his fellow deserters never revealed their shameful retreat and betrayal of Zariel. It was a badge of shame that the Hellriders, as they were came to be known, would wear in secret until the grave.
zh_tw: 詹德和他的逃兵同伴們從未透露過他們可恥的撤退和對扎瑞爾的背叛。這是一種恥辱的標記，地獄騎手們，他們後來開始被這樣稱呼，會一直把這秘密帶到墳墓裡。

english: After years of anguish, Jander chose to face the sun and throw himself on Lathander's mercy. The prayer fell on deaf ears, and his soul was condemned to the Nine Hells to suffer for his sins.
zh_tw: 經過多年的痛苦，詹德選擇直面陽光，寄希望於洛山達的憐憫。然而他的祈禱被置若罔聞，他的靈魂被判決下了九獄以償還他的罪孽。

english: When she beholds Jander impaled on the iron tree, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories of him return. She remembers his betrayal of Zariel and gives him a pitiful look. She then admits to the characters that she's made a mistake leading them here and needs to ponder her dreams in more detail to discern the Bleeding Citadel's whereabouts.
zh_tw: 當她看到詹德被刺穿在鐵樹上時，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}想起了關於他的回憶。她想起了他對扎瑞爾的背叛，就憐憫地看了他一眼。然後，她向角色們承認她帶你們來這裡是一個錯誤，她需要更詳細地思考自己夢境來確定湧血城砦的下落。

english: Haruman's Arrival
zh_tw: 哈魯曼的到來

english: If the characters free Jander or any of his companions, their bodies crumble to dust in grateful release. In response, twenty {@creature Stirge||stirges} attack the group. When the second round of combat begins, any crucified souls remaining on the trees wail in terror as Haruman, a {@creature narzugon|MTF}, swoops down from the sky on his {@creature nightmare} steed to punish the interlopers. He begins the encounter 300 feet away and orders the nightmare to close the distance between him and the adventurers as quickly as possible. As Haruman attacks, a {@creature hellwasp|BGDIA} appears from a nearby nest and tries to grab {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and fly off with her (see "Development" below).
zh_tw: 如果這些角色釋放了詹德或他的任何同伴，他們的身體就會在感激不盡的解脫中化為塵土。作為回應，20 只{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}會攻擊他們這個團隊。在戰鬥的第二輪開始時，當哈魯曼——一名{@creature narzugon|MTF|魘騎魔}駕駛著{@creature nightmare||夢魘}坐騎從空中猛衝出來懲罰入侵者時，任何仍被釘在樹上的靈魂都會在恐懼中哀號。他會在 300 尺外開始這場遭遇，並命令夢魘儘快拉近他和冒險者們之間的距離。當哈魯曼攻擊時，一隻{@creature hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}會從附近的巢穴中出現，試圖抓住{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}並帶著她飛走(請參閱下方的"發展")。

english: Haruman
zh_tw: 哈魯曼

english: If a character damages Haruman with an attack, a fresh tree bearing the character's name sprouts from the ground nearby, listing the character's crime as "assaulting an officer." Any character who sees their name on a tree for the first time must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of Haruman for 1 minute. A character who fails this saving throw can repeat it at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on them on a success.
zh_tw: 如果有一個角色在一次攻擊中傷害了哈魯曼，那麼附近的地上就會長出一棵寫著這個角色名字的樹，上面寫著該角色的罪行是"襲擊軍官"。任何第一次看到自己名字出現在樹上的角色都必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}的感知豁免檢定，否則就會對哈魯曼產生持續 1 分鐘的{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態。豁免失敗的角色可以在其每個回合結束時重複進行豁免，豁免成功則結束效應。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Haruman uses {@item infernal tack|MTF} to ride his nightmare.
zh_tw: 哈魯曼使用{@item infernal tack|MTF|煉獄鞍具}來騎乘他的夢魘。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the hellwasp abducts {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, it takes the hollyphant to its nest. If the characters wish to rescue {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, they must storm the nest (see "{@area Hellwasp Nest|1ef|x}").
zh_tw: 如果黃泉蜂抓走了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，它會把聖飛象帶回它的巢穴。如果角色們希望解救{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，他們必須衝進蜂巢（請參見"{@area 黃泉蜂巢|1ef|x}"）。

english: If the characters thwart the hellwasp's abduction of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, the hollyphant is grateful and apologizes for leading them to the wrong place, admitting that her memory of the Bleeding Citadel is hazier than she initially realized. Having pondered her dreams further, she says that two sites in Avernus seem important to finding the Citadel: a place where demons manifest (see "{@area Spawning Trees|1fb|x}"), and another where demons are destroyed (see "{@area Demon Zapper|230|x}"). {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has no preference which to investigate first, so she points out both locations on the characters' map and leaves the decision to the characters. Each of these locations opens a different branch of investigation that ultimately leads to the Bleeding Citadel. See {@adventure diagram 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees} and {@adventure diagram 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper} for overviews of the two paths—the {@adventure Path of Demons|BGDIA|4} and the {@adventure Path of Devils|BGDIA|5}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們阻止了黃泉蜂綁架{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的行動，那麼聖飛象就會非常感激並且為帶著角色們來到了錯誤的地方表示道歉，承認她關於湧血城砦的記憶比她自己想象得還要模糊。在更加深入地思考了她的夢境之後，她說了兩個在阿弗納斯的地點，它們似乎對於找到湧血城砦很重要：一個是惡魔顯現的地方（請參見"{@area 孵化樹|1fb|x}"）和一個惡魔被消滅的地方（請參見"{@area 滅魔器|230|x}"）。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}對於先調查哪一個地點沒什麼偏好，所以同時在角色們的地圖上指出這兩個地點並且把選擇權交於角色們。這兩個地點都開啟了一個不同的調查分支，它們最終都會導向湧血城砦。{@adventure 惡魔之路|BGDIA|4}和{@adventure 魔鬼之路|BGDIA|5}的概覽請分別參閱{@adventure 圖表 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees}和{@adventure 圖表 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper}。

english: Hellwasp Nest
zh_tw: 黃泉蜂巢

english: {@i Fallen angels are meat for hellwasps. Steer clear, lest you nourish their young with your flesh}.
zh_tw: {@i 墜落的天使是黃泉蜂的食物。繞開，免得用你的血肉滋養它們的幼蟲。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: Throughout Avernus, aggressive hellwasp colonies shape enormous nests from the cocooned carcasses of slain angels and other fallen celestials. Such structures are magically buoyant and must be tethered by chains to the surface of Avernus. The cocooned angels writhe unpleasantly from the motion of the larvae gorging on their insides, creating the false impression that they still live. Because of this, the mere sight of a hellwasp nest has been known to drive mortals mad. This entry describes a typical nest, such as the one {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is carried to from Haruman's Hill.
zh_tw: 在整個阿弗納斯中，好鬥的黃泉蜂群落用被殺死的天使和其他墜落的天界生物的屍體建造出了巨大的巢穴。這種結構具有一種魔法浮力，必須用鐵鏈將其拴在阿弗納斯的表面上。這些被繭裹著的天使因其體內幼蟲的蠕動而詭異地扭動著，這製造出了一種他們還活著的假象。正因為如此，僅僅黃泉蜂巢穴的景象就能夠讓凡人瘋狂。這個條目描繪了一個典型的黃泉蜂巢穴，就像{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}從哈魯曼之丘被帶過去的那個巢穴。

english: When the characters encounter their first hellwasp nest, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次遭遇黃泉蜂巢時，請向玩家們朗讀或轉述下列帶框文字：

english: A gigantic sac of wet, papery material floats high above the surface of hell. Angelic figures with feathery wings stick to its surface like flies in amber, their bodies struggling futilely underneath layers of gunk. Iron chains at the bottom of the structure tether it to the hellish landscape.
zh_tw: 一個巨大而潮溼的紙質囊狀物漂浮在地獄的地面之上。一些長著羽毛翅膀如天使般的身形粘在它的表面上，他們的身體在層層粘稠的物質下徒勞地掙扎著，就宛如琥珀裡的蒼蠅。該構造底部有著鐵鏈把它拴在這地獄景象之中。

english: A typical hellwasp nest contains eight {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps}, although twice this number are typically out hunting when the characters arrive. If they paralyze every character in the party with their stings, the hellwasps move them to their larder at the top of the nest ({@area area N4|1f7|x}) to be used as food for their larvae.
zh_tw: 一個典型的黃泉蜂巢穴中會有著 8 只{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}，但是當角色們到達巢穴時通常會有兩倍於此數量的黃泉蜂出來狩獵他們。如果它們用它們的釘刺麻痺了隊伍中的每個角色，黃泉蜂就會把他們帶到巢穴頂部的儲藏室({@area 區域N4|1f7|x})，來作為它們幼蟲的食物。

english: Encounters in the Nest
zh_tw: 巢穴中的遭遇

english: The following descriptions correspond to the areas marked on map 3.2. A hellwasp nest has no stairs, so the characters must fly or use climbing gear to traverse between levels. Each level of the nest is basically one large chamber. Map 3.2 includes a side view of the nest that shows how the various levels stack atop one another.
zh_tw: 文的描述對應於地圖3.2所標示的區域。黃泉蜂的巢穴沒有樓梯，所以角色們必須飛行或使用攀爬裝備來穿過不同的樓層。巢穴的每一層基本上都是一個大房間。地圖3.2裡包含了巢穴的側檢視，其顯示了各個樓層是如何堆疊在一起的。

english: Map 3.2 shows where dead angels are entombed in the hellwasp nest's translucent walls. The angels' well-preserved corpses, which are visible to creatures inside the nest, keep the nest aloft. Removing them from the walls causes the nest to slowly sink to the ground.
zh_tw: 地圖3.2也顯示了那些死去的天使們被埋葬在黃泉蜂巢穴半透明牆壁裡的位置。天使們的那些儲存完好的屍體，在巢穴裡的生物都可以看到，這些屍體使巢穴保持在高處。將它們從牆壁上移除會導致巢穴慢慢沉到地面。

english: Map 3.2: Hellwasp Nest
zh_tw: 地圖 3.2: 黃泉蜂巢

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: N1. Entry Level
zh_tw: N1. 入口層

english: The nest's entrance is on its underside, where one or more heavy chains tether the nest 100 feet above the surface of Avernus. The hellwasps keep this level mostly clear to avoid blocking off the hatcheries above. Even so, discarded gear accumulates here among the gory effluvia expelled from the wasps' devoured captives.
zh_tw: 巢穴的入口位於其底部，一條或者多條沉重的鏈條在那兒將巢穴拴在離阿弗納斯地面 100 尺的高度上。黃泉蜂會保持該層最大程度的清潔以防止堵塞住上層的孵卵場。即便如此，被丟棄的裝備仍會堆積在黃泉蜂吞噬俘虜後所排出的血腥汙穢物中。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Anyone searching through the junk finds a backpack containing five {@item Healer's Kit|PHB|healer's kits} and a fully charged {@item wand of magic missiles}.
zh_tw: 任何翻找這堆垃圾的人都能夠找到一個放著 5 個{@item Healer's Kit|PHB|醫療包}和一個滿充能的{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}的揹包。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Too much noise here alerts the hellwasps in area N2. Creatures rooting through the junk must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check or alert the wasps. Once the colony is placed on alert, call for initiative rolls. All the hellwasps act on the same initiative count. At the start of each of the hellwasps' turns, one {@creature hellwasp|BGDIA} arrives from area N2 to defend the nest until all three appear. The rest of the colony remains on high alert for two hours.
zh_tw: 在這發出太多的噪音會警示區域N2的黃泉蜂。翻找垃圾堆的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}的敏捷({@skill Stealth||隱匿})檢定，否則會驚動黃泉蜂。一旦該群落處於警戒狀態，要求進行先攻檢定。所有的黃泉蜂都使用同一個先攻骰值。在黃泉蜂每回合開始時，會有一隻{@creature hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}從區域N2過來保衛巢穴，直到共 3 只黃泉蜂全部出現。群落的其他成員也會保持高度警惕兩個小時。

english: N2. Drone Cells
zh_tw: N2. 雄蜂房間

english: This level is honeycombed with octagonal cells crafted by the hellwasps from a regurgitated mulch of bone, sand, and fat. Three {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps} are here unless they were drawn to area N1 by the characters' intrusion.
zh_tw: 這一層是由黃泉蜂用反芻的骨頭、沙子和脂肪製成的八角形房間構成的蜂巢結構。這裡有著三隻{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}，除非它們被吸引到N1區域。

english: N3. Hellwasp Larvae
zh_tw: N3. 黃泉蜂幼蟲魔

english: This level of the nest is always on high alert and contains three {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps}.
zh_tw: 巢穴的這一層總是處於高度警戒狀態，並且有著三隻{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}。

english: Hellwasp larvae are incubating inside the angel carcasses on this level. If a character takes piercing or slashing damage within 15 feet of an angel carcass or moves within 5 feet of one, the carcass explodes and releases {@dice 2d6} hostile {@creature hellwasp grub|BGDIA|hellwasp grubs} (use the {@creature giant centipede} stat block to represent them).
zh_tw: 在天使屍體內孵化的是黃泉蜂的幼蟲。如果一個角色在距離任意天使屍體 15 尺範圍內受到穿刺或揮砍傷害，或者移動到任意天使屍體 5 尺範圍內，該屍體就會爆裂開來並釋放{@dice 2d6}只敵對的{@creature hellwasp grub|BGDIA|黃泉蜂幼蟲}(它們使用{@creature giant centipede||巨蜈蚣}的資料面板)。

english: N4. Larder
zh_tw: N4. 食品儲藏室

english: The hellwasps gum their victims to the walls of this level using the same regurgitated bile that forms their nest. Two {@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|hellwasps} are stationed here at all hours.
zh_tw: 黃泉蜂用形成巢穴的反芻膽液將受害者們黏在這層的牆上。2 只{@creature Hellwasp|BGDIA|黃泉蜂}會一直駐紮在這裡。

english: If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} was abducted and brought to the nest, the characters find her here, stuck to a wall (see "Development" below). Any creature that ends up gummed to the walls can use an action to try to free itself, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A character can also make this check to pull free a companion within its reach.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}被綁架並帶到巢穴，角色們就會在這裡發現她被粘在牆上(請參見下述的"發展"條目)。任何被粘在牆上的生物都可以使用一個動作來嘗試掙脫，這需要成功透過一次{@dc 20}的力量({@skill Athletics||運動})檢定。一個角色也可以透過進行該檢定來釋放其觸及範圍內的一名同伴。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Ruined gear belonging to previous abductees is scattered across the floor. Characters who search through the gear find three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and a {@item helm of telepathy}.
zh_tw: 那些屬於之前的被綁者的廢棄裝備散落在地板上。翻找這些裝備的角色們能夠發現 3 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}和一個{@item helm of telepathy||心靈感應頭盔}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters free {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, she admits that her memory of the Bleeding Citadel is hazier than she initially realized. Having pondered her dreams further, she says that two sites in Avernus seem important to finding the Citadel: a place where demons manifest (see "{@area Spawning Trees|1fb|x}"), and another where demons are destroyed (see "{@area Demon Zapper|230|x}"). {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has no preference which to investigate first, so she points out both locations on the characters' map and leaves the decision to them. Each of these locations opens a different branch of investigation that leads to the Bleeding Citadel. See {@adventure diagram 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees} for an overview of the {@adventure Path of Demons|BGDIA|4} and {@adventure diagram 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper} for an overview of the {@adventure Path of Devils|BGDIA|5}.
zh_tw: 如果角色救出了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，她承認她關於湧血城砦的記憶比她自己想象得還要模糊。在更加深入地思考了她的夢境之後，她說了兩個在阿弗納斯的地點，它們似乎對於找到湧血城砦很重要：一個是惡魔顯現的地方（請參見"{@area 孵化樹|1fb|x}"）和一個惡魔被消滅的地方（請參見"{@area 滅魔器|230|x}"）。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}對於先調查哪一個地點沒什麼偏好，所以同時在角色們的地圖上指出這兩個地點並且把選擇權交於角色們。這兩個地點都開啟了一個不同的調查分支，它們最終都會導向湧血城砦。{@adventure 惡魔之路|BGDIA|4}和{@adventure 魔鬼之路|BGDIA|5}的概覽請分別參閱{@adventure 圖表 3.2|BGDIA|4|Spawning Trees}和{@adventure 圖表 3.3|BGDIA|5|Demon Zapper}。

english: Chapter 3: Avernus - Path of Demons
zh_tw: 第3章：阿弗納斯 - 惡魔之路

english: Spawning Trees
zh_tw: 孵化樹

english: Diagram 3.2: Path of Demons
zh_tw: 圖表 3.2：惡魔之路

english: {@i Demons beget demons. Where their filth lands, they spawn ever more corruption}.
zh_tw: {@i 惡魔孕育惡魔。在它們汙穢的降臨之地，它們孵化了更多的腐敗。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive here, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這裡時，請朗讀或轉述下列方框內文字：

english: Treelike growths cluster along the shoreline of a lake of bubbling, black goo. Each growth is formed from the same ichor as the lake and has writhing, membranous sacs budding from its limbs.
zh_tw: 像樹一樣的植物簇擁在一個充滿了不斷冒泡的黑色粘性液體的湖泊的岸邊。每棵植物都是由與湖中相同的穢液形成的，並且它的枝丫上長出了蠕動的膜質的囊。

english: Five bearded fiends heap coals around the trunk of one of the trees. As they hurl more coals onto the pyre, four of their number cruelly poke and tease the fifth member of their group.
zh_tw: 五個須魔在其中一棵樹的樹幹周圍堆放著煤炭。當他們往上扔更多的煤炭時，其中的四個須魔正殘酷地戲弄嘲笑他們隊伍中的第五個須魔。

english: Lakes of demonic ichor appear where demons are slaughtered in great numbers. Malformed trees grow on their shorelines, their branches laden with fleshy sacs. These eventually flop to the ground and wetly break open, each one releasing a fully grown {@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA}. Abyssal chickens are carnivorous, temperamental, tasty bottom-feeders native to the Abyss. They beat their leathery wings to scare predators and to help them run faster, and they taste like fatty chicken.
zh_tw: 惡魔穢液之湖會出現在惡魔被大量屠殺的地方。畸形的樹木生長在它們的岸邊，它們的樹枝上都長滿了肉質的囊。這些肉囊最終會掉到地上，然後潮溼地裂開，每個囊都會釋放出一隻成年的{@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA|深淵雞}。深淵雞是肉食性、喜怒無常的、美味的最低階層的惡魔，原產於深淵。它們會拍打堅韌的翅膀來嚇走捕食者或者幫助它們跑得更快，而且它們吃起來像肥美的雞。

english: With your permission, a character who casts the {@spell find familiar} spell can henceforth choose to conjure an abyssal chicken instead of a raven.
zh_tw: 在你允許的情況下，釋放法術{@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵}的角色可以選擇召喚一隻深淵雞來替代一隻烏鴉。

english: Devilish Work Crew
zh_tw: 魔鬼的工作人員

english: Zariel dispatched infernal cleanup crews to scour the lake shores for the trees and destroy them before they become thickets. When the characters arrive, they encounter a work crew of five {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} in the process of raising a pyre around a tree to incinerate it. Four of the devils tease the fifth, whose name is Krikendolt. A vrock savaged Krikendolt's skull during one of the many battles of the Blood War, leaving him with terrible scars and a brain injury that has turned his alignment to chaotic good. Krikendolt's comrades learned that he pities the abyssal chickens, and they are now goading him into slaughtering the chickens on pain of death. Secretly, Krikendolt keeps an {@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA} named Earwax in his sack.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾派出了地獄的清理人員在湖岸上搜尋這些樹木並在它們長成叢林之前摧毀掉它們。當角色們到達時，他們遇到了一個由 5 名{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}組成的工作小組，他們正在一棵樹周圍堆起柴堆，準備把它燒成灰燼。其中四個魔鬼正在戲弄第五個魔鬼，他的名字是克里肯多特。在血戰的一場戰鬥中，一名鷲魔猛擊了克里肯多特的頭部，這給他留下了可怕的傷疤以及大腦損傷，然而這使他的陣營轉變為了混亂善良。克里肯多特的同事們得知了他在同情深淵雞，於是他們現在正命令並驅趕他去屠殺這些雞，違令則處死他。然而克里肯多特在他的口袋裡秘密地養了一隻叫做耳垢的{@creature abyssal chicken|BGDIA|深淵雞}。

english: The devils are likely to attack on sight unless a character can convince them to parley with a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. The devils won't forgive their comrade for his compassion, but the characters could persuade them to release Krikendolt into their care if they offer the right price. Krikendolt knows Avernus well, so he makes a good traveling companion and guide. The characters can cure Krikendolt of his disorder using a {@spell heal} spell or similar magic, which restores his lawful evil alignment.
zh_tw: 魔鬼們很可能會一見面就發起攻擊，除非有角色能夠成功透過一次{@dc 12}的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來說服他們進行談判。魔鬼們不會原諒他們同事的同情心，但如果角色們出了一個合適的價格的話，他們可以說服魔鬼們釋放克里肯多特。克里肯多特非常瞭解阿弗納斯，所以他會是一個很好的旅行夥伴和嚮導。角色們可以使用法術{@spell heal||治癒}或類似的魔法治療克里肯多特的紊亂，以使他回到守序邪惡陣營。

english: The devils don't know where the Bleeding Citadel is, but they do know someone who could help. For the price of a {@item soul coin|BGDIA}, the devils direct the group to a mysterious outlander (see "Development" below). If the characters are unable to pay, they must return later with the coin and track down the fiends on the lake shore.
zh_tw: 魔鬼們不知道湧血城砦在哪裡，但是他們知道有某些人可以幫上忙。只要支付 1 枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的價格，這些魔鬼們就會帶著角色們去見一個神秘的外鄉人（請參閱下文的"發展"條目）。如果角色們無法支付，那他們必須稍後帶著靈魂幣回來湖岸邊找到這些邪魔。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The fiends carry five {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} and three vials of {@area demon ichor|1a7|x}.
zh_tw: 這些邪魔擁有 5 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}以及 3 瓶{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The fiends tell the characters about a powerful mage who visits Avernus from other planes and often pays yugoloths for their protection. If anyone knows where to find this Bleeding Citadel, it's surely Mordenkainen! The fiends mark the location of the wizard's tower on the players' map of Avernus. Following this lead takes the group to the Tower of Urm.
zh_tw: 這些邪魔們會告訴角色們有一個強大的法師從其他位面來到了阿弗納斯，並且經常付款購買尤格羅斯魔的保護。如果有什麼人知道哪裡能夠找到湧血城砦，那一定是魔鄧肯！這些邪魔們會在玩家們的地圖上標記出法師塔的位置。沿著這個引導能夠帶著角色們來到烏爾姆之塔。

english: {@creature Abyssal Chicken|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Abyssal Chicken|BGDIA|深淵雞}

english: Tower of Urm
zh_tw: 烏爾姆之塔

english: {@i A tower tumbles between planes on the whims of a mad mage. Where it goes next, nobody knows}.
zh_tw: {@i 一座法師塔在位面之間跳躍，就由於一時心血來潮。一個瘋掉的法師。它下一次會去哪裡沒人知道。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: The Tower of Urm jaunts across the multiverse. It is present in Avernus only if the characters arrive here after speaking to the fiends in the cleanup crew (see "{@area Spawning Trees|1fb|x}" above).
zh_tw: 烏爾姆之塔在多元宇宙中遨遊。只有在當角色在與清理工作小組中的魔鬼對話結束後到達這裡時，它才會出現在阿弗納斯(見上文的"{@area 孵化樹|1fb|x}")。

english: If the characters arrive when the Tower of Urm is present, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在烏爾姆之塔出現時到達，請為玩家們閱讀或意譯下列框內文字：

english: An iron tower rises atop an island on a lake of boiling blood. No windows penetrate the tower's walls, and its only visible door opens onto a high balcony. Red lightning crackles constantly between two horns of metal on the tower's roof.
zh_tw: 一座鐵塔矗立在湖心的小島上，這湖水是沸騰的鮮血。塔樓的外牆上沒有一扇窗戶，它唯一可見的門卻在一個很高的露臺上。鮮紅的閃電在塔頂的兩個角之間不斷嗶哩嗶哩地閃爍爆裂著。

english: Mordenkainen, a chaotic neutral human {@creature archmage}, often sojourns to Avernus to study how the Nine Hells affect the schools of magic. This archmage of Oerth leads a powerful group of adventurers called the Circle of Eight and has authored several planar tomes. He has also crafted many renowned spells.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯，一位混亂中立的人類{@creature archmage||大法師}，經常逗留在阿弗納斯研究九獄是如何影響魔法流派的。這位奧斯的大法師領導著一個強大的冒險者組織"八葉"，並撰寫了幾部位面鉅著。他也是許多知名的法術的創造者。

english: Mordenkainen takes the tower with him when he leaves Avernus. Its empty iron foundations remain behind to mark the site, and when the tower returns, it locks itself into place with a satisfying clunk. Mordenkainen pays yugoloths to carry out his bidding in Avernus. His wages are so attractive that these fiends have taken to gathering outside his tower. There are nine {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths} and three {@creature Nycaloth||nycaloths} present here at any time. The fiends aren't looking for trouble, since they're more interested in landing a lucrative contract with the mage.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯在他離開阿弗納斯時會帶著他的法師塔一起。只有空蕩蕩的鐵質地基留在原處標記出位置，然後當法師塔返回時，塔會隨著一聲令人滿足的沉悶金屬聲把它自己固定在那裡。魔鄧肯會付錢給尤格羅斯魔讓他們在阿弗納斯執行他的命令。他的出價是如此地誘人以至於這些邪魔都聚集在他的塔外面。這裡隨時都會有著 9 只{@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}和 3 只{@creature Nycaloth||征伐羅斯魔}。這些邪魔不是來找麻煩的，他們對於和法師簽訂一份豐厚的合同更感興趣。

english: Two of the nycaloths—Torgrazk and Shraal—are loyal to Zariel and have been sent here to assassinate Mordenkainen. If they overhear his discussions with the characters, the assassins decide to alter their plans. Both fiends turn {@condition invisible} and follow the party in hope of an opportunity to kidnap one or more characters and deliver them to Zariel. If they succeed, Zariel invites the rest of the group to her flying fortress to negotiate terms for their comrades' release (see "{@area Zariel's Flying Fortress|2b0|x}").
zh_tw: 其中兩個征伐羅斯魔，托拉格拉茲克和什拉爾，是效忠於扎瑞爾的，並且他們被派來暗殺魔鄧肯。如果他們偷聽到了魔鄧肯和角色們的討論，這些暗殺者們會決定改變他們的計劃。兩隻邪魔都會在變得{@condition invisible||隱形}後尾隨團隊以希望有機會抓住 1 個或者更多的角色們交於扎瑞爾。如果他們成功了，扎瑞爾會邀請團隊剩下的角色到她的飛行堡壘來協商關於釋放他們同伴的條款（請參閱"{@area 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘|2b0|x}"）。

english: Talking to Mordenkainen
zh_tw: 與魔鄧肯交談

english: Mordenkainen is a stern, bald man with a neatly trimmed black goatee beard and a penetrating stare. When his tower arrives in Avernus, Mordenkainen steps out onto the balcony to address the fiends gathered below. Fights frequently break out between the yugoloths as they jostle for his attention.
zh_tw: 魔鄧肯是一個嚴肅的光頭男人，他留著修剪整潔的黑色山羊鬍，目光洞徹人心。當他的法師塔到達阿弗納斯時，魔鄧肯會走到露臺上向選民聚集的邪魔們講話。尤格羅斯魔之間經常為了爭奪他的注目而爆發打鬥。

english: Zariel's assassins often lurk here, so Mordenkainen presents a {@spell simulacrum} of his true self that disintegrates into a pile of snow if it is destroyed. The real archmage remains deep inside his tower and swiftly shunts the building to another plane in times of danger.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的暗殺者經常潛伏在這兒，因此魔鄧肯使用了{@spell simulacrum||擬像術}創造出了一個和他本人自我相同的擬像，出現在眾人面前的擬像如果被消滅就會化作一堆雪。真正的大法師一直呆在他的法師塔深處，並且在危險發生時他會迅速地把這座建築傳送到另一個位面。

english: If the characters make themselves known to Mordenkainen's simulacrum, he demands to know their reasons for visiting. The archmage doesn't know the location of the Bleeding Citadel, nor does he care to find it. Even so, he claims that "balance will be maintained in the universe" by giving the characters directions to a lesser mage who also studies the workings of magic in Avernus—specifically, a "mage of no renown" who haunts the site of an obelisk. The yugoloths recently told Mordenkainen about this stranger and his guidance has an ulterior motive: if the characters end up slaying the mysterious mage, Mordenkainen has one less rival to contend with in Avernus.
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓魔鄧肯的擬像注意到了他們，他會要求知道他們來到此處的原因。這位大法師不知道湧血城砦的位置，也不願意去找它。儘管如此，他仍會一邊聲稱"宇宙的平衡將得以維持"——並給角色們指明一位小法師的方位，該法師同樣在鑽研阿弗納斯的魔法的執行，具體來說是一位徘徊於方尖碑遺址的"無名法師"。尤格羅斯魔們最近告知了魔鄧肯這位陌生人的位置，而魔鄧肯的指引也別有用心：如果角色們最後殺死了這位神秘的法師，魔鄧肯在阿弗納斯就少了一個競爭的同行。

english: Obelisk
zh_tw: 方尖碑

english: {@i An unknown man with unknown purpose. Assist him at your peril, lest he drag you into madness}.
zh_tw: {@i 一個無人知曉的男人，有著無人知曉的目的。協助他，後果自負。小心他將你拖入瘋狂。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A thirty-foot-tall obelisk ringed by seven smaller standing stones rises from the crest of this hill. A tall man wearing tattered robes strides between the standing stones, gesticulating wildly and screaming curses into the wind.
zh_tw: 一座三十尺高的方尖碑矗立在這座小山丘的山頂上，周圍環繞著七塊較小的立石。一個穿著破爛袍子的高個子男人在這些立石之間大步走著，瘋狂地指指點點，在風中大聲地咒罵著。

english: The pit fiend {@creature Bel|BGDIA} imprisoned the {@creature barlgura} demon Ubbalux inside this circle of standing stones. To torment his adversary, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} revealed that the secret to escaping the prison was hidden in the arcane runes etched across the standing stones. Ever since, the tormented demon has tried futilely to solve the riddle and escape. The figure pacing the standing stones is Ubbalux masquerading in human form using a {@spell disguise self} spell. The magic of the obelisk prevents the demon from leaving the circle and stops any form of divination magic from affecting the stones or targeting a creature inside their perimeter.
zh_tw: 深獄煉魔{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}把一隻名為烏巴盧克斯的{@creature barlgura||惡猿魔}囚禁在這個立石法陣中。為了折磨他的對手，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}向他透露了逃離監禁的秘密就藏在刻於立石上的奧秘符文裡。自此，這位飽受折磨的惡魔就徒然地試圖解開謎題然後逃出來。在立石之間踱步的人其實是使用了{@spell disguise self||易容術}偽裝成人類的烏巴盧克斯。方尖碑的魔法阻止了這個惡魔離開法陣並且使任何形式的預言學派魔法無法影響這些石頭也無法將法陣範圍內的生物作為目標。

english: Ubbalux appears as a tall human wizard. The demon stole this appearance from the last visitor to stray into his stones (after Ubbalux ate him). If the characters approach, the "wizard" greets them eagerly and is keen to divulge details of his studies, but his conversation often trails off on confusing tangents. The following information can be gleaned by speaking with the false wizard:
zh_tw: 烏巴盧克斯以一個高個子的人類法師的形象出現。惡魔從最後一個誤入了立石陣的訪客那裡偷走他的外表(當然是在烏巴盧克斯吃掉他之後)。如果角色們走近，這位"法師"會熱情地向他們打招呼，並熱衷於討論他研究的細節，但他的交談經常偏離到令人疑惑的方向上去。下列資訊可以透過與假法師的交談獲得:

english: The wizard claims that he no longer recalls his name or place of origin.
zh_tw: 法師聲稱他不再記得自己的名字和出生地。

english: If asked about the Bleeding Citadel, the wizard promises to direct the characters to "someone who can help," provided they help him solve the enigma of the obelisk first.
zh_tw: 如果被問及湧血城砦，法師承諾會引導角色找到"一些能幫上忙的人"，但前提是他們能先幫他解開方尖碑之謎。

english: Ubbalux can truly help the characters find the path to the Bleeding Citadel, but the demon hopes to manipulate the characters into releasing it from its prison first. If they become aware of its ruse, the demon admits to the deception and pleads for their help (see "Development" below).
zh_tw: 烏巴盧克斯真的可以幫助角色們找到通往湧血城砦的道路，但惡魔希望操縱角色們先把它從監禁中釋放出來。如果角色們識破了它的小詭計，這個惡魔會承認它的欺騙並懇求他們的幫助(請參閱下文的"發展"條目)。

english: A Wizard's Theory
zh_tw: 法師的理論

english: The wizard claims that each standing stone is keyed to one of the eight schools of magic (abjuration, conjuration, divination, enchantment, evocation, illusion, necromancy, and transmutation). His theory suggests that the central obelisk grants a boost in arcane power to mages across the cosmos, and he urges the characters to aid him in empowering it. In truth, Ubbalux has concocted this theory to dupe the characters into testing his latest escape plan. Characters who examine the standing stones and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check discern that the arcane runes do indeed relate to the eight schools of magic.
zh_tw: 這位法師聲稱每一塊立石都與八個魔法學派（防護，咒法，預言，惑控，塑能，幻術，死靈，變化）中的一種相關聯。他的理論認為，中央方尖碑會給予整個宇宙的法師以奧術力量的提升。事實上，烏巴盧克斯炮製了這個理論以欺騙角色們來測試他最新的逃跑計劃。檢查立石併成功透過一次{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色能夠辨別出符文的確和魔法的八個學派有關。

english: The wizard requests that each character places a hand upon a different stone, to "assist in channeling the streams of magic." When their hands are in place, Ubbalux begins to chant. The air fills with ozone as lightning courses over the standing stones. Each character who participates in the experiment takes 22 ({@dice 5d8}) lightning damage and suffers an additional effect based on the school of magic associated with the standing stone that the character touched, as noted in the Standing Stone Effects table. Ubbalux's latest attempt to escape his prison has failed.
zh_tw: 法師要求每個角色把手放在一個不同的石頭上以"協助引導魔法之流"。當他們的手放在了上面時，烏巴盧克斯開始吟唱。閃電掠過立石，空氣中充滿了臭氧的味道。每個參與這個實驗的角色都會受到 22（{@dice 5d8}）點閃電傷害並且根據角色所接觸的立石的魔法學派承受一個額外的效應，詳見立石效應表。烏巴盧克斯逃離監牢的最新嘗試失敗了。

english: Standing Stone Effects
zh_tw: 立石效應

english: School
zh_tw: 學派

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: Abjuration
zh_tw: 防護

english: You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the next 24 hours.
