zh_tw: 在接下來的 24 小時內，你的AC獲得+2 的加值。

english: Conjuration
zh_tw: 咒法

english: A {@creature monodrone} appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you and follows you around until it's destroyed. It is indifferent toward all creatures, including you.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature monodrone||單元冢}出現在你周圍 5 尺未被佔據的空間裡，並且會跟隨著你直到其被摧毀。它對所有的生物都漠不關心，包括你。

english: Divination
zh_tw: 預言術

english: You gain the benefits of a {@spell true seeing} spell for the next hour.
zh_tw: 你在接下來的 1 小時裡獲得{@spell true seeing||真知術}的效果。

english: Enchantment
zh_tw: 惑控

english: The standing stone casts {@spell confusion} on you (save {@dc 15}). The spell lasts for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 這塊立石對你釋放法術{@spell confusion||困惑術}（豁免{@dc 15}）。法術持續 1 分鐘。

english: Evocation
zh_tw: 塑能

english: The standing stone casts {@spell magic missile}, targeting you with five missiles.
zh_tw: 這塊立石對你釋放有 5 發飛彈的{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}。

english: Illusion
zh_tw: 幻術

english: An illusory swarm of harmless bats or pigeons (DM's choice) flutters over your head for the next hour. A {@spell dispel magic} cast on the swarm ends the effect.
zh_tw: 接下來 1 小時裡一群無害的蝙蝠或者鴿子幻影在你的頭頂盤旋。{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}可以結束這個效應。

english: Necromancy
zh_tw: 死靈

english: You also take 30 necrotic damage from the standing stone.
zh_tw: 你從立石上再受到 30 點暗蝕傷害。

english: Transmutation
zh_tw: 變化

english: Your skin turns blue for the next 24 hours. A {@spell remove curse} spell ends the effect on you.
zh_tw: 你在接下來的 24 小時裡皮膚變成藍色。{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}可以結束這個效應。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Dropping its disguise, the barlgura demon implores the characters to seek out Mephistopheles and return with an answer to his puzzle. The barlgura then gives them directions to a magic mirror (the Mirror of Mephistar) that can be used to gaze into Cania and contact the archdevil. If the characters win over Mephistopheles, Ubbalux promises to guide them to someone who can help them find the Bleeding Citadel.
zh_tw: 解除了他的偽裝，這隻惡猿魔乞求角色們去找到墨菲斯托費勒斯並且帶回他謎題的答案。然後這隻惡猿魔會給他們指出一個魔鏡（梅菲斯特之鏡）的方向，這個魔鏡可以用來窺見卡尼亞以及和那位魔鬼大公聯絡。如果角色們成功說服了墨菲斯托費勒斯，烏巴盧克斯承諾會帶著他們找到能夠幫忙找到湧血城砦的人。

english: Mirror of Mephistar
zh_tw: 梅菲斯特之鏡

english: {@i Mirror, mirror, made of ice—look within, but at what price}?
zh_tw: {@i 鏡子，鏡子，由冰製成，入眼亦是冰雪，但是——代價是什麼呢？}?

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A giant slab of ice is wedged at the end of this craggy ravine. Through its surface, you glimpse a glacial landscape draped in snow.
zh_tw: 一塊巨大的冰鑲嵌在這個崎嶇峽谷的盡頭。透過它的表面，你可以看到覆蓋著積雪的冰川景象。

english: Anyone who gazes into the surface of this 20-foot-tall mirror of ice sees their reflection as soulless, haggard, and encrusted with rime. This apparition stands in a frozen tundra, desolate save for a tower of ice far in the distance. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognize the tower as Mephistar, lair of the archdevil Mephistopheles.
zh_tw: 任何一個凝視著這面 20 尺高的冰鏡的人都會看到他們的倒影，那沒有靈魂、形容枯槁、覆著冰霜的倒影。這個倒影站在一片冰凍的苔原上，除了遠處的一座冰塔之外，只剩荒涼。成功透過一次{@dc 25}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色可以辨別出這座塔就是魔鬼大公墨菲斯托費勒斯的巢穴。

english: Any character who witnesses their reflection in the mirror must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. As they gaze {@condition stunned} into their reflection's eyes, Mephistopheles gains access to all their thoughts, fears, and knowledge, learning of their mission to retrieve Zariel's sword and free Elturel (see "Development" below).
zh_tw: 任何在鏡子中看到自己倒影的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 20}的智力豁免，否則將被{@condition stunned||震懾} 1 分鐘。當他們在{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態下凝視著他們倒影的眼睛時，墨菲斯托費勒斯就獲得了他們所有的想法、恐懼和知識，知曉了他們的任務——奪回扎瑞爾之劍，解放艾爾托瑞爾(請參閱下文的"發展")。

english: The Emissary
zh_tw: 使節

english: Shortly after arriving here, the characters see one of Mephistopheles's emissaries in the mirror: a {@creature cambion} named Rigorath. The emissary, only visible in the icy world beyond the mirror, swoops down from the direction of the tower. His skin is cadaver-blue, and his face is frozen in a scream. Rigorath holds a kettle of steaming water in one hand. Before speaking, he pours the boiling water over his face to thaw it out. After each utterance, the ice spreads over his face again, freezing into an expression of pained anguish.
zh_tw: 到達這裡不久之後，角色們會在鏡子裡看到墨菲斯托費利斯的使節之一：一名叫做瑞戈拉斯的{@creature cambion||坎比翁}。這位使節，只有在鏡子另一邊的冰雪世界才可見，他從塔的方向俯衝過來。他的皮膚如屍體般發青，一個吶喊的表情被凍結在他的臉上。瑞戈拉斯有一隻手拿著一壺熱氣騰騰的水。在說話之前，它會先把開水倒在他的臉上來解凍。在每說完一句話後，他的臉上就又泛起了一層冰，凍結出一種極度痛苦的表情。

english: Rigorath can perceive the characters though the mirror but can't pass through its surface, nor can the characters pass through the mirror or target Rigorath with spells or attacks. Rigorath tries to broker an infernal pact with the characters on behalf of his master Mephistopheles, offering them knowledge and power in return for their assistance:
zh_tw: 瑞戈拉斯可以透過鏡子感知到角色們但是不能穿過鏡子的表面，角色們當然也同樣不能穿過鏡子或者以瑞戈拉斯為目標釋放攻擊或者法術。瑞戈拉斯代表他的主人墨菲斯托費勒斯嘗試和角色們達成一份地獄契約，提供給角色們知識和力量作為他們協助的回報：

english: To fulfill their end of the bargain, the characters must dam the flow of the River Styx where it spills into a nearby slime-filled chasm (see "{@area Pit of Shummrath|20d|x}").
zh_tw: 為了履行他們的交易，角色們必須在冥河的水流中築起一道堤壩，在冥河水會流入附近一個充滿粘液的深坑的地方築起堤壩（請參閱"{@area 舒姆拉斯之坑|20d|x}"）。

english: If the characters fulfill their side of the bargain, Rigorath grants them rare knowledge: a secret they desire and a permanent +1 increase to each character's Intelligence or Wisdom score.
zh_tw: 如果角色履行了他們這邊的交易內容，瑞戈拉斯會給予他們珍稀的知識：一個他們渴望的秘密，與此同時每個角色的智力或者感知屬性永久+1。

english: Characters who came here from the Obelisk (see "{@area The Obelisk|203|x}") can bargain with Rigorath for the means to release Ubbalux from the standing stones. In this case, his terms are the same.
zh_tw: 從方尖碑(請參閱"{@area 方尖碑|203|x}")來到這裡的角色們可以與瑞戈拉斯交易以獲得從立石陣中釋放烏巴盧克斯的方法。在這種情況下，瑞戈拉斯提出的條款是一樣的。

english: Rigorath refuses to explain why Mephistopheles wants the River Styx dammed. His master is wary of angering Zariel and refuses to grant directions to the Bleeding Citadel. If the characters agree to Mephistopheles's pact, Rigorath etches the terms onto the surface of the mirror. The words form into chunks of ice on the group's side, which Rigorath instructs them to chisel off, melt, and then drink to seal the bargain.
zh_tw: 瑞戈拉斯會拒絕解釋為什麼墨菲斯托費勒斯要在冥河上築壩。他的主人擔心激怒扎瑞爾並會拒絕提供前往湧血城砦的路線。如果角色們同意了墨菲斯托費勒斯的契約，他就會把這些條款蝕刻在鏡子的表面上。這些字在角色們的這一邊形成了大塊的冰塊，瑞戈拉斯要求他們把這些冰塊鑿開，融化，然後喝下去以確保交易的成交。

english: To aid the characters with damming the River Styx, the emissary crafts an {@creature imp} out of snow, which hops through the mirror to join them. This imp has immunity to cold damage and carries a sling bag containing five {@item shatterstick|BGDIA|shattersticks} (see the "{@area Shattersticks|20c|x}" sidebar) that it can use to demolish the riverbank. The imp is focused on his task, dislikes procrastination, and spits shards of ice when annoyed. The imp can guide the characters to the chasm of the Pit of Shummrath.
zh_tw: 為了幫助角色們在冥河上築壩，使節用雪造出了一個{@creature imp||小魔鬼}，這隻小魔鬼會穿過鏡子加入角色們的隊伍。這個小魔鬼免疫寒冷傷害，並且帶著一個裝有五根{@item shatterstick|BGDIA|粉碎棒}的袋子（請參閱"{@area 粉碎棒|20c|x}"邊欄），它可以用來摧毀河岸。小魔鬼專注於它自己的任務，不喜歡拖延，生氣的時候就會吐出碎冰。小魔鬼可以引導角色們前往到舒姆拉斯之坑的峽谷口。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If Mephistopheles learns of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, the archdevil orders the imp to follow the group invisibly after it completes its demolition work and report back when they've located the Bleeding Citadel. At that point, Mephistopheles sends an {@creature ice devil} into Avernus with orders to murder the characters and steal the sword. If he gets the sword, Mephistopheles plans to use the artifact as leverage against Zariel in future dealings.
zh_tw: 如果墨菲斯托費勒斯知曉了{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的存在，這位魔鬼大公會命令小魔鬼在完成爆破工作之後隱形地跟著角色們的隊伍並且在他們到達湧血城砦時向他彙報。在那時，墨菲斯托費勒斯會將一個{@creature ice devil||冰魔}送到到達阿弗納斯，它被下了命令來殺死角色們以及偷走扎瑞爾之劍。如果他得到了扎瑞爾之劍，墨菲斯托費利斯計劃在未來的交易中使用這把神器作為對付扎瑞爾的手段。

english: Shatterstick
zh_tw: 粉碎棒

english: A shatterstick is a nonmagical, 12-inch-long, 4-pound stake made of blue-tinged infernal iron mined on Cania, the eighth layer of the Nine Hells. When embedded in earth or pounded into solid rock, the stake emits a seismic vibration in a 20-foot radius centered on itself for 1 minute, shaking the ground in that area for the duration. When the effects ends, the shatterstick breaks apart, becoming useless, and all structures within 20 feet of it take 35 ({@dice 10d6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 粉碎棒是一種非魔法的 12 寸長 4 磅重的棍子，由開採於九獄的第八層卡尼亞的泛藍煉獄鋼製成。當棍子嵌入泥土或被插進堅硬的岩石中時，它會在半徑 20 尺內以自身為中心發出一種持續一分鐘的地震振動，震動該範圍內的地面。當效應結束時，粉碎棒會碎裂並失去作用，它周圍 20 尺內的所有建築物都會受到 35（{@dice 10d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: Pit of Shummrath
zh_tw: 舒姆拉斯之坑

english: {@i Here you find a sticky situation. Poor Shummrath isn't the fiend it used to be}.
zh_tw: {@i 你會發現這裡黏糊糊的。可憐的舒姆拉斯再也不是它從前的樣子了。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A deep rift slashes across the surface of Avernus for as far as the eye can see. The canyon is over a mile deep and filled with a lake of green slime that undulates as though breathing. From a nearby cliff, a tributary of the River Styx cascades down into the slime.
zh_tw: 一道深峽斜跨阿弗納斯，直至視線不可及之處。峽谷有深度超過一英里，被如呼吸般起伏的綠色黏液湖水填滿。從附近的懸崖上，冥河的一條支流傾瀉而下，流入黏液中。

english: Dangling from a bent iron crane that leans out over the chasm is an iron cage containing a hairless, green-skinned humanoid wearing shackles on its ankles. The crane lowers the cage by a chain into the slime, immersing the creature in the goo for a minute before hoisting it back out. This dunking continues again and again, and the trapped creature seems helpless to stop it.
zh_tw: 一個裝著一名無毛，綠膚的類人生物的鐵籠懸掛在一座伸向峽谷上方的吊機上。吊機用鏈條把籠子降到黏液裡，把這個生物浸入黏液裡一分鐘，然後再吊出來。這種浸泡一次又一次的重複，而被困的生物似乎無力阻止。

english: Long ago, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} imprisoned a rival pit fiend named Shummrath at the bottom of this deep chasm. Over the years, Shummrath has been reduced to a fetid lake of slime. Ancient regenerative properties maintain some semblance of life within the sludge, allowing visitors to communicate with Shummrath telepathically. However, a tributary stream from the River Styx has spilled into his canyon and polluted the devil's mind. Shummrath now only retains thirty seconds of memory and conveys a single thought repeatedly.
zh_tw: 很久以前。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}把一個競爭對手，名叫舒姆拉斯的深獄煉魔，囚禁在這個深峽的底部。多年後，舒姆拉斯已經淪為一個惡臭的黏液湖。古老的再生特性在這些爛泥中維持了一些生命的表象，允許訪客與舒姆拉斯進行心靈感應溝通。然而，一條來自冥河的支流流入了他的峽谷，汙染了魔鬼的思想。舒姆拉斯現在只能保留 30 秒的記憶，並重復地表達一個念頭。

english: Those who establish communication with Shummrath discover that the devil repeats the same thought over and again: it failed to show proper deference to {@creature Bel|BGDIA} and will have its revenge. Shummrath can talk to the characters telepathically, but his mind unerringly loops back to this same vengeful thought.
zh_tw: 那些與舒姆拉斯建立聯絡的人會發現，魔鬼反覆地重複著同樣的念頭：它未能對{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}表現出完全的順從並將招致報復。舒姆拉斯可以用心靈感應的方式與角色對話，但他的思想卻總是無誤的回到同一個復仇執念上。

english: Imprisoned Ultroloth
zh_tw: 被囚禁的超等羅斯魔

english: When the characters arrive here, they spot an {@creature ultroloth} imprisoned in the iron cage suspended over the chasm. The iron crane has a magically powered winch mechanism that repeatedly dunks the cage into the goo, nearly drowning the prisoner with each submersion. The ultroloth, Baazit, is bound by {@item dimensional shackles} that prevent it from teleporting away.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這裡時，他們會發現一個被囚禁在峽谷上方懸吊著的鐵籠子裡的{@creature ultroloth||超等羅斯魔}。鐵製吊機有一個魔法驅動的絞盤置，不斷地把鐵籠泡進黏液，每次都差不多會把犯人淹死。這名尤格羅斯魔，巴茲特，被{@item dimensional shackles||次元鐐銬}束縛著，阻止它透過傳送越獄。

english: Baazit contacts the characters telepathically as soon as they're in range. The ultroloth was imprisoned by a pit fiend for stealing {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. Baazit promises to show the characters how to form magical servants from the goo if they free it. Baazit can also direct the group to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge (see "{@area Bel's Forge|251|x}").
zh_tw: 只要人物進入視野，巴茲特就會透過心靈感應聯絡他們。這名尤格羅斯魔因為偷了一枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}而被一個深獄煉魔囚禁起來。巴茲特承諾，如果這些角色釋放他，他將向這些角色展示如何利用這些黏液塑造魔法僕人。巴茲特還可以引導團隊前去去{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}鍛爐（參見"{@area 貝爾鍛爐|251|x}"）。

english: A character can jam the crane's winch with a crowbar or similar tool, preventing it from lowering or raising Baazit's cage. Once the cage stops moving, a character can try to use {@item thieves' tools|phb} to unlock the cage door, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also unlocks the cage door.
zh_tw: 一名角色可以用撬棍或類似的工具卡住吊機的絞盤，阻止它降低或升高巴茲特的籠子。一旦籠子停止移動，角色可以嘗試使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}來開啟籠子的門，這麼做需要一個成功的{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定，{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似的魔法也能開啟籠門。

english: Creating a Homunculus
zh_tw: 創造人工生命體

english: Characters can follow Baazit's instructions to scoop out a handful of the slime and spend an hour molding it into a tiny humanoid shape. At the end of this time, the slime animates as a loyal, lawful evil {@creature homunculus} made of dripping green jelly. Each character can only have one of these servants active at a time. If a character makes a second homunculus, the first one melts into a sticky puddle of inanimate goo.
zh_tw: 角色們可以按照巴茲特的指示，舀出一把黏液，花一個小時把它塑造成一個微型人工生命體。在這段時間結束後，黏液將被賦予獲利，成為一個忠誠的，由滴著液體的綠色膠狀物做成的守序邪惡{@creature homunculus||人工生命體}。每個角色同一時間只能啟用一個人工生命體。如果一個角色創造了第二個人工生命體，那麼第一個人工生命體就會融化成一灘失去活力的黏液。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who free or slay Baazit can claim the {@item dimensional shackles} that restrain it.
zh_tw: 釋放或殺死巴茲特的角色可以獲得束縛它的{@item dimensional shackles||次元鐐銬}。

english: Damming the Styx
zh_tw: 築壩冥河

english: If the characters are traveling with the ice imp (see "{@area Mirror of Mephistar|208|x}"), it leads them to the narrowest point of the Styx's tributary river and sets about hammering its five shattersticks into the rocky ravine walls (see the "{@area Shatterstick|20c|x}" sidebar). The imp asks the characters to stand guard while it works. As the imp places the shattersticks, eight {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} swoop down and attack. One minute after the last shatterstick is activated, the combined seismic activity of all the shattersticks triggers a huge rockfall that fills the gully, creating a dam.
zh_tw: 如果角色和冰小魔鬼（參見"{@area 梅菲斯特之鏡|208|x}"）一起旅行，它會把他們帶到冥河支流最狹窄的地方，並開始將它的五根粉碎棒錘入溝壑的巖壁（參見"{@area 粉碎棒|20c|x}"邊欄）。小魔鬼讓角色們在它工作的時候站崗。當小魔鬼設定碎石棒時，八個{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}會俯衝下來攻擊。在最後一根碎石棒被啟用一分鐘後，所有碎石棒的引起的地震聯動引發了巨大的山崩，填滿了河谷，形成了一座大壩。

english: With the polluted River Styx cut off from the chasm, Shummrath slowly starts to regenerate its mind and reform its body. After 48 hours, Shummrath reforms as a {@creature pit fiend} and flies off to wage war on his rival, {@creature Bel|BGDIA}. If the characters visit {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge later in the adventure (see "{@area Bel's Forge|251|x}"), they find it under siege from Shummrath's hastily mustered forces. The attackers are quickly overwhelmed, forcing Shummrath to retreat to some far corner of Avernus to escape {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s wrath.
zh_tw: 隨著峽谷中被汙染的冥河的截斷。舒姆拉斯開始緩慢地再生它的思想，重塑它的身體。48 小時後，舒姆拉斯重新變回了一隻{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}，隨後飛出峽谷並對他的死敵，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}開戰。如果角色在後續的冒險中訪問{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}鍛爐（參見"{@area 貝爾鍛爐|251|x}"）但攻擊者很快就被擊潰，迫使舒姆拉斯撤退到阿弗納斯的某個遙遠角落，以逃避{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的憤怒。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters successfully dam the River Styx, they can return to the Mirror of Mephistar to claim recompense. Rigorath the cambion tells them that Ubbalux must swear fealty to Mephistopheles to escape the standing stones. If Ubbalux does as Rigorath suggests, swearing its undying fealty to Mephistopheles, the archdevil makes it possible for the barlgura to escape.
zh_tw: 如果角色們成功地在冥河上築壩，他們可以回到梅菲斯特之鏡要求回報。魔裔瑞高拉斯告訴他們，烏巴盧克斯必須發誓效忠於墨菲斯托費勒斯，才能逃離這些站立的石頭。如果烏巴盧克斯像建議的那樣，發誓永遠效忠於墨菲斯托費勒斯，那麼魔鬼大公就有可能讓惡猿魔逃離立石。

english: If the characters return to the obelisk with the news, Ubbalux begrudgingly accepts these terms and reveals the location of the Crypt of the Hellriders on the players' map. Ubbalux says that the death knight Olanthius, guardian of the tomb, knows the secret location of the Bleeding Citadel. The demon also reveals that "For Glory" is the pass phrase to open to the catacombs, where many of Zariel's fallen comrades are interned.
zh_tw: 當角色帶著訊息回到方尖碑後，烏巴盧克斯會不情願地接受了這些條件，並在玩家的地圖上指出了地獄騎手墓穴的位置。烏巴盧克斯說，墳墓的守衛、死亡騎士奧蘭蘇斯知道湧血城砦的秘密位置。惡魔也揭示了"為了榮耀"是開啟地下墓穴的口令。那裡安葬著扎瑞爾的眾多陣亡戰友。

english: As the characters leave the obelisk, they witness Ubbalux swear fealty to Mephistopheles, whereupon black ice forms around the standing stones and causes them all to crack at once. Ubbalux is able to leave the ring of standing stones at that point, crying "Finally! I am free!" into the howling wind.
zh_tw: 當角色們離開方尖碑時，他們見證了烏巴盧克斯對墨菲斯托費勒斯宣誓效忠，隨之黑色冰塊圍繞立石形成，並使它們全部頓時開裂。烏巴盧克斯終於可以能夠離開那一圈立石，向著呼嘯的風嚎叫著"終於！我自由了！"

english: Crypt of the Hellriders
zh_tw: 地獄騎士之墓

english: {@i Zariel's fallen companions cannot rest. Nobody can in this nightmare hellscape}.
zh_tw: {@i 扎瑞爾墮落的同伴們無法安息。在這個可怕般的地獄，沒有人可以安息。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: Acrid smog swirls around a barren hill, rising from which like giant tombstones are a pair of leaning monoliths, each soaring more than fifty feet into the smoky red sky. Dozens of armored knights kneel in motionless reverence before the monoliths, between which a set of onyx steps leads down under the hill.
zh_tw: 刺鼻的煙霧在一座荒涼的小山上盤旋，那裡立著一對整塊石料製成的，傾斜的墓石，每一塊都超過五十尺高，直衝煙霧繚繞的紅色天空。數十名全副武裝的騎士在巨石前肅敬地跪倒在地，巨石之間有一條縞瑪瑙階梯通向山下。

english: The onyx steps descend into catacombs containing the remains of Hellriders who died fighting at Zariel's side. Their restless spirits yearn for peace yet are doomed to haunt this place until once more called to arms.
zh_tw: 縞瑪瑙臺階一直下到地下墓穴中，那裡埋葬著在扎瑞爾身邊戰鬥至死的地獄騎手的遺骸。他們無法安息的靈魂渴望平靜，然而卻註定要縛與此地，直到再次被徵召入伍。

english: Dozens of dead knights kneel before the monoliths, their foreheads resting on the pommels of their swords. The knights' armor serves as caskets for their bones, yet their corpses stay upright as though in prayer. Each knight wears the faded regalia of Elturel.
zh_tw: 數十名死去的騎士跪在巨石前，額頭抵在他們的劍柄上。騎士的盔甲成為了他們屍骨的棺材，而他們的屍體仍向在禱告中一樣脊樑挺直。每位騎士都身著艾爾托瑞爾那已褪色的禮服徽章。

english: Map 3.3: Crypt of the Hellriders
zh_tw: 地圖 3.3：地獄騎手的墓穴

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Encounters in the Crypt
zh_tw: 在墓穴裡的遭遇

english: The following descriptions correspond to areas marked on map 3.3. The entire crypt is terribly cold and wreathed in ankle-deep mist. All rooms and passages in the crypt are 10 feet tall and hewn from solid rock.
zh_tw: 下列描述適用地圖3.3所標示的地區。整個墓穴冷得可怕，並且籠罩在深及腳踝的霧氣中。墓穴裡所有的房間和通道都有 10 尺高，由堅固的岩石鑿成。

english: C1. Sealed Gates
zh_tw: C1. 封閉的大門

english: When the characters descend into the catacombs, read:
zh_tw: 當這些角色下到地下墓穴時，朗讀:

english: A pair of basalt doors block the passage ahead, their surfaces engraved with a relief of a knight locked in combat with a devil. Both wield burning swords.
zh_tw: 一扇雙開玄武岩大門擋住了前面的通道，它們的表面雕刻著一名被束縛的騎士正與魔鬼戰鬥的浮雕。雙方都揮舞著燃燒的劍。

english: The doors do not have visible handles, locks, or bolts, and they are magically locked, hardened, and enchanted to resist magic. Any spell cast to unlock, damage, or re-mold the doors automatically fails. Characters can use {@spell dimension door} or similar magic to get past the doors. They can also slip through the cracks between the doors if they have the magic to do so (such as the {@spell gaseous form} spell). Otherwise, they'll need the speak the pass phrase "For Glory" to proceed any farther. Characters can learn the pass phrase from Ubbalux the barlgura (as discussed in the "{@area Pit of Shummrath|20d|x}" section).
zh_tw: 大門沒有可見的把手、鎖或門閂，它們被魔法鎖住、加固並被附魔以抵抗魔法。任何被施放用來解鎖，傷害或改造門的法術都會自動失敗.角色可以使用{@spell dimension door||任意門}或類似的魔法來透過大門。他們也可以使用魔法（比如{@spell gaseous form||氣化形體}）從門縫裡溜進去。否則，他們將需要說出"為了榮耀"這句口令才能繼續前進。角色們可以從惡猿魔烏巴盧克斯（如前文所述的 "{@area 舒姆拉斯之坑|20d|x}"部分）。

english: If a character speaks the pass phrase aloud within 10 feet of the doors, the doors slowly grind open. The doors close on their own after 1 hour unless they are held or wedged open.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色在離門不到 10 尺的地方大聲說出口令，大門就會緩慢地吱呀作響地開啟。大門在 1 小時後自動關閉，除非它們是被撐開或用楔子固定。

english: C2. Funerary Chambers
zh_tw: C2. 葬禮室

english: There are several funerary chambers in the catacombs. When the characters enter one of these rooms, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 地下墓穴裡有幾個殯葬室。當這些角色進入其中一個房間時，向玩家們朗讀以下方框裡的文字：

english: Large iron burial urns are positioned reverently throughout this hall, each engraved with a noble coats-of-arms from the city of Elturel. Polished swords, lances, and shields hang from racks on the walls.
zh_tw: 大廳裡恭敬地擺滿了大量的鐵製骨灰翁，每一個上面都刻著一枚艾爾托瑞爾的貴族盾徽。光潔的槍劍和盾牌掛在牆壁的掛架上。

english: If a character says respectful words over the urns or disturb them in any way, three {@creature Ghost||ghosts} of Zariel's knights arise from their remains. The ghosts solemnly reveal the following information:
zh_tw: 如果一個角色對著骨灰盒唸誦禱詞或者以任何方式打擾了他們，那麼從他們的遺骸中就會出現三個扎瑞爾騎士的{@creature Ghost||幽魂}。這些幽魂肅穆地透露了以下資訊:

english: The knights fought and died alongside the angel Zariel when she waged war in Avernus.
zh_tw: 當天使扎瑞爾在阿弗納斯發動戰爭時，騎士們與她並肩戰鬥至死。

english: Zariel's crusade ended in failure. Most of their generals, including the angel herself, fell to evil and transformed into fiends.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的聖戰以失敗告終。大多數指揮官, 包括天使她自己, 墮入邪惡並被轉化成了邪魔.

english: One of Zariel's generals, Olanthius, killed himself rather than embrace tyranny. Zariel raised him as a death knight to ensure his loyalty.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的將軍之一奧蘭蘇斯寧願自殺，也不願擁抱暴政。扎瑞爾把他喚起為一名死亡騎士以確保他的忠誠。

english: The knights' souls are cursed to remain here. They yearn for the afterlife, but the oath they swore to Zariel binds them to her service. They beg the characters to help them find rest.
zh_tw: 騎士的靈魂被詛咒留在這裡。他們渴望來生，但對扎瑞爾的誓言卻將他們束縛於她的麾下。他們懇求角色們幫助他們獲得安息。

english: If the characters promise to help the ghosts achieve their final rest, the ghosts provide the following additional information:
zh_tw: 如果角色承諾幫助幽魂達成最終的安息，幽魂提供以下額外資訊：

english: Olanthius despises Zariel but is supernaturally bound to her service. The ghosts suggest there is still good in him.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯憎恨扎瑞爾，但被超自然地束縛、服務於她。幽魂暗示他內心仍存有善良。

english: Olanthius keeps quarters here in the catacombs. His rooms may contain evidence of his humanity that the characters can use to appeal to him.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯在地下墓穴裡有住處。他的房間裡可能有他仍包含人性的證據，可以用來打動他。

english: Once summoned, the ghosts remain by their urns until the characters leave the catacombs or free their souls. If a character defiles any remains, the ghosts use their Possession powers to drive the trespassers from the catacombs.
zh_tw: 一旦被召喚，幽魂就會滯留留在他們的骨灰甕裡，直到角色離開地下墓穴或解放他們的靈魂。如果一個角色玷汙了任何遺骸，幽魂就會用他們的附身能力把入侵者趕出地下墓穴。

english: C3. Knights' Caskets
zh_tw: C3. 騎士的棺材

english: When the characters approach one of these areas, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這些區域中任意一個時，請朗讀：

english: Recesses in the walls hold iron burial caskets. Each casket has a single, healthy red rose resting on its lid.
zh_tw: 牆壁上的壁龕裡放著鐵製的棺材。每口棺材的蓋子上都放著一朵鮮活的紅玫瑰。

english: Each of these corridors contains six caskets arranged in stacked pairs.
zh_tw: 這些走廊每一條都擺放了六具棺材，這些棺材成對堆疊。

english: Being entombed in Avernus has corrupted the spirits of these knights. Each casket contains a single {@creature wraith} magically held at bay by the rose laid on the casket. If a character removes a rose from a casket, the flower immediately withers and dies, and the wraith arises from the casket to attack any living creature or fiend that it sees. A wraith can't touch any of the roses on the other caskets.
zh_tw: 被埋葬在阿弗納斯已經腐蝕了這些騎士的靈魂。每個棺材裡都有一隻{@creature wraith||邪靈}，被放在棺材上的玫瑰魔法地遏制著。如果一個角色從棺材上取下玫瑰，這朵花就會立刻枯萎死亡，而邪靈則會從棺材裡出來攻擊它看到的任何活著的生物或邪魔。邪靈不能碰其他棺材上的玫瑰。

english: C4. Warlocks' Tomb
zh_tw: C4. 魔契師的墓穴

english: When the characters peer into this room, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們往這個房間裡窺視時，朗讀：

english: An iron urn heaped with human bones squats in an alcove at one end of this hall. On the wall nearby, a carved relief shows a column of mounted knights charging through a portal into a fiery hellscape.
zh_tw: 一個堆滿人骨的鐵製骨灰甕佔據在大廳一端的壁龕裡。在附近的牆壁上，雕刻的浮雕展示的是一隊騎馬騎士衝過傳送門進入火焰地獄的場景。

english: Zariel's warlocks helped build the Crypt of the Hellriders to gain infernal power in their mortal world. When they died, their cursed bodies were dragged into Avernus to guard the tomb for eternity. Eight {@creature mummy||mummies} now lurk inside this chamber and guard the path to the memorial steles. If the undead hear the characters elsewhere in the catacombs, they hide inside the large urn to the west. When the characters enter, they try to creep out silently and ambush them.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的魔契師透過協助建造地獄騎士的墓穴而在他們的凡人世界中獲得了地獄的力量。當他們死後，他們被詛咒的屍體被拖進了阿弗納斯，永世守護墳墓。八具{@creature mummy||木乃伊們}現在潛伏在這個房間裡，守衛著通往追悼碑林的道路。如果這些亡靈聽到了地下墓穴中其他地方的角色們的聲音，它們就會躲到西邊的大甕裡。當角色進入這裡時，它們會試圖悄無聲息地爬出來伏擊他們。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: One of the mummies carries a {@item wand of secrets}, and another wears a {@item necklace of fireballs}. If the characters defeat the undead, they can claim these items for themselves.
zh_tw: 其中一具木乃伊帶著一根{@item wand of secrets||探秘魔杖}，另一具則戴著{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}。如果角色們打敗亡靈，他們將這些物品歸為己用。

english: C5. Memorial Steles
zh_tw: C5. 追悼石碑

english: When the characters enter this room, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個房間時，朗讀:

english: Four memorial steles stand in this hall, each engraved with hundreds of names. A legend etched at the top of each stele reads, in Common: "Here lie the fallen. May their souls echo here until the end of time."
zh_tw: 四個追悼石碑矗立在這個大廳裡，每個石碑上都刻著數百個名字。每塊石碑的頂部都用通用語刻著這樣的文字:"戰死者沉眠此處。願其靈魂迴盪於此，直至湮滅。"

english: Adorning the wall across from the steles is a carved relief showing a solemn, blindfolded angel on the back of a mammoth with feathered wings. The mammoth is reared up on its hind legs, and the angel holds her sword high. All around them are the broken bodies of fallen knights and devils.
zh_tw: 碑林對面的牆上裝飾著一幅浮雕畫，畫中一名莊嚴，矇眼的天使騎在一頭生羽翼的猛獁象的背上，猛獁象用後腿立起身子，而天使高舉長劍，在她們周圍到處是陣亡騎士和魔鬼的破碎屍體。

english: Characters who use {@spell detect magic} or similar magic to examine the steles discern a strong aura of necromantic magic emanating from the engraved names.
zh_tw: 使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}或類似魔法來檢查石碑的角色，會察覺到這些雕刻的名字在放出強烈的死靈系靈光。

english: While the steles remain empowered, necrotic energy lashes out at anyone who touches them. A creature touching a stele must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@dice 8d8}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the soul-bound parchments in both ritual rooms (area C6) are destroyed, the steles deactivate. The characters can then free the warriors' souls by striking their names from the stone. As the names are removed, the knights' ghosts fade from view with gasps of relief. If all the names are struck from the stele, each character gains the benefit of a {@spell bless} spell that lasts for 24 hours.
zh_tw: 只要石碑還存有能量，任何接觸它們的人都會被黯蝕能量衝擊。一個生物觸碰任意一個石碑時必須進行一次{@dc 15} 的敏捷豁免，一次失敗的豁免檢定使角色受到 36 點（{@dice 8d8}）暗蝕傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。如果兩間儀式室（區域C6）中的魂縛紙稿被摧毀，石碑就會失效。然後，這些角色可以透過把從石碑上敲去戰士們的名字，來解放他們的靈魂。隨著名字被敲去，騎士們的幽魂隨著喘息聲從視線中逐漸消散。如果所有的名字都被從石碑上敲除，每個角色將在隨後 24 小時中獲得{@spell bless||祝福術}的增益效果。

english: C6. Ritual Rooms
zh_tw: C6. 儀式室

english: These two rooms are hidden behind secret doors. Characters with passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores of 15 or higher spot a secret door within 5 feet of them. Otherwise, a secret door can be found by a character who examines the surrounding wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 這兩個房間都藏在暗門後面，被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）為 15 或更高的玩家可以在暗門 5 尺內發現它，或者，一名角色可也以透過檢查周圍的牆壁並透過成功的{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定來找到一扇暗門。

english: These rooms are magically shielded against undead creatures, such that undead can't enter either room or even perceive its presence. Each ritual room appears to contain nothing more than ankle-deep mist. However, any character who explores a ritual room disturbs the mist enough to see features hidden underneath it:
zh_tw: 這些房間被魔法保護起來抵禦亡靈，這樣亡靈就不能進入任何一個房間，甚至不能感知它的存在。每個儀式房間似乎除了深及腳踝的薄霧外並無其他。然而，任何探索儀式房間，擾動霧氣的角色會看到隱藏其下面的事物：

english: As you disturb the ankle-deep mist, it parts to reveal a ritual circle daubed in blood on the floor. Hundreds of slivers of parchment are arranged within it, each tiny strip bearing a name written neatly in blood.
zh_tw: 當你撥開深及腳踝的迷霧，它被剝離以展現地板上的一個以鮮血繪成的儀式圓環。裡面排列著數百張羊皮紙片，每張小紙片上面都有一個用鮮血整齊書寫的名字。

english: The papers name every warrior interned in this place. Any character who has seen the steles in {@area area C5|220|x} can, with a successful {@dc 14} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, discern the papers' purpose: they bind the warriors' souls to the steles and compel them to serve Zariel in undeath by the terms of their original oath to her. By destroying the papers, the characters deactivate the memorial steles and can release the knights' souls from servitude (see {@area area C5|220|x} for details).
zh_tw: 這都些紙片寫出了每一個被拘禁在這裡的戰士的名字。任何在{@area 區域C5|220|x}見過碑林的角色，都可以透過成功的{@dc 14} 的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，來發現這些紙張的用途：它們將戰士的靈魂束縛石碑上，以迫使他們以亡靈的身份履行最初對扎瑞爾的誓言來為她服務。透過破壞這些紙條，這些角色可以使紀念石碑失效，並將騎士的靈魂從奴役中釋放出來（詳見{@area 區域C5|220|x}）。

english: C7. Olanthius's Retreat
zh_tw: C7. 奧蘭蘇斯的休息處

english: This room is hidden behind a secret door. Characters with passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores of 15 or higher spot the secret door once they get within 5 feet of it. Otherwise, it can be found by a character who examines the surrounding wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the characters open the secret door, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 這個房間藏在一扇暗門後面。被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）為 15 或更高的角色一旦進入到距離暗門 5 尺以內的地方，就會發現它。除此之外，它也可以被一個檢查周圍牆壁，並透過了{@dc 15} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色發現。如果角色開啟了暗門，請向玩家閱讀以下方框文字:

english: A stack of eight leather-bound journals rests atop a large writing table in this cramped chamber.
zh_tw: 在這個狹小的房間裡，一張大書桌上堆著八本皮革裝訂的日記。

english: The journals belong to Olanthius the death knight and are written in Common. Characters who spend a short rest poring over the journals learn the following information:
zh_tw: 這些日記屬於死亡騎士奧蘭蘇斯，並且是用通用語撰寫的。耗費一次短休仔細研究日記的人會瞭解到以下資訊：

english: Olanthius never recovered from Zariel's capitulation to Asmodeus and subsequent transformation into a devil. He blames himself for not seeing warning signs of Zariel's fall from grace early on—her single-minded determination to slay demons at all costs.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯從未從扎瑞爾向阿斯蒙蒂斯投降後又轉變成魔鬼的事中恢復過來。他責怪自己沒有及時注意到扎瑞爾墮落的徵兆——她一心要不惜一切代價去殺戮惡魔。

english: Olanthius took his life rather than face damnation, but he was transformed into an undead monster by Zariel to serve her forevermore.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯選擇了結了自己的生命而非面對詛咒，但他被扎瑞爾變成了一個不死的怪物永遠為她服務。

english: Olanthius describes Haruman, his one-time comrade in arms, as a heartless man bereft of compassion—now a devil bent on punishing anyone who stands in Zariel's way.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯把他曾經的戰友哈魯曼描述成一個失去同情心的無情之人——現在他是一個魔鬼，決心要懲罰任何擋了扎瑞爾的路的人。

english: Olanthius mourns the deaths of his fallen warriors and feels powerless to help them.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯為他死去的戰士們哀悼並感覺自己無力幫助他們。

english: Olanthius speaks well of General Yael, whom he clearly respects and secretly adores. In one journal, Olanthius hints that he knows where Yael hid the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} but fails to note the location.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯對雅艾爾將軍評價甚高，他顯然尊敬並暗地裡傾慕著她。在一本日記中，奧蘭蘇斯暗示他知道雅艾爾把{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}藏在哪裡，但卻沒有指出具體位置。

english: Olanthius Returns
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯歸來

english: If the characters desecrate any of the tombs or disturb the journals in {@area area C7|224|x}, Olanthius the {@creature death knight} returns to the crypt on a chariot pulled by two {@creature Gorgon||gorgons}. Olanthius is bound to protect the crypt and can be summoned from anywhere in Avernus to fulfill his duties. He descends below ground to hunt down intruders and interrogate them, leaving the gorgons and chariot outside.
zh_tw: 如果角色褻瀆了任何墳墓或翻閱了{@area 區域C7|224|x}的日記，{@creature death knight||死亡騎士}奧蘭蘇斯將乘坐由兩隻{@creature Gorgon||石化鐵牛}拉著的戰車返回墓穴。奧蘭蘇斯必須保護墓穴，而且會被從阿弗納斯的任何地方被召喚來履行他的職責。他下到地下追捕入侵者並審問他們，把石化鐵牛和戰車留在外面。

english: As Olanthius moves through the catacombs, he compels any ghosts he encounters to fight at his side. Any ghosts that the characters summoned from the urns in the funerary chambers ({@area area C2|219|x}) transform into {@creature Specter||specters} under Olanthius's command and join him on his hunt.
zh_tw: 當奧蘭蘇斯穿過地下墓穴時，他會強迫遇到的任何幽魂與他一同作戰。在奧蘭蘇斯的命令下，任何角色從殯葬室（見{@area 區域C2|219|x}）的骨灰甕中召喚出來的幽魂都會轉變成{@creature Specter||惡靈}並加入他的追捕。

english: Olanthius is an extraordinarily powerful foe for 9th-level characters. Fortunately, the characters can avoid combat with the death knight once they realize he's willing to help them.
zh_tw: 奧蘭蘇斯對於 9 級角色來說是一個非常強大的敵人。幸運的是，一旦他們意識到奧蘭蘇斯願意幫助他們，角色們就可以避免與死亡騎士戰鬥。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Characters who parley with Olanthius can gain a valuable ally in the fight against Zariel. To stand any chance of swaying the death knight to their cause, the characters must have read his journals and learned of his hatred for Zariel. Otherwise, he tries to annihilate them for their impudence.
zh_tw: 與奧蘭蘇斯談判的角色可以在與扎瑞爾的戰鬥中獲得寶貴的盟友。要想有機會把死亡騎士拉到他們一邊，角色們必須讀過他的日記，瞭解他對扎瑞爾的憎恨。否則，他會因為他們的冒失而試圖消滅他們。

english: Olanthius is willing to reveal the Bleeding Citadel's location only if the characters create a diversion to distract Zariel. The characters must seek out the demon lord {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}, who is imprisoned in Avernus and whose hammer Zariel stole. If freed, the demon lord is sure to want its weapon back, which should create the diversion that Olanthius needs.
zh_tw: 如果角色們可以創造一個轉移扎瑞爾注意力的誘餌，那麼奧蘭蘇斯願意透露出湧血城砦的位置。角色們必須找到惡魔領主{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}，他被囚禁在阿弗納斯，而他的錘子也被扎瑞爾偷走。如果被釋放，惡魔領主肯定會想要回他的武器，而這足以製造奧蘭蘇斯所需的誘餌。

english: The Arches of Ulloch can transport the characters to {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s Maw, where the demon lord is being held, provided the characters have a clear destination in mind as they pass through the arches. Olanthius provides directions to the Arches of Ulloch and can point to that location, as well as the location of {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s Maw, on the characters' map.
zh_tw: 烏洛克拱門可以將人物傳送到{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}巨口，也就是惡魔領主被關押的地方，前提是這些人物在穿過拱門時心裡有一個明確的目的地。奧蘭蘇斯為烏洛克拱門提供了方向，也會指出{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}的深淵在角色們的地圖上的位置。

english: Once {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} is released, the characters can report back to Olanthius at the Crypt of the Hellriders, whereupon he reveals the Bleeding Citadel's location.
zh_tw: 一旦{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}被釋放，角色們可以在地獄騎手的墓穴向奧蘭蘇斯報告，屆時他會揭示湧血城砦的位置。

english: Arches of Ulloch
zh_tw: 烏洛克拱門

english: {@i Only fools step through Ulloch's gates. They lead to nowhere a wise person wants to go}.
zh_tw: {@i 白痴才會踏過烏洛克拱門，他們會被扔到聰明人根本不想去的地方。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: Two ornate, black arches dominate the scorched landscape for miles, each one rising two hundred feet into the stiflingly hot air. Every inch of stonework is engraved with images of devils waging war against demons.
zh_tw: 兩座華麗的黑色的拱門主宰著數英里內焦土的景色，每一道都高達 200 尺，直衝悶熱雲霄。拱門到處都雕刻著魔鬼對抗惡魔的戰爭影象。

english: In forgotten times, archdevils used these twin arches to transport entire regiments to other planes of existence. The arches' magic has waned significantly, but there's still enough magic left in each one to transport creatures to another location in the Nine Hells. Characters who use a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic to examine the arches discern a powerful aura of conjuration magic around each one.
zh_tw: 在被遺忘的時代，魔鬼大公們利用這對拱門將魔鬼軍團傳送到到其他存在的位面。拱門的魔法現在已經顯著地減弱了，但是每個拱門殘存的魔法仍然足夠將生物傳送到九獄某處。使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法檢查拱門的角色，會發現強強烈的咒法系魔法靈光圍繞著每個拱門。

english: When a creature approaches within 100 feet of either arch, the stonework emits a loud, resonant hum that grows louder and higher in pitch as the creature draws closer. As a creature passes through an arch, a roaring sheet of flame fills the archway, teleporting the creature to another location in the Nine Hells. Any creature or object that passes through the arch while the portal is open is transported to the same destination. Each arch is wide enough to accommodate infernal war machines.
zh_tw: 當一個生物接近任一拱門 100 尺內時，石門會發出響亮的，共振的嗡嗡聲，並隨著生物的接近其聲音越來越大，聲調也會越來越高。當一個生物穿過一個拱門時，咆哮的火焰幕布會落下填滿拱門，將這個生物傳送到九獄的另一個地點。當傳送門開啟時，任何生物或物體透過拱門後都會被傳送到相同的目的地。每個拱門的寬度都足夠容納地獄戰爭機器。

english: To travel to a specific destination, a creature must have visited it before or be able to point to its location on a map. Characters who point to {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s Maw on their map as they pass through an arch are teleported to the top of the demon lord's prison-chasm.
zh_tw: 要前往一個特定的目的地，生物必須之前去過那裡，或者能夠在地圖上指出它的位置。在地圖上指出{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}的角色們在穿過拱門時會被傳送到這名惡魔領主的深坑監獄的上方。

english: If the characters fail to pick a destination, determine it randomly. Ask a player to roll a {@dice d20} on the poster map of Avernus. The location closest to where the die rests becomes the destination. If the die rolls off the map, the DM chooses a destination.
zh_tw: 如果角色沒有選擇目的地，那就隨機決定。讓一個玩家在阿弗納斯的海報地圖上投{@dice d20}。離骰子掉落點最近的位置就是目的地。如果骰子從地圖上滾落，則DM選擇一個目的地。

english: The portal remains open and fixed to the same destination for 10 minutes, after which it deactivates as the arch that created it crumbles and falls to the ground.
zh_tw: 傳送門保持開放和固定在同一目的地 10 分鐘後，它就會失去能量，因為製造它的拱門崩塌在了大地上。

english: Kostchtchie's Maw
zh_tw: 科斯徹奇巨口

english: {@i The enemy of my enemy is my friend, but does the same hold true for fiends}?
zh_tw: {@i 我敵人的敵人就是我的朋友，但這同樣適用於邪魔嗎？}?

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A dark chasm gapes between grumbling volcanoes that spew lava and smoke into the hateful sky. The air trembles with the bellowing of some monstrous creature in the dark depths of the chasm.
zh_tw: 一個黑暗的深坑在對著可憎天空噴湧巖漿的煙塵火山之間裂開。空氣隨著深坑的黑暗深處裡某個可怕生物的怒吼而顫抖。

english: The demon lord {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} resembles a squat hill giant with short, bandy legs and a grossly shaped head.
zh_tw: 惡魔領主{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}看起來像一個矮胖的山丘巨人，有著短粗的羅圈腿腿和非常巨大的腦袋。

english: Frost giants who forsake their gods and turn to demon worship can summon {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} with bloody offerings left on altars of hewn ice. If the demon lord chooses to answer the giants' call, he hunts and fights alongside them for a time, infecting the frost giants with savage madness and bloodlust before disappearing back to the Abyss. {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|Kostchtchie's} favored weapon is {@item Matalotok|BGDIA}, a warhammer forged by the frost giant god Thrym (see {@adventure appendix C|BGDIA|12} for more information about this legendary magic item).
zh_tw: 霜巨人如果拋棄了他們的神轉而去崇拜惡魔的話，就可以透過在冰雕的祭壇上留下血腥的祭品來召喚{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}。如果惡魔領主選擇回應巨人的召喚，他就會與巨人並肩戰鬥和捕獵一段時間，在返回深淵前令霜巨人染上野蠻的瘋狂和嗜血。{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}最喜歡的武器是霜巨人神索列姆鍛造的戰錘{@item Matalotok|BGDIA|瑪塔洛托克}（參見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}瞭解更多關於這個傳奇魔法物品的資訊）。

english: On his most recent visit to the Nine Hells, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} was defeated by the archdevil Zariel, who took his hammer and chained him at the bottom of this chasm, knowing that killing him would simply cause him to re-form on his icy layer of the Abyss. Without {@item Matalotok|BGDIA}, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s immunity to cold damage becomes resistance to cold damage.
zh_tw: 在他最近的一次九獄之旅中，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}被魔鬼大公扎瑞爾打敗了。她拿走了他的錘子，把他鎖在這個深坑的底部，因為扎瑞爾知道殺了他只會使他在深淵中屬於自己的冰冷位層裡重塑形體。沒有了{@item Matalotok|BGDIA|瑪塔洛托克}， {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}對寒冷傷害的免疫變成了對寒冷傷害的抗性。

english: Shackled by ever-tightening magical chains that prevent him from casting spells, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} squats in a 10-foot-deep, 80-foot-diameter pool of black tar in a cavern at the bottom of a chasm, his hands chained behind him. His unholy screams and vile epithets can be heard for miles. Characters who attempt to communicate with the demon lord are met with guttural cries of anguish and frustration. In sporadic moments of lucidity, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} glares at a character and bellows, "FREE ME!" or "BRING ME MY HAMMER!" in Giant first and Abyssal second. If that fails to garner the desired reaction, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} resorts to using telepathy to contact the nearest character, demanding its immediate release while offering nothing in return.
zh_tw: 為了防止他施展法術，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}被不斷收緊的魔法鎖鏈束縛著，只能蹲在深坑底部一個洞穴中一口深 10 尺、直徑 80 尺的黑瀝青池中，他的雙手被鎖在身後。幾裡外都能聽到他可怕的尖叫和邪惡的辱罵。試圖與惡魔領主溝通的角色將會承受歇斯底里的痛苦和沮喪地嚎叫。偶爾清醒的時候，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}會瞪著著角色先是用巨人語，然後是深淵語吼道："解放我!"或者"把我的錘子拿來！"。如果這還不能得到想要的反應，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}就會使用心靈感應來聯絡最近的角色，命令其立即釋放它且不求回報。

english: The Chasm
zh_tw: 深坑

english: The chasm descends to a depth of 500 feet. Although there are abundant handholds and footholds, the route to the bottom is steep and treacherous. Characters who can't fly must make {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to ascend or descend the chasm without climbing gear. If a check fails by 5 or less, the character makes no progress on their turn. If the check fails by more than 5, the character falls to the bottom of the chasm.
zh_tw: 深坑向下深度有 500 尺。雖然有許多手抓點和落腳點，但通往谷底的道路仍是陡峭而危險的。不能飛行的角色必須透過{@dc 15}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能在沒有攀爬裝備的情況下攀上或爬下深坑。如果檢定失敗的次數小於或等於 5 次，角色在他們的回合中停滯不前。如果檢定失敗的次數超過 5 次，角色就會掉落到深坑的底部。

english: Prison Guards
zh_tw: 監獄看守

english: A {@creature chain devil} named Mazer and four {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} guard the demon lord. If they detect intruders, the hounds pounce down from high caves as the devil emerges from the tar pit.
zh_tw: 一個名叫馬澤爾的{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}和四隻{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}看守著惡魔領主。如果它們發現入侵者，魔鬼會從瀝青坑裡浮出，而地獄犬會從高處的洞穴裡猛撲下來。

english: Mazer keeps {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s chains tight at all times. Hidden in the tar pit are dozens more chains (each 100 feet long) that Mazer can use its Animate Chains action to animate. Mazer uses these loose chains to bind enemies or drag them into the tar pit, which is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 馬澤爾一直把{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}的鏈條拴得緊緊的。在瀝青坑裡還藏著更多的鏈條(每條都有 100 尺長)，馬澤爾可以用它的活化魔鏈動作來操縱鏈條。馬澤爾使用這些鬆散的鏈條來捆綁敵人或把他們拖進瀝青坑中。這些瀝青坑是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}

english: If the chain devil dies, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}'s chains loosen enough for the demon lord to break free of them. Once free of its chains, the demon lord regains his spellcasting abilities.
zh_tw: 如果鏈魔死了，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}的鎖鏈就會變鬆到足以使惡魔領主掙斷它們。一旦擺脫了鎖鏈，惡魔領主就會恢復他的施法能力。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} is freed, the he cries out to Zariel (in Giant) that he's coming for his hammer and swears to crush her with it. He then casts {@spell wind walk}, which turns him into a cloudy form with an astonishingly fast flying speed of 300 feet. In this form, he travels with great haste across Avernus, determined to get his hammer back. Characters swift enough to follow in his wake are led to Zariel (see {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8}).
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}被釋放了，然後他就會用巨人語向扎瑞爾大吼他將會去取回他的戰錘，併發誓用錘子把扎瑞爾砸爛。然後，他施展{@spell wind walk||御風而行}，這將使他變成一種有著 300 尺驚人飛行速度的雲霧形態。以這種形態，他以極快的速度穿越阿弗納斯，決心要拿回他的錘子。速度足以尾隨其後的角色會被帶向扎瑞爾處（見{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}）。

english: With {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} freed, the characters can return to the Crypt of the Hellriders, where Olanthius dutifully reveals the location of the Bleeding Citadel (see {@adventure chapter 4|BGDIA|7}). As the characters leave the catacombs, he asks them to give his love to Yael when they see her.
zh_tw: 隨著{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}獲得自由，角色可以回到地獄騎手的墓穴，那裡奧蘭蘇斯誠實地指示出湧血城砦的位置（見{@adventure 第四章|BGDIA|7}）。當人物離開地下墓穴時，他會請求他們在看到雅艾爾時向她轉達他的愛。

english: Chapter 3: Avernus - Path of Devils
zh_tw: 第3章：阿弗納斯 - 魔鬼之路

english: Demon Zapper
zh_tw: 滅魔器

english: Diagram 3.3: Path of Devils
zh_tw: 圖表 3.3：魔鬼之路

english: {@i The purest of souls lures fiends into a hellish trap. Zap! Zap}!
zh_tw: {@i 最純潔的靈魂將引誘邪魔進入地獄陷阱。 砰！ 砰}!

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters approach this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當玩家接近此處時，請向玩家閱讀或轉述以下的文字：

english: Radiant light cascades from a rusted metal monument shaped like the upraised mandibles of a giant beetle.
zh_tw: 明亮的光簾從一座形似巨甲蟲抬起的下顎的生鏽金屬遺蹟中射出。

english: The light cascades from a {@creature unicorn} named Mooncolor, who is trapped inside a 10-foot-diameter sphere of magical force that prevents any matter from passing into it and blocks any spells cast into or out of it. The sphere is suspended between the zapper's spines, 50 feet above the ground. This light lures demons like moths to a flame, annihilating them when they get close. While trapped in the sphere, the unicorn can't use any of its magical abilities.
zh_tw: 光簾來自一隻名為月華的{@creature unicorn||獨角獸}，它被困在直徑 10 尺的魔法力場球體內，該球能阻止任何物質進入其中，並阻止任何法術進入或從中放出。球體懸掛在地面上方 50 尺處滅魔器的棘突之間。這種光輝像飛蛾撲火般誘使惡魔接近，在它們靠近時將其消滅。獨角獸被困在球體中時，無法使用其任何魔法能力。

english: The sphere targets the nearest fiend that moves within 100 feet of it, discharging a beam of radiance that forms a line 5 feet wide and up to 100 feet long, extending to the target. Any creature in the line that has 100 hit points or fewer disintegrates into a pile of ash. Creatures with more than 100 hit points in the line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 260 ({@dice 40d12}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once the demon zapper has fired, it must recharge for 1 minute before it can fire again.
zh_tw: 該球體會對進入 100 尺內，最接近它的邪魔為目標，它會釋放出一道 5 尺寬，100 尺長的光耀束，直達目標。生命值等於或小於 100 的生物都會被光線分解成一堆灰燼。生命值超過 100 的生物必須進行{@dc 18}的敏捷豁免，失敗需承受 260（{@dice 40d12}）的光耀傷害，成功則造成一半的傷害。滅魔器攻擊後，必須充能 1 分鐘才能再次射擊。

english: To free the unicorn, the characters must destroy the rusted metal structure around it, which has AC 14, 250 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The structure crumbles when it drops to 0 hit points, causing the sphere of force to slowly sink to the ground and fade away. If the characters free the unicorn, it accompanies them if they are of mostly good alignment.
zh_tw: 要釋放獨角獸，角色必須摧毀其周圍生鏽的金屬結構，該結構有AC 14，250 生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。該金屬結構在下降到 0 點生命時會崩塌，導致魔法力場球緩慢沉向地面並逐漸消失。如果角色們釋放了獨角獸，而隊伍又主要由善良陣營組成時，它會伴隨角色們一同旅行。

english: Ralzala the Dao
zh_tw: 土巨靈拉爾薩拉

english: A {@creature dao} named Ralzala defends the demon zapper. Ralzala swore loyalty to Zariel to gain revenge against a rival dao who tried to ruin her. The dao regrets the arrangement and wants to break her pact with the archdevil.
zh_tw: 一名被稱為拉爾薩拉的土巨靈{@creature dao||土巨靈}守護著滅魔器。拉爾薩拉發誓效忠扎瑞爾，以報復企圖毀滅她的敵對土巨靈。 拉爾薩拉對這個決定開始感到後悔，並想打破與魔鬼大公的契約。

english: Ralzala hides under the ground at the base of the zapper. If the characters damage the zapper, Ralzala emerges from the ground, casts {@spell tongues}, and offers them a deal. She reveals that the deposed archdevil {@creature Bel|BGDIA} would gladly aid the characters in overthrowing {@creature Archduke Zariel of Avernus|BGDIA|Zariel}. If the characters help Ralzala break her pact with Zariel, the dao promises to direct them to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Forge and write them a letter of introduction.
zh_tw: 拉爾薩拉藏在滅魔器的地基下。如果玩家攻擊滅魔器，拉爾薩拉就會從地面浮現，施放{@spell tongues||巧言術}，並向玩家提出交易。她透露被罷黜的魔鬼大公{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}很樂意幫助角色推翻{@creature Archduke Zariel of Avernus|BGDIA|扎瑞爾}。如果玩家幫助拉爾薩拉打破與扎瑞爾的契約，那土巨靈將會承諾指引他們前去{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}鍛爐，並給他們寫介紹信。

english: Ralzala knows an oracle named Red Ruth, who could surely divine a solution to her problem. Being bound to the demon zapper, Ralzala is unable to seek out this oracle herself, but the characters could do so in her stead. She tells them to speak with Red Ruth in the corrupted forest nearby and follow her instructions to break the pact. This leads the players to the {@area Bone Brambles|233|x}.
zh_tw: 拉爾薩拉認識一個名叫紅露絲的預言家，她肯定可以用占卜為她的問題找到解決方案。拉爾薩拉被守衛滅魔器的命令束縛了，無法親自尋找這個先知，但玩家可以代替她完成這件事。她希望冒險者到附近的腐化森林中與紅露絲交談，並按照她的指示破壞契約。這將引導玩家進入{@area 骨棘林|233|x}。

english: Bone Brambles
zh_tw: 骨棘林

english: {@i Your future is written in your blood. She'll open your veins to paint the story hidden in your heart}.
zh_tw: {@i 你的未來被寫在你的血液裡。她會剖開你的血管，繪出隱藏在你心中的故事。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A maze of warped trees and bonelike vines stretches before you. Calcified corpses merge with the trees, covered in fungal pods that feed on the blood oozing through the undergrowth. Here and there, narrow paths wend deeper into the wood.
zh_tw: 在你們面前的是由扭曲的樹木和白骨似的藤蔓形成的迷宮。鈣化的屍體與樹木融合在一起，被覆蓋在吸食下方滲出的鮮血的真菌莢孢下。各處都有狹窄的道路深入到樹林中。

english: In a bygone age, the night hag Red Ruth corrupted a community of dryads by fouling the roots of their trees with mind-bending poison. As the dryads fell to evil, their forest was wrenched from the Feywild into Avernus. Those dryads who resisted the poison died trying to merge back into their trees. The rest crumbled to ash and became restless, tortured spirits akin to banshees. Contented, Red Ruth made her home at the heart of the twisted wood.
zh_tw: 在很久以前，夜鬼婆紅露絲透過使用扭曲心神的毒藥來腐化樹精與之相連的根鬚，進而汙染整個樹精族群。當樹精們墮入邪惡時，他們的森林也被扭曲，從妖精荒野墜落到阿弗納斯中。那些抵抗住毒性的樹精在試圖重新融入他們的樹木時都死了。其餘的樹精肉體破碎成灰而靈魂變成類似報喪妖的永無安息、飽受折磨的靈魂。滿足的紅露絲將她的家安在了扭曲森林的中心。

english: The characters can venture into the wood out of curiosity or to find the oracle that Ralzala hopes can break her pact with Zariel.
zh_tw: 玩家可以因好奇而冒險進入樹林，或者尋找拉爾薩拉口中能夠打破與扎瑞爾契約的預言家而來。

english: Encounters in the Brambles
zh_tw: 骨棘林中的遭遇

english: Map 3.4: Bone Brambles
zh_tw: 地圖 3.4：骨棘林

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: The following descriptions correspond to areas marked on map 3.4.
zh_tw: 以下描述對應於地圖 3.4 上標記的區域。

english: B1. Entrances
zh_tw: B1. 入口

english: Characters who circle the tangled stretch of woodland uncover five separate paths leading into its interior. Impassable brambles choke the woodland outside these trails and even grow overhead to blot out the sky.
zh_tw: 環繞這片蔓延糾結的林地的角色會發現通向其內部的五條獨立路徑。無法穿越的荊棘堵死了小徑之外的林地，它們甚至長到半空遮蓋住了天空。

english: To avoid getting lost in the wood, the characters must succeed on a {@dc 15} group Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. On a success, the characters locate Red Ruth's lair at the heart of the woodland ({@area area B3|23c|x}). If they fail, they blunder into one of the dead ends listed below (area B2) and must make the check again when they move on. Once all four dead ends have been explored, the group automatically locates Red Ruth's lair.
zh_tw: 為避免在林中迷路，玩家必須透過{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。成功後，角色將在林地中心（{@area 區域B3|23c|x}）找到紅露絲的巢穴。如果他們失敗了，他們就會走進下面所列的死衚衕之一（區域B2），並且在繼續前進時再進行進行檢定。如果所有四個死衚衕都被探索過了，隊伍便自動找到了紅露絲的巢穴。

english: B2. Dead Ends
zh_tw: B2. 死衚衕

english: If the characters get lost in the brambles, roll on the Dead Ends table to determine where they end up, or choose a result that they haven't encountered yet.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在荊棘林中迷路了，請在根據"死衚衕"表擲骰以確定其在哪裡停下，或選擇一個它們尚未遭遇的擲骰結果。

zh_tw: 死衚衕

zh_tw: d4

zh_tw: 死衚衕

zh_tw: 死去的旅行者

zh_tw: 樹精靈魄
