zh_tw: 蔓生怪

english: Thorn trap
zh_tw: 荊棘陷阱

english: Dead Traveler
zh_tw: 死去的旅行者

english: The corpse of a drow rests at the end of the path, her flesh impaled by hungry vines and her face twisted in an expression of horror. The traveler wears a {@item bag of devouring} on a strap.
zh_tw: 一名卓爾的屍體躺在小路的盡頭，飢渴的藤蔓刺穿了她的肉體，她的面容因恐懼而扭曲。這名旅行者身上用帶子繫著一個{@item bag of devouring||吞噬袋}。

english: Dryad Spirits
zh_tw: 樹精靈魄

english: Three cursed dryad spirits (use the {@creature banshee} stat block to represent them) approach the characters and demand to be reminded of the "wonders of life." At your discretion, a character can mollify the spirits with a sweet story, a kiss, a song, or anything else that reminds the dryads of home. If the characters fail to satisfy them, the three spirits attack.
zh_tw: 三個被詛咒的樹精靈魂（它們使用{@creature banshee||報喪妖}的面板）接近冒險者並請求他們喚起她們對"生命的美好"之回憶。根據您的判斷，他們可以透過甜蜜的故事，親吻，歌曲或任何其他讓樹精回想起她們的家園的事物來撫慰她們的心靈。如果角色們不能滿足她們，樹精們就會進攻。

english: Shambling Mounds
zh_tw: 蔓生怪

english: Three {@creature Shambling Mound||shambling mounds} arise from the brambles and attack the characters.
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Shambling Mound||蔓生怪}從荊棘中殺出，攻擊角色們。

english: Thorn Trap
zh_tw: 荊棘陷阱

english: The characters spot a hawthorn staff entangled at the end of the path, buried behind a 15-foot-deep thicket of thorns. Each 5-foot-square section of thorns counts as {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and has AC 11, 15 hit points, immunity to psychic damage, and vulnerability to fire damage. If damaged but not destroyed, the thorns magically regrow to full health after 24 hours. The thorns restrain any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of them. Any creature that starts its turn {@condition restrained} by the thorns takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) slashing damage from the writhing barbs. Once a creature is entangled, it can break free only if all the thorn bushes within 5 feet of it are destroyed.
zh_tw: 角色發現一根山楂木法杖被糾纏在小路盡頭，埋在 15 尺深的荊棘叢中。每個 5 尺方格的荊棘區都被視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，並具有AC 11、15 生命，免疫心靈傷害並對火焰傷害易傷。如果受損但未被摧毀，荊棘會在24 小時後滿血回覆。荊棘將任何於其 5 尺內結束回合的生物{@condition restrained||束縛}。任何被荊棘束縛的生物在開始回合時都因扭動的倒刺而受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點揮砍傷害。一旦荊棘糾纏住一名生物，只有摧毀了其 5 尺內的所有荊棘叢，他才能掙脫。

english: The staff at the center of the maze is a decoy and crumbles to ashes in the hands of whoever claims it.
zh_tw: 迷宮中心的法杖是一個誘餌，在被任何人握在手中時會變成灰燼。

english: B3. Red Ruth's Lair
zh_tw: B3. 紅露絲的巢穴

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A cave-like hovel lies at the center of the maze. Hundreds of bones and body parts hang by twine from the entrance, and the ceiling is strung with garland made of bloody entrails. The air buzzes with flies.
zh_tw: 迷宮中央有一個類似洞穴的小屋。成百上千的骨頭和軀體零件用繩子吊在入口處，天花板上掛滿了由血淋淋的腸子製成的花環。蒼蠅在空中嗡嗡飛舞。

english: Red Ruth, a {@creature night hag}, makes her lair inside this gory den. She wears a dress made from stitched-together bones. Strings of infants' skulls hang around her neck and chatter nursery rhymes incessantly (and in different languages) as she talks.
zh_tw: {@creature night hag||夜鬼婆}紅露絲把她的巢穴放在在這個血腥小屋裡。她穿著由骨頭縫合在一起製成的連衣裙。由嬰兒顱骨串成的項鍊掛在她的脖子上，在她說話時不停地唱著各種童謠（用不同的語言）。

english: Evil visitors from all over the multiverse travel to Avernus to hear Red Ruth's divinations and sample her mystical brews. If the characters talk to Red Ruth about the dao's curse, she offers them a deal for her assistance (see "{@area Hold the Fort|23e|x}" below).
zh_tw: 來自全多元宇宙的邪惡拜訪者前往阿弗納斯聆聽紅露絲的預言並品嚐她神秘的釀造品。如果角色與紅露絲談論土巨靈的詛咒，她會向冒險者們提出一個交易以換取她的幫助（請參閱下面的"{@area 堅守陣地|23e|x}"）。

english: Red Ruth sells potions brewed from blood, which she gladly trades for {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} as listed on the Red Ruth's Bargains table. Each potion imparts an unpleasant but harmless side effect when imbibed: flatulence, boils, hair loss, or any other ghastliness you can conceive. Her divinations replicate the effects of a {@spell commune} spell, although Red Ruth provides the answers to the questions without needing to appeal to a divine being.
zh_tw: 紅露絲出售用血液釀造的藥水，她很樂意將藥水用{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}以"紅露絲特賣品"表格中所列價格出售。每種藥水都被告知在服用時都會帶來不悅但無害的副作用：例如脹氣，膿腫，脫髮或您設想的糟糕作用。她的占卜等同{@spell commune||通神術}的效果，但紅露絲能無需向神靈祈求而提供問題的答案。

english: Red Ruth's Bargains
zh_tw: 紅露絲特賣品

english: Goods
zh_tw: 商品

english: Price
zh_tw: 價格

english: Potion, common or uncommon
zh_tw: 藥水，普通或非普通

english: 1 {@item soul coin|BGDIA}
zh_tw: 1 {@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}

english: Potion, rare
zh_tw: 藥水，珍稀

english: 2 {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}
zh_tw: 2 {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}

english: {@spell Commune} spell
zh_tw: {@spell Commune||通神術}

english: 3 {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}
zh_tw: 3 {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}

english: Hold the Fort
zh_tw: 堅守陣地

english: Red Ruth says she knows how to free Ralzala the dao from her pact, but she won't tell the characters until they've performed a favor for her first. The hag explains that she's long overdue for her bath—it's been a couple of centuries at the very least since she last washed. She asks the characters to arrange and pay for a pampering session at Infernal Rapture in the {@area Wandering Emporium|297|x}. She warns the characters of one other condition before they decide: they must watch over her grove while she's gone. If the characters attack or threaten Red Ruth during this negotiation, she simply slips away into the Ethereal Plane and doesn't return until they leave.
zh_tw: 紅露絲說她知道如何從魔鬼契約中解救土巨靈拉爾薩拉 ，但除非角色們先幫他一個小忙不然她不會告訴他們。鬼婆說，她早就想泡個澡了——自從她上次洗澡以來，至少已經過去了數個世紀。她要求冒險者在流浪商城的地獄極樂中安排併為一次精緻護理洗浴付款（{@area 流浪商城|297|x}）。她在冒險者作出決定前，警告他們還有一個額外的條件：他們必須在她走後照看她的林地。如果玩家在協商過程中攻擊或威脅紅露絲，她就會溜進以太位面，直到他們離開後才返回。

english: The night hag can divine the location of the Wandering Emporium by spilling some of her own blood on the ground and studying the pattern that the blood makes. Red Ruth can then point to a location on the character's map of Avernus. (The location can be anywhere you choose.) When the characters arrive at that location, they encounter the Wandering Emporium just as the night hag predicted. Although Red Ruth knows that the owner of Infernal Rapture is a rakshasa, she doesn't share this information with the characters, expecting them to figure it out on their own.
zh_tw: 夜鬼婆可以透過將自己的一些血液灑在地面上，並研究血液形成的圖案來判斷流浪商城的位置。然後，紅露絲可以指向玩家阿弗納斯地圖上的某個位置。（該位置可以是您選擇的任何位置），當他們到達該位置時，他們會像夜鬼婆所預測的那樣遇到流浪商城。儘管紅露絲知道地獄極樂的擁有者是一隻羅剎，但她沒有向玩家分享此資訊，期望他們可以自己查清這件事。

english: Characters who return from the Wandering Emporium with confirmation of Red Ruth's appointment must watch over the grove for a few hours while the hag leaves to take her bath. During this time, the cursed spirits of the dryads arise to destroy Red Ruth's lair as punishment for her crimes. This force consists of two dryad spirits (use the {@creature banshee} stat block) and a walking, {@creature undead tree|BGDIA} (use the {@creature treant} stat block, except the tree is undead and has resistance to necrotic damage).
zh_tw: 從流浪商城返回並帶回紅露絲的預約確認函的玩家們必須在鬼婆離開去洗浴時待在樹林看守數小時。在這段時間裡，樹精們被詛咒的靈魂會現身併為了懲罰她所犯的罪行而摧毀紅露絲的巢穴。這波襲擊包括兩個樹精靈魂（使用{@creature banshee||報喪妖}面板）和一棵行走的{@creature undead tree|BGDIA|不死樹}（使用{@creature treant||樹人}面板，除了它是不死生物並且具有對暗蝕傷害的抗性）。

english: If the characters defeat the undead, Red Ruth fulfills her end of the bargain when she returns. Otherwise, the {@creature undead tree|BGDIA} collapses the entrance to Red Ruth's hovel. The night hag is not pleased and uses her Etherealness trait to walk through the collapsed entrance of her cave, disappearing into her lair without so much as a goodbye.
zh_tw: 如果角色擊敗了亡靈，紅露絲回來時便會履行交易中她的許諾。否則，{@creature undead tree|BGDIA|不死樹}會弄塌紅露絲小屋的入口。這會使夜鬼婆不悅，並利用她的以太化特性穿入她入口塌陷的小屋，一句話也沒有說就消失在她的巢穴中。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The dryad spirits have no treasure, but the {@creature undead tree|BGDIA} has a dead gnome skeleton lodged in a hollow cavity in its trunk. The skeleton wears a witch's hat (actually a {@item hat of disguise}) and clutches a {@item +1 wand of the war mage}.
zh_tw: 樹精的靈魂沒有攜帶任何寶藏，但{@creature undead tree|BGDIA|不死樹}的樹幹中有一個空洞，內裡有一個死掉侏儒的骨架。骷髏戴著一頂巫婆帽（實際上是{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}），並抓著一根{@item +1 wand of the war mage||+1 戰法師魔杖}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: To honor her end of the deal, Red Ruth reveals that Ralzala must drink the blood of a titan to free herself from Zariel's pact. The night hag says that Uldrak might be able to help but warns "he's not what he used to be." If the characters show her their map, she identifies Uldrak's location. This sends the group to Uldrak's Grave.
zh_tw: 為了遵守她的契約義務，紅露絲指明拉爾薩拉必須飲下泰坦之血，才能擺脫扎瑞爾的契約。夜鬼婆表示烏爾德拉克也許可以提供幫助，但警告說"他已經不是以前的他了"。如果玩家向她展示他們的地圖，則她會為他們指出烏爾德拉克的位置。這會將隊伍帶到烏爾德拉克之墓。

english: Uldrak's Grave
zh_tw: 烏爾德拉克之墓

english: {@i A fallen titan or a wimp with delusions of grandeur? I'll leave that for you to decide}.
zh_tw: {@i 是墮落的泰坦還是有著自大幻想的懦夫？我把這個決定留給你}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: The cracked helm and sword of a titan lies half buried in the ash of Avernus. A spherical stone set into the sword's pommel still gleams with scarlet radiance.
zh_tw: 泰坦破碎的頭盔和巨劍半埋在阿弗納斯的灰燼中。鑲嵌在劍柄末端的球形石頭仍然閃爍著猩紅色的光芒。

english: The {@creature empyrean} Uldrak quested into the Nine Hells to slay {@creature Tiamat|RoT} and win glory for his deity, Surtur, but he was beaten handily by the dragon queen. The empyrean wasn't slain; instead, Tiamat cursed him for his impudence by transforming him into a {@creature spined devil}. This wretched creature now hides inside the helmet that he once wore. For millennia, Uldrak has dwelled in this spot, forlornly plotting to restore his true form.
zh_tw: {@creature empyrean||至高天}烏爾德拉克被下達前往九獄，殺死{@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}併為他的神祇蘇爾特贏得榮耀的任務，但他被龍後輕而易舉地擊敗。至高天並沒有被殺死。恰恰相反，提亞馬特因他的無禮將他詛咒，把他變成了一個{@creature spined devil||棘魔}。這個可憐的生物現在藏在他曾經佩戴的頭盔內。幾千年來，烏爾德拉克一直居住在這個地方，孤零零地謀劃著恢復他真實形態的方法。

english: Dealing with Uldrak
zh_tw: 與烏爾德拉克交涉

english: Uldrak is a bitter creature who barely remembers his past. Long ago, he learned how to remove his curse, but the solution was so beyond him that he consigned himself to failure. Now, he's more interested in scrabbling to survive than trying to escape the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 烏爾德拉克是一隻幾乎不記得他的過去的滿腔憤恨的生物。很久以前，他已知道如何消除詛咒的方法，但是這個方法遠超他所能，因此他便沉淪失敗命運。現在，他比起逃出九獄更想掙扎求生。

english: Uldrak's empyrean heritage still lingers in his voice. He understands all languages, and when he speaks, he randomly switches language to Giant. Millennia of isolation have unhinged his mind, so he argues with himself often, even in front of strangers.
zh_tw: 烏爾德拉克的至高天遺澤仍然留在他的聲音中。他理解所有語言，並且說話時會隨機地將語言切換為巨人語。幾千年的孤獨使他精神錯亂，他經常與自己爭論，即使是在陌生人面前。

english: Uldrak reveals his sorry tale to any who ask him about the empyrean's whereabouts. Characters who came here to extract Uldrak's blood (see "{@area Bone Brambles|233|x}," above) can make a {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check when they learn that Uldrak is now a fiend. On a success, they hypothesize that the blood must be drawn from his titan form to break the dao's curse. Thankfully, Uldrak has a plan (see "Development" below).
zh_tw: 烏爾德拉克向任何詢問至高天下落的人透露他自身的不幸故事。當來到這裡抽取烏爾德拉克血液的角色（見"{@area 骨棘林|233|x}"）得知烏爾德拉克現在是一隻邪魔時，可進行{@dc 12}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，成功則可推斷必須從他的泰坦形態中抽血才可打破土巨靈的詛咒。幸運的是，烏爾德拉克已經有了一個計劃（請參見下面的"發展"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The sphere set into the pommel of Uldrak's sword is an {@item orb of dragonkind}. This item is vital to Uldrak's plan to free himself from his curse.
zh_tw: 鑲嵌在劍柄末端的球形石頭實際上是{@item orb of dragonkind||龍珠}。該物品對於烏爾德拉克擺脫詛咒的計劃至關重要。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: To regain his true form, Uldrak must spill some of Tiamat's blood on the ground of Avernus. Fighting Tiamat in his present form would be madness, but Uldrak has learned that a dragonborn named {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} carries some of Tiamat's blood in a reliquary around his neck. Uldrak reveals that the "gem" glowing on the pommel of his old sword is in fact an {@item orb of dragonkind}—an item sure to be of interest to Arkhan. He urges the characters to trade the orb to Arkhan for the reliquary and then return here. If the characters agree, Uldrak gives them directions to Arkhan's Tower.
zh_tw: 為了恢復自己的真實形態，烏爾德拉克必須親手將提亞馬特的一些血液灑在阿弗納斯的地面上。以他目前的形式與提亞馬特戰鬥將是自尋死跆，但烏爾德拉克獲悉，一位名叫{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}的龍裔將提亞馬特的一些血液儲存在他脖子上的聖物匣中。 烏爾德拉克揭示了在他的的舊劍劍柄上的發光"寶石"其實是{@item orb of dragonkind||龍珠}——一件阿克漢肯定會感興趣的物品。他敦促角色們向阿克漢提出用寶珠換取聖物匣，然後返回這裡。如果角色同意，烏爾德拉克會為他們指示前往阿克漢之塔的路線。

english: Arkhan's Tower
zh_tw: 阿克漢之塔

english: {@i He wears the hand of evil, yet his goal remains just beyond his fingertips}.
zh_tw: {@i 他身著邪惡之手，但目標仍然遙不可及。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A dark tower looms on the horizon, its black spire rising hundreds of feet, its ramparts bristling with charred skulls mounted on iron spikes. The tower's apex splits into five narrower spires that jab at the sky like clawed fingers. Circling above the tower's peak is a great white dragon stained with ash and soot.
zh_tw: 一座黑塔浮現在地平線上，它的黑色塔頂離地數百尺，城牆上佈滿了插著黑色骷髏頭的鐵刺。塔尖一分為五，如利爪般戳向天空。一條沾滿了灰燼和菸灰的巨大白龍盤旋塔上。

english: As you get closer to the tower, you notice figures shuffling atop its ramparts—undead guards in various states of decay.
zh_tw: 當你靠近塔樓時，你注意到城牆上有身影在移動——各種腐爛狀態的亡靈守衛。

english: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} has claimed this tower as his base. Here, with the help of a tortle death-priest of Tiamat named {@creature Krull|BGDIA}, the dragonborn warrior researches ways to assert his will over the artifact known as the {@item Hand of Vecna}, so he can use its secrets to free the evil dragon queen Tiamat from the Nine Hells. Arkhan has traveled to a nearby monument to commune with his goddess, leaving {@creature Krull|BGDIA} behind.
zh_tw: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}宣稱這座塔為他的基地。在這裡，在一個名為{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}的提亞瑪特的龜人死亡牧師幫助下，這名龍裔戰士正研究如何用他的意志施加於被稱為{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}的神器，這樣他就可以利用這個神器的秘密把邪惡龍後提亞瑪特從九獄中解放出來。阿克漢前往了附近的一座紀念碑與他的女神交流，將{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}留在這。

english: Dragons tore the obsidian rocks of Arkhan's tower from the fiery volcanoes of Avernus. Fifty {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} and thirty {@creature Zombie||zombies} stand ready to defend the tower, which is also guarded by the {@creature adult white dragon} Obatala. When it detects intruders, the dragon roars to alert {@creature Krull|BGDIA}, who emerges from the tower to greet new arrivals. {@creature Krull|BGDIA}, whose shell is carved with Draconic runes that spell out prayers to Tiamat, is joined by four {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} that serve as his assistants. The ghouls gnaw on bones and eye the characters hungrily as {@creature Krull|BGDIA} negotiates with them. Under no circumstances does {@creature Krull|BGDIA} allow intruders to enter the nine-story tower and disturb his experiments or Arkhan's chambers.
zh_tw: 巨龍從火熱的阿弗納斯火山撕下黑曜石來建造阿克漢的高塔。五十個只{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}和三十隻{@creature Zombie||喪屍}隨時準備捍衛塔樓，該塔樓還由{@creature adult white dragon||成年白龍}奧巴塔拉守衛。當它發現到入侵者時，巨龍以怒吼警告{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}，他會從塔樓出來迎接來客。{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}的背甲上刻著向提亞馬特祈禱的龍語符文，有四個{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}擔當他的助手。在{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}與他們談判時這些食屍鬼啃咬著骨頭，並且飢餓地盯著角色。{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}不會允許任何入侵者進入九層高塔幹擾他的實驗或弄亂阿克漢的房間。

english: {@creature Krull|BGDIA} is willing to lead the characters to Arkhan if they have something valuable in their possession, such as the {@item orb of dragonkind} recovered from Uldrak's Grave or the unicorn rescued from the {@area demon zapper|230|x}. Otherwise, the tortle instructs the characters to leave at once or die.
zh_tw: 如果玩家身上有他們感到興趣的東西，{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}願意帶玩家去見阿克漢，例如從烏爾德拉克之墓得到的秘寶{@item orb of dragonkind||龍珠}或從{@area 滅魔器|230|x}救出的獨角獸。否則，這隻龜人會下令玩家立即離開或給予他們死亡。

english: {@creature Krull|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}

english: In addition to its undead defenses, the tower has four smaller dragons living inside it: a {@creature young black dragon} named Slarkas, a {@creature young blue dragon} named Vistalancer, a {@creature young green dragon} named Vermilius, and a {@creature red dragon wyrmling} nicknamed Flash. These dragons attack characters who invade the tower and fight to the death to defend it.
zh_tw: 除了其亡靈守衛，塔樓內還住著四隻較小的龍：一條{@creature young black dragon||青年黑龍}名為斯拉凱斯，一條{@creature young blue dragon||青年藍龍}名為韋斯特蘭瑟，一條{@creature young green dragon||青年綠龍}名為福米盧斯，以及一條{@creature red dragon wyrmling||紅龍雛龍}綽號為閃電。這些龍會攻擊入侵塔樓的人並會為保護塔樓而死。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Krull|BGDIA} wields a {@item +1 maul} and carries five {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} and two {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} in a sling bag. The tower is filled with laboratories, morgues, and dragon hatcheries that might contain other treasures protected by magical wards, at your discretion.
zh_tw: {@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}揮舞一個{@item +1 maul||+1 巨錘}，並在背囊帶有中五瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}和兩枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣} 。塔樓上充滿實驗室、停屍房和龍孵化場，由您酌情決定其中可能包含由魔法結界保護的其他寶藏。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters convince {@creature Krull|BGDIA} to lead them to Arkhan, the tortle guides them safely to the Monument to Tiamat (see "{@area Monument to Tiamat|24d|x}"). The characters could also stake out Arkhan's tower and await the dragonborn's return. Arkhan reacts here as he does at the Monument to Tiamat, except that he can't summon Asojano the chimera.
zh_tw: 如果玩家能說服{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}帶領他們前往阿克漢的所在地，那麼龜人將把他們安全地引導至提亞馬特崇神處（請參閱"{@area 提亞馬特崇神處|24d|x}"）。玩家還可以監視著阿克漢之塔，等待他回來。阿克漢在塔中和在提亞瑪特崇神處上對玩家的反應是一樣的，只是他不能召喚奇美拉阿索哈諾了。

english: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}

english: Monument to Tiamat
zh_tw: 提亞馬特崇神處

english: {@i Draconic devils roost in a giant skull, through which the dragon queen speaks with five tongues}.
zh_tw: {@i 龍形的魔鬼棲息在一個巨大的頭骨中，龍後用她的五條舌頭透過此處發話。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A colossal dragon's skull leans against a mountainside, surrounded by bones the size of houses. Acrid smoke rises from the skull's maw. A military tent has been pitched among the bones, and parked next to it is a two-wheeled infernal war machine.
zh_tw: 一個龐大的巨龍頭骨倚在山腰上，四周是房屋大小的骨頭。顱骨的嘴裡冒出刺鼻的煙霧，一頂軍用帳篷已經紮在骨頭之間，停在它旁邊的是一輛兩輪地獄戰爭機器。

english: Gathered around this tent are a dozen chattering, reptilian humanoids with gleaming swords, white scales, and white, leathery wings.
zh_tw: 這個帳篷周圍聚集著一打閒聊著的爬蟲樣類人生物，它們帶閃光的劍，長著白色的鱗片和白色的皮質翅膀。

english: A tunnel at the back of the skull leads to Tiamat's lair. The devils nesting within the skull, the abishai, are believed to carry out her bidding—or perhaps guard over her prison on orders of Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 頭骨後的隧道通向提亞瑪特的巢穴。據信，居住在頭骨中的亞比沙執行她的命令——抑或遵從阿斯蒙蒂斯的命令看守對她的監牢。

english: From the depths of her lair, Tiamat can hear the prayers and pronouncements of faithful servants who call out to her from the maw of the colossal dragon skull. If the dragon queen chooses to reply, her five hissing voices issue from the darkness, amplified by the skull as they give commands and finish each other's sentences.
zh_tw: 從她的巢穴的深處，提亞瑪特可以聽她忠實僕人的從顱骨巨口處大聲呼喚她的祈禱和佈告。如果龍後選擇回應，她那五重帶著嘶嘶聲的話語將從黑暗中傳出，經由顱骨放大她們發出的命令和五種聲音互相補完的語句。

english: It would be madness to assault this location without an army. Abishai of all colors nest in the sulfurous caves behind the skull, and scores of {@creature white abishai|MTF} pour forth to counter any assault or invasion.
zh_tw: 只有瘋子會在沒有大軍的情況下進攻這個地方。各種顏色的亞比沙居住在頭骨後面的洞穴中，大量{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}會從中湧出以抵禦任何襲擊或入侵。

english: The infernal war machine parked next to the tent is a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA} belonging to {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}'s minotaur bodyguard, {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 停在帳篷旁的地獄戰爭機器是一架{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}， 它屬於{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}的牛頭人保鏢{@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA|託羅加·鋼拳}

english: {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA|託羅加·鋼拳}

english: Arkhan the Cruel
zh_tw: 殘酷者阿克漢

english: The dragonborn {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} is in the tent along with his {@creature manticore} companion, Chango, and {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA}, his savage minotaur bodyguard. Arkhan visits the monument to commune with his queen and report on his ongoing battle of wills to master the {@item Hand of Vecna}, which came into his possession during a brief excursion to the world of Exandria.
zh_tw: 龍裔{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}與他的{@creature manticore||刺尾獅}夥伴闡古一起呆在帳篷裡，{@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA|託羅加·鋼拳}，他的牛頭怪保鏢也守衛在他身旁。阿克漢來到崇神處與他的女王進行溝通，並報告他為掌控"{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}"而進行的意志爭奪戰進度。 這件神器是他短暫遊歷艾桑椎亞世界時所得到的。

english: If the characters approach Arkhan's encampment, the twelve {@creature white abishai|MTF} at the camp rush forward to intercept them. Characters accompanied by {@creature Krull|BGDIA} the tortle (see "{@area Arkhan's Tower|247|x}") or who have something Arkhan might consider valuable are permitted to approach his camp.
zh_tw: 如果玩家接近阿克漢的營地，則營地中的十二個{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}會衝上來攔截他們。但如果他們由{@creature Krull|BGDIA|克魯爾}陪同（請參閱"{@area 阿克漢之塔|247|x}"）或帶著龍裔可能有興趣的珍貴物品到來， 他們將被允許進入營地。

english: Arkhan believes he can use the {@item Hand of Vecna} to unlock the means of freeing Tiamat from her prison in the Nine Hells, but only if the hand doesn't kill him first. The hand is slowly corrupting Arkhan's flesh and decomposing his body on one side. To stave off this decline, Arkhan needs to use the {@item Hand of Vecna} to snuff the life out of good-aligned creatures. If the characters try to cut a deal with Arkhan—for a vial of Tiamat's blood or help contacting the dragon queen herself—Arkhan demands the sacrifice of a good-aligned creature in exchange. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is an ideal candidate, as is the unicorn Mooncolor (see "{@area Demon Zapper|230|x}"). Sacrificing such a creature to Arkhan is an evil act.
zh_tw: 阿克漢相信他可以使用{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}來將提亞瑪特從她在九獄的監牢中釋放出來，但這是在他不會被這隻手先殺死的前提下。這隻手正在慢慢侵蝕阿克漢的肉體，並正在分解他一側的身體。為了避免這種侵蝕，阿克漢需要使用{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}殺死善良陣營生物的生命。如果玩家試圖與阿克漢達成協議以換取一瓶提亞馬特的鮮血或幫助自己與龍後聯絡，阿克漢要求犧牲一個善良陣營生物生物作為交換。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和獨角獸月華都是理想的選擇（請參閱"{@area 滅魔器|230|x}"）。將這樣的生物獻給阿克漢是一種邪惡的行為。

english: In battle, Arkhan uses {@spell branding smite} to channel the radiant power of Tiamat into his weapon attacks. If a fight turns against him, he uses the {@spell teleport} power of the {@item Hand of Vecna} to return to his tower with as many allies as possible. Should one or more of his comrades fall in battle, Arkhan uses {@spell revivify} and {@spell raise dead} spells to bring them back to life as soon as possible.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，阿克漢利用{@spell branding smite||印記斬}將提亞瑪特的神力引入他的武器攻擊中。如果在戰鬥中處於劣勢，他將利用{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}的{@spell teleport||傳送術}帶著儘可能多的盟友一起返回塔樓。如果他的一個或多個戰友陣亡，阿克漢將使用法術{@spell revivify||回生術}和{@spell raise dead||死者復活}以使他們儘快復活返回戰鬥。

english: If Arkhan finds himself overwhelmed with opposition, he orders the abishai to attack. Arkhan can also use a bonus action to call forth Asojano, a {@creature chimera} lairing in the depths of the colossal dragon skull. This evil monster in the service of Tiamat considers Arkhan a friend and ally.
zh_tw: 如果阿克漢發現自己面臨壓倒性的劣勢，他會命令亞比沙發動進攻。阿克漢還可以使用附贈動作召喚出阿索哈諾，一隻棲息在這個巨大龍頭骨深處的{@creature chimera||奇美拉}。這個為提亞瑪特服務的邪惡怪物視阿克漢為朋友和盟友。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: The characters most likely come here to bargain with Arkhan for a vial of Tiamat's blood in his possession. If they acquire this reliquary, they can return Tiamat's blood to Uldrak and use it to break his curse. Uldrak excitedly splashes the vial's hissing contents onto the ground at his feet. Moments later, he sheds his fiendish skin and grows back into his true form, that of a lawful evil {@creature empyrean}. Laughing gleefully, Uldrak yanks his sword from the ground and gladly provides the characters with a gallon of his blood so they can break the curse on Ralzala. When this is done, he casts {@spell plane shift} to return to the realm of his deity, Surtur.
zh_tw: 玩家最有可能在這裡與阿克漢討價還價，從而索取他所有的一小瓶提亞馬特之血。如果他們獲得了這個聖物，他們可以將提亞瑪特的血交給烏爾德拉克，並用它來打破他的詛咒。 烏爾德拉克激動地將這小瓶中嘶嘶作響的血濺到他腳下的地面上。片刻之後，他擺脫自己的魔鬼外皮，重新長回自己的真實形態，一個守序邪惡的{@creature empyrean||至高天}。烏爾德拉克喜悅地大笑了起來，將配劍從地面上猛地拔出，愉快地為玩家提供了一加侖的鮮血，這樣他們就可以打破拉爾薩拉的詛咒。完成這些事後，他會施放{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}返回其神靈蘇爾特的神國。

english: Returning to the demon zapper, the characters find that Ralzala also honors her word. After gulping down the empyrean's blood to free herself from her pact, she etches her letter of introduction to {@creature Bel|BGDIA} onto a basalt tablet and directs the characters to his volcanic lair. The adventure continues in {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Forge.
zh_tw: 回到滅魔器，冒險們發現拉爾薩拉也同樣遵守了諾言。在吞下至高天的鮮血使自己擺脫契約後，她將給{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的介紹信刻在一塊玄武岩板上，並將指引他們到他的火山巢穴中去。隨後冒險將在{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}鍛爐繼續。

english: Bel's Forge
zh_tw: 貝爾鍛爐

english: {@i An ousted archduke sulking in a volcano, eager to reclaim his stolen throne}.
zh_tw: {@i 在火山中鬱鬱寡歡的是一名被廢黜的前任大公，渴望奪回他被竊取的王位。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: A gargantuan volcano dominates the horizon. Clouds of fire and ash spew from its caldera, and the air trembles with its angry grumblings. A vast, multilayered fortress has been hewn into the volcano's rocky slopes.
zh_tw: 一座巨大的火山躍出地平線。火焰與塵埃形成的烏雲從它的火山口噴出，空氣因它憤怒的轟鳴而顫抖著。一座巨大的多層堡壘被鑿入火山岩石的斜坡之中。

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, one of the Nine Hells' greatest military minds, dwells in this iron keep. From this bastion, Zariel's second-in-command and the former lord of Avernus oversees the forges that furnish weapons and armor for the Blood War.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}，九獄中最偉大的軍事戰術家之一，居住在這個鋼鐵城堡裡。在這個堡壘裡，扎瑞爾的副指揮官和前阿弗納斯領主監督著為血戰提供武器和盔甲的鍛造廠。

english: An army of devils guards {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fortress, and his dark magic alerts him to intruders within its walls. Strangers who venture too close are assaulted by a strike team of two {@creature Horned Devil||horned devils} leading ten {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}. If the intruders survive and linger in the area, a whole army of devils descends upon them.
zh_tw: 一支魔鬼部隊守衛著{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的堡壘，還有他的黑暗魔法也會警告他城牆內出現入侵者。敢於冒險的陌生人若是過於靠近，就會被由兩個{@creature Horned Devil||角魔}帶著十個{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}組成的突擊隊攻擊。如果入侵者倖存下來並在該地區逗留，一整支魔鬼軍隊將會攻擊他們。

english: Characters can gain an audience with {@creature Bel|BGDIA} if they have a letter of introduction (available from the dao Ralzala), or if they're captured or killed by {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forces. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} delights in raising his enemies from the dead to interrogate them, especially if they appear to be outlanders. Infiltrating {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fortress is possible, but only if the characters have magical means of shielding themselves from his divinations. If they befriend Olanthius (see "{@area Crypt of the Hellriders|214|x}"), cut a new deal with Red Ruth (see "{@area Bone Brambles|233|x}"), or perform a quest for Mephistopheles (see "{@area Mirror of Mephistar|208|x}"), they could feasibly infiltrate {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fortress by smuggling themselves in with any tribute their ally brings before {@creature Bel|BGDIA}. Whether the characters smuggle themselves inside, arrive with a letter of introduction, or get taken into custody, they eventually arrive at the lowest level of {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fortress, where {@creature Bel|BGDIA} lairs.
zh_tw: 如果角色有一封介紹信(可以從土巨靈拉爾薩拉處獲得)，或者他們被{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的部隊捕獲或殺死，角色們可能獲得一次覲見{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的機會。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}喜歡將他的敵人復活後再來審問他們，尤其是當他們看起來是異界來客的時候。潛入{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的堡壘是有可能的，但前提是角色們有魔法手段從他的預言法術中保護自己。如果他們與奧蘭蘇斯（見"{@area 地獄騎士之墓|214|x}"）成為朋友，與紅露絲（見"{@area 骨棘林|233|x}"）達成一個新交易，或者完成一個梅菲斯特（見"{@area 梅菲斯特之鏡|208|x}"）的要求，角色們就可以把他們自己藏在任何盟友獻給{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的貢品裡偷渡進入{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的要塞。不管角色是自己潛入，帶著介紹信到達，亦或是被關入監牢，他們最終都會到達{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的堡壘的最底層，也就是{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的巢穴。

english: Forge Features
zh_tw: 鍛爐特性

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge is carved out of volcanic rock and has soaring, 50-foot-high ceilings throughout. Other features of the forge are summarized below.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的鍛造廠是由火山岩開鑿而成，整個鍛造廠的頂部高達 50 尺。鍛爐的其他特徵概述如下。

english: {@b Heat}. {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge is unbearably hot, with an ambient temperature of 130 to 150 degrees Fahrenheit. The extreme heat has detrimental effects on creatures not acclimated to such environments (see "{@book Extreme Heat|DMG|5|Extreme Heat}" in {@book chapter 5|DMG|5} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
zh_tw: {@b 高溫}。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的鍛爐熱得讓人受不了，環境中的溫度高達 130 到 150 華氏度。極端高溫對不適應這種環境的生物有不利影響（參見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》{@book 第五章|DMG|5}中的"{@book 極度高溫|DMG|5|Extreme Heat}"）。

english: {@b Lava}. Open rivers of lava are channeled through the forge to smelt ore and soften metal. Any creature that enters the lava for the first time on its turn or starts its turn in it takes 33 ({@dice 6d10}) fire damage. Increase the damage to 99 ({@dice 18d10}) fire damage if the creature is fully immersed in the lava.
zh_tw: {@b 熔岩}。熔岩河流被引導穿過鍛造場來熔鍊礦石和軟化金屬。任何在它的回合中第一次進入熔岩或在其中開始回合的生物將受到 33（{@dice 6d10}）火焰傷害。如果該生物完全浸泡在熔岩中，將傷害增加到 99（{@dice 18d10}）點火焰傷害。

english: Encounters in the Forge
zh_tw: 熔爐的遭遇

english: Map 3.5: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Forge
zh_tw: 地圖 3.5：{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}鍛爐

zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: The following descriptions correspond to areas marked on map 3.5.
zh_tw: 以下描述對應於地圖 3.5 上標記的區域。

english: F1. Descent to the Forge
zh_tw: F1. 降臨熔爐

english: Read the following boxed text to the players when their characters reach the lowest level of {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fortress:
zh_tw: 在角色們抵達{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的要塞最底層後，向他們念出下框中的文字

english: A wrought iron spiral staircase descends into a cavernous forge. Channels of bubbling lava wind through the complex, casting fiery light over huge anvils. Chained giants with coal-black skin and fiery orange hair hammer out weapons under the malignant gaze of a pit fiend seated in a flying throne. Throughout the forge, sparks fall like rain.
zh_tw: 鍛鐵的螺旋狀的鐵樓梯向下通往一間巨大寬闊的鍛造室。咕咚冒泡的巖漿河道蜿蜒流過設施眾多的室內，發出的強烈光線照亮了巨大的鐵砧。室內是一群帶著鐐銬的巨人們，他們的皮膚如煤炭一般黝黑，頭髮如火焰般橘紅。一個深獄煉魔在他飛行的王座上，用奸邪的目光監視著巨人們打造出一件件兵器。整個鍛造室內，火星如雨點般飛濺著。

english: The pit fiend is {@creature Bel|BGDIA} (see "{@area Roleplaying Bel|25b|x}" below). Only he can control his Large flying throne, which has a flying speed of 15 feet and can hover.
zh_tw: 這個深獄煉魔就是{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}（見下文"{@area 扮演貝爾|25b|x}"），只有他能操控他的大型飛行王座，這個王座有著 15 尺的飛行速度，且可以懸浮。

english: F2. Fire Giant Blacksmiths
zh_tw: F2. 火巨人鐵匠

english: Four {@creature Fire Giant||fire giants} in chains are using enormous hammers and anvils to craft infernal weapons and armor under {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s watchful eye. A clutter of giant-sized objects surround each giant's anvil: iron buckets containing oily water, coils of greasy chain, mounds of iron filings, and more.
zh_tw: 四個{@creature Fire Giant||火巨人}被戴上了鐐銬，在{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的監督下用巨型的鐵錘和鐵砧打造煉獄武器與盔甲。每個巨人的鐵砧周圍都放著一堆巨型的雜物：盛著油汙水的鐵製水桶，盤著的油膩鐵鏈，大堆的鐵屑等。

english: The fire giants' names are Drumra, Jalt, Rosska, and Zrakorn. While chained, the giants have a walking speed of 10 feet. The giants despise {@creature Bel|BGDIA} but are bound by magic to do as he demands. The chains that bind them can't be broken or unlocked except by {@creature Bel|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 這些火巨人的名字叫做德拉姆拉、賈爾特、羅斯卡和茲拉科爾。在被鐐銬拷著的情況下，他們的移動速度為 10 尺。他們雖然憎惡{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}，但是受著魔法束縛，不得不遵從他的號令。除了{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}沒人能開啟或是破壞這些巨人的鐐銬。

english: F3. Weapons Rack
zh_tw: F3. 武器架

english: These racks contain weapons awaiting delivery to the front lines of the Blood War. Most of them are too big for Small or Medium characters to wield effectively.
zh_tw: 這些架子上的武器是準備送去血戰前線的。其中的大部分武器對於中型和小型的角色們來說都過於巨大導致難以使用。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Among the larger weapons are three magic weapons sized for Small and Medium characters: a pair of {@item Hellfire Javelin|BGDIA|hellfire javelins} and a {@item hellfire greatsword|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 在這些巨大的武器中有三把魔法武器的規格可以適配小型或是中型的角色們：一對{@item Hellfire Javelin|BGDIA|獄火標槍}和一把{@item hellfire greatsword|BGDIA|獄火巨劍}。

english: F4. Pool of Magma
zh_tw: F4. 巖漿池

english: Inside this cavern, steel pylons and gantries keep a huge and terrible new machine suspended above a pool of magma. The machine is {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s secret weapon in his cold war to overthrow Zariel. When the characters arrive here, the infernal machine is still under construction and far from complete.
zh_tw: 在這個洞穴中，鋼鐵支柱和龍門吊將一架可怕的，巨大的嶄新機器懸吊在了巖漿池上方。這個機器是{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}在他的冷戰中顛覆扎瑞爾的秘密武器。當冒險者們抵達的時候，這臺地獄機器還在製作中，遠未完工。

english: Roleplaying Bel
zh_tw: 扮演貝爾

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} oversees the manufacture of weapons and armor for the Blood War. Though Asmodeus has instructed Zariel to accept {@creature Bel|BGDIA} as her advisor, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} and Zariel loathe each other and invent distractions to keep them apart. When {@creature Bel|BGDIA} learns of the characters' intentions, he decides to use them as pawns to tarnish and ultimately overthrow Zariel.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}監督著著用於血戰的武器和盔甲的生產。雖然在阿斯蒙蒂斯的指示下，扎瑞爾接受了{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}作為她的參謀，但{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}和扎瑞爾互相厭惡。並編織各種藉口互不相見。在{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}知道了角色們的來意後，他決定利用角色們當做削弱扎瑞爾的棋子，並最終推翻她。

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} outwardly plays the role of Zariel's loyal vassal. Secretly, he uses telepathy to hatch a treasonous plot with the characters. {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s plan is as follows:
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}表面上維持著扎瑞爾的忠誠部屬形象。私底下會秘密地用心靈感應與角色們密謀叛亂。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的計劃如下：

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} wants the characters to retrieve nine adamantine rods that were stolen from his forge by Zariel's spies. Once all nine rods are returned to him, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} is willing to divulge the location of the Bleeding Citadel.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}希望冒險者們找回九根精金權杖，扎瑞爾的間諜從他的鍛造室裡偷走了它們。角色們找回全部九根精金權杖後，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會告訴他們湧血城砦的位置

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} suggests that the characters speak to a sibriex that was recently captured by his spies. Sibriexes are hoarders of forbidden lore, and this particular one has been a good source of information for {@creature Bel|BGDIA}. It might know where Zariel's spies hid the adamantine rods.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會建議角色們和他的間諜最近抓來的一隻巨顱魔聊聊。巨顱魔一族是禁忌知識的貯藏者，而這一隻巨顱魔已經成了{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的優秀資訊源。它很可能知道扎瑞爾的間諜們把精金權杖藏在了哪裡。

english: To help the characters reach the sibriex, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} offers to provide them with a barge they can use to ply the River Styx.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會提供給角色們一條能橫渡冥河的駁船，這樣他們就能去找巨顱魔了。

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} doesn't tell the characters that the Companion (what he calls the Solar Insidiator) was built in his forge, nor does he reveal that it has a planetar trapped inside it. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} also fails to mention that the nine adamantine rods are the keys to unlocking the device and freeing the planetar. If the characters ask what the rods are for, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} says, "That's not really any of your business. This is the best deal you'll get in Avernus. I suggest you take it."
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}不會告訴角色們伴陽（他稱作陰謀之陽）便是在這裡打造的，他也不會說這東西里面困著一個星天神使。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}不會提及那九根精金權杖就是開啟這個裝置，施放星天神使的鑰匙。如果角色們問他權杖是做什麼用的，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會說"這不關你的事。我能給你提供的交易可是阿弗納斯里最好的了，我建議你們同意成交。"

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}

english: If the characters become belligerent or demanding, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} sighs and snaps his fingers, causing the infernal chains to fall off the fire giants. He promises freedom to any fire giant that kills an intruder, prompting the giants to attack the characters without mercy. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} then steeples his fingers and watches the battle unfold. In battle, the fire giants hurl buckets, tools, and heavy chains instead of boulders. They also try to shove enemies into channels of molten lava.
zh_tw: 如果角色們十分好戰，或是索求無度，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會發出一聲嘆息，打上一個響指，讓火巨人們身上的火焰枷鎖掉落。他向他們許諾，任何殺死入侵者的火巨人就能重獲自由，以此鼓動他們對角色們毫不留情地下手。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}隨後就會雙手合十作壁上觀。在戰鬥中，火巨人們會揮舞著水桶，鍛造工具和沉重的枷鎖來取代巨石作為投擲物。他們也會試圖把敵人推進巖漿河中。

english: If the characters defeat the fire giants, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} commends their victory and offers them the same deal as before. If the characters refuse him a second time, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} smiles and says, "A pity. All those poor people in Elturel were counting on you." He then offers to teleport them out of his fortress, so they can be on their way. Gracious host that {@creature Bel|BGDIA} is, he won't attack the characters directly unless they attack him first, in which case he casts {@spell imprisonment} on a party member ({@creature Lulu|BGDIA} being his first choice). If the spell works, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} vows to release his prisoner once the nine adamantine rods are found and returned to him, no questions asked.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們擊敗了火巨人，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會對他們的勝利讚賞有加，並在此提出之前的交易。如果角色們第二次拒絕他，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會露齒一笑，說道"真是遺憾，所有在艾爾托瑞爾的人們還指望著你們呢" 他隨後提出可以把他們傳送出他的堡壘，大路朝天，各走一邊。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}是個非常親切有禮的主人，除非角色們率先攻擊他，他不會親自對角色們動手。如果他動手回擊，他會率先向一位成員（{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}是他的第一目標）施放{@spell imprisonment||禁錮術}。 如果法術施展成功，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會起誓，在角色們幫他找回九根精金法杖後會放人，一概不究。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: When the characters are ready to leave his forge, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} teleports them back to the surface. If the characters agreed to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s terms, an {@creature imp} named Balakros is waiting for them when they return to the surface. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} instructs the imp to help the characters reach the sibriex. The imp has performed this task before and knows, without having to be told, that its orders include reporting back to {@creature Bel|BGDIA} and whispering everything the sibriex said into its master's ear.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備好離開鍛爐後，{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會將他們傳送回地表。如果角色們接受了{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的交易，一個叫做巴拉卡羅斯的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}已經恭候多時。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}已經告訴這個小魔鬼要幫助角色們去找到巨顱魔。這個小魔鬼曾經執行過這樣的任務，無需多言，它也明白隱藏的命令中，即要將巨顱魔交代的一切事無鉅細地彙報給他的主子{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}。

english: If characters refuse to let Balakros accompany them, the imp bids them farewell, turns {@condition invisible}, and follows them at a respectful distance.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕讓巴拉卡羅斯和他們同行，小魔鬼會與他們告別，隨後轉入{@condition invisible||隱形}，在適當的位置上跟蹤著角色們。

english: River Travel
zh_tw: 渡河旅行

english: Balakros offers to lead the characters to an iron barge moored on the shore of the River Styx. An iron road leads from {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s volcano to the barge, and it's patrolled by {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} that won't attack the characters as long as Balakros is leading them. Lashed to the sides of the barge are demon skulls and bones. Characters who travel by barge must pass underneath the {@area Stygian Dock|285|x} on their way to the sibriex.
zh_tw: 巴拉卡羅斯會向冒險者們提議，帶他們去往建在冥河河畔的一艘鐵製駁船。一條鑄鐵的道路從{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的火山口前往駁船，巡守的{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}就不會攻擊由巴拉卡羅斯帶領的角色們他們。在駁船兩側捆著惡魔的骨骸。乘坐駁船的角色們必須從{@area 斯泰吉亞碼頭|285|x}下方透過，才能抵達他們的目的地，巨顱魔的所在地。

english: The barge is 30 feet long, 15 feet wide, and sturdy enough to transport up to two Huge infernal war machines. Twelve {@creature Merregon|MTF|merregons} under the command of a {@creature bone devil} named Krinjak operate the barge's oars. Krinjak's instructions are to take the characters where they need to go. Although it professes loyalty to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, Krinjak is secretly a spy for Zariel. After taking the characters as close to the sibriex as the River Styx allows, it flies off to warn Zariel that the characters are working for {@creature Bel|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 駁船長 30 尺，寬 15 尺，堅實可靠，足以運載兩個巨型地獄戰車。12 個{@creature Merregon|MTF|軍團魔}在一個名叫克林賈克的{@creature bone devil||骨魔}的號令下操槳。克林賈克得到的命令是帶著角色們去他們需要去的地方。雖然它自稱向{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}效忠，克林賈克其實暗地裡是扎瑞爾的間諜。在把角色們載到冥河上最接近巨顱魔的地方放下後，它會飛走去向彙報扎瑞爾：角色們在為{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}效命。

english: Overland Travel
zh_tw: 陸上旅行

english: If the characters would rather travel to the sibriex in some other fashion, Balakros the imp offers to serve as their overland guide, since it knows where the sibriex is. It can also point to the sibriex's location on the characters' map of Avernus.
zh_tw: 如果角色們向用其他的方式去往巨顱魔的所在，知道目的地的小魔鬼巴拉卡羅斯會成為他們的陸上嚮導。它也可以在角色們的阿弗納斯地圖上指出巨顱魔的所在地。

english: Sibriex
zh_tw: 巨顱魔

english: {@i A breeder of horrors and a hoarder of secrets, a sibriex is said to be as old as the Abyss}.
zh_tw: {@i 滋生恐怖者與秘密貯藏者，據說巨顱魔與無底深淵一樣古老。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at this location, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個位置時，請向玩家們朗讀或者意譯下列框內文字：

english: Spiky chains lash a fifteen-foot-diameter, floating blob of quivering flesh to a 20-foot-tall wrought-iron scaffold. Two fiends wrapped in chains stand atop the scaffold, torturing the bloated creature's flesh by tightening its chains. Demon ichor oozes from its wounds, forming a shallow pool around the scaffolding.
zh_tw: 帶著尖刺的鐵鏈將一坨直徑為 15 尺的聳動肉球捆在了離地二十米處的鑄鐵刑臺上。兩個渾身被鐵鏈包裹著的邪魔執掌著刑臺上的鐵鏈，他們拉緊鏈條，折磨這個被束縛著的腫脹肉球。惡魔穢液這個惡魔的傷口中流出， 在刑臺下形成了一個淺淺的池子。

english: A third, jackal-headed fiend uses a bronze horn to yell loudly at the bloated prisoner in multiple languages. It sits cross-legged about half-way up the scaffolding.
zh_tw: 另有第三個長著胡狼頭的邪魔舉著一個銅質的號角，大聲地用著多種語言向這個臃腫的囚犯喊話。它盤腿坐在刑臺半腰的位置上

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fiends captured a {@creature sibriex|MTF} and have been torturing and interrogating it for quite a long time now. The sibriex is {@condition restrained} by infernal chains from {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s forge that also prevent it from using its spells or actions to escape.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}手下的邪魔們抓住了一個{@creature sibriex|MTF|巨顱魔}，並且已經對其折磨和拷問了很長時間。巨顱魔被{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的鍛爐製造的的煉獄鎖鏈{@condition restrained||束縛}，不能使用它的咒語和動作來掙脫。

english: Sibriex
zh_tw: 巨顱魔

english: The demon ichor that pools around the scaffolding smells terrible but can be easily avoided. For more information on demon ichor, see "{@area Demon Ichor|1a7|x}".
zh_tw: 刑臺附近彙集的惡魔穢液聞起來糟糕極了，但要避開它卻輕而易舉。有關惡魔穢液的更多資訊請參閱"{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}"。

english: Two {@creature Chain Devil||chain devils} named Shalok and Jank are torturing the sibriex under the guidance of Fetchtatter, a cruel {@creature arcanaloth} who signed an infernal contract with {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, guaranteeing the arcanaloth's loyalty to {@creature Bel|BGDIA} in exchange for magic items and spellbooks. All three fiends are immune to the sibriex's Warp Creature power.
zh_tw: 兩位名為沙洛克和詹克的{@creature Chain Devil||鏈魔}在折磨著巨顱魔，他們的領導叫斐熾泰格，是一位{@creature arcanaloth||奧法羅斯魔}。這位頭目和{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}簽訂了煉獄契約，用它的效忠換取了來自{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的魔法物品和法術書。這三個邪魔都不受到巨顱魔的扭曲生物能力影響。

english: Fetchtatter uses its speaking horn to address the sibriex, treating it like an idiot child. The arcanaloth's declarations typically begin with, "Tell me everything you know about..." and end with a long pause as it waits for the sibriex to answer. The sibriex has grown increasingly obstinate, much to Fetchtatter's chagrin. The arcanaloth offers three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} to the characters if they can make the sibriex talk, but it has no intention of honoring this agreement.
zh_tw: 斐熾泰格用他的號角喇叭給巨顱魔發號施令，把它當傻小孩耍。他通常以"告訴我你知道的所有的關於......"開始，並在問話後停一會，給巨顱魔留出回答的時間。巨顱魔開始越來越頑固，而斐熾泰格也越來越生氣。這個奧法羅斯魔會向角色們許諾，如果他們能讓巨顱魔開口，他就給他們三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}作為報酬。然而，它完全無意於信守承諾。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Fetchtatter wears a {@item ring of x-ray vision} on its right hand. In the pockets of its bile-stained robe are two {@item Potion of Greater Healing||potions of greater healing} and six {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. The arcanaloth also carries a grimy spellbook bound in chasme flesh. Fetchtatter's spellbook contains all the spells the arcanaloth has prepared.
zh_tw: 斐熾泰格的右手戴有一枚{@item ring of x-ray vision||X射線戒指}。它沾染著膽汁的袍子口袋裡藏有兩瓶{@item Potion of Greater Healing||高等治療藥水}以及 6 枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。這個奧法羅斯魔還帶著一本汙穢的用喀嘶魔的血肉製成的法術書。斐熾泰格的法術書記載了所有這隻奧法羅斯魔能準備的法術。

english: Interrogating the Sibriex
zh_tw: 盤問巨顱魔

english: Before it was captured by {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s fiends, the sibriex wandered throughout Avernus, amassing information from every location it visited. At your discretion, the sibriex could have knowledge of other locations shown on the characters' map of Avernus. It gives up what it knows only if the characters use magical methods of interrogation. It doesn't know anything that can help the characters find the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, but it knows where {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s nine adamantine rods are located.
zh_tw: 在被{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}手下的邪魔捉拿前，這隻巨顱魔遊蕩在阿弗納斯的各地，收集著所到之處的資訊。你可以自主決定它知道那些角色們手中的阿弗納斯地圖上標明的其他地方資訊。它只會在角色們對他用魔法的手段審訊後給出資訊。它不知道任何能幫助角色們找到{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的資訊，但是它知道{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的九根精金權杖被藏在何處。

english: The sibriex uses its telepathy to contact the first party member who comes within 120 feet of it, offering information in exchange for its freedom. The character with whom the sibriex is speaking telepathically can detect the insincerity of the sibriex's offer with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. Contrary to its claim, the sibriex doesn't plan to help the characters.
zh_tw: 這個巨顱魔會用它的心靈感應向第一個接近他 120 尺內的冒險團隊成員進行溝通，許諾用情報換取自由。和巨顱魔進行心靈溝通的角色可以透過一個{@dc 17}的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定察覺到巨顱魔並不具有誠意。和它的說法相反，巨顱魔並不準備幫助角色們。

english: A character can, with a successful {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check, convince the sibriex to share one bit of useful information as a show of good faith. If asked about the adamantine rods, the sibriex claims to have seen all nine rods in the wreck of a crashed flying fortress. The sibriex won't reveal the wreck's location, but Balakros the imp knows where the wreck is and can lead the characters there if told about it. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} might also suddenly remember the wreck's location, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 透過一個成功的{@dc 17}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，一位成員能勸說巨顱魔先分享一點點有用的情報來表達誠意。如果問到了精金權杖，巨顱魔會宣稱它曾經在一個墜毀的飛行堡壘的廢墟里見過全部九根權杖。巨顱魔不會透露廢墟的位置，但是小魔鬼巴拉卡羅斯知道廢墟的所在，如果角色們和他提及此事，他會給大家帶路。你也可以自主決定，讓{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}突然間想起來她也知道廢墟的位置。

english: Releasing the Sibriex
zh_tw: 釋放巨顱魔

english: Fetchtatter and the chain devils attack characters who try to free the sibriex. Breaking three of the six chains that bind the sibriex allows it to slip free, whereupon it flies into the air and tries to get as far away from the iron scaffold as possible. Each chain has AC 19, 33 hit points, a damage threshold of 10, and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 斐熾泰格和鏈魔會攻擊試圖解救巨顱魔的角色。解開六條鏈條中的三條就能放出巨顱魔，它會飛向自由的方向，並盡力遠離這個鍛鐵刑臺。每條鐵鏈的AC為 19，生命值為 33，傷害閾值為 10，它們免疫火焰，毒素和心靈傷害。

english: Flesh Warping
zh_tw: 肉體扭曲

english: When a creature fails a saving throw against the sibriex's Warp Creature effect, you can roll percentile dice and consult the {@adventure Flesh Warping table|BGDIA|3|Flesh Warping} to determine an additional effect, which vanishes when Warp Creature ends on the creature. If the creature transforms into an {@creature abyssal wretch|MTF}, the effect becomes a permanent feature of that body.
zh_tw: 當一個生物未能成功豁免巨顱魔的扭曲生物效果，你可以扔一個百面骰，參考{@adventure 肉體扭曲表|BGDIA|3|Flesh Warping}來給他額外附加一個效果，這個會隨同扭曲生物的效果一起終止。如果這個生物轉化成了{@creature abyssal wretch|MTF|深淵行屍}， 這一扭曲效果被固化為永久效果。

english: A creature can willingly submit to flesh warping, an agonizing process that takes at least 1 hour while the creature stays within 30 feet of the sibriex. At the end of the process, roll once on the {@adventure Flesh Warping table|BGDIA|3|Flesh Warping} (or choose one effect) to determine how the creature is transformed permanently.
zh_tw: 生物可自願接受血肉扭曲，這是一個極為痛苦的過程，至少持續1小時，期間該生物須始終位於巨顱魔的 30 尺範圍內。過程結束時，擲一次{@adventure 肉體扭曲表|BGDIA|3|Flesh Warping}表（或選擇一個效果），以確定生物如何被永久性地改變。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: After tricking or magically compelling the sibriex to divulge the location of {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s adamantine rods, the characters can set out to recover the rods from the wrecked flying fortress.
zh_tw: 在用詐術或是魔法脅迫巨顱魔吐露了{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的精金權杖的所在地後，角色們可以出發去飛行堡壘的廢墟里尋回這些法杖。

english: Wrecked Flying Fortress
zh_tw: 飛行堡壘廢墟

english: {@i A weapon made for an archdevil, ravaged in battle and ripe for plunder}.
zh_tw: {@i 這件魔鬼大公的神兵如今已經在戰鬥中隕落，成了奪寶奇兵們的樂園}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: To reach the wrecked flying fortress, characters must cross a hot, windswept plain wracked by magical fire storms. Flying characters and fast-moving infernal war machines can easily avoid these fire storms.
zh_tw: 角色們必須穿過一片被魔法火焰肆虐、狂風大作的酷熱平原才能抵達飛行堡壘的廢墟。飛行和駕駛快速移動的地獄戰車可以幫角色們輕易地避開這些火焰風暴。

english: Characters traveling on foot must succeed on a {@dc 20} group Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check as they cross the fireswept plain. On a failed check, a fire storm filling a 60-foot cube sweeps across the ground and engulfs as many party members as it can. The storm then attaches itself to one randomly determined party member, staying centered on that creature for 1 minute. At the end of the duration, the storm detaches from that creature and moves off in a random direction. The storm must remain in contact with the ground at all times. If it becomes separated from the creature to which it has attached itself, the storm moves off in a random direction and ceases to endanger the party.
zh_tw: 步行的角色們在透過這篇熱浪滾滾的平原時必須透過一個{@dc 20}的團隊感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。如果失敗，一道填滿 60 立方尺空間的火龍捲將席捲而來，將儘可能多的團隊成員捲入其中。隨後，這道火龍捲會隨機選擇一位團隊成員依附其上，以這個生物為中心存留 1 分鐘。在這段時間結束後，火龍捲會分離，隨機向一個方向移動離開。這個火龍捲必須時時刻刻與地面接觸。如果它被從附著的生物上剝離了，這道龍捲會隨機向一個方向移動，不再威脅團隊。

english: Any character that enters a fire storm for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire storm ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or held. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 18}) cast on the storm causes it to flame out and disappear.
zh_tw: 任何第一次進入火龍捲範圍，或是在範圍內開始回合的角色必須透過一個{@dc 20}的敏捷豁免，失敗則承受 44（{@dice 8d10}）火焰傷害，成功減半。火龍捲會點燃一切未被持握，裝備的可燃物。成功釋放一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 18}）可以讓火龍捲熄滅消失。

english: Arrival at the Wreck
zh_tw: 抵達廢墟

english: When the characters arrive at the wreck, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們抵達廢墟後，向他們讀出或是描述下框中的文字

english: A towering wreck rises from the scorched hellscape. It looks like a giant sword blade, tilted to a twenty-degree angle and partly buried underground. Much of its exposed hull is rusted and torn asunder. Hot wind screams as it tears through the hollow structure, and six giant vultures circle high above it.
zh_tw: 一個塔狀的廢墟在灼熱的地獄中拔地而起。它的外觀看起來像是一把巨劍的劍刃，略有 20 度左右的傾斜，且部分被埋入了地下。它裸露在外的部分已經變得生鏽開裂，破爛不堪。熾熱的狂風從這片廢墟呼嘯而過，六隻巨大的禿鷲在上空高高地盤旋著。

english: After demons crippled this fortress in battle, Zariel abandoned it and left it to rust. The fortress is 150 feet tall, but the lower third of it is buried underground. All the lower decks have been picked clean, but the command deck at the top still holds promise. Characters can scale the wreck's torn outer hull to reach this deck, which is 80 feet off the ground at its lowest point. Climbing the outside of the wreck without proper gear requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Characters who can fly have no trouble reaching the command deck.
zh_tw: 自從惡魔們在戰鬥中將這個堡壘擊墜後，扎瑞爾就拋棄了它，任由它在此地生鏽。這個堡壘有 150 尺高，但是底下的 1/3 已經被埋入了地下。所有的底層甲板都被一掃而空，但是指揮層可能還未被搜刮。角色們可以透過攀爬廢墟撕裂的外壁來到達指揮所在層，這裡的最低點離地也有 80 尺。如果沒有合適的裝備輔助，攀爬廢墟外壁需要透過一個{@dc 15}的力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。可以飛行的角色能毫無阻礙地抵達指揮層。

english: The "giant vultures" circling above the wreck are six {@creature Vrock||vrocks} that attack anyone who gets within 50 feet of the command deck. If three vrocks are killed, the remaining ones flee and don't return.
zh_tw: 那些盤旋著的"巨大禿鷲"其實是六個{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}，它們會攻擊任何接近指揮層 50 尺內的生物。如果有三個鷲魔被宰了，剩下的就會四散而逃，絕不回頭。

english: Lower Decks
zh_tw: 底層甲板

english: The lower decks are riddled with holes, allowing easy access to the fortress interior. Characters can ascend to the command deck without needing to make ability checks simply by moving up through the ruins of the lower decks, but the wreckage inside the fortress makes the ascent arduous.
zh_tw: 底層甲板的漏洞多得和篩子一樣，讓人很容易就可以透過這些洞口進入堡壘內部。角色們可以很輕易地不用透過任何技能檢定就去到指揮層，他們只需要從廢墟的底層一步步爬上去就行，雖然遍佈的斷壁殘垣會讓這樣的攀登變得十分艱鉅。

english: Bone Whelks
zh_tw: 骸骨螺

english: Bone whelks are large mollusks that excrete an adhesive to attach skulls, bones, and other detritus to their bodies for protection. These slugs scour the wreck for organic matter to feed on, clinging to torn sections of wall, floor, and ceiling while taking shelter from the searing winds and hungry vrocks. Characters who try to make their way up through the interior of the wreck are attacked by five {@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA|bone whelks}. Too slow to mount an effective escape, the bone whelks fight to the death.
zh_tw: 骸骨螺是一種大型無脊椎動物，會分泌一種黏液將顱骨，遺骸和其他腐殖粘附在自己身上形成一層保護殼。這些蛞蝓搜刮著廢墟中的各類有機物質來填飽肚子，緊緊地貼著天花板，牆壁和地板的斷壁殘垣行走，躲避著咆哮的狂風和飢渴的鷲魔們。試圖從內部爬上指揮層的角色們會遭到 5 只{@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA|骸骨螺}的攻擊。這些傢伙想爬著逃走實在是太慢了，所以他們將會戰鬥至死。

english: When a bone whelk dies, it emits a scream that has a {@chance 50} chance of attracting the vrocks, which attack other creatures (including bone whelks) indiscriminately.
zh_tw: 當一隻骸骨螺死去時，它會爆出一聲尖叫，這會有{@chance 50}的機率吸引到鷲魔們，這些鷲魔會無差別地對其他生物（包括其他骸骨螺）一起發動攻擊。

english: {@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Bone Whelk|BGDIA|骸骨螺}

english: Soul Intake
zh_tw: 靈魂抽取管道

english: Deep inside the wreck is a 5-foot-diameter, cylindrical pipe made of iron that runs almost the full height of the fortress. This pipe was designed to siphon tormented souls from the River Styx, feeding them into a 10-foot-diameter cistern below the command deck to power the fortress. The pipe can be accessed by a hatch on every deck except the command deck. Nesting inside the cistern at the top of the pipe is a monster resembling a 30-foot-long centipede that exudes necrotic sludge. If it hears one of the hatches open, it slinks down the pipe to devour any creatures it sees. This creature uses the {@creature remorhaz} stat block, with these changes:
zh_tw: 在遺蹟的深處有著一根直徑 5 尺的圓柱形鐵管，它一直向上延伸到幾乎與堡壘等高的高低。這條管道的設計作用是從冥河中抽取受虐的靈魂，將它們投入到指揮層下方一個 10 尺直徑的容器中，作為供給整個堡壘的能量源。堡壘中除了指揮層外的每一層都有艙門口聯通這條管道。如今，一條 30 尺長的蜈蚣狀怪獸盤踞在管道頂端的滲著腐臭爛泥的容器內。當它聽到任何連通管道的艙門被開啟後，它會順著管道滑過去，吞噬一切它見到的生物。這個生物使用{@creature remorhaz||百足魔獸}的資料，但有以下改動：

english: Whenever the monster would deal fire damage, it deals necrotic damage instead.
zh_tw: 這個生物造成的一切火焰傷害都將改為暗蝕傷害。

english: It has immunity to necrotic damage instead of cold damage.
zh_tw: 它免疫暗蝕傷害，而不是寒冷傷害。

english: Command Deck Features
zh_tw: 指揮層的特徵

english: The command deck, shown on {@adventure map 3.6|BGDIA|5|Map 3.6: Wrecked Flying Fortress, Command Deck}, has the following features:
zh_tw: 指揮層如{@adventure 地圖 3.6|BGDIA|5|Map 3.6: Wrecked Flying Fortress, Command Deck}所示，具有以下特徵

english: {@b Iron Surfaces}. The floor, walls, ceilings, and doors are made of iron that has been twisted, bent, and ruptured in places. Ceilings throughout are 15 feet high.
zh_tw: {@b 鐵製表面}。地板，牆面，天花板和門都是鐵製的，如今已經扭曲，彎折，從原本的部位脫落。天花板離地 15 尺。

english: {@b Light Sources}. Areas that are exposed to the outdoors are dimly lit by the hellish red sky of Avernus. Beyond that, the only light sources are harmless showers of sparks that periodically rain down from gashes in the ceiling.
zh_tw: {@b 光源}。暴露在戶外的地區被阿弗納斯煉獄般紅色的天空微弱地照亮。除此以外，唯一的光源就是週期性從天花板上爆開掉落的無害火花。

english: {@b Slant}. Like the rest of the fortress, the command deck leans at a twenty-degree angle, with {@area area W5|27a|x} being the lowest part of the deck and {@area area W8|281|x} being the highest. The sloped metal floor is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: {@b 傾斜}。和堡壘的其他部分一樣，指揮層也傾斜 20 度。{@area 區域W5|27a|x}是它的最低點，而{@area 區域W8|281|x}是最高點。傾斜的地板被視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: Command Deck Encounters
zh_tw: 指揮層的遭遇

english: Map 3.6: Wrecked Flying Fortress, Command Deck
zh_tw: 地圖 3.6：飛行堡壘廢墟，指揮層

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: The following descriptions correspond to areas marked on map 3.6.
zh_tw: 以下描述對應於地圖 3.6 上標記的區域。

english: W1. Bridge
zh_tw: W1. 艦橋

english: Unless they've been defeated elsewhere, the six {@creature Vrock||vrocks} flying above the wreck swoop down to attack characters as they explore this area.
zh_tw: 除非這六個{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}在別處被打敗了，不然他們就會俯衝下來攻擊在此地探索的角色們。

english: Sparks rain down from gashes in the ceiling of what used to be the bridge, much of which is open to the sky. The room has been picked clean, though rows of stripped-down consoles and a few dangling chains remain.
zh_tw: 火花如雨點般從天花板的裂縫中灑落，這裡曾經是艦橋，但是已經大半暴露在天空之下。這裡已經被搜刮一空，但還殘留著一排被拆下的控制檯和一些懸掛著的鎖鏈。

english: None of the consoles are operational, though characters can salvage them for wires and other metal components.
zh_tw: 控制檯已經完全失效了，但冒險者們還是能從中剝離出可用的纜線和其他金屬材料。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: As the characters explore this location, they hear several loud infernal war machines approaching. Through holes in the wall, they can see three vehicles screaming across the hellscape toward the wreck:
zh_tw: 當角色們開始探索此地時，他們能聽見一些巨大的地獄戰爭機器靠近的聲音。透過牆壁上的洞口，他們能看見三臺機器咆哮著跨越地獄，向著廢墟襲來：

english: Two {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|Devil's Rides}, one driven by {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and the other by {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} (see "{@area Chukka and Clonk|1c0|x}"). Each kenku carries a small bag containing three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: {@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}（見{@area 楚卡和克朗克|1c0|x}）分別跨著兩架{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}。這兩位天狗各帶著一個裝著三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的小包。

english: A {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} crewed by Barnabas the {@creature flameskull} (using its {@spell mage hand} spell to drive) and three {@creature Redcap|VGM|redcaps}. Clinging to the vehicle's outer hull are six {@creature Redcap|VGM|madcaps}.
zh_tw: 一個叫巴納巴斯的{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}駕駛著一輛{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}（他用{@spell mage hand||法師之手}駕車）， 帶著三個{@creature Redcap|VGM|紅帽子}。車外還攀附著著六個{@creature Redcap|VGM|瘋帽子}。

english: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA} has sent this force to search the wreck for machine parts and other valuables. The {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA} and the {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|Devil's Rides} have 12 hours of fuel remaining before they need more {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}將這支部隊派來搜尋殘骸中的機械零件和其他有價之物。{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}和{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}剩下的燃料還夠維持 12 小時，它們需要{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}來補給。

english: If the characters left one or more infernal war machines parked outside the wrecked fortress, {@creature Chukka|BGDIA} and {@creature Clonk|BGDIA} search those vehicles while Barnabas leads the redcaps and madcaps into the lower decks of the wreck in search of treasure. If the characters left {@area Fort Knucklebone|1b3|x} on good terms with {@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA}, the flameskull and the kenku won't give the party too much trouble. However, the madcaps might try to steal one of the characters' infernal war machines or inadvertently release the monster lurking in the soul intake pipe (see "{@area Soul Intake|26c|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們在堡壘遺蹟外停泊了一輛或多輛地獄戰爭機器，{@creature Chukka|BGDIA|楚卡}和{@creature Clonk|BGDIA|克朗克}會搜檢這些戰車，而巴納巴斯會帶著紅帽子和瘋帽子們進入廢墟的低層甲板，搜刮財寶。如果角色們在離開{@area 指節骨要塞|1b3|x}的時候和{@creature Mad Maggie|BGDIA|瘋喜鵲}關係良好，天狗和燃焰之顱不會找角色們的麻煩。然而，瘋帽子還是會試著偷走一輛角色們的地獄戰爭機器，或是不經意地放出了遊蕩在靈魂抽取管道中的怪獸（見"{@area 靈魂抽取管道|26c|x}"）。

english: W2. Alarm Console
zh_tw: W2. 警報控制室

english: Characters can access this room from the deck below by climbing up through a hatch in the floor. They can also enter this room through an iron door. Describe the room to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 角色們可以從下一層甲板攀爬地板上的艙門進入此房間。他們也可以穿過一扇鐵門進入。用下文向玩家們描述這間房間：

english: Jagged gashes in the outer wall allow the hellish sky of Avernus to light this room. An open hatch in the floor leads down to the lower decks, and a metal console is plugged into one wall.
zh_tw: 外牆上鋸齒般的裂縫讓阿弗納斯的地獄天光照進了此間。地板上有一扇開啟的艙門通往下層甲板，一座金屬的控制檯連線在在了室內的一面牆上。

english: Any character who flips the switches on the console while it's plugged into the wall creates one or more of the following sound effects, which can be heard throughout the wrecked fortress:
zh_tw: 任何角色在控制檯仍連線著牆壁的時候撥動開關都會造成下列一種或是多種音效，這些聲效會響徹整個堡壘廢墟：

english: A blaring alarm klaxon
zh_tw: 一聲響亮的警報聲。

english: Loud, discordant instrumental music with screaming vocals
zh_tw: 響亮且跑調的，有著器樂伴奏的尖聲歌唱。

english: A soothing, female-sounding voice saying "Aj ta noss iz'lech'iz ta kraj-ka-nok Asmodei das," which is Infernal for, "You are important. Promotion is your destiny. Asmodeus loves you."
zh_tw: 一道輕柔的女聲說道："Aj ta noss iz'lech'iz ta kraj-ka-nok Asmodei das"，這是煉獄語，其意為："你是至關重要的。你命中註定將會晉升。阿斯蒙蒂斯喜愛你。"

english: A deep, devilish voice saying "Chy'gwa urnossk!" ("Abandon ship!" in Infernal) over and over
zh_tw: 一道深沉的魔鬼之音重複地喊著："Chy'gwa urnossk!"（煉獄語："棄艦！"）

english: W3. Damaged Machinery
zh_tw: W3. 損壞的機械

english: Describe this area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 向角色對本地區做出如下描述：

english: Sparks rain down from torn holes in the ceiling, falling onto a pair of rectangular machines that have been torn from the walls. The machines now stand in the middle of the room, their loose wires sticking out like bad hairdos.
zh_tw: 火花如雨滴般從天花板上的裂縫空洞中落下，灑在了一對從牆上被拔下的長方形機器上。如今這兩臺機器堆在了房間中，它們鬆散的纜線就像雜亂的頭髮散著。

english: Each machine resembles a metal file cabinet covered with switches and dials that no longer do anything. A character who spends at least 1 hour taking apart a machine can discern its original purpose with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check:
zh_tw: 這兩臺機器都像是金屬檔案櫃一般，其上遍佈著已經失去作用的開關和錶盤。一位花費至少一小時來研究分析這對機器的角色可以透過一個{@dc 20}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定得知：

english: The larger machine was used to scramble telepathic communications within 1 mile of the fortress.
zh_tw: 大號的那個機器能幹擾在堡壘 1 裡內的心靈通訊。

english: The smaller machine could send telepathic transmissions to all devils within 1 mile of the fortress.
zh_tw: 小號的那個機器可以向 1 裡內的所有魔鬼傳送心靈通訊。

english: W4. Records Room
zh_tw: W4. 檔案室

english: Characters who listen at the iron door to this room hear an inhuman cackling sound beyond. They need {@sense darkvision} or light sources to see into the room.
zh_tw: 如果角色們聆聽室內的情況，就會會聽見一種非人的咯咯笑聲從裡面傳來。他們需要有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}或是準備光源才能看清門內的情況。

english: Crouched on a pile of humanoid bones in the far, lowest corner of this room is a hunched gnoll that looks underfed. It gnaws on a bone while cackling maniacally to itself. Near its nest is another iron door.
zh_tw: 在房間遠處的低矮角落，一個看上去營養不良的鬣狗人蹲在一堆類人生物的骸骨之上。它一邊發出瘋狂的咯咯笑聲，一邊啃著一根骨頭。在它的巢穴邊是另一扇鐵門。

english: Lying on the floor near you are a pair of glass, bell-shaped horns attached to some loose wires. They look like they were removed from a pair of tall, slender, metal machines standing against the wall opposite you.
zh_tw: 你們腳邊的地上裸著一副玻璃質地的鐘形喇叭，它們的末端鬆散地繫著一些纜線。看起來它們是從你們對面牆上一雙高長纖細的金屬機器上拆下來的。

english: The gnoll is a shapechanged {@creature death slaad} under the effects of a {@spell feeblemind} spell. While fighting alongside Yeenoghu's demon hordes, the slaad fell into the River Styx, leaving it in a feebleminded state. In five days, it gets a new saving throw to end the effect. Any character who examines the gnoll and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check realizes that some sort of magical effect has reduced it to a witless nincompoop.
zh_tw: 這隻鬣狗人是一個受到{@spell feeblemind||弱智術}影響的變形後的{@creature death slaad||史拉亡蟾}。 它是在和耶諾古的惡魔獸群一起戰鬥時跌入了冥河，陷入了弱智的狀態。在五天內，他將再次骰出對此效果的豁免檢定。任一角色可以透過一個{@dc 15}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，可以發現是某種魔法效果讓它變成了如今的弱智傻蛋。

english: While the slaad is feebleminded, its Intelligence and Charisma scores are 1, and it can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way. It's not even self-aware enough to revert to its normal form. It eyes characters suspiciously but doesn't attack them. It has no weapons but can use its action to bite someone on its turn:
zh_tw: 在這個史拉蟾陷入弱智狀態時，它的智力和魅力變為 1，它不能施放法術，使用魔法物品，理解語言或是以可理解的方式溝通。它甚至缺乏足夠的自我認知，不能恢復成它的正常外形。它會用懷疑的目光看著角色們，但不會攻擊他們。它沒有武器，但是可以用它的行動在它的回合啃咬某人：

english: Bite
zh_tw: 啃咬

english: {@i Melee Weapon Attack}: {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@i Hit}: 8 ({@dice 1d6 + 5}) piercing damage.
zh_tw: {@i 近戰武器攻擊}: 命中 {@hit 9}，觸及 5 尺，單一生物。 {@i 命中}: 8 ({@dice 1d6 + 5}) 穿刺傷害。

english: Casting {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell heal}, or similar magic on the hapless creature restores its mental faculties, whereupon the slaad assumes its true form and attacks. As a creature of pure chaos and extreme malice, it delights in wanton destruction.
zh_tw: 對這個倒黴的生物施放{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}，{@spell heal||治癒}，或其他類似的魔法能幫它找回理智，隨後這個史拉蟾會重新恢復原形，發起攻擊。作為一個純粹混亂，極度邪惡的生物，它能從盡情放肆的破壞中收穫喜樂。

english: Machinery
zh_tw: 機械

english: The bell-shaped horns lying on the floor attach to the fronts of the two machines standing in the corner, neither of which is operational. Each machine resembles a vertical file cabinet covered with switches and burnt-out lights. A character who spends at least 1 hour taking apart a machine can discern its original purpose with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check:
zh_tw: 這副落在地上的鐘形喇叭連線著兩臺立在牆角的，已經不再運作的機器上。這兩臺機器長得都像是有著開關和燒壞的燈泡的立式檔案櫃。一個角色可以花費 1 小時拆解並研究機器，透過一個{@dc 20}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，可以發現：

english: The larger machine was used to transmit messages to other flying fortresses. (Messages were sent by speaking into the machine's glass bell.)
zh_tw: 更大的那臺機器是用來聯絡其他飛行堡壘的（透過向機器的玻璃喇叭喊話傳遞資訊。）

english: The smaller machine was used to broadcast messages throughout the flying fortress. (One could broadcast a message by speaking into the machine's glass bell.)
zh_tw: 更小的那臺機器是用來向整個飛行堡壘內部進行廣播用的。（某人可以透過向機器的玻璃喇叭喊話來進行廣播。）

english: The larger machine is damaged beyond repair, but a character proficient with {@item tinker's tools|PHB} can spend 1 hour attempting to repair the smaller machine using parts scavenged from other machines on the command deck, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence check. Once the machine's glass bell and a few wires are replaced, the device can be made to function for 24 hours. During this time, characters can use the device to transmit their voices throughout the wrecked fortress.
zh_tw: 大號的機器已經損壞到無法修復了，但是如果有角色能熟練運用{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}，他可以花費 1 小時來嘗試用從指揮層的其他機器那邊收集到的零件來修理小號的機器。他需要透過一個{@dc 15}的智力檢定來完成此任務。在機器的玻璃喇叭和其他纜線被重新修復後，這個裝置可以維持執行 24 小時。在此期間，角色們可以用這個裝置來把他們的聲音傳遍整個堡壘廢墟。

english: W5. Adamantine Rods
zh_tw: W5. 精金法杖

english: This chamber is at the lowest point of the command deck. Describe the room to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 這間房間處於整個指揮層的最低處。向玩家描述房間如下：

english: This dark room contains a metal console that has torn free of the wall to your right. Pinned between the console and another wall is a small, desiccated, winged devil that looks like it was crushed to death. In another corner stands a 3-foot block of infernal iron—a locked safe with clawed feet and a three-dial mechanism built into its thick door. Each dial bears numerals written in Infernal.
zh_tw: 這間漆黑的房間裡有一個從你們右手邊的牆上撕下來的金屬控制檯。在控制檯和另一面牆之間有一隻小號的乾透了的有翼魔鬼，看起來似乎是被砸死的。在另一個角落以一塊三尺見方的煉獄鐵箱——這是一個有著爪形腳，厚重的門上帶著三個機械錶盤的保險櫃。每個錶盤上都用煉獄語寫著數字。

english: The safe is stuck to the floor with {@item sovereign glue} and can't be moved. It's also airtight, watertight, and impervious to damage and {@item thieves' tools|phb}. To unlock it, the characters need the three-digit combination. When the dials are set to {@b 6 - 6 - 6} ("6-6-6" in Infernal), the safe door unlocks. Three {@spell knock} spells are needed to force it open, as the safe has three separate locking mechanisms.
zh_tw: 這個保險櫃被{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}黏在了地上，無法挪動。它具有氣密性，防水，且不會被破壞，也不能被{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}開啟。開啟這個箱子需要角色們使用特定的三個數字組合。當錶盤上的數位被設定為{@b 6 - 6 - 6}（煉獄語的"6-6-6"）時，這個保險櫃的門將被解鎖。使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}來強制解鎖則需要釋放三次，因為這個保險櫃有三道獨立的鎖。

english: After three unsuccessful attempts to open the safe with the wrong combination, an alarm klaxon sounds throughout the command deck. The alarm is loud enough to startle any vrocks still circling above the wreck, but the alarm attracts no one. The alarm stops after 1 minute.
zh_tw: 如果用錯誤的密碼進行了三次的失敗開鎖，一陣警報蜂鳴聲會響徹整個指揮層。這樣的警報會被盤旋在周圍的鷲魔聽見，但是它不足以吸引他們下來探查。警報會在 1 分鐘後停止。

english: The safe contains nine adamantine rods, each one weighing 3 pounds and engraved with runes that spell out the words "Solar Insidiator Lock" in Infernal, followed by a number from 1 to 9. These are the rods that the characters are searching for. Characters familiar with {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s infernal contract recall that "Solar Insidiator" is another name for the Companion. Armed with this knowledge, a character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check can conclude that the rods were designed to unlock the Companion, suggesting that it might contain something.
zh_tw: 這個保險櫃裡裝著九根精金權杖，每一根重達 3 磅，並用煉獄語銘刻的符文寫著"陰謀之陽鎖釦"以及 1-9 的編號。這就是角色們要找的權杖了。熟悉{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}的煉獄契約的角色們能回想起"陰謀之陽"是伴陽的別稱。瞭解這一情報後，角色們可以透過一個{@dc 10}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，知道這些權杖被設計用來解鎖伴陽，可能是裡面藏著什麼東西。

english: Dead Devil
zh_tw: 死去的魔鬼

english: A spined devil was operating the console when the fortress crashed into Avernus. The console tore free of one wall and pinned the devil against another wall, crushing it to death. The console is nonfunctional, and its original purpose can't be ascertained.
zh_tw: 在堡壘墜落的時候，有一個棘魔正在操作控制檯。這控制檯從牆上鬆脫，將這個魔鬼砸向了另一邊的牆上，活活壓死了。這個控制檯已經完全失去了作用，其原本的作用也不可考證了。

english: W6. Black Bell
zh_tw: W6. 黑鍾

english: Once per minute, a hollow "ka-clunk" sound emanates from this room, which contains the following:
zh_tw: 每隔一分鐘，這間房間內就傳出空洞的"咔嚓"聲，裡面的情形如下：

english: This room contains two rusty iron crates in one corner and an iron, bell-shaped contraption bolted to the floor in the opposite corner. The bell is nine feet tall and painted black, with several dents and dings in it. Every so often, the bell emits a loud "ka-clunk" sound.
zh_tw: 這間房間裡的一角有著兩個鏽跡斑斑的鐵板條箱，在相對的另一角有著一個鐵製的喇叭狀的精巧裝置被螺栓固定在了地上。這個被塗黑的裝置有 9 尺高，有幾個凹凸不平的痕跡。不時地，這個喇叭就發出響亮的"咔嚓"聲響。

english: Each crate contains twenty iron flasks of demon ichor (see "{@area Demon Ichor|1a7|x}").
zh_tw: 每個箱子裡裝有二十個裝滿惡魔穢液的鐵瓶。（見"{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}"）。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the bell-shaped contraption. Any character who examines the bell and succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check can ascertain its purpose: it kept the fortress aloft and level with the ground. The noise it makes is a rhythmic malfunction caused by the fact that the fortress is leaning to one side.
zh_tw: 施放{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}能發現這個喇叭狀的裝置閃耀著一層變化系的魔法靈光。任何檢視這個喇叭的角色在透過一個{@dc 20}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定後能確定其功能：它用來讓堡壘維持浮空並與地面平行。裝置如今發出噪音是由於堡壘正向一側傾斜而發出的一種有節奏的故障雜音。

english: W7. Stirge Nest
zh_tw: W7. 蚊蝠巢穴

english: Describe this area to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 向角色對本地區做出如下描述：

english: This chamber contains a stripped-down metal console and several rusty pipes that extend from floor to ceiling. One of the pipes has a two-foot-long gash in it.
zh_tw: 這間房間內有著一個被拆卸的金屬製控制檯，還有一些鏽跡斑斑的管道聯通著地板和天花板。其中一根管道有著一個 2 尺長的劃口。

english: The console's original purpose can't be determined.
zh_tw: 控制檯的原始用途無法確定。

english: Ten {@creature Stirge||stirges} nest in the pipe with the gash in it. If the pipe is jostled or otherwise disturbed, the stirges fly out and attack.
zh_tw: 十隻{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}在這個管道的裂口中築巢。如果有外力擠壓或是有別的事情打擾到了它們，它們就會飛出併發起攻擊。

english: W8. Signal Desks
zh_tw: W8. 資訊中心

english: This hall has four doors leading off it. Behind each door is a closet with a miniature console and chair bolted to the floor. These consoles have keys and function like Infernal typewriters. An imp stationed at each console would type orders from superiors on small slips of paper before delivering them to their intended recipients. Rigged above each desk is a long, slender horn through which bridge officers could dictate their orders.
zh_tw: 這條長廊內有有四扇門，每扇門後都有一個小型控制檯和一張固定在地上的椅子。這些控制檯有著鍵位，功能類似於煉獄打字機。每個工位上都有一個小魔鬼，將統帥的命令打在一小節紙上，然後送到各個接受命令的人那裡去。每個工位上方都掛著細長的喇叭，艦橋的官員們能由此傳達他們的命令。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: As the characters prepare to leave, a warband arrives to scavenge the wreck. This warband is led by one of the warlords described in the "{@area Warlords of the Avernian Wastelands|1e0|x}" section. The characters have a few rounds to hide, set an ambush, or return to their vehicles before the enemy warband arrives.
zh_tw: 當角色們準備離開時，一隊戰幫來到了廢墟，準備進行搜刮。這隊軍伍的領頭人是"{@area 阿弗納斯廢土上的軍閥們|1e0|x}"中的一位軍閥。角色們有幾輪的時間來躲藏，設伏，或是趕在戰幫到達前返回他們的載具。

english: Each warlord has a different reason for visiting the wreck, as outlined below.
zh_tw: 每位軍閥都有各自不同的理由來造訪廢墟，如下：

english: {@b Bitter Breath}. The horned devil is thinking about turning the wreck into a base and wants to inspect it.
zh_tw: {@b 苦痛之息}。這位角魔想把廢墟變為它的基地，因此前來探查。

english: {@b Feonor}. The archmage heard a rumor that someone has been stockpiling demon ichor inside the wreck, and she plans to steal it.
zh_tw: {@b 菲奧諾}。這位大法師聽聞一則傳言，有人在廢墟中儲存著惡魔穢液，她想偷走這些寶貝。

english: {@b Princeps Kovik}. Kovik's spies in {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s Forge have told the chain devil about the adamantine rods. Kovik plans to sell them to {@creature Mahadi the Rakshasa|BGDIA|Mahadi} (see "{@area Mahadi, Emporium Master|299|x}") for {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: {@b 元首科維克}. 科維克在{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的熔爐中的間諜們已經將精金法杖的訊息告訴了鏈魔。科維克計劃將它們賣給{@creature Mahadi the Rakshasa|BGDIA|馬哈迪}（見"{@area 商城之主馬哈迪|299|x}"）以換取{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Returning the Rods to Bel
zh_tw: 把精金權杖還給貝爾

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} isn't really expecting the characters to return the nine adamantine rods to him, and he looks positively disappointed if they do. ("We didn't even sign a contract!" he laments.) Rather, he hoped they might use the rods to unlock the Companion, thereby freeing the planetar trapped within it and potentially ruining Zariel's plans for Elturel. Bringing the nine rods back to {@creature Bel|BGDIA} merely implicates him in the plot to free the planetar. After uttering a few choice curse words, he strongly encourages the characters to take the rods to Elturel, stick them in locks along the Companion's equator, and see what happens.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾} 並不真的期望角色們將九根精金棒還給他，如果他們真的還了，他看起來會非常失望。（"我們甚至沒有籤合同！"他哀嘆道。）相反，他希望他們可能會使用這些棒子來解鎖伴侶，從而釋放被困在其中的異界神侍，並可能破壞扎瑞爾對艾爾托瑞爾的計劃。將九根棒子帶回給{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾} 只會讓他捲入釋放異界神侍的陰謀。在說了一些選擇性的咒罵之後，他強烈鼓勵角色們將棒子帶到艾爾托瑞爾，在伴侶的赤道沿線的鎖中插入它們，並看看會發生什麼。

english: Happy to let the characters keep the rods, {@creature Bel|BGDIA} makes good on his promise to reveal the location of the Bleeding Citadel. He tells the characters that the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} is a good-aligned artifact that Avernus itself has long sought to destroy. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} urges them to find the sword quickly, before the Bleeding Citadel is swallowed up by Avernus and the sword is lost forever. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is still with the party, she urges the characters to recover the sword before heading back to Elturel.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}除了樂於讓角色們持有權杖，也會守約將湧血城砦的位置告訴角色們。他會告訴角色們，{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}是一個阿弗納斯本身一直都想毀掉的善良陣營神器。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會敦促他們儘快找到這把劍，否則湧血城砦就會被阿弗納斯吞噬，而劍也會永遠地消失了。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}還和冒險者們在一起，她會督促大家在回艾爾托瑞爾前先把劍奪回來。

english: Chapter 3: Avernus - Other Locations
zh_tw: 第3章：阿弗納斯 - 其他地點

english: Some locations marked on the players' {@adventure map of Avernus|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus} lie outside the two quest paths. Others, like the Wandering Emporium and Zariel's Flying Fortress, move around. These locations are summarized below and described in the sections that follow.
zh_tw: 除了兩條任務路線外，還有一些其他位置被標註在了玩家們手中的{@adventure 阿弗納斯地圖|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus}。此外，還有流浪商城和，在不斷移動。這些位置在後面的章節中有詳述，在此簡述：

english: {@b Stygian Dock}. A river dock where flying fortresses can undergo repairs while siphoning souls from the Styx.
zh_tw: {@b 斯泰吉亞碼頭}。 這座建在冥河上的碼頭為飛行堡壘提供維修服務，並能讓他們汲取冥河中的靈魂能量。

english: {@b Styx Watchtower}. One of several fortifications along the River Styx used by devils to guard against invasion.
zh_tw: {@b 冥河瞭望塔}。 冥河周圍一系列的工事之一，魔鬼用來防備入侵的建築。

english: {@b Sundered Chains}. Broken chains of Avernus that tried and failed to bind other cities before Elturel.
zh_tw: {@b 破碎鎖鏈}。 阿弗納斯原本試圖抓取艾爾托瑞爾之前，拿來抓取別的城市卻失敗後留下的破碎的鎖鏈

english: {@b The Wandering Emporium}. A mobile marketplace built atop infernal war machines.
zh_tw: {@b 流浪商城}。 一座建在一臺地獄戰車上的移動商場。

english: {@b Zariel's Flying Fortress}. Zariel commands her legions from this mobile headquarters.
zh_tw: {@b 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘}。 扎瑞爾在這個移動的總部對她的軍團發號施令。

english: Stygian Dock
zh_tw: 斯泰吉亞碼頭

english: {@i The flying fortresses of Avernus need fuel, and what better fuel than the souls of the damned}.
zh_tw: {@i 阿弗納斯的飛行堡壘需要燃料，而有什麼燃料能比得上受詛咒的靈魂呢}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: Zariel's flying fortresses are serviced and repaired at this rusting repair dock. When the characters arrive here, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘在這個鏽跡斑斑的修船塢上接受維護和修理。在角色們抵達此地時，向玩家們念出下框中的文字：

english: A massive iron structure that appears to be a pair of docking arms straddles the River Styx and extends out over it. Hefty clamps, chains, and bars are fixed to the docking arms to lash large vessels between them.
zh_tw: 一對巨大的鐵製的船塢連線臂橫跨了冥河兩端，向內延伸。連線臂上有著大量沉重的夾鉗，鏈條和柵欄，用以固定停泊在這對連線臂中的大型艦船。

english: If the players arrive here after meeting {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, Zariel's flying fortress is present (see "{@area Zariel's Flying Fortress|2b0|x}"). If so, read the following boxed text to your players:
zh_tw: 如果玩家們是在和{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}會面後抵達此地，扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘就會停泊在此（見"{@area 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘|2b0|x}"）。如果是這種情況，向你的玩家們讀出下框的文字：

english: A gigantic basalt citadel shaped like a sword blade is moored at the dock. The flying fortress thrums as screaming souls from the River Styx are drawn up into it.
zh_tw: 一艘巨型的，如同劍刃一般的玄武岩堡壘停靠在了碼頭上。飛行堡壘被固定在了冥河之上，嗡嗡作響地吸取著河裡尖嘯著的靈魂。

english: The Stygian dock is a 100-foot-high service platform protruding from the rocky cliffs of the River Styx. The clamps, chains, and bars fixed to the upper arms of the dock hold flying fortresses in place.
zh_tw: 斯泰吉亞碼頭是冥河兩岸峭壁上向前突出建造的維修平臺，高達 100 尺。那些固定在連線臂上端的夾鉗，鏈條和柵欄是用來固定飛行堡壘的。

english: A {@creature horned devil} named Bazelsteen manages the dock for Zariel but yearns for the freedom to carry out its mechanical experiments. To earn its aid, visitors must first serve as test pilots for the devil's latest contraption.
zh_tw: 一個名叫巴澤勒斯滕的{@creature horned devil||角魔}為扎瑞爾管理碼頭，但他渴望能自由地實驗自己的機械工程機器。想要尋求他的幫助的訪客必須先給這個魔鬼當他最新型的機器試駕員。

english: Twelve {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils} patrol the dock in groups of three devils each. If Zariel's flying fortress is present, three {@creature Bone Devil||bone devils} also circle overhead. Intruders are attacked or warned away. If the characters try to negotiate with the devils, Bazelsteen swoops down to deal with them personally.
zh_tw: 12 個{@creature Barbed Devil||蝟魔}在甲板上三個一組進行巡邏。如果扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘在港，另有 3 個{@creature Bone Devil||骨魔}在天上盤旋。任何闖入者都會被打走，或是警告驅離。如果角色們希望和魔鬼做個交易，巴澤勒斯滕會親自落地和他們私下裡談。

english: Dealing with Bazelsteen
zh_tw: 和巴澤勒斯滕做交易

english: Engine oil covers this horned devil, which constantly chews on a shard of smoking, red hot coal. Bazelsteen is more interested in machines than creatures and is willing to repair or modify any infernal war machine that the characters currently use. See {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} for possible weapon replacements, armor upgrades, and magic gadgetry. Instead of payment, the horned devil requires that they help it complete a test (see "Test Run 221" below).
