If the characters perform this task well, Bazelsteen agrees to fully repair their infernal war machines. He also offers one free weapon swap, armor upgrade, or magical gadget.
zh_tw: 這個有角的魔鬼身上沾滿了引擎油，它不斷地咀嚼著一塊冒煙的、熾熱的煤塊。巴澤斯汀對機器比對生物更感興趣，願意修理或改造角色們當前使用的任何地獄戰爭機器。見{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11}以瞭解可能的武器替換、盔甲升級和魔法裝置。作為支付，這個有角的魔鬼要求他們幫助它完成一個測試（見下文的"測試執行221"）。如果角色們很好地執行這項任務，巴澤斯汀同意完全修理他們的地獄戰爭機器。他還提供一個免費的武器交換、盔甲升級或魔法裝置。

english: Test Run 221
zh_tw: 試執行 221

english: If the characters accept Bazelsteen's terms, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了巴澤斯汀的條件，請向玩家讀出或轉述以下加框的文字：

english: Bazelsteen takes you to a rusty barge anchored on the River Styx a few hundred yards from the dock. Hanging from the barge's loading crane by a rusty chain is a ten-foot-diameter, spherical diving bell made of iron and glass. Suction tubes protrude from the diving bell's lower hemisphere like flimsy arms.
zh_tw: 巴澤爾斯汀帶你到冥河上錨定的一艘生鏽的駁船，距離碼頭幾百碼遠。駁船的裝載起重機上掛著一個由鐵和玻璃製成的十尺直徑的球形潛水鐘，它由一條生鏽的鏈條懸掛著。潛水鐘的下半球伸出吸管，像脆弱的手臂一樣。

english: Bazelsteen built the experimental bathysphere to dredge the bottom of the River Styx for silted souls. He needs to test it, but he's unwilling to risk his devils. Bazelsteen's bathysphere is a Large object that can fit up to four Medium creatures inside it. The hatch is located in the bathysphere's upper hemisphere. Bazelsteen assures the characters that the device is airtight and watertight.
zh_tw: 巴澤斯汀建造了這個實驗性的潛水球，用來從冥河的河底挖掘沉積的靈魂。他需要測試它，但他不願意拿他的魔鬼冒險。巴澤斯汀的潛水球是一個大型物體，可以容納多達四個中型生物在裡面。艙口位於潛水球的上半球。巴澤斯汀向角色們保證這個裝置是密封且防水的。

english: Bazelsteen asks the characters to secure themselves inside the diving bell while he uses the crane to lower them into the river. Their job is to use the suction arms to scoop up silted souls from the bottom of the river, which lies 40 feet below the barge. The diving bell is attached to 50 feet of chain—more than enough length to reach the river's bottom. There are four "suction stations" inside the diving bell, each one equipped with a chair and some metal control levers.
zh_tw: 巴澤斯汀要求角色們在潛水鐘內固定自己，然後他用起重機將他們降到河中。他們的任務是使用吸盤臂從河底撈起沉積的靈魂，河底位於駁船下方40尺處。潛水鐘附著有50尺長的鏈條——長度足夠到達河底。潛水鐘內有四個"吸盤站"，每個站都配有一把椅子和一些金屬控制桿。

english: Bazelsteen knows that the diving bell has enough air to sustain one occupant for 1 hour (or four occupants for 15 minutes each). To be on the safe side, he plans to keep the diving bell submerged for only 10 minutes.
zh_tw: 巴澤斯汀知道潛水鐘有足夠的空氣來維持一個居住者1小時（或四個居住者每人15分鐘）。為了安全起見，他計劃只讓潛水鐘浸泡10分鐘。

english: If multiple characters participate in the experiment, Bazelsteen taps on the bathysphere before lowering it into the water and tells its occupants, "Whichever of you sucks up the most silted souls gets a {@item soul coin|BGDIA}."
zh_tw: 如果有多個角色參與實驗，巴澤爾斯汀在將潛水球放入水中之前會輕敲它，並告訴裡面的人說："你們當中吸收最多泥沙靈魂的人將獲得一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。"

english: Tortured souls coursing through the River Styx claw and scream at the bathysphere as they pass by. Once the bathysphere is lowered to the river bottom, characters inside it can use its siphoning tubes to suck up the silted souls that lie there. At the end of each minute, a character operating a suction station makes a Dexterity check. The number of silted souls that the character siphons is equal to the check result. The silted souls are stored in tanks attached to the bathysphere's underbelly, and dials on the tanks track the number of silted souls in each one.
zh_tw: 在冥河中穿行的受折磨的靈魂在經過深海探測球時會抓撓並尖叫。一旦深海探測球被降到河底，裡面的人物可以使用其抽吸管吸起躺在那裡的沉積靈魂。每分鐘結束時，操作吸盤站的角色需要進行一次敏捷檢定。角色吸起的沉積靈魂數量等於檢定結果。沉積靈魂被儲存在連線在深海探測球底部的罐子裡，罐子上的儀表跟蹤每個罐子中的沉積靈魂數量。

english: Fiends dine on silted souls like ambrosia. Silted souls can also be formed into lemures once they're "rescued" from the river's depths.
zh_tw: 惡魔們像享用仙露一樣享用沉積的靈魂。一旦從河底"救出"，沉積的靈魂也可以被塑造成劣魔們（一種低階惡魔）。

english: Demon Attack
zh_tw: 惡魔襲擊

english: Ten minutes after the bathysphere is lowered into the river, ten {@creature Vrock||vrocks} swoop down from the sky and attack the Stygian dock. Bazelsteen is lured away by the attack, leaving the barge and its crane unattended. When Bazelsteen leaves, have the characters roll initiative. Characters in the bathysphere have no idea what's happening on the barge, or vice versa, and the River Styx is so dark that visibility in the water is reduced to 10 feet.
zh_tw: 潛水球被放入河中十分鐘後，十隻{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}從天而降，攻擊冥河碼頭。巴澤爾斯汀被攻擊吸引走了，留下了無人看管的駁船和它的起重機。當巴澤爾斯汀離開時，讓角色們擲先攻骰。在潛水球裡的角色不知道駁船上發生了什麼，反之亦然，而且冥河非常黑暗，水下的能見度降低到了10尺。

english: Any character left on the barge can take control of the unattended crane. While seated at the crane's controls, the character can use an action to try to figure out how to operate them, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. If the check fails by 5 or more, the character accidentally drags the bathysphere {@dice 2d10} feet across the river bottom, dealing 5 ({@dice 2d4}) bludgeoning damage to all creatures inside it. It takes three consecutive, successful checks to bring the bathysphere back onto the barge.
zh_tw: 任何留在駁船上的角色都可以控制無人操作的起重機。坐在起重機控制檯前時，角色可以使用一個動作來嘗試弄清楚如何操作它，透過一個成功的 {@dc 17} 智力 ({@skill Arcana||奧秘}) 檢定來完成操作。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，角色意外地將潛水球拖拽了 {@dice 2d10} 尺在河底移動，對其中所有生物造成5 ({@dice 2d4}) 點鈍擊傷害。需要連續三次成功的檢定才能將潛水球帶回駁船上。

english: After the characters each take a turn, a {@creature glabrezu} lands on the barge and rolls initiative. On each of its turns, the demon uses its action and one of its pincers to try to snip through the bathysphere's rusty chain, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength check. If the chain breaks, the bathysphere falls to the bottom of the River Styx and remains there until salvaged. Once the glabrezu has taken three turns, Bazelsteen returns and scares the demon away if it hasn't been defeated by then. If the bathysphere's chain breaks, Bazelsteen dubs Test Run 221 a failure and leaves the sunken party members to their doom. Otherwise, the horned devil uses the crane to hoist the bathysphere back onto the barge, dubs the experiment a success, and rewards a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} to the character who suctioned up the most silted souls.
zh_tw: 在每個角色輪流行動後，一隻 {@creature glabrezu||迷誘魔} 降落在駁船上並擲先攻。在它的每回合，惡魔會使用它的動作和一隻鉗子試圖剪斷潛水球的生鏽鐵鏈，成功進行 {@dc 20} 力量檢定即可做到。如果鐵鏈斷裂，潛水球將墜落至冥河河底，直到被打撈上來。一旦格拉布祖行動了三輪，巴澤爾斯坦將返回並嚇跑惡魔，如果惡魔在那時還未被擊敗。如果潛水球的鐵鏈斷裂，巴澤爾斯坦將宣佈測試執行221失敗，並讓沉沒的隊員走向毀滅。否則，角魔會用起重機將潛水球吊回駁船，宣佈實驗成功，並獎勵一個 {@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣} 給收集了最多淤泥靈魂的角色。

english: Characters in the bathysphere begin to suffocate once its air supply is depleted. Opening the hatch while the bathysphere is submerged causes the River Styx to flood the compartment, exposing its occupants to the river's effects (see "{@area River Styx|1a3|x}").
zh_tw: 當深潛球內的空氣耗盡後，其中的角色開始窒息。在深潛球處於水下時開啟艙門會導致冥河之水湧入艙室，使其中的人員暴露於河流的效果之下（參見"{@area 冥河|1a3|x}"）。

english: Styx Watchtowers
zh_tw: 冥河瞭望塔

english: {@i The Styx is the demons' gateway into the Nine Hells. The devils keep a watchful eye on its shores}!
zh_tw: {@i 冥河是惡魔進入九層地獄的門戶。惡魔們警惕地監視著它的岸邊}!

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: Along the banks of the River Styx stand guard towers spaced such that no demonic army can enter Avernus without being spotted. Each tower outpost is within sight of two others, and neighboring troops can quickly arrive to aid in crushing an incursion should demons emerge from the river. Zariel's devils garrison these outposts, but in lean times when the souls of Avernus are dwindling, some of these structures remain vacant. Also, the mutable landscape of Avernus leaves outposts isolated from time to time.
zh_tw: 在冥河的河岸上，警衛塔被間隔設定，使得沒有任何惡魔軍隊能夠在不被察覺的情況下進入阿弗納斯。每個塔樓前哨站都能看到另外兩個，鄰近的部隊可以迅速到達，以幫助鎮壓任何從河中出現的惡魔的入侵。扎瑞爾的惡魔駐守在這些前哨站，但在阿弗納斯的靈魂減少的困難時期，這些建築中的一些會空置。此外，阿弗納斯變化多端的地形有時會使前哨站變得孤立無援。

english: Watchtower Features
zh_tw: 瞭望塔特點

english: A typical watchtower is a squat, 30-foot-tall, open-topped structure made of black basalt. Its other features are summarized below.
zh_tw: 一個典型的瞭望塔是一個矮胖的、30尺高的開放式頂部結構，由黑色的玄武岩製成。它的其他特徵如下所述。

english: {@b Garrison}. Unless it has been abandoned, the tower is staffed by an {@creature amnizu|MTF} commander, a {@creature chain devil} subcommander, ten {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} (each one with a {@creature hell hound} on the end of a short chain), and two {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} (see "{@area Watchtower Locations|28e|x}" for how these devils are deployed).
zh_tw: {@b 駐軍}。除非已被廢棄，否則塔樓由一位{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}指揮官，一位{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}副指揮官，十位{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}（每位都牽著一隻短鏈上的{@creature hell hound||地獄獵犬}）以及兩位{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}駐守（見"{@area 瞭望塔地區|28e|x}"瞭解這些魔鬼的部署方式）。

english: {@b Bugles}. Each devil on watch duty is issued an iron bugle. Blowing the bugle is a bonus action that blasts a hideous drone audible within 300 feet.
zh_tw: {@b 號角}。每個值班的魔鬼都會得到一個鐵製號角。吹響號角是一個附贈動作，會發出一個在300尺內可聽到的可怕嗡嗡聲。

english: {@b Exterior Grounds}. The ground is free of cover in a 60-foot radius around the tower.
zh_tw: {@b 外部場地}。塔周圍60尺半徑內沒有掩體。

english: {@b Wall Chains}. Barbed iron chains hang at 10-foot intervals down the exterior walls. These chains are part of the tower's defense, as the chain devil subcommander can animate them using its Animate Chains ability. Climbing a chain requires a successful {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: {@b 牆壁鏈條}. 帶刺的鐵鏈以10尺的間隔懸掛在外牆上。這些鏈條是塔樓防禦的一部分，因為鏈魔副指揮官可以使用其活化鏈條能力使它們活化。攀爬鏈條需要透過一個 {@dc 16} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Map 3.7: Styx Watchtower
zh_tw: 地圖 3.7: 冥河瞭望塔

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Watchtower Locations
zh_tw: 瞭望塔地區

english: The following locations are keyed to map 3.7.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖3.7。

english: T1. Ground Floor
zh_tw: T1. 一樓

english: The door at ground level is a stone slab secured from within by an iron crossbar that lifts away easily but requires a {@dc 23} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to break from the outside.
zh_tw: 地面層的門是一塊石板，從內部用一根鐵閂固定，鐵閂可以輕鬆抬起，但從外部打破需要進行一個{@dc 23}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: This level of the tower is drab and unadorned save for a plain, rectangular stone table set with a pair of stone benches. Spare polearms and scale armor, suitable for five Large and ten Medium devils, are stored in racks along the walls.
zh_tw: 這座塔的這一層非常單調且沒有裝飾，除了一張普通的長方形石桌和一對石凳。適合五個大型和十個中型魔鬼的備用長柄武器和鱗甲存放在牆邊的架子上。

english: Ten {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} and ten {@creature Hell Hound||hell hounds} occupy this floor. There is a {@chance 30} chance that half of the bearded devils and hell hounds are out patrolling the perimeter at any given time, returning 1 minute after combat starts unless the fighting remains very quiet.
zh_tw: 十隻{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}和十隻{@creature Hell Hound||地獄獵犬}佔據了這一層。任何時候都有{@chance 30}的機率，其中一半的須魔和地獄獵犬正在外圍巡邏，除非戰鬥保持得非常安靜，否則它們會在戰鬥開始1分鐘後返回。

english: An iron ladder rises through a hole in the northwest corner wide enough to accommodate Large creatures.
zh_tw: 一個鐵製梯子透過西北角的一個洞口上升，洞口足夠寬以容納大型生物。

english: T2. Second Floor
zh_tw: T2. 二樓

english: The tower's {@creature amnizu|MTF} commander and a {@creature chain devil} subcommander reside here. These commanders enjoy having one or more sentient beings on hand to torture, to help alleviate boredom.
zh_tw: 塔樓的{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}指揮官和一位{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}副指揮官居住在這裡。這些指揮官喜歡手頭有一或多個有感知的生物來折磨，以幫助緩解無聊。

english: The floor of this room is strewn with hooked chains, and manacles are bolted to the walls. In the middle of the room, a spiked iron chair is bolted to the floor. The chair's armrests and legs are fitted with iron shackles.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上散佈著帶鉤的鏈條，牆上固定著手銬。在房間中央，一把帶刺的鐵椅被固定在地板上。椅子的扶手和腿上裝有鐵製的鐐銬。

english: One corner of the room has gaping holes in the floor and ceiling, through which passes a large iron ladder leading to the tower's ground floor and rooftop.
zh_tw: 房間的一個角落在地板和天花板上有大洞，透過這些洞口有一架大型鐵梯通往塔的底層和屋頂。

english: The devils like to chain prisoners to the walls and use the spiked chair for interrogations. The chain devil can use its Animate Chains ability to animate the chains.
zh_tw: 魔鬼們喜歡將囚犯鎖在牆上，並使用帶刺的椅子進行審訊。鏈魔可以利用其活化鎖鏈的能力來啟用這些鏈條。

english: T3. Roof
zh_tw: T3. 屋頂

english: Two {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} roost on the roof and act as lookouts and scouts. An opening in one corner grants access to the tower's interior, with an iron ladder leading down to areas T1 and T2.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}棲息在屋頂上，充當哨兵和偵察兵。一個角落的開口通向塔樓的內部，有一架鐵梯通往T1和T2區域。

english: Sundered Chains
zh_tw: 破碎鎖鏈

english: {@i As close to a place of pilgrimage as you'll find in this accursed place. A beacon to those seeking the missing link or looking for a way out}.
zh_tw: {@i 在這個被詛咒的地方，這裡幾乎算是一個朝聖地。對於那些尋找缺失環節或尋求出路的人來說，這是一個指引燈塔。}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: When the characters arrive at one of these locations, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這些地點之一時，請向玩家閱讀以下加框文字：

english: Colossal spiked chains extend across the hellscape, their links partially buried under the ash and large chunks of masonry. Each broken chain is roughly a mile long.
zh_tw: 巨大的帶刺鐵鏈橫跨地獄景觀，它們的鏈環部分被埋在灰燼和大塊的石雕下。每條斷裂的鐵鏈大約有一英里長。

english: Long ago, these giant chains tethered an abducted city to Avernus. That city somehow tore free, leaving behind its broken bonds and scattered chunks of masonry. The chains are similar to the ones that bind Elturel.
zh_tw: 很久以前，這些巨大的鏈條將一個被綁架的城市拴在阿弗納斯。那個城市不知怎麼地掙脫了，留下了它破碎的束縛和散落的石塊。這些鏈條與束縛艾爾托瑞爾的鏈條相似。

english: Characters who examine a chain can tell that some intense, supernatural force caused one or more of its links to sunder. Although the cause of the damage can't be ascertained, characters can conclude that breaking the chains of Elturel is not beyond the realm of possibility.
zh_tw: 檢查鏈條的角色可以判斷出某種強烈、超自然的力量導致一個或多個鏈環斷裂。儘管無法確定損壞的原因，角色們可以得出結論，破壞艾爾托瑞爾的鏈條並非不可能之事。

english: Infernal Pilgrim
zh_tw: 煉獄聖地

english: Chain devils often make pilgrimages to these sites. The first sundered chain the characters happen upon has a {@creature chain devil} named Zartar performing a ritual atop it.
zh_tw: 鏈魔經常到這些遺址進行朝聖。角色們偶然遇到的第一條斷裂的鏈條上有一個名叫扎塔爾的{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}在其上進行儀式。

english: Zartar believes that the sundered chain can bestow great strength upon any chain devil that stands atop it while chanting prayers to Asmodeus. The chain devil is guarded by two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}, Narg and Yangor. If the characters make any noise near Zartar, they disturb the chain devil's concentration, causing all three devils to attack with fury.
zh_tw: 扎塔爾相信，斷裂的鏈條可以賦予任何站在其上並唸誦向阿斯蒙蒂斯祈禱的鏈魔巨大的力量。這個鏈魔由兩個{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}，納爾格和揚戈爾守護。如果角色們在扎塔爾附近發出任何噪音，他們會擾亂鏈魔的專注力，導致這三個魔鬼憤怒地攻擊。

english: The Wandering Emporium
zh_tw: 流浪商城

english: {@i Mahadi's Wandering Emporium has a knack for showing up when you least expect it}.
zh_tw: {@i 馬哈迪的漫遊商行總在你最不期待的時候出現}.

english: —The Cartographer
zh_tw: ——製圖師

english: A traveling bazaar winds its way across Avernus—a wandering menagerie of merchants, artisans, and misfits who ply their respective trades and sell their wares under the direction of Mahadi, a rakshasa that claims Asmodeus as his patron.
zh_tw: 一個旅行市集蜿蜒穿過阿弗納斯——一群流浪的商人、工匠和不合群的人，在馬哈迪的指導下從事他們各自的行業並出售他們的商品，馬哈迪是一個聲稱阿斯蒙蒂斯為他的庇護者的羅剎。

english: Most merchants in the Wandering Emporium are indentured to Mahadi's service until they pay off their soul debts. In many cases, the terms of repayment are vague enough to keep them in Mahadi's employ for as long as he deems them necessary to the operation of the Wandering Emporium.
zh_tw: 流浪商行中的大多數商人都被抵押給馬哈迪的服務，直到他們償還他們的靈魂債務。在許多情況下，償還條款足夠模糊，以使他們長期受僱於馬哈迪，只要他認為他們對流浪商行的運營是必要的。

english: Story Hooks
zh_tw: 故事動機

english: The characters could arrive at the Wandering Emporium for one or more of the following reasons:
zh_tw: 角色們可能因為以下一個或多個原因來到流浪商城：

english: The characters need supplies, weapons, or even an infernal war machine.
zh_tw: 角色們需要補給、武器，甚至可能是一臺地獄戰爭機器。

english: The characters need a safe place to rest and perhaps get a good meal.
zh_tw: 角色們需要一個安全的地方休息，也許還可以享用一頓美食。

english: The characters might have heard that they can sell demon ichor to a crazed wizard in the Wandering Emporium.
zh_tw: 角色們可能聽說他們可以在流浪商城賣給一個瘋狂的法師惡魔之血。

english: The characters might have collected more {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} than they feel comfortable carrying and need a place to spend them.
zh_tw: 角色們可能收集了比他們願意攜帶的更多的{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，並且需要一個地方來消費它們。

english: Mahadi, Emporium Master
zh_tw: 商城之主馬哈迪

english: {@creature Mahadi the rakshasa|BGDIA} appears as a wealthy merchant lord. Though extremely powerful, Mahadi doesn't believe in taking unnecessary risks, particularly in the Nine Hells where he can be permanently slain. Mahadi acts as the eyes and ears of Asmodeus in Avernus. As a deal broker and moderator, he's privy to all manner of dealings that might otherwise escape the attention of his patron.
zh_tw: {@creature Mahadi the rakshasa|BGDIA|羅剎馬哈迪}看起來像一個富有的商人領主。儘管極其強大，馬哈迪不相信冒不必要的風險，特別是在九層地獄，在那裡他可能會被永久殺死。馬哈迪作為阿斯蒙蒂斯在阿弗納斯的眼睛和耳朵。作為一個交易經紀人和調解人，他能夠瞭解到所有可能否則會逃過他贊助人注意的交易。

english: In his role as the master of the Wandering Emporium, Mahadi has received special dispensation from Asmodeus to travel freely between the Material Plane and the Nine Hells to operate his business, as well as to pursue information and broker contracts and other such arrangements as needed.
zh_tw: 作為流浪商城的主人，馬哈迪從阿斯蒙蒂斯這裡獲得了特許令，可以自由地在物質位面和九獄之間穿梭，經營他的業務，蒐集資訊，商討契約，以及進行其他必要的運營。

english: In addition to managing the Wandering Emporium, Mahadi is also the proprietor and host of {@area Infernal Rapture|2a1|x}, a restaurant and spa. Since the establishment exists within a demiplane, patrons can comfortably visit it at any time, even while the caravan is on the move. As long as they can pay for services rendered, guests need not fear being trapped within, since Mahadi is very serious about maintaining the contract between host and guest. Each guest must agree to this formal arrangement prior to gaining entrance.
zh_tw: 除了管理流浪商城，馬哈迪還是{@area 地獄極樂|2a1|x}的老闆和主人，這是一個餐廳和水療中心。由於該場所存在於一個半位面中，顧客可以隨時舒適地訪問它，即使商隊在移動中也是如此。只要他們能支付所提供的服務，客人就不必擔心被困在其中，因為馬哈迪非常認真地維護主人和客人之間的合同。每位客人必須在進入之前同意這種正式安排。

english: Mahadi has a special collection of named {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, each of which harbors the soul of an enemy the rakshasa vanquished in the past. Mahadi consults with these souls individually, forcing them to provide insight on all manner of subjects.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪擁有一個特殊的命名{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}收藏，每一枚都包含著羅剎在過去擊敗的敵人的靈魂。馬哈迪單獨與這些靈魂進行諮詢，迫使它們就各種主題提供見解。

english: Roleplaying Mahadi
zh_tw: 扮演馬哈迪

english: Outwardly, Mahadi presents himself as a charismatic and gracious host. He makes each guest of Infernal Rapture feel as though they're the most important person in all the planes of existence, catering to their every whim and desire. While he is equally cordial to all guests of the Wandering Emporium, those entering his establishment fall under a special contract and therefore rank most highly in his esteem.
zh_tw: 在外表上，馬哈迪表現得既有魅力又彬彬有禮。他讓每一位地獄極樂的客人都感覺他們是所有存在位面中最重要的人，滿足他們的每一個奇想和願望。雖然他對流浪百貨商店的所有客人都同樣親切，但那些進入他商店的人則受到特殊合同的約束，因此在他心中的地位最高。

english: Of course, guests leaving Infernal Rapture are expected to pay their bills in full prior to departure. If a guest cannot pay for whatever reason, the contract they signed on entry clearly stipulates their soul is forfeit. They're required to pay off their debt through service. All such individuals fall under the effect of a {@spell geas} cast as a 9th-level spell, which cannot be willingly broken by the affected individual until their debt is paid in full. What Mahadi does with such defaulters depends on their capabilities. Some become indentured servants, working at Infernal Rapture. If they possess a talent for sales, they might eventually obtain a business to run within the Wandering Emporium.
zh_tw: 當然，離開地獄極樂的客人需要在離開前全額支付賬單。如果客人由於某種原因無法支付，他們在進入時簽署的合同清楚地規定了他們的靈魂將被沒收。他們需要透過服務來償還債務。所有這些人都將受到一個9環法術位的{@spell geas||指使術}法術的影響，受影響的個人在債務完全償還之前不能自願打破這個法術。馬哈迪如何處理這些違約者取決於他們的能力。有些成為契約僕人，在地獄極樂工作。如果他們具有銷售天賦，他們可能最終在流浪商城內獲得一個業務來經營。

english: If adventurers inform Mahadi (and by extension Asmodeus) about Arkhan's possession of the {@item Hand of Vecna}, Mahadi does everything he can to strike a deal with them, offering any of the gifts listed under "{@area Mahadi's Deals|29b|x}" in exchange for the artifact. This is in lieu of the terms normally offered by Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者通知馬哈迪（並由此通知阿斯蒙蒂斯）關於阿克漢擁有{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}的情況，馬哈迪會盡一切努力與他們達成交易，提供在"{@area 馬哈迪的交易|29b|x}"下列出的任何禮物作為交換，以換取這個神器。這是代替阿斯蒙蒂斯通常提供的條款。

english: Mahadi's Deals
zh_tw: 馬哈迪的交易

english: Mahadi has the power to make deals at the direction and with the authority of Asmodeus as if he were an archdevil (see {@adventure appendix A|BGDIA|10}). All such deals must be presented to the other party without alteration, and they are not negotiable. In all such agreements, Asmodeus wants one thing only: a character signing one of these contracts gives up their soul forever. After the signing character reaches 17th level, if at any point they die, their death is permanent, with no chance to return from the grave. Asmodeus takes their soul and makes them a {@creature pit fiend}, in his service for eternity.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪擁有以阿斯蒙蒂斯的名義和許可權進行交易的力量，彷彿他是一位魔鬼大公（參見{@adventure 附錄A|BGDIA|10}）。所有這些交易都必須原封不動地呈現給對方，且不可協商。在所有此類協議中，阿斯蒙蒂斯只想要一樣東西：簽署這些合同之一的角色將永遠放棄他們的靈魂。在簽署角色達到17級後，如果在任何時候死亡，他們的死亡將是永久性的，沒有機會從墳墓中復活。阿斯蒙蒂斯將奪取他們的靈魂並將他們變成{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}，永遠為他服務。

english: Mahadi can offer the following gifts in exchange for a soul contract:
zh_tw: 馬哈迪可以提供以下禮物以換取靈魂契約：

english: {@b Magic Item}. Asmodeus gifts the adventurer with a {@item rod of lordly might}, to which only the recipient and its direct descendants can attune.
zh_tw: {@b 魔法物品}。阿斯蒙蒂斯贈送給冒險者一根{@item rod of lordly might||王者權杖}（尊貴之力法杖），只有接受者及其直系後裔可以與之協調。

english: {@b Resurrection}. Asmodeus sends one of his loyal priest followers to cast {@spell true resurrection} on a deceased character.
zh_tw: {@b 復生術}。阿斯蒙蒂斯派遣他的一位忠誠的牧師追隨者對一個已故的角色施放{@spell true resurrection||完全復生術}（真正復活）。

english: {@b Tiefling Transformation}. Asmodeus transforms the character into a {@race tiefling} with a direct infernal bloodline to him. Substitute the character's racial traits with {@race tiefling} racial traits.
zh_tw: {@b 提夫林變形}。阿斯蒙蒂斯將角色轉變為具有直接地獄血統的{@race tiefling||提夫林}。用{@race tiefling||提夫林}種族特性替換角色的種族特性。

english: Mahadi and Zariel
zh_tw: 馬哈迪與扎瑞爾

english: Zariel relies on Mahadi's services to provide supplies, magic items, and other items of value necessary for continuing her campaign in the Blood War. Infernal Rapture has also been known to host meetings or high-ranking devils as a neutral and private space.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾依賴馬哈迪的服務來提供物資、魔法物品以及其他對繼續她在血戰中的活動必不可少的有價值物品。地獄極樂也被認為是一箇中立且私密的空間，用於舉辦高階別魔鬼的會面。

english: Mahadi is bound by contract with Asmodeus to not stage a coup in Avernus or directly assist others to do so. Nothing in the contract, however, states that Mahadi can't indirectly assist others in attempting to overthrow Zariel or whoever else is in control, either by imparting information or selling goods.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪與阿斯蒙蒂斯有合同約束，不得在阿弗納斯發動政變，也不得直接幫助他人這麼做。然而，合同中沒有任何條款規定馬哈迪不能間接幫助他人試圖推翻扎瑞爾或任何其他掌權者，無論是透過傳遞資訊還是銷售商品。

english: Mahadi and Lulu
zh_tw: 馬哈迪與露露

english: When {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} arrives at the Wandering Emporium, its tantalizing sights, sounds, and smells are dimly familiar to her. Mahadi seems more familiar to {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} than anything else in the emporium, but she can't remember why.
zh_tw: 當{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}到達流浪商城時，它誘人的景象、聲音和氣味對她來說是模糊熟悉的。馬哈迪對{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}來說比交易市場的其他任何東西都更熟悉，但她記不得為什麼。

english: Although {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has no memory of any prior visit to the Wandering Emporium, Mahadi is happy to remind her that he sheltered {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} for a while after she became lost in Avernus. What Mahadi fails to mention is that, after earning her trust, he splashed {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} with water from the River Styx to strip her of her spellcasting abilities and memories. Mahadi then sold {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to some devils who, in turn, delivered her back to Zariel.
zh_tw: 雖然{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}不記得曾到訪過流浪者商棧，但馬哈迪很高興提醒她，在她迷失於阿弗納斯後，他曾收留{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}一段時間。馬哈迪沒有提到的是，在贏得她的信任後，他將{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}潑上了冥河之水，剝奪了她的施法能力和記憶。隨後，馬哈迪將{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}賣給了一些魔鬼，這些魔鬼又將她送回了扎瑞爾。

english: Mahadi is surprised to see {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} again but tries not to show it. He initially suspects that the hollyphant has come seeking revenge for the memory loss he inflicted upon her. Once he realizes that her intentions are benign, Mahadi pretends to be her friend once more.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪再次見到{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}時感到驚訝，但儘量不表現出來。起初，他懷疑這隻象頭人是來報復他讓她失去記憶的。一旦他意識到她的意圖是善良的，馬哈迪再次假裝是她的朋友。

english: Approaching the Wandering Emporium
zh_tw: 接近流浪商城

english: The Wandering Emporium travels on the backs of nine Huge infernal war machines similar to {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|Demon Grinders}, but with Flamethrowers and Styx Sprayers instead of Chompers and Wrecking Balls.
zh_tw: 流浪商行行駛在九個類似{@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}的巨大地獄戰爭機器的背上，但配備的是火焰噴射器和冥河噴射器，而不是嚼碎機和破壞球。

english: When {@creature Mahadi the Rakshasa|BGDIA|Mahadi} finds an adequate location to set up shop, he orders his drivers to form a horseshoe-shaped defensive perimeter. As the infernal war machines grind to a halt, their crews (comprised of indentured humans, {@creature duergar}, {@creature Hobgoblin||hobgoblins}, {@creature Salamander||salamanders}, {@creature Succubus||succubi}, {@creature Incubus||incubi}, and assorted other creatures) disembark and begin unpacking tents and whatnot. All shops are open within the hour and remain open for business until Mahadi decides it's time to pack up and move elsewhere.
zh_tw: 當{@creature Mahadi the Rakshasa|BGDIA|馬哈迪}找到一個合適的地點來設立商店時，他命令他的駕駛員形成一個馬蹄形的防禦周界。隨著地獄戰爭機器停止運轉，他們的船員（由契約人類、{@creature duergar||灰矮人}、{@creature Hobgoblin||大地精}、{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}、{@creature Succubus||魅魔}、{@creature Incubus||夢魔}以及其他各種生物組成）下船並開始卸下帳篷等物品。所有商店在一小時內開放，並保持營業，直到馬哈迪決定是時候打包搬到其他地方。

english: If the characters come upon the Wandering Emporium while it's open for business, describe it to the players as follows:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在流浪百貨商店營業時來到這裡，請按以下方式向玩家描述它：

english: A collection of brightly colored tents stands clustered together, creating an oasis of comfort amid the dread landscape of Avernus. Huge infernal war machines form a horseshoe about the tents, with curtains made of small, rectangular iron plates and lamps dangling from chains strung between them. Soft, lilting music and wondrous smells drift across the hot winds, inviting a closer look.
zh_tw: 一系列色彩鮮豔的帳篷聚集在一起，構成了阿弗納斯可怕景觀中的一片舒適綠洲。巨大的地獄戰爭機器圍繞著帳篷形成一個馬蹄形，帳篷由小的矩形鐵板製成的窗簾和懸掛在它們之間的鏈子上的燈籠組成。柔和悠揚的音樂和奇妙的氣味隨著熱風飄散，吸引著人們走近一看。

english: The Wandering Emporium provides a haven for all who enter and is considered neutral ground for those that might otherwise initiate a conflict. A sign posted at the entrance, strangely understandable in all languages, simply states: "All are welcome here. No fighting! No spellcasting! No exceptions!"
zh_tw: 流浪商城為所有進入者提供庇護所，並被認為是那些可能引發衝突的人的中立地帶。入口處掛著一個牌子，奇怪地可以用所有語言理解，簡單地宣告："這裡歡迎所有人。禁止打鬥！禁止施法！沒有例外！"

english: Mahadi greets all visitors, directing them toward whatever establishments interest them the most while reserving the highest praise for his own beloved restaurant and spa, Infernal Rapture. There, he fulfills their every desire in an attempt to place them in his debt. If this doesn't work, he isn't averse to offering payment in exchange for services rendered. The characters are welcome to stay as long as they wish, until such time as Mahadi decides it's time to pack up and go elsewhere. Characters indebted to Mahadi can stay on with the Wandering Emporium, but only as his servants.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪歡迎所有訪客，引導他們前往他們最感興趣的場所，同時為他自己的心愛餐館和水療中心——地獄極樂——保留最高的讚譽。在那裡，他滿足他們的每一個願望，試圖讓他們欠下他的人情。如果這不起作用，他也不反對提供報酬以換取提供的服務。角色們可以隨心所欲地停留，直到馬哈迪決定打包離開去其他地方。欠馬哈迪人情的角色可以繼續留在流浪商行，但只能作為他的僕人。

english: Wandering Emporium Businesses
zh_tw: 流浪商城的商店

english: The characters are free to visit any establishment in the Wandering Emporium. You can create your own businesses and add them to those presented here.
zh_tw: 角色們可以自由訪問流浪商城中的任何一家店鋪。你可以創造自己的商業並將其新增到此處展示的列表中。

english: Infernal Rapture
zh_tw: 地獄極樂

english: As the owner and host of Infernal Rapture, Mahadi takes his responsibilities very seriously. Every patron that enters the demiplane that houses his establishment must sign an infernal contract. It presents a very simple arrangement stipulating that patrons must pay for everything consumed and all services used before they leave.
zh_tw: 作為地獄極樂的主人和店主，馬哈迪非常認真地對待自己的職責。每個進入他所經營場所的半位面的顧客都必須簽署一份地獄契約。這份契約提出了一個非常簡單的安排，規定顧客在離開之前必須支付所有消費和服務的費用。

english: Mahadi employs many servants, each of them under the effect of a {@spell geas} spell to provide the best service they possibly can and appear happy while they work. Most of these individuals are former patrons.
zh_tw: 馬哈迪僱傭了許多僕人，他們都受到{@spell geas||指使術}法術的影響，以儘可能提供最好的服務並在工作時顯得快樂。這些個體大多數是前顧客。

english: Upon entry into Infernal Rapture, guests are escorted to a private chamber where they may lounge on pillows, cushions, and divans as they place orders for extravagant dishes from across the planes of existence and enjoy a variety of spa services that range from the simple and mundane to the exotic and bizarre.
zh_tw: 進入地獄極樂後，客人被引導至一個私人房間，在那裡他們可以躺在枕頭、墊子和沙發上，同時點選來自存在各個層面的奢華菜餚，並享受從簡單平凡到異國情調和奇異的水療服務。

english: Since Infernal Rapture exists in a demiplane, it doesn't technically reside in the Nine Hells. If someone wanted to meet with creatures unable or unwilling to travel to the Nine Hells (or even just Avernus), this establishment provides a possible meeting location. Of course, entrance to the demiplane must be negotiated with Mahadi, with the promise of appropriate payment.
zh_tw: 由於地獄極樂存在於一個半位面中，它從技術上講並不位於九層地獄。如果有人想要與那些無法或不願前往九層地獄（甚至只是阿弗納斯）的生物會面，這個場所提供了一個可能的會面地點。當然，進入半位面的入口必須與馬哈迪協商，並承諾支付適當的費用。

english: Each chamber that exists inside Infernal Rapture is created for a specific purpose. When that purpose ends and the occupants of the chamber leave, that room ceases to exist unless Mahadi deems otherwise.
zh_tw: 地獄極樂記憶體在的每個房間都是為了一個特定的目的而建立的。當這個目的結束且房間的居住者離開時，那個房間就會停止存在，除非馬哈迪另有決定。

english: Dining Services
zh_tw: 餐飲服務

english: The dining menu at Infernal Rapture changes daily, providing a fixed-price selection. Sample menus are provided as player handouts in {@adventure appendix E|BGDIA|14}. A full meal costs one {@item soul coin|BGDIA}. Unlike food consumed elsewhere in Avernus, which is uniformly terrible, the food at Infernal Rapture tastes delicious.
zh_tw: 地獄極樂的餐飲選單每天更換，提供固定價格的選擇。樣本選單作為玩家手冊在{@adventure 附錄 E|BGDIA|14}中提供。一頓完整的餐食花費一個{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。與阿弗納斯其他地方消費的食物不同，那裡的食物普遍難吃，而地獄極樂的食物味道卻非常美味。

english: Special food requests can be filled, but they must be made weeks in advance and can be costly. Mahadi charges from five to ten {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} for an exotic request, depending on the difficulty involved in fulfilling it. Consuming a meal at Infernal Rapture has the same benefits as a {@spell heroes' feast} spell, with the added effect that those who eat the food have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made against Mahadi.
zh_tw: 特殊食物請求可以得到滿足，但必須提前幾周提出，並且可能成本很高。馬哈迪對一個異國情調的請求收費從五到十個{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，具體取決於滿足它所涉及的難度。在地獄極樂享用餐食與施放{@spell heroes' feast||英雄宴}法術有相同的好處，並且有額外的效果，即那些食用食物的人在對馬哈迪進行的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定時會有不利。

english: Spa Services
zh_tw: 水療服務

english: Infernal Rapture offers a variety of spa services. Light spa amenities (body, foot, and hand treatments, massage therapy, skin care, general grooming and bathing) are included along with the standard dining menu at no additional expense.
zh_tw: 地獄極樂提供各種水療服務。輕水療設施（身體、足部和手部護理、按摩療法、皮膚護理、一般修飾和沐浴）包含在標準餐飲選單中，無需額外費用。

english: Specialty services include dream therapy, whole body restoration, and longevity therapy, as well as a host of services for every appetite, both wholesome and degenerate. Each of these services costs an additional {@item soul coin|BGDIA}. Mahadi consistently and laboriously upsells further services to clients at additional expense. He seeks to take possession of such individuals and make them permanent residents of Avernus.
zh_tw: 特色服務包括夢境治療、全身恢復和長壽療法，以及滿足各種慾望的服務，無論是健康的還是墮落的。這些服務中的每一項都需要額外支付一個{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。馬哈迪始終不懈並費力地向客戶推銷更多服務，以增加費用。他試圖佔有這些人，使他們成為阿弗納斯的永久居民。

english: Firesnake Forge
zh_tw: 火蛇鍛爐

english: This establishment is run by three {@creature Salamander||salamanders} named Rassh, Skids, and Slagg. The salamanders owe Mahadi a debt for taking them in and secreting them away after a bold escape from {@area Bel's Forge|251|x}. They operate as indentured servants, maintaining Mahadi's infernal war machines while also crafting wares for sale to visitors. From time to time, Mahadi sends them abroad to procure parts to refurbish the caravan. Nine {@creature Magmin||magmins} and eight suits of {@creature animated armor} assist the salamanders with their work.
zh_tw: 這個場所由三隻名叫拉什、斯基茲和斯拉格的{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}經營。這些火蜥蜴因為馬哈迪收留他們並在他們大膽逃離{@area 貝爾鍛爐|251|x}後秘密轉移他們而欠下他人情。他們作為抵押的僕人運營，維護馬哈迪的地獄戰爭機器，同時也為訪客製作商品出售。不時地，馬哈迪派遣他們出國採購零件來整修車隊。九個{@creature Magmin||火童}和八套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}協助火蜥蜴完成他們的工作。

english: The salamanders' infernal war machine has been cobbled together from a half dozen others. At a moment's notice, the vehicle can separate into three smaller infernal war machines, each piloted by one of the salamanders. Treat these smaller vehicles as {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|Tormentors}.
zh_tw: 火蜥蜴的地獄戰爭機器是由其他六種拼湊而成的。在接到命令的瞬間，這輛車可以分離成三個更小的地獄戰爭機器，每個由一隻火蜥蜴駕駛。將這些較小的車輛視為{@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}。

english: Weapons and Armor
zh_tw: 武器和護甲

english: All metal armor and weapons listed in {@book chapter 5|PHB|5} of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} are available for sale at this shop, at a 150 percent markup.
zh_tw: {@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中{@book 第五章|PHB|5}列出的所有金屬護甲和武器均在此店出售，售價為原價的150%。

english: Infernal War Machine Repair
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器修理

english: The salamanders can repair a damaged but functional infernal war machine at a cost of 50 gp per hit point restored.
zh_tw: 火蜥蜴可以修復受損但功能正常的地獄戰爭機器，每恢復1點生命值的費用是50金幣。

english: Burney the Barber
zh_tw: 理髮師布妮

english: Burney appears as a cheerful, well-kept Calishite woman. She provides all services any proficient barber might, up to and including medical attention for those with injuries or ailments. For healing purposes, treat Burney as though she has the {@feat Healer||Healer feat} as well as proficiency with both the {@item healer's kit|PHB} and the {@item herbalism kit|PHB}.
zh_tw: 布妮看起來是一位快樂、保養得當的卡利什女性。她提供任何熟練理髮師可能提供的服務，包括為受傷或有疾病的人提供醫療照顧。為了治療目的，將布妮視為具有{@feat Healer||治療者特性}以及對{@item healer's kit|PHB|醫療包}和{@item herbalism kit|PHB|草藥工具}的熟練使用。

english: While she works, Burney tells all manner of stories, making them up as she goes along, but always with a moral at the end. Burney's stories might point toward an achievable objective, if the customer is of good alignment and inclined to take direction from the chatty barber.
zh_tw: 布妮在工作時講述各種故事，邊講邊編，但總是以一個道德教訓作為結尾。如果顧客的陣營是善良的，並且願意接受這位健談理髮師的指導，布妮的故事可能會指向一個可實現的目標。

english: Burney is, in fact, an {@creature ancient copper dragon} named Balarystul. Burney resides in Avernus on direct assignment from Bahamut, keeping an eye out for signs of increased activity among Tiamat's followers. After the last time the queen of evil dragons tried to escape the Nine Hells, those who oppose her are taking no chances. Burney is particularly interested in any information about the activities of {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} (see "{@area Arkhan the Cruel|24f|x}").
zh_tw: 伯尼實際上是一位名叫巴拉瑞斯圖(巴拉里斯圖爾)的{@creature ancient copper dragon||遠古赤銅龍}。伯尼根據巴哈姆特的直接指派居住在阿弗納斯，留意提亞馬特追隨者之間活動增加的跡象。在邪惡龍後上一次試圖逃離九層地獄之後，那些反對她的人不會放過任何機會。伯尼對有關{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}(見"{@area 殘酷者阿克漢|24f|x}")的活動資訊特別感興趣。

english: Burney has received several blessings in her service to Bahamut:
zh_tw: 效力於巴哈姆特的布妮獲得了幾項賜福：

english: Unless Burney decided otherwise, once any creature less powerful than a deity has taken three steps from her, they can no longer remember her or having interacted with her specifically.
zh_tw: 除非布妮願意，否則任何比神明弱小的生物在離開她三步以後就會忘記她，不會記得與她一起具體做了些什麼。

english: Burney is under the effect of a permanent {@spell mind blank} spell, and cannot be detected by magical or mundane means unless she wishes it. In exchange for this blessing, Burney can take no direct action against the denizens of the Nine Hells, though she can certainly enlist the help of those who can.
zh_tw: 布妮身上被永久施展了{@spell mind blank||心靈屏障}的效果，除非她允許，否則無法透過魔法或普通手段發現這一點。為了換取這一賜福，布妮不能直接出手，和九獄的居民敵對。當然，她可以尋求不受限制者的幫助。

english: Burney always knows the location of the Wandering Emporium and can transport herself there as though by a {@spell word of recall} spell. This explains why Burney simply seems to appear amid the fully deployed marketplace each morning it is active to provide service and tell stories.
zh_tw: 布妮一直知道流浪商城的所在地點，她自己可以透過{@spell word of recall||回返真言}傳送至此。這也是為什麼布妮每天早上都似乎是憑空般的出現在已經完全展開的市場中間，給客戶提供服務和講故事。

english: Once each day, when Burney so desires, she can instantly transport herself to the court of Bahamut via a powerful blessing akin to the {@spell plane shift} spell.
zh_tw: 只要她願意，布妮每天有一次瞬間將她自己透過一個類似{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}的賜福，傳送到巴哈姆特王廷中的機會。

english: Barber Pricing
zh_tw: 理髮價格

english: Burney charges 1 gp for each service involving grooming. Burney can provide some small amount of magic healing, but only does so for good-aligned creatures, and at no cost.
zh_tw: 布妮對每項涉及美容的服務收取1金幣。布妮可以提供一些少量的魔法治療，但只對善良陣營的生物提供，並且不收費。

english: If someone offers Burney a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} for any reason, she looks extremely disappointed and turns it down. She refuses even to touch one.
zh_tw: 如果有人出於任何原因給布妮一個{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，她會顯得非常失望並拒絕接受。她甚至拒絕觸碰一個。

english: From Here to Avernus
zh_tw: 從這裡到阿弗納斯

english: Fhet'Ahla, an {@creature amnizu|MTF}, provides {@creature Imp||imps} as couriers as well as a variety of spellcasting services for transmitting information over long distances. The more secure the means, however, the more expensive the service. Additionally, Fhet'Ahla acts as an exchange for {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}, offering 100 gp in coins or gemstones for each {@item soul coin|BGDIA} delivered, and can serve as an official notary for the signing of infernal contracts.
zh_tw: 費特阿拉，一位{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}，提供{@creature Imp||小魔鬼}作為信使，以及各種施法服務，用於在長距離傳輸資訊。然而，傳輸手段越安全，服務費用就越昂貴。此外，費特阿拉還充當{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}的交換所，每交付一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，提供100金幣的硬幣或寶石，並可以作為官方公證人簽署地獄契約。

english: Fhet'Ahla failed a critical mission at some point in the past and gained the disfavor of Asmodeus. As a punishment, Asmodeus posted him with Mahadi. While Fhet'Ahla doesn't owe Mahadi any kind of debt, he is on the wrong side of Asmodeus and has no idea how many centuries this service will last. The amnizu is also forbidden from challenging Mahadi's authority in all matters pertaining to the operation of the Wandering Emporium or any other special assignments the rakshasa receives from Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 費特阿拉在過去某個時候未能完成一個關鍵任務，失去了阿斯蒙蒂斯的寵愛。作為懲罰，阿斯蒙蒂斯將他安排在馬哈迪手下。雖然費特阿拉不欠馬哈迪任何債務，但他在阿斯蒙蒂斯的對立面，也不知道這項服務將持續多少世紀。這位安祖魔還被禁止在任何涉及流浪商城運營或羅剎從阿斯蒙蒂斯那裡收到的任何其他特殊任務的事務上挑戰馬哈迪的權威。

english: Delivery Pricing
zh_tw: 運輸費

english: Fhet'Ahla charges a single {@item soul coin|BGDIA} for parcel deliveries weighing 5 pounds or less. For a larger parcel (up to 50 pounds), he charges two {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: 費特阿拉對重量為5磅或以下的包裹遞送收取一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。對於更大的包裹（重達50磅），他收取兩枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Notary Pricing
zh_tw: 公證費

english: Fhet'Ahla charges a single {@item soul coin|BGDIA} for notary services and collects a single {@item soul coin|BGDIA} for exchanges that don't involve the soul of a celestial. If a celestial is involved, he collects ten {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}.
zh_tw: 費特阿拉對公證服務收取一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，併為不涉及天界生物靈魂的交易收取一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。如果涉及到天界生物，他將收取十枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Ichor's Aweigh!
zh_tw: 新鮮穢液！

english: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA}, a lawful evil human {@creature mage}, collects and sells flasks of {@area demon ichor|1a7|x}. Exposure to demon ichor has warped {@creature Elliach|BGDIA} in the following ways:
zh_tw: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}，一個守序邪惡的人類{@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}，收集並出售裝有{@area 惡魔穢液|1a7|x}的小瓶。接觸惡魔之血使{@creature mage||魔法師}以以下方式發生了變異：

english: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA}'s arms have become tentacles with fingers at the ends, increasing his reach by 5 feet.
zh_tw: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}的手臂已經變成了帶有末端手指的觸手，這使他的觸及範圍增加了5尺。

english: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA}'s ears sprouted wings and flew away. Consequently, he is deaf. He relies on lip-reading and hand gestures.
zh_tw: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}的耳朵長出了翅膀並飛走了。因此，他失聰了。他依靠讀唇和手勢來交流。

english: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA} met Mahadi while on the run from debt collectors. Mahadi saw the value in paying off {@creature Elliach|BGDIA}'s debts and bringing him to Avernus to work in the Wandering Emporium. Thought to be insane by many of the other vendors, {@creature Elliach|BGDIA} uses demon ichor in a host of magical experiments, none of which seem to have the intended results.
zh_tw: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}在逃避債主時遇到了馬哈迪。馬哈迪看到了償還{@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}債務的價值，並把他帶到阿弗納斯在流浪商行工作。儘管許多其他商販認為{@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}瘋了，但他在一系列魔法實驗中使用惡魔之血，但這些實驗似乎都沒有達到預期的結果。

english: Demon Ichor Prices
zh_tw: 惡魔穢液價格

english: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA} sells demon ichor for 100 gp a flask and buys demon ichor for 25 gp a flask.
zh_tw: {@creature Elliach|BGDIA|艾拉赫}以每瓶100金幣的價格出售惡魔之血，並以每瓶25金幣的價格購買惡魔之血。

english: Z'neth's Larva Farm
zh_tw: 澤尼斯的幼蟲魔牧場

english: Z'neth is a bitter, old {@creature hobgoblin warlord} who buys and sells {@creature Larva|DMG|larvae} (see {@book chapter 2|DMG|2|Hades} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for statistics). Mahadi facilitated Z'neth's rise to power, helping him destroy entire kingdoms on the Material Plane. Z'neth's conquests eventually caught the eye of the mighty god Maglubiyet, who offered Z'neth a command on the battlefields of Gehenna. Before he could wrack up his first victory on that plane, however, Mahadi collected on Z'neth's debt and bore him away to Avernus, where he languishes in obscurity, far from the planar battlefield he had hoped to die on.
zh_tw: 澤涅斯是一個苦大仇深的老{@creature hobgoblin warlord||大地精軍閥}，他買賣{@creature Larva|DMG|幼蟲魔們}（相關資料請見{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@book 第二章|DMG|2|Hades}）。馬哈迪幫助澤涅斯獲得權力，協助他摧毀了物質位面的多個王國。澤涅斯的征服最終引起了強大的神祇瑪格魯比耶特的注意，後者任命他為焦炎火獄戰場的指揮官。然而，在他取得該位面的首次勝利之前，馬哈迪便收回了澤涅斯的債務，並將其帶到了阿弗納斯。澤涅斯從此在默默無聞中萎靡不振，遠離了他曾希望戰死的位面戰場。

english: Z'neth procures larvae from yugoloths and sells them at marked-up prices to hags and other interested buyers, giving half his proceeds to Mahadi in exchange for food and other necessities. Z'neth's wares are of little interest to adventurers. However, Z'neth is fond of using his profits to hire assassins to kill Mahadi, which the rakshasa finds endlessly amusing.
zh_tw: 茲內斯從尤格羅斯魔那裡採購幼蟲魔，並以高價賣給巫婆和其他感興趣的買家，將一半的收入給馬哈迪作為食物和其他必需品的交換。茲內斯的商品對冒險者來說幾乎沒有興趣。然而，茲內斯喜歡用他的利潤僱傭刺客去殺馬哈迪，這讓羅剎覺得非常有趣。

english: If the characters pay his establishment a visit, Z'neth offers them nine {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} (all he has) for Mahadi's head. A {@spell geas} spell prevents the hobgoblin from divulging Mahadi's true form. Mahadi greets Z'neth's would-be assassins with a smile and is more than happy to accept Z'neth's {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} as payment for goods and services at his fine restaurant.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拜訪他的場所，茲內斯向他們提供九枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}（他所有的），作為馬哈迪的頭顱的報酬。一個{@spell geas||指使術}法術阻止了大地精透露馬哈迪的真實形態。馬哈迪面帶微笑地迎接茲內斯的潛在刺客們，並且非常樂意接受茲內斯的{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}作為他精美餐館的商品和服務的支付。

english: Larvae
zh_tw: 幼蟲魔們

english: At any given time, Z'neth has {@dice 2d6} {@creature Larva|DMG|larvae} trapped in cages. He charges one {@item soul coin|BGDIA} per larva.
zh_tw: 在任何給定時間，茲內斯有{@dice 2d6}只{@creature Larva|DMG|幼蟲魔們}被困在籠子裡。他每隻幼蟲魔收費一個{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。

english: Zariel's Flying Fortress
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘

english: This 450-foot-tall structure is mobile and therefore doesn't appear on the poster map of Avernus or on {@adventure map 3.1|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus}. From this flying fortress, Zariel oversees the defense of her infernal realm.
zh_tw: 這個450尺高的建築是可移動的，因此不會出現在阿弗納斯的海報地圖或{@adventure 地圖 3.1|BGDIA|3|Map 3.1: Avernus}上。從這個飛行要塞，扎瑞爾監督她的地獄領域的防禦。

english: Attempting to infiltrate the fortress while it's on the move proves lethal due to the hundreds of devils onboard. While undergoing repairs and refueling at the Stygian Dock (see "{@area Stygian Dock|285|x}"), Zariel and most of her crew aren't present, leaving the fortress with a skeleton crew that consists of the following hostile forces:
zh_tw: 試圖在堡壘移動時潛入其中證明是致命的，因為有數百個魔鬼在船上。在冥河碼頭（見"{@area 斯泰吉亞碼頭|285|x}"）進行修理和加油時，扎瑞爾和她的大部份船員不在場，留下堡壘由以下敵對力量組成的最低限度的留守人員：

english: An {@creature erinyes} named Nariangela, who guards the bridge on the command deck (the fortress's topmost deck)
zh_tw: 一個名叫納裡安格拉的{@creature erinyes||罪魔}，守衛著指揮甲板上的橋樑（堡壘的最高層甲板）

english: Eighteen {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} in plate armor (AC 18), patrolling the lower decks in pairs
zh_tw: 十八個穿著板甲的{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}（AC 18），成對在下層甲板巡邏

english: Three {@creature Bone Devil||bone devils}, circling above the fortress
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Bone Devil||骨魔}，在堡壘上空盤旋

english: Infiltrating the Fortress
zh_tw: 入侵堡壘

english: Characters can enter Zariel's flying fortress using any of the following routes.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過以下任何路線進入扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘。

english: Rooftop Hatch
zh_tw: 屋頂艙口

english: Characters capable of flight can enter the flying fortress through an unlocked, 10-foot-square hatch on the flat top of the flying fortress. The hatch is watched by the bone devils that fly above the fortress and leads to a corridor just outside the bridge on the command deck. The corridor is not guarded while the flying fortress is moored at the Stygian Dock.
zh_tw: 能夠飛行的角色可以透過飛行要塞平坦頂部上一個未上鎖的10尺見方艙口進入飛行要塞。這個艙口由飛越要塞上空的骨魔守衛，並通向位於指揮甲板上艦橋外的走廊。當飛行要塞停靠在冥河碼頭時，這個走廊沒有守衛。

english: Signal Vents
zh_tw: 訊號口

english: Tiny hatches in the hull connect to 1-foot-diameter chutes that ascend to the vessel's command deck. During battle, Zariel's imp couriers use these chutes to enter and exit the flying fortress. Characters reduced to Tiny size or in gaseous form can navigate these narrow chutes to reach the command deck.
zh_tw: 船體上的小型艙口連線著直徑1尺的滑道，這些滑道通向飛船的指揮甲板。在戰鬥中，扎瑞爾的小惡魔信使使用這些滑道進出飛行堡壘。被縮小到微型大小或以氣態形式存在的角色可以透過這些狹窄的滑道到達指揮甲板。

english: Soul Intake Pipe
zh_tw: 靈魂抽取管道

english: Souls from the River Styx are drawn up into the flying fortress through a grilled vent at the bottom end of the fortress. This vent leads to a 5-foot-diameter, iron pipe that ascends through the body of the flying fortress to a 10-foot-diameter, spherical iron cistern directly below the command deck. The pipe is 400 feet long from top to bottom and has access hatches leading to each of the lower decks, but not the command deck.
zh_tw: 來自冥河的靈魂透過要塞底部末端的一個格柵通風口被吸入飛行要塞。這個通風口通向一個直徑5尺的鐵管，它穿過飛行要塞的主體，上升到指揮甲板正下方一個直徑10尺的球形鐵水箱。這個管道從上到下長400尺，有通往每個下層甲板的訪問艙口，但沒有通往指揮甲板的。

english: Necrotic energy floods the soul intake pipe and cistern while the flying fortress is docked above the River Styx. While the pipe is siphoning souls out of the Styx and storing them in the cistern, any creature that enters the pipe or cistern for the first time on its turn or starts its turn in either location takes 16 ({@dice 3d10}) necrotic damage.
zh_tw: 當飛行要塞停靠在冥河上方時，死靈能量湧入靈魂吸入管和蓄水池。當管道正在從冥河中吸取靈魂並將它們儲存在蓄水池中時，任何生物如果在其回合首次進入管道或蓄水池，或在其回合開始時位於任一位置，都會受到16（{@dice 3d10}）點暗蝕傷害。

english: Moving the Fortress
zh_tw: 開動堡壘

english: Characters who defeat the erinyes on the bridge might try to commandeer the flying fortress. However, there are no controls for moving or steering the fortress, as its movements are controlled telepathically by Zariel, and only while she's aboard. No one else can move the flying fortress.
zh_tw: 擊敗橋上的罪魔的角色可能會嘗試奪取飛行堡壘的控制權。然而，沒有用於移動或操縱堡壘的控制裝置，因為它的移動是由扎瑞爾透過心靈感應控制的，並且只有在她在船上時才行。沒有其他人可以移動飛行堡壘。

english: Sabotaging the Fortress
zh_tw: 破壞堡壘

english: Characters can sabotage the fortress by disabling or destroying a bell-like contraption on the bridge. This contraption is identical to the one in {@area area W6|27d|x} on the {@area wrecked flying fortress|267|x}, except that it's not making any strange noises beyond a low, barely audible hum. This device keeps the flying fortress aloft and level. Encasing the giant bell in an {@spell antimagic field} or destroying it causes the fortress to crash. The contraption is a Large object with AC 19, a damage threshold of 10, 45 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過禁用或摧毀位於艦橋上的一個類似鐘的裝置來破壞要塞。這個裝置與位於{@area 區域W6|27d|x}的{@area 飛行堡壘廢墟|267|x}中的裝置相同，除了它沒有發出任何奇怪的聲音，只有微弱的低沉嗡嗡聲。這個裝置使飛行要塞保持在空中並維持水平。將這個巨大的鐘罩在一個{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}中或摧毀它會導致要塞墜毀。這個裝置是一個大型物體，具有AC 19，傷害閾值為10，45生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Crashing the fortress destroys it. Any creature aboard the flying fortress when it crashes takes 70 ({@dice 20d6}) bludgeoning damage plus 70 ({@dice 20d6}) fire damage, and falls {@condition prone} amid the twisted wreckage.
zh_tw: 摧毀要塞會導致它墜落。任何在飛行要塞墜落時在船上的生物會受到70 ({@dice 20d6})點鈍擊傷害加上70 ({@dice 20d6})點火焰傷害，並在扭曲的殘骸中{@condition prone||伏地}（倒地）。

english: Stowing Away
zh_tw: 偷渡

english: Characters can stow away inside the flying fortress while it's moored at the Stygian Dock, provided they sneak aboard without being detected. When the flying fortress is repaired and refueled, Zariel returns with the rest of her crew and takes the flying fortress to the front lines of the Blood War.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在飛行堡壘停靠在冥河碼頭時藏身其中，前提是他們能夠不被察覺地潛入船上。當飛行堡壘修理完畢並加滿燃料後，扎瑞爾和她的其餘船員會返回，並將飛行堡壘帶到血戰的前線。

english: Whenever Zariel is aboard the flying fortress, its crew complement consists of hundreds of devils—too many for characters to defeat without an army behind them. Deck patrols are bolstered by erinyes using {@sense truesight} to search for ethereal and {@condition invisible} enemies, making it unlikely that stowaways will stay hidden for long.
zh_tw: 每當扎瑞爾在飛行要塞上時，其船員隊伍由數百個魔鬼組成——對於角色來說，如果沒有軍隊的支援，他們不可能擊敗這麼多魔鬼。甲板巡邏由使用{@sense truesight||真實視覺}搜尋以太和{@condition invisible||隱形}敵人的罪魔加強，這使得偷渡者很難長時間隱藏。

english: If the characters allow themselves to get caught, they are hauled before Zariel on the command deck, where she is joined by a {@creature pit fiend} general and six {@creature erinyes} bridge officers, including Nariangela. A dozen {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} in plate armor (AC 18) stand guard. For advice on roleplaying Zariel, see {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓自己被捕，他們將被帶到指揮甲板上的扎瑞爾面前，她旁邊有一位{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}將軍和包括納裡安吉拉在內的六位{@creature erinyes||罪魔}橋樑軍官。十二個穿著板甲的{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}（AC 18）守衛在此。關於扮演扎瑞爾的建議，請參閱{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}。

english: Poor Devil: Thavius Kreeg
zh_tw: 可憐的魔鬼：塔維斯·克雷格

english: If the characters killed {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}, his soul ends up in the Nine Hells, where it emerges from the River Styx as a lemure. Zariel instantly becomes aware of Thavius's fate and retrieves him. After promoting Thavius to an amnizu devil for his faithful service, Zariel confines him until Elturel's destruction. The characters find Thavius trapped in a cell aboard Zariel's flying fortress, feeling sorry for himself.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中殺死了{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，他的靈魂最終會到達九層地獄，從冥河中以劣魔的形式出現。扎瑞爾立刻意識到塔維斯的命運並將他救出。在提升塔維斯為安祖魔魔鬼以表彰他的忠誠服務後，扎瑞爾將他關押起來，直到艾爾托瑞爾的毀滅。角色們在扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘上的一個牢房中找到了自怨自艾的塔維斯。

english: Characters who search the lower decks of Zariel's flying fortress hear sobs coming from an unguarded cellblock. If they investigate the sobbing, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 搜尋扎瑞爾飛行要塞下層甲板的角色會聽到來自一個無人守衛的牢房區的哭泣聲。如果他們調查這哭泣聲，請向玩家讀出以下框選文字：

english: Through the bars of a cell, you see a sobbing figure huddled in the shadows. It appears to be a paunchy devil with small wings and horns, bound by shackles to the far wall. The walls of his cell are covered with blasphemous runes that glow with an infernal red light.
zh_tw: 透過牢房的柵欄，你看到一個蜷縮在陰影中的哭泣身影。它看起來是一個有小翅膀和角的大腹便便的魔鬼，被鐐銬鎖在遠處的牆上。他的牢房牆壁上覆蓋著發光的地獄紅色褻瀆符文。

english: The pitiable figure in the cell is {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, now an {@creature amnizu|MTF}. If the characters met Thavius when he was human, they recognize him in his devil form with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The locked cell door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or a character can use {@item thieves' tools|phb} to try to pick its lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 牢房中的可憐身影是{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，現在已變為{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}。如果角色們在塔維斯還是人類時見過他，他們可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定認出他的魔鬼形態。牢房的門可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟，或者角色可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}嘗試撬鎖，成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定即可實現。

english: Thavius poses no threat to the characters in his current predicament, and his shackles aren't long enough to let him get close to the cell door. Characters can kill him at range without even entering the cell, if they wish, by launching attacks through the bars. However, Thavius screams in agony whenever he takes damage, which might attract nearby patrols of bearded devils, at your discretion.
zh_tw: 塞維烏斯（塔維斯）在目前的困境中對角色們構不成威脅，他的鐐銬不夠長，無法讓他靠近牢房門。如果角色們願意，他們可以在不進入牢房的情況下遠端殺死他，透過牢房的鐵欄杆發動攻擊。然而，每當塞維烏斯受到傷害時，他都會痛苦地尖叫，這可能會吸引附近的須魔巡邏隊，具體取決於你的判斷。

english: Once Elturel is pulled down into the River Styx, Thavius believes Zariel will set him free, but until then he's content to wallow in self-pity. He didn't expect to end up in the Nine Hells so soon. See {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8} for more information on how to roleplay the devil Thavius.
zh_tw: 一旦艾爾托瑞爾被拉入冥河，塔維斯認為扎瑞爾會放他自由，但在那之前，他寧願沉浸在自憐中。他沒想到這麼快就到了九層地獄。有關如何扮演魔鬼塔維斯的更多資訊，請參閱{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}。

english: Symbols and Shackles
zh_tw: 符號與枷鎖

english: The symbols on the walls prevent creatures from teleporting into and out of the cell. For example, a creature can't use {@spell misty step} or {@spell dimension door} to enter or leave the cell. However, the cell does not prohibit creatures from entering or leaving via altered forms. For example, a creature in gaseous form can slip between the bars to enter or leave the cell, as can any creature thin enough to pass between the bars.
zh_tw: 牆上的符號阻止生物透過傳送進入或離開牢房。例如，生物不能使用{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}或{@spell dimension door||任意門}進入或離開牢房。然而，牢房並不禁止生物透過改變形態進入或離開。例如，以氣態形式存在的生物可以溜過柵欄進入或離開牢房，任何足夠瘦小能夠穿過柵欄的生物也可以做到這一點。

english: Only Zariel can unlock Thavius's shackles, though a creature can break them with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The shackles can also be attacked; they have AC 19, a damage threshold of 15, hp 20, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
zh_tw: 只有扎瑞爾可以解開塔維斯的鐐銬，儘管一個生物透過成功的 {@dc 25} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定可以將其打破。鐐銬也可以被攻擊；它們有 AC 19，傷害閾值為 15，生命值為 20，對毒性和心靈傷害免疫，並且對非精金製成的非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫。

english: Roaming Encounter: Smiler the Defiler
zh_tw: 漫遊遭遇：汙化者笑爺

english: Characters can encounter {@creature Smiler the Defiler|BGDIA} anywhere in Avernus. Where and when he appears is up to you.
zh_tw: 角色可以在阿弗納斯的任何地方遇到{@creature Smiler the Defiler|BGDIA|汙化者笑爺}。他出現在哪裡以及何時出現由你決定。

english: This eladrin adventurer from the Feywild became stranded in Avernus after his companions abandoned him. He has spent the past seventy years roaming Avernus, making deals with fiends to survive. Smiler eventually sold his soul to a pit fiend, who gave him the means to topple a nycaloth warlord named Yarrasto. Smiler took control of the nycaloth's warband and their infernal war machines. Smiler's gang came to be known as Smiler's Defilers, and their ferocity terrified the other warlords of Avernus for a while.
zh_tw: 這位來自妖精荒野的雅靈冒險家在他的同伴們拋棄了他之後被困在了阿弗納斯。過去的幾年他都在阿弗納斯流浪，與邪魔們交易維持生存。笑爺最終還是向一位深獄煉魔出賣了他的靈魂，換取了他的幫助，推翻了一位名叫雅羅斯托的征伐羅斯魔軍閥。笑爺接管了征伐羅斯魔的軍伍和地獄戰爭機器。笑爺的團夥隨後被稱作了笑爺汙染者，他們的兇殘一度震懾了阿弗納斯的其他軍閥們。

english: Three of Smiler's rivals—{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}, {@creature Feonor|BGDIA}, and {@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA}—joined forces to wipe out Smiler's Defilers. Smiler escaped and tears around Avernus on a {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA}, looking for adventurers willing to help him get revenge on the warlords who ganged up on him. {@area Mad Maggie|1bc|x} remains his only ally, though he refuses to join her gang.
zh_tw: 笑爺的三個對手——{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}，{@creature Feonor|BGDIA|菲奧諾}，和{@creature Princeps Kovik|BGDIA|元首科維克}——聯手消滅了笑爺的瀆神者。笑爺逃脫了，並乘坐{@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}在阿弗納斯四處遊蕩，尋找願意幫助他報復那些聯手對付他的軍閥的冒險者。{@area 瘋喜鵲|1bc|x}仍然是他唯一的盟友，儘管他拒絕加入她的幫派。

english: When the characters first encounter Smiler, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色首次遇到微笑者時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: You see an two-wheeled infernal war machine parked next to a large rock. Standing atop the rock, peeing into the hot wind, is a slender elf-like figure.
zh_tw: 你看到一輛雙輪的地獄戰爭機器停在一塊大石頭旁邊。站在石頭上，向熱風中小便的，是一個身材苗條的精靈般的人物。

english: Smiler has an unnerving smile—hence his name. When he sees the characters, his smile widens as he leaps down to greet them.
zh_tw: 微笑者的笑容令人不安——這也是他名字的由來。當他看到角色們時，他的笑容變得更加燦爛，隨即跳下來迎接他們。

english: A more apt name for this eladrin would be Smiler the Beguiler, as he's constantly trying to intoxicate others with his relentless optimism and shocking recklessness. Smiler thinks he can accomplish anything with a positive attitude and some death-defying stunt. Although he admits others might end up getting killed by his actions, he believes he can bend the multiverse to his whims if he tries hard enough. He's really quite insane.
zh_tw: 更適合這個雅靈的名字應該是蠱惑師笑爺。 他經常用他那不變的樂觀和驚人的莽撞行動來蠱惑他人。笑爺覺得他只要有著積極的態度和一些視死如歸的冒險行為，他就無所不能。雖然他承認他的行為會可能害死其他人，但他相信只要他足夠努力，整個多元宇宙都會因他的妄想而改變。他是真的非常瘋狂。

english: One of Smiler's favorite antics is to use a {@spell hallucinatory terrain} spell to create a little bit of the Feywild in Avernus: a beautiful woodland glade in which to lose himself for a few hours while he meditates and plots.
zh_tw: 笑爺最愛的滑稽把戲之一就是用{@spell hallucinatory terrain||幻景}在阿弗納斯創造出一小片妖精荒野：在這片美麗的林中空地他可以放鬆幾個小時，進行冥想或是密謀。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Smiler wears {@item +2 leather armor}. He carries seven {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} in a bag and a {@item +1 shortsword}.
zh_tw: 微笑者穿著一件{@item +2 leather armor||+2 皮甲}。他攜帶著一個袋子裡裝有七個{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}和一把{@item +1 shortsword||+1 短劍}。

english: {@creature Smiler the Defiler|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Smiler the Defiler|BGDIA|汙化者笑爺}

english: Chapter 4: Sword of Zariel
zh_tw: 第4章：扎瑞爾之劍

english: The characters should be 11th level by the time they discover the location of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. The weapon awaits them in a cathedral formed out of positive energy. Avernus abhors the structure and has surrounded it in a bloody scab, earning it the name the Bleeding Citadel. This scab has also engulfed a demon named {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} that was sent by the demon lord Yeenoghu to devour the blade. The holy power of the citadel resists the scab's attempts to fully engulf it and make it one with Avernus, leaving the top of the citadel visible. The characters get directions to this location from {@creature Bel|BGDIA} or Olanthius in {@adventure chapter 3|BGDIA|3}.
zh_tw: 當角色們發現{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的位置時，他們應該是11級。這把武器在一座由正能量構成的大教堂中等待著他們。阿弗納斯憎惡這個建築，並在其周圍形成了一個血淋淋的瘡疤，因此得名流血堡壘。這個瘡疤還吞噬了一個名叫{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的惡魔，它是惡魔領主耶諾古派來吞噬刀刃的。堡壘的聖潔力量抵抗了瘡疤試圖完全吞噬它並將它與阿弗納斯融為一體的企圖，使得堡壘的頂部仍然可見。角色們從{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}或奧蘭蘇斯在{@adventure 第三章|BGDIA|3}中得到了這個位置的方向指引。

english: Yeenoghu's demons carve tunnels through the scab as they search for a way to free {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} and break into the Bleeding Citadel, which is otherwise impenetrable. A nalfeshnee named Trantolox oversees this force.
zh_tw: 耶諾古的惡魔在尋找釋放{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}並闖入無法穿透的流血堡壘的方法時，雕刻著隧道穿過瘡疤。一個名叫特蘭托洛克斯的判魂魔監督著這股力量。

english: Approaching the Citadel
zh_tw: 前往城砦

english: As the characters approach the Bleeding Citadel, read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們接近流血堡壘時，請閱讀或轉述以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: A great, disgusting scab the size of a large hill rises up from a stinking swamp of blood. The domed top of an alabaster temple pokes through the scab. Many black iron chains of Avernus converge on the building, attaching within the grotesque mound.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的、令人作嘔的瘡疤，大小如同一座大山，從一片惡臭的血沼澤中升起。一個雪白的圓頂神廟頂部穿過瘡疤。許多阿弗納斯的黑鐵鏈匯聚在這座建築上，固定在這座怪誕的土丘中。

english: Diagram 4.1: Chapter 4 Flowchart
zh_tw: 圖表 4.1: 第4章流程圖

english: The exposed portions of the Bleeding Citadel are impenetrable and indestructible. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she shares her fear that the scab will eventually cover the entire structure, whereupon the citadel will be absorbed into the Nine Hells and the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} lost forever. She also tells the characters that the only entrance to the citadel is covered by the lower portion of the scab.
zh_tw: 流血堡壘的暴露部分是無法穿透和摧毀的。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和角色們在一起，她會分享她的恐懼，擔心瘡疤最終會覆蓋整個結構，到那時堡壘將被吸收進九層地獄，而{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}將永遠丟失。她還告訴角色們，堡壘的唯一入口被瘡疤的下部覆蓋著。

english: Yeenoghu's demons have dug tunnels and chambers throughout the scab. Unless otherwise noted, Yeenoghu's forces attack characters they notice and fight until destroyed.
zh_tw: 耶諾古的惡魔在瘡疤中挖掘了隧道和房間。除非另有說明，耶諾古的部隊會攻擊他們注意到的角色，並戰鬥到被摧毀為止。

english: The Scab
zh_tw: 大血痂

english: The scab is 300 feet high. The lower 100 feet of the scab is hard as rock, and each 5-foot cube of hard scab has AC 17, 18 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The upper 200 feet is newer, softer growth covered in weeping wounds. This part of the scab has a spongy consistency and is much easier to destroy. A 5-foot cube of soft scab has AC 9, 10 hit points, and immunity to psychic damage. Damage to the soft scab causes reeking blood to flow from the wound.
zh_tw: 這個瘡疤高300尺。瘡疤的下部100尺堅硬如石，每個5尺的堅硬瘡疤立方體有AC 17，18點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。上部200尺是較新的、較軟的生長物，覆蓋著流血的傷口。這部分瘡疤具有海綿狀的一致性，更容易被摧毀。一個5尺的軟瘡疤立方體有AC 9，10點生命值，並對心靈傷害免疫。對軟瘡疤的傷害會導致惡臭的血液從傷口流出。

english: Entering the Scab
zh_tw: 進入血痂

english: The most obvious way to enter the Scab is through a hole near the top of the Scab ({@area area S1|2c6|x}). Climbing a chain or the outer surface of the scab to reach this hole requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 進入瘡疤最明顯的途徑是透過瘡疤頂部附近的一個洞口（{@area 區域S1|2c6|x}）。攀爬鏈條或瘡疤的外表面以到達這個洞口需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}檢定。

english: Once inside the Scab, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} can sense the distance and direction of the Bleeding Citadel's entrance ({@area area S14|2e4|x}), and guide the characters toward it.
zh_tw: 一旦進入瘡疤內，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露} 能感知流血堡壘入口（{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}）的距離和方向，並引導角色們朝它前進。

english: Interior Features
zh_tw: 內部特徵

english: Map 4.1 shows a cross-section of the scab interior, the features of which are as follows:
zh_tw: 地圖 4.1 顯示了瘡疤內部的橫截面，其特點如下：

english: {@b Darkness}. The scab contains no light sources unless the text states otherwise. The demons infesting the scab rely on {@sense darkvision} to see.
zh_tw: {@b 黑暗術}。瘡疤內沒有光源，除非文字另有說明。侵擾瘡疤的惡魔依賴於{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}來視物。

english: {@b Interior Surfaces}. All tunnels and chambers were dug out by demons using their claws or, in some cases, their teeth.
zh_tw: {@b 內部表面}。所有的隧道和房間都是惡魔使用它們的爪子挖掘出來的，或者在某些情況下，使用它們的牙齒。

english: {@b Pools of Blood}. Pools of blood fill the areas shown on map 4.1. The pools are {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Any humanoid that enters or starts its turn in a pool must make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains the flaw, "I am cruel and uncaring toward others," for the next 8 hours. This flaw overrides any conflicting personality trait. A {@spell dispel evil and good} spell or similar magic removes the flaw.
zh_tw: {@b 血池}. 血池充滿了地圖 4.1 上顯示的區域內。這些血池是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。任何類人生物進入血池或在其回合開始時位於血池中，必須進行一次{@dc 13} 感知豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將在接下來的8小時內獲得缺陷，"我對他人殘忍且漠不關心，" 此缺陷將覆蓋任何與之衝突的性格特徵。一個{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡} 法術或類似的魔法可以移除該缺陷。

english: {@b Tunnel Dimensions}. Unless noted otherwise, tunnels are 10 feet wide. At various points, the ceilings are so low that Medium characters must crawl to pass underneath them.
zh_tw: {@b 隧道尺寸}。除非另有說明，隧道寬10尺。在不同的地方，天花板非常低，中等體型的角色必須爬行才能從下面透過。

english: Scab Locations
zh_tw: 血痂的地區

english: The following encounters are keyed to {@adventure map 4.1|BGDIA|7|Map 4.1: Side View of the Scab}. Because the scab wraps around the Bleeding Citadel, a creature can move off the left-hand side of the map onto the right-hand side of the map, or vice versa.
zh_tw: 以下遭遇與{@adventure 地圖 4.1|BGDIA|7|Map 4.1: Side View of the Scab}相關聯。因為瘡疤環繞著流血堡壘，生物可以從地圖的左側移動到右側，反之亦然。

english: S1. Oozing Entrance
zh_tw: S1. 黏嗒嗒的入口

english: This entrance to the scab is a tube-shaped tunnel with a 20-foot radius. As the characters approach the entrance, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 這個進入瘡疤的入口是一個管狀隧道，半徑為20尺。當角色們接近入口時，向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: A circular gaping wound near the top of the scab forms a tunnel that descends into darkness.
zh_tw: 瘡疤頂部附近的一個圓形巨大傷口形成了一個隧道，它向下延伸進入黑暗中。

english: The tunnel tapers as it descends toward area S2.
zh_tw: 隧道在向下通往S2區域的過程中逐漸變窄。

english: S2. Angelic Window
zh_tw: S2. 天使之窗

english: Demons digging in this tunnel exposed a 20-foot-tall, 5-foot-wide window:
zh_tw: 在這個隧道挖掘的惡魔暴露了一個20尺高、5尺寬的窗戶：

english: The scab on one side of this narrow passage is stripped away, partially revealing one of the citadel's stained glass windows. The opaque blue and yellow panes depict the contemplative face of a beautiful angel.
zh_tw: 這個狹窄通道一側的瘡疤被剝去了，部分露出了堡壘的一扇彩色玻璃窗。不透明的藍色和黃色窗格描繪了一個美麗的天使沉思的面容。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the window radiates an aura of abjuration magic. The window is unbreakable, and no one can enter the citadel from here. Any creature of good alignment that touches the window gains 20 temporary hit points. A creature affected by the window's magic cannot be affected by the window again for 24 hours.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了這個窗戶散發出防護魔法的氣息。這個窗戶是不可破壞的，沒有人能從這裡進入堡壘。任何善良陣營的生物觸控窗戶將獲得20點臨時生命值。受到窗戶魔法影響的生物在24小時內不能再被窗戶影響。

english: S3. Drowned Hag
zh_tw: S3. 淹死的鬼婆

english: When the characters enter this 30-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個30尺寬的房間時，請閱讀以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: A pool of blood fills the center of this chamber. Five goat-headed demons reeking of rot crouch along the edges of the pool, staring at a corpse floating in it.
zh_tw: 這個房間的中心充滿了血池。五個山羊頭的惡魔散發著腐爛的氣味，蹲在血池邊緣，凝視著漂浮在其中的屍體。

english: Five {@creature Bulezau|MTF|bulezaus} drowned a night hag in the pool. The hag, Yiggleblight, was working with Trantolox to find {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} until the nalfeshnee suspected the hag was secretly plotting against it. Trantolox ordered the bulezaus to kill the hag. They plan to eat her once the corpse bloats, but the characters make excellent appetizers.
zh_tw: 五隻{@creature Bulezau|MTF|佈雷祖魔}在池中淹死了一個夜魔。這個夜魔名叫伊格爾布萊特，曾與特蘭託洛克斯合作尋找{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}，直到這個判魂魔懷疑夜魔在秘密策劃反對它。特蘭託洛克斯命令布萊扎烏殺死夜魔。他們計劃一旦屍體膨脹就吃掉她，但角色們是極好的開胃菜。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the characters search the hag's tattered robes, they find a belt pouch containing a diamond worth 5,000 gp and small flask of water from the River Styx. The flask magically preserves the water (see "{@area River Styx|1a3|x}" for effects).
zh_tw: 如果角色們搜查那個女巫的破爛長袍，他們會找到一個腰帶袋，裡面有一個價值5000金幣的鑽石和一小瓶來自冥河的水。這個小瓶神奇地儲存了水（見"{@area 冥河|1a3|x}"瞭解效果）。

english: S4. Bloody Downpour
zh_tw: S4. 血雨傾盆

english: When the characters enter this 40-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個40尺寬的房間時，請閱讀以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: Blood streams down from a gaping wound in the ceiling, filling a large pool that covers the floor of this chamber. A hunk of scab floats in the blood.
zh_tw: 血水從天花板上的一個巨大傷口中流下，填滿了覆蓋這個房間地板的大血池。一塊瘡疤在血水中漂浮。

english: Three {@condition invisible} {@creature Barlgura||barlguras} cling to the walls of this chamber, their claws digging into the soft walls. The demons wait for prey to enter the room before attacking. They hungrily pursue more elusive prey.
zh_tw: 三隻{@condition invisible||隱形} {@creature Barlgura||惡猿魔}緊貼在這個房間的牆壁上，它們的爪子深陷柔軟的牆面中。這些惡魔等待獵物進入房間後才會發起攻擊。它們貪婪地追逐更難捕捉的獵物。

english: The barlguras tore the floating chunk of scab from the center of the ceiling, causing blood to pour out of the wound. A character who expends five uses of a {@item healer's kit|PHB} and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check bandages the wound effectively enough to stop the downpour. This process takes 5 minutes and exposes the character to the blood's effects (see "{@area Interior Features|2c4|x}"). A {@spell cure wounds} spell or similar magic cast on the wound closes it, stanching the blood flow.
zh_tw: 巴爾古拉從天花板的中心撕下了一塊漂浮的痂，導致血液從傷口中湧出。一個角色如果消耗了五次{@item healer's kit|PHB|醫療包}的使用次數，併成功透過{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定，可以有效包紮傷口以停止血流。這個過程需要5分鐘，並使角色暴露於血液的效果中（參見"{@area 內部特徵|2c4|x}"）。在傷口上施放{@spell cure wounds||療傷術}法術或類似魔法可以閉合傷口，止住血流。

english: S5. Food Fight
zh_tw: S5. 奪食之戰

english: When the characters enter this 30-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個30尺寬的房間時，請閱讀以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: Two fiends resembling scaly, 9-foot-tall, bipedal toads stand waist-deep in a pool of blood, bellowing as they claw at each other. Floating near them is the half-eaten corpse of a bearded devil clutching a glaive. The pool is 20 feet wide and 40 feet long, with a horseshoe-shaped ledge around it.
zh_tw: 兩隻高9尺、外形宛如覆鱗雙足蟾蜍的邪魔站在及腰的血池中，一面嘶吼，一面互相抓撓。牠們身旁漂著一具被啃去一半的須魔屍體，手中仍緊握長柄刀。血池寬20尺、長40尺，四周環繞著馬蹄形的平臺。

english: Two hungry {@creature Hezrou||hezrous} fight over the devil's tasty corpse. Unless they notice the characters, the demons battle until one of them is killed. If the characters allow the fight to play out, one hezrou emerges victorious with 30 hit points remaining. Characters have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to sneak past the hezrous while the demons fight each other.
zh_tw: 兩隻飢餓的{@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}在爭奪惡魔美味的屍體。除非它們注意到角色們，否則惡魔們會戰鬥到其中一個被殺死。如果角色們允許戰鬥繼續進行，一隻狂蟾魔會以30點生命值獲勝。當惡魔們相互戰鬥時，角色們在進行敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定以悄悄溜過狂蟾魔時擁有優勢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The half-eaten bearded devil clutches a {@item +1 glaive}.
zh_tw: 那個半吃剩的長鬚魔鬼緊握著一把{@item +1 glaive||+1 長柄刀}。

english: S6. Torture Chamber
zh_tw: S6. 拷問室

english: When the characters enter this large, 30-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個寬敞的、30尺寬的房間時，向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: Two iron chains attached to the ceiling end in hyena skulls that bite into the flesh of a screaming devil with sharp spines covering its thin, man-sized body. Jabbing the chained fiend with their long proboscises are three droning flies as big as horses.
zh_tw: 兩條鐵鏈從天花板垂下，末端的鬣狗頭骨咬進一隻魔鬼的血肉，令牠痛苦尖叫。牠有著人類大小的瘦削身軀，渾身長滿尖刺。三隻馬匹般巨大的蒼蠅嗡嗡作響，以長喙刺戳這隻被鎖住的邪魔。

english: The chained fiend is Alazub, a {@creature barbed devil} with 25 hit points remaining. The giant flies are three {@creature Chasme||chasmes}. Characters who enter the chamber are susceptible to the chasmes' Drone trait. The chasmes cease their torture of Alazub to attack intruders.
zh_tw: 被鎖住的邪魔名叫阿拉祖布，是一隻僅剩25點生命值的{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}。三隻巨蠅是{@creature Chasme||喀嘶魔}。進入房間的角色會受到喀嘶魔「嗡鳴」特性的影響。牠們會停止折磨阿拉祖布，轉而攻擊入侵者。

english: Trantolox caught Alazub sneaking around the scab and wants to know if the devil knows anything about the citadel that could help the demons break into it. Unfortunately for the barbed devil, it knows nothing that the nalfeshnee would consider useful.
zh_tw: 特蘭託洛克斯發現阿拉祖布在瘡疤周圍鬼鬼祟祟，並想知道這個惡魔是否知道有關堡壘的任何資訊，這些資訊可以幫助惡魔闖入其中。不幸的是，對於這個棘魔來說，它並不知道任何判魂魔會認為有用的東西。

english: Chains
zh_tw: 鏈條

english: The two chains that bind Alazub hold the barbed devil 25 feet above the floor. Each chain has AC 19, 15 hit points, and immunity to cold, fire, poison, and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 束縛阿拉祖布的兩條鎖鏈將這個帶刺魔鬼懸掛在離地面25尺的高空。每條鎖鏈具有AC 19，15點生命值，並且對寒冷、火焰、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: The hyena skull at the end of each chain grips Alazub by one arm, biting into the devil's flesh. A character can use an action to rip a skull from Alazub's flesh, but doing so deals 7 ({@dice 2d6}) piercing damage to the devil. This damage is considered magical and therefore ignores Alazub's resistance to piercing damage. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check removes the skull-tipped chain from the devil without harming it.
zh_tw: 每條鏈條末端的鬣狗頭骨咬住阿拉祖布的一隻手臂，咬入魔鬼的肉體中。一個角色可以使用一個動作將頭骨從阿拉祖布的肉體中撕下，但這樣做會對魔鬼造成7點（{@dice 2d6}）穿刺傷害。這種傷害被視為魔法傷害，因此忽略阿拉祖布對穿刺傷害的抗性。一個成功透過{@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定的角色可以從魔鬼身上移除帶刺鏈而不對它造成傷害。

english: Roleplaying Alazub
zh_tw: 扮演埃拉札布

english: Alazub came to the scab to spy on Trantolox's progress for Zariel. If Alazub is freed, a character who makes a successful Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check against Alazub's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check can convince the devil that Zariel sent the characters to save it. If convinced that the characters are on its side, a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check convinces Alazub to share the following information:
zh_tw: 阿拉祖布來到這片荒地，為扎瑞爾監視特蘭託洛克斯的進展。如果阿拉祖布被釋放，一個角色若能用魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定成功對抗阿拉祖布的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定，就能說服這位魔鬼相信扎瑞爾派這些角色來救它。如果阿拉祖布被說服認為這些人站在它這一邊，一個角色若能用魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定成功透過{@dc 15}的難度等級，就能說服阿拉祖布分享以下資訊：

english: Demons under the command of a {@creature nalfeshnee} named Trantolox have found the entrance to the Bleeding Citadel but can't break in (see {@area area S14|2e4|x}).
zh_tw: 在名為特蘭託洛克斯的{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}指揮下的惡魔們已經找到了通往血堡的入口，但無法突破（參見{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}）。

english: A shadow demon has found Yeenoghu's lost pet, the great demon {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}, in the hard part of the scab. It leads the crew of demons that is digging out the enormous creature (see {@area area S9|2db|x}).
zh_tw: 一個影魔在瘡疤的堅硬部分發現了耶諾古的失蹤寵物，偉大的惡魔{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}。它領導著挖掘這個巨大生物的惡魔船員（見{@area 區域S9|2db|x}）。

english: If the characters refuse to free Alazub, the barbed devil tries to make a deal. It can offer the information it knows or anything else within its power in exchange for freedom. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she urges the characters not to make any deals with the devil and grows despondent if her advice is ignored. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} refuses to do anything but the bare minimum to help the characters until her confidence in their good judgment is restored.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕釋放阿拉祖布，這個帶刺魔鬼會試圖達成交易。它可以提供它所知道的情報或其能力範圍內的任何東西以換取自由。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們在一起，她會敦促角色們不要與魔鬼達成任何交易，並且如果她的意見被忽視，她會變得沮喪。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}拒絕做任何超出最低限度的事情來幫助角色們，直到她對他們良好判斷力的信心得到恢復。

english: If the characters mention their interest in the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, Alazub realizes they are Zariel's foes and makes reporting that information to Zariel a priority. After being freed and talking with the characters, the barbed devil leaves the scab.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提到他們對{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的興趣，阿拉祖布意識到他們是扎瑞爾的敵人，並將向扎瑞爾報告那個資訊作為優先事項。在被釋放並與角色們交談後，這個棘魔離開了瘡疤。

english: S7. Trantolox's Larder
zh_tw: S7. 川託洛克斯的儲藏室

english: When the characters enter this 20-foot-wide cavern, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個20尺寬的洞穴時，向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: Hordes of hellish flies buzz around this dark chamber, which is strewn with mutilated devil corpses and gnawed bones. A hole in the floor reveals another dark cavern below this one.
zh_tw: 成群的地獄蒼蠅在這個黑暗的房間裡嗡嗡作響，房間裡散佈著被肢解的魔鬼屍體和被啃過的骨頭。地板上的一個洞揭示了下面另一個黑暗的洞穴。

english: Close examination of the mutilated corpses reveals that they include three bearded devils, two barbed devils, and a bone devil. All of the corpses are torn to pieces and, in some cases, partially eaten.
zh_tw: 仔細檢查這些殘缺不全的屍體，會發現它們包括三個長鬚魔、兩個帶刺魔鬼和一隻骨魔。所有的屍體都被撕成碎片，在某些情況下，部分被吃掉了。

english: The first time a creature that isn't a fiend tries to cross this room, the flies gather into four hostile {@creature Swarm of Insects||swarms of insects}. Replace the swarms' climbing speed with a flying speed of 30 feet.
zh_tw: 當第一次有不是惡魔的生物試圖穿過這個房間時，蒼蠅會聚整合四個敵對的{@creature Swarm of Insects||昆蟲叢集}。將這些蟲群的攀爬速度替換為30尺的飛行速度。

english: Map 4.1: Side View of the Scab
zh_tw: 地圖 4.1：瘡疤的側檢視

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: S8. Hag's Lair
zh_tw: S8. 鬼婆的巢穴

english: The tunnel leading to this cave narrows to a height of 2 feet, requiring Medium characters to crawl through it. As the characters peer into this 20-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 通往這個洞穴的隧道在高度上縮小到2尺，需要中等體型的角色爬行透過。當角色們窺視這個20尺寬的房間時，向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: The floor of this dark cyst is strewn with bones and dotted with weeping sores. Shallow niches gouged into the scabby walls hold an assortment of stoppered flasks, polished black orbs, humanoid skulls, and other curios.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗囊泡的地面上散佈著骨頭，佈滿了流膿的瘡口。在瘡疤牆上挖出的淺龕裡，擺放著各種塞著的瓶子、拋光的黑色球體、類人生物的頭骨以及其他稀奇古怪的物品。

english: Yiggleblight the night hag used this chamber as a lair until she was rudely disposed of (see {@area area S3|2ca|x}).
zh_tw: 夜巫伊格爾布萊特（伊格布萊特）曾將這個房間作為她的巢穴，直到她被粗魯地趕走（見{@area 區域S3|2ca|x}）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals six magic items in the niches, including a black sack made of stitched flesh, a lustrous black gem shaped like a human baby's fist, an {@item iron flask} containing a berserk {@creature fiendish flesh golem|BGDIA} that can't be controlled, and three {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. The sack is Yiggleblight's {@i soul bag}, which is of no use to the characters. The black gem is the night hag's {@i heartstone}. (For more information on these two magic items, see the "{@creature Night Hag}" entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.)
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了壁龕中的六個魔法物品，包括一個由縫合的肉體製成的黑色袋子，一個像人類嬰兒拳頭一樣形狀的有光澤的黑色寶石，一個裝有無法控制的狂暴{@creature fiendish flesh golem|BGDIA|邪魔血肉魔像}的{@item iron flask||收妖瓶}，以及三枚{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。這個袋子是伊格爾布萊特的{@i 靈魂袋}，對角色們沒有用處。黑色寶石是夜魔的{@i 心石}。（有關這兩件魔法物品的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的"{@creature Night Hag||夜鬼婆}"條目。）

english: Yiggleblight also kept a collection of poisons in six small, stoppered tubes made from human finger bones. Each flask holds a single dose of a different kind of poison: {@item Burnt Othur Fumes}, {@item Carrion Crawler Mucus}, {@item Essence of Ether}, {@item Malice}, {@item Oil of Taggit}, and {@item Torpor} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for the effects of each). A character with a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB} can use it to take tiny samples of each poison for analysis. After spending 1 minute analyzing a poison, the character can identify it and its effects with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check. The character's proficiency bonus applies to the check if the character is proficient with the {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}.
zh_tw: 伊格布萊特還將一系列毒藥儲存在六隻由人類指骨製成的小而密封的管子裡。每隻瓶子中裝有不同種類的毒藥：{@item Burnt Othur Fumes||焦引燻煙}、{@item Carrion Crawler Mucus||食腐蟲粘液}、{@item Essence of Ether||乙醚精}、{@item Malice||怨恨}、{@item Oil of Taggit||腐精之油} 和 {@item Torpor||蒙汗藥}（有關每種毒藥的效果，請參見 {@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons} 在第8章中的 {@book 城主指南|DMG}）。擁有 {@item poisoner's kit|PHB|毒藥工具} 的角色可以使用它來採集每種毒藥的微量樣本進行分析。在分析毒藥1分鐘後，角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Nature||自然}）檢定來識別它及其效果。如果角色精通 {@item poisoner's kit|PHB|毒藥工具}，則角色的熟練加值適用於此次檢定。

english: The only other valuable items are three 3-pound orbs of polished obsidian (100 gp each) that can be used as arcane focuses for spellcasting.
zh_tw: 其他有價值的物品是三個重3磅的拋光黑曜石球體（每個價值100金幣），它們可以用作施法的奧術法器。

english: Other curios include an empty casket sized for a human infant, a copper cowbell, a rope noose, a nothic's shriveled claw on the end of a black cord, a soot-stained wooden coffer containing three teeth from a red dragon wyrmling, a dead tomato plant in a ceramic pot adorned with images of dancing cherubs, and nine gnoll skulls.
zh_tw: 其他的稀奇古怪的物品包括一個適合人類嬰兒大小的空箱子、一個銅製牛鈴、一個繩套、一個黑繩末端的枯瘦諾斯爪、一個沾滿煙漬的木製箱子裡裝有三顆紅龍幼龍的牙齒、一個裝飾有跳舞小天使圖案的陶盆裡的死番茄植物，以及九個鬣狗人頭骨。

english: S9. Digging Demons
zh_tw: S9. 挖掘中的惡魔們
