english: At this point, the scab transitions from being soft and spongy to hard as rock.
zh_tw: 在這一點上，瘡痂從柔軟和海綿狀轉變為堅硬如石。

english: When the characters enter this 20-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個20尺寬的房間時，向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: Ten small, snarling demons covered in matted gray fur claw and bite a hole into the hard, scabby floor. A demon made of shadow flies over the smaller fiends, screaming at them in Abyssal.
zh_tw: 十隻小而咆哮的惡魔，身上覆蓋著打結的灰色毛髮，用爪子和牙齒在堅硬、結痂的地面上挖了一個洞。一隻由陰影構成的惡魔飛過這些較小的惡魔，用深淵語對他們尖叫。

english: If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she senses the presence of {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} nearby (see area S10). She tells the characters about Yeenoghu's pet and speculates that the demons are trying to free {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們在一起，她能感知到附近{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的存在（見區域S10）。她告訴角色們關於耶諾古的寵物，並推測惡魔們正試圖釋放{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}。

english: Vatilan, a {@creature shadow demon}, directs seven {@creature Dretch||dretches} to dig their way toward area S10. The shadow demon found {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} while scouting the scab using its Incorporeal Movement trait. If the characters attack, the shadow demon leaves the dretches behind as it passes through the nearest wall and heads to {@area area S14|2e4|x} to warn Trantolox that intruders are near. Vatilan remains by the nalfeshnee's side until convinced that the intruders have been dealt with.
zh_tw: 瓦蒂蘭，一隻{@creature shadow demon||幽影惡魔}，指揮著七個{@creature Dretch||怯魔}向S10區域挖掘前進。這隻陰影惡魔在偵察結痂區域時，利用其無形移動特性發現了{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}。如果角色們發動攻擊，陰影惡魔會留下怯魔，穿過最近的牆壁，前往{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}警告特蘭托洛克斯有入侵者接近。瓦蒂蘭會一直陪伴在判魂魔身邊，直到確信入侵者已經被處理。

english: S10. Crokek'toeck's Prison
zh_tw: S10. 咔洛咯克托克的監獄

english: Yeenoghu's pet, {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}, is tightly packed into this cavity, {@condition incapacitated} and {@condition restrained}. If at least 20 feet of the scabby walls that encase {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} are destroyed, the monster is able to move its body again and breaks free of the scab.
zh_tw: 耶諾古的寵物，{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}，被緊緊地塞進這個腔室，處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}和{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態。如果至少有20尺的包裹著{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的瘡疤牆壁被摧毀，這個怪物就能夠再次移動它的身體並從瘡疤中逃脫。

english: If {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} breaks out of the scab, it leaves a 30-foot-radius passage in its wake. The fiend is hungry and tries to consume any creature that crosses its path. It then leaves to find its master, Yeenoghu.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}從瘡口中逃出，它會在其身後留下一個30尺半徑的通道。這個惡魔很餓，試圖吞噬任何穿過它路徑的生物。然後它會離開去尋找它的主人，耶諾古。

english: If {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} is freed, Trantolox and the rest of the demons in {@area area S14|2e4|x} investigate. The nalfeshnee attempts to control {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}, but Yeenoghu's pet answers only to the Gnoll Lord. After Trantolox tries to control {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} for 3 rounds, the nalfeshnee and the other demons retreat back to {@area area S14|2e4|x}.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}被釋放，特蘭托洛克斯和{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}中的其餘惡魔將會進行調查。判魂魔試圖控制{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}，但耶諾古的寵物只聽從鬣狗人領主的命令。在特蘭托洛克斯嘗試控制{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}三輪之後，判魂魔和其他惡魔撤退回{@area 區域S14|2e4|x}。

english: S11. Statue of Yeenoghu
zh_tw: S11. 耶諾古的雕像

english: When the characters enter this 40-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個40尺寬的房間時，請閱讀以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: A nine-foot-tall statue of a hulking biped with clawed hands and feet stands on the floor of this chamber. Three vulture-like demons and six gnolls cackle as they dance around the statue.
zh_tw: 一個九尺高的雕像，刻畫著一個有爪手爪腳的龐大兩足動物，矗立在這個房間的地板上。三個像禿鷲一樣的惡魔和六個鬣狗人在雕像周圍狂笑跳舞。

english: Three {@creature Vrock||vrocks} and six {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} dance around the statue, reveling in their evil madness. The vrocks are quick to use their spores, even if it means infecting their gnoll allies. The demons and gnolls fight to the death.
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Vrock||鷲魔}和六隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}圍繞著雕像跳舞，沉浸在他們的邪惡瘋狂中。鷲魔s很快就使用它們的孢子，即使這意味著感染它們的鬣狗人盟友。惡魔和鬣狗人戰鬥至死。

english: The statue is carved out of hardened scab. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that it radiates an aura of evocation magic. Any demon or gnoll with at least 1 hit point remaining that starts its turn within 30 feet of the statue regains 10 hit points.
zh_tw: 這座雕像是用硬化的瘡疤雕刻而成。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了它散發出一種咒法魔法的氣息。任何至少剩餘1點生命值的惡魔或鬣狗人，在其回合開始時如果處於雕像30尺範圍內，將恢復10點生命值。

english: If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she recognizes that the statue is a crude likeness of Yeenoghu and encourages the characters to destroy it.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們在一起，她會認出雕像是耶諾古的粗糙形象，並鼓勵角色們將其摧毀。

english: The statue is a Large object with AC 17, 60 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If the statue is destroyed, it explodes. Each creature within 30 feet of the exploding statue must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 這座雕像是一個大型物體，擁有 AC 17，60 點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果雕像被摧毀，它會爆炸。爆炸雕像30尺範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，豁免失敗則受到 22 ({@dice 4d10}) 點穿刺傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。

english: S12. Trantolox's Chamber
zh_tw: S12. 川託洛克斯的房間

english: When the characters enter this 30-foot-wide chamber, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入這個30尺寬的房間時，請閱讀以下加框文字給玩家們：

english: A massive pile of bones and offal sits in the middle of this otherwise empty chamber.
zh_tw: 在這個本應空無一物的房間中央，有一堆巨大的骨頭和內臟。

english: Creatures who examine the bones and offal closely notice a stoppered bottle in the pile.
zh_tw: 仔細觀察骨頭和內臟的生物會發現一堆中有一個塞住的瓶子。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The bottle is a {@item eversmoking bottle}.
zh_tw: 這個瓶子是一個{@item eversmoking bottle||無盡煙壺}。

english: S13. Cackling Gnolls
zh_tw: S13. 咯咯笑的鬣狗人

english: Characters hear the cackling of gnolls as they enter this corridor. They can surprise the gnolls by dousing their lights and succeeding on a {@dc 10} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check.
zh_tw: 角色們在進入這條走廊時聽到了鬣狗人的獰笑聲。他們可以透過熄滅燈光併成功進行一個 {@dc 10} 群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定來突襲鬣狗人。

english: Targ Nar, a {@creature gnoll fang of Yeenoghu} with 100 hit points, is here with a gang of fifteen {@creature Gnoll||gnolls}. Targ Nar obeys Trantolox, who has ordered him to guard the corridor. To pass the time, the gnolls are tossing around the severed head of one of their fellow gnolls, whom Trantolox decapitated on a whim.
zh_tw: 塔格納，一個擁有100點生命值的{@creature gnoll fang of Yeenoghu||鬣狗人·耶諾古毒牙}，和一隊十五個{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}在這裡。塔格納服從特蘭託洛克斯，後者命令他守衛走廊。為了打發時間，鬣狗人們正在拋擲他們一個同伴鬣狗人的被斬首的頭顱，而特蘭託洛克斯是一時興起斬首了它。

english: S14. Entrance to the Bleeding Citadel
zh_tw: S14. 湧血城砦的入口

english: When the characters arrive at this 40-foot-wide area, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達這個40尺寬的區域時，向玩家們宣讀以下加框文字：

english: Brass double doors stand exposed in the wall of the scab. A relief image on the doors depicts a blindfolded angel wielding a sword, and carved into the door frame are beautiful, gold-inlaid runes. Three goat-headed demons with barbed tails throw themselves against the door as a corpulent, ape-like fiend with tusks and tiny wings kicks at them, roaring commands in Abyssal.
zh_tw: 銅質的雙開門暴露在結痂的牆壁上。門上的浮雕描繪了一個蒙著眼睛的天使揮舞著劍，門框上雕刻著美麗的鑲金符文。三隻長著山羊頭和帶刺尾巴的惡魔衝撞著門，與此同時，一隻肥胖的、猿猴般的惡魔，長著獠牙和小小的翅膀，踢著它們，用深淵語咆哮著命令。

english: Trantolox, a {@creature nalfeshnee}, is commanding three {@creature Bulezau|MTF|bulezaus} to force open the double door that leads into the Bleeding Citadel. The nalfeshnee is desperate to get inside to claim the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} for Yeenoghu. Despite the bulezaus' best efforts, the doors refuse to budge (see "Doors" below).
zh_tw: 特蘭托洛克斯，一隻{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}，正在指揮三隻{@creature Bulezau|MTF|佈雷祖魔}強行開啟通往流血城堡的雙門。這隻判魂魔急於進入城堡，為耶諾古奪取{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。儘管佈雷祖魔竭盡全力，門仍然紋絲不動（見下文的"門"）。

english: The nalfeshnee doesn't attack the characters right away if it thinks it can trick them into opening the doors for it. The nalfeshnee suggests an alliance and an "equal split" of whatever treasure is hidden inside the citadel. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she strongly advises them not to trust the demon. Trantolox has no intention of honoring the deal and claims to know nothing about the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. In battle, the nalfeshnee fights until reduced to 60 hit points, then tries to flee the scab and report back to Yeenoghu. The insane bulezaus fight to the death.
zh_tw: 如果納爾菲什魔王認為可以誘騙角色為它開啟門，它不會立即發起攻擊。納爾菲什魔王會提出結盟並"均分"城堡內隱藏的寶藏。如果 {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露} 與角色在一起，她會強烈建議他們不要信任這個惡魔。特蘭託洛克斯無意履行協議，並聲稱對 {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍} 一無所知。在戰鬥中，納爾菲什魔王會戰鬥到生命值降至60點，然後試圖逃離這片惡地，並向耶諾古彙報。瘋狂的布勒祖斯則會戰鬥至死。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: The doors, like the citadel itself, are indestructible. The runes around them say, in Celestial: "Against evil, we stand united. Only the pure of heart can part these holy gates."
zh_tw: 這些門和城堡本身一樣，是不可摧毀的。周圍的符文用天界語寫道："對抗邪惡，我們團結一致。只有心靈純潔之人才能開啟這些聖潔之門。"

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of abjuration magic around the double door, which can be opened only by a creature of good alignment while {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is within 60 feet of the door. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} herself can open the doors, if need be. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is alive but not present when the characters try to enter the citadel, the doors remain locked. The characters receive a telepathic message from an unfamiliar female voice, saying, "Bring {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} here, and I'll let you inside." Only when the characters return with {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} can the doors be opened. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} died earlier in the adventure, she's waiting for them inside the citadel, just beyond the doors.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了雙扇門周圍的防護魔法光環，只有當{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在門的60尺範圍內時，善良陣營的生物才能開啟它。如果需要，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}自己可以開啟門。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}活著但不在場時角色嘗試進入城堡，門將保持鎖定狀態。角色們會從一位不熟悉的女性聲音那裡收到一條心靈感應資訊，說：'把{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}帶到這裡，我會放你們進來。'只有當角色們帶著{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}回來時，門才能被開啟。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在冒險早期就已經死亡，她就會在城堡內的門後等待他們。

english: When the doors open, a bright white light pours out, filling area S14. Any fiend or undead that enters or starts its turn in the light must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Fiends and undead can't pass through the doorway of the citadel even while the doors are open.
zh_tw: 當門開啟時，一道明亮的白光傾瀉而出，充滿S14區域。任何進入光線或在光線中開始其回合的魔鬼或不死生物必須透過一次{@dc 22}體質豁免，失敗則受到44（{@dice 8d10}）點光耀傷害，成功則只受半數傷害。即使門是開著的，魔鬼和不死生物也無法透過城堡的門道。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: Allow players to advance their characters from 11th to 12th level before they enter the Bleeding Citadel.
zh_tw: 在角色們進入流血要塞之前，允許玩家將他們的角色從11級提升到12級。

english: Entering the Citadel
zh_tw: 進入城砦

english: The characters should be 12th level by the time they enter the Bleeding Citadel. The citadel has one purpose: to keep the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} out of evil hands.
zh_tw: 角色們進入流血堡壘時應該達到12級。這座堡壘有一個目的：防止{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}落入邪惡之手。

english: Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players when the characters enter the Bleeding Citadel:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入流血要塞時，向玩家們宣讀或轉述以下加框文字：

english: A bright white light burns away the blood and grit staining your clothes. Restorative energy brings life to numb muscles as the glow softens to reveal the interior of a sun-kissed cathedral. How light passes through the scab and into the stained glass windows is a mystery only magic can answer.
zh_tw: 一束明亮的白光燒掉了衣服上的血跡和汙垢。恢復性的能量使麻木的肌肉恢復生機，隨著光芒柔和下來，顯露出一個陽光照耀的大教堂內部。光線是如何穿過瘡口進入彩色玻璃窗的，只有魔法才能解答這個謎題。

english: Pillars line a path from the door to a raised dais carved with Celestial runes. Embedded in a stone atop the dais is a glowing longsword.
zh_tw: 從門到刻有天界語符文的高臺之間，排列著一排柱子。高臺上嵌著一塊石頭，裡面插著一把發光的長劍。

english: If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} died earlier in the adventure, add the following:
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}在冒險早期已經死亡，請新增以下內容：

english: Fluttering just inside the doorway is a golden hollyphant that greets you with a pleasing trumpet sound.
zh_tw: 在門口內側飄動的是一隻金色的象鼻蟲，它用悅耳的喇叭聲向您打招呼。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} has all her hit points if she's restored to life by the citadel's magic. However, she has no memories between the time the characters last saw her and now.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}透過要塞的魔法復活，她的生命值會完全恢復。然而，她沒有從角色們上次見到她到現在這段時間的記憶。

english: The holy power of the citadel restores the characters, and they gain the benefits of a long rest. If a creature gained a flaw from a blood pool or similar effect, the flaw is removed. Casting {@spell detect magic} in the Bleeding Citadel reveals that the whole structure radiates auras of abjuration and evocation magic.
zh_tw: 堡壘的神聖力量恢復了角色們，他們獲得了長休的效果。如果生物因血池或類似效果獲得了缺陷，這個缺陷將被移除。在流血堡壘中施放{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}揭示了整個結構散發出防護和咒法魔法的氣息。

english: The interior of the citadel is one large alabaster chamber brightly lit by magically created sunlight shining through windows. The sword atop the dais is the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} (see {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|12}). The carvings on the dais read, in Celestial, "The hero who becomes one with this blade exists no longer."
zh_tw: 要塞的內部是一個大型的雪花石膏大廳，由魔法創造的陽光透過窗戶照亮。高臺上的劍是{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}（見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}）。高臺上的雕刻用天界語寫著，"成為這把劍一體的英雄不再存在。"

english: The characters can't claim the sword until they complete the Idyllglen memory (see "{@area Idyllglen|2ed|x}" below).
zh_tw: 角色們必須完成伊迪爾格倫的記憶（見下文"{@area 艾德爾格蘭|2ed|x}"）後，才能獲得這把劍。

english: Yael's Ghost
zh_tw: 雅埃爾的靈魂

english: If the characters move toward the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, the ghost of Yael appears before them and pulls the characters into one of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s forgotten memories to see if they are worthy of possessing the weapon. Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 如果角色們走向{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，耶爾的幽靈會在他們面前出現，並將角色們拉入{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的一個被遺忘的記憶之中，以檢驗他們是否配得上擁有這件武器。向玩家讀出或轉述以下框內文字：

english: The translucent image of a woman in her thirties wearing plate armor and bearing a thin scar on her cheek appears before you. As she points toward the hollyphant, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s eyes turn pure white. A whisper fills your ears and says, "I remember!" A wave of radiant energy erupts from {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s body and in that blinding flash the ghostly warrior, the hollyphant, and the Bleeding Citadel disappear.
zh_tw: 一位三十多歲、穿著板甲、面頰上有一道細疤的女性半透明影像出現在你面前。當她指向象象時，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的眼睛變成了純白色。一陣耳語充滿你的耳朵，說道："我記得了！"從{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的身體中爆發出一股輻射能量，在那耀眼的光芒中，幽靈戰士、象象和流血要塞消失了。

english: The solace of the cathedral is replaced by havoc, screams of panic, and acrid smoke. You stand at the edge of a small town of burning cottages, fields, and trees. A broken sign on the ground reveals the settlement's name: Idyllglen. Shrieking townsfolk run from cackling, snarling demons and gnolls.
zh_tw: 大教堂的寧靜被混亂所取代，驚恐的尖叫聲和刺鼻的煙霧瀰漫四周。你站在一個燃燒的小屋、田野和樹木的小村莊邊緣。地上的一個破碎的招牌揭示了這個定居點的名字：伊迪爾格倫。尖叫的村民從狂笑、咆哮的惡魔和鬣狗人那裡逃走。

english: The characters are transported into {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory of Idyllglen near the west edge of Idyll Road ({@area area I1|2f6|x} on {@adventure map 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}).
zh_tw: 角色們被傳送到{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記憶中的伊迪爾格倫，位於伊迪爾路西側邊緣（{@area 區域I1|2f6|x}在{@adventure 地圖 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}上）。

english: Idyllglen
zh_tw: 艾德爾格蘭

english: Yael pulls the characters into {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory of Zariel's final battle against Yeenoghu in Faerûn. The characters experience a series of events in Idyllglen before returning to the Bleeding Citadel, where they can finally claim the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. While the characters are in Idyllglen, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is not with them, though she does make an appearance as a winged mammoth in "{@area Event 7. Zariel's Arrival|310|x}".
zh_tw: 耶爾將角色們帶入{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}對扎瑞爾與耶諾古在費倫最終戰鬥的記憶。角色們在伊迪爾格倫經歷了一系列事件，然後返回流血堡壘，最終他們可以認領{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。當角色們在伊迪爾格倫時，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}並不在他們身邊，儘管她在"{@area 事件7. 扎瑞爾降臨|310|x}"中以一隻翼手象的形象出現。

english: Idyllglen History
zh_tw: 艾德爾格蘭的歷史

english: Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill History} or {@skill Religion}) check recalls the following information about Idyllglen:
zh_tw: 任何透過 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill History||歷史} 或 {@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定的角色都會回憶起以下關於伊甸林的資訊：

english: Ages ago, Idyllglen was threatened by gnoll tribes. As the gnolls raided the town, Solndor Brightstar, a cleric of Lathander, led the people in prayer to his god for aid. Lathander was moved by the people's bravery and sent the angel Zariel to defeat the gnolls. After driving off the gnolls, the people erected a statue of Zariel to honor her.
zh_tw: 很久以前，伊迪爾格倫受到鬣狗人部落的威脅。當鬣狗人襲擊城鎮時，作為拉桑德爾的牧師，索爾多·明亮之星帶領人們向他的神祈禱求援。拉桑德爾被人們的勇敢所感動，派遣天使扎瑞爾來擊敗鬣狗人。在擊退鬣狗人之後，人們豎立了一座扎瑞爾的雕像來紀念她。

english: Generations later, the gnolls returned to Idyllglen, this time with demons in their ranks and Yeenoghu himself leading the war band. Zariel and the Hellriders came to the Idyllglen's aid, but not before the town was mostly destroyed.
zh_tw: 幾代人之後，鬣狗人回到了伊迪爾格倫，這次他們的行列中有惡魔，並且是耶諾古本人領導著戰爭團隊。扎瑞爾和地獄騎士團前來援助伊迪爾格倫，但那時小鎮已經被大部分摧毀了。

english: Idyllglen Features
zh_tw: 艾德爾格蘭特徵

english: The town of Idyllglen has the following general features.
zh_tw: 伊迪爾格倫小鎮有以下一般特徵。

english: Borders
zh_tw: 邊界

english: The characters are confined to the part of Idyllglen shown on {@adventure map 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}. Beyond the edges of the map, everything is engulfed in a smoky haze. Characters who fly or levitate to an altitude of 120 feet or higher find themselves engulfed in a similar smoky haze.
zh_tw: 角色們被限制在{@adventure 地圖 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}上顯示的伊迪爾格倫區域。在地圖邊緣之外，一切都被煙霧籠罩。當角色飛行或懸浮到120尺或更高高度時，他們發現自己被類似的煙霧所包圍。

english: A creature that enters or starts its turn in the haze must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 進入或開始在迷霧中的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到 22 ({@dice 4d10}) 點心靈傷害，若豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。

english: Burning Buildings
zh_tw: 燃燒的房屋

english: The unlabeled buildings on {@adventure map 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen} are homes and businesses that the gnolls have set ablaze. The buildings' supplies were taken by fleeing townsfolk or ransacked by Yeenoghu's horde. Each building is one or two stories tall (DM's choice) and 10 feet high per story. The interior rooms of the buildings have 9-foot-high ceilings with 8-foot-high doorways connecting them. A character can climb the walls of a building without equipment by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 在 {@adventure 地圖 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen} 上未標記的建築物是鬣狗人點燃的住宅和商鋪。建築物內的物資已被逃走的鎮民帶走或被耶諾古的掠奪者洗劫一空。每棟建築物有一到兩層（由DM決定），每層高10尺。建築物內部房間有9尺高的天花板，8尺高的門連線各個房間。角色可以透過成功進行 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定，無需裝備即可攀爬建築物的牆壁。

english: A creature that starts its turn in or on a burning building must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 一個生物在燃燒的建築物內或上開始其回合時，必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定。若豁免失敗，將受到 10 ({@dice 3d6}) 點火焰傷害；若豁免成功，則受到一半的傷害。

english: Burning Trees
zh_tw: 燃燒的樹木

english: Each tree depicted on {@adventure map 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen} is {@dice 1d6 + 10} feet tall and on fire. No ability check is required to climb a tree. However, a creature that starts its turn in a burning tree must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 在{@adventure 地圖 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}上描繪的每棵樹都高{@dice 1d6 + 10}尺並且正在燃燒。爬樹不需要進行能力檢定。然而，如果生物在燃燒的樹中開始其回合，它必須進行一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，如果失敗則受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點火焰傷害，若成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: Townsfolk
zh_tw: 鎮民

english: Like Idyllglen itself, the townsfolk are figments created from {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory. Most residents of Idyllglen flee for their lives or hide in terror. If the characters try to get information out of these townsfolk, the most anyone can offer are a few quick words about demons and gnolls coming out of nowhere to ransack the town.
zh_tw: 就像伊迪爾格倫本身一樣，鎮民們是從{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的記憶中創造出來的虛構之物。伊迪爾格倫的大多數居民為了生命而逃離或因恐懼而躲藏。如果角色們試圖從這些鎮民那裡獲取資訊，最多隻能得到幾句關於惡魔和鬣狗人突然出現並洗劫小鎮的簡短話語。

english: The characters have opportunities to save Idyllglen's people from Yeenoghu's hordes and other dangers. Townsfolk saved from certain death give a quick show of gratitude before running toward the hazy borders of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory and disappearing.
zh_tw: 角色們有機會從耶諾古的部落和其他危險中拯救伊迪爾格倫的人民。被從必死無疑中救出的鎮民在跑向{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記憶的朦朧邊界並消失之前，會迅速表達感激之情。

english: Character Death
zh_tw: 角色死亡

english: The Idyllglen memory is as real to the characters as any location, and they can die here.
zh_tw: 伊迪爾格倫的記憶對角色們來說就像任何真實的地方一樣，他們在這裡也可能死亡。

english: Idyllglen Locations
zh_tw: 艾德爾格蘭地區

english: Map 4.2: Idyllglen
zh_tw: 地圖 4.2：伊迪爾格倫

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點標記於地圖 4.2。

english: I1. Idyll Road
zh_tw: I1. 艾德爾路

english: Idyll Road is the only paved street in Idyllglen. It leads from the west edge of the town to the statue of Zariel (area I2). The street is strewn with broken carts, debris, and corpses.
zh_tw: 伊迪爾路是伊迪爾格倫唯一的鋪砌街道。它從小鎮的西邊延伸到扎瑞爾雕像（區域I2）。街道上散落著破碎的馬車、碎片和屍體。

english: I2. Statue of Zariel
zh_tw: I2. 扎瑞爾的雕像

english: This 30-foot-tall, white marble statue stands atop a 2-foot-high raised dais and depicts an armored, blindfolded angel in a calm, protective stance, with her sword drawn and wings unfurled. The dais is carved with the following words, in Common: "Zariel, guardian of Idyllglen. Offer prayers to Lathander, and his light will shield thee."
zh_tw: 這座30尺高的白色大理石雕像立在一個2尺高的底座上，刻畫著一個身著盔甲、蒙著眼睛的天使，她以一種平靜、保護的姿態站著，劍已出鞘，翅膀展開。底座上刻有以下文字，用通用語："扎瑞爾，伊迪爾格倫的守護者。向拉桑德爾祈禱，他的光芒將庇護你。"

english: This statue of Zariel is a Gargantuan object with AC 17, 300 hit points, a damage threshold of 15, and immunity to poison, psychic, and radiant damage. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the statue radiates an aura of abjuration magic.
zh_tw: 這座扎瑞爾雕像是一個巨型物體，具有17點護甲等級，300點生命值，15點傷害閾值，並對毒素、精神和光耀傷害免疫。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了雕像散發出防護魔法的氣息。

english: Any fiend that starts its turn within 15 feet of the statue causes it to flare with radiant energy. Each time the statue flares, every fiend within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 任何在雕像15尺範圍內開始其回合的邪魔都會使其爆發出光輝能量。每當雕像爆發時，其30尺範圍內的每個邪魔都必須進行一次{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，若檢定失敗則受到18點（{@dice 4d8}）光輝傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Any character who touches the statue and uses an action to offer a prayer to Lathander gains the benefit of a {@spell protection from evil and good} spell for 1 hour. A character can gain this benefit only once while in the memory.
zh_tw: 任何觸控雕像並使用行動向拉桑德爾祈禱的角色，將獲得{@spell protection from evil and good||防護善惡}法術的效果，持續1小時。角色在記憶中只能獲得這一次好處。

english: I3. Temple of Lathander
zh_tw: I3. 洛山達的神殿

english: This two-story, white stone temple carved with images of the sun on its exterior walls is the largest building in the town. Iron shutters cover the building's windows, and its doors are made of oak. The temple's occupants and features are discussed more below.
zh_tw: 這座兩層樓的白色石頭神廟外牆上雕刻著太陽圖案，是鎮上最大的建築。建築物的窗戶被鐵百葉窗覆蓋，門是用橡木製成的。神廟的居住者和特點在下文有更詳細的討論。

english: {@b Occupants}. Jhessa Brightstar, a neutral good female human {@creature priest} of Lathander, leads a congregation of fifty townsfolk ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) in prayer on the first floor. If forced into combat, the commoners take the {@action Dodge} action. The townsfolk are terrified of Yeenoghu's forces and grateful for any aid the characters provide.
zh_tw: {@b 居住者}。傑莎·布萊特斯塔，一箇中立善良的女性人類{@creature priest||祭司}，是拉桑德爾的信徒，她在一樓帶領五十名鎮民（{@creature Commoner||平民}）進行祈禱。如果被迫進入戰鬥，普通人會採取{@action Dodge||閃避}行動。鎮民們對耶諾古的軍隊感到恐懼，並對角色們提供的任何幫助表示感激。

english: {@b Illumination}. Torches burning in sconces brightly light the temple's interior.
zh_tw: {@b 照明}。壁臺上燃燒的火把將神廟內部照得通明。

english: {@b Barred Entrance}. An oak double door serves as the temple's entrance and is barred from the inside. A creature can use an action to try to force open the doors from the outside, doing so with a successful {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A character can also convince the congregation to open the doors by shouting through the doors and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
zh_tw: {@b 有柵欄的入口}. 一扇橡木雙開門作為神殿的入口，並從內部被封鎖。一個生物可以使用一個動作嘗試從外部強行開啟門，成功透過一次 {@dc 22} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可做到。一個角色也可以透過對著門大喊併成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來說服會眾開啟門。

english: {@b Shuttered Windows}. All windows are covered with locked iron shutters. The iron shutters are latched from the inside and have AC 19, 25 hit points, a damage threshold of 10, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A character with {@item thieves' tools|phb} can try to unlock a window's shutters, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: {@b 關閉的窗戶}. 所有窗戶都被帶有鎖的鐵質百葉窗覆蓋。鐵質百葉窗從內部閂上，具有AC 19、25點生命值、傷害閾值為10，並且對毒性和精神傷害免疫。擁有{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}的角色可以嘗試解鎖窗戶的百葉窗，成功透過{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定即可開啟。

english: Roleplaying Jhessa Brightstar
zh_tw: 扮演傑莎·明星

english: Jhessa is a pious priest of Lathander and a descendant of Solndor Brightstar (see "{@area Idyllglen History|2ee|x}"). The soft-spoken woman in her forties leads her flock in a prayer to Lathander, begging the Morning Lord to send Zariel to protect the people of Idyllglen once more.
zh_tw: 傑莎是拉桑德爾虔誠的牧師，也是索恩多·布萊特斯塔（見"{@area 艾德爾格蘭的歷史|2ee|x}"）的後裔。這位四十多歲的溫和女士帶領她的羊群向拉桑德爾祈禱，懇求晨曦之主再次派遣扎瑞爾來保護伊迪爾格倫的人民。

english: Jhessa is steadfast in her faith that Lathander hears the prayer and believes it's just a matter of time before Zariel appears. If she meets the characters, Jhessa uses her spells to heal and bolster them, hoping they can protect her congregation long enough for Zariel to arrive. If the forces of Yeenoghu enter the temple, Jhessa puts herself between any threat and the commoners within, giving her life if necessary.
zh_tw: 傑莎堅信拉桑德爾能聽到她的祈禱，並相信扎瑞爾出現只是時間問題。如果她遇到角色們，傑莎會使用她的法術來治療和加強他們，希望他們能夠保護她的會眾直到扎瑞爾到來。如果耶諾格的勢力進入神廟，傑莎會將自己置於任何威脅和裡面的平民之間，必要時不惜犧牲自己的生命。

english: Idyllglen Events
zh_tw: 艾德爾格蘭事件

english: The following events occur in sequence as soon as the characters arrive in Idyllglen.
zh_tw: 角色們一到伊迪爾格倫，以下事件就會按順序發生。

english: Event 1. Characters' Arrival
zh_tw: 事件1. 角色到達

english: When the characters arrive in Idyllglen (at {@area area I1|2f6|x}), the following encounters occur simultaneously:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達伊迪爾格倫（在{@area 區域I1|2f6|x}），以下遭遇同時發生：

english: Six {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} surround and attack the characters.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}包圍並攻擊角色們。

english: Six {@creature Dretch||dretches} on Idyll Road ({@area area I1|2f6|x}) claw at an overturned cart covering Ella Deepwell, a neutral female human {@creature commoner}.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature Dretch||怯魔}在伊迪爾路上（{@area 區域I1|2f6|x}）用爪子抓著一輛翻倒的馬車，馬車下面藏著艾拉·迪普韋爾，一箇中立的女性人類{@creature commoner||平民}。

english: A {@creature giant hyena} attacks a {@creature mastiff} near the statue of Zariel ({@area area I2|2f7|x}).
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature giant hyena||巨鬣狗}在扎瑞爾雕像附近（{@area 區域I2|2f7|x}）攻擊一隻{@creature mastiff||獒犬}。

english: A {@creature hezrou} pounds on the door to the temple of Lathander ({@area area I3|2f8|x}), trying to force its way inside.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature hezrou||狂蟾魔}正在敲打拉桑德爾神廟的門（{@area 區域I3|2f8|x}），試圖強行進入。

english: Have the players roll initiative for their characters, then roll initiative for the gnolls, dretches, giant hyena, mastiff, and hezrou. All the gnolls act on the same initiative count, and all the dretches act together as well. Ella doesn't participate in the combat.
zh_tw: 讓玩家為他們的角色擲先攻骰，然後為鬣狗人、怯魔、巨型鬣狗、獒犬和狂蟾魔擲先攻骰。所有的鬣狗人在同一先攻計數上行動，所有的怯魔也一起行動。艾拉不參與戰鬥。

english: Gnolls
zh_tw: 鬣狗人

english: The gnolls fight to the death, cackling maniacally all the while.
zh_tw: 鬣狗人戰鬥至死，期間一直瘋狂地咯咯笑。

english: Cart and Dretches
zh_tw: 貨車與怯魔們

english: The cart is a Large object with AC 15, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A creature can use an action to attempt to lift the cart, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這輛推車是一個大型物體，擁有AC 15、27點生命值，並且對毒素和精神傷害免疫。一個生物可以使用一個動作嘗試抬起推車，這需要透過一個成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: If the dretches destroy the cart, they attack Ella Deepwell. If she dies, the dretches attack the characters.
zh_tw: 如果怯魔摧毀了馬車，它們會攻擊艾拉·迪普韋爾。如果她死亡，怯魔會攻擊角色們。

english: If the characters attack the dretches, the dretches turn to fight them, ignoring the cart. Once the dretches are destroyed, Ella emerges from the cart, thanks the characters, and flees to safety.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攻擊怯魔，怯魔會轉身反擊他們，忽略貨車。一旦怯魔被摧毀，艾拉會從貨車中出現，感謝角色們，並逃往安全地帶。

english: Giant Hyena and Mastiff
zh_tw: 巨鬣狗與獒犬

english: If the characters don't intervene, the giant hyena turns its attention to the characters after killing the mastiff. If the characters attack the giant hyena, it ignores the mastiff and turns to face the bigger threat, fighting to the death.
zh_tw: 如果角色們不幹預，巨型鬣狗在殺死獒犬後會將注意力轉向角色們。如果角色們攻擊巨型鬣狗，它會忽略獒犬，轉而面對更大的威脅，戰鬥至死。

english: The mastiff stays with the characters if they rescue it, using the {@action Help} action to distract enemies in combat. A character who makes a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check can convince the mastiff to stay out of the fight and find shelter.
zh_tw: 如果角色們解救了它，這隻獒犬會與他們同行，在戰鬥中利用{@action Help||協助}動作分散敵人注意力。如果角色成功透過{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}）檢定，可以說服獒犬遠離戰鬥並找到安全的避難所。

english: Hezrou
zh_tw: 狂蟾魔

english: On its turn, the demon tries to force open the temple doors, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the hezrou forces open the doors to the temple, it begins attacking the people inside on its next turn. If the characters attack the hezrou or it kills all the creatures in the temple, it turns its attention toward the characters.
zh_tw: 在它的回合中，惡魔試圖強行開啟寺廟的大門，成功後需要進行一個 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果海茲魯成功開啟了寺廟的大門，它會在下一個回合開始攻擊裡面的人。如果角色攻擊海茲魯或者它殺死了寺廟中的所有生物，它會將注意力轉向角色。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: When only one of the characters' enemies remains, proceed with event 2.
zh_tw: 當角色們的敵人只剩下一個時，繼續進行事件2。

english: Event 2. Yeenoghu's Champion
zh_tw: 事件2. 耶諾古的鬥士

english: This event overlaps with the end of the previous event. When it begins, read the following to the players:
zh_tw: 此事件與前一個事件的結尾重疊。當它開始時，向玩家們宣讀以下內容：

english: A chorus of screams rises up as people, sheep, and pigs scamper through the town, chased by a demon with the lower body of a great serpent and the upper body of a six-armed gnoll clutching a wicked sword in each of its clawed hands.
zh_tw: 人們、羊群和豬隻在鎮上四處奔逃，尖叫聲此起彼落。一頭惡魔正在追趕他們：牠的下半身是巨蛇，上半身則是六臂豺狼人，每隻爪手都緊握著一把兇惡的劍。

english: The terrified animals and townsfolk dart through Idyllglen, chased by Garoknul, a unique demon in the service of Yeenoghu. Use the {@creature marilith} stat block to represent Garoknul. The fleeing beasts and townsfolk disappear when they reach the edge of the map. Garoknul stops its chase to battle the characters. If reduced to 50 hit points or fewer, Garoknul uses its next action to teleport away.
zh_tw: 受驚的動物和鎮民在伊迪爾格倫四處逃竄，被加洛克努爾追逐，加洛克努爾是為耶諾古服務的獨特惡魔。使用{@creature marilith||六臂蛇魔}的統計資料塊來代表加洛克努爾。逃走的野獸和鎮民在到達地圖邊緣時消失。加洛克努爾停止追逐，轉而與角色們戰鬥。如果生命值降至50點或以下，加洛克努爾將使用其下一個行動來傳送離開。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: When Garoknul leaves the area or dies, proceed with event 3.
zh_tw: 當加羅克努爾離開該區域或死亡時，進行事件3。

english: Event 3. Madness Reigns
zh_tw: 事件3. 瘋狂渴權

english: This event begins as the previous one ends. Read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 上一個事件結束時，這個事件開始。向玩家讀出以下框內文字：

english: Five guards wielding spears advance from the north. Splattered head-to-toe with black ichor, they gaze at you with hungry eyes.
zh_tw: 五名手持長矛的守衛從北邊前進。他們從頭到腳沾滿了黑色的血液，用渴望的眼神盯著你們。

english: The five human {@creature Guard||guards} are named Caladra Telmaster, Esselyn Xharn, Jai Wen, Tal Hannefar, and Yaerklos Summerlast. Their armor is covered in the ichor of Yeenoghu's demons. The ichor has driven the guards mad, making them hunger for humanoid flesh. When they notice the characters, the guards attack.
zh_tw: 這五名人類{@creature Guard||警衛}分別名為卡拉德拉·特爾瑪斯特、埃瑟琳·克薩爾恩、傑·溫、塔爾·漢尼法爾和亞克洛斯·薩默拉斯。他們的盔甲上沾滿了耶諾古的惡魔的黑色血液。這種血液使守衛們發狂，使他們渴望人形生物的肉。當他們注意到角色們時，守衛們發起了攻擊。

english: If a character kills a guard, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s mind attempts to punish the character. That character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} as {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s mind saps the character's energy.
zh_tw: 如果某個角色殺死了一名守衛，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的心靈會試圖懲罰這個角色。該角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 的感知豁免檢定，否則會因 {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的心靈吸取其能量而獲得1層 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。

english: A guard's madness can be cured with a {@spell dispel evil and good}, {@spell greater restoration}, or {@spell remove curse} spell. Guards who are cured of their madness thank the characters and explain that they were battling demons in the fields when they suddenly felt an overwhelming desire to consume humanoid flesh. These guards are eager to return to the battle in the fields, disappearing as they pass through the hazy border.
zh_tw: 守衛的瘋狂可以透過{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}、{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}或{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術來治癒。被治癒瘋狂的守衛會感謝角色們，並解釋說他們在田野中與惡魔戰鬥時突然感到一種強烈的渴望去吞食人形生物的肉。這些守衛渴望回到田野中的戰鬥，當他們穿過朦朧的邊界時消失了。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: After the characters deal with the guards, proceed with event 4.
zh_tw: 角色們處理完守衛後，繼續進行事件4。

english: Event 4. Unsettling Calm
zh_tw: 事件4. 大戰前的短暫和平

english: This event begins with Yael telepathically contacting the characters:
zh_tw: 這個事件以耶爾心靈感應聯絡角色們開始：

english: A woman's voice enters your mind. "Nice work. Take a break. You've got an hour before the really bad stuff happens."
zh_tw: 一個女性的聲音進入你的腦海。"幹得不錯。休息一下。你有一個小時的時間，然後真正糟糕的事情就要發生了。"

english: The characters can spend the next hour interacting with {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory of Idyllglen. They can explore the town, extinguish fires, speak to Jhessa Brightstar in the temple of Lathander ({@area area I3|2f8|x}), or take a short rest. During this time, the fields continue to burn, and the occasional scream is heard in the distance beyond the hazy border.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在未來的一個小時內與{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記憶中的伊迪爾格倫互動。他們可以探索小鎮，撲滅火焰，與拉桑德爾神廟中的傑莎·布萊特斯塔交談（{@area 區域I3|2f8|x}），或者進行短休。在此期間，田野繼續燃燒，遠處朦朧邊界之外偶爾傳來尖叫聲。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: As this event approaches its end, the characters hear cackling laughter far off in the distance. This laughter gets closer and louder, heralding the arrival of more of Yeenoghu's troops. Proceed with event 5.
zh_tw: 隨著這個事件接近尾聲，角色們聽到遠處傳來的咯咯笑聲。這笑聲越來越近，越來越響，預示著耶諾古的更多部隊即將到來。繼續進行事件5。

english: Event 5. Renewed Assault
zh_tw: 事件5. 新一輪進攻

english: This event begins as the previous one ends. Read or paraphrase the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 此事件在前一個事件結束時開始。向玩家讀出或轉述以下加框文字：

english: Six demons appear on the western edge of Idyllglen—a hulking, ape-like brute and five small, doglike creatures with rubbery gray bodies and big ears. Cackles in the distance signal more enemies on the way.
zh_tw: 六個惡魔出現在伊迪爾格倫的西邊——一個高大的、類人猿的野獸和五個小的、狗一樣的生物，它們有著橡膠般的灰色身體和大耳朵。遠處的嘲笑聲預示著更多的敵人即將到來。

english: A {@creature barlgura} and five {@creature Dretch||dretches} appear on the western edge of {@adventure map 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}. If these demons notice the characters, they attack. If they don't notice the characters, they attack the temple ({@area area I3|2f8|x}), hoping to kill everyone within. At the start of the second round of combat, a {@creature gnoll pack lord} and six {@creature Gnoll||gnolls} join the fray from the south. At the start of the third round of combat, a {@creature vrock} swoops down from the sky to join the battle.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature barlgura||惡猿魔}和五隻{@creature Dretch||怯魔}出現在{@adventure 地圖 4.2|BGDIA|7|Map 4.2: Idyllglen}的西邊。如果這些惡魔注意到角色們，它們會發起攻擊。如果它們沒有注意到角色們，它們會攻擊神廟（{@area 區域I3|2f8|x}），希望殺死裡面的每一個人。在戰鬥的第二回合開始時，一隻{@creature gnoll pack lord||鬣狗人頭領}和六隻{@creature Gnoll||鬣狗人}從南方加入戰鬥。在戰鬥的第三回合開始時，一隻{@creature vrock||鷲魔}從天空俯衝下來加入戰鬥。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: When only three enemies remain or after six rounds of combat, whichever comes first, proceed with event 6.
zh_tw: 當只剩下三個敵人，或者經過六輪戰鬥後，以先到為準，繼續進行事件6。

english: Event 6. Yeenoghu
zh_tw: 事件6. 耶諾古

english: This event overlaps with the end of the previous one. Read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 此事件與前一個事件的結尾重疊。向玩家讀出以下加框文字：

english: A wild, hideous laugh pierces the air and cuts through the din of battle. A giant gnoll covered in matted, bloodstained fur and swinging a three-headed flail charges out of the haze from the west. Gore drips from his red maw, open in a violent laugh.
zh_tw: 一種狂野而醜陋的笑聲刺穿空氣，在戰鬥的喧囂中傳開。一個巨大的鬣狗人，渾身覆蓋著糾結的、血跡斑斑的毛髮，揮舞著三頭鏈枷，從西邊的霧中衝出。他的紅色大口中滴著血，張開在一個狂暴的笑聲中。

english: {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF} attacks any creature not allied with him that he notices. If Yeenoghu doesn't notice any enemies, he attacks the statue of Zariel ({@area area I2|2f7|x}) before moving on to the temple ({@area area I3|2f8|x}).
zh_tw: {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF|耶諾古} 攻擊任何他注意到的不與他結盟的生物。如果耶諾格沒有注意到任何敵人，他會先攻擊扎瑞爾的雕像（{@area 區域I2|2f7|x}），然後再前往神廟（{@area 區域I3|2f8|x}）。

english: Next Event
zh_tw: 下一個事件

english: Event 7 begins after three rounds of combat with the demon lord or when Yeenoghu is reduced to 100 hit points or fewer.
zh_tw: 在與惡魔領主戰鬥三回合後，或者當耶諾古的生命值降至100點或更少時，事件7開始。

english: Left to right: Charge of Zariel and the Hellriders, the war on Avernus, and Zariel's surrender to Asmodeus
zh_tw: 從左到右：扎瑞爾的衝鋒和地獄騎士，阿弗納斯的戰爭，以及扎瑞爾向阿斯蒙蒂斯投降

english: Event 7. Zariel's Arrival
zh_tw: 事件7. 扎瑞爾降臨

english: This event overlaps with the end of the previous one. Read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 此事件與前一個事件的結尾重疊。向玩家讀出以下加框文字：

english: The cackling demon lord shuts his maw and narrows his eyes, gazing up toward the sky as a beam of radiant light pierces the haze. A powerful angel streaks down from above, followed by a gold-furred mammoth with feathered wings. The angel slashes her sword across Yeenoghu's chest and utters a spell. A portal opens behind the demon lord as the mammoth rams its head into Yeenoghu. The demon lord is sent tumbling through the portal, which quickly closes behind him.
zh_tw: 狂笑的惡魔領主閉上他的大嘴，眯起眼睛，抬頭望向天空，一道燦爛的光芒穿透了迷霧。一位強大的天使從上方疾馳而下，緊隨其後的是一隻金色皮毛、長有羽毛翅膀的猛獁象。天使揮劍劃過耶諾格胡的胸膛，並念出咒語。一個傳送門在惡魔領主身後開啟，猛獁象用頭撞擊耶諾格胡。惡魔領主被送入傳送門，傳送門在他身後迅速關閉。

english: The angel is Zariel (use the {@creature solar} stat block), and the winged mammoth is {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} the {@creature hollyphant|BGDIA} in shapechanged form. After ridding Idyllglen of Yeenoghu, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Zariel introduce themselves to the characters, healing them as best they can. While these introductions happen, the original Hellriders ({@creature Knight||knights}) appear on {@creature Warhorse||warhorses} and kill any remaining demons and gnolls. One of these Hellriders, a woman in her thirties with a fresh, deep cut on her cheek, thanks the characters and introduces herself as Yael. She gives a wink before lining up to join the rest of the battalion. The characters might also recognize Olanthius, Haruman, and other original Hellriders they have come across during their travels in Avernus.
zh_tw: 天使是扎瑞爾（使用{@creature solar||熾天神侍}的統計資料塊），而長著翅膀的猛獁象是變形後的{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，即{@creature hollyphant|BGDIA|聖飛象}。在清除了耶諾格的伊迪爾格倫之後，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和扎瑞爾向角色們介紹自己，並儘可能地治療他們。在這些介紹發生的同時，最初的地獄騎士（{@creature Knight||騎士}）騎著{@creature Warhorse||戰馬}出現，並殺死了所有剩餘的惡魔和鬣狗人。其中一位地獄騎士，一位三十多歲、臉頰上有一道新鮮深切口的女性，感謝角色們並介紹自己為雅埃爾。她在排隊加入其餘的營隊前眨了眨眼。角色們也可能認出奧蘭修斯、哈魯曼以及其他在阿弗納斯旅行中遇到的最初地獄騎士。

english: Zariel can cast the {@spell resurrection} spell up to three times. She uses this magic to resurrect as many dead characters as she can.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾最多可以施展{@spell resurrection||復生術}三次。她利用這個魔法儘可能多地復活死去的角色。

english: As Zariel prepares to lead her forces through the portal into Avernus, all other creatures except for her, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}, and the characters stop moving and responding as if frozen in time. Zariel turns to the characters and says, "Yeenoghu slaughtered those I swore to protect. I can stop him and others like him. I might have to give up all I stand for, but I could stem the tide of chaos and save many lives from the demonic terrors of the Abyss. Were you in my place, would you risk it all to save others?"
zh_tw: 當扎瑞爾準備帶領她的部隊透過傳送門進入阿弗納斯時，除了她自己、{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和角色們之外的所有生物都停止移動和響應，彷彿時間被凍結了。扎瑞爾轉向角色們並說："耶諾格屠殺了我所誓言要保護的人。我可以阻止他和像他一樣的其他人。我可能不得不放棄我所代表的一切，但我可以阻止混亂的浪潮，從無底深淵的惡魔恐怖中拯救許多生命。如果你們處在我的位置，你們會冒險去拯救他人嗎？"

english: Zariel lets each character answer her question in turn. She thanks them for their responses, then utters a blessing to Lathander over the characters. Characters who answered that they would risk it all as Zariel did each gain a {@reward charm of vitality}. Characters who answered that they would not risk it all to stop the demon lords each gain a {@reward charm of restoration}. (See "{@book Charms|DMG|7|Charms}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for the benefits of these supernatural gifts.) Characters who can't or won't answer the question receive nothing.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾讓每個角色依次回答她的問題。她感謝他們的答覆，然後向拉桑德爾為角色們祈禱祝福。那些回答說他們會像扎瑞爾一樣冒險一切的角色，每個人都會獲得一個{@reward charm of vitality||活力護咒}。那些回答說他們不會冒險一切去阻止惡魔領主的角色，每個人都會獲得一個{@reward charm of restoration||復原護咒}。（詳見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第7章中的'{@book 護咒|DMG|7|Charms}'瞭解這些超自然禮物的好處。）無法或不願回答問題的角色將一無所獲。

english: Once Zariel bestows her supernatural charms, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s Idyllglen memory ends. A flash of light brings all the characters (including dead ones) back to the Bleeding Citadel so that one of them might finally claim the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 一旦扎瑞爾賦予她的超自然護咒，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的伊迪爾格倫記憶就結束了。一道閃光將所有角色（包括死去的）帶迴流血城堡，以便其中一人最終可以認領{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。

english: Left to right: Haruman emerging from the Styx, Olanthius transformed into a death knight, and both by Zariel's side
zh_tw: 從左至右：哈魯曼從冥河出現，奧蘭修斯變成了死亡騎士，兩者都在扎瑞爾的身邊

english: Claiming the Sword
zh_tw: 執握寶劍

english: When the characters return to the Bleeding Citadel from {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory of Idyllglen, read the following boxed text to the players:
zh_tw: 當角色們從{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的伊迪爾格倫記憶中返回流血城堡時，向玩家讀出以下加框文字：

english: You stand before the dais, atop which glows the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Also before you are {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the ghostly warrior, Yael. The hollyphant is the first to speak. "I remember everything now. Idyllglen was the last straw. We followed Zariel to Avernus, but the evil there proved to be too much for us. Asmodeus appeared and promised Zariel infernal legions to end the Blood War, but she had to give the Lord of the Nine Hells her fealty. She accepted and became an archdevil, but not before Yael and I took her sword, hoping it could redeem Zariel someday. I gave up my magic and memories, and Yael gave her life to construct this place to protect the sword."
zh_tw: 你站在高臺前，上面放著發光的{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。同樣在你面前的是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和幽靈戰士耶爾。聖飛象是第一個說話的。"我現在記起一切了。伊迪爾格倫是最後一根稻草。我們跟隨扎瑞爾到了阿弗納斯，但那裡的邪惡對我們來說太過分了。阿斯蒙蒂斯出現並向扎瑞爾承諾，給予她地獄軍團來結束血戰，但她必須向九獄之王效忠。她接受了併成為了魔鬼大公，但在此之前，耶爾和我拿走了她的劍，希望有一天能夠救贖扎瑞爾。我放棄了我的魔法和記憶，而耶爾獻出了生命來建造這個地方，以保護這把劍。"

english: Yael's ghost says, "You have faced many trials to claim the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. I'm sorry to say, you face one more. As the inscription on the dais says, 'The hero who becomes one with this blade exists no longer.' Which of you is brave enough to draw the blade and be gone forever?"
zh_tw: 雅艾爾的鬼魂說："你們經歷了許多考驗來索取{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。我很遺憾地說，你們還要面對一個。正如基座上的銘文所說，'與這把劍合為一體的英雄將不復存在。' 你們中誰足夠勇敢，拔出劍並永遠消失？"

english: Any character who survived {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memory of Idyllglen can pull the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} from the dais. Characters who died in Idyllglen are not able to remove the sword from the stone.
zh_tw: 任何在{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}記憶中的伊迪爾格倫存活下來的角色都可以從基座上拔出{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。在伊迪爾格倫死去的角色無法將劍從石頭中拔出。

english: Once the sword is removed from its stone, a character can attune to it immediately if the sword deems that character worthy, and attuning to the sword changes the character irrevocably (see the item's description in {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|12}). When a character attunes to the sword, the citadel and the scab around it explode outward in blinding rays of light. Creatures in the scab take 110 ({@dice 20d10}) radiant damage and are hurled 1,000 feet away from the sword. Any demons that survive the explosion limp off to lick their wounds. Creatures inside the Bleeding Citadel are unharmed by the explosion and find themselves suddenly under Avernus's red sky.
zh_tw: 一旦劍從石頭中拔出，如果劍認為那個角色值得，角色可以立即與之共鳴，並且與劍共鳴會不可逆轉地改變角色（見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}中該物品的描述）。當角色與劍共鳴時，城堡和周圍的瘡痕會向外爆炸，發出耀眼的光芒。在瘡痕中的生物會受到110點（{@dice 20d10}）光耀傷害，並被拋向遠離劍1000尺的地方。任何在爆炸中倖存的惡魔會蹣跚地離開去舔舐他們的傷口。在流血城堡內的生物不受爆炸傷害，發現自己突然處於阿弗納斯的紅色天空下。

english: Once a character claims the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, Yael's work is done. Her ghost bids the party good luck and fades away as her soul passes into the afterlife.
zh_tw: 一旦有角色認領了{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，雅埃爾的任務就完成了。她的靈魂向隊伍道別好運，隨著她的靈魂進入來世，她的身影漸漸消失。

english: The destruction of the Bleeding Citadel restores all of {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s memories, which she can share with the characters. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} continues to travel with the characters and encourages them to use the sword to redeem Zariel.
zh_tw: 流血堡壘的毀滅恢復了{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的所有記憶，她可以與角色們分享這些記憶。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}繼續與角色們同行，並鼓勵他們使用這把劍來救贖扎瑞爾。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: The characters should be at least 13th level before heading into {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8} of the adventure.
zh_tw: 角色在進入本冒險的{@adventure 第5章|BGDIA|8}之前，應至少達到 13 級。

english: Chapter 5: Escape from Avernus
zh_tw: 第5章：逃離阿弗納斯

english: All adventures must end, but the best ones end with a bang. The climax of {@i Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus} comes when the characters try to redeem Zariel, save Elturel, or both. This chapter sets out some of the most likely ways for these events to happen. As with all Dungeons  & Dragons adventures, a host of other outcomes are possible, so feel free to let the story evolve beyond the suggested endings outlined in this chapter.
zh_tw: 所有冒險都必須結束，但最好的冒險會以轟轟烈烈的方式結束。{@i 博德之門：墜入阿弗納斯}的高潮出現在角色們試圖救贖扎瑞爾、拯救埃爾特瑞爾，或者同時達成這兩者。本章列出了一些最有可能實現這些事件的方式。與所有龍與地下城冒險一樣，還有許多其他可能的結果，因此請隨意讓故事超越本章概述的建議結局發展下去。

english: If the characters don't want to save Elturel, they don't need to. However, if they intend to save Elturel, the players should be aware that this is a twofold task:
zh_tw: 如果角色們不想拯救艾爾托瑞爾，他們沒有必要這麼做。然而，如果他們打算拯救艾爾托瑞爾，玩家們應該意識到這是一個雙重任務：

english: Elturel must be freed from the chains that bind it to Avernus.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾必須從束縛它到阿弗納斯的鎖鏈中解放出來。

english: Elturel must be returned to the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾必須被送回物質界。

english: Though some of the actions the characters can take will accomplish both these tasks at once, others will solve only half the problem.
zh_tw: 儘管角色們可以採取的一些行動能夠同時完成這兩個任務，但其他行動只能解決一半的問題。

english: Who Should Rule Avernus?
zh_tw: 誰應該統治阿弗納斯？

english: The characters could give Zariel more power to rule Avernus, or they could support one of the archdevil's enemies in a bid to unseat her. They could also try to destroy Zariel, creating a power vacuum that throws Avernus into disarray. Whatever the outcome, the characters are poised to help write cosmic history.
zh_tw: 角色們可以給扎瑞爾更多的力量來統治阿弗納斯，或者他們可以支援其中一個魔鬼大公的敵人，試圖推翻她。他們也可以嘗試摧毀扎瑞爾，製造一個權力真空，使阿弗納斯陷入混亂。無論結果如何，角色們都準備幫助書寫宇宙歷史。

english: Redeeming Zariel
zh_tw: 救贖扎瑞爾

english: In this outcome, the adventurers entreat the archdevil to redeem her angelic soul and take up her celestial mantle once more. Even though Zariel has fallen, there remains a faint glimmer of hope for her salvation. A fragment of the devil's former self still lingers within her sword, but inspiring Zariel to reverse the course of her destiny is not as easy as simply handing her the blade.
zh_tw: 在這個結局中，冒險者們懇求魔鬼大公贖回她的天使靈魂，並再次承擔起她的天界使命。儘管扎瑞爾已經墮落，但對她的救贖仍然有一絲希望。魔鬼過去的自我片段仍然殘留在她的劍中，但激勵扎瑞爾逆轉她命運的軌跡並不僅僅是簡單地把劍交給她。

english: Presenting the Sword
zh_tw: 獻劍

english: To redeem Zariel, the characters must possess the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Bringing the sword within 10 feet of Zariel causes the weapon to glow brighter, then levitate to hover before her. Confronted with the last fragment of her angelic spark, Zariel faces an internal struggle. In this moment, the characters have a chance to help the archdevil return to the light.
zh_tw: 要救贖扎瑞爾，角色們必須擁有{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。將劍帶到扎瑞爾10尺以內，會導致武器發光更亮，然後懸浮在她面前。面對她天使火花的最後碎片，扎瑞爾面臨內心的掙扎。在這個時刻，角色們有機會幫助魔鬼大公迴歸光明。

english: One of the characters must present Zariel with the argument to rejoin the celestial host, then make a {@dc 25} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. If the check is successful, Zariel is convinced to grasp the sword and accept its angelic spark back into her soul. The DC of this check is reduced by 5 for each of the following NPCs that are present when the characters try to redeem Zariel:
zh_tw: 其中一個角色必須向扎瑞爾提出重新加入天界軍團的觀點，然後進行一次{@dc 25}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果檢定成功，扎瑞爾會被說服握住這把劍，並接受其天使之火花回到她的靈魂中。當角色們試圖救贖扎瑞爾時，每有以下一個NPC在場，該檢定的DC就會減少5：

english: {@b Lulu}. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, the hollyphant regains all of her spellcasting abilities and weeps for what Zariel has become. Zariel feels sorrow as she remembers {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s friendship. If Zariel is redeemed, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} once again serves as Zariel's friend and mount.
zh_tw: {@b 露露}。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們在一起，這個神聖象會恢復她所有的施法能力，併為扎瑞爾所變成的樣子而哭泣。扎瑞爾在回憶起{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的友誼時感到悲傷。如果扎瑞爾得到救贖，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}再次成為扎瑞爾的朋友和坐騎。

english: {@b Olanthius}. If the characters made an ally of Olanthius, the death knight kneels before Zariel. Seeing him fills Zariel with shame for leaving her loyal friend to a horrific fate. If Zariel is redeemed, she turns the death knight to dust, letting his soul rest at last.
zh_tw: {@b 奧蘭蘇斯}。如果角色們與奧蘭修斯結成了盟友，這位死亡騎士會在扎瑞爾面前跪下。看到他讓扎瑞爾感到羞愧，因為她讓自己忠誠的朋友遭受了可怕的命運。如果扎瑞爾得到救贖，她會將死亡騎士化為塵土，讓他的靈魂終於得以安息。

english: If the Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check succeeds, continue with "Zariel's Redemption" below. If the check fails, proceed with "{@area Zariel's Wrath|31d|x}" instead.
zh_tw: 如果魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定成功，請繼續閱讀下面的'扎瑞爾的救贖'。如果檢定失敗，請改為進行'{@area 扎瑞爾的憤怒|31d|x}'。

english: Zariel's Redemption
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的救贖

english: If Zariel is convinced to accept the angelic spark, she grasps the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Read or paraphrase the following boxed text out loud when this happens:
zh_tw: 如果扎瑞爾被說服接受天使之光，她將緊握{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。當這種情況發生時，請大聲讀出或轉述以下框內文字：

english: Zariel's trembling hand reaches toward the gleaming hilt of her sword. Her fingers brush against it, and she grimaces as radiant light sears her flesh. As her grip tightens, she gasps in pain, then speaks an oath through tears of confusion, sorrow, and dawning joy.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾顫抖的手伸向她劍柄的閃閃發光。她的手指輕觸到它，隨著光芒灼燒她的肉體，她皺起了眉頭。當她握緊劍柄時，她因痛苦而喘息，然後帶著困惑、悲傷和漸漸湧現的喜悅的淚水說出了誓言。

english: "I, Zariel, supplicate myself before the holy light of justice. If it should accept me, I vow to take up this blade once more in its service."
zh_tw: "我，扎瑞爾，在正義的聖光前謙卑自己。如果它願意接納我，我發誓再次拿起這把劍，為其服務。"

english: The archdevil's words hang in the air for a silent moment, and she glances upward in agonized uncertainty. Then Zariel is bathed in a brilliant wash of radiant light. Her fiery halo disappears, and feathers burst from her leathery wings. All of her diabolical features vanish as her angelic form is restored. At the sight of this blessed transformation, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} gasps in delight—and transforms into a celestial mammoth with golden fur, feathered wings, and gleaming tusks.
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公的話音落下，四周靜默片刻。她痛苦而猶疑地仰望上方，隨即沐浴在璀璨的光耀之中。扎瑞爾燃燒的光環消失，皮膜雙翼迸生羽毛；所有魔鬼特徵都隨著天使形體的復原而褪去。目睹這受祝福的轉變，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}欣喜地倒抽一口氣，化為一頭擁有金色皮毛、羽翼與閃亮長牙的天界猛獁象。

english: All mortal creatures that witness Zariel's apotheosis are surrounded by twinkling wisps of the same light that transformed her, and are infused with a {@reward blessing of health} (see "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
zh_tw: 所有目睹扎瑞爾升格的凡間生物都會被與她轉變時相同的微光環繞，並獲得一個{@reward blessing of health||健康祝福}（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第7章中的"{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7}"）。

english: Returned to her full celestial glory, Zariel takes on the task of saving the besieged city of Elturel. If Zariel must travel some distance to reach Elturel, make sure the characters have the ability to keep up with the angel, or have her bring them along by magical means.
zh_tw: 恢復了她全部的天界榮耀，扎瑞爾承擔起了拯救被圍困的埃爾圖瑞爾城的任務。如果扎瑞爾需要行進一段距離才能到達埃爾圖瑞爾，請確保角色們有能力跟上天使，或者讓她用魔法手段帶領他們一起前進。

english: Zariel first soars above Elturel to within reach of the corrupted Companion. She closes her eyes, raises her sword above her head, takes a deep, centering breath, and brings the blade down. The Companion then explodes in a flash of light and sound, as described in "{@area Shattering the Companion|33e|x}" later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾首先飛越艾爾托瑞爾，接近被腐化的夥伴。她閉上眼睛，將劍高舉過頭，深呼吸，集中精神，然後將劍刃砍下。隨後，夥伴在一道光和聲音的爆發中爆炸，如本章後面的"{@area 粉碎伴陽|33e|x}"中所描述。

english: With the destruction of the Companion, the people of Elturel are freed from infernal bondage. The planetar imprisoned within the Companion raises the city out of the Nine Hells and returns it to Faerûn (see "{@area The Planetar's Power|33f|x}"). Zariel accompanies the city until she is satisfied that Elturel is safe.
zh_tw: 隨著伴侶的毀滅，艾爾托瑞爾的人民從地獄的束縛中解放出來。被囚禁在伴侶內的異界神侍將城市從九層地獄中舉起，將其返回到費倫（見"{@area 異界神侍的力量|33f|x}"）。扎瑞爾陪伴著這座城市，直到她確信艾爾托瑞爾是安全的。

english: The characters can return to the Material Plane with Elturel if they so choose, or they might wish to stick around Avernus to see who rises to become its new ruler (see "{@area Ruling Avernus|326|x}").
zh_tw: 角色們可以選擇帶著伊爾圖勒返回物質位面，或者他們可能希望留在阿弗納斯，看看誰會崛起成為新的統治者（參見"{@area 統治阿弗納斯|326|x}"）

english: If the characters return with Elturel to the Material Plane, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色們與埃爾圖瑞爾一同返回到物質界，請宣讀或轉述以下內容：

english: The Chionthar River shines like a golden road stretching from Elturel to Baldur's Gate, and to the sea beyond. The scent of morning dew cuts through the odor of smoke, brimstone, and rot that clings to Elturel's stones.
zh_tw: 奇昂塔河像一條金色的道路，從艾爾托瑞爾延伸到博德之門，再延伸到更遠的海洋。清晨露水的清新氣息穿透了煙霧、硫磺和腐爛的氣味，這些氣味附著在艾爾托瑞爾的石頭上。

english: Slowly, the people of the city make their way out from their hiding places to stand in the light of the mortal world once more. All eyes focus on Zariel where she stands, sword in hand. The planetar that raised Elturel out of Avernus kneels before her. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} nudges Zariel, then gestures toward you with her trunk. Zariel strides toward you, bowing her head in solemn gratitude. "This dark chapter has at last come to an end, and it is a brighter end than I ever dared to hope for. Thank you. Your selflessness will live on in my memory forever."
zh_tw: 慢慢地，城市的人們從他們的藏身之處出來，再次站在凡人世界的光芒中。所有目光都集中在手持劍的扎瑞爾身上。那個將艾爾托瑞爾從阿弗納斯中提升出來的異界神侍跪在她面前。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}輕推扎瑞爾，然後用她的象鼻指向你們。扎瑞爾大步走向你們，低頭表示莊嚴的感謝。"這個黑暗的章節終於結束了，而且它的結局比我敢希望的要光明。謝謝你們。你們的無私將永遠銘記在我的記憶中。"

english: "And in mine!" {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} says, beaming.
zh_tw: "也在我心中！"{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}說，滿面笑容。

english: Zariel's tone turns more somber as she says, "You have made an enemy of Asmodeus this day. We have that in common now. I wish you strength and good fortune—and if ever you have need of my power, hold this feather aloft and invoke my name. I shall come to your aid."
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的語氣變得更加沉重，她說："今天你們與阿斯蒙蒂斯結下了樑子。現在我們有了一個共同點。我祝願你們力量和好運——並且，如果你們有需要我的力量的時候，舉起這片羽毛並呼喚我的名字。我會來幫助你們的。"

english: Zariel pulls a single golden feather from one of her wings and hands it to the character closest to her. A creature that holds this feather can cast {@spell planar ally} as an action, calling Zariel and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} only, after which the feather dissolves into a ray of sunlight. If the two are called to aid the characters, they do so for up to 1 hour, with no payment asked for in return.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾從她的一隻翅膀上拔下一根金色的羽毛，遞給了離她最近的角色。持有這根羽毛的生物可以作為一個動作施放{@spell planar ally||異界誓盟}，僅召喚扎瑞爾和{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}，之後羽毛會溶解成一縷陽光。如果他們被召喚來幫助角色，他們會這樣做，最長持續1小時，且不要求任何回報。

english: With her gift given, Zariel inclines her head, unfurls her wings, and soars into the sky. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} turns to wrap you all up in a massive hug with her trunk. When she lets you go, she smiles warmly and says, "We'll see each other again. Someday."
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾贈予了禮物後，她點頭致意，展開翅膀，飛向天空。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}轉過身來，用她的象鼻將你們所有人都緊緊擁抱。當她放開你們時，她溫暖地微笑著說，"我們將來會再見面的。某一天。"

english: The golden mammoth then flaps her wings and soars into the sky. You watch her silhouette dwindle until it is swallowed by sunlight.
zh_tw: 金色的象鼻蟲隨後拍打翅膀，飛向天空。你注視著她的剪影逐漸縮小，直到被陽光吞沒。

english: Characters who return with Elturel can find plenty to do in the city, aiding survivors and helping restore order in the aftermath of so much death and destruction. In addition to the leadership and magic the characters can lend to the people of Elturel, the planetar once bound within the Companion remains in the city for as long as it is needed, using its ability to raise the dead to restore as many of those lost to the destruction as it can.
zh_tw: 與艾爾托瑞爾一同返回的角色們在城市中有很多事情可做，他們可以幫助生還者，並在如此多的死亡和破壞之後幫助恢復秩序。除了角色們可以為艾爾托瑞爾的人民提供的領導力和魔法外，曾經被束縛在伴侶內的異界神侍將留在城市中，只要需要，利用它復活死者的能力儘可能多地恢復那些在破壞中失去的人。

english: In the longer term, the characters might also have loose ends in Baldur's Gate to take care of, especially if any villains in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1} were left alive to continue their dark plots.
zh_tw: 從長遠來看，角色們可能在博德之門還有一些未了結的事情需要處理，尤其是如果{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中的任何反派還活著，繼續他們的黑暗陰謀的話。

english: Even if the tale of the two cities has been successfully completed to the characters' satisfaction, the events of the adventure continue to play out in Baldur's Gate and Elturel after the fact. In particular, if Grand Duke Ravengard survives and returns with Elturel, the survivors of the city will be greatly in his debt. Ravengard's efforts to defend the city should dramatically change the political landscape of Baldur's Gate and Elturel, ushering in an era of detente, if not full friendship and alliance, between the two cities.
zh_tw: 即使兩個城市的故事已經成功地按照角色們的滿意程度完成，冒險的事件在博德之門和艾爾托瑞爾之後仍然繼續上演。特別是，如果大公爵瑞文嘉德倖存下來並帶著艾爾托瑞爾返回，城市的生還者將深深地欠他的人情。瑞文嘉德為保衛城市所做的努力應該戲劇性地改變博德之門和艾爾托瑞爾的政治格局，為兩個城市之間帶來一個緩和的時期，如果不是完全的友誼和聯盟的話。

english: Zariel's Wrath
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的憤怒

english: If the characters fail to redeem Zariel and don't make a deal with her (see "{@area Making a Deal with Zariel|339|x}"), she attacks. Her first goal is to destroy the adventurers who dared insult her, after which she means to erase from existence all those whom she once loved.
zh_tw: 如果角色們未能救贖扎瑞爾，並且沒有與她達成協議（見"{@area 和扎瑞爾做交易|339|x}"），她會發起攻擊。她的第一個目標是摧毀敢於侮辱她的冒險者，之後她打算將她曾經愛過的所有人從存在中抹去。

english: At this grim juncture, the characters' only hope is to defeat Zariel or to bend the knee in fealty. Killing Zariel frees the citizens of Elturel from infernal bondage. The characters might choose this endgame intentionally, or they could be forced to fight Zariel if they fail to redeem her.
zh_tw: 在這個嚴峻的關頭，角色們唯一的希望是擊敗扎瑞爾或者屈服效忠。殺死扎瑞爾可以使埃爾圖瑞爾的市民擺脫地獄的束縛。角色們可能會有意選擇這個終局，或者如果他們未能救贖她，也可能被迫與扎瑞爾戰鬥。

english: Defeating Zariel is easier said than done. At her full power, the archdevil is more than a match for most mortals. Adventurers who hope to lay her low must scheme like a devil. Forging an alliance with a powerful, supernatural being such as {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, Gargauth, Tiamat, or one of the demon lords besieging Avernus could grant the characters the power necessary to cast down Zariel.
zh_tw: 擊敗扎瑞爾說起來容易做起來難。在她全力施展時，這位魔鬼大公比大多數凡人都要強大。希望將她擊敗的冒險者必須像惡魔一樣策劃。與像{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}、加葛斯、提亞瑪特，或者圍攻阿弗納斯的惡魔領主等強大超自然生物結盟，可能會賦予角色們必要的力量來打倒扎瑞爾。

english: Baphomet, Kostchtchie, or Yeenoghu
zh_tw: 巴弗滅，科斯徹奇或耶諾古

english: {@creature Baphomet|MTF} and {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF} are fighting to claim Avernus for themselves, and {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} (assuming the characters released him in {@area chapter 3|22a|x}) wants his hammer back. None of them can be trusted. Demon lords are savagery incarnate, and they take orders from no one.
zh_tw: {@creature Baphomet|MTF|巴弗滅}和{@creature Yeenoghu|MTF|耶諾古}正在爭奪阿弗納斯的控制權，而{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}（假設角色們在第三章{@area 第三章|22a|x}釋放了他）想要回他的錘子。他們中的任何一個都不能被信任。惡魔領主是野蠻的化身，他們不接受任何人的命令。

english: The extent to which Baphomet, {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA}, and Yeenoghu are present in Avernus makes it easy for characters to commune with any of these demon lords using {@spell contact other plane} spells or similar magic.
zh_tw: 巴菲門特，{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}，和耶諾格在阿弗納斯的存在程度使得角色們很容易透過使用{@spell contact other plane||異界探知}法術或類似的魔法與這些惡魔領主交流。

english: Bel
zh_tw: 貝爾

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA} rankles at Zariel's rulership of the layer of the Nine Hells that was once his, but he won't challenge her directly as long as he thinks Asmodeus supports Zariel.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾} 對扎瑞爾統治原本屬於他的九層地獄的層面感到不滿，但只要他認為阿斯蒙蒂斯支援扎瑞爾，他就不會直接挑戰她。

english: {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s aim is to let the characters try to redeem Zariel by helping them retrieve her sword. {@creature Bel|BGDIA} knows Zariel's redemption is a long shot, which is why he also gives characters a means to unlock the Companion. Freeing the planetar trapped within the Companion denies Zariel her latest prize—the city of Elturel—and makes her look inept, which is the best {@creature Bel|BGDIA} can hope for.
zh_tw: {@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}的目的是讓角色們嘗試透過幫助他們取回她的劍來救贖扎瑞爾。{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}知道救贖扎瑞爾的可能性很小，這也是為什麼他還給了角色們一種解鎖夥伴的方法。釋放被困在夥伴內的異界神侍使扎瑞爾失去了她最新的戰利品——艾爾托瑞爾城——並讓她顯得無能，這已經是{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}所期望的最佳結果了。

english: Gargauth
zh_tw: 加葛斯

english: The {@creature pit fiend} Gargauth would like nothing more than to be released from its prison and replace Zariel as Lord of Avernus. If the characters possess the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}, they can free Gargauth as described in the item's description (see {@adventure Appendix C|BGDIA|12}).
zh_tw: 魔鬼 {@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔} 加爾加斯最渴望的莫過於從它的監牢中獲釋並取代扎瑞爾成為阿弗納斯的領主。如果角色擁有 {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，他們可以按照物品描述中的說明釋放加爾加斯（參見{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}）。

english: If released, Gargauth thanks the characters through tears of mirth. The pit fiend's first act is to produce a contract out of thin air, claiming that it will aid the characters in their quest to destroy Zariel if they sign it. The contract is full of convoluted text, and is summarized in its final clause: "I, the undersigned, agree to form a compact with Gargauth, joining with it to destroy the archdevil Zariel. While bound by this compact, no intentional harm shall befall either party by the other party's hand, without voiding this agreement."
zh_tw: 如果被釋放，加葛斯會透過歡笑的淚水向角色們表示感謝。這個深獄煉魔的第一個行動是從空氣中拿出一份合同，聲稱如果角色們簽署它，它將幫助他們在摧毀扎瑞爾的任務中。這份合同充滿了複雜的文字，並在其最後一條中總結如下："我，簽名者，同意與加葛斯結成契約，聯合起來摧毀魔鬼大公扎瑞爾。在受此契約約束期間，除非解除此協議，否則任何一方不得故意傷害另一方。"

english: Gargauth takes joy in subverting ill-worded contracts and betraying those bound by them. Notably, the contract presented lasts only until Zariel is destroyed, after which point Gargauth intends to tear the adventurers limb from limb. Clever adventurers can subvert the pit fiend's betrayal by ensuring Zariel's capture, banishment, or some other nonlethal defeat.
zh_tw: 加葛斯喜歡顛覆措辭不當的合同，並背叛那些受合同約束的人。特別是，所提出的合同僅在扎瑞爾被摧毀之前有效，在那之後，加葛斯打算將冒險者們撕成碎片。聰明的冒險者可以透過確保扎瑞爾被捕獲、流放或以其他非致命方式被擊敗來顛覆這個深獄煉魔的背叛。

english: In that event, though, Gargauth has left itself an easy out. The only consequence for harming an ally under the terms of the contract is the contract's immediate negation—leaving Gargauth free to do whatever it sees fit. The pit fiend hopes that it can sneak this ruse through unchallenged, and argues fiercely if the characters spot this tricky phrase and demand its removal from the contract.
zh_tw: 然而，在那種情況下，加葛斯已經為自己留下了一個簡單的出路。根據合同條款，傷害盟友的唯一後果是合同立即無效——這使得加葛斯可以自由地做它認為合適的事情。這個深獄煉魔希望它能夠不被發現地透過這個詭計，並且如果角色們發現了這個棘手的短語並要求將其從合同中移除，它會激烈地爭辯。

english: Tiamat
zh_tw: 提亞馬特

english: The queen of evil dragons is mighty and aloof, and she rarely acts unless her triumph is assured. Challenging an archdevil directly is risky, and {@creature Tiamat|RoT} stands to lose a great deal if Zariel prevails. Fortunately, Tiamat has a champion she can send in her stead: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 邪惡龍後強大而孤傲，她很少行動，除非勝利在握。直接挑戰一位魔鬼大公是危險的，而如果扎瑞爾獲勝，{@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}將失去許多。幸運的是，提亞馬特有一位冠軍可以代替她行動：{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}。

english: The adventurers can't communicate with Tiamat directly, but they can approach Arkhan at his tower (see "{@area Arkhan's Tower|247|x}"). Arkhan is preoccupied with trying to find a way to free Tiamat from the Nine Hells while also staving off the physical deterioration caused by the {@item Hand of Vecna}. He won't entertain thoughts of vanquishing Zariel unless there's something in it for him and his dark queen.
zh_tw: 冒險者們不能直接與提亞瑪特溝通，但他們可以接近阿肯塔的塔樓（見"{@area 阿克漢之塔|247|x}"）。阿肯塔忙於尋找一種方法，將提亞瑪特從九層地獄中釋放出來，同時也在抵禦由{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}引起的身體退化。除非對他和他的黑暗女王有利，否則他不會考慮擊敗扎瑞爾的想法。

english: White Abishai
zh_tw: 亞比莎白龍魔

english: While the head of Zariel would be a grand trophy, a trophy isn't enough to sway Arkhan. The characters must convince him that he can rule Avernus in Zariel's stead, with Tiamat by his side and armies of abishai and infernal dragons at his back. After contemplating this notion, Arkhan raises the {@item Hand of Vecna} and boasts, "With this hand, I shall tear Zariel's head from her shoulders and rule Avernus with my queen at my side."
zh_tw: 儘管扎瑞爾的頭顱會是一個宏偉的戰利品，但戰利品並不足以動搖阿坎。角色們必須說服他，他可以在扎瑞爾的位置上統治阿弗納斯，提亞瑪特在他身邊，阿比沙伊和地獄龍的軍隊作為他的後盾。在深思熟慮這個想法後，阿坎舉起了{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}並誇口說："有了這隻手，我將從她的肩膀上撕下扎瑞爾的頭顱，並讓我的王后陪伴我統治阿弗納斯。"

english: Arkhan declares that he will muster an army and depose Zariel in ten days. Exactly ten days later, two hundred {@creature white abishai|MTF} fly from Arkhan's tower toward Zariel's current location, with Arkhan leading the charge on the back of Asojano the {@creature chimera}, and {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA} by his side, carried on the back of Chango the {@creature manticore}. Arkhan's army is bolstered by five chromatic dragons—one adult dragon of each color—sent by Tiamat to help ensure victory. If they so choose, the characters can join Arkhan. The abishai and the dragons engage Zariel's legions while Arkhan, Torogar, and the characters challenge the archdevil herself. This battle can play out as part of the "{@area Endgame in Elturel|340|x}" section described at the end of this chapter.
zh_tw: 阿坎宣稱他將集結一支軍隊並在十天內廢黜扎瑞爾。確切的十天後，兩百隻{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}從阿坎的塔樓飛向扎瑞爾的當前位置，阿坎騎在阿索亞諾這隻{@creature chimera||奇美拉}的背上領導衝鋒，而{@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA|託羅加·鋼拳}在他身邊，騎在昌戈這隻{@creature manticore||刺尾獅}的背上。阿坎的軍隊得到了五隻色彩龍的加強——每種顏色的成年龍一隻——由提阿瑪特派遣來幫助確保勝利。如果他們選擇，角色們可以加入阿坎。阿比夏和龍與扎瑞爾的軍團交戰，而阿坎、託羅加和角色們挑戰這位魔鬼大公本人。這場戰鬥可以作為本章末尾描述的"{@area 艾爾托瑞爾的終局|340|x}"部分的一部分展開。

english: Serving Zariel
zh_tw: 服從扎瑞爾

english: The characters might decide after meeting Zariel that they wish to serve her, joining her army and smiting demons in the Blood War. They also might wind up serving her if they fail to redeem her and wish to live.
zh_tw: 角色們在見到扎瑞爾後可能會決定他們願意為她服務，加入她的軍隊並在血戰中打擊惡魔。如果他們未能救贖她並希望活命，他們也可能會最終為她服務。

english: Souls are Forfeit
zh_tw: 剝奪靈魂

english: Characters who choose to serve Zariel must sign a contract (see {@adventure appendix A|BGDIA|10}) forfeiting their souls to the archdevil. She then returns such characters to the Material Plane to do her bidding. Zariel has numerous schemes spinning at any given time, but the adventurers are particularly well suited to preparing Baldur's Gate to meet the same fate as Elturel. As a sign of favor, she bestows a charm upon each character (see "{@area Archdevil Charms|414|x}").
zh_tw: 選擇為扎瑞爾服務的角色必須簽署一份合同（見{@adventure 附錄A|BGDIA|10}），將他們的靈魂交給這位魔鬼大公。然後，她將這些角色送回物質界，以執行她的命令。扎瑞爾隨時都有無數的陰謀在進行，但冒險者們特別適合準備博德之門迎接與艾爾托瑞爾相同的命運。作為青睞的標誌，她給每個角色賜予了一個護身符（見"{@area 魔鬼大公的護咒|414|x}"）。

english: Characters who die in Zariel's service are reborn as {@creature Lemure||lemures} from the River Styx. They lose all memories of their previous lives, and their alignment changes to lawful evil. If a character pleased Zariel with their loyalty in life, she might allow them to keep their memories as she promotes them to an NPC devil of your determination.
zh_tw: 在扎瑞爾服務中死去的角色會作為來自冥河的{@creature Lemure||劣魔}重生。他們失去了所有前世的記憶，並且他們的陣營變為守序邪惡。如果一個角色在生活中因其忠誠而取悅了扎瑞爾，她可能會允許他們保留記憶，並將他們提升為你確定的NPC魔鬼。

english: Zariel's Sword is Destroyed
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾之劍被摧毀

english: With no one to sway Zariel from her path to absolute damnation, Zariel demands that the characters give her the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} if they possess it. After she claims the sword, Zariel holds it aloft and shatters it (see "{@area Relinquishing the Sword|337|x}").
zh_tw: 如果沒有人能夠影響扎瑞爾，讓她偏離通往絕對毀滅的道路，扎瑞爾會要求角色們，如果他們擁有的話，把{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}交給她。在她得到這把劍之後，扎瑞爾將它高舉過頭並將其粉碎（見"{@area 放棄聖劍|337|x}"）。

english: Lulu Falls
zh_tw: 露露墮落

english: For Zariel to fall beyond redemption is the worst outcome for {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}. This unimaginable tragedy shatters the hollyphant's mind, leaving {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} insane. Roll or choose the specific effects of her madness from the {@table long-term madness||Long-Term Madness table} in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}, but this madness can be overcome only by a {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 對於{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}來說，扎瑞爾墮落到無可救藥的地步是最糟糕的結果。這一難以想象的悲劇擊碎了這頭神聖象的心靈，使{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}陷入瘋狂。從{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@book 第八章|DMG|8}中的{@table long-term madness||長期性瘋狂表}中擲骰或選擇她的瘋狂具體效果，但只有透過{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}或類似魔法才能克服這種瘋狂。

english: Ruling Avernus
zh_tw: 統治阿弗納斯

english: If Zariel is redeemed or killed, the first layer of the Nine Hells falls into chaos. You can decide which of the many powerful figures in Avernus make a play to replace Zariel, but any new ruler immediately faces enemies on all sides. The invading armies of Baphomet and Yeenoghu are wreaking havoc and threatening to tear Avernus apart. Moreover, dozens of ambitious greater devils will gleefully try to supplant their new and untested ruler.
zh_tw: 如果扎瑞爾得到救贖或被殺死，九層地獄的第一層將陷入混亂。您可以決定阿弗納斯眾多強大人物中哪一個試圖取代扎瑞爾，但任何新統治者立即面臨來自四面八方的敵人。巴菲米特和耶諾格的入侵軍隊正在製造混亂，威脅著要將阿弗納斯撕裂。此外，數十個雄心勃勃的更強大的魔鬼將高興地試圖取代他們新的和未經考驗的統治者。

english: Ruling a layer of the Nine Hells as a mortal is effectively impossible. None of the devils of Avernus will knowingly serve anyone but a superior devil. However, Asmodeus admires ambition. The Lord of the Nine Hells might see a brash and powerful mortal as a worthy replacement for Zariel, offering to transform the character into an NPC archdevil that can rule Avernus. Alternatively, the characters might attempt to claim Avernus on their own terms.
zh_tw: 作為一個凡人統治九層地獄的一個層面實際上是不可能做到的。阿弗納斯的魔鬼們不會知情地為任何不是高階魔鬼的人服務。然而，阿斯蒙蒂斯欣賞雄心壯志。九層地獄之主可能會看到一個魯莽而強大的凡人作為扎瑞爾的合適替代者，提出將角色轉變成一個能夠統治阿弗納斯的NPC魔鬼大公。或者，角色們可能會嘗試按照他們自己的條件來宣稱阿弗納斯。

english: Idealistic characters seeking to destroy the Nine Hells from the inside out might see this power vacuum as an opportunity to strike a mortal blow to Asmodeus's reign. This might be the only time in cosmic history that such a blindly idealistic cause could succeed. But even if the party can wrest Avernus from Asmodeus's control, this ultimately serves to unite the remaining archdevils, aligning them toward the common goal of reclaiming Avernus—which works to Asmodeus's advantage.
zh_tw: 理想主義角色尋求從內到外摧毀九層地獄，可能會將這種權力真空視為對阿斯蒙蒂斯統治發起致命一擊的機會。這可能是宇宙歷史上唯一一次，如此盲目的理想主義事業能夠成功。但即使隊伍能夠從阿斯蒙蒂斯的控制中奪取阿弗納斯，這最終會使剩餘的魔鬼大公團結起來，朝著奪回阿弗納斯的共同目標前進——這反而對阿斯蒙蒂斯有利。

english: Will Elturel Be Saved?
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾會得救嗎？

english: Unless the characters intervene, Elturel is inevitably dragged into the River Styx. The memories of its inhabitants will be wiped clean, and their souls will be made into devils—fodder for the front lines of the Blood War.
zh_tw: 除非角色們進行幹預，否則艾爾托瑞爾不可避免地會被拖入冥河。其居民的記憶將被抹去，他們的靈魂將變成魔鬼——血戰前線的食糧。

english: The characters have several ways to save the city at its most desperate hour (see "{@area Endgame in Elturel|340|x}"). To save Elturel without redeeming Zariel, the chains binding the city to the infernal iron posts sinking into Avernus must be severed, and the city must be returned to the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 角色們有幾種方法在艾爾托瑞爾最絕望的時刻拯救這座城市（見"{@area 艾爾托瑞爾的終局|340|x}"）。要在不救贖扎瑞爾的情況下拯救艾爾托瑞爾，必須切斷將城市與正在沉入阿弗納斯的煉獄鐵樁相連的鎖鏈，並將城市帶回物質位面。

english: Forging the Blade of Avernus
zh_tw: 鑄造阿弗納斯之刃

english: At some point after the destruction of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, Zariel gives her servants (including the characters if they have taken on that role) the task of forging a new blade for her. This endeavor comes with the following objectives:
zh_tw: 在{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}被摧毀之後的某個時刻，扎瑞爾給她的僕人（包括角色們，如果他們已經擔任了這個角色）下達了為她鑄造一把新劍的任務。這項努力伴隨著以下目標：

english: If {@creature Bel|BGDIA} is still in Zariel's service, she calls on him to forge the blade. Otherwise, her servants must scour the cosmos for a worthy weaponsmith, such as an efreeti from the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}仍在扎瑞爾的麾下效力，她會召喚他來鍛造這把劍。否則，她的僕人們必須在宇宙中搜尋一位配得上的武器匠，例如火元素位面的黃銅之城中的一位火巨靈。

english: Zariel needs at least ten pounds of metal or material to make the blade of the sword. Adamantine would do, or a talon from Tiamat.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾需要至少十磅的金屬或材料來製造劍的刀刃。精金可以，或者是提阿瑪特的一隻爪子。

english: To grant the blade its power, the freshly forged weapon must be quenched in the blood of a celestial, a demon lord, and an archdevil. Zariel can supply her own blood, but her servants must collect the other two sacrifices.
zh_tw: 為了賦予劍力量，新鍛造的武器必須在天界的血液、惡魔領主和魔鬼大公的血液中淬火。扎瑞爾可以提供她自己的血液，但她的僕人必須收集其他兩個祭品。

english: Zariel names this new artifact the {@item Blade of Avernus|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾將這件新神器命名為{@item Blade of Avernus|BGDIA|阿弗納斯之刃}。

english: Breaking the Chains
zh_tw: 打破枷鎖

english: Eight chains of infernal iron anchor Elturel to its binding posts, and each of those chains must be broken to free the city. If all the chains are broken, Elturel remains floating above Avernus and is no longer drawn toward the River Styx. However, the characters must still find a way to return the city to the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 八條地獄鐵鏈將艾爾托瑞爾錨定在其繫結柱上，必須打破所有這些鏈條才能解放這座城市。如果所有的鏈條都被打破，艾爾托瑞爾將停留在阿弗納斯上方，不再被拉向冥河。然而，角色們仍然需要找到一種方法將這座城市帶回物質界。

english: Each chain link is 30 feet long and 20 feet wide, and is formed of a welded loop of infernal iron that is 5 feet thick. A chain link is a Huge object with AC 19, 250 hit points, a damage threshold of 30, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. See {@adventure chapter 2|BGDIA|2} for information on moving along the chains and climbing the infernal iron posts they connect to.
zh_tw: 每個鏈條環節長30尺，寬20尺，由一個焊接成環的地獄鐵製成，厚度為5尺。鏈條環節是一個巨大的物體，具有19的護甲等級，250點生命值，30點傷害閾值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。有關沿著鏈條移動以及攀登它們連線的地獄鐵柱的資訊，請參見{@adventure 第二章|BGDIA|2}。

english: Ire of Tiamat
zh_tw: 提亞瑪特之怒

english: Tiamat's divine power is mighty enough to break the chains that bind Elturel. {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA} is willing to commune with his goddess to this end, but only if the characters offer him a suitably potent gift. In an inscrutable twist, Tiamat decides to aid the characters, and tells Arkhan as such. Read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 提亞瑪特的神力足夠強大，可以打破束縛艾爾托瑞爾的鏈條。{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}願意為了這個目的與他的女神交流，但前提是角色們必須給他一個足夠強大的禮物。在一個難以理解的轉折中，提亞瑪特決定幫助角色們，並告訴阿肯塔這一點。閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: A shroud of confusion passes over Arkhan's face, dissolving his bravado. He mutters to Tiamat under his breath, "Is that wise, my queen?" Then his eyes darken as his body hangs limp like a puppet cut from its strings. After a moment, Arkhan stands up straight, his eyes glowing with prismatic light. A hungry smile crosses his face, and five voices echo from his mouth, each resonating with the ire of an imprisoned goddess.
zh_tw: 一層困惑的面紗掠過阿坎（阿克漢）的臉龐，溶解了他的虛張聲勢。他低聲對提亞馬特（提亞馬特）嘟囔：'這樣做明智嗎，我的女王？'然後他的眼睛變暗，身體像斷了線的木偶一樣無力地垂下。過了一會兒，阿坎站直了身體，眼睛閃爍著七彩的光芒。一個飢渴的微笑掠過他的臉，五個聲音從他的口中迴響，每一個都與被囚禁的女神的憤怒共鳴。

english: "I will aid you," Tiamat growls. "If your power is enough to threaten Zariel's ambitions, then I have nothing to fear. I can destroy the chains binding Elturel, but you must be present to bear witness to my majesty. Now go. I will know when you are there."
zh_tw: "我將助你一臂之力，" 提阿瑪特咆哮著說。"如果你的力量足以威脅到扎瑞爾的野心，那我就沒有什麼可擔心的。我可以摧毀束縛艾爾托瑞爾的鏈條，但你們必須在場見證我的威嚴。現在去吧。我會知道你們什麼時候到達那裡。"

english: When the characters next set foot in Elturel, {@creature Tiamat|RoT} bursts forth from her distant lair and blazes like a meteor across the sky of Avernus. Appearing above the city, she swoops down and focuses her breath weapons on one chain at a time, dealing 67 acid damage, 88 lightning damage, 72 cold damage, and 91 fire damage—more than enough to destroy the chain's links. Once all eight chains are destroyed, Tiamat roars in triumph and departs.
zh_tw: 當角色們再次踏入艾爾托瑞爾時，{@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}從她遙遠的巢穴中爆發而出，在阿弗納斯的天空中像流星一樣劃過。出現在城市上空，她俯衝下來，將她的吐息武器依次集中在一條鏈上，造成67點強酸傷害、88點閃電傷害、72點寒冷傷害和91點火焰傷害——足以摧毀鏈環。一旦所有八條鏈都被摧毀，提亞瑪特在勝利中咆哮並離開。

english: Jaws of Crokek'toeck
zh_tw: 咔洛咯克托克之頜

english: If the demon {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} is freed from the scab encasing the Bleeding Citadel, it begins wandering Avernus and devouring all in its path. Though the demon consumes indiscriminately, it hungers most for divine blood. As such, the essence of a good-aligned god, the blood of a good celestial, or even the blood of a good paladin draws {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}'s attention from miles away. If the adventurers slather a chain link in blood from such a source, {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} picks up the delicious scent and gallops across Avernus toward it.
zh_tw: 如果惡魔{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}從包裹流血城堡的結痂中被釋放出來，它開始在阿弗納斯遊蕩併吞噬它路徑上的一切。儘管這個惡魔不加選擇地吞噬，但它最渴望的是神聖的血液。因此，善良陣營神祇的本質、善良天界的血液，甚至是善良聖武士的血液，都能從數英里外吸引{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的注意。如果冒險家們用這樣的血液塗抹鏈條環節，{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}就會嗅到這美味的氣味，並橫跨阿弗納斯向它奔去。

english: The creature must bleed willingly upon a chain link. Either it or an ally can use an action to wound the creature for 5 ({@dice 1d10}) piercing or slashing damage. This damage can't be negated or reduced, and the infernal energy within the chains causes the creature's hit point maximum to be reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken until the creature finishes a long rest. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is willing to make at least part of this sacrifice of blood if the characters ask her.
zh_tw: 生物必須自願地在一個鏈條環節上流血。它或其盟友可以使用動作來傷害生物，造成5（{@dice 1d10}）點穿刺或揮砍傷害。這個傷害不能被抵消或減少，並且鏈條內的地獄能量會導致生物的生命值上限減少，減少量等於所受傷害，直到生物完成一次長休。如果角色們請求，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}願意做出至少部分的這種獻血犧牲。

english: {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} appears near Elturel within 1 hour of the first drop of blood being shed. All nearby devils immediately try to slay the demon, while nearby demons leap to its defense. As the two opposing forces clash, {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA} slips past the devils. The demon can gnaw through a bloodied chain link in 1 minute.
zh_tw: {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}在艾爾托瑞爾附近出現，這是在第一滴血滴下後的1小時內。所有附近的惡魔立即試圖殺死這個惡魔，而附近的惡魔則跳出來保護它。當這兩個對立的力量衝突時，{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}悄悄地溜過惡魔。這個惡魔可以在1分鐘內啃斷一個血跡斑斑的鏈條環節。

english: Breaking the Contract
zh_tw: 打破契約

english: Voiding the infernal contract between Zariel and {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} causes the hellish chains binding Elturel to crumble to ash.
