This can be accomplished by either killing Zariel or by destroying the original contract. Zariel can use an action to summon the contract, which appears in her one hand. The contract is otherwise hidden in a secret place known only to her. Getting Zariel to call forth the contract takes guile, as the archdevil can't be {@condition charmed}. Destroying the original copy of {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s contract frees Elturel while leaving Zariel's other contracts intact.
zh_tw: 廢除扎瑞爾和{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}之間的地獄契約會導致束縛艾爾托瑞爾的地獄鏈條化為灰燼。這可以透過殺死扎瑞爾或摧毀原始契約來實現。扎瑞爾可以使用一個動作來召喚契約，契約會出現在她的一隻手中。契約通常隱藏在一個只有她知道的秘密地方。讓扎瑞爾召喚契約需要狡猾，因為這位魔鬼大公不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。摧毀{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}契約的原始副本可以釋放艾爾托瑞爾，同時保留扎瑞爾的其他契約。

english: The original contract resembles the copy stored in Thavius's {@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA}: nine square plates of infernal iron linked together by short chains, each plate inseparable from the others and inscribed with the terms of the contract written in Infernal. Casting the contract into the River Styx or immersing it in molten magma of one of Avernus's active volcanoes destroys it instantly.
zh_tw: 原始合同類似於儲存在塔維斯的{@item infernal puzzle box|BGDIA|煉獄謎盒}中的副本：九個由短鏈連線的地獄鐵製方形板，每個板與其他板不可分割，並刻有以地獄語寫成的合同條款。將合同投入冥河或將其浸入阿弗納斯某座活火山的熔岩中會立即將其銷燬。

english: Destroying Zariel voids all the active contracts she has made with beings across the multiverse. This causes no small amount of cosmic chaos.
zh_tw: 摧毀扎瑞爾將使她與多元宇宙中生物簽訂的所有有效契約失效。這將引起不小的宇宙混亂。

english: The Fate of Thavius Kreeg
zh_tw: 塔維斯·克雷格的命運

english: If the characters killed {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} in Baldur's Gate, he crawled out of the River Styx as a {@creature lemure}. In accordance with the terms of their contract, Zariel promoted him to an {@creature amnizu|MTF}, then confined him in her fortress (see "{@area Poor Devil: Thavius Kreeg|2b8|x}"). If Thavius dies in the Nine Hells as a devil, he is permanently dead—but this does not break the full terms of Zariel's contract. Even with the primary signatory dead, the people of Elturel remain bound to Zariel by the Creed Resolute.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在博德之門殺死了{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，他作為{@creature lemure||劣魔}從冥河爬了出來。根據他們契約的條款，扎瑞爾將他晉升為{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}，然後將他關押在她的堡壘中（見"{@area 可憐的魔鬼：塔維斯·克雷格|2b8|x}"）。如果塔維斯作為魔鬼在九層地獄中死亡，他將永久死亡——但這並不會破壞扎瑞爾契約的全部條款。即使主要簽署者死亡，艾爾托瑞爾的人民仍然透過《堅定信條》被繫結在扎瑞爾身邊。

english: Killing Thavius
zh_tw: 殺死塔維斯

english: Characters hoping for a climactic battle against a worthy adversary won't find one by fighting {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}. Despite the power he now possesses, the devil Thavius is a coward who would rather grovel than fight. Killing him marks a wretched end to a wretched life.
zh_tw: 希望與有價值的對手進行高潮戰鬥的角色們在與{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}戰鬥時不會找到一個。儘管他現在擁有力量，但這個魔鬼塔維斯是一個懦夫，寧願卑躬屈膝也不願戰鬥。殺死他標誌著一個悲慘生命的悲慘結局。

english: If the characters left Thavius alive in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}, they must find a way back to the Material Plane to kill him. His location in Baldur's Gate (or the chance that he might have fled the city) is left to your determination, as is the process by which the characters can track down his devilish incarnation on Avernus after they return.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中讓塔維斯活著，他們必須找到一種方法返回物質界來殺死他。他在博德之門中的位置（或者他可能已經逃離了這座城市的可能性）由你來決定，同樣，角色們在返回後如何追蹤他在阿弗納斯上的惡魔化身的過程也由你來決定。

english: Mercy for the Fallen
zh_tw: 憐憫墮落之人

english: If the characters threaten him, Thavius snivels and begs for his life. He also claims to know where the original contract that sealed Elturel's doom is hidden. This is a lie, the claim a desperate ploy to buy time and, hopefully, a chance to escape.
zh_tw: 如果角色們威脅他，塔維斯會哭泣並乞求饒命。他還聲稱知道封存艾爾托瑞爾命運的原始合同藏在哪裡。這是一個謊言，這個聲稱是絕望的計策，以爭取時間，並希望有機會逃脫。

english: The Ultimate Sacrifice
zh_tw: 終極犧牲

english: If the characters have no other options for dealing with Zariel, one or more of them might be willing to give up everything in order to save the innocent people of Elturel. When a good-aligned paladin or cleric of 10th level or higher performs such a selfless act, the power of that deed is eternally written upon their soul. To creatures that covet souls, this deed blazes like a bonfire in the darkness—and Zariel desires it. Such a character is likely destined to pass into the Upper Planes after death, and as such, they make a handsome prize for an archdevil to shape into a loyal servant of the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有其他處理扎瑞爾的選擇，他們中的一個或多個人可能願意放棄一切，以拯救艾爾托瑞爾的無辜人民。當一個善良陣營的聖武士或牧師，且等級在10級或以上，執行這樣一個無私的行為時，這一行為的力量將永恆地書寫在他們的靈魂上。對於那些渴望靈魂的生物來說，這一行為就像黑暗中的篝火一樣閃耀——扎瑞爾渴望得到它。這樣的角色很可能註定在死後進入上層界，因此，他們成為魔鬼大公塑造成九層地獄忠實僕人的絕佳獎品。

english: If any of the characters fit that description, Zariel senses their power when the characters are in her presence. "Your soul shines bright," she says. "Brighter even than the beacon above Elturel. I would have it."
zh_tw: 如果任何角色符合那個描述，扎瑞爾在角色們在她面前時會感知到他們的力量。"你的靈魂閃耀著光芒，"她說。"甚至比艾爾托瑞爾上方的信標還要明亮。我想要它。"

english: If the character willingly offers their soul in exchange for the souls of the people of Elturel, Zariel is taken aback by their selflessness. She furrows her brow and asks, "You would lay down your soul for these people? People whose cowardice and weakness have caused you nothing but grief?"
zh_tw: 如果角色願意為了艾爾托瑞爾人民的靈魂自願奉獻自己的靈魂，扎瑞爾對他們的無私感到驚訝。她皺起眉頭問道："你會為了這些人放下自己的靈魂嗎？這些人的懦弱和軟弱給你帶來的只有悲傷？"

english: A character offering to sacrifice their soul can take advantage of this moment of uncertainty, making a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check with advantage to sway Zariel from the path of evil. Resolve a successful check as noted in "{@area Redeeming Zariel|317|x}" earlier in this chapter. Even if the check fails, though, Zariel accepts the offered soul in exchange for all the souls of Elturel. Unless you want to add additional challenges for the characters, the archdevil can free the city from its chains and return it to the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 一個角色提出犧牲自己的靈魂可以利用這個不確定的時刻，進行帶有優勢的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，以說服扎瑞爾放棄邪惡的道路。如本章前面"{@area 救贖扎瑞爾|317|x}"所述，解決成功的檢定。即使檢定失敗，扎瑞爾也會接受所提供的靈魂，以換取艾爾托瑞爾所有的靈魂。除非你想為角色增加額外的挑戰，否則魔鬼大公可以釋放這座城市的鏈條，將其返回物質界。

english: Relinquishing the Sword
zh_tw: 放棄聖劍

english: If the characters try to bargain for Elturel's release without the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, Zariel considers their offer and produces a contract stating that she will release the city in exchange for the sword, delivered without any complications or deceit. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} rankles at the idea of the characters forging any sort of pact with the archdevil, but holds out hope that Zariel can be redeemed if the sword is brought before her.
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖在沒有{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的情況下為艾爾托瑞爾的釋放進行討價還價，扎瑞爾考慮了他們的提議，並出示了一份合同，宣告她將以劍作為交換釋放這座城市，且交付過程中不得有任何複雜情況或欺騙。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}對角色們與魔鬼大公締結任何形式的契約感到憤怒，但仍抱有希望，認為如果寶劍呈現在扎瑞爾面前，她可以得到救贖。

english: If the characters present the sword to Zariel and either fail to redeem her or choose not to try, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們將劍呈現給扎瑞爾，並且要麼未能救贖她，要麼選擇不嘗試，閱讀：

english: Zariel grabs the sword by the blade and lets her fiendish blood cascade down its edge, snarling in pain. "With this final rite, I discharge my divine duty. Let my name be forever struck from the ledger of Mount Celestia." She tightens her grip, and the sword shatters. The angelic spark lodged within it dwindles, then dies.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾抓住劍刃，讓她那惡魔之血順著劍刃流下，痛苦地咆哮著。"透過這個最後的儀式，我解除了我的神性職責。願我的名字永遠從天堂山的賬簿中抹去。"她握緊了劍柄，劍隨之碎裂。嵌入其中的天使火花減弱，然後熄滅。

english: Once destroyed, the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} can't be restored, ending any hope of redemption for the archdevil.
zh_tw: 一旦被摧毀，{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}無法恢復，這終結了魔鬼大公得到救贖的所有希望。

english: Making a Deal with Zariel
zh_tw: 和扎瑞爾做交易

english: Characters out of other options might simply bow to Zariel's power. If the characters make a deal with Zariel to save Elturel, they must specify that the city is to be freed from its chains and returned to the Material Plane. Otherwise, Zariel will release the chains but leave Elturel in Avernus with no hope of salvation.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有其他選擇，他們可能只能屈服於扎瑞爾的力量。如果角色們與扎瑞爾達成協議以拯救艾爾托瑞爾，他們必須明確指出這座城市應該從鎖鏈中解放出來，並返回到物質界。否則，扎瑞爾將釋放鎖鏈，但將艾爾托瑞爾留在阿弗納斯，沒有救贖的希望。

english: To Destroy a Demon Lord
zh_tw: 消滅惡魔領主

english: {@creature Baphomet|MTF} and {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF} are both clear and present dangers to Avernus. Although Zariel would relish slaying either of them personally, she gladly draws up a contract agreeing to trade Elturel and the souls within the city for either demon lord's destruction. Delivering the glaive of Baphomet or the flail of Yeenoghu to her is sufficient to prove the characters' success.
zh_tw: {@creature Baphomet|MTF|巴弗滅}和{@creature Yeenoghu|MTF|耶諾古}都是對阿弗納斯明顯而現實的威脅。儘管扎瑞爾個人會很高興親自殺死他們中的任何一個，但她還是高興地起草了一份合同，同意用艾爾托瑞爾和城內的靈魂交換任何一個惡魔領主的毀滅。將巴弗滅的釤刀或耶諾古的鏈枷交給她足以證明角色們的成功。

english: If the characters agree to Zariel's terms, they learn that both demon lords have recently converged around Elturel. You can add either demon lord to the battle in "{@area Endgame in Elturel|340|x}" later in this chapter. If the characters freed the demon lord {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} in {@area chapter 3|22a|x}, he can also make an appearance.
zh_tw: 如果角色們同意扎瑞爾的條件，他們將得知兩位惡魔領主最近都聚集在艾爾托瑞爾周圍。你可以在本章後面的"{@area 艾爾托瑞爾的終局|340|x}"戰鬥中加入任一惡魔領主。如果角色們在{@area 第三章|22a|x}中釋放了惡魔領主{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}，他也可以出現。

english: Shield of the Hidden Lord
zh_tw: 隱藏領主的盾牌

english: If the characters still possess the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}, Zariel blithely declares that she would consider trading Elturel for it. From within the shield, the pit fiend Gargauth begs and sobs and promises the world to the characters if they spare its life and find a way to restore the devil to its former glory. These are empty promises, though Gargauth's fear is real.
zh_tw: 如果角色們仍然擁有{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}，扎瑞爾輕鬆地宣佈她會考慮用它來交換艾爾托瑞爾。盾牌內的深獄煉魔加葛斯懇求、哭泣，並承諾如果角色們饒恕它的生命並找到方法恢復魔鬼昔日的榮耀，它將給予角色們整個世界。儘管這些是空洞的承諾，但加葛斯的恐懼是真實的。

english: If the characters give her the shield, Zariel casts {@spell dispel evil and good} on it. Her spell causes Gargauth to manifest as a miserable, malformed {@creature pit fiend} at half its hit point maximum and with 4 levels of {@condition exhaustion}. She commands the characters to destroy the wretch. If they succeed, she casually dismisses them and ignores any attempt by the characters to hold her to promises made without a contract.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將盾牌交給她，扎瑞爾會對其施放{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}。她的法術會使加爾加斯顯現為一個悲慘且畸形的{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}，其生命值減半並帶有4層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。她命令角色們消滅這個可憐蟲。如果他們成功了，她會隨意打發他們離開，並且無視角色們試圖讓她履行沒有契約支援的承諾的任何努力。

english: If the characters press Zariel for a formal agreement before giving her the shield, she presents a fair contract. However, she refuses to both free Elturel and return it to the Material Plane, promising only one or the other in exchange for the shield alone.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在將盾牌交給扎瑞爾之前要求一個正式的協議，她會提出一個公平的合同。然而，她拒絕既釋放艾爾托瑞爾又將其返回物質界，只承諾用盾牌單獨交換其中一個。

english: Dealing with the Companion
zh_tw: 處理伴陽

english: The Companion that once warded Elturel against undead is powered by a {@creature planetar} trapped inside it. Long thought of as Elturel's savior, the Companion was also its undoing, for it was the beacon that allowed the power of Avernus to drag the city into the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 曾經保護艾爾托瑞爾免受不死生物侵害的伴侶是由一個被困在其內的{@creature planetar||異界神侍}提供動力的。長久以來被認為是艾爾托瑞爾的救星的伴侶也是它的毀滅之源，因為它是允許阿弗納斯的力量將這座城市拖入九層地獄的信標。

english: The Companion is a nearly indestructible metal orb 50 feet in diameter. When it protected Elturel, it hung in the sky like a second sun and emitted sunlight so bright that the orb itself couldn't be seen. Now, lightning plays across the surface of the dull sphere, which is surrounded by a 400-foot-diameter, 10-foot-thick shell of impenetrable, magical darkness. A creature with {@sense darkvision} can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it. If this darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 8th level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.
zh_tw: 同伴是一個幾乎不可摧毀的金屬球體，直徑50尺。當它保護艾爾托瑞爾時，它像第二個太陽一樣懸掛在空中，發出的陽光如此耀眼以至於球體本身看不見。現在，閃電在暗淡的球體表面閃爍，它被一個直徑400尺、厚10尺的不可穿透、魔法黑暗的外殼所包圍。具有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}的生物無法透過這黑暗看到任何東西，非魔法光源也無法照亮它。如果這黑暗與由8級或更低階別的法術創造的光照區域重疊，創造光的法術將被解除。

english: Unlocking the Companion
zh_tw: 解鎖伴陽

english: The Companion is sealed by nine locks evenly spaced around its equator. These locks can only be opened by inserting nine adamantine rods into them. The rods are hidden in Zariel's {@area wrecked flying fortress|267|x}.
zh_tw: 同伴被赤道上均勻分佈的九個鎖封閉。這些鎖只能透過插入九根精金棒來開啟。這些棒子隱藏在扎瑞爾的{@area 飛行堡壘廢墟|267|x}中。

english: Inserting the nine adamantine rods into the nine locks of the Companion causes its upper hemisphere to open, freeing the planetar within.
zh_tw: 將九根精金棒插入伴侶的九個鎖中會導致其上半球體開啟，從而釋放出內部的異界神侍。

english: Shattering the Companion
zh_tw: 粉碎伴陽

english: The {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} has the power to shatter the Companion and dispel the darkness around it. Striking the orb with the sword causes the Companion to ring like a bell and then shatter, sounding out an angelic tone that can be heard with perfect clarity across the infinite breadth of Avernus. Unless the sword is wielded by an angel of challenge rating 15 or higher, or a good-aligned cleric or paladin of at least 10th level, the unchecked power reverberates through the sword and shatters it.
zh_tw: {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}擁有粉碎同伴並驅散其周圍黑暗的力量。用劍擊中球體會導致同伴像鍾一樣響起，然後碎裂，發出一個可以在阿弗納斯無限廣度中完美清晰聽到的天使般的音調。除非劍是由挑戰等級15或更高的天使，或至少10級的善良陣營牧師或聖武士所揮舞，否則未經抑制的力量會透過劍傳播並將其粉碎。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} knows that the sword possesses this power. However, she wants the characters to use the sword to redeem Zariel, not simply to save Elturel. As such, she conceals this fact unless it's clear that redeeming Zariel is an impossible task.
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}知道這把劍擁有這種力量。然而，她希望角色們使用這把劍來救贖扎瑞爾，而不僅僅是為了拯救艾爾托瑞爾。因此，除非很明顯救贖扎瑞爾是不可能的任務，否則她會隱瞞這一事實。

english: Alternatively, if the characters strike a bargain with a powerful entity such as Tiamat or a demon lord, that being can attack and shatter the Companion. For more information on allying with a supernatural power, see "{@area Breaking the Chains|32e|x}" earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: 或者，如果角色與提亞馬特或惡魔領主等強大實體達成協議，該存在可以攻擊並摧毀伴侶。有關與超自然力量結盟的更多資訊，請參見本章前面的"{@area 打破枷鎖|32e|x}"。

english: The Planetar's Power
zh_tw: 異界神侍的力量

english: If the Companion is shattered or unlocked, the {@creature planetar} inside it is released. The planetar's name is Nascius, and its power can help save Elturel, but only if the infernal chains that bind the city have been severed. If asked to save the city, the planetar takes a brief moment to recover its strength. It then swoops down below the fallen city, rises to set the earthmote on its broad shoulders, and raises Elturel out of Avernus and back to its rightful place in the Material Plane.
zh_tw: 如果伴侶被粉碎或解鎖，裡面的{@creature planetar||異界神侍}就會被釋放。這個異界神侍的名字是納西烏斯，它的力量可以幫助拯救艾爾托瑞爾，但這只有在束縛城市的地獄鏈條被切斷的情況下才能實現。如果被請求拯救這座城市，異界神侍會短暫地恢復它的力量。然後它飛到墜落的城市下方，上升到將大地支柱放在它寬闊的肩膀上，並將艾爾托瑞爾從阿弗納斯舉起，回到物質界的正確位置。

english: Endgame in Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾的終局

english: The material presented earlier in this chapter describes some of the ways the characters might accomplish the goals of redeeming Zariel and saving Elturel. Within the range of available options, you are free to determine the conditions under which those goals are met.
zh_tw: 本章前面介紹的材料描述了角色們可能實現救贖扎瑞爾和拯救艾爾托瑞爾目標的一些方式。在可用選項的範圍內，您可以自由決定滿足這些目標的條件。

english: This section describes an epic event that can serve as the adventure's climax: Elturel being pulled down into the River Styx while Zariel and her forces battle an army of demons beneath the city. A demon lord—either {@creature Baphomet|MTF} or {@creature Yeenoghu|MTF}—has launched an all-out attack on Elturel before it's dragged into the River Styx. This section includes encounters that you can run to challenge the characters as they maneuver to confront Zariel. These encounters are suitable for a party of four 13th-level characters. If the party is weaker or stronger, adjust the encounters accordingly.
zh_tw: 這一節描述了一場史詩般的事件，可以作為冒險的高潮：艾爾托瑞爾被拉入冥河，而扎瑞爾和她的力量在城市下方與一支惡魔軍隊戰鬥。一位惡魔領主——要麼是{@creature Baphomet|MTF|巴弗滅}要麼是{@creature Yeenoghu|MTF|耶諾古}——在艾爾托瑞爾被拖入冥河之前對它發起了全面攻擊。這一節包括可以執行的遭遇戰，用來挑戰角色們，因為他們在操縱中面對扎瑞爾。這些遭遇戰適合一個由四個13級角色組成的隊伍。如果隊伍較弱或較強，請相應調整遭遇戰。

english: Event 1: River's Edge
zh_tw: 事件1：河邊

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} guides the characters toward Zariel, finding her on the ground of Avernus beneath Elturel. Read or paraphrase the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}引導角色們走向扎瑞爾，在艾爾托瑞爾下方的阿弗納斯地面上找到了她。閱讀或轉述以下內容以設定場景：

english: Elturel hangs above you and the River Styx. The iron spikes that anchor the city have dragged it nearly to the river's banks. Within a few hours, Elturel will sink into the Styx.
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾懸掛在你們上方，冥河就在下方。錨定城市的鐵釘已經將它拖到了河岸附近。在幾個小時內，艾爾托瑞爾將沉入冥河。

english: Hordes of distant demons fly around the city like gnats, and a battle rages fiercely beneath it. Thousands of fiends clash in Elturel's shadow. And at their center stands a being wreathed in flame, striking down demons with tireless fury.
zh_tw: 成群的遠處的惡魔像蚊子一樣在城市周圍飛舞，而在其下方激烈地進行著戰鬥。成千上萬的惡魔在艾爾托瑞爾的陰影下衝突。在它們的中心，站著一個被火焰包圍的存在，以不知疲倦的狂暴擊倒惡魔。

english: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} points at the figure with her trunk and whispers, "That's her. Zariel stands exactly where she always does—where the fighting is fiercest."
zh_tw: {@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}用她的象鼻指著那個身影低聲說："就是她。扎瑞爾就站在她經常在的地方——戰鬥最激烈的地方。"

english: This encounter takes place on an open field bordered by the River Styx, with Zariel visible a mile away. Allow the characters a few moments to plan their next move. When they decide to act, two {@creature Horned Devil||horned devils} break toward them after a fleeing {@creature glabrezu}, which is cut down and dissolves to ichor that flows into the Styx. The devils attack at range with Hurl Flame attacks. Each devil has 125 hit points remaining and fights to the death.
zh_tw: 這次遭遇發生在一片被冥河環繞的開闊地上，扎瑞爾在遠處一英里處可見。給角色們一些時間規劃下一步行動。當他們決定行動時，兩隻{@creature Horned Devil||角魔}朝他們衝來，追趕著一隻逃跑的{@creature glabrezu||迷誘魔}，後者被砍倒並溶解成流入冥河的腐液。魔鬼們使用投擲火焰攻擊進行遠端攻擊。每隻魔鬼剩餘125點生命值，並戰鬥至死。

english: Between this event and the next, the characters might delve deeper into the melee, or could make their way up to Elturel by flying or climbing.
zh_tw: 在這個事件和下一個事件之間，角色們可能會更深入地參與混戰，或者可以透過飛行或攀爬來到艾爾托瑞爾。

english: Event 2: Field of Flames
zh_tw: 事件2: 火焰之地

english: The front of Zariel's army has crashed into the flank of the demonic horde, whether on the streets of Elturel or on the battlefield below. Taking on both armies headfirst is impossible, but savvy characters might be able to use the battlefield's geography to avoid combat.
zh_tw: 扎瑞爾的軍隊前線已經撞入惡魔軍團的側翼，無論是在艾爾托瑞爾的街道上還是在下方的戰場上。正面迎戰兩支軍隊是不可能的，但是精明的角色或許能夠利用戰場的地形來避免戰鬥。

english: The characters must make three group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to navigate the battlefield, with each round of checks increasing in difficulty—{@dc 15}, {@dc 17}, and {@dc 19}. Every time the group fails a check, each character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) poison damage plus 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage from the noxious gas and flames roiling across the battlefield.
zh_tw: 角色們必須進行三次群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來穿越戰場，每輪檢定的難度逐漸增加——{@dc 15}、{@dc 17} 和 {@dc 19}。每次群體檢定失敗時，每個角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則將因戰場上的有毒氣體和火焰而受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）毒素傷害加22點（{@dice 4d10}）火焰傷害。

english: After making these ability checks, the characters stumble into a battle between six {@creature Hezrou||hezrous} and Lucille, the {@creature pit fiend} general they spotted as they were leaving Elturel at the end of {@area chapter 2|193|x}:
zh_tw: 在進行這些能力檢定後，角色們意外地捲入了六隻{@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}與他們在離開{@area 第二章|193|x}結尾的埃圖爾時所見到的{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}將軍露西爾之間的戰鬥中：

english: A pit fiend wearing an eyeless helm clutches an infernal battle standard in one clawed hand while swinging a huge flaming mace in the other. The pit fiend is beset on all sides by six hulking, froglike demons that croak vile epithets as they tear the pit fiend's flesh with their claws.
zh_tw: 一個戴著無眼頭盔的深獄煉魔用一隻爪子緊握著地獄戰旗，同時另一隻手持巨大的火焰釘頭錘揮舞。這個深獄煉魔四面楚歌，被六個高大的、像青蛙一樣的惡魔圍攻，它們用爪子撕扯深獄煉魔的肉體，同時發出惡毒的辱罵聲。

english: Two {@creature Hezrou||hezrous} break off from this melee to attack the characters. The other fiends continue fighting Lucille.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Hezrou||狂蟾魔}從這場混戰中脫離出來攻擊角色們。其他的惡魔繼續與露西爾戰鬥。

english: By the time the characters deal with the hezrous attacking them, Lucille has destroyed the remaining hezrous or sent them scrambling away in search of easier prey. Lucille turns toward the characters, gives them a curt nod, and takes to the air. Characters can attack the pit fiend, which has 175 hit points remaining. If they let it go, the pit fiend returns the favor by using its {@item helm of devil command|BGDIA} to issue orders to its troops that the characters are not to be harmed. As the characters make their way toward Zariel, demons that might otherwise cross their path are intercepted by devils, creating an avenue of safe passage for the characters.
zh_tw: 當角色們處理完攻擊他們的狂蟾魔時，露西爾已經摧毀了剩下的狂蟾魔，或者將它們趕跑去尋找更容易的獵物。露西爾轉向角色們，對他們點了點頭，然後飛向空中。角色們可以攻擊這個深獄煉魔，它還剩下175點生命值。如果他們放過它，深獄煉魔會以禮相報，使用它的{@item helm of devil command|BGDIA|魔鬼指揮官頭盔}向它的部隊下達命令，不得傷害角色們。當角色們向扎瑞爾前進時，本來會擋住他們去路的惡魔被惡魔攔截，為角色們創造了一條安全通道。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Lucille's {@item helm of devil command|BGDIA} and {@item battle standard of infernal power|BGDIA} are described in {@adventure appendix C|BGDIA|12}.
zh_tw: 露西爾的{@item helm of devil command|BGDIA|魔鬼指揮官頭盔}和{@item battle standard of infernal power|BGDIA|地獄之力戰旗}在{@adventure 附錄C|BGDIA|12}中有描述。

english: Event 3: Showdown with Zariel
zh_tw: 事件3: 決戰扎瑞爾

english: At some point, the characters get close to {@creature Archduke Zariel of Avernus|BGDIA}. When they do, Zariel is locked in combat with a hyena-faced {@creature balor}—one of Yeenoghu's demons. A 100-foot-diameter circle has formed around Zariel and the balor, as other devils and demons stay clear of the destruction the two unleash. Unless the characters draw attention to themselves, the fiends pay them no mind.
zh_tw: 在某個時刻，角色們接近了{@creature Archduke Zariel of Avernus|BGDIA|阿弗納斯的大公扎瑞爾}。當他們這樣做時，扎瑞爾正與一個長著鬣狗臉的{@creature balor||巴洛炎魔}——耶諾格的惡魔之一——激烈戰鬥。在扎瑞爾和巴洛炎魔周圍形成了一個100尺直徑的圓圈，其他惡魔和魔鬼都遠離了兩者釋放的破壞。除非角色們引起注意，否則惡魔們不會理會他們。

english: If you don't want to roll dice to determine the outcome of this battle, Zariel reduces the balor to 0 hit points after 4 rounds of combat, causing it to explode in a great fireball. When the battle is over, Zariel has 450 hit points remaining and takes a round to collect herself as the eye of the storm that surrounded her dissolves once more into chaos.
zh_tw: 如果你不想透過擲骰子來決定這場戰鬥的結果，扎瑞爾在戰鬥的4輪後將巴洛炎魔的生命值降至0，導致它在一次巨大的火球中爆炸。戰鬥結束後，扎瑞爾還剩下450點生命值，並在風暴之眼再次化為混亂後，用一輪時間來恢復自己。

english: If the characters released {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} from his prison in {@area chapter 3|22a|x} but lost track of him, the demon lord wades into battle and tries to get close enough to Zariel to wrest {@item Matalotok|BGDIA}, his hammer, from her clutches. Devils loyal to Zariel confound {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} at every turn, denying him his prize, and Zariel herself refuses to engage him. Still, the characters can count on {@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA} to create a distraction big enough to draw attention away from their activities, whatever those might be.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@area 第三章|22a|x}釋放了{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}，但隨後失去了他的蹤跡，這位惡魔領主會踏入戰場，試圖靠近扎瑞爾，以便從她手中奪回{@item Matalotok|BGDIA|瑪塔洛托克}，他的錘子。忠於扎瑞爾的惡魔在每一個轉折點上都使{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}感到困惑，不讓他得到他的獎品，而扎瑞爾本人則拒絕與他交戰。儘管如此，角色們可以指望{@creature Kostchtchie|BGDIA|科斯徹奇}製造足夠的幹擾，將注意力從他們的活動上轉移開，無論這些活動是什麼。

english: It is hard for insignificant mortals to gain the archdevil's attention, but if they anger Zariel, aid her in combat, or display {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} or the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, she stops what she's doing and gives the characters a chance to speak to her—or to challenge her.
zh_tw: 對於微不足道的凡人來說，要引起魔鬼大公的注意是很難的，但如果他們激怒了扎瑞爾，幫助她在戰鬥中，或者展示{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}或{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，她會停下手頭的事情，給角色們一個與她交談——或者挑戰她的機會。

english: If the characters attempt to break the infernal chains binding Elturel to the posts that are slowly sinking into Avernus (see "{@area Breaking the Chains|32e|x}"), Zariel takes notice when the first chain is sundered or the planetar is released from the Companion. If the characters are making use of a demon to break the chains, Zariel attacks it and defeats it after {@dice 2d4} rounds if the characters don't come to the demon's aid. If Tiamat is the one destroying the chains, Zariel attacks the characters in the hopes that Tiamat will cease her attack once her accomplices are slain.
zh_tw: 如果角色試圖打破束縛艾爾托瑞爾的地獄鎖鏈，這些鎖鏈正慢慢沉入阿弗納斯（見"{@area 打破枷鎖|32e|x}"），當第一條鎖鏈被切斷或伴星天使從束縛中釋放時，扎瑞爾會注意到。如果角色正在利用惡魔來打破鎖鏈，如果角色不援助惡魔，扎瑞爾會在{@dice 2d4}回合後攻擊並擊敗它。如果提亞馬特是破壞鎖鏈的人，扎瑞爾會攻擊角色，希望提亞馬特一旦她的同夥被殺就會停止攻擊。

english: If Zariel is reduced to 100 hit points or fewer, she withdraws to the edge of the battle, taking refuge in her flying fortress if it's nearby and hasn't been destroyed (see "{@area Zariel's Flying Fortress|2b0|x}").
zh_tw: 如果扎瑞爾的生命值降至100點或更少，她會撤退到戰場邊緣，如果她的飛行堡壘在附近且尚未被摧毀，她會前往那裡避難（參見「{@area 扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘|2b0|x}」）。

english: The Blood War is the cosmic struggle between the evil forces of Law and Chaos—a war that threatens to tear the multiverse asunder.
zh_tw: 血戰是秩序邪惡勢力與混沌邪惡勢力之間的宇宙鬥爭——一場有可能撕裂多元宇宙的戰爭。

english: Baldur's Gate Gazetteer
zh_tw: 博德之門地理志

english: Even the most hardened adventurers watch their steps in Baldur's Gate, where lives hold prices in copper and greed proves deadlier than dragon fire. Baldur's Gate has a reputation for being a rough place, where crime and opportunity walk hand in hand, and where anything can be bought, sold, or seized at sword-point. If something can be given a price, it's for sale somewhere in Baldur's Gate. Drugs and poisons sit on shelves alongside tinctures and remedies. Trade goods from Chult, mechanical wonders from Neverwinter, tomes of magic from Calimshan, and the most believable counterfeits of each can all be found in the city's stalls.
zh_tw: 即便最堅毅的冒險者也會在博德之門步步為營，這裡的命如銅錢，貪婪比龍焰更致命。博德之門素有險惡之地的名聲，犯罪與機遇如影隨形，任何事物都能被買售，或被劍鋒劫取。但凡能標價之物，必在城內某處出售。藥水與毒劑同列貨架，來自楚特的特產、來自無冬城的機械奇物、源於卡林杉的魔法典籍，乃至每種物品最以假亂真的贗品，皆能在市井攤鋪覓得。

english: The Flaming Fist, a mercenary company paid for by the city, protects residents without the barest hint of civil delicacy. The Watch, the guardian force of the wealthy Upper City, exists only to serve the patriars—the city's detached upper class. Meanwhile, crime flourishes under the control of the Guild, which oversees almost every organized criminal act, from dockside gambling rings to blackmail at patriar garden parties. Either under the Guild's auspices or in defiance of them, those who cut purses or throats make a decent living in the city, their talents traded as briskly—and often just as openly—as those of any other professional.
zh_tw: 焰拳，是由城市支付的僱傭兵公司，保護居民時毫無文明的細膩。守衛，是富裕上城的守護力量，只服務於貴族——城市中與世隔絕的上層階級。與此同時，在公會的控制下，犯罪活動蓬勃發展，它監管著幾乎所有有組織的犯罪行為，從碼頭邊的賭博團夥到貴族花園聚會的勒索。無論是在公會的支援下還是在反抗它們的情況下，那些割包或割喉的人在城市中過著體面的生活，他們的才能被交易得同樣活躍——通常也和任何其他專業人士一樣公開。

english: For all its shadows and dark dealings, Baldur's Gate is not without its lights. Some residents earnestly seek to make the city a safer place by banding together to make their own sort of imperfect but effective justice.
zh_tw: 儘管博德之門有其陰暗和暗中的交易，這座城市並非沒有光明。一些居民真誠地尋求透過團結一致來創造一種雖然不完美但有效的正義，使這座城市變得更安全。

english: History of Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的歷史

english: Since its beginning as a quiet backwater community, Baldur's Gate has undergone a dramatic transformation, becoming the hub of danger and adventure it is today.
zh_tw: 從最初作為一個寧靜的偏遠社群，博德之門經歷了戲劇性的轉變，成為了今天這個危險和冒險的中心。

english: Founding Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 建立博德之門

english: Centuries ago, the hero Balduran spent years questing in lands across the Sea of Swords and beyond. When finally he returned to his village of Gray Harbor, he brought fantastic wealth with him, much of which he gifted to friends and family. These boons greatly improved Gray Harbor's fortunes, launching businesses, expanding its docks, and seeing the creation of a defensive wall around the town. In honor of their heroic patron, the citizens came to call one of their new wall's passages Baldur's Gate. Within a generation, though, the gate became synonymous with the community, and the settlement known as Baldur's Gate began appearing on maps of the Sword Coast.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀前，英雄巴爾杜蘭在劍之海對岸及更遠的地方進行了多年的探險。當他最終返回他的村莊灰港時，他帶回了鉅額財富，其中大部分他贈送給了朋友和家人。這些恩惠極大地改善了灰港的命運，推動了商業發展，擴大了碼頭，並建造了環繞小鎮的防禦牆。為了紀念他們的英雄贊助人，市民們開始將他們的新城牆的一個通道稱為博德之門。然而在一代人的時間裡，這扇大門成為了社群的代名詞，而被稱為博德之門的定居點開始出現在劍海岸的地圖上。

english: The city's surprising growth attracted all manner of people. Peasants affected by raiding and war, farmers rendered penniless by famine and drought, pirates seeking a neutral port—all types saw a chance to put their mark on the rapidly growing community.
zh_tw: 這座城市出人意料的增長吸引了各種各樣的人。受到襲擊和戰爭影響的農民，因饑荒和乾旱而一貧如洗的農民，尋找中立港口的海盜——各種型別的人都看到了在這個迅速增長的社群留下自己印記的機會。

english: Order in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的秩序

english: As the city swelled, questions of law and taxation arose. The community's eldest families—largely those wealthy enough to afford homes within the city walls—came to be known as patriars and grew wary of the influx of strangers settling beyond their walls. The creation of various additional taxes on trade and travel led to violence breaking out between the Upper City—behind the original walls of Gray Harbor—and the Lower City, built on the slopes leading down to the Chionthar River. Patriar houses were ransacked, family heirlooms were lost forever, and heirs were kidnapped, never to be seen again. Gold flowed like blood as families and guilds hired mercenaries to protect them. Only the election of a new group of rulers—known as the dukes and, collectively, as the Council of Four—put the matter to rest. These elected rulers have been a part of the city's governance ever since.
zh_tw: 隨著城市的擴張，法律和稅收問題隨之而來。社群中最古老的家族——主要是那些富有到能夠在城牆內擁有家園的家族——被稱為貴族，他們對那些在城牆外定居的陌生人的湧入變得警惕。對貿易和旅行徵收各種額外的稅收導致上城——位於灰港原始城牆之後——和下城，建在通往奇翁塔河的斜坡上——之間爆發了暴力衝突。貴族的房屋被洗劫，家族的傳家寶永遠丟失，繼承人被綁架，再也沒有被看到過。金幣像血液一樣流動，因為家族和公會僱傭僱傭兵來保護他們。只有選舉出一群新的統治者——被稱為公爵，總體上稱為四人議會——才使這個問題得到解決。這些選舉產生的統治者一直是城市治理的一部分。

english: Another pillar of order in Baldur's Gate formed when the adventurer Eltan, a noted warrior raised in the area, returned home from exploits abroad. Seeing the chaos that had splintered his beloved city, Eltan united the city's independent mercenary companies under a single banner, that of the Flaming Fist. Eltan used the mercenaries to quash what pockets of disorder he found, punishing lawbreakers for their crimes. Though plenty of theft, blackmail, and assassination continued behind closed doors, the founding of the Flaming Fist marked a new chapter in the city's story.
zh_tw: 博德之門的另一秩序支柱是在冒險家艾爾坦，一位在該地區長大的著名戰士，從國外探險歸來時形成的。看到使他心愛的城市分裂的混亂，艾爾坦將城市的獨立僱傭兵公司統一在一個旗幟下，即焰拳。艾爾坦利用僱傭兵來鎮壓他發現的混亂，懲罰違法者的罪行。儘管在緊閉的門後仍然有大量的盜竊、勒索和暗殺行為，但焰拳的成立標誌著城市故事的新篇章。

english: Bhaalspawn
zh_tw: 巴爾之子

english: Over the years, Baldur's Gate has harbored countless evil schemes and conspiracies. Perhaps the most dastardly, though, was that perpetrated by Bhaal, god of murder, who foresaw his own death during the Time of Troubles. While in mortal form, Bhaal conceived multitudes of offspring, plotting to have them resurrect him. They actively hunted and slew each other, with the survivors collecting ever more of Bhaal's godly essence.
zh_tw: 多年來，博德之門一直是無數邪惡計劃和陰謀的溫床。然而，其中最惡毒的，是由謀殺之神巴爾所策劃的，他在動盪時期預見了自己的死亡。在凡人形態時，巴爾孕育了眾多後代，並密謀讓他們復活自己。他們積極地相互追捕和殺戮，生還者收集了越來越多的巴爾神性本質。

english: Sarevok, a Bhaalspawn and member of the Iron Throne merchants' guild, sought to spark war with the nation of Amn and become the new Lord of Murder. Another Bhaalspawn, aided by powerful allies, thwarted Sarevok's plan and brought stability, if not peace, to Baldur's Gate once more. Yet, Bhaal and his faithful have menaced the city ever since.
zh_tw: 薩瑞沃克是巴爾之子，也是鐵王座商人公會的成員。他企圖挑起與安姆的戰爭，成為新的謀殺之主。另一位巴爾之子在強大盟友的協助下挫敗了他的計畫，讓博德之門再次恢復穩定，儘管未必稱得上和平。自那之後，巴爾與其信徒始終威脅著這座城市。

english: Baldur's Gate Today
zh_tw: 現今的博德之門

english: This chapter describes the independent city of Baldur's Gate as things are in 1492 DR.
zh_tw: 這一章描述了1492年DR時博德之門作為一個獨立城市的情況。

english: The original wall ringing the Upper City still stands, and a second defensive wall now rings the Lower City. The Outer City, a collection of hastily made structures and shantytowns, runs along the River Chionthar.
zh_tw: 環繞上城的原始城牆依然矗立，現在下城也有了第二道防禦城牆。外城是沿著奇翁塔河延伸的一系列倉促建造的建築和棚戶區。

english: While the Outer City might seem the most lawless, every district of Baldur's Gate has its own threats. In the Upper City, patriar families and government officials jostle to secure their positions. Many are not above using private agents to acquire blackmail material, sabotage public appearances, or even frame innocents to secure power. The victims of these plots, and officials who want a fair and honest legal system, must resort to hiring their own agents to unearth conspiracies, break out unfairly imprisoned citizens, and obtain evidence the Flaming Fist cannot.
zh_tw: 儘管外城看起來似乎是最無法無天的地方，但博德之門的每個區域都有自己的威脅。在上城區，貴族家族和政府官員爭奪鞏固他們的地位。許多人不惜使用私人代理來獲取勒索材料，破壞公眾形象，甚至構陷無辜者以鞏固權力。這些陰謀的受害者，以及希望建立公平公正法律體系的官員，必須求助於僱傭自己的代理來揭露陰謀，解救被不公正監禁的公民，並獲取焰拳無法獲得的證據。

english: The Upper City's political intrigues and the Outer City's violence spills over into the Lower City, the city's middle ground. Rampant crime, class grudges, foreign threats, and economic pressures leave many Baldurians feeling trapped within their own homes. Flaming Fist patrols react to threats with indiscriminate violence, doing little to make citizens feel safer. As a result, in recent years many citizens have started banding together in crews. These counter-gangs align along professional or neighborhood affiliations, doing their best to protect their territories. While this has given some of the city's people a way of feeling more in control of their lives, it's also increased the number of armed citizens on the streets. Whether the Lower City is actually safer after the formation of crews remains an open question.
zh_tw: 上城的政治陰謀和外城的暴力蔓延到了下城，這個城市的中間地帶。猖獗的犯罪、階級怨恨、外來威脅和經濟壓力讓許多巴爾杜爾居民感到被困在自己的家中。焰拳巡邏隊以不加選擇的暴力應對威脅，幾乎沒有讓市民感到更安全。因此，近年來，許多市民開始結成團隊。這些反幫派按照職業或社群關係結盟，盡最大努力保護他們的領地。雖然這讓城市中的一些人感到對自己的生活有了更多的控制，但也增加了街上武裝公民的數量。下城在團隊形成後是否真的更安全仍然是一個懸而未決的問題。

english: In the Outer City, all the world washes against the city's gates. Here crime and poverty are contrasted by wonders from afar and the riches of cultures across Faerûn. The mix of wanderers and refugees remains in constant flux, with communities forming and disbanding on a monthly basis. None can possibly keep track of all the foreign traditions or the dangerous—sometimes outright evil—religious practices observed in the Outer City. As a result, Baldur's Gate has widely adopted a "do no harm" policy when it comes to faiths and organizations operating in the city. Any group is welcome to operate openly so long as the city's important citizens aren't harmed.
zh_tw: 在外城區，世界各地的人們湧入城市的大門。在這裡，犯罪和貧困與來自遙遠地方的奇觀以及費倫各地文化的財富形成鮮明對比。流浪者和難民的混合體不斷變化，社群的形成和解散以月為單位。沒有人能夠追蹤外城區所觀察到的所有外國傳統，或者有時完全是邪惡的宗教實踐。因此，博德之門在涉及在城市中運作的信仰和組織時，廣泛採納了"不造成傷害"的政策。任何團體只要不對城市的重要公民造成傷害，都歡迎公開運作。

english: Beyond all its dangers, Baldur's Gate is an adventurer's city, a place where a sword-for-hire can find a rich patron, join a secret guild, stalk killers for a bounty, or come to the aid of desperate citizens. Good-hearted champions fight against corruption and bring murderers to justice, while less moral mercenaries find a good price for their services. The city offers opportunities as well as the most reliable and ruthless market on the Sword Coast. Information, treasures, secrets, and souls can be bought or sold for the right price.
zh_tw: 除了所有的危險，博德之門是一個冒險者的城市，一個僱傭劍客可以找到富有的贊助人，加入一個秘密公會，為了懸賞而追蹤殺手，或來幫助絕望的公民的地方。心地善良的冠軍與腐敗作鬥爭，將謀殺犯繩之以法，而道德水準較低的僱傭兵則為他們的服務找到了好價錢。這座城市提供了機會，以及劍海岸上最可靠和無情的市場。資訊、財寶、秘密和靈魂都可以以合適的價格買賣。

english: As a great hero of Baldur's Gate once said, "Watch your step in the shadows. Watch your back in the light. Win a prize beyond your wildest dreams or disappear into forgotten history. Every day your life is on the line. Every day you could become a legend. Welcome to Baldur's Gate."
zh_tw: 正如博德之門的一位偉大英雄曾經說過："在陰影中小心你的腳步。在光明中小心你的背後。贏得超越你最狂野夢想的獎品，或者消失在被遺忘的歷史中。每一天你的生命都懸在一線。每一天你都可能成為傳奇。歡迎來到博德之門。"

english: Baldur's Gate and Its Coat of Arms
zh_tw: 博德之門及其紋章

english: Population: 125,000 (predominantly humans)
zh_tw: 人口：125,000（主要是人類）

english: Government: Plutocracy, helmed by the Council of Four and Parliament of Peers
zh_tw: 政府：富豪統治，由四人議會和貴族議會領導

english: Defense: Flaming Fist mercenaries, the Watch
zh_tw: 防禦：焰拳僱傭兵，守衛

english: Commerce: Dyes, fish, imports from Chult, mercenaries, nautical supplies
zh_tw: 商業：染料、魚類、來自楚爾特的進口商品、僱傭兵、航海用品

english: Organizations: The Guild, neighborhood crews, trade guilds
zh_tw: 組織：公會、社群團隊、貿易公會

english: Religions: Gond, Tymora, Umberlee, any other law-abiding faith, cults of the Dead Three
zh_tw: 宗教：貢德、提莫拉、安博裡，任何其他遵守法律的信仰，死亡三神教的邪教

english: The Baldur's Gate coat of arms represents the city's role as a hub for river and ocean trade as well as nodding toward its namesake, the explorer Balduran. The symbol originated as a pirate emblem, though, and its components hold a double meaning today.
zh_tw: 博德之門的紋章代表了這座城市作為河流和海洋貿易中心的角色，同時也向其命名者，探險家巴爾杜蘭致敬。這個符號最初是一個海盜標誌，不過，它組成部分今天擁有雙重含義。

english: Originally, the alternating bands of water beneath the ship indicated the turbulent dangers of the sea, but also the rich rewards it can bring. The crimson flags of the ship referenced the brutal life of a pirate, blood spilled on the deck or in the water. The crisscrossing ropes and canted sail symbolized the web of secrets and intrigue that mark a pirate captain's life.
zh_tw: 最初，船下的交替條紋象徵著海洋的洶湧危險，但也代表著它可能帶來的豐富回報。船上的深紅色旗幟指的是海盜殘酷的生活，甲板上或水中灑下的鮮血。交錯的繩索和傾斜的帆象徵著海盜船長生活中的陰謀和秘密之網。

english: Today, some optimistic souls try to recast the seal, claiming its calm waters represent the city's desire to remain a peaceful power and the clear skies symbolize a prosperous future. But those who know the city's history see the cunning and violence underpinning the emblem. For many, the contradictory interpretations make the city's coat of arms all the more fitting.
zh_tw: 如今，一些樂觀的人試圖重新詮釋這個印章，聲稱其平靜的水域代表城市希望保持和平力量的願望，晴朗的天空象徵著繁榮的未來。但是瞭解城市歷史的人會看到紋章背後的狡猾和暴力。對許多人來說，這些矛盾的解釋使得這座城市的紋章更加貼切。

english: Map: Sword Coast
zh_tw: 地圖：劍海岸

english: Neighbors, Rivals, and Allies
zh_tw: 鄰居、對手和盟友

english: Other cities and nations keep a watchful eye on Baldur's Gate, which is growing in wealth, power, and influence.
zh_tw: 其他城市和國家都在密切關注著博德之門，它在財富、權力和影響力方面都在不斷增長。

english: Baldur's Gate trades with the coastal cities of Waterdeep and Neverwinter to the north while contending with the aggressive mercantile nation of Amn to the south. Amn seeks to dominate trade on the Sea of Swords and views Baldur's Gate as a growing threat. Baldur's Gate joined the Lords' Alliance, a coalition of independent cities that includes Neverwinter and Waterdeep, largely because of disputes with Amn. Should Amn decide to attack Baldur's Gate, the city can count on the other members of the Lords' Alliance to come to its defense. This arrangement infuriates Amn, which is not prepared to test the alliance's resolve.
zh_tw: 博德之門與北方的沿海城市深水城和無冬城進行貿易，同時與南方的侵略性商業國家阿姆恩競爭。阿姆恩試圖控制劍海的貿易，並將博德之門視為日益增長的威脅。博德之門加入了領主聯盟，這是一個包括無冬城和深水城在內的獨立城市聯盟，主要是因為與阿姆恩的爭端。如果阿姆恩決定攻擊博德之門，這座城市可以指望領主聯盟的其他成員來為其辯護。這種安排激怒了阿姆恩，它還沒有準備好考驗聯盟的決心。

english: To the east, the nations of Elturgard and Cormyr view Baldur's Gate as a lawless cesspool that might have to be dealt with someday. These nations especially frown on the city's broad religious tolerance.
zh_tw: 在東部，艾爾托迦德和科米爾等國家將博德之門視為一個無法無天的汙水坑，可能將來某一天需要加以應對。這些國家特別不贊成這座城市對宗教的廣泛容忍。

english: Candlekeep
zh_tw: 燭堡

english: To enter the great library of Candlekeep, one must furnish the library's monks with a book not already contained in the library's archives. Travelers on the way to Candlekeep often stop in Baldur's Gate, anticipating that they can find such a book in the city's markets. As such, Baldur's Gate does a small but bustling trade in rare books. Several merchants have a known policy of buying valuable books without question, selling them at a high markup. Travelers seeking a specific book also hire mercenaries or adventurers to venture into dungeons or ruins and bring back the prize.
zh_tw: 要進入燭堡的大圖書館，必須為圖書館的僧侶們提供一本尚未包含在圖書館檔案中的書。前往燭堡的旅行者經常在博德之門停留，預計他們能在這座城市的市場裡找到這樣的書。因此，博德之門在稀有書籍方面做了一筆雖小但繁忙的交易。一些商人有一項眾所周知的政策，即不問任何問題購買有價值的書籍，並以高價出售。尋找特定書籍的旅行者還僱傭僱傭兵或冒險者冒險進入地牢或廢墟，並將獎品帶回來。

english: If information can't be found in the whisper-markets of Baldur's Gate, then Candlekeep becomes a logical next stop. Adventurers are sometimes hired to guard a desperate traveler on the road south, or to guard the outrageously rare tomes scholars might carry to gain admission. The Guild knows the signs of a traveler headed for Candlekeep, and often dispatches robbers to steal books and resell them to the merchants of the city.
zh_tw: 如果在博德之門的耳語市場中找不到資訊，那麼燭堡就成為了合乎邏輯的下一站。有時，冒險家會被僱傭來保護一個絕望的旅行者在南行的路上，或者保護學者可能攜帶的極其稀有的書籍以獲得入場許可。公會知道前往燭堡的旅行者的跡象，並經常派遣強盜去偷書，並將它們轉售給城市的商人。

english: Elturel
zh_tw: 艾爾托瑞爾

english: Prior to the events described in this adventure, the holy city of Elturel—the capital of Elturgard—sat upriver on the Chionthar. Whereas Baldur's Gate is a cutthroat city policed by mercenaries, Elturel was a lawful city of pious folk watched over by knights of Helm, Torm, Tyr, and Lathander. The two cities couldn't be less alike.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險所描述的事件之前，艾爾托迦德的首都，聖城艾爾托瑞爾坐落在奇翁塔河上游。與由僱傭兵維持治安的博德之門不同，艾爾托瑞爾是一個守法的城市，虔誠的人民受到海姆、託姆、提爾和洛山達騎士的守護。兩個城市的差異再大不過了。

english: Whenever Baldur's Gate has tried to seize too much territory in Elturgard's eyes, Elturel has responded by imposing a heavy tax on shipments headed downriver. This sort of economic brinkmanship coupled with radically different religious viewpoints has created bad blood between the two cities, though neither city has been eager to test the military might of the other.
zh_tw: 每當博德之門試圖在艾爾托迦德的眼中奪取太多領土時，艾爾托瑞爾就會透過對下河運輸的貨物徵收重稅來回應。這種經濟邊緣政策，加上截然不同的宗教觀點，在兩個城市之間造成了惡劣的血緣關係，儘管兩個城市都沒有急於測試對方的軍事實力。

english: Port Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 南扎路港

english: Baldur's Gate serves as one of the main ports from which ships depart for Chult, a peninsula far to the south. Port Nyanzaru, located on the northern coast of Chult, enjoys a respectful and mutually beneficial trade relationship with Baldur's Gate, and both cities are united in their dislike for the nation of Amn.
zh_tw: 博德之門是通往遙遠南方的半島楚爾特的主要港口之一。位於楚爾特北岸的南扎路港與博德之門享有一種尊重和互利的貿易關係，兩個城市都對安姆國抱有反感。

english: Outside of Port Nyanzaru, Baldur's Gate maintains its own holdings in Chult. Fort Beluarian serves as a beachhead for the interests of the city, the Flaming Fist, and numerous patriar families in Chult. This small military hub oversees much of the exploration (and exploitation) in regions of Chult claimed by Baldur's Gate. It also serves as a departure point for smuggling the region's treasures back the Sword Coast, as well as other ventures the Baldurians would prefer the native Chultans don't learn about. As a result, rarities from the depths of Chult, seen nowhere else on the Sword Coast, regularly trickle into the port and market stalls of Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 在南扎路港之外，博德之門在楚爾特擁有自己的領地。貝路利安堡作為該城市、焰拳以及在楚爾特的眾多家族利益的灘頭堡。這個小型軍事中心監督了博德之門聲稱的楚爾特地區的大部分探險（和開發）。它也是走私該地區寶藏回到劍海岸的出發點，以及巴爾杜爾人更希望當地楚爾特人不瞭解的其他企業。因此，來自楚爾特深處的稀有物品，劍海岸其他地方看不到的，定期流入博德之門的港口和市場貨攤。

english: The sea routes between Baldur's Gate and Chult are far from safe. Pirates, Amnian privateers, and sea monsters are common in these waters.
zh_tw: 博德之門和楚爾特之間的海上路線遠非安全。海盜、阿姆尼亞私掠船和海怪在這些水域很常見。

english: Government
zh_tw: 政治

english: The Parliament of Peers, a group mainly composed of nearly fifty patriar members, makes recommendations on issues of law and governance. Once the parliament comes to a majority decision on a matter, usually after much heated debate, it presents its position to the Council of Four. Three dukes and one grand duke make up this ruling council (see "{@area Council of Four|354|x}," below, for more information). The council also votes on matters, and in the case of a tie, the grand duke's vote counts as two.
zh_tw: 同僚議會主要由近五十名愛國者成員組成，就法律和治理問題提出建議。一旦議會對某一事項達成多數決定（通常經過激烈辯論後），它就會向四人議會提交其立場。三名公爵和一名大公組成了這個統治委員會（有關更多資訊，請參見下方的"{@area 四人議會|354|x}"）。委員會也對事項進行投票，在平局的情況下，大公的投票計為兩票。

english: Common belief holds that many parliament members, and possibly one or more of the dukes, can be bribed for their votes. Corrupt parliament members don't wish to be caught taking payments, usually not out of fear of legal reprisal, but of being perceived as incompetent among their peers. The perception is that one who can't be trusted to receive something as simple as a bribe likely can't be trusted to manipulate the city's intricate social web. Such leads to the common farce of officials buying cheap jewelry or fake art objects with their bribe money (usually in the form of platinum coins or jewels) hidden inside.
zh_tw: 普遍的看法認為，許多議會成員，可能還包括一位或多位公爵，可以被賄賂以換取他們的投票。腐敗的議會成員不希望被抓到收受款項，通常不是出於對法律懲罰的恐懼，而是因為在同僚中被視為無能。人們的看法是，一個連簡單的賄賂都不能被信任的人，很可能也不能被信任去操縱這座城市錯綜複雜的社會網路。這導致了一個常見的鬧劇，官員們用他們的賄賂金（通常以白金硬幣或寶石的形式）購買廉價的珠寶或假藝術品，賄賂金（通常藏在其中）。

english: Council of Four
zh_tw: 四人議會

english: Comprised of four dukes, the Council of Four presides over the government of Baldur's Gate. Though the Parliament of Peers and the patriars hold a great deal of power, the Council of Four is the ultimate authority. It convenes in High Hall, a fortress in the middle of the Upper City, and controls the Flaming Fist, the navy, the tax collectors, and all public utilities, among other things.
zh_tw: 四人議會由四位公爵組成，負責主持博德之門的政府。儘管貴族議會和貴族擁有很大的權力，四人議會才是最終權威。它在上城中心的堡壘高廳召開會議，並控制著焰拳、海軍、稅務員和所有公共事業等。

english: Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard
zh_tw: 烏爾德·瑞文嘉德大公爵

english: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} is a fearless soldier who rose up through the ranks of the Flaming Fist to become its supreme marshal. Ravengard used his military position and influence to secure for himself a seat on the Council of Four. Following the deaths of two council members amid a cloud of corruption and scandal, he persuaded the Parliament of Peers to back his election to grand duke.
zh_tw: {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}是一位無畏的士兵，他從焰拳的行列中崛起，成為其最高元帥。拉文加德利用自己的軍事地位和影響力為自己在四人議會中爭取到了一個席位。在兩位議會成員因腐敗和醜聞而死亡後，他說服貴族議會支援他當選為大公爵。

english: Upon ascending to the highest position in the city government, Ravengard refused to relinquish command of the Flaming Fist, making him the most powerful figure in the city by far. This decision has not endeared him to anyone, but Ravengard could care less about his popularity. His only concerns are the stability and prosperity of Baldur's Gate, and he doesn't trust any of the other dukes or anyone in the Parliament of Peers to put the city's interests before their own.
zh_tw: 在升至市政府最高職位後，瑞文嘉德拒絕放棄焰拳的指揮權，這使他成為該城迄今為止最有權勢的人物。這個決定並沒有讓他受到任何人的喜愛，但瑞文嘉德可能對自己的聲望漠不關心。他只關心博德之門的穩定和繁榮，不相信任何其他公爵或宗貴議會中的人會把城市的利益置於自己的利益之上。

english: Ravengard rose to grand duke on a platform largely backed by idealistic commoners and enemies of the other established dukes. While he won election handily, Ravengard has struggled in performing his duties, finding his hands tied at every turn by both overt and invisible bureaucracy. Despite this, he's been a voice of reason and common sense on the Council of Four—if not the egalitarianism some hoped. He's also proven largely resistant to scandal and corruption, though many of his fellow dukes and those in the Parliament of Peers still regularly outmaneuver him politically. One of his only obvious pleasures remains the surprise inspections he regularly visits upon the troops at {@area Wyrm's Rock|3c4|x}.
zh_tw: 拉文加德在理想主義平民和其它已建立公爵的敵人的大力支援下，上升為大公爵。雖然他輕鬆贏得了選舉，但拉文加德在履行職責時遇到了困難，發現自己在每一個轉折點上都被公開的和隱形的官僚主義束縛。儘管如此，他一直是四人議會中理性和常識的聲音——即使不是一些人希望的平等主義。他還被證明在很大程度上對醜聞和腐敗有抵抗力，儘管他的許多同僚公爵和貴族議會的成員仍然經常在政治上智勝他。他唯一明顯的樂趣之一仍然是他定期對{@area 龍之巖|3c4|x}的部隊進行突擊檢查。

english: Ravengard was recently tricked into attending a diplomatic summit in Elturel, unaware that his political enemies in Baldur's Gate orchestrated this meeting in a fiendish plot to remove him from power. In his absence, the Flaming Fist is leaderless, the council rudderless.
zh_tw: 瑞文嘉德最近被騙參加了在艾爾托瑞爾舉行的外交峰會，卻不知道他在博德之門的政敵策劃了這場旨在推翻他政權的邪惡陰謀。他不在的時候，焰拳失去了領袖，委員會失去了舵錨。

english: Duke Belynne Stelmane
zh_tw: 貝萊恩·斯特梅公爵

english: Once a vigorous and formidable politician, Duke Belynne Stelmane recently suffered a seizure that left her with a partially paralyzed face and slowed speech. In truth, a mind flayer provoked the duke's "seizure" when it took mental possession of her. Now Stelmane wages a silent war against the mind flayer's influence, biding her time until she can find a way to signal for aid or regain her will. Not even Stelmane's aides are aware of her secret struggle, though they cover for her as best they can.
zh_tw: 曾經是一位精力充沛且令人敬畏的政治家，斯特梅恩公爵最近遭受了一次癲癇發作，導致她的臉部分癱瘓，說話變慢。實際上，是一隻靈吸怪引發了公爵的"癲癇發作"，當時它精神上控制了她。現在，斯特梅恩在無聲的戰爭中對抗靈吸怪的影響，等待時機，直到她找到求助的方法或恢復她的意志。即使是斯特梅恩的助手們也不知道她的秘密鬥爭，儘管他們儘可能地為她打掩護。

english: Given her current situation, Duke Stelmane is in no position to oppose attempts by her fellow dukes to seize the reins of power in Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 鑑於她當前的處境，斯特爾曼公爵無力反對她的同僚公爵們試圖奪取博德之門的權力。

english: Duke Dillard Portyr
zh_tw: 迪拉德·波泰爾公爵

english: Duke Dillard Portyr was once a respected businessman, but after a string of sour deals, he pulled back from his investments. Now he uses his time to enjoy the comforts that his wealth and title provide him. He lives alone in his manor, having outlived his two wives and three sons, and trades correspondence with his niece, Liara Portyr, who commands a Flaming Fist outpost on Chult known as Fort Beluarian.
zh_tw: 波提爾公爵曾經是一位受人尊敬的商人，但在一系列糟糕的交易之後，他撤回了他的投資。現在，他利用自己的時間來享受他的財富和頭銜所提供的舒適。他在莊園裡獨自生活，已經比他的兩位妻子和三個兒子活得都長，並且與他的侄女莉爾阿·波提爾保持書信往來，莉爾阿指揮著一個位於楚爾特的焰拳前哨站，被稱為貝路利安堡。

english: Duke Portyr is conflict-averse and goes out of his way to avoid stress. He shows well in social situations, but is easily manipulated in the political arena. He is known for listening with concern, showing an earnest desire to help, making promises to look into things, and then doing nothing. As a result, a great deal of the citizenry's scorn lies heaped upon Duke Portyr's shoulders.
zh_tw: 波提爾公爵不喜歡衝突，並且會竭盡全力避免壓力。他在社交場合表現良好，但在政治舞臺上容易被操縱。他以關切地傾聽而聞名，表現出真誠的願望去幫助，承諾會調查事情，然後什麼也不做。因此，很多市民的鄙視都落在了波提爾公爵的肩上。

english: Duke Portyr expressed concern about Ravengard's diplomatic mission to Elturel, fearing what the Flaming Fist might do while Ravengard is away. If his worst fears come true and the Flaming Fist can't control itself, Duke Portyr plans to write a letter to his niece, urging her to return to Baldur's Gate and take command of the Flaming Fist in Ravengard's absence. It's literally the least he can do.
zh_tw: 波特公爵對拉文加德前往埃爾圖瑞爾的外交任務表示擔憂，他擔心在拉文加德不在的時候焰拳會做出什麼事。如果他最糟糕的擔憂成真，焰拳無法自我控制，波特公爵計劃寫一封信給他的侄女，敦促她返回博德之門，在拉文加德缺席時指揮焰拳。這確實也是他能做的最起碼的事情。

english: Duke Thalamra Vanthampur
zh_tw: 薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵

english: Acid-tongued, shrewd, and aggressive, {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} is the matriarch of the Vanthampur family. Born with nothing, she spent years wallowing in obscurity, repairing and renovating the city's ancient sewer system. One promotion after another followed until she was named Master of Drains and Underways. By then, she had been married three times and given birth to three sons. Her lifelong goal has been to lift herself and her family out of the sewers and into high society.
zh_tw: 尖酸刻薄、精明且富有侵略性的{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}是萬塔普爾家族的女族長。她出生時一無所有，多年來默默無聞地致力於修復和改造城市古老的下水道系統。一次又一次的晉升後，她最終被任命為下水道與地下通道總管。那時，她已經結過三次婚，並生了三個兒子。她的終身目標是將自己和家人從下水道中拉出來，躋身上流社會。

english: Years of political dealing, blame shuffling, and bribery paid off when Thalamra was elected to the Council of Four. Although she has served on the council for the shortest amount of time, Duke Vanthampur is easily the most politically savvy council member. She speaks little during meetings of the council, preferring to further her political agenda through meetings in her private offices and at her family estate. When she does choose to debate, she speaks with a strength beyond what it seems like her age should allow, and is known for leveling insults that land unsettlingly close to (supposedly) hidden truths.
zh_tw: 多年從事政治交易、責任推諉和賄賂，在薩拉瑪拉被選入四人議會時得到了回報。儘管她在議會中的服務時間最短，但範薩姆普爾公爵無疑是最具政治頭腦的議會成員。她在議會會議上很少發言，更願意透過在她私人辦公室和家族莊園的會議來推進她的政治議程。當她選擇辯論時，她說話的力量超出了她的年齡似乎應該允許的範圍，並且以揭露令人不安的（據說是）隱藏的真相而聞名。

english: Military
zh_tw: 軍用

english: Baldur's Gate boasts two military forces: the Flaming Fist and the Watch. Use the {@adventure Guard Arrival Times table|BGDIA|9|Guard Arrival Times} to determine how long it takes for the Flaming Fist or the Watch to arrive at a location after a crime or similar incident is reported.
zh_tw: 博德之門擁有兩支軍事力量：焰拳和守望者。使用{@adventure 守衛到達時間表|BGDIA|9|Guard Arrival Times}來確定在犯罪或類似事件被報告後，焰拳或守望者到達一個地點需要多長時間。

english: The Flaming Fist
zh_tw: 焰拳

english: The red and gold symbol of the Flaming Fist mercenary company (see "{@adventure Flaming Fist Coat of Arms|BGDIA|1|Flaming Fist Coat of Arms}") has become emblematic of Baldur's Gate. The Council of Four funds the Flaming Fist, supporting it as the city's army. Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} is now its undisputed leader.
zh_tw: 焰拳僱傭兵公司的紅色和金色標誌（見"{@adventure 焰拳紋章|BGDIA|1|Flaming Fist Coat of Arms}"）已經成為博德之門的象徵。四人議會資助焰拳，支援它作為城市的軍隊。大公爵{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}現在是它無可爭議的領導者。

english: The Flaming Fist largely patrols the {@area Lower City|39a|x}, though it holds nominal authority over the {@area Outer City|3b5|x} as well. The company has enough to do maintaining order within the city walls without straying too far from its gates, though the Fist has been known to hire independent agents when its ranks are spread thin.
zh_tw: 火焰之拳主要在{@area 下城區|39a|x}巡邏，儘管它對{@area 外城區|3b5|x}也有名義上的管轄權。這支隊伍在城內維護秩序已經足夠繁忙，無需遠離城門，不過眾所周知，當人手不足時，火焰之拳會僱傭獨立代理人。

english: Thousands of soldiers currently serve in the Flaming Fist: in Baldur's Gate proper, at the fortress of {@area Wyrm's Rock|3c4|x} on the Chionthar River, and at remote outposts such as Fort Beluarian in Chult. The Flaming Fist offers employment and a sense of belonging to any who can lift a sword and follow orders. Native Baldurians, immigrants, former criminals, and retired adventurers can all be found within the company's ranks.
zh_tw: 成千上萬的士兵目前在焰拳服役：在博德之門本部、在奇恩塔河上的{@area 龍之巖|3c4|x}以及諸如楚爾特的貝路利安堡這樣的邊遠前哨站。焰拳為任何能揮舞劍並聽從命令的人提供就業機會和歸屬感。在該公司的行列中可以找到土生土長的博德人、移民、前罪犯和退休的冒險家。

english: The Watch
zh_tw: 守望者

english: Watch officers can spend their entire careers within the {@area Upper City|37d|x}. Bankrolled by the patriars, the Watch has a reputation as glorified bodyguards for the city's elite.
zh_tw: 警衛官可能會把他們整個職業生涯都花在{@area 上城區|37d|x}。由貴族資助的警衛隊被稱為城市精英的光鮮保鏢。

english: Orderly and regimented, the Watch maintains precise, predictable patrols. At dusk, the Watch clears the Upper City of everyone but residents, their household staffs, and guests bearing written invitations. Many Watch officers, born and raised in the city, pride themselves on recognizing every Upper City resident on sight.
zh_tw: 守夜人秩序井然，執行精確且可預測的巡邏。在黃昏時分，守夜人會清空上城區，只留下居民、他們的家庭工作人員以及持有書面邀請的客人。許多守夜人官員在這座城市出生並長大，他們自豪於能夠一眼就認出每一個上城區的居民。

english: The Watch operates out of the {@area Citadel|396|x}, a massive keep built into the Upper City's walls. In times of crisis, bells at the {@area High Hall|38c|x} and the Citadel are rung simultaneously. If the pealing continues for more than a few minutes, every Watch member is required to rally at the Citadel or appointed guard posts. The function of the bells is common knowledge.
zh_tw: 守望者組織在{@area 城堡|396|x}中運作，這座巨大的要塞建在上城區的城牆中。在危機時刻，{@area 至高大廳|38c|x}和堡壘中的鐘聲會同時響起。如果鐘聲持續超過幾分鐘，每個守望者成員都需要在堡壘或指定的守衛崗位集合。鐘聲的作用是眾所周知的。

english: Law and Order
zh_tw: 律法與秩序

english: Everyone in Baldur's Gate is expected to hew to common law. Murder, theft, assault, blackmail, and fraud all carry severe penalties. Patriars, the wealthy, and the well-connected are given much more leniency than commoners. A noble heir who steals from a shop might get away with a fine paid by a parent, whereas a commoner committing the same crime may be jailed or publicly flogged.
zh_tw: 博德之門的每個人都應該遵守普通法。謀殺、盜竊、攻擊、敲詐和欺詐都會受到嚴厲的懲罰。族長、富人和關係網廣的人比普通人受到的寬容要多得多。一個貴族繼承人從商店偷東西可能只需父母支付罰款就能逃脫，而犯下同樣罪行的普通人可能會被監禁或公開鞭打。

english: Both the Watch and the Flaming Fist have the right to dispense immediate justice, should they witness a crime in progress. In unclear situations, or when a person of influence is involved, the accused is jailed until a trial can be set. Patriars and other powerful individuals are usually placed under house arrest, except in dire circumstances. Commoners await their trial in jail. On occasion, a vigilante or hired mercenary will break an accused commoner out of prison in order to ensure the accused's safety until the trial date.
zh_tw: 無論是守衛還是焰拳，在目睹犯罪行為進行時都有權立即執行正義。在不明確的情況下，或者當涉及到有影響力的人物時，被告會被監禁直到可以安排審判。貴族和其他權勢人物通常被軟禁，除非在極端情況下。平民則在監獄中等待審判。有時，一個自警隊成員或僱傭的僱傭兵會將被告平民從監獄中解救出來，以確保被告在審判日期之前安全。

english: Minor crimes, such as creating a public disturbance, petty theft, or vandalism carry commensurate punishments. Time in the stocks, public humiliation, or a fine are the usual judgments. Some patriar families consider petty crimes to be worse than major ones—they are a sign that one can't manage one's baser instincts. Patriars have been known to pay huge bribes or promise outsized favors to protect a rebellious heir from being charged with a minor crime.
zh_tw: 輕微犯罪，如製造公共騷亂、小偷小摸或破壞公物，會受到相應的懲罰。通常的判決包括坐牢、公開羞辱或罰款。一些貴族家庭認為小罪比大罪更嚴重——它們是一個人無法控制自己基本本能的標誌。貴族們為了保護一個叛逆的繼承人不被控以輕微犯罪，已經知道會支付鉅額賄賂或承諾巨大的恩惠。

english: Lawyers must belong to the Barrister's Guild to practice, and the associated fees means they prefer to represent wealthy clients. Poorer citizens often must throw themselves on the mercy of the courts, or scrape together what coin they can to hire an adventurer or mercenary to find evidence to support their plea.
zh_tw: 律師必須加入律師公會才能執業，而相關的費用意味著他們更願意代表富裕的客戶。較貧窮的公民通常必須依靠法庭的仁慈，或者儘可能地湊錢僱傭一個冒險者或僱傭兵來尋找證據支援他們的辯護。

english: Citizenry
zh_tw: 市民

english: The citizens of Baldur's Gate include many races and ethnicities. Though prejudices can exist among certain residents, Baldur's Gate as a whole is a diverse and unprejudiced—if not welcoming—city.
zh_tw: 博德之門的居民包括許多種族和民族。儘管某些居民之間可能存在偏見，但作為一個整體，博德之門是一個多樣化且沒有偏見——如果不是歡迎——的城市。

english: Many of the patriar families of Baldur's Gate can trace their lineage back for generations, but a significant portion of Baldurians were not born in the city. Most citizens began their lives in Tethyr, the North, the Western Heartlands, or other communities along the Sword Coast. Baldurians born in Amn, the High Forest, and nations bordering the Inner Sea are less common, but still present. Rarely, travelers from as far away as Chult, Mulhorand, or Luiren decide to follow the flow of trade and settle in the city.
zh_tw: 博德之門的許多貴族家族可以追溯他們的血統好幾代，但相當一部分博德之門人並非在這座城市出生。大多數市民開始他們的生活是在特西爾、北方、西心之地，或劍海岸沿線的其他社群。在阿姆恩、高森林以及內海沿岸國家出生的博德之門人較少，但仍然存在。偶爾，來自遠處如楚爾特、穆爾霍蘭德或盧裡安的旅行者決定跟隨貿易的流動並在這座城市定居。

english: Commoners and Crews
zh_tw: 平民和船員

english: Baldur's Gate can be a rough place for ordinary folk. Among the twisting streets of the Lower City, commoners have significantly fewer rights than patriars, with only the brusque mercenaries of the Flaming Fist to keep them safe. Even worse off are the poor residents of the Outer City, many of whom aren't recognized as citizens. With the Flaming Fist too eager to punish criminal behavior by drubbing both accuser and accused, it's important that common folk have someone to watch their backs. That's why the people of Baldur's Gate created crews—collections of like-minded folk who band together for mutual protection. Depending on the crew, this protection can range from taking someone's side in a tavern brawl or guarding each other's shops to price fixing or inter-crew loans.
zh_tw: 對於普通百姓而言，博德之門可能是個險惡之地。在下城區的曲折街巷中，平民享有的權利遠不及貴族階層，唯有焰拳傭兵團那些粗魯的傭兵負責維持他們的安全。外城區的貧困居民處境更為艱難，其中許多甚至不被承認為合法公民。由於焰拳傭兵總是熱衷於用毆打原告與被告的方式來懲戒犯罪行為，平民百姓急需有人為他們撐腰。正因如此，博德之門民眾組建了幫派——由志同道合者結成互助保護的團體。根據幫派性質不同，這種保護可能涵蓋酒館鬥毆時幫人助陣、互相照看店鋪，也可能涉及價格壟斷或幫派間借貸等行為。

english: Crews were the first to institute the common practice of {@i burl}. Under this system, anyone seeking shelter and safety—usually those fleeing from the Flaming Fist or some other danger—can approach a house or shop and give three sharp knocks followed by a heavier one. The residents are then obligated to take that person in and hide them. This applies even to members of opposing crews, though anyone requesting sanctuary from a crew other than their own incurs a debt, both personally and on behalf of their crew. Abusing someone who's granted burl is grounds for immediate expulsion from one's crew, and such "drowners" are universally shunned.
zh_tw: 街頭幫派最早訂下後來普遍通行的{@i 庇護慣例}。依照這項慣例，任何尋求安全庇護的人——通常是正在逃避焰拳或其他危險的人——都能走到民宅或商店門口，急促地敲三下，再重敲一下。屋內居民有義務收留並藏匿來人，連敵對幫派的成員也不例外。不過，向其他幫派求援的人，自己與所屬幫派都會欠下一份人情。傷害已獲庇護的人，足以讓犯事者立刻被逐出幫派；這類被稱為「溺人者」的傢伙會遭到所有人唾棄。

english: The dozens of crews calling Baldur's Gate home are as different in attitude and approach as the city's residents. For instance, everyone in the Lower City knows that if you need cheap muscle, you hire members of the burly Porters' Union or Stonemasons' Guild, and not even the Flaming Fist would willingly pick a fight with the blood-spattered Butchers' Block or the mercenaries and "security consultants" of the Bannerless Legion. Other crews, such as the Scribes and Sages or the Honorable Order of Moneylenders, would never dream of getting their hands dirty, while the Apothecary Alliance and Brethren of Barbers don't need to throw a punch to strike fear into rivals. From carpenters to grocers, the Forgeworkers' Lodge to the Wisewoman Weavers, nearly every profession offers some access to a crew. And not just legal professions, either; the Revelers' Union, made up of night-workers who sell drugs, companionship, and other recreations, is one of the most powerful in the city, thanks to the information it gathers from its clients.
zh_tw: 在博德之門安家的數十個船員和城市居民的態度和方法一樣多樣化。例如，下城區的每個人都知道，如果你需要廉價的肌肉力量，你應該僱傭健壯的搬運工工會或石匠工會的成員，甚至焰拳也不願意與血跡斑斑的屠夫區或無旗軍團的僱傭兵和"安全顧問"挑起爭端。其他船員，如文書和智者或體面的錢莊，做夢也不會想到要弄髒自己的手，而藥劑師聯盟和理髮師兄弟會則不需要揮拳就能讓對手感到恐懼。從木匠到雜貨商，鐵匠公會到智慧女巫織工，幾乎每個職業都提供了加入船員的機會。而且不僅僅是合法職業；由夜間工作者組成的狂歡者聯盟，他們銷售毒品、陪伴和其他娛樂，是城市中最強大的聯盟之一，這要歸功於它從客戶那裡收集的資訊。

english: Some crews are simply neighborhood-based, their association based on territory rather than trade, such as the Right Pashas of Little Calimshan, the Crossed of Wyrm's Crossing, the Gravemakers of Tumbledown, or the Bloomridge Dandies.
zh_tw: 有些船員僅僅是基於社群的，他們的聯合是基於地域而非行業，例如小卡利姆沙的右帕夏、龍之十字路口的十字軍、倒塌鎮的造墓人，或是布盧姆裡奇的花花公子。

english: By far the most important crew to travelers, however, is the Gateguides. Made up primarily of teenage lantern bearers, the Gateguides earn a living hiring themselves out to newcomers to show them the ropes of the city, help make connections with other crews, and offer some degree of collective protection.
zh_tw: 然而，對旅行者來說最重要的船員是門導。門導主要由十幾歲的提燈者組成，他們透過向新來者出租自己的服務來謀生，向他們展示城市的規則，幫助他們與其他船員建立聯絡，並提供一定程度的集體保護。

english: Noteworthy Laws
zh_tw: 值得注意的法律

english: Of the city's nuanced and unreliably enforced laws, the following tend to be the most surprising to newcomers.
zh_tw: 在這座城市微妙且執行不可靠的法律中，以下往往是最讓新來者感到驚訝的。

english: Foreign Agents
zh_tw: 外國代理人

english: While traders and visitors to Baldur's Gate are always welcome, spies and saboteurs are not. Legitimate foreign agents, such as ambassadors, are required to report to the High Hall for an elaborate series of interviews and licenses. Visitors technically should do the same, but the law is rarely mentioned at the city's gates and even more rarely enforced. What distinguishes a visitor and a foreign agent can be unclear, and if an individual doesn't have a license marking them as one or the other, any duke or peer can unilaterally change a non-citizen's status, effectively sentencing them to imprisonment or worse.
zh_tw: 儘管博德之門總是歡迎商人和訪客，但間諜和破壞者則不受歡迎。合法的外國代理人，如大使，必須向高堂報告，接受一系列複雜的面試和許可證。技術上訪客也應該這樣做，但這項法律很少在城市的大門被提及，更少被執行。區分訪客和外國代理人可能並不清楚，如果個人沒有許可證標明他們屬於哪一類，任何公爵或貴族都可以單方面改變一個非公民的地位，實際上判處他們監禁或更糟。

english: Livestock Restriction
zh_tw: 牲畜限制

english: By tradition, Baldur's Gate bans animals larger than a {@creature peacock|BGDIA} within the city walls. Visitors determined not to surrender their beloved pets (or valuable animals they intend to sell) sometimes arrive at the city with large peacocks in tow, to prove their furred companion meets the legal requirement. This has led to a burgeoning, noisy, and particularly cutthroat {@creature peacock|BGDIA}-breeding industry in the Outer City.
zh_tw: 根據傳統，博德之門禁止在城市圍牆內飼養比{@creature peacock|BGDIA|孔雀}更大的動物。一些決心不放棄自己心愛寵物（或打算出售的珍貴動物）的訪客有時會帶著大型孔雀來到城市，以證明他們毛茸茸的同伴符合法律規定。這導致了外城地區一個蓬勃、喧鬧且尤其殘酷{@creature peacock|BGDIA|孔雀}養殖業的興起。

english: Most travelers pay to stable oversize animals, either in Outer City liveries or at ranches outside the city. Some animals are simply surrendered at the gate, though, becoming property of the Watch (in the Upper City) or the Flaming Fist (in the Lower City), or sold during monthly auctions.
zh_tw: 大多數旅行者會支付費用來安置超大型動物，要麼在城外的馬廄，要麼在城外的牧場。然而，有些動物在城門口就被放棄了，成為守衛（在上城區）或焰拳（在下城區）的財產，或者在每月的拍賣中被出售。

english: Patriars
zh_tw: 族長

english: Patriars are the elite upper class of the city, a rank defined largely by money and lines of vague, increasingly inconsequential heritage. Many nobles claim generations of lineage, dating to the earliest days of Baldur's Gate. Their money funds industries and lines political pockets, but their names allow them to wield influence throughout the city.
zh_tw: 貴族是這座城市的精英上層階級，這個等級在很大程度上是由金錢和模糊不清、日益無關緊要的血統來定義的。許多貴族聲稱他們的血統可以追溯到博德之門最早的時代。他們的資金資助了產業，政治上也得到了支援，但他們的名字使他們能夠在整個城市中施展影響力。

english: Some patriars are economically-minded individuals who rise early and spend their days in meetings and negotiations. They fund expeditions into dangerous locales and hire explorers to map uncharted territories. Other patriars manipulate the city's power players through diplomacy and intrigue. They spend their days flitting from theater performances to private balls, while quietly making and breaking the alliances that underwrite the city's structures.
zh_tw: 一些貴族是具有經濟頭腦的個體，他們早起，整天忙於會議和談判。他們資助進入危險地區的探險活動，並僱傭探險家去測繪未被標記的領土。其他貴族則透過外交和陰謀操縱城市的權力玩家。他們花費時間在劇院表演和私人舞會之間穿梭，同時悄悄地建立和破壞支援城市結構的聯盟。

english: Patriars live and work in the Upper City. Their manor homes employ dozens of servants, along with contingents of personal guards. The wall surrounding the Upper City as well as the constant presence of the Watch—which exclusively patrols that district—goes far toward assuring their security. As a side effect, it also means many patriars go months without engaging with the city's common folk, their insulation leading to the spread of divisive rumors.
zh_tw: 族長們居住並工作在上城區。他們的莊園僱傭了數十名僕人，以及私人警衛隊伍。圍繞上城區的城牆以及巡邏隊——專門巡邏那個區域——在很大程度上保證了他們的安全。作為一個副作用，這也意味著許多族長數月不與城市的普通民眾接觸，他們的隔離導致了分裂性謠言的傳播。

english: Patriars know the danger of the other districts, where their wealth is a lure and their names carry no weight. Patriars who have to travel the Lower City always do so with guards, and still risk robbery or worse violence.
zh_tw: 貴族們知道其他區域的危險，在那裡他們的財富是一個誘惑，而他們的名字沒有任何分量。需要前往下城區的貴族總是帶著保鏢，儘管如此，仍然有被搶劫或更糟的暴力風險。

english: Many patriar families hire proxies to carry out their business in the Lower City or Outer City. If circumstances force patriars to visit the Outer City personally, they typically travel in disguise, paying adventurers or mercenaries to protect them without drawing the attention of a uniformed personal guard.
zh_tw: 許多族長家族僱傭代理人在下城區或外城區處理他們的事務。如果情況迫使族長親自訪問外城區，他們通常會偽裝出行，僱傭冒險者或僱傭兵來保護他們，以避免引起制服個人警衛的注意。

english: Among the common folk and criminal element of the city, patriars have a reputation for callousness. Common wisdom holds that patriars are out of touch with everyday life and value citizens' lives cheaply. For some nobles, this assessment holds true. These patriars are class-conscious dilettantes who spend their money on frivolous bets, debauched entertainment, and risky business ventures. For this callous lot, the common people are nothing more than fools to be bilked, clods undeserving of comfort and wealth due to their lack of comfort and breeding.
zh_tw: 在城市的平民和犯罪分子中，貴族們以冷酷無情著稱。普遍的看法是貴族們與日常生活脫節，並且輕視公民的生命。對於一些貴族來說，這種評價是真實的。這些貴族是階級意識強烈的半吊子，他們將錢花在輕率的賭注、放蕩的娛樂和冒險的商業投資上。對於這些冷酷的人來說，普通人不過是些容易被欺騙的傻瓜，由於缺乏舒適和教養，不值得享有舒適和財富。

english: For a few patriars, though, the inequality of Baldur's Gate is a serious concern. Blocked by a corrupt government and uncaring peers, these civic-minded nobles use unorthodox channels to distribute aid. They quietly fund vigilante action that protects the vulnerable groups. They stage robberies on their own property and secretly send the "stolen goods" to sick houses and charities. These patriars know that to act openly is to invite scorn from their peers, which may edge them out of alliances and deals that could strengthen their standing. Worse, it makes them targets for corrupt elite who prefer the city's divisions as they are.
zh_tw: 然而，對於一些族長來說，博德之門的不平等是一個嚴重的問題。由於腐敗的政府和漠不關心的同僚阻撓，這些具有公民意識的貴族利用非傳統渠道分發援助。他們悄悄地資助保護弱勢群體的義警行動。他們在自己的財產上策劃搶劫，並將"被盜物品"秘密送往醫院和慈善機構。這些族長知道，公開行動將引來同僚的鄙視，這可能會使他們失去聯盟和交易，從而削弱他們的地位。更糟糕的是，這使他們成為那些更喜歡城市現狀的腐敗精英的目標。

english: Some good-hearted but naïve patriars have been known to venture into the Lower City and even the Outer City to volunteer with the disadvantaged or share their wealth. Even in disguise, though, these nobles are usually quickly identified and become targets of the Guild or other criminals. More than one patriar on a mission of mercy has disappeared into the Lower City, never to be seen again.
zh_tw: 一些心地善良但天真的貴族們已經嘗試進入下城區甚至外城區，去幫助弱勢群體或分享他們的財富。然而，即使偽裝，這些貴族通常很快就被識別出來，成為公會或其他罪犯的目標。不止一位執行仁慈使命的貴族在下城區消失，再也沒有出現過。

english: Prominent Patriar Families
zh_tw: 著名族長家族

english: Below are the names of and a few details about many of the other patriar families in the city.
zh_tw: 以下是城市中許多其他族長家族的名稱及一些詳細資訊。

zh_tw: {@b 腰帶}

english: {@b Caldwell} owns most of the city's art museums.
zh_tw: {@b 卡爾德威爾} "擁有城市中大多數的藝術博物館。"

english: {@b Dlusker} is nearly broke but maintains a textile mill in the Lower City and a few slaughterhouses in the Outer City.
