english: Economy and Trade
zh_tw: 經濟與貿易

english: With trade ways running north and south along the Sword Coast, a port on the Sea of Swords, and the Chionthar River leading inland, Baldur's Gate is perfectly situated for its role as a commercial hub. Craftspeople, merchants, traders, and smugglers all make a brisk living in the city, and many immigrants are drawn by the dream that anyone willing to work hard can be successful in Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 博德之門位於劍海岸南北貿易路線上，擁有通往劍海的港口，以及通往內陸的基恩塔河，地理位置優越，非常適合作為商業中心。工匠、商人、貿易者和走私者都在這座城市中過著繁榮的生活，許多移民被這樣一個夢想所吸引：任何願意努力工作的人都能在博德之門取得成功。

english: Baldur's Gate has plenty of exports, notably fish, fish glue, and sea salt, but its main economic force is trade itself. The city boasts multiple large and well-connected trade guilds and a marketplace where wholesalers can exchange goods before moving up or down the Sword Coast.
zh_tw: 博德之門擁有豐富的出口產品，尤其是魚、魚膠和海鹽，但其主要的經濟力量是貿易本身。這座城市擁有多個大型且聯絡緊密的貿易公會和一個市場，批發商們可以在那裡交換商品，然後沿著劍海岸向上或向下移動。

english: The number of ships in port and traders making their way north or south mean that Baldur's Gate boasts one of the most expansive markets in the west. Coin trumps morals in Baldur's Gate, with profit being the ultimate good. As a result, nearly anything can be bought and sold in the city's shops, whether it be rare jewels, magic weapons, secrets, alliances, or even murder. People visit the city seeking imports from Port Nyanzaru, verdigris-covered treasures dredged from the sea, blackmail information on political rivals, or custom-brewed poisons.
zh_tw: 由於港口中船隻眾多，商人南北往來，博德之門擁有西部最廣闊的市場之一。在博德之門，金錢勝過道德，利潤是最終的善。因此，幾乎任何東西都可以在城市的商店中買賣，無論是稀有珠寶、魔法武器、秘密、聯盟，甚至是謀殺。人們來到這座城市尋求從南扎路港進口的商品，從海中打撈上來的銅綠覆蓋的寶藏，針對政治對手的勒索資訊，或是定製的毒藥。

english: Though the city has laws regarding the sale of stolen property, smuggling, and contract killing, such crimes are rarely reported and even more rarely enforced. Unless the complainant is a patriar or other powerful individual, law enforcement lacks the time and interest to pursue those engaging in mutually beneficial transactions. The unwritten law is do nothing that interferes with the city's economy and make your bargains in peace. Individuals who suffer due to morally questionable contracts must seek out private means of obtaining justice.
zh_tw: 儘管城市有關於銷售贓物、走私和合同殺人的法律，但這類犯罪很少被舉報，更少被執行。除非投訴人是貴族或其他有權勢的個人，執法機構缺乏時間和興趣去追究那些參與互惠交易的人。不成文的法律是不要做任何干擾城市經濟的事情，並在和平中達成你的交易。那些因道德上有問題的合同而受苦的個人必須尋求私人手段來獲得正義。

english: Professional Guilds
zh_tw: 專業行會

english: Craftspeople and merchants organize in professional guilds and follow official charters. Unofficial guilds are technically illegal, but in the Outer City, such informal guilds are common.
zh_tw: 工匠和商人在專業公會中組織起來，並遵循官方章程。非官方的公會從技術上講是非法的，但在外城區，這樣的非正式公會很常見。

english: Most professional guilds operate in the Lower City, but prefer to provide their goods to the wealthy patriar families of the Upper City. Commoners grumble that they can't even buy from their own neighbors, with the choicest items and freshest food traveling up the hill. A laborer might toil all day at a fishmonger's shop, then be forced to take their pay to the Outer City and buy yesterday's catch from an unlicensed seller.
zh_tw: 大多數專業行會在下城區運營，但更願意向富裕的上城區族長家族提供他們的商品。平民抱怨說他們甚至不能從自己的鄰居那裡購買，最好的商品和最新鮮的食品都被運送到了山上。一個勞動者可能在魚店辛苦工作了一整天，然後被迫帶著他們的薪水到外城區，從一個無照賣家那裡購買昨天的漁獲。

english: In many cases, guilds intersect with crews. Such groups take an interest in their members beyond a professional level, working to assure that they're safe on the streets and at home so they can return to work the next morning. Those who mistreat a guild member might find themselves ostracized by all members of that profession, or even find themselves cornered by members of the guild's associated crew, their most menacing tools of the trade in hand.
zh_tw: 在許多情況下，公會與船員有交集。這些團體對他們的成員不僅僅是在專業層面上感興趣，他們努力確保成員在街上和家中的安全，以便他們第二天早晨能夠返回工作崗位。那些虐待公會成員的人可能會發現自己被該職業的所有成員排斥，或者甚至發現自己被公會相關船員的成員逼到角落，手中拿著他們最威脅的工具。

english: Religion
zh_tw: 宗教

english: Baldurians are permitted to worship whatever deities they wish, so long as they refrain from violent acts and practices that disrupt trade. While multiple temples rise within the city walls, hundreds of tiny shrines sit along the twisted streets of the Outer City.
zh_tw: 博德之門的居民被允許崇拜他們所希望的任何神祇，只要他們避免採取暴力行為和幹擾貿易的做法。雖然城市牆內有多座神廟，但外城區蜿蜒的街道上坐落著數百個小神龕。

english: In the city proper, worship centers around a handful of well-known and generally respectable deities. Most established temples, with clergy and daily rituals, are in the Upper City, which precludes commoners from worshiping after dark, when only residents are allowed to remain in the Upper City. Since most commoners work during the day, their faith usually becomes secondary in their lives. Ostentatious adherence to religious rituals is seen as a privilege of the wealthy. Some Baldurians even think outwardly displaying one's faith is a sign of pretentiousness and insincerity.
zh_tw: 在城市中心，崇拜活動主要圍繞一些眾所周知且普遍受人尊敬的神祇。大多數設有神職人員和日常儀式的固定寺廟位於上城區，這使得平民在天黑後無法進行崇拜，因為那時只有居民被允許留在上城區。由於大多數平民在白天工作，他們的信仰通常在他們的生活中成為次要的。公開堅持宗教儀式被視為富人的特權。一些博德之門人甚至認為公開展示自己的信仰是矯揉造作和不真誠的標誌。

english: Among the many deities worshiped in Baldur's Gate, a handful hold particular prominence.
zh_tw: 在博德之門崇拜的眾多神祇中，少數幾位特別突出。

english: Dead Three
zh_tw: 死亡三神

english: Bane (the Lord of Tyranny), Bhaal (the Lord of Murder), and Myrkul (the Lord of Bones) make up the Dead Three. While these deities have lost much of their power, their faiths still command respect and fear throughout Baldur's Gate. While open worship of the Dead Three is frowned upon in Baldur's Gate, their worship is not illegal—so long as worship remains within the laws. Every now and then, rumors surface that a powerful political figure is a Bhaalspawn (see "{@area Bhaalspawn|34c|x}"). These claims almost always prove to be smear campaigns with no basis in truth—though, in some cases, such claims have actually raised a figure's standing in the public eye.
zh_tw: 班恩（暴政之主）、巴爾（謀殺之主）和米爾寇（骨骼之主）構成了死亡三神。儘管這些神祇已經失去了大部分力量，但他們的信仰在博德之門仍然令人敬畏。在博德之門，公開崇拜死亡三神是不被看好的，但他們的崇拜並不違法——只要崇拜活動遵守法律。時不時地，有關某個強大的政治人物是巴爾之子（見"{@area 巴爾神選|34c|x}"）的謠言就會浮現。這些說法幾乎總是被證明是沒有根據的誹謗活動——儘管，在某些情況下，這樣的指控實際上提高了一個人在公眾眼中的地位。

english: For more details on the Dead Three, see "{@area Dangers in Baldur's Gate|370|x}".
zh_tw: 有關死亡三神更詳細的資訊，請參見"{@area 博德之門的危險|370|x}"。

english: Gond
zh_tw: 貢德

english: The High House of Wonders, located in the Upper City, serves as the city's temple of Gond, a god of innovation and invention. Within the walls of the temple, clergy members are permitted to brew experimental potions and elixirs, build and test mechanical constructs, and hire locals to participate in controlled experiments—all in the spirit of invention and innovation.
zh_tw: 奇蹟高殿位於上城區，作為城市的貢德神廟，貢德是創新和發明之神。在神廟的牆內，神職人員被允許釀造實驗性藥水和藥劑，建造和測試機械構造，並僱傭當地人參與控制實驗——所有這些都是為了發明和創新的精神。

english: High-ranking members of Gond's clergy oversee a number of secret projects sponsored by wealthy patriars or the Flaming Fist.
zh_tw: 貢德神職中的高階成員監督著一些由富裕的族長或焰拳贊助的秘密專案。

english: Helm
zh_tw: 海姆

english: In a city as dangerous as Baldur's Gate, prayers to the Vigilant One are many. Members of the Watch and the Flaming Fist, mercenaries, bodyguards, and the fearful pray for Helm's protection at his shrine, the Watchful Shield, located in the Upper City. Patriars who see themselves as protectors of the common folk pray to Helm for guidance as well.
zh_tw: 在像博德之門這樣危險的城市中，對警覺者的祈禱是很多的。守衛和焰拳的成員、僱傭兵、保鏢以及害怕的人都在上城區的警戒之盾神殿向赫爾姆祈求保護。自認為是平民保護者的貴族也向赫爾姆祈求指引。

english: The Order of the Gauntlet, a good-aligned faction devoted to Helm, quietly sponsors vigilantes throughout Baldur's Gate. These self-styled "protectors of the innocent" leave Helm's holy symbol on the bodies of dead criminals, or carved into the flesh of live ones left at the Flaming Fist's doorstep.
zh_tw: 護手令，一個致力於赫爾姆的善良陣營組織，在博德之門悄悄地資助義警。這些自詡為"無辜者的保護者"的人會在死去的罪犯身上留下赫爾姆的聖徽，或者在被留在焰拳門前的活人身上刻下這個符號。

english: Ilmater
zh_tw: 伊爾梅特

english: Ilmater's humble shrine stands in a quiet square in Heapside. The Shrine of Suffering provides free meals and a few coppers to the poor and destitute.
zh_tw: 伊爾馬特的謙卑神龕位於堆場區一個安靜的廣場上。苦難神龕為窮人和無家可歸者提供免費餐食和一些銅幣。

english: Even in the Upper City, some citizens feel their existence is one of secret torment and suffering. The idea that pain has nobility to it—that there can be a divine reason behind the trials that face Baldurians—comforts many.
zh_tw: 即使在上城區，一些市民也感覺他們的存在充滿了秘密的痛苦和折磨。痛苦具有貴族氣質——認為博德之門人面臨的考驗背後可能有神聖的理由——這種想法安慰了許多人。

english: Some patriars spread word of Ilmater's faith not out of devotion, but to control their lessers. If people believe their suffering is worthy, they are less likely to demand safer conditions, higher pay, or more rights. In recent memory, cryptic notes have appeared on the gates of patriar estates, warning that "those who falsely champion the Crying God will find their own suffering multiplied."
zh_tw: 一些貴族宣揚伊爾馬特的信仰並非出於虔誠，而是為了控制他們的下屬。如果人們相信他們的痛苦是值得的，他們就不太可能要求更安全的條件、更高的薪酬或更多的權利。在最近的記憶中，神秘的紙條出現在貴族莊園的大門口，警告說"那些虛假地支援哭泣之神的人會發現他們自己的痛苦倍增。"

english: Oghma
zh_tw: 歐格瑪

english: An eye-catching, white marble pavilion in the Upper City known as the Unrolling Scroll serves as Oghma's shrine. Pilgrims on the road to Candlekeep often stop at the shrine to purchase or trade rare tomes. Adventurers looking for work sometimes linger nearby, waiting to hire on to missions intent on recovering lost books of magic.
zh_tw: 上城區有一個引人注目的白色大理石亭子，被稱為展開的卷軸，它是奧格瑪的神龕。前往燭堡的朝聖者經常在神龕停留，購買或交換稀有的書籍。尋找工作的冒險者有時會在附近徘徊，等待被僱傭去執行尋找遺失魔法書籍的任務。

english: Siamorphe
zh_tw: 賽雅茉芙

english: Siamorphe, goddess of nobility and divine right, is not widely worshiped in Baldur's Gate, but her image looks out from the alcoves of weathered noble estates and from behind vines within patriar gardens.
zh_tw: 賽雅茉芙，貴族和神授權利的女神，在博德之門並不廣泛受到崇拜，但她的形象從貴族莊園的壁龕中和貴族花園中的藤蔓後望出。

english: Long ago, many nobles of Baldur's Gate worshiped Siamorphe. Legend tells that her temple was a wonder to behold, its nave decorated with crests of the most powerful ruling families of the time. A secret vault contained signet rings, family trees, and copies of important decrees, holding them in case of some calamity.
zh_tw: 很久以前，博德之門的許多貴族崇拜希亞莫爾菲。傳說她的神廟是一個令人驚歎的奇觀，其中殿裝飾著當時最強大的統治家族的紋章。一個秘密的金庫包含了家族紋章戒指、家譜和重要法令的副本，以備災難發生時使用。

english: During one of the city's early uprisings, the temple became a target for rioters and was burned to the ground. Where the temple stood has since been forgotten. However, rumors persist that the temple's vault is likely hidden beneath a patriar home or even a different temple. Urban treasure hunters, desperate politicians, and disenfranchised nobles still sift through the unreliable records of ages past to find it.
zh_tw: 在城市早期的一次起義中，神廟成為了暴徒的目標，並被燒成了平地。神廟所在地自那以後就被人遺忘了。然而，有傳言堅持認為神廟的金庫很可能隱藏在貴族的家中，甚至另一個神廟下面。城市中的尋寶者、絕望的政治家和被剝奪權利的貴族仍然在翻查過去年代不可靠的記錄，以尋找它。

english: Tymora
zh_tw: 泰摩拉

english: Adherents of the goddess of good fortune maintain her temple in the Upper City. Given the number of people in Baldur's Gate who rely on luck to make it through each day, her following thrives. Even cruel-hearted criminals turn to Tymora for luck, hoping the goddess recognizes their boldness and daring. Evildoers who work outside the Guild tip their hats to Lady Luck before going out on a job.
zh_tw: 好運女神的信徒在上城區維護著她的神廟。鑑於博德之門有許多人依賴運氣度過每一天，她的影響力蓬勃發展。即使是心狠手辣的罪犯也會向提莫拉尋求好運，希望女神能認識到他們的大膽和勇敢。那些在行會之外活動的惡人，在執行任務之前也會向幸運女士致敬。

english: Citizens who must walk the Lower City at night, or who venture into the depths of the Outer City, usually whisper joint prayers to Tymora and Helm. They know that luck is almost as valuable as vigilance when it comes to staying alive in the city.
zh_tw: 那些必須在夜晚穿過下城區，或者冒險進入外城區深處的市民，通常會一起向泰摩拉和赫爾姆祈禱。他們知道，運氣在保持城市生存方面幾乎和警覺一樣寶貴。

english: Tymora's temple unofficially serves as a gathering place for adventurers seeking dangerous quests. Citizens with bizarre problems or in overwhelmingly perilous situations come to the temple in hopes of finding the perfect aid to help them.
zh_tw: 提莫拉的神廟實際上成為了尋求危險任務的冒險者的聚集地。面臨奇怪問題或處於極度危險境地的市民來到神廟，希望能夠找到完美的幫助。

english: Umberlee
zh_tw: 安博裡

english: No city as reliant on the sea as Baldur's Gate could do without a temple to Umberlee. Fisherfolk pray to the Queen of the Depths for good waters to ply their trade, and sailors beg Umberlee's mercy before embarking on their voyages.
zh_tw: 像博德之門這樣依賴海洋的城市離不開向烏姆貝爾莉祈禱的神廟。漁民向深淵女王祈求良好的水域來從事他們的貿易，水手們在開始他們的航行前懇求烏姆貝爾莉的憐憫。

english: Smugglers, too, pay homage to Umberlee. A great deal of illegal trade passes through the harbor in small crafts on moonless nights, and smugglers—particularly of dangerous beasts and kidnapped souls—know to drop a few coins into the water as they pass into the harbor to appease Umberlee.
zh_tw: 走私者也向昂貝雷致敬。大量的非法貿易在沒有月亮的夜晚透過小船在港口進行，特別是那些走私危險野獸和被綁架靈魂的走私者，知道在進入港口時要往水裡扔幾個硬幣，以安撫昂貝雷。

english: Umberlee's adherents work out of the Water Queen's House, a magnificent structure on the city docks. They provide blessings to sailors and identify relics dredged up from the deep. When Umberlee is offended by the removal of an item from the sea, she expresses her displeasure to the clergy by sending them omens, urging the priests to advise the finder to return the plundered item to the depths at once—or else.
zh_tw: 烏姆貝爾莉的信徒們在城市碼頭上的一座宏偉建築——水之女王之屋進行活動。他們為水手們提供祝福，並鑑定從深海中挖掘出來的遺物。當烏姆貝爾莉因為從海中移除某物而受到冒犯時，她會透過傳送徵兆向神職人員表達不滿，敦促牧師們建議發現者立即將掠奪的物品歸還到深海中——否則後果自負。

english: Murderous servants of the Dead Three corner their prey near the statue of Minsc and Boo.
zh_tw: 死亡三神的殺手在明斯克和布的雕像附近圍捕他們的獵物。

english: Dangers in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的危險

english: Crime is a powerful force in the city. Fearsome creatures hunt along cobbled streets, and the worship of evil deities continues to rise.
zh_tw: 犯罪是這座城市的強大力量。可怕的生物在鵝卵石街道上狩獵，對邪惡神祇的崇拜持續上升。

english: The Guild
zh_tw: 公會

english: The organization known simply as the Guild unites cutpurses, loan sharks, killers, thugs, con artists, grave robbers, cat burglars, and every other type of criminal in the city. The Guild operates under the noses of the Watch and the Flaming Fist by adroitly keeping its illicit activities quiet.
zh_tw: 被稱為行會的組織將扒手、放高利貸者、殺手、暴徒、詐騙藝術家、盜墓賊、入室竊賊以及城市中所有其他型別的罪犯聯合起來。行會在警衛隊和焰拳的眼皮底下透過巧妙地保持其非法活動的秘密運作。

english: Each city neighborhood falls under control of one or more kingpins, crime bosses who report to the head of the Guild. These kingpins style themselves as elite criminals, often adopting memorable nicknames and distinctively decadent dress. Scores of common criminals work beneath each kingpin, with the most competent and cutthroat members rising to favored status.
zh_tw: 每個城市社群都處於一個或多個大頭目的控制之下，這些犯罪頭目向公會的首領彙報。這些大頭目自詡為精英罪犯，常常採用難以忘記的綽號和獨特墮落的著裝。在每個大頭目下面有成群的普通罪犯工作，其中最有能力和無情的成員上升到受寵的地位。

english: Some kingpins keep strictly to the shadows, but others operate more openly. Particularly in the Outer City, citizens often know their local kingpin. A kingpin might receive requests for help from citizens, asking for loans or dealing with unauthorized crime, such as a thieving neighbor. A kingpin tracks these favors and debts, calling them in when it suits them—often with interest.
zh_tw: 一些黑幫老大嚴格保持在暗處活動，但其他人則更加公開地運作。特別是在外城區，市民通常知道他們當地的黑幫老大。黑幫老大可能會收到市民的求助請求，請求貸款或處理未授權的犯罪，比如偷竊的鄰居。黑幫老大會跟蹤這些恩惠和債務，並在對他們有利時——通常還要加上利息——索取回報。

english: Rivalries exist between kingpins, and their territorial borders shift constantly. As long as these internal feuds don't disrupt Guild business or draw the attention of the authorities, no one interferes. Recent rumors claim that an Outer City kingpin known as Straightstick is calling in all his favors to make a move on a Lower City turf. Crossing the wall is riskier than the average power play, and those in the know predict the coming conflict to be a bloody one.
zh_tw: 大頭目之間存在競爭，他們的領土邊界不斷變化。只要這些內部紛爭不幹擾公會的業務或引起當局的注意，就沒有人會干涉。最近的傳言聲稱，一個被稱為直棍的外城區大頭目正在呼叫他所有的人情債來對下城區的地盤採取行動。越過城牆比一般權力遊戲風險更大，知情人士預測即將到來的衝突將是血腥的。

english: Guild operations in the Outer City center on smuggling and gambling. Some violent crime and theft occur, but for the most part, Outer City residents are too poor to draw the attention of the Guild. Travelers and visitors do fall victim to pickpocketing, muggings, and assault, though. As the Flaming Fist rarely comes to the district, the Guild has long operated with impunity. In recent years, though, the interference of vigilantes and hired adventurers has been on the rise.
zh_tw: 外城區的行會活動主要圍繞走私和賭博。雖然偶爾會發生一些暴力犯罪和盜竊，但總的來說，外城區的居民太窮，無法引起行會的注意。然而，旅行者和訪客確實容易成為扒手、搶劫和襲擊的目標。由於焰拳很少來到這個區域，行會長期以來一直逍遙法外。不過，近年來，義警和僱傭冒險者的幹擾有所增加。

english: The Lower City serves as the heart of the Guild's operations. The locals here have enough money to make burglary and protection schemes worthwhile, and the Flaming Fist is spread too thin to address every instance of petty crime. The Guild's operations widen to numerous commercial ventures, such as gambling dens, animal fights, races, and brawling tournaments. Their traffickers also maintain routes into other districts, and guide individuals and illicit trade through them for a fee. Those who oppose the Guild—typically by going to the Flaming Fist—invite retaliation upon themselves and their neighbors. This makes most folk afraid to report crimes and pressures their neighbors to keep quiet as well.
zh_tw: 下城區是行會行動的中心。這裡的當地人有足夠的錢，使得盜竊和保護計劃值得實施，而焰拳的人力過於分散，無法解決每一個小犯罪。行會的行動擴充套件到眾多商業活動，如賭博窩點、動物戰鬥、賽跑和摔跤錦標賽。他們的販子還維護著通往其他區域的路線，並以收費的方式引導個人和非法貿易透過這些路線。那些反對行會的人——通常是透過向焰拳報告——會給自己和他們的鄰居招致報復。這使得大多數人害怕報告犯罪，並迫使他們的鄰居也保持沉默。

english: In the Upper City, the Guild engages in burglary, extortion, blackmail, and confidence games. Patriars might even hire Guild members to gain (or plant) information about their rivals, involving the Guild in Upper City politics.
zh_tw: 在上城區，公會從事盜竊、敲詐、勒索和詐騙遊戲。貴族們甚至可能僱傭公會成員來獲取（或植入）有關他們對手的資訊，讓公會捲入上城區的政治。

english: Only the most talented criminals dare to burgle patriar estates, but the lower ranks of a kingpin's operation often work as pickpockets or try to con residents of the district. Here, the Watch zealously monitors for Guild activities and targets anyone threatening the peace. Kingpins can often come to an agreement with the Watch, though, offering bribes so that Watch officers look the other way. Every month, the kingpin makes their payment to the Watch and selects a new safe word. Guild members caught by the Watch utter the safe word to avoid arrest. Rival kingpins and unaffiliated criminals looking to work in the Upper City pay well for the month's safe word, though any member of the Guild found selling the information faces harsh punishment.
zh_tw: 只有最有天賦的罪犯才敢闖入貴族莊園行竊，但大頭目手下的低階成員通常充當扒手或試圖欺騙該區居民。在這裡，守衛隊熱情地監視公會的活動，針對任何威脅和平的人。然而，大頭目通常可以與守衛隊達成協議，提供賄賂，以便守衛隊官員視而不見。每個月，大頭目都會向守衛隊支付款項並選擇一個新的安全詞。被守衛隊抓住的公會成員說出安全詞以避免被捕。想要在上城區活動的敵對大頭目和非附屬的罪犯願意為本月的安全詞支付高價，儘管任何被發現出售資訊的公會成員都將面臨嚴厲的懲罰。

english: Nine-Fingers Keene
zh_tw: 九指基恩

english: The current leader of the Guild, {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA}, disdains flashy garb and illusion magic. She appears to the world as she is: an unassuming woman of middling age and build. Her forgettable looks have proven her greatest asset as a thief, as her victims have trouble recognizing her even when they meet her again face-to-face. Keene's leadership over the years earned her a reputation of thoughtful pragmatism. When necessary, she seeks revenge for offenses against the Guild—provided doing so is profitable. Her methods are vicious when necessary, and she is as feared as she is respected.
zh_tw: 行會的現任領袖，{@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA|九指基恩}，不屑於華麗的服飾和幻術魔法。她向世界展示她真實的樣子：一個外表不起眼的中年女性。她容易被人遺忘的外表作為小偷來說證明是她最大的資產，因為即使面對面再次遇到，她的受害者也很難認出她。基恩多年來的領導贏得了她深思熟慮的實用主義的聲譽。必要時，她會為對行會的冒犯尋求報復——前提是這樣做有利可圖。她的方法在必要時是殘忍的，她既被畏懼也被尊敬。

english: Keene has become increasingly intolerant of the populous tide turning against her organization. While the occasional rabble-rouser has always impeded criminal business, the rise of organized crews and vigilantes is interfering with Guild operations. After a carefully coordinated attack on a patriar's estate fell to pieces when a vigilante clumsily alerted the estate guards, Keene declared open season on do-gooders of all stripes.
zh_tw: 基恩越來越無法容忍民間大勢轉為反對她的勢力。一方面，偶爾總有鼓舞民眾的人在阻礙犯罪活動，另一方面，有組織的互助會和警醒衛士的崛起正在幹擾公會的運作。在一場精心策劃的針對宗貴莊園的襲擊失敗後——因為一名警醒衛士歪打正著地讓莊園守衛警覺了起來——基恩宣佈開始狩獵各行各業的行善者。

english: {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA|九指基恩}

english: The Dead Three
zh_tw: 死亡三神

english: The plots of patriars and the schemes of Guild operatives fill the gossip and whispers of Baldur's Gate. Yet, throughout the city, no names are as synonymous with dastardly acts as those of Dead Three. The demigods Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul walk among mortals, personally seeking followers to their cause. More than once, it's rumored, the trio has even trod the streets of Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 博德之門充滿了族長們的陰謀和行會特工的詭計。然而，在整個城市中，沒有任何名字像死亡三人組那樣與惡行同義。半神巴恩、巴拉和米爾庫爾在凡人中行走，親自尋找追隨者加入他們的事業。有傳言說，這個三人組甚至不止一次踏足過博德之門的街道。

english: Nefarious patriars whisper prayers to Bane when they seek to gain power through coercion, intimidation, and forceful exaction of the law. Gang leaders, evil mercenaries, and others who rely on fear and control, also pay homage to Bane. Those who want to evoke dominance and ruthlessness favor wearing black gloves—a nod to Bane's holy symbol.
zh_tw: 當邪惡的貴族尋求透過脅迫、恐嚇和強行執行法律來獲得權力時，他們會向班恩祈禱。幫派頭目、邪惡的僱傭兵以及依賴恐懼和控制的其他人，也向班恩表示敬意。那些想要喚起支配和無情的人喜歡戴黑色手套——這是對班恩聖徽的致敬。

english: Myrkul claims a following among those who wish to learn from or command the dead. Those who plunder tombs for lost knowledge, grim entrepreneurs who see business sense in undead servants, even pragmatic necromancers seeking to conjure secrets from the wealthy dead of Cliffside Cemetery all whisper prayers to Myrkul. Of the Dead Three, Myrkul's base of power is the smallest. Residents of Baldur's Gate rarely fear death by old age—a grim fact of living in such a dangerous city. As a result, few desperate elders seek the blessing of the Lord of Bones. Those who do, though, tend to be both cagey and wealthy, which means that although Myrkul's worshipers are small in number, their resources have hidden depths.
zh_tw: 米爾寇在那些希望從死者那裡學習或指揮死者的人中擁有追隨者。那些為了失落知識而掠奪墳墓的人，那些在不死僕人中看到商業意義的陰鬱企業家，甚至是那些尋求從懸崖公墓的富有死者那裡召喚秘密的實用主義死靈法師，都會向米爾寇低聲祈禱。在死亡三神中，米爾寇的權力基礎是最小的。博德之門的居民很少害怕老死——在一個如此危險的城市生活的嚴峻事實。因此，很少有絕望的老人尋求骨骼之主的祝福。不過，那些尋求的人往往既狡猾又富有，這意味著儘管米爾寇的信徒數量不多，但他們的資源有隱藏的深度。

english: Since the time when the Bhaalspawn Sarevok plotted to start a war between Baldur's Gate and Amn as a path to claiming Bhaal's power, awareness of the Lord of Murder's children has grown. Baldur's Gate maintains a grim draw for Bhaalspawn, whether due to some foul influence in the city itself, or merely because of Sarevok's lingering reputation.
zh_tw: 自從巴拉之子薩雷沃克策劃在博德之門和阿姆之間引發戰爭，以此作為獲取巴拉力量的途徑以來，人們對謀殺之主的子嗣的意識已經增強。無論是因為城市本身某種邪惡的影響，還是僅僅因為薩雷沃克的餘威，博德之門對巴拉之子來說始終是一個陰森的吸引。

english: At the same time, worship of Bhaal proves darkly popular in Baldur's Gate. Few openly admit to worshiping the Lord of Murder, but there is an unspoken assumption that anyone who benefits from violent death has some respect for Bhaal. Assassination and murder underpin many of the plots in the city, from the business of highly-paid killers on patriar payrolls to slayings of opportunity committed by Outer City fanatics. Such bloodthirsty faithful rarely gather in numbers, but they typically mark themselves by carving a fresh gouge on their thumbs—spilling their blood in Bhaal's name while creating a subtle mark identifying that identifies them among allies. Despite the Lord of Murder's decentralized worship, some believe a temple to Bhaal exists near or under the city, possibly in an ancient chamber beneath the sewers or carved into Dusthawk Hill. Rumor holds that eleven red crystals on the wall of the temple grow brighter with every murder committed, gathering power for either Bhaal or one of his future chosen. Some claim that Bhaal himself regularly visits the temple, his presence contributing to the city's high murder rate.
zh_tw: 與此同時，巴爾崇拜在博德之門暗中盛行。很少有人公開承認信奉謀殺之主，但人們心照不宣：凡是從暴力死亡中獲利的人，多少都敬畏巴爾。從貴族重金僱用的殺手，到外城狂熱信徒伺機行兇，暗殺與謀殺支撐著城中許多陰謀。這些嗜血信徒很少大批集會，通常會在拇指上劃出新傷，以巴爾之名流血，留下讓同道辨識的隱晦記號。雖然巴爾信徒各行其是，有人仍相信城內、城郊或地下藏著一座神殿，或許位於下水道下方的古老密室，或開鑿在塵鷹丘中。傳聞殿牆上的十一顆紅色水晶，每逢謀殺便更為明亮，替巴爾或他未來的某位選民積聚力量。也有人宣稱巴爾本人經常造訪，正是他的存在使城內謀殺如此頻繁。

english: While the Dead Three occupy a prominent place in Baldurians' fears, their faiths currently have only the shallowest roots in the city. Followers of the Dead Three have done more to incite dread than faith. As a result, their numbers remain relatively small. Their sinister reputations outstrip their actual influence, though, with gossip spreading quickly whenever the deities' ominous symbols appear in graffiti or the Flaming Fist cracks down on overzealous fanatics. Despite public fears and resistance from law enforcement, the cults of the Dead Three persist, causing many to darkly wonder why the servants of Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul hold such interest in Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 儘管死亡三神在博德之門人的恐懼中佔有顯著位置，但他們的信仰目前在城市中僅有最淺薄的基礎。死亡三神的追隨者們更多地激發了恐懼而非信仰。因此，他們的人數仍然相對較少。然而，他們邪惡的聲譽超出了他們實際的影響力，每當神祇的不祥標誌出現在塗鴉中，或者焰拳打擊過於狂熱的狂熱分子時，流言就會迅速傳播。儘管公眾感到恐懼，執法部門也持反對態度，但死亡三神的邪教仍然持續存在，這使得許多人暗自想知道為什麼班恩、巴爾和米爾寇的僕人對博德之門如此感興趣。

english: Prominent Guild Kingpins
zh_tw: 顯赫的行會頭目

english: All Guild operations are overseen by kingpins, a handful of which are described below.
zh_tw: 所有行會的行動都由一些頭目監督，以下是其中幾位的描述。

english: Goblin Behnie
zh_tw: 地精貝尼

english: Most are surprised to find Goblin Behnie looks nothing like his name or monstrous reputation suggest, the Bloomridge kingpin being a tall, polished-looking gentleman in his early thirties. The name comes from his ferocious ego, wild rages, and a propensity for biting off the fingers of those who disappoint him. Behind his viciousness, though, Goblin Behnie has a keen eye, making him and his forgers the city's best source of illicit Watch tokens (for passage into the Upper City), visitor licenses, and docking permits.
zh_tw: 大多數人驚訝地發現，地精貝尼看起來與他的名字或怪物般的名聲完全不符，這位布魯姆裡奇的行會頭目是一個三十出頭、風度翩翩的紳士。這個名字來自於他兇猛的自我、狂野的憤怒，以及對那些讓他失望的人咬斷手指的傾向。然而，在他殘忍的外表背後，地精貝尼有著敏銳的眼光，使他和他的偽造者成為城市中非法守望令牌（用於進入上城區）、訪客許可證和泊位許可證的最佳來源。

english: Straightstick
zh_tw: 直棍

english: The kingpin of the Twin Songs Faithless runs one of the city's best smuggling operations, slipping goods into the city along the Chionthar River and over Dusthawk Hill. The seventy-year-old claims to have been attacked by the infamous (and doubtfully real) Ol' Cholms, a giant snapping turtle rumored to sleep at the bottom of Gray Harbor. To prove his story, Straightstick uses a splinted old ferry pole as a crutch. Recently, the kingpin has grown bitter about his position, believing he deserves a territory within Baldur's Gate proper. He's planning an attack on Brampton, the destination of much of his smuggling and the territory of his ex-wife, Diamond Urchin.
zh_tw: 雙子之歌不忠派系的大頭目經營著城市中最好的走私行動之一，沿著奇昂塔河和塵埃鷹山將貨物偷運進城。這位七十歲的老人聲稱曾被臭名昭著的（且令人懷疑其真實性的）老喬姆斯襲擊，據說這是一種巨鱷龜，睡在灰港的底部。為了證明他的故事，直棍使用一根舊渡輪杆作為柺杖。最近，這位大頭目對自己的地位感到不滿，認為自己應該在博德之門內擁有一塊地盤。他正計劃攻擊布蘭普頓，這是他走私活動的目的地，也是他前妻鑽石海膽的地盤。

english: The Whiskey Lady
zh_tw: 威士忌女士

english: Few know that the last true heir of the Raddle patriar family died several years ago. Despite this, "Dowager Raddle" continues to throw lavish social events at her estate, though she never personally attends. Instead, her supposed relative welcomes guests, engaging them with sharp wit, hard liquor, political gossip, and political opportunities of "gray" legality. No one seem to know their host's name, though—a faux pas none would ever admit. As a result, the Manorborn neighborhood's politically active Guild kingpin is known only as the Whiskey Lady.
zh_tw: 很少有人知道，拉德爾族長家族的最後一個真正繼承人幾年前就去世了。儘管如此，'拉德爾寡婦'仍然在她莊園舉辦奢華的社交活動，儘管她從不出面。相反，她所謂的親戚歡迎客人，用銳利的機智、烈酒、政治八卦和'灰色'合法性的政治機會與他們互動。似乎沒有人知道他們主人的名字，儘管——這是一個沒有人願意承認的失禮。因此，曼諾本地區的政治活躍的行會黑幫老大隻被稱為威士忌女士。

english: Map 6.2: Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 地圖 6.2: 博德之門

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Murder
zh_tw: 謀殺

english: Blackmail and theft pay well, but murder is the preferred tool of the ambitious. Murder silences witnesses, disposes of enemies, and clears the path to power. Assassins never lack for work in Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 勒索和盜竊收益豐厚，但謀殺是野心家的首選工具。謀殺可以封口證人，消除敵人，清除通往權力的道路。在博德之門，刺客永遠不缺工作。

english: In the Outer City, murder is practically a way of life. With neither the Watch nor the Flaming Fist to look after residents, criminals run free in the sprawling district. Criminals use murder to keep order among their ranks and remove threats to their organization. So-called "snuff streets" hold the bodies of the dead, dumped by their murderers in piles along the lane. The most desperate of Outer City residents prowl the snuff streets, hoping to find a missed copper piece or a salvageable boot to pawn. They strip the teeth from bodies, cut off hair that might fetch a coin, and sometimes—it is rumored—slice flesh from the corpses to stave off starvation. Recent reports of ghoul activity in the Outer City likely have their origins in these snuff streets.
zh_tw: 在外城區，謀殺幾乎是一種生活方式。由於沒有守衛隊或焰拳來照看居民，罪犯在廣闊的區域中自由行動。罪犯使用謀殺來維持他們之間的秩序並消除對他們組織的威脅。所謂的"熄燈街"上堆滿了死者的屍體，被他們的謀殺者沿著小巷堆放成堆。外城區最絕望的居民在熄燈街上徘徊，希望找到一個遺漏的銅幣或者可以典當的可回收靴子。他們從屍體上剝離牙齒，剪掉可能賣得一塊錢的頭髮，有時——據傳言——還從屍體上切下肉來抵禦飢餓。最近有關外城區食屍鬼活動的報道很可能起源於這些熄燈街。

english: In the Lower City, murder is less common but remains a threat. Long-time residents know to travel in groups after dark. Those looking to earn a few coins sometimes linger outside of taverns, hiring out as escorts for drunken patrons. Revelers can stay as late as they wish and still get home safely, provided they hire someone trustworthy to guard their trip home.
zh_tw: 在下城區，謀殺較為少見，但仍然是一個威脅。長期居住的居民知道天黑後要成群結隊出行。那些想賺幾個小錢的人有時會在酒館外徘徊，作為醉酒顧客的護送者提供服務。狂歡者可以隨心所欲地待到很晚，並且只要他們僱傭了值得信賴的人來保護他們回家的旅程，仍然可以安全地回家。

english: Most murders in the Lower City have reasons behind them. The merchant found with his throat cut and pockets emptied, the husband murdered so his wife can marry her young mistress, the tyrannical shop owner stabbed by a desperate underling—residents understand these crimes. What frightens people are the senseless murders. The man found ripped to pieces with his pockets still full of gold, the woman slaughtered so viciously that her grieving husband is sent to the asylum, the shop owner who suddenly strikes down his faithful clerk—these are the crimes that lead to panic and wild rumors.
zh_tw: 下城區的大多數謀殺案背後都有原因。商人被發現喉嚨被割開，口袋被掏空；丈夫被謀殺，這樣他的妻子就可以嫁給她年輕的情婦；暴君般的店主被絕望的下屬刺傷——居民們理解這些罪行。讓人們感到恐懼的是無意義的謀殺。一個男子被發現被撕成碎片，口袋裡還裝滿了金幣；一個女子被如此殘忍地殺害，以至於她悲痛的丈夫被送進了精神病院；店主突然殺死了他忠實的店員——這些是導致恐慌和瘋狂謠言的罪行。

english: Some commoners claim that something about the city itself sparks violence in its citizens. A popular theory is that the spirits of the vicious pirates that once sailed the harbors still influence the city. Another is that the spirit of the long-executed serial murderer Alhasval Drenz, the Whitkeep Whistler, still stalks the city, possessing innocents to continue her unmatched killing spree. This adventure posits a third possibility: that the presence of the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA} fuels the avarice and ambitions of evil-minded folk in Baldur's Gate. This magic item lies in a vault under Vanthampur Villa (see {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}) and has a pit fiend trapped inside it (see "{@adventure Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|12|Shield of the Hidden Lord}"). Were the shield to be taken from the city, the murder rate might drop suddenly.
zh_tw: 一些平民聲稱，這座城市本身激發了市民的暴力傾向。一種流行的理論認為，曾經在港口航行的兇惡海盜的靈魂仍在影響著這座城市。另一種說法是，早已被處決的連環殺手阿爾哈斯瓦爾·德倫茲（白堡口哨幫）的靈魂仍在城市中游蕩，附身於無辜者以繼續她無與倫比的殺戮狂歡。這個冒險提出了第三種可能性：{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}的存在助長了博德之門中邪惡之徒的貪婪和野心。這件魔法物品位於範薩普宅邸下的一個金庫中（參見{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}），其中困住了一個地獄魔（參見"{@adventure 隱藏領主的盾牌|BGDIA|12|Shield of the Hidden Lord}"）。如果這面盾牌被帶離城市，謀殺率可能會突然下降。

english: It's unclear whether the rise of Bhaal's faith in Baldur's Gate stems from the frequency of murders, or if the murders spring from the worship of Bhaal. The Flaming Fist suspects a group of Bhaal worshipers behind a spate of recent similar murders, the victims stabbed to death and their own blood dribbled like a crown around their heads. The Fist's investigations have not yet resulted in an arrest, but officers suspect the murderers to be commoners with seemingly unremarkable lives covering their true, bloodthirsty natures.
zh_tw: 目前尚不清楚，巴爾信仰在博德之門的興起是因為謀殺案的頻繁發生，還是因為巴爾的崇拜導致了謀殺案的發生。焰拳懷疑一群巴爾崇拜者是最近一系列類似謀殺案的幕後黑手，受害者被刺死，他們自己的血液像皇冠一樣滴在他們的頭上。焰拳的調查尚未導致逮捕，但官員們懷疑兇手是表面上看似普通、掩蓋他們真正嗜血本性的平民。

english: In the Upper City, murder brings results. Muggings and crimes of opportunity are rare here. The Watch keeps Upper City residents safe from criminals and riffraff. The biggest threat to patriars are other patriars.
zh_tw: 在上城區，謀殺能帶來結果。搶劫和機會犯罪在這裡很少見。守望者保護上城區居民免受罪犯和流氓的侵害。族長們面臨的最大威脅是其他族長。

english: Bribery and blackmail can secure votes or sway an allegiance temporarily, but murder permanently changes the makeup of the Parliament of Peers. Several elite assassins exclusively take on political targets. The Watch puts little effort into tracking down expert assassins, knowing that arresting one means possibly exposing a whole cadre of powerful patriars. The wrath that would fall on the Watch isn't worth putting one assassin in the cells.
zh_tw: 賄賂和勒索可以暫時確保選票或影響忠誠，但謀殺永久性地改變了貴族議會的構成。一些精英刺客專門針對政治目標。警衛隊很少努力追蹤專家刺客，因為他們知道逮捕一個可能會導致一群有權勢的族長曝光。警衛隊認為，將一個刺客關進牢房所可能引發的憤怒不值得。

english: City Landmarks
zh_tw: 城市地標

english: Today, Baldur's Gate is split into three districts: the wealthy Upper City on the hills above the docks, the bustling Lower City around the harbor, and the lawless Outer City (which includes all neighborhoods outside the city walls). Regardless of what district one might be visiting, certain features are impossible to ignore, like the wash of Gray Harbor, the shadows of Dusthawk Hill, or the gates that contribute to the city's name.
zh_tw: 如今，博德之門被劃分為三個區域：位於碼頭上方山坡上的富裕上城區，圍繞港口繁忙的下城區，以及無法無天的外城區（包括所有城牆外的社群）。無論訪問哪個區域，某些特徵都不可能被忽視，比如灰港的沖刷，塵埃山丘的陰影，或者為城市命名的大門。

english: Important landmarks are marked on the large map of the city ({@adventure map 6.2|BGDIA|9|Map 6.2: Baldur's Gate}), which shows the entirety of Baldur's Gate and its immediate surroundings.
zh_tw: 重要的地標在城市的大地圖上被標記出來（見{@adventure 地圖 6.2|BGDIA|9|Map 6.2: Baldur's Gate}），這張地圖展示了博德之門及其周邊地區全貌。

english: The Gates
zh_tw: 城門

english: Nine gates separate the districts of Baldur's Gate, providing the only points of entry to pass from the Upper City to the Lower City, or from the walled city proper to the Outer City and the wider world beyond. Baldurians, particularly if they do not wish to reveal a crew or family affiliation to a potentially hostile audience, often describe themselves by the nearest gate to their homes. Terms like "Gondgater" and "Dragongater" are widely understood as neighborhood identities, and are also understood as a way of eliding more troublesome connections.
zh_tw: 九個大門分隔了博德之門的區域，它們是連線上城區和下城區的唯一入口，也是從城牆內的城市到外城區以及更廣闊世界的唯一通道。巴爾杜爾人，特別是如果他們不希望向可能敵對的聽眾透露他們的團隊或家庭關係，通常會透過他們家附近的大門來描述自己。像'貢德蓋特'和'龍蓋特'這樣的術語被廣泛理解為鄰裡身份，並且也被理解為一種避免更麻煩聯絡的方式。

english: The Watch guards gates leading to the Upper City, while the Flaming Fist oversees the rest. Guards assigned to Baldur's Gate and Black Dragon Gate stay at sharp attention and seldom accept bribes. Those assigned to the smaller and more secluded gates, however, can be less attentive, particularly when distracted by jingling coins.
zh_tw: 守衛隊負責守衛通往上城區的大門，而焰拳則負責其餘部分。被分配到博德之門和黑龍門的守衛保持高度警惕，很少接受賄賂。然而，那些被分配到較小且更隱蔽的大門的守衛可能會比較不專注，特別是當他們被叮噹作響的硬幣分散注意力時。

english: Anyone entering the city must pay a nominal entry toll of 5 cp. While this is a small sum, it ensures that the truly destitute remain outside, consigned to the slums of the Outer City. Beggars and refugees crowd at the fringes of these slums, typically around Black Dragon Gate and Basilisk Gate, pleading for money to pay the toll and hoping that the guards won't drive them off for annoying more prosperous travelers.
zh_tw: 任何進入城市的人都必須支付5銅幣的象徵性入場費。雖然這是一筆小數目，但它確保了真正貧困的人留在城外，被安置在外城區的貧民窟。乞丐和難民聚集在這些貧民窟的邊緣，通常在黑龍門和石蜴門附近，懇求錢財以支付通行費，並希望守衛不會因為他們打擾更富裕的旅行者而趕走他們。

english: When the city is not under lockdown, merchants pour through the external gates from morning till night, while peddlers, delivery carriers, and servants move in equally swift streams through the inner gates. Toll collectors work quickly but methodically to inspect incoming and outgoing trade goods, ensuring that commerce flows smoothly and the city gets its share at every turn.
zh_tw: 當城市沒有封鎖時，商人從早晨到夜晚湧入外部大門，而小販、送貨員和僕人也透過內部大門以同樣迅速的人流移動。收費員迅速而有條不紊地工作，檢查進出的貿易貨物，確保商業流通順暢，城市在每個環節都能獲得其份額。

english: The city gates are closed at night. At dusk, the Watch evicts anyone from the Upper City who is not a patriar, bearing a patriar's livery or permission letter, or carrying a Watch-issued token. The enforcement of this rule is one of the means by which the Upper City reinforces its snobbery over the other districts. More than one Lower City merchant visiting an Upper City restaurant or theater near sundown has been embarrassed by a Watch member's loud, public caution that the gates are about to close. While being seen hurrying toward the gates is an obvious embarrassment, being caught and escorted out would be far more bruising—both to one's ego and body.
zh_tw: 城市大門在夜間是關閉的。在黃昏時，守衛隊會驅逐任何不在上城區的貴族、沒有穿著貴族徽章或持有貴族許可信，或攜帶守衛隊發放的令牌的人。執行這項規則是上城區加強其對其他區域的傲慢態度的手段之一。不止一位下城區商人在黃昏時分訪問上城區的餐館或劇院時，因守衛隊員大聲公開提醒大門即將關閉而感到尷尬。雖然被人看到匆忙走向大門顯然是令人尷尬的，但被抓到並被護送出去會更傷自尊和身體。

english: The nightly closing of the gates ostensibly keeps the patriars safe. Closing off the Upper City pushes street crime into poorer neighborhoods, or out of the city altogether. In the Upper City, patriars can walk down alleys with relatively little fear, but beyond its well-lit streets and tightly watched gates, the other districts become much more dangerous after dark.
zh_tw: 城門每晚的關閉表面上是為了確保族長們的安全。關閉上城區將街頭犯罪推向更貧困的社群，或者完全趕出城市。在上城區，族長們可以相對無憂地走下小巷，但在其明亮的街道和嚴密看守的城門之外，其他區域在天黑後變得危險得多。

english: Gray Harbor
zh_tw: 灰港

english: One of the largest and deepest harbors on Faerûn's western coast, Gray Harbor is also one of the busiest. The city's independence and general laissez-faire attitude toward the types of goods and people flowing through its port—so long as the government gets its cut—means that the harbor throngs with both honest captains conducting forthright trade and pirate crews looking to fence their wares. Plenty of sailors also make their homes nearby in the Lower City.
zh_tw: 灰港是費倫西海岸最大且最深的港口之一，也是最繁忙的港口之一。這座城市的獨立性以及對透過其港口流動的貨物和人員的普遍放任態度——只要政府得到它的份額——意味著港口裡擠滿了進行正當貿易的誠實船長和想要銷贓的海盜船員。許多水手也在下城區附近安家。

english: The harbor's most immediately striking feature is its machinery, with dozens of enormous cranes and countless powered scoops and cargo carts dramatically accelerating the loading and unloading process. Though designed by the Church of Gond, these marvels are run by the Harborhands, the most powerful crew in the city thanks to the dockworkers' ability to shut off the city's economic lifeblood with a strike. Managing the whole affair is Harbormaster Darus Kelinoth, a lawful neutral male human {@creature noble} who runs the port's operations and taxation from a small, heavily fortified brick building set well apart from other structures.
zh_tw: 港口最引人注目的特徵是其機械裝置，數十個巨大的起重機以及無數動力剷鬥和貨物推車極大地加速了裝卸過程。雖然這些奇蹟是由貢德教會設計的，但它們由港手幫運營，他們是城市中最強大的團隊，因為碼頭工人有能力透過罷工切斷城市的經濟命脈。管理這一切的是港口主管達魯斯·凱利諾斯（達魯斯·凱利諾斯），一位守序中立的人類男性{@creature noble||貴族}，他從小而堅固的磚砌建築中運營港口事務和稅收，這棟建築與其他建築完全分開。

english: The port itself is a tangle of piers, floating docks, and anchorages, from the massive Freighter's Finger pier catering to the heaviest barges to the more ordinary slips at Northtree or Commonsdock. Not actually attached to shore, the chaotic Flotilla is the city's cheapest long-term moorage option, where boats are welcome to raft together around common anchor buoys, and where some houseboats haven't moved in generations. A special division of the Flaming Fist called the Gray Wavers patrols the harbor, yet it's no secret that the more expensive docks are safer than the budget options. Sailors and even whole ships have been known to go missing in Gray Harbor, and while some assume such disappearances are the result of local shore-based pirates, others speak of Ol' Cholms, a mysterious sea beast capable of dragging ships down to the river's lightless bottom.
zh_tw: 港口本身是一個由碼頭、浮動碼頭和錨地組成的迷宮，從為最重的駁船服務的大型貨船之指碼頭，到北樹或公共碼頭更普通的泊位。實際上並不連線到岸邊，混亂的浮船隊是城市最便宜的長期停泊選擇，船隻被歡迎在公共錨浮標周圍聚集，有些船屋幾代人都沒有移動過。一個名為灰浪者的特別部門巡邏著港口，然而，眾所周知，更昂貴的碼頭比預算選擇更安全。水手甚至整艘船在灰港失蹤是眾所周知的，雖然一些人認為這些失蹤是當地海岸海盜的結果，其他人則談論老霍姆斯，一種神秘的海獸，能夠把船拖到河流黑暗的底部。

english: Dusthawk Hill
zh_tw: 塵鷹山

english: East of the city, high above the scattered slums and cut-rate inns that stretch along the trade road, rises the steep yellow granite of Dusthawk Hill. This cliff-skirted hill is one of the last known refuges of the Chionthar dusthawk (use the {@creature hawk} statistics), a once-common raptor whose numbers precipitously declined over the last century as regional turmoil and the ever-spreading slums outside Baldur's Gate consumed its habitat.
zh_tw: 在城市的東側，高聳於沿著貿易道路延伸的零星貧民窟和廉價旅館之上，是塵埃鷹山陡峭的黃色花崗巖。這座懸崖環繞的山丘是奇昂塔塵埃鷹（使用{@creature hawk||隼}的具體數值）最後已知的棲息地之一，這種曾經常見的猛禽在過去一個世紀中由於地區動盪和博德之門外不斷擴張的貧民窟侵佔其棲息地，數量急劇下降。

english: Local legend holds that the dusthawk was Balduran's favorite hunting bird, and that the Chionthar population is descended from his own personal hunting hawks. When the dukes of Baldur's Gate realized that the dusthawk was on the verge of extinction, they declared the hill, which included both the hawks' cliffside nests and their hunting grounds, to be off limits to unlicensed hunters. Despite the fences and cliffs that cordon off most of the hill, trespassers remain common, the demand for dusthawk hunting birds having exploded among the wealthy.
zh_tw: 當地傳說認為塵埃鷹是巴爾杜蘭最喜歡的狩獵鳥，而奇昂塔爾族群是來自他自己的個人狩獵鷹。當博德之門的公爵們意識到塵埃鷹瀕臨滅絕時，他們宣佈這座包括鷹巢的懸崖和狩獵場的小山為未經許可的獵人禁止進入。儘管大部分小山被圍欄和懸崖隔離，但入侵者仍然很常見，因為富裕階層對塵埃鷹狩獵鳥的需求激增。

english: Many in the Outer City resent the hill being turned into private land. Several camps and slums were cleared as a result, their dwellers losing everything. The homeless resent the patriars for being willing to spend money giving hawks a home, but not them. Others resent the Flaming Fist guards who keep them from trapping on the hill. Stringy rabbits and scrawny quail made poor meals, but they were meals, and now many hunters have none.
zh_tw: 外城區的許多人對這座山變成私有土地感到不滿。結果，一些營地和貧民窟被清除，居民們失去了一切。無家可歸者對族長們感到憤怒，因為他們願意花錢為鷹提供家園，卻不為他們提供。還有一些人對焰拳的守衛感到憤怒，因為這些守衛阻止他們在山上設陷阱。瘦弱的兔子和瘦小的鵪鶉雖然只能提供簡陋的餐食，但它們畢竟可以充飢，而現在許多獵人一無所有。

english: Rumors hold that werewolves lair in the sea caves under Dusthawk Hill, pretending to be ordinary smugglers—or ordinary animals—while plotting against the city. Whenever a grisly murder captures Baldurians' imaginations, someone is always quick to claim that it must be one of the Dusthawk werewolves who did the deed.
zh_tw: 有傳言稱，狼人在塵埃山丘下的海洞中築巢，假裝是普通的走私者——或者普通的動物——同時策劃對抗城市。每當一起可怕的謀殺案吸引了巴爾杜爾人的想象力，總有人會迅速聲稱這一定是塵埃山丘的狼人所為。

english: Upper City
zh_tw: 上城區

english: The Upper City, home to the patriar aristocracy of Baldur's Gate, is a place of beauty and splendor, where magnificent public sculptures stand alongside historic manors, upscale theaters and boutiques, and tiny stone-walled gardens tucked among the streets like hidden jewels. Flowers bloom along the tree-lined streets, ushering away any stray miasma that escapes from the less fortunate quarters below. Silks and velvets, gold braid and mink, water-clear diamonds and luminous pearls: these are common sights in the Upper City, and hardly glimpsed elsewhere except as cheap imitations.
zh_tw: 上城區，博德之門貴族的家園，是一個美麗而輝煌的地方，宏偉的公共雕塑與歷史悠久的莊園、高檔劇院和精品店以及隱藏在街道中的小石牆花園並肩而立，宛如隱藏的寶石。花朵在綠樹成蔭的街道上盛開，驅散來自下方不幸區域的任何飄散的瘴氣。絲綢和天鵝絨、金線和貂皮、清澈如水的鑽石和光彩奪目的珍珠：這些在上城區是常見的景象，在其他地方除了作為廉價仿製品外，幾乎難以一見。

english: Everything in the Upper City speaks of privilege and wealth. Magical lights illuminate the clean-swept streets, some bearing enchantments that hold back the river fog. Most of the city's major temples are located in this district, flagrant evidence of how the faiths value the city's wealthy elite over congregants with shallower pockets. The finest wine shops, ateliers, and jewelers are all in the Upper City, where the Watch's nightly ritual of expelling all non-residents reinforces their air of luxurious exclusivity. Those without either Watch-issued tokens or a patriars' vouchsafe must leave at nightfall, without exception.
zh_tw: 上城區的一切都在訴說著特權和財富。魔法燈光照亮了清潔的街道，有些還帶有阻止河霧的魔法。城市中大多數主要的神廟都位於這個區域，這是對信仰如何重視城市富裕精英而非財力較淺的信徒的公然證明。最好的葡萄酒商店、工作室和珠寶店都在上城區，警衛每晚的儀式性驅逐所有非居民加強了他們的奢侈排他性氛圍。那些沒有警衛發放的令牌或族長擔保的人晚上必須離開，無一例外。

english: Residents of the Upper City feel great pressure to maintain outward appearances, and will keep their estate's facade finely maintained even at the cost of pawning everything within. Admitting to poverty in this district is admitting to shameful failure.
zh_tw: 上城區的居民感到巨大的壓力，需要保持外表的形象，甚至不惜抵押內部的一切來精細維護他們莊園的立面。在這個區域承認貧困等同於承認可恥的失敗。

english: The patriars' unabashed snobbery fosters deep resentment among denizens of the Lower City and Outer City, who can see the good life enjoyed before their eyes but are excluded from all but the smallest tastes. The Watch is merciless about turning beggars and malcontents away from the gates, where an erratically enforced entry toll for non-residents and those without Watch tokens or escorts effectively bars the poor from setting foot within this district. A patriar caught outside the Upper City after dark, therefore, is at high risk of robbery, beating, or worse.
zh_tw: 族長們毫不掩飾的勢利行為在下城區和外城區的居民中培養了深深的怨恨，他們可以看到眼前的美好生活，卻被排除在最小的嘗試之外。警衛對將乞丐和不滿者拒之門外毫不留情，非居民和沒有警衛令牌或護送的人的入口通行費執行不規律，有效地阻止了窮人踏入這個區域。因此，晚上被發現在上城區外的族長面臨著被搶劫、毆打或更糟糕的風險。

english: A pallid maid wearing the livery of House Bormul stumbles into a party, whispers "not... shellfish," and passes out.
zh_tw: 一個臉色蒼白的女僕，穿著博姆爾家族的制服，跌跌撞撞地闖入一個聚會，低聲說"不要......吃貝類"，然後暈了過去。

english: A smirking valet eyes the party, slips over, and hands them an elegant crimson envelope: an invitation to a gathering at Eomane House.
zh_tw: 一個冷笑的僕人注視著隊伍，悄悄走過來，遞給他們一個優雅的深紅色信封：這是到艾奧梅恩宅邸參加聚會的邀請。

english: A wide-eyed, fast-talking priest of Gond laments that a thief stole her designs for a "pocket clock." She describes the thief as a tall, perfume-scented man in black wearing a red scarf.
zh_tw: 一位眼睛睜得大大的，說話很快的貢德牧師哀嘆說，一個小偷偷了她設計的"懷錶"。她描述這個小偷是一個高大的、身上有香水味的穿黑色衣服的男人，戴著一條紅色的圍巾。

english: A chatty stranger, Ellyn Harbreeze, invites the party to tea at Harbreeze Bakery, eager to gossip with them.
zh_tw: 一個健談的陌生人，艾琳·哈布利茲，邀請隊伍到哈布利茲麵包店喝茶，渴望與他們閒聊。

english: A merchant giving away samples of her wares offers each party member a free cigar.
zh_tw: 一位商人在分發她的商品樣品，給每個隊伍成員提供免費的雪茄。

english: A street artist offers to sketch one of the characters for the modest fee of 3 copper pieces. The sketch isn't particularly good.
zh_tw: 一位街頭藝術家提出以3銅幣的合理費用為其中一位角色畫素描。這幅素描並不是很出色。

english: A priest of Tymora approaches the party, offering them a small sum to help do a good deed for a poor family at the Lady's Hall.
zh_tw: 一位提莫拉的牧師接近隊伍，提出給他們一小筆錢，幫助他們在女士大廳為一個貧困家庭做好事。

english: Ominous, disembodied whispers reach the party's ears. The whispers lead to Hhune House.
zh_tw: 不祥的、無形的耳語傳入了隊伍的耳朵。這些耳語引導著他們前往休恩莊園。

english: The wizard Lorroakan approaches the party, offering them pay and free waterproofing for their clothing if they help him clean out the cluttered upper floors of Ramazith's Tower.
zh_tw: 法師洛羅坎接近隊伍，提出如果他們幫助他清理拉馬齊斯之塔混亂的上層，他將支付他們費用並免費為他們的衣服做防水處理。

english: Yvandre Rillyn asks if a party member really knows how to use a distinctive weapon they carry. If so, she asks them to be a guest teacher at the Rillyn School.
zh_tw: 伊凡德·瑞林問是否有隊伍成員真的知道如何使用他們攜帶的一把獨特武器。如果知道，她邀請他們去瑞林學校擔任客座教師。

english: One random character is struck by a kite. The kite is being flown by a young boy belonging to a wealthy patriar family. One of the boy's nine bodyguards checks to make sure the character is okay.
zh_tw: 一個隨機的角色被風箏擊中。這個風箏是由一個來自富裕貴族家庭的小男孩操控的。小男孩的九個保鏢之一過來確認這個角色是否安好。

english: A shady broker claims to know exactly what the party needs, leading characters to the Undercellar to show them a selection of interesting but shady goods.
zh_tw: 一位可疑的經紀人聲稱他確切知道隊伍需要什麼，帶領角色們前往下層酒窖向他們展示一系列有趣但可疑的商品。
