english: Lower City Gazetteer
zh_tw: 下城區地理志

english: Presented below in alphabetical order are some of the most noteworthy Lower City locations. These locations are also marked on the city map ({@adventure map 6.2|BGDIA|9|Map 6.2: Baldur's Gate}).
zh_tw: 按字母順序列出的是一些最值得注意的下城區地點。這些地點也在城市地圖上標記出來了（{@adventure 地圖 6.2|BGDIA|9|Map 6.2: Baldur's Gate}）。

english: Baldur's Mouth
zh_tw: 巴爾德爾之口

english: Patronized by all levels of society, Baldur's Mouth is the city's primary news service and gossip rag. Utilizing a small army of lantern bearers, the Mouth spreads news both by selling broadsheets on street corners and by shouting summaries of top stories at passersby. From the slums of the Outer City to the finest manor house sitting rooms, the Mouth is where Baldurians go to be informed, incited, and pleasantly scandalized. While some of the news—such as word of new laws passed by the Council of Four or official election results—is handed down directly by the government, most comes from freelance journalists, and official pronouncements often sit side by side with scathing editorials or unflattering political cartoons of those same officials.
zh_tw: 受到社會各階層的贊助，巴爾杜爾之口是這座城市的主要新聞服務和八卦小報。利用一支小規模的燈籠手隊伍，巴爾杜爾之口透過在街角出售傳單和向路人喊出頭條新聞的摘要來傳播新聞。從外城的貧民區到最精緻的莊園客廳，巴爾杜爾之口是巴爾杜爾人獲取資訊、被煽動情緒和愉快地被醜聞化的地方。雖然一些新聞——比如由四議會透過的新法律或官方選舉結果——是由政府直接下達的，但大多數新聞來自自由撰稿人，官方宣告經常與尖銳的社論或對同一批官員不恭的政治漫畫並列。

english: Ettvard Needle, a chaotic good male human {@creature commoner}, runs the operation from a surprisingly modest converted warehouse in Heapside. The son of an established Lower City tailor, he had always rankled at the way Lower City residents were treated by haughty patriars, and started Baldur's Mouth as a way to empower the city's poor via what he saw as the greatest weapon of social change: information. In the beginning, he simply paid local lantern bearers to shout his stories of upper-crust injustices, but as enthusiasm for the practice built and more people began bringing him information, he began writing the stories down for his distributors—teaching many of them to read in the process—and then selling the notes directly. Today, Needle prints his broadsheets by the cartload, aided by mechanical scribes purchased from the Hall of Wonders and funded by advertisements from merchants across the city.
zh_tw: 艾特瓦德·尼德爾，一位混亂善良的男性人類 {@creature commoner||平民}，在希普塞德一處出人意料地簡陋的改造倉庫中運營著這一切。作為下城區一位知名裁縫的兒子，他一直對高傲的貴族對待下城區居民的方式感到不滿，並因此創辦了《博德之門之聲》，旨在透過他所認為的社會變革最強大的武器——資訊，來賦予城市中的窮人力量。起初，他只是僱當地的提燈人喊出他關於上層社會不公的故事，但隨著這種做法的熱情高漲，越來越多的人開始向他提供資訊，他開始將這些故事寫下來交給他的分發者——同時在這個過程中教會了其中很多人閱讀——然後直接出售這些筆記。如今，尼德爾藉助從奇蹟大廳購買的機械抄寫員，並將資金來自全城商人的廣告，成車印刷他的報紙。

english: Though beholden to advertisers and tacitly sanctioned by the city government, the Mouth has never lost its populist bent. Needle carefully ensures that the paper is useful enough to the government that it's never in their interest to shut it down, yet devotes the rest of the paper to news the government might prefer hushed up, from aristocratic scandal and evidence of corruption to straight talk about various threats to the city, always with a healthy dose of anti-elite rhetoric. His editorials have a particular soft spot for his friend {@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA}, the Guild kingpin of Little Calimshan. While Needle loathes the Guild, he sees in Rilsa's egalitarian tendencies the potential for a hero of the people, and naively hopes she'll transform the Guild from a predatory criminal organization into a community police force serving the city's downtrodden.
zh_tw: 儘管受到廣告商的支援並被市政府默許，但巴爾杜爾之口從未失去其民粹主義傾向。尼德爾小心確保報紙對政府足夠有用，以至於關閉它不符合他們的利益，但同時將報紙的其餘部分用於報道政府可能更願意保持沉默的新聞，從貴族醜聞和腐敗證據到直接談論城市面臨的各種威脅，總是伴隨著大量反精英言論。他的社論特別偏愛他的朋友{@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA|瑞爾薩·雷爾}，小卡利姆珊的公會頭目。儘管尼德爾厭惡公會，但他看到瑞爾薩的平等主義傾向中有著成為人民英雄的潛力，並天真地希望她能將公會從掠奪性犯罪組織轉變為服務於城市底層的社群警察力量。

english: Baldur's Mouth is a prime source of opportunity for adventurers in the city, as Needle is always looking to hire daring "investigative reporters" willing to investigate rumors of strange happenings or procure proof of corruption by the city's elite. Even just reading the broadsheet can present adventure opportunities via advertisements recruiting mercenaries, half-substantiated reports of monster attacks ignored by the Flaming Fist, and more. And of course, should adventurers succeed or fail in some high-profile venture, they might just find caricatures of themselves and stories of their exploits in the Mouth's latest edition.
zh_tw: 巴爾杜爾之口是城市中冒險者的主要機會來源，因為尼德爾總是在尋找敢於調查奇怪事件的傳言或獲取城市精英腐敗證據的"調查記者"。即使只是閱讀傳單，也可以透過招募僱傭兵的廣告、被焰拳忽略的怪物襲擊的半證實報告等，呈現冒險機會。當然，如果冒險者在一些高調的事業中成功或失敗，他們可能會在巴爾杜爾之口的最新版中找到自己的漫畫形象和他們的事蹟故事。

english: Blade and Stars
zh_tw: 刀鋒與星辰

english: This comfortable inn was named for its original sign, an enchanted wooden shield. Painted black, the circular shield displayed an image of a curved silver saber gripped by a pale, slender arm. An enchantment on the shield caused glimmering, starlike motes of light to sparkle along the saber's blade. The former innkeeper of the Blade and Stars, a chaotic neutral half-orc {@creature bandit} named Aurayaun, used to insist that the illusory effect was the shield's only magic, and that it did exactly what she intended it to do: draw in business.
zh_tw: 這家舒適的旅館以它最初的標誌命名，一個被施了魔法的木盾。盾牌被漆成黑色，圓形的盾牌上展示了一個蒼白、纖細的手臂握著一把彎曲的銀色軍刀的影象。盾牌上的魔法使得像星星一樣的閃爍光點沿著軍刀的刀刃閃爍。刀鋒與星辰的前旅館老闆，一個混亂中立的半獸人匪徒{@creature bandit||匪徒}名叫奧拉尤恩，過去總是堅稱這種虛幻的效果是盾牌唯一的魔法，並且它完全按照她的意圖行事：吸引生意。

english: Still, it appears that there's more to the shield's story, for recently both Aurayaun and the shield disappeared. Since then, Aurayaun's worried wife Lupin, a chaotic good female human {@creature commoner}, has been running the inn and loudly expressing her belief that the disappearance is the result of foul play. What kind of foul play, she has no idea.
zh_tw: 然而，似乎盾牌的故事還有更多內容，因為最近奧拉揚和盾牌都消失了。從那時起，奧拉揚擔心的妻子露萍，一個混亂善良女性人類{@creature commoner||平民}，一直在經營這家旅館，並大聲表達她的信念，認為失蹤是惡意行為的結果。是什麼樣的惡意行為，她並不清楚。

english: While Aurayaun was quiet about her past, she had no enemies that Lupin knew about. Lupin furiously rejects the Flaming Fist's conclusion that her wife simply abandoned her. A local vagrant claims to have seen Aurayaun climb up and remove the sign-shield late on the night she went missing, then vanish into an alley with a cloaked figure. Since then, though, Lupin has received parcels containing pieces of the shattered shield, each bearing a tiny constellation upon it. Lupin is convinced it's a map, but to where, and whether that destination is terrestrial or the heavens she doesn't know. She's willing to pay to find out, though.
zh_tw: 儘管奧拉尤恩對自己的過去保持沉默，據盧平所知，她並沒有敵人。盧平憤怒地駁斥了焰拳的結論，即他的妻子只是拋棄了她。一位當地的流浪者聲稱看到奧拉尤恩在她失蹤的夜晚晚些時候爬上去取下標誌盾牌，然後與一個披著斗篷的人物一起消失在一條小巷裡。從那時起，儘管盧平收到了包含破碎盾牌碎片的包裹，每個碎片上都刻有一個小小的星座。盧平確信這是一張地圖，但地圖指向哪裡，以及那個目的地是在地面上還是天上，她並不知道。不過，她願意為此付出代價來找出答案。

english: Blushing Mermaid
zh_tw: 臉紅的美人魚

english: Infamous up and down the Sword Coast, the Blushing Mermaid is known as the best tavern and inn in Baldur's Gate for those looking to get their teeth kicked in, or to kick in someone else's. Always one spilled drink away from a brawl, the bar is the sort of place most don't visit unless they're well-armed or with a lot of friends—preferably both. The place takes its name from the life-sized wooden mermaid hanging above the incongruous reception desk, a dozen blackened and withered hands nailed to its body—souvenirs left by those who refused to pay their bill.
zh_tw: 沿著劍海岸臭名昭著的羞澀美人魚是博德之門最好的酒館和旅館，適合那些想要被人打牙或打別人牙的人。這個酒吧總是距離一場混戰只有一杯灑出的酒的距離，是那種大多數人除非武裝到牙齒或帶著很多朋友——最好是兩者都有——否則不會去的地方。這個地方的名字來源於掛在不協調的接待臺上方的真人大小的木製美人魚，它的身上釘著一打燒焦和枯萎的手——那些拒絕支付賬單的人留下的紀念品。

english: Beyond the combination lobby and common room, the Blushing Mermaid is a confusing maze of wings and oddly interconnected floors, hiding dozens of small and shabby rooms and at least four levels of cellars. Few people bother to sleep at the Mermaid, due in part to its operators' loud pronouncement that they aren't responsible for any losses, including those of life and limb. Instead, its plethora of back rooms and antechambers act as de facto offices for the menagerie of shady characters who spend their days drinking here. Ostensibly retired sailors, the bar's regulars are in fact contacts for a variety of unsavory organizations, from smugglers and bandits to fences, drug dealers, and panderers. Some work for the Guild, others for operations all along the Sword Coast. Those looking to do business with the Gate's underworld find that a handful of silver in the Mermaid can open doors, but the wrong word can find you dumped {@condition unconscious} in the alley out back. While the Mermaid's criminal aspects are an open secret, the place is well connected enough that the Flaming Fist traditionally leaves it alone.
zh_tw: 在兼具大廳和公共休息室的區域之外，臉紅的美人魚是一個令人困惑的迷宮，由多個翼樓和奇怪地相互連線的樓層組成，隱藏著數十間小而簡陋的房間以及至少四層地窖。很少有人選擇在美人魚過夜，部分原因是經營者大聲宣佈他們對任何損失概不負責，包括生命和肢體的損失。相反，這裡眾多的後室和前廳充當了那些整天在此飲酒的陰暗人物的實際辦公室。表面上是退休的水手，這些酒吧的常客實際上是各種不光彩組織的聯絡人，從走私者和土匪到銷贓者、毒品販子和皮條客。有些人為公會工作，其他人則服務於劍灣沿線的各種行動。那些想要與門城的黑社會做生意的人會發現，在美人魚花上幾枚銀幣就可以開啟大門，但說錯一句話可能會讓你被丟在後巷，{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。雖然美人魚的犯罪成分是公開的秘密，但這個地方關係網深厚，以至於焰拳傳統上不會插手。

english: Candulhallow's Funeral Arrangements
zh_tw: 坎杜洛霍洛的葬禮安排

english: For as long as anyone can remember, the moon elves of the Candulhallow family have managed the city's small fleet of corpse carts. Though family members rarely push carts themselves anymore, their terse agents are a constant sight around the city, picking up the dead and using hand-drawn wagons to haul their shrouded loads to the Shrine of the Suffering or outlying cemeteries, funded by city stipends and tips from grieving loved ones.
zh_tw: 據人們所知，坎杜洛霍洛家族的月精靈們管理著這座城市的小規模靈車隊伍。雖然家族成員很少親自推車了，但他們簡明的代理人是城市中常見的景象，他們收集死者，並使用手繪馬車將他們的裹屍布載到苦難聖殿或郊區墓地，資金來源於城市的津貼以及悲傷親人的小費。

english: In secret, the Candulhallows have grown quietly rich off a variety of death-related scams. Chief among these is a secret smuggling arrangement with {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA} to conceal contraband in corpses' funeral wrappings, which the guards and toll collectors never check. Even less savory is the harvesting and sale of corpses or their parts for the city's cultists and necromancers. Chief among these latter customers is the family matriarch, Leylenna Candulhallow, a neutral evil female moon elf {@creature mage} who takes the choicest and rarest of the deceased for her experiments, replacing them with pauper's corpses and weighted coffins. Should any of the family's misdealing come to light, it would doubtlessly shock the city to the core and potentially force Leylenna to reveal the elaborate necromantic masterpiece—an evolution of both art and life—that she's been slowly patching together for months in her basement.
zh_tw: 暗地裡，坎杜洛家族透過各種與死亡有關的騙局悄悄地變得富有。其中最主要的是與{@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA|九指基恩}的秘密走私安排，將走私品藏在屍體的葬禮包裹中，守衛和收費員從不檢查。更不光彩的是，他們收割和出售屍體或其部件給城市的邪教徒和死靈法師。這些後者客戶中最重要的是家族女家長，萊倫娜·坎杜洛，一箇中立邪惡的女性月精靈{@creature mage||魔法師}，她為她的實驗選取最精選和最稀有的死者，用窮人的屍體和加重的棺材替換他們。如果家族的任何不法行為被揭露，無疑會震驚整個城市，並可能迫使萊倫娜揭示她在地下室裡幾個月來慢慢拼湊起來的精心製作的死靈傑作——藝術和生命的進化。

english: Counting House
zh_tw: 會計所

english: This thick-walled fortress of commerce has been a center of trade in Baldur's Gate for centuries, acting as the primary location for banking and currency exchange.
zh_tw: 這座厚牆的商業堡壘幾個世紀以來一直是博德之門的貿易中心，作為銀行業務和貨幣兌換的主要地點。

english: As much a bunker as a bank, the Counting House squats on the waterfront, its two windowless upper stories heavily guarded. Most ordinary patrons never make it past the ground-level offices, yet the majority of the Counting House stretches below, extending down into the mud like a cylindrical stone taproot. Here are the building's legendary vaults, where the city's patriars and merchants from across the world store items too valuable to be trusted to lesser security. Only the most vetted of humanoid guards are allowed in the Counting House's depths. Instead, {@creature Stone Golem||stone golems} patrol the twisting lower corridors, while {@creature Water Elemental||water elementals} circle the outside in flooded channels, keeping thieves from tunneling into the magically warded vaults.
zh_tw: 既是堡壘又是銀行，記賬房坐落在海濱，其兩層樓沒有窗戶且重兵把守。大多數普通客戶從未越過地面層的辦公室，然而記賬房的大部分延伸至下方，像圓柱形的石質主根一樣深入泥中。這裡是建築中傳奇的金庫，城市的貴族和來自世界各地的商人將價值連城的物品存放在這裡，因為它們太珍貴了，不能信任給較低階別的安全措施。只有經過最嚴格審查的人形守衛才被允許進入記賬房的深處。相反，{@creature Stone Golem||石魔像}在曲折的下層走廊巡邏，而{@creature Water Elemental||水元素}在外圍的洪水通道中環繞，防止小偷挖入被魔法保護的金庫。

english: A lawful evil gold dwarf named Rakath Glitterbeard ({@creature bandit captain}) acts as the bank's proprietor and key treasurer of the city's banking crew, the Honorable Order of Moneylenders. More importantly, he's also the Guild kingpin for the Steeps, controlling the lesser loan sharks and knee-cappers who cater to the city's more desperate credit risks, along with its outright thieves. Stolen treasures from innumerable heists reside in the Counting House's vaults alongside legitimate deposits, protected by the bank's walls and Rakath's web of political influence and predatory loans. Between the dwarf's sinister reputation and the bank's legendary security, few thieves would even contemplate trying to crack the Counting House—but anyone who succeeded would likely be set for life.
zh_tw: 一個名為拉卡斯·格利特鬍鬚的守序邪惡金矮人({@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長})擔任銀行的所有者和城市放貸者團體——尊敬的放貸者秩序——的關鍵財務主管。更重要的是，他還是陡坡區的公會頭目，控制著那些為城市中更絕望的信貸風險服務的小額貸款者和膝蓋折斷者，以及它的徹頭徹尾的小偷。無數搶劫案中被盜的寶藏存放在會計所的金庫中，與合法存款一起，受到銀行牆壁和拉卡斯的政治影響力及掠奪性貸款網路的保護。在矮人的邪惡聲譽和銀行傳奇般的安全之間，很少有小偷會考慮試圖破解會計所——但任何成功的人可能會為一生而設定。

english: Eastway Expeditions
zh_tw: 東道探險隊

english: Eastway Expeditions used to buy dubious exploration and dungeon-delving gear on the cheap—often from hollow-eyed early retirees—before marking it up to sell to optimistic would-be heroes. Scalm Shilvin, a neutral female tiefling {@creature spy}, is the shop's slick, tail-coat-wearing tiefling proprietor. She made a decent living from her business, but all that changed when Baldur's Gate forged a lucrative trade alliance with the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru in Chult.
zh_tw: 東行探險公司過去常常以低廉的價格購買可疑的探險和地下城探險裝備——通常來自眼神空洞的早期退休人員——然後提高價格出售給樂觀的潛在英雄。斯卡爾姆·希爾文，一位中立的女性提夫林{@creature spy||間諜}，是這家商店的光滑、穿著燕尾服的提夫林老闆。她從她的生意中過上了體面的生活，但當博德之門與楚爾特的南扎路港的商王建立了有利可圖的貿易聯盟時，一切都改變了。

english: Shilvin quickly capitalized on the growing interest in Chult, outfitting droves of green adventurers and directing them aboard ships headed south. Most never returned—leaving her uncertain of whether any of her "jungle-proof" or "dinosaur-deterring" equipment worked as she'd marketed. Eventually the local government got involved after several overly ambitious patriar scions vanished on ventures hastily outfitted by Eastway Expeditions. Now Shilvin can sell her modest selection of goods and any jungle-related gear only after a ten-day waiting period, helping to ensure that fewer citizens rush off to Chult unprepared. To make up for the resulting loss of business, Shilvin has made connections with several trading (and piratical) ventures in regular need of crew. Eastway Expeditions has since gained a low-key reputation for helping people get out of the city fast, so long as they don't care overly much where they go.
zh_tw: 希爾文迅速抓住人們對楚爾特日益增長的興趣，為大批新手冒險者配備裝備並安排他們登上南下的船隻。大多數人再未歸來——這讓她不確定自己推銷的那些「叢林專用」或「恐龍驅避」裝備是否真的有效。最終當地政府介入此事，起因是幾位野心過大的貴族子弟在使用東徵探險隊倉促提供的裝備後失蹤。現在希爾文必須經過十天等待期才能銷售她有限的商品和任何與叢林相關的裝備，以此確保較少市民毫無準備地衝向楚爾特。為了彌補由此帶來的業務損失，希爾文已與幾家經常需要船員的貿易（及海盜）企業建立聯絡。東徵探險隊從此獲得了一個低調名聲：只要不在乎目的地，就能幫你快速離開這座城市。

english: Elfsong Tavern
zh_tw: 精靈之歌酒館

english: Despite its rough-and-tumble clientele, this tavern is one of the most popular in Baldur's Gate. At infrequent and seemingly random intervals, a disembodied elven voice cuts through the crowd, its song haunting enough to magically dim the room's lanterns and make even the bar's most hardened customers weep.
zh_tw: 儘管顧客群體粗魯，這家酒館是博德之門最受歡迎的酒館之一。在不頻繁且看似隨機的間隔中，一個脫離肉體的精靈聲音穿透人群，它的歌聲足以神奇地使房間的燈籠變暗，甚至讓酒吧裡最鐵石心腸的顧客流淚。

english: For more information about this establishment, see {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}.
zh_tw: 有關這個機構的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}。

english: Felogyr's Fireworks
zh_tw: 費洛吉爾的焰火

english: This four-story stone structure constantly streams smoke of unusual colors from various vents and chimneys. From the elaborate showroom spanning the bottom two floors, alchemist Avery Sonshal (neutral male human {@creature mage}) maintains his family's longstanding monopoly on {@item smokepowder|WDH} production in Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 這座四層的石質建築不斷從各種通風口和煙囪中排放出不尋常顏色的煙霧。從橫跨底層兩層的精緻展廳中，鍊金術士艾弗裡·桑沙爾（中立男性人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）維護著他家族在博德之門對{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}生產的長期壟斷。

english: While {@item smokepowder|WDH} is reserved for the Council of Four and Gond's High House of Wonders, the shop sells a variety of lesser alchemical items to the public, from torches with colored flames to smoke grenades and fireworks, some of them enhanced with harmless illusions. While the windowless workshop filling the building's upper two stories is strictly off-limits, its stairwell blocked by a massive iron vault door and a {@creature thug} hired from the Bannerless Legion, the mutton-chopped Avery is usually happy to chat with customers and other alchemical enthusiasts on the lower floors.
zh_tw: 雖然{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}是為四議會和貢德的奇蹟高殿保留的，但這家商店向公眾出售各種較低階別的鍊金術物品，從帶有彩色火焰的火炬到煙霧彈和焰火，其中一些增強了無害的幻象。雖然填滿建築上兩層的無窗車間嚴格禁止進入，其樓梯井被一扇巨大的鐵庫門和從無旗軍團僱傭的{@creature thug||暴徒}阻擋，但留著鬢角的艾弗裡通常樂於在較低樓層與顧客和其他鍊金術愛好者聊天。

english: At the moment, however, Avery is visibly troubled. Recently, someone managed to break into the upper workshop while he was sleeping and steal four kegs of {@item smokepowder|WDH}. In their place, he found a drawing of a phoenix. Avery is terrified of what the thieves might do with the powder—he's all too aware that someone with that much {@item smokepowder|WDH} could blow up a portion of the High Hall, Wyrm's Rock, or any number of other fortifications. Yet as horrifying as he finds those possibilities, he seems more concerned about himself: {@item smokepowder|WDH} security is his responsibility, and he can't tell the city government about the theft without getting punished for negligence. Yet if he keeps quiet and the thieves use the powder, he'll obviously be implicated. The only solution is to hire someone discreet and trustworthy to track down and recover the missing kegs of {@item smokepowder|WDH} before it's too late.
zh_tw: 然而，目前艾弗裡顯然很煩惱。最近，當他睡覺時，有人設法闖入上層的工作室，偷走了四桶{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}。在它們的位置，他發現了一隻鳳凰的圖畫。艾弗裡非常擔心小偷們會用這些粉末做什麼——他非常清楚，有人擁有那麼多的{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}可能會炸燬高廳、龍石，或其他許多防禦工事的一部分。然而，儘管他發現這些可能性很可怕，他似乎更擔心自己：{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}的安全是他的責任，如果他告訴市政府盜竊的事情，他將因疏忽而受到懲罰。但如果他保持沉默，小偷使用粉末，他顯然會被牽連。唯一的解決辦法是僱傭一個謹慎可靠的人追蹤並找回失蹤的{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}桶，以免為時過晚。

english: If {@item smokepowder|WDH} is set on fire, dropped, or otherwise handled roughly, it explodes and deals fire damage to each creature or object within 20 feet of it: {@dice 1d6} for a handful, {@dice 9d6} for a keg. A successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on {@item smokepowder|WDH} renders it permanently inert.
zh_tw: 如果 {@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉} 被點燃、掉落或處理不當，它將會爆炸並對 20 尺範圍內的每個生物或物體造成火焰傷害：少量火藥為 {@dice 1d6}，一桶火藥為 {@dice 9d6}。成功透過 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免可使傷害減半。對 {@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉} 施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} 會使其永久失效。

english: Garmult's House of Mastery
zh_tw: 加穆爾特武藝館

english: Part school and part alehouse, this wide three-story building leans precariously over the street in Eastway. Run by an old, agender martial artist named Garmult (neutral good human {@creature gladiator}), the House of Mastery offers both martial training of all sorts for the city's would-be warriors and a central hangout for the Bannerless Legion crew. Garmult assists crew leader Dezri "Guts" Lamouer in matching clients with mercenaries. They also hire members to teach classes in the building's open-air atrium while other members lounge on the overlooking balconies. At any given time, there's usually multiple veteran mercenaries here swapping stories and waiting for contracts.
zh_tw: 這棟寬敞的三層樓建築兼作武術學館與酒館，朝東道街面危險地傾斜。經營者是年邁、無性別的武術家加穆爾特（中立善良的人類{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}）。武藝館提供各式武術訓練，吸引城中有志成為戰士的人，也作為無旗軍團幫派的聚會據點。加穆爾特協助首領德茲裡「腸子」拉穆爾替客戶與傭兵牽線，並僱用團員在露天中庭授課，其他人則在上方陽臺休息。任何時候通常都有幾位老練傭兵在這裡交換見聞、等待委託。

english: While anyone can pay Garmult to study in the House of Mastery, only those who've earned membership in the Bannerless Legion are welcome to socialize and find work here. Those who come around looking for such things are challenged to a friendly sparring match in the atrium, usually with Garmult. If they impress Garmult, they're welcomed with a laugh and a firm handshake, at which point Garmult is happy to hook the new members up with bodyguarding contracts and other work, taking only a nominal finder's fee. Though not everyone in the Legion is as welcoming of new members, Garmult allows only consensual, nonlethal sparring within their establishment. Few members challenge Garmult's authority for risk of missing out on future contracts.
zh_tw: 儘管任何人都可以支付加穆爾特在武藝館學習，但只有那些在無旗軍團中獲得會員資格的人才會在這裡受到歡迎，進行社交和找工作。那些來到這裡尋找這些的人通常會在中庭與加穆爾特進行一場友好的搏擊比賽。如果他們給加穆爾特留下深刻印象，他們會以笑聲和堅定的握手被歡迎，此時加穆爾特很樂意為新成員提供保鏢合同和其他工作，並只收取象徵性的中介費。雖然軍團中的並非所有人都歡迎新成員，但加穆爾特只允許在他們的場所內進行雙方同意的、非致命的搏擊。很少有成員挑戰加穆爾特的權威，因為擔心錯失未來的合同。

english: Harborside Hospital
zh_tw: 海濱醫院

english: Generations ago, an outbreak of extremely contagious dancing croup—a deadly plague that caused those afflicted to cough themselves to death even as their limbs thrashed uncontrollably—caused many Baldurians to rethink their approach to medicine. Requiring individual victims to seek out healing from their respective clergies accelerated the disease's spread as the infected traveled to different houses of worship throughout the city, overwhelming the facilities at each. In the aftermath, the Lower City decided to consolidate. While patriars might still be able to afford house calls and personal priests and physicians, commoners funded the building of a single large facility where everyone could come for treatment. Eager to no longer have every worship service interrupted by contagious congregants, several of the city's temples were only too happy to provide clerics to work in the facility. Of course, coin still determines one's quality of care, the clerics rarely work for free, and those without sufficient funds generally end up in the ominously stained basement with the chirurgeons-in-training—but at least those in need know where they can go for help. Chronically understaffed, especially in those wards catering to poor Outer City residents, the hospital has constant security problems, from angry patients to spontaneously arising undead, unethical or experimental treatments by priests of non-good faiths, or excessive withdrawals from the stores of painkilling narcotics.
zh_tw: 幾代人前，一種極易傳染的舞蹈性哮吼病爆發——一種致命的瘟疫，導致患者即使四肢無法控制地抽動，也會咳到死亡——讓許多巴爾杜爾人重新思考他們的醫療方法。要求個別受害者尋求他們各自神職人員的治癒加速了疾病的傳播，因為感染者前往城市中不同的宗教場所，壓倒了每個地方的設施。事後，下城區決定合併。雖然貴族們仍然能夠負擔得起家庭訪問和個人神職人員和醫生，但平民資助建造了一個大型設施，供所有人前來接受治療。為了不再讓每一次禮拜服務都被傳染的會眾打斷，城市的幾個寺廟非常樂意提供神職人員在該設施工作。當然，金錢仍然決定了一個人的護理質量，神職人員很少免費工作，那些沒有足夠資金的人通常最終會進入帶有實習外科醫生的不祥汙漬的地下室——但至少需要幫助的人知道他們可以去哪裡尋求幫助。醫院長期人手不足，特別是那些為貧困的外城居民提供服務的病房，醫院不斷面臨安全問題，從憤怒的患者到突然產生的不死生物，非善良信仰的神職人員的不道德或實驗性治療，或過度提取止痛藥庫存。

english: It perhaps says something about Baldur's Gate that city officials decided to build the hospital right next to Cliffgate, convenient to the graveyard and as far as possible from the wealthy neighborhoods.
zh_tw: 這或許說明瞭博德之門的一些事情，城市官員決定將醫院建在懸崖門旁邊，靠近墓地，儘可能遠離富裕的社群。

english: Hissing Stones
zh_tw: 嘶嘶石

english: This low stone bathhouse in the Seatower neighborhood is one of the oldest buildings in the area. Built in the Chessentan style, it features heated pools, echoing halls, and gorgeous tile mosaics.
zh_tw: 這個位於海塔區的低矮石質浴室是該地區最古老的建築之一。它以切森坦風格建造，設有加熱池、迴音大廳和華麗的瓷磚馬賽克。

english: The Hissing Stones hold a special niche in Baldurian politics due to its status as a neutral, safe, and private meeting place. Its longtime proprietor, a neutral female moon elf {@creature spy} named Merilyn Allaryr, ensures that clients enter the baths bearing nothing but the thin robes she provides, leaving all weapons and other possessions with her. Merilyn's reputation, and that of her highly capable attendants, is formidable enough that even rival crews or businesses engaged in the tensest of negotiations never violate the house's rule against violence.
zh_tw: 由於其作為中立、安全和私密會面場所的地位，嘶嘶石在巴爾杜爾政治中佔有特殊地位。其長期所有者，一位中立的女性月精靈{@creature spy||間諜}名叫梅里琳·阿拉里爾，確保客戶進入浴室時只穿著她提供的薄袍，將所有武器和其他財物留給她。梅里琳的聲譽以及她非常能幹的服務員的聲譽足夠強大，即使是參與最緊張談判的對立團隊或企業也從不違反該房屋的反暴力規則。

english: This establishment's commitment to discretion also makes the bathhouse the prime venue for paid companionship in the Lower City. Many of the most sought-after courtesans meet their patrons in the Hissing Stones' steamy private rooms, trusting to Merilyn's silence and the house's reputation for business meetings to deflect the suspicion of jealous spouses or gossipy wags. Unlike Merilyn, the Reveler's Union—the city-spanning crew of night-workers—isn't averse to selling secrets teased from the bathhouse's clients, and those looking to purchase such information need only whisper in the right ear here. Though this dichotomy keeps Merilyn herself from officially joining the Union, the crew uses the location as its de facto headquarters, regularly renting out and conducting meetings in its vast central pool.
zh_tw: 這家機構對隱私的承諾也使得浴室成為下城付費陪伴的首選場所。許多最受歡迎的情婦在嘶嘶石的蒸汽私密房間與他們的贊助人見面，信任梅莉琳的沉默和房子的商務會議聲譽來轉移嫉妒配偶或愛說閒話的人的懷疑。與梅莉琳不同，狂歡者聯盟——遍佈城市的夜班工作者團隊——並不介意出售從浴室客戶那裡逗引出來的秘密，那些想要購買這類資訊的人只需要在這裡輕聲細語。儘管這種二元性使梅莉琳本人無法正式加入聯盟，但該團隊將這個地點作為其事實上的總部，定期租用並在其廣闊的中央池中進行會議。

english: Insight Park
zh_tw: 洞察公園

english: Forty years ago, an lawful neutral shield dwarf {@creature druid} named Torimesh arrived home in the city after decades of adventuring abroad and purchased this small portion of the hillside. Too steep to build on, the area had long been an illegal junkyard, with locals standing atop a rocky promontory and dumping their refuse over the edge of the embankment. Instead of clearing the debris away, Torimesh used magic to nurture the local plants, causing a forest of green to grow up over the garbage, rusting away debris and creating soft lawns and thickets shot through with small recesses and tunnels where the old refuse had piled high. This revamped space he dedicated as a public park, arguing that the poor need to feel nature's touch just as much as rich patriars with their manicured gardens. Torimesh himself lives in a tiny hut backed against the jutting outcropping still known as Dumper's Rock.
zh_tw: 四十年前，一位名為託利梅什的守序中立護盾矮人{@creature druid||德魯伊}在國外冒險數十年後回到了家鄉的城市，併購買了這片山坡的一小塊地。由於地勢過於陡峭，無法建造房屋，這片區域長期以來一直是一個非法的垃圾場，當地人站在岩石岬角上，將垃圾傾倒到堤岸的邊緣。託利梅什沒有將垃圾清除乾淨，而是使用魔法培育當地的植物，使一片綠色森林在垃圾上生長起來，讓垃圾逐漸鏽蝕，形成了柔軟的草坪和茂密的灌木叢，其間散佈著一些小的凹陷和隧道，這些地方曾經堆積著高高的舊垃圾。他將這片改造後的空間作為公園向公眾開放，認為窮人與擁有精心修剪花園的富有的貴族一樣，也需要感受到自然的觸控。託利梅什本人住在一間小屋裡，小屋背靠著一片突出的岩石，這片岩石至今仍被稱為"傾倒者之石"。

english: The main appeal of Insight Park is the Drawing Tree. Planted by Torimesh and grown to full-size in a matter of days, the tree is of a species no one can identify, and Torimesh steadfastly refuses to say anything about its origins, yet everyone knows its power. When properly entreated by Torimesh, the tree's red bark cracks and curls like parchment. Pulling it carefully away reveals a prophetic scene rendered in bloody sap. These arboreal visions of the future are often cryptic, yet inevitably come to pass. As much as the city's elite would love to harness this power, anyone else attempting to peel the tree's bark or force a prophecy reveals only bark and sends Torimesh into a near-murderous rage. For his part, the druid refuses to work for money, peeling off prophecies only according to the unspoken whims of the tree, or in exchange for bizarre and dangerous favors.
zh_tw: 洞察公園的主要吸引力是畫圖樹。這棵樹由托里梅什種植，僅在幾天內就長到了全尺寸，它是一種無人能識別的物種，托里梅什堅決拒絕透露其起源的任何資訊，但每個人都知道它的力量。當托里梅什適當地請求時，樹的紅色樹皮會像羊皮紙一樣裂開和捲曲。小心地剝開它，會揭示出用血紅色樹液渲染的預言場景。這些關於未來的樹木幻象通常很隱晦，但最終總會實現。儘管城市精英很想利用這種力量，但任何試圖剝去樹皮或強迫預言的人都只會發現樹皮，並將托里梅什激怒至近乎謀殺的憤怒。就他而言，這位德魯伊拒絕為金錢工作，只有在樹的無言願望下剝去預言，或以換取奇怪而危險的好處。

english: Jopalin's
zh_tw: 喬帕林的

english: After taking over from his father, a neutral evil male half-elf {@creature thug} named Jopalin transitioned this building from a seedy dockside tavern to a thriving, upscale teahouse. Many were shocked by the growth of such a sophisticated establishment among the port's lowbrow customers, but no one can deny the addictive nature of the half-elf proprietor's special blend. Jopalin includes sable moonflower leaves in his tea, creating a subtle, slow-building addiction among those who drink it. Many never realize what's happening, knowing only that they deeply crave his tea above all others, and for those who do uncover the scam, it's often too late, leaving them with no choice but to keep coming back. Jopalin personally watches over the customers and ensures that only those who seem vulnerable get the "special" tea, avoiding suspicion from any who might decide to fight back if the truth were to come out.
zh_tw: 從他父親手中接管後，一箇中立邪惡的男性半精靈{@creature thug||暴徒}名叫喬帕林將這座建築從一家破舊的碼頭酒館轉變為一家繁榮的高檔茶館。許多人對這樣一個精緻的場所在港口低俗的顧客中的成長感到震驚，但沒有人能否認半精靈老闆特製混合茶的上癮本質。喬帕林在他的茶中加入了黑月花葉，這在喝茶的人中創造了一種微妙的、逐漸增強的癮。許多人從未意識到發生了什麼，只知道他們深深地渴望他的茶超過其他所有茶，對於那些發現這個騙局的人，通常為時已晚，讓他們別無選擇，只能繼續回來。喬帕林親自監督顧客，並確保只有那些看起來易受傷害的人得到"特別"的茶，避免任何可能決定反擊真相大白的人的懷疑。

english: Jopalin also runs a more traditionally squalid moonflower den in the shop's damp basement, catering to ordinary addicts and those who've become so reliant on the tea that they can no longer pass as normal customers. These sad cases are shuffled in through an entrance in the building next door to avoid suspicion, where a group of thugs presides over several dozen filthy cots, collecting Jopalin's fees and dispensing his moonflower supply. The paranoid Jopalin himself lives in a lavish and heavily booby-trapped loft above the café.
zh_tw: 喬帕林還在店鋪潮溼的地下室經營著一個更傳統的骯髒月夜花窩點，迎合普通癮君子和那些對茶如此依賴以至於不能再作為正常顧客的人。這些可悲的案例透過隔壁建築的一個入口被帶進來以避免引起懷疑，那裡有一群暴徒管理著幾十張骯髒的床鋪，收取喬帕林的費用並分發他的月夜花供應。偏執的喬帕林本人住在咖啡館上方一個豪華且設有重重陷阱的閣樓裡。

english: Low Lantern
zh_tw: 矮提燈

english: This old, three-masted ship rocks gently in the water alongside Stormshore Street Dock on the harbor's eastern side. A notorious festhall and tavern, the ship is no longer seaworthy and is in desperate need of repair.
zh_tw: 這艘老舊的三桅帆船在港口東側的風暴海岸街碼頭旁輕輕搖擺。作為一個臭名昭著的娛樂廳和酒館，這艘船已不再適合航行，迫切需要修理。

english: On warm days and evenings, respectable clients can sit at tables on the upper deck beneath hanging lanterns, smoking and drinking between wagers, while a more raucous crowd congregates around bars and gambling tables on the decks below.
zh_tw: 在溫暖的日子和晚上，體面的客戶可以坐在上層甲板上掛著燈籠的桌子旁，一邊吸菸和喝酒，一邊下注，而更喧鬧的人群則聚集在下面甲板上的酒吧和賭博桌周圍。

english: For more information about this establishment, see {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}.
zh_tw: 有關這個機構的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}。

english: Mandorcai's Mansion
zh_tw: 曼多卡伊的大廈

english: The only blight in otherwise upscale Bloomridge, this mansion appeared out of nowhere in the middle of the night, taking over a previously vacant lot. Fully staffed with close-lipped servants, the imposing manse hosted a few lavish parties for the Lower City elite, presided over by an eccentric and brooding human wizard named Mandorcai. And then, just as suddenly as he had arrived, Mandorcai shut the manor's doors and vanished from public life. Curious locals who peered through the windows reported a completely empty manor, its furniture looking as though it hadn't been touched in years. Yet soon thereafter, individuals around the city began to receive invitations to visit, written in silver on black paper folded into pentagons.
zh_tw: 在其他方面都是高檔的布盧姆裡奇中唯一的汙點，這座豪宅在一夜之間突然出現，接管了之前空置的地塊。完全由守口如瓶的僕人組成，這座威嚴的大廈為下城區的精英舉辦了幾次奢華的派對，由一個古怪而憂鬱的人類法師曼多卡伊主持。然後，就像他突然出現一樣，曼多卡伊關閉了莊園的大門，從公共生活中消失了。好奇的當地人透過窗戶報告說，這座豪宅完全空無一物，傢俱看起來好像多年未動。然而不久之後，城市中的個人開始收到訪問邀請，邀請函是用銀色寫在黑色紙上，折成五邊形。

english: Those who entered the mansion for the requested appointments never emerged. After a handful of such disappearances, a Flaming Fist squad smashed its way into the building. Only two of its members emerged, babbling about shifting rooms and blood-soaked abattoirs filled with writhing hooks and chains. With no laborers willing to tear the place down, the Council of Four boarded up the doors but left the mansion standing. For decades now, no one has been observed going in or out. Whether the little black invitations that still occasionally appear on citizens' doorsteps are genuine or harmless pranks remains anyone's guess.
zh_tw: 那些應邀進入大廈的人從未出現。在一些這樣的失蹤事件之後，火焰之拳小隊闖入了這座建築。只有兩名成員出現，他們胡言亂語地談論著變換的房間和血跡斑斑的屠宰場，裡面充滿了扭曲的鉤子和鏈條。由於沒有工人願意拆除這個地方，四議會封上了門但保留了大廈。幾十年來，沒有人被觀察到進出。那些偶爾出現在市民門前的小黑色邀請函是否真實或無害的惡作劇，仍然是任何人的猜測。

english: In truth, Mandorcai gained occult knowledge and his magical manor in a bargain with the obese twin {@creature Chain Devil||chain devils} Kyrix and Valisog. For years Mandorcai upheld his side of the contract by bringing the fiends mortal sacrifices, until an accidental breach of contract let the devils haul him screaming into the Nine Hells. Since then, the mansion's hungry traps and shape-changing powers have lain dormant. Recently, however, a group of {@creature Cultist||cultists} have broken into the house, seeking to harness its fell powers. Though they haven't yet figured out how to commune with the chain devils yet, when they do, it'll likely be without the safeguards Mandorcai managed to negotiate, potentially resulting in fiendish disaster for the whole neighborhood.
zh_tw: 實際上，曼多卡伊透過與肥胖的雙胞胎{@creature Chain Devil||鏈魔}凱裡克斯和瓦利索格的交易獲得了神秘知識和他的魔法莊園。多年來，曼多卡伊透過為魔鬼提供凡人祭品來履行他的合同，直到一次意外的合同違約讓魔鬼將他尖叫著拖入九層地獄。從那時起，這座豪宅的飢餓陷阱和變形力量一直處於休眠狀態。然而，最近，一群{@creature Cultist||邪教徒}闖入了房子，試圖利用其邪惡的力量。儘管他們還沒有弄清楚如何與鎖鏈魔鬼交流，但當他們這樣做時，很可能沒有曼多卡伊設法談判的安全措施，可能會導致整個社群的魔鬼災難。

english: Seatower of Balduran
zh_tw: 巴爾杜蘭的海塔

english: The headquarters of the Flaming Fist stands on a rocky islet in the harbor, its sheer walls erupting from the stone in such a way as to grant invaders from the sea few footholds. From the fortress's five stout towers, specially made Gondan trebuchets stand ready to hurl stones three times the distance of an ordinary siege weapon, giving the fortress command of not just the entire harbor but the opposite bank of the river as well. Any invading ships not intimidated by such death from above would also have to contend with the massive chain running from the Seatower to pilings under the easternmost wharf in Brampton. A capstan in the tower can raise the chain, stretching it across the harbor mouth and keeping anything larger than a rowboat from entering or leaving. As for land-based attacks, the 400-foot-long causeway connecting the Seatower's islet to the shore needs no gates or drawbridges, as any attackers foolish enough to charge along its length would be easy marks for the wall's archers.
zh_tw: 火焰之拳的總部坐落在港口中的一個岩石小島上，其陡峭的牆壁從石頭中突兀而出，幾乎不給來自海上的入侵者留下立足點。從堡壘的五個堅固塔樓中，特製的貢丹投石機已準備就緒，能夠投擲三倍於普通攻城武器距離的石塊，這不僅賦予了堡壘對整個港口的控制，還有對河對岸的控制。任何不被這種來自上方的死亡威脅嚇退的入侵船隻，還必須應對從海塔到布蘭普頓最東邊碼頭下的樁子的巨大鏈條。塔中的絞盤可以升起鏈條，將其橫跨港口入口，阻止任何比劃艇大的船隻進出。至於基於陸地的攻擊，連線海塔小島與海岸的400尺長的堤道不需要大門或吊橋，因為任何愚蠢到沿著其長度衝鋒的攻擊者都將很容易成為城牆弓箭手的目標。

english: Roughly a hundred Flaming Fist soldiers occupy the fortress at any given time, along with the residents of the Officers' Tower. In the central bailey, the organization's vast armory holds every weapon a mercenary company could need, along with trophies from campaigns abroad, a priceless library of war-related texts, and more. Rumors also speak of the Fist's treasury, kept in a lead-lined vault somewhere beneath the Officers' Tower and surrounded by yards of solid stone, the secret doors leading to its vaults hidden by clever mechanisms and cleverer magic.
zh_tw: 大約有一百名焰拳士兵隨時駐紮在這座堡壘中，以及軍官塔的居民。在中央庭院中，該組織的龐大軍械庫擁有僱傭兵公司可能需要的每一種武器，以及來自國外戰役的戰利品，無價的戰爭相關文字圖書館，等等。還有傳言說焰拳的財寶，存放在軍官塔下方某個鉛襯的金庫中，周圍是數碼厚的實心石頭，通往其金庫的秘密門被巧妙的機械和更聰明的魔法所隱藏。

english: In addition to defending the city, the Seatower also serves as the local prison of Baldur's Gate. Three levels of dungeons extend beneath it, the lower two below sea level and integrating part of a naturally occurring cavern system. This both keeps the prison secure and pacifies prisoners, as any who act out know that they can always be moved from the dry cells to the dank lower levels. Particularly problematic inmates end up in the Swimming Hole—a flooded and lightless shaft where prisoners must constantly tread water or risk drowning, while also fending off the blind, biting shrimp that dwell there. Though long-term incarceration is rare in the city, there are always a few inmates rotting in these cells, ranging from petty criminals to political prisoners locked away on trumped-up charges.
zh_tw: 除了保衛城市，海塔還充當博德之門的當地監獄。三個級別的地牢位於其下方，其中較低的兩個位於海平面以下，並與自然形成的洞穴系統的一部分相結合。這既確保了監獄的安全，也安撫了囚犯，因為任何表現出反抗行為的人都知道，他們隨時可能從乾燥的牢房被轉移到潮溼的下層。特別有問題的囚犯最終會被關進"游泳洞"——一個被水淹沒且沒有光線的豎井，囚犯們必須不斷地踩水以避免溺水，同時還要抵禦那裡居住的盲目、咬人的蝦。儘管在這座城市長期監禁是罕見的，但總有一些囚犯在這些牢房裡腐爛，從輕微的罪犯到因捏造的指控而被關押的政治犯。

english: Characters who run seriously afoul of the law in Baldur's Gate might wind up in the Seatower. While the Fist treats the prison as something of an afterthought, any trying to break in or out of the dungeons still have their work cut out for them. Only the upper cells have windows, and anyone trying to break through the walls of the lower cells risks catastrophic flooding. Sentries are constantly on alert for ships drawing suspiciously near the island, and no one is allowed through the fortress's gate without a reason and an escort. Cells themselves have heavy steel doors with high-quality locks, with the keys held by Jailer Albrecht Little, a lawful neutral male human {@creature gladiator}, or his second, Jailer Cogrus Stonehammer, a lawful neutral female shield dwarf {@creature knight}. Soldiers are often assigned to "cell duty" as a temporary punishment—while this generally means rougher treatment for prisoners, the regular turnover might present a sliver of opportunity for anyone attempting a rescue.
zh_tw: 在博德之門嚴重違法的角色可能會最終被關進座椅塔。雖然拳頭把監獄當作一種事後的想法，但任何試圖闖入或逃出地牢的人都還有他們的工作要做。只有上層牢房有窗戶，任何試圖打破下層牢房牆壁的人都冒著災難性洪水的風險。哨兵不斷警惕地監視著可疑靠近島嶼的船隻，沒有人可以在沒有理由和護送的情況下透過堡壘的大門。牢房本身有沉重的鋼門和高質量的鎖，鑰匙由監獄長阿爾布雷希特·利特爾持有，他是一個守序中立的男性人類{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}，或者是他的副手，監獄長科格魯斯·斯通哈默，一個守序中立的女性盾矮人{@creature knight||騎士}。士兵經常被分配到"牢房值班"作為臨時懲罰——雖然這通常意味著囚犯受到更粗暴的對待，但人員經常更替可能會為任何試圖營救的人提供一個微小的機會。

english: Seskergates
zh_tw: 塞斯克爾門

english: Once home to the Sesker merchant family, this tall, gaudy mansion was abandoned after the last member of the family died in it under mysterious circumstances several years ago. Shortly thereafter, a neutral evil human {@creature mage} from Athkatla named Imbralym Skoond bought the place to use as his home and magical workshop, drawn there by stories of the structure's original builder, a smuggler who turned the place into a warren of secret passages, hidden rooms, false walls, and concealed entrances, most of which have now been forgotten.
zh_tw: 這座高大而俗麗的大廈曾經是塞斯克商人家族的家，幾年前家族的最後一位成員在其中神秘死亡後，這座大廈就被廢棄了。不久之後，一位來自阿特卡特拉的中立邪惡人類{@creature mage||魔法師}，名叫伊姆布拉利姆·斯科恩德，購買了這個地方作為他的家和魔法工作室，他被這座建築的原始建造者的故事所吸引，這位走私者將這個地方變成了一個充滿秘密通道、隱藏房間、假牆和隱蔽入口的迷宮，其中大部分現在已經被遺忘。

english: Ambitious and thoroughly amoral, Skoond rose to prominence as the Council of Four's wizard, doing regular favors for the council to further his own plots. Though rarely home, he boards four alchemist lackeys in the building, along with several guards, using the secret passages to cover their comings and goings. Their only job is to uncover and map out as many of the building's secrets as possible—one of the histories Skoond read suggested that the building's original architect had died while smuggling a rare magical tome, leading him to suspect that it still lies hidden in the house's walls.
zh_tw: 斯科恩德雄心勃勃且徹底不道德，作為四議會的法師而聲名鵲起，定期為議會做點小恩小惠以推進自己的計劃。雖然他很少在家，但他在大樓裡寄宿了四名鍊金術助手和幾名守衛，利用秘密通道來掩蓋他們的來來往往。他們唯一的工作是儘可能多地發現和繪製大樓的秘密——斯科恩德讀過的歷史之一暗示，大樓的原始建築師在走私一本稀有的魔法書籍時死了，這讓他懷疑這本書仍然隱藏在房子的牆壁裡。

english: Unfortunately, Skoond's apprentices aren't the only ones searching. Drawn up through hidden tunnels by the magical auras of both the tome and neighboring Mandorcai's Mansion, a {@creature nothic} lurks in the house's passages, using them to spy on the wizards and search for the treasure. So far, none of the residents have detected it—the last person to do so was the previous owner, killed by the nothic's rotting gaze. Though evil and unwilling to cede claim to the tome—which it hasn't yet located—the nothic is full of secrets from both its spying and its weird oracular abilities, and might be willing to sell them for the right price.
zh_tw: 不幸的是，斯科恩德的學徒並不是唯一在尋找的人。由於魔法書籍和鄰近的曼多卡伊大廈的魔法光環的吸引，一個{@creature nothic||諾斯怪}透過隱藏的隧道潛入房子的通道中，利用它們來監視法師並尋找寶藏。到目前為止，沒有一個居民察覺到它——最後一個這樣做的人是前主人，被諾斯怪的腐爛凝視所殺。儘管邪惡並不願意放棄對它尚未找到的魔法書籍的所有權，這個諾斯怪充滿了從其間諜活動和其怪異的神諭能力中獲得的秘密，並且可能願意以合適的價格出售它們。

english: Sewer Keep
zh_tw: 下水道守衛

english: Like many port cities, Baldur's Gate has traditionally dumped its sewage downstream and let the river carry its problems elsewhere. As the city grew, however, this began to dangerously pollute the river, leading a coalition of druids and patriars to construct the Sewer Keep.
zh_tw: 像許多港口城市一樣，博德之門傳統上將其汙水排放到下游，讓河流將其問題帶到其他地方。然而，隨著城市的增長，這開始危險地汙染河流，導致一群德魯伊和貴族聯合建造了下水道守衛。

english: A series of three towers built into the walls at the western end of the Seatower neighborhood, the facility was intended to treat the sewage just before it enters the river, using vast enclosed holding tanks of magically augmented plants to purify the effluent. Though the facility was a marvel of magical ecological engineering, the public proved singularly unwilling to care about their waste, and funding quickly collapsed. Since then, the Keep has been a shadow of its intended glory, struggling to keep the worst of Baldur's Gate from the waterway.
zh_tw: 這是一組建在海塔區西端城牆內的三座塔樓，該設施的目的是處理汙水，在它進入河流之前，使用大量封閉的、用魔法增強的植物來淨化廢水。儘管該設施是魔法生態工程的奇蹟，但公眾證明特別不願意關心他們的廢物，資金很快枯竭。從那時起，這個設施一直是其預期輝煌的陰影，努力防止博德之門最糟糕的情況進入水道。

english: Today, the facility still operates, but mostly as a headquarters and cover for the Sewerkeepers crew. Most of the "druids" and technicians running the plant are anything but—instead, they're a specialized thieving crew that uses the keep's position to pass unseen through the city's network of sewer pipes and cisterns. From this warren of tunnels, they can smuggle goods and conduct daring burglaries, as well as occasionally acting as subterranean monster-hunters and paid guides through the city's guts.
zh_tw: 如今，這個設施仍在運營，但主要是作為下水道守衛團隊的總部和掩護。大多數運營該廠的"德魯伊"和技術人員實際上並非如此——相反，他們是一支專業的盜竊團隊，利用守衛的位置透過城市下水道和蓄水池的網路悄無聲息地移動。從這個隧道迷宮中，他們可以走私貨物，進行大膽的盜竊，以及偶爾充當地下怪物獵人和城市內臟的付費嚮導。

english: The Sewerkeepers' leader, Genamine Kopali (neutral evil female human {@creature assassin}), also acts as the Guild kingpin for the Seatower neighborhood. Along with a spectrum of ne'er-do-wells, her crew also contains several actual {@creature Druid||druids} who keep the facility running and control the crew's several guardian beasts, including a number of sweet-smelling {@creature Shambling Mound||shambling mounds} that live in the tanks, churning them as part of the purification process. {@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA} (see "{@adventure Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|1|{@dice D29}. Mortlock Vanthampur}") pays Genamine to keep him apprised of strange activities in the sewers. Mortlock, in turn, reports whatever he learns to his mother, {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA}.
zh_tw: 排水管守護者的首領，傑娜敏·科帕利（中立邪惡女性人類{@creature assassin||刺客}），同時也擔任席塔社群的行會頭目。除了各式各樣的無賴之外，她的團隊中還有幾位真正的{@creature Druid||德魯伊}，他們維持著設施的執行，並控制著團隊的幾隻守護獸，包括幾隻生活在淨化池中的芳香{@creature Shambling Mound||蔓生怪}，它們攪動池水，作為淨化過程的一部分。{@creature Mortlock Vanthampur|BGDIA|摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾}（見"{@adventure 摩特洛克·範薩姆普爾|BGDIA|1|{@dice D29}。莫特洛克·範塔普爾}"）付錢給傑娜敏，讓她隨時向他彙報下水道中的異常活動。莫特洛克則將他所知道的一切報告給他的母親，{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩拉瑪拉·範薩姆普爾公爵}。

english: Shrine of the Suffering
zh_tw: 苦難聖殿

english: This simple stone shrine to Ilmater, god of martyrs and patient endurance, stands in a small, quiet square, the edges of its plaza thick with the pallets and meager belongings of the Lower City's homeless population. Here, poor Baldurians can come to receive free meals and enough coppers to pay their way through the city's gates, thanks to the ministrations of Brother Hodges, a lawful good male strongheart halfling {@creature priest}. Supported by donations from all ranks of society and beloved by their community, the halfling cleric and his adult children Hansen and Sissa (both lawful good strongheart halfling {@creature Acolyte||acolytes}) can inevitably be found here chatting with the city's downtrodden, offering what healing and alms they can.
zh_tw: 這個簡單的石頭神殿供奉著伊爾馬特，殉道者和耐心忍耐之神，它坐落在一個小而安靜的廣場上，廣場邊緣堆滿了下城區無家可歸者的墊子和微薄的財產。在這裡，貧窮的巴爾杜爾人可以來領取免費餐食，並獲得足夠的銅幣來支付他們穿過城市大門的費用，這要感謝霍奇斯兄弟的關懷，他是一個守序善良男性強壯心半身人{@creature priest||祭司}。在社會各階層的捐贈支援下，受到他們社群的喜愛，這位半身人牧師和他的成年子女漢森和西莎（都是守序善良強壯心半身人{@creature Acolyte||侍僧}）總是可以在這裡找到，與城市的不幸者交談，提供他們所能的治療和施捨。

english: The church's only source of non-donation income is a twisting series of crypts that extends down from an entrance behind the altar, at several points piercing the city's sewers. For a small fee, anyone can have a corpse brought down into the cramped tomb, where hordes of sewer rats flood in to eat the flesh, leaving (mostly) clean bones to be interred in the attached ossuary by Ilmater's faithful. While a somewhat ignoble end, it's often the only holy-ground burial the city's poor can afford, and Brother Hodges does his best to bring quiet dignity to the practice. However, a fertile {@creature carrion crawler} has recently slithered up from the sewers to feast on the corpses in the tomb, leaving a trail of squirming young wherever it passes. Brother Hodges is incensed by the desecration, but doesn't dare face the beasts himself, and the Flaming Fist has been slow to come to his aid. Though the church can't pay, he would gratefully offer free healing to anyone who dealt with the menace.
zh_tw: 教堂唯一非捐贈收入的來源是一系列曲折的地下墓穴，這些墓穴從祭壇後面的入口一直延伸下去，並在幾個點穿過了城市的排水系統。只需支付少量費用，任何人都可以將一具屍體送入這狹窄的墓穴，成群的排水溝老鼠會湧入啃食屍體，留下（大部分）乾淨的骨頭，然後由伊爾馬特的信徒將其安葬在附帶的骨灰堂中。雖然這種結局有些不夠體面，但它往往是這座城市裡的窮人唯一負擔得起的聖地下葬方式，而霍吉斯兄弟盡他所能為這一做法帶來了安靜的尊嚴。然而，最近一隻肥沃的{@creature carrion crawler||食腐蟲}從排水溝中爬出，在墓穴中以屍體為食，所到之處留下一串蠕動的幼崽。霍吉斯兄弟對這種褻瀆行為感到憤怒，但他不敢親自面對這些野獸，而焰拳的援助又遲遲未到。雖然教堂無法支付報酬，但他會感激地向任何處理這一威脅的人提供免費的治療。

english: Smilin' Boar
zh_tw: 微笑野豬

english: With its downright ribald menu of salaciously renamed breakfast foods, the Smilin' Boar was always intended to cause a stir in well-to-do Bloomridge. Yet the current buzz is more than owner Jentha Allinamuch, a chaotic good female strongheart halfling {@creature commoner}, ever intended. For the past six months, bodies have been appearing in the alley just behind the halfling's café. More than a dozen have appeared so far, never with any witnesses as to how they go there. The victims have no apparent commonalities—being of all ages, races, genders, and social classes, and having disappeared from points all across the city—yet there's no question in anyone's mind that the same killer is responsible, as each is found with curved slices across their wrists and a heart-piercing wound. The whole district is astir over the murders, but so far the Fist hasn't been able to turn up any leads on what locals have fearfully dubbed the Sickle Man. With business plummeting, Jentha is as eager as any grieving family to find answers, and would happily pay independent investigators to help track down the killer. In fact, the killer is not one person, but a group of Dead Three cultists looking to spread fear in the city (see "{@area Hamhocks Slaughterhouse|3be|x}").
zh_tw: 以其直白的下流選單，重新命名的早餐食品，微笑野豬本意是在富裕的布盧姆裡奇引起轟動。然而，目前的熱議超出了店主珍塔·阿利納穆奇，一個混亂善良女性強心半身人{@creature commoner||平民}的預期。在過去的六個月裡，屍體開始出現在半身人咖啡館後面的小巷裡。到目前為止，已經出現了十幾個，沒有人知道它們是如何到達那裡的。受害者沒有任何明顯的共同點——年齡、種族、性別和社會階層各不相同，且從城市的各個地方消失——但毫無疑問，同一個殺手負責，因為每個受害者的手腕上都有彎曲的切口，並且心臟被刺穿。整個區域都因謀殺案而騷動，但到目前為止，拳頭（警局）還沒有找到任何線索，當地人恐懼地稱之為鐮刀人。隨著生意的急劇下滑，珍塔和任何悲痛的家庭一樣渴望找到答案，並願意支付獨立的調查員幫助追蹤殺手。實際上，殺手不是一個人，而是一群死亡三人教派的信徒，他們試圖在城市中傳播恐懼（見"{@area 火腿屠場|3be|x}"）。

english: Sorcerous Sundries
zh_tw: 魔法雜貨

english: A dome of stained glass roofs this tall, round shop, casting chaotic shafts of color down across several open-air floors that rise upon wooden pillars, connected by staircases and ladders. While the living quarters upstairs teem with rare plants and bookcases, the bottom floor acts as one of the most popular magic shops in the city. Inside its delicate-looking but magically warded walls, customers can buy and sell all manner of curios and common magic items from the eccentric shopkeeper, Rivalen Blackhand, a neutral male human {@creature mage} with a withered right hand.
zh_tw: 一個彩色玻璃圓頂覆蓋著這家高大的圓形商店，將混亂的色彩光束投射到幾個由木柱支撐、透過樓梯和梯子連線的露天樓層上。雖然樓上的生活區充滿了稀有植物和書架，底層則作為城市最受歡迎的魔法商店之一。在其外觀精緻但被魔法保護的牆壁內，顧客可以購買和出售各種奇特和常見魔法物品，店主是裡瓦倫·黑手，一箇中立的男性人類{@creature mage||魔法師}，右手枯萎。

english: Blackhand almost always has {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} available for sale. He also typically has up to 500 gp on hand to buy items from those with interesting magical wares, though he's a savvy bargainer and rarely pays anything close to full price.
zh_tw: 黑手幾乎總是有{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}出售。他還通常手頭有高達500金幣用來購買那些擁有有趣魔法商品的人的物品，儘管他是一個精明的討價還價者，很少支付接近全價的價格。

english: Currently, the wizard finds himself in the grip of an unusual protection racket. His supposed apprentice Gilligunn, a neutral evil female rock gnome {@creature spy}, is actually a Guild member. Whenever Blackhand makes a sufficiently large transaction, Gilligunn secretly tracks the customer, leading an appropriately sized group of Guild toughs to ambush them days later, knowing they'll be carrying either a large sum of money or a valuable magic item they can sell back to Blackhand. Though the shopkeeper isn't happy with the arrangement, the Guild varies its patterns enough to keep suspicion away from him, and he has to admit it's a better deal than paying protection money himself.
zh_tw: 目前，這位法師發現自己陷入了一個不尋常的保護費勒索中。他所謂的學徒吉利貢，一箇中立邪惡的女性岩石地侏{@creature spy||間諜}，實際上是公會的成員。每當黑手進行一筆足夠大的交易時，吉利貢就會秘密跟蹤客戶，幾天後帶領一群合適規模的公會硬漢伏擊他們，知道他們將攜帶一大筆錢或他們可以賣回給黑手的有價值的魔法物品。儘管店主對這種安排不滿意，但公會變化其模式足以使懷疑遠離他，他不得不承認這比他自己支付保護費要好。

english: Water Queen's House
zh_tw: 水之女王之屋

english: The oldest temple in Baldur's Gate, the Water Queen's House clings to its enormous pier like a monster of the deep, its stone walls trailing over the side and descending down beneath the waves and river mud. At the pier's tip, a huge fountain in the shape of a sinking ship sprays water high, reminding faithful of the price of failing to appease Umberlee.
zh_tw: 博德之門最古老的神殿，水之女王之家依附在它巨大的碼頭上，就像深海中的怪物一樣，它的石牆沿著一側延伸並在波濤和河流泥沙下延伸。在碼頭的尖端，一個巨大的沉船形狀的噴泉高高噴水，提醒信徒們如果不安撫烏姆貝爾利，就會付出代價。

english: The intimidating Allandra Grey, a chaotic evil female human {@creature priest}, leads the temple's score of waveservants, most of them women widowed or orphaned by the sea. Ordinary Baldurians rarely see the waveservants, and never step inside the temple. When the faithful wish to make offerings, they must ring a bell by the door. Two waveservants (chaotic evil female human {@creature Acolyte||acolytes}) answer the door, one accepting the offering inside while the other says a short prayer in the doorway. Once the prayer is spoken and the donation collected, they step back and close the door.
zh_tw: 令人生畏的阿蘭德拉·格雷，一個混亂邪惡的女性人類{@creature priest||祭司}，領導著寺廟的一群海浪僕人，其中大多數是被大海奪去丈夫或孩子的寡婦或孤兒。普通的巴爾杜爾人很少見到海浪僕人，也從不踏入寺廟。當信徒希望獻祭時，他們必須按響門邊的鈴。兩位海浪僕人（混亂邪惡的女性人類{@creature Acolyte||侍僧}）應門，一位在門內接受獻祭，而另一位在門口唸一段簡短的祈禱。一旦祈禱完畢，捐款收集完畢，她們就後退並關上門。

english: Though no outsiders know exactly how the temple's finances work, the dour waveservants buy little in the markets save essentials. The rest of the tithes are carried in solemn procession down crumbling, moss-covered stairs that cling to the outside of the temple and descend into the murky water. The waveservants disappear below the water for a few minutes, only to return empty-handed. What happens to the treasures is anyone's guess, with some suggesting they're hidden in underwater vaults. Others believe the gifts are borne away by Umberlee herself. In truth, the waveservants leave the treasures at the bottom of the staircase, where they are fetched within the hour by {@dice 2d6} {@creature sahuagin} led by a {@creature sahuagin priestess}. The sahuagin make the long trip from the Sea of Swords to obtain these treasures, and in exchange, they refrain from attacking the city, its harbor, and ships heading out to sea.
zh_tw: 儘管沒有外來者確切知道這座寺廟的財務是如何運作的，陰沉的海浪僕人們在市場上除了必需品外很少購買其他東西。其餘的什一稅以莊嚴的行列沿著附著在寺廟外部、長滿苔蘚的搖搖欲墜的樓梯下行，深入渾濁的水中。海浪僕人們在水下消失幾分鐘，然後空手而歸。寶藏發生了什麼，誰也說不準，有人猜測它們被藏在水下的金庫中。其他人相信這些禮物是由烏姆伯莉本人帶走的。實際上，海浪僕人們把寶藏留在了樓梯底部，它們在一個小時內被{@dice 2d6}名{@creature sahuagin||鯊華魚人}在一名{@creature sahuagin priestess||鯊華女祭司}的帶領下取走。鯊華魚人人從劍海長途跋涉來獲取這些寶藏，作為交換，他們避免攻擊這座城市、它的港口以及出海的船隻。

english: If the waveservants wish harm to befall a ship or its crew, they leave a clam with the treasure in the water. When the clam is opened, it magically recites up to 25 words in Common. This information helps the sahuagin identify the ship. The sahuagin priestess uses a {@spell tongues} spell to translate the clam's words, then executes an attack on the ship during the next new moon.
zh_tw: 如果浪潮侍者們希望一艘船或其船員遭遇不幸，他們會將一隻蛤蜊與財寶一起留在水中。當蛤蜊被開啟時，它會用通用語魔法般地誦讀多達25個詞。這些資訊幫助鯊華魚人識別船隻。鯊華魚人女祭司使用一個{@spell tongues||巧言術}法術來翻譯蛤蜊的話語，然後在下一次新月時對船隻發動攻擊。

english: Outer City
zh_tw: 外城區

english: Dirty and uncouth, the Outer City holds everything the elite of Baldur's Gate resist allowing within their walls: the poor, refugees, tanneries and stockyards, and other industries that offend highborn sensibilities. Stretching forth from each of the city's external gates, the Outer City sprawls in a chaotic tangle of shanties and shops, carts and tents lining the roads in hopes of bleeding off enough city trade for their owners to survive. And indeed, much of the commerce in Baldur's Gate happens in these unregulated markets, with even patriars shopping from inside perfumed litters.
zh_tw: 骯髒且粗俗，外城擁有博德之門精英們拒絕在其城牆內允許的一切：窮人、難民、製革廠和屠宰場，以及其他冒犯高貴感覺的工業。從城市的每個外門延伸出來，外城在棚屋和商店、手推車和帳篷的混亂糾結中蔓延，希望沿著道路排開足夠多的城市貿易，以便它們的主人能夠生存。的確，博德之門的大部分商業活動都發生在這些無監管的市場中，甚至貴族們也在香氛轎子裡購物。

english: While smaller neighborhoods such as Tumbledown and Blackgate squat outside their respective gates, the majority of the Outer City runs along the Coast Way as it curves around the foot of Duskhawk Hill, between Wyrm's Crossing and the city proper. Residents of these neighborhoods are not technically citizens and receive no representation in the government, nor do they receive the benefit of the city's police forces. The Flaming Fist rarely patrols the Outer City, usually emerging only to pursue Outer City residents for crimes committed within the walls.
zh_tw: 雖然像塔姆布羅恩和布萊克蓋特這樣的較小社群分別位於他們各自的城門外，但外城的大部分地區沿著海岸路延伸，在黃昏山腳下彎曲，位於龍之十字路口和城市主體之間。這些社群的居民從技術上講不是公民，在政府中沒有代表權，也沒有享受到城市警察部隊的好處。焰拳很少巡邏外城，通常只在追擊在外城牆內犯下罪行的外城居民時才會出現。

english: The Outer City's challenges lead to small, tightly knit communities, where a person's honor and social connections are the only things standing between them and a quick death.
zh_tw: 外城的挑戰導致形成了小而緊密的社群，在那裡，一個人的榮譽和社會聯絡是他們與快速死亡之間唯一的屏障。

english: Approaching the City
zh_tw: 接近城市

english: Visitors approaching Baldur's Gate by road first pass through the Outer City's ramshackle neighborhoods, their traffic hemmed in by cook fires, market stalls, and industries too noisy or repugnant for more genteel citizens. Here travelers must leave any sizable mounts or beasts of burden at one of countless stables and caravanserais before paying the fees to pass through the gates into the city proper. Travelers from the south are twice blessed in this regard, paying once for the bridge at Wyrm's Crossing and again once they've run the gauntlet of Outer City neighborhoods circling Duskhawk Hill.
zh_tw: 透過道路接近博德之門的訪客首先穿過外城破敗的社群，他們的交通被烹飪火、市場攤位和對於更文雅的市民來說太吵鬧或令人厭惡的工業所限制。在這裡，旅行者必須在無數的馬廄和旅館中留下任何大型坐騎或馱獸，然後支付費用透過城門進入城市。來自南方的旅行者在這方面是雙重幸運的，他們先是為穿越龍之十字路口的橋樑支付一次費用，然後在穿越環繞黃昏鷹山的外城社群的通道後再次支付。

english: Travelers arriving via the river wait in the center of Gray Harbor, under the watchful eye of the Seatower, until one of the harbormaster's agents approaches in a fast-moving skiff. Protected by coteries of Gray Wavers (Flaming Fist {@creature Veteran||veterans}), these customs officials assess the boat's cargo, collect taxes, and sell hourly berth assignments at one of the city's many docks and piers. Large vessels may also pay to make use of the city's marvelous mechanical cranes, dramatically accelerating their unloading process.
zh_tw: 透過河流抵達的旅行者在灰色海港中心等待，處於座椅塔的警惕監視之下，直到港務長的代理在一艘快速移動的小艇中接近。由灰浪者（焰拳{@creature Veteran||老兵}）組成的小團體保護的這些海關官員評估船隻的貨物，收取稅費，並在城市眾多碼頭和棧橋之一出售按小時計費的泊位分配。大型船隻也可以付費使用城市奇妙的機械起重機，大大加快它們的卸貨過程。

english: Neighborhoods
zh_tw: 社群

english: The following neighborhoods make up the Outer City.
zh_tw: 以下社群構成了外城。

english: {@b Blackgate}. The Outer City settlement beyond the Black Dragon Gate, Blackgate serves those traveling to and from Waterdeep on the Trade Way. Huge stables cater to travelers' mounts, while a community of shield dwarf ironsmiths draws even residents of the Upper City with their skill.
zh_tw: {@b 黑門}。位於黑龍門外的外城定居點，黑門為往返於貿易之路上的深水城的旅行者提供服務。巨大的馬廄迎合旅行者的坐騎需求，而一群盾矮人鐵匠以其技藝甚至吸引了上城居民。

english: {@b Little Calimshan}. This walled community's Calishite inhabitants fiercely guard their home from the Guild and the rest of Baldur's Gate. Little Calimshan is further detailed in "{@area Little Calimshan|3bf|x}".
zh_tw: {@b 小卡利姆沙}。這個有圍牆的社群的卡利希特居民激烈地保護他們的家園免受公會和博德之門其餘部分的侵擾。小卡利姆沙在 "{@area 小卡利姆沙|3bf|x}" 中有更詳細的描述。

english: {@b Norchapel}. The quietest of the Outer City neighborhoods, Norchapel caters to those residents willing to pay more than the usual protection money to the Guild, in exchange for having their safety and security.
zh_tw: {@b 諾爾教堂}。外城區中最安靜的社群，諾查佩爾迎合那些願意支付比通常的保護費更多的居民，以換取他們的安全和保障。

english: {@b Rivington}. This self-contained village of anglers and river-powered mills is the first neighborhood encountered by travelers approaching from the south. Dominated by a local gang called the Rivington Rats, it's also a haven for smuggling thanks to its river access.
zh_tw: {@b 裡文頓}。這個自給自足的漁民和河流動力磨坊村莊是來自南方的旅行者遇到的第一個社群。它由一個名為裡文頓老鼠的地方幫派控制，並且由於其河流通道，也是一個走私的避風港。

english: {@b Sow's Foot}. Here, expatriates from dozens of far-flung nations mingle with races ranging from lizardfolk to svirfneblin among the scents of exotic food and the calls of strange animals, banding together against a city that views them as outsiders.
zh_tw: {@b 豬腳}。在這裡，來自數十個遙遠國度的外籍人士與從蜥蜴人到深矮人等種族混合在一起，在異國食物的香氣和奇怪動物的叫聲中相互交流，團結起來對抗一個將他們視為外來者的城市。

english: {@b Stonyeyes}. Just outside the Basilisk Gate that gives it its name, this neighborhood is full of stables and stockyards. Many Outer City residents who work within the city live here to be as close as possible to their places of business. Among them is a significant community of half-orc porters.
zh_tw: {@b 石眼}。這個社群位於以其命名的石蜥門之外，充滿了馬廄和牲畜圍欄。許多在城內工作的外城居民住在這裡，以便儘可能靠近他們的工作地點。其中有一個重要的半獸人搬運工社群。

english: {@b Tumbledown}. Off by itself overlooking the river, this perpetually foggy neighborhood hosts the Cliffside Cemetery.
zh_tw: {@b 破落區}。這個獨自坐落在河邊上方，常年多霧的社群擁有懸崖邊的墓地。

english: {@b Twin Songs}. Standing ready to welcome visitors as they cross the river, Twin Songs is renowned for its enormous diversity of shrines and places of worship, from tiny roadside altars and idols to home-based temples. While those in search of significant magic must still generally visit the larger temples in the city proper, no god is too foreign or obscure to be worshiped in Twin Songs' divine sprawl, where even non-criminal worship of fiends and the Dead Three goes unchallenged.
zh_tw: {@b 雙生之歌}。當訪客過河時，雙歌區準備迎接他們，以其巨大的神殿和禮拜場所的多樣性而聞名，從小型路邊祭壇和雕像到家庭式寺廟。雖然那些尋求重要魔法的人通常仍需訪問城市中較大的寺廟，但在雙歌區的神聖蔓延中，沒有神太外來或太隱秘而不能被崇拜，甚至對惡魔和死亡三者的非犯罪崇拜也未受挑戰。

english: {@b Whitkeep}. This neighborhood takes its name from the white manor house at its center, which houses the city's largest enclave of gnomes. Free-spirited and home to hordes of artists, the neighborhood would likely attract trendy city folk and price out the resident radicals, if not for its odoriferous tanneries.
zh_tw: {@b 懷特基普}。這個社群的名稱來源於其中心的白色莊園，那裡是城市最大的侏儒聚居地。這個社群自由奔放，是眾多藝術家的家園，很可能會吸引時尚的城市居民，並且趕走居民中的激進分子，如果不是因為其散發著惡臭的製革廠的話。

english: {@b Wyrm's Crossing}. This massive bridge crosses the Chionthar River. Shops and homes gird the bridge's edges. See "{@area Wyrm's Crossing|3c3|x}" for more information.
zh_tw: {@b 飛龍渡}。這座巨大的橋樑橫跨奇昂塔河。商店和住宅環繞在橋的兩側。欲瞭解更多資訊，請參見"{@area 飛龍渡|3c3|x}"。
