english: Balduran Looks Out to Sea
zh_tw: 巴爾杜蘭望向大海

english: Shortly after Balduran disappeared for the final time, this statue appeared on the cliffs of Tumbledown. Twice the size of the actual man, the statue bears an uncanny likeness to Balduran, squinting west over city and river. While its sudden arrival created something of a stir, most assumed it was simply a tribute to the great man—until one morning several months later when passersby noticed that one of the statue's hands had risen to shade its eyes. Scholars immediately began studying the statue, learning that at sunrise on the first day of each new year, the statue flickers, changing its position in an eyeblink. Though it always looks west, the precise line of its gaze can change by up to thirty degrees, and it may peer through a spyglass, stand with hands on hips, point with an open hand, and so on.
zh_tw: 在巴爾杜蘭最後一次消失後不久，這座雕像出現在了破敗區的懸崖上。這座雕像是實際人物的兩倍大小，與巴爾杜蘭有著驚人的相似之處，它眯著眼睛向西俯瞰城市和河流。雖然它的突然出現引起了一些騷動，但大多數人認為這只是對這位偉人的致敬——直到幾個月後的一個早晨，過路人注意到雕像的一隻手已經舉起以遮擋眼睛。學者們立即開始研究這座雕像，發現在每個新年的第一天的日出時分，雕像會閃爍，瞬間改變其姿勢。儘管它總是向西看，但它的凝視精確線可以改變多達三十度，並可能透過望遠鏡窺視，雙手叉腰站立，用張開的手指示等等。

english: For centuries, the predominant theory was that Balduran still lived somewhere far to the west, and the statue tracked his movements. Yet a generation ago, a knight of Oghma vowed to follow the line of the statue's gaze as far as necessary to learn the truth. His journey was shorter than expected. In a wood just a few miles west of the city, he came upon a cylindrical stone building, its open doorway revealing stairs leading down into the forest floor. Atop the building, a smaller statue of Balduran stared back the way he had come. Prevented from entering by a pattern of magical lights he couldn't identify, the knight raced back to the city to gather additional scholars—yet when he returned, the structure was gone. Since then, the forested structure—which popular stories now refer to as Balduran's Tomb—has been discovered three more times in the same fashion, each time in a different location, yet so far no one has been able to enter.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀以來，主要的理論是巴爾杜蘭仍然生活在遙遠的西方某處，而雕像追蹤著他的移動。然而在一代人之前，一位奧格瑪的騎士發誓要跟隨雕像目光的方向，儘可能遠地去了解真相。他的旅程比預期的要短。在城市西側僅幾英里的樹林中，他發現了一個圓柱形的石制建築，其敞開的門道揭示了通往森林地面的樓梯。在建築頂部，一個較小的巴爾杜蘭雕像凝視著他來時的方向。由於無法識別的魔法光線圖案而無法進入，騎士急忙回到城市召集更多的學者——然而當他回來時，這個結構已經消失了。自那以後，這個森林中的結構——現在流行的傳說稱之為巴爾杜蘭的墳墓——已經以相同的方式被發現了三次，每次都在不同的地點，但到目前為止，沒有人能夠進入。

english: Cliffside Cemetery
zh_tw: 懸崖墓地

english: The value of land and sheer population density in Baldur's Gate means only the wealthiest patriars can afford to bury their dead within the city, interring them in catacombs beneath the city's temples or in family crypts on their own grounds. For everyone else, there's the ignoble Shrine of the Suffering or the scattering of cemeteries outside the city. The largest of the latter is Cliffside Cemetery, located in the Tumbledown neighborhood and employing many local residents as gravediggers, stonemasons, morticians, and professional mourners.
zh_tw: 在博德之門，土地價值和人口密度意味著只有最富有的貴族才能負擔得起在城內埋葬死者的費用，將他們安葬在城市神廟下的地下墓穴或自家的家族墓穴中。對於其他人來說，還有不太體面的苦難神殿或城外散落的墓地。後者中最大的是懸崖墓地，位於塔姆布羅恩社群，僱傭了許多當地居民作為掘墓人、石匠、殯儀員和職業哀悼者。

english: Long ago, the graveyard was an empty estate owned by the mercantile Szarr family, with only a few family crypts near the cliffs. When a business rival murdered the entire family in their beds, no one was eager to move into their former manor, and the city decided to turn the estate into a single massive graveyard that acts as the primary repository for the city's dead.
zh_tw: 很久以前，這個墓地是一個空曠的莊園，屬於商人薩札爾家族所有，莊園裡只有幾個家族墓穴靠近懸崖。當一個商業競爭對手在床上謀殺了全家後，沒有人急於搬進他們以前的宅邸，城市決定將這個莊園變成一個巨大的墓地，作為城市死者的主要存放地。

english: The graveyard itself is a maze of crypts and monuments, its organization nearly impossible for outsiders to discern as the multi-chamber ossuaries of rich merchants and pirate lords loom over the simple plaques and rotting wooden holy symbols of the poor. Natural cavern systems have been expanded and shored up to create extensive crypts, yet over generations maps have been lost or poorly updated, and it's not uncommon for a gravedigger to find themselves striking the wood of a coffin where no coffin should be, or tumbling through into a forgotten stretch of tunnel. Rampant grave robbery by brigands and necromancy-obsessed followers of Myrkul only increases the chaos, as bodies get exhumed and reburied wherever it's convenient. Most significantly, a major landslide decades ago dropped a large portion of the cemetery's cliff into the river below, causing the remaining bone-houses and markers to shift and lean, while also exposing numerous crypts and tomb-tunnels to the air, prompting a fresh rush of grave robbing. Though Baldurians rarely bury their dead with valuables anymore, and many of the easier pickings have been taken, it's common wisdom that some of the greatest treasures of past centuries still lie entombed with their heroes, their headstones wiped anonymously clean by wind and rain.
zh_tw: 這個墓地本身是一個由墓穴和紀念碑組成的迷宮，其組織結構對於外來者來說幾乎無法辨認，因為富裕商人和海盜領主的多室骨灰堂高聳在窮人簡單的牌匾和腐爛的木製聖物之上。自然洞穴系統已經被擴建和加固，以建立廣泛的墓穴，但經過幾代人的時間，地圖已經丟失或更新不當，所以掘墓人發現自己在本不應該有棺材的地方敲擊棺材木頭，或者跌入被遺忘的隧道延伸段，這並不罕見。強盜猖獗的墳墓搶劫和痴迷於米爾庫爾的死靈法師追隨者只會增加混亂，因為屍體被挖掘出來並隨處重新埋葬。最顯著的是，幾十年前的重大山體滑坡使墓地的一大部分懸崖掉入下面的河流，導致剩餘的骨灰屋和標記移動和傾斜，同時也使許多墓穴和墓道暴露在空氣中，引發了新一輪的墳墓搶劫熱潮。儘管巴爾杜爾人很少再將他們的死者與貴重物品一起埋葬，而且許多容易得到的戰利品已經被取走，但普遍認為過去幾個世紀的一些最偉大的寶藏仍然與他們的英雄一起被埋葬，他們的墓碑被風雨匿名地擦洗乾淨。

english: Watching over all of this is the powerful Gravemakers crew. Far more than simply caretakers and laborers, the Gravemakers guard the dead—and Tumbledown—from threats. With so much death concentrated in one spot, undead are a constant problem. Skeletons and revenants regularly claw spontaneously out of their graves, while ghouls and ghasts burrow into crypts and catacombs, drawn by the scent of decaying flesh. Wights hide in their tombs by day, while ghosts and wraiths terrorize unsuspecting mortals. Putting down such threats before they can prey on citizens is the Gravemakers' primary job, and though rightfully proud of their prowess, their leader Leone Wen, a lawful good female human {@creature knight} and servant of Torm, is always looking for fresh recruits or contractors to join them in their crusade. The crew operates out of the half-burned old Szarr Mansion in the cemetery's center, its moldering halls reputedly still infested by the ghosts of the murdered Szarrs—though stories remain split as to whether the ghosts prey on the Gravemakers or aid them in their duty.
zh_tw: 守護著這一切的是強大的掘墓幫團隊。他們不僅僅是看護人和勞動者，掘墓幫保護死者和破敗區免受威脅。由於如此多的死亡集中在一個地方，不死生物是一個持續存在的問題。骷髏和還魂鬼定期自發地從墳墓中爬出，而食屍鬼和幽靈則被腐爛肉體的氣味吸引，鑽進墓穴和地下墓室。屍妖白天藏在他們的墳墓裡，而鬼魂和幽靈則恐嚇毫無戒備的凡人。在這些威脅能夠捕食市民之前消除它們是掘墓幫的主要工作，儘管他們對自己的能力感到自豪，但他們的領袖，利昂·溫，一個守序善良女性人類{@creature knight||騎士}和託姆的僕人，總是在尋找新招募或承包商加入他們的十字軍東徵。團隊在墓地中心的半燒燬的舊薩札爾大廈運作，據說這座腐朽的大廳仍然被被謀殺的薩札爾家族的鬼魂侵擾——儘管關於這些鬼魂是捕食掘墓幫還是幫助他們履行職責的故事仍然存在分歧。

english: Church of Last Hope
zh_tw: 最後的希望教堂

english: This combined chapel and asylum in the Twin Songs neighborhood has long offered sanctuary for the depressed and mentally ill. The few attendants ascribe to the faith of no particular god, but extol the virtues of meditation and whatever calm faiths visitors might bring with them.
zh_tw: 這個位於雙歌社群的禮拜堂和精神病院長期以來一直為抑鬱症患者和精神疾病患者提供庇護。少數工作人員並不信奉任何特定的神，而是推崇冥想和訪客可能帶來的任何平靜信仰的美德。

english: Few seek the church's services on their own. Rather, most who come to dwell at the church either have a room rented for them by concerned family or receive a somewhat mysterious—and usually unexpected—invitation from the institute's superintendent, Mother Aramina, a lawful good female human {@creature priest}. Aramina is a former Candlekeep scholar who's moved her lifelong study of psychology from the academic to the clinical. How Mother Aramina learns of individuals' distress and under what circumstances she offers free room and board in her facility is something of a mystery, but as of yet, none have discovered any sinister angle to her work. In fact, Mother Aramina has been known to hire empathic intermediaries to help extricate the needful from destructive conditions. Despite its charity, though, the Church of Last Hope is not universally loved. The Faithless, the Guild-associated gang in Twin Songs, see a trove of wealthy city-dwellers and wishy-washy non-priests in their midst, ripe targets for protection schemes, kidnappings, and all manner of other plots. Currently none of the Church's patients have been endangered, but Mother Aramina is cautiously looking for more permanent security solutions.
zh_tw: 很少有人主動尋求教堂的服務。相反，大多數來到教堂居住的人要麼是由關心他們的家人為他們租了房間，要麼是收到了來自學院主管阿瑪琳娜修女的某種神秘——通常是出乎意料的——邀請。阿瑪琳娜修女是一位守序善良女性人類{@creature priest||祭司}，她曾是燭堡的學者，將她一生的心理學研究從學術領域轉移到了臨床實踐。阿瑪琳娜修女是如何得知個人的困境，以及在什麼情況下她提供免費的住宿和膳食，這一直是個謎，但到目前為止，還沒有人發現她工作中有任何邪惡的意圖。事實上，阿瑪琳娜修女已知會僱傭富有同情心的中介來幫助那些需要幫助的人擺脫破壞性的環境。儘管教堂有慈善之舉，但最後的希望教堂並不是普遍受到愛戴。雙歌地區的無信仰者，即與公會有關的幫派，看到了一群富有的城市居民和猶豫不決的非牧師，在他們中間，是保護計劃、綁架和各種其他陰謀的理想目標。目前，教堂的病人還沒有受到威脅，但阿瑪琳娜修女正在謹慎地尋找更永久的安全解決方案。

english: Danthelon's Dancing Axe
zh_tw: 丹瑟隆的跳舞斧

english: This two-story shop sells everything an adventurer might need, from weapons and armor to rowboats and mobile monster cages. Presiding over the crammed shelves is Entharl Danthelon, a neutral good male shield dwarf {@creature commoner} who claims to have been an adventurer once himself, as evidenced by the magical flying axe that guards his shop at night. Customers are inevitably treated to the story of the grateful elven princess who enchanted the axe for him as a reward for a daring adventure undertaken on her behalf.
zh_tw: 這家兩層的商店出售冒險者可能需要的一切，從武器和盔甲到划艇和移動怪物籠。管理著擁擠貨架的是恩塔哈爾·丹瑟隆，一箇中立善良的男性盾矮人{@creature commoner||平民}，他聲稱自己曾經也是一個冒險者，這可以從晚上守衛他商店的魔法飛行斧頭看出。顧客們不可避免地會聽到那個感激的精靈公主為他施魔斧頭的故事，作為對她代表的大膽冒險的回報。

english: In truth, Danthelon's "dancing axe" is actually a tame {@creature stirge} wrapped in the illusion of a double-bladed axe, which Danthelon sets loose each night. The illusion is courtesy of Yssra Brackrel, a neutral female half-elf {@creature mage} and brilliant hairstylist who rents out the shop's attic. Yssra's cantankerousness is as legendary as the shop's flying axe, and anyone seeking just her spellcasting is subject to a frank and unflattering critique of their current coiffure.
zh_tw: 實際上，丹瑟隆的"跳舞斧"其實是一隻被馴服的{@creature stirge||蚊蝠}，被包裹在雙刃斧的幻象中，丹瑟隆每晚都會將其釋放。這個幻象是伊斯拉·布拉克雷爾的功勞，她是一位中立的女性半精靈{@creature mage||魔法師}和傑出的髮型師，她租用了店鋪的閣樓。伊斯拉的脾氣和這家店鋪飛行斧的傳說一樣出名，任何只尋求她施法的人都會受到坦率且不留情面的對他們當前髮型的批評。

english: While Danthelon may never have been a real adventurer, he loves associating with them, and constantly keeps his ears open for rumors and opportunities, which he happily passes along to paying customers. At the moment, he's obsessed with reports of a group of smugglers who recently went missing in the Riverveins tunnels along with a chest full of valuable magic potions, and eagerly encourages his shoppers to investigate—and then return to tell him the story.
zh_tw: 儘管丹瑟隆可能從未真正成為過冒險者，但他喜歡與他們交往，並不斷傾聽謠言和機會，他樂於將這些資訊傳遞給付費客戶。目前，他對一群最近在瑞弗文隧道失蹤的走私者以及一箱價值連城的魔法藥水的報道著迷，並熱切地鼓勵他的顧客去調查——然後回來告訴他故事。

english: Garynmor Stables and Menagerie
zh_tw: 加里姆諾馬廄和動物園

english: As horses and other beasts of burden aren't allowed inside the city walls, the Outer City overflows with stables and hostlers, ranging from muddy pens to barns nicer than most inns. Of these, the largest is Garynmor Stables, which offers the unique benefit of operating locations in both Stonyeyes and Blackgate; those travelers passing through have the option of leaving their beasts on one side of the city and picking them up on the other, after grooms have ferried them around the outside of the walls. The stables are also unusual in their willingness to rent mounts to city residents in need of transportation, cutting down on the need of city dwellers to own their own horses. Yet the true gem setting Garynmor Stables apart is its menagerie.
zh_tw: 由於馬和其他馱獸不允許進入城牆內，外城充斥著馬廄和馬伕，從泥濘的圍欄到比大多數旅館還要好的穀倉。在這些馬廄中，最大的是加里摩爾馬廄，它提供的獨特優勢是在石眼區和黑門區都有運營地點；那些過境的旅行者可以選擇在城市的一側留下他們的獸，在梳洗工將它們繞過城牆外部運送到另一側後，再將它們接走。馬廄還不同尋常地願意向需要交通工具的城市居民出租坐騎，減少了城市居民擁有自己的馬匹的需求。然而，真正使加里摩爾馬廄與眾不同的是它的動物展覽館。

english: A former world traveler, Ubis Garynmor (chaotic good male human {@creature commoner}) has long had a fascination with exotic beasts, and having already developed the infrastructure to take care of large numbers of ordinary animals, he found it easy enough to expand the scope of his establishment. His menagerie in Stonyeyes contains a variety of rare creatures both mundane and magical, from an aged cockatrice and two wing-clipped hippogriffs to an owlbear. Always on the lookout for new attractions, he happily pays adventurers for healthy specimens of rare creatures, sometimes reselling the smaller and less dangerous species. While the menagerie is popular with city folk who pay a few coppers to view the creatures, many neighbors fear that Ubis doesn't take security seriously enough, and that his desire to coddle such dangerous beasts could lead to them breaking free and rampaging through the district.
zh_tw: 烏比斯·加里諾爾（混亂善良男性人類{@creature commoner||平民}），一位前世界旅行者，長期以來一直對異國情調的野獸著迷，並且已經發展了基礎設施來照顧大量的普通動物，他發現擴大他的設施範圍是足夠容易的。他在石眼區的動物園包含了各種平凡和神奇的稀有生物，從年老的基克拉特和兩隻剪翼的駿鷹到梟熊。他總是在尋找新的景點，他很高興地為健康的稀有生物樣本支付給冒險者報酬，有時轉賣較小且危險性較低的物種。雖然動物園受到城市居民的歡迎，他們支付幾個銅幣來觀看這些生物，但許多鄰居擔心烏比斯沒有足夠重視安全，他想要溺愛這些危險野獸的願望可能會導致它們逃脫並在區域內肆虐。

english: Hamhocks Slaughterhouse
zh_tw: 火腿屠場

english: This huge complex of pens, barns, and abattoirs is the largest slaughterhouse and knackery in Baldur's Gate. Located in the Stonyeyes neighborhood so as to be convenient to the city's butchers, the facility has a generally adversarial relationship with neighboring establishments, as other herders and hostlers claim the omnipresent smell of blood makes their animals nervous. Yet it's the citizens themselves who should be nervous, for the slaughterhouse recently came under new management.
zh_tw: 這個由圍欄、穀倉和屠宰場組成的龐大建築群是博德之門最大的屠宰場和廢料處理場。位於石眼街區，以便方便城市的屠夫們，這個設施與鄰近的商家通常存在敵對關係，因為其他牧人和馬伕聲稱無處不在的血腥味讓他們的動物感到緊張。然而，真正應該感到緊張的是市民們自己，因為屠宰場最近換了新的管理。

english: Seeking to spread fear and chaos, cultists of the Dead Three have infiltrated the slaughterhouse and begun murdering people across the city, leaving the victims in an alley behind the Smilin' Boar in Bloomridge. To further fan the flames, the cult slices the corpses across the wrists and inflicts a heart-piercing wound, giving rise to rumors that the murders are the result of a supernaturally deadly serial killer.
zh_tw: 為了傳播恐懼和混亂，死亡三重奏的邪教徒已經滲透到屠宰場，並開始在城市中殺害人們，將受害者留在布盧姆裡奇的微笑野豬後面的小巷裡。為了進一步煽動火焰，邪教徒在屍體的手腕上劃開，並造成心臟刺穿的傷害，引發了謀殺案是由一個超自然致命的連環殺手所為的謠言。

english: Pasque Enrial, a {@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA}, is the cult's mastermind. He engineered the death of the slaughterhouse's former owner so that he could take over, figuring that constant blood, offal, and animal screams would provide a suitable cover for the cult's murderous activities. Since then, he's been slowly laying off existing workers and replacing them with cultists loyal to the group's mission. Assisting him are Corian Khee, a {@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA} who spends days crushing livestock skulls with a massive hammer and nights leading the cult's murderous field operations, and Jaemus Exheltarion, a half-elf {@creature master of souls|BGDIA}. Of the three, Jaemus is the least convincing in his role as the slaughterhouse's new accountant, as he greets customers with an eerie stare, openly reads strange-looking tomes, and spends entirely too much time in the cult's trophy locker, a cold-storage facility where he's using pieces harvested from victims and livestock to construct a ram-headed flesh golem.
zh_tw: 帕斯奎·恩瑞爾，一位{@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之黑手}，是邪教的策劃者。他策劃了屠宰場前所有者的死亡，以便自己接管，認為不斷的血液、內臟和動物的尖叫聲將為邪教的謀殺活動提供合適的掩護。從那時起，他一直在慢慢解僱現有工人，用忠於組織使命的邪教徒替換他們。協助他的是科裡安·克希，一位{@creature death's head of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的死神之首}，他白天用巨大的錘子砸碎家畜的頭骨，晚上領導邪教的謀殺野外行動，還有傑穆斯·埃克塞勒塔里昂，一位半精靈{@creature master of souls|BGDIA|馭魂者}。在這三者中，傑穆斯作為屠宰場新會計的角色最不令人信服，因為他用詭異的眼神迎接顧客，公開閱讀看起來奇怪的書籍，並在邪教的戰利品儲藏室——一個冷藏設施中度過太多時間，在那裡他使用從受害者和家畜身上收穫的部件來構建一個公羊頭的血肉魔像。

english: Little Calimshan
zh_tw: 小卡利姆沙

english: Generations ago, a fleet of Calishite refugees fleeing war in the south came sailing into Gray Harbor. Rather than opening their doors to the foreigners, the people of Baldur's Gate quickly hustled them out of the city, forcing them out the Basilisk Gate in the middle of the night and taxing them for the privilege. Desperate and weary, the refugees finally found succor in a caravanserai run by a fellow Calishite in the Outer City. There they used what little wealth they'd been able to bring with them to construct a new home—a traditional Calishite settlement that would be precisely as friendly to Baldur's Gate as the Baldurians had been to them.
zh_tw: 幾代人以前，一群逃離南方戰爭的卡利希特難民乘船進入了灰港。博德之門的人們並沒有向這些外國人敞開大門，而是迅速將他們趕出城市，半夜裡把他們從石蜥門趕出去，並且對他們的特權徵稅。絕望和疲憊的難民最終在外城的一個由同胞卡利希特人經營的旅館中找到了庇護。在那裡，他們利用他們所能帶來的微薄財富建造了一個新的家園——一個傳統的卡利希特定居點，其對博德之門的友好程度將與巴爾杜爾人對他們的友好程度完全相同。

english: Though much time has passed since that ignominious beginning, tensions remain high between Little Calimshan and the rest of the city, particularly with regard to those Baldurians living in the city proper. Unlike most of the Outer City, where neighborhoods blend into each other and no one can quite say where one ends and another begins, Little Calimshan is sharply defined by brick-and-plaster walls, 15 feet tall, 5 feet thick, and topped with minarets in the classic Calishite style. These walls don't simply surround the neighborhood, either. Little Calimshan is built like a traditional Calishite city in miniature, with its interior divided into multiple drudachs (neighborhoods). Each drudach is walled off and inhabited by a particular family or tribe, with its own religious site, inn or tavern, marketplace, and places of industry such as smithies, armories, tanneries, or mills. While such an abundance of walls might make Little Calimshan seem fractious and standoffish, in fact the opposite is true: the thick wall walks act as elevated streets, with locals able to look out over the layout from above and easily pick a path to their intended destination.
zh_tw: 儘管自從那個恥辱的開始以來已經過去了很長時間，但小卡利姆珊與城市其他地區之間的緊張關係仍然很高，特別是與居住在城市主體中的那些巴爾杜爾人。與大多數外城不同，那裡的社群相互融合，沒有人能確切地說一個在哪裡結束，另一個在哪裡開始，小卡利姆珊被磚灰泥牆清晰地定義，牆高15尺，厚5尺，頂部是經典的卡利什蒂風格的尖塔。這些牆不僅僅環繞著社群。小卡利姆珊的建造就像一個傳統的卡利什蒂微型城市，其內部被劃分為多個德魯達奇（社群）。每個德魯達奇都被牆隔開，由特定的家庭或部落居住，擁有自己的宗教場所、客棧或酒館、市場，以及鐵匠鋪、軍械庫、製革廠或磨坊等工業場所。儘管如此多的牆壁可能會使小卡利姆珊看起來分裂和疏遠，但實際上恰恰相反：厚實的城牆步道充當了高架街道，當地人可以從上方俯瞰佈局，並輕鬆選擇通往目的地的路徑。

english: Second only to the Wide in the chaos and liveliness of its markets, Little Calimshan opens its gates to outsiders for just a few hours each day. Inside its warren of bazaars, local merchants have a near-monopoly on many southern imports, from silks and fine blades of Calishite steel to tomes of rare magical lore, thanks to exclusive trade agreements with various caravans. As soon as mid-afternoon arrives, however, shoppers are shuffled back out the arched gates, and the only non-Calishites still allowed within the neighborhood are those who've married into a Little Calimshan family or otherwise earned the sacred trust of a drudach's residents. While many residents of Little Calimshan venture into the larger city for business or pleasure, not even the Flaming Fist is able to force its way into the neighborhood-turned-fortress after hours except in the direst circumstances, and each drudach is instead patrolled by a militia of young unmarried warriors ({@creature Guard||guards} with scimitars instead of spears) called amlakkars.
zh_tw: 在市場混亂和活力方面僅次於寬廣之地，小卡利姆沙每天僅對外界開放幾個小時。在其錯綜複雜的集市中，當地商人幾乎壟斷了許多南方進口商品，從卡利希特鋼製成的絲綢和精美刀劍到稀有魔法知識的書籍，這得益於與各種商隊的獨家貿易協議。然而，一到午後，購物者就被趕回拱形大門之外，唯一被允許留在這個社群內的非卡利希特人是那些與小卡利姆沙家庭結婚或以其他方式贏得了德魯達奇居民神聖信任的人。雖然許多小卡利沙的居民為了商務或娛樂進入更大的城市，但即使在最緊急的情況下，連火焰之拳也無法在營業時間之外強行進入這個變成堡壘的社群，而每個德魯達奇則由一隊年輕未婚戰士（手持彎刀而非長矛的{@creature Guard||警衛}）組成的民兵巡邏，稱為阿姆拉卡斯。

english: While Little Calimshan presents a unified face to the rest of the city, it has all the problems of any settlement. Income inequality is made all the more obvious by density, with paupers living literally side-by-side with wealthy genie-binders. Older isolationists clash with young folk eager for more interaction with the wider city. Yet by far the largest issue is the gang war currently ravaging Little Calimshan. Seeing the Guild as fundamentally an outsider organization, a Calishite gang called the Right Pashas seeks to oust Guild agents from Little Calimshan's underworld. The Guild's popular half-Calishite kingpin, {@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA}, naturally objects to this insult, and each night residents bar their doors tight as a turf war of thugs and thieves rages across their rooftops.
zh_tw: 儘管小卡利姆珊對城市其他地區呈現出統一的面貌，但它擁有任何定居點的所有問題。由於密集度的原因，收入不平等變得更加明顯，窮人與富有的神靈繫結者實際上生活在一起。主張孤立的老一輩與渴望與更廣闊城市更多互動的年輕一代發生衝突。然而，迄今為止最大的問題是目前正在蹂躪小卡利姆珊的幫派戰爭。一個名為正義帕夏的卡利什蒂幫派將公會視為基本上是外來組織，試圖將公會代理人從下層世界的小卡利姆珊驅逐出去。公會受歡迎的半卡利什蒂頭目{@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA|瑞爾薩·雷爾}，自然反對這種侮辱，每晚居民們緊緊關上門，因為地盤爭奪戰在屋頂上肆虐，暴徒和小偷之間的衝突不斷。

english: Among Little Calimshan's most notorious locations is the Calim Jewel Emporium, widely regarded as the best jeweler in the city—and the best place to fence stolen gems, as it's also the local Guild headquarters. In addition to hosting regular public forums in her shop, Rael tacitly oversees the Garden of Whispers, a maze of wood-and-paper screens where people from across the city can buy and sell secrets with Guild agents and each other, speaking through the barriers so as to maintain anonymity. Also popular are schools like the Lamp of Learning and the Verdashir Academy (also known as the Dervish Academy), which train spellcasters and warriors in the styles of their ancestral homeland, allowing only the most talented outsiders to access their archives or join in their lessons. And, of course, every patriar in the city has visited the famous Oasis Theater, home of the city's most daring—and sometimes dangerous—productions.
zh_tw: 在小卡利姆珊最著名的地點中，卡利姆珠寶大賣場被廣泛認為是城市中最好的珠寶商——也是銷售贓物寶石的最佳場所，因為它也是當地公會的總部。除了在她的商店舉辦定期的公共論壇外，雷爾還默許監管耳語花園，這是一個由木頭和紙張屏風組成的迷宮，來自城市各地的人們可以在這裡與公會代理人和彼此買賣秘密，透過屏障交談以保持匿名。同樣受歡迎的還有像學習之燈和維達希爾學院（也被稱為苦行僧學院）這樣的學校，它們培訓施法者和戰士，以他們祖先家園的風格，只允許最有才華的外來者訪問他們的檔案或參加他們的課程。當然，城市的每一位貴族都曾參觀過著名的綠洲劇院，這是城市最大膽——有時也是危險——製作的所在地。

english: Oasis Theater
zh_tw: 綠洲劇院

english: Baldur's Gate plays home to a variety of small theaters and cabarets, but none can hold a candle to the epic spectacle of the Oasis. Theater owner and director Jonas Goodnight, a chaotic neutral male human {@creature spy}, puts on shows even more outrageous than his magnificently crafted outfits. Productions involve everything from live monsters to powerful illusion magic, while also showcasing the most talented performers in the city. Actors and musicians perform their songs and monologues from atop flaming trapezes or human towers, while acrobats shock the audience with physical feats bordering on the supernatural.
zh_tw: 博德之門是各種小型劇院和卡巴萊的家園，但沒有一個能與綠洲的史詩般壯觀相媲美。劇院老闆兼導演喬納斯·古德奈特，一個混亂中立男性人類{@creature spy||間諜}，上演的劇目甚至比他精心製作的服裝更加離譜。製作涉及從活生生的怪物到強大的幻象魔法的一切，同時還展示了城市中最有才華的表演者。演員和音樂家們在火焰鞦韆或人塔上表演他們的歌曲和獨白，而雜技演員則以近乎超自然的體能表演震撼觀眾。

english: Even lowbrow theatergoers unable to decipher Goodnight's artistic genius can appreciate his flagrant breaking of taboos, with risqué burlesque and satirical scripts mocking everyone from the dukes to {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA} herself. The fact that these performances sometimes go terribly awry, with monsters breaking loose or a broken piece of equipment sending a performer plummeting into the crowd, only adds to the excitement, and patriars and common folk alike vie for seats at the theater's afternoon-only performances. Ticket prices are decided capriciously and on the spot by Goodnight, varying wildly between any given individual.
zh_tw: 即使是無法解讀古德奈特藝術天賦的普通戲劇觀眾，也能欣賞他公然打破禁忌的行為，帶有猥褻性滑稽戲和諷刺劇本，從公爵到{@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA|九指基恩}本人都成為嘲笑的物件。這些表演有時會嚴重出錯，比如怪物逃脫或裝置損壞導致表演者墜入觀眾席，這只是增加了興奮感，貴族和普通人都爭搶劇院僅限下午的演出座位。票價由古德奈特隨意且當場決定，每個人之間的差異很大。

english: While Goodnight is always looking for new performers, at the moment he needs more than just a talented bard or contortionist. The cost of putting on his outrageous shows has landed him deep in debt, and his compulsive need to roast every potential patron or ally in the city hasn't helped matters. With the Guild ready to step in and assume ownership if he doesn't start repaying his loans, he needs to either turn to outright crime or put on a show more amazing than anything he's done before. He's got an idea, but to pull it off, he'll need an experienced adventuring party willing to play the stars in the world's first live-audience adventure.
zh_tw: 雖然古德奈特總是在尋找新的表演者，但目前他需要的不僅僅是一個有才華的吟遊詩人或柔術演員。他那些離譜的表演所花費的成本讓他深陷債務，他那種強迫性地想要諷刺每一個潛在的贊助人或盟友的衝動也沒有幫助解決問題。隨著公會準備介入並接管所有權，如果他不開始償還貸款，他需要要麼轉向徹頭徹尾的犯罪，要麼上演一場比他以前做過的任何事情都要驚人的表演。他有一個想法，但要實現它，他需要一個經驗豐富的冒險隊伍願意在世界上第一場現場觀眾的冒險中扮演主角。

english: {@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@creature Rilsa Rael|BGDIA|瑞爾薩·雷爾}

english: Riverveins
zh_tw: 瑞弗文

english: Just east of the city, where Dusthawk Hill rises along the Chionthar River, eddies captured by outcroppings have bored into the stone, carving a maze of meandering tunnels and draining into subterranean aquifers. Though hardly diverting enough water to impact the river's flow, the web of submerged chambers has become a source of mystery and legend for locals.
zh_tw: 就在城市東側，塵埃之鷹山沿著琴薩河升起，被突出的岩石捕獲的漩渦已經鑽入石頭中，雕刻出一個蜿蜒隧道的迷宮，並排入地下水層。儘管這些隧道幾乎不會分散足夠的水以影響河流的流動，但這些淹沒的房間網路已經成為當地人神秘和傳說的源泉。

english: While most of the tunnels are submerged, changes in river height over time mean that some of the tunnels and caverns are dry or only half-flooded for long stretches, making them favored hideouts for fugitives, smugglers, aquatic predators, and particularly adventurous trysting lovers. Though rumors whisper that some tunnels lead directly under Baldur's Gate, to date all mapped caverns are accessible only from the river, and even just climbing into a tunnel mouth or steering a boat inside can be deadly as the current attempts to smash vessels against the cliffs. Stories of ancient treasure in the flooded caverns are only enhanced by stories of Ol' Cholms, a river monster, prowling the tunnels. Many would-be fortune hunters have been disappointed to discover dry tunnels containing nothing more than crude graffiti, empty wine bottles, and flocks of bloodthirsty {@creature Stirge||stirges}.
zh_tw: 雖然大部分隧道都被淹沒了，但隨著時間的推移，河流高度的變化意味著一些隧道和洞穴是乾燥的或者長時間只有一半被淹沒，這使得它們成為逃犯、走私者、水生捕食者，特別是喜歡冒險的情侶幽會的理想藏身之地。儘管有傳言稱一些隧道直接通向博德之門下方，但迄今為止所有繪製的洞穴只能從河流進入，甚至只是爬進隧道口或駕駛船隻進入內部也可能是致命的，因為水流會試圖將船隻撞向懸崖。關於淹沒洞穴中古老寶藏的故事因為有關河流怪物'老喬姆斯'在隧道中徘徊的故事而更加引人入勝。許多想要尋找財富的人失望地發現乾燥的隧道里除了粗糙的塗鴉、空酒瓶和一群嗜血的{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}之外，什麼都沒有。

english: Whitkeep Hostel
zh_tw: 惠特堡旅舍

english: In a city often thought to be dour and dangerous, the Whitkeep Hostel is a spark of light and levity. Built by a wealthy caravan operator who lost their fortune to monster attacks, this white-walled manor house was quickly overtaken by squatters, and has now spent most of a century as an all-gnome artist's commune. Though only gnomes are invited to rent one of the rambling manor's thirty-seven studio apartments, Baldurians of all races are welcome to socialize at the place's infamous surrealist parties or attend its concerts and offbeat art happenings. As such, the hostel has become the central gathering point for the city's radicals and revolutionaries, as well as many artists and dreamers.
zh_tw: 在一個常被認為是嚴肅和危險城市中，懷特基普旅館是一絲光明和輕鬆的氣息。這個白色牆壁的莊園由一位富有的商隊經營者建造，他們因怪物襲擊而失去了財富，很快被擅自佔地者接管，現在大部分時間作為一個世紀以來的全侏儒藝術家公社。儘管只有侏儒被邀請租用這座曲折莊園的三十七個工作室公寓之一，但所有種族的巴爾杜爾人都可以參加這個地方的臭名昭著的超現實主義派對，或參加它的音樂會和古怪的藝術活動。因此，旅館已成為城市激進分子和革命家的中心聚集點，以及許多藝術家和夢想家。

english: One of the neighborhood's more outspoken critics of the Gate's government, Pernilla "Prole" Cabrenock, a chaotic neutral female rock gnome {@creature bandit captain}, has teamed up with an oddball inventor and arcanist named Ardryn Deagle, a chaotic good male rock gnome {@creature mage}. Rumors spread by Prole herself suggest that they've almost completed a magical invention that will "finally strip away the bonds of capital and free the people to flourish," but security around the project has been unusually tight, keeping even many members of the commune in the dark. While most people assume this is merely some strange new critique of the city's patriars, both the Guild and the Flaming Fist would dearly love to infiltrate the revolutionaries' project and make sure it doesn't pose a threat to the status quo.
zh_tw: 社群中對大門政府更加直言不諱的批評者之一，佩爾尼拉"普羅利"卡布羅克，一個混亂中立的女性岩石地侏{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}，已經與一個名叫阿德林·迪格爾的古怪發明家兼奧術師，一個混亂善良的男性岩石地侏{@creature mage||魔法師}聯手。普羅利本人散佈的謠言表明，他們幾乎完成了一個魔法發明，將"最終剝離資本的束縛，讓人們自由繁榮"，但圍繞該專案的安全措施異常嚴密，甚至許多公社成員都被矇在鼓裡。雖然大多數人認為這只是一種對城市貴族的奇怪新批評，但公會和火焰之拳都非常希望滲透到革命者的專案中，並確保它不會對現狀構成威脅。

english: Wyrm's Crossing
zh_tw: 飛龍渡

english: Wyrm's Crossing
zh_tw: 飛龍渡

english: This neighborhood is actually two enormous bridges, each spanning half the Chionthar River and meeting at Wyrm's Rock, a tall, rocky islet in the center. While the Flaming Fist maintains a fortress on the island to tax travelers along the Coast Way and control city access in times of trouble, the bridges themselves are fair game for squatters. Ramshackle wooden tenements, taverns, and shops crowd both sides of the arched stone spans, leaning out over the narrow road between them. Even more cling to the sides of the bridges, anchored to each other or cantilevered over the water. The tendency of these latter structures to occasionally drop into the rushing river, pulling their neighbors down with them, is not enough to deter residents who hope to be the first to sell to travelers on their way into the city, or the last to pick their pockets on the way out.
zh_tw: 這個社群實際上是兩座巨大的橋樑，每座橋橫跨琴薩河的一半，在中心的龍之巖，一個高大的岩石小島上相遇。雖然焰拳在島上維持著一座堡壘，以徵稅沿著海岸路旅行的人，並在困難時期控制城市通道，但橋樑本身是擅自佔地者的公平遊戲。搖搖欲墜的木製租屋、酒館和商店擠滿了拱形石跨的兩側，向它們之間的狹窄道路傾斜。甚至更多地附著在橋樑的側面，錨定在彼此或懸臂在水面上。這些後者結構偶爾掉入急流的河流，拉著它們的鄰居一起下來，這不足以阻止居民們希望成為第一個向進入城市途中的旅行者出售商品的人，或者是最後一個在他們離開時搜刮他們口袋的人。

english: Even among members of the Outer City, residents of Wyrm's Crossing have a reputation as rakes and riffraff, and the neighborhood specializes in seedy dive bars and gambling halls where belligerent drunks can be ejected directly out over the river. At the same time, it also has a large and tight-knit strongheart halfling community, whose low-ceilinged tenements and lighter weight are perfect for the neighborhood's precarious architectural style.
zh_tw: 即使在外城的居民中，龍之十字路口的居民也以放蕩不羈和烏合之眾而聞名，這個社群以破敗的酒吧和賭博場所為特色，在那裡好鬥的醉漢可以直接被扔進河裡。同時，它還有一個龐大而緊密團結的強壯半身人社群，他們的低天花板住宅和較輕的體重非常適合該社群不穩定的建築風格。

english: While the Crossing is renowned for cheats and criminals, the residents stick together, and a local crew called the Crossers ensures that all predatory practices are applied primarily to travelers, and never to fellow bridge-dwellers. For those who consistently refuse to play well with their neighbors, the answer is often Sweetjen's Spices, a precarious bridge-side shop whose halfling proprietor quietly sells some of the most potent drugs and untraceable poisons in the city.
zh_tw: 雖然十字路口因欺騙和犯罪分子而聞名，但居民們團結一致，一個名為渡客幫的地方團隊確保所有掠奪性行為主要針對旅行者，並且永遠不會針對其他橋上居民。對於那些始終拒絕與鄰居和睦相處的人，答案往往是甜珍香料店，這是一家不穩定的橋邊商店，其半身人店主悄悄地銷售城市中最強力的藥物和無法追蹤的毒藥。

english: Wyrm's Rock
zh_tw: 龍之巖

english: This formidable fortress rises from the center of the river on an algae-slick islet, its sheer walls nearly impossible to scale. Built by the Flaming Fist on a rock once said to have housed a bronze dragon, the fortress is the first checkpoint at which Baldur's Gate taxes northbound travelers. Anyone seeking to cross the river via the fortress's two massive bridges must pay the 5 cp toll and pass through the fortress via a long central tunnel riddled with arrow slits and murder holes. Between twenty-five and fifty Flaming Fist soldiers staff the checkpoint, which operates only during the day. After dark, the drawbridges on either side of the keep are raised, halting all traffic and forcing latecomers to take shelter at one of the many bridge-top inns in Wyrm's Crossing until morning.
zh_tw: 這座令人敬畏的堡壘位於河中心一個滑膩的藻類覆蓋的小島上，其陡峭的牆壁幾乎無法攀爬。由焰拳在一個曾經據說是銅龍棲息的岩石上建造，這座堡壘是博德之門向北行的旅行者徵稅的第一個檢查站。任何試圖透過堡壘的兩座巨大的橋樑過河的人都必須支付5銅幣的通行費，並透過一個長長的中心隧道，該隧道佈滿了箭縫和槍眼。二十五到五十名焰拳士兵駐守在這個檢查站，它只在白天運營。天黑後，堡壘兩側的吊橋被拉起，阻止了所有交通，並迫使遲到的人在龍之十字路口的眾多橋頂旅館中尋找住所，直到早上。

english: The fortress has four levels: the bridge level, taken up by the gauntlet tunnel and offices devoted to traffic management; a second-story armory full of oil, javelins, and everything the soldiers need to withstand a siege; a third story for soldier's quarters; and a high-ceilinged dungeon level below the bridges to hold temporary prisoners and the fortress's supply of small boats (should the garrison need to sally through heavily fortified river-level gates). Soldiers stationed in the fortress tend to fall into two categories: those disappointed at being stuck on toll-collection duty so far from the city, and those overjoyed at easy work and a chance to carouse in Wyrm's Crossing, with the latter ensuring that the Fist doesn't patrol their neighboring bridges too heavily.
zh_tw: 堡壘共有四層：橋面層設有戒備森嚴的通道與交通管理辦公室；第二層是軍械庫，備有油、標槍及士兵抵禦圍城所需的一切；第三層是兵舍；橋下另有挑高的地牢層，用來暫時關押囚犯並存放小船，好讓駐軍必要時能從河面高度、重兵防守的大門出擊。駐守士兵大致分為兩類：一類不滿自己被派到遠離城區的地方收通行費，另一類則樂於工作清閒，又能到飛龍渡暢飲作樂。後者會設法讓焰拳別把鄰近橋樑巡得太勤。

english: The commander of Wyrm's Rock, an old brute named Skorpin Crane, died in his sleep recently. Foul play was ruled out, and Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} was in the midst of finding Crane's replacement when he was lured away on a diplomatic mission to Elturel. Until a replacement is found, the Mage Defender of Wyrm's Rock, a neutral evil shield dwarf {@creature mage} named Gardak Horn, has taken command. The guards loathe Gardak because he uses a {@creature homunculus} to spy on them.
zh_tw: 龍之巖的指揮官，一個名叫斯科爾賓·克拉恩的老粗，在睡夢中最近去世了。已排除了謀殺的可能性，當大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}正在尋找克拉恩的替代者時，他被誘騙去艾爾托瑞爾進行外交任務。在找到替代者之前，龍之巖的法師守衛，一箇中立邪惡的盾矮人{@creature mage||魔法師}名叫加達克·霍恩，已經接管了指揮權。守衛們憎恨加達克，因為他使用一個{@creature homunculus||人工生命體}來監視他們。

english: This section presents new backgrounds suitable for creating characters from Baldur's Gate, along with notes on adapting characters who have backgrounds drawn from the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
zh_tw: 本節介紹了適合創造來自博德之門角色的新背景，以及關於適應那些背景來源於{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}的角色的說明。

english: This material is meant to be a tool for you, the DM. Once players have decided on their characters' backgrounds, review the material here. Some backgrounds have at least one new variant feature that ties the background to a group in Baldur's Gate, provided to give characters an additional connection to the city. Characters may choose to replace the standard feature of their background with one of these variant features. Each background also includes a bonus feature that marks a character as a native of Baldur's Gate who's familiar with the city—both its streets and its scars. These additional features are referred to as "Baldur's Gate features." While a character's background features are broadly useful, the effects of a Baldur's Gate feature can be used only while the character is in Baldur's Gate—though, at the DM's discretion, they might have applicable effects in situations similar to those in Baldur's Gate. These location-based features do not replace other features; a character gains them merely for being familiar with Baldur's Gate. If a background presents multiple Baldur's Gate features, you gain all the features associated with that background, or as many of them as you wish to take.
zh_tw: 這些材料旨在成為您，地下城主（DM）的工具。一旦玩家們決定了他們角色的背景，就請回顧這裡的內容。一些背景至少有一個與博德之門中的團體相聯絡的新變體特徵，提供這些是為了給角色們增加與這座城市的聯絡。角色們可以選擇用這些變體特徵替換他們背景的標準特徵。每個背景還包括一個獎勵特徵，標誌著一個熟悉博德之門城市——它的街道和它的傷痕——的博德之門本地人。這些額外的特徵被稱為"博德之門特徵"。雖然一個角色的背景特徵通常是廣泛有用的，但博德之門特徵的效果只能在角色在博德之門時使用——儘管，在地下城主的自由裁量下，它們在類似於博德之門的情況中可能具有適用的效果。這些基於位置的特徵不取代其他特徵；一個角色僅因熟悉博德之門而獲得它們。如果一個背景提供了多個博德之門特徵，您可以獲得與該背景相關的所有特徵，或者選擇您想要獲得的任意數量的特徵。

english: Working amid the High Hall's records, you came to realize just how little separated commoners from patriars. Slowly you worked to upend the old families' control over the city—but then someone noticed.
zh_tw: 在高廳的記錄中工作，你開始意識到平民與貴族之間的差距有多麼微小。你慢慢地努力顛覆舊家族對城市的控制——但隨後有人注意到了。

english: You knew something powerful lurked within Mandorcai's Mansion. You and others sought the tools and rites to prod the power within, to draw it out and make it yours. But what lies within the mansion refuses to ever serve again.
zh_tw: 你知道曼多卡伊的宅邸中潛藏著強大的力量。你和其他人尋求工具和儀式來激發內部的力量，將其引出並據為己有。但宅邸中潛藏的東西拒絕再次為任何人服務。

english: Too long has the Guild monopolized control over criminal operations in Baldur's Gate. You sought to add a little competition and break the Guild's monopoly. It was going well after your last heist, too—until the Guild came for its cut.
zh_tw: 行會在博德之門對犯罪行動的壟斷太久了。你試圖增加一些競爭，打破行會的壟斷。在你們上次的搶劫之後，事情進展得很順利——直到行會來要求分成。

english: You and the other revolutionaries of Whitkeep Hostel sought nothing less than a new, egalitarian future for Baldur's Gate—a future that neither the dukes nor the patriars can envision. Someone clearly had enough of your art and shouted slogans, though.
zh_tw: 你和懷特基普旅館的其他革命者尋求的不僅僅是博德之門一個全新的平等主義未來——一個公爵和貴族都無法想象的未來。然而，顯然有人受夠了你們的藝術品和口號。

english: {@b Leader}. Yours was the voice the others followed, the call they heeded, following you to their end.
zh_tw: {@b 首領}。你是其他人追隨的聲音，是他們聽從的號召，跟隨你直到最後。

english: {@b Survivor}. You should have fallen with the rest of your group, but fate interceded. Now you're a loose end.
zh_tw: {@b 生還者}

english: {@b Partner}. You knew little of the conspiracy, but your partner, family member, or associate did. Now they're gone, and you're next.
zh_tw: {@b 夥伴}。你對陰謀知之甚少，但你的夥伴、家庭成員或同事知道。現在他們消失了，接下來就輪到你了。

english: {@b Innocent}. You knew nothing of the conspiracy. That matters little to those stamping it out, though.
zh_tw: {@b 無辜者}。你對陰謀一無所知。然而，對於那些正在鎮壓它的人來說，這並不重要。

english: {@b Affiliate}. You worked with the conspirators but weren't a member—a detail that only matters to you.
zh_tw: {@b 會員}

english: {@b Witness}. You got a glimpse of what happened to your fellow conspirators and the fate that awaits you.
zh_tw: {@b 見證者}。你窺見了你的同謀者發生了什麼，以及等待你的命運。

zh_tw: d6

english: Conspiracy Consequences
zh_tw: 陰謀後果

english: The other members of your group were arrested, rightfully or otherwise. Now you're on the run.
zh_tw: 你的團隊其他成員已經被逮捕，無論是否有正當理由。現在你正在逃亡。

english: Your group's meeting place burned, slaying all inside. Only by happenstance did you survive. You're sure it wasn't an accident, though.
zh_tw: 你們的小組聚會地點被燒燬，裡面的人全部遇難。你之所以倖存，純屬偶然。但你確信這不是意外。

english: The other members of your group have been murdered, slain in some distinctive way.
zh_tw: 你的團隊其他成員已經被謀殺，以某種獨特的方式被殺害。

english: None of the other members of your conspiracy remember you or have any memory of being aligned with you.
zh_tw: 你們陰謀組織的其他成員都不記得你，也沒有任何與你結盟的記憶。

english: The other members of your group betrayed you to save themselves.
zh_tw: 你的團隊其他成員為了自保而背叛了你。

english: The other conspirators vanished, disappearing one at a time and without a trace.
zh_tw: 其他同謀者消失了，一個接一個地無影無蹤地消失了。

english: Murder in Baldur's Gate
zh_tw: 博德之門的謀殺案

english: There's blood on the characters' hands. They all had a part to play in a murder—justified or not. Shared guilt, coercion, and fear keep the secret between them.
zh_tw: 角色們的手上沾有鮮血。他們都參與了一起謀殺——無論是否正當。共同的罪責、脅迫和恐懼使他們之間保守著這個秘密。

zh_tw: 謀殺細節

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Murder Details
zh_tw: 謀殺細節

english: She knew, which meant tomorrow every pastry-loving patriar in Baldur's Gate would too. The Upper City's most notorious gossip, Ellyn Harbreeze of Harbreeze Bakery, had to be dealt with. Who knew a bakery could be so dangerous?
zh_tw: 她知道了，這意味著明天每一個熱愛糕點的博德之門的貴族也會知道。上城區最著名的八卦者，來自哈布瑞茲麵包店的艾琳·哈布瑞茲，必須得處理一下。誰知道一個麵包店會這麼危險呢？

english: Revenge will come for the sadistic Nysene Eomane eventually. You thought you'd have a hand in it—you exacted your plan perfectly. But your snare caught another. Now Dolandre Eomane lies dead, while the intended target yet lives.
zh_tw: 對殘忍的奈瑟妮·伊奧曼的復仇終將到來。你以為你會參與其中——你完美地實施了你的計劃。但你設下的陷阱卻捕獲了另一個人。現在多蘭德·伊奧曼死了，而原本的目標還活著。

english: Doctor Holk Thinster jeopardized lives every night he worked at Cliffgate Hospital. Who knows how many were crippled on Thinster's table or died under his inexpert knife. For them, you put an end to Thinster's practice for good.
zh_tw: 霍克·辛斯特醫生在懸崖門醫院工作的每個晚上都危及生命。誰知道有多少人在辛斯特的手術檯上致殘，或者在他的不熟練的手術刀下喪生。為了他們，你徹底結束了辛斯特的醫療實踐。

english: The first step to healing is admitting you have a problem. The second is seeing your abusive dealer bleeding out on the floor. Jopalin, of the teahouse of the same name, had it coming, and you haven't felt the moonflower itch since.
zh_tw: 治癒的第一步是承認你有問題。第二步是看到你虐待你的交易商在地板上流血。同名茶館的喬帕林是自找的，從那以後你就再也沒有感受到月夜花的渴望。

english: You were only protecting your own—in a way. Olten Grinn of Cliffside Cemetery's Gravemakers was going to put a mace through your grandpappy's skull. You put one through his first. It was the right thing to do. After all, grandpappy never asked to be a ghoul.
zh_tw: 你在某種程度上只是在保護自己人。懸崖墓地的掘墓幫組織的奧爾滕·格林打算用釘頭錘打穿你祖父的頭骨。你先對他下手了。這麼做是正確的。畢竟，祖父從未想過要成為食屍鬼。

english: They should call it justice. Jedren Hiller, Bailiff of the Wide, had preyed on desperate business owners for years, growing fatter and richer every day. Fate gave you the opportunity. You're a hero, but no one cheered.
zh_tw: 他們應該稱之為正義。傑德倫·希勒，寬廣之地的執行官，多年來一直剝削絕望的企業主，每天都在變得更胖更富有。命運給了你機會。你是個英雄，但沒有人歡呼。

zh_tw: {@b 謀殺者}。透過利刃、推搡或故意不作為，你奪走了一個生命。

english: {@b Bystander}. You could have prevented a death. You chose not to.
zh_tw: {@b 旁觀者}

english: {@b Instigator}. You're the architect of someone's demise, your words spreading death.
zh_tw: {@b 煽動者}。你是某人滅亡的策劃者，你的言辭傳播著死亡。

english: {@b Liar}. You know what happened, but didn't tell.
zh_tw: {@b 騙子}。你知道發生了什麼，但是沒有說出來。

If they find out what the characters did, their trial will be short and their deaths will be just. Determine the fallout of the characters' murderous deeds by rolling on the Murder Consequences table, or allow the players to create their own ominous stakes.
zh_tw: 人們正在議論。來自守望者、火焰之拳、行會或其他組織的成員正在提出問題。如果他們發現了角色們所做的事情，他們的審判將會很短，他們的死亡將會是公正的。透過在謀殺後果表上擲骰子，或允許玩家創造他們自己不祥的利害關係，來確定角色們謀殺行為的後果。

zh_tw: 謀殺後果

english: Murder Consequences
zh_tw: 謀殺後果

english: You're not sure who, but someone saw the murder and has turned your names over to the law. Now you're wanted fugitives, your faces and names plastered on posters throughout the city.
zh_tw: 你不確定是誰，但有人目睹了謀殺案，並將你們的名字交給了法律。現在你們成了通緝犯，你們的面孔和名字被貼在城市各處的海報上。

english: Someone associated with your victim wants revenge—the sort the law won't provide.
zh_tw: 與你的受害者有關的人想要復仇——是法律無法提供的那一種。

english: Your victim won't stay dead, having fought their way back from death to take vengeance.
zh_tw: 你的受害者不會就此死去，他們從死亡中掙扎回來進行復仇。

english: Your victim was a member of a larger organization, such as the Guild. This organization refuses to let the killing go unanswered.
zh_tw: 你的受害者是一個更大組織，比如公會的成員。這個組織拒絕讓這起殺戮無回應。

english: Somehow, your victim is still alive and knows what you did. Now you've got to figure out how to put them down a second time.
zh_tw: 不知何故，你的受害者仍然活著並且知道你所做的事情。現在你得想辦法如何再次讓他們閉嘴。

english: Your victim's death ignited a social spark. Now you're being sought by mobs seeking to bring new justice to Baldur's Gate.
zh_tw: 你受害者的死亡點燃了社會火花。現在你被一群尋求為博德之門帶來新正義的暴民追捕。

zh_tw: 博德之門的盜竊案

zh_tw: 角色們透過偷竊貴重物品觸犯了法律。問題是，角色們是因為他們需要或想要某樣東西而進行盜竊，還是因為他們不希望別人擁有它？

english: Theft Details
zh_tw: 盜竊細節

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Theft Details
zh_tw: 盜竊細節

english: You did it for the prestige as much as the money. It took months to plan and even longer to get everyone into place. The High Hall is locked down tight every evening. Its crypts less so. Now a priceless treasure of the city, the spyglass of Balduran himself, is yours.
zh_tw: 你這麼做既為了聲望也為了金錢。它花費了數月的時間來策劃，甚至更長時間來讓每個人都就位。高廳每天晚上都嚴密封鎖。它的地窖則不那麼嚴格。現在，城市的無價之寶，巴爾杜蘭本人的望遠鏡，是你的了。

english: With the help of an inside man, you purloined money from the Counting House, the most secure bank in Baldur's Gate. With the bank's reputation at stake, you know the Honorable Order of Moneylenders won't rest until the money is returned to its rightful owners and the thieves are brought to justice.
zh_tw: 在內賊的幫助下，你從博德之門最安全的銀行——記賬房偷走了錢財。由於銀行的聲譽岌岌可危，你知道體面的放貸者秩序不會休息，直到錢財歸還給合法所有者，並將小偷繩之以法。

english: Dangerous goods mean hazard pay. You stole four kegs of {@item smokepowder|WDH} from Felogyr's Fireworks and sold them to a gang of revolutionaries. Your pay is already spent, but the fireworks have yet to begin.
zh_tw: 危險物品意味著高風險報酬。你從費洛吉爾的煙花店偷了四桶 {@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉} 並把它們賣給了一群革命者。你的報酬已經花光了，但煙火表演尚未開始。

english: Stealing a night's worth of earnings from the Low Lantern, a ship-turned-tavern and gambling den, proved to be quite a feat. You didn't think you left any loose ends, but now a gang of kenku killers haunts your trail and your nightmares.
zh_tw: 從低燈籠——一家改裝成酒館和賭場的船上——偷走了一整晚的收入，這證明瞭是一項相當了不起的專長。你原以為你沒有留下任何未了結的線索，但現在一幫天狗殺手正縈繞在你的行蹤和噩夢中。

english: It seemed like buried treasure—a collection of strange, topaz-eyed statues hidden deep in the Riverveins. You absconded with them, but now the smugglers who stole them first want their booty back. They don't know who took them, but they know you're involved from a clue you inadvertently left behind.
zh_tw: 它看起來像是埋藏的寶藏——一系列隱藏在河脈深處的奇異的黃玉眼睛雕像。你帶著它們逃跑了，但現在那些最初偷走它們的走私者想要回他們的戰利品。他們不知道是誰拿走了它們，但他們知道你參與了，因為你無意中留下了一個線索。

english: Both the Guild and Little Calimshan's Right Pashas wanted it—such a little thing, a vial that could hold no more than a few perfume drops. It spoke to you, though. You could hear it in your mind. You knew it needed to be free. But now that it is, you can't bring yourself to open it.
zh_tw: 公會和卡利姆沙的右帕夏都想要它——這麼小的東西，一個小瓶，最多隻能裝幾滴香水。但它對你說話了。你可以在腦海中聽到它的聲音。你知道它需要自由。但現在它自由了，你卻無法讓自己開啟它。

english: {@b Breaker}. Force is your specialty, whether your breaking through a wall or breaking bones.
zh_tw: {@b 破壞者}。力量是你的專長，無論是破牆而入還是打斷骨頭。

english: {@b Burglar}. It was theirs, but all you had to do was reach out to make it yours.
zh_tw: {@b 盜竊犯}。那曾經是他們的，但你只需要伸手就能將其變成你的。

english: {@b Distraction}. While all eyes were on you, your friends were making off with the goods.
zh_tw: {@b 紛擾}。當所有目光都集中在你身上時，你的朋友們正帶著貨物離開。

english: {@b Lockpicker}. Every lock is just a puzzle to be mastered.
zh_tw: {@b 鎖匠}。每一個鎖都只是一個待解的謎題。

english: {@b Lookout}. Watching out for trouble is the best way to avoid it.
zh_tw: {@b 望風}。警惕麻煩是避免它的最佳方式。

english: {@b Mole}. You knew the job inside out, particularly because you were on the inside all along.
zh_tw: {@b 探子}。你對工作瞭如指掌，特別是因為你一直就在內部。

english: The owner of what you stole got the authorities involved. Now they're offering a reward for your capture.
zh_tw: 你偷的東西的主人讓當局介入了。現在他們為抓捕你提供懸賞。

english: Another group of thieves is after you now, trying to claim what you stole.
zh_tw: 現在另一群小偷在追捕你，試圖奪取你偷走的東西。

english: What you stole wasn't what you thought. You want to get rid of it, but that's become a problem—especially since it's grown, hatched, or started talking.
zh_tw: 你偷的東西並不是你原本以為的那樣。你想擺脫它，但那已經成了一個問題——特別是自從它長大了、孵化了或者開始說話之後。

english: Everyone wants what you have. Multiple dangerous groups have approached you to buy it, and will be offended if you sell to anyone else.
zh_tw: 每個人都想要你所擁有的。多個危險的團體已經接近你，想要購買它，如果你賣給其他人，他們會不高興。

english: What you stole belonged to someone other than your intended mark. Now a deadly organization such as the Guild is after you.
zh_tw: 你偷的東西並不屬於你原本的目標。現在，像公會這樣的致命組織正在追捕你。

english: You were caught! The owner demands their property's return, threatening death or worse, but it's already been taken from you.
zh_tw: 你被抓住了！失主要求歸還他們的財產，並威脅說如果不還將會遭受死亡或更糟糕的命運，但東西已經被從你這裡奪走了。

zh_tw: 角色們與其他人合謀奪取權力但失敗了，暴露了他們的野心和背叛。這種黑暗的行為可能是小規模的，比如試圖控制一個貴族家族，也可能是更大規模的，比如試圖推翻公爵、奪取公會控制權，或者推翻火焰之拳。

english: Your patriar parents seemed like relics. Their days of leading the family and its business holdings were long past. With the help of their partners, you sought to seize your family's holdings, but you underestimated the cunning that comes with age.
zh_tw: 你的貴族父母看起來像是過時的遺物。他們領導家族及其商業資產的日子早已過去。在他們的合作伙伴的幫助下，你試圖奪取家族的資產，但你低估了隨著年齡增長而來的狡猾。

english: A patriar promised you riches or something else of value if you helped remove Duke Dillard Portyr from power, creating a vacancy on the Council of Four. Your plot to blackmail the duke into retirement backfired when a rival of the treacherous patriar learned of the plot. Will the patriar give you up to save themselves?
zh_tw: 一位貴族承諾，如果你幫助將迪拉德·波特公爵從權力位置上移除，從而在四人議會中製造出一個空缺，就會給你財富或其他有價值的東西。你企圖勒索公爵退休的計劃適得其反，因為一個奸詐貴族的對手得知了這個計劃。這位貴族會不會為了自保而將你出賣？

english: {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA} thinks she has the Guild under her thumb, but various kingpins are plotting against her. The Guild will descend into violence unless it has a strong leader. You knew that Nine-Fingers wasn't going to step down willingly. Scaring her into retirement seemed like the only humane thing to do, but she refused to take the hint. Now she and the kingpins have it out for you.
zh_tw: {@creature Nine-Fingers Keene|BGDIA|九指基恩}認為她已經掌控了公會，但是各路老大正在密謀反對她。除非有一個強有力的領導者，否則公會將陷入暴力。你知道九指不會自願下臺。讓她因恐懼而退休似乎是唯一的人道做法，但她拒絕接受暗示。現在她和那些老大都在找你算賬。

english: The Flaming Fist is corrupt. You turned against your commanding officer, seeking to take the Fist in a new direction. Now you're branded a traitor.
zh_tw: 火焰之拳腐敗了。你背叛了你的指揮官，試圖帶領拳頭走向新的方向。現在你被標記為叛徒。

english: {@b Beneficiary}. This was your chance for glory. Your chance to rise above them all.
zh_tw: {@b 受益人}。這是你榮耀的機會。是你超越所有人的機會。

english: {@b Voyeur}. You should have prevented the power grab from happening. Your inaction makes you culpable.
zh_tw: {@b 窺視者}。你本應阻止權力的掠奪。你的不作為使你有罪。

english: {@b Patsy}. You might have been tricked into helping, but you helped all the same.

zh_tw: 那些反對未遂政變的人並沒有輕易放過角色們的背叛行為。透過在政變失敗後果表上擲骰或創造一些更糟糕的情況，來確定政變預定目標是如何扭轉局勢對付角色們的。

english: You've been ousted by the same group you sought to subvert. They've taken everything from you, and they plan to take more.
zh_tw: 你被你試圖顛覆的同一群人排斥了。他們已經從你這裡奪走了一切，並且他們計劃奪走更多。

english: The whole opportunity was a set-up! Now your former target is conducting a campaign of retribution against you.
zh_tw: 整個機會都是一個陷阱！現在你之前的攻擊目標正在對你進行報復行動。

english: You were a moment too late. A rival swept in and deposed your target. Now you're all that stands between them and total control.
zh_tw: 你晚了一步。一個對手搶先一步推翻了你的目標。現在你是阻止他們完全掌控的唯一障礙。

english: Your target had allies you didn't realize—interests from outside the city that now seek reprisal.
zh_tw: 你的目標有你未曾意識到的盟友——來自城市外部的利益集團，現在正在尋求報復。

english: Your efforts were rebuked handily. You didn't realize your target had such a weapon at their disposal, but now they're using it to hunt you down.
zh_tw: 你的努力被輕易地駁回了。你沒有意識到你的目標擁有如此強大的武器，但現在他們正利用它來追捕你。

english: One of your own ratted you out. Now you're all being hunted, but one of you is a traitor among traitors.
zh_tw: 你們中的一個出賣了你們。現在你們所有人都被追捕，但你們中的一個在叛徒中也是個叛徒。

english: Appendix A: Diabolical Deals
zh_tw: 附錄A：魔鬼契約

english: A hallmark of devils is their delight in striking deals with mortals. These deals are more than mere agreements; they are cosmically binding exchanges in which a devil grants a mortal character some measure of power for a price. Once an agreement is reached, the deal is sealed with a binding contract, which both parties must sign.
zh_tw: 魔鬼的一個顯著特徵是他們喜歡與凡人達成交易。這些交易不僅僅是簡單的協議；它們是宇宙間具有約束力的交換，在這種交換中，魔鬼賦予凡人角色一定程度的力量，但需要付出代價。一旦達成協議，交易就會透過一個雙方都必須簽署的具有約束力的合同來封存。

english: A devil's ultimate goal is to claim mortal souls. If it can't get a mortal's soul in one fell swoop, the devil tries to take it one little piece at a time by encouraging the mortal to commit evil acts and thereby condemning the mortal's soul to the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 魔鬼的終極目標是奪取凡人的靈魂。如果它不能一舉奪取凡人的靈魂，魔鬼會嘗試透過鼓勵凡人犯下惡行，逐步奪取靈魂，從而將凡人的靈魂定罪到九層地獄。

english: Infernal deals are enforced by the weight of the multiverse itself, by the very essence of the forces of Law and Evil. Devils channel this essence through the infernal hierarchy that governs their existence. Devils higher up in the hierarchy can leverage more potent deals and offer more enticing gifts.
zh_tw: 地獄契約由多元宇宙本身的力量維繫，其約束力來自秩序與邪惡力量的本質。魔鬼透過支配自身的地獄階級體系運用這股力量；地位越高，便能締結效力越強的契約，提供越誘人的贈禮。

english: Least devils can't enter into deals. Lesser and greater devils can enter into deals either for themselves or as an intermediary for their infernal superiors. Archdevils are the only devils able to freely deal with creatures outside the Nine Hells, usually when mortals invoke them to beg their favor.
zh_tw: 最下級魔鬼無法締結契約。下級與上級魔鬼既能為自己締約，也能代表地獄中的上司居間締約。唯有魔鬼大公能自由地與九獄之外的生物交易，通常是凡人呼喚他們、乞求恩惠之時。

english: Entering into a Deal
zh_tw: 達成協議

english: Despite their thirst for trapping mortal souls in binding contracts, devils can enter into deals only in specific circumstances. The easiest way for a devil to forge a deal is to do so within the Nine Hells, where it's closer to the infernal hierarchy and can more easily channel its power. Elsewhere in the multiverse, most devils are too removed from their power structure to enter into binding deals without some extraordinary circumstances.
zh_tw: 儘管魔鬼渴望將凡人的靈魂困在具有約束力的合同中，但它們只能在特定情況下進入交易。魔鬼最容易達成交易的方式是在九層地獄之內，那裡更接近地獄層級體系，可以更容易地引導其力量。在多元宇宙的其他地區，大多數魔鬼由於遠離其力量結構，無法在沒有一些特殊情況下進入具有約束力的交易。

english: A deal consists of a proposal that covers the terms each party expects, and a contract that seals the deal and makes it binding.
zh_tw: 交易包括一個涵蓋每方期望條件的提議，以及一個封存交易並使其具有約束力的合同。

english: Lesser and greater devils can't freely make deals outside of their home plane, but there are ways it can be done. If a summoner on another plane knows a devil's true name or has its talisman (as described in "Devil True Names and Talismans" in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}), instead of binding the devil into service, the summoner can create a ritual circle that allows the devil to forge a deal. Once the deal is sealed with a contract, the devil returns to the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 下級與上級魔鬼無法在其家園之外自由地締結契約，但有一些方法可以實現。如果另一個位面的召喚師知道一個魔鬼的真名或持有其護符（如{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中"魔鬼真名與護符"所述），召喚師可以建立一個儀式法陣，允許魔鬼締結契約，而不是將魔鬼束縛為僕從。一旦契約透過合同生效，魔鬼就會返回九層地獄。

english: An archdevil who wishes to make a deal with a character can do so in person or send a minion to propose the deal and negotiate on its behalf. A character can also contact an archdevil by killing a chaotic- or good-aligned humanoid and praying to the archdevil over the course of 1 hour. The archdevil hears the character's prayer and can choose to respond in dreams or visions, or it can send a minion with the authority to make a deal on its behalf.
zh_tw: 一個想要與角色交易的魔鬼大公可以親自進行，或者派遣一個手下提出交易並代表它進行談判。角色也可以透過殺死一個混亂或善良陣營的類人生物，並在1小時的祈禱過程中向魔鬼大公祈禱來聯絡魔鬼大公。魔鬼大公會聽到角色的祈禱，並可以選擇在夢中或幻象中回應，或者它可以派遣一個有權力代表它進行交易的手下。
