english: Proposal
zh_tw: 提案

english: Diabolical deals start with either the devil or the character broaching the subject and offering something. The terms of the deal require, at a minimum, the devil to offer a gift and the character to agree to a price. If the terms aren't acceptable to either party, they can negotiate and try to sweeten the deal by offering more valuable terms, or simply walk away. Not every deal is meant to be.
zh_tw: 魔鬼交易始於魔鬼或角色提出話題並提供某些東西。交易的條款至少要求魔鬼提供一個禮物，角色同意一個價格。如果條款對任何一方不可接受，他們可以協商並嘗試透過提供更有價值條款來使交易更有吸引力，或者簡單地走開。並非每個交易都註定要達成。

english: If the price is anything less than the character's soul, a devil often stipulates a penalty in the event the character fails to meet the deal's price.
zh_tw: 如果代價低於角色的靈魂，魔鬼通常會在角色未能滿足交易條件時規定一個處罰。

english: Once both parties agree to the terms, they seal the deal with a physical contract, which can take one of many forms (see "{@area Infernal Contracts|40a|x}").
zh_tw: 一旦雙方同意條款，他們將透過一份實體合同來封存交易，這份合同可以採取多種形式（見"{@area 地獄契約|40a|x}"）。

english: Ability Checks and Deal-Making
zh_tw: 屬性檢定與交易制定

english: Most deals with devils can be resolved without rolling dice to determine the outcome. A Charisma check can't deceive or persuade most devils into a bad deal because the fiends are too clever and experienced in deal-making to be fooled. If devils do get involved in a deal that sounds too good to be true or is confusing, they're likely to pause negotiations while they ask smarter devils for their opinions on the deal.
zh_tw: 大多數與魔鬼的交易可以在不擲骰子確定結果的情況下解決。魅力檢定無法欺騙或說服大多數魔鬼接受一個糟糕的交易，因為這些魔鬼在交易制定方面太過狡猾和經驗豐富，不會被愚弄。如果魔鬼確實參與了一個聽起來太好而不真實或令人困惑的交易，他們可能會暫停談判，同時他們向更聰明的魔鬼詢問他們對交易的看法。

english: The following ability checks can be made during deal-making:
zh_tw: 在交易制定過程中，可以進行以下屬性檢定：

english: If a devil attempts to deceive a character at the deal-making stage, the devil can make a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check opposed by the character's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If the character's check result is higher than the devil's, the character sees through the devil's deception.
zh_tw: 如果一個魔鬼在交易階段試圖欺騙角色，魔鬼可以進行一次魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定，與角色的感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定相對抗。如果角色的檢定結果高於魔鬼的，角色就能看穿魔鬼的欺騙。

english: Devils like to slip extra clauses into the fine print of a contract. When this happens, a character who can read Infernal can make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check opposed by the devil's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If the character's check result is higher than the devil's, the character detects the extra clauses in the fine print and can have them removed before the contract is signed.
zh_tw: 魔鬼喜歡在合同的小字中加入額外條款。當這種情況發生時，能夠閱讀煉獄語的角色可以進行智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，與魔鬼的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定相對抗。如果角色的檢定結果高於魔鬼的，角色就能在合同簽署前發現小字中的額外條款，並可以要求將其刪除。

english: What Devils Want
zh_tw: 魔鬼想要什麼

english: A devil wants souls, as every soul that it acquires brings the devil one step closer to its next promotion. If a character wants something from a devil but isn't willing to trade their soul, the devil might ask the character to perform a service for it instead. Archdevils are also fond of making mortals swear fealty to them.
zh_tw: 魔鬼渴望得到靈魂，因為每獲得一個靈魂，魔鬼就離下一次晉升更近一步。如果一個角色想要從魔鬼那裡得到某些東西，但又不願意交易他們的靈魂，魔鬼可能會要求角色為它執行一項服務。魔鬼大公也喜歡讓凡人向他們宣誓效忠。

english: Souls
zh_tw: 靈魂

english: When characters give up their souls to devils, they are promising to serve in the Nine Hells as devils themselves after death. Once promised to a devil, a character's soul can't be claimed by another creature.
zh_tw: 當角色將他們的靈魂交給魔鬼時，他們承諾在死後在九層地獄中作為魔鬼自己服務。一旦向魔鬼承諾，角色的靈魂就不能再被其他生物索取。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: A devil that can't claim a character's soul might demand a service by way of compensation. Such services drive the character toward committing evil or morally questionable acts designed to make the character more amenable to darker deals in the future. Here are a few examples:
zh_tw: 無法索取角色靈魂的魔鬼可能會要求提供一項服務作為補償。這樣的服務會驅使角色去執行邪惡或道德上可疑的行為，旨在使角色在未來更容易接受更黑暗的交易。以下是一些示例：

english: Without using magical coercion, the character must convince another mortal to enter into an infernal contract with the devil.
zh_tw: 不使用魔法強迫，角色必須說服另一個凡人與魔鬼簽訂地獄契約。

english: The character is told about a plague, an invasion, or other calamity that the devil has orchestrated, but must do nothing to affect the outcome.
zh_tw: 角色被告知有關瘟疫、入侵或其他災難，這些是魔鬼策劃的，但角色必須什麼都不做以影響結果。

english: The character must steal a holy relic from a good-aligned temple and deliver it to the devil or one of its subordinates.
zh_tw: 角色必須從一個善良陣營的神廟中偷取一件聖物，並將之交給魔鬼或其下屬。

english: Fealty (Archdevils)
zh_tw: 效忠（魔鬼大公）

english: Archdevils prize fealty almost as much as souls. One way in which a mortal can demonstrate fealty to an archdevil is to lead a religious cult devoted to the archdevil or perform heinous acts in the archdevil's name. A character can also enter into an agreement to serve the archdevil as a warlock. Such a character must take at least one level in the warlock class, choosing {@class Warlock||the Fiend|Fiend} (represented in this case by the archdevil) as their otherworldly patron.
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公幾乎像珍視靈魂一樣珍視效忠。凡人可以領導崇拜某位魔鬼大公的教派，或以其名義犯下滔天惡行，藉此表明忠誠。角色也能締約，以契術師身分效忠魔鬼大公；這樣的角色必須至少取得一個契術師職業等級，並選擇{@class Warlock||邪魔|Fiend}作為異界宗主，此處的宗主就是那位魔鬼大公。

english: What Devils Offer
zh_tw: 魔鬼所提供的

english: The limits of what a devil can offer are determined by its status in the infernal hierarchy. The {@area Infernal Hierarchy table|3ff|x} lists devils in ascending order of power, from lowly lemures to the mighty archdukes and archduchesses. (The orthon is included in this table for the sake of completeness, though orthons don't appear in this adventure or in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}. You can find out more about them in {@book Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes|MTF}.)
zh_tw: 魔鬼能提供什麼，取決於其在地獄階級體系中的地位。{@area 地獄階級表|3ff|x}按力量由低至高列出各種魔鬼，從卑微的劣魔到強大的魔鬼大公。（為求完整，表中也列入奧頓魔，儘管本冒險與{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}都未收錄這種魔鬼。關於牠們的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 魔鄧肯的眾敵卷冊|MTF}。）

english: Devils like to tempt mortals with treasure and magic items. Magic items bestowed by devils usually have a devilish cast to them. They're made of infernal iron, bear Infernal script, give off faint wails of torment, smell of brimstone, or have some other telltale sign (see the {@table Special Features; What Quirk Does It Have||What Quirk Does It Have? table} in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for examples).
zh_tw: 魔鬼喜歡用寶藏和魔法物品來誘惑凡人。由魔鬼賜予的魔法物品通常帶有魔鬼的特徵。它們由地獄鐵製成，刻有地獄文字，發出微弱的痛苦哀嚎，帶有硫磺的氣味，或有其他明顯的跡象（關於示例，請參閱{@book 城主指南|DMG}第7章中的{@table Special Features; What Quirk Does It Have||它有什麼怪癖？表格}）。

english: Devils might also agree to serve mortals for a time, acting as advisors and bodyguards.
zh_tw: 魔鬼也可能同意暫時為凡人服務，充當顧問和保鏢。

english: Lesser Devils
zh_tw: 下級魔鬼

english: A lesser devil can offer any or all of the following:
zh_tw: 一個下級魔鬼可以提供以下任何或所有內容：

english: Up to 500 gp worth of art objects, coins, or gems
zh_tw: 價值高達500金幣的藝術物品、硬幣或寶石

english: An uncommon magic item
zh_tw: 一件不常見的魔法物品

english: Loyal service for a period not exceeding nine years
zh_tw: 忠誠服務期限不超過九年

english: Greater Devils
zh_tw: 上級魔鬼

english: A greater devil can offer any or all of the following:
zh_tw: 一個上級魔鬼可以提供以下任何或所有內容：

english: Up to 5,000 gp worth of art objects, coins, or gems
zh_tw: 價值高達5,000金幣的藝術物品、硬幣或寶石

english: An uncommon or rare magic item
zh_tw: 一件稀有或罕見的魔法物品

english: Loyal service for a period not exceeding nine days
zh_tw: 為期不超過九天的忠誠服務

english: Archdevils
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公

english: An archdevil can offer any or all of the following:
zh_tw: 一個魔鬼大公可以提供以下任何或所有內容：

english: Up to 50,000 gp worth of art objects, coins, gems, or property
zh_tw: 價值高達50,000金幣的藝術物品、硬幣、寶石或財產

english: An uncommon, rare, or very rare magic item
zh_tw: 一件稀有、罕見或非常罕見的魔法物品

english: A valuable piece of information that can't be acquired by any other means
zh_tw: 一條無法透過其他任何方式獲得的有價值資訊

english: A single task that the archdevil or one of its minions can complete within the next nine days
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公或其手下在接下來的九天內可以完成的單一任務

english: A supernatural gift manifesting as a charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} and "{@area Archdevil Charms|414|x}")
zh_tw: 一種表現為護咒的超自然恩賜（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第7章的"{@book 超自然贈禮|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}"以及"{@area 魔鬼大公的護咒|414|x}"）

english: The benefit of a {@spell wish} spell (with no {@condition exhaustion} for using an effect other than duplicating another spell)
zh_tw: 一個{@spell wish||祈願術}法術的好處（使用除了複製其他法術之外的效果時，不會獲得{@condition exhaustion||力竭}）

english: Infernal Contracts
zh_tw: 地獄契約

english: Once the devil and the character agree to the terms of a deal, the agreement must be sealed with a contract, which the devil can produce as an action. The contract often appears in some theatrical manner; for example, it might arrive in a puff of smoke, accompanied by a fiendish cackle or an imp waving a sparkler.
zh_tw: 一旦魔鬼和角色就交易條款達成一致，協議必須透過合同來封存，魔鬼可以作為動作產生這份合同。合同通常以某種戲劇性的方式出現；例如，它可能會隨著一陣煙霧到來，伴隨著魔鬼的邪惡笑聲或是一個揮舞著火花的小魔鬼。

english: Contracts take a variety of forms, with the terms of the deal written out in Infernal, and are made binding in one of several ways, ranging from a simple signature to a revolting act. Once all concerned parties perform the actions necessary to enter the contract, the deal is struck. The character who struck the deal gains the benefits of the devil's gift and is bound to pay the price.
zh_tw: 契約有多種形式，交易條款用煉獄語書寫，並且可以透過幾種方式之一來使其具有約束力，從簡單的簽名到令人厭惡的行為。一旦所有相關方執行了進入契約所需的行動，交易就達成了。達成交易的角色獲得了魔鬼禮物的好處，並承諾支付代價。

english: Breach of Contract
zh_tw: 違背契約

english: A character bound by an infernal contract who fails to pay the price specified in the contract immediately suffers a penalty for breaching the contract, as specified in the contract itself. Common penalties include the following:
zh_tw: 被地獄契約束縛的角色如果未能支付契約中指定的價格，將立即因違反契約而受到懲罰，具體懲罰由契約本身規定。常見的懲罰包括以下幾點：

english: The character's soul is forfeit when the character dies (that is, the character is reborn in the Nine Hells as a lemure).
zh_tw: 角色死亡時，其靈魂將被沒收（即角色作為劣魔在九層地獄中重生）。

english: The character loses all monetary wealth and property, or a powerful magic item (determined by the DM), to the devil.
zh_tw: 角色失去了所有的貨幣財富和財產，或者一個強大的魔法物品（由DM決定），歸魔鬼所有。

english: The character grows horns, a tail, or some other devilish features that can't be removed by any means short of divine intervention (though illusions or disguises can conceal them). As long as these marks persist, the character detects as a fiend when subjected to {@spell detect evil and good} spells or similar magic.
zh_tw: 角色長出了角、尾巴或其他一些惡魔特徵，這些特徵除了神的幹預外，無法透過任何手段移除（儘管幻象或偽裝可以隱藏它們）。只要這些標記持續存在，角色在被施以{@spell detect evil and good||偵測善惡}法術或類似魔法時，會被檢測為惡魔。

english: The character gains a new flaw. A character who exhibits behavior inconsistent with this flaw has disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the behavior changes to match the flaw.
zh_tw: 角色獲得了一個新的缺陷。一個表現出與此缺陷不一致的行為的角色，在所有攻擊擲骰、屬性檢定和豁免檢定上都有劣勢，直到行為改變以符合缺陷為止。

english: Voiding a Contract
zh_tw: 使契約失效

english: Voiding an infernal contract releases all parties from its terms without penalty, as if the deal never happened. Any gifts or prices revert immediately, though some contracts might leave a scar or other lasting effect.
zh_tw: 廢除地獄契約可以使所有方免受其條款的懲罰，就像交易從未發生過一樣。任何禮物或價格會立即恢復，儘管有些契約可能會留下疤痕或其他持久影響。

english: The devil and the character who signed the contract must both agree to void the terms of the contract. As an action, the devil magically produces the contract. When both parties state their agreement to terminate it, the contract crumbles to dust and is destroyed.
zh_tw: 魔鬼和簽署契約的角色必須都同意解除契約條款。作為一個動作，魔鬼用魔法產生契約。當雙方宣告同意終止它時，契約化為灰塵並被銷燬。

english: Devils require compensation in exchange for voiding a contract. Some cowardly devils might be willing to void a contract in exchange for their lives, but most would rather risk death than demotion to a lower form of devil and the scorn of its peers.
zh_tw: 魔鬼在廢除合同時需要得到補償。一些膽小的魔鬼可能會願意為了自己的生命而廢除合同，但大多數魔鬼寧願冒險死亡，也不願意被降職為低階的魔鬼，遭受同僚的鄙視。

english: A devil might be persuaded to void a contract in exchange for one of the following:
zh_tw: 魔鬼可能會被說服解除契約，作為交換，可以提供以下其中一種：

english: One or more {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} (lesser devils will often settle for three, greater devils for nine, and archdevils have no interest in such a paltry alternative)
zh_tw: 一個或多個{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}（下級魔鬼通常願意接受三個，上級魔鬼接受九個，而魔鬼大公對這樣微不足道的替代品沒有興趣）

english: An exorbitant sum of gold plus the sacrifice of many humanoids in the devil's name
zh_tw: 一筆鉅額金幣加上以魔鬼之名犧牲的眾多人形生物

english: A powerful artifact, such as the {@item Hand of Vecna} or the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}
zh_tw: 一件強大的神器，比如{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那魔掌}或者{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}

english: Contract Forms
zh_tw: 契約形式

english: The Contract Forms table has examples of different forms of infernal contracts. The sections that follow the table describe the various contracts and the means by which they can be destroyed and voided.
zh_tw: 契約形式表提供了不同形式的地獄契約示例。表格後面的部分描述了各種契約以及它們被銷燬和解除的方式。

english: Contract Forms
zh_tw: 契約形式

english: d6
zh_tw: d6

english: Contract Form
zh_tw: 合同形式

english: Baby dolls
zh_tw: 洋娃娃

english: Damned wretch
zh_tw: 下地獄的可憐蟲

english: Infernal scroll
zh_tw: 地獄卷軸

english: Lemure kiss
zh_tw: 劣魔之吻

english: Song of the devil
zh_tw: 魔鬼之歌

english: Written in stone
zh_tw: 以石為墨

english: Baby Dolls
zh_tw: 洋娃娃

english: The devil produces two baby dolls made of dirty rags or rotting wood. The dolls recite the deal in high-pitched voices (in Infernal) and spew blood when they are hugged. To enter the contract, the devil and the character making the deal must each hug a doll. When the contract is finalized, the devil keeps one doll and the character keeps the other.
zh_tw: 魔鬼製造了兩個由髒布或腐爛木頭製成的嬰兒玩偶。這些玩偶用尖銳的聲音（用煉獄語）背誦交易內容，當它們被擁抱時會噴出血液。要進入合同，魔鬼和達成交易的角色都必須各自擁抱一個玩偶。當合同最終確定時，魔鬼保留一個玩偶，角色保留另一個。

english: To void such a contract, each doll must be destroyed within 1 minute of the other. Failure to destroy the second doll in the allotted time causes the first doll to re-form after 1 minute. Each doll is a Tiny object with AC 9, 9 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 要廢除這樣的契約，每個玩偶都必須在另一隻被摧毀後的1分鐘內被摧毀。未能在規定時間內摧毀第二隻玩偶會導致第一隻玩偶在1分鐘後重新形成。每個玩偶是一個小型物體，具有9的護甲等級，9點生命值，對火焰傷害易損，並免疫於毒素和心靈傷害。

english: Damned Wretch
zh_tw: 下地獄的可憐蟲

english: A portal opens, and a humanoid bound in chains with its eyes and mouth sewn shut stumbles through it. This individual is likely someone who breached their own infernal contract and is now paying the price. The terms of the deal are carved into the poor wretch's skin. To enter the contract, the devil and the character who made the deal carves their names into the wretch, who is then promptly banished.
zh_tw: 一個門戶開啟，一個被鏈條束縛、眼睛和嘴巴被縫起來的人形生物跌跌撞撞地穿過它。這個個體很可能是違反了自己地獄契約的人，現在正在付出代價。交易的條款被刻在這個可憐人的肌膚上。為了進入契約，魔鬼和達成交易的角色在可憐人身上刻下他們的名字，然後他立刻被放逐。

english: Use the {@creature commoner} stat block to represent the wretch, who is {@condition blinded} while its eyes are sewn shut. Once the contract is signed by both parties, the wretch no longer ages or needs food, drink, air, or sleep, and it gains immunity to all damage that isn't dealt by the devil or the character who made the deal. If the wretch dies, the contract is void.
zh_tw: 使用{@creature commoner||平民}的統計塊來代表這個可憐人，他的眼睛被縫上，處於{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態。一旦雙方簽署合同，這個可憐人就不再老化，也不需要食物、飲料、空氣或睡眠，並且他對不是由魔鬼或達成交易的角色造成的所有傷害都免疫。如果這個可憐人死了，合同就無效。

english: Infernal Scroll
zh_tw: 地獄卷軸

english: The devil produces a vellum scroll with the deal written on it in blood. To enter the contract, the devil and the character making the deal sign the scroll in their own blood, or that of a humanoid who has been dead for no longer than 1 minute. Immediately after it's signed by both parties, the contract vanishes to a secure location in the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 魔鬼出示了一份用血書寫協議的羊皮紙卷軸。要進入契約，魔鬼和達成協議的角色必須用自己的血，或者用一個死亡時間不超過1分鐘的類人生物的血，在卷軸上簽名。雙方簽署後，契約會立即消失，傳送到九層地獄的一個安全地點。

english: Burning the scroll voids the contract. It's immune to all other damage and harm.
zh_tw: 焚燒卷軸可以解除契約。它對所有其他傷害和損害免疫。

english: Lemure Kiss
zh_tw: 劣魔之吻

english: The devil summons a {@creature lemure} with the deal printed in glowing runes on its lumpy flesh. To enter the contract, the devil and character making the deal and must kiss the lemure. When that happens, the lemure is transformed into a stone statue with the deal visible on the surface. The statue then vanishes to the depths of the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 魔鬼召喚了一個{@creature lemure||劣魔}，交易內容以發光的符文印在其凹凸不平的肉體上。要進入合同，魔鬼和達成交易的角色都必須親吻劣魔。當這樣做時，劣魔會轉變成一座石雕，交易內容在表面上可見。然後，石雕消失到九層地獄的深處。

english: The statue is a Medium object with AC 17, 50 hit points, and immunity to all damage except radiant damage. No spell can turn it back into a lemure. Destroying the statue voids the contract.
zh_tw: 雕像是一箇中等大小的物件，具有17的護甲等級，50點生命值，並且對所有傷害免疫，除了光耀傷害。沒有任何法術可以將其變回劣魔。摧毀雕像可以解除契約。

english: Song of the Devil
zh_tw: 魔鬼之歌

english: The devil produces sheet music with the deal written on it. To enter the contract, the devil and the character making the deal must sing or play the discordant song, which remains stuck in their heads until the deal is fulfilled.
zh_tw: 魔鬼拿出一份寫有交易條款的樂譜。要締結契約，魔鬼與締約角色必須唱出或演奏這首不協調的曲子。曲調會一直在雙方腦海中盤旋，直到契約履行完畢才會消失。

english: Soaking the sheet music in holy water destroys and voids the contract, and causes the character and the devil to lose the ability to speak. A {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic ends the effect on its recipient.
zh_tw: 將樂譜浸泡在聖水中可以銷燬並使合同無效，並且導致角色和魔鬼失去說話的能力。一個{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}法術或類似的魔法可以結束對其接受者的效果。

english: Written in Stone
zh_tw: 以石為墨

english: A swell of lava oozes from a crack in the ground and quickly cools into rock. The deal appears as glowing script on the hardening lava. To enter the contract, the devil and the character making the deal must each place their left hand into the lava, which doesn't harm them, and leave a hand-shaped imprint in the stone. The slab of cooled lava then vanishes to a place of safekeeping.
zh_tw: 一股熔岩從地面的裂縫中湧出，迅速冷卻成岩石。交易條款以發光的文字出現在凝固的熔岩上。為了進入契約，魔鬼和簽訂交易的角色必須各自將左手放入熔岩中，熔岩不會對他們造成傷害，並在石頭上留下手印。然後，冷卻後的熔岩板會消失到一個安全的地方。

english: If the left hands of both the devil and the character who struck the deal are severed and placed into the handprints, the hands and the contract are destroyed, which also voids the contract.
zh_tw: 如果魔鬼和達成交易的角色的左手都被切斷並放入手印中，手和合同都將被銷燬，這也使合同無效。

english: Archdevil Charms
zh_tw: 魔鬼大公的護咒

english: Charms are supernatural gifts described in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Charms} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Archdevils and their appointed vassals can bestow such gifts on mortals, usually to entice them into signing an infernal contract. This section describes several new charms that archdevils and their vassals can bestow.
zh_tw: 護咒是{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Charms}中描述的超自然禮物（選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。魔鬼大公及其任命的附庸可以將這些禮物賦予凡人，通常是為了引誘他們簽署地獄契約。本節描述了魔鬼大公及其附庸可以賦予的幾種新護咒。

english: {@reward Charm of Agelessness|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Agelessness|BGDIA|長生不老護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of Diabolical Inspiration|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Diabolical Inspiration|BGDIA|邪魔激勵護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of Greater Conscription|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Greater Conscription|BGDIA|高等徵召護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of Hellish Rebuke|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Hellish Rebuke|BGDIA|煉獄叱喝護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of Lesser Conscription|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Lesser Conscription|BGDIA|次級徵召護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of Many Tongues|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of Many Tongues|BGDIA|千舌護咒}

english: {@reward Charm of the Adamant|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@reward Charm of the Adamant|BGDIA|堅心護咒}

english: Appendix B: Infernal War Machines
zh_tw: 附錄B：地獄戰爭機器

english: Infernal war machines are vehicles built in the Nine Hells and fueled by the souls of the damned. Smaller war machines carry raiding parties or scouts. Larger, more menacing war machines can crush entire hordes of demons or deliver shock troops behind enemy lines.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器是在九獄打造而成的，以被詛咒的靈魂作為燃料的車輛。小號的戰車通常交給掠奪小隊或是斥候使用。而那些更大，更危險的戰爭機器則是能擊潰整群的惡魔，或者向敵方陣線的後方投送突擊部隊。

english: Infernal war machines are made of infernal iron and bristle with spikes, blades, chains, and siege weapons. An infernal war machine's engine roars a bass, growling rumble with an undertone of agonized screams as its furnace burns souls for fuel.
zh_tw: 這些戰車用地獄鐵製成，裝備有尖刺，刀劍，鎖鏈以及攻城武器。地獄戰爭機器的引擎會發出低沉的轟鳴聲，通常還伴隨著痛苦的尖叫聲——來自於它熔爐中燃燒著的靈魂。

english: This appendix includes stat blocks for infernal war machines, rules for running and repairing them, and guidelines for handling chases in Avernus.
zh_tw: 此附錄收錄了各類地獄戰爭機器的資料，包括它們的駕駛和維修規則，以及阿弗納斯中追逐戰的處理方法。

english: Stat Blocks
zh_tw: 資料卡

english: Stat blocks for four sample infernal war machines are presented in this appendix. An infernal war machine's statistics function like those for creatures, with the following additional considerations.
zh_tw: 附錄中收錄了四種地獄戰爭機器的資料。地獄戰爭機器的資料處理方式和生物的處理方式相同，但要加入以下額外規則。

english: Creature and Cargo Capacity
zh_tw: 乘員數量和載貨量

english: Creature capacity describes how many creatures can ride the infernal war machine comfortably. More creatures can fit by squeezing or by clinging to the outside of the vehicle.
zh_tw: 乘員數量決定了地獄戰爭機器能容納多少生物。可以透過擠著坐，或是抓在戰車的外邊來容下更多生物。

english: Cargo capacity specifies how much cargo the infernal war machine can carry.
zh_tw: 載貨量決定了地獄戰爭機器能裝下多少貨物。

english: Armor Class
zh_tw: 護甲等級

english: An infernal war machine is typically made of infernal iron and has an Armor Class of 19 + its Dexterity modifier. While the vehicle is not moving, attack rolls made against it have advantage.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器使用地獄鐵製作而成的，它的護甲等級=19+敏捷調整值。當戰車處於靜止狀態時，對它發動的攻擊有優勢。

english: Ability Scores
zh_tw: 屬性值

english: An infernal war machine has the six ability scores and corresponding modifiers. Its size and weight determines its Strength. Dexterity represents its handling and maneuverability. A vehicle's Constitution reflects its durability and quality of construction. Infernal war machines usually have a score of 0 in Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器有六項屬性值以及對應的調整值。它的力量值由其大小和重量決定。敏捷反映了戰車的操縱效能。戰車的體質值反映了它的耐用性以及結構的牢固程度。地獄戰爭機器的智力，感知和魅力通常為0。

english: If an infernal war machine has a 0 in a score, it automatically fails any ability check or saving throw that uses that score.
zh_tw: 若地獄戰爭機器在某項屬性值上為0，則它在任何使用該屬性的能力檢定或豁免檢定中都將自動失敗。

english: Hit Points
zh_tw: 生命值

english: An infernal war machine's hit points can be restored by making repairs to the vehicle (see "{@area Repairs|435|x}"). When an infernal war machine drops to 0 hit points, it ceases to function and is damaged beyond repair, and any souls trapped in the vehicle's furnace are released to the afterlife (see "{@area Soul Fuel|42d|x}").
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的生命值可以透過維修來恢復（見"{@area 維修|435|x}"）。當一輛戰車的生命值降為 0 時，它將停止運作並且無法修復，所有被困於其熔爐中的靈魂都會被釋放（見"{@area 靈魂燃料|42d|x}"節）。

english: Damage Threshold
zh_tw: 傷害閾值

english: Infernal war machines have bulk or armor that allows them to shrug off minor hits. A vehicle with a damage threshold has immunity to all damage unless it takes an amount of damage equal to or greater than its damage threshold value, in which case it takes damage as normal. Any damage that fails to meet or exceed the vehicle's damage threshold is considered superficial and doesn't reduce the vehicle's hit points.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的體積和護甲讓它們能無視一些輕微的傷害。擁有傷害閾值的戰車免疫所有小於其傷害閾值的傷害；當其受到的傷害值大於或等於其傷害閾值時，它會照常受到傷害。所有小於其傷害閾值的傷害不會降低戰車的生命值。

english: Mishap Threshold
zh_tw: 厄運閥值

english: If an infernal war machine takes damage from a single source equal to or greater than its mishap threshold, it must roll on the Mishaps table (see "{@area Mishaps|433|x}").
zh_tw: 當地獄戰爭機器一次性受到大於或等於其厄運閾值的傷害時，它必須根據{@area 厄運|433|x}投擲一次厄運。

english: Actions Stations and Crew
zh_tw: 操作檯和操作人員

english: An infernal war machine doesn't have actions of its own. It relies on crew to occupy stations and use their actions to operate the vehicle's various functions. Any option that appears in the Action Stations section of an infernal war machine's stat block requires an action to perform.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器本身不能執行動作。它必須依靠佔據操作檯的人員用他們的動作來操作戰車的各種功能。所有在地獄戰爭機器資料中，操作檯一欄出現的功能都需要一個動作來使用。

english: Rules
zh_tw: 規則

english: Rules for infernal war machines are summarized below.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的使用規則如下。

english: Magical Elements
zh_tw: 魔法要素

english: An infernal war machine's engine, furnace, and weapons are magical and become inoperable within an {@spell antimagic field}. When the engine or furnace comes into contact with such an effect, the infernal war machine shuts down and can't be restarted until both the engine and the furnace are free of the field.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的引擎，熔爐以及武器都具有魔法，因此在{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}中無法運作。當戰車的引擎或熔爐遭遇此種效果時，戰車會停止運作，並且在引擎和熔爐都脫離該區域前都無法重新啟動。

english: Opportunity Attacks
zh_tw: 藉機攻擊

english: Infernal war machines provoke opportunity attacks as normal. When an infernal war machine provokes an opportunity attack, the attacker can target the vehicle or any creature riding on or inside it that doesn't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} and is within reach.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器會像其他生物一樣，正常觸發藉機攻擊。當地獄戰爭機器觸發藉機攻擊時，攻擊者可以選擇戰車本身，或是任何正在騎乘戰車或在戰車內部的生物，只要他們不處於{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}並且位於攻擊者的攻擊範圍內。

english: Action Stations
zh_tw: 操作檯

english: A creature can use an action of the station it's occupying. Once a creature uses a station's action, that action can't be used again until the start of that creature's next turn. Only one creature can occupy each station.
zh_tw: 生物可以使用其所在的操作檯的一個動作。在一個操作檯動作被使用後，直到該生物的下一個回合開始前，它都不能被再次使用。每個操作檯只能同時存在一個生物。

english: A creature not occupying an action station is either in a passenger seat or clinging to the outside of the vehicle. It can take actions as normal.
zh_tw: 不處於操作檯的生物可以坐在乘客席或是攀附在戰車的外部。此狀態下的生物可以如常進行動作。

english: Helm
zh_tw: 海姆

english: The helm of an infernal war machine is a chair with a wheel, levers, pedals, and other controls. The helm requires a driver to operate. An infernal war machine with no driver automatically fails Dexterity saving throws.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的駕駛室包括一張椅子，一個方向盤，槓桿，踏板，以及其他操縱裝置。駕駛室內需要一位駕駛員來駕駛。沒有駕駛員的地獄戰爭機器會自動在敏捷豁免中失敗。

english: A driver proficient with land vehicles can add its proficiency bonus to ability checks and saving throws made using the infernal war machine's ability scores.
zh_tw: 擁有陸地載具熟練的駕駛員，可以在戰車進行屬性檢定和豁免檢定時，在戰車屬性的基礎上加入自己的熟練加值。

english: Drive
zh_tw: 駕駛

english: While the infernal war machine's engine is on, the driver can use an action to propel the vehicle up to its speed or bring the vehicle to a dead stop. While the vehicle is moving, the driver can steer it along any course.
zh_tw: 當地獄戰爭機器的引擎正在執行時，駕駛員可以用一個動作給戰車加速或者進行緊急制動。當戰車處於移動中時，駕駛員可以沿任何路線駕駛它。

english: If the driver is {@condition incapacitated}, leaves the helm, or does nothing to alter the infernal war machine's course and speed, the vehicle moves in the same direction and at the same speed as it did during the driver's last turn until it hits an obstacle big enough to stop it.
zh_tw: 當駕駛員處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，或離開駕駛室，或不做任何動作來改變戰車的移動路線和速度，那麼戰車會按照駕駛員上一回合所設定的速度和方向前進，直到撞上足夠令它停止的障礙物為止。

english: Bonus Actions
zh_tw: 附贈動作

english: As a bonus action, the driver can do one of the following:
zh_tw: 駕駛員可以用一個附贈動作做出如下行為之一：

english: Start the infernal war machine's engine or shut it off.
zh_tw: 啟動或停止地獄戰爭機器的引擎。

english: Cause the infernal war machine to take the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action while the vehicle's engine is running.
zh_tw: 在引擎已經啟動的前提下，讓戰車使用{@action Dash||疾走}或{@action Disengage||撤離}動作。

english: Insert a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} or pour a flask of demon ichor into the engine's furnace (see "{@area Soul Fuel|42d|x}" and "{@area Demon Ichor Boost|42e|x}" below).
zh_tw: 向熔爐內放入一枚{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}或是一瓶惡魔穢液（見下方的"{@area 靈魂燃料|42d|x}"和"{@area 惡魔穢液提速|42e|x}"）

english: Weapon Stations
zh_tw: 武器操作檯

english: Each of an infernal war machine's weapons takes up a station on the vehicle.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的每個武器都會佔據一個操作檯。

english: One weapon can be replaced with another (see "{@area Alternative Weapon Stations|43d|x}"), provided the crew requirement needed to operate the replacement weapon is the same.
zh_tw: 戰車上的武器可以被替換成不同種類（見"{@area 可選武器|43d|x}"），前提是操作兩種武器所需要的成員要求相同。

english: Soul Fuel
zh_tw: 靈魂燃料

english: The engine at the heart of every infernal war machine has a furnace fueled by {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins}. Among the vehicle's helm controls is a narrow slot into which {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} can be fed. {@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|soul coins} placed in this slot tumble into the furnace, which is two size categories smaller than the vehicle containing it.
zh_tw: 每輛地獄戰爭機器的引擎核心都是一個用{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}作為燃料的熔爐。戰車的駕駛室內有個窄槽，可以從此處放入{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}。放入此槽的{@item Soul Coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}會進入熔爐，熔爐的大小比車輛的大小要小兩級。

english: An infernal war machine's furnace consumes a {@item soul coin|BGDIA} instantly, expending all the coin's remaining charges at once and destroying the coin in the process. The soul trapped in the coin becomes trapped in the furnace instead, powering the infernal war machine for a duration determined by how many charges the {@item soul coin|BGDIA} had when it was consumed: 1 charge, 24 hours; 2 charges, 48 hours; 3 charges, 72 hours. If it's still trapped in the furnace when this duration ends, the soul is destroyed. Not even divine intervention can restore a soul destroyed in this manner.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器的熔爐會立即消耗掉{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}，並同時一次性消耗掉靈魂幣剩餘的充能，在此過程中，靈魂幣會被摧毀。原本困在靈魂幣內的靈魂會被困在熔爐內，根據{@item soul coin|BGDIA|靈魂幣}被消耗時剩餘的充能來給引擎提供相應時間的動力：1 次充能持續 24 小時，2 次充能持續 48 小時，3 次充能持續 72 小時。如果在給引擎的充能時間結束後，靈魂依舊被困在熔爐內，那麼它會被摧毀。此情形下，即使是神祇的幹預也無法救回被摧毀的靈魂。

english: Regardless of its size, a furnace can hold any number of souls, their screams of anguish audible out to a range of 60 feet. Each new soul fed to the furnace adds more fuel to the vehicle, allowing it to run longer.
zh_tw: 無論其大小，熔爐都可以容納任意數量的靈魂，它們痛苦的悲鳴聲可以在 60 尺外被聽見。每個被投入熔爐的新靈魂都會給戰車提供燃料，讓它們執行更長的時間。

english: Demon Ichor Boost
zh_tw: 惡魔穢液提速

english: Pouring a flask of demon ichor into an infernal war machine's furnace increases the vehicle's speed by 30 feet for 1 minute. While the vehicle's speed is increased in this way, roll a {@dice d20} at the start of each of the driver's turns. On a 1, the vehicle suffers the Furnace Rupture result on the Mishaps table (see "{@area Mishaps|433|x}").
zh_tw: 往戰車的熔爐倒入一瓶惡魔穢液可以為戰車提供1分鐘額30尺移速加成。在此狀態下，每當駕駛員的回合開始時，投一個{@dice d20}。如果結果為 1，那麼戰車會遭受{@area 厄運|433|x}上的"熔爐破裂"。

english: {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@vehicle Devil's Ride|BGDIA|魔鬼座駕}

english: {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@vehicle Tormentor|BGDIA|摧殘者}

english: {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@vehicle Demon Grinder|BGDIA|惡魔粉碎者}

english: {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA}
zh_tw: {@vehicle Scavenger|BGDIA|拾荒者}

english: Mishaps
zh_tw: 厄運

english: Roll on the Mishaps table when one of the following occurs to an infernal war machine while it's in motion:
zh_tw: 如果地獄戰爭機器處於移動中時發生了以下任意情況，請根據"厄運表"骰出隨機情況：

english: The infernal war machine takes damage from a single source equal to or greater than its mishap threshold.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器一次受到了超過厄運閾值的傷害。

english: The infernal war machine fails an ability check (or its driver fails an ability check using the vehicle's ability) by more than 5.
zh_tw: 地獄戰爭機器在屬性檢定中失敗（或是駕駛員使用戰車的能力值在屬性檢定中失敗），且骰值低於目標檢定DC 5 點。

english: If a mishap has a repair DC, the mishap can be ended by making repairs to the vehicle (see "{@area Repairs|435|x}" below).
zh_tw: 如果此厄運有維修DC，則可以透過維修來避免此次厄運（見下方"{@area 維修|435|x}"一欄）。

english: Mishaps
zh_tw: 厄運

english: Mishap
zh_tw: 遇難

english: Repair DC
zh_tw: 修理難度

english: {@b Engine Flare}. Fire erupts from the engine and engulfs the vehicle. Any creature that starts its turn on or inside the vehicle takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage until this mishap ends.
zh_tw: {@b 引擎起火}。引擎處起火併蔓延到了車上。直到厄運結束前，所有在車內部的生物都要在其回合開始時，受到 10（{@dice 3d6}）點火焰傷害。

english: 15 (Dex)
{@b Locked Steering}. The vehicle can move in a straight line only. It automatically fails Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws until this mishap ends.
zh_tw: {@b 轉向鎖死}。戰車只能直線前進。直到厄運結束前，它的所有敏捷檢定和敏捷豁免自動失敗。

english: 15 (Str)
{@b Furnace Rupture}. The vehicle's speed decreases by 30 feet until this mishap ends.
zh_tw: {@b 熔爐破裂}. 厄運結束前，車輛的速度減少30尺。

english: 15 (Str)
{@b Weapon Malfunction}. One of the vehicle's weapons (DM's choice) can't be used until this mishap ends. If the vehicle has no functioning weapons, no mishap occurs.
zh_tw: {@b 武器故障}。厄運結束前，戰車的一個武器無法使用（由DM決定）。如果此車輛沒有正在使用的武器，則無事發生。

english: 20 (Str)

{@b Blinding Smoke}. The helm station fills with smoke and is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured} until this mishap ends. Any creature in the helm station is {@condition blinded} by the smoke.
zh_tw: {@b 蔽目煙霧}。魔舵站充滿煙霧，直到此厄運結束前處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||重度遮蔽}狀態。任何在魔舵站內的生物都會因煙霧而陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態。

english: 15 (Dex)
{@b Shedding Armor}. The vehicle's damage threshold is reduced by 10 until this mishap ends.
zh_tw: {@b 護甲碎裂}。厄運結束前，戰車的傷害閾值降低10點。

english: 15 (Str)

{@b Damaged Axle}. The vehicle grinds and shakes uncontrollably. Until the mishap ends, the vehicle has disadvantage on all Dexterity checks, and all ability checks and attack rolls made by creatures on or inside the vehicle have disadvantage.
zh_tw: {@b 車軸損壞}。車輛開始不受控制地抖動。直到厄運結束前，戰車在所有敏捷檢定中獲得劣勢，車內所有生物的屬性檢定和攻擊檢定都獲得劣勢

english: 20 (Dex)

{@b Flip}. The vehicle flips over, falls {@condition prone}, and comes to a dead stop in an unoccupied space. Any unsecured creature holding on to the outside of the vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be thrown off, landing {@condition prone} in a random unoccupied space within 20 feet of the overturned vehicle. Creatures inside the vehicle fall {@condition prone} and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: {@b 翻車}。車子翻了，陷入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，並且會熄火停在一處未佔據空間。所有爬在車外且沒有安全措施的生物必須透過一個{@dc 20}的力量豁免來防止被甩出去，失敗的生物會被隨機扔到車輛的 20 尺內一處未佔據空間，並處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。車內的生物會處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，並且需要透過 1 次{@dc 15}的力量檢定，否則受到 10（{@dice 3d6}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: None
zh_tw: 無

english: Vehicular Exhaustion
zh_tw: 車輛損壞

english: The harsh conditions of the Nine Hells can cause an infernal war machine to stop functioning properly, until it eventually breaks down. Such wear and tear can be represented using {@condition exhaustion}, as described in {@condition exhaustion||appendix A} of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, with these modifications:
zh_tw: 九獄嚴酷的環境可能會使得地獄戰爭機器的停止正常運作，並最終完全損毀。這種損耗可以用{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態來體現，如《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》{@condition exhaustion||附錄A}中所述，但做出如下變化：

english: When an infernal war machine reaches {@condition exhaustion} level 6, its hit points drop to 0, and the vehicle breaks down.
zh_tw: 當一輛地獄戰爭機器達到 6 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，它的HP降為 0，且車輛完全損壞。

english: The only way to remove the effects of {@condition exhaustion} on an infernal war machine is to repair the vehicle.
zh_tw: 解除戰車{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態的唯一手段是維修。

english: Repairs
zh_tw: 維修

english: When an infernal war machine is damaged, suffers a mishap, or gains one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion}, a creature can attempt to make repairs to the vehicle. The creature making the repairs must meet the following criteria:
zh_tw: 當地獄戰爭機器受損，遭到厄運，或是得到 1 級或更高的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}時，人物可以嘗試維修戰車。進行維修的生物必須滿足下列條件：

english: The creature can't operate the vehicle's helm or one of its weapon stations while making repairs.
zh_tw: 維修過程中，生物不能駕駛車輛或是使用武器。

english: The creature must be within reach of the damaged area in need of repair.
zh_tw: 損壞區域必須在生物的觸及範圍內。

english: The creature must have the right tools for the job ({@item smith's tools|PHB} or {@item tinker's tools|PHB}, for example).
zh_tw: 生物必須持有相應的工具（如{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}或{@item tinker's tools|PHB|修補工具}）。

english: Before beginning repairs, a creature must decide whether the repairs are aimed at ending a mishap, removing a level of {@condition exhaustion}, or restoring the damaged vehicle's hit points. Each option is discussed below.
zh_tw: 在開始維修前，生物必須決定維修的目的是結束厄運，解除 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，或是恢復戰車的HP。三種選項的詳述見下文。

english: End a Mishap
zh_tw: 結束厄運

english: A creature can use its action to make an ability check based on the nature of the mishap (see the {@area Mishaps|433|x} table), with disadvantage if the vehicle is moving. The creature adds its proficiency bonus to the check if it's proficient with the tools used to make the repairs. A successful check ends the mishap. A mishap with no repair DC can't be repaired.
zh_tw: 生物可以使用它的行動來進行基於不幸事件性質的屬性檢定（見{@area 厄運|433|x}表格），如果車輛正在移動，則檢定處於劣勢。如果生物對用於修理的工具熟練，則將其熟練加值加到檢定上。成功的檢定可以結束不幸事件。沒有修理DC的不幸事件無法被修理。

english: Remove Exhaustion
zh_tw: 移除力竭

english: If the infernal war machine has one or more levels of {@condition exhaustion}, a creature can spend 1 hour or more trying to reduce the vehicle's {@condition exhaustion} level. The vehicle must be stationary, and the creature must have spare parts to make the necessary repairs. After 1 hour of repair work, the creature makes a {@dc 15} Intelligence check, adding its proficiency bonus to the check if it's proficient with the tools used to make repairs. If the check succeeds, the vehicle's {@condition exhaustion} level decreases by 1. If the check fails, the vehicle's {@condition exhaustion} level remains unchanged, though the repair can be attempted again using the same replacement parts.
zh_tw: 如果這輛地獄戰爭機器有一個或多個等級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，一個生物可以花費1小時或更長時間試圖減少車輛的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級。車輛必須處於靜止狀態，並且該生物必須擁有備用零件來進行必要的維修。經過1小時的維修工作後，該生物進行一個{@dc 15}的智力檢定，如果它精通用於維修的工具，則將其熟練加值加到檢定中。如果檢定成功，車輛的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級減少1。如果檢定失敗，車輛的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}等級保持不變，儘管可以使用相同的替換零件再次嘗試維修。

english: Restore Hit Points
zh_tw: 回覆生命

english: If the infernal war machine has taken damage but has at least 1 hit point, a creature can spend 1 hour or more trying to patch the hull and replace damaged parts. The vehicle must be stationary, and the creature must have the spare parts to make the necessary repairs. After 1 hour of repair work, the creature makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity check, adding its proficiency bonus to the check if it's proficient with the tools used to make repairs. If the check succeeds, the vehicle regains {@dice 2d4 + 2} hit points. If the check fails, the vehicle regains no hit points, but the repair can be attempted again using the same replacement parts.
zh_tw: 如果地獄戰爭機器受到了傷害但至少還有1點生命值，一個生物可以花費1小時或更長時間嘗試修補船體並更換受損部件。車輛必須保持靜止，並且該生物必須擁有進行必要修理的備用部件。經過1小時的修理工作後，該生物進行一個{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定，如果它熟練使用修理工具，可以將其熟練加值加到檢定中。如果檢定成功，車輛恢復{@dice 2d4 + 2}點生命值。如果檢定失敗，車輛不會恢復生命值，但可以使用相同的替換部件再次嘗試進行修理。

english: Crashing
zh_tw: 撞擊

english: When an infernal war machine crashes into something that could reasonably damage it, such as an iron wall or another vehicle of its size or bigger, the infernal war machine comes to a sudden stop and takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it moved since its last turn (maximum {@dice 20d6}). Whatever the vehicle struck takes the same amount of damage. If this damage is less than the infernal war machine's damage threshold, the vehicle takes no damage from the crash.
zh_tw: 當一個地獄戰爭機器撞上某物，而這個物體可以合理地對其造成損傷，比如鐵牆或者至少與其大小相同的其他車輛時，地獄戰爭機器會突然停下，並根據自上一次回合以來它移動的每10尺，受到{@dice 1d6}點鈍擊傷害（最多{@dice 20d6}）。任何被車輛撞擊的物體也會受到相同數量的傷害。如果這個傷害小於地獄戰爭機器的損傷閾值，車輛不會因撞擊而受到任何傷害。

english: Regardless of whether or not the infernal war machine takes damage, each creature on or inside the vehicle when it crashes must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the vehicle moved since its last turn (maximum {@dice 20d6}), or half as much damage on a successful save.
zh_tw: 無論地獄戰爭機器是否受到傷害，當車輛撞擊時，車上或車內的每個生物都必須進行一個 {@dc 15} 的力量豁免檢定，自其上一個回合以來車輛每移動 10 尺就受到 {@dice 1d6} 的鈍擊傷害（最多 {@dice 20d6}），若豁免成功則傷害減半。

english: Crashing into Creatures
zh_tw: 撞擊生物

english: An infernal war machine can crash into a creature by entering its space. The creature can use its reaction to attempt to get out of the vehicle's way, doing so and taking no damage with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the vehicle slams into the creature and deals {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage to the creature for every 10 feet the vehicle moved since its last turn (maximum {@dice 20d6}).
zh_tw: 一臺地獄戰爭機器可以透過進入生物的空間來撞擊它。該生物可以使用其反應動作嘗試避開車輛，成功進行 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定即可避開且不受傷害。如果豁免檢定失敗，車輛將撞擊該生物，並對其造成每移動10尺 {@dice 1d6} 鈍擊傷害（最大 {@dice 20d6}），距離從車輛上一回合結束的位置算起。

english: An infernal war machine that is at least two size categories bigger than the creature it crashed into can continue moving through that creature's space if the infernal war machine has any movement left. Otherwise, the vehicle comes to a sudden stop, and each creature on or inside the infernal war machine when it crashes must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw, taking {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the vehicle moved since its last turn (maximum {@dice 20d6}), or half as much damage on a successful save.
zh_tw: 如果一臺地獄戰爭機器的體型至少比它撞擊的生物大兩個等級，並且它還有剩餘的移動力，它可以繼續穿過該生物的空間。否則，這臺載具會突然停止，當它撞擊時，所有位於或在地獄戰爭機器上的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 力量豁免檢定，每自其上一回合以來移動了 10 尺，就受到 {@dice 1d6} 鈍擊傷害（最多 {@dice 20d6}），如果豁免成功，則只受到一半傷害。

english: Falling
zh_tw: 墜落

english: When an infernal war machine goes over a cliff or otherwise falls, the vehicle and all creatures on or inside it take damage from the fall as normal ({@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen, maximum {@dice 20d6}) and land {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 當一輛地獄戰爭機器從懸崖上掉下去或以其他方式墜落時，該車輛及其中或其上的所有生物都會像平常一樣從墜落中受到傷害（每下降10尺受到{@dice 1d6}點鈍擊傷害，最大{@dice 20d6}），並且落地時處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。

english: Fiendish Variations
zh_tw: 惡魔變體

english: Devils work tirelessly to create new and more powerful engines of war to stem the demonic tides flowing out of the Abyss. In addition, infernal war machines can be equipped with more unusual weapons and armor.
zh_tw: 魔鬼不懈地打造更新、更強大的戰爭機器，以遏止從無底深淵湧出的惡魔浪潮。此外，地獄戰爭機器也能裝上更不尋常的武器與裝甲。

zh_tw: 可選武器

english: One weapon station can be switched for another, but the infernal war machine can't have more weapon stations than it normally has. A handful of alternative weapon stations are described in this section.
zh_tw: 一個武器站可以換成另一個，但是地獄戰爭機器不能擁有比它通常擁有的更多的武器站。本節描述了一些替代的武器站。

english: Chases on Avernus
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯的追逐戰

english: Using the guidelines in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Chases} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} and the Avernus Chase Complications table, you can build a chase that incorporates hazards unique to Avernus. Use an infernal war machine's Constitution modifier to determine how many times it can Dash during a chase.
zh_tw: 根據{@book 城主指南|DMG}中{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Chases}的指引以及阿弗納斯追逐事件表，你可以構建一場包含阿弗納斯特有危險的追逐。使用地獄戰爭機器的體質調整值來決定它在追逐過程中可以進行多少次衝鋒。

english: When a chase complication forces the vehicle to make an ability check, or the driver to make an ability check using the vehicle's ability, a mishap occurs if the check fails by 5 or more (see "{@area Mishaps|433|x}").
zh_tw: 當追逐併發症迫使載具進行屬性檢定，或駕駛員使用載具的能力進行屬性檢定時，如果檢定失敗差距達到5或更多，則會發生意外（見"{@area 厄運|433|x}"）。

english: Avernus Chase Complications
zh_tw: 阿弗納斯追逐複雜情況

english: Complication
zh_tw: 困境

english: You drive past a creature native to Avernus, and it chases after you. The DM chooses the creature.
zh_tw: 你駛過一個阿弗納斯特有的生物，它開始追趕你。由DM選擇這個生物。

english: A fire tornado, 300 feet high and 30 feet wide at its base, crosses your path. The vehicle avoids the tornado with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. Otherwise, the tornado envelops the vehicle, and each creature on or inside it that doesn't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 99 ({@dice 18d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 一個高達300尺，底部寬30尺的火龍捲橫穿你的路徑。車輛成功透過一個{@dc 15}敏捷豁免可以避開火龍捲。否則，火龍捲將包圍車輛，車上或車內的每個生物，如果沒有{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，則必須進行一次{@dc 18}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗將受到99點（{@dice 18d10}）火焰傷害，成功則只受一半傷害。

english: A swirling cloud of dust envelops the vehicle. Any creature on or inside the vehicle that doesn't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} is {@condition blinded} by the dust until the start of its next turn unless it's using some kind of protective eyewear.
zh_tw: 塵土形成的漩渦包圍了車輛。任何在車輛上或車內的生物，如果沒有獲得{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，將被塵土{@condition blinded||目盲}，直到其下一回合開始，除非它使用了某種保護性眼鏡。

english: Natural pillars of rock can grant cover as the vehicle swerves between them. The driver of the vehicle can make a {@dc 15} Dexterity check using the vehicle's Dexterity. On a success, the pillars provide {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} against attacks from other vehicles until the start of the driver's next turn.
zh_tw: 當車輛在自然形成的高聳石柱間急轉時，這些石柱可以提供掩護。車輛的駕駛者可以使用車輛的敏捷值進行一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定。若成功，在駕駛者的下一個回合開始之前，這些石柱將提供 {@quickref Cover||3||掩護} 來抵禦來自其他車輛的攻擊。

english: Your vehicle drives into a herd of {@creature Lemure||lemures}, {@creature manes}, or other fiends. The vehicle must make a {@dc 15} Strength or Dexterity check (driver's choice) to plow through the herd unimpeded. On a failed check, the herd counts as 30 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 你的載具駛入了{@creature Lemure||劣魔}、{@creature manes||原魔}或其他惡魔的群體中。載具必須進行{@dc 15}力量或敏捷檢定（由駕駛員選擇），以暢通無阻地穿過群體。如果檢定失敗，這個群體將被視為30尺的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: The vehicle drives off a 10-foot-high ledge and comes crashing down. Any unsecured creature on the outside of the vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or tumble off, taking normal damage from the fall and landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space on the ground.
zh_tw: 車輛從10尺高的邊緣駛下並墜落。車輛外部的任何未固定生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}敏捷豁免檢定，否則會從車上跌落，承受正常墜落傷害，並在地面上的一個未佔據空間{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: Uneven ground threatens to slow your vehicle's progress. The vehicle must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity check to navigate the area. On a failed check, the ground counts as 60 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 崎嶇的地面可能會減緩你的車輛的行駛速度。車輛必須進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷檢定以透過該區域。若檢定失敗，該地面視為60尺的{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: Derelict infernal war machines dot the landscape, rusted beyond repair and half buried in the dust. If the vehicle uses {@action Dash} this turn, the driver must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity check using the vehicle's Dexterity or crash into one of the derelict infernal war machines (see "{@area Crashing|439|x}").
zh_tw: 廢棄的地獄戰爭機器散落在各地，鏽蝕得無法修復，半埋在塵土中。如果車輛這回合使用{@action Dash||疾走}，駕駛員必須使用車輛的敏捷進行一次{@dc 10}的敏捷檢定，否則會撞上其中一臺廢棄的地獄戰爭機器（參見"{@area 撞擊|439|x}"）。

english: Part of the ground gives way underneath the vehicle, causing it to roll over. The vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the vehicle rolls into an upright position and can continuing moving. On a failure, the vehicle lands {@condition prone}, either upside down or on its side, after coming to a dead stop. When the vehicle rolls, any unsecured creature holding on to the outside of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or tumble off, landing {@condition prone} in an unoccupied space within 20 feet of the overturned vehicle.
zh_tw: 車輛下方的地面突然塌陷，導致車輛翻覆。車輛必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免。若成功，車輛會重新翻正並可以繼續移動。若失敗，車輛在完全停止後會 {@condition prone||伏地}，可能是倒置或側翻。當車輛翻覆時，任何未固定在車輛外部的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 力量豁免，否則會摔落，落在翻覆車輛20尺內的一個未被佔據的空間，並變為 {@condition prone||伏地} 狀態。

english: Foreword
zh_tw: 前言

english: {@i Tomb of Annihilation} is a story about death and the lengths individuals go to avoid it. As is true with many D&D adventures, it's bound to be funny, not so much in the words and pictures, but in the experience of playing it. Every bad player decision, unfortunate die roll, plan gone awry, silly voice, dorky monster, and ill-timed character death has the potential to make us laugh. Like clowns in a rodeo, adventurers will often do hilarious things to survive and succeed.
zh_tw: {@i 湮滅之墓}是一個關於死亡以及人們為避免死亡而竭盡全力的故事。就像許多D&D冒險一樣，它註定會很有趣，不是因為文字和圖片，而是因為遊戲體驗本身。每一個糟糕的玩家決策、不幸的擲骰結果、偏離計劃的行動、滑稽的聲音、愚蠢的怪物以及不合時宜的角色死亡都有可能讓我們發笑。就像牛仔競技中的小丑一樣，冒險者們往往會做出風趣的事情來生存和取得成功。

english: This adventure is much more than a deadly dungeon. To make it fun, we turned to Pendleton Ward, creator of the D&D-inspired animated series {@link Adventure Time|https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1305826}. Pen is a master storyteller who knows how to craft a meaningful narrative around humorous characters and trappings, and he understands that D&D players can create their own hilarity when given fun toys to play with. With Pen's help, we've tried to craft a tale filled with classic D&D tropes and odd twists that will make you and your players laugh, even as things are looking grim for the heroes. If the dancing monkey fruit doesn't do it for you, maybe the catapulting goblin village or the zombie-spewing undead tyrannosaurus will. There's also the tomb itself, which will hopefully illicit chuckles and screams of laughter with its murderous ingenuity.
zh_tw: 這場冒險遠不只是一座致命地城。為了讓它充滿樂趣，我們找來彭德爾頓·沃德協助；他創作的動畫影集{@link 探險活寶|https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1305826}正是受到D&D啟發。彭是一位敘事大師，擅長以滑稽的角色與佈景編織有意義的故事，也深知只要給D&D玩家有趣的玩具，他們自然會創造笑料。在彭的幫助下，我們試著寫出一個充滿經典D&D元素與古怪轉折的故事：即使英雄的處境十分險惡，你和玩家仍會笑出聲來。如果猴舞果還逗不笑你，也許能彈射出去的哥布林村落，或會吐出殭屍的不死暴龍就辦得到。當然還有墓穴本身；我們希望那些巧妙又致命的設計，能帶來竊笑、大笑與尖叫。

english: To our playtesters, I offer my heartfelt gratitude. You helped make {@i Tomb of Annihilation} a more fun experience for everyone. Your feedback—as brutal as any trap found herein—was tremendously valuable. Rest assured, your characters didn't die for nothing.
zh_tw: 對我們的測試玩家，我獻上衷心的感謝。你們幫助讓{@i 湮滅之墓}成為對所有人來說更有樂趣的體驗。你們的反饋——如同這裡發現的任何蠻橫陷阱一樣殘酷——極其寶貴。請放心，你們的角色並非白白犧牲。

english: Introduction
zh_tw: 簡介

english: Something evil is trapping the souls of the dead and draining life from all who have been raised from death by magic. This worldwide "death curse" not only prevents the raising of the dead but also causes creatures that were previously raised from the dead to wither and die. The source of this death curse lies in a trap-riddled tomb hidden beneath a lost city in the depths of a vast jungle.
zh_tw: 某種邪惡的力量正在囚禁死者的靈魂，並從所有透過魔法復活的死者身上吸取生命。這場全球性的"死亡詛咒"不僅阻止了死者的復活，還導致之前復活的生物枯萎並死亡。這個死亡詛咒的源頭位於一個佈滿陷阱的陵墓中，這個陵墓隱藏在一片廣闊叢林深處的失落城市之下。

english: {@i Tomb of Annihilation} is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure that takes place on the peninsula of Chult in the Forgotten Realms. Chult is a tropical wilderness composed mostly of jungles, plateaus, impassable mountains, and belching volcanoes. You can substitute a different jungle setting, changing location names as needed. Alternative D&D settings include the Amedio Jungle of Oerth, the Savage Coast of Mystara, the jungles of Xen'drik on Eberron, or a comparable setting on your home campaign world.
zh_tw: {@i 湮滅之墓} 是一個發生在遺忘國度的楚爾特半島上的龍與地下城冒險。楚爾特是一個熱帶荒野，主要由叢林、高原、不可逾越的山脈和噴發的火山組成。您可以替換為不同的叢林場景，根據需要更改地點名稱。其他龍與地下城設定包括奧斯的阿米迪奧叢林、密斯塔拉的野蠻海岸、艾伯倫的贊德里克叢林，或者您家鄉戰役世界的類似設定。

english: This adventure is designed to begin with a party of four to six 1st-level characters, who should advance to 11th level or higher by the adventure's conclusion.
zh_tw: 這次冒險設計為開始時有四到六名1級角色的派對，他們應該在冒險結束時達到11級或更高等級。

english: Story Overview
zh_tw: 故事梗概

english: The characters are drawn into the story by {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}, a retired adventurer and merchant who, years ago, was raised from the dead. Now, she's withering away. When she consulted priests, Syndra learned that the affliction was widespread and that no spell could cure it. She spoke to her friends among the Harpers, who determined the source of the affliction: an ungodly necromantic device called the Soulmonger. The Harpers received their intelligence from a lich, but they don't know much about the Soulmonger other than its name and general whereabouts. Adventurers willing to help Syndra must travel to Chult, a land of jungles and monsters, to find the Soulmonger and destroy it.
zh_tw: 角色們被{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}拉入故事，她是一位退休的冒險家和商人，多年前從死亡中被復活。現在，她正在逐漸枯萎。當她諮詢祭司時，辛德拉得知這種痛苦是普遍存在的，沒有任何咒語能夠治癒它。她向哈珀斯的朋友諮詢，他們確定了痛苦的源頭：一個被稱為噬魂器的邪惡死靈裝置。哈珀斯從一位巫妖那裡獲得了情報，但他們除了噬魂器的名字和大致位置外，對它知之甚少。願意幫助辛德拉的冒險者必須前往楚爾特，一個叢林和怪物之地，找到並摧毀噬魂器。

english: Unknown to Syndra and her allies, the Soulmonger is trapping the souls of the dead and depriving liches of the means to trap souls in their phylacteries. (The Soulmonger snatches up the souls before they can be trapped elsewhere.) Szass Tam, the most powerful lich among the Red Wizards of Thay, has sent operatives to Chult to steal the Soulmonger or, failing that, destroy it. Leading the Thayan expedition is Szass Tam's devoted lieutenant, {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA}. Valindra has been warned that adventurers might cross her path, so she's prepared for them.
zh_tw: 辛德拉和她的盟友們不知道，靈能者正在捕捉死者的靈魂，剝奪巫妖們用護身符捕捉靈魂的手段。(靈能者在靈魂被其他地方捕捉之前就將它們奪走。) 薩扎斯坦，泰伊紅法師中最強大的巫妖，已經派特工前往楚爾特去偷取靈能者，或者，如果失敗的話，摧毀它。領導泰伊遠徵隊的是薩扎斯坦的忠誠副手，{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}。瓦琳德拉已經被警告說冒險家可能會穿過她的路徑，所以她已經做好了準備。

english: Also lurking in the heart of Chult is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, a mythic, villainous figure among Chultans. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} was a human paladin and a sworn protector of the city of Mezro. He betrayed his oaths and was banished. Rather than redeem himself, he raised an undead army to conquer Mezro. The would-be tyrant was defeated and banished once more. Mezro was later destroyed by the Spellplague (or so it seemed), during which {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} lost his power to create and command undead. He withdrew to the city of Omu, leaving the vestiges of his undead army to roam unchecked throughout the jungle. That was not the end of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, however. Bitter over his loss of power, he forged an alliance with the yuan-ti lurking in the ruins of Omu and underwent a ritual of transformation, becoming a yuan-ti malison. As a yuan-ti, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} imposed his terrible will on the evil snake people and became their leader.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特的心臟地帶潛藏著{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，他是楚爾特人中的一個神話般的、邪惡的人物。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}曾是一個人類聖武士，也是梅茲羅城的誓言守護者。他背叛了他的誓言並被放逐。他沒有尋求救贖，而是召集了一支不死軍團來征服梅茲羅。這位潛在的暴君被擊敗並再次被放逐。梅茲羅後來被法術瘟疫摧毀（或看起來是這樣），在此期間，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}失去了創造和指揮不死生物的力量。他撤退到了奧穆城，留下了他的不死軍團的殘餘在叢林中無拘無束地漫遊。然而，這並不是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的終結。他對失去力量感到憤怒，與潛藏在奧穆廢墟中的元提結成了聯盟，並經歷了一種轉變儀式，成為了惡咒蛇人。作為元提，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}強加他可怕的意志於邪惡的蛇人，併成為了他們的領袖。

english: Beneath the cracked and broken streets of Omu lies a secret yuan-ti temple called the Fane of the Night Serpent, where {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} holds sway and plots to bring about the end of the world. Omu is also home to the Tomb of the Nine Gods. As the characters explore this multilevel dungeon, they encounter the spirits of Omu's trickster gods and are potentially inhabited by them. Each god embodies a different alignment, and any character inhabited by one gains a special power as well as a flaw. The nine trickster gods don't get along, and they try to push one another out of the characters' bodies. As the gods fight over their living hosts, the characters must deal with the deadly traps and monsters that guard the Soulmonger. Venturing deeper into the tomb, they uncover clues about the dungeon's evil architect—the archlich {@creature Acererak|ToA}—and learn that the Soulmonger is feeding souls to an undead horror called an atropal. Once it consumes enough souls, the atropal will transform into an evil god.
zh_tw: 在奧穆的破碎街道之下，隱藏著一個名為夜蛇神殿的秘密蛇人神廟，其中{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}掌握著權力，並且策劃著終結世界。奧穆也是九神之墓的所在地。當角色們探索這個多層地牢時，他們遇到了奧穆的詭神，並且可能被他們附身。每個神都體現了不同的陣營，被附身的角色也會獲得一個特殊能力以及一個缺陷。九個詭神並不和睦，他們試圖將彼此從角色的身體中推出。當神靈爭奪他們的活體宿主時，角色們必須應對守護噬魂器的致命陷阱和怪物。深入墓穴，他們發現了關於地牢邪惡建築師——巫妖{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}——的線索，並瞭解到噬魂器正在將靈魂餵養給一個叫做萎縮者的不死恐怖生物。一旦它吸收了足夠多的靈魂，萎縮者將轉變為一個邪惡的神。

english: Destroying the Soulmonger ends the death curse affecting the world, while killing the atropal incurs the wrath of {@creature Acererak|ToA}. Under normal circumstances, the enraged archlich would be far too great a foe for mortal adventurers to overcome, but with the trickster gods of Omu on their side, the heroes have a fighting chance.
zh_tw: 摧毀噬魂器可以結束影響世界的死亡詛咒，而殺死萎縮者會招致來自{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的憤怒。在正常情況下，憤怒的巫妖對於凡人冒險者來說是一個難以克服的敵人，但有了奧穆的詭神的幫助，英雄們有了一線生機。

zh_tw: 要進行這次冒險，你需要D&D第五版核心規則書（{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}, {@book 城主指南|DMG}, 和 {@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}）。

zh_tw: 當一個生物的名字以{@b 粗體}字型出現時，這是一個視覺提示，指引你檢視{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的統計資料塊。如果統計資料塊出現在{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}，冒險的文字會告訴你。
