english: Adventure Summary
zh_tw: 冒險摘要

english: The adventure is likely to play out as follows.
zh_tw: 這個冒險可能會按照以下方式展開。

english: The adventurers are teleported to Port Nyanzaru, the only major settlement in Chult. After exploring the city ({@area chapter 1|02e|x}), they embark on an expedition into the wilds of Chult ({@area chapter 2|09c|x}), eventually finding the ruined city of Omu ({@area chapter 3|1d6|x}). The characters don't know that Omu is their ultimate destination from the outset; they must find clues or evidence pointing in that direction.
zh_tw: 冒險家們被傳送到楚爾特的南扎路港，這是楚爾特唯一的主要定居點。在探索了這座城市（{@area 第一章|02e|x}）之後，他們開始了對楚爾特荒野的遠徵（{@area 第二章|09c|x}），最終找到了奧穆的廢墟城市（{@area 第三章|1d6|x}）。角色們並不知道奧穆從一開始就是他們的最終目的地；他們必須找到指向那個方向的線索或證據。

english: In this adventure, three creatures know that the cause of the death curse lies in Omu: {@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru, {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} in the Heart of Ubtao, and Saja N'baza in Orolunga. Several creatures know Omu's location: the guides {@creature Eku|ToA} and {@creature Salida|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru, {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} in the Heart of Ubtao, the aarakocra of Kir Sabal, Zalkoré of Nangalore, Saja N'baza in Orolunga, and the red dragon Tzindelor in Wyrmheart Mine. If the characters are unable to locate Omu or ascertain the source of the death curse, the following additional creatures might possess the knowledge they seek, at your discretion: Krr'ook in Dungrunglung, Nephyr in Firefinger, {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} in Mbala, Bwayes O'tamu in the wreck of the {@i Narwhal}, the survivors of the {@i Star Goddess} shipwreck, and Red Wizards under {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA}'s command.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險中，三個生物知道死亡詛咒的根源在奧穆：在南扎路港的{@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA|澤騰貝爺爺}，烏塔歐之心的{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}，以及奧羅隆加的薩賈·恩巴扎。幾個生物知道奧穆的位置：在南扎路港的嚮導{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}和{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}，烏塔歐之心的{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}，基爾薩巴爾的鳥羽人族，南戈洛雷的扎爾柯蕊，奧羅隆加的薩賈·恩巴扎，以及在龍心礦井的紅龍特辛德爾。如果角色們無法找到奧穆或確定死亡詛咒的來源，以下額外的生物可能擁有他們尋求的知識，由你酌情決定：東格隆格的克魯克，火指的尼菲爾，姆巴拉的{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}，{@i 獨角鯨}殘骸中的布瓦耶斯·奧塔穆，{@i 星辰女神}船難的生還者，以及在{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}指揮下的紅法師。

english: As the adventurers explore Omu, they are either captured by yuan-ti or forced to confront them in their underground temple ({@area chapter 4|298|x}). Not far from the yuan-ti temple is the entrance to the Tomb of the Nine Gods ({@area chapter 5|305|x}). The Soulmonger lies deep within the tomb, which is riddled with puzzles, traps, monsters, and magical wards. Best case scenario: the adventure concludes with the destruction of the Soulmonger and the heroes' daring escape from the tomb. Worst case scenario: the characters succumb to the evil of {@creature Acererak|ToA}, and their souls are devoured.
zh_tw: 當冒險者探索奧穆時，他們要麼被元提族捕獲，要麼被迫在他們的地下神廟中與他們對抗（{@area 第四章|298|x}）。元提神廟不遠處是九神之墓的入口（{@area 第五章|305|x}）。噬魂器位於墓穴深處，墓穴中充滿了謎題、陷阱、怪物和魔法結界。最佳情況：冒險以噬魂器的毀滅和英雄們大膽逃離墓穴而結束。最壞情況：角色屈服於{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的邪惡，他們的靈魂被吞噬。

english: Who Is Acererak?
zh_tw: 誰是阿瑟瑞克？

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} is a powerful lich known and feared throughout the multiverse. Much of his past is forgotten, but ancient texts assert that he comes from a world called Oerth.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 是一個在整個多元宇宙中聞名且令人畏懼的強大巫妖。他的過去大部分已被遺忘，但古老的文獻堅稱他來自一個叫做奧瑟（奧斯）的世界。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} travels the planes in search of artifacts. When he finds something useful or interesting, he locks it away. Although he's powerful enough to pursue godhood as other liches have done (Vecna being a prime example), {@creature Acererak|ToA} has no interest in being a god or being worshiped. He prefers to create evil gods and unleash them on mortals and immortals who oppose him.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 穿梭於各個位面尋找神器。當他發現有用或有趣的東西時，他會將其鎖起來。儘管他有足夠的力量像其他巫妖一樣追求神性（維克那是一個典型的例子），但{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 對成為神或被崇拜沒有興趣。他更喜歡創造邪惡的神，並將其釋放在反對他的凡人和不朽者身上。

english: Despite passing up opportunities for godhood, {@creature Acererak|ToA} attracts his fair share of followers and worshipers. He doesn't grant spells, nor does he give his devotees much of his precious time. Mostly he likes to watch them suffer and die as a result of their magical pursuits and folly.
zh_tw: 儘管放棄了成為神的機會，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}仍然吸引著他應得的追隨者和崇拜者。他不授予法術，也不會給他的信徒們太多他寶貴的時間。他主要喜歡看著他們在追求魔法和愚蠢行為的過程中受苦和死亡。

english: Although he has lived on many worlds and crafted countless demiplanes, {@creature Acererak|ToA} spends most of his time building tombs. He fills each one with treasure to attract powerful adventurers. He then kills them off in terrible fashion, using deadly traps and monsters while baiting and ridiculing them. The terror he evokes scars their souls, which he traps in his phylactery, the location of which is one of the multiverse's greatest secrets.
zh_tw: 儘管他在許多世界生活過並創造了無數的半位面，但{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}大部分時間都在建造墳墓。他用財寶吸引強大的冒險家。然後他用致命的陷阱和怪物以可怕的方式殺死他們，同時引誘和嘲笑他們。他喚起的恐懼在他們的靈魂上留下疤痕，他將這些靈魂困在他的護身符中，其位置是多元宇宙中最大的秘密之一。

english: Not too long ago by human standards, {@creature Acererak|ToA} found an atropal adrift at the edge of the Negative Plane and built the Soulmonger to nourish it to godhood. The lich chose one of his tombs—specifically the Tomb of the Nine Gods on Toril—to serve as the atropal's nursery.
zh_tw: 按照人類的時間標準來看，不久之前，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 在負能量平面的邊緣發現了一個漂泊的萎縮者，並建造了噬魂器來滋養它成為神明。巫妖選擇了他的一個陵墓——具體來說，是託瑞爾（托瑞爾）上的九神陵墓——作為萎縮者的育嬰室。

english: For more information on {@creature Acererak|ToA}, including his statistics, see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 有關{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的更多資訊，包括他的具體數值，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: Death Curse
zh_tw: 死亡詛咒

english: Understanding how {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s death curse works is vital to running the adventure smoothly.
zh_tw: 理解{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的死亡詛咒如何運作對於順利進行冒險至關重要。

english: The Soulmonger was activated 20 days ago and remains active until it is destroyed. While the Soulmonger is active, the following effects are in play:
zh_tw: 魂靈收割者在20天前被啟用，並且會一直活躍直到被摧毀。當魂靈收割者活躍時，以下效果將發揮作用：

english: Any humanoid on the planet that has been brought back from the dead begins to waste away. Its hit point maximum is reduced by 20 (1 for each day the Soulmonger has been active) and decreases by 1 every midnight until the Soulmonger is destroyed. If a humanoid's hit point maximum drops to 0, it dies. Traveling to another world or plane does nothing to halt the wasting effect once it has begun.
zh_tw: 任何在該星球上被從死亡中復活的人形生物都會開始逐漸衰弱。其生命值最大值減少20（噬魂器每活躍一天減少1），並且每個午夜減少1，直到噬魂器被摧毀。如果一個人形生物的生命值最大值降至0，它就會死亡。一旦開始衰弱效果，前往另一個世界或位面也無法停止這一效果。

english: A humanoid whose hit point maximum is reduced can't increase or restore it. This is true whether the creature's hit point maximum is reduced by the Soulmonger or by some other life-draining effect, such as the touch of a wight, wraith, or similar creature.
zh_tw: 一個類人生物的最大生命值如果被減少，則無法增加或恢復。這適用於生物的最大生命值被噬魂器減少，或者被其他生命吸取效果減少，例如被食屍鬼、幽魂或類似生物的觸碰。

english: If a humanoid dies anywhere on the planet, its soul becomes trapped inside the Soulmonger. Only the destruction of the Soulmonger can free the trapped soul.
zh_tw: 如果一個人形生物在星球任何地方死亡，它的靈魂就會被囚禁在靈能者內。只有摧毀靈能者才能釋放被囚禁的靈魂。

english: Any spell that breathes life into the dead (including {@spell revivify}, {@spell raise dead}, {@spell resurrection}, and {@spell true resurrection}) automatically fails if cast on a humanoid whose soul is either trapped in the Soulmonger or has been devoured by the atropal (see "{@area Soul Devouring|00a|x}" below).
zh_tw: 任何能夠賦予死者生命的法術（包括{@spell revivify||回生術}、{@spell raise dead||死者復活}、{@spell resurrection||復生術}和{@spell true resurrection||完全復生術}）如果在靈魂被囚禁在靈魂收集者中或被萎縮者吞噬的人形生物上施放，將自動失敗（見下文的"{@area 靈魂吞噬|00a|x}"）。

english: The Soulmonger does not affect the workings of {@spell speak with dead} spells or similar magic. The death curse has no effect on preexisting ghosts or spirits.
zh_tw: 噬魂器不影響{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術或其他類似魔法的工作。死亡詛咒對現有的鬼魂或靈魂沒有影響。

english: Meat Grinder
zh_tw: 肉磨機

english: {@i Tomb of Annihilation} can be played as written, or you can make it even more difficult by running it as a meat grinder. This mode of play is suitable for experienced players who have highly optimized characters and who don't mind putting those characters in jeopardy for the sake of a good challenge. It is less ideal for players who are inexperienced or get anxious at the thought of losing their characters.
zh_tw: {@i 湮滅之墓}可以按照原文進行遊戲，或者你可以透過將其執行為絞肉機模式來使其更加困難。這種遊戲模式適合那些擁有高度最佳化角色且不介意為了良好挑戰而將這些角色置於危險之中的經驗豐富的玩家。對於沒有經驗或一想到失去角色就感到焦慮的玩家來說，這不太理想。

english: You must choose to run the adventure as a meat grinder from the very beginning. In this mode of play, the Soulmonger gains the power to draw characters who are close to death, and the following rule applies:
zh_tw: 你必須從一開始就選擇以肉磨模式執行冒險。在這個玩法模式中，噬魂器獲得了吸引瀕臨死亡的角色的力量，並且以下規則適用：

english: A death saving throw succeeds on a roll of 15 or higher (instead of 10 or higher). This effect ends when the Soulmonger is destroyed. Other rules concerning death saving throws remain unchanged.
zh_tw: 死亡豁免檢定成功需要擲出15或更高（而不是10或更高）。當噬魂器被摧毀時，這個效果結束。關於死亡豁免檢定的其他規則保持不變。

english: Soul Devouring
zh_tw: 靈魂吞噬

english: The soul of any humanoid that dies while the death curse is active becomes trapped inside the Soulmonger. The soul remains there until it is consumed by the atropal or the Soulmonger is destroyed.
zh_tw: 任何在死亡詛咒活躍時死去的人形生物的靈魂都會被囚禁在魂靈收割者內。靈魂將留在那裡，直到被萎縮者吞噬或魂靈收割者被摧毀。

english: Once a soul becomes trapped in the Soulmonger, it's only a matter of time before the atropal devours it. You can determine the status of a trapped soul at dawn on any given day by secretly rolling a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 2 or higher, the soul remains trapped in the Soulmonger, at least until the next dawn. A roll of 1 indicates that the soul was devoured by the atropal. A creature whose soul is devoured in this horrific manner can't be returned to life by any means, including divine intervention.
zh_tw: 一旦靈魂被困在噬魂器中，它被萎縮者爾吞噬只是時間問題。您可以在任何一天的黎明時透過秘密擲一個{@dice d20}來確定被困靈魂的狀態。如果擲出2或更高的點數，靈魂將仍然被困在噬魂器中，至少直到下一個黎明。擲出1表示靈魂被萎縮者爾吞噬。以這種可怕方式被吞噬的生物無法透過任何手段復活，包括神聖幹預。

english: If the Soulmonger is destroyed and you haven't been tracking the status of a particular soul trapped within, grab a handful of d20s—one die for each day the soul was trapped—and roll them together. If you roll a 1 on any of the dice, the soul was devoured before it could be set free.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂收集者被摧毀，而您沒有跟蹤特定被困靈魂的狀態，請抓一把d20骰子——靈魂被困的每一天一個骰子——並將它們一起擲出。如果您在任何一個骰子上擲出了1，那麼在靈魂被釋放之前，它就被吞噬了。

english: Spells such as {@spell commune} and {@spell divination} can be used to determine whether a soul has been devoured or whether it's still trapped in the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 像{@spell commune||通神術}和{@spell divination||預言}這樣的法術可以用來確定一個靈魂是否已經被吞噬，或者它是否仍然被困在噬魂器中。

english: How many souls must the atropal devour to become a god? It could be thousands or millions. Ultimately it's the DM's call, but the default assumption is that this apotheosis could take months or years.
zh_tw: 萎縮者惡魔需要吞噬多少靈魂才能成為神？可能是數千或數百萬。最終由地下城主決定，但預設假設是這種神化可能需要幾個月或幾年。

english: Replacement Characters
zh_tw: 替代角色

english: The death curse means that, for the most part, dead characters stay dead. If a character dies and there's no reasonable way for the player to continue playing that character, you can have the player create a new character. A replacement character should be the same level as the rest of the party.
zh_tw: 死亡詛咒意味著，在大多數情況下，死去的角色會保持死亡狀態。如果一個角色死亡，並且玩家沒有合理的方式繼續扮演該角色，你可以讓玩家建立一個新角色。替代角色的等級應該與隊伍中的其他角色相同。

english: Chult attracts adventurers from all over the world, and the activation of the Soulmonger draws even more adventurers than usual to its untamed wilderness. The player characters are among the earliest to arrive, but adventurers from across the globe begin to converge in Chult as the crisis mounts. It should not be difficult to introduce new characters to replace those who have perished. A new character might be the last surviving member of a doomed expedition, a guide who has lived in Chult for years, a lone explorer seeking glory or treasure, or someone racing against time to save a loved one affected by the death curse. Work with the player to come up with a story that makes sense, given the circumstances.
zh_tw: 楚爾特吸引了來自世界各地的冒險家，靈能者的啟用比平時吸引了更多的冒險家來到其未開化的荒野。玩家角色是最早到達的人之一，但隨著危機的加劇，來自世界各地的冒險家開始匯聚在楚爾特。引入新角色來替代那些已經死去的人不應該太困難。新角色可能是一個註定失敗的遠徵隊的最後倖存者，一個在楚爾特生活多年的嚮導，一個尋求榮耀或財寶的孤獨探險家，或者是一個與時間賽跑以拯救受到死亡詛咒影響的親人的人。與玩家合作，想出一個在給定情況下講得通的故事。

english: Ticking Clock
zh_tw: 倒計時

english: {@i Tomb of Annihilation} is a time-bomb adventure. In other words, time is of the essence. The characters are under pressure to find and destroy the Soulmonger quickly, since many lives depend on it.
zh_tw: {@i 湮滅之墓} 是一場倒計時冒險。換句話說，時間至關重要。角色們面臨著找到並迅速摧毀靈魂收集者的壓力，因為許多生命都依賴於此。

english: Time pressure aside, Chult is a land ripe with adventure possibilities, and characters might be drawn by curiosity or circumstance to locations such as the garden ruin of Nangalore, the dwarven forge of Hrakhamar, or the pirate haven of Jahaka Anchorage. Such locations present dangers that, when overcome, prepare the characters for greater threats awaiting them in Omu. If the characters reach Omu too soon, they probably won't be high enough level to survive there for long. When the characters make inquiries about Omu, paint the lost city as a terrifying place so that players feel the tension of wanting to get there quickly, but not too quickly.
zh_tw: 拋開時間壓力不談，楚爾特是一個充滿冒險可能性的土地，角色們可能因為好奇心或環境因素被吸引到像南加洛爾的花園廢墟、矮人鍛造場哈拉卡馬爾，或者是海盜避風港賈哈卡錨地等地點。這些地點存在的危險，一旦克服，將為角色們準備好迎接奧穆更大的威脅。如果角色們太早到達奧穆，他們可能等級不夠高，無法在那裡生存太久。當角色們詢問奧穆時，將這座失落的城市描繪成一個可怕的地方，這樣玩家就會感受到想要快速到達，但又不能太快的緊張感。

english: Character Advancement
zh_tw: 角色升級

english: Characters begin the adventure at 1st level and gain XP by defeating monsters. After each game session, add up all the XP earned and distribute it evenly among the party members. If the characters gain enough XP to advance a level, encourage your players to level up their characters before the next session. Ideally, the characters should fall within the desired level range for each chapter of the adventure, as shown in the Suggested Character Levels table.
zh_tw: 角色們從1級開始冒險，並透過擊敗怪物獲得經驗值(XP)。在每次遊戲會話結束後，將所有獲得的經驗值加起來，並平均分配給隊伍成員。如果角色們獲得足夠的經驗值以提升等級，鼓勵你的玩家在下一次會話前提升他們角色的等級。理想情況下，角色們應該在冒險的每個章節中處於期望的等級範圍內，如建議角色等級表所示。

english: Suggested Character Levels
zh_tw: 建議角色等級

english: Chapter
zh_tw: 章節

english: Suggested Level
zh_tw: 建議等級

english: 1. Port Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 1. 南扎路港

english: 1st and higher
zh_tw: 1級及以上

english: 2. Land of Chult
zh_tw: 2. 楚爾特之地

english: 1st–6th
zh_tw: 1級至6級

english: 3. Dwellers of the Forbidden City
zh_tw: 3. 禁忌之城的居民

english: 5th–8th
zh_tw: 5至8級

english: 4. Fane of the Night Serpent
zh_tw: 4. 夜蛇神殿

english: 7th–9th
zh_tw: 7級至9級

english: 5. Tomb of the Nine Gods
zh_tw: 5. 九神之墓

english: 9th and higher
zh_tw: 9級及以上

english: You can slow the rate of advancement by withholding XP, "banking" it until you're ready for the party to level up. Conversely, you can hasten level advancement by awarding ad hoc XP for making discoveries, completing goals, roleplaying well, and surviving or avoiding deadly traps. Any such ad hoc award should be no more than what the characters would earn for defeating a monster with a challenge rating equal to their level. For example, a fair ad hoc award for a party of 2nd-level adventurers would be 450 XP, which is what the characters would earn for defeating a challenge rating 2 monster. As with other XP awards, the amount should be divided evenly among all party members.
zh_tw: 你可以透過保留經驗值(XP)來減緩升級速度，將其"儲存"起來，直到你準備好讓隊伍升級。相反，你可以透過為做出發現、完成目標、出色扮演角色以及生存或避免致命陷阱而授予臨時經驗值來加快等級提升。任何此類臨時獎勵都不應超過角色擊敗與他們等級相等挑戰等級的怪物所能獲得的經驗值。例如，對於2級冒險家隊伍來說，一個公平的臨時獎勵是450 XP，這是他們擊敗挑戰等級2的怪物所能獲得的經驗值。與其他經驗值獎勵一樣，這個數量應該平均分配給所有隊伍成員。

english: As the DM, you can dispense with XP tracking and allow characters to gain levels at whatever pace suits your campaign, using the Suggested Character Levels table as your guide.
zh_tw: 作為DM，您可以忽略經驗值（XP）追蹤，並允許角色以適合您戰役的節奏升級，使用建議角色等級表作為您的指南。

english: Chult is loaded with fun distractions, alluring locations, and opportunities for characters to explore. Consequently, it can be hard to gauge what level the characters will be when they arrive at adventure locations. Again, let the Suggested Character Levels table guide you. For example, if the characters are 4th level and about to stumble into Omu ({@area chapter 3|1d6|x}), you might want to steer them in a different direction, throw random encounters at them until they've reached 5th level, advance them to 5th level automatically, or adjust encounters in Omu to make the threats easier to overcome.
zh_tw: 楚爾特充滿了有趣的分心事物、誘人的地點以及供角色探索的機會。因此，很難衡量角色抵達冒險地點時會達到什麼等級。再次強調，請參考"建議角色等級"表格作為指導。例如，如果角色是4級並且即將誤入奧穆（{@area 第三章|1d6|x}），你可能想引導他們轉向其他方向，透過隨機遭遇讓他們升至5級，自動將他們提升至5級，或者調整奧穆的遭遇使其威脅更容易克服。

english: Starting at Higher Levels
zh_tw: 從更高等級開始

english: Although the adventure assumes that the characters begin at 1st level, you can start them off at 5th level or 9th level instead.
zh_tw: 儘管冒險假定角色從1級開始，但你也可以選擇讓他們從5級或9級開始。

english: Starting at 5th Level
zh_tw: 從5級開始

english: Characters of 5th level will still find parts of chapters 1 and 2 challenging. If an encounter becomes too much of a cakewalk, you can introduce enemy reinforcements. Hold off on XP awards and level advancement until the characters reach Omu in chapter 3.
zh_tw: 5級的角色在第1章和第2章的部分內容中仍然會面臨挑戰。如果某個遭遇戰變得太容易，您可以引入敵人增援。在角色到達第3章的奧穆之前，暫緩經驗值獎勵和等級提升。

english: Starting at 9th Level
zh_tw: 從9級開始

english: Characters of 9th level will steamroll through chapters 1 and 2, and that's fine. Spend less time on encounters in the jungle, and steer the characters toward Omu as quickly as possible. Once they arrive, run the adventure as you normally would. Characters at this level will still be challenged by chapters 3 and 4, particularly if you play the yuan-ti as intelligent adversaries. Hold off on XP awards and level advancement until the characters enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods in chapter 5.
zh_tw: 9級的角色將會輕鬆透過第1章和第2章，這是可以接受的。在叢林中的遭遇戰上花費較少時間，並儘可能快地引導角色前往奧穆。一旦他們到達，就像平常一樣進行冒險。在這個等級的角色在第3章和第4章仍然會面臨挑戰，特別是如果你將元提（ 蛇人 ）作為聰明的對手來玩的話。在角色進入第5章的九神陵墓之前，暫緩經驗值獎勵和等級提升。

english: Starting the Adventure
zh_tw: 開始冒險

english: The adventure's default starting location is the city of Baldur's Gate on the Sword Coast, in the Forgotten Realms setting. However, any large settlement will do. Possibilities from other D&D worlds include the Free City of Greyhawk on Oerth, the city of Specularum on Mystara, and the city of Sharn on Eberron.
zh_tw: 冒險的預設起始地點是被遺忘的國度設定中劍海岸的博德之門城市。然而，任何大型定居點都可以。來自其他D&D世界的可能性包括奧斯世界的自由城格雷休姆，密斯塔拉世界的斯佩庫拉姆城，以及艾伯倫的沙恩城。

english: To get things rolling, read or paraphrase the following introductory text to the players:
zh_tw: 為了開始，向玩家們閱讀或轉述以下引言文字：

english: For the past several days, the talk of the streets and taverns has all been about the so-called death curse: a wasting disease afflicting everyone who's ever been raised from the dead. Victims grow thinner and weaker each day, slowly but steadily sliding toward the death they once denied. When they finally succumb, they can't be raised—and neither can anyone else, regardless of whether they've ever received that miracle in the past. Temples and scholars of divine magic are at a loss to explain a curse that has affected the entire region, and possibly the entire world.
zh_tw: 過去幾天來，街頭巷尾和酒館裡談論的都是所謂的死亡詛咒：一種消耗性疾病，困擾著每一個曾經從死亡中被復活的人。受害者每天變得越來越瘦弱，緩慢但穩定地滑向他們曾經拒絕的死亡。當他們最終屈服時，他們無法再次被復活——其他人也是如此，無論他們過去是否曾經得到過那個奇蹟。神殿和神聖魔法的學者們對這種影響整個地區，甚至可能是整個世界的詛咒束手無策。

english: At this point, invite the players to explain why their characters are together, how long they've been together, and what they've been doing. If the characters don't know each other, you can have them meet at {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}'s residence.
zh_tw: 在這一點上，邀請玩家解釋為什麼他們的角色在一起，他們已經在一起多久了，以及他們一直在做什麼。如果角色們彼此不認識，你可以讓他們在{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的住所相遇。

english: Syndra Silvane's Curse
zh_tw: 希瓦娜的詛咒

english: The party's benefactor is a retired adventurer named {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}. Being a wizard and merchant of no small repute, she has magic to expedite the party's journey to Chult as well as treasure with which to reward characters for their assistance.
zh_tw: 隊伍的贊助人是一位名叫{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的退休冒險家。作為一名聲名顯赫的法師和商人，她擁有魔法來加速隊伍前往楚爾特的旅程，以及用以獎勵角色們協助的財寶。

english: When you're ready for the characters to meet with Syndra, read:
zh_tw: 當你準備好讓角色們與辛德拉見面時，請閱讀：

english: You have been invited to the home of {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}, a retired adventurer and merchant. A uniformed attendant leads you up a grand staircase to the third floor, then ushers you into a wood-paneled room with a fireplace, comfortable chairs, and a heavy table bearing goblets and bottles of wine. The darkly paneled walls are hung with maps and sea charts. Racks, shelves, and cabinets hold hundreds more rolled-up maps and charts.
zh_tw: 你被邀請到了退休冒險家兼商人{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的家中。一位穿著制服的侍從帶領你走上宏偉的樓梯，來到三樓，然後將你引入一個鑲有木板的房間，房間裡有壁爐、舒適的椅子，以及一個沉重的桌子上擺放著酒杯和葡萄酒瓶。深色的木板牆上掛著地圖和海圖。架子、書架和櫥櫃裡存放著數百卷卷起的地圖和海圖。

english: A person is seated in an overstuffed chair near the fire. You can't discern a gender, because only the person's head emerges from under a heavy blanket draped over the chair, and an embroidered hood and silver mask conceal the wearer's face. Even the person's dry, raspy voice provides no clue. "Help yourselves to wine, and seat yourselves, friends—I hope I may call you that."
zh_tw: 有一個人坐在火爐旁的一張填充過多的椅子上。你無法分辨性別，因為只有這個人的頭部從覆蓋在椅子上的沉重毯子下露出來，繡花兜帽和銀色面具掩蓋了佩戴者的臉。即使是這個人乾燥、嘶啞的聲音也沒有提供任何線索。"請自便喝點酒，坐下吧，朋友們——我希望我可以這樣稱呼你們。"

english: The masked speaker is {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}. She is a Tethyrian human {@creature archmage}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 戴面具的演講者是{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}。她是一位泰瑟瑞安人{@creature archmage||大法師}，有以下變化：

english: Syndra is lawful neutral and speaks Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Halfling.
zh_tw: 辛德拉是守序中立的，並且會說通用語、矮人語、精靈語和半身人語。

english: Syndra's hit point maximum has been reduced to 79 by the Soulmonger's death curse, and it decreases by 1 every midnight. If her hit point maximum drops to 0, Syndra dies and can't be brought back from the dead until the death curse has ended (and if her soul hasn't been devoured). Destroying the Soulmonger is the only way to halt the attrition and restore her hit point maximum to normal.
zh_tw: 由於靈能者的死亡詛咒，辛德拉的生命值上限已降至79，並且每午夜減少1點。如果她的生命值上限降至0，辛德拉就會死亡，並且直到死亡詛咒結束（並且如果她的靈魂沒有被吞噬）之前，她不能被復活。摧毀靈能者是唯一能停止損耗並恢復她生命值上限至正常的方法。

english: Roleplaying Syndra Silvane
zh_tw: 扮演辛德拉·西爾瓦尼

english: Syndra tells the characters her story and makes her request. Roleplay the encounter, paraphrasing the following information and responding in Silvane's dry, cracking voice to the characters' questions:
zh_tw: 辛德拉向角色們講述了她的故事並提出了她的請求。在角色扮演這次遭遇時，可以對以下資訊進行意譯，並用席爾瓦因乾燥、沙啞的聲音回答角色們的問題：

english: "I was an adventurer years ago. I died once and was raised from the dead. I have since closed the door on that stage of my life."
zh_tw: "我多年前是個冒險家。我死過一次，然後從死裡復活。從那以後，我關閉了生命中的那個階段。"

english: "The death curse you've heard about has struck me. I don't know how much longer I'll last before I perish. Clerics have no help to offer. They're stymied by what is happening."
zh_tw: "你們聽說過的死亡詛咒已經降臨到我身上。我不知道在我死去之前還能堅持多久。牧師們無法提供幫助。他們對正在發生的事情束手無策。"

english: "My contacts in the Harpers have learned that the cause of the death curse is a necromantic artifact called the Soulmonger. According to their sources, the Soulmonger is somewhere in Chult."
zh_tw: "我在豎琴手聯盟的聯絡人得知，死亡詛咒的原因是被稱為魂靈收割者的死靈法術神器。根據他們的訊息來源，魂靈收割者位於楚爾特的某個地方。"

english: "Chult is a peninsula ringed with mountains and choked with rainforests. Enormous reptiles, savage goblins, and an army of undead prowl its jungles and ruins. Mapping the place has always been nigh impossible, and nothing is known about the region's current geography beyond a few miles from the coast."
zh_tw: "楚爾特是一個被山脈環繞、雨林茂密的半島。巨大的爬行動物、野蠻的地精和一支不死生物的軍隊在它的叢林和廢墟中徘徊。繪製這個地方的地圖幾乎是不可能的，除了沿海幾英里之外，人們對該地區當前的地理情況一無所知。"

english: "Working from dozens of sea charts, log books, and explorers' journals, I assembled everything known about the current state of Chult into one map. I'll provide it to you if you undertake my mission."
zh_tw: "根據數十張海圖、航海日誌和探險家日記，我將所有已知的關於楚爾特當前狀態的資訊彙總成一張地圖。如果你承擔我的使命，我會提供給你。"

english: "When you're ready to depart, I will teleport us all to Port Nyanzaru, the only major settlement in Chult. I've been there several times before, so there's little chance of mishap. Once there, I'll stay with a friend named {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA}. He's one of seven merchant princes who rule the city."
zh_tw: "當你們準備好出發時，我會把我們所有人都傳送到南扎路港，這是楚爾特唯一的主要定居點。我之前已經去過那裡幾次，所以很少有意外發生。一旦到達那裡，我會和一個叫{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}的朋友呆在一起。他是統治這座城市的七個商王之一。"

english: Syndra has misgivings about sending inexperienced adventurers on so dangerous a quest, but she isn't taking any chances. She fails to mention that other, more experienced parties of adventurers have been sent to Chult already. All have disappeared, and Syndra fears the worst. In truth, they fell victim to the perils of Chult or crossed paths with {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA}, and were never seen or heard from again. If the characters urge Syndra to seek out a more experienced party of adventurers, she replies dryly, "I already have."
zh_tw: 辛德拉對於派遣沒有經驗的冒險家去執行如此危險的任務感到擔憂，但她不會冒任何風險。她沒有提及，其他更有經驗的冒險家團隊已經被派往楚爾特。所有人都消失了，辛德拉擔心最壞的情況。事實上，他們成為了楚爾特的危險的犧牲品，或者與{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}相遇，從此再也沒有人見過或聽說過他們。如果角色們催促辛德拉去尋找一個更有經驗的冒險家團隊，她會乾巴巴地回答："我已經這麼做了。"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Syndra promises each character a rare or uncommon magic item, delivered upon successful completion of her quest. (At the end of the adventure, each player can choose an appropriate item, subject to your approval.) Syndra also expects that the characters will find enough treasure in Chult to make them as rich as kings.
zh_tw: 辛德拉向每個角色承諾，如果成功完成她的任務，將提供一件稀有或不常見的魔法物品。（冒險結束時，每個玩家可以選擇一個合適的物品，需經您批准。）辛德拉還期望角色們在楚爾特找到足夠的財寶，使他們像國王一樣富有。

zh_tw: 如果角色們要求預先支付金幣，辛德拉會給每個角色50金幣以支付在南扎路港的費用。

english: Welcome to Chult
zh_tw: 歡迎來到楚爾特

english: With the exception of a few coastal settlements, Chult is untamed tropical wilderness: dense jungles and snaky rivers ringed by mountains, volcanoes, and sheer escarpments. Walls of mountains to the west, south, and east shield the interior from the sea and from the view of sailors. The rivers are so sluggish that it can be difficult determining which direction is upstream and which is down. The rivers pick up speed only where they thunder down through steep-sided gorges.
zh_tw: 除了一些沿海定居點外，楚爾特是一個未被馴服的熱帶荒野：密集的叢林和蜿蜒的河流被山脈、火山和陡峭的懸崖環繞。西部、南部和東部的山脈像牆壁一樣保護內陸不受海洋和水手視線的侵擾。河流流速如此緩慢，以至於很難判斷上游和下游的方向。只有在它們穿過陡峭的峽谷時，河流才會加速。

english: The safest entry points into this overgrown realm ("safest" is a relative term in this context) are on the north and east. The coast from the Bay of Chult to Refuge Bay offers beaches on which to embark into the uncharted jungle. Along the entire coast, the Bay of Chult is the only spot where travelers can find welcoming civilization. The rest of the peninsula is a breeding ground for bloodsucking, disease-bearing insects, monstrous reptiles, carnivorous birds and beasts of every variety, and murderous undead. The farther one moves from the coast, the more humid, hot, and inhospitable the land becomes.
zh_tw: 進入這個雜草叢生的領域最安全的地方（在這個語境下，"最安全"是一個相對的概念）是在北部和東部。從楚爾特灣到避難灣的海岸提供了可以進入未被標記的叢林的海灘。沿著整個海岸線，楚爾特灣是旅行者能找到友好文明的唯一地點。半島的其他地區是吸血、攜帶疾病的昆蟲、怪物爬行動物、食肉鳥類和各種野獸，以及殺人不死生物的繁殖地。一個人離海岸越遠，土地就越潮溼、炎熱、不適宜居住。

english: Weather
zh_tw: 天氣

english: Chult is hot, humid, and rainy throughout the year. The temperature regularly climbs as high as 95 degrees F (35 degrees C) during the day and seldom falls below 70 degrees F (20 degrees C) even at night. A day without rain is rare, but rain varies from a steady mist to drenching downpours.
zh_tw: 楚爾特全年炎熱、潮溼且多雨。白天的溫度經常高達95華氏度（35攝氏度），即使在夜間也很少降至70華氏度（20攝氏度）以下。不下雨的日子很少，但雨量從持續的薄霧到傾盆大雨不等。

english: Visibility in heavy rain is limited to 50 yards. Beyond that distance, only Huge or larger objects can be distinguished. Missile weapon ranges are halved during rain.
zh_tw: 在大雨中的視線限制在50碼以內。超過這個距離，只能分辨出大型或更大的物體。在雨中，遠端武器的射程減半。

english: On days that receive heavy rain, there's a {@chance 25} chance of a full-blown tropical storm featuring sheets of rain, high wind, lightning, tall waves at sea, and immense surf along the coast. Guides who know the conditions in Chult recommend hunkering down and staying put on these days. Travel by river is impossible (canoes are swamped by waves within 15 minutes of launching). If characters insist on traveling by foot, every character gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} automatically and must make a successful {@dc 10} Constitution check or gain another. Skill checks to avoid becoming lost are made with disadvantage on storm days.
zh_tw: 在遭遇暴雨的日子裡，有{@chance 25}機率形成完全發展的熱帶風暴，伴隨傾盆大雨、狂風、閃電、海上的巨浪以及沿岸的巨大浪湧。熟悉瓊達爾地區情況的嚮導建議在這些日子裡就地躲避。河道旅行將無法進行（獨木舟在出發後15分鐘內就會被浪湧淹沒）。如果角色堅持徒步旅行，每個角色將自動獲得1層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態，並且必須成功透過{@dc 10}體質檢定，否則再獲得1層。在暴風雨天氣中，避免迷路的技能檢定將具有劣勢。

english: Races of Chult
zh_tw: 楚爾特的種族

english: Members of every race and nationality of Faerûn can be found in Port Nyanzaru, but few of them ever travel more than a hundred yards beyond the city walls. The native peoples must be divided into those that are commonly known and those whose presence is legendary or only suspected. The first group consists of Chultans (humans), aarakocra, Batiri (goblins), dwarves (including albino dwarves), pterafolk, and tabaxi. In the second category, weretigers are suspected to be present in small numbers; explorers and hunters sometimes report seeing grungs (frog folk) deep in the jungle; and yuan-ti are rumored to be making a resurgence in remote areas.
zh_tw: 在南扎路港，可以找到費倫大陸上每個種族和國籍的成員，但他們中的少數人會走出城牆一百多碼。當地人民必須被分為那些通常已知的和那些存在是傳奇的或只是懷疑的。第一組包括庫爾坦人（人類）、鳥羽人族、巴提裡族（地精）、矮人（包括白化矮人）、翼手獸和斑貓人。在第二類中，懷疑有少量的虎人存在；探險家和獵人有時會報告說在叢林深處看到格朗族（蛙人）；還有傳言說在偏遠地區，蛇人正在重新崛起。

english: In addition to these known and suspected residents, a crew of frost giants has come to Chult seeking the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} and an expedition of Red Wizards is hunting for the Soulmonger, but the presence of these bands is still unknown to the larger population.
zh_tw: 除了這些已知和疑似居民外，一群霜巨人來到楚爾特尋找{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}，一支紅法師的遠徵隊正在尋找靈能者，但這些團隊的存在對更廣泛的人口來說仍然是未知的。

english: Finally, the deep jungle is overrun by skeletons, zombies, ghouls, and other types of undead. Everyone in Chult is all too aware of their presence.
zh_tw: 最後，茂密的叢林中充斥著骷髏、殭屍、食屍鬼以及其他型別的不死生物。楚爾特的每個人都非常清楚它們的存在。

english: Chultans
zh_tw: 楚爾特人

english: Chultans are the human natives of Chult. They have dark skin, black hair, and a rich culture. Driven out of the jungle by monsters and undead, they took refuge behind the stout walls of Port Nyanzaru, gave up their dynasties, and united to become a mercantile power in the southern ocean, eager to do business with anyone who visits their perilous land. A few Chultans migrated northward and established outposts in distant cities such as Athkatla, Baldur's Gate, Calimport, Memnon, and Zazesspur.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人是楚爾特的土生土長的人類。他們有著深色皮膚、黑髮和豐富的文化。由於怪物和不死生物的驅趕，他們被迫離開叢林，逃到了南扎路港堅固的城牆後面，放棄了他們的王朝，聯合起來成為南大洋的一個商業強國，渴望與任何訪問他們危險土地的人做生意。一些楚爾特人向北遷移，在諸如阿特卡拉、博德之門、卡林港、門農和扎澤斯普爾等遙遠城市建立了前哨站。

english: The lines of kings and queens that once held political sway throughout Chult have been mostly wiped out by time, war, calamity, and misfortune. They've been replaced by Chultan merchant princes who learned the art and craft of trading from Amnian and Tethyrian profiteers, and who now use their wealth to forge profitable alliances and to steer the fate of their frontier realm.
zh_tw: 曾經在楚爾特地區掌握政治權力的國王和王后的血統，大多已被時間、戰爭、災難和不幸所抹去。他們被楚爾特的商王所取代，這些王子從安姆人和泰瑟爾人的奸商那裡學到了貿易的藝術和技巧，現在他們利用自己的財富來建立有利可圖的聯盟，並引導他們邊疆王國的命運。

english: Chultans dress in light, colorful clothing appropriate for the tropical climate. They trade in gold, gemstones, jewelry, textiles, spices, rare herbs, ivory, wood, unrefined metal ore, and other commodities plucked and plundered from the jungles, valleys, and mountains of Chult. Among themselves, all Chultans still speak their own languages (a mix of exhaled and inhaled vowels, consonants, and tongue clicks), but any who deal regularly with foreigners also speak Common fluently, often with a heavy, characteristic accent.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人穿著輕便、色彩鮮豔的服裝，適合熱帶氣候。他們交易黃金、寶石、珠寶、紡織品、香料、稀有草藥、象牙、木材、未精煉的金屬礦石以及其他從楚爾特的叢林、山谷和山脈中採摘和掠奪的商品。在他們自己之間，所有楚爾特人仍然說著自己的語言（一種混合了呼氣和吸氣母音、子音和舌音的語言），但那些經常與外國人打交道的人也能流利地說通用語，通常帶有濃重而有特色口音。

english: Chultans in Port Nyanzaru seldom don armor because of the climate, but large, colorful shields made from toughened dinosaur hide are ubiquitous. These shields are called hlang and function as ordinary shields. In melee, they favor the traditional {@item yklwa|ToA} (pronounced YICK-ul-wah), a short, broad-bladed, one-handed, spear-like weapon. For more information about the yklwa, see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}."
zh_tw: 由於氣候原因，南扎路港的楚爾特人很少穿戴盔甲，但由堅韌的恐龍皮製成的大型、多彩的盾牌卻無處不在。這些盾牌被稱為hlang，功能與普通盾牌相同。在近戰中，他們偏愛傳統的{@item yklwa|ToA|伊庫瓦短矛}（發音為YICK-ul-wah），這是一種短小、寬刃、單手使用的矛狀武器。有關伊庫瓦短矛的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"。

english: Chultan Names
zh_tw: 楚爾特名字

english: You can use the following lists to create Chultan NPC names on the fly. Some Chultans adopt their old dynastic names as surnames.
zh_tw: 您可以使用以下列表即時建立楚爾特 NPC的名字。一些楚爾特人將他們古老的王朝名字作為姓氏。

english: {@b Male Names}: Atuar, Atumwa, Chiwa, Dengo, Emporo, Juma, Kundé, Kwalu, Losi, Mezoar, Mzolu, Olu, Osaw, Rindawan, Selu, Teron, Ugor, Vazul, Weshtek, Yapa
zh_tw: {@b 男性名字}: 阿圖阿爾, 阿圖馬瓦, 奇瓦, 登戈, 恩波羅, 朱馬, 昆德, 誇盧, 洛西, 梅佐阿爾, 姆佐盧, 奧盧, 奧薩烏, 林達萬, 塞盧, 特隆, 烏戈爾, 瓦祖爾, 韋什泰克, 亞帕

english: {@b Female Names}: Azuil, Bati, Chuil, Déla, Eki, Fipya, Isi, Joli, Katéla, Lorit, Mainu, Naboli, Nyali, Omoyala, Razira, Sana, Tefnek, U'lolo, Wadizi, Yuta, Zaidi, Zamisi
zh_tw: {@b 女性名字}: 阿祖伊爾，巴蒂，丘伊爾，黛拉，埃基，菲皮亞，伊西，喬莉，卡特埃拉，洛裡特，邁努，納博利，尼亞利，奧莫亞拉，拉齊拉，薩娜，特夫內克，烏洛洛，瓦迪齊，尤塔，扎伊迪，扎米西

english: {@b Dynastic Names}: Agolo, Atazi, Balaka, Bolélé, Dawa, Ekulu, Hakal, Imbogoro, Jaharwon, M'wenye, Natombe, Ngore, Oboko, O'tamu, Sahandi, Talro'a, Utugelu, Yudan, Zuberi
zh_tw: {@b 王朝名稱}: 阿戈洛，阿塔齊，巴拉卡，博萊萊，達瓦，埃庫盧，哈卡爾，因博戈羅，賈哈沃恩，姆文耶，納通貝，恩戈爾，奧博科，奧塔穆，薩漢迪，塔爾羅阿，烏圖格魯，尤丹，祖貝裡

english: Aarakocra
zh_tw: 鳥羽人

english: Tribes of aarakocra live atop the mountains and plateaus of Chult. Aarakocra leaders are skilled dancers who use their dances to inspire their followers as well as cast spells.
zh_tw: 楚爾特的山脈和高原上居住著鳥羽人族群。鳥羽人的領袖是技藝高超的舞者，他們利用舞蹈激勵追隨者，同時也施展法術。

english: Aarakocra strive to defend the land against the forces of evil. They have a reputation for aiding explorers who are lost, sick, or in some other trouble, provided those explorers aren't intent on plundering Chult's natural resources or exploiting its inhabitants. The aarakocra are natural enemies of pterafolk and the gargoyles of Omu.
zh_tw: 鳥羽人努力保衛這片土地，抵禦邪惡勢力。他們以幫助迷路、生病或有其他麻煩的探險者而聞名，前提是這些探險者無意掠奪楚爾特的自然資源或剝削其居民。鳥羽人是翼手獸和奧穆的石像鬼的天然敵人。

english: One aarakocra tribe has laid claim to a remote Chultan monastery called Kir Sabal. This site's existence is well known in Port Nyanzaru because the structures can be seen from the River Olung through occasional breaks in the jungle along the eastern bank. Little is known beyond that, however, because the cliffside structures are so difficult to reach from the ground. The aarakocra there shelter the last descendants of Omu's royal family, who hope to someday restore their reign.
zh_tw: 一個鳥羽人族群聲稱擁有一個偏遠的楚爾特修道院，名為基爾薩巴爾。這個地方在南扎路港眾所周知，因為透過叢林中偶爾的空隙，可以從奧倫河上看到這些建築。然而，除此之外，人們對這個地方知之甚少，因為這些懸崖上的建築從地面上很難到達。鳥羽人在那裡庇護著奧穆王室的最後後裔，他們希望有朝一日能夠恢復他們的統治。

english: Batiri (Goblins)
zh_tw: 巴提裡（地精）

english: Chult is home to scores of independent goblin tribes collectively known as the Batiri. A Batiri tribe is ruled by a queen (use the {@creature goblin boss} statistics). When a queen dies, fighting ensues until a new queen emerges victorious and proclaims herself ruler of the tribe. While the Batiri have many cultural and mythical aspects that make them unique, they behave essentially like other goblins; they are superstitious, cruel, suspicious of outsiders, fractious among themselves, and just as likely to torture and eat other humanoids as they are to trade with them. They are not only sadistic but highly creative in their tortures. For example, they enjoy tying enemies to trees, dousing them in honey, and leaving them to be devoured by insects over the course of several days, if a larger predator doesn't finish them off first.
zh_tw: 楚爾特是眾多獨立的地精部落的家園，這些部落統稱為巴提裡（巴提里）。一個巴提裡部落由一個女王統治（使用{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}的具體數值）。當一個女王死去時，戰鬥就會爆發，直到一個新的女王勝利出現並自稱為部落的統治者。儘管巴提裡擁有許多文化和神話方面的獨特之處，但他們的行為本質上與其他地精相似；他們迷信、殘忍、對外界人懷疑、內部紛爭不斷，並且同樣可能折磨和吃掉其他類人生物，就像他們與這些生物進行交易一樣。他們不僅殘忍，而且在折磨手段上極具創造力。例如，他們喜歡將敵人綁在樹上，用蜂蜜澆灌他們，然後將他們留給昆蟲在幾天內慢慢吞噬，除非更大的捕食者先一步將他們解決。

english: War Masks
zh_tw: 戰爭面具

english: Batiri warriors wear oversized wooden war masks into combat. Each goblin paints and decorates its own mask to make it look as fearsome as possible. Aside from intimidating enemies, these masks serve the same purpose among the Batiri as coats of arms among noble knights of Faerûn. Batiri of opposing tribes might not know an enemy's given name, but they'll know Snarling Crocodile or Fanged Ape.
zh_tw: 巴提裡戰士在戰鬥中戴著超大號的木製戰爭面具。每個地精都會自己繪畫和裝飾面具，使其看起來儘可能可怕。除了恐嚇敵人外，這些面具在巴提裡部落中的作用與費倫貴族騎士的紋章相同。對立部落的巴提裡可能不知道敵人的名字，但他們知道"咆哮的鱷魚"或"獠牙猿"。

english: Battle Stacks
zh_tw: 戰鬥堆疊

english: Batiri warriors sometimes ride on each other's shoulders in battle, in a formation known as a battle stack. These can be up to nine goblins tall. Each goblin tracks its hit points individually, but the stack moves and makes ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws as one creature. Only the goblin at the top of the stack can attack, and only the goblin at the bottom can move (all goblins stacked on its shoulders move with it). The goblin at the top makes all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability checks and saving throws for the stack. The goblin at the bottom makes all Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability checks and saving throws for the stack. A battle stack can't jump, but it can grapple or shove another creature, swing from vines, and use the {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Dodge}, and {@action Hide} actions. The stack has advantage on melee attacks because of its built-in "pack tactics" effect; all the goblins are waving spears at the enemy, even if only one can hit.
zh_tw: 巴提裡戰士有時在戰鬥中會騎在彼此的肩膀上，形成一種被稱為戰鬥堆疊的陣型。這些堆疊可以達到九個地精的高度。每個地精分別跟蹤其生命值，但堆疊作為一個生物移動並進行屬性檢定、攻擊骰和豁免投擲。只有堆疊頂部的地精可以攻擊，只有底部的地精可以移動（所有騎在它肩膀上的地精隨它一起移動）。頂部的地精為堆疊進行所有的感知、感知和魅力屬性檢定和豁免檢定。底部的地精為堆疊進行所有的力量、敏捷和體質屬性檢定和豁免檢定。戰鬥堆疊不能跳躍，但它可以抓住或推搡另一個生物，從藤蔓上蕩，以及使用{@action Dash||疾走}、{@action Disengage||撤離}、{@action Dodge||閃避}和{@action Hide||躲藏}動作。由於其內建的"群體戰術"效果，堆疊在近戰攻擊上有優勢；所有的地精都在向敵人揮舞長矛，即使只有一個能擊中。

english: When a goblin in the stack drops to 0 hit points, it is thrown from the stack. If the stack succeeds on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, it remains intact (albeit one goblin shorter). On a failed save, the stack collapses and all the goblins fall {@condition prone} in a 5-foot-square space.
zh_tw: 當疊加的哥布林中有一個的生命值下降到0，它會被丟擲疊加狀態。如果疊加成功透過一個{@dc 10}的敏捷豁免檢定，它將保持完整（儘管少了一隻哥布林）。如果豁免失敗，疊加會崩潰，所有哥布林會跌倒{@condition prone||伏地}在一個5尺見方的空間內。

english: To form a new battle stack, a goblin must use its action to climb onto the shoulders of another willing goblin within 5 feet of it. Other goblins can join an existing battle stack in the same way. A goblin can use its action to remove itself from a battle stack, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the bottom of the stack.
zh_tw: 要形成一個新的戰鬥堆疊，地精必須使用它的行動能力爬到另一個願意的地精肩上，且該地精必須在它5尺範圍內。其他地精也可以以相同的方式加入現有的戰鬥堆疊。地精可以使用它的行動能力從戰鬥堆疊中移除自己，落在堆疊底部5尺範圍內的未被佔據的空間。

english: The Batiri invented battle stacks as a way to combat creatures much larger than themselves as well as a way to reach enemies in trees. The battle stack formation has the added effect of making the puny goblins appear taller and more fearsome to their larger enemies. Battle stacks are not effective against other ground-based threats, since all but the topmost goblin give up their attacks and mobility to be part of the stack.
zh_tw: 巴提里人發明瞭戰鬥堆疊作為一種對抗比自己大得多的生物的方法，同時也是為了能夠到達樹上的敵人。戰鬥堆疊陣形還有一個額外的效果，那就是讓矮小的地精在較大的敵人面前顯得更加高大和可怕。戰鬥堆疊對其他地面威脅並不有效，因為除了最上面的地精之外，所有地精都放棄了他們的攻擊和機動性，成為堆疊的一部分。

english: Dwarves
zh_tw: 矮人

english: Most of the shield dwarf strongholds beneath Chult were destroyed by intense volcanic activity. Hundreds of dwarves were forced to flee their collapsing halls, only to be slaughtered and devoured by jungle predators. A few made it to Port Nyanzaru, where they remain to this day. Some of these survivors are albinos (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for more information).
zh_tw: 楚爾特之下的大多數盾矮人要塞因強烈的火山活動而被摧毀。數百名矮人被迫逃離他們坍塌的大廳，結果卻被叢林捕食者屠殺和吞噬。少數人抵達了南扎路港，他們至今仍然留在那裡。這些生還者中有些是白化病患者（更多資訊見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。

english: Frost Giants
zh_tw: 霜巨人

english: Twenty frost giants came to Chult in search of the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. Their ship is anchored north of Kitcher's Inlet, and teams of frost giants are scouring the jungle for signs of the ring and its wearer, {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}. A female frost giant named {@creature Drufi|ToA} leads the hunt. So far the frost giants have gone about their business unnoticed, but it's only a matter of time before they encounter a Flaming Fist patrol from Fort Beluarian. The frost giants hate Chult and its climate, but they won't give up the search for the ring no matter what the cost.
zh_tw: 二十名霜巨人來到楚爾特尋找{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。他們的船錨定在基徹爾灣的北部，霜巨人團隊正在叢林中搜尋戒指及其佩戴者{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}的蹤跡。一位名叫{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}的雌性霜巨人領導著這次狩獵。到目前為止，霜巨人在進行他們的活動時還未被注意到，但他們遲早會遇到來自貝路利安堡的焰拳巡邏隊。霜巨人討厭楚爾特及其氣候，但無論代價如何，他們都不會放棄對戒指的搜尋。

english: Grungs
zh_tw: 格龍蛙人們

english: These predominantly evil frog folk live in villages scattered throughout the jungle. They build their primitive structures from mud, vines, and wicker, and are more comfortable in trees than on the ground. They pepper enemies with poisoned arrows and leap from branch to branch without leaving any trail.
zh_tw: 這些主要為邪惡的蛙族生活在叢林中分散的村莊裡。他們用泥巴、藤蔓和柳條建造原始的建築，並且更習慣在樹上而不是地面上生活。他們用毒箭射擊敵人，並在樹枝間跳躍，不留下任何痕跡。

english: Not all grungs are evil. A few are willing to help explorers in exchange for food or treasure. Evil or not, grungs warn away intruders by hanging the bodies of slain foes from trees at the edge of their territory.
zh_tw: 並非所有的格朗族都是邪惡的。一些格朗族願意為了食物或財寶幫助探險者。無論邪惡與否，格朗族透過將被殺敵人的屍體懸掛在他們領地邊緣的樹上來警告入侵者。

english: Some Chultan guides are aware of one grung village due south of Port Nyanzaru, just above the headwater of the River Tiryki (pronounced tee-REE-kee). For more information on this village, see "{@area Dungrunglung|0d8|x}." {@adventure Appendix D|ToA|9|Grungs} contains additional information on grungs.
zh_tw: 一些楚爾特嚮導知道在南扎路港正南方，提爾基河（發音為tee-REE-kee）源頭上方有一個格朗村莊。關於這個村莊的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 登格隆格|0d8|x}"。{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9|Grungs}包含了關於格朗的額外資訊。

english: Pterafolk ("Terror Folk")
zh_tw: 翼手獸（"恐怖族"）

english: These malevolent flying reptilian humanoids swoop down on unsuspecting prey, steal what they can, and retreat to their high lairs to gloat over their stolen loot. The suddenness and violence of their raids has earned them the nickname "terror folk" among other races of Chult. They are natural enemies of the aarakocra. See the pterafolk entry in {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for full details.
zh_tw: 這些惡毒的飛行爬行類人形生物會突然俯衝下來攻擊毫無戒備的獵物，偷取他們能拿到的東西，然後撤退到他們高處的巢穴中去炫耀他們偷來的戰利品。他們襲擊的突然性和暴力性使他們在楚爾特的其他種族中贏得了"恐怖族"的綽號。他們是鳥羽人族的天然敵人。有關詳細資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}中的翼手獸條目。

english: Tabaxi
zh_tw: 斑貓人

english: Tabaxi are feline humanoids, originally native to the western continent of Maztica. Some Chultans refer to them as "cat folk" or "leopard people." Groups of tabaxi wound up in Chult after escaping from slavers. They are a cultured people and seldom evil. A few work as guides out of Port Nyanzaru. Others enter the jungle in small groups to hunt grungs and goblins for their own purposes.
zh_tw: 塔巴克西（斑貓人）是一種貓科類人生物，最初來自西部大陸馬茲蒂卡（馬茲提卡）。一些楚爾特人稱呼他們為"貓族"或"豹人"。一些塔巴克西在逃離奴隸販子後最終來到了楚爾特。他們是一個有文化的民族，很少是邪惡的。一些人在南扎路港擔任嚮導。其他人則以小組形式進入叢林，為了自己的目的狩獵格朗（格龍蛙人們）和地精。

english: Tabaxi hunters can be encountered anywhere in Chult. Tabaxi minstrels are seldom met outside Port Nyanzaru. {@adventure Appendix D|ToA|9|Tabaxi} includes statistics for both. Tabaxi can also be player characters (see {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|VGM} for tabaxi racial traits).
zh_tw: 斑貓獵人可以在楚爾特的任何地方遇到。斑貓詩人很少在南扎路港之外遇到。{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9|Tabaxi}包含了兩者的具體數值。斑貓人也可以是玩家角色（見{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|VGM}以瞭解斑貓人種族特性）。

english: Undead
zh_tw: 亡靈

english: Over a century ago, the warlord {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} raised an undead army to conquer the city of Mezro. The army consisted mainly of dead Chultans raised as zombies and cannibals transformed into ghouls. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and his legion were defeated and driven back into the jungle. Before {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} could organize another attack, Mezro planeshifted away, and {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} was stripped of his god-given powers. Declaring himself an enemy of the world, he threw his lot in with the yuan-ti. The remnants of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s undead army spread through the jungle like a blight, until now they claim hundreds of miles of wilderness as their hunting ground. To make matters worse, {@creature Acererak|ToA} filled out their ranks with horrible undead creatures such as girallon zombies and tyrannosaurus zombies (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), mainly to discourage explorers from getting too close to Omu. As the atropal feeds on the souls of the dead, it grows in power. Eventually, it will become powerful enough to control these ravenous undead creatures. Until then, the undead hordes of Chult have no leader.
zh_tw: 一個多世紀前，軍閥{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}組建了一支不死軍隊來征服梅卓城。這支軍隊主要由作為殭屍復活的死去的楚爾特人和被轉化為食屍鬼的食人族組成。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}和他的軍團被擊敗並被趕回叢林。在{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}能夠組織另一次攻擊之前，梅卓被平面轉移走，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}被剝奪了他的神賜力量。他自稱為世界的敵人，加入了玉帝。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的不死軍隊的殘餘像瘟疫一樣在叢林中蔓延，直到現在他們聲稱有數百英里的荒野作為他們的獵場。更糟糕的是，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}用可怕的不死生物如四臂猿怪喪屍和暴龍喪屍（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）填補了他們的行列，主要是為了防止探險者過於接近奧穆。隨著萎縮者吞噬死者的靈魂，它的力量在增長。最終，它將變得足夠強大，能夠控制這些貪婪的不死生物。在那之前，楚爾特的不死軍團沒有領袖。

english: Weretigers
zh_tw: 虎人

english: Chultans infected with weretiger lycanthropy haunt the jungle in small families or prides. Everyone in Port Nyanzaru has heard this rumor, but not all believe it.
zh_tw: 感染了虎人狼人的庫爾坦人在叢林中以小家庭或小團體的形式出沒。南扎路港的每個人都聽說過這個謠言，但並不是所有人都相信它。

english: Weretiger prides avoid outsiders, including adventurers, but a few evil weretigers enjoy making a sport of hunting intruders who come to plunder their land. Since weretigers can appear human, they readily pose as Chultan hunters, guides, rescuers, or explorers to lure in prey. These evil weretigers usually worship Malar, the god of the hunt. Others continue worshiping whatever deities they revered before becoming lycanthropes.
zh_tw: 虎人族群避免與外來者接觸，包括冒險家，但一些邪惡的虎人喜歡將狩獵入侵者作為娛樂，這些入侵者來到他們的領地是為了掠奪。由於虎人可以看起來像人類，他們很容易偽裝成楚爾特的獵人、嚮導、救援者或探險者來吸引獵物。這些邪惡的虎人通常崇拜狩獵之神馬拉爾。其他人則繼續崇拜他們成為獸化人之前所尊敬的神祇。

english: Yuan-ti
zh_tw: 蛇人

english: After being driven out of their ancient city (see "{@area Hisari|115|x},"), the yuan-ti claimed the ruins of Omu as their demesne. Their spies in Port Nyanzaru keep a wary eye on the merchant princes, would-be treasure hunters, and adventurers. Characters might also encounter yuan-ti purebloods, yuan-ti malisons, and yuan-ti abominations searching the jungle for hidden settlements and lost treasures.
zh_tw: 在被驅逐出他們的古城之後（見"{@area 希薩裡|115|x}"），元提族聲稱奧穆的廢墟為他們所有。他們在南扎路港的間諜警惕地監視著商王、潛在的寶藏獵人和冒險家。角色們也可能遇到尋找隱藏定居點和失落寶藏的元提族純血、惡咒蛇人和元提族怪物。

english: The yuan-ti of Omu believe that a sealed portal lies somewhere under the Peaks of Flame and that opening it will enable Dendar the Night Serpent to enter the world. The god Ubtao was supposed to stand against Dendar, but with Ubtao gone from the world, the yuan-ti believe nothing can stop the Night Serpent. They have dedicated an underground temple to this serpentine destroyer of worlds, but they are a long way from fulfilling their ultimate goal.
zh_tw: 奧穆的元提（蛇人）相信一個封閉的傳送門位於火焰峰（烈焰群峰）的某個地方，開啟它將使夜蛇丹德爾進入這個世界。神祇烏塔歐本應對抗丹德爾，但隨著烏塔歐離開這個世界，元提認為沒有什麼能阻止夜蛇。他們已經為這個毀滅世界的蛇形生物奉獻了一個地下神廟，但他們距離實現他們的終極目標還有很長的路要走。

english: Additional information about yuan-ti can be found in {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|VGM}, as well as {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 關於蛇人的更多資訊可以在《{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|VGM}》中找到，以及在《{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}》中。

english: Gods of Chult
zh_tw: 楚爾特的神祇

english: A central figure in Chult's history is the greater god Ubtao, who long protected the land and Chultan civilization. But Ubtao grew angry over his worshipers' endless warring and their reliance on him to solve all their problems. More than a century ago, Ubtao simply abandoned Chult, and his influence hasn't been felt there since that day. When he left, the Chultans suffered a crippling spiritual blow, but eventually the disunited, warring tribes learned to put aside their petty conflicts and unite as one people. To this day, the dinosaurs of Chult are still revered as Ubtao's sacred children by many Chultans, even though Ubtao himself is no longer popular.
zh_tw: 楚爾特歷史上的一箇中心人物是偉大的神祇烏博濤，他長久以來保護著這片土地和楚爾特文明。但烏博濤對他的信徒無休止的戰爭以及他們依賴他來解決所有問題感到憤怒。一個多世紀前，烏博濤簡單地拋棄了楚爾特，從那天起他的影響力就再也沒有在那裡感受到。當他離開時，楚爾特人遭受了一次毀滅性的靈性打擊，但最終，分裂的、交戰的部落學會了放下他們的小衝突，團結成一個民族。直到今天，楚爾特的恐龍仍然被許多楚爾特人尊崇為烏博濤的神聖子嗣，儘管烏博濤本人已不再受歡迎。

english: With Ubtao gone, the Chultans turned to other deities, including ones introduced to them by missionaries from distant civilizations. Waukeen, a goddess of trade, is revered by Port Nyanzaru's many merchants. Other deities with shrines in the city include Gond (god of craft), Savras (god of divination and fate), Sune (goddess of love and beauty), and Tymora (goddess of good fortune).
zh_tw: 隨著烏博塔奧的離去，楚爾特人轉向了其他的神祇，包括由來自遙遠文明的傳教士介紹給他們的神祇。瓦金，貿易之神，受到南扎路港眾多商人的尊敬。在這座城市中擁有神龕的其他神祇包括貢德（工藝之神）、薩瓦斯（占卜和命運之神）、蘇妮（愛與美之女神）和提莫拉（好運女神）。

english: Besides spreading word of their deities, however, too many foreign missionaries also exploited the Chultans and their land for profit, which led to many conflicts. The temples and shrines persist, but most of the clergy are now Chultans. Foreign clerics who proselytize too energetically aren't welcomed in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 然而，除了傳播他們的神祇之外，太多的外國傳教士也利用楚爾特人及其土地謀取利潤，這導致了眾多衝突。寺廟和神龕仍然存在，但大多數神職人員現在都是楚爾特人。在南扎路港，過於熱心傳教的外國神職人員並不受歡迎。

english: Chapter 1: Port Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 第1章：南扎路港

english: Port Nyanzaru hugs the coastline at the south end of the Bay of Chult. No other city exists in Chult, along the coast or anywhere else, except in ruins or overrun by monstrous creatures. Until recently, Port Nyanzaru was under the firm control of Amn, a foreign nation. Nine years ago, Amn was forced to relinquish the city to a wealthy and powerful consortium of Chultan traders backed by the Ytepka Society (pronounced yeh-TEP-kah), or risk a bloody conflict that probably would have ended with the city winning its independence anyway. Seven Chultan traders have since grown into influential merchant princes, enticing folk from up and down the Sword Coast with their wares.
zh_tw: 南扎路港依偎在楚爾特灣的南端海岸線上。在楚爾特，除了南扎路港之外，沒有其他城市，無論是沿海還是其他地方，除了廢墟或被怪物佔據的地方。直到最近，南扎路港一直受到外國阿曼（安姆）的嚴格控制。九年前，阿曼被迫將這座城市交給一個富有且強大的楚爾特商人聯盟，這個聯盟得到了伊特帕卡協會（發音為yeh-TEP-kah）的支援，否則可能會發生一場血腥衝突，最終這座城市無論如何都會贏得獨立。自那以後，七位楚爾特商人已經成長為有影響力的商王，他們用他們的商品吸引來自劍海岸上下的人們。

english: Port Nyanzaru is a bastion of civilization and commerce in a terrifying land. The amount of business that unfolds here and the cash that moves through its counting houses would make any merchant of Baldur's Gate or Waterdeep jealous. It's also a colorful, musical, aroma-filled, vibrant city in its own right. Other than trade, the biggest attractions are the weekly dinosaur races through the streets. Locals and visitors alike wager princely sums on the races' outcomes. The city also boasts grand bazaars, glorious mansions and temples, circuses, and gladiatorial contests.
zh_tw: 南扎路港是這個恐怖之地中的文明和商業堡壘。在這裡進行的商業活動和透過其會計所流動的現金會讓博德之門或深水城的任何商人都感到嫉妒。它本身也是一個色彩繽紛、音樂四溢、香氣撲鼻、充滿活力的城市。除了貿易，最大的吸引力是每週在街道上舉行的恐龍賽跑。當地人和遊客都在比賽結果上下了鉅額賭注。這座城市還擁有宏偉的集市、輝煌的豪宅和寺廟、馬戲團和角鬥士比賽。

english: Enemies surround Port Nyanzaru on all sides. The jungle teems with ferocious reptiles and murderous undead, pirates prowl the surrounding sea, and the mouth of the bay is home to a greedy dragon turtle.
zh_tw: 敵人從四面八方包圍著南扎路港。叢林中充滿了兇猛的爬行動物和殺人的不死生物，海盜在周圍海域徘徊，而海灣的入口則是一隻貪婪的龍龜的家園。

english: Characters who question locals can learn rumors that might help them survive the perils of Chult. The characters can secure gear and guides before leaving the city. {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA} is too weak to accompany them or provide any additional support.
zh_tw: 詢問當地居民的角色可以瞭解到一些可能幫助他們在楚爾特生存下來的謠言。角色們可以在離開城市前確保裝備和嚮導。{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}太虛弱了，無法陪同他們或提供任何額外的支援。

english: If you are running this adventure in a homebrew D&D setting, you can place Port Nyanzaru wherever you see fit and even change its name. If you're using another published D&D setting, you can dispense with Port Nyanzaru entirely and use a different coastal city as the launching point for the party's jungle expedition. Examples from other settings include the city of Sasserine on the edge of the Oerth's Amedio Jungle, the city of Slagovich near the Savage Coast of Mystara, and the city of Stormreach on Eberron's continent of Xen'drik.
zh_tw: 如果你在一個自制的D&D設定中進行這場冒險，你可以將南扎路港放置在你認為合適的地方，甚至可以更改它的名字。如果你使用另一個已釋出的D&D設定，你可以完全不用南扎路港，而使用一個不同的沿海城市作為隊伍叢林探險的起點。其他設定中的例子包括位於奧斯的阿米迪奧叢林邊緣的薩瑟林城，靠近密斯塔拉的野蠻海岸的斯拉戈維奇城，以及艾伯倫的仙德瑞克大陸上的風暴之港城。

english: Arrival
zh_tw: 抵達

english: {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA} teleports herself and the characters to Port Nyanzaru's Harbor Ward, not far from the harbormaster's office ({@area area 13|043|x}). Read:
zh_tw: {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因} 將自己和角色們傳送到南扎路港的海港區，離港務長辦公室（{@area 區域13|043|x}）不遠。閱讀：

english: You appear in a tropical city under the blazing sun. The familiar sounds of a harbor—creaking ropes, slapping waves, heavy barrels rolling across cobblestones—mingle with voices shouting and cursing in an unfamiliar language filled with clicks, inhalations, and singsongy words that make it sound almost musical. The aroma of unfamiliar spices and tropical fruit mixes with the wharfside smells of fish, tar, and canvas.
zh_tw: 你出現在一個熱帶城市中，陽光炙烤著大地。熟悉的港口聲音——繩索的吱吱聲、拍打的海浪聲、沉重的木桶在鵝卵石上滾動的聲音——與用一種不熟悉的語言喊叫和咒罵的聲音交織在一起，這種語言充滿了咔噠聲、吸氣聲和歌唱般的詞彙，聽起來幾乎是音樂般的。不熟悉的香料和熱帶水果的香氣與碼頭上的魚、焦油和帆布的氣味混合在一起。

english: Beyond all that, Port Nyanzaru is an explosion of color. Buildings are painted in bright shades of blue, green, orange, and salmon pink, or their walls are adorned with murals portraying giant reptiles and mythical heroes. Every building sports baskets and clay urns of colorful flowers or is draped in leafy, flowering vines. Minstrels in bright clothing adorned with feathers and shells perform on street corners. Multicolored pennants and sun awnings flutter atop the city walls. A crowd of children dressed in feathered hats and capes races past you, squealing in delighted terror as a street performer costumed as a big-toothed lizard stomps and roars behind them. The whole city seems to be bustling, sweating, laughing, swearing, and singing.
zh_tw: 除此之外，南扎路港是一片色彩的盛宴。建築物被漆成鮮豔的藍色、綠色、橙色和鮭魚粉紅色，或者牆壁上裝飾著描繪巨型爬行動物和神話英雄的壁畫。每棟建築都掛著裝滿五顏六色花朵的籃子和陶罐，或者被覆蓋著葉子茂盛、開滿花朵的藤蔓。穿著鮮豔服裝、裝飾著羽毛和貝殼的吟遊詩人在街角表演。多彩的旗幟和遮陽篷在城牆上飄揚。一群戴著羽毛帽子和披風的孩子們從你身邊跑過，他們尖叫著，因為一個裝扮成大牙蜥蜴的街頭表演者在他們後面踩踏和吼叫，感到既興奮又害怕。整個城市似乎都在忙碌、流汗、歡笑、咒罵和歌唱。

english: Syndra recommends that the characters secure rooms for themselves at either the Thundering Lizard (if they're looking for a raucous time) or Kaya's House of Repose (if they want a good night's sleep). Both inns are located near the Red Bazaar ({@area area 18|049|x}). Meanwhile, Syndra heads to the villa of the merchant prince {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA}. There she intends to stay for the remainder of the adventure. If the characters express interest in accompanying her, she's more than happy to introduce them to Wakanga (see "{@area Merchant Princes|056|x}").
zh_tw: 辛德拉建議角色們在雷霆蜥蜴（如果他們想要一個喧鬧的時光）或卡婭的休息之家（如果他們想要一個良好的夜間睡眠）為自己安排房間。兩家旅館都位於紅集市附近（{@area 區域18|049|x}）。與此同時，辛德拉前往商王{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}的別墅。她打算在那裡度過冒險的剩餘時間。如果角色們表示有興趣陪同她，她非常樂意將他們介紹給瓦康加（見"{@area 商王|056|x}"）。

english: When describing the sights and sounds of Port Nyanzaru, emphasize the heat, the humidity, the exotic sounds and smells, and other unique aspects of Port Nyanzaru. Some of its notable features are described hereafter:
zh_tw: 在描述南扎路港的景象和聲音時，要強調熱度、溼度、異國情調的聲音和氣味，以及其他南扎路港的獨特方面。以下是它的一些顯著特點：

english: Medium and Large dinosaurs are used as beasts of burden to haul two-wheeled carts, to hoist heavy loads on cranes, and to tow boats along the canals.
zh_tw: 中型和大型恐龍被用作馱獸來拉兩輪車，用起重機吊起重物，以及在運河中拖船。

english: Dinosaurs compete in weekly races through the streets. These brightly painted racing dinosaurs are fast, vicious, and barely under their riders' control.
zh_tw: 恐龍在街道上進行每週的比賽。這些顏色鮮豔的賽跑恐龍速度快、兇猛，幾乎不受騎手控制。

english: Flowers, green plants, and vines grow everywhere, seeming to spring out of the building stones themselves. The profusion of greenery needs constant tending to prevent roots and shoots from damaging buildings or tile roofs.
zh_tw: 花朵、綠色植物和藤蔓到處生長，看起來就像是從建築石塊本身生長出來的。這些茂盛的綠色植物需要不斷的照料，以防止根部和嫩芽破壞建築物或瓦屋頂。

english: The city's defensive walls and towers are topped with colorful awnings to shield guards from the sun and rain.
zh_tw: 這座城市的防禦牆和塔樓頂部裝有色彩鮮豔的遮陽篷，用以保護守衛免受陽光和雨水的侵襲。

english: All streets within the city walls are paved with cobblestones or flagstones, and they have deep rain gutters as much as 2 feet wide. Residents of Port Nyanzaru pay little attention to any but the heaviest deluge.
zh_tw: 城牆內的所有街道都鋪有鵝卵石或石板，並且它們有深達2尺的雨水溝。南扎路港的居民除了最猛烈的暴雨之外，幾乎不會注意其他任何情況。

english: Tabaxi minstrels wander the streets, performing for anyone who tosses them a few coins.
zh_tw: 斑貓詩人在街道上游蕩，為任何向他們投擲幾枚硬幣的人表演。

english: Walls divide the city into districts, and the open archways above the streets are painted with murals of dinosaurs, mountains, and mythic heroes.
zh_tw: 城牆將城市劃分成不同的區域，街道上方的開放式拱門上繪有恐龍、山脈和神話英雄的壁畫。

english: Crumbling ancient buildings covered with vines and lichens indicate the city's great age.
zh_tw: 覆蓋著藤蔓和苔蘚的破敗古建築表明這座城市有著悠久的歷史。

english: The ground floors of most buildings are made of stucco-covered stone and have tiny windows to keep out the heat at street level. The upper floors have bamboo or thatch walls with enormous windows to let in the breeze, under broad thatched or tiled eaves. All buildings are richly decorated with paint, ivy, and vivid flowers. Some are painted in symmetrical, geometric patterns of straight lines and sharp angles, while others portray animals, monsters, landscapes, and heroes in a stylized manner unique to Chult. Where space permits, buildings traditionally include a walled yard or garden.
zh_tw: 大多數建築的底層由灰泥覆蓋的石頭建成，並且有很小的窗戶以保持街道層的涼爽。上層則有竹製或茅草牆，配有巨大的窗戶以讓微風進入，在寬闊的茅草或瓦片屋簷下。所有建築物都裝飾著油漆、常春藤和鮮豔的花朵。有些建築以直線和尖銳角度的對稱幾何圖案進行繪畫，而其他建築則以楚爾特特有的風格化方式描繪動物、怪物、風景和英雄。在空間允許的情況下，建築物傳統上包括一個有圍牆的庭院或花園。

english: All the city's water comes from rain, so every building has a cistern or wooden barrels to catch water running off the roof. Every public square is built around a fountain or rain basin. With so much water running downhill, Chultans also make excellent use of water-driven mechanical gadgets. Many buildings have water wheels built into their cisterns. Rainwater running through spouts or channels turns the wheel, which pumps water into pools, turns millstones, powers bellows or lathes or saws, or accomplishes any other labor-saving or amusing task Chultan engineers can dream up.
zh_tw: 這座城市的所有水源都來自雨水，因此每個建築都有水箱或木桶來收集屋頂流下的水。每個公共廣場都是圍繞噴泉或雨水盆地建造的。由於有大量的水流下山，楚爾特人也非常好地利用了水力機械裝置。許多建築的水箱內都建有水輪。雨水透過噴口或渠道流過，轉動輪子，將水抽入水池，轉動磨石，驅動風箱或車床或鋸床，或完成任何楚爾特工程師能想到的節省勞力或有趣的任務。

english: Side Quests
zh_tw: 支線任務

english: As the characters explore Port Nyanzaru, they might encounter NPCs who need their help. Given the urgency of their mission, characters might be reluctant to take on side quests. They are under no obligation to complete them; however, completing a side quest can lead to unexpected rewards and discoveries.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索南扎路港時，他們可能會遇到需要幫助的NPC。鑑於他們任務的緊迫性，角色們可能不願意承擔支線任務。他們沒有義務完成它們；然而，完成支線任務可以帶來意想不到的獎勵和發現。

english: Introduce as many or as few of these side quests as you like. The NPCs who trigger them can be encountered anywhere within the city. If you can't decide which side quest to choose, roll a {@dice d10}.
zh_tw: 您可以隨意介紹這些支線任務中的多少個。觸發它們的NPC可以在城市的任何地方遇到。如果您無法決定選擇哪個支線任務，請擲一個{@dice d10}。

english: Collect a Debt
zh_tw: 討債

english: K'lahu (N female Chultan human {@creature thug}), a bookie who takes bets at Executioner's Run (see {@area area 2|036|x}), asks the adventurers to come with her as she collects a debt. The pay is 10 percent of whatever is collected on the 500 gp debt, which is owed by a man named Taban (N male Chultan human {@creature gladiator}). Taban refuses to pay anything until he's beaten down to 20 or fewer hit points, whereupon he offers up a pouch containing ten 50 gp gemstones. Ashamed by his defeat and eager to redeem himself, Taban offers to join the party as a follower, demanding no pay for the duration of the adventure.
zh_tw: 卡'拉胡（中立女性楚爾特人人類 {@creature thug||暴徒}），一位在處刑者之徑（見{@area 區域2|036|x}）收受賭注的莊家，邀請冒險者隨她一同去收債。報酬是收回500金幣債務中的10%。這筆債的欠款者是一個叫塔班（中立男性楚爾特人人類 {@creature gladiator||角鬥士}）的男人。塔班在被擊倒至20點或更少生命值前拒絕支付任何款項，之後他會交出一個裝有十顆50金幣寶石的袋子。因失敗感到羞愧並渴望挽回顏面，塔班提出作為追隨者加入隊伍，在冒險期間不要求任何報酬。

english: Create a Distraction at Fort Beluarian
zh_tw: 在貝路利安堡製造騷動

english: Rokah (N male Chultan human {@creature spy}) works for the Zhentarim. The Zhents believe that pirates have formed an alliance with the Flaming Fist. Rokah has orders to infiltrate Fort Beluarian and find proof so that the Zhentarim can blackmail the fort's commander. He asks the adventurers to escort him safely to the fort and create a distraction so that he can ransack the commander's quarters. As a reward, Rokah offers to cover the cost of a charter of exploration (50 gp), which the characters will almost certainly need if they want to avoid future confrontations with the Flaming Fist. Rokah also offers to introduce the characters to two wilderness guides—a pair tabaxi siblings named {@creature River Mist|ToA} and {@creature Flask of Wine|ToA} (see "{@area Finding a Guide|08f|x}")—and pay the guides' fees.
zh_tw: 羅卡（中立男性楚爾特人人類 {@creature spy||間諜}）為散塔林會工作。散提爾人相信海盜已與焰拳結盟。羅卡奉命潛入貝路利安堡尋找證據，以便散塔林會能要挾要塞指揮官。他請求冒險者護送他安全抵達要塞並製造騷亂，以便他能洗劫指揮官的住所。作為回報，羅卡願意承擔探索許可證的費用（50金幣）——如果角色們想避免未來與焰拳的衝突，這幾乎是必需品。羅卡還承諾將角色們引薦給兩位荒野嚮導——名為{@creature River Mist|ToA|河霧}和{@creature Flask of Wine|ToA|酒瓶}的斑貓人兄妹（參見"{@area 尋找嚮導|08f|x}"）——並支付嚮導費用。

english: Escort a Priest to Camp Vengeance
zh_tw: 護送牧師前往復仇營地

english: Undril Silvertusk (LG female half-orc {@creature priest} of Torm with {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet) is a representative of the Order of the Gauntlet and newly arrived in Port Nyanzaru. She needs to deliver herself plus a packet of dispatches from her superiors to Commander {@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA} at Camp Vengeance. Undril was led to believe she could simply buy a horse in the city and ride to the camp, but now that she sees the terrain and conditions, that's clearly not possible. She hopes to join any expedition headed up the River Soshenstar. Undril is quite attached to her chain shirt, but she's not unreasonable when presented with good arguments for shedding the armor. If characters gain Undril's respect, she'll intercede strongly on their behalf if any difficulties arise with Commander Breakbone (as they're likely to, as discussed in {@area chapter 2|0cd|x}).
zh_tw: 銀牙·安德里爾（守序善良女性半獸人 {@creature priest||祭司}，信仰託姆，擁有{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}，範圍60尺）是鐵手套教團的代表，新近抵達南扎路港。她需要將自己和上級的一包急件送達復仇營地的指揮官{@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA|奈爾斯·斷骨}處。安德里爾原以為可以在城裡買匹馬騎行至營地，但目睹地形和現狀後，顯然無法實現。她希望能加入任何沿索申斯塔河上游的遠徵隊。安德里爾十分珍愛她的鍊甲衫，但若有人提出卸甲的好理由，她也會通情達理。如果角色們贏得安德里爾的尊重，當與斷骨指揮官發生衝突時（如{@area 第二章|0cd|x}所述，這很可能發生），她將極力為他們斡旋。

english: Explore the Aldani Basin
zh_tw: 探索阿爾達尼盆地

english: Inete (LG female Chultan human {@creature acolyte} of Savras) has had disturbing visions of red-robed wizards operating a secret base somewhere in the Aldani Basin. The head of her temple, {@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA}, has too many other things on his mind, but he's given Inete permission to investigate. Inete would like to accompany the characters' expedition for safety, if characters are heading toward or through that region. She'll provide her own food and supplies, and "donate" another 100 gp to the expedition's expenses. She insists on stopping by the temple of Savras to gather her belongings and urges the characters to come along. If they do, the characters can meet {@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA} (see {@area area 7|03c|x}).
zh_tw: 伊奈特（守序善良女性楚爾特人類，薩弗拉斯的{@creature acolyte||侍僧}）一直受到關於紅袍法師在阿爾達尼盆地某處運作秘密基地的困擾幻象。她所在神殿的首領{@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA|澤騰貝爺爺}雖然事務繁忙，但已準許她展開調查。如果角色們正前往或途經該區域，伊奈特希望為安全起見能隨隊同行。她會自備食物補給，並"捐贈"100金幣作為探險經費。她堅持要先去薩弗拉斯神殿取行李，並極力勸說角色們同行。若應允，角色們將見到{@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA|澤騰貝爺爺}（參見{@area 區域7|03c|x}）。

english: Find Artus Cimber
zh_tw: 尋找阿圖斯·辛貝爾

english: A half-elf named {@creature Xandala|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) approaches the characters and claims to be {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}'s daughter. Feigning worry, she asks the characters to help her find him. Artus can't be found using magic, but {@creature Xandala|ToA} has heard that Artus left the city with a reptilian man who doesn't talk and smells funny. Both were last seen heading into the jungle. {@creature Xandala|ToA} wants the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} in Artus's possession, but she doesn't share this with the characters. Summerwise, {@creature Xandala|ToA}'s pet {@creature pseudodragon}, thinks the quest for the ring is too dangerous but has given up trying to talk sense into its mistress. Good-aligned characters might be able to turn Summerwise against {@creature Xandala|ToA}, or at least get information from it that they can use to thwart {@creature Xandala|ToA}'s plan or to aid Artus.
zh_tw: 一位名叫{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的半精靈接近玩家們，聲稱自己是{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}的女兒。她假裝擔憂地請求玩家們幫助尋找父親。阿圖斯無法透過魔法被找到，但{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}聽說阿圖斯與一名沉默寡言、氣味古怪的爬行類男子一同離開了城市。最後有人看見他們前往叢林深處。{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}真正想要的是阿圖斯持有的{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}，但她並未向玩家們透露這點。夏日智者——{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}的{@creature pseudodragon||偽龍}寵物認為尋找戒指的冒險過於危險，但已放棄勸說主人。善良陣營的玩家或許能讓夏日智者背叛{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}，或至少從其口中獲取資訊，用以挫敗{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}的計劃或幫助阿圖斯。

english: Help a Dyeing Man
zh_tw: 幫助一位垂死之人

english: Omala (N male Chultan human {@creature commoner}) is a master colorist at the dye works (area 23). He recently bought some dancing monkey fruit on the black market and used them to make and sell dye. Shortly thereafter, he received an iron token from the Ytepka Society—a grim warning. He wishes to atone for his crime and seeks an audience with Kwayothé, the merchant prince who controls the legal sale of fruit. Fearing for his life, Omala asks the adventurers to accompany him to Goldenthrone (see {@area area 4|039|x}), where he plans to beg for Kwayothé's forgiveness. He has no money to offer the characters as a reward. Kwayothé is willing to forgive Omala's lapse in judgment provided the characters agree to kill a man named {@creature Shago|ToA} within the next 10 days—no questions asked—and speak of the deed to no one. Kwayothé tells them that {@creature Shago|ToA} works as a guide out of Fort Beluarian. If the characters fail in this task, Kwayothé has Omala sentenced to Executioner's Run (see {@area area 2|036|x}) for his crime.
zh_tw: 奧馬拉（N男性楚爾特人類{@creature commoner||平民}）是染坊（區域23）的調色大師。他最近在黑市購買了一些跳舞猴果並用於製作和銷售染料。不久後，他收到了來自耶特普卡協會的鐵令牌——一個嚴厲的警告。他希望贖罪，並尋求控制水果合法銷售的商王克薇歐澤的接見。由於擔心生命安全，奧馬拉請求冒險者陪同他前往黃金王座（參見{@area 區域4|039|x}），他計劃在那裡乞求克薇歐澤的寬恕。他沒錢給角色們作為報酬。克薇歐澤願意原諒奧馬拉的判斷失誤，前提是角色們同意在10天內殺死一個名叫{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}的人——不問任何問題——並且不向任何人提及此事。克薇歐澤告訴他們，{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}在貝路利安堡外擔任嚮導。如果角色們未能完成此任務，克薇歐澤將判處奧馬拉因罪行而參加劊子手之跑（參見{@area 區域2|036|x}）。

english: Help the Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 協助領主聯盟

english: Lerek Dashlynd (LN male Illuskan human {@creature spy}), an agent of the Lords' Alliance, offers to trade a sailing ship for an accurate map of Chult that shows the exact location of the ruins of Nangalore and Orolunga. Lerek represents wealthy Waterdhavian interests, and the offer is genuine. If the characters present such a map, Lerek has a cleric cast {@spell augury} before agreeing to buy it, to make sure he's not buying a fake. Once he's convinced that the map is genuine, Lerek arranges to have the promised ship arrive in 10 days.
zh_tw: 萊雷克·達什林德（守序中立男性伊路斯坎人 {@creature spy||間諜}），領主聯盟的特工，提出用一艘帆船交換一張精確的楚爾特地圖，地圖需標明珠冠城和奧羅隆加廢墟的確切位置。萊雷克代表富有的深水城利益集團，這個提議是真實的。如果角色們提供了這樣的地圖，萊雷克會讓一位牧師施放{@spell augury||卜筮術}來確認地圖真偽，然後再同意購買。一旦他確信地圖是真的，萊雷克會安排承諾的船隻在10天后抵達。

english: Hunt Pirates
zh_tw: 追獵海盜

english: The harbormaster, {@creature Zindar|ToA} (see {@area area 13|043|x} and {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), is a secret member of the Ytepka Society. He knows that three pirate captains are attacking merchant ships heading to and from the Bay of Chult. The pirate ships are called the {@i Dragonfang}, the {@i Emerald Eye}, and the {@i Stirge}. {@creature Zindar|ToA} has permission from the merchant princes to offer a bounty of 2,000 gp for each pirate ship that is captured and brought into port, and a bonus 500 gp for the capture of each pirate captain.
zh_tw: 港務長{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}（參見{@area 區域13|043|x}與{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）是耶泰普卡協會的秘密成員。他知道有三名海盜船長正在襲擊往返於瓊達爾灣的商船。這些海盜船分別名為{@i 龍牙}、{@i 翡翠之眼}和{@i 蚊蝠}。{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}已獲得商王們的授權，可為每艘被俘獲並帶入港口的海盜船提供2,000金幣的賞金，每抓獲一名海盜船長額外獎勵500金幣。

english: Save an Innocent Man
zh_tw: 拯救無辜之人

english: Belym (LG male Chultan human {@creature commoner}) is distraught because his husband, Draza (LG male Chultan {@creature commoner}), has been sentenced to Executioner's Run for stealing. Belym asserts that his husband was a victim of mistaken identity and sentenced without a proper hearing or trial. He's been unable to persuade anyone in authority that Draza is innocent. He'll give the characters 25 sp (all his savings) if they can help Draza from the sidelines so he survives the run. Draza is about to be thrown into the pit with a pair of {@creature Velociraptor|VGM|velociraptors}, so the characters must act quickly. Both the authorities and the gamblers take a dim view of interference.
zh_tw: 貝利姆（守序善良男性楚爾特人{@creature commoner||平民}）因他的丈夫德拉扎（守序善良男性楚爾特人{@creature commoner||平民}）因盜竊罪被判參加'劊子手逃亡'而心煩意亂。貝利姆堅稱他的丈夫是被誤認的受害者，且未經正當聽證或審判就被判刑。他無法說服任何當權者相信德拉扎是無辜的。如果角色們能從旁協助讓德拉紮在逃亡中存活，他會給予25枚銀幣（他的全部積蓄）。德拉扎即將被投入鬥獸坑與一對{@creature Velociraptor|VGM|伶盜龍}搏鬥，因此角色們必須迅速行動。當局和賭徒們對幹預行為都持否定態度。

english: Seek Wisdom at Orolunga
zh_tw: 在奧羅倫加尋求智慧

english: Eshek (NG male Chultan human {@creature acolyte} of Savras) stumbles up to the characters in the street and whispers, "Speak to the wise guardian of Orolunga, east of Mbala. She can direct you to that which you seek." Then he collapses, {@condition unconscious}. When he awakens moments later, Eshek has no memory of the last 12 hours aside from a driving need to find people matching the characters' descriptions. He's as puzzled by what just happened as the characters probably are, but he'll help them however he can. At the very least, he knows where Mbala is from speaking to porters who've been to Camp Vengeance.
zh_tw: 埃謝克（NG男性楚爾特人類，薩弗拉斯的{@creature acolyte||侍僧}）在街上跌跌撞撞地走向角色們，低聲說道："去和奧羅倫加的智者守護者談談，她在姆巴拉以東。她能指引你們找到所尋之物。"隨後他便{@condition unconscious||昏迷}倒地。片刻後醒來時，埃謝克對過去12小時的記憶一片空白，只記得一股強烈的衝動要尋找符合角色們特徵的人。他對剛剛發生的事和角色們一樣困惑，但會盡力協助他們。至少透過與去過復仇營地的腳伕交談，他知道姆巴拉的位置。

english: Locations in the City
zh_tw: 城市中的地點

english: Shown in map 1.1, Port Nyanzaru is a city of walls within walls. Burgeoning wealth has driven the city's richest residents to raise defenses against the jungle's dangers, and possibly against the dangers they perceive from the city's less-well-off districts, which all lie outside the main wall. The walls are impressive barriers of massive, fitted stone. Like other structures in Port Nyanzaru, they're decorated with colorful paintings of geometric designs, animals, and mythic figures.
zh_tw: 如圖1.1所示，南扎路港是一個城牆內的城牆之城。日益增長的財富驅使這座城市最富有的居民提高防禦措施，以抵禦叢林的危險，也可能抵禦他們從城市較貧窮區域感知到的危險，這些區域都位於主牆之外。這些城牆是由巨大的、精心拼接的石頭構成的令人印象深刻的屏障。像南扎路港的其他建築一樣，它們裝飾著幾何圖案、動物和神話人物的彩色繪畫。

english: The city is defined by four steep hills. The westernmost hill, called Temple Hill because it's home to the temple of Savras, is completely walled off from lower ground. A wide stone bridge crosses on arched columns from Temple Hill to Throne Hill, site of Goldenthrone. A second bridge connects Throne Hill to the southern slopes, site of several merchant princes' villas. East of the harbor, the Hall of Gold gleams atop the city's tallest hill, Mount Sibasa, which is connected by bridge to the neighboring Yklwazi Hill (pronounced yick-ul-WAH-zee), site of the Grand Coliseum. Steep, stepped streets and terraces surround each hill.
zh_tw: 這座城市由四座陡峭的山丘定義。最西邊的山丘被稱為神殿山，因為它是薩弗拉斯神廟的所在地，完全被從低地隔離開來。一座寬闊的石橋橫跨拱形柱子，從神殿山通向寶座山，即金御座所在地。第二座橋連線寶座山到南部山坡，那裡有幾座商王的別墅。在港口東側，金廳在城市最高的山丘，西巴斯山上閃閃發光，透過橋樑與鄰近的伊克瓦齊丘（發音為yick-ul-WAH-zee），即大競技場所在地相連。陡峭的臺階街道和梯田圍繞著每座山丘。

english: Outside the main walls are three slums: the Old City to the southwest, where many buildings are remnants of older, pyramidal construction; Malar's Throat to the south, where buildings cling to the walls of a lush canyon spanned by rope bridges; and Tiryki Anchorage to the southeast, where explorers and river folk gather.
zh_tw: 主城牆外有三個貧民區：西南邊的舊城區，那裡的許多建築是較舊的金字塔式構造的遺蹟；南邊的馬拉喉嚨區（馬拉之喉），那裡的建築緊貼著由繩橋連線的鬱鬱蔥蔥的峽谷牆壁；以及東南邊的提爾基錨地（提爾基錨地），那裡是探險者和河岸居民聚集的地方。

english: About half the city's population lives crowded together outside the walls, where they're always exposed to sudden attacks by carnivores or undead. A volunteer citizens' brigade keeps watch for approaching danger. When residents of the outer wards hear the long blast of warning horns, day or night, they scramble for the safety of the Market Ward and Merchants' Ward until the all clear sounds.
zh_tw: 城市大約一半的人口擠在城牆外生活，他們總是暴露在肉食動物或不死生物的突然襲擊之下。一支志願者市民旅團負責監視逼近的危險。當外城區的居民聽到警告號角的長鳴，無論是白天還是夜晚，他們會爭先恐後地尋找市場區和商人區的安全，直到解除警報的聲音響起。

english: Troubleshooting
zh_tw: 解決問題

english: There's enough happening in Port Nyanzaru that you won't need to rely on random encounters to keep things interesting. That being said, if the players seem restless, use the random encounters in {@adventure appendix B|ToA|7} to spice things up a bit as they're gathering supplies for their expedition. At any time, the party might run into Volothamp Geddarm (see "{@area City Denizens|054|x}"). Volo's familiarity with Port Nyanzaru makes him a font of useful information. If the party doesn't already have a wilderness guide, he advises characters to secure one before they enter the jungle. Volo might also suggest that characters partake in the dinosaur races (see "{@area Things to Do|083|x}").
zh_tw: 南扎路港有足夠多的活動，你不需要依賴隨機遭遇來保持事情的趣味性。話雖如此，如果玩家們顯得焦躁不安，可以使用《{@adventure 附錄 B|ToA|7}》中的隨機遭遇來為他們收集探險物資時增添一些趣味。任何時候，隊伍可能會遇到沃洛桑普·蓋德姆（見"{@area 城市居民|054|x}"）。沃洛對南扎路港的熟悉使他成為有用資訊的源泉。如果隊伍還沒有野外向導，他建議角色們在進入叢林前確保有一個。沃洛也可能建議角色們參加恐龍賽跑（見"{@area 要做的事情|083|x}"）。

english: If characters visit {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA}, he gives them the wizard's journal in his possession. If the party has not yet secured a guide by the time they meet Wakanga, he suggests that the characters arrange one through {@creature Jobal|ToA}. Volo can facilitate an introduction. For more information on guides and their rates, see "{@area Finding a Guide|08f|x}."
zh_tw: 如果角色們拜訪{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}，他會將自己擁有的法師日誌交給他們。如果隊伍在遇到瓦康嘎時還沒有找到嚮導，他建議角色們透過{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}來安排一個。瓦羅可以協助介紹。有關嚮導及其費率的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 尋找嚮導|08f|x}"。

english: Map 1.1: Port Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 地圖1.1：南扎路港

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Old City
zh_tw: 舊城區

english: Three ancient, vine-covered ziggurats tower above this crumbling ward. The whole district is a juxtaposition of ancient and decaying (but still occupied) stone structures interspersed with flimsy new huts and longhouses of bamboo and thatch.
zh_tw: 三座古老、藤蔓覆蓋的塔樓高聳在這個破敗的區域之上。整個區域是古老和破敗（但仍然有人居住）的石頭建築與簡陋的新茅屋和長屋的並置，這些新建築是用竹子和茅草搭建的。

english: The Old City is run by "beggar princes" in a mocking parallel to the merchant princes of the city proper. They have no official authority, but each of them sits atop a web of debts, favors, incriminating information, and loyal muscle that allows them to get things done with an efficiency that the merchant princes sometimes envy. Unlike the merchant princes, whose positions are based on wealth that passes from generation to generation in the same family, the identities and even the number of the beggar princes changes continually.
zh_tw: 舊城區由"乞丐王子"管理，這是對城市正式商王的諷刺性模仿。他們沒有官方權威，但每個人都掌握著債務、人情、罪證資訊和忠誠的肌肉力量的網路，使他們能夠以一種效率完成事情，有時連商王都會羨慕。與商王不同，後者的地位是基於財富，這些財富在同一家族中代代相傳，乞丐王子的身份甚至數量則不斷變化。

english: The Old City is run down but it isn't a slum or a haven for thieves. Most of the residents are lower-class laborers or struggling artisans who can't afford the higher rents of homes inside the city walls.
zh_tw: 舊城區有些破敗，但它不是貧民窟，也不是小偷的藏身之地。大多數居民是低收入的勞動者或掙扎中的工匠，他們負擔不起城牆內住宅的更高租金。

english: 1. Beggars' Palaces
zh_tw: 1. 乞丐宮殿

english: The Beggars' Palaces are the two largest ziggurats of the Old City. Shops and tenements of bamboo are jammed onto the terraces of the ziggurats in wild profusion. The upper levels are cleaner and less crowded than those near street level. A narrow wooden bridge connects the upper levels above the press and noise of the street.
zh_tw: 乞丐宮殿是舊城區兩座最大的金字形神塔。竹製的商店和住宅雜亂無章地擠滿了神塔的露臺。上層比接近街道的樓層更乾淨、不那麼擁擠。一座狹窄的木橋連線著上層，遠離街道的擁擠和噪音。

english: 2. Executioner's Run
zh_tw: 2. 劊子手之路

english: The road through the Old City splits around a rectangular, stone-lined pit 15 feet deep, 50 feet wide, and 200 feet long. The original Amnian residents built it as an arena for a highly competitive ball game, and it still provides cheap entertainment for the locals. {@creature Velociraptor|VGM|Velociraptors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), {@creature Panther||panthers}, or other hungry beasts (a juvenile {@creature allosaurus} is a guaranteed crowd pleaser) are set loose in the pit, then convicted criminals are dropped in at one end. Any criminals who make it alive through the gauntlet of carnivores to the far end of the pit can scramble up knotted ropes and win their freedom, along with the adulation of the crowd. Spectators line the walls for these spectacles—including representatives from every level of Port Nyanzaru society, not just residents of the Old City. Bets are placed on which criminals will survive, which will die, how far runners will get before a beast brings them down, and how many kills each animal will rack up.
zh_tw: 穿過舊城的道路圍繞著一個長方形、石砌的坑道分叉開來，這個坑道深15尺，寬50尺，長200尺。原來的安姆居民將其建造為一種極具競爭性的球類運動的競技場，它至今仍為當地人提供廉價的娛樂。{@creature Velociraptor|VGM|伶盜龍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）、{@creature Panther||豹}或其他飢餓的野獸（一隻幼年{@creature allosaurus||異特龍}異特龍肯定能取悅觀眾）被放入坑中，然後被定罪的罪犯被扔進一端。任何能夠活著透過食肉動物的圍攻到達坑道另一端的罪犯都可以爬上打結的繩索，贏得自由，同時獲得人群的歡呼。觀眾沿著牆壁觀看這些壯觀的場面——包括來自南扎路港社會各個層面的代表，不僅僅是舊城的居民。人們下注哪些罪犯會生存下來，哪些會死去，跑步者在被野獸擊倒之前能跑多遠，以及每隻動物將累積多少擊殺。

english: A handful of Chultans have become celebrities by surviving multiple dashes through Executioner's Run. It's been suggested that some people continue committing crimes solely because a conviction is the only way to get tossed into the pit, and betting is always heaviest on a repeat offender.
zh_tw: 一些庫爾坦人因為多次穿越劊子手之路而倖存下來，成為了名人。有人建議說，有些人繼續犯罪的唯一原因是因為被定罪是唯一能夠被扔進坑裡的方式，而且賭注總是最重的押在重複犯罪者身上。

english: Occasionally an animal manages to leap or scramble out of the pit and runs amok through the terrified crowd. Moments of such high peril provide a perfect opportunity for bystanders to become heroes in the city and earn favors from the merchant princes.
zh_tw: 偶爾有動物設法跳出或爬出坑，在驚恐的人群中橫衝直撞。這種高度危險的時刻為旁觀者提供了成為城市英雄並從商人貴族那裡贏得好感的絕佳機會。

english: 3. Refuse Pit
