zh_tw: 3. 垃圾坑

english: An enormous sinkhole serves as the city's garbage dump. Every type of refuse gets tossed here, up to and including dead bodies. It's a festering scar of garbage, rancid water, and vermin. Rats, insects, and ravens abound. {@creature Ghoul||Ghouls} are sometimes seen prowling through the pit in search of fresh corpses.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的天坑被用作城市的垃圾場。各種型別的廢棄物都被扔到這裡，甚至包括屍體。這是一個垃圾、臭水和害蟲滋生的潰爛疤痕。老鼠、昆蟲和烏鴉隨處可見。有時可以看到{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}在坑中徘徊，尋找新鮮的屍體。

english: Although the level of refuse in the pit rises and falls, the pit never gets full. This is thanks to an unknown number of {@creature Otyugh||otyughs} living at the bottom and eating their fill daily. They're content to remain in the bountiful pit, but they'd quickly pounce on anyone careless or unlucky enough to slip on the greasy edge and fall in.
zh_tw: 儘管坑中的垃圾量時多時少，但坑從未滿過。這要歸功於坑底居住的未知數量的{@creature Otyugh||食腐獸}，它們每天在坑中飽食。它們樂於待在這個物產豐富的坑中，但如果有人不小心或不幸滑倒在油膩的邊緣並掉進去，它們會迅速撲向他們。

english: Merchants' Ward
zh_tw: 商人區

english: The western half of the city is called the Merchants' Ward because it's the site of the Grand Souk and because many of the merchant princes' villas are there. In general, this is the upper-class section of the city. The majority of the city's merchants and traders actually live and work in the Market Ward.
zh_tw: 城市的西半部被稱為商人區，因為它是大集市的所在地，也因為許多商人貴族的別墅都在那裡。總的來說，這是城市的上層階級區域。實際上，城市的大多數商人和小販居住和工作在市場區。

english: 4. Goldenthrone
zh_tw: 4. 金王座

english: This palace serves as the meeting place for the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru and is recognized as the seat of the city's loose government. It was built decades ago by an Amnian trader and is one of the most opulent structures in the city, rivaled only by the grander temples and the merchant princes' villas. An honor guard of eight Chultan {@creature Gladiator||gladiators} is always on duty, to keep away loiterers in the daytime and thieves in the night.
zh_tw: 這座宮殿是南扎路港商王們的會面之地，被認為是城市鬆散政府的所在地。它是幾十年前由一位阿姆尼亞商人建造的，是城市中最豪華的建築之一，僅次於更宏偉的神廟和商王們的別墅。八名楚爾特{@creature Gladiator||角鬥士}榮譽衛隊始終在崗，白天驅趕閒逛者，夜晚防範小偷。

english: Goldenthrone is the best place to meet any of the merchant princes without an appointment. They rarely meet with visitors who show up unannounced at their homes. During the day, each merchant prince has a 1-in-6 chance to be at Goldenthrone, accompanied by a retinue of aides and guards. Characters must wait {@dice 1d3} hours before being given an audience. In fact, the merchant princes have few day-to-day responsibilities when it comes to running Port Nyanzaru, so unless a meeting is being held to discuss city business, the delay is just a tactic to underscore who's in charge. If the characters have interesting news, they're likely to obtain an audience and to be given as much of the merchant's time as they need.
zh_tw: 金座是與任何商王會面而無需預約的最佳地點。他們很少與未經宣佈就出現在他們家中的訪客見面。在白天，每個商王有六分之一的機會在金座，伴隨著助手和守衛的隨行。角色必須等待{@dice 1d3}小時才能被接見。實際上，商王在管理南扎路港的日常事務中幾乎沒有責任，所以除非正在舉行討論城市事務的會議，否則這種延遲只是一種強調誰是負責人的策略。如果角色有有趣的訊息，他們很可能會獲得接見，並被給予他們需要的商人的時間。

english: 5. Merchant Prince's Villa
zh_tw: 5. 商王別墅

english: Each merchant prince has a private villa in the city. These residences have beautifully plastered walls adorned with bright murals, patios and arcades festooned with fresh flowers, garden courtyards open to the sky, and enormous cisterns equipped with water wheels to power fountains, fans, and kinetic sculptures.
zh_tw: 每位商王在城市中都有一座私人別墅。這些住宅擁有裝飾精美的灰泥牆壁，牆壁上裝飾著鮮豔的壁畫，露臺和拱廊上掛著鮮花，開放天空的花園庭院，以及裝備有水輪的巨大水箱，用來驅動噴泉、風扇和動態雕塑。

english: None of the merchant princes is likely to meet player characters who show up unannounced at their doors unless the characters did something noteworthy (such as winning a dinosaur race, stopping a rampaging carnivore, or completing an expedition that made significant discoveries). The exception is {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA}, who welcomes any adventurers traveling in the company of {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}.
zh_tw: 除非玩家角色做了一些值得關注的事情（例如贏得恐龍賽跑、阻止一隻暴走的食肉動物，或完成一次有重大發現的探險），否則商王不太可能在他們不請自來時會見他們。例外的是{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}，他歡迎任何與{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}同行的冒險家。

english: For details of a sample villa, see "{@area Merchant Prince's Villa|065|x}."
zh_tw: 有關示例別墅的詳細資訊，請見"{@area 商王別墅|065|x}。"

english: 6. Grand Souk
zh_tw: 6. 大市集

english: The Grand Souk, or market, is one of the three beating hearts of Port Nyanzaru—the others being the jewel market and the Red Bazaar. True to its name, the Grand Souk is the grandest of the three.
zh_tw: 大集市，或者市場，是南扎路港三個跳動的心臟之一——其他兩個是珠寶市場和紅市集。正如其名，大集市是三者中最宏偉的。

english: Traders from up and down the Sword Coast come to this market to buy timber, spices, medicines concocted from jungle plants, dinosaur skulls and claws, iron, tiger pelts, carved ivory, Batiri and grung handiwork, colored feathers, tropical fruit, monkeys, plesiosaur meat, and all the other riches of Chult. Business begins before the sun comes up, and dealing doesn't stop until well after darkness edges across the city. It's a noisy, jostling, aroma-rich circus. Guards are numerous, but less numerous than the urchins and pickpockets. Street performers and tabaxi minstrels add to the cacophony. Colorful awnings protect the market from sun and rain but also trap the heat and smells.
zh_tw: 來自劍海岸上下的商人來到這個市場購買木材、香料、由叢林植物配製的藥物、恐龍頭骨和爪子、鐵、老虎皮、雕刻的象牙、巴提裡和格龍手工製品、彩色羽毛、熱帶水果、猴子、蛇頸龍肉以及楚爾特的所有其他財富。商業活動在太陽昇起之前就開始了，交易直到城市籠罩在黑暗中很久之後才會停止。這是一個喧鬧、擁擠、香氣四溢的馬戲團。警衛數量眾多，但比流浪兒和小偷偷要少。街頭表演者和斑貓詩人增加了喧囂。色彩繽紛的遮陽篷保護市場免受陽光和雨水的侵襲，但也困住了熱量和氣味。

english: Everything listed in {@book chapter 5|PHB|4} of the {@i Player's Handbook} can be purchased in the Grand Souk. Unusual items might not be available (elephants aren't found in Chult, for example), but a merchant can always be contracted who'll bring an item to order, for the right price.
zh_tw: 在{@book 第五章|PHB|4}（選自{@i 玩家手冊}）中列出的所有物品都可以在大集市購買到。稀有物品可能無法直接獲得（例如，在楚爾特找不到大象），但只要有合適的價格，總可以找到商人定製並運送貨物。

english: 7. Temple of Savras
zh_tw: 7. 薩弗拉斯神廟

english: Savras is a deity of wizards, fortune tellers, diviners, and those who unfailingly speak the truth regardless of whether listeners want to hear it. His symbol is a monstrous eye, or a crystal ball filled with eyes. Savras's temple is one of the oldest, grandest buildings in the city. The tiled roof of its great dome resembles an unblinking eye, staring skyward.
zh_tw: 薩弗拉斯是法師、占卜者、預言者以及那些無論聽眾是否願意聽都始終如一地說出真相的人的神祇。他的象徵是一個怪物的眼睛，或者是一個裝滿眼睛的水晶球。薩弗拉斯的神廟是這座城市中最古老、最宏偉的建築之一。它巨大的穹頂上的瓦片屋頂看起來像一個不眨眼睛，凝視著天空。

english: A deity devoted to revealing the truth might seem to have a weak draw in a city of merchants, but Savras was widely worshiped in Chult long before the Spellplague. In those years, Savras's clergy were valued because they could keep tabs on the activities of the inscrutable yuan-ti. The snake people still loom large as bogeymen in the imaginations of Chultans, but nowadays the clergy of Savras scries into more mundane matters: portents around business affairs, the outlook for newborn children, and affairs of the heart.
zh_tw: 一個致力於揭示真相的神祇在商人之城可能看起來吸引力不大，但在法術瘟疫之前，薩夫拉斯在楚爾特被廣泛崇拜。在那些年代，薩夫拉斯的神職人員因為他們能夠監視難以捉摸的元提人的活動而受到重視。蛇人族在楚爾特人的想象中仍然是可怕的存在，但現在薩夫拉斯的神職人員更多地關注更世俗的事務：圍繞商業事務的徵兆，新生兒的前景，以及感情事務。

english: The head priest of the temple is {@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA} (LG male Chultan human {@creature priest}). When the characters meet the priest for the first time, he's in the midst of a heated conversation with three members of the Zhentarim (NE male Tethyrian human {@creature Assassin||assassins}) who are looking for {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}. The Zhents have come to the temple to see if Zitembe can cast a spell to aid in their search. Although the assassins offer payment in the form of a 500 gp ruby, Zitembe senses their evil intentions and shoos them away. The assassins seem hesitant to leave without satisfaction, but the arrival of the characters changes their minds, and they depart with scowls on their faces. The characters' timely arrival makes Zitembe predisposed to help them.
zh_tw: 寺廟的主持是{@creature Grandfather Zitembe|ToA|澤騰貝爺爺}（LG男性楚爾特人類{@creature priest||祭司}）。當角色們第一次見到這位牧師時，他正與三名散塔林會成員（NE男性特提裡安人類{@creature Assassin||刺客}）進行激烈的對話，他們正在尋找{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}。散塔林會成員來到寺廟，看澤騰貝是否能夠施展法術幫助他們的搜尋。儘管刺客們提出以一枚500金幣的紅寶石作為報酬，但澤騰貝察覺到他們的邪惡意圖並將他們趕走。刺客們似乎不願未得到滿足就離開，但角色們及時的到來改變了他們的主意，他們帶著怒容離開了。角色們及時的到來使澤騰貝傾向於幫助他們。

english: If he's approached for aid or advice in tracking down the Soulmonger, Zitembe's first reaction is to express disbelief that the death curse has anything to do with Chult. If characters give a compelling argument or make a donation to the church of at least 25 gp, Zitembe agrees to "consult the guides." This ritual takes 24 hours, during which Zitembe sees visions of "a jungle city far to the south, enclosed by cliffs and crawling with snakes" and "a black obelisk draped in vines." He dared not peer any deeper, but he urges the characters to seek out this city and the obelisk.
zh_tw: 如果有人為了尋找靈能者的援助或建議而接近澤騰貝，他的第一反應是表示懷疑死亡詛咒與楚爾特有任何關係。如果角色們給出了有說服力的論點，或者至少向教堂捐贈25金幣，澤騰貝同意"諮詢嚮導"。這個儀式需要24小時，在這期間，澤騰貝看到了"一個位於南方遙遠地帶的叢林城市，被懸崖環繞，到處都是蛇"和"一個被藤蔓覆蓋的黑色方尖碑"的幻象。他不敢再深入探究，但他敦促角色們去尋找這座城市和方尖碑。

english: 8. Temple of Gond
zh_tw: 8. 貢德神廟

english: The boxy stone temple of Gond looms behind the royal docks. It's popular among Port Nyanzaru's many artisans, craftspeople, smiths, ivory carvers, and hydro-engineers. Where most such temples have a forge as a centerpiece, this one features an immense fountain whose water jets shift continually to create amazing shapes. It's all done with nozzles and valves moving on cams, driven by the city's plentiful water pressure.
zh_tw: 貢德（貢德）的方形石廟矗立在皇家碼頭後面。它在南扎路港的眾多工匠、手藝人、鐵匠、象牙雕刻師和水利工程師中非常受歡迎。與大多數這樣的神廟以鍛造中心為特色不同，這座神廟以一個巨大的噴泉為特色，其水柱不斷地變化，創造出令人驚歎的形狀。這一切都是透過凸輪上移動的噴嘴和閥門完成的，由城市豐富的水壓驅動。

english: 9. Temple of Sune
zh_tw: 9. 蘇恩神廟

english: Isolated atop a rocky formation in the sea, the temple of Sune is reachable only by an elevated causeway from Temple Hill or by boat. Steep steps wind up the cliff from the temple's small harbor. When seen from a distance, the temple's roof seems to float in midair—an illusion created by mirrors lining the outside walls. Inside, Sune's faithful and casual visitors alike can partake of public baths, receive lessons in applying makeup and styling one's hair, and learn to dress in a manner that suits the individual's body, profession, and the climate. Newcomers to the temple must make a Charisma check. Those who score 15 or higher are welcomed as brothers and sisters of Sune; those who score 10 or higher are offered friendly advice on how to improve their presentation; and those who score 9 or less are greeted with sad, sympathetic looks and surrounded by a crowd of coddling devotees.
zh_tw: 孤立在海中的岩石上，蘇妮的神廟只能透過從神廟山的高架堤道或乘船到達。陡峭的臺階從神廟的小港口蜿蜒而上。從遠處看，神廟的屋頂似乎懸浮在空中——這是由鏡子排列在外牆所創造的幻覺。在裡面，蘇妮的信徒和偶然的訪客都可以享受公共浴室，接受化妝和打理髮型的課程，並學習如何穿著適合個人身體、職業和氣候的方式。新來神廟的人必須進行魅力檢定。得分15或以上的人被歡迎為蘇妮的兄弟姐妹；得分10或以上的人會得到如何改善他們形象的友好建議；得分9或以下的人會得到悲傷、同情的目光，並被一群溺愛的信徒包圍。

english: 10. Jewel Market
zh_tw: 10. 珠寶市場

english: The jewel market is intentionally styled as a miniature, more exclusive version of the Grand Souk. Its chief business is buying and selling the rich supply of jewels that are dug out of Chult's mines, but many other rare luxury items are also traded here. This market is largely secure against pickpockets and thieves, thanks to the privately hired security agents patrolling it openly ({@creature Guard||guards}) and undercover ({@creature Spy||spies}). All of them work for the merchant prince {@creature Zhanthi|ToA}, who has a monopoly on the jewelry trade in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 寶石市場故意設計成大市集的縮小版，更加獨家。它的主要業務是買賣從楚爾特礦山挖掘出來的豐富寶石，但許多其他稀有奢侈品也在這裡交易。由於公開巡邏的（{@creature Guard||警衛}）和秘密活動的（{@creature Spy||間諜們}）私人僱傭的安全代理，這個市場在很大程度上免受小偷和竊賊的侵擾。他們所有人都為商王{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}工作，他在南扎路港的珠寶貿易中擁有壟斷地位。

english: Harbor Ward
zh_tw: 海港區

english: Port Nyanzaru's harbor can accommodate ships of all sizes. The enclosed, eastern portion of the harbor is reserved for the use of the merchant princes, but the rest of the docks are available for use by any ship.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的港口可以容納各種大小的船隻。港口封閉的東部區域是為商王保留使用的，但其餘的碼頭可供任何船隻使用。

english: If the characters wish to travel by sea, they can book passage on the {@i Brazen Pegasus} at a cost of 10 gp per day (for the whole party). A 60-foot sloop built for speed, she has a single mast flying a square mainsail plus two triangular foresails, one aft sail, and a small topsail. All that canvas gives her a top speed of 10 mph under ideal conditions.
zh_tw: 如果角色們希望乘船旅行，他們可以預訂{@i 銅皮天馬號}，每天的費用為10金幣（整隊）。這是一艘為速度而建造的60尺單桅帆船，有一個方主帆加上兩個三角前帆，一個後帆和一個小頂帆。所有這些帆布在理想條件下能讓她達到10英里/小時的最高速度。

english: The {@i Brazen Pegasus} is captained by {@creature Ortimay Swift and Dark|ToA} (CG female rock gnome {@creature bandit captain} with {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet), who is both clever and calm. The first mate is Grig Ruddell (N male Illuskan human {@creature veteran}), a hulking man whose face is almost hidden by a heavy beard streaked with gray. Other than shouting orders at the crew and conversing in low tones with Captain Ortimay, Ruddell barely speaks. The remainder of the crew consists of six sailors (N male and female {@creature Bandit||bandits} of various ethnicities).
zh_tw: {@i 銅皮天馬號}由{@creature Ortimay Swift and Dark|ToA|鷗爾忒梅·斯威夫特·達克}（CG女性岩石侏儒{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}，擁有達到60尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}）指揮，她既聰明又冷靜。大副是格里格·魯德爾（N男性伊魯斯坎人類{@creature veteran||老兵}），一個高大的男人，他的臉幾乎被灰色條紋的濃密鬍鬚遮住。除了向船員喊命令和與奧蒂梅船長低聲交談外，魯德爾幾乎不說話。其餘的船員由六名水手（N男性和女性不同種族的{@creature Bandit||匪徒}）組成。

english: Characters might assume that Ortimay's chief business is smuggling—and they'd be correct. However, she is happy to take adventurers wherever they need to go. She knows about the dragon turtle in the Bay of Chult and expects the characters to provide the necessary tribute. She also knows that pirates prowl the waters around Chult, though her ship easily outruns theirs.
zh_tw: 角色們可能會認為奧蒂梅的主要業務是走私——他們是對的。然而，她很樂意帶冒險家去他們需要去的任何地方。她知道楚爾特灣有一隻龍龜，並期望角色們提供必要的貢品。她也知道海盜在楚爾特周圍的水域徘徊，儘管她的船很容易就能甩掉他們。

english: There are no permanent shelters or cabins on the main deck of the {@i Brazen Pegasus}. A tarp can be rigged across the aft portion of the deck for shade from the tropical sun. The sailors sleep on deck when weather permits. The lower deck houses Captain Ortimay's cabin and the cargo hold, which doubles as the crew's cooking, eating, and sleeping area in foul weather.
zh_tw: 在{@i 銅皮天馬號}的主甲板上沒有永久性的遮蔽所或小屋。可以拉起一張防水帆布橫跨船尾部分，以遮擋熱帶陽光。天氣允許時，水手們在甲板上睡覺。下層甲板設有奧蒂梅船長的船艙和貨艙，惡劣天氣時，貨艙也充當船員的烹飪、用餐和睡覺區域。

english: 11. Royal Docks
zh_tw: 11. 皇家碼頭

english: The term "royal" dates back to the age when Chult was ruled by true kings and queens instead of merchants. Now these docks are reserved for the exclusive use of the merchant princes and those diplomats, dignitaries, and influential foreign merchants whom the merchant princes want to flatter with privilege or impress with magnificence.
zh_tw: "皇家"這個術語可以追溯到楚爾特由真正的國王和王后統治而不是商人的時代。現在這些碼頭被預留給商王的獨家使用，以及那些商王想要用特權取悅或用宏偉印象影響的外交官、顯要人物和有影響力的外國商人。

english: 12. Statue
zh_tw: 12. 雕像

english: The statue at the center of the harbor represents an ancient Chultan king in full regalia, resplendent in a loincloth of leopard skin and a headdress of feathers, shells, and tyrannosaurus teeth; draped in a cape of girallon fur and monkey tails; and wielding the traditional oval shield and yklwa of Chult. Residents call it {@creature Na|ToA} N'buso, the Great King.
zh_tw: 港口中心的雕像代表了一位古代楚爾特國王，他身著全套禮服，身著豹皮的腰布和用羽毛、貝殼以及暴龍牙齒裝飾的頭飾；披著由海象皮和猴尾製成的披風；手持楚爾特傳統的橢圓形盾牌和伊庫瓦短矛。居民們稱其為{@creature Na|ToA|娜} 恩布索，偉大的國王。

english: The statue isn't nearly as ancient as the mythic king it portrays. It was erected just five years ago, at a time when Port Nyanzaru was flexing its new mercantile muscle, to impress on foreigners that Chult is an independent land with a glorious history. Few who see it fail to get the message.
zh_tw: 這座雕像遠不如它所描繪的神話國王那樣古老。它是在五年前建造的，當時南扎路港正在展示其新興的商業實力，向外國人傳達楚爾特是一片擁有輝煌歷史的獨立土地。看到它的人很少會忽視這一資訊。

english: 13. Harbormaster's Office
zh_tw: 13. 港務長辦公室

english: Outside of the harbormaster's office is a bulletin board that provides the names and whereabouts of several wilderness guides (see "{@area Finding a Guide|08f|x}"). The harbormaster is a half-gold dragon named {@creature Zindar|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). He's seldom in this sturdy, airy building, however; most of his time is spent dealing with the hundreds of disputes, traffic jams, and other minor problems that crop up every day on a busy quayside. {@creature Zindar|ToA} finds that his imposing personal presence gets issues resolved more quickly and more to his satisfaction than any number of subordinates can accomplish. Clerks in the office seldom know exactly where {@creature Zindar|ToA} is at any time, but messages can be left for him; he'll leave a reply within {@dice 1d6} hours.
zh_tw: 在港口管理員辦公室外有一個公告板，上面提供了幾位荒野嚮導的名字和下落（見"{@area 尋找嚮導|08f|x}"）。港口管理員是一條半金龍，名叫{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。然而，他很少在這個堅固通風的建築物裡；他大部分時間都花在處理每天在繁忙的碼頭邊出現的數百起糾紛、交通堵塞和其他小問題上。{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}發現，他那令人印象深刻的個人魅力能更快、更令自己滿意地解決問題，而不是任何數量的下屬所能完成的。辦公室裡的職員很少確切知道{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}任何時候在哪裡，但可以給他留言；他會在{@dice 1d6}小時內回覆。

english: If characters present themselves as adventurers, {@creature Zindar|ToA} offers them a quest (see "{@area Side Quests|031|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們自稱為冒險家，{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}會給他們提供一個任務（見"{@area 支線任務|031|x}"）。

english: 14. Lighthouse
zh_tw: 14. 燈塔

english: A flame burns atop the lighthouse day and night to guide ships through darkness, fog, and rain to the harbor. Various powders can be added to the fire to create thick columns of colored smoke that can be seen from Fort Beluarian and from the mines along the Bay of Chult.
zh_tw: 燈塔上的火焰日夜燃燒，引導船隻在黑暗、霧和雨中駛向港口。可以向火中新增各種粉末，以產生從貝路利安堡和楚爾特灣沿岸礦區可見的濃密彩色煙柱。

english: 15. Fort Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 15. 尼亞扎魯堡壘

english: The fort contains a winch for raising and lowering an immense iron chain stretched between the fort and the lighthouse. When the chain is raised, no ship can sail into or out of the harbor. The chain hasn't been raised against attackers in decades, but it's used occasionally to prevent a ship from slipping out of the harbor with criminals or contraband on board. The fort also mounts two ballistas that can launch heavy bolts or canisters of alchemist's fire. Its garrison consists of a {@creature noble} (the castellan), four {@creature Veteran||veterans} (officers), and forty {@creature Guard||guards} loyal to the merchant princes.
zh_tw: 堡壘內設有一個絞盤，用於升降連線堡壘和燈塔之間的巨大鐵鏈。當鐵鏈升起時，沒有船隻能進入或離開港口。幾十年來鐵鏈從未用來抵禦攻擊者，但偶爾會用來防止船隻攜帶罪犯或違禁品悄悄離開港口。堡壘還配備了兩臺弩炮，可以發射重型弩箭或鍊金術士的火藥罐。它的守軍由一位{@creature noble||貴族}（城堡主），四位{@creature Veteran||老兵}（官員）和四十名{@creature Guard||警衛}組成，他們都忠於商王。

english: 16. Warehouse District
zh_tw: 16. 倉庫區

english: Goods of every type being shipped into or out of Port Nyanzaru are stored in these warehouses. Canals are cut between the rows of warehouses, allowing ships to be towed by harnessed dinosaurs directly to the desired warehouse for easier loading and unloading. A large ship can easily block a canal, so good traffic management is required; that's one of the harbormaster's responsibilities.
zh_tw: 進出南扎路港的各種貨物都儲存在這些倉庫中。在倉庫排之間開鑿了運河，允許船隻被套上恐龍直接拖到所需的倉庫，以便更容易地裝載和解除安裝。一艘大船很容易堵塞運河，因此需要良好的交通管理；這是港口管理員的職責之一。

english: Like any warehouse district, this one is largely deserted at night, making it a good spot for secret meetings and other mischief.
zh_tw: 像任何倉庫區一樣，這個地方在夜晚大部分時間都是空蕩蕩的，這使得它成為秘密會面和其他惡作劇的好地方。

english: 17. Dry Dock
zh_tw: 17. 幹船塢

english: Port Nyanzaru isn't famous for building ships, but many vessels that come here wind up needing hull repairs—especially those that had run-ins with typhoons, pirates, or Aremag the dragon turtle (see "{@area Bay of Chult|0b5|x}"). It's easy work for dinosaurs to drag ships out of the water into the drydock so holes can be patched and barnacles scraped off.
zh_tw: 南扎路港並不以造船聞名，但許多來到這裡的船隻最終都需要修理船體——尤其是那些遭遇颱風、海盜或龍龜阿雷瑪格（見"{@area 楚爾特灣|0b5|x}"）的船隻。對於恐龍來說，將船隻拖出水面送入幹船塢是輕而易舉的工作，以便修補洞孔和刮掉藤壺。

english: Market Ward
zh_tw: 市場區

english: The Market Ward is where most of Port Nyanzaru's regular shops are located and where most of its tradesfolk, merchants, and other middle-class residents live and work.
zh_tw: 市場區是南扎路港大多數普通商店的所在地，也是其商人、貿易者和其他中產階級居民生活和工作的地方。

english: 18. Red Bazaar
zh_tw: 18. 紅市集

english: No one knows how the Red Bazaar got its name. One story is that the label comes from the huge slabs of dinosaur meat sold here and the resulting buckets of blood that stain the rain-washed gutters, and that's probably as good an explanation as any.
zh_tw: 沒有人知道紅市集這個名字是怎麼來的。一個說法是這個標籤來自這裡出售的巨大恐龍肉塊以及由此產生的血桶，這些血跡染紅了雨水沖洗的排水溝，這可能和任何其他解釋一樣合理。

english: The residents of Port Nyanzaru shop for their daily needs at the Red Bazaar. Unlike the Grand Souk, which deals heavily in durable goods and luxury items, the Red Bazaar deals in everyday needs: locally produced meat, vegetables, tropical fruit, tej, light tropical clothing, insect repellent, rain catchers, and other household goods. The buyers and sellers in the Red Bazaar are predominantly locals.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的居民在紅市集購買他們的日常需求。與主要交易耐用品和奢侈品的大市集不同，紅市集交易的是日常必需品：當地生產的肉類、蔬菜、熱帶水果、特吉酒、輕便熱帶服裝、驅蟲劑、雨水收集器以及其他家庭用品。紅市集的買家和賣家主要是當地人。

english: Inns
zh_tw: 旅館

english: Two noteworthy inns are located near the Red Bazaar. The Thundering Lizard caters to a raucous clientele, and a bed for the night costs 5 sp. Kaya's House of Repose is much quieter, but a bed for the night costs 1 gp. Wilderness guides are known to frequent both establishments, looking for work (see "{@area Finding a Guide|08f|x}").
zh_tw: 紅色集市附近有兩家值得注意的旅店。雷霆蜥蜴旅店迎合吵鬧的顧客，一晚住宿費用為5銀幣。卡雅的安息之屋則安靜得多，但一晚住宿費用為1金幣。荒野嚮導們常光顧這兩家旅店，尋找工作（詳見"{@area 尋找嚮導|08f|x}"）。

english: 19. Fish Market
zh_tw: 19. 魚市場

english: Seafood is a staple in Port Nyanzaru, both because catching fish is easier and safer than hunting dinosaurs, and tender fish tastes better than tough reptile. The fish market is a great place to buy the day's meals. Prices are higher in the morning, when quality and selection are also better.
zh_tw: 海鮮是南扎路港的主食，這不僅是因為捕魚比狩獵恐龍更容易和安全，而且嫩滑的魚肉比堅韌的爬行動物肉更美味。魚市是購買當天餐食的好地方。早上的價格更高，但那時的質量和選擇也更好。

english: 20. Grand Coliseum
zh_tw: 20. 大競技場

english: This stone arena is the site of gladiatorial games (usually nonlethal, but accidents happen), bloody animal combats, and spectacular circuses. The best gladiators become celebrities and earn fortunes. Statues of the arena's greatest champions line the tops of the Grand Coliseum's walls, including one of the city's current merchant princes. ({@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} gained fame and fortune as a gladiator before retiring from the arena to become a trader and politician.)
zh_tw: 這座石制競技場是角鬥士遊戲（通常非致命，但意外會發生）、血腥的動物戰鬥和壯觀馬戲表演的場所。最好的角鬥士成為名人，賺取財富。競技場最偉大的冠軍的雕像排列在大競技場牆壁的頂部，包括該市現任商王之一。({@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}作為角鬥士贏得了名聲和財富，然後退休成為商人和政治家。)

english: Events are held on most afternoons; only special shows are held after sundown, as the coliseum depends on natural light. During the week, the bill features qualifying matches, consolation bouts, and other small events. Major events, championships, and special extravaganzas are staged on holidays. A holiday show might include a battle between "heroes of legend" and "pirates" (all portrayed by gladiators), a bloody match pitting {@creature Velociraptor|VGM|velociraptors} against {@creature Tiger||tigers}, or even a contest of mages battling captured {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}, {@creature Skeleton||skeletons}, or {@creature Zombie||zombies}.
zh_tw: 大多數下午都會舉行活動；只有在日落後才會舉行特別表演，因為鬥獸場依賴自然光。在一週內，節目包括資格賽、安慰賽和其他小型活動。主要活動、錦標賽和特別盛會則在節日舉行。假日表演可能包括"傳說中的英雄"與"海盜"（均由角鬥士扮演）之間的戰鬥，一場血腥的比賽，讓{@creature Velociraptor|VGM|伶盜龍}對抗{@creature Tiger||虎}，甚至是一場法師與被捕獲的{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}、{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}或{@creature Zombie||喪屍}的戰鬥比賽。

english: 21. Hall of Gold
zh_tw: 21. 黃金大廳

english: This magnificent structure is a temple to Waukeen, but residents call it the Hall of Gold for its shining, golden roof and for Waukeen's focus on trade and wealth. Mount Sibasa is the highest point in the city, and when the sun is shining, light glinting off the temple roof can be seen for miles out at sea. Some city residents swear that the roof is sheathed in pure burnished gold, but it's only paint. A wide stone bridge connects Mount Sibasa to the Grand Coliseum on Yklwazi Hill.
zh_tw: 這座宏偉的建築是瓦金女神的神廟，但居民們稱它為黃金大廳，因為它閃亮的金色屋頂以及瓦金女神對貿易和財富的關注。西巴斯山是城市中的最高點，當陽光照耀時，從神廟屋頂反射的光芒可以在海上數英里外看到。一些城市居民發誓說屋頂覆蓋著純金，但它只是油漆。一座寬闊的石橋連線著西巴斯山和位於伊克瓦茲山上的宏偉競技場。

english: The chief priest of Waukeen in Port Nyanzaru is Sibonseni, Mother of Prosperity (LN female Chultan {@creature priest}). She is one of the city's most influential residents after the merchant princes, and she enjoys tremendous support from every layer of society for the temple's charitable work and for its support of civic improvements. In fact, the temple is also one of the city's richest banks. When Mother Sibonseni travels through the streets, she rides in an elegant sedan chair accompanied by drummers, singers, dancers, and temple aides who distribute fistfuls of copper coins to the poor. Needless to say, this causes traffic jams, but the people of the city love her.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的渥金主祭司是西邦瑟尼，繁榮之母（守序中立女性楚爾特 {@creature priest||祭司}）。她是城市中僅次於商王的最有影響力的居民之一，並且由於寺廟的慈善工作和對城市改進的支援，她享有社會各階層的巨大支援。實際上，寺廟也是城市中最富有的銀行之一。當繁榮之母西邦瑟尼穿過街道時，她乘坐在優雅的轎子中，由鼓手、歌手、舞者和寺廟助手陪同，他們向窮人分發一把把銅幣。不用說，這會引起交通堵塞，但城市裡的人們非常愛她。

english: 22. Public Bathhouse
zh_tw: 22. 公共浴場

english: Port Nyanzaru is a very clean city thanks to the cleansing rain, and its residents are also scrupulous about hygiene. Most would be repulsed by the thought of a day without a bath. Dozens of small bathhouses across the city operate like private clubs, but the public bathhouse is open to everyone and is run by the priesthood of Sune (see {@area area 9|03e|x}). It's both egalitarian and elegant: wealthy merchants and dock laborers rub elbows in the tiled baths and marble-floored changing rooms. There is no charge, but bathers are requested to leave a donation to the temple of Sune befitting their station in life. Because Chultans are justifiably proud of this facility, even the poorest try to leave at least a copper piece in the giant clamshell by the entrance. Many independent masseurs and masseuses are on hand to massage weary muscles; these services cost {@dice 2d10} sp.
zh_tw: 南扎路港是一座非常乾淨的城市，多虧了清潔的雨水，其居民也非常注重衛生。大多數人想到一天不洗澡都會感到厭惡。城市中遍佈著數十家小型浴場，它們像私人俱樂部一樣運作，但公共浴場對所有人開放，由淑妮的祭司管理（見 {@area 區域9|03e|x}）。它既平等又優雅：富有的商人和碼頭工人在鋪有瓷磚的浴室和大理石地面的更衣室裡相互碰撞。這裡不收費，但要求沐浴者根據其社會地位向淑妮的神廟留下適當的捐贈。因為楚爾特人人對這一設施感到自豪，即使是最窮的人也至少會嘗試在入口處的巨大蛤殼裡留下一枚銅幣。許多獨立的按摩師和按摩女在場，為疲憊的肌肉提供按摩服務；這些服務的費用是{@dice 2d10} sp。

english: 23. Dye Works
zh_tw: 23. 染色工坊

english: Along with cleanliness, Chultans love colorful clothing. Textile weaving is not one of Chult's native industries, because the jungle isn't suited for growing cotton or raising sheep. However, the jungle and the sea provide everything necessary to concoct vibrant dyes in a rainbow of colors. Merchants import light, plain fabrics, which are dyed in vibrant colors and patterns at the dye works before being sold locally or exported back to the regions where the cloth originated. Local tailors craft the fabric into the long shirts, knee-length pants, sarongs, and kilts favored in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人除了愛乾淨之外，還喜歡色彩鮮豔的服裝。紡織業並非楚爾特的本土產業，因為叢林不適合種植棉花或養羊。然而，叢林和海洋提供了調配出彩虹般色彩的所有必需品。商人進口輕便、素色的織物，在染色作坊中染上鮮豔的顏色和圖案，然後在當地銷售或出口回布料原產地。當地的裁縫將這些織物製作成長襯衫、及膝褲、圍裙和在南扎路港受歡迎的裙子。

english: The cliff below the dye works and the sea around it are perpetually stained bright orange, blue, red, green, and yellow, depending on what colors are being dumped from the vats that day. People employed at the dye works are easily recognized on the street because their hands and feet are likewise brightly stained.
zh_tw: 染色作坊下方的懸崖和周圍的海水總是被染成鮮亮的橙色、藍色、紅色、綠色和黃色，這取決於那天從染缸中傾倒出的顏色。在染色作坊工作的人在街上很容易被認出，因為他們的手和腳也染上了同樣鮮亮的顏色。

english: Malar's Throat
zh_tw: 馬拉之喉

english: This region outside the city walls is Port Nyanzaru's slum district. Two sheer, jungle-draped ridges flank a deep ravine. Ramshackle buildings cling to the sides of the ridges, each structure seemingly built atop the lower one's roof. During heavy rain, runoff pours down the ravine, through Ubtao's Jaws (the large gate in the city wall facing Malar's Throat), and down the paved streets to the harbor, often sweeping along unattended baskets, dead animals, and even clumsy or unlucky Chultans in its tow.
zh_tw: 這片城牆外的區域是南扎路港的貧民窟。兩個陡峭、叢林覆蓋的山脊夾著一個深邃的峽谷。破舊的建築物緊貼在山脊的兩側，每個結構似乎都建在下面一個建築物的屋頂上。在大雨期間，徑流沿著峽谷傾瀉而下，穿過烏博濤之顎（面向馬拉之喉的城市牆上的大型城門），沿著鋪砌的街道流向港口，經常會沖走無人看管的籃子、死動物，甚至笨拙或不幸的楚爾特人。

english: Foot bridges of rope and bamboo hang above the ravine. Some of them are 200 feet long or longer and sway a hundred feet above ground, terrifying the faint of heart. Skilled thieves have been known to drop hooks on thin lines from the bridges and "fish" purses right off victims' belts.
zh_tw: 繩索和竹製的足橋懸掛在峽谷上方。有些橋長達200尺甚至更長，它們在地面上方100尺處搖擺，令膽小的人感到恐懼。有技巧的小偷被知道會從橋上放下細線上的鉤子，直接從受害者的腰帶上"釣魚"般地取走錢包。

english: 24. Temple of Tymora
zh_tw: 24. 提莫拉神廟

english: Tymora's temple is built like a sturdy blockhouse of heavy stone. It's not an elegant structure, but residents rely on it to be a safe refuge when floodwater pours down Malar's Throat or when the alarm horns blow and there's no time to reach the safety of the city before undead swarm up the ravine. The people who live in Malar's Throat don't consider themselves especially lucky, but what little luck they have, they attribute to the Lady's presence among them.
zh_tw: 提莫拉的神廟建造得像一個堅固的重型石塊房屋。它不是一個優雅的建築，但居民們依靠它作為一個安全的避難所，當洪水從馬拉的喉嚨傾瀉而下，或者當警報號角吹響，沒有時間在不死生物湧上山谷之前到達城市的安全地帶。生活在馬拉的喉嚨地區的人們並不認為自己特別幸運，但他們所擁有的一點點運氣，他們歸功於女士在他們中間的存在。

english: Tiryki Anchorage
zh_tw: 提爾基錨地

english: This district east of the city is populated by animal trainers, river folk, explorers who need inexpensive lodging, and other rough-and-tumble sorts. Smugglers prefer the unregulated docks of the anchorage over the policed and inspected docks of the harbor, despite the shortage of dock workers and beast-powered cranes to assist in loading and unloading.
zh_tw: 城市東側的這個區域居住著動物訓練師、河流居民、需要廉價住宿的探險家以及其他粗獷不羈的人。儘管碼頭工人和獸力起重機較少，無法協助裝卸貨物，但走私者更喜歡這個不受監管的錨地碼頭，而不是受到警察檢查和審查的港口碼頭。

english: Unlike Malar's Throat and the Old City, Tiryki Anchorage has no fortified temple or ancient stone ziggurats where residents can take shelter against undead or carnivores. Most people dash for Tiryki Gate when the alarm sounds and hope to get through before it's locked ahead of them. Fortunately, the animals in their pens are more sensitive to approaching enemies than humans are, so few creatures are able to sneak into the area undetected.
zh_tw: 與馬拉喉嚨區（馬拉之喉）和舊城區不同，提爾基錨地（提爾基錨地）沒有設防的廟宇或古老的石制金字形神塔，居民們無法在其中躲避不死生物或食肉動物。當警報響起時，大多數人會衝向提爾基門（提爾基門），希望在它被鎖上之前透過。幸運的是，圍欄裡的動物對接近的敵人比人類更敏感，所以很少有生物能夠未被發現地潛入該區域。

english: 25. Dinosaur Pens
zh_tw: 25. 恐龍圍欄

english: Most of the beasts of burden in the city were trained out here, and they're penned up at night. Ankylosauruses and triceratopses are the most common in that role. Dinosaurs trained for street racing are also stabled here. Most Chultan handlers have a +5 bonus to {@skill Animal Handling} skill checks, and they work with the same animals day after day.
zh_tw: 這座城市的大多數馱獸都是在這裡訓練的，它們在夜間被關起來。甲龍和三角龍在這個角色中最常見。為街頭賽跑訓練的恐龍也在這裡飼養。大多數楚爾特馴獸師在{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}技能檢定時有+5的加值，並且他們日復一日地與相同的動物一起工作。

english: City Denizens
zh_tw: 城市居民

english: Chultans comprise two-thirds of Port Nyanzaru's population. The city's remaining inhabitants are foreigners, many of whom are profiteers or adventurers seeking either to plunder Chult of its riches or to help protect the city against encroaching monsters.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人佔南扎路港人口的三分之二。城市其餘的居民是外國人，其中許多人是牟利者或尋求掠奪楚爾特財富的冒險家，或是幫助保護城市免受逼近的怪物侵害的人。

english: Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm
zh_tw: 瓦羅贊普"瓦羅"格達姆

english: Characters can encounter Volo anywhere in Port Nyanzaru. For more information on him, see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在南扎路港的任何地方遇到沃洛。有關他的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: The legendary world traveler is in Port Nyanzaru to deliver signed copies of his new book, {@i Volo's Guide to Monsters}, to the merchant princes (some of whom he knows well, and others he claims to know well), and to promote his latest work. Characters are most likely to encounter Volo in one of the city's inns or taverns, or in a merchant prince's villa.
zh_tw: 這位傳奇的世界旅行家來到南扎路港，是為了向商人貴族（其中一些人他很熟悉，還有一些他聲稱很熟悉）贈送他新書《{@i 瓦羅怪物指南}》的簽名副本，並推廣他的最新作品。角色們最有可能在城市的旅館或酒館中，或者在商人貴族的別墅裡遇到沃洛。

english: Volo is a font of information, but not everything he says is true, despite his hearty avowals of accuracy. He won't venture outside Port Nyanzaru under any circumstances.
zh_tw: 沃洛是資訊的源泉，但他所說的並不全是真實的，儘管他堅定地聲稱其準確性。他不會在任何情況下冒險離開南扎路港。

english: If the characters buy a copy of Volo's book (50 gp for a durable hardcover edition), they can put it to use. Any time they want to know lore about a particular monster described in the book, give them useful tidbits from {@i Volo's Guide to Monsters}. Do not impart game statistics, since such information would not be available in-world. If this reference is unavailable, use the information in {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們購買了一本沃羅的書（50金幣一本耐用的精裝版），他們可以加以利用。每當他們想要了解書中描述的特定怪物的背景知識時，可以給他們提供一些來自{@i 瓦羅怪物指南}的有用資訊。不要透露遊戲統計資料，因為這些資訊在遊戲世界中是不可獲取的。如果沒有這本參考書，請使用{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}中的資訊。

english: Merchant Princes
zh_tw: 商王

english: Seven merchant princes rule Port Nyanzaru, each one with an equal vote in matters of state. All are Chultan. Their single qualification is that they're the seven richest people in the city. Their seat of governance is Goldenthrone, an old, regal Amnian palace overlooking the bay. A merchant prince who retires can yield his or her position to a family member or someone else of immense wealth agreed on by the majority.
zh_tw: 七位商王統治著南扎路港，每個人在國家事務上都有平等的投票權。他們都是楚爾特人。他們唯一的資格是他們是城市中最富有的七個人。他們的治理所在地是金座（黃金王座），一座俯瞰海灣的古老、威嚴的阿姆尼亞宮殿。退休的商王可以將他或她的職位傳給家庭成員，或者是多數人同意的另一位極富有的人。

english: The merchant princes surround themselves with loyal family and underlings, but they also employ foreign mercenaries both as city guards and as personal guards. Most of these mercenaries are Zhents, and where one finds the Zhentarim, one can also find Harper spies.
zh_tw: 商王周圍圍繞著忠誠的家人和下屬，但他們也僱傭外國僱傭兵，既作為城市守衛也作為個人保鏢。這些僱傭兵中大多數是散塔林會成員（可能指特定組織或族群，未明確翻譯），而在有散塔林會（可能指特定組織，未明確翻譯）的地方，通常也能找到豎琴手間諜。

english: The merchant princes have specific monopolies on all merchandise sold in the city. Characters in need of gear or supplies must deal through these individuals directly or their consortiums indirectly. The only alternative is to resort to the black markets in Malar's Throat or Tiryki Anchorage.
zh_tw: 商王對城市中出售的所有商品擁有特定的壟斷權。需要裝備或補給的角色必須直接與這些人打交道，或者透過他們的聯合企業間接交易。唯一的替代方案是訴諸於馬拉喉嚨或提爾基錨地的黑市。

english: Ekene-Afa
zh_tw: 艾珂內-阿法

english: {@i Deals in weapons, shields, traveling gear, rain catchers, saddles, wagons, and canoes}
zh_tw: {@i 交易武器、盾牌、旅行裝備、雨水收集器、馬鞍、馬車和獨木舟}

english: {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} (LG female Chultan human {@creature gladiator}) won numerous gladiatorial contests in Port Nyanzaru's arena before she invested her winnings into financing her first trade deals. She is a legend among the common rabble who grew up watching her battles. Her husband, Kura, is a painter, and they have twin teenage sons named Soshen and Tiryk. Soshen is a city guard, and Tiryk is a popular dinosaur racer. Both were named after Chultan rivers.
zh_tw: {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}（守序善良女性楚爾特人類{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}）在南扎路港的競技場贏得了眾多角鬥士比賽，之後她將獎金投資於她的首次貿易交易。她是那些看著她戰鬥長大的普通百姓中的傳奇人物。她的丈夫庫拉是一位畫家，他們有一對名叫索申和提爾克的十幾歲的雙胞胎兒子。索申是一名城市守衛，而提爾克是一位受歡迎的恐龍賽跑選手。兩個孩子都是以楚爾特河流命名的。

english: {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} sells nonmagical weapons and shields of every kind, but most of her inventory consists of flint daggers, yklwas with wooden shafts and obsidian tips (see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}"), and shields made of wooden frames with layers of reptile hide stretched over them. {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} pays {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA} to place permanent enchantments on a select few of these items, which she sells at the prices listed in the Magic Shields and Weapons for Sale table.
zh_tw: {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}出售各種非魔法武器和盾牌，但她的大部分庫存由燧石匕首、帶有木柄和黑曜石尖的伊庫瓦短矛（見"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"），以及由木框架和伸展在其上的爬行動物皮層製成的盾牌組成。{@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}支付{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}在這些物品中選擇少數幾個進行永久性附魔，她以魔法盾牌和武器出售表中列出的價格出售它們。

english: Ifan Talro'a
zh_tw: 伊方·塔若阿

english: {@i Deals in beasts and beast training}
zh_tw: {@i 交易野獸和馴獸}

english: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} (NE male Chultan human {@creature noble}) is a greedy, conniving man supported by influential and dangerous friends among the Zhentarim. He is jealous of {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA}'s magical power and {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA}'s reputation from the arena. Talro'a sells animals that can be trained as mounts or pets, including dinosaurs and flying monkeys. The yuan-ti of Omu secretly pay Talro'a to warn them if treasure hunters are headed south into the deep jungle. He uses flying snakes as messengers. Talro'a doesn't know for certain that the messages go to yuan-ti, but he strongly suspects it.
zh_tw: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿} (NE 男性 楚爾特 人類 {@creature noble||貴族}) 是一個貪婪、狡猾的人，他得到了散塔林會中有影響力且危險的朋友的支援。他嫉妒 {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆} 的魔法力量和 {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法} 在競技場中的聲譽。塔若阿 出售可以訓練為坐騎或寵物的動物，包括恐龍和飛猴。奧穆 的蛇人暗中支付 塔若阿，以警告他們是否有寶藏獵人朝南進入叢林深處。他使用飛蛇作為信使。塔若阿 並不確定這些資訊是否確實傳送給了蛇人，但他強烈懷疑是。

english: Ifan has no family and no close relationships. He is naturally distrustful of everyone.
zh_tw: 伊凡沒有家庭，也沒有親密的關係。他天生對每個人都不信任。

english: Buying Beasts
zh_tw: 購買野獸

english: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} employs dozens of merchants throughout Port Nyanzaru who not only serve as his spies but also sell domesticated beasts that can be used as companions, mounts, or pack animals. {@creature Flying Snake|MM|Flying snakes} trained as messengers are popular with the Zhentarim, and Talro'a sells them to no one else.
zh_tw: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}在南扎路港僱傭了數十名商人，他們不僅充當他的眼線，還出售馴化的野獸，這些野獸可用作夥伴、坐騎或馱獸。被訓練為信使的{@creature Flying Snake|MM|飛蛇}深受散塔林會青睞，而塔爾羅阿只向他們出售這些生物。

english: The Beasts for Sale table lists the creatures available for purchase in Port Nyanzaru. Statistics for the hadrosaurus, the deinonychus, and the flying monkey appear in {@area appendix D|536|x}. See the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for all others.

english: Jessamine
zh_tw: 婕薩敏

english: {@i Deals in plants, poison, and assassination}
zh_tw: {@i 從事植物、毒藥和暗殺}

english: {@creature Jessamine|ToA} (N female Chultan human {@creature assassin}, her hit point maximum reduced to 58) doesn't speak often. When the council finds itself divided on an issue, however, {@creature Jessamine|ToA} usually casts the deciding vote. Most of her body is hidden under billowy robes and tightly wrapped black bandages.
zh_tw: {@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}（中立女性楚爾特人類{@creature assassin||刺客}，她的生命值上限降低至58）不常說話。然而，當議會在某個問題上意見分歧時，{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}通常會投決定性的一票。她的身體大部分被寬鬆的長袍和緊緊包裹的黑色繃帶隱藏起來。

english: {@creature Jessamine|ToA} trades in plants, herbs, poison, and sanctioned assassination. Murder is illegal in Port Nyanzaru, as it is almost everywhere, but {@creature Jessamine|ToA} has a monopoly on "sanctions"—writs that allow a killing by ordained methods (usually poison or stabbing with a blade). For an added fee, her agents will carry out the assassination, with results guaranteed. Poison is her specialty, and she has a vast personal collection. She sells all the poisons listed in the Poisons table in {@book chapter 8|DMG|8|Poisons} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} at market prices.
zh_tw: {@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}從事植物、草藥、毒藥和合法暗殺的交易。謀殺在南扎路港是非法的，就像幾乎在任何地方一樣，但{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}壟斷了"制裁"——即允許透過指定方法（通常是毒藥或刀刺）進行殺戮的許可令。對於額外費用，她的代理人將執行暗殺，結果有保證。毒藥是她的專長，她擁有龐大的個人收藏。她以市場價格出售第{@book 第八章|DMG|8|Poisons}（選自{@i 城主指南}）中毒藥表中列出的所有毒藥。

english: Twelve years ago, {@creature Jessamine|ToA} had a brief but torrid love affair with an Amnian sea captain. The "fruit" of that affair is a shy daughter named Ymezra. Under {@creature Jessamine|ToA}'s watchful eye, tutors are teaching Ymezra the skills she needs to take over the family business one day.
zh_tw: 十二年前，{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}與一位阿姆尼亞海員有過一段短暫而熱烈的愛情。那段愛情'果實'是一個害羞的女兒，名叫伊梅茲拉。在{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}的嚴密監視下，家庭教師正在教授伊梅茲拉將來接管家族生意所需的技能。

english: Jessamine's Curse
zh_tw: 婕薩敏的詛咒

english: Before she went into business for herself, {@creature Jessamine|ToA} worked as an assassin for a Calishite pasha. She died on a mission, but her benefactor paid a handsome price to raise her from the dead. As a result of her misfortune years ago, {@creature Jessamine|ToA} is now suffering from the effects of the Soulmonger's death curse. She covers her rotting flesh with scarves and bandage wrappings, and she is predisposed to help any adventurers actively trying to end the death curse.
zh_tw: 在她自己創業之前，{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}曾為一位卡利什帕夏擔任刺客。她在一次任務中死亡，但她的贊助人支付了一大筆錢讓她從死裡復活。由於多年前的不幸，{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}現在正遭受靈魂收集者死亡詛咒的影響。她用圍巾和繃帶包裹著腐爛的肉體，她傾向於幫助任何積極嘗試結束死亡詛咒的冒險家。

english: Jobal
zh_tw: 喬巴

english: {@i Deals in guides and sellswords}
zh_tw: {@i 提供嚮導和僱傭兵服務}

english: {@creature Jobal|ToA} (NE male Chultan human {@creature scout}) made a fortune as a wilderness guide when the party he was working for discovered a stunning cache of Chultan gold and jewels. Miraculously, only {@creature Jobal|ToA} survived the gauntlet of undead and dinosaur attacks, making it back to Port Nyanzaru in a canoe laden with treasure. There's no doubt he's led a life of adventure; his body bears many scars from his escapades. His chief spy, confidante, and consort is Aazon Talieri (NG male Tethyrian human {@creature spy}). {@creature Jobal|ToA} trusts him implicitly, and Aazon's loyalty is beyond reproach.
zh_tw: {@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}（NE 男性楚爾特人類 {@creature scout||斥侯}）在作為野外向導時，因他所工作的團隊發現了大量楚爾特黃金和珠寶而發了財。奇蹟般地，只有{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}在不死生物和恐龍攻擊的圍攻中倖存下來，他乘坐滿載著寶藏的獨木舟返回南扎路港。毫無疑問，他過著冒險的生活；他的身體因他的冒險而佈滿了許多傷痕。他的主要間諜、知己和情人是阿贊·塔里耶里（NG 男性特提斯人類 {@creature spy||間諜}）。{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}完全信任他，而阿贊的忠誠是無可指責的。

english: Because of his dealings with explorers, {@creature Jobal|ToA} has an intense interest in maps of Chult. He would pay the characters handsomely for {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}'s map, if he learns of its existence. If they refuse to sell, he'll resort to theft, and eventually to murder.
zh_tw: 由於他與探險者的交易，{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴} 對楚爾特的地圖有著濃厚的興趣。如果他得知了地圖的存在，他願意為{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的地圖支付豐厚的報酬。如果他們拒絕出售，他將訴諸於盜竊，最終甚至訴諸於謀殺。

english: Hiring a Guide
zh_tw: 僱傭嚮導

english: If the characters visit {@creature Jobal|ToA} in search of a guide, he recommends that they seek out one or more of his guides in Port Nyanzaru (see "{@area Finding a Guide|08f|x}"). {@creature Jobal|ToA} assigns Aazon the task of escorting the adventurers to whichever guides interest them. {@creature Jobal|ToA} doesn't require payment up front, since all guides in Port Nyanzaru are required by law to pay him a fair cut of their earnings.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拜訪{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}尋找嚮導，他建議他們在南扎路港尋找他的一位或多位嚮導（見"{@area 尋找嚮導|08f|x}"）。{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}指派阿贊負責護送冒險者到他們感興趣的嚮導那裡。{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}不需要預付款，因為根據法律，南扎路港的所有嚮導都必須向他支付他們收入的合理份額。

english: If the characters follow {@creature Jobal|ToA}'s advice and accompany Aazon, give them copies of handouts 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 8 (see {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}) as Aazon introduces the party to various guides in the city.
zh_tw: 如果角色們遵循{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}的建議並陪伴阿贊，當阿贊向隊伍介紹城市中的各種嚮導時，給他們提供傳單2、3、4、5、6和8的副本（見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}）。

english: Kwayothé
zh_tw: 克薇歐澤

english: {@i Deals in fruit, wine, ale, tej, oil, perfume, and insect repellent}
zh_tw: {@i 交易水果、葡萄酒、麥芽酒、特吉酒、油、香水和驅蟲劑}

english: {@creature Kwayothé|ToA} (NE female Chultan human {@creature priest} wearing a {@item ring of fire resistance}) is calm and contemplative in a way that's vaguely menacing. She worships the fire god Kossuth (pronounced kaw-SOOTH) and likes torturing others, particularly if it involves fire and hot coals. Kwayothé has two consorts—a {@creature succubus} named Ixis and an {@creature incubus} named Indar. These fiends take the forms of beautiful Chultans.
zh_tw: {@creature Kwayothé|ToA|克薇歐澤}（NE女性楚爾特人{@creature priest||祭司}，佩戴著一枚{@item ring of fire resistance||火焰抗性戒指}）以一種隱約帶有威脅性的方式平靜而深思。她崇拜火神寇索斯（發音為kaw-SOOTH），並且喜歡折磨他人，特別是如果涉及到火和熱炭。克薇歐澤有兩個情人——一個名叫伊克西斯的{@creature succubus||魅魔}和一個名叫因達爾的{@creature incubus||夢魔}。這些惡魔化身為美麗的楚爾特人。

english: Kwayothé grew up in the streets of Port Nyanzaru, poor and destitute. She despises nobility and wants to destroy every last vestige of the Chultan royal families. She considers {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} her mortal enemy and has grown impatient waiting for the old noblewoman to die. Although she hides her contempt well, Kwayothé is forever meddling in {@creature Zhanthi|ToA}'s business and family affairs. If {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} is aware of Kwayothé's hostility toward her and her family, she's elected not to show it.
zh_tw: 克薇歐澤在南扎路港的街頭長大，貧窮且無依無靠。她鄙視貴族，並想要摧毀楚爾特王室家族的每一個最後的痕跡。她認為{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}是她的死敵，並且對於等待這位老貴族女性去世已經變得不耐煩。儘管她很好地隱藏了自己的蔑視，克薇歐澤仍在不斷地干涉{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}的事務和家庭事務。如果{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}意識到克薇歐澤對她和她家人的敵意，她選擇不表現出來。

english: Kwayothé employs traders who make their own tej and insect repellent. For more information on these special items, see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}."
zh_tw: 克薇歐澤僱傭了商人自己製作特吉酒和驅蟲劑。關於這些特殊物品的更多資訊，請見"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"。

english: Wakanga O'tamu
zh_tw: 瓦康嘎·歐塔姆

english: {@i Deals in magic and lore}
zh_tw: {@i 交易魔法與傳說}

english: {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA} (LN male Chultan human {@creature mage}) is the only arcane spellcaster among the merchant princes. He's a long-time friend of {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}, and he's something of a dandy who's easily seduced by smart women—or perhaps that's only a carefully constructed public image. Unknown to his peers, Wakanga is sympathetic to the Harpers and allows them to use his villa as a safe house.
zh_tw: {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}（守序善良男性庫爾坦人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）是商王中唯一的奧術施法者。他是{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的長期朋友，也是一個相當注重外表的花花公子，容易被聰明的女人所吸引——或者這只是他精心構建的公眾形象。他的同行們不知道的是，瓦康加對豎琴手聯盟同盟抱有同情，並允許他們使用他的別墅作為安全屋。

english: Wakanga deals in knowledge, information, lost lore, potions, and scrolls. He knows of the death curse but little else about it. If the characters seem committed to ending the curse, he'll help them as best he can, including selling them minor magic items (see the Magic Items for Sale table). Wakanga has a monopoly on these items in Port Nyanzaru, so characters either pay his prices or go without. As much as he wants to help, he's unlikely to extend credit; all purchases must be in coin, gemstones, or jewelry.
zh_tw: 瓦康嘎交易知識、資訊、遺失的傳說、藥水和卷軸。他對死亡詛咒有所瞭解，但除此之外知之甚少。如果角色們似乎決心要結束這個詛咒，他會盡他所能地幫助他們，包括向他們出售次要的魔法物品（見出售魔法物品表）。瓦康嘎在南扎路港對這些物品擁有壟斷，所以角色們要麼支付他的要價，要麼就無法獲得。儘管他很想幫忙，但他不太可能賒賬；所有購買必須用硬幣、寶石或珠寶支付。

zh_tw: 魔法物品出售表
