english: Wizard's Journal
zh_tw: 法師的日誌

english: In his collection, Wakanga has a tattered, water-damaged explorer's journal that was brought out of the jungle 15 years ago. It describes a wizard's explorations of various places in Chult, but not in enough detail to locate them on a map. The unnamed author does, however, make many mentions of his only traveling companion: a shield guardian named Vorn. If the characters befriend Wakanga, he gives them the journal and shows them on Syndra's map where it was found (he accurately indicates the hex containing the guardian; see "{@area Vorn|1a6|x}" in chapter 2 for more information). The journal contains a picture of Vorn's control amulet but provides no clues to the amulet's current whereabouts. As reward for finding and retrieving the construct and its control amulet, Wakanga offers a spellbook containing fifteen randomly determined spells (roll a {@dice d6} to determine the level of each spell).
zh_tw: 在他的收藏中，瓦康嘎有一本破舊、水漬斑斑的探險家日誌，這本日誌是在15年前從叢林中帶出來的。它描述了一位法師對楚爾特各地的探索，但並沒有足夠的細節來在地圖上定位它們。然而，這位未具名的作者多次提到他唯一的旅行伴侶：一個名為沃爾恩的盾衛。如果角色們與瓦康嘎結為朋友，他會給他們這本日誌，並在辛德拉的地圖上展示它被發現的地方（他準確地指出了包含守護者的六邊形；見第2章中的"{@area 沃恩|1a6|x}"以獲取更多資訊）。日誌中包含了沃爾恩控制護身符的圖片，但沒有提供護身符當前位置的線索。作為找到並取回構裝生物及其控制護身符的獎勵，瓦康嘎提供了一本包含十五個隨機確定的法術的法術書（擲一個{@dice d6}來確定每個法術的等級）。

english: Zhanthi
zh_tw: 絳則

english: {@i Deals in gems, jewelry, cloth, and armor}
zh_tw: {@i 交易寶石、珠寶、布料和盔甲}

english: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} (NG female Chultan human {@creature noble}) has royal blood in her veins, and few have the courage to dispute the wise, old trader. She's a secret member of the Ytepka Society (see "{@area Factions and Their Representatives|079|x}"), and she has forged ties with the Zhentarim so that she can monitor the organization's activities.
zh_tw: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}（中立善良女性庫爾坦人類{@creature noble||貴族}）血管中流淌著王室血統，很少有人敢質疑這位明智的老商人。她是伊特帕卡協會的秘密成員（見"{@area 派系及其代表|079|x}"），並且她已經與散塔林會建立了聯絡，以便她可以監視該組織的活動。

english: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} trades in gems, jewelry, colorful Chultan cloth, and nonmagical leather, studded leather, and hide armor. Her son, {@creature Shago|ToA}, is a guide stationed at Fort Beluarian. {@creature Shago|ToA} sends regular reports to his mother about what's happening at the fort, but he's not her most reliable spy among the Flaming Fist.
zh_tw: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則} 交易寶石、珠寶、色彩繽紛的楚爾特布料，以及非魔法的皮甲、鉚釘皮甲和獸皮甲。她的兒子，{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}，是駐紮在貝路利安堡的嚮導。{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}定期向他的母親報告堡壘發生的事情，但他不是她在焰拳中最可靠的間諜。

english: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} is one of very few people who've stumbled onto evidence of {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}'s secret arrangement with the pirates, but she keeps this knowledge to herself for the time being. {@creature Zindar|ToA}, the half-dragon harbormaster, is looking for adventurers to dispose of the pirates, while {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} is putting up the reward money.
zh_tw: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}是極少數偶然發現了{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}與海盜的秘密安排的證據的人之一，但她暫時保留這些知識。{@creature Zindar|ToA|金達爾}，這位半龍港務長，正在尋找冒險家來處理海盜，而{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}正在提供懸賞金。

english: Merchant Prince's Villa
zh_tw: 商王別墅

english: Each merchant prince maintains a lavish villa where he or she lives and conducts private business. These airy, opulent mansions include guest quarters for important visitors and trading partners, and they're patrolled by loyal, well-drilled guards at all hours.
zh_tw: 每位商王都維護著一座豪華別墅，他們在這裡生活並進行私人業務。這些通風良好、富麗堂皇的宅邸包括為重要訪客和貿易夥伴準備的客房，並且由忠誠、訓練有素的警衛全天候巡邏。

english: Map 1.2 provides a sample floor plan. Each villa is both a palatial tropical home and a fortress. The outer walls are 8 to 12 feet tall, up to 2 feet thick, and topped with carnivore teeth, slivered seashells, and broken glass that glitters colorfully in the sun but also deters intruders. Any character who climbs over the wall must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 2 ({@dice 1d4}) slashing damage from the sharp objects.
zh_tw: 地圖1.2展示了一個樣板平面圖。每座別墅既是奢華的熱帶住宅，也是一座堡壘。外牆高8至12尺，厚達2尺，頂部佈滿食肉動物的牙齒、碎貝殼和碎玻璃，在陽光下閃閃發光，但也能嚇阻入侵者。任何試圖翻越牆壁的角色必須成功進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷豁免檢定，否則會因為尖銳物體受到2點（{@dice 1d4}）的揮砍傷害。

english: You can customize a villa by assigning the following decorative motifs to each merchant prince:
zh_tw: 您可以透過為每位商王分配以下裝飾圖案來定製別墅：

english: Ornate weapons, shields, and framed paintings are displayed throughout {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA}'s villa, as are squawking parrots in gilded cages.
zh_tw: 華麗的武器、盾牌和裝裱的畫作遍佈{@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}的別墅，同樣還有在鍍金籠子裡的尖叫鸚鵡。

english: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} decorates his villa and gardens with relics and vases plundered from Chultan ruins, and colorful {@creature Flying Snake||flying snakes} swoop and glide through the spacious hallways.
zh_tw: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿} 用從楚爾特遺蹟中掠奪來的文物和花瓶裝飾他的別墅和花園，色彩斑斕的{@creature Flying Snake||飛蛇}在寬敞的走廊中俯衝和滑翔。

english: The walls and pillars in {@creature Jessamine|ToA}'s villa are painted with colorful serpents, and decorative stone fountains and fonts share a similar serpentine motif.
zh_tw: {@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}的別墅牆壁和柱子上繪有色彩斑斕的蛇，裝飾性的石制噴泉和水池也採用了類似的蛇形圖案。

english: The walls of {@creature Jobal|ToA}'s villa are festooned with silk draperies, tapestries, and the mounted heads of beasts.
zh_tw: {@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}別墅的牆壁上裝飾著絲綢帷幔、掛毯和野獸的頭部標本。

english: Kwayothé's villa reeks with scented perfumes, and bowls of fresh fruit can be found throughout. Oil lamps and braziers are kept lit on honor of Kossuth.
zh_tw: 克薇歐澤的別墅充滿了香水的氣味，到處都可以找到盛滿新鮮水果的碗。為了向卡署斯表示敬意，油燈和火盆一直保持點燃。

english: Wakanga's villa is lit with {@spell continual flame} spells, and soft music (created by magic) plays throughout. Doors to private chambers have {@spell arcane lock} spells cast on them, and {@creature Flying Sword||flying swords} are mounted on the walls, ready to attack on Wakanga's command. The occasional floor rug or hanging rug might be a {@creature rug of smothering} in disguise.
zh_tw: 瓦康嘎的別墅被施有{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮，柔和的音樂（由魔法創造）在各處播放。通往私人房間的門上施有{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，牆上安裝著{@creature Flying Sword||凌空劍}，隨時準備在瓦康嘎的命令下發動攻擊。偶爾的地板地毯或掛毯可能是偽裝的{@creature rug of smothering||悶人毯}。

english: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA}'s villa is decorated with standing suits of gold-plated armor and large potted plants, and the bejeweled skulls of {@creature Zhanthi|ToA}'s ancestors rest in wall niches.
zh_tw: {@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}的別墅裝飾著站立的鍍金盔甲和大型盆栽植物，{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}祖先的珠寶骷髏安放在牆壁的壁龕中。

english: Map 1.2: Merchant Prince's Villa
zh_tw: 地圖1.2：商王的別墅

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Lower Level
zh_tw: 低層

english: Paintings, statues, murals, frescoes, tapestries, and oil lamps meant to impress guests decorate this level.
zh_tw: 這個層次裝飾著畫作、雕像、壁畫、溼壁畫、掛毯和油燈，用以給客人留下深刻印象。

english: 1. Entryway
zh_tw: 1. 入口

english: This pleasant, breezy, tiled courtyard includes a splashing fountain and green plants. Visitors can refresh themselves in a washroom to the left of the entrance before meeting residents of the villa. The entry portico is always guarded by {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Gladiator||gladiators} recruited from the merchant prince's extended family or hand-picked for their loyalty and fighting prowess. These guards are always on alert against tricksters and magicians trying to gain entrance to their master's home, so they have advantage on skill checks and saving throws against attempts to distract, bamboozle, or charm them.
zh_tw: 這個宜人、通風、鋪著瓷磚的庭院包括一個噴水的噴泉和綠色植物。訪客可以在入口左側的洗手間裡洗洗自己，然後才能見到別墅的居民。入口門廊總是由{@dice 1d4 + 1}名{@creature Gladiator||角鬥士}守衛，這些角鬥士是從商王的大家族中招募的，或者是因為他們的忠誠和戰鬥能力而被精心挑選出來的。這些守衛總是警惕著試圖進入他們主人家中的騙子和魔術師，因此他們在技能檢定和豁免檢定上對分散注意力、迷惑或魅惑的嘗試具有優勢。

english: The ceiling of the entryway is two stories tall. In some homes, it's open to the sky. In those cases, the fountain is sunk into the floor and doubles as a drain for rainwater.
zh_tw: 入口處的天花板高達兩層樓。在一些住宅中，它是露天的。在這些情況下，噴泉嵌入地面，兼作雨水的排水口。

english: 2. Sitting Area
zh_tw: 2. 休息區

english: This is both a waiting area and a meeting area for guests who aren't known to the villa's master, and therefore won't necessarily be given access to the inner chambers of the house. Decorative columns support the arched doorway from area 1. Rugs and comfortable pillows are arranged on the floor. Narrow windows look into the garden, but these double as arrow slits in case visitors aren't as friendly as they claim to be.
zh_tw: 這是一個等候區，也是一個為那些別墅主人不熟悉的客人準備的會面區，因此他們可能不會被允許進入房子的內部房間。裝飾性的柱子支撐著從區域1的拱形門道。地毯和舒適的枕頭擺放在地板上。狹窄的窗戶可以望向花園，但如果訪客並不像他們聲稱的那樣友好，這些窗戶也可以作為箭縫使用。

english: 3. Grand Hall
zh_tw: 3. 大廳

english: A magnificently tiled floor is flanked by two sweeping staircases that ascend to the upper floor. Decorations are in keeping with the individual merchant prince's taste and specialization.
zh_tw: 一座宏偉的瓷磚地板兩側是兩座通往上層的宏偉樓梯。裝飾與各個商王的品味和專長保持一致。

english: 4. Guest Rooms
zh_tw: 4. 客房

english: Most of the right side of the house is devoted to accommodations for guests. Three private sleeping rooms with attached baths, plus two sitting rooms and access to the garden, make this far more luxurious than a typical inn.
zh_tw: 房子的右側大部分是為客人準備的住宿設施。三個帶有獨立浴室的私人臥室，加上兩個休息室和通往花園的通道，使得這裡的住宿比典型的旅館要豪華得多。

english: 5. Garden
zh_tw: 5. 花園

english: Ferns, potted palms, orchids, and other tropical flowers are cultivated in the garden, which is open to the sky. Chultan plants with useful properties or applications as poison might be found in the garden of a merchant prince with a horticultural bent, such as {@creature Jessamine|ToA}. See {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8} for examples of rare plants.
zh_tw: 蕨類植物、盆栽棕櫚、蘭花以及其他熱帶花卉在露天的花園裡被培育。在對園藝有興趣的商王的花園中，如{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}，可能會發現具有實用特性或用作毒藥的庫爾坦植物。見《{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}》瞭解稀有植物的例子。

english: 6. Dining Room
zh_tw: 6. 餐廳

english: The dining table is very low, just a few inches above the floor. Diners relax on pillows as they eat.
zh_tw: 餐桌非常低，僅離地面幾吋。用餐者在用餐時可以放鬆地坐在枕頭上。

english: 7. Sauna
zh_tw: 7. 桑拿

english: In addition to daily baths, well-to-do Chultans love relaxing in saunas. Dry heat is a welcome change from Chult's high humidity. Most home saunas are heated with charcoal burners or hot stones, but in the homes of the merchant princes, a trapped {@creature fire elemental} provides round-the-clock heat, and a servant or slave is always available to massage tired muscles.
zh_tw: 除了日常沐浴之外，富裕的楚爾特人喜歡在桑拿中放鬆。乾燥的熱量與楚爾特的高溼度相比是一種受歡迎的變化。大多數家庭桑拿使用炭爐或熱石頭加熱，但在商王的家中，一個被困住的{@creature fire elemental||火元素}提供全天候的熱量，總有僕人或奴隸隨時準備按摩疲勞的肌肉。

english: 8. Bath
zh_tw: 8. 浴室

english: The bath is the cornerstone of a Chultan mansion, even more so than the dining room or family rooms. The family relaxes here during private times, but there's nothing unusual about a merchant prince holding meetings in the bath with trusted advisors and close business associates. Being invited into the household bath is considered an honor in Chultan society, and treating it as anything less than an honor risks offending the person who extended the invitation.
zh_tw: 浴室是楚爾特式豪宅的基石，甚至比餐廳或家庭室更為重要。家庭成員在私人時間裡在這裡放鬆，但商王在浴室與信任的顧問和親密的商業夥伴舉行會議也並無不尋常。在楚爾特社會中，被邀請進入家庭浴室被視為一種榮譽，將其視為低於榮譽的待遇可能會冒犯發出邀請的人。

english: 9. Kitchen
zh_tw: 9. 廚房

english: The kitchen is large, high-ceilinged, and well ventilated; otherwise, heat from cooking fires would make it unbearably hot. Stairs lead up to the laundry room (area 14).
zh_tw: 廚房寬敞，天花板高，通風良好；否則，烹飪火源產生的熱量會讓它變得難以忍受的熱。樓梯通往洗衣房（區域14）。

english: Upper Level
zh_tw: 高層

english: The rooms on this level are decorated for comfort. The artwork and other decor reflects the taste of the merchant prince to whom the villa belongs.
zh_tw: 這一層的房間佈置得非常舒適。藝術品和其他裝飾反映了別墅所有者，商王的品味。

english: 10. Library
zh_tw: 10. 圖書館

english: Chultans are fans of mythical romance, and the city has an active literary community with many book clubs. Port Nyanzaru's most successful novelists and playwrights concoct stirring tales about legendary heroes who pursue their lovers through unimaginable danger and save them from fates worse than death—which is more likely to involve a forced marriage to someone who doesn't love them than being eaten by an impossibly huge tyrannosaurus, although monstrous tyrannosauruses make regular appearances in these tales, too.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人喜愛神話般的浪漫故事，這座城市擁有一個活躍的文學社群和許多讀書俱樂部。南扎路港最成功的小說家和劇作家編造了激動人心的故事，講述傳說中的英雄們在難以想象的危險中追求他們的愛人，並將他們從比死亡更糟糕的命運中拯救出來——這更有可能涉及被迫與不愛他們的人結婚，而不是被一隻巨大得難以置信的暴龍吃掉，儘管這些故事中也經常出現怪物般的暴龍。

english: A character who spends a few hours sifting through the formulaic fiction and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check finds useful books of Chultan lore mixed in with the romances. Use this as an opportunity to answer specific questions posed by the players. A library won't reveal the location of Omu, but a book of lore might mention the city and describe it as it was during its height.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果花費數小時篩選公式化的小說，並透過了一個 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，將會在浪漫小說中發現夾雜其中的有關卻爾坦傳說的有用書籍。利用這個機會回答玩家提出的具體問題。圖書館不會揭示奧穆的位置，但一本傳說書籍可能會提到這座城市，並描述其鼎盛時期的面貌。

english: 11. Family Rooms
zh_tw: 11. 家庭房

english: The merchant prince's children, spouses, and other close family members live in these apartments. They are richly appointed with pillows and tiger-skin rugs.
zh_tw: 商王的孩子、配偶和其他近親居住在這些公寓中。這些公寓裝飾華麗，配有枕頭和虎皮地毯。

english: 12. Master Suite
zh_tw: 12. 主臥

english: The merchant prince's suite is the most opulent room in the palace. A pleasant breeze blows through large, lattice-covered windows, causing the potted plants to sway gently. The headboard of the master bed is fantastically carved in motifs suggestive of the merchant's business. Connected rooms contain a small, private bath and a walk-in closet filled with expensive clothing, mirrors, combs, and so forth.
zh_tw: 商王的套房是宮殿中最豪華的房間。宜人的微風透過大型覆蓋著格子的窗戶吹進來，使得盆栽植物輕輕搖擺。主床的床頭板雕刻精美，圖案暗示著商人的生意。相連的房間內有一個小型私人浴室和一個步入式衣櫥，裡面裝滿了昂貴的衣物、鏡子、梳子等。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The suite contains personal items equivalent to two rolls on the "Gems or Art Objects" column of the {@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG} table in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the room contains jewelry, there is a {@chance 50} chance it is in a locked jewelry box requiring {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check to open.
zh_tw: 這套物品包含相當於在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中{@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG|庫藏寶藏：挑戰等級 0—4}表格的"寶石或藝術品"欄擲骰兩次所獲得的個人物品。如果房間內有珠寶，則有{@chance 50}機率被鎖在珠寶盒中，需要使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷檢定才能開啟。

english: 13. Guard Rooms
zh_tw: 13. 警衛室

english: This guard room is intentionally set in the midst of the family rooms and the master suite. The guards are responsible for safeguarding the family during their most vulnerable time, when they're sleeping or relaxing in their own chambers. This station is always manned by {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Gladiator||gladiators} who are fanatically loyal to the merchant prince and richly rewarded for their devotion.
zh_tw: 這個警衛室故意設在家庭房間和主臥之間。警衛們負責在家人最脆弱的時候，也就是睡覺或在自己房間裡放鬆時，保護家人。這個崗位總是由{@dice 1d4 + 1}名對商王極度忠誠並因其忠誠而得到豐厚回報的{@creature Gladiator||角鬥士}駐守。

english: 14. Laundry Room
zh_tw: 14. 洗衣房

english: Chultans are as scrupulous about their clothing as about their bodies—a fastidiousness that's almost essential, given how much everyone sweats in Port Nyanzaru's climate. Laundry is washed here every day, then hours are spent fanning it to and fro on lines trying to encourage the wet cloth to dry in the humid air.
zh_tw: 楚爾特人對他們的服裝和身體一樣講究——鑑於在南扎路港的氣候下每個人都會出很多汗，這種過分講究幾乎是必需的。這裡每天洗衣服，然後花費數小時在晾衣繩上來回扇動，試圖鼓勵溼衣物在潮溼的空氣中晾乾。

english: 15. Servants' Quarters
zh_tw: 15. 僕人住處

english: The servants' quarters are isolated from the family sleeping areas for security. There is nothing remarkable about them.
zh_tw: 僕人住處與家庭臥室區域隔離開來，以確保安全。它們並無特別之處。

english: 16. Rain Traps
zh_tw: 16. 雨水收集器

english: Every room in the house contains (at minimum) a small water basin with running water coming either from a rooftop basin or lifted from barrels or an underground cistern by a water wheel.
zh_tw: 房子裡的每個房間至少包含一個小水盆，自來水來自屋頂的水盆或由水車從桶裡或地下蓄水池提升上來。

english: Factions and Their Representatives
zh_tw: 派系及其代表

english: Port Nyanzaru is the lone civilized hub on a vast peninsula of great wealth. Many factions would like to tap into that wealth, and they all have agents vying for influence in the city or scouting the jungle for opportunities. Some of these can aid the characters, and others will try to hinder them.
zh_tw: 南扎路港是位於巨大半島上的唯一的文明中心，這個半島蘊藏著巨大的財富。許多派系都希望利用這筆財富，他們都有代理人在城市中爭奪影響力或在叢林中尋找機會。其中一些可以幫助角色們，而其他一些則會試圖阻礙他們。

english: Laws and Punishments
zh_tw: 法律與懲罰

english: The merchant princes can create or alter laws by decree as they see fit, and judges are expected to interpret laws freely but wisely. Such a system would seem to invite abuse and bribery, but the Chultan courts are surprisingly free of corruption.
zh_tw: 商王可以根據需要透過法令制定或修改法律，法官被期望自由但明智地解釋法律。這樣的制度似乎容易招致濫用和賄賂，但楚爾特法院出人意料地沒有腐敗。

english: Slavery isn't illegal in Port Nyanzaru, but it's frowned upon, and the merchant princes won't do business with slavers or show them any legal favor.
zh_tw: 奴隸制在南扎路港不是非法的，但是它被不贊成，商王不會與奴隸販子做生意，也不會給他們任何法律上的優待。

english: Murder is illegal, but "sanctions"—legal permission to kill someone or to have someone killed—can be purchased from the merchant prince {@creature Jessamine|ToA}. The price depends on the prominence of the intended victim, the reason for the sanction, and the wealth of the purchaser. The minimum price possible is 150 gp; the maximum is limitless. The availability of sanctions doesn't mean they're common—it's rare for more than six to be sold in a year. That has less to do with price than with the fact that if word gets out who purchased a sanction, nothing can stop the friends of the victim from sanctioning the original purchaser.
zh_tw: 謀殺是非法的，但是可以從商王{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}那裡購買"授權"——合法許可去殺害某人或安排某人被殺。價格取決於預期受害者的知名度、授權的理由以及購買者的財富。最低價格是150金幣；最高沒有限制。授權的可用性並不意味著它們很常見——一年內賣出超過六個授權的情況很少。這與價格關係不大，而是因為如果傳出誰購買了授權的訊息，無法阻止受害者的朋友對最初的購買者進行授權。

english: Despite their high ambition, the merchant princes' power is entirely contained in the city. Elsewhere, Chult is ruled by the red law of tooth and claw. An individual is either predator or prey, and the predator might be a mob of undead, a ravenous allosaurus, a grung hunting party, Jahakan pirates, or a Flaming Fist patrol.
zh_tw: 儘管有著很高的野心，商王的權力完全侷限在城市之內。在其他地方，楚爾特遵循著牙齒和爪子的紅色法則。一個人要麼是捕食者，要麼是獵物，而捕食者可能是一群不死生物，一隻貪婪的異特龍，一個格朗狩獵隊伍，賈哈卡海盜，或者是焰拳巡邏隊。

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: The Emerald Enclave is a widespread group of wilderness survivalists who preserve the natural order by rooting out unnatural threats. They struggle to keep civilization and the wilderness from destroying one another.
zh_tw: 翡翠聯盟是一個廣泛的野外生存主義者組織，他們透過根除不自然的威脅來維護自然秩序。他們努力防止文明和荒野相互毀滅。

english: In Chult, the Emerald Enclave is chiefly concerned with protecting inhabitants from the undead menace. A few guides in Port Nyanzaru and Fort Beluarian are openly associated with the enclave, and a few others are secret members or are sympathetic to its goals. The faction maintains several well-camouflaged outposts in the jungle. They serve as hidden observation posts, not forward fighting positions.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特，翡翠聯盟主要關注於保護居民免受不死生物的威脅。南扎路港和貝路利安堡的一些嚮導公開與聯盟有聯絡，還有一些是秘密成員或對其目標表示同情。該派系在叢林中維護著幾個偽裝得很好的前哨站。它們作為隱蔽的觀察點，而不是前線戰鬥位置。

english: If characters get into trouble in the wilderness, the Emerald Enclave is a potential rescuer.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在荒野中遇到麻煩，翡翠聯盟是一個可能的救援者。

english: Flaming Fist
zh_tw: 焰拳

english: The Flaming Fist is a mercenary company headquartered in (and fiercely loyal to) Baldur's Gate. The Fist maintains a permanent stronghold in Chult at Fort Beluarian. From there, Flaming Fist patrols strike out into the jungle to "pacify" territory and claim lost treasures. The Flaming Fist has already plundered the ruins of Mezro. Now the mercenaries and their wealthy backers in Baldur's Gate would like nothing better than to do the same to Omu, but they've had no luck locating the lost city. The Flaming Fist's researchers are convinced the city lies south of Lake Luo but east of the Peaks of Flame, at the western end of the Valley of Dread. Because of the distance from Fort Beluarian, they're looking for adventurers to conduct an initial exploration of that area and locate what they believe will be mostly abandoned ruins.
zh_tw: 焰拳是總部設在（並且極度忠誠於）博德之門的僱傭兵公司。焰拳在楚爾特的貝路利安堡維持著一個永久性的要塞。從那裡，焰拳的巡邏隊出擊進入叢林"平定"領土並奪取失落的寶藏。焰拳已經掠奪了梅茲羅的廢墟。現在，這些僱傭兵和他們在博德之門的富有支持者最想做的就是對奧穆做同樣的事，但他們在尋找這座失落的城市方面沒有運氣。焰拳的研究者確信這座城市位於盧奧湖的南面，但在火焰之峰的東面，在恐懼之谷的西端。由於距離貝路利安堡很遠，他們正在尋找冒險家來進行該地區的初步探索並定位他們認為將主要是被遺棄的廢墟。

english: The commander of Fort Beluarian and highest ranking member of the Flaming Fist in Chult is {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). She holds the rank of blaze (major) and has complete autonomy in Chult, answering only to Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate. Portyr will happily assign some of her mercenaries to accompany adventurers by sea to Refuge Bay or even to Snapping Turtle Bay—either is an excellent starting point for any incursion into the western reach of the Valley of Dread.
zh_tw: 貝路利安堡的指揮官，也是楚爾特地區焰拳組織中級別最高的成員是{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。她擁有烈焰（少校）的軍銜，在楚爾特擁有完全的自主權，只向博德之門的烏爾德·瑞文嘉德公爵彙報。波特會很高興地指派她的一些僱傭兵陪同冒險者乘海路前往避難灣，甚至龜裂灣——這兩個地方都是進入恐懼之谷西部地區的絕佳起點。

english: Only six ranks are recognized within the Flaming Fist: fist (private), gauntlet (corporal), manip (sergeant), flame (lieutenant), blaze (major), and marshal (general).
zh_tw: 焰拳內只認可六個等級：拳頭（二等兵）、護手（下士）、操縱（中士）、火焰（中尉）、烈焰（少校）和元帥（將軍）。

english: Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: The Harpers are spellcasters and spies who covertly oppose any abuse of power, magical or otherwise. Working alone or in small cells, they gather information throughout Faerûn, analyze the political dynamics in each region or realm, and use what they uncover to help the weak, the poor, and the oppressed from behind the scenes. Harpers act openly only as a last resort.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟是施法者和間諜，他們秘密地反對任何濫用權力的行為，無論是魔法還是其他形式。他們單獨工作或組成小團體，在費倫各地收集資訊，分析每個區域或王國的政治動態，並利用他們發現的資訊在幕後幫助弱者、窮人和受壓迫者。豎琴手聯盟只有在萬不得已時才會公開行動。

english: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}, a former member of the Harpers, is hiding out in Chult. He possesses an artifact called the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}, and other Harpers are concerned lest the ring fall into evil hands. To prevent that, a handful of Harper spies are combing Port Nyanzaru and Chult for clues to Artus's whereabouts—ostensibly to protect the ring, but exactly what they'll do when they find it is an open question. Magical efforts to locate Artus are futile, as the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} shields itself and its wearer against divination spells and scrying sensors.
zh_tw: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}，一位前豎琴手聯盟成員，正隱藏在楚爾特。他擁有一個叫做{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}的神器，其他豎琴手聯盟擔心戒指落入邪惡之手。為了防止這種情況，一些豎琴手聯盟間諜正在南扎路港和楚爾特搜尋有關阿圖斯下落的線索——表面上是為了保護戒指，但當他們找到它時會做什麼則是一個未知數。定位阿圖斯的魔法嘗試是徒勞的，因為{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}能夠保護自己及其佩戴者免受占卜法術和偵查感測器的探測。

english: Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: A number of cities and settlements banded together to form the Lords' Alliance, a coalition that works actively to eliminate threats to their mutual safety and prosperity. The coalition is loose—some might even call it shaky. Alliance leaders push their own interests above counterparts from other cities, and operatives seek honor and glory for themselves and their own lords at the expense of less powerful members.
zh_tw: 一些城市和定居點聯合起來形成了領主聯盟（領主聯盟），這是一個積極致力於消除對他們共同安全和繁榮構成威脅的聯盟。這個聯盟是鬆散的——有些人甚至可能稱之為不穩定。聯盟的領導人將自己的利益置於其他城市同行之上，而特工們為了自己和他們自己的領主的榮譽和榮耀而工作，以犧牲較弱成員的利益為代價。

english: A key figure in the Lords' Alliance is Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate, a city with a vested interest in the affairs of Chult. The flag of Baldur's Gate flies over the stronghold of Fort Beluarian, which is garrisoned by Flaming Fist mercenaries under the command of Ravengard's vassal, {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}. If push came to shove, Ravengard would place the priorities of Baldur's Gate above those of the Lord's Alliance.
zh_tw: 領主聯盟中的關鍵人物是博德之門的大公爵烏爾德·瑞文嘉德，這座城市對楚爾特的事務有著既得利益。博德之門的旗幟飄揚在貝路利安堡的上空，該堡壘由拉文加德的臣屬{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}指揮的焰拳僱傭兵駐守。如果到了緊要關頭，拉文加德會將博德之門的優先事項置於領主聯盟之上。

english: Other Lords' Alliance cities such as Waterdeep and Neverwinter have operatives in Port Nyanzaru, where they undermine the efforts of non-alliance powers such as Calimshan, Amn, and Tethyr to expand their control over Chult's vast resources. Most of these representatives are open about their ties to the Lord's Alliance and style themselves as ambassadors of their cities, but they also employ covert agents to undermine each other's plans and carry out less savory tasks. The Lords' Alliance sponsors mapping expeditions into the peninsula, with the aim of finding more treasures or mines it can plunder.
zh_tw: 像深水城和無冬城這樣的其他領主聯盟城市在南扎路港有行動人員，他們破壞非聯盟勢力如卡利姆杉、阿姆恩和特西爾擴大對楚爾特豐富資源控制的努力。這些代表大多數公開表明他們與領主聯盟的關係，並自稱為他們城市的大使，但他們也僱傭秘密特工來相互破壞對方的計劃並執行不那麼體面的任務。領主聯盟資助進入半島的測繪探險，目的是尋找更多它可以掠奪的寶藏或礦場。

english: Order of the Gauntlet
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團

english: Members of the Order of the Gauntlet vow to protect others from the depredations of evildoers. Placing their faith in good-aligned deities such as Torm, Helm, and Tyr, they bring the strength of their faith, their hearts, and their weapons to bear against villainy.
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團的成員發誓要保護他人免受惡人的侵害。他們信任諸如託姆、海姆和提爾等善良陣營的神祇，他們將信仰的力量、心靈和武器用於對抗邪惡。

english: The order has committed considerable resources toward quelling the undead menace in Chult. Its forward base, Camp Righteous, was overrun by undead. The order, undaunted, built a new fortification even deeper in the jungle. Dubbed Camp Vengeance, it has fallen on hard times. Its commander is a woefully inept noble named {@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA}. His lieutenants are more likely to share useful information or offer aid, but only if the characters offer some form of assistance to Camp Vengeance in return.
zh_tw: 該組織已經投入了大量資源來平息楚爾特的不死生物威脅。其前線基地，正義營地，在不死生物的衝擊下被淹沒。該組織毫不氣餒，在叢林更深處建造了新的防禦工事。被稱為復仇營地，它已經陷入了艱難時期。其指揮官是一個名叫{@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA|奈爾斯·斷骨}的不幸無能貴族。他的副官更有可能分享有用的資訊或提供幫助，但前提是角色們能夠以某種形式援助復仇營地作為回報。

english: All members of the Order of the Gauntlet are unflinchingly brave, but many of their expeditions fare poorly or meet with outright disaster when confronted by conditions that confound their training and contradict their mindset.
zh_tw: 戰拳團契（鐵手套教團）的所有成員都毫不畏懼，但許多探險隊在面對使他們的訓練陷入困境並與其心態相矛盾的條件時，表現不佳或遭遇徹底的災難。

english: Red Wizards of Thay
zh_tw: 泰伊紅袍法師

english: Red Wizards are in Chult to find and steal the Soulmonger for Szass Tam. They've occupied the Heart of Ubtao and are using it as a base. Their leader is {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA}. She remains at the Heart of Ubtao while her Thayan minions comb the ruins of Omu for clues to the Soulmonger's whereabouts. For more information on Valindra, see "{@area Heart of Ubtao|10b|x}."
zh_tw: 紅袍法師在楚爾特的目的是尋找並竊取噬魂器以獻給薩扎斯坦。他們佔領了烏塔歐之心並將其作為基地。他們的領袖是{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}。她留在烏塔歐之心，而她的賽爾語手下則在奧穆的廢墟中搜尋噬魂器下落的線索。有關瓦琳朵拉的更多資訊，請見"{@area 烏塔歐之心|10b|x}"。

english: Ytepka Society
zh_tw: 伊特帕卡協會

english: The Ytepka Society, also known as the Triceratops Society, is based in Port Nyanzaru and dedicated to preventing any individual or group from abusing power and upsetting the natural social order. Its members are primarily neutral good Chultans. In many respects, the society's goals are similar to those of the Harpers.
zh_tw: 伊特帕卡協會，也被稱為三角龍協會，總部設在南扎路港，致力於防止任何個人或團體濫用權力和破壞自然的社會秩序。其成員主要是中立善良的楚爾特人。在許多方面，協會的目標與豎琴手聯盟（豎琴手聯盟）相似。

english: The Ytepka Society was instrumental in liberating Port Nyanzaru from foreign powers and facilitating the rise of the seven merchant princes. Its members now work tirelessly to prevent the Zhentarim and other dubious factions from taking over the government or gaining undue influence. The Ytepkas also work covertly to eliminate the threat from pirates, but they've been unable to locate the pirates' base or track down pirate spies in the city. A handsome reward awaits those who can definitively pinpoint the pirates' base or capture their ships.
zh_tw: 伊特帕卡協會在解放南扎路港免受外國勢力控制以及促進七位商王崛起方面發揮了重要作用。現在，其成員不懈地工作，以防止散塔林會和其他可疑派系接管政府或獲得不當影響。伊特帕卡人還秘密地努力消除海盜的威脅，但他們一直未能找到海盜的基地或追蹤到城市中的海盜間諜。那些能夠確切地確定海盜基地或捕獲他們的船隻的人將獲得豐厚的獎勵。

english: Currently there are fewer than fifty active members of the Ytepka Society. They don't advertise their membership but identify one another using a simple hand gesture: a raised left hand with the index finger, middle finger, and third finger extended, representing the three horns of the triceratops.
zh_tw: 目前伊特帕卡學會的活躍成員不足五十人。他們不公開宣傳自己的成員身份，而是使用一個簡單的手勢來相互識別：左手舉起，食指、中指和無名指伸出，代表三角龍的三隻角。

english: When the society judges that someone has damaged the social fabric of Chult or is on the verge of committing a great wrong, it presents a warning by anonymously delivering an iron token bearing the likeness of a triceratops. It's up to the marked individual to figure out the meaning of the token and take steps to correct the offending behavior or undo the damage. If the person ignores the warning and persists in offending the society, the Ytepkas secure permission from the merchant princes to mete out punishment as they see fit, up to and including a sanction (see the "{@area Laws and Punishments|07a|x}" sidebar earlier in this chapter).
zh_tw: 當協會判斷某人已經破壞了楚爾特的社會結構或即將犯下嚴重錯誤時，它會透過匿名傳送一枚刻有三角龍圖案的鐵製令牌來發出警告。被標記的個人需要弄清楚令牌的含義，並採取措施糾正冒犯行為或彌補損失。如果該人忽視警告並繼續冒犯協會，伊特帕卡人會從商人貴族那裡獲得執行懲罰的許可，他們將根據情況自行決定懲罰方式，包括但不限於採取制裁措施（見本章前面的"{@area 法律與懲罰|07a|x}"邊欄）。

english: Unfortunately, because of the society's secretiveness, not many people understand what those iron tokens signify, and there's a lot of misinformation about the Ytepkas in Port Nyanzaru. The society doesn't recollect its tokens, either, so unscrupulous types have used old (or even counterfeit) tokens to frighten competitors away from business ventures.
zh_tw: 不幸的是，由於該社團的神秘性，沒有多少人理解那些鐵製令牌的含義，關於南扎路港的伊特帕卡協會成員也存在很多誤解。該社團也不回收其令牌，因此一些不擇手段的人利用舊的（甚至是偽造的）令牌來嚇走商業競爭對手。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: The Zhentarim is an unscrupulous shadow network that seeks to expand its influence and power base throughout Faerûn. Its members pursue wealth and power through any means, though the public face of the organization appears much more benign—the Zhentarim provides the best mercenaries money can buy.
zh_tw: 散塔林會是一個不擇手段的暗網組織，它試圖在整個費倫擴張其影響力和權力基礎。其成員透過任何手段追求財富和權力，儘管該組織對公眾的形象看起來要溫和得多——散塔林會提供的是金錢能買到的最好的僱傭兵。

english: The merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru hire Zhentarim guards to defend the city walls and Zhentarim mercenaries to protect hunting, lumbering, and mining operations in the jungle and foothills. The Black Network has used this wide-ranging access to the city to set up its own woodcutting camps and mining operations. It also mounts treasure-hunting expeditions. In addition, Black Network spies have learned that {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} is in Chult, and they've assembled teams to find the ex-Harper and wrest the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} from him.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的商王僱傭了散塔林會守衛來保衛城牆，並僱傭散塔林會僱傭兵來保護叢林和山麓中的狩獵、伐木和採礦作業。黑網利用對城市的廣泛訪問權建立了自己的伐木營地和採礦作業。它還組織了尋寶遠徵隊。此外，黑網間諜得知{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}在楚爾特，他們已經組建了團隊去尋找這位前豎琴手並從他手中奪取{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。

english: Things to Do
zh_tw: 要做的事情

english: Port Nyanzaru offers plenty of distractions for visitors, but the following sections describe four activities that the characters are likely engage in before setting out to explore the darkest reaches of Chult:
zh_tw: 南扎路港為遊客提供了豐富的娛樂活動，但以下部分描述了角色們在出發探索楚爾特最黑暗的角落之前可能會參與的四項活動：

english: Buying a special item
zh_tw: 購買特殊物品

english: Dinosaur racing
zh_tw: 恐龍賽跑

english: Finding a guide
zh_tw: 尋找嚮導

english: Gathering information
zh_tw: 收集資訊

english: Buying a Special Item
zh_tw: 購買特殊物品

english: Characters can easily find most mundane items for sale in any of Port Nyanzaru's markets, at standard prices. Anything needed to survive in the jungle is considered a mundane item in Chult. The chief exception is heavy armor, which is rare in Chult and thus commands a high price: triple the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} prices for heavy armor, or double them if the character makes a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to bargain down the price.
zh_tw: 角色可以輕鬆在南扎路港的任何市場以標準價格購買到大多數普通物品。在楚爾特，任何在叢林中生存所需的物品都被視為普通物品。主要例外是重甲，在楚爾特很罕見，因此價格高昂：重甲的價格是{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中價格的三倍，如果角色成功透過一個{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定來討價還價，價格則為兩倍。

english: The only alternative to buying specialty items through the merchant princes is to deal with the black market, which is highly secretive in Port Nyanzaru; the merchant princes crack down harshly on competitors. Contacting black marketeers takes half a day in the Old City, Malar's Throat, or Tiryki Anchorage, plus a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check to pose the right questions to the right people at the right time. To determine the black market price of an item, multiply the item's normal price (see the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} where appropriate) by {@dice 1d4 + 2}. If an unusually large quantity is needed, increase the price multiplier by 1.
zh_tw: 透過商王購買特殊物品的唯一替代方案是與黑市打交道，在南扎路港，黑市極為隱秘；商王嚴厲打擊競爭者。在舊城區、馬拉爾的咽喉或提裡奇錨地聯絡黑市商人需要半天時間，並且需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定，以便在正確的時間向正確的人提出正確的問題。要確定某件物品的黑市價格，請將該物品的正常價格（參見 {@book 玩家手冊|PHB}）乘以 {@dice 1d4 + 2}。如果需要異常大量的物品，則將價格乘數增加1。

english: The following special goods are available for sale in Chultan markets.
zh_tw: 楚爾特市場中有以下特殊商品出售。

english: Canoe
zh_tw: 獨木舟

english: A canoe can be purchased in Port Nyanzaru for 50 gp. It holds up to six Medium creatures and has a maximum speed of 2 mph. It is otherwise identical to a rowboat (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 一艘獨木舟可以在南扎路港以50金幣的價格購買。它最多可容納六個中型生物，最大速度為每小時2英里。除此之外，它與划艇相同（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||第五章}）。

english: The sale of canoes in Port Nyanzaru is controlled by the merchant prince {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA}.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的獨木舟銷售由商王{@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}控制。

english: Insect Repellent
zh_tw: 驅蟲劑

english: Insect repellent can be purchased in Port Nyanzaru in two forms: blocks of incense or a greasy salve. The merchant prince Kwayothé controls the sale of both. Neither kind of repellent protects against giant insects or the vile swarms of insects described in {@book appendix A|MM|1} of the {@i Monster Manual}.
zh_tw: 驅蟲劑可在南扎路港以兩種形式購買：香塊或油膩的藥膏。商王克薇歐澤控制著這兩種產品的銷售。無論是哪種驅蟲劑都無法抵禦巨型昆蟲或{@book 附錄A|MM|1}中描述的{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的邪惡昆蟲群。

english: A block of incense sells for 1 sp. When lit, it burns for 8 hours and repels normal insects within a 20-foot-radius centered on it.
zh_tw: 一塊香的售價為1銀幣。點燃後，它可以燃燒8小時，並在其為中心的20尺半徑範圍內驅趕普通昆蟲。

english: A gourd or vial of salve, which sells for 1 gp, contains 20 applications of odorless grease. One application protects its wearer against normal insects for 24 hours. The salve is waterproof so it doesn't wash off in rain.
zh_tw: 一個葫蘆或小瓶裝的藥膏，售價為1金幣，包含20次使用的無臭油脂。一次使用可以保護使用者在24小時內免受普通昆蟲的侵擾。這種藥膏是防水的，所以即使下雨也不會被沖掉。

english: Rain Catcher
zh_tw: 集雨器

english: A rain catcher is a simple contraption consisting of a 5-foot-square leather tarp and a wooden frame with legs. When the tarp is stretched across the wooden frame, it forms a basin that can catch 2 gallons of drinking water per inch of rainfall and hold up to 8 gallons. The tarp and wooden frame fold up for easy transport. A rain catcher costs 1 gp and weighs 5 pounds.
zh_tw: 雨水收集器是一種簡單的裝置，由一個5尺見方的皮革防水布和帶有腿的木製框架組成。當防水布拉伸在木製框架上時，它形成一個可以收集雨水的盆地，每吋降雨量可以收集2加侖的飲用水，並最多可儲存8加侖。防水布和木製框架可以摺疊起來方便攜帶。一個雨水收集器的成本是1金幣，重量為5磅。

english: Merchant prince {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} controls the sale of rain catchers in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 商王{@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}控制著南扎路港雨水收集器的銷售。

english: Tej
zh_tw: 特吉

english: Tej is an amber-colored, fermented drink made from honey. It's more common and popular in Chult than beer or ale. A mug of tej costs 4 cp in Port Nyanzaru or 6 cp in Fort Beluarian. A 1-gallon cask costs 2 sp in the city or 3 sp at the fort.
zh_tw: 蜜酒是一種由蜂蜜製成的琥珀色發酵飲料。它比啤酒或麥酒更常見，也更受歡迎。一杯蜜酒在南扎路港賣 4 cp，在貝路利安堡賣 6 cp。一桶蜜酒容量為 1 加侖，在南扎路港賣 2 sp，在貝路利安堡賣 3 sp。

english: Sale of tej is controlled by the merchant prince Kwayothé.
zh_tw: 特吉酒的銷售由商王克薇歐澤控制。

english: Yklwa
zh_tw: 伊庫瓦短矛

english: A yklwa (pronounced YICK-ul-wah) is a simple melee weapon that is the traditional weapon of Chultan warriors. A yklwa consists of a 3-foot wooden shaft with a steel or stone blade up to 18 inches long. It costs 1 gp, and it deals {@dice 1d8} piercing damage on a hit. Although it has the thrown weapon property, the yklwa is not well balanced for throwing (range 10/30 ft.).
zh_tw: 伊克瓦（發音為YICK-ul-wah）是一種簡單的近戰武器，是楚爾特戰士的傳統武器。伊克瓦由一根3尺長的木柄和一把長達18吋的鋼製或石制刀片組成。它的價格是1金幣，擊中時造成{@dice 1d8}穿刺傷害。儘管它具有投擲武器的特性，但伊克瓦並不是為投擲而設計得很好平衡（射程10/30尺）。

english: The merchant prince {@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA} controls the sale of yklwas in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 商人貴族{@creature Ekene-Afa|ToA|艾珂內-阿法}控制著南扎路港的伊庫瓦短矛銷售。

english: Dinosaur Racing
zh_tw: 恐龍賽跑

english: The city is famous for its weekly dinosaur races through the streets. Dinosaurs are painted in bright designs, and their riders try to steer them along a course that winds around the harbor and the city's four hills. Spectators are seldom injured, but it's a dangerous sport for the dinosaurs and their riders.
zh_tw: 這座城市以每週在街道上舉行的恐龍賽跑而聞名。恐龍被繪有鮮豔的圖案，它們的騎手試圖引導它們沿著蜿蜒穿過港口和城市四座小山的賽道前進。觀眾很少受傷，但對恐龍和它們的騎手來說，這是一種危險的運動。

english: A typical race day has three races: one for four-legged beasts, one for two-legged beasts, and one no-holds-barred "unchained" race. Many of the dinosaurs involved are juveniles, since fully grown versions can be too large and too difficult for riders to manage. The dinosaurs are stoutly muzzled and have their claws and horns blunted in all but the unchained race.
zh_tw: 一個典型的比賽日有三場比賽：一場是四條腿的野獸比賽，一場是兩條腿的野獸比賽，還有一場是無限制的"無鏈"比賽。參與的恐龍大多是幼體，因為完全長大的恐龍可能體型過大，騎手難以控制。除了無鏈比賽外，恐龍都戴著堅固的口套，它們的爪子和角都被磨鈍了。

english: The four-legged race is dominated by young ankylosauruses and triceratopses, but dimetrodons have also done well when paired with Small riders. Most competitors in the two-legged race are hadrosauruses and deinonychuses (again with Small riders). The unchained race sees racers on anything, including young allosauruses and very young tyrannosauruses.
zh_tw: 四足賽跑主要由年輕的甲龍和三角龍佔據優勢，但當與小型騎手配對時，二齒龍也表現出色。雙足賽跑的大多數參賽者是鴨嘴龍和矮暴龍（同樣與小型騎手配對）。無拘無束的賽跑中，選手們騎乘各種恐龍，包括年輕的異特龍和非常年輕的暴龍。

english: Betting
zh_tw: 下注

english: Characters can bet on the dinosaur races to help fund a jungle expedition or earn some extra cash. The racers, the available odds, and the chance to win are listed in the Betting on Dinosaur Races table. Bets can range from 1 cp to 500 gp. Once bets are placed, roll a die for each bet. Losing bets cost the full amount of the wager. Winning bets pay out according to the table. Bets can be for a dinosaur to win, place, show, or do something specific during the race (like attack another racer or throw its rider), so many bets can win in the course of a single race.
zh_tw: 角色們可以對恐龍賽跑下注，以資助叢林探險或賺取一些額外的現金。賽跑者、可用賠率和獲勝機會列在恐龍賽跑下注表中。下注範圍可以從1銅幣到500金幣。下注後，為每個下注擲一個骰子。輸掉的賭注將損失全部下注金額。贏得的賭注根據表格進行賠付。下注可以是為了恐龍贏得比賽、獲得名次、表現突出，或者在比賽過程中做特定的事情（比如攻擊另一個賽跑者或把騎手甩下來），因此許多賭注可以在單次比賽中獲勝。

english: Losers are expected to pay up in a timely fashion. Those who don't are visited by a debt collector backed up by Chultan legbreakers ({@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Thug||thugs} or {@creature Gladiator||gladiators}, depending on the level and reputation of the bettor). Port Nyanzaru bookies never forget a debt; even a year away on an expedition into the jungle isn't long enough to erase an unpaid gambling loss.
zh_tw: 輸家應該及時支付賭金。那些不支付的人將被債務收集者拜訪，由楚爾特的斷腿者支援（{@dice 1d4 + 1}名{@creature Thug||暴徒}或{@creature Gladiator||角鬥士}，取決於賭徒的等級和聲譽）。南扎路港的賭注經紀人從不忘記債務；即使在叢林探險一年，也不足以抹去未付的賭博損失。

english: Racing
zh_tw: 賽跑

english: Player characters might get involved in a dinosaur race, either through their own interest or because they're approached by a racing team. In this case, you'll need to play out the race. This can be quite a bit of fun, especially if you let players whose characters aren't directly involved take over at least some of the NPC racers. Encourage everyone to race hard, even if it's in the group's best interest for a particular dinosaur to win.
zh_tw: 玩家角色可能會因為自己的興趣愛好或被賽車隊接觸而參與恐龍賽跑。在這種情況下，你需要進行賽跑遊戲。如果你讓那些角色沒有直接參與的玩家來控制至少一些NPC賽車手，這可能會非常有趣。鼓勵大家全力以赴地比賽，即使為了小組的最佳利益，特定的恐龍應該獲勝。

english: A race runs a length of 300 feet; this is abstract, as a race actually covers a lot more ground. Every round, each rider makes a Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check; the DCs for different types of dinosaurs are listed in the Racing Dinosaurs table. With each successful {@skill Animal Handling} check, the first number listed as the dinosaur's speed is added to its "running tally." If the check fails, that dinosaur's tally doesn't increase that turn. When a racer's tally equals or exceeds 300, that dinosaur crosses the finish line. A racer can try to move at the higher listed speed by lashing the animal furiously; in this case, the {@skill Animal Handling} check is made with advantage, but the dinosaur must also make a successful {@dc 10} Constitution check at the end of this round or its speed is halved for the rest of the race.
zh_tw: 一場比賽的長度為300尺；這是抽象的，因為實際上比賽會覆蓋更多的地面。每輪比賽的騎手都需要進行一次感知（{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}）檢定；不同型別恐龍的DC值列在"賽跑恐龍"表格中。每次成功的{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}檢定，恐龍的速度列表中的第一個數字將被新增到它的"奔跑累計值"中。如果檢定失敗，恐龍的累計值在該輪中不會增加。當某位賽手的累計值等於或超過300時，那隻恐龍將越過終點線。賽手可以透過猛烈鞭打動物來嘗試以更高的速度移動；在這種情況下，{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}檢定將具有優勢，但恐龍還必須在本輪結束時成功透過一次{@dc 10}體質檢定，否則其速度將在剩餘的比賽中減半。

english: No initiative is involved. Riders can make their {@skill Animal Handling} checks in any order, or all at the same time. If two or more dinosaurs cross the finish line on the same round, the one with the highest tally wins. If the tallies are the same, the racers tied. In the event of a tie, brawls are likely to break out in trackside betting pools.
zh_tw: 不涉及主動權。騎手可以按任何順序進行他們的{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}檢定，或者同時進行。如果有兩隻或更多恐龍在同一輪次衝過終點線，那麼得分最高的獲勝。如果得分相同，則賽跑者打平。在平局的情況下，賽道旁的投注區域很可能會爆發鬥毆。

english: In the unchained event, dinosaurs can attack other dinosaurs if their tallies are within 50 of each other at the end of a round. Each dinosaur's pertinent combat statistics are listed on the Racing Dinosaurs table. If a dinosaur has half or fewer of its starting hit points, the rider makes {@skill Animal Handling} checks with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 在無鏈事件中，如果一輪結束時它們的得分相差不超過50，恐龍可以攻擊其他恐龍。每隻恐龍的相關戰鬥具體數值都列在恐龍賽跑表格上。如果一隻恐龍的生命值降至起始生命值的一半或更少，騎手進行{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}檢定時會受到不利影響。

english: For simplicity, riders can't attack or be attacked, but DMs with a cruel streak might be tempted to relax that rule. Just be aware that if rider attacks are allowed, the event is more likely to become a straight-up dinosaur fight than anything resembling a race. Raising a dinosaur to be a racer is difficult and expensive. Most owners aren't willing to lose one—especially a fast one—in a weekly bloodfest.
zh_tw: 為了簡化，騎手不能攻擊或被攻擊，但是有些殘忍傾向的DM可能會想要放寬這個規則。請注意，如果允許騎手攻擊，這個活動更有可能變成一場直接的恐龍戰鬥，而不是任何類似比賽的東西。培養一隻賽跑恐龍是困難且昂貴的。大多數擁有者不願意在每週的血腥盛宴中失去一隻——特別是一隻快速的。

english: Finding a Guide
zh_tw: 尋找嚮導

english: Guides can be retained in Port Nyanzaru or Fort Beluarian. All Port Nyanzaru guides must register and serve under the auspices of {@creature Jobal|ToA}, who takes a princely cut of their earnings and findings. The Zhentarim also have a black market network in the city that provides guides. {@creature Jobal|ToA} is aware that this network exists and makes it abundantly clear that guides who fail to register with him will be beaten, {@condition blinded}, or beheaded.
zh_tw: 嚮導可以在南扎路港或貝路利安堡被僱傭。所有南扎路港的嚮導都必須註冊並在{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}的贊助下服務，他會從他們的收入和發現中抽取豐厚的分成。散塔林會在城市中也有一個黑市網路提供嚮導。{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}知道這個網路的存在，並且明確表示，未在他那裡註冊的嚮導將會被毆打、{@condition blinded||目盲}或斬首。

english: Guides working for {@creature Jobal|ToA} leave their contact information on message boards outside inns and taverns or at the harbormaster's office in Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 為{@creature Jobal|ToA|喬巴}工作的嚮導在旅館和酒館外的公告板上或南扎路港的海事辦公室留下他們的聯絡資訊。

english: Several guides are described in this section. Some will work for free if characters agree to certain conditions. Otherwise, guides charge 5 gp per day, and payment for 30 days up front is standard, even if the expedition is expected to be shorter than that. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check negotiates the price down to 4 gp per day, or 3 gp per day if the check succeeds by 5 or more. Alternatively, guides might forgo wages in exchange for an equal share of treasure.
zh_tw: 本節描述了多位嚮導。如果角色同意某些條件，有些嚮導會免費工作。否則，嚮導的收費標準是每天5金幣，通常情況下需要預付30天的費用，即使預計探險時間短於此。成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可以將價格談判到每天4金幣，如果檢定成功超過5點或更多，則可以降至每天3金幣。或者，嚮導可能會放棄工資以換取等額的寶藏份額。

english: You can roleplay preliminary meetings and conversations with guides, or simply describe all the available guides to the players and let them choose. To help the party select a guide, you can give players copies of handouts 2 through 10 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}. These handouts give players a sense of each guide's personality. You can give the players several handouts at once, or provide handouts only for the guides they track down.
zh_tw: 你可以進行角色扮演，與嚮導進行初步會議和對話，或者簡單地向玩家描述所有可用的嚮導，並讓他們選擇。為了幫助團隊選擇一個嚮導，你可以給玩家提供{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}中的手冊2到10的副本。這些手冊讓玩家瞭解每個嚮導的性格。你可以一次性給玩家幾個手冊，或者只提供他們找到的嚮導的手冊。

english: Guides as Party Members
zh_tw: 嚮導作為隊伍成員

english: A guide who is hired by the adventurers becomes a NPC party member and receives an equal share of XP. However, the guide doesn't gain levels as player characters do.
zh_tw: 被冒險家僱傭的嚮導成為NPC隊伍成員，並得到等額的經驗值(XP)份額。然而，嚮導不會像玩家角色那樣獲得等級。

english: You can use the optional loyalty rule in {@book chapter 4|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty} of the Dungeon Master's Guide to track the loyalty of a guide who isn't beholden to a secret master. Disloyal guides won't risk their lives to save player characters and might abandon the party entirely to preserve themselves. The guides described in this chapter have goals beyond helping the characters survive. Helping guides fulfill their personal goals increases their loyalty.
zh_tw: 你可以使用《城主指南》{@book 第4章|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}的忠誠度選用規則，追蹤未暗中效忠他人的嚮導之忠誠度。不忠誠的嚮導不會冒險拯救玩家角色，甚至可能為了自保而完全拋下隊伍。本章介紹的嚮導各有自身目標，並非只想協助角色生存。幫助嚮導達成個人目標，能提高他們的忠誠度。

english: A particularly loyal guide (loyalty score of 10 or higher) will follow characters into a dangerous location such as Omu or the Tomb of the Nine Gods. A tenuously loyal guide (loyalty score of 1 to 9) might choose to wait for the characters outside the location rather than abandon the party altogether.
zh_tw: 一個特別忠誠的嚮導（忠誠度得分10或更高）會跟隨角色進入像奧穆或九神之墓這樣危險的地方。一個不太忠誠的嚮導（忠誠度得分1到9）可能會選擇在地點外等待角色，而不是完全放棄隊伍。

english: Azaka Stormfang
zh_tw: 婀扎卡·風暴之牙

english: {@i Weretiger (Port Nyanzaru})
zh_tw: {@i 虎人（南扎路港）})

english: When the characters meet Azaka, give the players a copy of handout 2 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到婀扎卡時，給玩家們一份{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}中的傳單2副本。

english: Azaka (NG female Chultan human {@creature weretiger}) works out of Port Nyanzaru. She conceals her lycanthropy from the characters for as long as possible and will guide adventurers for free if they agree to help her retrieve an item that was stolen by the pterafolk of Firefinger. If questioned about the stolen item, Azaka responds only that it's a family heirloom: a wooden mask carved to resemble a tiger's face. It is actually a {@item mask of the beast|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}).
zh_tw: 婀扎卡（NG 女性楚爾特人類 {@creature weretiger||虎人}) 在南扎路港工作。她儘可能長時間地向角色隱瞞她的狼人身份，並會免費為冒險家提供嚮導服務，如果他們同意幫助她從火指部落的翼手獸那裡取回一個被盜的物品。如果被問及被盜物品，婀扎卡只回答說它是一件家傳寶物：一個雕刻成老虎面孔的木製面具。實際上，它是一個{@item mask of the beast|ToA|野獸面具}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}）。

english: Azaka has wandered far and wide through the jungle in tiger form. She is acquainted with Saja N'baza, the powerful and wise guardian naga of Orolunga, and gladly leads characters to the naga if they're looking for guidance.
zh_tw: 婀扎卡以虎的形態在叢林中漫無目的地漫遊。她熟悉薩賈·恩巴扎，這位強大而睿智的守秘納迦居住在奧羅倫加，如果角色們尋求指引，她很樂意帶領他們去找納迦。

english: Azaka stands 6 feet tall and weighs about 150 pounds. She will not willingly spread her lycanthropic curse. She is also afraid of heights and will not willingly put herself in a situation in which she's in danger of falling more than 60 feet. Azaka's damage immunities do not protect her against damage from falling.
zh_tw: 婀扎卡身高6尺，體重大約150磅。她不會自願傳播她的狼人詛咒。她也害怕高處，不會自願置身於有超過60尺墜落危險的情境中。婀扎卡的傷害免疫並不能保護她免受墜落傷害。

english: Eku
zh_tw: 依庫

english: {@i Disguised couatl (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 偽裝的羽蛇（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Eku|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 3 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}時，給玩家們一份附錄E中手冊3的副本，見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}。

english: {@creature Eku|ToA} is a {@creature couatl} polymorphed into a middle-aged Chultan woman. She is one of the few who knows the location of Omu, although she doesn't advertise this fact. The couatl is looking for adventurers to help rid the jungle of the evil that infests it. She'll work only with good-aligned adventurers.
zh_tw: {@creature Eku|ToA|依庫} 是一隻變形為中年楚爾特女性的 {@creature couatl||羽蛇}。她是少數知道奧穆位置的人之一，儘管她並不宣傳這一事實。這隻羽蛇正在尋找冒險家幫助清除侵染叢林的邪惡。她只願與善良陣營的冒險家合作。

english: While in human form, {@creature Eku|ToA} is clothed in light blue robes and carries a walking stick carved in the likeness of a stylized couatl. In this form, {@creature Eku|ToA} stands 5 feet 6 inches tall and weighs 110 pounds. She is on good terms with the aarakocra of Kir Sabal, and she's made numerous treks to Nangalore to retrieve rare flowers. {@creature Eku|ToA} also knows about the evil gargoyles that guard Omu, though she's never fought them, and the guardian naga of Orolunga, whose oracular abilities are legendary. If the characters hire her to guide them but aren't sure where to go, she recommends visiting the guardian naga.
zh_tw: 在人類形態時，{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}身著淺藍色長袍，手持一根雕刻成風格化羽蛇形象的柺杖。在這個形態中，{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}身高5尺6吋，體重110磅。她與基爾·薩巴爾的鳥羽人族關係良好，並且曾多次前往南戈爾採集稀有花朵。{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}還知道守護奧穆的邪惡石像鬼，儘管她從未與它們戰鬥過，以及奧羅倫加的守秘納迦，其預言能力是傳奇的。如果角色們僱傭她作為嚮導但不確定去哪裡，她建議去拜訪守秘納迦。

english: {@creature Eku|ToA} had great love and respect for the people of Mbala, who were tricked and eaten by a green hag named {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA}. {@creature Eku|ToA} regards the hag as one of the greatest evils in Chult. If the characters travel anywhere near Mbala and {@creature Eku|ToA} is with them, she asks them to help her rid the world of {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} once and for all.
zh_tw: {@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}對姆巴拉的人民懷有極大的愛和尊重，他們被一個名叫{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}的綠巫婆欺騙並吃掉了。{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}認為這個巫婆是楚爾特最大的邪惡之一。如果角色們在{@creature Eku|ToA|依庫}的陪同下前往姆巴拉附近任何地方，她會請求他們幫助她徹底擺脫{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}。

english: Faroul and Gondolo
zh_tw: 法魯爾和岡多洛

english: {@i Incompetent fortune hunters (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 無能的尋寶者（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Faroul|ToA} and {@creature Gondolo|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 4 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾}和{@creature Gondolo|ToA|岡多洛}時，給玩家們一份附錄E中手冊4的副本，見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}。

english: {@creature Faroul|ToA} (NG male Calishite human {@creature scout}) and {@creature Gondolo|ToA} (CG male lightfoot halfling {@creature scout} with 13 hit points) are two dandies down on their luck in Port Nyanzaru. Spoiled and pompous, {@creature Faroul|ToA} was shipped off by his exasperated parents to Port Nyanzaru and told to make his fortune there. Bursting with coin and ready for adventure, {@creature Faroul|ToA} brought along his carousing companion, {@creature Gondolo|ToA}. Together, they thought they'd soon be living the high life on distant shores. Within a few months, they'd squandered most of {@creature Faroul|ToA}'s cash at the dinosaur races and were in debt to numerous bookies and several merchant princes. The only thing they have to show for their months of debauchery is a flatulent racing {@creature triceratops} named Zongo. They purchased it for the races, but it was hopelessly slow; now they use Zongo as a pack animal.
zh_tw: {@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾}（NG 男性卡琳珊人人類 {@creature scout||斥侯}）和 {@creature Gondolo|ToA|岡多洛}（CG 男性 輕足半身人 {@creature scout||斥侯}，生命值為13）是在南扎路港運氣不佳的兩個花花公子。被寵壞且自大的 {@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾} 被他惱怒的父母送到南扎路港，並告訴他在那裡發財。帶著滿滿的錢財和對冒險的渴望，{@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾} 帶來了他的飲酒夥伴 {@creature Gondolo|ToA|岡多洛}。他們一起認為，他們很快將在遙遠的海岸上過上奢侈的生活。在幾個月內，他們在恐龍賽跑中揮霍了大部分{@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾}的現金，並欠下了許多賭徒和幾位商王的債務。他們幾個月放縱的唯一收穫是一隻名叫宗戈的放屁賽跑{@creature triceratops||三角龍}。他們買來參加比賽，但它慢得無可救藥；現在他們把宗戈當作馱獸使用。

english: In desperation, {@creature Gondolo|ToA} bought a treasure map from a fever-wracked explorer who needed cash to buy passage back to Baldur's Gate. Miraculously, the map accurately indicates the location of Needle's Bones. This hapless pair hope to be hired by adventurers on an equal-shares basis so they can lead the group to what they believe will be an easily claimed dragon's hoard.
zh_tw: 在絕望中，{@creature Gondolo|ToA|岡多洛}從一個發燒的探險家那裡購買了一張藏寶圖，這位探險家需要現金買票返回博德之門。奇蹟般地，這張地圖準確地指示了針骨的位置。這對不幸的搭檔希望被冒險家僱傭，以平等股份的方式，這樣他們就可以帶領團隊前往他們認為將輕易獲得的龍穴寶藏。

english: {@creature Faroul|ToA} is 5 feet 10 inches tall and 175 pounds. He tells great tales of his battle prowess but he uses his shortsword only in emergencies.
zh_tw: {@creature Faroul|ToA|法魯爾}身高5尺10吋，體重175磅。他講述自己戰鬥勇猛的壯麗故事，但他只在緊急情況下使用他的短劍。

english: {@creature Gondolo|ToA} is 3 feet 6 inches tall and 80 flaccid pounds. He fancies himself a poet, a pugilist, and a philosopher who'll make up important-sounding facts when he runs out of actual ones. He has a knack for narrowly escaping the jaws of peril and has the normal halfling's luck.
zh_tw: {@creature Gondolo|ToA|岡多洛} 高3尺6吋，重80磅（鬆軟狀態下）。他自認為是個詩人、拳擊手和哲學家，當他真正事實用盡時，會編造一些聽起來很重要的事實。他有在危險邊緣僥倖逃脫的本領，並且擁有一般半身人擁有的運氣。

english: Hew Hackinstone
zh_tw: 休·哈金斯頓

english: {@i Barmy dwarf dragon slayer (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 瘋狂的矮人屠龍者（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet Hew, give the players a copy of handout 5 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色遇到休時，給玩家一份位於{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}中的講義5的副本。

english: Three years ago, Hew was part of a dwarven expedition seeking to reopen Wyrmheart Mine. The expedition encountered Tinder the red dragon. Hew alone escaped, and only after the dragon bit off his left arm. Hew wants to return to the mine and slay the dragon, but he needs a band of stout-hearted adventurers to help him. If the characters hire him as a guide, Hew says he can lead them wherever they want, but he'll only take them to Wyrmheart Mine.
zh_tw: 三年前，休是一支試圖重新開放巨龍之心礦井的矮人探險隊的成員。這支探險隊遇到了紅龍火種。只有休一個人逃脫了，龍咬下了他的左臂。休想返回礦山並殺死巨龍，但他需要一群堅定的冒險家來幫助他。休嘴上說著他能帶他們去任何他們想去的地方，但等到角色們正式僱用他作為嚮導之後，他就只會把他們帶去巨龍之心礦井。

english: {@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|Hew} is a shield dwarf {@creature berserker}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|砍伐者} 是一位盾矮人{@creature berserker||狂戰士}，有以下變化：

english: Hew is chaotic neutral.
zh_tw: 砍伐者是混亂中立。

english: He has {@skill Survival} +4.
zh_tw: 他有{@skill Survival||求生} +4。

english: He has resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.
zh_tw: 他對毒素傷害具有抗性，並且在對被{@condition poisoned||中毒}的豁免檢定上有優勢。

english: He has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 他具有達到60尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: He wields a battleaxe instead of a greataxe that deals 7 ({@dice 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage on a hit. Hew can't wield the weapon with two hands, since he's missing his left arm.
zh_tw: 他揮舞的是一把戰斧而不是雙手斧，每次命中造成7（{@dice 1d8 + 3}）點揮砍傷害。由於他失去了左臂，他不能雙手握持武器。

english: Musharib
zh_tw: 穆沙瑞卜

english: {@i Albino dwarf (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 白化侏儒（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Musharib|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 6 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature Musharib|ToA|穆沙瑞卜}時，給玩家們一份附錄E中手冊6的副本，見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}。

english: {@creature Musharib|ToA} (LG male {@creature albino dwarf spirit warrior|ToA}; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) will gladly serve as a guide out of Port Nyanzaru, but he is secretly looking for adventurers of the right skill and fortitude to help him reclaim Hrakhamar—or at least to sneak into its treasury and retrieve Moradin's Gauntlet, a dwarven relic. If there are any dwarves in the player characters' party, {@creature Musharib|ToA} locks onto them and appeals to their love of dwarvenkind to aid him in reclaiming his clan's ancestral forge. In general, he directs his questions and answers to dwarves in the party unless there's no way around speaking to someone else.
zh_tw: {@creature Musharib|ToA|穆沙瑞卜}（守序善良男性{@creature albino dwarf spirit warrior|ToA|白矮人精魂武者}；參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）很樂意擔任離開南扎路港的嚮導，但他暗中尋找具備適當技能和毅力的冒險者，以幫助他奪回赫拉卡瑪爾——或者至少潛入其寶庫，取回摩拉丁之握，這是一件矮人遺物。如果玩家角色中有任何矮人，{@creature Musharib|ToA|穆沙瑞卜}會鎖定他們，並訴諸他們對矮人族的熱愛，請求他們幫助他奪回他氏族的祖傳熔爐。通常情況下，他會將問題和答案直接指向隊伍中的矮人，除非沒有其他選擇。

english: {@creature Musharib|ToA} is 4 feet 5 inches tall and weighs 140 pounds. He carries a wooden maul named Skullbash. His armor is fashioned from the spatulate bones of dinosaurs, and it's gashed and scarred by weapons, claws, and teeth.
zh_tw: {@creature Musharib|ToA|穆沙瑞卜} 身高4尺5吋，體重140磅。他攜帶著一把名為碎顱的木槌。他的盔甲是用恐龍的鏟狀骨頭製成的，上面佈滿了武器、爪子和牙齒造成的切口和疤痕。

english: Qawasha and Kupalué
zh_tw: 卡瓦沙和庫帕魯艾

english: {@i Chultan druid and vegepygmy (Fort Beluarian)}
zh_tw: {@i 楚爾特德魯伊和植物巨人（貝路利安堡）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Qawasha|ToA} and Kupalué, give the players a copy of handout 7 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}和庫帕魯艾時，給玩家們一份附錄E中手冊7的副本，見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}。

english: {@creature Qawasha|ToA} (NG male Chultan {@creature druid}) is a member of the Emerald Enclave based in Fort Beluarian. The druid travels with a {@creature vegepygmy|VGM} companion named Kupalué, a Chultan word that means "walking weed." {@creature Qawasha|ToA} often refers to his companion simply as Weed. They communicate with each other using their own unique sign language. See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for vegepygmy statistics.
zh_tw: {@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}（NG男性楚爾特 {@creature druid||德魯伊}) 是翡翠聯盟的成員，常駐於貝路利安堡。這位德魯伊與一個名為庫帕魯艾的{@creature vegepygmy|VGM|孢子人}夥伴同行，庫帕魯艾是一個楚爾特詞彙，意思是"行走的雜草"。{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}通常簡稱他的夥伴為雜草。他們使用自己獨特的手語進行溝通。檢視{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}以獲取孢子人的具體數值。

english: {@creature Qawasha|ToA} would like to rid the jungle of its undead menace, so he deliberately leads adventurers through undead-infested regions. As he travels through the jungle, {@creature Qawasha|ToA} calls out the names of unusual flora and fauna around him. The druid also has a knack for camping in places where chwingas (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) dwell, and he has experience dealing with the elemental spirits.
zh_tw: {@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙} 希望擺脫叢林中的不死生物威脅，因此他故意帶領冒險家穿越充滿不死生物的地區。當他穿越叢林時，{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙} 會大聲說出他周圍不尋常的動植物的名字。這位德魯伊還有在怯蘊阿靈（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）居住的地方露營的訣竅，並且他有處理元素精魂的經驗。

english: If the characters hire {@creature Qawasha|ToA}, he recommends that they also purchase a charter of exploration before leaving Fort Beluarian. {@creature Qawasha|ToA} has witnessed firsthand the Flaming Fist's mistreatment of adventurers who explore Chult without the requisite paperwork.
zh_tw: 如果角色們僱傭了{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}，他建議他們在離開貝路利安堡之前也購買一份探險許可證。{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}親眼目睹了焰拳對沒有適當檔案就探險楚爾特的冒險家的虐待。

english: {@creature Qawasha|ToA} stands 6 feet 2 inches tall and weighs 180 pounds. Weed stands 3 feet tall and weighs about 30 pounds dry (50 pounds wet).
zh_tw: {@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙} 身高6尺2吋，體重180磅。雜草 身高3尺，乾燥時重約30磅（溼潤時50磅）。

english: River Mist and Flask of Wine
zh_tw: 河霧與酒壺

english: {@i Tabaxi siblings (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 斑貓人兄妹（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature River Mist|ToA} and {@creature Flask of Wine|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 8 in {@area appendix E|540|x}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature River Mist|ToA|河霧}和{@creature Flask of Wine|ToA|酒瓶}時，給玩家們一份{@area 附錄 E|540|x}中的傳單8副本。

english: {@creature River Mist|ToA} and {@creature Flask of Wine|ToA} (CG female and male {@creature Tabaxi Hunter|ToA|tabaxi hunters}; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are siblings in league with the Zhentarim. Consequently, they pay no fees or fealty to any merchant prince; they keep their business quiet, meeting potential clients only in Malar's Throat or seedier houses in Tiryki Anchorage. They refer to one another as River and Flask.
zh_tw: {@creature River Mist|ToA|河霧} 和 {@creature Flask of Wine|ToA|酒瓶}（CG 女性和男性 {@creature Tabaxi Hunter|ToA|斑貓獵人}；見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）是一對手足，與散塔林會有聯絡。因此，他們不向任何商王支付費用或效忠；他們保持業務低調，只在馬拉之喉或提爾基錨地的陰暗房屋中與潛在客戶會面。他們互相稱呼對方為河霧和酒瓶。

english: River is about 5 feet 5 inches and 100 pounds. She wears leather armor and an eye patch. (She lost her right eye in a childhood mishap involving a sling.) River is furtive and uncomfortable in crowds, preferring the jungle where she is truly at home.
zh_tw: 河霧大約身高5尺5吋，體重100磅。她穿著皮甲，戴著眼罩。（她小時候因為投石器的意外失去了右眼。）河霧在人群中表現得鬼鬼祟祟，感到不自在，更喜歡她真正感到自在的叢林。

english: Flask seldom speaks except to agree with River, often repeating the last few words of River's utterance (with a slight lisp) while nodding in assent. Despite this laconic nature, he enjoys being among people and might even be considered gregarious, for a tabaxi. He is tall and lanky (5 feet 8 inches and 140 pounds).
zh_tw: 酒瓶很少說話，除非是同意河霧的觀點，經常重複河霧話語的最後幾個詞（帶有一點口齒不清），同時點頭表示同意。儘管他天性不愛說話，但他喜歡和人在一起，對於一個塔巴西斑貓人來說，他甚至可能被認為是社交的。他身材高大瘦長（5尺8吋，140磅）。

english: River and Flask can guide characters to Firefinger and Dungrunglung. They've also heard stories about an old woman in Mbala who can animate the dead in such a way that the zombies retain the abilities and memories they had in life.
zh_tw: 河霧和酒瓶可以引導角色前往火指和登格隆格。他們還聽說過在姆巴拉有一個老婦人的故事，她能夠讓死者活化，以這樣的方式讓殭屍保留他們在生命中所擁有的能力和記憶。

english: Zhentarim agents in Port Nyanzaru have instructed River and Flask to keep an eye out for {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}. If they encounter Artus, the tabaxi try to learn as much as they can about him. The next time they return to Port Nyanzaru, the tabaxi report what they've seen and learned to their Zhent masters unless they're incentivized not to.
zh_tw: 南扎路港的散塔林會代理人已指示河霧與酒壺留意{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}。如果他們遭遇阿圖斯，斑貓人會儘可能多地瞭解他。除非受到激勵不這樣做，否則下次他們返回南扎路港時，斑貓人會向他們的散塔林會主人報告所見所聞。

english: Salida
zh_tw: 薩莉達

english: {@i Yuan-ti spy (Port Nyanzaru)}
zh_tw: {@i 蛇髮間諜（南扎路港）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Salida|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 9 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當玩家遇到{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}時，給玩家一份{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}中的講義9的副本。

english: {@creature Salida|ToA} (NE female Chultan {@creature yuan-ti pureblood} with {@skill Survival} +5) poses as a human guide in Port Nyanzaru, but she really works for {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. She keeps him apprised of the activity of anyone who's heading south in search of Omu. They communicate via {@item sending stones}. {@creature Salida|ToA} keeps her {@item sending stones} in a pouch and tries to join the player characters' expedition as a guide, a warrior, or even as a lowly bearer or paddler.
zh_tw: {@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}（NE 女性 楚爾特 {@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}，具有 {@skill Survival||求生} +5）在南扎路港偽裝成人類嚮導，但她實際上為{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}工作。她讓他了解任何前往南部尋找奧穆的人的活動。他們透過{@item sending stones||短訊石}進行交流。{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}將她的{@item sending stones||短訊石}放在一個袋子裡，並嘗試作為嚮導、戰士，甚至是卑微的搬運工或劃槳手加入玩家角色的探險隊。

english: {@creature Salida|ToA} is 5 feet 4 inches tall and 120 pounds. She is fit and completely looks the part of a seasoned explorer. Her garb covers up the scaly patches of skin that betray her true nature. {@creature Salida|ToA} is skilled at crafting colorful insults and concocting believable lies to cover her true background. Her wit makes her an enjoyable traveling companion—a trait that she leverages to the fullest to join the characters' expedition.
zh_tw: {@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達} 身高5尺4吋，體重120磅。她身材健美，完全符合一位經驗豐富的探險家的形象。她的裝束掩蓋了透露她真實身份的鱗片斑塊。{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達} 擅長製造豐富多彩的侮辱言辭，並編造可信的謊言來掩蓋她的真實背景。她的機智使她成為一個愉快的旅行伴侶——她充分利用這一特點加入角色們的遠徵。

english: Shago
zh_tw: 鯊狗

english: {@i Chultan gladiator (Fort Beluarian)}
zh_tw: {@i 楚爾特角鬥士（貝路利安堡）}

english: When the characters meet {@creature Shago|ToA}, give the players a copy of handout 10 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 當角色們遇到{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}時，給玩家們一份來自{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}的手冊 10 的副本。

english: {@creature Shago|ToA} (CG male Chultan {@creature gladiator} with {@skill Survival} +7) is a Chultan and the only son of {@creature Zhanthi|ToA}, one of Port Nyanzaru's merchant princes. He works out of Fort Beluarian, and although he presents himself as an independent operator, he's in league with the Flaming Fist. {@creature Shago|ToA} has led many Flaming Fist expeditions into the jungle to clear out undead, despite having a great fear of being turned into a zombie or ghoul.
zh_tw: {@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}（混亂善良男性楚爾特{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}，擁有{@skill Survival||求生}技能+7）是楚爾特人，也是南扎路港商王之一{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}的唯一兒子。他在貝路利安堡工作，儘管他自稱是獨立行動者，但實際上與焰拳傭兵團有勾結。{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}曾領導多次焰拳的探險隊進入叢林，清除不死生物，儘管他非常害怕被變成殭屍或食屍鬼。

english: Despite his fears, {@creature Shago|ToA} knows that the undead must be defeated. This is why he works with the Flaming Fist; the merchant princes bemoan the threat from undead but, other than hiring guards to defend Port Nyanzaru, they won't pay to take effective action against it. His mother believes she's "recruited" him to keep an eye on the Flaming Fist, but his sympathies are with the mercenaries and he rarely provides her with any secret or useful information.
zh_tw: 儘管他有所恐懼，{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}知道必須擊敗不死生物。這就是他與焰拳合作的原因；商王們對來自不死生物的威脅感到悲哀，但他們除了僱傭守衛來保衛南扎路港之外，不願意支付採取有效行動的費用。他的母親認為她"招募"了他來監視焰拳，但他的同情心在僱傭兵這邊，他很少向她提供任何秘密或有用的資訊。

english: {@creature Shago|ToA} is 6 feet 3 inches tall and 220 pounds, with rippling muscles and a friendly smile. His main goal is to impress {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} enough to earn a rank within the Flaming Fist. While {@creature Shago|ToA} is their guide, characters gain advantage on Charisma checks made to influence members of the Flaming Fist.
zh_tw: {@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗} 高6尺3吋，體重220磅，肌肉線條分明，面帶友好的微笑。他的主要目標是給{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}留下深刻印象，以在焰拳中獲得一席之地。當{@creature Shago|ToA|鯊狗}作為他們的嚮導時，角色們在進行魅力檢定時，影響焰拳成員時獲得優勢。

english: Gathering Information
zh_tw: 收集資訊

english: The challenge for characters isn't getting people to tell them about Chult; it's sifting the truth from the mountain of rumor, conjecture, and myth.
zh_tw: 對角色們來說，挑戰不在於讓人們告訴他們關於楚爾特的資訊；而是從謠言、推測和神話的大山中篩選出真相。

english: The best people to talk to are those who actually work or live in the jungle: hunters, guides, and explorers. No skill checks are necessary to get people talking, but to acquire reliable information, characters must go where in-the-know folks gather. For each hour spent talking to knowledgeable travelers, a character can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If the check succeeds, roll percentile dice and consult the Chult Rumors table to determine what the character learns.
zh_tw: 最佳交談物件是那些真正在叢林中工作或生活的人：獵人、嚮導和探險者。開始交談不需要進行技能檢定，但為了獲取可靠的資訊，角色們必須前往知情人士聚集的地方。每花一小時與知識淵博的旅行者交談，角色可以進行一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定。如果檢定成功，投擲百分比骰並參考"查爾特謠言表"以確定角色獲得的資訊。

english: Chult Rumors
zh_tw: 楚爾特謠言

english: Rumor
zh_tw: 流言

english: Bird folk inhabit a monastery that hangs on the side of a plateau many miles up the Olung River, past the Laughing Gorge. The bird folk are holding the last royal heir of Chult as their prisoner.
zh_tw: 鳥人族居住在一個修道院，該修道院懸掛在奧倫河上游數英里的一個高原側面，過了笑谷。鳥人族將楚爾特的最後一位王室繼承人作為他們的囚犯。

english: Deep in the heart of the jungle is a city built by minotaurs. It's now overrun by snake people, but even worse things dwell below. In visions, I have seen strange devils screaming in the dark.
zh_tw: 在叢林的深處，有一座由牛頭人建造的城市。現在它被蛇人佔領了，但更糟糕的是，下面還棲息著其他生物。在幻象中，我看到了奇怪的魔鬼在黑暗中尖叫。

english: If you head up the Tiryki River about five days by canoe, you'll see a stone spire to the east. Natives call it Firefinger. "Terror folk" nest there, and if they spot you, you're in for a fight.
zh_tw: 如果你乘獨木舟沿提爾基河向上遊走大約五天，你會看到東邊有一座石塔。當地人稱它為火指。"恐怖族"在那裡築巢，如果他們發現了你，你就準備戰鬥吧。

english: One must purchase a charter of exploration at Fort Beluarian before undertaking any jungle expedition. The Flaming Fist punishes explorers who don't have the required paperwork.
zh_tw: 在進行任何叢林探險之前，必須在貝路利安堡購買勘探許可證。焰拳會懲罰那些沒有所需檔案的探險者。

english: Chult had many kings and queens, but none more beautiful than Queen Zalkoré. Thousands of warriors killed and died for her, but the only memorial of her reign is the garden palace of Nangalore, which lies near the eastern shore of the River Olung, north of Lake Luo.
zh_tw: 楚爾特有許多國王和王后，但沒有一個比扎爾柯蕊女王更美麗。成千上萬的戰士為她而戰死，但她統治的唯一紀念物是位於奧倫格河東側、盧湖以北的南戈爾花園宮殿。

english: Chult was once a playground for a green dragon. Her bones mark the location of a hidden treasure trove. If you travel to Mezro and head east across the Laughing Gorge, then south toward Kir Sabal, you might stumble on the dragon's bones and earn yourself a place in the history books!
zh_tw: 楚爾特曾經是一條綠龍的遊樂場。她的骨頭標誌著一個隱藏的寶藏庫的位置。如果你前往梅茲羅，向東穿過笑谷，然後向南前往基爾薩巴爾，你可能會偶然發現龍的骨頭，並在歷史書籍中贏得一席之地！

english: The city of Mezro was not destroyed during the Spellplague after all. Its ruins are an illusion. I heard a pale-skinned man whisper this to a dinosaur man with a big sword. The dinosaur man smelled like honeysuckle.
zh_tw: 梅茲羅城在法術瘟疫期間並沒有被摧毀。它的廢墟其實是一種幻象。我聽到一個皮膚蒼白的男人對著一個手持巨劍的恐龍人低聲說這些。那個恐龍人聞起來像忍冬花。

english: Dwarves are determined to reclaim Wyrmheart Mine, but a red dragon lives there now. Haven't seen one of them in a while.
zh_tw: 矮人決心奪回龍心礦井，但現在那裡住著一條紅龍。已經有一段時間沒見到他們了。

english: The jungle is full of nature spirits—weird little elemental creatures with masks. They don't speak, and I've never known one to be harmful, but their magical powers should not be taken lightly.
zh_tw: 叢林裡充滿了自然精魂——一些戴著面具的怪異小元素生物。它們不說話，我從不知道它們會造成傷害，但它們的魔法力量不容小覷。

english: Some city folk were expecting the arrival of a Halruaan airship called the {@i Star Goddess}. It never arrived. I bet it crashed in the jungle somewhere.
zh_tw: 一些城裡人正期待著一艘名為{@i 星辰女神}的哈魯安飛艇的到來。但它從未抵達。我打賭它在叢林的某個地方墜毀了。

english: There are giant snapping turtles in Snapping Turtle Bay. One of them is as big as a house. He's known as King Toba, and his shell has gemstones embedded in it.
zh_tw: 在巨鱷龜灣有巨大的巨鱷龜。其中一隻像房子一樣大。它被稱為託巴國王，它的殼上鑲嵌著寶石。

english: The Order of the Gauntlet came here to cleanse the jungle of undead. They lost one of their encampments not too long ago. They're just barely hanging on to another one. I see their emissaries all the time, heading up the River Soshenstar in canoes to get more supplies and templars from Port Nyanzaru.
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團來到這裡是為了清除叢林中的不死生物。他們不久前失去了一個營地。他們勉強維持著另一個。我總是看到他們的使者，乘著獨木舟沿著索申斯塔河前往南扎路港獲取更多的補給和聖殿騎士。

english: Watch out for any mist with a blue tinge to it. It spreads a fever that drives people mad.
zh_tw: 要小心任何帶有藍色光暈的霧氣。它會傳播一種使人發狂的熱病。

english: A dragon turtle named Aremag lives in the Bay of Chult. If you wish to set sail from Port Nyanzaru, you'll need treasure to appease the greedy monster. How much treasure, I can't say. Aremag will tell you what it wants, and you'd best give it what it demands.
zh_tw: 一隻名叫阿瑞瑪格的龍龜居住在楚爾特灣。如果你想從南扎路港啟航，你需要財寶來安撫這個貪婪的怪物。需要多少財寶，我說不上來。阿瑞瑪格會告訴你它想要什麼，你最好給它所要求的。

english: A ruined city lies up the River Tath, past Kahakla Gorge. Supposedly, no one's explored past the gorge, but that's not true. It's just that the few who made it out alive mostly keep quiet about what they found there. I have it on good authority that the ruins are guarded by a naga who is both wise and generous.
zh_tw: 塔斯河上游，卡哈克拉峽谷之後，有一座廢棄的城市。據說，沒有人探索過峽谷的更深處，但這不是真的。只是那些活著出來的少數人大多對在那裡發現的東西保持沉默。據可靠訊息，這些廢墟由一位既智慧又慷慨的納迦守護。

english: The great god Ubtao once guided the people of Chult, be he tired of their constant warring and abandoned them. Since then, Chultans have turned to the worship of other gods, some of which were tricksters and deceivers.
zh_tw: 偉大的神烏博塔奧曾經引導楚爾特的人民，但他厭倦了他們不斷的戰爭並拋棄了他們。從那時起，楚爾特人轉向了對其他神的崇拜，其中一些是詭計多端和欺騙的神。

english: Long ago, a peaceful tribe of fisherfolk called the Aldani angered Ubtao by catching and eating all the lobsters in a river. As punishment for their greed, they were all transformed into monsters that dwell in the Aldani Basin.
zh_tw: 很久以前，一個被稱為阿爾達尼的和平漁民部落因捕食並吃掉河中所有的龍蝦而激怒了烏博濤。作為對他們貪婪的懲罰，他們全部被變成了居住在阿爾達尼盆地的怪物。

english: Perched atop a plateau overlooking the Aldani Basin is a ghost village. All the people there disappeared. No one knows why. You can reach the Aldani Basin by following the River Soshenstar.
zh_tw: 坐落在俯瞰阿爾達尼盆地的高原上的是一個鬼村。那裡的人都消失了。沒有人知道為什麼。你可以透過沿著索申斯塔河到達阿爾達尼盆地。

english: The great god Ubtao loved mazes. If you happen upon a maze of any kind, trace a path through it. You will earn Ubtao's favor by doing so.
zh_tw: 偉大的神烏博濤喜歡迷宮。如果你偶然遇到任何型別的迷宮，就描繪出一條穿過它的路徑。透過這樣做，你將贏得烏博濤的青睞。

english: Chapter 2: The Land of Chult
zh_tw: 第2章：楚爾特之地

english: When the adventurers mount their expedition into the heart of Chult, they have the option of striking out from any of several locations. Port Nyanzaru is the most obvious starting point. It offers easy access by canoe to two major rivers, the Soshenstar and the Tiryki. Journeys up these rivers make excellent shake-down expeditions for explorers just learning the ropes of this unforgiving land. Characters can also strike out from Fort Beluarian or travel by ship to coastal landing sites such as Jahaka Bay, Kitcher's Inlet, Refuge Bay, Shilku Bay, and Snapping Turtle Bay.
zh_tw: 當冒險家們開始進入楚爾特的心臟地帶時，他們可以選擇從幾個地點中的任何一個出發。南扎路港是最明顯的起點。它提供了透過獨木舟輕鬆到達兩條主要河流——索申斯塔河和提爾基河的途徑。沿這些河流的旅程為探險者提供了極好的磨合探險，適合那些剛開始瞭解這片無情土地的探險者。角色們也可以從貝路利安堡出發，或乘船前往沿海登陸點，如賈哈卡灣、基徹爾灣、避風港灣、希爾庫灣和撲龜灣。

english: Chult is a land of adventure, and this chapter aims to make the characters' wilderness journey a memorable one. By design, the adventure locations are not tailored to characters of a specific level. If the adventuring party is relatively weak, it's up to the players to choose whether to flee instead of fight, negotiate instead of attack, or surrender instead of die. It's up to you as the DM to be flexible and keep the story moving forward as best you can. If an encounter is going badly for the adventurers, you can have the monsters suddenly withdraw, demand the party's surrender, or deal nonlethal damage. You can have an NPC show up to lend assistance. Mindless predators might be scared off by a sudden volcanic eruption or earth tremor. In short, there is always a way to turn the party's misfortune into a fighting chance of survival.
zh_tw: 楚爾特是一片冒險之地，本章節旨在使角色的荒野之旅難忘。設計上，冒險地點並不針對特定等級的角色。如果冒險隊伍相對較弱，玩家需要選擇是逃跑而不是戰鬥，談判而不是攻擊，還是投降而不是死亡。作為DM，你需要靈活應對，儘可能使故事向前推進。如果冒險者遭遇不利，你可以讓怪物突然撤退，要求隊伍投降，或者造成非致命傷害。你可以讓一個NPC出現提供幫助。無意識的捕食者可能會被突然的火山爆發或地震嚇跑。簡而言之，總有辦法將隊伍的不幸轉化為生存的機會。

english: The Expedition Begins
zh_tw: 遠徵開始

english: The sections that follow contain information that will help you run this part of the adventure smoothly. For each day that the party travels through the wilderness, follow these steps:
zh_tw: 以下部分包含的資訊將幫助您順利進行這部分冒險。對於隊伍穿越荒野的每一天，請按照以下步驟進行：

english: Using the poster map, identify the hex in which the party is currently located. Don't share this information with the players if the party is lost; otherwise, show the players the party's location by pointing to the appropriate hex on their map of Chult.
zh_tw: 使用海報地圖，確定派對目前所在的六邊形。如果派對迷路了，不要與玩家分享這些資訊；否則，請透過指向楚爾特地圖上適當的六邊形來向玩家展示派對的位置。

english: Let the players determine what direction the party wants to go, and whether the party plans to move at a normal pace, a fast pace, or a slow pace (see "{@area Travel Distances|09e|x}" below).
zh_tw: 讓玩家決定隊伍想要前往的方向，以及隊伍計劃以正常速度、快速還是慢速行進（見下文"{@area 旅行距離|09e|x}"）。

english: Let the players choose a navigator, then make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check on the navigator's behalf to determine if the party becomes lost (see "{@area Navigation|0a1|x}" below).
zh_tw: 讓玩家選擇一個導航員，然後代表導航員進行一次感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，以確定派對是否會迷路（見下方"{@area 導航|0a1|x}"）。

english: Check for random encounters throughout the day (see {@adventure appendix B|ToA|7}).
zh_tw: 全天檢查隨機遭遇（見{@adventure 附錄 B|ToA|7}）。

english: At the end of the day, check to see if any party members are dehydrated (see "{@area Dehydration|0a2|x}" below).
zh_tw: 在一天結束時，檢查是否有任何隊伍成員脫水（見下文"{@area 脫水|0a2|x}"）。

english: Travel Distances
zh_tw: 旅行距離

english: On the map of Chult, each hex measures 10 miles across. Characters moving at a normal pace can travel 1 hex per day on foot through coastal, jungle, mountain, swamp, or wasteland terrain. They can travel 2 hexes per day if they're traveling by canoe on a river or lake. The rate of travel up or down river is the same; the rivers are so sluggish that current is almost imperceptible. Without canoes, the normal rate of travel along a river is the same as through the surrounding terrain. Canoes move 1 hex per day through swamp.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特的地圖上，每個六邊形的寬度為10英里。以正常速度移動的角色步行可以透過沿海、叢林、山地、沼澤或荒地地形每天移動1個六邊形。如果他們乘獨木舟在河流或湖泊上旅行，每天可以移動2個六邊形。沿河流上下游的旅行速度是相同的；河流流速如此緩慢，以至於幾乎感覺不到流動。如果沒有獨木舟，沿河流的旅行速度與周圍地形相同。獨木舟在沼澤中每天可以移動1個六邊形。

english: If characters move at a fast pace, the easiest way to deal with their progress is to roll a {@dice d4}. On a roll of 3 or 4, they advance 1 additional hex that day. Characters moving at a fast pace take a–5 penalty to their passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) scores, making them more likely to miss clues and walk into ambushes.
zh_tw: 如果角色以快速步伐前進，處理他們進展的最簡單方式是擲一個{@dice d4}。如果擲出3或4，他們那天額外前進一個六邊形。以快速步伐移動的角色對他們的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分有-5的懲罰，這使他們更有可能錯過線索並走進伏擊。

english: If characters set a slow pace, roll a {@dice d4}. On a roll of 1 or 2, they advance 1 fewer hex that day (in other words, 1 hex by canoe or none by foot). On any other result, their caution is rewarded, and they travel the same distance as a group moving at a normal pace. Characters moving at a slow pace can move stealthily. As long as they're not in the open, they can try to surprise or sneak by other creatures they encounter.
zh_tw: 如果角色們保持緩慢的步伐，擲一個{@dice d4}。如果是1或2，那天他們少前進一個六邊形（換句話說，乘獨木舟前進1個六邊形或步行不前進）。如果是其他結果，他們的謹慎會得到回報，他們可以像正常速度移動的團隊一樣行進相同的距離。以慢速移動的角色可以悄無聲息地移動。只要他們不在開闊地帶，他們就可以嘗試突襲或悄悄繞過他們遇到的其他生物。

english: Tracking Miles
zh_tw: 追蹤里程

english: Instead of tracking movement by hexes, you can keep track of the actual distances covered (10 miles per day at a normal pace, 15 miles per day at a fast pace, or 9 miles per day at a slow pace), but this is likely to be more bother than it's worth if the group switches pace from day to day.
zh_tw: 你可以跟蹤實際覆蓋的距離而不是透過六邊形來跟蹤移動（以正常速度每天10英里，以快速每天15英里，或以慢速每天9英里），但如果團隊每天改變速度，這可能會比它值得的更麻煩。

english: A character with a flying speed of 30 feet can travel 4 miles per hour.
zh_tw: 具有30尺飛行速度的角色可以每小時行進4英里。

english: Where's Artus Cimber?
zh_tw: 阿圖斯·辛貝爾在哪裡？

english: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and his traveling companion {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} are good-aligned NPCs who can help the characters accomplish their goals. Both are described in {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}. During the adventure, Artus and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} are either searching for Orolunga or gathering supplies and information in Port Nyanzaru. They can be encountered anywhere on the peninsula. Characters have a small chance of meeting Artus and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} as a random encounter (see {@adventure appendix B|ToA|7}).
zh_tw: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和他的旅行夥伴{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}是善良陣營的NPC，可以幫助角色實現他們的目標。兩者都在{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}中描述。在冒險期間，阿圖斯和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}要麼在尋找奧羅倫加，要麼在南扎路港收集物資和資訊。他們可以在半島上的任何地方被遇到。角色有很小的機會作為隨機遭遇遇到阿圖斯和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|ToA|7}）。

english: If Artus and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} don't appear as a random encounter, here are a few places where they might be found:
zh_tw: 如果阿圖斯和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}沒有作為隨機遭遇出現，以下是一些他們可能出現的地方：

english: Camp Righteous (exploring the ruins)
zh_tw: 正義營地（探索廢墟）

english: The Heart of Ubtao (spying on the Red Wizards)
zh_tw: 烏塔歐之心（監視紅袍法師）

english: Jahaka Anchorage (trying to free prisoners trapped in the pirates' dungeon)
zh_tw: 賈哈卡錨地（試圖解救被困在海盜地牢中的囚犯）

english: Kir Sabal (gathering information from the aarakocra or Princess Mwaxanaré)
zh_tw: 基爾·薩巴爾（從鳥羽人或公主姆瓦克絲娜瑞收集資訊）

english: Orolunga (consulting with Saja N'baza)
