zh_tw: 奧羅隆加（與薩賈·恩巴扎商議）

english: Literally anywhere in the jungle, fleeing from a pack of screaming {@creature Ghoul||ghouls}, a horde of cannibalistic {@creature Tribal Warrior||tribal warriors}, or a {@creature tyrannosaurus zombie|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9})
zh_tw: 幾乎在叢林的任何地方，逃離一群尖叫的{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}，一群食人的{@creature Tribal Warrior||部族武者}，或者一隻{@creature tyrannosaurus zombie|ToA|暴龍喪屍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）

english: Artus is reluctant to reveal why he's exploring Chult. He tries to get a sense of the characters' intentions before saying too much. Once he's confident that they're all on the same side, he'll swap whatever he knows (which is as much as you want to tell the characters) for whatever the characters know. Once Artus and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} become aware of the Soulmonger and the danger it poses, they're more than happy to help the party destroy it.
zh_tw: 阿圖斯不太願意透露他探索楚爾特的原因。在過多透露之前，他試圖瞭解角色們的意圖。一旦他確信他們都站在同一戰線，他就會交換他所知道的資訊（這取決於你想要告訴角色的資訊量）以換取角色們所知道的資訊。一旦阿圖斯和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}意識到靈能者及其所帶來的危險，他們非常樂意幫助隊伍摧毀它。

english: Any party that includes Artus and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} will have an easier time overcoming the adventure's challenges. However, Artus is being hunted by the forces of evil. Frost giants, the Zhentarim, {@creature Xandala|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} (see "{@area Heart of Ubtao|10b|x}" later in this chapter), and the Red Wizards of Thay can appear at any time and try to capture Artus. If Artus believes that his presence is endangering the characters, he will leave the party and take {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} with him.
zh_tw: 任何包括阿圖斯和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}的隊伍將更容易克服冒險的挑戰。然而，阿圖斯正被邪惡勢力追捕。霜巨人、散塔林會、{@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）、{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}（見本章後面的"{@area 烏塔歐之心|10b|x}"）和泰伊的紅法師可以隨時出現並試圖捕獲阿圖斯。如果阿圖斯認為他的存在正危及角色們，他將離開隊伍並帶走{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}。

english: Navigation
zh_tw: 導航

english: Have the players designate one party member as the navigator. The navigator might be an NPC, such as a guide, and the party can switch its navigator day to day.
zh_tw: 讓玩家指定一名隊伍成員作為領航員。領航員可能是NPC，比如嚮導，隊伍可以每天更換其領航員。

english: At the start of each new travel day, the DM makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check on behalf of the navigator. The result of the check determines whether or not the party becomes lost over the course of the day. The DC of the check is based on the day's most common terrain: {@dc 10} for coasts and lakes, or {@dc 15} for jungles, mountains, rivers, swamps, and wastelands. Apply a +5 bonus to the check if the group sets a slow pace for the day, or a–5 penalty if the group is moving at a fast pace. It's possible to get lost on a river by following a tributary instead of the main branch.
zh_tw: 在每個新的旅行日開始時，DM 代表導航員進行一次感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。檢定的結果決定了團隊在當天是否會迷路。檢定的DC基於當天最常見的地形：海岸和湖泊為 {@dc 10}，叢林、山脈、河流、沼澤和荒地為 {@dc 15}。如果團隊當天以慢速度行進，則在檢定上獲得+5加值；如果以快速度行進，則施加-5減值。如果在河流上跟隨支流而非主流，也有可能迷路。

english: If the check succeeds, the navigator knows exactly where the party is on the players' map of Chult throughout the day.
zh_tw: 如果檢定成功，導航者能在整個白天準確地知道隊伍在玩家的楚爾特地圖上的位置。

english: If the check fails, the party becomes lost. Each hex on the map is surrounded by six other hexes; whenever a lost party moves 1 hex, roll a {@dice d6} to randomly determine which neighboring hex the party enters, and do not divulge the party's location to the players. While the party is lost, players can't pinpoint the group's location on their map of Chult. The next time a navigator succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check made to navigate, reveal the party's actual location to the players.
zh_tw: 如果檢定失敗，隊伍就會迷路。地圖上的每個六邊形都被其他六個六邊形包圍；每當迷路的隊伍移動1個六邊形時，擲一個{@dice d6}來隨機確定隊伍進入的鄰近六邊形，並且不要向玩家透露隊伍的位置。在隊伍迷路期間，玩家不能在他們的楚爾特地圖上確定團隊的位置。下一次導航者在進行感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定以導航時成功，向玩家揭示隊伍的實際位置。

english: Map 2.1: Chult
zh_tw: 地圖 2.1：楚爾特

english: Dehydration
zh_tw: 脫水

english: Characters who explore Chult need plenty of water to stay hydrated. The water found in rivers and on the ground is unfit for drinking unless it is boiled first. If they have a rain catcher (see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}"), characters can use it to collect rain and then store the water in portable containers.
zh_tw: 探索楚爾特的角色需要大量的水來保持水分。河流和地面上的水不適合飲用，除非先煮沸。如果他們有雨水收集器（見"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"），角色可以使用它收集雨水，然後將水儲存在便攜容器中。

english: At the end of each day, any character who hasn't drunk at least 2 gallons of fresh water must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or suffer 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. The saving throw is made with disadvantage if the character is wearing medium armor, heavy armor, or heavy clothing. Characters traveling at a fast pace, instead of a normal or slow pace, take a–5 penalty on their saving throws against dehydration.
zh_tw: 每天結束時，任何未飲用至少2加侖淡水的角色必須成功透過一項{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，否則將承受1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。如果角色穿著中甲、重甲或厚重的衣物，則此豁免檢定帶有劣勢。以快速步旅行而非正常或慢速步旅行的角色，在對抗脫水的豁免檢定中受到–5的懲罰。

english: Characters traveling with beasts of burden and other animals must keep them fed and hydrated as well. See "{@book Food and Water|DMG|5|Food and Water}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for basic requirements based on creature size. Dinosaurs and other creatures native to Chult can forage for food and drink as long as they are in their native habitat.
zh_tw: 攜帶馱獸和其他動物的角色也必須確保它們有充足的食物和水。有關基於生物體型的基本需求，請參閱{@i 城主指南}第五章中的"{@book 糧食與水|DMG|5|Food and Water}"。恐龍以及其他原生於楚爾特（楚爾特）的生物，只要處於它們的原生棲息地，就可以自行覓食和飲水。

english: Diseases
zh_tw: 疾病

english: The following diseases can affect giants and humanoids exploring the jungles of Chult. Remember that lesser restoration and similar magic can cure a disease.
zh_tw: 以下疾病可能會影響到探索楚爾特叢林的巨人和類人生物。請記住，少效恢復和類似的魔法可以治癒疾病。

english: Blue Mist Fever
zh_tw: 藍霧熱

english: A magical mist creeps through the jungles of Chult. Contact with this thin, blue, odorless mist can infect giants and humanoids with blue mist fever. A {@spell dispel magic} spell destroys the mist in a 20-foot square starting at a point chosen by the caster within the spell's range. An encounter with this mist typically covers {@dice 1d6} such areas (400–2,400 square feet).
zh_tw: 一種魔法霧氣悄悄穿過楚爾特的叢林。接觸這種稀薄、藍色、無氣味的霧氣可以使巨人和類人生物感染藍霧熱。一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術可以在施法者選擇的法術範圍內的20尺平方區域內消滅霧氣。通常，這種霧氣的遭遇會覆蓋{@dice 1d6}個這樣的區域（400-2,400平方尺）。

english: A giant or humanoid that comes into contact with the mist must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or become infected with blue mist fever. An infected creature begins seeing vivid hallucinations of blue monkeys {@dice 1d6} hours after failing the save, and the hallucinations last until the disease ends on the creature. A creature can repeat the saving throw every 24 hours, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 接觸到霧氣的巨人或類人生物必須透過 {@dc 13} 的體質豁免，否則將感染藍霧熱。受感染的生物在豁免失敗後 {@dice 1d6} 小時內開始出現幻覺，看到上躥下跳的藍色猴子，這些幻覺持續到疾病結束。該生物每24小時可以重複進行一次豁免，成功則結束效應。

english: Shivering Sickness
zh_tw: 寒顫病

english: Insects native to the jungles and marshes of Chult carry this disease, shivering sickness. The easiest protection against it is a coating of insect-repelling salve on all exposed skin (for the cost of insect repellent, see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}").
zh_tw: 來自楚爾特叢林和沼澤的昆蟲攜帶這種疾病，顫抖病。最簡單的防護措施是在所有暴露的皮膚上塗抹一層驅蟲藥膏（關於驅蟲劑的費用，請參見"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"）。

english: A giant or humanoid that takes damage from insect swarms or from giant centipedes, giant scorpions, or giant wasps is exposed to the disease at the end of the encounter. Those who haven't applied insect repellent since their previous long rest are exposed to the disease when they finish a long rest.
zh_tw: 在遭遇戰結束時，受到昆蟲群襲或來自巨大蜈蚣、巨大蠍子或巨大黃蜂傷害的巨人或類人生物將暴露於疾病中。自從上次長休以來沒有使用驅蟲劑的人，在完成長休時將暴露於疾病中。

english: A giant or humanoid exposed to the disease must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected. A creature with natural armor has advantage on the saving throw. It takes {@dice 2d6} hours for symptoms to manifest in an infected creature. Symptoms include blurred vision, disorientation, and a sudden drop in body temperature that causes uncontrollable shivering and chattering of the teeth.
zh_tw: 暴露在該疾病下的巨人或類人生物必須進行一次 {@dc 11} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則被感染。具有天生護甲的生物在該豁免上具優勢。受感染的生物在 {@dice 2d6} 小時後表現出症狀，包括視力模糊、失去方向感、體溫突然下降，無法控制的戰慄和牙齒打顫。

english: Once symptoms begin, the infected creature regains only half the normal number of hit points from spending Hit Dice and no hit points from a long rest. The infected creature also has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. At the end of a long rest, an infected creature repeats the saving throw, shaking off the disease on a successful save.
zh_tw: 一旦症狀開始，受感染的生物在消耗生命骰時回血時，只能獲得正常恢復的生命值的一半，並且無法從長休中恢復生命值。被感染的生物的屬性檢定和攻擊檢定具劣勢。在長休結束後，受感染生物重骰該豁免，豁免成功則擺脫該疾病。

english: Throat Leeches
zh_tw: 咽喉水蛭

english: Minuscule parasites known as throat leeches infect the water in Chult's forests, swamps, and rivers. Any giant or humanoid that swallows tainted water must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be infested with throat leeches. Immediate symptoms include throat inflammation and shortness of breath. After {@dice 1d6} hours, the infected character gains 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} that can't be removed (except as described below) until the disease is cured. At the end of each long rest, the infected creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} increases by 1 level; on a successful save, the creature's {@condition exhaustion} decreases by 1 level. If a successful saving throw reduces the infected creature's level of {@condition exhaustion} below 1, the creature recovers from the disease.
zh_tw: 被稱為咽喉水蛭的微小寄生蟲會感染楚爾特叢林、沼澤和河流中的水源。任何喝下了受汙染的水的巨人或類人生物必須進行一次 {@dc 12} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則感染咽喉水蛭。症狀立即發作，包括喉嚨發炎和呼吸急促。{@dice 1d6} 小時後，受感染角色提升 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，持續至該疾病被治癒為止（下列情況除外）。每次長休結束時，受感染生物必須重骰該豁免。豁免失敗則該生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}增加 1 級；豁免成功則該生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}降低 1 級。如果一次成功的豁免使受感染生物的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}降低至 0，則該生物從該疾病中恢復。

english: Explorers can avoid contracting throat leeches by drinking only rainwater or water that's been boiled or magically purified.
zh_tw: 冒險者可以透過只喝雨水、或經過煮沸的水、或被魔法淨化的水來避免感染咽喉水蛭。

english: A Cure for Dead Characters
zh_tw: 治癒已死亡角色的方法

english: If a player character dies while exploring the wilds of Chult, an NPC guide might suggest that the party take its dead member to the ghost village of Mbala. A powerful witch is rumored to dwell there. According to local legends, the witch forged a pact with the Lord of Bones, a god who granted her the power to create zombies that retain their former personalities. For more information on the so-called witch, see "{@area Mbala|15a|x}" later in this chapter.
zh_tw: 如果一個玩家角色在探索楚爾特荒野時死亡，一個NPC嚮導可能會建議派對將其死去的成員帶到鬼魂村莊姆巴拉。據傳聞，那裡居住著一位強大的女巫。根據當地傳說，這位女巫與骨骼之主，一位賦予她創造保留其原有個性的殭屍的神，簽訂了契約。有關這位所謂女巫的更多資訊，請參見本章後面的"{@area 姆巴拉|15a|x}"。

english: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇

english: Chult is home to an immense variety of plants, beasts, monsters, and intelligent beings. Random encounters with the local wildlife are inevitable and help to make the party's expedition a memorable one. {@adventure Appendix B|ToA|7} contains guidelines for generating random encounters in the wilderness.
zh_tw: 楚爾特擁有種類繁多的植物、野獸、怪物和智慧生物。與當地野生動物的隨機遭遇不可避免，並有助於使團隊的探險成為一次難忘的經歷。{@adventure 附錄 B|ToA|7} 包含了在荒野中生成隨機遭遇的指南。

english: Undead Territory
zh_tw: 不死生物領地

english: Undead creatures have nearly pushed human civilization off the peninsula, except for a few isolated outposts where Chultans and their allies take refuge behind walls. Map 2.1 shows where the undead are thickest. Characters passing through territories marked with black skull-and-bones icons are likely to have random encounters with undead. The likelihood of an undead encounter increases in territories marked with red skull-and-bones icons. Most guides know these territories well. Where undead are concerned, traveling by river is safer than traveling by land, both because undead are poor swimmers at best and because it's easier to pour on speed in canoes and escape across the water than to flee through tangled jungle.
zh_tw: 不死生物幾乎將人類文明從半島上擠出，除了幾個孤立的前哨站，那裡的楚爾特人及其盟友在牆後避難。地圖2.1顯示了不死生物最密集的地方。角色透過標有黑色骷髏和交叉骨圖示的領土時，很可能會有隨機的不死生物遭遇戰。在標有紅色骷髏和交叉骨圖示的領土，遭遇不死生物的可能性增加。大多數嚮導對這些領土非常熟悉。在涉及不死生物的問題上，透過河流旅行比透過陸地旅行更安全，因為不死生物最多是拙劣的游泳者，而且因為可以在獨木舟上快速加速並穿越水域逃離，比在錯綜複雜的叢林中逃跑更容易。

english: Locations in Chult
zh_tw: 楚爾特的地點

english: Map 2.1 depicts the Chultan peninsula with key locations marked. The same map appears on one side of the poster map. The remainder of this chapter describes these key locations, which are presented in alphabetical order for ease of reference.
zh_tw: 地圖2.1描繪了楚爾特半島，並標出了關鍵地點。相同的地圖出現在海報地圖的一側。本章其餘部分描述了這些關鍵地點，它們按字母順序排列，以便於參考。

english: If there's a particular site that you want the characters to discover and explore, you can move the site so that it falls along their path, and give it a new name if necessary. For example, the goblin village of Yellyark doesn't have to be in the location marked on your map. You can place it anywhere you want, or create another goblin village that has a similar configuration. Many other locations described in this chapter are just as adaptable. In addition to relocating a site, you can add or remove monsters and traps to make it harder or easier.
zh_tw: 如果您希望角色發現並探索特定的地點，您可以移動該地點，使其沿著他們的路徑，並在必要時給它一個新的名稱。例如，地精村莊葉利亞克不必位於地圖上標記的位置。您可以將它放置在任何您想要的地方，或者建立另一個具有類似配置的地精村莊。本章描述的許多其他地點同樣具有適應性。除了重新定位地點外，您還可以新增或移除怪物和陷阱，使其變得更難或更容易。

english: Aldani Basin
zh_tw: 阿爾達尼盆地

english: The Soshenstar and Tath rivers flow out of this marshy upland basin, which is a popular feeding ground for dinosaurs and swarms of biting insects. Tall plateaus and walls of dense foliage enclose the marsh.
zh_tw: 索申斯塔河和塔斯河從這片沼澤高地盆地流出，這裡是恐龍和成群的咬人昆蟲的熱門覓食地。高聳的高原和密集植被構成的牆壁環繞著這片沼澤。

english: The basin is named after the aldani, a race of lobsterfolk (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). Many Chultans recall childhood fables about the eerie lobsterfolk that lived in the rivers and lakes of their homeland. No reliable witnesses have reported an encounter with aldani in decades, so most Chultans believe the aldani perished. In fact, the lobsterfolk retreated to the secluded lakes of this basin, where they've kept hidden for a century.
zh_tw: 這個盆地以龍蝦人種族阿爾達尼命名（參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。許多楚爾特人還記得童年時關於那些生活在他們家鄉河流和湖泊中的詭異龍蝦人的傳說。幾十年來，沒有可靠的目擊者報告過與阿爾達尼的遭遇，因此大多數楚爾特人認為阿爾達尼已經滅絕。事實上，龍蝦人已經撤退到這個盆地的隱秘湖泊中，在那裡他們隱藏了整整一個世紀。

english: When the sky is clear, the Heart of Ubtao can be seen floating above the marsh from up to 50 miles distant (roll {@dice 1d4} each day to determine how many hexes away it's visible through the mist and heat haze). See "{@area Heart of Ubtao|10b|x}," for more information on this location.
zh_tw: 當天空晴朗時，從遠處50英里外也能看到烏塔歐之心漂浮在沼澤上（每天擲一個{@dice 1d4}來決定在霧氣和熱浪中能看到多少六邊形的距離）。關於這個地點的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 烏塔歐之心|10b|x}"。

english: Ataaz Kahakla
zh_tw: 阿塔茲·卡哈克拉

english: The river canyon called Ataaz Kahakla ("Gorge of Death") inspires wonder in most people who see it. The cliff walls, which vary from 50 to 200 feet high, are lined with row upon row of coral. It's all dead, but it retains its rainbow colors, making the canyon into a breathtaking, pseudo-underwater seascape. Mixed in among the corals are intact skeletons of plesiosaurs, giant sharks, and other sea creatures.
zh_tw: 被稱為阿塔茲·卡哈克拉（"死亡峽谷"）的河流峽谷在大多數看到它的人中激發了驚奇。懸崖壁從50到200尺不等，上面排列著一排排的珊瑚。它們都已經死亡，但仍然保持著彩虹般的色彩，使得峽谷變成了一個令人歎為觀止的偽水下海景。在珊瑚之間，還夾雜著完整的蛇頸龍、巨型鯊魚和其他海洋生物的骨骼。

english: Ataaz Muhahah
zh_tw: 阿塔茲·穆哈哈

english: Shown in map 2.2, Ataaz Muhahah ("Laughing Gorge") is a gaping chasm crossed by an ancient stone span called the Monkey Bridge. The structure got its name from the monkeys that perch on its walls and hang by their tails from its underside. The monkeys are a mix of living monkeys and ancient carvings that are part of the bridge. Most of the carvings have been damaged by time, but the skilled artistry remains apparent.
zh_tw: 如地圖2.2所示，阿塔茲·穆哈哈（'笑谷'）是一個巨大的裂谷，被一座古老的石橋所跨越，這座橋被稱為猴橋。這座結構之所以得名，是因為有猴子棲息在其牆壁上，並從其底部懸掛著尾巴。這些猴子是活生生的猴子和作為橋的一部分的古老鵰刻的混合體。大多數雕刻都已隨時間被損壞，但精湛的藝術工藝仍然顯而易見。

english: The living monkeys chatter and shriek continually, and the gorge echoes with the sound of their cries. Occasionally, the echoes from up and down the gorge overlap in a way that transforms the cacophony into haughty, gloating laughter. When that happens, the terrified monkeys fall silent for several minutes as the "laughter" dies away before resuming their chatter.
zh_tw: 活著的猴子不斷地喋喋不休和尖叫，峽谷中迴盪著它們的叫聲。偶爾，峽谷上下的回聲以一種方式疊加，將喧鬧聲變成傲慢、幸災樂禍的笑聲。當這種情況發生時，驚恐的猴子會沉默幾分鐘，直到"笑聲"消失，然後才繼續它們的喋喋不休。

english: Map 2.2: Ataaz Muhahah
zh_tw: 地圖2.2：阿塔茲·穆哈哈

english: Symbolic mazes are carved prominently onto the bridge and its supports. Any Chultan and most guides can confirm that maze symbols and the solving of mazes are associated with the ancient worship of Ubtao. A character can recall this information with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check.
zh_tw: 符號迷宮被醒目地雕刻在橋樑及其支撐結構上。任何楚爾特人和大多數嚮導都能確認，迷宮符號和迷宮的解謎與對烏布托的古老崇拜有關。角色可以透過一個成功的{@dc 20}智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定回憶起這一資訊。

english: Shrine of Ubtao
zh_tw: 烏布塔奧神廟

english: A stone shrine stands at the midpoint of the bridge. It consists of an imposing statue of a Chultan warrior wearing a war mask, hunkered down like a panther ready to pounce. Like the monkeys elsewhere on the bridge, the carving is highly stylized. Bright gems flash in its eye sockets.
zh_tw: 一座石頭神殿位於橋的中點。它由一個莊重的楚爾特戰士雕像組成，他戴著戰爭面具，蹲伏著像一隻準備撲擊的豹子。像橋上其他地方的猴子一樣，雕刻非常風格化。明亮的寶石在它的眼窩中閃爍。

english: A human skeleton lies crumpled near the statue's feet. Several of its bones are obviously broken, but it's impossible tell whether these injuries happened while the person was alive or were caused by scavengers after death.
zh_tw: 一個人類骷髏蜷縮在雕像的腳邊。它的幾根骨頭明顯斷裂，但無法確定這些傷害是在人活著時發生的，還是死後被食腐動物造成的。

english: The statue is, in fact, a {@creature stone golem} created to defend the bridge against ancient invaders. It attacks anyone who desecrates it (including trying to remove its eye gems, which are purely decorative and worthless), who damages the bridge, or who passes the shrine without making the proper obeisance to Ubtao. The required homage involves placing a fingertip at the center of one of the bridge's mazelike carvings and tracing an unbroken path past the statue. Guides who are natives of Chult would know this. The symbolic labyrinths aren't terribly complex; the biggest difficulty comes from the lichens and moss growing over them. If these are cleared away with a knife or other tool before tracing the maze, it can be traced properly with a successful {@dc 5} Intelligence check. If it's not cleaned first, the DC increases to 10. If it's cleaned by scraping with bare hands, the golem interprets that as tracing the maze incorrectly and attacks. Tracing the maze with a dagger or other tool counts as nothing; it must be done with a finger.
zh_tw: 這座雕像實際上是用來防禦古時入侵者而創造的{@creature stone golem||石魔像}。它會攻擊任何褻瀆它的人（包括試圖移除它那純粹裝飾性且無價值的眼珠寶石的人）、破壞橋樑的人，或者經過神殿時未向烏布塔奧（烏塔歐）做出恰當敬禮的人。必要的敬禮包括將指尖放在橋樑上一個迷宮狀雕刻的中心，並沿著一條不間斷的路徑透過雕像。來自楚爾特（楚爾特）的本地嚮導會知道這一點。這些象徵性的迷宮並不非常複雜；最大的困難來自於覆蓋在上面的苔蘚和地衣。如果事先用刀或其他工具清理這些附著物，那麼只需透過一個成功的 {@dc 5}智力檢定，就可以正確地追蹤迷宮路徑。如果不先清理，難度等級（DC）將增加到10。如果用手直接刮擦清理，魔像會認為這是錯誤地追蹤迷宮路徑並發動攻擊。用匕首或其他工具追蹤迷宮路徑則毫無意義；必須用手指來完成。

english: If the golem has the opportunity in combat, it pushes enemies off the bridge. The golem is so heavy that it has advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to resist being pushed. It doesn't pursue enemies off the bridge unless they continue using ranged attacks or spells against it after retreating.
zh_tw: 如果石像魔在戰鬥中有機會，它會將敵人推下橋。石像魔非常重，因此在力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定上抵抗被推時具有優勢。除非敵人在撤退後繼續使用遠端攻擊或法術對其攻擊，否則它不會追擊敵人離開橋樑。

english: The skeleton lying at the statue's feet is all that remains of a human explorer killed by the golem. It has long since been picked clean.
zh_tw: 躺在雕像腳下的骷髏是被石像魔殺死的人類探險家留下的唯一遺骸。它早已被清理乾淨。

english: Bridge Gap
zh_tw: 橋面斷裂

english: Part of the bridge has fallen away, leaving a 20-foot gap. The stone at either edge looks crumbly and unsafe.
zh_tw: 橋的一部分已經坍塌，留下了一個20尺的缺口。兩邊的石頭看起來鬆散且不安全。

english: The 20-foot gap is too long for most characters to cross with a running jump. A jump from the high edge to the low edge, however, is effectively only 15 feet, while jumping from low to high is effectively 25 feet. Crumbling remains of the parapets shorten the distance by another 5 feet, but landing on one of those thin surfaces requires a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check; a jumper who fails that check slips off the stone and falls into the gorge (a 100-foot drop).
zh_tw: 對於大多數角色來說，20尺的缺口過寬，無法透過助跑跳躍跨越。然而，從高邊緣跳到低邊緣實際上只有15尺，而從低邊緣跳到高邊緣實際上需要25尺。破碎的城牆殘骸將距離縮短了額外的5尺，但成功降落在這些狹窄表面上需要透過一個 {@dc 13} 敏捷 ({@skill Acrobatics||體操}) 檢定；未透過檢定的跳躍者會從石頭上滑落，掉入深谷（100尺的落差）。

english: Hanging Vines
zh_tw: 懸掛藤蔓

english: Hundreds of vines hang below the bridge. Characters can cross the gorge under the bridge by moving hand-over-hand from vine to vine and swinging across the gap. This doesn't activate the stone golem at all, but it requires two successful ability checks: a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to scramble across the vines and swing across the gap without falling, and a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) to make the passage without setting off a panic in the monkeys that consider the vines their home. If the {@skill Animal Handling} check fails, the character is attacked by {@dice 1d4} {@creature Baboon||baboons}. The animals fight normally, but the character hanging in the vines has disadvantage on every attack roll and ability check while under attack.
zh_tw: 橋下懸掛著數百條藤蔓。角色可以透過手拉手從一條藤蔓移動到另一條藤蔓並蕩過峽谷的方式來穿越橋下的峽谷。這不會啟用石頭傀儡，但需要兩次成功的能力檢定：一次 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）或敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定以攀爬過藤蔓並蕩過峽谷而不墜落，以及一次 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸}）檢定以確保透過時不驚擾將藤蔓視為家園的猴子。如果 {@skill Animal Handling||馴獸} 檢定失敗，角色將受到 {@dice 1d4} 只 {@creature Baboon||狒狒} 的攻擊。這些動物會正常戰鬥，但掛在藤蔓上的角色在受到攻擊時，每次攻擊檢定和能力檢定都有劣勢。

english: Ataaz Yklwazi
zh_tw: 阿塔茲·伊庫瓦茲

english: Blades of black basalt thrust up from the floor of this deep, volcanic canyon to create a forest of sorts: one that can easily draw blood from unwary trekkers who brush against the ebon piles that are as sharp as the razor-edged weapons they're named after.
zh_tw: 黑色的玄武岩片從這個深邃的火山峽谷的地板上突起，形成了一種森林：這種森林可以輕易地從不小心觸碰到這些黑色石堆的旅行者身上劃出鮮血，這些石堆和它們被命名的剃刀邊緣武器一樣鋒利。

english: Ataaz Yklwazi ("Gorge of Blades") forms a gateway of sorts to the Valley of Lost Honor from the north. The valley is the domain of firenewts. They protect it by patrolling the gorge and ambushing any intruders they believe they're strong enough to defeat. A typical patrol consists of four {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} mounted on {@creature Giant Strider|VGM|giant striders} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for both creatures' statistics).
zh_tw: 阿塔茲·伊庫瓦茲（"刀刃峽谷"）從北方形成了通往失落榮譽谷的一種門戶。這個谷地是火蜥蜴的領地。它們透過巡邏峽谷並伏擊任何他們認為足夠強大可以擊敗的入侵者來保護它。一個典型的巡邏隊由四名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}組成，他們騎乘著{@creature Giant Strider|VGM|闊步鳥}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}，瞭解這兩種生物的具體數值）。

english: The gorge is also the favored hunting ground of a female {@creature young red dragon} named Tzindelor, dubbed Tinder by those who've seen her and survived. The treacherous terrain is littered with the charred skeletons of Tinder's victims. If the characters take a long rest in the gorge, they encounter the dragon at the end of their rest. For more information on Tinder, see "{@area Wyrmheart Mine|1af|x}."
zh_tw: 這座峽谷也是一條名為辛德洛爾的雌性{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}偏愛的獵場，那些曾見過她並倖存下來的人稱她為"提恩德"。險峻的地形上散落著提恩德的受害者焦黑的骨架。如果角色們在峽谷中進行了長休，他們會在休息結束時遭遇這條龍。有關提恩德的更多資訊，請參閱"{@area 龍心礦井|1af|x}"。

english: Bay of Chult
zh_tw: 楚爾特灣

english: Ships must pass through the Bay of Chult as they come and go from Port Nyanzaru or the beaches west of Fort Beluarian. The mouth of the bay is watched over by Aremag, a {@creature dragon turtle} with a blind, milky left eye and a piece of its shell missing. Aremag demands that ships toss treasure into the bay to appease it. Aremag then gathers up the loot and hides it in its lair, which no one has yet found.
zh_tw: 船隻必須透過楚爾特灣，從南扎路港或貝路利安堡西邊的海灘來來往往。灣口由阿瑞瑪格守護，它是一隻左眼瞎了、乳白色的，並且缺少一塊殼的{@creature dragon turtle||龍龜}。阿瑞瑪格要求船隻把財寶扔進海灣以安撫它。然後阿瑞瑪格收集這些戰利品，並將其藏在它的巢穴中，至今還沒有人找到過。

english: If the characters enter or leave the Bay of Chult by ship, Aremag appears:
zh_tw: 如果角色們乘船進入或離開楚爾特灣，阿瑞瑪格就會出現：

english: The sea ahead roils and churns, and waves crash over the bow of your ship, driven by saw-toothed hills rising from the heaving foam. Water streams off the rising crags like rivers crashing down a mountainside. At last the emerging island stops growing in size, although the sea around still tosses your ship like a drifting feather. Then a huge blast of steam erupts from the waves, and through the drifting, rainbow-crossed mist, you see an immense beak and a milky eye the size of a hogshead cask staring blindly in your direction. As the water calms, you also spot a dozen or more shark fins circling the ship.
zh_tw: 前方的海面翻滾洶湧，海浪在你們船頭破碎，被鋸齒狀的山丘從翻騰的泡沫中升起所推動。水流從升起的峭壁上傾瀉而下，就像山間河流的衝擊。最後，這個浮現的島嶼停止了增長，儘管周圍的海水仍然像飄動的羽毛一樣搖晃著你們的船。然後，一股巨大的蒸汽從波濤中噴發出來，透過飄動的、彩虹交錯的霧氣，你看到一個巨大的喙和一隻像酒桶一樣大小的乳白色眼睛盲目地朝你的方向凝視。隨著水面平靜下來，你還看到一群或更多鯊魚鰭在船周圍盤旋。

english: Aremag speaks first in Draconic; if no one answers intelligibly, it switches to Aquan.
zh_tw: 阿瑞瑪格首先用龍語說話；如果沒有人能聽懂地回答，它會改用水族語。

english: During the negotiation, the dragon turtle slowly circles the ship. At first, characters must continually circle the deck of the ship to maintain face-to-face contact with the creature, but eventually it creates an eddy that causes the sloop to revolve at a rate matching Aremag's motion. It should be obvious to everyone that the dragon turtle could easily sink the vessel.
zh_tw: 在談判過程中，龍龜慢慢地繞著船轉圈。起初，角色們必須不斷地在甲板上轉圈，以保持與這個生物面對面的接觸，但最終它製造了一個漩渦，使得小船以與阿瑞瑪格運動相匹配的速度旋轉。對每個人來說，龍龜很容易就能擊沉這艘船應該是顯而易見的。

english: Aremag demands tribute for safe passage but doesn't specify an amount. Those aboard must throw valuables into a sack, in view of Aremag, until the dragon turtle is satisfied with the offering. Aremag extorts a different amount from every vessel, depending on how rich it suspects the cargo to be and how greedy it feels at the moment. To determine the minimum value in gold pieces Aremag will accept, roll {@dice 2d4 × 50} gp. As each fresh offering is displayed and added to the sack, the dragon turtle roars "More!" until the total reaches or exceeds its minimum. If characters act ridiculous about this—adding only a pittance at a time, for example—Aremag impatiently blows a blast of steam breath above the ship and slaps the hull with its tail, causing everyone not below deck to make a successful {@dc 15} Strength or Dexterity saving throw or tumble overboard. The bay is full of {@creature Reef Shark||reef sharks}, and anyone who stays in the water more than 3 rounds is attacked by {@dice 1d4} of them.
zh_tw: 阿雷馬格要求貢品以確保安全透過，但未指定具體數量。船上的人必須在阿雷馬格的視線範圍內將貴重物品扔進一個袋子，直到這隻龍龜對貢品感到滿意。阿雷馬格會根據它懷疑船上貨物有多少以及它此刻的貪婪程度，向每艘船勒索不同的金額。要確定阿雷馬格會接受的最低金幣價值，擲骰子 {@dice 2d4 × 50} 金幣。每當新的貢品被展示並加入袋子時，龍龜會咆哮"再來！"，直到總價值達到或超過它的最低要求。如果角色們在這件事上表現得很荒謬——例如，每次只新增一點點——阿雷馬格會不耐煩地在船上方噴出一股蒸汽，並用尾巴拍打船體，導致所有不在甲板下的人必須成功進行一次 {@dc 15} 力量或敏捷豁免，否則會跌入海中。海灣裡充滿了 {@creature Reef Shark||礁鯊}，任何在水裡停留超過 3 輪的人都會被 {@dice 1d4} 只礁鯊攻擊。

english: Some negotiation is possible. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check can persuade Aremag that the passengers have no more to give, provided they've placed at least 50 gp of value into the sack. Only one character can make the check; others can aid, if they contribute a convincingly pitiable plea to the argument. The check is made with disadvantage if the sack contains less than 100 gp in value, or with advantage if the sack contains 150 gp or more. Every time this check is tried and failed, Aremag reacts as described above, as if characters were adding only a few gold pieces at a time.
zh_tw: 可以進行一些談判。如果乘客們已經在袋子裡放入了至少50 gp的財物，一個成功的{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定可以說服阿雷瑪格（阿瑞瑪格）這些乘客已經無物可給了。只有一名角色可以進行此檢定；其他角色如果能為辯論貢獻一個令人信服的可憐懇求，可以協助檢定。如果袋子裡的財物價值少於100 gp，檢定將處於劣勢；如果袋子裡有150 gp或更多的財物，檢定將處於優勢。每次嘗試此檢定並失敗時，阿雷瑪格都會如上所述作出反應，就像角色們每次只新增了幾枚金幣一樣。

english: When the offering is sufficient, Aremag announces "Heave it over!" The bag can be tossed onto Aremag's craggy back, into his mouth, or directly into the water. The dragon turtle submerges without further talk, causing the ship to pitch and roll violently until the sea calms down. Characters can watch the enormous disk of its shell swimming down into the clear water of the bay until it disappears in the lightless depths.
zh_tw: 當供品足夠時，阿瑞瑪格宣佈"把它扔過來！"袋子可以扔到阿瑞瑪格崎嶇的背上，扔進他的嘴裡，或者直接扔進水裡。龍龜不再多說，潛入水中，使船劇烈地顛簸和翻滾，直到海面平靜下來。角色們可以看到它那巨大的殼盤在海灣清澈的水中游動，直到它消失在無光的深處。

english: Camp Righteous
zh_tw: 正義營地

english: You come upon an abandoned riverside camp strewn with wreckage. The tents are moldy and tattered, and all the permanent structures appear to have burned to the ground. Two intact rowboats are tied off to a short dock. North of the camp is a ridge, built into which is an 80-foot-tall stone statue carved to look like a man with a crocodile on his back. Between the statue's feet is a stone archway leading to a dark tunnel. To the left of the statue is a crude animal pen with a small, panicked bird running around inside it. There are no other signs of life.
zh_tw: 你來到了一個廢棄的河邊營地，到處都是殘骸。帳篷發黴破爛，所有永久性建築似乎都被燒成了平地。兩艘完好的划艇系在一個小碼頭上。營地北面是一條山脊，上面建有一尊80尺高的石雕，雕刻成一個背上有鱷魚的男人。雕像的腳之間有一個石拱門，通往一個黑暗的隧道。雕像左邊是一個簡陋的動物圍欄，裡面有一隻小而驚慌的鳥在裡面跑來跑去。沒有其他生命跡象。

english: When the Order of the Gauntlet first brought its war against undead to Chult, its members established this base camp (map 2.3) around an ancient Chultan shrine, which local guides call the House of the Crocodile. The shrine wasn't the focus of the order's activity, but it was an object of intense curiosity. Despite being in ruins, the shrine's traps were still active, and they overcame the order's attempts to reach the heart of the shrine.
zh_tw: 當鐵手套教團首次將其對抗不死生物的戰爭帶到楚爾特時，其成員圍繞一個古老的楚爾特神殿（地圖2.3）建立了這個基地營地，當地嚮導稱其為鱷魚之家。神殿並不是騎士團活動的焦點，但它是一個極度好奇的物件。儘管已經成為廢墟，神殿的陷阱仍然活躍，它們克服了騎士團試圖到達神殿核心的嘗試。

english: The overconfident visitors neglected to build defenses around the camp, believing that their own strong arms were sufficient protection. A couple months ago, they were proved tragically wrong when hundreds of undead swarmed out of the jungle and overran the camp. Only a handful of warriors escaped from that slaughter. No bodies remain in the camp; the remains of everyone who died defending it have either been buried by the second wave of templars (now at Camp Vengeance) or dragged away by jungle scavengers.
zh_tw: 過於自信的訪客忽視了在營地周圍建造防禦措施，他們相信他們自己強大的臂膀就足以提供保護。幾個月前，當數百個不死生物從叢林中湧出並淹沒了營地時，他們悲劇性地錯了。只有少數戰士從那次屠殺中逃脫。營地裡沒有留下屍體；所有為保衛營地而死的人的遺體要麼已經被第二波聖騎士（現在在復仇營地）埋葬，要麼被叢林的食腐動物拖走了。

english: When characters arrive, the camp is being watched by a party of Batiri goblins consisting of two {@creature Goblin||goblins} per player character. Leading the group is a {@creature goblin boss} named Yokka. The goblins wear wooden masks and hide in the foliage north of the camp. They believe the shrine is cursed, so they avoid it. However, Yokka had a vision of a treasure inside the shrine that could make him a great figure in his tribe, so he and his followers have spent the last tenday trying to work up the courage to tackle the shrine's traps. The arrival of adventurers is a great boon from Yokka's point of view. If they defeat the shrine's traps, he can simply take its treasure from them as they emerge. If they don't, they might at least weaken the shrine's defenses.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，營地正被一群巴提里地精監視，每名玩家角色對應兩名{@creature Goblin||地精}。領導這個群體的是名叫尤卡的{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}。地精們戴著木製面具，藏在營地北部的樹葉中。他們認為神殿被詛咒了，所以他們避開它。然而，尤卡夢見了神殿裡的財寶，這可以使他在部落中成為偉大的人物，所以他和他的追隨者在過去的十天裡一直在努力鼓起勇氣去應對神殿的陷阱。從尤卡的角度來看，冒險者的到來是天大的好事。如果他們擊敗了神殿的陷阱，他就可以簡單地在他們出現時從他們那裡拿走財寶。如果他們沒有，他們至少可能會削弱神殿的防禦。

english: Yokka's band bedevils the party without revealing its presence until the final moment. For example, if no guard is left to watch over the party's boats, the goblins steal them or knock holes in their bottoms. If all the party members enter the shrine, the goblins set up an ambush outside. If all else fails, the goblins use horns and animal calls to draw the attention of nearby undead ({@dice 1d8} {@creature Zombie||zombies} and {@dice 1d8} {@creature Skeleton||skeletons}) or aggressive beasts (a hungry {@creature allosaurus} and {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Axe Beak||axe beaks}).
zh_tw: 尤卡的樂隊在不暴露自己存在的情況下困擾著派對，直到最後一刻。例如，如果沒有守衛留下來看守派對的船隻，地精就會偷走它們或在船底敲洞。如果所有派對成員進入神殿，地精就會在外面設定伏擊。如果其他方法都失敗了，地精會使用號角和動物叫聲來吸引附近不死生物（{@dice 1d8}個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}和{@dice 1d8}個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}）或攻擊性強的野獸（一隻飢餓的{@creature allosaurus||異特龍}和{@dice 1d4 + 1}個{@creature Axe Beak||斧嘴鳥}）的注意。

english: Map 2.3: Camp Righteous
zh_tw: 地圖 2.3: 正義營地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Command Tents
zh_tw: 1. 指揮帳篷

english: Templars from the Order of the Gauntlet removed everything of value from these tents when they came to inspect the scene of the disaster. A character who pokes around in one of these tents has a 1-in-6 chance of stirring up a {@creature poisonous snake}.
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團的聖殿騎士前來勘查災難現場時，已帶走這些帳篷裡所有值錢的物品。角色在其中一頂帳篷裡翻找時，有六分之一的機率驚動一條{@creature poisonous snake||毒蛇}。

english: 2. Soldiers' Tents
zh_tw: 2. 士兵帳篷

english: All the tents are ruined one way or another. Most were slashed by claws or weapons during the fight, and all the canvas is at the point of disintegration from mildew and jungle rot.
zh_tw: 所有的帳篷都以某種方式被毀壞了。大多數在戰鬥中被爪子或武器撕裂，所有的帆布都因黴變和叢林腐爛而處於解體的邊緣。

english: 3. Burned-Out Shrine
zh_tw: 3. 燒燬的神龕

english: During the battle, overturned lamps started fires in the templars' partially built shrine, setting ablaze the stockpile of material that was meant to become permanent barracks. All that remains is a burnt-out ruin.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，翻倒的油燈在聖騎士們部分建成的神殿中引發了火災，點燃了本應成為永久性營房的物資儲備。現在只剩下一片燒燬的廢墟。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A silver holy symbol of Torm (25 gp) still hangs by a leather thong from a peg on the shrine wall, overlooked until now.
zh_tw: 一個託姆的銀色聖徽（價值25金幣）仍然掛在神殿牆上的一個釘子上，用皮繩掛著，直到現在才被發現。

english: 4. Animal Pens
zh_tw: 4. 動物圍欄

english: The templars kept swine in this pen for food. They're long gone, but a fledgling {@creature axe beak} with 6 hit points and no effective attacks (0 XP) has gotten itself trapped inside the enclosure. If characters leave it alone or set it loose, it causes no problems. If they attack or harass the bird, its squawks attract five adult {@creature Axe Beak||axe beaks}, which crash out of the jungle 2 rounds later, ready to fight whatever they meet.
zh_tw: 聖騎士們在這個圍欄裡飼養豬作為食物。豬早已不見了，但一隻幼小的{@creature axe beak||斧嘴鳥}，有6點生命值且沒有有效的攻擊（0經驗值）被困在了圍欄裡。如果角色們不打擾它或放它自由，它不會帶來任何問題。如果他們攻擊或騷擾這隻鳥，它的尖叫聲會吸引五隻成年的{@creature Axe Beak||斧嘴鳥}，在兩輪後從叢林中衝出來，準備攻擊它們遇到的任何東西。

english: 5. Latrines
zh_tw: 5. 廁所

english: During the attack on the camp, one templar's courage failed him, and he hid from the undead by climbing down into the southernmost latrine. He survived the attack but couldn't climb out of the reeking pit by himself, and he died of thirst within days.
zh_tw: 在對營地的攻擊中，一名聖騎士的勇氣失敗了，他為了躲避不死生物而爬進了最南邊的廁所。他雖然在攻擊中倖存下來，但無法獨自爬出這個惡臭的坑，幾天內因口渴而死亡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search the dead templar find a suit of scale mail (ruined), a warhammer, and a pouch containing five assorted gemstones (10 gp each).
zh_tw: 搜尋死去的聖騎士的角色會發現一套鱗甲（已毀），一把戰錘，以及一個袋子，裡面裝有五顆各式各樣的寶石（每顆價值10金幣）。

english: 6. House of the Man and Crocodile
zh_tw: 6. 人與鱷魚之屋

english: This shrine was built centuries ago by Chultans. Carved into a stony hillside, its entrance lies between the feet of an 80-foot-high stone statue depicting a man carrying a crocodile on his back. Any Chultan can identify this as a figure from local mythology and can recall the story for the characters. If characters ask a Chultan what the statue signifies, read:
zh_tw: 這個神殿是幾個世紀前由楚爾特人建造的。它被雕刻進一個石質山坡，入口位於一個80尺高的石雕的腳之間，這個石雕描繪了一個背上馱著鱷魚的男人。任何楚爾特人都能認出這是來自當地神話的人物，並且可以為角色們回憶起這個故事。如果角色們問一個楚爾特人這尊雕像代表什麼，請閱讀：

english: In the early days of the world, Man stood by the banks of a river, frightened. Crocodile raised his head from the water and asked, "What troubles you, cousin Man?"
zh_tw: 在世界之初，人類站在河邊，感到害怕。鱷魚從水中抬起頭問道：'是什麼困擾著你，表親人類？'

english: Man said, "I must cross this river, but I fear to enter the water alone, because it teems with your brethren."
zh_tw: 人類說：'我必須過這條河，但我害怕獨自進入水中，因為裡面充滿了你們的同類。'

english: Crocodile replied, "It's true, you would not be safe. But I will carry you across the river safely on my back, if you promise to return the favor." Man agreed, and Crocodile bore him safely across the water
zh_tw: 鱷魚回答說：'確實，你不會安全。但如果你能承諾回報這個恩情，我會揹著你安全地過河。' 人類同意了，鱷魚安全地把他背過了水。

english: When they reached the far bank, Man asked, "How can I repay you?" Crocodile replied, "I wish to see the realm of Humans, but I fear to go there alone, because it teems with your brethren. You must carry me on your back across your realm." Man had been tricked, but a promise is a promise, so he carried Crocodile safely on his back across the entire realm of humans, a journey that lasted many years. He also swore, in his anger, that never again would Men and Crocodiles be friends, and so it has remained to this day.
zh_tw: 當他們到達對岸時，人類問道：'我該如何報答你？' 鱷魚回答說：'我想看看人類的領域，但我害怕獨自前往，因為那裡充滿了你們的同類。你必須揹著我穿過你們的領域。' 人類被欺騙了，但承諾就是承諾，所以他揹著鱷魚安全地穿過了整個人類的領域，這次旅行持續了許多年。他還發誓，出於憤怒，人類和鱷魚再也不會成為朋友，從那時起一直如此。

english: This tale is a hint that can get characters safely past the traps in the shrine.
zh_tw: 這個故事是一個提示，可以幫助角色安全地透過神殿中的陷阱。

english: Man and Crocodile
zh_tw: 人類與鱷魚

english: None of the traps in the shrine will be triggered by two characters who are imitating Man and Crocodile, with one riding on the other's shoulders. Those characters can still be injured by a trap that's triggered by someone else; they just won't trigger it themselves. Navigating the shrine is difficult, however, for a two-person piggyback team. There's a recurring danger that they'll lose their balance or the rider will fall off. Any moment when they're not carrying or riding one another, they risk setting off traps like anyone else. If the rider is at least one size category smaller than the carrier, the carrier makes requisite Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws with advantage.
zh_tw: 如果兩個角色模仿人類與鱷魚，其中一個騎在另一個的肩膀上，神殿中的陷阱都不會被觸發。那些角色仍然可能因為其他人觸發的陷阱而受傷；他們只是不會自己觸發陷阱。然而，對於一個兩人的馱載團隊來說，導航神殿是困難的。他們不斷面臨著失去平衡或騎手掉下來的危險。任何時候，如果他們不互相馱載或騎行，他們就有像其他人一樣觸發陷阱的風險。如果騎手至少比馱載者小一個尺寸類別，馱載者在進行必要的力量和敏捷檢定以及豁免檢定時具有優勢。

english: Ledges
zh_tw: 巖架

english: In a few places, the floor of the shrine rises 7 feet, forming a ledge. No check is needed to climb a ledge solo, but the ledge's height makes it difficult to see what lies ahead. A rider/carrier team probably is tall enough to see over a ledge, but to climb it, the carrier must make a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check; the rider can aid this check. If the check fails by 5 or more, both of them sprawl to the lower floor and, for 1 round at least, they're just two individuals, not a rider and a carrier. If the check fails by less than 5, they tumble forward onto the upper terrace, sprawl apart, and probably set off whatever trap is on that level.
zh_tw: 在一些地方，神殿的地面升高了7尺，形成了一個巖架。單獨攀爬巖架不需要進行檢定，但巖架的高度使得很難看清前方的情況。一個騎手/載具組合可能足夠高以看到巖架上方，但若要攀爬它，載具必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定；騎手可以協助這個檢定。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，他們雙雙摔落到較低的地面，並且在至少1輪內，他們只是兩個獨立的個體，不再是騎手和載具。如果檢定失敗但差值小於5，他們向前翻滾到上層平臺，分開摔倒，並可能會觸發該層級的任何陷阱。

english: Spotting Traps
zh_tw: 發現陷阱

english: Unless indicated otherwise, a trap can be spotted with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. It's best if just one character makes this check, and only the first check counts, no matter how many times the search is attempted. If players insist on having everyone crowd in and search for traps, goblins might steal the party's canoes or rig traps of their own.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，陷阱可以透過成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現。最好只有一個角色進行此檢定，無論嘗試搜尋多少次，只有第一次檢定有效。如果玩家堅持讓所有人都擠進來搜尋陷阱，哥布林可能會偷走隊伍的獨木舟或設定他們自己的陷阱。

english: 6A. Concealed Pit Trap
zh_tw: 6A. 隱藏的坑陷阱

english: The ceiling here is 23 feet high and draped with cobwebs, and the stone-tiled floor is covered with a thick layer of mud, creepers, and blown-in leaves, so attempts to spot this pit trap are made with disadvantage. An individual who crosses this section of floor has a {@chance 50} chance of triggering the trapdoor and dropping into the 20-foot-deep pit, taking damage from the fall as normal.
zh_tw: 此處天花板高23尺，懸掛著蛛網，石磚地面上覆蓋著厚厚的泥漿、藤蔓和被風吹入的落葉，因此察覺此陷坑的嘗試將承受劣勢。任何經過該地段的個體有{@chance 50}機率觸發活板門，墜入20尺深的陷坑，如常承受墜落傷害。

english: Once the pit opens, a narrow ledge remains around the outside edge. The ledge can be traversed safely with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, but a character with someone riding on his or her shoulders makes the check with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 一旦陷坑開啟，外邊緣會留下一個狹窄的巖架。透過一個成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定，可以安全地穿越這個巖架，但如果角色肩上載有他人，則進行檢定時會受到劣勢影響。

english: 6B. Blade Trap
zh_tw: 6B. 刀刃陷阱

english: The ceiling here is 23 feet high and draped with cobwebs. Each individual that passes through this section of the corridor has a {@chance 50} chance of triggering scything blades that sweep out from concealed wall niches. Any creature in the 10-foot-square section of hall between the blades must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once identified, the trap can be jammed by hammering spikes or metal blades into the niches and succeeding on four separate {@dc 10} Strength checks (to hammer in the metal solidly enough). Each successful check jams one scythe and reduces the trap's damage by {@dice 1d8}.
zh_tw: 此處天花板高23尺，佈滿蛛網。每個經過走廊該區域的個體都有{@chance 50}機率觸發從隱蔽壁龕掃出的鐮刃。處於兩片刀刃之間10尺方形區域內的生物必須進行{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，失敗將受到18（{@dice 4d8}）點揮砍傷害，成功則減半。陷阱被識別後，可透過向壁龕釘入尖刺或金屬刃片並透過四次獨立的{@dc 10}力量檢定（確保金屬牢固嵌入）來卡住機關。每次成功檢定可卡住一片鐮刃，並使陷阱傷害減少{@dice 1d8}。

english: 6C. Puzzle Floor
zh_tw: 6C. 謎題地板

english: To reach this section of hall, characters must climb a 7-foot-high ledge (see "Ledges" above). The area north of the ledge forms a 16-foot-high terrace, the floor of which is tiled in a four-by-four pattern of squares. There's just enough room for a person to stand at the top of the ledge without stepping on the tiles, but beyond that, the pattern covers the floor from wall to wall, clear back to another 7-foot-high ledge that separates this section of hall from area 6D. The wooden door at area 6D has a similar four-by-four pattern carved into it. A character atop someone else's shoulders can see the entire pattern, but a person of normal height can't see the bottom row of the pattern on the door—and that's unfortunate, because one square of that bottom row on the door glows faintly (roll a {@dice d4} to determine which square it is). Even if someone can see that area of the door, the glow is so faint that a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check is needed to notice it.
zh_tw: 要到達大廳的這一部分，角色們必須攀爬一個7尺高的壁架（見上文的"壁架"）。壁架北面的區域形成了一個16尺高的平臺，平臺的地面由四乘四的方格圖案組成。壁架頂部剛好有足夠的空間讓一個人站立而不會踩到地磚，但除此之外，這個圖案從牆到牆完全覆蓋了地板，一直延伸到另一個7尺高的壁架，這個壁架將大廳的這一部分與區域6D隔開。區域6D的木門上雕刻著類似的四乘四圖案。站在別人肩膀上的角色可以看到整個圖案，但身高正常的人無法看到門底部的一行圖案——這很不幸，因為門上底部一行的一個方格會發出微弱的光芒（擲一個 {@dice d4} 來決定是哪個方格）。即使有人能看到門的那一區域，光芒也非常微弱，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能注意到它。

english: The pattern on the door corresponds to the pattern on the floor, with the bottom door row matching to the floor row closest to the characters. If an individual applies more than a few pounds of pressure to any square except the one corresponding to the lit-up square on the door, magical flames blast out from the walls. Every creature on the terrace when the flames appear must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the correct tile is stepped on or depressed, no flames are triggered and a square in the second row on the door lights up—again very faintly. As characters advance across the floor tiles, the ledge blocks more and more of the pattern on the door, always making it hard for characters to see which square is lit unless they are riding on the shoulders of a companion.
zh_tw: 門上的圖案與地板上的圖案相對應，門底部的行與最接近角色們的地板行相匹配。如果任何人對除了與門上亮起方塊相對應的方塊之外的任何方塊施加超過幾磅的壓力，魔法的火焰就會從牆壁中噴出。當火焰出現時，露臺上的每個生物都必須進行一個 {@dc 13} 的敏捷豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）點火焰傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。如果踩下或按壓正確的方塊，則不會觸發火焰，並且門第二行的一個方塊會亮起——再次非常微弱。隨著角色們在地板方塊上前進，壁架逐漸遮擋門上的圖案，使得角色們難以看清哪個方塊亮起，除非他們騎在同伴的肩膀上。

english: The tiled pattern on the floor can be crossed safely by stepping only on the squares that light up on the door, or by a two-person rider/carrier team. Putting pressure on any other square triggers the flames. This trigger and trap are magical, so they can't be disarmed or jammed mechanically. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on the floor tiles disables the trap for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 透過只踩在門上發光的方塊，或者由兩名角色組成的騎手/馱載者團隊，可以安全地穿過地板上的圖案。對任何其他方塊施加壓力都會觸發火焰。這個觸發器和陷阱是魔法的，所以它們不能透過機械方式被解除或卡住。對地板瓷磚施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術可以使陷阱在1小時內失效。

english: 6D. Puzzle Door
zh_tw: 6D. 謎題門

english: To reach this door, characters must climb another 7-foot-high ledge, above which the ceiling is 9 feet high. A wooden door at the back of the ledge has no apparent handle or latch. To open it, the four lit-up squares must be touched, in order from bottom to top, by a rider/carrier team emulating Man and Crocodile. The bottom two squares must be touched by the carrier and the top two by the rider. If the squares are pressed correctly, the door swings open into area 6E. If wrong squares are pressed, the squares are pressed in the wrong order, or they're pressed by the wrong people, a {@spell glyph of warding} on the door triggers a {@spell thunderwave} spell. Finding the glyph requires a thorough search of the door and a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Every creature on the ledge when the spell triggers must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) thunder damage, is pushed 10 feet away from the door, and falls into area 6C, setting off the trap there. A creature that succeeds on the save takes half damage and is not pushed.
zh_tw: 要到達這扇門，角色們必須爬上另一個7尺高的巖架，巖架上方天花板高9尺。巖架後部的一扇木門沒有明顯的門把手或門閂。要開啟它，必須模仿"人與鱷魚"的騎手/載具團隊從下到上依次觸控四個亮起的方塊。底部兩個方塊必須由載具觸控，頂部兩個由騎手觸控。如果方塊被正確按下，門將向內擺動進入區域6E。如果按錯了方塊、按方塊的順序錯誤，或由錯誤的人按下，門上的一個{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}將觸發一個{@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}法術。發現法陣需要對門進行徹底的搜尋，併成功透過一個{@dc 13} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定。當法陣觸發時，巖架上的每個生物都必須進行一個{@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定。如果豁免失敗，生物將受到9點（{@dice 2d8}）雷鳴傷害，被推離門10尺，並墜入區域6C，觸發那裡的陷阱。如果豁免成功，生物受到一半傷害且不會被推開。

english: 6E. Treasury
zh_tw: 6E. 寶庫

english: The floor of this dusty, 40-foot-high, 20-foot-wide chamber is littered with dinosaur bones. Webs stretch from the walls to a 30-foot-tall central pillar, coiled around which is a narrow stone staircase, its steps covered with dust. Carved into the pillar are reliefs of a man carrying a crocodile. The reliefs follow the stairs to the top of the pillar, on which sits a large, beautiful, ceramic jug.
zh_tw: 這個佈滿灰塵的房間高40尺，寬20尺，地面上散落著恐龍骨頭。蛛網從牆壁延伸到一個30尺高的中央支柱，圍繞著支柱的是一條狹窄的石質樓梯，臺階上覆蓋著灰塵。支柱上雕刻著一個揹著鱷魚的男人的浮雕。這些浮雕沿著樓梯一直延伸到支柱頂部，那裡放著一個大型的、美麗的陶瓷壺。

english: The staircase that spirals around the pillar is 2 feet wide, and each step is 1 foot higher than the one below it. Whenever a character who is carrying another character starts his or her turn on the staircase, both the rider and the carrier must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. If both checks fail, the rider and carrier fall. Otherwise, the team maintains its balance.
zh_tw: 環繞柱子的螺旋樓梯寬2尺，每級臺階比下一級高1尺。每當攜帶另一個角色的角色在樓梯上開始其回合時，被攜帶者和攜帶者都必須進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。如果兩者檢定都失敗，被攜帶者和攜帶者都會跌落。否則，團隊保持平衡。

english: Trapped Steps
zh_tw: 觸發陷阱的臺階

english: There are thirty steps in total. Each of steps 3, 10, 17, and 23 has a {@spell glyph of warding} spell placed on it, set to trigger when the step is walked on. Creatures emulating Man and Crocodile don't trigger the glyphs. Each triggered glyph releases a 20-foot-radius sphere of lightning centered on the step. Every creature in the area must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures emulating Man and Crocodile have disadvantage on the saving throw. To spot a glyph, the dust on the step must be cleared away, and a character searching the step must succeed on a {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 總共有三十級臺階。第3、10、17和23級臺階上各有一個{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術，當踩踏臺階時會觸發。模仿"人"與"鱷魚"的生物不會觸發刻文。每個觸發的刻文會釋放一個以臺階為中心的20尺半徑的閃電球。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到22點（{@dice 5d8}）閃電傷害，豁免成功則只受一半傷害。模仿"人"與"鱷魚"的生物在進行豁免時具有劣勢。要發現刻文，必須先清除臺階上的灰塵，並且搜尋臺階的角色必須透過一次{@dc 13}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The jug is an {@item alchemy jug}, placed here ages ago by Chultans who revered it as a gift from Ubtao. The only safe way to pick up the {@item alchemy jug} is to emulate Man and Crocodile. Either member of a rider/carrier team can pick up the jug safely and carry it out of the room. If the jug is picked up by anyone else, loose bricks begin to fall from the ceiling. Every creature in area 6E is struck by falling bricks and must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that starts its turn in the room repeats the saving throw. After 3 rounds, the bricks stop falling.
zh_tw: 這個壺是一個{@item alchemy jug||鍊金壺}，很久以前被崇拜它作為烏伯託禮物的楚爾特人放置在這裡。唯一安全拿起{@item alchemy jug||鍊金壺}的方法是模仿人與鱷魚的動作。在騎手/搬運者的團隊中，任何一個成員都可以安全地拿起壺並將其帶出房間。如果壺被其他人拿起，鬆動的磚塊開始從天花板上掉下。區域6E中的每個生物都會被掉落的磚塊擊中，並且必須進行一個{@dc 13}的敏捷豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）鈍擊傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。在房間內開始其回合的生物需重複進行豁免檢定。3輪後，磚塊停止掉落。

english: A rider/carrier team trying to descend the stairs while carrying the {@item alchemy jug} makes Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks with disadvantage unless the jug is placed in a backpack, or slung in a sack or some other hands-free carrier.
zh_tw: 一個騎手/馱載者團隊在攜帶{@item alchemy jug||鍊金壺}（鍊金術壺）嘗試下樓梯時，進行敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定會處於不利狀態，除非該壺被放置在揹包中，或者懸掛在袋子或其他無需手持的容器中。

english: Camp Vengeance
zh_tw: 復仇營地

english: Through the foliage, you see a crude timber fortification—a walled compound with watchtowers and tents inside it, encircled by a ditch bristling with sharpened stakes. A large gatehouse faces the river, on the shore of which are four rowboats tied to a wooden post.
zh_tw: 透過植被，你看到一個簡陋的木製防禦工事——一個有瞭望塔和帳篷的圍牆圍成的院子，周圍是佈滿鋒利木樁的壕溝。一個大型的門樓面向河流，河邊有一個木樁上繫著四艘划艇。

english: Scattered around the fort are piles of charred human corpses and flayed animal carcasses swarming with flies.
zh_tw: 要塞周圍散落著燒焦的人類屍體堆和剝皮的動物屍體，上面爬滿了蒼蠅。

english: The corpses around the fort (map 2.4) are the remains of beasts and undead that attacked the camp. The camp dwellers took meat off the dead dinosaurs and other beasts to feed themselves, leaving the rest to rot.
zh_tw: 要塞周圍的屍體（地圖2.4）是攻擊營地的野獸和不死生物的殘骸。營地居民從死去的恐龍和其他野獸身上取下肉來養活自己，剩下的則任其腐爛。

english: A handful of warriors of the Order of the Gauntlet escaped the undead onslaught against Camp Righteous by retreating up the River Soshenstar toward the Aldani Basin. Three days later, they ended their retreat by digging in on this spot. Eventually they got word of their situation back to Port Nyanzaru, and they've since been reinforced. Their original, small camp has been transformed into a fortified base far more capable of withstanding attack than Camp Righteous ever was.
zh_tw: 少數鐵手套教團的戰士透過向索申斯塔河上游撤退至阿爾達尼盆地，從而逃離了對正義營地的不死生物攻擊。三天後，他們在這個地方結束了撤退。最終，他們將他們的情況傳回了南扎路港，並且從此得到了增援。他們原本的小營地已經轉變成了一個設防的基地，比正義營地更能抵禦攻擊。

english: That's not to say the camp is a hale and healthy place. Unwholesome vapors and clouds of insects descend on it from the pestilential Aldani Basin lying only a few miles to the south. The knights stationed here are disease-ridden and exhausted from their constant battles against giant jungle carnivores by day and undead horrors by night.
zh_tw: 這並不是說營地是一個健康的地方。來自僅幾英里外南部的瘟疫之地阿爾達尼盆地的不健康蒸汽和昆蟲雲層籠罩著它。駐紮在這裡的騎士們飽受疾病困擾，並且由於白天與巨大叢林食肉動物的持續戰鬥以及夜間與不死生物恐怖的戰鬥而筋疲力盡。

english: The templar in charge is a devout worshiper of Tyr named {@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA} (LG male Chondathan human {@creature noble}), a man who's dedicated to everything the Order of the Gauntlet represents but poorly suited to commanding a post like Camp Vengeance. Aside from Commander Breakbone, the standard garrison at the base consists of fifty-eight people, though the actual number of effective warriors at any given time is usually lower due to sickness. Breakbone has two captains under his command: Ord Firebeard (LG male gold dwarf {@creature veteran}) and Perne Salhana (LG female Tethyrian human {@creature veteran}). Reporting to them is a fighting force comprised of eight {@creature Veteran||veterans} and twenty-four {@creature Guard||guards}. This is supplemented by a religious corps of six {@creature Acolyte||acolytes} led by Sister Cyas (LG female Chondathan human {@creature priest} of Helm). Technically, the religious templars are part of the fighting force, but in practice, they spend most of their time tending the sick and wounded. Finally, the fort is supported by a ragtag troop of Chultan hunters and scouts consisting of fifteen {@creature Tribal Warrior||tribal warriors} led by Lorsa Bilwatal (CN female Chultan human {@creature scout}) and {@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA}'s longtime friend, Wulf Rygor (CG male half-elf {@creature scout}).
zh_tw: 負責的聖騎士是一個虔誠崇拜提爾的信徒，名叫{@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA|奈爾斯·斷骨}（守序善良男性瓊達斯人人類{@creature noble||貴族}），一個致力於鐵手套教團所代表的一切的人，但並不適合指揮像復仇營地這樣的駐地。除了指揮官斷骨之外，基地的標準守備部隊由五十八人組成，但由於疾病，任何時候實際有效的戰士人數通常較少。斷骨手下有兩個隊長：奧德·火鬚（守序善良男性金矮人{@creature veteran||老兵}）和佩爾恩·薩爾哈娜（守序善良女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）。向他們彙報的是一支由八名{@creature Veteran||老兵}和二十四名{@creature Guard||警衛}組成的戰鬥力量。此外，還有由西雅絲修女（守序善良女性瓊達斯人人類海姆的{@creature priest||祭司}）領導的六名{@creature Acolyte||侍僧}組成的宗教團體。從技術上講，宗教聖騎士是戰鬥力量的一部分，但實際上，他們大部分時間都在照料病人和傷員。最後，堡壘得到了由楚爾特獵人和偵察兵組成的雜牌軍的支援，包括由洛爾莎·比爾瓦塔爾（中立女性楚爾特人類{@creature Tribal Warrior||部族武者}）和{@creature Niles Breakbone|ToA|奈爾斯·斷骨}的老朋友伍爾夫·瑞戈爾（混亂善良男性半精靈{@creature scout||斥侯}）領導的十五名{@creature scout||斥侯}。

english: Map 2.4: Camp Vengeance
zh_tw: 地圖 2.4: 復仇營地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Boats
zh_tw: 1. 船隻

english: Although the camp gets much of its food by hunting, it depends entirely on rowboats and canoes coming up the River Soshenstar to bring replacement soldiers, armor, weapons, arrows and bolts, medicine, tents, cots, boots, clothing, and just about everything else. After the disaster at Camp Righteous, Commander Breakbone would like to have enough boats on hand to carry most, if not all, of the garrison to safety in case the camp is overrun. That's seldom the case.
zh_tw: 儘管營地透過狩獵獲得大部分食物，但它完全依賴於透過索申斯塔河上游的划艇和獨木舟運送替換士兵、盔甲、武器、箭和弩箭、藥品、帳篷、床鋪、靴子、服裝以及幾乎所有其他物資。在正義營地的災難之後，斷骨指揮官希望有足夠的船隻來運送大部分，如果不是全部的話，守軍安全撤離，以防營地被淹沒。但這種情況很少出現。

english: 2. Gatehouse
zh_tw: 2. 門房

english: The camp is ringed by a 20-foot-deep ditch lined with sharpened stakes backed by a stout, 12-foot-high log palisade. The depth of the ditch isn't apparent because it's perpetually filled with muddy water. The spikes are too big to be effective against undead but they're dangerous to Large and Huge beasts. The gatehouse is heavy enough to withstand a charging triceratops, and the gates are never opened without an express command from one of the camp's top three officers.
zh_tw: 營地被一個20尺深的溝渠環繞，溝渠內佈滿了鋒利的木樁，後面是一堵堅固的、12尺高的原木柵欄。由於溝渠裡總是充滿了泥水，所以溝渠的深度並不明顯。這些尖刺對於不死生物來說太大了，無法有效，但對大型和巨型野獸來說卻很危險。門房足夠堅固，能夠抵禦一隻衝鋒的三角龍，而且沒有營地前三名官員的明確命令，大門永遠不會開啟。

english: The gatehouse consists of the ground-level entryway, an upper floor that serves as an armory (all of the garrison's spare weapons and armor are stored here because it's one of the few places that remains reliably dry), and a roofless fighting platform surrounded by a palisade that gives {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} against attacks made from the ground. Two {@creature Guard||guards} are stationed atop the gatehouse day and night.
zh_tw: 門樓由地面入口、作為軍械庫的上層（因為這裡是少數保持乾燥的地方之一，所以駐軍的備用武器和盔甲都存放在這裡）以及一個無頂的戰鬥平臺組成，平臺被木柵欄環繞，為來自地面的攻擊提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}日夜駐守在門樓頂部。

english: The rampart under the palisade impedes the camp's drainage. The entire compound is riddled with puddles and ankle-deep mud, which make it a breeding ground for mosquitoes and other vermin.
zh_tw: 柵欄下的護牆妨礙了營地的排水。整個院子到處都是水坑和沒腳踝的泥漿，這成為蚊子和其他害蟲的滋生地。

english: 3. Watchtowers
zh_tw: 3. 瞭望塔

english: Each watchtower has a defended top level (providing {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}) that looms above the camp palisade. A lower level consists of a wooden floor raised several feet above the ground and enclosed with a combination of thin wood and canvas to create a reasonably dry living space. Lorsa Bilwatal, Wulf Rygor, and their cadre of Chultan scouts have their quarters in these lower watchtower billets.
zh_tw: 每座瞭望塔都有一個防禦性的頂層（提供{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}），聳立在營地柵欄之上。較低的一層由一個離地數尺高的木地板組成，並用薄木板和帆布圍合，形成一個相對乾燥的生活空間。洛爾薩·比爾瓦塔爾、沃爾夫·萊戈以及他們的一群楚爾特偵察兵都駐紮在這些較低的瞭望塔營房中。

english: Theoretically, each watchtower is staffed by two {@creature Guard||guards} day and night, but personnel shortages sometimes reduce that to one guard or force the knights to take turns on watch.
zh_tw: 從理論上講，每個瞭望塔都有兩名{@creature Guard||警衛}晝夜守衛，但由於人員短缺，有時這會減少到一名守衛，或者迫使騎士們輪流值班。

english: 4. Animal Pen
zh_tw: 4. 動物圍欄

english: The knights built this pen for swine, but the camp proved too unhealthy for them and they all died. The current livestock consists of four sickly {@creature goat||goats}.
zh_tw: 騎士們為豬建造了這個圍欄，但營地環境對它們來說太不健康，它們全都死了。目前的牲畜包括四隻病弱的{@creature goat||山羊}。

english: 5. Field Hospital Tents
zh_tw: 5. 野戰醫院帳篷

english: These tents are filled with sick and dying soldiers of the Order. At any given time, each tent holds {@dice 2d6} patients suffering from a range of maladies. The acolytes tending the sick are themselves so ill and exhausted that they can't make effective use of their magic. Any help the characters provide is greatly appreciated, especially if they donate {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing} or other magic. If characters provide substantial medical aid, Sister Cyas becomes their staunch defender against Commander Breakbone's unreasonable demands.
zh_tw: 這些帳篷裡充滿了秩序的病弱和垂死的士兵。任何時候，每個帳篷都有{@dice 2d6}名患者，他們遭受著各種疾病的困擾。照顧病人的侍僧們自己也病得很重，精疲力盡，以至於他們無法有效地使用他們的魔法。角色們提供的任何幫助都會受到極大的歡迎，特別是如果他們捐贈了{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}或其他魔法物品。如果角色們提供了大量的醫療援助，西雅絲修女會成為他們對抗斷骨指揮官不合理要求的堅定捍衛者。

english: 6. Command Tent
zh_tw: 6. 指揮帳篷

english: Commander Breakbone understands war well enough when it involves battle lines, waving banners, trumpets, and supply trains, but this war of ambush and creeping through the jungle only mystifies and frustrates him. He spends most of his time in his command tent, poring over inaccurate maps and reviewing reports about the camp's supplies. His two immediate subordinates, Ord Firebeard and Perne Salhana, do a commendable job of managing the camp in the absence of effective leadership from Breakbone.
zh_tw: 斷骨指揮官在涉及戰鬥線、飄揚的旗幟、號角和補給列車的戰爭中理解得相當透徹，但這種涉及伏擊和悄悄穿過叢林的戰爭只會讓他感到困惑和沮喪。他大部分時間都待在他的指揮帳篷裡，仔細研究不準確的地圖並審查有關營地物資的報告。他的兩個直接下屬，奧德·火鬚和佩爾恩·薩爾哈娜，在缺乏斷骨有效領導的情況下，做得非常好，成功地管理著營地。

english: Commander Breakbone has two immediate problems. If characters arrived by boat, he needs them to carry messages and seven sick soldiers downriver to Port Nyanzaru. Each soldiers is suffering from blue mist fever, shivering sickness, or throat leeches (see "{@area Diseases|0a3|x}"). If characters arrived on foot, Breakbone insists that they lead a detachment of his soldiers (consisting of four {@creature Guard||guards} and four {@creature Tribal Warrior||tribal warriors}) on a two-week patrol back in the direction they came from; their orders are to destroy any undead they encounter. If either request is refused, Breakbone orders the characters arrested and tied hand and foot in separate guard towers, to await trial for insubordination during a military emergency. If they're found guilty, the penalty is to be stripped of all gear, tied to trees in the forest, and left for the carnivores or the undead.
zh_tw: 斷骨指揮官有兩個緊迫的問題。如果角色乘船到達，他需要他們將訊息和七名生病的士兵順流帶到南扎路港。每名士兵都患有藍霧熱、顫抖病或咽喉水蛭（見"{@area 疾病|0a3|x}"）。如果角色步行到達，斷骨堅持要求他們帶領他的士兵分遣隊（由四名{@creature Guard||警衛}和四名{@creature Tribal Warrior||部族武者}組成）進行為期兩週的巡邏，返回他們來時的方向；他們的命令是摧毀遇到的任何不死生物。如果任何請求被拒絕，斷骨下令逮捕角色，並將他們分別捆綁在不同的守衛塔中，等待因在軍事緊急情況下違抗命令而受審。如果他們被判有罪，懲罰是被剝奪所有裝備，綁在森林中的樹上，留給食肉動物或不死生物。

english: Sufficiently powerful characters might actually win a fight against the entire camp, but even if they do, they'll be marked for death by the Order of the Gauntlet wherever they go in Chult (and potentially elsewhere in the Realms). If characters escorted Undril Silvertusk to the camp and gained her respect (see "{@area Side Quests|031|x}"), she will intercede on their behalf and persuade Commander Breakbone to let the characters go. Otherwise, they'll need to win over both Ord and Perne with persuasive arguments to avoid Breakbone's judgment. Each of them can be swayed with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, but only if the character making the check has a sound case for leniency.
zh_tw: 如果角色足夠強大，他們確實有可能在與整個營地的戰鬥中獲勝，但即使他們贏了，無論他們在楚爾特（以及可能在其他領域中）走到哪裡，都會被鐵手套教團標記為死亡目標。如果角色護送昂德里爾·銀牙到營地並獲得她的尊重（見"{@area 支線任務|031|x}"），她會為他們說情，並說服指揮官斷骨讓他們離開。否則，他們需要以有說服力的論點贏得奧爾德和珀恩的支援，以避免斷骨的審判。每個人都能透過一次成功的{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定被說服，但前提是進行檢定的角色有充分的理由請求寬大處理。

english: 7. Soldiers' Tents
zh_tw: 7. 士兵帳篷

english: Each tent is intended to house four people in reasonable comfort. They have log floors to keep the occupants above the mud, and reed-filled cloth mattresses for sleeping on. None of the material, however, is suitable for long-term use in Chult. The canvas is riddled with mildew and fungus, dampness quickly seeps up through the floors, and vermin of every imaginable variety thrives in the mattresses.
zh_tw: 每個帳篷旨在為四個人提供合理的舒適度。它們有木製地板，使居住者遠離泥濘，並且有裝滿蘆葦的布質床墊供睡覺使用。然而，所有的材料都不適合在楚爾特長期使用。帆布上佈滿了黴菌和真菌，潮溼很快透過地板滲透上來，各種可以想象的害蟲在床墊中繁衍生息。

english: 8. Latrines
zh_tw: 8. 廁所

english: Anywhere but Chult, these latrines would be excellent. Here, daily rain floods the pits and flushes their contents through the camp. As if that's not bad enough, the wooden structures are sinking into the soft ground around the pits, threatening at any moment to collapse utterly. Most soldiers in the camp avoid the latrines and instead relieve themselves in the jungle (if they can volunteer for outside work details) or over the top of the palisade wall. Either option is safer and more sanitary than using the latrines.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特之外的任何地方，這些廁所都會是極好的。在這裡，日常的雨水淹沒了坑洞，將裡面的內容沖刷到營地中。如果這還不夠糟糕，木製結構正下沉到坑洞周圍的軟地面中，隨時都有可能徹底倒塌。營地中的大多數士兵避開廁所，而是選擇在叢林中（如果他們能自願承擔外部工作）或在柵欄牆的頂部解決個人需要。無論哪種選擇都比使用廁所更安全、更衛生。

english: The Cauldron
zh_tw: 大鍋

english: Lava pouring into the sea from nearby volcanoes causes immense columns of steam to continually erupt from this bay. This steam combined with billowing clouds of ash and black smoke from the volcanoes give the bay its name. No sea life survives in the bay—the {@condition poisoned} water is perpetually covered by a layer of floating soot—and vegetation along the coast is all dead and coated in ash.
zh_tw: 附近火山噴湧而出的熔岩流入海中，導致這片海灣不斷騰起巨大的蒸汽柱。這些蒸汽與火山噴發的滾滾灰雲和黑煙交織，賦予了海灣其名。海灣中沒有任何海洋生物存活——{@condition poisoned||中毒}的水體永遠覆蓋著一層漂浮的煤灰——沿岸植被也全部枯死，裹挾在灰燼之中。

english: Dungrunglung
zh_tw: 登格隆格

english: The grungs of Dungrunglung (map 2.5) toil under the tyranny of their despotic king, Groak, who is obsessed with summoning the goddess Nangnang and mating with her. To please their king, the grungs have erected a 60-foot-tall mud shrine, where Groak plans to woo the goddess and where she, in turn, can bless him with generations of god-touched, royal Groaklings.
zh_tw: 登格隆格（地圖2.5）的格龍蛙人們在暴君國王格羅克的專制統治下勞作，格羅克痴迷於召喚女神娜浪並與她交配。為了取悅他們的國王，格龍蛙人們建造了一個60尺高的泥質神殿，格羅克計劃在那裡向女神求愛，而她反過來可以賜福於他，讓他擁有一代代被神觸控的、皇家的格羅克後代。

english: Although grungs are traditionally scheming, greedy, and generally unpleasant to deal with, the grungs of Dungrunglung are experiencing desperate times. Ghouls and zombies threaten their existence, and grung poison is ineffective against the undead. Consequently, the grungs are strongly incentivized to use outsiders to solve their undead problem instead of making slaves or meals out of them.
zh_tw: 儘管格龍蛙人們傳統上是狡猾、貪婪的，通常與人交往不愉快，但登格隆格的格龍蛙人們正經歷著絕望的時期。食屍鬼和殭屍威脅著他們的生存，而格龍蛙人的毒藥對不死生物無效。因此，格龍蛙人們有很強的動機利用外來者來解決他們的不死生物問題，而不是將他們變成奴隸或食物。

english: King Groak holds absolute sway in Dungrunglung, and his subjects follow his orders without question. However, should the balance of power shift firmly to Krr'ook or Roark (see the "Grungs of Dungrunglung" sidebar), the grungs do not hesitate to tear Groak limb from limb in a cathartic frenzy. At some point during the adventurers' time in Dungrunglung, they will be approached in secrecy by Krr'ook.
zh_tw: 國王格羅克在登格隆格擁有絕對的控制權，他的臣民毫無質疑地遵循他的命令。然而，如果權力平衡堅定地轉移到克魯克或羅阿克（見"登格隆格的格龍蛙人們"邊欄），格龍蛙人們們不會猶豫在一場淨化的狂潮中將格羅克撕成碎片。在冒險者在登格隆格的時間裡，他們將在秘密中被克魯克接近。

english: At any given time, Dungrunglung is home to grungs representing all castes and colors. There is only one gold grung (Groak) and one red grung (Krr'ook). For grung stat blocks and more information on grung castes, see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 在任何給定的時間，登格隆格是代表所有種姓和顏色的格龍蛙人們的家園。只有一個金色格龍蛙人（格羅克）和一個紅色格龍蛙人（克魯克）。關於格龍蛙人的統計資料塊和更多關於格龍蛙人種姓的資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: The grungs speak no language other than their own, which complicates any dealings with them. How they treat adventurers depends on how strong they appear:
zh_tw: 格龍蛙人們除了自己的語言外不說任何其他語言，這使得與他們的任何交易都變得複雜。他們對待冒險者的方式取決於他們看起來有多強大：

english: If the party appears weak (few in number or needing assistance), {@dice 1d6 + 6} {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} with green skin (warriors) surround them as soon as they enter the thorn maze, and press them to attend an audience with the king. The grungs attack and subdue characters who resist. If the adventurers accept, they are taken through the maze to the shrine, where they are received by King Groak. He offers sanctuary and talks of the great ritual to summon Nangnang. Once the characters are rested, Groak commands them to help Krr'ook make final preparations.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍看起來比較弱（人數少或需要幫助），他們一進入荊棘迷宮，就會被{@dice 1d6 + 6}個皮膚為綠色的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（戰士）包圍，並迫使他們去見國王。格朗會攻擊並制服反抗的角色。如果冒險者接受，他們會被帶到迷宮中的神殿，那裡由國王格羅克接待。他提供庇護，並談論召喚娜浪的盛大儀式。一旦角色們休息好了，格羅克命令他們幫助克魯克做好最後的準備。

english: If the party looks capable of putting up a good fight, they are greeted by {@dice 1d6 + 6} {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} with green skin (warriors) once they reach the settlement. The grungs welcome them to Dungrunglung and beg the characters to hear what King Groak has to say. Groak entreats the adventurers to be part of his divine destiny, and to aid Krr'ook in completing the preparations to summon Nangnang. He offers Dungrunglung's hospitality as well as information about Chult in exchange for their help.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍看起來有能力進行一場精彩的戰鬥，當他們到達定居點時，會由{@dice 1d6 + 6}個綠色皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（戰士）歡迎他們。格朗們歡迎他們來到登格隆隆，並請求角色們聽聽國王格洛克有什麼要說的。格洛克懇求冒險者成為他神聖命運的一部分，並幫助克魯克完成召喚娜浪的準備工作。他提供登格隆隆的熱情款待以及關於楚爾特的資訊，以換取他們的幫助。

english: Characters who offend King Groak are thrown in the prison pit ({@area area 7|0e3|x}). There, they are approached in secret by Krr'ook, who tries to explain her dilemma. If the party agrees to help her, Krr'ook will find a way to free the party members to aid in her task. Prisoners who are deemed "not useful" will either be roasted over a fire or sacrificed to Nangnang during the Great Ritual.
zh_tw: 冒犯格羅克國王的角色將被扔進監獄坑（{@area 區域7|0e3|x}）。在那裡，克魯克會秘密接近他們，試圖解釋她的困境。如果隊伍同意幫助她，克魯克將找到一種方法釋放隊伍成員以協助她的任務。那些被認為"沒有用"的囚犯將要麼被放在火上烤，要麼在偉大的儀式中被獻祭給娜浪。

english: Grungs of Dungrunglung
zh_tw: 登格隆格的格龍蛙人們

english: The following grungs have key roles to play in Dungrunglung. For grung statistics, see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 以下格龍蛙人們在登格隆格中扮演著關鍵角色。有關格龍蛙人們的具體數值，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: Groak (gold {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM} wearing a {@item circlet of blasting|DMG}) is the love-struck king who seeks to woo the goddess Nangnang. Charismatic but unstable, Groak can swing from friendly to homicidal in the span of a few seconds. Because of this, his people dare not even whisper a harsh word about him. Groak wants to be seen as a visionary and a romantic, and he loves to hear stories of the outside world. However, he threatens anyone who dares to question his inflated self-image. Groak tolerates adventurers as long as they entertain him, generally agree with everything he says, and are willing to aid him in his quest to realize his divine destiny to become Nangnang's consort.
zh_tw: 格羅克（一位戴著{@item circlet of blasting|DMG|爆裂頭飾}的{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}）是痴情的國王，試圖追求女神娜浪。他富有魅力但情緒不穩定，可能在幾秒鐘內從友善轉變為殺人狂。因此，他的臣民甚至不敢低聲說一句關於他的壞話。格羅克希望被視為一個有遠見的浪漫主義者，喜歡聽外界的故事。然而，他會威脅任何膽敢質疑他膨脹自我形象的人。只要冒險者能取悅他、大體上贊同他所說的一切，並願意幫助他實現成為娜浪配偶的神聖命運，格羅克就會容忍他們。

english: Krr'ook (red {@creature grung wildling|VGM}) is a grung priest who fears the king's madness. She whispers favorable signs and omens in the king's ear to keep in his good graces. Secretly, Krr'ook suspects that the Great Ritual to summon Nangnang will fail. Consequently, she fears for her life. She approaches the adventurers to see if they can help her fool the king on the night of the ritual. If Krr'ook senses anything out of kilter, or if the ritual goes awry, she scapegoats the adventurers and delivers them straight into the king's infantile wrath.
zh_tw: 克魯克（紅色{@creature grung wildling|VGM|格龍蛙人蠻荒祭司}）是一位格龍蛙人牧師，她害怕國王的瘋狂。為了保持國王的寵愛，她在國王耳邊低語吉祥的徵兆和預兆。秘密地，克魯克懷疑召喚娜浪的偉大儀式將會失敗。因此，她為自己的命運感到擔憂。她接近冒險者，想看看他們是否能在儀式之夜幫助她欺騙國王。如果克魯克感覺到任何不協調的跡象，或者儀式出了差錯，她會將冒險者作為替罪羊，直接將他們送入國王幼稚的憤怒之中。

english: Roark (orange {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM}) is a dutiful and dangerous grung warrior, dedicated to his mad king. Roark thinks all this goddess-summoning nonsense is distracting from the real issue at hand: defending Dungrunglung from the undead. Secretly, Roark's loyalty is to the tribe first and Groak second, but Roark is dutifully abiding the king's obsession for now. He is suspicious of adventurers yet open to help in defending his village from the undead.
zh_tw: 羅阿克（橙色{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}）是一位盡職盡責且危險的格龍蛙人戰士，他致力於效忠於他瘋狂的國王。羅阿克認為所有這些召喚女神的胡言亂語都分散了對當前真正問題的注意力：保衛登格隆格免受不死生物的侵害。秘密地，羅阿克的忠誠首先是對部落的，其次是對格羅克的，但羅阿克目前盡職地忍受著國王的執念。他對冒險者持懷疑態度，但願意接受幫助以保衛他的村莊免受不死生物的侵害。

english: Map 2.5: Dungrunglung
zh_tw: 地圖2.5：東隆隆

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Thorn Maze
zh_tw: 1. 荊棘迷宮

english: Dungrunglung is surrounded by a 20-foot-high maze of magical, twisted vines. The outer wall bristles with thorns that zombies mindlessly skewer themselves on in their attempts to swarm over it.
zh_tw: 登格隆格被20尺高的魔法纏繞藤蔓迷宮所包圍。外牆上佈滿了荊棘，殭屍在試圖爬過時會毫無意識地將自己刺穿。

english: The maze has one visible entrance to the north and numerous secret entrances elsewhere around the perimeter. A secret entrance is simply a well-hidden doorway that requires a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot.
zh_tw: 迷宮在北面有一個明顯的入口，在周圍的其他地方還有許多秘密入口。秘密入口只是一個隱藏得很好的門口，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能發現。

english: The maze's passages are open to the sky and magically change configuration every minute or so, turning passageways into dead ends, and vice versa. Whichever character is leading the way through the maze must make six successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks to find the entrance to the settlement ({@area area 2|0db|x}). Each successful or failed check represents 1 minute of searching the maze. Between each check, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Thorn Maze Encounters table to determine what, if anything, the characters encounter. Characters can avoid the maze entirely by flying over it.
zh_tw: 迷宮的通道向天空敞開，並且每分鐘左右會魔法般地改變配置，將通道變成死衚衕，反之亦然。無論哪個角色在引領穿越迷宮，都必須成功進行六次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，以找到定居點的入口（{@area 區域2|0db|x}）。每次成功或失敗的檢定代表在迷宮中搜尋的1分鐘。在每次檢定之間，擲一個 {@dice d20} 並參考荊棘迷宮遭遇表，以確定角色們會遇到什麼，如果有的話。角色們可以透過飛越迷宮來完全避開它。

english: Thorn Maze Encounters
zh_tw: 荊棘迷宮遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: No encounter.
zh_tw: 無遭遇。

english: {@dice 1d6 + 6} {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} (green-skinned warriors) on patrol.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6 + 6} 只皮膚為綠色的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（巡邏的戰士）。

english: {@dice 1d3} {@creature Assassin Vine|ToA|assassin vines} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) blending in with the surrounding walls.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d3}個{@creature Assassin Vine|ToA|刺客藤}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）與周圍牆壁融為一體。

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} lost in the maze.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼} 在迷宮中迷失。

english: A harmless yahcha beetle (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}).
zh_tw: 一隻無害的亞查甲蟲（見 {@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}）。

english: The characters hear a throaty croak that sounds at once both lusty and forlorn. Its source cannot be ascertained.
zh_tw: 角色們聽到了一種喉嚨深處的叫聲，聽起來既充滿生機又顯得淒涼。它的來源無法確定。

english: {@dice 1d6} {@creature Zombie||zombies} lost in the maze.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} 只{@creature Zombie||喪屍}在迷宮中迷路。

english: A concealed pit 5 feet wide, 10 feet deep, and lined with poisoned wooden stakes. The lead character spots the pit with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The first character to step on a pit falls in, taking 3 ({@dice 1d6}) bludgeoning damage and landing on {@dice 1d4} stakes, each of which deals 3 ({@dice 1d6}) piercing damage and 7 ({@dice 2d6}) poison damage.
zh_tw: 一個隱蔽的陷阱，寬5尺，深10尺，內部排列著有毒的木樁。領隊角色透過成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現了陷阱。第一個踏入陷阱的角色會掉入其中，受到3（{@dice 1d6}）點鈍擊傷害，並落在{@dice 1d4}根木樁上，每根木樁造成3（{@dice 1d6}）點穿刺傷害和7（{@dice 2d6}）點毒素傷害。

english: An interior secret door. It requires a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot.
zh_tw: 一扇內部的秘密門。需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能發現。

english: 2. Main Entrance
zh_tw: 2. 主入口

english: If the characters exit the maze at this point, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在這一點離開迷宮，請閱讀：

english: Through an opening in the maze wall, you see a small lake surrounded by reed huts, ferns, and lily pads. Rising up from a flat island in the middle of the lake is a 60-foot-tall shrine made of painted mud bricks, shaped in the likeness of a giant frog. Stairs climb from the lake shore to an open doorway carved into the frog's fat belly. Patrolling the shrine's perimeter are several small, frog-like humanoids with bright orange skin and shortbows.
zh_tw: 透過迷宮牆上的一個開口，你看到一個被蘆葦屋、蕨類植物和睡蓮環繞的小湖。在湖中央的平坦小島上，矗立著一座60尺高的神殿，由彩繪泥磚建造，形狀像一隻巨大的青蛙。從湖岸有樓梯通往雕刻在青蛙肥大肚子上的一個開放式門洞。在神殿周圍巡邏的是幾個小的、像青蛙一樣的類人生物，他們有著鮮亮的橙色皮膚和短弓。

english: Four green-skinned {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} (warriors) emerge from nearby hovels to confront strangers who approach the shrine unescorted. They attack if no one speaks the correct passphrase in Grung ("Roook, roooook, erp"). If a fight breaks out, reinforcements in the form of twelve {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} arrive in 2 rounds. The grungs in {@area area 3|0dd|x} begin shooting arrows at the same time.
zh_tw: 四隻綠皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（戰士）從附近的小屋中出現，以面對未經護送就接近神殿的陌生人。如果沒人說出正確的格朗語口令（'Roook, roooook, erp'），他們就會攻擊。如果發生戰鬥，十二隻{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}作為援軍將在2回合內到達。同時，{@area 區域3|0dd|x}區域的格朗開始射箭。

english: 3. Groak's Isle
zh_tw: 3. 格羅克島

english: Marshy shores surround the shrine, which is 60 feet tall and made of carved mud blocks painted with natural dyes. Patrolling its base are eight {@creature Grung Elite Warrior|VGM|grung elite warriors} with orange skin. They wield daggers and shortbows, and are loyal to Roark first, King Groak second. Strangers who reach the island without a grung escort are attacked.
zh_tw: 沼澤的岸邊圍繞著這座60尺高的神殿，它由雕刻的泥磚製成，用天然染料上色。在其基座巡邏的是八名{@creature Grung Elite Warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}，皮膚為橙色。他們手持匕首和短弓，首先忠於羅阿克，其次是格羅克國王。未經格朗護送到達島嶼的陌生人將遭到攻擊。

english: 4. Shrine
zh_tw: 4. 神龕

english: The interior of the shrine is one large, hollow room. Just inside the entrance is a clear pool of water that ranges in depth from 2 to 5 feet. Phosphorescent fungi illuminate the pool with soft, dreamy hues. Short, frog-like humanoids of different colors are fussing with the fungi and tossing flower petals into the pool.
zh_tw: 神殿的內部是一個大型的空心房間。入口處有一個清澈的水池，深度從2到5尺不等。發光的真菌以柔和、夢幻的色彩照亮了水池。不同顏色的短小、像青蛙一樣的類人生物正在擺弄真菌，向水池中拋撒花瓣。

english: At the back of the shrine is an elevated semicircular basin of water 10 feet high. Wallowing in the basin is a grung with gold skin. On its brow rests a golden circlet. An orange-skinned grung perches nearby, shortbow at the ready.
zh_tw: 神殿的後部是一個高出10尺的半圓形水池。水池中躺著一隻金色皮膚的格朗。它的額頭上戴著一個金色的頭環。一隻橙色皮膚的格朗在附近蹲伏，短弓準備就緒。

english: The shallow pool at the front of the shrine is where Krr'ook (a red-skinned {@creature grung wildling|VGM}; see the "Grungs of Dungrunglung" sidebar) and her assistants (six blue-skinned {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs}) prepare for the Great Ritual by tending the phosphorescent fungi and scenting the water with delicate perfumes. Removing the fungi from the pool is forbidden, by order of King Groak.
zh_tw: 神殿前部的淺水池是克魯克（一隻紅皮膚的{@creature grung wildling|VGM|格龍蛙人蠻荒祭司}；見"登格隆格的格朗"側邊欄）和她的助手們（六隻藍皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}）為大儀式做準備的地方，他們照料著發光的真菌，並用精緻的香水給水增添香味。根據格羅克國王的命令，禁止從水池中移除真菌。

english: The elevated pool at the back of the shrine is fed by an underground spring. King Groak (a gold-skinned {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM} with a {@item circlet of blasting}; see the "Grungs of Dungrunglung" sidebar) issues commands from the pool during the day and sleeps here at night. He rarely has cause to leave the shrine these days. By his side is Roark (orange-skinned {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM}; see the "Grungs of Dungrunglung" sidebar).
zh_tw: 神殿後部的高水池由一個地下泉水供應。格羅克國王（一隻金色皮膚的{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}，戴著一個{@item circlet of blasting||爆裂頭飾}；見"登格隆格的格朗"側邊欄）在白天從水池中發號施令，晚上在這裡睡覺。這些天他很少離開神殿。他身邊是羅阿克（橙色皮膚的{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}；見"登格隆格的格朗"側邊欄）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: King Groak wears a {@item circlet of blasting}, which he's not afraid to use against anyone who insults or defies him. Lining the bottom of his pool are 33 gp and a fist-sized chunk of green quartz (50 gp).
zh_tw: 格羅克國王戴著一個{@item circlet of blasting||爆裂頭飾}，他不怕用它來對付任何侮辱或違抗他的人。他的水池底部鋪著33金幣和一個拳頭大小的綠色石英塊（50金幣）。

english: 5. Grung Hovels
zh_tw: 5. 格隆小屋

english: Dotted about the shores of the lake are several squat huts made from swamp moss and reeds plastered together with mud. The huts range from about 15 to 25 feet in diameter, and each has a single, low entrance. Some have small, round window-like openings, and a few have stout mudchimneys.
zh_tw: 湖邊零星散佈著幾座低矮的茅屋，由沼澤苔蘚和蘆葦混著泥漿搭成。這些茅屋直徑約15到25尺不等，每座都有個低矮的入口。有些開著圓形小窗般的孔洞，還有幾座立著粗短的泥砌煙囪。

english: Each hut is large enough to accommodate six adult {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} plus {@dice 2d6} baby grungs (noncombatants). All the occupants of a given hut belong to the same caste, and thus have the same color skin (except the young, which are all dull green-gray).
zh_tw: 每個小屋都足夠大，可以容納六名成年的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}加上{@dice 2d6}只格朗幼崽（非戰鬥者）。一個特定小屋的所有居住者屬於同一個種姓，因此擁有相同的膚色（除了幼崽，它們都是暗淡的灰綠色）。

english: 6. Lake Grunglung
zh_tw: 6. 格隆隆湖

english: Lake Grunglung is really just a large pond covered with lily pads and duckweed, where slow-moving catfish gulp at the surface for air. The thick, muddy bottom is littered with the bones of the grungs' feasts.
zh_tw: 格朗格隆湖實際上只是一個大池塘，上面覆蓋著睡蓮和浮萍，行動緩慢的鯰魚在水面上吞食空氣。厚厚的泥濘底部散落著格朗們的盛宴留下的骨頭。

english: 7. Prison Pit
zh_tw: 7. 監獄坑

english: This dug-out pit is 5 feet deep and covered by stout, wooden bars. Prisoners confined here are guarded around the clock by two green-skinned {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} (warriors) until they can be cooked and eaten. Any items taken from the prisoners are entrusted to purple-skinned grungs in the nearby hovels (see {@area area 5|0e1|x}).
