zh_tw: 這個挖掘出的坑深5尺，被堅固的木條覆蓋。關押在這裡的囚犯由兩名綠皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（戰士）全天候看守，直到他們可以被煮熟並被吃掉。從囚犯那裡拿走的任何物品都交給了附近小屋裡的紫皮膚格朗（見{@area 區域5|0e1|x}）。

english: A character in the pit can throw aside the prison bars with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Before the check is made, each guard makes one opportunity attack against the character attempting the check.
zh_tw: 坑中的角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 20}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定將監獄欄杆推開。在檢定進行之前，每個守衛都會對嘗試檢定的角色進行一次藉機攻擊。

english: The Great Ritual
zh_tw: 大儀式

english: Once the Great Ritual is complete, King Groak expects Nangnang to materialize and speak words of love, praise, and reassurance to him. Fearing that the ritual will fail, Krr'ook has concocted a desperate plan to fool the king but needs the adventurers' help to pull it off.
zh_tw: 一旦大儀式完成，格羅克國王期望娜浪顯現並說出愛、讚美和安慰的話。克魯克擔心儀式會失敗，已經制定了一個絕望的計劃來欺騙國王，但需要冒險家們的幫助來實現。

english: Krr'ook's Plan.
zh_tw: 克魯克的計劃。

english: A while ago, Krr'ook found a box of {@item Nolzur's marvelous pigments}, which she hid from the king. She plans to paint an image of Nangnang of such quality that Groak will be fooled into thinking it's the real goddess. Krr'ook hopes that one of the adventurers will have the skill to illustrate Nangnang convincingly. She's willing to give the magical pigments as a reward to the adventurers if all goes well. As a further reward, Krr'ook offers a {@item ring of jumping}.
zh_tw: 克魯克的計劃。不久前，克魯克找到了一盒{@item Nolzur's marvelous pigments||諾澤爾的驚奇顏料}，她將其藏起來不讓國王知道。她計劃繪製一幅如此高質量的娜浪畫像，以至於格羅克會被愚弄，認為這是真正的女神。克魯克希望其中一位冒險家擁有令人信服地描繪娜浪的技能。如果一切順利，她願意將魔法顏料作為獎勵給予冒險家們。作為進一步的獎勵，克魯克提供了一枚{@item ring of jumping||跳躍戒指}。

english: Moment of Truth.
zh_tw: 真相時刻。

english: The ritual happens at night. Fires are lit throughout the village, whereupon scores of common grungs enter the lake and watch the shrine. King Groak dons ceremonial garb made from reeds and wild orchids, and awaits his love on the steps of the shrine, wringing his rubbery hands with anticipation.
zh_tw: 儀式在夜晚舉行。整個村莊點燃了火把，成群的普通格朗進入湖中，注視著神殿。格羅克國王穿上由蘆葦和野生蘭花製成的儀式服裝，在神殿的臺階上等待他的愛人，滿懷期待地扭動著他那橡膠般的雙手。

english: To fool Groak, the characters must paint an image of Nangnang on a surface or craft some other representation of her, then use magic (if they can) to give it a semblance of life. {@spell Animate objects}, {@spell major image}, {@spell minor illusion}, and similar spells can help enhance the illusion. Spells such as {@spell color spray} and {@spell prestidigitation} can also be used to dazzle an audience long enough to conceal a fatal flub.
zh_tw: 為了欺騙格羅克，角色們必須在某個表面上繪製娜浪的影象，或者製作她的其他表現形式，然後使用魔法（如果他們可以的話）賦予它生命的跡象。{@spell Animate objects||活化物件}、{@spell major image||高等幻影}、{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}以及類似的法術可以幫助增強這個幻象。像{@spell color spray||七彩噴射}和{@spell prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}這樣的法術也可以用來迷惑觀眾，讓他們足夠長時間地分散注意力，以掩蓋一個致命的錯誤。

english: Whoever gives voice to Nangnang must "sell" the illusion with honeyed words, in order to convince King Groak that he has won a special place in Nangnang's heart. Finally, the ritual must end with Nangnang's departure, handled in such a way that King Groak won't suspect he's been fooled or abandoned forever. If Nangnang or her words ring false, King Groak orders the deaths of Krr'ook and anyone believed to have aided her.
zh_tw: 無論誰扮演娜浪，都必須用甜言蜜語'銷售'這個幻象，以說服格羅克國王，他已在娜浪心中贏得了一個特別的位置。最後，儀式必須以娜浪的離去結束，處理方式要讓格羅克國王不會懷疑他被愚弄或被永遠拋棄。如果娜浪或她的話顯得不真實，格羅克國王會下令處死克魯克和任何被認為幫助過她的人。

english: Making Nangnang.
zh_tw: 製作娜浪。

english: To fool Groak, the party must succeed at three or more of the following tasks. Have the characters make the requisite ability checks in the following order:
zh_tw: 為了欺騙格羅克，隊伍必須成功完成以下至少三項任務。讓角色按照以下順序進行必要的屬性檢定：

english: Painting or crafting a representation of Nangnang requires a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence check. Using {@item Nolzur's marvelous pigments} grants advantage on the check.
zh_tw: 繪畫或製作娜浪的象徵物需要進行一次成功的{@dc 12}智力檢定。使用{@item Nolzur's marvelous pigments||諾澤爾的驚奇顏料}將使本次檢定獲得優勢。

english: Animating Nangnang convincingly requires a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If multiple characters contribute, have one character make the check with advantage.
zh_tw: 要令人信服地扮演娜浪，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 魅力 ({@skill Deception||欺瞞}) 檢定。如果多個角色參與，讓其中一名角色以優勢進行檢定。

english: Convincing Groak that Nangnang's words are genuine requires a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance}) check. If the words are delivered in a language King Groak doesn't understand, the check is made with disadvantage. (Groak speaks Grung only.)
zh_tw: 要讓格羅克相信娜浪的話是真心的，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞} 或 {@skill Performance||表演}）檢定。如果這些話是用格羅克國王不懂的語言表達的，則檢定帶有劣勢。（格羅克只會說格蘭語。）

english: Selling Nangnang's blessed departure requires a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, or {@skill Persuasion}) check. The check is made with disadvantage if her words are spoken in a language other than Grung.
zh_tw: 出售娜浪的祝福離境需要透過一次 {@dc 15} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}, {@skill Intimidation||威嚇}, 或 {@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定。如果她的話是用格倫語以外的語言說出，則檢定將帶有劣勢。

english: End Result.
zh_tw: 最終結果。

english: If the characters succeed at three or more checks, King Groak is thoroughly duped and very happy for the foreseeable future. Characters who request his help will receive it, no questions asked. If the party's trickery is discovered, King Groak orders his subjects to attack them. The attacking force consists of sixteen grung elite warriors (including Roark) and forty grungs. Groak retreats to his elevated pool in the shrine and makes his final stand there.
zh_tw: 如果角色們成功透過三項或更多的檢定，格羅克國王將被徹底欺騙，並且在可預見的未來會非常高興。請求他幫助的角色將得到他的支援，無需任何問題。如果隊伍的詭計被揭穿，格羅克國王命令他的臣民攻擊他們。攻擊力量包括十六名格朗精英戰士（包括羅阿克）和四十名格朗。格羅克撤退到神殿中的高水池，並在那裡做最後的抵抗。

english: Firefinger
zh_tw: 火指

english: Rising high above the jungle canopy is a 300-foot-tall, naturally formed spire of rock with smoke issuing from a flaming beacon at the top of it. The walls of the spire are sheer and dotted with small caves. Frail-looking ladders hang from narrow ledges at various heights.
zh_tw: 高聳於叢林樹冠之上的是一座300尺高的天然形成的岩石尖塔，頂部有一個火焰訊號燈，煙霧從其中冒出。尖塔的牆壁陡峭，點綴著一些小洞穴。看起來脆弱的梯子懸掛在不同高度的狹窄壁架上。

english: The rocky pinnacle called Firefinger (map 2.6) is an ancient Chultan signal tower. Before the Spellplague toppled them, many such towers were used to send messages between cities via colored flames at night or colored smoke during the day. Firefinger is one of the few still standing, if not the only one.
zh_tw: 被稱為火焰之指（地圖2.6）的岩石尖塔是古代楚爾特訊號塔。在咒災之前，許多這樣的塔被用來在夜間透過彩色火焰或白天透過彩色煙霧在城市之間傳送資訊。火焰之指是少數仍然屹立不倒的塔之一，如果不是唯一的話。

english: Firefinger has been taken over by a flock of pterafolk that preys on hunters and explorers along the River Tiryki. The tower is a perfect lair for the pterafolk; in clear weather, from its 300-foot-high vantage point, they can spot anything moving on the river less than 10 miles away, and its sheer walls and crumbling ladders make it potentially lethal for anything without wings to attempt the ascent.
zh_tw: 火指被一群翼手獸佔領，它們在提爾基河沿岸捕食獵人和探險者。這座塔是翼手獸的完美巢穴；在晴朗的天氣裡，從其300尺高的有利位置，它們可以發現任何在10英里以內的河流上移動的目標，而且它陡峭的牆壁和破舊的梯子使得任何沒有翅膀的生物試圖攀登都可能致命。

english: If {@creature Azaka Stormfang|ToA} (see {@area chapter 1|091|x}) is with the characters, she insists they attack the spire. She suggests waiting until nightfall or rain, if none of the characters think of it. If characters refuse to attack the pterafolk, Azaka leaves their service in disgust.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Azaka Stormfang|ToA|婀扎卡·風暴之牙}（見{@area 第一章|091|x}）與角色們在一起，她堅持要他們攻擊尖塔。如果角色們沒有人想到，她建議等到夜幕降臨或下雨時再行動。如果角色們拒絕攻擊翼手獸，婀扎卡會因厭惡而離開他們的服務。

english: The best way to approach Firefinger without being spotted by the pterafolk is to stay under heavy forest canopy and cross open areas only when rain or darkness limits visibility. If these precautions aren't taken, have the party make a {@dc 12} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. If the group check fails, the pterafolk mount an attack from above. The attack force numbers two {@creature pterafolk|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) for each party member. If the pterafolk become outnumbered, the survivors flee back to the spire and warn the others (in which case, the characters have lost the element of surprise).
zh_tw: 在接近火指峰而不被翼手獸發現的最佳方法是保持在茂密的森林冠層下，並只在降雨或黑暗限制視線時穿越開闊區域。如果沒有采取這些預防措施，讓隊伍進行一次 {@dc 12} 集體敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定。如果隊伍檢定失敗，翼手獸會從上方發起攻擊。攻擊力量為每位隊伍成員配備兩隻 {@creature pterafolk|ToA|翼手獸}（參見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。如果翼手獸數量被壓制，生還者會逃回尖塔並警告其他同類（在這種情況下，角色已經失去了出其不意的優勢）。

english: Near the base of the spire, characters find the body of an elf lying in the mud. Most of his limbs are broken, the ribcage is crushed, and broken twigs and torn leaves are stuck in it what's left of his clothes. This unfortunate explorer was captured on the river, flown to Firefinger, stripped of valuables, then tossed off the top of the tower to his death. Not far away, the characters find another body, and a third, and so on as they scan around the base of the tower. This same fate awaits any character captured by the pterafolk.
zh_tw: 在尖塔的底部，角色們發現了一具躺在泥裡的精靈屍體。他的大部分肢體都斷了，胸腔被壓碎，破碎的枝條和撕裂的樹葉粘附在他殘存的衣服上。這位不幸的探險家在河上被捕，被帶到火指，被剝奪了財物，然後被從塔頂扔下致死。在不遠處，角色們發現了另一具屍體，然後是第三具，如此類推，當他們掃視塔底周圍時。任何被翼手獸捕獲的角色都將面臨同樣的命運。

english: The rope-and-wood ladders mounted to the spire are ancient and crumbling. Each character who ascends a ladder to the next higher level (from the ground to level 1, from level 1 to level 2, and so on) must make a {@dc 8} Dexterity ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check succeeds, the character reaches the next level safely without damaging the fragile ladder. If the check fails, a few rungs of the ladder are damaged and the DC increases by 2 for everyone following behind the climber. If the check fails by 5 or more, the ladder is damaged and the climber falls—quite possibly to his or her death, unless precautions were taken (roping characters together, for example).
zh_tw: 安裝在尖塔上的繩木梯古老且搖搖欲墜。每個角色從地面到第一層、從第一層到第二層（以此類推）攀爬梯子時，都必須進行一次{@dc 8}敏捷（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色安全到達下一層且不會損壞脆弱的梯子。如果檢定失敗，梯子的幾級橫檔會損壞，後續攀爬者的DC會增加2。如果檢定失敗超過5點或更多，梯子會損壞，攀爬者會墜落——如果沒有采取預防措施（例如用繩子將角色綁在一起），很可能會導致死亡。

english: Pterafolk glide around the spire constantly except when it's raining. They don't pay much attention to the spire itself, since they arrogantly believe they're safe in their stronghold. Characters might take elaborate precautions to avoid being spotted, but they're surprisingly safe as long as they reach the spire unseen. During rain or at night, there's no chance they'll be spotted climbing the tower. During daytime in clear weather, a circling pterafolk spots climbers with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, unless characters have taken other precautions.
zh_tw: 翼手獸除了下雨時外，會不斷地在尖塔周圍滑翔。他們對尖塔本身並不太關注，因為他們傲慢地認為自己在堡壘中是安全的。角色們可能會採取精心設計的預防措施以避免被發現，但只要他們未被發現地到達尖塔，他們就會出人意料地安全。在雨天或夜晚，他們攀爬塔樓時沒有被發現的機會。在晴朗的白天，盤旋的翼手獸需要成功透過一個 {@dc 20} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能發現攀爬者，除非角色們採取了其他預防措施。

english: Firefinger's caves were formed by erosion and have ceilings that range from 7 to 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 火焰之指的洞穴是由侵蝕形成的，天花板高度在7到10尺之間。

english: Map 2.6: Firefinger
zh_tw: 地圖 2.6: 火焰之指

english: Level 1. Abandoned Cave
zh_tw: 第一層。廢棄的洞穴

english: A ladder clinging to the south face of the spire ends at this level, which is 60 feet above ground.
zh_tw: 一架緊貼在尖塔南側的梯子在這個層面結束，這個層面距離地面60尺。

english: The pterafolk don't use this cave, the most prominent feature of which is a 10-foot-deep pit. The shortest distance across the pit where characters can use a long jump is 15 feet. Climbing into or out of the pit is easy and requires a successful {@dc 5} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. However, the first character who enters the pit disturbs four {@creature Giant Wolf Spider||giant wolf spiders} that nest in crevices along the pit walls. Only a character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 17 or higher is not {@status surprised} when the spiders attack.
zh_tw: 翼手獸不使用這個洞穴，其最顯著的特徵是一個10尺深的坑。角色可以使用長跳跨越這個坑的最短距離是15尺。爬進或爬出坑很容易，需要進行一個成功的{@dc 5}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。然而，第一個進入坑的角色會驚動在坑壁裂縫中築巢的四隻{@creature Giant Wolf Spider||巨狼蛛}。只有被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為17或更高的角色在蜘蛛攻擊時不會被{@status surprised||突襲}。

english: Reaching Level 2
zh_tw: 到達第二層

english: A rock chimney leads up to level 2. It's a 90-foot climb with plenty of handholds but several tricky, twisty spots; a successful {@dc 8} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is required to ascend or descend it without the aid of climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 一處岩石煙囪通向第2層。這是一段90尺的攀登，雖然有很多手抓點，但也有幾處複雜曲折的地方；在沒有攀爬裝備或魔法輔助的情況下，要成功攀爬或下降需要一次成功的{@dc 8}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: Level 2. Stirge Cave
zh_tw: 第二層。吸血蝙蝠洞

english: A ladder clinging to the south face of the spire ends at this level, which is 160 feet above ground.
zh_tw: 一架緊貼尖塔南側的梯子在此層結束，這一層距地面160尺。

english: The pterafolk don't use this cave. However, the chamber in the northeast corner is the lair of nine {@creature Stirge||stirges}, which cling to the 10-foot-high ceiling. They don't react unless multiple characters enter their lair or someone brings in a torch or other open flame, in which case they attack.
zh_tw: 翼手獸不使用這個洞穴。然而，東北角的房間是九隻{@creature Stirge||蚊蝠}的巢穴，它們附著在10尺高的天花板上。除非有多個角色進入它們的巢穴，或者有人帶入火把或其他明火，否則它們不會作出反應，如果是這樣，它們會攻擊。

english: Six months ago, an explorer who was captured by the pterafolk managed to escape and descend this far before falling prey to the stirges. Her desiccated corpse is slumped along the northern wall of the stirges' chamber, and the glint of gold and gems can be seen through tattered clothing and a rotting purse.
zh_tw: 六個月前，一名被翼手獸俘虜的探險家設法逃脫並下降到這裡，但在被吸血蝙蝠捕食之前。她的乾屍靠在吸血蝙蝠巢穴的北牆上，透過破爛的衣物和腐爛的錢包可以看到金光閃閃的金子和寶石。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who brave the stirges and search the dead explorer can recover 15 gp, a gold and carnelian ring (60 gp), and two onyx figurines representing chwingas (50 gp each). See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for more information on chwingas.
zh_tw: 勇敢面對吸血蝙蝠並搜尋死去探險家的角色可以回收15金幣，一枚金和紅玉髓戒指（60金幣），以及兩個代表怯蘊阿靈的黑玉雕像（每個50金幣）。有關怯蘊阿靈的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: Reaching Level 3
zh_tw: 到達第三層

english: Clinging to the west face of the spire is a ledge, above which is a ladder leading up to level 3. Whenever a character crosses the ledge, roll a {@dice d6}. On a roll of 1, a sudden gust of wind threatens to blow the character off the ledge. The character must make a {@dc 9} Dexterity saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the character falls to the base of the spire unless he or she is secured by ropes.
zh_tw: 在尖塔的西側表面有一個突出的巖架，上方是一個通向第三層的梯子。每當一個角色穿過巖架時，擲一個{@dice d6}。若擲出1，一陣突如其來的強風可能將角色吹下巖架。角色必須進行一個{@dc 9}的敏捷豁免檢定。若豁免失敗，角色將墜落到尖塔的底部，除非他或她被繩索固定住。

english: Level 3. Pterafolk Nest
zh_tw: 第三層。翼手獸的巢穴

english: This level is 240 feet above ground. A ladder clinging to the west face of the spire connects this level to the one below.
zh_tw: 這一層距地面240尺。一架緊貼尖塔西面的梯子將這一層與下面的一層相連。

english: Pterafolk elders inhabit this area. They've constructed a traditional nest that's better sheltered from wind and rain. The southwest chamber is home to four elder {@creature pterafolk|ToA} (13 hit points each; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). They spend most of their time tending their fire (which makes the chamber stiflingly hot and smoky) and carving grisly totems from the bones of their enemies.
zh_tw: 翼手獸的長者居住在這個區域。他們建造了一個更受風和雨保護的傳統巢穴。西南房間是四隻長者翼手獸（{@creature pterafolk|ToA|翼手獸}，每隻有13點生命值；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的家園。他們大部分時間都在照料他們的火（這使得房間變得令人窒息地熱和煙霧瀰漫），並從敵人的骨頭上雕刻出可怕的圖騰。

english: When the pterafolk have prisoners, they're confined to the eastern portion of this cave. Currently, there's one prisoner: a male {@creature aarakocra} named Nephyr. He hails from Kir Sabal and was ambushed by pterafolk while on patrol. His wrists, ankles, and beak are bound with rope, and he has no weapons. He knows that at least eight pterafolk live on Firefinger's peak, but he has no idea how many are there now.
zh_tw: 當翼手獸有俘虜時，他們被關押在這個洞穴的東側。目前，有一個俘虜：一個名叫涅菲爾的雄性{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}。他來自基爾·薩巴爾，在巡邏時被翼手獸伏擊。他的手腕、腳踝和喙都被繩子捆綁著，他沒有武器。他知道至少有八個翼手獸居住在火焰之指的頂峰，但他不知道現在那裡有多少人。

english: If the characters set him free, Nephyr is grateful. Before departing, he urges the characters to visit Kir Sabal and petition {@creature Asharra|ToA} to perform the Dance of the Seven Winds. This dance, he says, is part of a magical ritual that grants nonflying creatures the ability to fly. Once back at Kir Sabal, Nephyr spreads word of the characters' heroism. Characters gain advantage on Charisma checks made to influence the aarakocra of Kir Sabal from that point on.
zh_tw: 如果角色們釋放了他，涅菲爾會非常感激。在離開之前，他敦促角色們前往基爾·薩巴爾並請求{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}進行七風之舞。他說，這個舞蹈是一個魔法儀式的一部分，它賦予非飛行生物飛行的能力。一旦回到基爾·薩巴爾，涅菲爾會傳播角色們的英雄事蹟。從那時起，角色們在影響基爾·薩巴爾的鳥羽人族時，在魅力檢定上獲得優勢。

english: Reaching Level 4
zh_tw: 到達第四層

english: A 50-foot-tall chimney ascends to the pinnacle of Firefinger. The chimney contains plenty of handholds and requires a successful {@dc 8} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to climb without gear or magic. At this height, any significant noise in the shaft alerts the pterafolk in area 4 to the presence of intruders.
zh_tw: 一根50尺高的煙囪直通火指峰的頂端。煙囪上有許多手抓點，需要成功的{@dc 8}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能在無裝備或魔法的情況下攀爬。在這個高度，煙囪內任何顯著的噪音都會驚動區域4的翼手獸，使其察覺到入侵者的存在。

english: Level 4. Pinnacle
zh_tw: 第四層。尖頂

english: The spire's pinnacle is flat and roughly 40 feet square. The edges are crumbling away; it wouldn't be safe to stand too close to any of them. Vines and low brush grow in profusion. Bones and scraps of meat from dozens of creatures are scattered everywhere.
zh_tw: 尖塔的尖頂是平坦的，大約40尺見方。邊緣正在崩解；站在它們太近的地方是不安全的。藤蔓和低矮的灌木叢茂盛生長。來自數十種生物的骨頭和肉片散落一地。

english: A crumbling stone tower rises another 30 feet above the northern corner of the platform. A roaring flame floats in the air, hovering above the tower. Tumbled debris from the tower is heaped around its foundation. Three humanoid creatures with needlelike beaks and leathery wings are worrying the last shreds of flesh from well-chewed bones near an open doorway into the base of the tower.
zh_tw: 一座破敗的石塔在平臺的東北角上方又升起了30尺。一團熊熊的火焰在空中漂浮，懸停在塔的上方。塔周圍的廢墟堆積在它的基座周圍。三隻有著針狀喙和皮革翅膀的人形生物正在塔底部的一個開放門口附近，從被咀嚼過的骨頭上撕扯最後一點肉屑。

english: Firefinger's pinnacle is 300 feet above ground. When the sky is clear, characters can see over 20 miles around the tower. More importantly, they can make out the scattered plateaus, the Peaks of Flame and other volcanoes and mountains ringing the southern coast, and the enormous gaps in the jungle canopy that mark the Aldani Basin, Lake Luo, and the Valley of Embers.
zh_tw: 火焰之指的尖頂距地面300尺。當天空晴朗時，角色們可以看到塔周圍超過20英里的地方。更重要的是，他們可以辨認出散佈的高原、火焰之峰和其他環繞南部海岸的火山和山脈，以及標誌著阿達尼盆地、羅湖和餘燼谷的叢林天蓬的巨大缺口。

english: Pterafolk never use the chimney between level 3 and level 4 other than to occasionally drop food to a prisoner. The top of the chimney is surrounded by rocks and low bushes, providing enough concealment for three Medium creatures. Hiding from the pterafolk requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, with advantage at nighttime or when it's raining.
zh_tw: 翼手獸在第三層和第四層之間從不使用煙囪，除了偶爾向囚犯投遞食物。煙囪頂部被岩石和低矮的灌木叢包圍，為三個中型生物提供了足夠的隱蔽。躲避翼手獸需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定，在夜間或下雨時具有優勢。

english: Six {@creature pterafolk|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) lair atop the tower, including the flock's leader, Nrak, who has 40 hit points. Nrak is a hate-filled creature with a scar that begins at the top of its head and cuts down the right side of its face and chest to below its right wing.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature pterafolk|ToA|翼手獸}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在塔頂築巢，包括這群翼手獸的領袖納拉克，它有40點生命值。納拉克是一個充滿仇恨的生物，它的疤痕從頭頂開始，沿著它的右臉和胸部一直延伸到右翼下方。

english: If {@creature Azaka Stormfang|ToA} (see {@area chapter 1|091|x}) is with the group, consider adding more pterafolk to the fight; she swings the balance heavily in favor of the attackers. Additional pterafolk circle high overhead and can join the fray at any time. Pterafolk won't hesitate to shove a character who foolishly stands at the edge of the tower. They can jump from the tower, circle around on the wing, and use their dive attacks to great advantage.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Azaka Stormfang|ToA|婀扎卡·風暴之牙}（見{@area 第一章|091|x}）與隊伍在一起，考慮增加更多的翼手獸加入戰鬥；她極大地傾斜了戰鬥的天平，使之傾向於攻擊者。額外的翼手獸在高空盤旋，可以隨時加入戰鬥。翼手獸不會猶豫將那些愚蠢地站在塔邊的角色推下去。他們可以從塔上跳下，在空中盤旋，利用俯衝攻擊獲得巨大優勢。

english: Firefinger's beacon is a magical plume of fire that puts out tremendous heat. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the flame takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage. Any creature that enters the flame or starts its turn there takes 35 ({@dice 10d6}) fire damage. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 17}) cast on the flame dispels it.
zh_tw: 火焰指的信標是一束魔法火焰，散發出巨大的熱量。任何生物在火焰10尺範圍內開始其回合時，會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）火焰傷害。任何生物進入火焰或在火焰中開始其回合時，會受到35點（{@dice 10d6}）火焰傷害。成功對火焰施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 17}）可以驅散它。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the tower are crude nests and four moldy wooden chests. The chests aren't locked. All together, they hold 2,000 cp, 730 sp, four gemstones (50 gp each), and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell commune with nature}. One of the chests also contains a cloth-wrapped, wooden mask resembling a stylized tiger's face. This is Azaka's {@item mask of the beast|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}). If she's with the characters, she claims it immediately.
zh_tw: 塔內有簡陋的巢穴和四個發黴的木箱。這些箱子沒有上鎖。總共，它們包含2000銅幣，730銀幣，四顆寶石（每顆價值50金幣），以及一張{@spell commune with nature||問道自然}的{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}。其中一個箱子還裝有一個布包裹的木製面具，它類似於一個風格化的老虎面孔。這是婀扎卡的{@item mask of the beast|ToA|野獸面具}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}）。如果她與角色們在一起，她會立即認領它。

english: Fort Beluarian
zh_tw: 貝路利安堡

english: The flag of Baldur's Gate flies over this wooden stockade. The whole structure sits atop a 10-foot hillock, the sides of which are shaved vertically to make them steep and difficult to climb. The fort's main gate faces west. On the east side of the stockade, a tall keep holds a commanding view of the surrounding wilderness.
zh_tw: 博德之門的旗幟飄揚在這個木製柵欄上。整個結構坐落在一個10尺高的土丘上，土丘的側面被垂直削平，使其陡峭且難以攀爬。堡壘的主門朝向西方。在柵欄的東側，一座高大的塔樓俯瞰著周圍的荒野。

english: Fort Beluarian's elevation and lack of a ditch allows the stockade to drain well even in heavy rain. The fort (map 2.7) is garrisoned by Flaming Fist mercenaries. Immense wealth passes through Fort Beluarian—enough to make the nobles and merchants of Baldur's Gate rich beyond the dreams of avarice.
zh_tw: 貝路利安堡的高海拔和沒有壕溝使得即使在大雨中，柵欄也能很好地排水。這座堡壘（地圖2.7）由焰拳僱傭兵駐守。巨大的財富流經貝路利安堡——足以讓博德之門的貴族和商人富得流油，超出了貪婪的夢想。

english: Commanding Fort Beluarian is a lawful evil Flaming Fist blaze (major) named {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), who answers directly to Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate. Liara is 47 years old and has held her post for the past three years. To her, a posting in Chult feels like a test of mettle, but to many of her subordinates, it feels like banishment. The garrison consists of a castellan named Gruta Halsdottir (LN female Illuskan human {@creature knight}), three corporals ({@creature Veteran||veterans}), and fifty-four privates ({@creature Guard||guards}). The garrison operates in three eight-hour shifts, with one {@creature Veteran||corporal} (gauntlet) and eighteen {@creature Guard||privates} (fists) on duty during each shift.
zh_tw: 貝路利安堡的指揮官是一位守序邪惡的焰拳烈焰使者（重要人物），名叫{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），她直接向博德之門的大公爵烏爾德·瑞文嘉德彙報。莉爾阿今年47歲，過去三年一直擔任這個職位。對她來說，在楚爾特的職位感覺像是對她勇氣的考驗，但對她的許多下屬來說，感覺像是流放。要塞由一位名叫格魯塔·哈爾斯多蒂爾（LN女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature knight||騎士}）的城堡主、三名下士（{@creature Veteran||老兵}）和五十四名士兵（{@creature Guard||警衛}）組成。要塞分為三個八小時的輪班，每個輪班有一個{@creature Veteran||下士}（護手）和十八名{@creature Guard||私人的}（拳頭）值班。

english: Unknown to her boss, Liara is in league with pirates based out of Jahaka Anchorage and earns a tidy profit from their exploits. Liara's spies in Port Nyanzaru furnish her with ship manifests and departure schedules, which she passes to the pirates via a {@item Sending Stones||sending stone}; the pirate captain {@creature Zaroum Al-Saryak|ToA} holds the matching stone (see "{@area Jahaka Anchorage|130|x}"). Because of their arrangement, the pirates agreed to Portyr's demand that they never attack ships flying the flag of Baldur's Gate. Liara receives a cut of the pirate's profits, some of which goes toward paying bonuses to her garrison to keep the soldiers happy.
zh_tw: 莉爾阿與賈哈卡錨地的海盜有勾結，她的上司並不知道這一點，她從海盜的掠奪中獲得了可觀的利潤。莉爾阿在南扎路港的間諜為她提供了船隻的清單和離港時間表，她透過一個{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}將這些資訊傳遞給海盜；海盜船長{@creature Zaroum Al-Saryak|ToA|扎如姆·艾薩亞克}持有匹配的石頭（見"{@area 賈哈卡錨地|130|x}"）。由於他們的安排，海盜同意了波提爾的要求，即永遠不攻擊懸掛博德之門旗幟的船隻。莉爾阿從海盜的利潤中分得一杯羹，其中一部分用於支付給她的守軍獎金，以保持士兵們的快樂。

english: Although she's a villain of sorts, {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} has no reason to be an enemy to the characters. She spends most of her time managing the security of her stronghold, going over field reports, and sifting through reports from her spies in Port Nyanzaru. She admires adventurers, and as long as the characters do nothing to antagonize her, she can provide them with useful advice and material aid against the myriad threats lurking in the jungle.
zh_tw: 儘管{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}算是某種反派，但她沒有理由成為角色們的敵人。她大部分時間都花在管理她的要塞安全、審查戰地報告以及篩選來自南扎路港間諜的報告上。她欽佩冒險家，只要角色們沒有做出挑釁她的行為，她可以為他們提供有用的建議和物質援助，以對抗潛伏在叢林中的無數威脅。

english: Liara is puzzled by reports coming from her patrols to the south. They've crossed the trails of large creatures in the jungle that don't match anything known to live in Chult. If the characters are planning to explore the region between the east coast and the River Tiryki, or they've already been there and seen anything unusual, she'd be grateful for any light they can shed on the mystery. (Her patrols are seeing signs of the frost giants searching for {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}.)
zh_tw: 莉爾阿對她的巡邏隊從南方帶回的報告感到困惑。他們在叢林中發現了大型生物的蹤跡，這些生物與已知生活在楚爾特的任何生物都不匹配。如果角色們計劃探索東海岸和提爾基河之間的區域，或者他們已經去過那裡並看到了任何異常情況，她將對他們能提供的任何關於這個神秘現象的資訊表示感謝。（她的巡邏隊發現了霜巨人尋找{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}的跡象。）

english: Given that Baldur's Gate is a member of the Lords' Alliance, it should surprise no one that a handful of alliance operatives are sprinkled through the garrison. The Emerald Enclave has expert guides stationed here as well. One of them, a druid named {@creature Qawasha|ToA} (see "{@adventure Finding a Guide|ToA|1|Qawasha and Kupalué}"), comes highly recommended.
zh_tw: 鑑於博德之門是領主聯盟的成員，要塞中散佈著一些聯盟特工，這不足為奇。翡翠盟約也在這裡設有專家嚮導。其中一位名叫{@creature Qawasha|ToA|卡瓦沙}（見"{@adventure 尋找嚮導|ToA|1|Qawasha and Kupalué}"）的德魯伊非常受推崇。

english: The main reason adventurers have for visiting Fort Beluarian is to buy a "charter of exploration." Baldur's Gate lays claim to everything east of the Mistcliff and north of Kitcher's Inlet, and now that Mezro is picked clean, it's trying to extend its claim south to Refuge Bay. No one (including the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru) has the force in Chult to dispute this claim. So within its territory, the Flaming Fist does as it pleases, including demanding that explorers buy charters. A charter grants permission to the holder to explore Chult and plunder its riches, but half of an expedition's proceeds and discoveries must be turned over to the Flaming Fist. The charter costs 50 gp, which is treated as a down payment on the split of profits. In addition, those who buy a charter can hire up to six Flaming Fist mercenaries ({@creature Guard||guards}) to accompany them for the very reasonable rate of 1 gp per tenday each. It's easy enough to launch an expedition from Port Nyanzaru without a charter. The only risk is that if a Flaming Fist patrol runs into an expedition without a charter, it will attack the expedition and confiscate its gear.
zh_tw: 冒險家們訪問貝路利安堡的主要原因是購買"探險許可證"。博德之門聲稱擁有迷霧崖以東和基徹爾灣以北的所有地區，並且由於梅茲羅已經被徹底搜刮一空，它現在正試圖將其主張擴充套件到南部的避難灣。沒有人（包括南扎路港的商王）在楚爾特擁有足夠的力量來爭議這一主張。因此，在它的領土內，焰拳為所欲為，包括要求探險家購買許可證。許可證授予持有人探索楚爾特並掠奪其財富的許可，但探險隊收益和發現的一半必須交給焰拳。許可證的費用是50金幣，被視為利潤分成的首付。此外，購買許可證的人可以以每旬每人1金幣的合理價格僱傭多達六名焰拳僱傭兵（{@creature Guard||警衛}）陪同他們。沒有許可證也可以很容易地從南扎路港發起探險隊。唯一的風險是，如果焰拳的巡邏隊遇到沒有許可證的探險隊，它將攻擊探險隊並沒收其裝備。

english: Everything being shipped in or out of the fort goes through Beluarian Landing, which is nothing more than a stretch of beach with a few log buildings above the tide line. Ships anchor a half-mile offshore, and people and supplies are ferried back and forth on rowboats. Six Flaming Fist {@creature Guard||guards} defend this station; their chief duty is rowing the boats back and forth. In case of danger, they can barricade themselves inside the stoutest log building or row out to sea until whatever threatens them loses interest and wanders away.
zh_tw: 進出要塞的所有物資都要經過貝盧阿瑞安登陸點，這裡不過是一段海灘，上面有幾座木製建築位於潮線之上。船隻停泊在離岸半英里的地方，人們和物資透過划艇來回擺渡。六名焰拳{@creature Guard||警衛}保衛著這個站點；他們的主要任務是來回划船。遇到危險時，他們可以把自己封鎖在最堅固的木製建築內，或者划船出海，直到威脅他們的東西失去興趣並離開。

english: The trek from Beluarian Landing to the fort is 14 miles along a well-marked trail. This trail is not patrolled.
zh_tw: 從貝盧阿瑞安登陸點到要塞的徒步旅行是沿著一條標記清晰的小徑進行的，全程14英里。這條小徑沒有巡邏。

english: Map 2.7: Fort Beluarian
zh_tw: 地圖 2.7: 貝路利安堡

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. West Gate
zh_tw: 1. 西門

english: The main entrance is closed by two massive wooden doors with bars that take eight people to slide aside. Because the area is patrolled and the fort has excellent all-round lines of sight, the gates stand open during the day, except when heavy rain restricts visibility and allows the possibility of a sneak attack. The western gatehouse walls are 20 feet high, and the parapets are patrolled day and night by six {@creature Guard||guards}. The walls ringing the rest of the camp are 12 feet high, but they look higher from outside because of the fort's elevation.
zh_tw: 主入口由兩扇巨大的木門和需要八個人才能推開的橫杆關閉。由於該區域有巡邏，並且要塞擁有極佳的全方位視線，大門在白天通常是敞開的，除非大雨限制了能見度並允許偷襲的可能性。西門樓的牆壁高達20尺，六個{@creature Guard||警衛}日夜在城牆上巡邏。環繞營地其餘部分的牆壁高12尺，但由於要塞的地勢較高，從外面看它們看起來更高。

english: 2. Ore Gate
zh_tw: 2. 礦石門

english: Despite its name, this secondary gate on the south wall of the fort has nothing to do with ore. It's a sally port the fort's defenders can use to launch counterattacks against enemies assailing the main gate. It stays solidly closed and barred most of the time.
zh_tw: 儘管有這個名字，要塞南牆上的這個次要大門與礦石無關。這是一個出擊口，要塞的防禦者可以用它來對攻擊主門的敵人發起反擊。它大部分時間都是牢固關閉並上閂的。

english: 3. Armorer/Weaponsmith
zh_tw: 3. 盔甲匠/武器匠

english: The iron mines of Chult provide everything the garrison needs to make weapons, armor, and metal tools and implements. Korhie Donadrue (LG male Chondathan human {@creature spy}) is the chief armorer for the fort. Having spent years as an adventurer himself before becoming a smith, he enjoys having adventurers and explorers spend time in his work area, swapping tales and sharing news of the world.
zh_tw: 楚爾特的鐵礦為守軍提供了製造武器、盔甲和金屬工具及器具所需的一切。柯希·多納德魯（LG男性瓊達斯人人類{@creature spy||間諜}）是堡壘的首席鐵匠。他曾在成為一名鐵匠之前多年作為冒險家，因此他喜歡有冒險家和探險者在他的工作區花時間，交換故事並分享世界新聞。

english: Characters can buy most types of weapons, ammunition, and armor here, at prices 25 percent above those listed in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Donadrue would charge them less, but the prices are set by the Flaming Fist.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在這裡購買大部分型別的武器、彈藥和盔甲，價格比《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》中列出的高出25%。多納德魯本可以給他們更便宜的價格，但價格是由焰拳設定的。

english: 4. Bazaar
zh_tw: 4. 市集

english: A dozen traders live within the fort and manage its bazaar. Soldiers from the fort are only a tiny part of their business. Most of their trade involves selling gear to explorers and supplies to miners. The traders also buy and sell gems, hides, animal parts (feathers, teeth, and so forth), and small animals. Their prices are 50 percent higher than those in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, due to the remoteness of the station.
zh_tw: 有十幾個商人居住在堡壘內並管理著它的集市。來自堡壘的士兵只是他們生意的一小部分。他們的大部分貿易涉及向探險者出售裝備和向礦工提供補給。這些商人還買賣寶石、毛皮、動物部件（羽毛、牙齒等）以及小動物。由於駐地的偏遠，他們的價格比{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的價格高出50%。

english: 5. Temple of Helm
zh_tw: 5. 海爾姆神廟

english: Fort dwellers pray to Helm for protection against the dangers of the land. Shilau M'wenye (LN male Chultan human {@creature priest}) is in charge of the temple and accepts donations. His father was a Chultan priest, and his mother was a Shou mercenary posted in Chult. He always tries to see the best in other people without judging them.
zh_tw: 要塞居民向海爾姆祈禱，以求得對抗這片土地上危險的保護。希勞·姆溫耶（LN男性楚爾特人類{@creature priest||祭司}）負責管理神廟並接受捐贈。他的父親是一位楚爾特牧師，母親是一位駐紮在楚爾特的壽族僱傭兵。他總是盡力看到別人最好的一面，而不對他們進行評判。

english: 6. Stables
zh_tw: 6. 馬廄

english: Horses aren't native to Chult, and the climate (and its many pests) are hard on the animals. Still, a few Tethyrian members of the Flaming Fist brought their horses to Fort Beluarian with them, and they're now a part of the culture of the fort. The horses seldom leave the immediate vicinity of the fort; they're all but useless in the jungle.
zh_tw: 馬匹並非楚爾特的原生動物，而且這裡的氣候（以及眾多害蟲）對這些動物來說很嚴苛。儘管如此，一些來自泰瑟爾人的焰拳成員還是帶著他們的馬匹來到了貝路利安堡，現在它們已成為堡壘文化的一部分。這些馬匹很少離開堡壘附近的區域；在叢林中它們幾乎無用。

english: The stable has stalls for a dozen horses. Only seven are stabled there now (two {@creature Riding Horse||riding horses} and five unarmored {@creature Warhorse||warhorses}).
zh_tw: 馬廄有十幾個馬廄。現在只有七匹馬在馬廄裡（兩匹{@creature Riding Horse||乘用馬}和五匹未裝備盔甲的{@creature Warhorse||戰馬}）。

english: The stablemaster is Thaeven the Bald (N male Tethyrian human {@creature commoner} with {@skill Animal Handling} +4). He takes excellent care of the animals, to the extent that's possible in this climate, while complaining constantly about the impossibility of taking proper care of horses in this climate.
zh_tw: 馬廄管理員是禿頭塞文（N男性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature commoner||平民}，具有{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸} +4）。在這個氣候下，他儘可能地照顧動物，同時不斷地抱怨在這個氣候下無法妥善照顧馬匹。

english: 7. Jousting Field
zh_tw: 7. 馬上比武場

english: The main reason horses are kept at the fort is for jousting. Tournaments are held once a month, and lesser bouts occur when enough people have time off or when two Flaming Fist members have an issue to settle between them.
zh_tw: 在要塞養馬的主要原因是為了比武。每月舉行一次錦標賽，當足夠多的人有休息時間，或者當兩名焰拳成員之間有需要解決的問題時，也會舉行較小規模的比賽。

english: Tethyrian soldiers stationed at Fort Beluarian brought their chivalric panoply and pageantry with them, but they've combined it with a jungle aesthetic to create something unique. The usual symbols involving falcons, dragons, suns, and so forth give way in Chult to leopard-skin tabards, dinosaur-themed heraldry, helmets shaped like snarling panthers or swooping pteranodons, and armor bedecked with tyrannosaurus teeth and parrot feathers.
zh_tw: 駐紮在貝路利安堡的泰瑟爾人士兵帶來了他們的騎士盔甲和儀式，但他們將其與叢林美學相結合，創造出了獨特的東西。通常涉及獵鷹、龍、太陽等象徵的圖案在楚爾特讓位於豹皮斗篷、恐龍主題紋章、形狀像咆哮的豹子或俯衝的翼手龍的頭盔，以及裝飾有暴龍牙齒和鸚鵡羽毛的盔甲。

english: Wealthy merchants from Port Nyanzaru sometimes make the journey to attend the jousting tournaments. They camp around the fort in colorful pavilions and place outrageous bets on the outcomes of matches.
zh_tw: 來自南扎路港的富有商人有時會特意前來參加比武錦標賽。他們在要塞周圍搭建色彩斑斕的帳篷，並在比賽結果上下重注。

english: Agents of the Flaming Fist
zh_tw: 赤拳代理人

english: If the adventurers spend a day in Fort Beluarian, {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} becomes aware of them and dispatches a guard to bring them to the great hall (area 10C). Adventurers who refuse the summons are banished from the fort. Those who agree to meet with Liara are asked to serve the Flaming Fist. For each service they perform, the characters receive a reward. Characters who decline to serve the Flaming Fist are welcome to continue about their business, but anything they wish to buy in Fort Beluarian costs five times the normal price from that point on.
zh_tw: 如果冒險家們在貝路利安堡逗留一天，{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}會注意到他們，並派遣一名守衛將他們帶到大廳（區域10C）。拒絕召喚的冒險家將被驅逐出要塞。那些同意與莉爾阿會面的冒險家將被要求為焰拳服務。對於他們所執行的每項服務，角色們會收到獎勵。拒絕為焰拳服務的角色可以繼續他們的事務，但從那時起，他們在貝路利安堡購買的任何東西的價格將是正常價格的五倍。

english: Ghoul Hunters.
zh_tw: 食屍鬼獵人

english: Portyr asks the characters to help rid the jungle of ghouls. If the characters are up to the task, Portyr gives the party a free charter of exploration. For every severed ghoul head the characters bring her, she'll pay them 20 gp. (She has enough money to cover the reward for up to eleven severed ghoul heads.)
zh_tw: 波提爾請求角色們幫助清除叢林中的食屍鬼。如果角色們願意接受這項任務，波提爾將免費給隊伍一個探險許可證。角色們每帶給她一個割下的食屍鬼頭，她將支付他們20金幣。（她有足夠的錢支付多達十一個割下的食屍鬼頭的獎勵。）

english: Shilku Reconnaissance.
zh_tw: 希爾庫偵察

english: Portyr asks the characters to set sail for Shilku Bay, conduct a one-week reconnaissance of the destroyed village of Shilku, and return to Fort Beluarian to report what they've seen. If the characters accept the mission, Portyr pays for their food and passage and gives the party a free charter of exploration. If they complete the mission, the characters are given free meals and guest rooms (see area 10J) whenever they visit Fort Beluarian, and each character receives one potion or scroll chosen from the ones available in the stores (see area 10G).
zh_tw: 波提爾要求角色們前往希爾庫灣，對被摧毀的希爾庫村莊進行為期一週的偵察，並返回貝路利安堡報告他們所見到的情況。如果角色們接受這項任務，波提爾將支付他們的食物和交通費用，並免費給隊伍一個探險許可證。如果他們完成任務，每次訪問貝路利安堡時，角色們將獲得免費餐食和客房（見區域10J），並且每個角色將從倉庫中可獲得一種藥水或卷軸（見區域10G）。

english: Strangers in a Strange Land.
zh_tw: 在陌生之地的陌生人。

english: Flaming Fist scouts have spotted giant footprints south of Fort Beluarian. If the characters find out who or what is making the tracks, and discover where they're coming from and what threat (if any) they pose to Fort Beluarian, Portyr will reward them with five magic arrows (see area 10G). If the characters accept the mission, Portyr gives the party a free charter of exploration. To complete the mission, the characters must locate at least one group of frost giants as well as their longship (see "{@area Hvalspyd|12b|x}"). To complicate matters, Portyr doesn't believe any report that claims frost giants have landed in Chult and won't pay up unless the characters back up their claims with compelling evidence (such as a frost giant's severed head or a giant-sized weapon).
zh_tw: 焰拳的偵察兵在貝路利安堡南部發現了巨大的腳印。如果角色們找出是誰或什麼東西留下了這些蹤跡，並發現它們的來源以及它們對貝路利安堡構成的威脅（如果有的話），波提爾將會用五支魔法箭作為獎勵（見區域10G）。如果角色們接受了任務，波提爾會給予隊伍一份免費的探索許可證。為了完成任務，角色們必須找到至少一群霜巨人以及他們的長船（見"{@area 瓦爾斯皮德|12b|x}"）。使事情複雜化的是，波提爾不相信任何聲稱霜巨人已在楚爾特登陸的報告，除非角色們用令人信服的證據支援他們的說法（例如霜巨人的斷頭或巨人大小的武器），否則他不會支付。

english: 8. Flaming Fist Provisioner
zh_tw: 8. 焰拳供應站

english: The fort provisioner, or sutler, is a store that serves the soldiers of the Flaming Fist exclusively. It doesn't have much variety and the prices aren't great, but some elements of the garrison appreciate its "no civilians allowed" policy. It sells basic necessities during the day and serves food and drink in the evening. The store is run by a sharp-tongued old man named Jaro (NG male Chultan human {@creature commoner}).
zh_tw: 堡壘的供應官，或稱為軍需官，是一家專門服務於赤拳士兵的商店。它的品種不多，價格也不理想，但是一些守軍成員欣賞它的"不允許平民進入"的政策。商店在白天銷售基本必需品，並在晚上提供食物和飲料。這家商店由一個名叫加羅（NG男性楚爾特人類{@creature commoner||平民}）的尖刻老人經營。

english: 9. Flaming Fist Barracks
zh_tw: 9. 焰拳團軍營

english: The barracks are the sleeping, eating, and general getting-out-of-the-rain space for the fort's enlisted garrison.
zh_tw: 兵營是堡壘中徵召守軍的睡覺、吃飯以及一般避雨的空間。

english: On particularly stifling nights, many soldiers abandon the barracks and sling hammocks in the guard towers. The breeze atop the walls provides some cooling and relief from insects.
zh_tw: 在特別悶熱的夜晚，許多士兵會離開兵營，在守望塔裡吊起吊床。城牆頂部的微風提供了一些涼爽和緩解昆蟲騷擾的效果。

english: 10. Inner Bailey
zh_tw: 10. 內堡

english: This bastion is a fort within a fort. The bailey is 20 feet tall at the peak of the roof, and the attached palisade is 16 feet high, so the whole structure can be seen from outside Fort Beluarian. The gates are always open unless the fort is under attack or patrols have reported unusual amounts of undead in the neighborhood. In the event that the outer wall is breached and the main enclosure overrun, the garrison would retreat to this redoubt for its final defense.
zh_tw: 這個堡壘是要塞內的堡壘。在屋頂的頂峰，圍場高達20尺，附加的柵欄高達16尺，因此整個結構可以從貝路利安堡外部看到。除非要塞受到攻擊或巡邏隊報告附近有不尋常數量的不死生物，否則大門總是敞開的。如果外牆被突破，主圍場被攻佔，駐軍將撤退到這個防禦工事進行最後的防禦。

english: 10A. Courtyard
zh_tw: 10A. 庭院

english: The bailey's central courtyard is open to the sky. It can be sealed off with heavy gates and stoutly defended by even a handful of soldiers. A boardwalk is installed around the courtyard, so people don't need to walk in the mud when rain pours down.
zh_tw: 城堡的中心庭院是露天的。它可以用沉重的大門封閉，並且即使只有少數士兵也能堅固地防守。庭院周圍安裝了木板人行道，這樣下雨時人們就不必在泥濘中行走。

english: A wooden statue of an armored man stands in the middle of the courtyard. The statue portrays Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate, leader of the Flaming Fist.
zh_tw: 庭院中央矗立著一座木製雕像，雕像刻畫的是一位身穿盔甲的男子。這座雕像描繪的是博德之門的領袖，赤拳的領導者，大公爵烏爾德·瑞文嘉德。

english: 10B. Raptor Pen
zh_tw: 10B. 猛禽籠

english: Six {@creature Hadrosaurus|VGM|hadrosauruses} and four {@creature Deinonychus|VGM|deinonychuses} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for both creatures' statistics) are housed in protected stables. The hadrosauruses serve as mounts for small, fast-moving patrols or as pack animals for larger, longer patrols. The deinonychuses are used for hunting—like dogs, only far more vicious. These animals are well respected by the soldiers of the garrison.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature Hadrosaurus|VGM|鴨嘴龍}和四隻{@creature Deinonychus|VGM|恐爪龍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}，瞭解這兩種生物的具體數值）被安置在受保護的馬廄中。鴨嘴龍用作小規模、快速移動的巡邏隊伍的坐騎或作為較大規模、更長時間的巡邏隊伍的馱獸。恐爪龍用於狩獵——像狗一樣，只是要兇猛得多。這些動物受到要塞士兵的高度尊重。

english: The head trainer for the fort's reptiles is Rahl Zuberi (CG male human Chultan {@creature tribal warrior} with {@skill Animal Handling} +4). His face and arms are covered in tattoos and scars, and he's missing half of his right hand; tooth marks are still clearly visible in the scar tissue. Despite Rahl's ferocious appearance, he's a jovial prankster who spends most of his off-duty time telling wild stories at the provisioner or one of the ale tents in the bazaar, in exchange for free drinks.
zh_tw: 堡壘爬行動物的首席訓練師是拉爾·祖貝里（CG男性人類楚爾特 {@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}，具有{@skill Animal Handling||馴獸} +4技能）。他的臉部和手臂上佈滿了紋身和傷疤，並且他失去了右手的一半；疤痕組織中仍然清晰可見的齒痕。儘管拉爾外表兇猛，他實際上是個快樂的惡作劇者，大部分休息時間都在供應處或集市中的一個啤酒帳篷裡講述狂野的故事，以換取免費飲料。

english: 10C. Hall
zh_tw: 10C. 大廳

english: The great hall of the bailey is where most of the fort's military business is conducted, and where {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) meets important visitors. It resembles a hunting lodge, with dinosaur heads and skulls mounted on the walls and the pelts of exotic animals hung like tapestries.
zh_tw: 圍場的大廳是進行大部分軍事事務的地方，也是{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）會見重要訪客的地方。它看起來像一個狩獵小屋，牆上掛著恐龍頭和頭骨，以及像掛毯一樣掛著的異國動物的毛皮。

english: Liara carries a set of keys to the locked storeroom doors (area 10G) and the iron strongbox in her quarters (area 10I). If the characters meet with her, she offers them one or more special quests (see the "Agents of the Flaming Fist" sidebar).
zh_tw: 莉爾阿持有通向鎖著的儲藏室門（區域10G）和她住處的鐵製保險箱（區域10I）的一串鑰匙。如果角色們與她會面，她會為他們提供一項或多項特殊任務（見"焰拳的代理人"側邊欄）。

english: 10D. Kitchen
zh_tw: 10D. 廚房

english: This kitchen serves the camp officers and guests, and prepares special meals during feasts. The enlisted troops are largely responsible for preparing their own food by squads; most of that is handled in the barracks area.
zh_tw: 這個廚房為營地的軍官和客人服務，並在節日期間準備特殊餐食。列兵主要由小隊自己負責準備自己的食物；大部分工作在兵營區域進行。

english: Sigbeorn Dunebar (NG male Illuskan human {@creature veteran}) has logged more years in Chult than any other living member of the Flaming Fist, and he loves it. When he grew too old for fighting and patrolling in the jungle, he volunteered to transfer to the kitchen. Now he's not only the head cook but, more important, is responsible (under the castellan) for ensuring the fort always has an adequate food supply.
zh_tw: 西格比約恩·沙丘（NG男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）在楚爾特度過的年頭超過了任何其他活著的赤拳成員，並且他非常喜歡這裡。當他年紀太大，不再適合在叢林中戰鬥和巡邏時，他自願轉到了廚房。現在，他不僅是主廚，更重要的是，在指揮官的領導下，他負責確保堡壘始終有充足的食物供應。

english: 10E. Castellan
zh_tw: 10E. 城堡指揮官

english: The castellan of Fort Beluarian is Gruta Halsdottir (LN female Illuskan human {@creature knight}). As castellan, she's second in command to {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}, and she's responsible for every detail of the day-to-day functioning of the fort. If a soldier breaks the rules, Gruta decides on the punishment. If a patrol is overdue from the jungle, it's her duty to find out why. When strangers arrive, Gruta is the one who greets them, finds out why they're here, and decides whether they deserve any of {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}'s time.
zh_tw: 貝路利安堡的城堡主是格魯塔·哈爾斯多蒂爾（LN女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature knight||騎士}）。作為城堡主，她是{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}的第二指揮官，負責要塞日常運作的每一個細節。如果士兵違反規定，格魯塔決定懲罰。如果巡邏隊在叢林中遲遲未歸，找出原因是她的職責。當陌生人到達時，格魯塔是迎接他們、瞭解他們來意並決定他們是否值得{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}時間的人。

english: This chamber is Gruta's office; her sleeping quarters are upstairs. Her duties take her all over the fort, so she's not often here during the day. She carries one set of keys to the locked storeroom doors (area 10G).
zh_tw: 這個房間是格魯塔的辦公室；她的臥室在樓上。她的職責讓她在堡壘中到處跑，所以她白天通常不在這裡。她持有一套鑰匙，可以開啟儲藏室的門（區域10G）。

english: 10F. Bell Tower
zh_tw: 10F. 鐘樓

english: The bell tower rises another 10 feet above the thatched roof of the bailey, making it 30 feet tall overall. In a normal day, the bell is rung twelve times: it's rung every four hours to signal the change of watch, and it's rung 10 minutes before each of those to signal that a change of watch is about to occur. At the change of the watch, it's rung a number of times equaling the number of the watch: once at the start of the first watch, twice at the start of the second watch, and so forth. On what the garrison calls "the wake-ups," it rings once.
zh_tw: 鐘樓在圍場的茅草屋頂上方又高出10尺，總體高度達到30尺。在平常的一天中，鍾會敲響十二次：每四小時敲響一次，以標誌換崗，每次換崗前10分鐘也會敲響，以訊號即將換崗。在換崗時，鍾會根據崗次敲響相應次數：第一次崗開始時敲響一次，第二次崗開始時敲響兩次，以此類推。在要塞所稱的"喚醒時刻"，鍾會敲響一次。

english: In the event of a camp-wide alarm, the bell is rung continuously for at least a half-minute. The tolling can be heard from 2 miles away by creatures in the open, or 1 mile by creatures in the jungle.
zh_tw: 如果營地範圍內發生警報，警鐘會連續敲響至少半分鐘。在開闊地帶的生物可以聽到2英里外的鐘聲，而在叢林中的生物則可以聽到1英里外的鐘聲。

english: 10G. Stores
zh_tw: 10G. 倉庫

english: Reserves of vital supplies are kept under lock and key in these two chambers. The door to each room is locked, and {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} and Gruta Halsdottir carry the only keys. Each door is made heavy wood reinforced with iron bands (AC 17, 20 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage), and its lock can be picked with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 重要物資儲備被鎖在這兩個房間內。每個房間的門都上了鎖，只有{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}和格魯塔·哈爾斯多蒂爾持有鑰匙。每扇門由厚重的木材製成，並用鐵條加固（AC 17，20點生命值，免疫毒素和心靈傷害），其鎖可以透過{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}和一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定撬開。

english: The types of supplies stored here include mundane items such as paper and ink, locks, clothing, boots, rope, lanterns, lamp oil, and candles.
zh_tw: 這裡存放的物資包括諸如紙張和墨水、鎖具、衣物、靴子、繩索、燈籠、燈油和蠟燭等普通物品。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The second room contains four {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}, four {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} (two each of {@spell lesser restoration} and {@spell purify food and drink}), five {@item +1 Arrow||+1 arrows} in a quiver, and a {@item bowl of commanding water elementals} (to aid in any last-ditch defense of the fort). Portyr and Halsdottir don't blab about these treasures to adventurers, no matter how trustworthy they seem.
zh_tw: 第二個房間包含四瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}，四個{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（兩個{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}和兩個{@spell purify food and drink||淨化飲食}），一個箭袋中有五支{@item +1 Arrow||+1 箭矢}，以及一個{@item bowl of commanding water elementals||命令水元素水缽}（用於要塞的最後防線）。波提爾和哈爾斯多蒂爾不會向冒險家透露這些寶藏，無論他們看起來多麼可靠。

english: 10H. Gauntlets' Room
zh_tw: 10H. 鐵手套房間

english: This ready room was intended to house a squad of soldiers assigned to regular guard duty in the bailey, but it's been taken over as quarters by Sigbeorn Dunebar (see {@area area 10D|102|x}) and three other {@creature Veteran||veterans} who serve as corporals (gauntlets) in the Flaming Fist garrison.
zh_tw: 這個待命室原本打算作為分配給城堡內定期守衛任務的小隊士兵的住房，但它已被西格比約恩·沙丘（見{@area 區域10D|102|x}）和其他三名在赤拳守軍中擔任下士（手銬）的{@creature Veteran||老兵}接管作為他們的宿舍。

english: 10I. Command Quarters
zh_tw: 10I. 指揮區

english: {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} sleeps in the southern chamber, while Gruta Halsdottir sleeps in the smaller, southeastern chamber. Both rooms contain books, clothes, and other personal effects.
zh_tw: {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾} 睡在南邊的房間裡，而格魯塔·哈爾斯多蒂爾睡在更小的東南房間裡。兩個房間都包含書籍、衣服和其他個人物品。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who searches under the bed in {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}'s chamber finds a locked iron strongbox. A character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and succeeding on a {@dc 18} Dexterity check can pop it open. The box contains 220 gp and a {@item Sending Stones||sending stone} that Liara uses to communicate with the pirates of Jahaka Anchorage.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果在{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}的床下搜尋，會發現一個上鎖的鐵製保險箱。使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過{@dc 18}敏捷檢定成功的角色可以將其撬開。箱子裡有220枚金幣和一塊{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}，莉亞拉用它來與賈哈卡錨地的海盜們聯絡。

english: 10J. Guest Quarters
zh_tw: 10J. 客房

english: Important guests sometimes come to the fort: a merchant prince from Port Nyanzaru, a high-ranking officer of the Flaming Fist, or a noble from Baldur's Gate. Such individuals are housed in one or more of these chambers.
zh_tw: 重要的客人有時會來到要塞：來自南扎路港的商王，焰拳的高階軍官，或博德之門的貴族。這些人會被安排在這些房間中的一個或多個住宿。

english: Characters might be given the use of one or more of these rooms if they do something to earn that privilege. Examples include turning over a valuable discovery to the Flaming Fist, leading a counterattack against assaulting undead, or bringing proof that they drove off an incursion by frost giants.
zh_tw: 如果角色們做了一些事情來贏得這項特權，他們可能會被提供使用一個或多個這些房間。例子包括將有價值的發現交給赤拳，領導反擊攻擊的不死生物，或者帶來證據證明他們擊退了霜巨人的入侵。

english: Heart of Ubtao
zh_tw: 烏塔歐之心

english: A massive chunk of earth and rock torn from the earth drifts over the swampy forest, about two hundred feet above the ground. A petrified tree towers above the stone, with its stone roots protruding from the bottom. Between the shape of the rock and the branching of the tree's limbs, it creates the impression of a gigantic stone heart hanging in the sky. The impression is only made more gruesome by the red liquid dripping from the roots.
zh_tw: 一大塊從地面撕裂出來的泥土和岩石在沼澤森林上方漂浮，距離地面約兩百尺。一棵石化的樹高聳在石頭上方，其石化的樹根從底部伸出。岩石的形狀和樹枝的分叉，給人一種巨大的石心懸掛在天空中的印象。樹根滴下的紅色液體使得這種印象更加陰森。

english: You see a cave mouth in the side of the slowly rotating "heart," and a staircase winding from the cave up to the flattened top where the petrified tree stands. The staircase definitely isn't natural; it was carved with tools into the rock.
zh_tw: 你在緩慢旋轉的"心臟"一側看到了一個洞穴口，還有一條從洞穴蜿蜒至石化樹所在的平坦頂部的樓梯。樓梯絕對不是自然形成的；它是用工具雕刻在岩石上的。

english: The Heart of Ubtao (map 2.8) is an earthmote—a massive chunk of earth held aloft by magic that can't be dispelled. It hovers 200 feet above the ground and rotates slowly counterclockwise, completing one revolution every hour. Chultans call it the Heart of Ubtao because the earthmote is vaguely heart-shaped, and the petrified tree adds the impression of veins and arteries. The dripping red liquid is rainwater that was stained by filtering through iron ore deposits in the rock.
zh_tw: 烏塔歐之心（地圖2.8）是一個土元素體——一大塊被魔法懸浮在空中，無法被解除的土壤。它距離地面200尺，並緩慢地逆時針旋轉，每小時完成一次旋轉。楚爾特人稱其為烏塔歐之心，因為土元素體形狀模糊地像心臟，並且石化的樹木增添了靜脈和動脈的印象。滴下的紅色液體是雨水，它透過岩石中的鐵礦床過濾後被染色。

english: Chultans who've seen the earthmote believe it's actually the petrified heart of the god Ubtao, and they consider it sacred. Priests of Ubtao used to travel here on the backs of flying dinosaurs to seek visions inside the heart and to beseech Ubtao to return. Many Chultans would be incensed to learn that the Heart of Ubtao has become the lair of an undead monster.
zh_tw: 見過土元素體的楚爾特人相信它實際上是神烏博濤的石化心臟，並且他們認為它是神聖的。烏博濤的祭司們過去常常騎著飛行恐龍來到這裡，在心臟內尋求異象，並懇求烏博濤迴歸。如果許多楚爾特人得知烏塔歐之心已經變成了一個不死生物的巢穴，他們會感到非常憤怒。

english: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} works for Szass Tam, the most powerful lich among the Red Wizards of Thay, though she is not a Red Wizard herself. She found the heart and converted it into a base to use while her minions search for the Soulmonger. Her orders from Szass Tam are to seize control of the Soulmonger, if possible, or destroy it otherwise. Valindra created a {@spell teleportation circle} inside the heart that she uses to travel instantly to and from Thay (where her phylactery is safely stored), to deliver reports to Szass Tam and pick up new instructions.
zh_tw: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}為薩扎斯坦工作，薩扎斯坦是泰伊紅袍法師中最強大的巫妖，儘管瓦琳朵拉本人並不是紅袍法師。她發現了這顆心臟並將其改造成了一個基地，供她的手下在尋找噬魂器時使用。她從薩扎斯坦那裡接到的命令是，如果可能的話，奪取噬魂器的控制權，否則就將其摧毀。瓦琳朵拉在心臟內部建立了一個{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}，她用它來瞬間往返於泰伊（她的聖物被安全地存放在那裡），向薩扎斯坦彙報並獲取新指示。

english: Characters who explore the Heart of Ubtao are certain to meet Valindra. She's considered the possibility that adventurers might cross her path, and she won't necessarily be hostile toward them. Her mission is to seize the Soulmonger by any means; if adventurers can help her achieve that, she'll use them.
zh_tw: 探索烏塔歐之心的角色肯定會遇見瓦琳朵拉。她考慮過冒險者們的目標可能與她相同，所以她不一定對他們懷有敵意。她的任務是以任何方式拿下易魂裝置；如果冒險者可以幫助她實現這一目標，她會利用他們。

english: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|Valindra} is an elven {@creature lich}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉} 是一位精靈{@creature lich||巫妖}，具有以下變化：

english: Valindra is neutral evil.
zh_tw: 瓦琳朵拉是中立邪惡的。

english: She speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Infernal.
zh_tw: 她會說深淵語、通用語、龍語、矮人語、精靈語和地獄語。

english: When preparing her spells, Valindra can swap out any spell on her list of prepared spells for another wizard spell of the same level.
zh_tw: 準備她的法術時，瓦琳朵拉可以將她的已準備法術列表上的任何法術替換為同一環階的另一個法師法術。

english: As a bonus action, Valindra can mask her shriveled flesh and appear to be a living elf. This magical illusion lasts until she ends it as a bonus action or until she uses her Frightening Gaze legendary action. The effect also ends if Valindra drops to 30 hit points or fewer, or if {@spell dispel magic} is cast on her.
zh_tw: 作為附贈行動，瓦琳朵拉可以掩飾她的乾癟肉體，看起來就像一位活著的精靈。這種魔法幻象持續至她使用附贈動作結束，或直到她使用她的傳奇動作恐懼凝視。如果瓦琳朵拉的 HP 下降到 30 或更少，或者如果在她身上施放一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}，該效應也會結束。

english: She can't take lair actions in the Heart of Ubtao.
zh_tw: 她無法在烏塔歐之心中採取巢穴行動。

english: With her ability to appear as a living elf, Valindra can easily conceal her lichdom and her association to Thay. She presents herself as a scholarly wizard who wants to "imprison" the Soulmonger; that way, its unique magic can be studied while it's safely quarantined from the world. She argues that destroying it should be a last resort.
zh_tw: 憑藉她那和活著的精靈一樣的外貌，瓦琳朵拉可以很容易地隱藏她的巫妖特徵以及她與塞爾的聯絡。她自己表現地像是一位想要"封印"易魂裝置的大法師；這樣，她就可以在安全地與世界相隔離的同時研究其獨特的魔力。她認為，摧毀它應該是最後的手段。

english: Valindra believes that the Soulmonger is hidden somewhere in the ruins of Omu. She shares this information with the characters even if she suspects they'll betray her down the road, because in the meantime, they might weaken some of Omu's defenses.
zh_tw: 瓦琳朵拉相信噬魂器隱藏在奧穆遺蹟的某個地方。即使她懷疑角色們將來可能會背叛她，她也會與他們分享這些資訊，因為在這期間，他們可能會削弱奧穆的一些防禦。

english: If the characters have no way to reach the earthmote when they first encounter it—or at least, no way for everyone to reach it—eventually they spot an elf woman looking down at them from the staircase. After a few moments, she hails them in Elvish, asking their names, why they've come, and so on. If this conversation goes well, she opens an {@spell arcane gate} (cast from a scroll) and invites the player characters to come up. If they have many porters or NPC warriors, she asks that only the "key figures" come up, explaining that her home doesn't have room for their entire expedition. Valindra assures characters that their companions will be safe on the ground.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在首次遇到地動時沒有辦法到達那裡——或者至少，沒有辦法讓每個人都到達——最終他們會看到一個精靈女性從樓梯上俯視著他們。過了一會兒，她用精靈語向他們打招呼，詢問他們的名字、他們為何而來等等。如果這次對話進展順利，她就會開啟一個{@spell arcane gate||秘法門}（從卷軸中施放），並邀請玩家角色上來。如果他們有很多搬運工或非玩家角色戰士，她要求只有"關鍵人物"上來，解釋說她的家沒有足夠的空間容納他們的整個探險隊。瓦琳朵拉向角色們保證，他們的同伴在地面上將是安全的。

english: The lich has no interest in killing the characters as long as there's any chance they could be useful. If a fight breaks out (and there's little reason one should unless the characters start it), Valindra lets her undead servants deal with the adventurers, then slips through her {@spell teleportation circle} back to Thay. The destination sigils aren't recorded anywhere in the heart, so following her is impossible. She'll return in a few days when things have quieted down. How she proceeds from that point is left to your imagination.
zh_tw: 只要還有機會利用這些角色，巫妖對殺死他們沒有興趣。除非角色們挑起戰鬥（否則幾乎沒有理由發生戰鬥），瓦琳朵拉會讓她不死的僕從去對付冒險家，然後透過她的{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}悄悄回到賽爾。目的地符文沒有記錄在心臟的任何地方，所以跟隨她是不可能的。幾天後，當事情平息下來時，她會回來。從那時起她將如何繼續，留給你的想象。

english: Map 2.8: Heart of Ubtao
zh_tw: 地圖 2.8: 烏塔歐之心

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Petrified Tree
zh_tw: 1. 石化樹

english: A {@creature swarm of bats} inhabits this hollow, petrified tree. The bats emerge each evening to feast and attack any other warm-blooded creature that enters their lair. At the bottom of the tree is a gaping hole that opens in the ceiling of {@area area 4|110|x}.
zh_tw: 一群{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}棲息在這個空心的石化樹中。每晚蝙蝠們會出來覓食，並攻擊任何進入它們巢穴的溫血生物。在樹底部有一個大洞，它通向{@area 區域4|110|x}的天花板。

english: 2. Staircase
zh_tw: 2. 樓梯

english: These stairs are smooth and don't show much sign of wear. Only a handful of creatures have walked on them: Valindra, a few of her servants, and the priests of Ubtao who made pilgrimages to the heart. There's no risk of falling off unless a character does something foolish, but the height is dizzying.
zh_tw: 這些樓梯表面光滑，磨損跡象不多。只有少數生物走過它們：瓦琳朵拉、她的幾個僕人，以及前往心臟朝聖的烏博濤祭司。除非角色做出愚蠢的事情，否則沒有摔下去的風險，但高度令人眩暈。

english: 3. Cave Entrance
zh_tw: 3. 洞穴入口

english: The floor of this entrance slopes up slightly toward the inside of the heart, so water streams out through it continually. The cave mouth appears natural, unlike the steps outside it.
zh_tw: 這個入口的地面向心髒內部微微傾斜，因此水流不斷地透過它流出。這個洞穴口看起來是自然的，與它外面的階梯不同。

english: 4. Valindra's Lair
zh_tw: 4. 瓦琳朵拉的巢穴

english: This cave is musty and dimly lit by daylight filtering down through the hollow, {@condition petrified} tree trunk 20 feet above. A pool of dirty rainwater occupies the central 20 feet of the floor, between natural pillars formed by the roots of the {@condition petrified} tree. Three tall bookcases stand against the wall to the right of the cave entrance. A desk and several wooden crates stand against the left-hand wall. Opposite the entrance are two open doorways into smaller chambers and, between them, a large iron cage.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴潮溼發黴，光線昏暗，日光透過上方20尺處中空的{@condition petrified||石化}樹幹照射下來。一灘渾濁的雨水佔據著地面中央20尺的區域，位於由{@condition petrified||石化}樹根形成的天然石柱之間。三個高大的書架靠在洞穴入口右側的牆邊。一張桌子和幾個木箱靠在左側牆邊。入口對面是兩個通往較小房間的敞開門口，中間是一個大鐵籠。

english: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|Valindra's} undead patrols sometimes capture luckless explorers and bring them here. Prisoners are kept in the iron cage while Valindra questions them, then disposed of in the swamp. The cage is not in use when characters arrive, unless you choose to place {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} here as prisoners.
zh_tw: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉的}不死生物巡邏隊有時會捕獲不幸的探險者並將他們帶到此處。囚犯們被關在鐵籠裡，瓦琳朵拉會審問他們，然後將其丟棄在沼澤中。當角色們到達時，鐵籠並未在使用中，除非你選擇將{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}作為囚犯放置在這裡。

english: As a lich, Valindra isn't bothered by how dank and uncomfortable the cave is. If that subject comes up, she explains that as an elf, she has no need for a bed or for hours and hours of sleep; she simply meditates for a while at her desk each day. The rest of her time is spent poring over her maps and histories, searching for likely hiding spots for the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 作為巫妖，瓦琳朵拉並不在意洞穴的潮溼和不舒適。如果提到這個話題，她會解釋說，作為精靈，她不需要床或長時間的睡眠；她每天只需在她的桌子上冥想一會兒。她的其餘時間都花在研究地圖和歷史記錄上，尋找噬魂器的可能藏身之處。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The bookcases are filled with books, scrolls, tablets, and maps, all about Chult in one way or another. They cover history, geography, culture, and natural philosophy in great depth, but all of them predate the Spellplague. Valindra would literally kill to possess {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}'s map, if she learns of its existence. Her spellbooks aren't here—they're safe back in Thay—but the shelves do hold two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} of {@spell arcane gate}.
zh_tw: 書架上擺滿了書籍、卷軸、石板和地圖，它們都以這樣或那樣的方式關於楚爾特。它們深入覆蓋了歷史、地理、文化和自然哲學，但所有這些資料都早於咒災。如果瓦琳朵拉得知其存在，她會不惜殺人以獲取{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的地圖。她的法術書並不在這裡——它們安全地存放在泰伊——但書架上確實有兩卷{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}，上面記載著{@spell arcane gate||秘法門}。

english: 5. Undead Guardians
zh_tw: 5. 不死生物守衛

english: Stuffed in this closet are six Chultan {@creature Zombie||zombies} and two {@creature Girallon Zombie|ToA|girallon zombies} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). They stand here inertly until attacked, or until Valindra calls them out to fight or act as servants.
zh_tw: 這個壁櫥裡塞著六個楚爾特 {@creature Zombie||喪屍}和兩個{@creature Girallon Zombie|ToA|四臂猿怪喪屍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。它們在這裡靜止不動，直到被攻擊，或者直到瓦琳朵拉召喚它們出來戰鬥或充當僕人。

english: 6. Teleportation Circle
zh_tw: 6. 傳送陣

english: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|Valindra's} {@spell teleportation circle} is etched onto the floor of this chamber. Anyone with proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill recognizes what the circle is and can write down or memorize its sigils so it can be used as a destination from another {@spell teleportation circle}. Valindra isn't foolish enough to leave the sigils from her Thayan circle scribbled somewhere in this lair, so no one can follow her if she chooses to escape.
zh_tw: {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉的} {@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣} 被刻在這個房間的地板上。任何具有{@skill Arcana||奧秘}技能熟練度的人都能認出這個圓圈是什麼，並且可以將其符號寫下來或記住，以便將其作為另一個{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}的目的地使用。瓦琳朵拉不會愚蠢到在這個巢穴的某處留下她泰伊傳送門的符號，所以如果她選擇逃跑，沒有人可以跟隨她。

english: Hisari
zh_tw: 希薩裡

english: This ruined yuan-ti city stands in the jungle at the foot of the Crown, a fuming volcano that marks the western end of the Sky Lizard Mountains. A powerful ward similar to that of an {@spell antipathy/sympathy} spell prevents yuan-ti from entering the city. Many of the serpent folk who once dwelled here have since relocated to Omu.
zh_tw: 這座被毀的蛇人城市位於王冠火山腳下的叢林中，王冠火山是天空蜥蜴山脈西端的一個冒煙的火山。一個類似於{@spell antipathy/sympathy||嫌惡術/關懷術}法術的強大結界阻止了蛇人進入這座城市。許多曾經居住在這裡的蛇人已經遷移到了奧穆。

english: The earth swallowed half of the city, which rests in a sprawling underground cavern that has never been warmed by the sun. The rest of Hisari remains above ground, engulfed by vines and creeping flowers. Every brick and pillar is coated in moss, and a latticework of roots and ash covers the city's cracked, golden domes.
zh_tw: 大地吞噬了這座城市的一半，它位於一個從未被陽光溫暖的龐大地下洞穴中。希薩里的其餘部分仍然位於地面之上，被藤蔓和攀緣植物所包圍。每一塊磚和柱子都覆蓋著苔蘚，裂縫累累的金色圓頂被根和灰燼構成的格子覆蓋。

english: Hrakhamar
zh_tw: 赫拉卡馬爾

english: Nearby volcanic eruptions forced the dwarves to abandon Hrakhamar (map 2.9). They always intended to reoccupy and reactivate the forge when it was deemed safe, but that day never came.
zh_tw: 附近的火山爆發迫使矮人們放棄了赫拉卡馬爾（地圖2.9）。他們一直打算在認為安全的時候重新佔領並重新啟用鍛造場，但那一天從未到來。

english: Firenewts moved in and put the forge to work crafting armor and weapons for themselves. A small group of albino dwarves lurks in the jungle nearby and keeps watch on the forge, but their numbers are too low to challenge the firenewts.
zh_tw: 火蠑蜍搬進來並開始使用鍛造爐為自己打造盔甲和武器。一小群白化矮人潛伏在附近的叢林中，監視著鍛造爐，但他們的人數太少，無法挑戰火蠑蜍。

english: If characters travel within 10 miles (1 hex) of the forge, four {@creature Albino Dwarf Warrior|ToA|albino dwarf warriors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) spot and approach them. Their spokesperson is blunt-talking Sithi Vinecutter. She lays out the problem ("firenewts have taken over our ancestral forge") and proposes the solution ("kill them"). As a reward, each character will be allowed to take twenty 1-pound ingots of refined adamantine from the forge, and the dwarves will lead them to the location of a crashed "flying boat" from some far-off land (see "{@area Wreck of the Star Goddess|1aa|x}").
zh_tw: 如果角色們在鍛造場10英里（1六邊形）範圍內旅行，四名{@creature Albino Dwarf Warrior|ToA|白矮人武者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）會發現並接近他們。他們的發言人是直率的西希·斷藤。她明確地陳述了問題（"火蜥蜴佔領了我們的祖傳鍛造場"）並提出瞭解決方案（"殺死它們"）。作為獎勵，每個角色將被允許從鍛造場拿走二十個1磅重的精煉金剛石錠，並且矮人們將帶領他們前往一個來自遙遠之地的墜毀的"飛艇"的位置（見"{@area 星辰女神號的殘骸|1aa|x}"）。

english: The dwarves offer to stand guard outside while the characters rid Hrakhamar of firenewts. If the characters seem underpowered or in need of a guide, Sithi offers to accompany them. She remembers the layout of the forge but doesn't know how many firenewts are inside, or where they might be hiding.
zh_tw: 矮人們提出在角色們清除赫拉卡馬爾的火蠑蜍時在外面守衛。如果角色們看起來力量不足或需要嚮導，西希提出陪同他們。她記得鍛造爐的佈局，但不知道里面有多少火蠑蜍，或者它們可能藏在哪裡。

english: When the forge was operated by the dwarves, it was linked by trade roads to Shilku Bay and other points on the peninsula. Although those roads have endured a century of neglect, in the vicinity of the forge they were of dwarven construction, and not even a century of disrepair can erase a dwarven road. The roads are buried under ash in the Valley of Lost Honor, but where the mountains rise above the ash plain, the road can be spotted easily and followed to the forge entrance. A character who makes a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check while examining the road sees scorch marks indicative of firenewts or other flame creatures using it.
zh_tw: 當矮人操作這座熔爐時，它透過貿易道路與希庫灣和半島上的其他地點相連。雖然這些道路已經荒廢了一個世紀，但在熔爐附近，它們是由矮人建造的，即使一個世紀的失修也無法抹去矮人道路的痕跡。在榮譽失落谷，道路被埋在灰燼下，但在山脈高出灰燼平原的地方，道路可以輕鬆地被發現，並跟隨它到達熔爐的入口。一個角色在檢查道路時成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定，會看到火蜥蜴或其他火焰生物使用的灼燒痕跡。

english: When the characters reach Hrakhamar, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們到達赫拉卡馬爾時，閱讀：

english: The entrance is a 10-foot-tall arched doorway beneath a massive relief carving of a crossed hammer and tongs. Two iron doors were fitted to the entrance, but one lies on the ground, completely rusted off its hinges, and the other sags so badly it appears as if it could collapse at any moment. Several buildings once stood outside the forge, but they've been reduced to their foundations.
zh_tw: 入口是一個10尺高的拱形門道，上方是一把交叉的錘子和鉗子的巨大浮雕雕刻。原本安裝了兩扇鐵門，但一扇躺在地上，已經完全鏽蝕脫離了鉸鏈，另一扇下垂得如此嚴重，看起來隨時都可能倒塌。曾經有幾座建築物矗立在鍛造場外，但它們已經減少到只剩下地基。

english: The entrance gradually narrows to just 5 feet wide by 10 feet high. The tunnel proceeds this way, sloping downward very slightly but with occasional staircases leading down, for three-quarters of a mile before reaching the forge proper. Scorch marks cover the walls and floor.
zh_tw: 入口逐漸變窄，只有5尺寬，10尺高。隧道以這種方式延伸，向下傾斜得非常輕微，但偶爾有樓梯向下，延伸了四分之三英里後才到達鍛造爐本身。牆壁和地板上佈滿了燒焦的痕跡。

english: Map 2.9: Hrakhamar
zh_tw: 地圖2.9：赫拉卡馬爾

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Magma Rift
zh_tw: 1. 巖漿裂縫

english: The dwarves exploited a volcanic rift in the heart of Hrakhamar to smelt iron and adamantine, which they lowered into the magma in clay crucibles.
zh_tw: 矮人們利用了赫拉卡馬爾中心的一處火山裂縫來冶煉鐵和精金，他們將這些材料放入粘土坩堝中，然後下放到巖漿中。

english: A cavern of molten magma bubbles and flames before you. The cavern walls are lined with metal gantries and cranes that support immense crucibles of scorched clay. Huge chains stretch across the cavern, apparently to shuttle multi-ton buckets of ore across the lava. The heat takes your breath away, brings water to your eyes, and bakes your skin. From where you stand, the only obvious way across is via a narrow stone trestle built for rail carts. The sound of rhythmic hammering comes from somewhere beyond the magma rift.
zh_tw: 一個充滿熔岩的洞穴在你面前冒著氣泡和火焰。洞穴壁上排列著金屬走道和起重機，支撐著裝滿燒焦粘土的巨大坩堝。巨大的鏈條橫跨洞穴，顯然是用來在熔岩上運輸多噸礦石的桶。熱量奪走了你的呼吸，讓你的眼睛充滿水汽，並烤焦了你的皮膚。從你站立的地方，唯一明顯的過路方式是透過為礦車建造的狹窄石橋。有節奏的敲打聲來自巖漿裂縫的某處。

english: The magma is 10 feet below the level of the gantries and the rail cart trestles. Great chains span the rift in two places, allowing ore to be hoisted across in buckets.
zh_tw: 巖漿位於走道和軌道礦車橋架下方10尺處。兩條巨大的鏈條橫跨裂縫，允許礦石在桶中被吊起穿過。

english: There's no danger of falling if characters cross the magma on one of the two rail cart trestles. A successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is needed to cross hand-over-hand along one of the chain conveyors. On a failed check, the character falls into the magma. A creature that falls in the magma or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 如果角色透過兩條軌道礦車棧橋中的一條穿過巖漿，就不會有墜落的危險。成功透過{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定，角色可以手把手地沿著其中一條鏈條傳送帶穿過。如果檢定失敗，角色會墜入巖漿。掉入巖漿或在其回合開始時位於巖漿中的生物會受到55（{@dice 10d10}）點火焰傷害。

english: 2. Smelter
zh_tw: 2. 冶煉廠

english: The hammering sound grows louder, but it's not coming from the chamber ahead. This enormous, rectangular chamber is a working smelter. A rectangular pit in the center of the room is filled with molten iron. Six devices of dwarven design and make, arranged around the pit, siphon off the liquid metal and draw out the impurities. A smaller pool in the southeast corner holds what appears to be molten silver.
zh_tw: 敲打聲變得越來越響，但它不是來自前面的房間。這個巨大、矩形的房間是一個工作的冶煉爐。房間中心的一個矩形坑裡充滿了熔鐵。圍繞坑邊排列著六個矮人設計製造的裝置，它們吸走液態金屬並提煉出雜質。東南角的一個較小的池子裡似乎盛著熔化的銀。

english: Creatures that look like a mix of humanoid amphibians and elemental fire are tending to the machines. So far, they haven't noticed you.
zh_tw: 看起來像是人類兩棲動物和元素火混合體的生物正在照看機器。到目前為止，它們還沒有注意到你。

english: The hammering sound comes from the east.
zh_tw: 敲打聲來自東方。

english: Eight {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) work here. They're involved in their tasks and not expecting intruders, and the chamber is noisy, so the firenewts are {@status surprised} unless characters move around openly or otherwise draw attention to themselves.
zh_tw: 八名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在這裡工作。他們忙於自己的任務，沒有預料到會有入侵者，而且這個房間很吵鬧，所以除非角色公開移動或以其他方式引起注意，否則火蜥蜴戰士們將處於{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: The central pit contains molten iron. The smaller pool contains molten adamantine, not silver. A creature that falls into either pit or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 中心坑內含有熔鐵。較小的池子裡含有熔化的精金，不是銀。任何生物掉入任一坑中或在其上方開始其回合都會受到55（{@dice 10d10}）點火焰傷害。

english: The crane to the south (overhanging {@area area 1|118|x}) is used to lower a crucible of ore into the magma river until the ore is liquid. Liquified ore is rolled along the tracks into area 2, where it's dumped into the appropriate cauldron.
zh_tw: 南側的起重機（懸在{@area 區域1|118|x}上方）用來將一個礦石坩堝降入熔岩河中，直到礦石熔化。熔化的礦石沿著軌道滾到區域2，然後被倒入適當的大鍋中。

english: 3. Armory
zh_tw: 3. 軍械庫

english: The dwarves' enemies coveted the riches of Hrakhamar. To defend their trove, the dwarves stockpiled weapons and armor in this chamber. The firenewts haven't bothered most of it; they prefer their own weapons over heavier dwarven designs, and the dwarves' armor doesn't fit them.
zh_tw: 矮人們的敵人覬覦赫拉卡馬爾的財富。為了保衛他們的寶藏，矮人們在這個房間裡囤積了武器和盔甲。火蠑蜍沒有動用大部分的物資；他們更喜歡自己的武器，而不是更重的矮人設計，而且矮人的盔甲也不適合他們。

english: This chamber includes six each of battleaxes, greataxes, mauls, morningstars, war picks, warhammers, and heavy crossbows, plus two hundred crossbow bolts and four suits of dwarven half-plate armor. If characters are led here by Sithi Vinecutter, she's willing to let the characters take one weapon apiece.
zh_tw: 這個房間包括六個戰斧、雙手斧、釘頭錘、晨星、戰鎬、戰錘和重型十字弓，另外還有兩百支十字弓弩箭和四套矮人中型板甲。如果角色們由西希·斷藤帶領到這裡，她願意讓每個角色拿走一件武器。

english: 4. Forge
zh_tw: 4. 鍛造車間

english: Molten iron and adamantine from {@area area 2|11a|x} is hoisted into the northernmost of these two chambers, where it's cast into ingots. Some of the metal was worked into tools and replacement parts on the anvils in the room, but most of the iron was moved to the treasury (area 6). Adamantine ingots were sent to the southern portion of the forge, where the massive stamping hammer in the center of the room pounded out impurities. The pounding sound heard throughout the forge comes from this machine-driven hammer.
zh_tw: 來自{@area 區域2|11a|x}的熔鐵和精金被吊到這兩個房間中最北邊的一個，在那裡被鑄造成錠。一些金屬在房間中的鐵砧上被加工成工具和替換部件，但大部分鐵被轉移到了金庫（區域6）。精金錠被送往鍛造爐南部，房間中心的巨大沖壓錘在那裡敲打出雜質。鍛造爐中聽到的敲打聲就是來自這個機械驅動的錘子。

english: When characters arrive, four {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} are in the northern chamber, and six {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} are working in the southern chamber under the supervision of a {@creature firenewt warlock of Imix|VGM}. See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for the firenewts' statistics.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，有四名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}在北邊的房間裡，另外六名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}在南邊的房間裡工作，在一名{@creature firenewt warlock of Imix|VGM|熔螈·伊米希魔契師}的監督下。火蜥蜴的具體數值見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: Iron Lever
zh_tw: 鐵質槓桿

english: The hallway between areas 4 and 6 is featureless except for a heavy iron lever set into the north wall 20 feet from the door to area 4. The lever is in the down position and can be lifted easily. Doing so extends the walkway across the magma to {@area area 6|120|x}, if the trap there caused it to retract. Moving the lever while the gantry is extended causes gears to grind for a few moments deep in the rock, but nothing else.
zh_tw: 4號和6號區域之間的走廊除了一個嵌入北牆、距離4號區域門20尺的沉重鐵桿外，沒有其他特徵。杆子處於放下位置，可以輕鬆提起。如果那裡的陷阱導致它收回，這樣做會延伸通往{@area 區域6|120|x}的走道。在走道伸出時移動杆子會導致岩石深處的齒輪轉動片刻，但除此之外沒有其他效果。

english: 5. Stores
zh_tw: 5. 倉庫

english: In these chambers, the dwarves stored supplies of every kind, from food to leather aprons to protective goggles to parchment and ink. The firenewts looted all of it. Now the chief features of these rooms are "nests" of ancient dwarven clothing, insulated gloves, and other padded material that the firenewts sleep on in shifts. The smell in this area is horrid, like burning hair mixed with burning rubber. A disturbance in any of the chambers awakens and draws in all the firenewts in the storage area.
zh_tw: 在這些房間裡，矮人們儲存了各種物資，從食物到皮革圍裙，到防護眼鏡，再到羊皮紙和墨水。火蠑蜍洗劫了所有這些東西。現在這些房間的主要特點是"巢穴"，由古老的矮人服裝、隔熱手套和其他軟墊材料組成，火蠑蜍輪班在此睡覺。這個區域的氣味令人作嘔，就像燒焦的頭髮混合著燒焦的橡膠。任何在這些房間中的幹擾都會喚醒並吸引倉庫區域所有的火蠑蜍。

english: The northwest room is unoccupied. In the northeast room, three {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} play knucklebones with dwarven knuckles. Four {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} sleep in a heap in the middle of the southwest room. The southeast room contains two {@creature Firenewt Warlock of Imix|VGM|firenewt warlocks of Imix} arguing quietly over whether to denounce the warlock in {@area area 4|11d|x} for heresy against Imix. See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for the firenewts' statistics.
zh_tw: 西北房間無人居住。在東北房間裡，三名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}正在用矮人的指關節玩擲骨子遊戲。四名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}在西南房間的中央堆成一堆睡覺。東南房間裡有兩名{@creature Firenewt Warlock of Imix|VGM|火蜥蜴魔契師，來自伊米西}在小聲爭論是否要因對伊米克斯的異端而譴責在{@area 區域4|11d|x}的魔契師。有關火蠑蜍的具體數值，請見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: 6. Treasury
zh_tw: 6. 國庫

english: Two suits of dwarven {@item half plate armor|PHB} stand on either side of an adamantine-banded iron door. These suits of armor were beautiful once, but now they're scarred by weapons, scorched by fire, and smeared with filth. The door has two locks, one above the other.
zh_tw: 兩套矮人制造的{@item half plate armor|PHB|半身板甲}矗立在一扇秘銀鑲邊的鐵門兩側。這些盔甲曾經精美絕倫，但如今已被武器劃傷、火焰燒焦，並沾滿汙穢。鐵門上下各有一把鎖。

english: The dwarves sealed their treasure vault before leaving Hrakhamar, and it's remained sealed to this day. Despite their best efforts, the firenewts have been unable to force the door or defeat the locks.
zh_tw: 矮人們在離開赫拉卡馬爾之前封閉了他們的寶庫，至今它仍然被封閉著。儘管火蜥蜴們盡了最大努力，但仍然無法強行開啟門或破壞鎖。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door's upper lock is embedded in an adamantine frame resembling a stylized form of the dwarven rune for "beginnings." The rune can be interpreted correctly by a character who reads Dwarvish. The lower lock was originally embedded in a golden frame in the shape of a stylized dwarven rune for "endings," but the firenewts scraped away the gold and used it to decorate their shrine to Imix ({@area area 7|125|x}). Scarring on the door hints at what used to be there; it can be interpreted correctly by someone who reads Dwarvish and makes a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Each lock can be picked with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 門的上部鎖具嵌在一個精金框架中，框架呈現為風格化的矮人符文，意為"開端"。能閱讀矮人語的角色可以正確解讀該符文。下部鎖具原本嵌在一個黃金框架中，形狀為風格化的矮人符文"終結"，但火蜥蜴人颳走了黃金，用來裝飾他們獻給伊米克斯的神殿（{@area 區域7|125|x}）。門上的刮痕暗示了原先的存在；能閱讀矮人語並透過一次{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定者可正確解讀。每把鎖都能用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來撬開。

english: The lower lock is trapped. The trap can be spotted with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, but it's impossible to disarm or bypass. The trap is triggered if an attempt to pick the lower lock fails by 5 or more, if the wrong key is used in the lock, or if it's opened by any means before the upper lock. The trap causes the metal gantry between the treasury and the forge ({@area area 4|11d|x}) to retract west, leaving a 40-foot gap across the magma. The bridge can be re-extended only by lifting the lever in the corridor from {@area area 4|11d|x}. The lever is too far away to be manipulated with {@spell mage hand} by anyone on the treasury side of the magma river.
zh_tw: 下方的鎖是帶陷阱的。如果透過成功的 {@dc 13} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定可以發現這個陷阱，但無法解除或繞過它。如果嘗試撬開下方鎖時失敗並超過 5 點，使用錯誤的鑰匙開鎖，或在開啟上方鎖之前以任何方式開啟它，陷阱會被觸發。陷阱會使金庫和熔爐之間的金屬天橋 ({@area 區域4|11d|x}) 向西縮回，形成一個跨越巖漿的 40 尺寬的缺口。只有在走廊中透過 {@area 區域4|11d|x} 處拉動手柄，才能重新延伸橋樑。對於巖漿河流金庫一側的人來說，手柄距離太遠，無法透過 {@spell mage hand||法師之手} 操作。

english: The keys to the treasury were within the firenewts' grasp. However, they failed to recognize the keys for what they were and incorporated them into a statue they built in the shrine of Imix ({@area area 7|125|x}).
zh_tw: 通往金庫的鑰匙原本在火蠑蜍的掌握之中。然而，它們並沒有認出這些鑰匙的真正用途，而是將它們併入了他們在伊米克斯神龕（{@area 區域7|125|x}）建造的一座雕像中。

english: Side Chamber
zh_tw: 側室

english: The solution to opening the door lies in a seemingly empty side chamber near the treasury. Anyone searching this room turns up a curious box tossed into the corner. The box is made of iron and resembles a book, and it opens from both sides, rather like the front and back covers of a book. One side bears the dwarven rune for "beginnings," the other bears the rune for "endings." Opening either side reveals the impression of a key in the iron plate. The original keys for the treasury were stored in this box.
zh_tw: 開啟這扇門的解決方案位於金庫附近的一個看似空蕩的側室中。任何搜尋這個房間的人都會找到一個被扔在角落裡的奇特盒子。這個盒子由鐵製成，看起來像一本書，它可以從兩側開啟，就像書的前封面和後封面一樣。一側刻有矮人符文"開始"，另一側刻有符文"結束"。開啟任一側會看到鐵板上鑰匙的印記。金庫的原始鑰匙就存放在這個盒子裡。

english: With all the tools of Hrakhamar at their disposal, copies of both keys can be made from these impressions by a character who has proficiency with {@item smith's tools|PHB} and who makes a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence check. Sithi Vinecutter has the needed proficiency if none of the characters do. {@creature Musharib|ToA} (see "{@area Finding a Guide|095|x}") also has the necessary skill. After three failed checks, the box's impressions are ruined, and the box can no longer be used to mold new keys.
zh_tw: 利用哈拉卡瑪的所有工具，一個熟練使用{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}並透過{@dc 10}智力檢定的角色可以根據這些印記複製出兩把鑰匙。如果隊伍中沒有這樣的角色，西希·藤切擁有所需的技能。{@creature Musharib|ToA|穆沙瑞卜}（參見"{@area 尋找嚮導|095|x}"）也具備必要的技能。若檢定失敗三次，盒子上的印記將被破壞，無法再用於鑄造新鑰匙。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The treasury contains the stockpiled wealth of Hrakhamar. Thousands of iron and adamantine ingots are neatly sorted, stacked, and crated. Each iron ingot is worth 1 gp and weighs 10 pounds. Each adamantine ingot is worth 10 gp and weighs 1 pound. If she is present, Sithi Vinecutter allows the characters to collect their reward, though she watches them closely to be sure no one takes more than twenty ingots.
zh_tw: 金庫中存放著赫拉卡馬爾積累的財富。成千上萬的鐵錠和精金錠被整齊地分類、堆放和裝箱。每塊鐵錠價值1金幣，重10磅。每塊精金錠價值10金幣，重1磅。如果西希·斷藤在場，她會允許角色們收集他們的獎勵，儘管她會密切監視他們，確保沒有人拿走超過二十塊錠。

english: Resting atop one crate is a gauntlet made of gold and sized for an adult dwarf. The dwarves of Chult call it Moradin's Gauntlet, and it's customarily worn by the overseers of Hrakhamar. It is finely crafted and worth 2,500 gp, though a wealthy dwarf would pay twice that much to acquire it.
zh_tw: 一個金制的、適合成年矮人佩戴的手套放在一個板條箱上。楚爾特的矮人稱之為摩拉丁之手套，通常由赫拉卡馬爾的監督者佩戴。它製作精良，價值2500金幣，儘管一個富有的矮人願意支付兩倍的價格來購買它。

english: 7. Imix Shrine
zh_tw: 7. 伊米西神殿

english: It's unclear what the dwarves used this area for, but the firenewts converted it into a shrine.
zh_tw: 不清楚矮人最初用這個區域做什麼，但火蠑蜍將其改造成了一個神龕。
