english: The reek of sulfur and burning flesh assaults your nostrils as the tunnel opens into a small chamber. At the northern end of the room is a five-foot-tall statue made of iron, copper, gold, and silver, crudely hammered together into a form suggesting something vaguely humanoid but also fiery. Four firenewts worship before it.
zh_tw: 當隧道通向一個小型房間時，硫磺和燒焦的肉味衝擊著你的鼻孔。房間北端是一座五尺高的雕像，由鐵、銅、金和銀粗糙地錘打在一起，形成一個隱約類似人形但帶有火焰特徵的形狀。四隻火蠑蜍在它面前朝拜。

english: The worshipers are two {@creature Firenewt Warlock of Imix|VGM|firenewt warlocks of Imix} and two {@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for the firenewts' statistics). They fight to the death.
zh_tw: 這些朝拜者包括兩名{@creature Firenewt Warlock of Imix|VGM|火蜥蜴魔契師，來自伊米西}和兩名{@creature Firenewt Warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}，瞭解火蠑蜍的具體數值）。他們戰鬥至死。

english: The statue weighs 150 pounds and represents Imix, the evil, fiery primordial at the center of the firenewts' militarized, theological society. The statue has little artistic merit (firenewts are passable smiths but poor artists). If the gold and silver are separated from the other metals, they're worth 20 gp and 400 sp, respectively. An albino dwarf or a character skilled at smithing could smelt out the valuable metals with the equipment in Hrakhamar in a few hours.
zh_tw: 這座重150磅的雕像代表著伊米克斯，火蠑蜍軍事化、神學化社會中心的邪惡火焰原始生物。雕像幾乎沒有藝術價值（火蠑蜍是尚可的鐵匠，但藝術造詣很差）。如果將金子和銀子從其他金屬中分離出來，它們分別值20金幣和400銀幣。一個白化矮人或一個熟練於鐵匠工作的角色可以使用赫拉卡馬爾的裝置在幾個小時內熔鍊出有價值的金屬。

english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check while examining (or smelting down) the statue of Imix recognizes an object hammered into its flames as having once been part of a key. It's the only bit of adamantine on the statue, and only the toughness of adamantine prevented it from being hammered out of all recognition. Once the adamantine fragment is picked out, a more careful search turns up a second fragment of gold, so thoroughly hammered that it's barely recognizable. These keys once unlocked the door to the treasury ({@area area 6|120|x}) and are beyond repair; so little of them remains that not even a {@spell mending} spell can fix them.
zh_tw: 當一個角色在檢查（或熔鍊）伊米克斯雕像時，成功透過了 {@dc 13} 的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會認出被錘入其火焰中的一個物體曾是鑰匙的一部分。這是雕像上唯一的精金部分，正是精金的堅韌性使它沒有被錘打得無法辨認。一旦精金碎片被取出，更仔細的搜尋會發現另一塊黃金碎片，它被錘打得如此徹底以至於幾乎無法辨認。這些鑰匙曾經開啟了寶庫的門（{@area 區域6|120|x}），但現在已無法修復；剩下的部分太少，甚至連 {@spell mending||修復術} 也無法修復它們。

english: 8. Smoke-Filled Caverns
zh_tw: 8. 煙霧瀰漫的洞穴

english: The size and shape of this area are impossible to determine. Clouds of roiling smoke sting your eyes, and drifting embers burn your throat as you breathe. You can, however, barely make out what looks like a lantern farther back in the smoke.
zh_tw: 這個區域的大小和形狀無法確定。滾滾煙雲刺痛你的眼睛，當你呼吸時，飄散的餘燼灼燒你的喉嚨。然而，你幾乎可以辨認出在煙霧中更遠的地方看起來像有一盞燈籠。

english: These linked caverns are the lair of two {@creature Smoke Mephit||smoke mephits}. What the characters perceive as a dim lantern is a {@spell dancing lights} spells cast by one of the mephits to lure the characters deeper into the noxious lair.
zh_tw: 這些相連的洞穴是兩個{@creature Smoke Mephit||煙魔蝠}的巢穴。角色們感知到的昏暗燈籠實際上是其中一個魔蝠施放的{@spell dancing lights||舞光術}法術，用來引誘角色們深入到這個有毒的巢穴中。

english: All of area 8 is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured}. Characters can move 10 feet per round by following a wall with their hand; moving faster than that means taking 1 bludgeoning damage from banging heads and shins into stone protrusions. After 2 rounds in the smoke, each character must make a successful {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at the start of each of his or her turns or gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}. Those who hold their breath won't gain {@condition exhaustion} for as long as their breath holds out; characters who tie wet rags across their nose and mouth or take similar precautions have advantage on the saving throw for 10 rounds, but then the rag dries out in Hrakhamar's intense heat.
zh_tw: 區域8的所有區域都處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||重度遮蔽}狀態。角色可以沿著牆壁用手摸索前進，每輪移動10尺；移動速度超過此限會導致因頭部和脛骨撞上石質突起而受到1點鈍擊傷害。在煙霧中停留2輪後，每個角色必須在其每回合開始時成功透過一次{@dc 10}體質豁免，否則將獲得一級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。屏住呼吸的角色在閉氣期間不會獲得{@condition exhaustion||力竭}；用溼布捂住口鼻或採取類似預防措施的角色，在進行該豁免檢定時具有優勢，效果持續10輪，但之後布塊會在哈拉卡瑪的酷熱中變幹。

english: The mephits aren't interested in attacking adventurers directly, but they'll gleefully loot the bodies of anyone who collapses in the smoke. If cornered, they beg for mercy. They offer to trade information for their lives if a character makes a successful {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check. They know the forge is infested with firenewts, where the newts' giant strider mounts are kept, and that two dwarf prisoners are tied up in the cells due west of the mephits' lair.
zh_tw: 這些小精靈對直接攻擊冒險者不感興趣，但他們會歡快地掠奪那些在煙霧中倒下的人的屍體。如果被逼到絕境，他們會乞求憐憫。如果角色成功透過一次{@dc 10}魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定，他們願意用資訊換取自己的性命。他們知道熔爐被火蜥蜴侵擾，火蜥蜴的巨型步行者坐騎就安置在那裡，還有兩名矮人囚犯被綁在小精靈巢穴正西的牢房裡。

english: 9. Cells and Passage to Wyrmheart Mine
zh_tw: 9. 通往龍心礦井的牢房和通道

english: Firenewts are notorious torturers and eaters of humanoid flesh. Prisoners are tied up, gagged, and tossed here until the firenewts decide how to inflict the most intense and longest-lasting pain on them. Most prisoners are dead within a tenday, but they wish for the end much sooner.
zh_tw: 火蠑蜍是臭名昭著的折磨者和人形生物肉體的食用者。囚犯們被捆綁起來，塞住嘴巴，然後被扔到這裡，直到火蠑蜍決定如何給他們帶來最強烈和最持久的痛苦。大多數囚犯在十天內死亡，但他們更希望能早點結束。

english: Dwarves are the exception. There's much about the workings of Hrakhamar the firenewts still don't understand. Captured dwarves are tortured for hints about how the foundry's tools and machines work. Two luckless {@creature Albino Dwarf Warrior|ToA|albino dwarf warriors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are tied, gagged, and blindfolded here when characters arrive. Their names are Laz Drumthunder and Malkar Stonegrist. Both are wounded and have 1 hit point remaining. They are also starving, dehydrated, and suffering from 5 levels of {@condition exhaustion}. Laz will recover normally with time and care, or magical healing. Malkar has gone mad; he shudders uncontrollably and screams nonstop if his gag is removed. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell or comparable magic is needed to restore his sanity. If Laz and Malkar are taken to Sithi Vinecutter, she and her companions look after them.
zh_tw: 矮人是個例外。火蠑蜍對赫拉卡馬爾的運作仍有許多不明白的地方。被捕獲的矮人被折磨以獲取有關鑄造廠工具和機器如何工作的資訊。當角色們到達時，這裡綁著兩個不幸的{@creature Albino Dwarf Warrior|ToA|白矮人武者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。他們的名字是拉茲·雷鼓和馬爾卡爾·磨石。兩人都受傷了，只剩下1點生命值。他們也在捱餓，脫水，並遭受5個等級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。拉茲在時間和照顧或魔法治療下會正常恢復。馬爾卡爾已經瘋了；如果他的塞口物被取下，他會不停地顫抖並不停地尖叫。需要{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}法術或相當的魔法來恢復他的理智。如果拉茲和馬爾卡爾被帶到西希·斷藤那裡，她和她的同伴會照顧他們。

english: The tunnel winds southward 40 miles to Wyrmheart Mine, which has been taken over by the dragon Tzindelor and her kobold minions (see "{@area Wyrmheart Mine|1af|x}"). The tunnel is passable and the rail cart tracks are intact for the full length, but encounters with {@creature Carrion Crawler||carrion crawlers} and {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} are guaranteed. As characters get closer to Wyrmheart Mine, they might also encounter bands of {@creature Kobold||kobolds}. The albino dwarves know where the tunnel leads but are quick to warn characters about the red dragon that has taken over Wyrmheart Mine.
zh_tw: 這條隧道向南蜿蜒40英里，直達被巨龍辛德洛和她的一群狗頭人僕從（見"{@area 龍心礦井|1af|x}"）佔領的龍心礦井。隧道可以通行，軌道車的軌道全程完好無損，但必然會遭遇{@creature Carrion Crawler||食腐蟲}和{@creature Giant Spider||巨蜘蛛}。當角色們接近龍心礦井時，他們還可能會遇到{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}小隊。白化矮人們知道隧道的去向，但他們很快就警告角色們關於佔領龍心礦井的紅龍的事情。

english: 10. Mine Cart Bay
zh_tw: 10. 礦車灣

english: The dwarves parked their ore carts and flatbed rail carts here when they weren't in use. Two of each are still here, and both are in minimal working condition.
zh_tw: 矮人們在不使用時會將他們的礦車和平板軌道車停放在這裡。每種還各有兩輛，它們都處於最低限度的工作狀態。

english: The firenewts use the area as stables for twelve {@creature Giant Strider|VGM|giant striders} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). The giant striders are tethered, but the tethers are meant only to keep them from crossing the westernmost line of cart tracks and wandering through the tunnels. An angry or alarmed strider can easily break loose, and these vicious creatures become both angry and alarmed when they see humanoids who aren't their firenewt masters.
zh_tw: 火蠑蜍將這個區域用作十二隻{@creature Giant Strider|VGM|闊步鳥}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的馬廄。巨型步行者被拴住了，但拴住它們只是為了不讓它們越過軌道車最西邊的線路並漫遊穿過隧道。一隻憤怒或受到驚嚇的步行者可以輕易掙脫，當這些兇猛的生物看到不是它們火蠑蜍主人的人形生物時，它們會變得既憤怒又受到驚嚇。

english: As soon as a non-firenewt enters area 10, the giant striders begin stamping, growling, and straining at their tethers. Beginning on the following round, {@dice 1d3} giant striders break loose each round and attack or join in an ongoing battle. They don't attack firenewts, and a firenewt can hop onto a giant strider and ride it as a mount using the standard rules for {@book mounted combat|PHB|9|Mounted Combat}.
zh_tw: 一旦任何非火蜥蜴人進入區域10，巨型火蜥蜴會立即開始跺腳、低吼並試圖掙脫束縛。從下一回合開始，每回合有{@dice 1d3}只巨型火蜥蜴掙脫並加入戰鬥。它們不會攻擊火蜥蜴人，且火蜥蜴人可以跳上巨型火蜥蜴背部，根據{@book 騎乘戰鬥|PHB|9|Mounted Combat}的標準規則將其作為坐騎使用。

english: Hvalspyd
zh_tw: 瓦爾斯皮德

english: The {@i Hvalspyd} (the name means "whale spear") is a longship sized for frost giants: 250 feet long, with sails made from white dragon wings. It's anchored 100 yards off a beach along Chult's northeast coast, 70 miles north of Kitcher's Inlet. It's impossible for the giants to hide the vessel; anyone sailing down the coast can't miss it.
zh_tw: {@i 瓦爾斯皮德號}的名字意為「鯨魚之矛」，是一艘依霜巨人體型打造的長船：船長 250 尺，船帆以白龍的翅膀製成。它停泊在楚爾特東北海岸一處海灘外 100 碼，位於基徹灣以北 70 英里。巨人不可能藏起這艘船，任何沿岸航行的人都不會錯過它。

english: The {@i Hvalspyd} sailed south from the Sea of Moving Ice with a crew of twenty frost giants. Three {@creature Frost Giant||frost giants} remain aboard the ship—two stand guard while the third rests. Two more {@creature Frost Giant||frost giants} watch the sea from the beach. The other fifteen giants have split into five search parties of three giants each, and are searching the jungle for {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. One of the frost giant hunters is the {@i Hvalspyd}'s captain, {@creature Drufi|ToA} (NE female {@creature frost giant}).
zh_tw: {@i 瓦爾斯皮德}從移動冰海向南航行，船員由二十名霜巨人組成。船上還剩下三名{@creature Frost Giant||霜巨人}——兩名站崗守衛，而第三名休息。另外兩名{@creature Frost Giant||霜巨人}從海灘上監視著海面。其他十五名巨人分成了五個由三名巨人組成的搜尋隊，正在叢林中搜尋{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。其中一名霜巨人獵人是{@i 瓦爾斯皮德}的船長，{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}（NE女性{@creature frost giant||霜巨人}）。

english: At the behest of her lord, Jarl Storvald, {@creature Drufi|ToA} led this expedition to retrieve the ring. Storvald wants it for reasons explained in the adventure {@i Storm King's Thunder}. He believes that with the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}, he can freeze the world and bring about the Age of Everlasting Ice—a wonderful dream that keeps {@creature Drufi|ToA} focused on the task at hand. The giants know nothing of {@creature Acererak|ToA}, the Soulmonger, or the death curse.
zh_tw: 應她的主人，領主 斯托瓦爾德的要求，{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}帶領這次探險隊來取回戒指。斯托瓦爾德出於冒險{@i 風暴君王之雷霆}中解釋的原因需要它。他相信有了{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}，他可以凍結世界，帶來永久冰河時代的來臨——這個美妙的夢想讓{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}專注於手頭的任務。巨人們對{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}、噬魂器或死亡詛咒一無所知。

english: The frost giants are out of their element in tropical jungle. They regard it as the worst kind of hell imaginable. They have no intention, however, of failing their jarl and letting the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} slip through their grasp.
zh_tw: 霜巨人在熱帶叢林中感到不適應。他們認為這是可以想象的最糟糕的地獄。然而，他們無意失敗，也不想讓冬之環（{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}）從他們手中溜走。

english: Frost Giant Search Parties
zh_tw: 霜巨人搜尋隊

english: {@creature Drufi|ToA}'s search party includes two male {@creature Frost Giant||frost giants} and a pair of {@creature Winter Wolf||winter wolves}. Each of the other four search parties consists of three {@creature Frost Giant||frost giants} and {@dice 1d2} {@creature Winter Wolf||winter wolves}. The frost giants can't move through the jungle without leaving a trail. If characters encounter giants, they're likely to see evidence hours or days before the actual meeting: trampled brush, broken or uprooted trees, gigantic boot prints, 3-foot-high runic trail markings carved into trees or etched onto boulders, and winter wolf droppings. Chult has many gigantic carnivores, so a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check is needed to identify these indicators as foreign to the jungle; if the check succeeds by 5 or more, the source is recognized as frost giants. A Chultan guide has advantage on this check but won't make the leap to frost giants. That idea is just too far-fetched.
zh_tw: {@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}的搜尋隊包括兩名雄性{@creature Frost Giant||霜巨人}和一對{@creature Winter Wolf||冬狼}。其他四支搜尋隊各由三名{@creature Frost Giant||霜巨人}和{@dice 1d2}只{@creature Winter Wolf||冬狼}組成。霜巨人無法在不留下蹤跡的情況下穿越叢林。如果角色遇到巨人，他們可能在實際會面前的數小時或數天就看到證據：踩踏的灌木、折斷或被連根拔起的樹木、巨大的靴印、刻在樹上或巨石上的3尺高的符文標記，以及冬狼的糞便。楚爾特有許多巨型食肉動物，因此需要進行一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來識別這些跡象是否與叢林環境不符；如果檢定結果超過5點或更多，則可以識別出這些跡象來自霜巨人。楚爾特的嚮導在此檢定上有優勢，但不會聯想到霜巨人。這個想法太牽強了。

english: So far, the giants' searching has roamed from the coast to the River Tiryki, and from the ruins of Port Castigliar to the northeastern mountains. {@creature Drufi|ToA} has seen Fort Beluarian from a distance and Port Nyanzaru from across the mouth of the River Tiryki, but the giants avoid Flaming Fist patrols. For their part, the mercenaries and scouts from the fort have seen many puzzling signs in the jungle to the south, but they haven't yet concluded they're dealing with frost giants. The giants' next step will be to push farther south. At some point (determined by you), they'll return to the {@i Hvalspyd}, sail south to Refuge Bay, and start the search afresh from there. Obviously, this is a very inefficient way to search an area as large and as dense as Chult, but {@creature Drufi|ToA} has no better idea.
zh_tw: 到目前為止，巨人的搜尋範圍已經從海岸延伸到提爾基河，從卡斯蒂利亞爾廢墟延伸到東北部的山脈。{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲} 從遠處看到了貝路利安堡，從提爾基河口對面看到了南扎路港，但巨人避開了焰拳的巡邏隊。就他們而言，來自堡壘的僱傭兵和偵察兵在南部的叢林中看到了很多令人困惑的跡象，但他們還沒有得出結論，他們正在與霜巨人打交道。巨人的下一步將是向南推進。在某個時刻（由你決定），他們將返回到{@i 瓦爾斯皮德}，向南航行到避難灣，並從那裡重新開始搜尋。顯然，這是搜尋像楚爾特這樣大而密集的地區的一種非常低效的方式，但{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}沒有更好的主意。

english: {@creature Drufi|ToA} has no reason to attack or kill the characters, should they meet, unless the characters attack her or if she suspects they know more than they're admitting about the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. Before taking any action, she'll try to ferret out what, if anything, the characters know about {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and the artifact. {@creature Drufi|ToA}'s attempts to be cagey about her interest have all the subtlety of a charging mammoth. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check quickly recognizes that {@creature Drufi|ToA}'s clumsy questions are about a powerful magic item in Cimber's possession.
zh_tw: {@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲} 沒有任何理由攻擊或殺害角色，如果他們相遇，除非角色攻擊她或她懷疑他們比他們承認的更多有關{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}的資訊。在採取任何行動之前，她會試圖打探出角色對{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和這件神器的瞭解程度。{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}試圖掩飾她的興趣，但她的方式如同一頭衝撞的長毛象般毫無掩飾。任何成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定的人物會迅速意識到 {@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}笨拙的問題其實是在詢問關於辛伯所擁有的強大魔法物品的資訊。

english: Any meeting between the characters and the giants will be more dramatic if it occurs after the characters' first encounter with {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}. If they admit they've met him but can't (or won't) tell {@creature Drufi|ToA} where he is, she has all the reason she needs to capture the characters and torture the information out of them.
zh_tw: 角色與巨人之間的任意遭遇如果在角色第一次遭遇{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}之後發生會更加戲劇性。如果他們承認見過他但無法（或不願）告訴{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}他的下落，她就有充分理由抓捕角色並拷問出訊息。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The {@i Hvalspyd}'s stores have been mostly depleted, and the frost giants didn't bring treasure with them on the expedition.
zh_tw: {@i 瓦爾斯皮德}的儲備已經基本耗盡，霜巨人在這次探險中也沒有攜帶寶藏。

english: Ishau
zh_tw: 伊肖

english: The coastal settlement of Ishau sank into the sea. Now, the village's stone buildings sit completely underwater in Refuge Bay, a few miles from shore. Hunter sharks and reef sharks glide among the sunken ruins, competing with plesiosaurs for the position as top predator—but all of them fear and avoid the vicious sea hags who occasionally scour the ruins for human remains and waterlogged trinkets.
zh_tw: 沿海定居點伊紹（伊肖）沉入了海底。現在，這個村莊的石頭建築完全位於避難灣（避難灣）的水下，距離海岸幾英里。獵人鯊和礁鯊在沉沒的廢墟中滑行，與蛇頸龍競爭頂級捕食者的地位——但所有這些生物都害怕並避開那些偶爾在廢墟中搜尋人類殘骸和浸水小飾品的惡毒海巫。

english: Jahaka Anchorage
zh_tw: 賈哈卡錨地

english: Three pirate ships use Jahaka Anchorage (map 2.10) as a haven: the {@i Dragonfang}, the {@i Emerald Eye}, and the {@i Stirge}. All three are sailing ships (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). See the "{@adventure Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage|ToA|2|Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage}" sidebar for information on the captain and crew of each vessel.
zh_tw: 三艘海盜船將賈哈卡錨地（地圖2.10）作為避風港：{@i 龍牙}、{@i 翡翠之眼}和{@i 蚊蝠}。這三艘船都是帆船（參見{@i 城主指南}中的 {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||第五章}）。關於每艘船的船長和船員資訊，請參見"{@adventure 賈哈卡錨地的海盜|ToA|2|Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage}"側邊欄。

english: Only one pirate ship is docked at the anchorage at any given time. A second ship rides at anchor outside the harbor up to a mile away, ready to defend the anchorage. The third ship is always at sea, usually prowling for victims. You can randomly determine which ships are where. The captain of whichever ship is docked commands the anchorage from aboard his ship.
zh_tw: 任何時候只有一艘海盜船停靠在錨地。第二艘船在港口外一英里範圍內拋錨，隨時準備保衛錨地。第三艘船總是出海，通常在尋找獵物。你可以隨機決定哪些船在哪裡。停靠在錨地的船的船長從他的船上指揮錨地。

english: The anchorage is sheltered inside a sea cave. It's damp and echoing, but at least the cave keeps out the daily rain. The pirates outfitted it with a pier and a ramshackle fort built from scavenged planking, old barrels, deck grates, spars, and whatever else they could scrounge. It incorporates a warehouse where they stash their stolen booty until it can be sold (area 4), a cell where captives are held until they're ransomed or sold (area 5), and a tavern where the pirates carouse (areas 6A–6C).
zh_tw: 錨地位於一個海洞內部。這裡潮溼且回聲不斷，但至少洞穴能夠遮擋每日的雨水。海盜們用撿來的木板、舊桶、甲板柵欄、桅杆和其他任何他們能找到的東西搭建了一個碼頭和一個破舊的堡壘。它包括一個倉庫，他們在那裡存放被盜的贓物直到能夠出售（區域4），一個囚禁俘虜直到他們被贖回或出售的牢房（區域5），以及一個海盜們狂歡的酒館（區域6A-6C）。

english: The three pirate captains are in league with {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} of Fort Beluarian, who gives them information about vessels sailing into and out of Port Nyanzaru and helps the pirates sell their stolen cargoes. Ships flying the ensign of Baldur's Gate are usually left alone, as a condition of Portyr's cooperation. The Flaming Fist commander is kept apprised of upcoming naval patrols originating from nations on the mainland, and she passes this information to the pirates via a {@item Sending Stones||sending stone}.
zh_tw: 三位海盜船長與貝路利安堡的{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}勾結，她向他們提供有關進出南扎路港的船隻的資訊，並幫助海盜銷售他們偷來的貨物。通常，懸掛博德之門旗幟的船隻會被放過，這是波提爾合作的條件之一。焰拳的指揮官會得到來自大陸國家即將進行的海軍巡邏的資訊，並她透過一個{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}將這些資訊傳遞給海盜。

english: Even more than their deal with {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}, the pirates' most important asset is this hidden base, and every pirate must swear a blood oath to protect its secret location. Any ship that sails within visual distance of the anchorage is attacked and chased, if necessary. The {@i Brazen Pegasus} (see "{@adventure Harbor Ward|ToA|2|Harbor Ward}") has a good chance to escape because she's so fast; other ships are unlikely to get away.
zh_tw: 比他們與{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}的交易更為重要的是，海盜們最重要的資產是這個隱蔽的基地，每個海盜都必須發誓用血誓來保護其秘密位置。任何駛入錨地視距內的船隻都會受到攻擊並在必要時被追擊。{@i 銅皮天馬號}（參見"{@adventure 海港區|ToA|2|Harbor Ward}"）有很大的機會逃脫，因為它速度極快；其他船隻則不太可能逃脫。

english: Anyone who wanders into the anchorage from the jungle or from the bay is unlikely to be allowed to leave. If characters stumble into Jahaka Anchorage, the pirates claim it's a trading post or an exploratory base established by the Flaming Fist or a merchant consortium, and they'll put up a convincing front to that effect. They'll do whatever it takes to get strangers off their guard, then kill or capture them.
zh_tw: 任何從叢林或海灣誤入錨地的人，都不太可能被允許離開。如果角色們偶然進入賈哈卡錨地，海盜們會聲稱這是一個由焰拳或商人聯盟建立的貿易站或探險基地，並會為此提供令人信服的表面。他們會盡一切努力讓陌生人放鬆警惕，然後殺死或俘虜他們。

english: The roof of the cave looms 60 feet above the water, on average (this varies a bit with the tide). It's 50 feet above ground level and 20 feet above the top of the watch tower and gantry. Two natural stone columns sit across the mouth of the inlet with only a 25-foot gap between them, so that ships must be carefully towed into the cave by small boats and maneuvered with ropes once they're inside.
zh_tw: 洞穴的頂部平均高出水面60尺（這會隨著潮汐略有變化）。它高出地面50尺，高出瞭望塔和起重機頂部20尺。兩個天然的石柱橫跨在入口處，它們之間只有25尺的間隙，因此船隻必須由小船小心拖入洞穴，並在進入後用繩索操縱。

english: Thanks to its sheltered position and the perpetual mist in the bay, the cave is difficult to find unless a person knows where to look. An alert lookout spots the structures and docked ship inside the cave automatically if passing within a half-mile of shore. At a distance up to 2 miles, a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check is needed. Lookouts at the anchorage notice a ship within 2 miles automatically.
zh_tw: 由於其隱蔽的位置和海灣中常年不散的霧氣，除非知道具體位置，否則很難找到這個洞穴。當船隻經過半英里內的海岸時，警覺的瞭望者會自動發現洞穴內的建築和停泊的船隻。在不超過2英里的距離內，需要進行一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。錨地的瞭望者會自動注意到2英里內的船隻。

english: The pirates' first line of defense is a ring of submerged rocks a quarter-mile from shore. The captain of a ship trying to sail though must make a {@dc 10} Intelligence check. If the check succeeds, the ship gets past the rocks safely. If it fails by 4 or less, the ship strikes a rock and springs a few leaks but suffers no serious damage and can continue seeking a passage through. If the check fails by 5 or more, a rock causes significant damage; the ship lists badly and its speed is halved until the hull is repaired. Striking a third rock causes the ship to sink. The pirates, of course, know where the rocks are and avoid them.
zh_tw: 海盜的第一道防線是距離海岸四分之一英里的一圈水下岩石。試圖航行的船長必須進行一次{@dc 10}的智力檢定。如果檢定成功，船隻安全透過岩石。如果失敗但差值不超過4，船隻會撞上岩石並出現一些漏水，但不會受到嚴重損壞，可以繼續尋找通道。如果差值達到5或更多，岩石會造成重大損壞；船隻嚴重傾斜，速度減半，直到船體修復。撞上第三塊岩石會導致船隻沉沒。當然，海盜知道岩石的位置並會避開它們。

english: The watchtower ({@area area 6|139|x}) and the entire elevated walkway from the tower to the warehouse ({@area area 4|135|x}) have crenelated parapets for defense. These provide {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}.
zh_tw: 瞭望塔（{@area 區域6|139|x}）和從塔到倉庫（{@area 區域4|135|x}）的整個高架走道都設有鋸齒形護牆用於防禦。這些護牆提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: Aside from the pirate crews, Jahaka Anchorage is home to a handful of pirates who answer to the tavernkeeper, {@creature Bosco Daggerhand|ToA} ({@area area 6A|139|x})—and only because he's master of the ale.
zh_tw: 除了各艘海盜船的船員，賈哈卡錨地還住著少數聽命於酒館老闆{@creature Bosco Daggerhand|ToA|博斯科·匕手}（{@area 區域6A|139|x}）的海盜——而他們服從的唯一理由，就是麥酒供應掌握在他手裡。

english: Pirates of Jahaka Anchorage
zh_tw: 賈哈卡錨地的海盜

english: Three pirate ships use Jahaka Anchorage as a base, and their captains have forged tenuous alliances with each other and {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} of Fort Beluarian. Use the deck plans in {@book appendix C|DMG|12} of the Dungeon Master's Guide to represent each pirate ship, as needed. Each ship's crew is described below.
zh_tw: 三艘海盜船將 賈哈卡 錨地作為基地，它們的船長與彼此以及貝路利安堡的{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}建立了脆弱的聯盟。根據需要，可使用城主指南的{@book 附錄C|DMG|12}中的甲板平面圖來表示每艘海盜船。每艘船的船員描述如下。

english: Dragonfang
zh_tw: 龍牙

english: Captain {@creature Elok Jaharwon|ToA} (NE male Chultan human {@creature wereboar}) has no patience or sense of humor. He was first mate of the Dragonfang until a year ago, when he staged a mutiny and hurled the former captain overboard. The other captains are still adjusting to their ill-mannered new confederate, who seems intent on bullying his way toward declaring himself king of the pirates.
zh_tw: 船長{@creature Elok Jaharwon|ToA|伊洛克·加哈望}（NE 男性楚爾特人類{@creature wereboar||野豬人}）沒有耐心也沒有幽默感。他曾是龍牙號的副船長，直到一年前，他發動了一場叛變，將前船長扔出了船。其他船長仍在適應這位粗魯的新同夥，他似乎打算透過欺凌的方式自封為海盜之王。

english: Elok wants to stop sending a slice of the pirates' profits to Fort Beluarian, which would end the alliance with {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} and probably be self-defeating; the pirates could keep more of their profit, but they'd take fewer prizes and incur more risk. The other captains see the disadvantages clearly, but Jaharwon is building a following among the rank-and-file pirates of all three crews.
zh_tw: 伊洛克想要停止向貝路利安堡傳送海盜利潤的一部分，這將結束與{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}的聯盟，並且可能會適得其反；海盜們可以保留更多的利潤，但他們將獲得更少的戰利品並承擔更大的風險。其他船長清楚地看到了這些缺點，但賈哈爾旺正在所有三支船員中的普通海盜中建立自己的追隨者。

english: The Dragonfang's crew includes a first mate named Mad Kalita (LE female Chultan human {@creature spy}), fifteen Chultan {@creature Bandit||bandits}, three Chultan {@creature Thug||thugs}, and a "sea witch" named Eye of the Deep (N female Calishite human {@creature druid}).
zh_tw: 龍牙號的船員包括一個名叫瘋狂卡利塔（瘋卡莉塔，LE 女性楚爾特人類{@creature spy||間諜}）的副船長，十五名楚爾特{@creature Bandit||匪徒}，三名楚爾特{@creature Thug||暴徒}，以及一位名為深海之眼（深淵之眼號，N 女性卡利希特人類{@creature druid||德魯伊}）的"海巫"。

english: Emerald Eye
zh_tw: 翡翠之眼

english: The calculating Captain {@creature Zaroum Al-Saryak|ToA} (LE male Calishite human {@creature bandit captain}) has a special fondness for gemstones. He wears a coat with glittering gems sewn into it (750 gp) and wears a scimitar with gemstones embedded in the hilt (1,250 gp). His ship, the Emerald Eye, has cabins decorated like rooms in a Calishite pasha's palace. Al-Saryak is fond of chopping off the heads of those who displease him and dangling them from his ship's mermaid figurehead. A long-ago injury cost him his left eye and incised a scar in the form of a large X across his face. The ruined eye socket now holds a magical gem that allows Al-Saryak to discern ghostly pathways leading to treasure. The gem works for no one else. Al-Saryak holds the {@item Sending Stones||sending stone} matched to {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA}'s (see "{@area Fort Beluarian|0f2|x}").
zh_tw: 精明的船長{@creature Zaroum Al-Saryak|ToA|扎如姆·艾薩亞克}（LE男性卡利什特人類{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}）對寶石情有獨鍾。他穿著一件縫有閃閃發光寶石的外套（750金幣），並佩戴著一把劍柄上嵌有寶石的彎刀（1250金幣）。他的船，翡翠之眼，船艙裝飾得像卡利什特帕夏宮殿裡的房間。艾薩亞克喜歡砍掉那些得罪他的人的頭，並將其懸掛在他的船的美人魚船首上。很久以前的一次傷害使他失去了左眼，並在他的臉上留下了一個大大的X形疤痕。毀壞的眼窩現在裝有一顆魔法寶石，使艾薩亞克能夠辨別通往寶藏的幽靈路徑。這顆寶石對其他人不起作用。艾薩亞克持有與{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}匹配的{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}（見"{@area 貝路利安堡|0f2|x}"）。

english: The crew of the Emerald Eye consists of a first mate named Voltan (CE male Calishite human {@creature berserker}), twelve Calishite {@creature Bandit||bandits}, two Calishite {@creature Thug||thugs}, and five Chultan {@creature Tribal Warrior||tribal warriors}.
zh_tw: 翡翠之眼號的船員包括一個名叫沃爾坦（沃爾坦，CE 男性卡利希特人類{@creature berserker||狂戰士}）的副船長，十二名卡利希特{@creature Bandit||匪徒}，兩名卡利希特{@creature Thug||暴徒}，以及五名楚爾特{@creature Tribal Warrior||部族武者}。

english: Stirge
zh_tw: 蚊蝠

english: Captain {@creature Laskilar|ToA} (NE male Tethyrian human {@creature bandit captain} wearing a {@item cape of the mountebank}) is a flamboyant, rakish pirate who's grown tired of chasing merchant ships and hearing their captains whine and plead over lost revenues and spilled blood. He'd rather seek lost treasures and magic items, but not by digging into ruins and tombs; instead, he'll happily pursue adventurers across jungles and oceans to steal whatever hard-earned plunder he believes they have. His ship, the Stirge, is filled with scoundrels and cutthroats eager to do his dirty work. {@creature Laskilar|ToA} also stays in contact with a host of wealthy patrons in Port Nyanzaru and more distant ports who are eager to pay a king's ransom for the rarest of his ill-gotten gains.
zh_tw: 船長{@creature Laskilar|ToA|拉斯基拉爾}（NE 男性特西里安人類{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}，穿著一件{@item cape of the mountebank||江湖騙子披風}）是一個浮誇、不拘小節的海盜，他已經厭倦了追逐商船，聽著船長們因為損失的收入和灑出的血而哀嚎和懇求。他更願意尋找失落的寶藏和魔法物品，但不是透過挖掘遺蹟和墳墓；相反，他樂於在叢林和海洋中追逐冒險者，偷走他認為他們辛苦賺來的戰利品。他的船，蚊蝠，充滿了流氓和刺客，渴望為他做髒活。{@creature Laskilar|ToA|拉斯基拉爾}還與南扎路港和更遠港口的一群富有贊助人保持聯絡，他們渴望為他最稀有的非法所得支付國王的贖金。

english: The crew of the Stirge includes a first mate named Heel (NE male half-orc {@creature gladiator}), twelve Chultan and Tethyrian {@creature Bandit||bandits}, six Chultan {@creature Thug||thugs}, and a mad sea priest named Caldos Hellingskorn (CE male Illuskan {@creature priest} of Umberlee).
zh_tw: 蚊蝠號的船員包括一個名叫腳跟的大副（NE男性半獸人{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}），十二名楚爾特和泰瑟爾人的{@creature Bandit||匪徒}，六名楚爾特的{@creature Thug||暴徒}，以及一個瘋狂的海祭司卡爾多斯·赫林斯科恩（CE男性伊路斯坎人的安博裡的{@creature priest||祭司}）。

english: Map 2.10: Jahaka Anchorage
zh_tw: 地圖 2.10: 賈哈卡錨地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Jungle Gate
zh_tw: 1. 叢林之門

english: The narrow strip of land between the cliff and the water is closed off by a 15-foot-high wall made of thick palm logs lashed together with stout vines. Their bottoms are set into the ground, and the whole wall is braced up along the inner side with more palm logs. The wall is meant to keep out undead and dinosaurs. The gates are roughly made but reinforced with iron bands and backed by two heavy wooden bars. The pirates never open these gates without the approval of whichever captain is currently in charge of the anchorage.
zh_tw: 懸崖和水之間的狹窄土地被一堵由厚實棕櫚樹幹製成的15尺高的牆封閉，這些樹幹用結實的藤蔓捆綁在一起。它們的底部埋入地面，整堵牆在內側用更多的棕櫚樹幹加固。這堵牆的目的是防止不死生物和恐龍進入。大門製作粗糙，但用鐵帶加固，並由兩根沉重的木條支撐。海盜們在沒有當前負責錨地的船長批准的情況下，從不開啟這些大門。

english: 2. Pier
zh_tw: 2. 碼頭

english: Whichever pirate ship is in port is tied up at this pier. Cargo is offloaded using the crane at the warehouse ({@area area 4|135|x}). The pier is covered in slick moss and perpetually in need of repair.
zh_tw: 無論哪艘海盜船在港內，都會停靠在這個碼頭。貨物使用倉庫的起重機解除安裝（{@area 區域4|135|x}）。碼頭上覆蓋著滑膩的苔蘚，並且永遠需要維修。

english: Two small boats are kept here. One is a simple dinghy used mainly for carrying food and water to prisoners in {@area area 5|138|x}. The other is a small cutter with six oars and a single mast, used for towing ships into and out of the anchorage. Any sailor recognizes that the rowboat would quickly be swamped by waves if it was taken out of the safe harbor, but the cutter could be rowed and sailed on the open sea in an emergency. It has a top speed of 5 mph under sail or half that when rowed, and it can hold up to ten Medium occupants.
zh_tw: 這裡停靠著兩艘小船。一艘是簡單的小艇，主要用於向{@area 區域5|138|x}的囚犯運送食物和水。另一艘是一艘小型快艇，配有六支槳和一根單桅杆，用於拖船進出錨地。任何水手都知道，如果小艇被帶出安全的港口，很快就會被波浪淹沒，但在緊急情況下，快艇可以被劃槳和航行在開闊的海上。它在帆下的最高速度為每小時5英里，劃槳時則減半，並且可以容納多達十個中等體型的乘客。

english: A short pier allows access to Sharkbait Rock. Prisoners with no value or who have information they refuse to give up, or pirates who've seriously broken the buccaneer's code, can be lashed to the rock. There they'll either drown at high tide or be nibbled on by sharks and other predators until their punishment is complete or their tongues are sufficiently loose.
zh_tw: 一個短碼頭可以通往鯊魚餌巖。沒有價值或拒絕提供資訊的囚犯，或者嚴重違反海盜守則的海盜，可以被綁在岩石上。在那裡，他們要麼在高潮時淹死，要麼被鯊魚和其他捕食者啃食，直到他們的懲罰完成或他們的舌頭足夠鬆動。

english: 3. Officers' Quarters Ashore
zh_tw: 3. 岸上軍官宿舍

english: Each of the three captains has one of these chambers for his private use. In practice, the captains seldom use them, preferring the comfort and safety of the cabins aboard their own ships. Instead, the use of these private quarters is meted out as a reward to crew members who distinguished themselves on the latest voyage, and as a result, they tend to be squalid and smelly.
zh_tw: 三位船長每人都有這樣一個房間供私人使用。實際上，船長們很少使用它們，更喜歡他們自己船上的舒適和安全。相反，這些私人住處的使用作為對在最近航行中表現出色的船員的獎勵，因此，它們往往很髒亂且有異味。

english: 4. Warehouse
zh_tw: 4. 倉庫

english: All three captains store their booty in this common warehouse. The double door is sealed with an iron padlock to which only the captains have keys. It can be picked with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 三位船長都將他們的戰利品儲存在這個公共倉庫中。雙扇門用一把鐵掛鎖密封，只有船長們有鑰匙。可以使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來撬開。

english: A fortified balustrade overlooks the anchorage to the south. The wooden platform extends over the water on pilings, and a crane on the platform serves to lift cargo up to the warehouse. Thrust into the rough-hewn back wall of the warehouse are scores of rusty blades—old longswords, shortswords, rapiers, scimitars, and daggers.
zh_tw: 一個加固的欄杆俯瞰著南方的錨地。木製平臺延伸在樁上，平臺上的起重機用於將貨物吊到倉庫。在倉庫粗糙的後牆上，插著許多鏽跡斑斑的刀片——舊的長劍、短劍、刺劍、彎刀和匕首。

english: Among the rusty blades stuck in the walls are ten {@creature Flying Sword||flying swords} that pull themselves free and attack when the treasure in the room (see "Treasure" below) is disturbed. The animated blades don't attack any creature wearing an eye patch, nor do they animate when an eye patch-wearing creature disturbs the treasure.
zh_tw: 在牆上插著的生鏽刀片中有十把{@creature Flying Sword||凌空劍}，當房間裡的寶藏（見下文的"寶藏"）被擾動時，它們會自行拔出並發動攻擊。這些活化的劍不會攻擊任何佩戴眼罩的生物，也不會在佩戴眼罩的生物擾動寶藏時活化。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The warehouse's treasure is contained in numerous unlocked chests, sacks, sealed crates, and casks. The trove consists of 6,400 cp, 2,500 sp, 300 gp, 60 pp, ten gold bracelets (25 gp each), an electrum goblet (25 gp), and two {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell knock} and {@spell Leomund's tiny hut}) in corked wooden tubes.
zh_tw: 倉庫的寶藏存放在許多未上鎖的箱子、袋子、密封的板條箱和木桶中。這個寶藏包括6400銅幣，2500銀幣，300金幣，60白金幣，十個金手鐲（每個25金幣），一個銻制高腳杯（25金幣），以及兩個裝在塞著軟木塞的木管中的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell knock||敲擊術}和{@spell Leomund's tiny hut||李歐蒙小屋}）。

english: 5. The Cage
zh_tw: 5. 籠子

english: Prisoners are held in this large but filthy cell until they're ransomed or sold into slavery. High waves sometimes wash into the chamber, soaking everyone and leaving puddles on the floor. Palm logs form the bars across the front of the cage; they're held in place by sturdy pins that must be noisily hammered out before the logs can be lifted out to create a gap wide enough for a Small or Medium creature to slip through. Escape is risky for three reasons. First, pirates on watch atop the tower ({@area area 6|139|x}) keep an eye on the cage. Second, {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Reef Shark||reef sharks} inhabit the water below the cage. Third, the only place escapees can go is the jungle, which is more cruel than the pirates.
zh_tw: 囚犯被關在這個大而骯髒的牢房裡，直到他們被贖回或被賣為奴隸。高浪有時會衝進室內，浸溼每個人並在地板上留下水坑。棕櫚木條構成了籠子前面的柵欄；它們由堅固的銷釘固定，必須先用力敲打出來，然後才能抬起木條，為小型或中型生物創造一個足夠寬的縫隙。逃跑有三個風險。首先，塔上（{@area 區域6|139|x}）的海盜會監視籠子。其次，{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature Reef Shark||礁鯊}棲息在籠子下方的水域。第三，逃跑者唯一能去的地方是叢林，叢林比海盜更殘酷。

english: Whether any prisoners are in the cell when characters arrive at Jahaka Anchorage is up to you, but it's seldom empty. Besides captive sailors and merchants, there could also be Harpers, Zhents, or adventurers. Adventurers imprisoned here could be members of the Society of Stalwart Adventurers, a group from Cormyr that maps uncharted places and hunts for lost artifacts. Characters who have not yet encountered {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} might find them hiding nearby, plotting to free the prisoners. As a former member of the Society of Stalwart Adventurers, Artus would be motivated to help other society members in jeopardy.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達賈哈卡錨地時，牢房裡是否有囚犯由你決定，但這裡很少空著。除了被俘的水手和商人，還可能有哈珀斯、詹特斯或冒險家。被囚禁在這裡的冒險家可能是來自科米爾的堅定冒險家協會的成員，這個組織負責繪製未標地圖的地方並尋找失落的神器。如果角色們還沒有遇到{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}，他們可能會發現他們藏在附近，計劃釋放囚犯。作為堅定冒險家協會的前成員，阿圖斯會有動機幫助處於危險中的其他協會成員。

english: 6. Watchtower
zh_tw: 6. 瞭望塔

english: This ramshackle watchtower stands 30 feet above "dry" land. It's surrounded by a crenelated parapet that provides {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} to defenders. A ballista is also mounted on the tower. It can be used against vessels intruding in the anchorage, but it's primarily for defense against large reptiles threatening the jungle wall ({@area area 1|132|x}). Two pirates ({@creature Bandit||bandits}) are always on duty atop the tower, and more come pouring out of Bosco's Bilge (area 6A) if the brass alarm bell is rung. A spiral staircase carved into a nearby pillar of rock allows access to Bosco's Bilge.
zh_tw: 這座破舊的瞭望塔高30尺，位於"乾燥"的陸地之上。它被帶有城垛的護牆所環繞，為防禦者提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。塔上還安裝了一臺弩炮。它可以用於對付侵入錨地的船隻，但主要是為了防禦威脅叢林牆的大型爬行動物（{@area 區域1|132|x}）。塔頂總是有兩名海盜（{@creature Bandit||匪徒}）值班，如果銅質警報鈴被敲響，更多的海盜會從博斯科的船艙（區域6A）湧出。一個螺旋樓梯被雕刻在附近的岩石柱上，可以通往博斯科的船艙。

english: 6A. Bosco's Bilge
zh_tw: 6A. 博斯科的底艙

english: This structure is built from the hull of a captured ship that was too slow to be used as a pirate ship, but it had one fine quality: it didn't leak. The pirates hauled it out of the bay, hacked it apart, and flipped it upside down to form a building of sorts. It's now Bosco's Bilge, an ersatz tavern catering to the off-duty pirate crews relaxing at Jahaka Anchorage. The room contains benches, stools, and a few tables on a sand floor. It reeks of spilled beer, old food, and stale tobacco smoke.
zh_tw: 這個建築是用一艘被俘獲的船隻的船體建造的，這艘船速度太慢，無法用作海盜船，但它有一個優點：它不漏水。海盜們把它從海灣拖出來，把它砍碎，然後倒過來形成一個類似建築的東西。現在它是博斯科的船底，一個為在賈哈卡錨地放鬆的下班海盜船員提供服務的仿製酒館。房間裡有長凳、凳子和一些桌子，地板上鋪著沙子。它散發著溢位的啤酒、舊食物和陳舊菸草煙霧的氣味。

english: The proprietor is {@creature Bosco Daggerhand|ToA} (NE male human {@creature thug} who wears a {@item ring of animal influence}), so called because he never shakes anyone's hand without his other hand resting threateningly on the dagger in his sash. He keeps a semi-tame {@creature deinonychus|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) as a guard animal, which he controls with his magic ring. The pirates refer to the raptor as Knuckles—because someone who's foolish enough to let it nip their hand won't have anything else left.
zh_tw: 店主是{@creature Bosco Daggerhand|ToA|博斯科·匕手}（NE 男性人類{@creature thug||暴徒}，戴著一個{@item ring of animal influence||影響動物戒指}），之所以這樣稱呼，是因為他從不在不威脅性地將另一隻手放在腰帶上的匕首上的情況下與任何人握手。他養了一隻半馴服的{@creature deinonychus|VGM|恐爪龍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）作為守衛動物，他用他的魔法戒指來控制它。海盜們稱這隻猛禽為指節——因為足夠愚蠢讓它咬一口的人將不會再有其他的手。

english: Any time of the day or night, {@dice 2d6} pirates ({@creature Bandit||bandits}) are carousing in Bosco's Bilge. Another {@dice 1d6} pirates are passed out on the tables or floor.
zh_tw: 無論白天還是夜晚，{@dice 2d6}名海盜（{@creature Bandit||匪徒}）在博斯科的船底酒吧裡狂歡。另外還有{@dice 1d6}名海盜躺在桌子上或地板上不省人事。

english: 6B. Kitchen
zh_tw: 6B. 廚房

english: Bosco's customers aren't very interested in food, but the simple fare he offers—boiled shark, roasted snake, and other jungle delights—is prepared here. When leftovers become so rancid the pirates won't eat them, they're either fed to the deinonychus or sent to the captives in the cage ({@area area 5|138|x}). The door to the kitchen is always closed, to keep Knuckles from raiding the pantry.
zh_tw: 博斯科的顧客對食物不太感興趣，但他提供的簡單食物——煮鯊魚、烤蛇和其他叢林美食——是在這裡準備的。當剩飯變得如此腐敗，海盜們不願意吃時，它們要麼餵給恐龍雞，要麼送到籠子裡的俘虜那裡（{@area 區域5|138|x}）。廚房的門總是關著的，以防止克努克爾斯偷吃儲藏室裡的食物。

english: 6C. Bosco's Bunk
zh_tw: 6C. 博斯科的鋪位

english: Bosco's private room contains a hammock, a locked sea chest stuffed with clothes and trinkets, a few musty books, and a pile of reeds for Knuckles to sleep on. Bosco carries the key to the chest, or the lock can be picked with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 博斯科的私人房間裡有一個吊床、一個塞滿衣物和小飾品的上鎖海箱、幾本發黴的書籍，以及一堆給納克爾斯睡覺用的蘆葦。博斯科隨身攜帶箱子的鑰匙，或者可以使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A false bottom in the sea chest can be found with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The compartment holds 58 gp, 140 sp, a {@item potion of water breathing}, and three black eye patches. (The pirate captains don the eye patches before trying to remove treasure from {@area area 4|135|x}.)
zh_tw: 透過成功的 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，可以在海箱中發現一個假底。隔間內裝有 58 gp、140 sp、一瓶 {@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水} 和三塊黑色眼罩。（海盜船長們在嘗試從 {@area 區域4|135|x} 移除寶藏前會戴上眼罩。）

english: Jahaka Bay
zh_tw: 賈哈卡灣

english: Pirate ships enter and leave this bay as they come and go from Jahaka Anchorage. The River Tath plunges down multiple waterfalls before spilling into the bay, so mist perpetually drifts out of the river mouth and across the bay. This mist isn't especially heavy but its effect accumulates over distance, so it restricts visibility to a few miles on all but the windiest days. The outline of the coastal mountains can be seen from any distance in the bay, but finer details—something the size of a ship or smaller, for example—can't be discerned from more than 2 or 3 miles distant. Since the bay is about 20 miles wide and 40 miles deep, it's an excellent hiding spot for pirates. Any ship that wanders into the bay without knowing precisely where to look is unlikely to stumble upon Jahaka Anchorage.
zh_tw: 海盜船隻進出這個海灣，來往於賈哈卡錨地。塔斯河在流入海灣之前，經過多個瀑布，因此霧氣永遠從河口飄出，瀰漫在海灣上。這種霧不是特別濃，但其效果隨距離累積，因此在除了風最大的日子之外，它限制了能見度只有幾英里。從海灣的任何地方都可以看到沿海山脈的輪廓，但更精細的細節——例如船隻或更小的物體——從超過2或3英里的距離就無法辨認了。由於海灣寬約20英里，深40英里，它是海盜的絕佳藏身之處。任何不知道精確位置就誤入海灣的船隻不太可能偶然發現賈哈卡錨地。

english: Kir Sabal
zh_tw: 基爾·薩巴爾

english: An ancient monastery overlooks the jungle from its perch on the cliff of a tall plateau. Stone steps and rickety walkways connect the various buildings, the lowest of which is 500 feet above the ground. The main building has a circular mazelike symbol carved into its crumbling facade.
zh_tw: 一座古老的修道院坐落在高高的高原懸崖上，俯瞰著叢林。石階和搖搖欲墜的走道連線著各個建築，其中最低的建築離地面有500尺。主建築的破敗立面上雕刻著一個圓形迷宮般的符號。

english: Every few minutes, bird folk either land at the monastery or launch themselves from its balconies and take to the sky.
zh_tw: 每隔幾分鐘，鳥人族要麼在修道院降落，要麼從它的陽臺上起飛，飛向天空。

english: Kir Sabal (map 2.11) is home to a flock of aarakocra and a peaceful sanctuary where heroes can find rest and safety—if they can reach it. The aarakocra are also sheltering the last human descendants of the royal line of Omu. If the characters eventually liberate Omu from the evil possessing it, the royal line can be restored.
zh_tw: 基爾·薩巴爾（地圖2.11）是一群鳥羽人的家園，也是一個和平的庇護所，英雄們可以在這裡找到休息和安全——如果他們能夠到達那裡。鳥羽人也在庇護奧穆王室血統的最後人類後裔。如果角色們最終從邪惡的控制中解放奧穆，王室血統就可以恢復。

english: Originally, the monastery structures could be reached by ascending a path that combined natural stone ramps, steps cut into the cliff face, and wooden walkways built onto the cliff. The ramps and steps are still mostly intact, but the wooden walkways are rotting or missing entirely in many places. The aarakocra don't need them and have no reason to repair them.
zh_tw: 最初，修道院的建築可以透過一條結合了天然石坡、在懸崖面上鑿出的臺階和建在懸崖上的木製走道的路徑到達。坡道和臺階大多仍然完好，但許多地方的木製走道已經腐爛或完全缺失。鳥羽人族不需要它們，也沒有理由去修復它們。

english: To reach the monastery from the ground, a character must make three ability checks. Each time a check fails, the character must choose between either taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage from a fall or gaining 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} (which means disadvantage on further ability checks). The three ability checks are as follows:
zh_tw: 要從地面到達修道院，角色必須進行三次屬性檢定。每次檢定失敗時，角色必須選擇要麼承受10（{@dice 3d6}）點因跌落造成的鈍擊傷害，要麼獲得1級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態（這意味著在後續的屬性檢定上會有劣勢）。這三次屬性檢定如下：

english: A {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to climb around gaps in the walkway.
zh_tw: 一個 {@dc 15} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定來在走道的縫隙中攀爬。

english: A {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to cross wide gaps in the wooden walkways by jumping along oddly spaced support beams.
zh_tw: 進行一次{@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定，透過在間隔怪異的支撐樑上跳躍來穿過木棧道上的寬大間隙。

english: A {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot rotted planking that won't support weight.
zh_tw: 進行一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，以發現無法承重的腐爛木板。

english: The climb takes 1 hour, plus 10 minutes for every failed ability check. Unless characters make the climb invisibly, at night, or during a rainstorm, it's impossible to reach the monastery without the aarakocra knowing they're coming.
zh_tw: 攀登需要1小時，加上每次失敗的屬性檢定額外的10分鐘。除非角色以隱形的方式攀登，或在夜間或暴風雨期間，否則在鳥羽人族不知情的情況下到達修道院是不可能的。

english: Fifty-six {@creature aarakocra} live in Kir Sabal, in twelve "nests" or extended family groups. About a third of the aarakocra population are juveniles; the rest are adults split evenly between males and females. They live primarily by hunting in the jungle, fishing along the River Olung, and gardening atop the plateau, where they're safe from most of Chult's predators.
zh_tw: 五十六隻{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}居住在基爾·薩巴爾，分為十二個"巢穴"或大家庭群體。大約三分之一的鳥羽人人口是幼體；其餘的是成年體，男女數量相等。他們主要透過在叢林中狩獵，在奧倫河沿岸捕魚，以及在高原上耕作來維持生活，在那裡他們遠離了楚爾特大部分的捕食者。

english: The leader of the community is an incredibly old aarakocra named {@creature Asharra|ToA}. The others refer to her as Teacher, and they revere her as a living saint. {@creature Asharra|ToA} is intelligent, ambitious, and somewhat manipulative, but never cruel or insensitive. {@creature Asharra|ToA} is an {@creature aarakocra}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 這個社群的領袖是一隻極其年長的鳥人，名叫{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}。其他人稱她為老師，並尊她為活聖人。{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}聰明、野心勃勃，並且有些操縱慾，但從不殘忍或冷漠。{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}是一隻{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}，但有以下變化：

english: {@creature Asharra|ToA} is lawful neutral.
zh_tw: {@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 是守序中立的。

english: She has 31 ({@dice 7d8}) hit points.
zh_tw: 她有31點（{@dice 7d8}）生命值。

english: She has an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 17, and the following skills: {@skill History} +4, {@skill Insight} +5, {@skill Perception} +7.
zh_tw: 她的感知是14，感知是17，並且擁有以下技能：{@skill History||歷史} +4，{@skill Insight||洞悉} +5，{@skill Perception||感知} +7。

english: She has the Spellcasting trait described below.
zh_tw: 她具備下面描述的施法特性。

english: She speaks Auran and Common.
zh_tw: 她說氣族語和通用語。

english: She has a challenge rating of 2 (450 XP).
zh_tw: 她的挑戰等級為2（450經驗值）。

english: Spellcasting
zh_tw: 施法

english: {@creature Asharra|ToA} is a 5th-level spellcaster who uses Wisdom as her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}; {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:
zh_tw: {@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 是一個5級施法者，使用感知作為她的施法屬性（法術豁免 {@dc 13}；法術攻擊命中 {@hit 5}）。她準備了以下德魯伊法術：

english: Cantrips (at will): {@spell druidcraft}, {@spell mending}, {@spell produce flame}
zh_tw: 隨意施放的戲法：{@spell druidcraft||德魯伊伎倆}，{@spell mending||修復術}，{@spell produce flame||燃火術}

english: 1st level (4 slots): {@spell detect magic}, {@spell faerie fire}, {@spell thunderwave}
zh_tw: 1環（4個法術位）：{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}（偵測魔法），{@spell faerie fire||妖火}（仙女火），{@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}（雷鳴波）

english: 2nd level (3 slots): {@spell gust of wind}, {@spell hold person}, {@spell lesser restoration}
zh_tw: 2環（3個法術位）：{@spell gust of wind||造風術}，{@spell hold person||定身類人}，{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}

english: 3rd level (2 slots): {@spell call lightning}, {@spell wind wall}
zh_tw: 3環（2個法術位）：{@spell call lightning||召雷術}（召喚閃電），{@spell wind wall||風牆術}（風牆）

english: The aarakocra of Kir Sabal lead ritualistic lives and follow strict rules of behavior laid down by tradition and the Teacher. To a large extent, the rules and rituals have taken on a life of their own irrespective of any religious observance.
zh_tw: 基爾·薩巴爾的鳥羽人族過著儀式化的生活，遵循由傳統和教師制定的嚴格行為規則。在很大程度上，這些規則和儀式已經獨立於任何宗教儀式而形成了自己的生活。

english: If the characters approach peacefully, they'll be welcome in Kir Sabal as long as they don't harm anyone, disrupt traditions, steal, or lie. Even as guests, they're expected to spend a few hours a day helping with chores (sweeping floors and cleaning dishes, mostly).
zh_tw: 如果角色們和平地接近，只要他們不傷害任何人，不擾亂傳統，不偷竊，不撒謊，他們就會在基爾·薩巴爾受到歡迎。即使作為客人，他們也預期每天要花幾個小時幫忙做家務（主要是掃地和洗碗）。

english: If the characters tell {@creature Asharra|ToA} of their plan to visit Omu and destroy the Soulmonger, she offers to perform a ritual called the Dance of the Seven Winds, bestowing on the characters the magical ability to fly (see the "Dance of the Seven Winds" sidebar). To complete the ritual, she needs a black orchid, which can be found only in {@area Nangalore|166|x} (described later in this chapter). {@creature Asharra|ToA} can provide directions, but she doesn't allow her people to go anywhere near the ruins because of the evil, intelligent cranes (eblis) known to live there.
zh_tw: 如果角色們告訴{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}他們計劃訪問奧穆並摧毀噬魂器，她會提出進行一個叫做七風之舞的儀式，賦予角色們魔法飛行能力（見"七風之舞"側邊欄）。為了完成儀式，她需要一朵黑蘭花，這種花只能在{@area 南戈爾|166|x}找到（本章後面有描述）。{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}可以提供方向，但她不允許她的人民靠近廢墟，因為那裡有已知居住的邪惡、有智慧的鶴（魔王鶴）。

english: Dance of the Seven Winds
zh_tw: 七風之舞

english: {@creature Asharra|ToA} knows a ritual called the Dance of the Seven Winds, which temporarily grants magical flight to as many as ten nonflying creatures. The ritual, which takes 10 minutes to complete, can only be performed by an aarakocra elder and requires a black orchid as a material component.
zh_tw: {@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 知道一種叫做七風之舞的儀式，該儀式能暫時賦予多達十隻非飛行生物魔法飛行能力。這個儀式需要10分鐘才能完成，只能由一個鳥羽人族長執行，並且需要一朵黑色蘭花作為材料元件。

english: {@creature Asharra|ToA} must grind the orchid to powder, inhale it, and dance in circles around the ritual's beneficiaries uninterrupted while seven other aarakocra chant prayers to the Wind Dukes of Aaqa. When the dance concludes, {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s wings disappear and she loses the ability to fly. The ritual's beneficiaries each gain a magical flying speed of 30 feet (allowing them to fly 4 miles per hour). This benefit lasts for 3 days, after which {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s wings reappear and she regains the ability to fly.
zh_tw: {@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 必須將蘭花磨成粉末，吸入它，並在儀式受益者的周圍不間斷地跳舞，同時其他七個鳥羽人向風公爵阿卡唸誦祈禱。當舞蹈結束時，{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 的翅膀會消失，她將失去飛行能力。儀式的受益者每人獲得30尺的魔法飛行速度（使他們能夠以每小時4英里的速度飛行）。這個好處持續3天，之後{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾} 的翅膀會重新出現，她將重新獲得飛行能力。

english: Seventeen-year-old {@creature Mwaxanaré|ToA|Princess Mwaxanaré} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) is the oldest living descendant of the royal families of Omu and the primary heir to the fallen kingdom. She and her six-year-old brother {@creature Na|ToA} (a noncombatant with AC 10 and 3 hit points) are guests of the aarakocra—although "wards" might be a more accurate description. Their great-grandmother, Napaka, was the last ruling queen of Omu; their father, Omek, died in a fall, and their mother, Razaan, was killed by pterafolk. The aarakocra aim to protect the young royals (and their progeny, if necessary) until the evil in Omu is banished. The aarakocra say that they're doing this solely for the future of Chult, but {@creature Asharra|ToA} secretly hopes that the aarakocra will be elevated to key roles in any renewed Chultan kingdom, if and when it comes about.
zh_tw: 十七歲的{@creature Mwaxanaré|ToA|公主姆瓦克絲娜瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）是奧穆王室現存最年長的後裔，也是這個陷落王國的主要繼承人。她和她的六歲弟弟{@creature Na|ToA|娜}（一個非戰鬥人員，AC 10和3點生命值）是鳥羽人族的客人——儘管"受監護人"可能是更準確的描述。他們的曾祖母，納帕卡，是奧穆的最後一位統治女王；他們的父親，奧梅克，在一次跌落中去世，他們的母親，拉贊，被翼手獸殺害。鳥羽人族的目標是保護年輕的王室成員（以及他們後代，如果必要的話），直到奧穆的邪惡被驅逐。鳥羽人族說他們這樣做完全是出於楚特的未來，但{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}秘密希望，如果楚特王國得以復興，鳥羽人族將能在其中擔任關鍵角色。

english: Mwaxanaré is vain, headstrong, and impatient to claim her throne. She doesn't take kindly to backtalk and is unaccustomed to speaking to anyone except {@creature Asharra|ToA} without condescension. In her view, she's already Queen of Chult; the rest of the world is at fault for not acknowledging that.
zh_tw: 姆瓦克絲娜瑞自負、固執，並且急切地想要奪取她的王位。她不喜歡別人反駁，也不習慣在不居高臨下的情況下與除了{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}之外的任何人交談。在她看來，她已經是楚爾特的女王了；世界其他地方沒有承認這一點是他們的錯。

english: Unfortunately, the princess's whole life has been sheltered at Kir Sabal, so her understanding of the world beyond the monastery is woefully, almost comically, narrow and distorted. For example, she never refers to other kingdoms as anything but principalities or holdings ("the holding of Waterdeep," "the principality of Amn"); she believes that the other rulers of Faerûn would send thousands of soldiers to her aid in a matter of days if they were aware of her need; and she's certain the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru will welcome her return and gladly hand over rulership of the city to their rightful monarch. The world as she understands it is tiny and hungry for her leadership. Mwaxanaré isn't a fool; for the most part, these are things she's been taught by {@creature Asharra|ToA}.
zh_tw: 不幸的是，公主的一生都在基爾薩巴爾受到庇護，因此她對寺院之外世界的理解非常狹隘，幾乎到了可笑的地步。例如，她從不將其他國家稱為王國，只稱之為領地或侯國（"深水城的領地"，"安姆的侯國"）；她相信，如果費倫的其他統治者知道她需要幫助，他們會在幾天內派出成千上萬的士兵來援助她；她確信，南扎路港的商王會歡迎她的歸來，並樂意將城市的統治權交給他們合法的君主。她所理解的世界是渺小的，渴望她的領導。姆瓦克絲娜瑞並不是傻瓜；在很大程度上，這些都是由{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}教給她的。

english: Mwaxanaré believes she can garner widespread support to repopulate and rebuild Omu by retrieving a symbolically significant yet long-lost treasure called the Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare (see {@area chapter 5|4c3|x}). If the characters claim to be headed to Omu, she urges them to find the chalice and return it to her "for the good of Chult." If the characters request something more substantial as a reward, she offers them 250 gp worth of choice pieces from her private treasury (see {@area area 5|154|x}).
zh_tw: 姆瓦克絲娜瑞相信，透過找回一個象徵性重要但早已失傳的寶藏——查加卡雷的骷髏聖盃（見{@area 第五章|4c3|x}），她能夠獲得廣泛的支援來重新人口和重建奧穆。如果角色聲稱他們要去奧穆，她敦促他們找到聖盃並將其歸還給她"為了楚特的利益"。如果角色要求更實質性的獎勵，她提供給他們價值250金幣的精選物品，來自她的私人財寶（見{@area 區域5|154|x}）。

english: Although the aarakocra treat her well, Mwaxanaré is lonely; the only other human in Kir Sabal is her brother. Consequently, the princess is likely to fixate on one of the adventurers as a potential romantic partner. This attachment will be powerful, fiery, and jealous, and Mwaxanaré is accustomed to getting everything she wants.
zh_tw: 儘管鳥羽人對她很好，姆瓦克絲娜瑞仍然感到孤獨；基爾·薩巴爾唯一的另一個人類是她的兄弟。因此，公主可能會對其中一位冒險者產生強烈的依戀，視其為潛在的浪漫伴侶。這種依戀將是強烈、熱烈且嫉妒的，而姆瓦克絲娜瑞習慣於得到她想要的一切。

english: Against {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s wishes, the princess forged a pact with the Wind Dukes of Aaqa, ancient beings of the Outer Planes, to become a fledgling warlock. She detests physical labor and puts her {@spell mage hand} and {@spell unseen servant} spells to constant use. Through her pact, she has also gained telepathy, which she enjoys using.
zh_tw: 違背了{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}的意願，公主與外層位面的古老生物風公爵阿卡締結了契約，成為了一名新手魔契師。她厭惡體力勞動，並且經常使用她的{@spell mage hand||法師之手}和{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}法術。透過她的契約，她還獲得了心靈感應能力，她喜歡使用。

english: If {@creature Asharra|ToA} suspects that Mwaxanaré might learn disturbing or inconvenient truths about the world from the characters, or that her passion for one of them might lead to tragedy, they become a dangerous presence in {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s eyes—and Kir Sabal is a precarious place for creatures without wings.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}懷疑姆瓦克絲娜瑞可能從角色們那裡瞭解到關於世界的令人不安或不便的真相，或者她對其中一人的熱情可能導致悲劇，那麼在{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}眼中，他們就成了一個危險的存在——對於沒有翅膀的生物來說，基爾·薩巴爾是一個危險的地方。

english: {@creature Na|ToA} wears an aarakocra costume he made himself and pretends to be one of the bird folk. He is uncommonly studious and bookish for a six-year-old boy. He is polite, deferential, and speaks softly with a wisdom beyond his meager years. His only outdoor interests are walking among the gardens atop the plateau, where he studies plants and insects, and launching complex flying toys made of wood and folded paper out the window of his room and watching them glide lazily across the jungle. {@creature Na|ToA} would laugh, and then be aghast, if anyone suggested he would make a better monarch than Mwaxanaré.
zh_tw: {@creature Na|ToA|娜}穿著他自己製作的鳥羽人族服裝，假裝是鳥人族之一。對於一個六歲的男孩來說，他異常勤奮好學，喜歡讀書。他彬彬有禮，恭敬，說話輕聲細語，卻有著超越他微小年齡的感知。他唯一的戶外活動興趣是在高原頂部的花園中散步，在那裡他研究植物和昆蟲，以及從他房間的窗戶放飛由木頭和摺紙製成的複雜飛行玩具，看著它們在叢林上空悠閒地滑翔。如果有人建議他會比姆瓦克絲娜瑞成為更好的君主，{@creature Na|ToA|娜}會笑，然後感到震驚。

english: When Gargoyles Attack
zh_tw: 當石像鬼攻擊時

english: The gargoyles of Omu and the aarakocra of Kir Sabal are bitter enemies. Aarakocra scouts watch over the distant city, and their brazen intrusion annoys the gargoyles. Once in a while, gargoyles follow a patrol back to Kir Sabal and attack the monastery. If this happens while the characters are visiting Kir Sabal, the aarakocra appreciate whatever help the party can provide. The attacking force consists of ten gargoyles. If six or more are slain, the rest fly back to Omu.
zh_tw: 奧穆的石像鬼和基爾·薩巴爾的鳥羽人是死敵。鳥羽人偵察兵監視著遠處的城市，他們厚顏無恥的入侵激怒了石像鬼。偶爾，石像鬼會跟蹤巡邏隊回到基爾·薩巴爾並攻擊修道院。如果這發生在角色們訪問基爾·薩巴爾期間，鳥羽人會感激隊伍所能提供的幫助。攻擊力量由十隻石像鬼組成。如果殺死了六隻或更多，其餘的會飛回奧穆。

english: Map 2.11: Kir Sabal
zh_tw: 地圖 2.11: 基爾·薩巴爾

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Monastery
zh_tw: 1. 修道院

english: Six {@creature aarakocra} inhabit the monastery, living as monks. While in the monastery, they wear prayer bead necklaces and paint labyrinthine patterns on their beaks, hands, and feet.
zh_tw: 六隻{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}居住在修道院中，過著僧侶的生活。在修道院時，它們戴著念珠項鍊，並在喙、手和腳上繪製迷宮般的圖案。

english: A large, circular labyrinth symbol of Ubtao is painted on the face of this building, but it can't be seen from anywhere in Kir Sabal; it's visible only from the air or from the ground below.
zh_tw: 這座建築的表面畫著一個大型的圓形迷宮符號，這是烏博塔的象徵，但在基爾·薩巴爾的任何地方都看不到它；只有在從空中或從下方地面看時才能看到。

english: 1A. Refectory
zh_tw: 1A. 食堂

english: The entrance hall of the monastery is also the dining chamber. The aarakocra monks take all their meals here, but it's also where meetings take place. The aarakocra use backless benches and stools for seats, to accommodate their wings. The table can seat twenty.
zh_tw: 修道院的入口大廳也是餐廳。鳥羽人僧侶們在這裡吃所有的餐點，但這裡也是舉行會議的地方。鳥羽人使用無靠背的長凳和凳子作為座位，以適應他們的翅膀。這張桌子可以容納二十人。

english: 1B. Prayer Hall
zh_tw: 1B. 祈禱大廳

english: This is the main hall of the monastery, and it's an impressive sight. The rafters of the ceiling are fully 60 feet above the floor, and the peak of the thatched roof is 15 feet above that. The space is large enough that aarakocra can fly inside it, though they seldom do for the sake of decorum.
zh_tw: 這是修道院的主廳，是一個令人印象深刻的景象。天花板的椽子距離地面整整60尺，而茅草屋頂的頂端又比椽子高出15尺。這個空間足夠大，以至於鳥羽人可以在室內飛行，儘管為了禮儀，他們很少這樣做。

english: The circular labyrinth symbol of Ubtao is laid out on a floor mosaic 25 feet in diameter. The aarakocra monks spend much of their days meditating while viewing the labyrinth from the lower and upper landings of the staircase. Other aarakocra come here only on special occasions such as weddings, funerals, and holy days.
zh_tw: 烏博塔的圓形迷宮符號被鋪設在直徑25尺的地板馬賽克上。鳥羽人僧侶們花費大部分時間在樓梯的上下平臺上冥想，同時凝視迷宮。其他鳥羽人只有在特殊場合，如婚禮、葬禮和聖日時才會來到這裡。

english: 1C. Masters' Quarters
zh_tw: 1C. 導師寢室

english: The aarakocra monks use these sleeping chambers. Each chamber contains a bunk bed and a small table for a candle and washbasin. The monks have no possessions; even their clothes and prayer beads belong to the monastery.
zh_tw: 這些睡眠室由鳥羽人僧侶使用。每個房間內有一個雙層床和一張小桌子，用於放置蠟燭和洗手盆。僧侶們沒有任何個人財產；即使是他們的衣服和祈禱唸珠也屬於修道院。

english: 1D. Antechamber
zh_tw: 1D. 前廳

english: Before entering the shrine, the monks prepare themselves in this antechamber by washing with scented oils, reading from inspirational scrolls, and painting labyrinthine patterns onto their beaks, hands, and feet.
zh_tw: 在進入神殿之前，僧侶們在這個前廳準備自己，透過用香精油洗滌，閱讀啟發性的卷軸，並在他們的喙、手和腳上繪製迷宮圖案。

english: 1E. Shrine
zh_tw: 1E. 神殿

english: A life-size wooden statue of a noble tabaxi stands against the far wall, draped in flowers and beads and wreathed in incense smoke. Unlike the other statues in Kir Sabal, this one is in excellent condition, though it's still very old. It can be recognized as a portrayal of Ubtao in tabaxi form with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check. The aarakocra don't know the statue as Ubtao; they revere it simply as a talisman that safeguards Kir Sabal and as a focus for meditation.
zh_tw: 一尊與真斑貓人貴族等高的木製雕像靠在對面的牆上，被鮮花和珠子裝飾，並環繞著薰香的煙霧。與基爾薩巴爾的其他雕像不同，這座雕像儲存完好，儘管它仍然非常古老。透過成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，可以認出這是烏塔奧以斑貓人形態的描繪。阿卡拉寇拉人並不認識這座雕像是烏塔奧；他們僅僅將它視為保護基爾薩巴爾的護符和冥想的焦點。

english: 1F. Training Hall
zh_tw: 1F. 訓練大廳

english: The aarakocra monks use this hall for instruction in meditation and martial arts. It contains no furniture except woven grass mats.
zh_tw: 鳥羽人族僧侶們在這個大廳裡進行冥想和武術的教學。這裡除了編織的草蓆之外沒有其他傢俱。

english: 2. Cleansing Chambers
zh_tw: 2. 淨化室

english: Aarakocra ritually cleanse themselves in this building before visiting the monastery. This is also where they leave offerings for Teacher and their mysterious guardian figure (the statues of Ubtao as a tabaxi).
zh_tw: 鳥羽人在訪問修道院之前，會在這座建築內進行儀式性的清潔。這也是他們為教師和他們神秘的守護者形象（烏博塔作為斑貓人的雕像）留下供品的地方。

english: 2A. Washroom
zh_tw: 2A. 洗手間

english: The lower chamber contains a wash basin for performing ablutions and smaller vessels of salt, powdered chalk, and gold dust (50 gp worth) for sprinkling onto one's feathers before visiting the monastery.
zh_tw: 下層房間設有一個洗手盆，用於進行淨身儀式，還有裝有鹽、粉末狀粉筆和金粉（價值50金幣）的較小容器，用於在訪問修道院前撒在羽毛上。

english: 2B. Shrine
zh_tw: 2B. 神殿

english: The upper chamber contains a wooden case with shelves of candles and head scarves for visitors to the monastery. At the east end of the chamber is a 5-foot-tall wooden statue with flowers and offerings of food placed at its feet. The statue is obviously very old, and it's worn almost smooth by thousands of hands brushing against it, so it's impossible to determine what it originally portrayed. Offerings left here are picked up daily by {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s servant and placed on the statues in the monastery or the elder's house.
zh_tw: 上層房間內有一個木製的箱子，上面放著供修道院訪客使用的蠟燭和頭巾。在房間的東端，有一個5尺高的木製雕像，雕像腳下放著鮮花和食物供品。這個雕像顯然非常古老，成千上萬隻手的觸控使它幾乎變得光滑，因此無法確定它最初描繪的是什麼。這裡留下的供品每天由{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}的僕人收集，並放置在修道院或長老的房子裡的雕像上。

english: 3. Elder's House
zh_tw: 3. 長老的房屋

english: {@creature Asharra|ToA} and an elderly female {@creature aarakocra} servant named Yingmatona (pronounced ying-mah-TOE-nah) live in this grand structure. No other aarakocra ever set foot inside. Mwaxanaré visits occasionally, and only {@creature Na|ToA} is allowed to come and go as he pleases. This building is off-limits to the characters unless they're invited inside. Trespassing in the Teacher's home is a horrendous breach of hospitality.
zh_tw: {@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}和一位名叫英瑪託娜（發音為ying-mah-TOE-nah）的年邁女性{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}侍從居住在這座宏偉的建築中。其他翼族從未踏入過此地。姆瓦克絲娜瑞偶爾會來訪，只有{@creature Na|ToA|娜}可以隨意進出。除非受到邀請，否則角色不得進入這座建築。擅闖教師的家是對待客之道的嚴重違背。

english: 3A. Shrine
zh_tw: 3A. 神殿

english: The lower floor of the house is a single room. Yingmatona sleeps on a mattress under the stairs. A life-size wooden statue resembling a tabaxi stands opposite the door. Flowers and offerings of food are placed at its feet. The statue is obviously very old and carved in the stylized Chultan manner, so a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check is needed to recognize it as a depiction of Ubtao as a tabaxi. This realization is automatic if someone already figured it out in the monastery.
zh_tw: 房子的下層是一個單間房間。英瑪託娜在樓梯下的床墊上睡覺。一尊與斑貓人相似的真人大小木雕像位於門的對面。雕像的腳下襬放著鮮花和供品。雕像明顯非常古老，且以丘爾坦風格雕刻，因此需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定才能認出這是烏布塔奧以斑貓人形象出現的描繪。如果有人在修道院中已經發現了這一點，那麼這一認識將自動實現。

english: The walls of the chamber bear faded frescoes of floral designs and—somewhat jarringly—mathematical symbols. A section of floor has collapsed from age. Anything falling through plunges hundreds of feet to the rocks below.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上有著已經褪色的花卉圖案壁畫，以及——有些不協調地——數學符號。地板的一部分由於年久失修而塌陷。任何掉落的東西都會墜入下方數百尺的岩石上。

english: 3B. Asharra's Quarters
zh_tw: 3B. 阿莎爾的房間

english: The upper floor is decorated with frescoes similar to those on the lower floor. The landing atop the stairs has no windows, being set inside the cliff, but it's dimly lit by two candles (one at each end of the hallway).
zh_tw: 上層裝飾有與下層相似的壁畫。樓梯頂端的平臺沒有窗戶，因為它建在懸崖內部，但由走廊兩端各一支蠟燭微弱地照亮。

english: The outer room is a library with a single bookcase holding forty-four ancient books. {@creature Na|ToA} likes to come here and read the books, none of which are magical. They cover most areas of knowledge: mathematics, natural philosophy, geography, fabulous creatures, theology, and so forth. All the books predate the Spellplague, so little useful information about Chult can be gleaned from them.
zh_tw: 外間是一個圖書館，有一個書架，上面放著四十四本古老的書籍。{@creature Na|ToA|娜} 喜歡來這裡閱讀這些書籍，它們都不是魔法書。這些書籍涵蓋了大部分知識領域：數學、自然哲學、地理、神話生物、神學等等。所有書籍都是在魔法瘟疫之前出版的，因此從它們中幾乎無法獲取有關楚爾特的有用資訊。

english: The inner room is {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s personal chamber. It contains a comfortable bed, a nightstand, a few books of Chultan poetry, and a wardrobe holding everyday and ceremonial clothing. Under the bed is a small, closed box holding four {@item Potion of Poison||potions of poison} that are easily mistaken for {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}. {@creature Asharra|ToA} might resort to these if the characters' presence in Kir Sabal becomes inconvenient.
zh_tw: 內室是{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}的私人房間。裡面有一張舒適的床，一個床頭櫃，幾本楚爾特詩歌書籍，以及一個衣櫃，裡面裝有日常和儀式服裝。床下有一個小盒子，裡面裝有四瓶{@item Potion of Poison||毒藥藥水}，這些很容易被誤認為是{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。如果角色們在基爾·薩巴爾的存在變得不便，{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}可能會訴諸這些毒藥水。

english: 4. Dwellings
zh_tw: 4. 住宅

english: The dwellings in Kir Sabal aren't all identical, but they're similar enough. Each is occupied by {@dice 2d4} {@creature aarakocra}. A standard dwelling has two or three levels connected by a ladder (the interiors are too tight for flying). Most aarakocra in Kir Sabal have little in the way of valuables, aside from totems handcrafted from wood, feathers, scales, shells, and teeth.
zh_tw: 基爾·薩巴爾的住所並不完全相同，但它們足夠相似。每個住所都住著{@dice 2d4}只{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}。一個標準的住所有兩到三層，由梯子連線（內部太狹窄，無法飛行）。基爾·薩巴爾的大多數鳥羽人除了由木頭、羽毛、鱗片、貝殼和牙齒手工製作的圖騰外，幾乎沒有什麼貴重物品。

english: 5. Royal House
zh_tw: 5. 王宮

english: Perched between the monastery ({@area area 1|146|x}) and the elder's house ({@area area 3|150|x}) is a dwelling similar to the ones described in {@area area 4|153|x}. However, this particular house is furnished for humans and belongs to Mwaxanaré and {@creature Na|ToA}. It is much finer than the others, as befits their royal status.
zh_tw: 位於修道院（{@area 區域1|146|x}）和長者的房子（{@area 區域3|150|x}）之間，是一個與{@area 區域4|153|x}中描述的相似的住所。然而，這個特定的房子是為人類準備的，屬於姆瓦克絲娜瑞和{@creature Na|ToA|娜}。它比其他的要精緻得多，這符合他們的王室地位。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Mwaxanaré has many beautiful trinkets: silver brushes and mirrors, crystal perfume bottles, writing quills made from multicolored parrot feathers, jewels for braiding into her hair, necklaces and rings set with fiery Chultan opals and amber. All together, these are worth 330 gp, but to be caught in Kir Sabal with items stolen from Mwaxanaré means death—and since no one in Kir Sabal would ever steal, suspicion automatically falls on the characters if anything disappears.
zh_tw: 姆瓦克絲娜瑞擁有許多美麗的小飾品：銀製的刷子和鏡子、水晶香水瓶、由多色鸚鵡羽毛製成的書寫筆、用來編入她頭髮的珠寶、鑲有熾熱的楚特貓眼石和琥珀的項鍊和戒指。這些總共價值330金幣，但在基爾·薩巴爾被抓到偷取姆瓦克絲娜瑞的物品意味著死亡——而且由於基爾·薩巴爾沒有人偷竊，如果有任何東西消失，懷疑自然會落在角色們身上。

english: Kitcher's Inlet
zh_tw: 基徹爾灣

english: The River Olung pours into this shallow bay named after Ilyber Kitcher, a pompous Cormyrean explorer who claimed to have discovered it a few centuries ago. He did no such thing, of course; the inlet's existence and location were well known before Kitcher missed the Bay of Chult (he was a terrible navigator) and unknowingly sailed down the peninsula's eastern coast before a storm blew him back within sight of land. There is nothing remarkable about the inlet, other than it provides access to the ruins of Port Castigliar and Mezro.
zh_tw: 奧倫河傾瀉進這個以伊萊伯·基徹命名的淺灣，他是一個自大的科米爾探險家，聲稱在幾個世紀前發現了這個海灣。當然，他沒有做到這一點；基徹錯過了楚爾特灣（他是一個糟糕的航海家），在一場風暴把他吹回到陸地視線之前，他無意中沿著半島的東海岸航行。除了它提供了通往卡斯蒂利亞港和梅茲羅廢墟的通道之外，這個海灣沒有什麼特別之處。

english: Lake Luo
zh_tw: 羅湖

english: This lake sits above an immense geothermal sink, where it's heated by volcanic vents and by lava streaming down from the Valley of Embers. Portions of the lake are actually boiling, sending up clouds of steam that can be seen for miles. The water is too hot and too alkaline for fish or any other type of aquatic life to survive in it, and the shore around the lake is a dead wasteland of ash and salt flats. Aside from mud mephits and steam mephits, few creatures thrive in the area. The water cools and loses most of its alkalinity as it flows north along the River Olung.
zh_tw: 這個湖泊位於一個巨大的地熱沉降區上方，由火山噴氣孔和從餘燼谷流下的熔岩加熱。湖泊的部分地區實際上是沸騰的，釋放出蒸汽雲，這些蒸汽雲可以被看到數英里遠。水太熱且鹼性太強，以至於魚類或其他型別的水生生物無法在其中生存，湖泊周圍的岸邊是一片由灰燼和鹽灘組成的死亡荒地。除了泥魔蝠和蒸汽侏儒之外，很少有生物在該地區繁衍。當水流向北沿著奧倫河流動時，水會冷卻並失去大部分鹼性。

english: Land of Ash and Smoke
zh_tw: 灰燼與煙霧之地

english: This hellish, smoky sea of black volcanic rock is traced with streams of lava. The Land of Ash and Smoke is a playground for firenewts and for Tzindelor, a young red dragon (see "{@area Wyrmheart Mine|1af|x}"), who likes to bathe in the lava streams. This gray, barren valley is typically 20 to 40 degrees hotter than anywhere else in Chult. It receives only a fraction of the rain that falls on the rest of the peninsula, and what rain does fall rapidly evaporates in the punishing heat. Several expeditions have tried to explore the area, but most of what's known about it (and shown on {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}'s map) is based on visual observations made from atop the coastal mountains.
zh_tw: 這片地獄般的、煙霧繚繞的黑色火山岩海被熔岩流所貫穿。灰燼與煙霧之地是火蜥蜴和年輕的紅龍辛德洛（見"{@area 龍心礦井|1af|x}"）的遊樂場，他喜歡在熔岩流中沐浴。這個灰暗、貧瘠的山谷通常比楚爾特其他地方熱20到40度。它接收到的雨水只是半島其他地方降雨量的一小部分，而且即使有雨水也會在酷熱中迅速蒸發。幾次探險試圖探索這個地區，但是關於它的大部分已知資訊（以及在{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的地圖上顯示的內容）都是基於從沿海山脈頂端進行的視覺觀察。

english: Mbala
zh_tw: 姆巴拉

english: A 1,800-foot-high plateau with sheer cliffs rises above heaps of boulders as large as ships. A narrow path is cut into the cliff face and seems to climb all the way to the top.
zh_tw: 一個高達1800尺的高原，其懸崖峭壁陡峭，上面堆滿了像船一樣大的巨石。一條狹窄的小徑被鑿在懸崖面上，似乎一直通向頂部。

english: The plateau's sheer cliffs can be scaled, but only with a climbing kit, proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill, and at least 300 feet of rope.
zh_tw: 高原的陡峭懸崖可以攀爬，但需要攀爬工具包、熟練掌握{@skill Athletics||運動}技能，並且至少需要300尺的繩索。

english: The path is a much easier route to the top. It begins on the north side of the plateau. Through many switchbacks, it winds across the cliff face for 3 miles before reaching the top. The path width varies but averages 5 feet. Tumbled boulders and tangled roots block the path in many places, but as long as characters aren't being chased by anything, they can clear the obstructions safely. The first ascent takes 3 hours; once the road is cleared, it can be climbed or descended in half that time.
zh_tw: 這條路是通往頂部的更簡單路線。它從高原的北側開始。經過許多急轉彎，它在懸崖面上蜿蜒3英里才到達頂部。小徑的寬度不一，平均為5尺。滾落的巨石和糾結的樹根在許多地方阻塞了道路，但只要角色們沒有被任何東西追趕，他們可以安全地清除障礙。第一次攀登需要3小時；一旦道路被清理，攀登或下降的時間可以減半。

english: As the characters climb ever higher above the tree line, they are treated to stunning views of the surrounding wilderness. Across the Aldani Basin to the southeast, they can see the Heart of Ubtao, and nestled in the jungle to the west is the ziggurat at Orolunga. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check also spot some sort of shipwreck in the jungle, beyond the plateaus to the south (see "{@area Wreck of the Star Goddess|1aa|x}").
zh_tw: 當角色們不斷攀升，越過林木線時，他們被周圍荒野的壯麗景色所震撼。在東南方向，跨越阿爾達尼盆地，他們可以看到烏塔歐之心，而在西側的叢林中，則坐落著奧羅倫加的階梯金字塔。成功透過 {@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定的角色還能在南方的臺地之外的叢林中發現某種沉船的殘骸（參見"{@area 星辰女神號的殘骸|1aa|x}"）。

english: About a hundred feet below the lip of the plateau, the path (which is proceeding west across the cliff at that point) veers directly into a natural cleft in the stone face. Steps are cut into the 15-foot-wide crevice, and scenes of jungle predators, flying lizards, and erupting volcanoes are carved in shallow relief onto the walls in ways that make creative use of the natural shape of the rock. When the characters reach the top of the steps, read:
zh_tw: 在高原邊緣下方約一百尺處，小徑（此時正沿著懸崖向西延伸）突然轉向一個自然的石縫。石階被鑿入這個15尺寬的裂縫中，牆壁上雕刻著以淺浮雕形式展現的叢林捕食者、飛行蜥蜴和噴發的火山，這些雕刻巧妙地利用了岩石的自然形狀。當角色們到達石階頂部時，請閱讀：

english: The stone steps emerge onto the top of the plateau beneath a once grand, but now decrepit wooden gateway. The gates that sealed this entrance are rotted away; only their rusted iron hinges and reinforcing bands remain. In their place are heaps of human skulls. Picked clean of all flesh and bleached white by the sun, they grin up at you from the roadway and down from atop towering mounds.
zh_tw: 石階出現在高原頂部，位於曾經宏偉但現在破敗的木製大門下方。封閉這個入口的大門已經腐爛消失；只剩下它們的鏽跡斑斑的鐵鉸鏈和加固帶。取而代之的是一堆人頭骨。它們被剝離了所有的肉，被太陽曬得蒼白，從道路上和高聳的土堆頂部對你露出笑容。

english: The skulls are all that remain of Mbala's former residents. The citizens were devoured by a hag posing as a witch doctor. All the skulls show signs of having been gnawed on. The hag is now Mbala's sole living resident.
zh_tw: 這些頭骨是姆巴拉前居民的唯一遺物。居民們被一個偽裝成巫醫的女巫吞噬。所有的頭骨都顯示出被啃食的跡象。現在，這個女巫是姆巴拉唯一的活居民。

english: To move off the steps, characters must either wade through heaps of skulls or climb over the sides of the staircase and go around the gate. Evidence of a wooden palisade can be seen, but it, too, is almost entirely gone or fallen over.
zh_tw: 要離開臺階，角色們必須要麼趟過一堆頭骨，要麼爬上樓梯的兩側，繞過大門。可以看到木製柵欄的痕跡，但它也幾乎完全消失了或倒塌了。

english: Mbala was once the seat of a small kingdom. Most of the structures were wood and thatch, and they're now just crumbling compost heaps demolished by rain, wind, and time. A few stone foundations and overgrown ramps poke up through the debris, indicating this was more than just a simple village.
zh_tw: 姆巴拉曾經是一個小王國的中心。大部分建築是木頭和茅草建造的，現在它們只是被雨水、風和時間摧毀的破碎堆肥堆。一些石頭地基和雜草叢生的坡道從廢墟中突出，表明這裡不僅僅是一個簡單的村莊。

english: Nanny Pu'pu
zh_tw: 普普奶奶

english: If the characters explore the ruins of Mbala, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們探索姆巴拉的廢墟，請閱讀：

english: The only structure still intact is a lone hut about a thousand yards southwest of the gate, at the edge of a boulder field. The hut is made from thatch and animal hides stretched over the rib cage of an immense reptile. Animal skulls, wind chimes, and totems of feathers and shells rattle in the breeze, and smoke drifts from hut.
zh_tw: 唯一保持完好的結構是一間孤獨的小屋，位於大門西南方向約一千碼處，緊鄰一片巨石區。這間小屋由茅草和動物皮毛製成，覆蓋在一個巨大爬行動物的胸腔上。動物頭骨、風鈴以及羽毛和貝殼製成的圖騰在微風中叮噹作響，小屋中飄出煙霧。

english: A creature shuffles slowly around the hut, hunched over in an animal-like posture. You realize it's a human woman: impossibly old, crippled by arthritis, {@condition blinded} by cataracts. Her dark face and bald pate are outlined with streaks of yellow clay suggesting the shape of a skull—or perhaps it's her shriveled flesh creating that illusion.
zh_tw: 一個生物以動物般的姿勢彎腰緩慢地繞著小屋移動。你意識到這是一個人類女性：難以置信的年老，因關節炎而殘疾，因白內障而{@condition blinded||目盲}。她黝黑的面孔和禿頂被黃色泥土勾勒出骷髏的形狀——或者也許是她乾癟的肉體創造了這種錯覺。

english: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA}, a {@creature green hag}, plays the part of an ancient crone to the hilt. She claims that all the other villagers were killed over the course of many years by winged creatures that live on the south side of the plateau. She is the only survivor—too stringy or too wily for the predators. She lives on the roots in her garden and the few birds and lizards she catches in snares. If asked her name, she needs several moments to recall that the villagers called her {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA}.
zh_tw: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}，一個{@creature green hag||綠鬼婆}，扮演著一個古老巫婆的角色。她聲稱在過去許多年裡，所有其他村民都被生活在高原南邊的有翼生物殺害了。她是唯一的生還者——對於捕食者來說太瘦弱或者太狡猾。她靠花園裡的根和在陷阱中捕獲的少數鳥類和蜥蜴為生。如果有人問她的名字，她需要好一會兒才能記起村民叫她{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}。

english: The hag wants two things from the adventurers: for them to destroy the nest of pterafolk on the south side of the plateau (see "Pterafolk Nest" below), and then to become her meals for several months. She's not likely to attack them openly. She'd rather get them off their guard and pick them off one by one, as she did with the villagers.
zh_tw: 這個女巫想要從冒險者那裡得到兩樣東西：讓他們摧毀高原南邊的翼手獸巢穴（見下文的"翼手獸巢穴"），然後成為她幾個月的食物。她不太可能公開攻擊他們。她更願意趁他們不備，一個接一個地幹掉他們，就像她對村民做的那樣。

english: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} isn't entirely alone. With a whistle, she can call forth {@dice 2d6} {@creature Flying Monkey|ToA|flying monkeys} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) that live in the trees, and she has a {@creature flesh golem} buried in a shallow grave outside her small hut. The hag uses the flying monkeys to gather food and supplies, but they won't fight for her. The golem will, however; it erupts from the earth as a bonus action if commanded to attack.
zh_tw: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}並不完全孤單。她吹一聲口哨，就能召喚出{@dice 2d6}只{@creature Flying Monkey|ToA|飛猴}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），它們生活在樹上，而且她還有一個{@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}埋在她的小屋外的淺墳裡。這個老巫婆用飛猴來收集食物和補給，但它們不會為她戰鬥。魔像會為她戰鬥；如果被命令攻擊，它會作為附贈動作從地下爆發出來。

english: Rite of Stolen Life
zh_tw: 偷來的生命儀式

english: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} is a worshiper of Myrkul, the Lord of Bones, and knows a ritual of transformation that can turn a dead humanoid into a zombielike creature. Characters who bring their dead comrades to Mbala can ask {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} to transform them into the walking dead. However, she does nothing for free. Wiping out the nest of pterafolk is the least payment she'll consider for this ritual. She might also request a lock of Commander Breakbone's hair and a few of his fingernails (see "{@area Camp Vengeance|0cd|x}") or one of Saja N'baza's iridescent scales (see "{@area Orolunga|18d|x}"). Either would certainly be used in casting evil magic.
zh_tw: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}是骨頭之主米爾寇的信徒，並且知道一種可以將死去的類人生物變成類似殭屍生物的變形儀式。將死去的同伴帶到姆巴拉的角色可以請求{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}將他們變成行屍走肉。然而，她不會免費做任何事情。清除翼手獸的巢穴是她為這個儀式考慮的最低代價。她還可能要求獲得指揮官斷骨的頭髮綹和幾個他的指甲（見"{@area 復仇營地|0cd|x}"）或薩迦·恩巴扎的一個彩虹鱗片（見"{@area 奧羅倫加|18d|x}"）。任何一個無疑都將被用於施展邪惡魔法。

english: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} is the only creature in Chult who can perform the Rite of Stolen Life. The ritual takes 1 hour to complete and requires three things: a mostly intact humanoid corpse, a gemstone worth at least 100 gp, and, most disturbingly, the sacrifice of another humanoid. If characters are unwilling to sacrifice one of their own to save a fallen comrade, {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} recommends they capture a goblin, a grung, or other humanoid and bring it to her. {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} kills the sacrifice, captures its spirit in the gemstone, and magically embeds the stone in the dead humanoid's forehead. After {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA} speaks a prayer to Myrkul, the spirit of the sacrifice gains the knowledge and the personality of the humanoid to which it is bound, in effect imitating that humanoid's spirit. When the ritual is complete, the dead humanoid awakens as if from a deep slumber, though it is not alive.
zh_tw: {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶} 是楚爾特唯一能夠執行偷來的生命儀式的生物。這個儀式需要1小時來完成，並且需要三樣東西：一個大體完整的類人生物屍體，一個至少價值100金幣的寶石，以及最令人不安的——另一個類人生物的犧牲。如果角色們不願意犧牲他們中的一個來拯救一個倒下的同伴，{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}建議他們捕獲一個地精、一個格隆或其他類人生物並帶給她。{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}殺死犧牲品，將其靈魂捕獲在寶石中，並透過魔法將寶石嵌入死者的額頭。在{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}向米爾寇祈禱之後，犧牲的靈魂獲得了與其繫結的類人生物的知識和個性，實際上模仿了那個類人生物的靈魂。當儀式完成後，死去的類人生物彷彿從深度睡眠中醒來，儘管它並未真正復活。

english: A character transformed by this ritual into the walking dead regains all its hit points and retains its statistics, except as noted here:
zh_tw: 透過這個儀式被轉化為行屍走肉的角色恢復其所有生命值，並保留其具體數值，除非此處有特別說明：

english: The character is considered an undead, not a humanoid, and is subject to all effects that target undead. The character doesn't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe.
zh_tw: 這個角色被視為不死生物，而不是類人生物，並且會受到所有針對不死生物的效果的影響。這個角色不需要進食、飲水、睡眠或呼吸。

english: The character's hit point maximum is reduced by {@dice 1d4} at dawn each day, representing the physical decay of the body. No spell or effect can halt or counteract this decay.
zh_tw: 角色的生命值上限每天黎明時減少{@dice 1d4}，代表身體的生理衰退。沒有任何法術或效果可以停止或抵消這種衰退。

english: If the character's hit point maximum drops to 0, the gemstone embedded in the character's forehead shatters, and the character becomes a corpse once more.
zh_tw: 如果角色的生命值上限降至0，嵌入角色額頭的寶石會碎裂，角色將再次變成屍體。

english: A character that is turned into the walking dead and later raised or resurrected loses all memory of being an undead creature, but it doesn't lose any levels or XP gained while it was undead.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果被變成行屍走肉，並且在後來被復活或重生，將會失去作為不死生物的所有記憶，但在作為不死生物期間獲得的等級或經驗值不會丟失。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The green hag keeps nothing of value in her hut. Her treasure is hidden in a cistern in the old village. Anyone who moves through the ruins notices the cistern. The opening is 15 feet in diameter, and the shaft drops 15 feet to scummy, black water. The lip and walls of the cistern are brick-lined.
zh_tw: 綠女巫在她的小屋中沒有存放任何有價值的東西。她的寶藏隱藏在舊村莊的一個蓄水池裡。任何穿過廢墟的人都會發現蓄水池。蓄水池的開口直徑為15尺，井道下降15尺到達汙濁的黑色水面。蓄水池的邊緣和牆壁都是磚砌的。

english: The water is 40 feet deep and so murky that it's {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured}. Unless characters have {@sense blindsight}, they must feel their way with their hands. About 20 feet below the surface, the bricks have been pulled from one wall to create a hole. Characters searching with their hands find it with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check.
