A narrow, 10-foot-long tunnel leads from the hole to a cramped, completely flooded chamber. In the chamber is a tied sack made from human skin. It contains six onyx gemstones (50 gp each), a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell comprehend languages}, and ten adamantine ingots (10 gp each) stamped with dwarven runes. These are identical to the ingots found in Hrakhamar (see "{@area Hrakhamar|116|x}").
zh_tw: 此處水深40尺且異常渾濁，導致水域處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||重度遮蔽}狀態。除非角色擁有{@sense blindsight||盲視}能力，否則必須用手摸索前進。在水面下約20尺處，某面牆的磚塊被拆除形成了一個洞口。角色透過成功透過{@dc 10}敏捷檢定即可用手摸到洞口。一條10尺長的狹窄隧道從洞口通向完全被水淹沒的密閉艙室。艙室內有一個用人類皮膚縫製的扎口皮袋，內裝：六顆縞瑪瑙（每顆價值50金幣）、一張{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}（記載{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}法術）、十塊印有矮人符文的精金錠（每塊價值10金幣）。這些金錠與在赫拉卡瑪爾發現的（參見"{@area 赫拉卡馬爾|116|x}"）完全一致。

english: If characters miss the hole in the wall as they're searching down the cistern wall, they find a heap of bricks on the bottom of the cistern. Searching upward from the discarded bricks leads them to the hole automatically.
zh_tw: 如果角色在沿著水池壁搜尋時錯過了牆上的洞，他們會在水池底部發現一堆磚塊。從丟棄的磚塊向上搜尋會自動引導他們找到洞口。

english: Pterafolk Nest
zh_tw: 翼手獸巢穴

english: A flock of twenty pterafolk nests in a cave just below the southern lip of the plateau. It can be reached by climbing down the cliff face, but characters who scout the area carefully and succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check locate a chute in the rocks 70 feet back from the cliff. This chimney is wide enough for a Small creature, or for a Medium creature who's wearing nothing heavier than light armor, to squeeze through. After worming down 30 feet, it drops into the back of the pterafolk cave, which is roughly triangular in floor plan: 30 feet wide at the mouth, 60 feet deep, and 20 feet high. The pterafolk are unaware that this back entrance to their cave exists.
zh_tw: 一群二十隻翼手獸在高原南部邊緣下方的洞穴中築巢。可以透過攀爬懸崖到達，但仔細偵察該區域並在 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定中成功的角色可以發現距離懸崖 70 尺的岩石中有一條滑道。這條煙囪足夠寬，可以讓小型生物或穿著不超過輕甲的中型生物擠過去。在蜿蜒下潛 30 尺後，它通向了翼手獸洞穴的後部，洞穴的平面大致呈三角形：入口寬 30 尺，深 60 尺，高 20 尺。翼手獸並未意識到這條通往他們洞穴的後門存在。

english: The pterafolk keep no watch, believing their cliffside retreat is impregnable. Stealthy characters can enter the cave unnoticed. At any given time, {@dice 2d6} {@creature pterafolk|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are present in the cave. The rest are out hunting, but they'll return before nightfall.
zh_tw: 翼手獸沒有設定守衛，他們相信自己的懸崖避難所是堅不可摧的。潛行的角色可以不被注意地進入洞穴。在任何給定時間，洞穴中有{@dice 2d6}個{@creature pterafolk|ToA|翼手獸}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。其餘的在外面狩獵，但他們會夜幕降臨前返回。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In the back half of the cave are the bodies of two partially eaten explorers. A discarded backpack near them contains 6 gp in a pouch, a {@item silvered dagger|PHB}, and a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 在洞穴的後半部分有兩具被部分啃食的探險家屍體。它們附近一個被丟棄的揹包裡有一個裝有6 gp的小包、一把{@item silvered dagger|PHB|鍍銀匕首}和一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Mezro
zh_tw: 梅茲羅

english: Nothing about this Chultan city is what it seems. By all accounts, Mezro was destroyed by the Spellplague, and its ruins indicate as much. In truth, the city's immortal defenders—the barae—used their god-given magic to transport the entire city to a paradise (a magically constructed demiplane, far from prying eyes). Empty ruins were left behind to create the impression that Mezro had been destroyed. It is not known if and when the Mezroans and their city will return.
zh_tw: 這個楚爾特城市並非看上去那樣。據所有記載，梅茲羅被魔法瘟疫摧毀了，其廢墟也表明了這一點。實際上，這座城市的不朽守護者——巴拉伊——利用他們神賜的魔法將整個城市傳送到了一個天堂（一個遠離窺探之眼的魔法構造的半位面）。留下的空蕩蕩的廢墟給人留下了梅茲羅已被摧毀的印象。目前尚不清楚梅茲羅人和他們的城市是否會回來。

english: One of the barae, a human paladin named Alisanda, is wed to {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}. The two fell in love more than a century ago, after Artus helped defend Mezro against the evil warlord {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and his undead horde. Before she allowed herself to be spirited away along with the rest of the city, Alisanda promised Artus that she would return to Chult when the city was no longer in peril.
zh_tw: 巴拉之一，一個名叫阿莉桑德拉的人類聖武士，與{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}結婚。一百多年前，當阿圖斯幫助梅茲羅抵禦邪惡的軍閥{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}及其不死生物軍團後，兩人墜入了愛河。在允許自己隨整個城市一同消失之前，阿莉桑德拉向阿圖斯承諾，當城市不再處於危險之中時，她將返回楚爾特。

english: Artus won't endanger the Mezroans by revealing the truth about their city. Although the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} makes him immortal, he has grown impatient in the intervening years and longs for Alisanda's return. He visits the ruins from time to time to see what, if anything, has changed. When he's not at the ruins, he's searching the jungles of Chult for Orolunga, another ruined city, in the hopes of consulting with a prescient guardian naga believed to dwell there.
zh_tw: 阿圖斯不會透過透露他們城市的真實情況來危及梅茲羅人。儘管{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}使他不朽，但在過去幾年中，他變得不耐煩，渴望阿莉桑達的歸來。他不時地參觀廢墟，看看是否有任何變化。當他不在廢墟時，他正在楚特的叢林中尋找奧羅隆加，這是另一個廢墟城市，希望與那裡居住的預知守秘納迦進行諮詢。

english: Exploring the Ruins
zh_tw: 探索廢墟

english: The ruins that were left behind form a circle. Four main avenues to the north, south, east, and west meet at a central plaza. The whole ruin has subsided over the centuries, so that water from the River Olung flows over the ancient wharfs. Crumbling, vine-covered buildings rise above the flooded streets that are now more like canals than roadways. The site is eerily quiet.
zh_tw: 留下的廢墟形成了一個圓形。四條主要的大街通往北、南、東、西，在中心廣場交匯。整個廢墟經過幾個世紀的沉降，以至於奧倫河的水覆蓋了古老的碼頭。搖搖欲墜、藤蔓覆蓋的建築物矗立在現在更像是運河而不是道路的被水淹沒的街道上。這個地方異常安靜。

english: The ruins have been thoroughly ransacked by the Flaming Fist in the name of Baldur's Gate, and Flaming Fist patrols still visit the site regularly—partly as training for new recruits, partly to make sure nothing was missed. Neither treasure nor clues remain for the player characters to find here.
zh_tw: 廢墟已經被焰拳團以博德之門的名義徹底洗劫，焰拳團的巡邏隊仍然定期訪問這個地方——部分是為了訓練新兵，部分是為了確保沒有遺漏任何東西。玩家角色在這裡找不到任何財寶或線索。

english: Mistcliff
zh_tw: 迷霧崖

english: The Mistcliff is a 1,000-foot-high wall of volcanic rock that stretches for 200 miles along Chult's west coast. There is no beach whatsoever, just immense, jagged rocks and plunging, crashing waves. If that isn't enough to keep most people away, the cliffs are home to large aarakocra settlements, as well as nests of pteranodons and quetzalcoatluses.
zh_tw: 霧崖是一堵高達1000尺的火山岩壁，沿著楚爾特西海岸延伸200英里。這裡根本沒有海灘，只有巨大的鋸齒狀岩石和洶湧的海浪。如果這些還不足以讓大多數人遠離，那麼懸崖上還居住著大型鳥羽人部落，以及翼手龍和羽蛇龍的巢穴。

english: Nangalore
zh_tw: 南戈爾

english: This great garden (map 2.12) was built to honor Zalkoré, a vain Omuan queen. Its builder, Thiru-taya, was Zalkoré's foremost general and consort. In their time, the garden was called Ka-Nanji, the Hanging Garden of Dreams. Ka-Nanji was a palatial retreat from the intrigues and pressures of Omu, and the beautiful, tiered garden was praised as a worthy tribute to the queen.
zh_tw: 這個宏偉的花園（地圖2.12）是為了紀念自負的奧穆女王扎爾柯蕊而建造的。建造者希魯塔雅是扎爾柯蕊的首席將軍和配偶。在他們的時代，這個花園被稱為卡南吉，即夢幻懸掛花園。卡南吉是逃離奧穆的陰謀和壓力的宮殿式隱居地，這個美麗的分層花園被譽為對女王的恰當致敬。

english: Unceasing flattery festered with poisonous vanity in Zalkoré's mind until she bargained with an erinyes to retain her youth and beauty forever. The erinyes fulfilled the deal by transforming the queen into a medusa. When knowledge of her evil bargain spread through the realm, the army forced Zalkoré to abdicate and exiled her to Ka-Nanji, which became known ever after as Nangalore, the Garden of Lost Dreams.
zh_tw: 不斷的奉承和有毒的虛榮心在扎爾柯蕊的心中潰爛，直到她與一位罪魔交易，以永遠保持她的青春和美麗。罪魔透過將女王變成美杜莎來履行交易。當她邪惡交易的訊息在王國中傳播開來時，軍隊強迫扎爾柯蕊退位，並將她流放到卡南吉，這個地方從此被稱為南加洛爾，失落夢境的花園。

english: Believing that Thiru-taya was among the generals who exiled her, Zalkoré defaced all the statues and portraits of him in Nangalore. She learned he had stayed true to her all his life, through decades of imprisonment and disgrace in Omu, only when his ashes were brought to the garden for interment, as was his dying wish. Zalkoré cultivates hallucinogenic plants in the garden, because only in their narcotic, lotus dreams can she conjure up the face of her dead love.
zh_tw: 扎爾柯蕊認為提魯-塔亞是流放她的將軍之一，因此在南加洛爾破壞了所有他的雕像和肖像。她直到他的骨灰被帶到花園安葬，這是他臨終的願望，才得知他一生都忠於她，儘管在奧穆遭受了數十年的監禁和恥辱。扎爾柯蕊在花園裡種植致幻植物，因為在它們的麻醉性、夢幻般的睡蓮夢中，她才能召喚出她死去愛人的面容。

english: Characters can discover Zalkoré's tragic story by interpreting carvings throughout the garden. If that makes them sympathetic toward her, so be it, but her tragedy didn't ennoble Zalkoré or make her a better person; it turned her into a monster.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過解讀花園中隨處可見的雕刻來發現扎爾柯蕊的悲慘故事。如果這讓他們對她產生了同情，那也無妨，但她的悲劇並沒有使扎爾柯蕊變得高尚，也沒有讓她成為一個更好的人；它使她變成了一個怪物。

english: The medusa is not alone in the cursed garden. Eblis serve her as sentinels and spies. Colorful parrots and canaries flock to the garden's great variety of plants, some of which are hostile toward visitors. Finally, brave Chultans sometimes seek out Zalkoré as a sort of jungle mystic, either to learn the secrets of her hallucinogenic plants or to ask questions about the distant past.
zh_tw: 美杜莎在被詛咒的花園裡並不孤單。魔王鶴族作為她的哨兵和間諜為她服務。五彩繽紛的鸚鵡和金絲雀成群結隊地飛向花園中種類繁多的植物，其中一些對訪客具有敵意。最後，勇敢的楚爾特人有時會尋找扎爾柯蕊，將她視為一種叢林神秘人物，要麼學習她致幻植物的秘密，要麼詢問關於遙遠過去的問題。

english: Nangalore lies a half-mile from the River Olung. Thanks to centuries of silting and erosion, one of the river's tributaries floods right up to the garden gate ({@area area 1|167|x}), making the site easy to reach by boat. Traveling to Nangalore by foot is a nightmare, since the land within 1 mile is nothing but boggy marsh.
zh_tw: 南戈爾位於奧隆湖河半英里遠的地方。由於幾個世紀的淤積和侵蝕，河流的一個支流洪水直接湧到花園門口（{@area 區域1|167|x}），使得這個地點乘船容易到達。步行前往南戈爾是一場噩夢，因為1英里內的土地無非是泥濘的沼澤地。

english: The garden has multiple levels. Map 2.12 uses elevation markers to indicate how high the levels are relative to the ground. Some keyed locations contain multiple levels; for example, {@area area 4|171|x} is 25 feet above ground level, with a crumbled 10-foot-high balcony (35 feet above ground level) and a 20-foot-deep pit (5 feet above ground level).
zh_tw: 這個花園有多個層次。地圖2.12使用高度標記來指示這些層次相對於地面的高度。一些關鍵位置包含多個層次；例如，{@area 區域4|171|x}位於地面以上25尺處，有一個坍塌的10尺高的陽臺（地面以上35尺）和一個20尺深的坑（地面以上5尺）。

english: Throughout Nangalore are inscriptions written in Old Omuan. A character with the {@background Cloistered Scholar|SCAG} or {@background Sage} background can translate an Old Omuan inscription with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check. A warlock with the Eyes of the Rune Keeper invocation can do so automatically. Otherwise, a {@spell comprehend languages} spell or similar magic is needed.
zh_tw: 整個南加洛爾都刻有古老的奧姆安文銘文。擁有{@background Cloistered Scholar|SCAG|與世隔絕的學者}或{@background Sage||智者}背景的角色可以透過成功的{@dc 10}智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定來翻譯古老的奧姆安銘文。擁有符文守護者之眼異能的魔契師則可以自動翻譯。否則，需要使用{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}法術或類似的魔法。

english: Map 2.12: Nangalore
zh_tw: 地圖 2.12: 南戈爾

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Entrance
zh_tw: 1. 入口

english: A fantastic edifice rises up out of the jungle: a hanging garden of exotic beauty. Water streams down the steps between two massive elephant carvings. Beyond them, a broad, flooded avenue runs arrow-straight for more than a hundred feet before ending at a carving of a tyrannosaurus face. Water pours from the tyrannosaurus's jaws and flows the length of the concourse to drain down the steps in front of you. Five-foot-high terraces flank the boulevard. Low archways—three on each side—are built into the terrace walls. These archways are in various stages of collapse, as are the tunnels beyond them. Beautifully carved, larger-than-life stone faces are mounted between the arches.
zh_tw: 一座宏偉的建築從叢林中升起：一個懸掛的花園，充滿了異國情調的美麗。水流沿著兩個巨大的雕刻大象之間的臺階流下。在它們後面，一條寬闊的、被洪水淹沒的大道筆直地延伸了一百多尺，最後到達一個暴龍頭的雕刻。水從暴龍的下巴傾瀉而出，沿著大道流動，然後從你面前的臺階流下。五尺高的梯田圍繞著這條林蔭大道。低矮的拱門——每邊三個——被建在梯田的牆壁中。這些拱門和它們後面的隧道都處於不同程度的倒塌狀態。在拱門之間安裝著雕刻精美的、超現實的巨大石雕面孔。

english: A wild profusion of plants grows on the upper terraces, and multicolored parrots and canaries flit and sing among them. To the north, a dilapidated brick dome rises above the tyrannosaurus-head waterspout. Smaller, bell-shaped domes surmount the highest terraces to your left and right.
zh_tw: 上層露臺上生長著繁茂的野生植物群，五彩繽紛的鸚鵡和金絲雀在其中穿梭歌唱。在北部，一個破敗的磚砌圓頂在暴龍頭形的噴泉上方升起。在您的左右兩側，最高露臺上矗立著更小的鐘形圓頂。

english: Four {@creature Crocodile||crocodiles} live in the flooded marsh south of the garden. They ignore characters in boats, attack anyone in the water, and won't climb up the stairs.
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature Crocodile||鱷魚}生活在花園南部的洪水沼澤中。它們會忽略船上的角色，攻擊在水中的任何人，並且不會爬上樓梯。

english: The water flowing down the main concourse is only 1 foot deep, and the current isn't particularly strong. Originally, the six side branches off the main avenue were roofed over, but two of the roofs have caved in, and three others are partially collapsed. Debris chokes the walkways where the tunnel roofs fell. The roofs that remain intact have vines and roots hanging down from them. The covered tunnels are only 4 feet high and contain a foot of water.
zh_tw: 流經主大道的水只有1尺深，水流並不特別強。最初，主大道的六條側支道都有屋頂覆蓋，但其中兩個屋頂已經坍塌，另外三個部分倒塌。隧道屋頂坍塌的地方堆滿了碎片，阻塞了走道。仍然完好的屋頂上掛著藤蔓和樹根。有蓋的隧道只有4尺高，裡面積有1尺深的水。

english: Stone Faces
zh_tw: 石雕面孔

english: The four stone visages staring across the avenue between the walkways portray a regal woman (Zalkoré) whose expression changes slightly with each visage. Inscribed above each face are phrases in Old Omuan. The phrases form a message. To get the message in sequence, it should be read from the south end of the concourse to the tyrannosaurus spout while alternating from the left (west) side to the right (east).
zh_tw: 在步道之間的大街上，四尊石雕面孔凝視著對面，描繪了一位威嚴的女性（扎爾柯蕊），每尊面孔的表情都有細微的變化。每個面孔上方都刻有古奧穆語的短語。這些短語構成了一條資訊。要按順序獲取資訊，應該從南端的大道開始，沿著暴龍頭形噴泉的方向，從左側（西邊）交替到右側（東邊）閱讀。

english: Face 1 (lower west) has a bemused expression. The message above it reads, "This garden is dedicated to Zalkoré, queen of Omu and jewel of Chult."
zh_tw: 面孔1（下方西側）帶著一種困惑的表情。它上方的資訊寫著："這個花園是為奧穆的女王、楚爾特的寶石扎爾柯蕊而奉獻的。"

english: Face 2 (upper west) has a condescending expression. The message above it reads, "Worshiped by her people and by Thiru-taya, who loves BETRAYED her." (The word "loves" has been chipped away, and the word "BETRAYED" is scratched into the stone above it.)
zh_tw: 第二面（上西）帶著一種輕蔑的表情。它上面的資訊寫道："被她的人民和愛她的提魯-塔亞崇拜，但她被背叛了。"（"愛"這個詞被鑿掉了，在它上面的石頭上刻著"背叛"。）

english: Face 3 (upper east) has a stern expression. The message above it reads, "In this, the tenth year of her reign, may she govern forever in splendor."
zh_tw: 第三尊面孔（上東）表情嚴肅。其上方的資訊寫著："在她統治的第十年，願她永遠在輝煌中治理。"

english: Face 4 (lower east) has a serene expression. The message above it reads, "And may the gods themselves marvel at this humble reflection of her beauty."
zh_tw: 面孔4（下方東側）帶著一種寧靜的表情。它上方的資訊寫著："願眾神自己也對這謙卑的美麗倒影感到驚歎。"

english: 2. Terraces
zh_tw: 2. 梯田

english: Untamed overgrowth can't hide the fact that this garden is a haven for exotic plants that don't grow naturally in the surrounding jungle. Unfamiliar flowers, towering ferns, and even stranger plants resembling giant pine cones or lily pads spread and tangle everywhere. Bright canaries flit between them, and parrots with striped beaks squawk at you.
zh_tw: 野生的過度生長無法掩蓋這個花園是外來植物的避難所，這些植物在周圍的叢林中不會自然生長。不熟悉的花朵、高聳的蕨類植物，甚至更奇怪的植物，像巨大的松果或睡蓮葉，到處蔓延和糾纏。明亮的金絲雀在它們之間飛舞，帶有條紋喙的鸚鵡對你尖叫。

english: These terraces overlooking the main concourse are home to myriad creatures, many of them dangerous.
zh_tw: 這些俯瞰主要通道的梯田是無數生物的家園，其中許多是危險的。

english: A {@creature mantrap|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) grows on the eastern terrace between two of the partially collapsed tunnels. When it senses movement within 30 feet of it, the mantrap releases its attractive pollen.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature mantrap|ToA|捕人草}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）生長在東側的梯田上，位於兩個部分倒塌的隧道之間。當它感應到30尺內有移動時，捕人草會釋放它的迷人花粉。

english: Characters who explore the western terrace encounter six {@creature Yellow Musk Zombie|ToA|yellow musk zombies} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) lurking among the trees and plants. The zombies blend in with their surroundings, and any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score lower than 12 is automatically {@status surprised} by them. Coiled around the northernmost tree on the western terrace is a {@creature yellow musk creeper|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) that uses its musk when one or more characters come within 30 feet of it.
zh_tw: 探索西部露臺的角色會遇到六隻{@creature Yellow Musk Zombie|ToA|黃迷香喪屍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），它們潛伏在樹木和植物之間。殭屍與周圍環境融為一體，任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分低於12的角色都會被它們自動{@status surprised||突襲}。在西部露臺最北邊的樹上盤繞著一隻{@creature yellow musk creeper|ToA|黃迷香爬藤}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），當一個或多個角色接近它30尺以內時，它會使用自己的麝香。

english: At the north end of the garden, two arched doorways open into the southwest and southeast flower gardens ({@area area 5|177|x}). Steps still climb up to the doorway on the east, but the western steps collapsed and fell into the walkway below. A character can reach the western doorway with an easy jump and a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to catch the ledge.
zh_tw: 在花園的北端，兩個拱形門通向西南和東南的花園區域（{@area 區域5|177|x}）。東邊的臺階仍然通往門口，但西邊的臺階已經坍塌，掉落到下方的走道上。角色可以透過一個簡單的跳躍併成功透過一個{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定來抓住邊緣，從而到達西邊的門口。

english: Garden Discoveries
zh_tw: 花園發現

english: A character who spends at least 10 minutes searching a garden terrace for treasure inevitably stumbles upon a hidden creature or exotic plant, determined by rolling a {@dice d20} and consulting the Garden Discoveries table. After the party makes five such discoveries, no more can be found.
zh_tw: 一個角色若花費至少10分鐘在花園露臺中搜尋寶藏，必定會發現隱藏的生物或奇異植物，具體由投擲{@dice d20}並查閱花園發現表決定。當隊伍完成五次此類發現後，將無法再找到更多物品。

english: Garden Discoveries
zh_tw: 花園發現

english: Discovery
zh_tw: 發現

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature almiraj|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 只{@creature almiraj|ToA|獨角兔}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）

english: 1 {@creature assassin vine|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9})
zh_tw: 1 {@creature assassin vine|ToA|刺客藤}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）

english: 1 {@creature chwinga|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) hiding in a flower
zh_tw: 1 {@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）躲藏在一朵花中

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Flying Monkey|ToA|flying monkeys} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) perched in a tree. The monkeys playfully hurl {@item dancing monkey fruit|ToA} (see {@area appendix C|535|x}) at nearby characters. They fly away if attacked.
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4}只{@creature Flying Monkey|ToA|飛猴}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）棲息在樹上。這些猴子頑皮地向附近角色投擲{@item dancing monkey fruit|ToA|猴舞果}（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）。若被攻擊它們會飛走。

english: {@dice 1d4} {@creature Jaculi|ToA|jaculis} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4}個{@creature Jaculi|ToA|幻色蛇}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）

english: Menga bush with {@dice 2d6} ounces of leaves (see {@area appendix C|535|x})
zh_tw: 門加灌木，帶有{@dice 2d6}盎司的葉子（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）

english: {@dice 1d4} ryath roots (see {@area appendix C|535|x})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 個雷亞斯根（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）

english: {@dice 4d6} sinda berries growing on a bush (see {@area appendix C|535|x})
zh_tw: {@dice 4d6}個生長在灌木上的辛達漿果（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）

english: {@dice 1d4} wildroots (see {@area appendix C|535|x})
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 個野生根（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）

english: Yahcha beetle (see {@area appendix C|535|x})
zh_tw: 亞查甲蟲甲蟲（見{@area 附錄C|535|x}）

english: The rotting corpse of a human mage who was strangled to death by an assassin vine. A search of the corpse yields a scholar's pack, a pouch containing 15 gp, and a {@item folding boat}. This discovery can only be made once. If this result comes up again, re-roll on the table.
zh_tw: 一個被刺客藤勒死的人類法師的腐爛屍體。對屍體的搜尋會發現一個學者揹包、一個包含15金幣的小袋，以及一個{@item folding boat||摺疊船}。這個發現只能進行一次。如果再次出現這個結果，請重新在表上擲骰。

english: 3. Spirit Domes
zh_tw: 3. 靈魂穹頂

english: A bell-shaped dome of sculpted stone rises from the end of each upper walkway. The dome to the east is beginning to crumble with age. The one to the west is wrapped and draped with thick webs.
zh_tw: 每個上層步道的末端都有一個由雕刻石料製成的鐘形圓頂。東邊的圓頂因年久失修開始崩塌。西邊的圓頂被厚厚的蛛網包裹和覆蓋。

english: These two domes were built to attract nature spirits.
zh_tw: 這兩個圓頂建築是為了吸引自然精魂而建造的。

english: Western Dome
zh_tw: 西圓頂

english: This dome has been taken over by a {@creature giant spider} missing one of its legs. The seven-legged arachnid lurks in its webs and attacks anyone who approaches within 10 feet of its home. Characters who kill the spider and search the webs find the cocooned, desiccated corpses of an albino dwarf and a goblin, but no treasure.
zh_tw: 這個圓頂被一隻少了一條腿的{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}佔據。這隻七腿的蜘蛛潛伏在它的蛛網中，攻擊任何接近其家10尺以內的人。如果角色們殺死蜘蛛並搜尋蛛網，他們會找到被包裹著的乾枯的白化矮人和地精的屍體，但沒有寶藏。

english: Eastern Dome
zh_tw: 東圓頂

english: Three {@creature Chwinga|ToA|chwingas} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) live in this dome. They emerge from the stone to spy on creatures that pass by. One chwinga is fascinated by tall people and might bestow a {@reward charm of restoration} (see {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Charms} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) on the tallest party member, should it take a shine to the party. The other two chwingas are shy and suspicious of strangers.
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）居住在這個穹頂中。他們從岩石中出殼來間諜路過的生物。一隻怯蘊阿靈對高個子的人著迷，可能會賜予隊伍中最高的成員一個{@reward charm of restoration||復原護咒}（見{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Charms}的{@i 城主指南}），如果它對隊伍有好感的話。另外兩隻怯蘊阿靈害羞且對陌生人疑心。

english: 4. Ruined Palace
zh_tw: 4. 廢墟宮殿

english: Traces of gold-colored plaster still cling to this dome in a few spots, but everywhere else you see old weathered bricks, more than a few of which have fallen through. The larger-than-life-size elephant carvings and the graceful, towering spire are still magnificent sights, even if their glory is dimmed by time and decay.
zh_tw: 這個圓頂上仍然有幾處殘留著金色石膏的痕跡，但在其他地方你看到的是老舊風化的磚塊，其中不少已經掉落。儘管時間的流逝和衰敗使它們的輝煌有所褪色，但超大型的大象雕刻和優雅的高聳尖塔仍然是壯觀的景象。

english: A character can climb the outside of the dome with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) and peer inside through any one of a number of holes. The top of the dome has been weakened by time and collapses under the weight of a creature weighing 200 pounds or more. Any creature standing on or clinging to the roof when it collapses falls, taking damage as normal and possibly landing in the cistern.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過成功進行 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動} 檢定來爬上穹頂的外部，並透過其中一個洞窺視內部。穹頂的頂部因時間流逝而變得脆弱，會在重達 200 磅或以上的生物的重量下坍塌。任何在屋頂坍塌時站在或依附在屋頂上的生物都會墜落，正常受到傷害，並可能掉入蓄水池中。

english: Iron doors on the eastern side of the dome are rusted shut and can be forced open only with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check—but the impact causes a portion of the ceiling to collapse. Whoever forced the doors open must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 ({@dice 2d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Identical doors on the western side of the dome are rusted completely off their hinges.
zh_tw: 圓頂東側的鐵門生鏽無法開啟，只有透過成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能強行開啟——但衝擊會導致部分天花板坍塌。任何強行開啟門的人必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免，豁免失敗將受到 9（{@dice 2d8}）點鈍擊傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。圓頂西側的鐵門則完全從鉸鏈上脫落。

english: When characters enter the ruined palace, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入廢棄的宮殿時，請閱讀：

english: An 18-foot-tall stone statue of a Chultan warrior in splint armor, wearing a helmet festooned with tyrannosaurus teeth and bearing a shield of intricately patterned leopard hide, towers over the chamber and looms above a wide, octagonal cistern. The chamber echoes with the sound of rainwater dripping from the ceiling into the gaping pit. The face of the giant warrior statue is obliterated by deep gouges, but the rest of the statue remains intact. Clutched in the statue's right hand is a stone spear, and resting on the floor beneath it is a clay urn. North of the statue is an open balcony overlooking a flooded garden.
zh_tw: 一尊18尺高的石雕，雕刻著一個穿著夾板盔甲的楚爾特戰士，頭戴裝飾著暴龍牙齒的頭盔，手持豹皮盾牌，盾牌上有著複雜的圖案，它高聳在大廳之上，俯瞰著一個寬闊的八邊形蓄水池。大廳裡迴盪著雨水從天花板滴入大坑的聲音。巨人戰士雕像的面部被深深的劃痕破壞了，但雕像的其餘部分仍然完好。雕像的右手緊握著一支石制長矛，而在其下方的地面上放著一個陶土甕。雕像的北邊是一個開放的陽臺，可以俯瞰一個被水淹沒的花園。

english: Standing to one side of the giant warrior is another statue, this one much smaller. Exquisitely lifelike, it depicts a man reaching for the urn, his face turned toward the balcony. In his lifeless eyes, you see terror.
zh_tw: 站在這位巨人戰士的一側，是另一尊雕像，這尊雕像要小得多。它栩栩如生地描繪了一個伸手去拿骨灰甕的男人，他的臉轉向陽臺。在他無生命的眼睛裡，你看到了恐懼。

english: Stone steps ascend along the curved wall to the level of a second floor, but that floor is almost entirely collapsed. Someone's been up there, however, because a message of some sort is scrawled across the domed ceiling.
zh_tw: 石階沿著彎曲的牆壁上升至二樓，但二樓幾乎完全坍塌了。然而，有人曾到過那裡，因為某種資訊被潦草地寫在了圓頂天花板上。

english: When it was intact, the second floor was actually a mezzanine that wrapped around three sides of the dome. The head, chest, and shoulders of the warrior statue rose above the mezzanine level.
zh_tw: 當它完好無損時，二樓實際上是一個環繞圓頂三面的夾層。戰士雕像的頭部、胸部和肩部高出了夾層的水平面。

english: The 20-foot-deep pit contains {@dice 1d4 + 2} inches of rainwater and is home to two {@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||swarms of poisonous snakes}. The swarms are content to remain in the pit and attack any creature that joins them, except for Zalkoré, whom the snakes obey. The walls of the pit can't be climbed without gear or magic.
zh_tw: 這個20尺深的坑裡積有{@dice 1d4 + 2}吋的雨水，並且是兩個{@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||毒蛇群}的棲息地。這些蛇群滿足於待在坑裡，並且會攻擊任何加入它們的生物，除了扎爾柯蕊，蛇群聽從他的命令。沒有裝備或魔法的幫助，坑壁是爬不上去的。

english: Rainwater pouring into the pit through holes in the roof drains via pipes through the tyrannosaurus spout at the head of the main concourse ({@area area 1|167|x}). The snakes can also come and go through the pipes, which are 6 inches wide.
zh_tw: 雨水透過屋頂的洞口流入坑中，透過管道從主要通道（{@area 區域1|167|x}）頭部的暴龍頭形噴口中排出。蛇也可以透過這些管道進出，這些管道寬6吋。

english: Mezzanine Message
zh_tw: 夾層訊息

english: The message scrawled on the inside of the dome can be read only by climbing to the mezzanine, but the decrepit condition of the stairs and balcony makes this venture risky. A character who climbs the steps must make a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to move without jarring the flooring; otherwise, the steps collapse and the character takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage from the fall. A Small character has advantage on the check. Without the steps, climbing the inward-curving wall requires a climbing kit and a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 圓頂內側潦草寫下的資訊只有爬上夾層才能閱讀，但樓梯和陽臺的破舊狀態使這一冒險變得危險。一個爬上臺階的角色必須成功進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定，以在不震動地板的情況下移動；否則，臺階會坍塌，角色將因墜落受到 {@dice 1d6} 鈍擊傷害。小型角色在此檢定中獲得優勢。若無臺階，爬上升內彎曲的牆壁需要攀爬工具和一次成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: The message, scrawled in Old Omuan, states, "True love, faithful general, safe will you rest in Nangalore eternal. None will disturb you while I live. Such is my vow of penance, and for my sins I cannot die."
zh_tw: 這條資訊用古奧穆語潦草地寫著："真愛，忠誠的將軍，在南加洛爾你將安息。只要我活著，就無人會打擾你。這是我的懺悔誓言，因為我的罪過，我不能死去。"

english: Statues
zh_tw: 雕像

english: The large statue portrays Thiru-taya. Zalkoré had it commissioned out of appreciation and affection, but defaced it when she believed the general betrayed her. The face is completely destroyed. Gouged across its back in Old Omuan are the words "Forgive me."
zh_tw: 這座大型雕像描繪的是提魯-塔亞。扎爾柯蕊出於感激和喜愛委託製作了它，但當她認為這位將軍背叛了她時，她破壞了這座雕像。雕像的面部已經完全被毀。在雕像的背部用古奧穆語刻著"原諒我"這幾個字。

english: The smaller statue is actually a {@condition petrified} adventurer named Gowl (NG male Chultan human {@creature scout}). He came to Nangalore in search of riches and was turned to stone by Zalkoré while reaching for the urn. Scratched into the floor next to him are the following words, in Old Omuan: "Once a thief, forever a slave!"
zh_tw: 較小的雕像實際上是一個名為高爾（守序善良男性楚爾特人類 {@creature scout||斥侯}）的{@condition petrified||石化}冒險者。他為了尋找財富來到南加洛爾，並在伸手去拿骨灰罈時被扎爾柯蕊變成了石頭。他旁邊的地板上刻著以下古老的奧穆安文字："一次為賊，終身為奴！"

english: Urn
zh_tw: 甕

english: The clay urn contains Thiru-taya's ashes.
zh_tw: 陶土甕內裝有提魯-塔亞的骨灰。

english: 5. Hallucinogenic Plants
zh_tw: 5. 致幻植物

english: Zalkoré cultivates hallucinogenic plants in these four sheltered gardens. From the plants, she brews a narcotic tincture that allows her to dream of Thiru-taya. Without it, she can't recall his face.
zh_tw: 扎爾柯蕊在這些四個遮蔽的花園裡種植致幻植物。她從這些植物中釀造一種麻醉藥水，使她能夠夢見提魯-塔雅。沒有它，她無法回憶起他的面容。

english: The plants in this enclosed garden are like nothing you've ever seen. Their shapes are fantastic, and their colors are like gems sparkling in the sun. Enclosed by 5-foot-high walls, this strangely beautiful garden imparts a sense of serenity.
zh_tw: 這個封閉花園裡的植物是你從未見過的。它們的形狀奇異，顏色如寶石在陽光下閃爍。被5尺高的牆壁環繞，這個異常美麗的花園傳達出一種寧靜的感覺。

english: A message is deeply scratched into the wall.
zh_tw: 一條資訊深深地被劃在牆上。

english: Four of these gardens are situated around the palace ({@area area 4|171|x}). Any humanoid that spends 1 minute or longer in any one of them must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes {@condition poisoned}. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is also {@condition charmed} by every other creature in Nangalore. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each hour, ending the effect on itself on a success. If any saving throw after the initial one fails by 5 or more, the creature falls {@condition unconscious} and remains so until it takes damage or until it succeeds on a saving throw against this effect.
zh_tw: 其中四座花園圍繞宮殿（{@area 區域4|171|x}）而建。任何類人生物在其中任何一座花園停留1分鐘或更長時間，必須進行一次{@dc 10}體質豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。以此方式{@condition poisoned||中毒}時，該生物還會被納加洛爾的每隻其他生物{@condition charmed||魅惑}。該生物可以在每小時結束時重複進行豁免，成功則結束此效果。如果在初始豁免之後的任何一次豁免失敗且差值達到5或更多，該生物將陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態，並保持昏迷直到受到傷害或成功透過對抗此效果的豁免。

english: A character who has proficiency in both {@skill Medicine} and {@skill Nature} recognizes these plants as soporifics after 2 rounds of examination. A character with proficiency in either skill, but not both, recognizes the plants with a successful {@dc 15} check in the trained skill.
zh_tw: 一個同時熟練於{@skill Medicine||醫療}和{@skill Nature||自然}的角色在2輪檢查後能識別這些植物為催眠劑。一個僅熟練於其中一項技能，而非兩項都熟練的角色，可以透過在被訓練技能中成功進行{@dc 15}的檢定來識別這些植物。

english: A single character who spends 30 minutes in a garden can strip it of its hallucinogenic plants, gathering 3 pounds of leaves in the process. {@creature Jessamine|ToA} (see {@area chapter 1|05c|x}) is willing to pay 20 gp for each pound of leaves.
zh_tw: 一個單身角色如果在花園裡花費30分鐘，可以清除其致幻植物，在此過程中收集3磅葉子。{@creature Jessamine|ToA|婕薩敏}（見{@area 第一章|05c|x}）願意為每磅葉子支付20金幣。

english: Zalkoré and the eblis don't miss the opportunity to strike while characters are drugged, or to offer them poisoned fruit and wine if they've done nothing offensive (see {@adventure area 8|ToA|2|8. Zalkoré's Lair}).
zh_tw: 扎爾柯蕊和魔王鶴不會錯過在角色們被下藥時發動攻擊的機會，或者如果他們沒有做出任何冒犯行為，會向他們提供有毒的水果和酒（見{@adventure 區域8|ToA|2|8. Zalkoré's Lair})。

english: 5A. Southwest Garden
zh_tw: 5A. 西南花園

english: An open archway in the south wall of the garden overlooks a flooded tunnel with a collapsed roof (see {@area area 1|167|x}). Written on the south wall in Old Omuan are the words "Without dreams, eternity is unbearable."
zh_tw: 花園南牆上的一個開放式拱門俯瞰著一個屋頂坍塌的被洪水淹沒的隧道（見{@area 區域1|167|x}）。在南牆上用古奧穆語寫著"沒有夢想，永恆是難以忍受的"。

english: 5B. Southeast Garden
zh_tw: 5B. 東南花園

english: Three {@creature Tri-flower Frond|ToA|tri-flower fronds} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) grow in this garden. Any character who moves through the garden can't help but brush up against one of these beautiful but deadly plants. Written on the south wall in Old Omuan are the words "Great Ubtao, free me!"
zh_tw: 這個花園裡生長著三株{@creature Tri-flower Frond|ToA|三花株}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。任何穿過花園的角色都不可避免地會觸碰到這些美麗但致命的植物。在南牆上用古奧穆語寫著"偉大的烏博塔奧，釋放我！"

english: 5C. Northwest Garden
zh_tw: 5C. 西北花園

english: The steps leading to the upper walkway are overgrown by tree roots. Scrawled on the north wall in Old Omuan are the words "For the lies of a few, all must pay."
zh_tw: 通往上層步道的臺階被樹根覆蓋。在北牆上用古奧穆語寫著"因為少數人的謊言，所有人都必須付出代價。"

english: 5D. Northeast Garden
zh_tw: 5D. 東北花園

english: This garden has been taken over by a {@creature mantrap|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), which lies hidden under other plants. It attacks any creature that's not Zalkoré or an eblis. Scrawled on the east wall in Old Omuan are the words "To dream, to dance."
zh_tw: 這個花園已經被一個{@creature mantrap|ToA|捕人草}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）佔據，它隱藏在其他植物下面。它攻擊任何不是扎爾柯蕊或魔王鶴的生物。在東牆上用古奧穆語寫著"夢想，跳舞"。

english: 6. Pagoda
zh_tw: 6. 寶塔

english: This crumbling pagoda must have been lovely once, with its wide, graceful arches inviting the breeze to blow through, and overlooking the silent pool below. But time, decay, and some bestial presence have given it a sinister air. It smells foul, and dark stains cover the floor and seep down the white steps.
zh_tw: 這座破敗的寶塔曾經一定非常美麗，它有著寬闊、優雅的拱門，邀請微風穿過，俯瞰下方靜謐的水池。但時間、衰敗和某種野獸的存在賦予了它一種陰森的氣氛。它散發出惡臭，深色的汙跡覆蓋著地板，沿著白色的臺階滲透下來。

english: This pagoda houses six {@creature eblis|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) that serve as Zalkoré's sentries and servants. The interior is filthy, with gnawed bones strewn everywhere and the floor thick with droppings. Unless the characters creep through the garden with uncommon stealth, the eblis see or hear them coming, in which case this nest will be empty. Three eblis move to Zalkoré's lair ({@adventure area 8|ToA|2|8. Zalkoré's Lair}), while the others take up positions in trees, on walls, or on rooftops. Their job is not to attack intruders on sight, but to alert Zalkoré and be ready to back up whatever she does.
zh_tw: 這座塔樓是扎爾柯蕊的六個{@creature eblis|ToA|魔王鶴}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的住所，它們作為她的哨兵和僕人。內部非常髒亂，到處散落著被啃過的骨頭，地板上覆蓋著厚厚的糞便。除非角色們以非凡的潛行技巧穿過花園，否則惡魔族會看到或聽到他們的到來，在這種情況下，這個巢穴將會是空的。三個惡魔族會移動到扎爾柯蕊的巢穴（{@adventure 區域8|ToA|2|8. Zalkoré's Lair}），而其他的則會在樹上、牆上或屋頂上佔據位置。它們的工作不是一見到入侵者就攻擊，而是警告扎爾柯蕊並準備支援她的任何行動。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search through the refuse find some baubles tucked away by the eblis, including a pouch containing seven assorted gemstones (10 gp each), a painted gold bracelet shaped like a couatl (50 gp), and a wooden scroll tube engraved with skeletons, which contains a {@item scroll of protection}{@i (undead)}.
zh_tw: 角色們在搜尋垃圾時會發現魔王鶴藏起來的一些小玩意兒，包括一個包含七顆不同寶石的小袋（每顆10金幣），一個形狀像羽蛇的彩繪金手鐲（50金幣），以及一個雕刻有骷髏的木製卷軸筒，裡面裝有一份{@item scroll of protection||守護卷軸}{@i （不死生物）}。

english: 7. Flooded Garden
zh_tw: 7. 洪水花園

english: The water in this pool is unusually clear. A dozen or more large fish, turtles, and lizards swim lazily through it, and waterbirds paddle on the surface. Their ripples obscure something on the bottom of the pool, so you can't quite make it out, but the bottom appears to be blanketed in oddly shaped stones.
zh_tw: 這個池塘的水異常清澈。十幾條大魚、烏龜和蜥蜴在其中悠閒地遊動，水鳥在水面上划水。它們的漣漪使池塘底部的某些東西變得模糊，所以你無法完全看清楚，但底部似乎被奇特形狀的石頭覆蓋。

english: Bits of shattered stone rest atop a square dais that rises from the middle of the pool—evidence of a sculpture that once stood atop it. Part of the sculpture lies in the pool, west of the dais: a large stone face staring up at the sky.
zh_tw: 一些破碎的石頭碎片躺在從池中升起的方形基座上——這曾是一尊雕塑的證據，它曾經矗立在基座頂部。雕塑的一部分位於基座西側的水池中：一個巨大的石制面孔仰望著天空。

english: An immense stone bust of Zalkoré once rose above the pool atop the dais. It was the most beautiful sculpture in the garden. After Zalkoré learned the truth about Thiru-taya, she destroyed the likeness of herself in an act of self-revulsion.
zh_tw: 曾經有一個巨大的扎爾柯蕊石質半身像矗立在底座上的水池上方。它是花園中最美麗的雕塑。在扎爾柯蕊得知有關希魯塔雅的真相後，她出於自我厭惡的行為摧毀了自己的形象。

english: The stones in the pool are a 2-foot-deep layer of fish, turtles, lizards, and water birds {@condition petrified} by Zalkoré as they swam in the water. They've been piling up in the bottom of the pool for centuries. The {@condition petrified} animals could be sold to collectors in Port Nyanzaru for 1 gp apiece. Each one weighs 1 pound. Beneath the {@condition petrified} animals are the {@condition petrified} forms of Kwani and Shabarra, two adventurers (CN female Chultan {@creature Scout||scouts}) who ran afoul of Zalkoré many decades ago.
zh_tw: 池中的石頭是由魚、龜、蜥蜴和水鳥形成的 2 尺深的層，它們在水中游泳時被扎爾柯蕊{@condition petrified||石化}。這些石頭已經在池底堆積了幾個世紀。這些{@condition petrified||石化}的動物可以賣給南扎路港的收藏家，每個價值 1 金幣。每個重 1 磅。在{@condition petrified||石化}的動物下方是誇尼和沙巴拉兩位冒險者的{@condition petrified||石化}形態，他們是（混亂中立女性楚爾特人 {@creature Scout||斥侯}）在幾十年前與扎爾柯蕊發生衝突時被石化。

english: 8. Zalkoré's Lair
zh_tw: 8. 扎爾柯蕊的巢穴

english: This bell-shaped dome appears intact: it has no obvious holes in the roof, and the bronze double door hangs squarely in its frame. The doors are closed but not locked. Unless characters have been uncommonly stealthy (or Zalkoré is already dead), the queen is expecting them.
zh_tw: 這座鐘形圓頂看起來完好無損：屋頂沒有明顯的洞，而且青銅雙扇門方正地懸掛在門框中。門是關著的，但沒有上鎖。除非角色們非常隱秘（或者扎爾柯蕊已經死了），否則女王正在等待他們。

english: The single, large chamber inside the dome is obviously a royal apartment—or was, centuries ago. Now the bright, floral murals are dim and gray, bits of colored glass are heaped beneath a cracked mosaic, enameled wooden tables are split and tilting, and every bit of cloth is frayed and streaked.
zh_tw: 圓頂內部的單一大房間顯然是皇室公寓——或者幾個世紀前是。現在，明亮的花卉壁畫變得暗淡無光，彩色玻璃碎片堆積在破裂的馬賽克下面，琺琅木桌破裂且傾斜，所有的布料都磨損且有條紋。

english: At the center of the room, a long divan stands atop a circular dais. Reclining on the divan is a woman dressed in a flowing robe made from parrot feathers in stunning colors. Despite the heat, her arms, head, and face are covered in feathery veils. Next to her, a black orchid grows out of a large clay pot at the head of the divan. She addresses you in a voice tinged with odd inflections. "Strangers have come to Nangalore, my love. What boon do our subjects beseech?"
zh_tw: 在房間的中心，一張長沙發坐落在一個圓形的基座上。沙發上斜躺著一位穿著由鸚鵡羽毛製成的流動長袍的女子，顏色絢麗。儘管天氣炎熱，她的手臂、頭部和臉部都覆蓋著羽毛面紗。在她旁邊，一朵黑色的蘭花從一個大型陶罐中生長出來，位於沙發的頭部。她用帶有奇怪語調的聲音對你們說："陌生人來到了南加洛爾，我的愛人。我們的臣民祈求什麼恩惠？"

english: The {@creature medusa} isn't completely insane, but thanks to her plant extract, she continually hallucinates that Thiru-taya is standing at her side. Most of Zalkoré's comments include him somehow; try to make these references as puzzling as possible for the characters. She also believes that she's still queen of Omu while simultaneously remembering and understanding that she was exiled here. She can make contradictory statements about herself and her past without any apparent cognitive dissonance.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature medusa||美杜莎}並不完全瘋狂，但由於她的植物提取物，她不斷地產生幻覺，認為提魯-塔亞站在她身邊。扎爾柯蕊的大部分評論都涉及到他；嘗試讓這些提及對角色們來說儘可能令人困惑。她還相信自己仍然是奧穆的女王，同時記憶並理解她被流放到了這裡。她可以關於自己和她過去做出矛盾的陳述，而沒有任何明顯的認知失調。

english: Characters can have a pleasant, somewhat informative encounter with Zalkoré if they abide by three conditions:
zh_tw: 如果角色遵守三個條件，他們可以與扎爾柯蕊有一個愉快且有些資訊量的邂逅：

english: Disturbing Thiru-taya's ashes or damaging his statue are unpardonable. If characters did either, then a fight to the death is guaranteed.
zh_tw: 擾亂提魯-塔亞的骨灰或破壞他的雕像是不可饒恕的。如果角色們做了其中任何一件事，那麼一場生死戰鬥是不可避免的。

english: The first time someone makes a disparaging remark about Thiru-taya or refers to his "betrayal," they draw a furious response from Zalkoré, but she recomposes herself. If it happens a second time, a battle is assured.
zh_tw: 第一次有人對提魯-塔雅發表不敬的評論或提到他的"背叛"時，扎爾柯蕊會做出憤怒的反應，但她會重新鎮定自己。如果這種情況第二次發生，一場戰鬥是肯定的。

english: If someone snatches away Zalkoré's veil, makes a grab for the black orchid, or brings out a mirror, their fate is sealed. If someone asks why she wears a veil, Zalkoré replies that she no longer desires to show her face to anyone but her beloved Thiru-taya.
zh_tw: 如果有人奪走扎爾柯蕊的面紗，試圖搶奪黑色蘭花，或拿出鏡子，他們的命運就註定了。如果有人問她為什麼戴面紗，扎爾柯蕊回答說她不再願意向除了她心愛的希魯塔雅之外的任何人展示她的面容。

english: As long as the meeting remains cordial, Zalkoré can reveal much about Omu. She can direct characters to its general location ("between the fire peaks and the great iron mine of the dwarves") and warns them that yuan-ti covet the city. She knows nothing about the Soulmonger or the death curse. She's heard that at least one of her descendants is in hiding with the bird folk of Kir Sabal, awaiting the restoration of the monarchy. (These are examples of how Zalkoré simultaneously thinks of herself as still the ruling queen of Omu as it was centuries ago, and is also aware the city has fallen and she's in exile. Both situations coexist in her hallucinatory reality.)
zh_tw: 只要會面保持友好，扎爾柯蕊可以透露很多關於奧穆的資訊。她可以指引角色們到它的大致位置（"在火山峰和矮人的巨大鐵礦之間"），並警告他們元提族垂涎這座城市。她對魂噬者或死亡詛咒一無所知。她聽說至少有一個她的後代隱藏在基爾·薩巴爾的鳥人中，等待君主制的恢復。（這些例子說明瞭扎爾柯蕊同時認為自己仍然是奧穆的統治女王，就像幾個世紀前一樣，同時也意識到這座城市已經陷落，她處於流亡之中。這兩種情況在她的幻覺現實中共存。）

english: Black Orchid
zh_tw: 黑蘭花

english: Characters in search of a black orchid for {@creature Asharra|ToA}'s ritual (see "{@area Kir Sabal|13f|x}") find one here, but Zalkoré won't part with it unless the characters offer her something of equal beauty. As payment, she demands a gemstone, a piece of jewelry, or an art object worth at least 500 gp. (She won't accept lesser quality goods of equal value.) Zalkoré is also attracted to characters with a Charisma of 16 or higher and will accept one such character as a slave in exchange for the flower. The black orchid in Zalkoré's possession is the only one to be found in Nangalore.
zh_tw: 尋找黑色蘭花以用於{@creature Asharra|ToA|阿莎爾}的儀式的角色（見"{@area 基爾·薩巴爾|13f|x}"）可以在這裡找到，但扎爾柯蕊不會放手，除非角色提供給她同樣美麗的東西。作為交換，她要求一顆寶石、一件珠寶或一件價值至少500金幣的藝術物品作為支付。（她不會接受同等價值但質量較低的商品。）扎爾柯蕊也對魅力為16或更高的角色感興趣，並願意接受這樣的角色作為奴隸來換取花朵。扎爾柯蕊擁有的黑色蘭花是在南戈爾能找到的唯一一朵。

english: Poisonous Hospitality
zh_tw: 有毒的款待

english: If Zalkoré resolves to kill the characters over an offense but the situation is still more-or-less cordial, she offers food and drink. She rings a silver handbell, and an {@creature eblis|ToA} servant (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) arrives with a tray of fruit and wine. All of it is artfully drugged; the contamination can be detected only by someone who has proficiency in {@skill Medicine} and who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check. Zalkoré partakes, but she's built up such a tolerance that this dose won't affect her. Characters who eat or drink must make a successful {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour or until they drink 2 quarts of water.
zh_tw: 如果扎爾柯蕊因冒犯決定殺死角色，但情況仍算得上友好，她會提供食物和飲料。她搖響一個銀手鈴，一個{@creature eblis|ToA|魔王鶴}僕人（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）端著一盤水果和葡萄酒出現。所有食物都被巧妙地下了藥；只有具有{@skill Medicine||醫療}熟練項且成功透過{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定的人才能發現汙染。扎爾柯蕊也會食用，但她對此類藥物已產生了耐受性，因此這次劑量不會影響她。食用或飲用這些食物的角色必須成功透過{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，否則將{@condition poisoned||中毒}1小時或直到飲用2誇脫水。

english: Thiru-Taya
zh_tw: 提魯-塔亞

english: When Zalkoré is reduced to 63 hit points or fewer, she calls out to her dead lover for protection. The spirit of Thiru-Taya answers the call, appearing as a barely visible 10-foot-tall apparition of a Chultan warrior wielding a massive spear of force. The apparition is impervious to damage and spells, and it can't be turned or controlled. It looms above Zalkoré until she dies or regains all her hit points. Once per turn, when a creature within 15 feet of Zalkoré damages her, Thiru-Taya's apparition unerringly hits the attacker with its spear, dealing 15 ({@dice 2d8 + 6}) force damage to it.
zh_tw: 當扎爾柯蕊被減少到63點生命值或更少時，她會呼喚她已故的愛人來保護她。提魯-塔亞的靈魂響應了這個呼喚，以一個幾乎看不見的10尺高的楚爾特戰士的幻象出現，手持一根巨大的力量之矛。這個幻象對傷害和法術無動於衷，不能被驅散或控制。它高懸在扎爾柯蕊上方，直到她死亡或恢復所有生命值。每當一個生物在扎爾柯蕊15尺範圍內傷害她時，提魯-塔亞的幻象就會用它的矛無誤地擊中攻擊者，對其造成15（{@dice 2d8 + 6}）點力場傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Most of what remains in Zalkoré's lair has little value. Her feathered dress is worth 50 gp, if it wasn't too damaged in the fight (the dress is ruined if more than half the damage done to Zalkoré was slashing, acid, or fire damage, or if she was hit by a {@spell fireball} or similar effect). Her lair contains {@dice 2d6} vials of her dreaming tincture. Each vial contains a single dose and can be sold for 10 gp in Port Nyanzaru. Any character that drinks a dose of the tincture must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. Characters who are immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition succeed automatically. On a failed save, the character begins to experience illusory sights, sounds, smells, and sensations that seem real. Casting a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic on the character ends the effect, which otherwise lasts for {@dice 1d4 + 4} hours.
zh_tw: 在扎爾柯蕊的巢穴中，大部分遺留物都沒有什麼價值。她的羽毛禮服價值50金幣，前提是它沒有在戰鬥中被嚴重損壞（如果扎爾柯蕊受到的傷害超過一半是劈砍、酸或火焰傷害，或者她受到了{@spell fireball||火球術}或類似效果的影響，那麼這件禮服就被毀了）。她的巢穴中還有{@dice 2d6}瓶她的夢境酊劑。每瓶酊劑含有一次劑量，可以在南扎路港以10金幣的價格出售。任何飲用了一瓶酊劑的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}的體質豁免。對{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態免疫的角色自動成功豁免。如果豁免失敗，該角色將開始體驗到看似真實的幻覺景象、聲音、氣味和感覺。對角色施放{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}或類似的魔法可以結束這種效果，否則效果將持續{@dice 1d4 + 4}小時。

english: Needle's Bones
zh_tw: 針骨

english: A wide sinkhole yawns before you, the earth around it littered with goblin bones. The opening is 90 feet across and roughly circular, and the stone walls are nearly vertical. Thirty feet down, the sinkhole is filled with murky green water. Hundreds of frogs hop from one floating plant to another.
zh_tw: 一個寬闊的天坑在你面前張開，周圍的地面上散落著地精的骨頭。洞口寬90尺，大致呈圓形，石壁幾乎垂直。30尺深的地方，天坑裡充滿了渾濁的綠色水。數百隻青蛙從一個漂浮的植物跳到另一個。

english: The massive rib cage and fine wing bones of a dragon rise above the murk. Vines, moss, and lichen hang from the bones. Judging from how much of the skeleton is exposed, the water can't be more than 3 or 4 feet deep.
zh_tw: 一個龍的巨大肋骨架和精緻的翼骨在泥濘中顯現出來。藤蔓、苔蘚和地衣懸掛在骨骼上。從暴露出的骨架部分判斷，水深最多也就三四尺。

english: The walls of the sinkhole are rough and draped with dozens of stout vines, so climbing into or out of the grotto is easy and automatically successful.
zh_tw: 天坑的牆壁粗糙，掛著幾十條結實的藤蔓，所以爬進或爬出這個洞穴是容易的，並且是自動成功的。

english: The bones are the remains of Ormalagos, an adult green dragon better known during her lifetime as Needle. She used this grotto as a lair but feared Batiri goblins had sniffed out its location and were getting ready to raid it. Needle was in the process of moving her treasure to other locations when the goblins struck. While the dragon was away, they dumped baskets full of quippers into the sinkhole. When the dragon returned, they trapped her in the sinkhole with vine nets. As the quippers devoured the dragon from below, the Batiri showered Needle with spears from above until she finally died. Nearly the entire goblin tribe perished in the fight, too.
zh_tw: 這些骨頭是奧瑪拉戈斯的遺骸，一隻成年綠龍，在她的一生中更常被稱為針刺。她將這個洞穴作為巢穴，但擔心巴提裡地精發現了它的位置，並準備襲擊它。針刺正在將她的寶藏轉移到其他地方時，地精發動了攻擊。當龍外出時，地精們將裝滿食人魚的籃子倒入了陷坑。當龍返回時，他們用藤蔓網將她困在陷坑中。當食人魚從下方吞噬龍時，巴提裡地精從上方用長矛雨攻擊針刺，直到她最終死去。幾乎整個地精部落也在戰鬥中滅亡了。

english: The characters' first impression of the water is correct; it varies from 3 to 4 feet deep everywhere. A search of the muddy bottom turns up hundreds of goblin bones and stone spear heads, greatly annoys the multitude of frogs, and draws attacks from two {@creature Swarm of Quippers||swarms of quippers}. Someone who examines the dragon bones and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check sees enough regularity in the vines draped across the ribs to conclude the dragon was tangled in a net. To identify the remains as a green dragon, characters must lift its skull out of the water and muck; that feat takes a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 角色們對水的第一印象是正確的；水到處都深 3 到 4 尺。在泥濘的底部搜尋會發現數百個哥布林骨頭和石頭矛頭，這極大地激怒了大量的青蛙，並招致了兩群 {@creature Swarm of Quippers||食人魚群} 的攻擊。如果有人檢查龍骨併成功透過一個 {@dc 13} 智力 ({@skill Investigation||調查}) 檢定，他們會看到肋骨上覆蓋的藤蔓有足夠的規律性，從而得出結論：龍被一張網纏住了。要確認這些遺骸為綠龍，角色們必須將其頭骨從水和淤泥中抬起；這需要一個成功的 {@dc 15} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A 10-foot-wide, 10-foot-high secret door in the northwest wall of the grotto conceals a 15-foot-deep alcove. The secret door is carved from natural rock and disguised to look like part of the wall, and all the plants around it are dead. The secret door can be detected with a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Characters who inspect the plants around the door and succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check can tell that the plants were killed by poison. Needle opened the secret door by breathing poison gas on it; smearing or spraying poison on the door also causes it to swing open. Otherwise, a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic is needed to open it.
zh_tw: 在洞穴西北牆上的一個 10 尺寬、10 尺高的密門隱藏著一個 15 尺深的壁龕。密門由天然岩石雕刻而成，偽裝成牆壁的一部分，周圍的植物都已枯死。密門可以透過成功的 {@dc 17} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現。檢查門周圍植物併成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定的角色可以辨別出植物是被毒藥殺死的。針（針）透過向門噴吐毒氣開啟了密門；在門上塗抹或噴灑毒藥也會使門開啟。否則，需要使用 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 咒語或類似的魔法來開啟它。

english: Needle hid the following items in the alcove: a purse made from triceratops hide, a small box made from two velociraptor skulls cleverly fitted together, and a hollow dinosaur bone with a wax plug at one end. The purse contains 55 gp, 800 sp, and three blue quartz rings (10 gp each). The skull box is worth 12 gp and contains a {@item wand of fear} and two diamonds (500 gp each). The hollow dinosaur bone contains five {@item +1 Sling Bullet||+1 sling bullets}.
zh_tw: 針刺在壁龕中藏有以下物品：一個由三角龍皮製成的錢包，一個由兩個巧妙拼合在一起的伶盜龍頭骨製成的小盒子，以及一根一端有蠟塞的空心恐龍骨頭。錢包裡有55金幣，800銀幣和三個藍色石英戒指（每個10金幣）。頭骨盒子價值12金幣，內含一根{@item wand of fear||恐懼魔杖}（恐懼法杖）和兩顆鑽石（每顆500金幣）。空心恐龍骨頭內含五枚{@item +1 Sling Bullet||+1 投石索子彈}。

english: Nsi Wastes
zh_tw: 恩西荒原

english: This vast tract of jungle was ravaged by blight long ago and never recovered. The plants here are sickly and poisonous. In the heart of this wasteland is the ruined palace of the warlord {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}: a crumbled stone fortress that once stood on the backs of a dozen giant undead turtles. Its destruction by {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s rampaging undead was so complete that nothing remains of this once-awesome structure except the crushed shells and bleached bones of the turtles, and heaps of stone so jumbled that not even the outlines of the ancient walls can be picked out, slowly sinking into the muck. The chance for a random encounter is doubled in this region.
zh_tw: 這片廣闊的叢林很久以前被疫病摧毀，從未恢復。這裡的植物病態且有毒。在這片荒地的中心是軍閥{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的廢棄宮殿：一個曾經建立在一打巨型不死龜背上的崩塌的石制堡壘。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的狂暴不死軍團對其造成的破壞如此徹底，以至於這座曾經令人敬畏的建築除了被壓碎的龜殼和漂白的骨頭，以及一堆堆如此混亂的石頭之外，什麼也沒有留下，這些石頭正在慢慢沉入泥沼中，連古老的牆壁輪廓都無法辨認。在這個區域，隨機遭遇的機率增加了一倍。

english: Omu
zh_tw: 奧穆

english: The lost city of Omu is described in {@area chapter 3|1d6|x}.
zh_tw: 失落之城奧穆在{@area 第三章|1d6|x}中有描述。

english: Orolunga
zh_tw: 奧羅倫加

english: All that remains of the ancient city of Orolunga is a crumbling ziggurat watched over by a {@creature guardian naga}. The naga is thousands of years old and a font of useful information—perhaps the best source of information in Chult. However, she's not easy to reach.
zh_tw: 奧羅隆加這座古老城市留下的唯一遺蹟是一座破敗的金字形神塔，由一位{@creature guardian naga||守秘納迦}守護。這條納迦有數千年的歷史，是大量有用資訊的源泉——可能是楚特地區最好的資訊來源。然而，她並不容易接觸。

english: A massive brick and stone ziggurat rises from the jungle. Two staircases angle up and across the front face, one from the right, the other from the left, to meet at a landing on the second level 30 feet above your heads. That layout repeats on the second level, and the third level, but with each successive layer adding less height than the one below it. The fourth level, 60 feet above the jungle floor, is an enclosed shrine or temple, its walls adorned with labyrinth symbols.
zh_tw: 一座巨大的磚石結構的金字形神塔從叢林中升起。兩個樓梯呈對角線上升並橫跨正面，一個從右側開始，另一個從左側開始，它們在你們頭頂上方30尺高的第二層平臺上相遇。這種佈局在第二層和第三層重複出現，但每上一層的高度都比下面一層要矮。第四層位於叢林地面上方60尺處，是一個封閉的神殿或寺廟，其牆壁上裝飾著迷宮符號。

english: The jungle encroaches right up to and onto this ancient structure. The first flights of steps are choked with creepers, tree roots, and flowering vines. It might have been surrounded by a city long ago, but the jungle is so dense that it would take hours of searching to find buried foundations and tumbled stones.
zh_tw: 叢林一直蔓延到這座古老建築的邊緣，甚至覆蓋了它的部分結構。最初的幾段臺階被藤蔓、樹根和開花的藤本植物阻塞。很久以前，這裡可能被城市所環繞，但叢林如此茂密，要找到埋藏的地基和倒塌的石頭，需要花費數小時的搜尋。

english: The ziggurat is encased in magic, which becomes obvious if anyone casts {@spell detect magic}. This protective shell prevents anyone from ascending the ziggurat by any means other than climbing the stairs. Characters who try to fly up rise above the trees but never get any closer to the ziggurat, as if they're flying into a powerful headwind they can't detect. Those who try to climb a wall get halfway up, then inexplicably loses their grip and slide back down. A ladder built to scale a wall never reaches the top, no matter how long the ladder. A rope-and-hook thrown up to catch the edge always falls short. Casting {@spell teleport} or {@spell misty step} moves the caster sideways instead of up to the next level. Bypassing the tests by any means is flat-out impossible. It might help to think of the whole situation as a fairy tale; it doesn't need to make sense, because the magic of Orolunga is on a mythic scale that overpowers the ability of any mortal.
zh_tw: 這座金字塔形建築被魔法包裹著，如果有人施放{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}，這一點就會變得明顯。這個保護殼阻止任何人透過除了爬樓梯以外的任何方式攀登金字塔。試圖飛上去的角色會飛越樹梢，但永遠不會更接近金字塔，就好像他們正在飛向一個他們無法察覺的強大逆風。那些試圖攀爬牆壁的人爬到一半時，會莫名其妙地失去抓握力，然後滑下來。一個為攀爬牆壁而建造的梯子永遠達不到頂部，無論梯子有多長。扔上去勾住邊緣的繩索和鉤子總是夠不著。施放{@spell teleport||傳送術}或{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}會將施法者橫向移動，而不是上升到下一個層次。以任何方式繞過這些考驗都是不可能的。將整個情況想象成童話可能會有所幫助；它不需要講得通，因為奧羅倫加的魔法處於神話般的規模，壓倒了任何凡人的能力。

english: First Steps
zh_tw: 第一步

english: The steps from the ground to level 1 of the ziggurat are 50 feet long and rise 30 feet. A tangle of roots, vines, and creepers covers the steps. Characters can climb the first 10 feet as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. After 10 feet, they begin getting scratched by thorns. If they continue, they take 1 slashing damage per foot climbed. After 20 feet, that increases to 2 slashing damage per foot. The thorns regrow as quickly as they're slashed, burned, or destroyed, and they can't be parted by magic or by abilities. No damage is incurred for moving down the steps.
zh_tw: 從地面到金字形神塔第一層的臺階長50尺，高30尺。臺階上覆蓋著糾結的樹根、藤蔓和攀緣植物。角色們可以將最初的10尺視為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}來攀爬。超過10尺後，他們開始被荊棘揮砍。如果他們繼續攀爬，每爬升一尺會遭受1點揮砍傷害。超過20尺後，這個傷害增加到每尺2點揮砍傷害。這些荊棘被砍斷、燒燬或摧毀後會迅速重新生長，它們不能被魔法或能力分開。下臺階移動時不會受到傷害。

english: After the characters' first attempts to climb the steps, they notice a {@creature chwinga|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) standing among them. It's about a foot tall, and its mask resembles a triceratops' head. It's also carrying a large orange and purple orchid. After a moment, it charges up the steps; the thorns part before it and close immediately behind it.
zh_tw: 在角色們第一次嘗試攀爬臺階後，他們注意到一個{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）站在它們中間。它大約一尺高，它的面具類似於三角龍的頭部。它還拿著一朵大型的橙色和紫色蘭花。片刻之後，它衝上臺階；荊棘在它面前分開，並在它身後立即合攏。

english: To ascend the steps, characters must find more of the orange and purple orchids. They can be found in the jungle in 30 minutes if anyone in the group has proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill, or 60 minutes otherwise. Each character climbing the stairs needs his or her own orchid.
zh_tw: 為了爬上臺階，角色們必須找到更多的橙色和紫色蘭花。如果隊伍中有人精通{@skill Nature||自然}技能，可以在叢林中30分鐘內找到它們，否則需要60分鐘。每個爬樓梯的角色都需要自己有一朵蘭花。

english: Second Steps
zh_tw: 第二臺階

english: The steps from level 1 to level 2 are 33 feet long and rise 20 feet. The stone is crumbling from age and decay. Those who try climbing the steps find that, after the first few, the stone crumbles into gravel beneath them so they can't make any more progress. However much the characters try to climb and demolish the steps, they never seem to get any worse and the gravel never piles up any deeper.
zh_tw: 從第一層到第二層的臺階長33尺，升高20尺。石頭因年久失修而崩裂。試圖攀爬臺階的人發現，在走了最初的幾步之後，石頭在他們腳下崩解成礫石，因此他們無法再取得更多進展。無論角色們如何嘗試攀爬和拆除臺階，臺階似乎永遠不會變得更糟，礫石也永遠不會堆積得更深。

english: After the characters' first attempts to climb, they notice another {@creature chwinga|ToA} standing among them at the base of the steps. Its mask resembles a chameleon's head. It's carrying an orange and purple orchid and a red parrot feather, and it races up the steps with ease, literally light as a feather on the fragile stones.
zh_tw: 在角色們第一次嘗試攀爬後，他們注意到另一個{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}站在臺階底部的它們中間。它的面具類似變色龍的頭部。它攜帶著一朵橙紫相間的蘭花和一根紅色鸚鵡羽毛，並以輕盈如羽毛般的姿態輕鬆地跑上易碎的臺階。

english: Characters can find parrot feathers in the jungle or lying around on this level after just a few minutes of searching. They need both the feather and the orchid to climb the steps.
zh_tw: 角色們可以在叢林中或在這一層搜尋幾分鐘後在地上找到鸚鵡的羽毛。他們需要同時擁有羽毛和蘭花才能爬上臺階。

english: Third Steps
zh_tw: 第三步

english: The steps from level 2 to level 3 (the level of the shrine) are 20 feet long and rise 12 feet. The stairs are in excellent condition, but {@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||swarms of poisonous snakes} slither over them. If snakes are killed, more crawl out through holes in the stone to replace them, so the swarms can never be destroyed or even weakened. No spells or abilities prevent the snakes from attacking someone who climbs the stairs.
zh_tw: 從第二層到第三層（神殿層）的臺階長20尺，升高12尺。這些臺階狀況極佳，但是{@creature Swarm of Poisonous Snakes||毒蛇群}在臺階上爬行。如果蛇被殺死，會有更多的蛇透過石頭上的洞爬出來替換它們，因此這些蛇群永遠無法被摧毀或甚至削弱。沒有法術或能力可以阻止蛇攻擊爬樓梯的人。

english: After a few moments of examining the stairs, the characters notice a third {@creature chwinga|ToA} standing among them at the base of the steps. Its mask resembles a mongoose's face, and it carries a red parrot feather and an orange and purple orchid. At the bottom step, the chwinga whacks a snake with its orchid to make it angry, then strokes the snake's flank with the feather to calm it down, then lies down facing the snake, whereupon the reptile crawls through the mouth of the mask and inside the chwinga. The chwinga then slithers up the steps like a snake, untroubled by any of the other poisonous snakes. To climb the steps safely, characters must do the same thing, but this stage isn't automatic. Using the orchid and the feather are easy, but a character must make a successful {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw after swallowing a snake. Evil-aligned characters have disadvantage on the saving throw. If the save succeeds, the character can slither up the steps safely. If the saving throw fails, the character takes 17 ({@dice 5d6}) psychic damage and can try again, but the DC increases to 11. The DC increases by 1 more with each successive failure.
zh_tw: 在檢查樓梯片刻後，角色們注意到第三步臺階處站著一個{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}。它的面具形似獴的面部，手持一根紅色鸚鵡羽毛和一朵橙紫相間的蘭花。在臺階底部，怯蘊阿靈用蘭花抽打一條蛇激怒它，然後用羽毛輕撫蛇的側翼使其平靜，接著面朝蛇躺下，隨後這條爬行動物便從面具口中鑽入怯蘊阿靈體內。接著怯蘊阿靈像蛇一樣蜿蜒爬上臺階，完全不受其他毒蛇幹擾。要安全攀爬臺階，角色們必須如法炮製，但這個等級並非自動完成。使用蘭花和羽毛很容易，但角色吞下蛇後必須成功透過{@dc 10}的體質豁免檢定。邪惡陣營角色進行該豁免檢定時具有劣勢。若豁免成功，角色可安全蜿蜒爬上臺階。若豁免失敗，則受到17（{@dice 5d6}）點心靈傷害並可重試，但DC提升至11。後續每次失敗DC再增加1。

english: Saja N'baza's Shrine
zh_tw: 薩迦·恩巴扎的神殿

english: The shrine atop the ziggurat is a simple, rectangular structure of brick. The outside walls are decorated with labyrinth symbols of Ubtao. Beyond the open doorway is a barren, dusty room, but any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher notes the aroma of incense.
zh_tw: 金字形神塔頂部的神殿是一個簡單的磚制矩形結構。外牆裝飾有烏博塔的迷宮符號。穿過敞開的門口是一個貧瘠、多塵的房間，但任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分為13或更高的角色都會注意到香味的氣味。

english: Characters who enter without their orchid and feather find the shrine empty. Leaving and coming back with the items changes nothing; it's too late. Characters who enter with their orchid and feather find themselves in the same room, but as it was centuries ago. They can enter the naga's presence once. Someone who leaves and comes back in sees only the bare room.
zh_tw: 沒有攜帶蘭花和羽毛的角色進入時，會發現神殿是空的。離開後再帶著物品回來，情況並沒有改變；已經太晚了。攜帶蘭花和羽毛的角色進入時，會發現自己在同一個房間裡，但那是幾個世紀前的樣子。他們只能進入納迦的面前一次。如果有人離開後再回來，看到的只是空蕩蕩的房間。

english: Read the following to players whose characters find themselves in the naga's presence:
zh_tw: 對那些角色發現自己處於納迦面前的玩家閱讀以下內容：

english: Hanging lamps illuminate the room, while incense burners fill it with exotic scents and curling smoke. Cushions and reed mats cover the floor, pots of blooming flowers line the plastered walls, and singing birds flit from plant to plant.
zh_tw: 懸掛的燈具照亮了這個房間，而香爐則用異國情調的香氣和繚繞的煙霧填滿了它。墊子和蘆葦墊覆蓋著地板，開花的花盆排列在粉刷過的牆壁上，唱歌的鳥兒在植物間穿梭。

english: An immense snake with iridescent scales rests on a heap of cushions opposite the doorway. It rises slowly to a height of 5 feet, staring directly into your eyes as it moves. Its face is remarkably humanlike, and its tongue flicks before it speaks.
zh_tw: 一條巨大的蛇，擁有彩虹般光澤的鱗片，躺在門口對面的一堆墊子上休息。它慢慢地升起到5尺高，當它移動時，直接凝視著你的眼睛。它的臉非常像人類，它的舌頭在說話前快速地閃動。

english: "I am Saja N'baza. What do you seek in this ancient place? Speak truly, for I hear your hearts!"
zh_tw: "我是薩賈·恩巴扎。你們在這個古老之地尋找什麼？說實話，因為我能聽到你們的心聲！"

english: If the characters haven't yet encountered {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and {@creature Dragonbait|ToA}, the duo might be conferring with the {@creature guardian naga} when the party arrives. Saja N'baza knows what happened to the city of Mezro (see "{@area Mezro|163|x}") and tells Artus that it won't return as long as {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} lives. This gives Artus incentive to accompany the party to Omu.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還沒有遇到{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}，當隊伍到達時，他們可能會與{@creature guardian naga||守秘納迦}商議。薩迦·恩巴扎知道梅茲羅城發生了什麼（見"{@area 梅茲羅|163|x}"），並告訴阿圖斯，只要{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}活著，它就不會回來。這給了阿圖斯陪伴隊伍前往奧穆的動力。

english: The naga knows through visions that {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and his yuan-ti followers are scheming to end the world from their lair in Omu. She doesn't know much about the death curse, but when characters describe it, she confirms that it fits with various omens tied to Omu. The naga knows that Omu lies between the Peaks of Flame and the Valley of Lost Honor, and she also knows it's sunken below the level of the surrounding jungle, so the best way to spot it will be from the air or from the nearest high ground.
zh_tw: 納迦透過幻象知道{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}和他的元提追隨者正密謀從他們在奧穆的巢穴中終結世界。她對死亡詛咒瞭解不多，但當角色們描述它時，她確認它與與奧穆相關的各種徵兆相符。納迦知道奧穆位於火焰峰和失落榮譽谷之間，她也知道它沉沒在周圍叢林的水平面之下，所以要從空中或最近的高地才能最好地發現它。

english: The naga remembers {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s first uprising, and she urges the characters to kill him both as punishment for his past atrocities and to prevent any possibility of a recurrence. Each character who agrees receives a supernatural charm (see {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Charms} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) to aid their task. Assign charms to characters that are appropriate to their roles in the party. Characters who seem reluctant might have {@spell geas} cast on them.
zh_tw: 納迦記得{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的第一次起義，她敦促角色們殺死他，既是對他過去暴行的懲罰，也是為了防止任何復發的可能性。每個同意的角色都會收到一個超自然的護咒（見{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Charms}的{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。根據角色在隊伍中的角色分配適當的護咒。那些似乎猶豫不決的角色可能會被施加{@spell geas||指使術}法術。

english: Leaving the Shrine
zh_tw: 離開神殿

english: After characters leave the shrine, nothing they do brings them back to Saja N'baza's presence. The shrine is a barren chamber every time they reenter. It's dawn of the next day, no matter what time it was when they entered. They can descend the ziggurat with no difficulty, with or without the orchid and feather; the snakes are gone, the steps are solid, and a clear path extends through the plants and thorns. When they reach the ground, characters see blue tulips blooming all around the base of the ziggurat. The tulips are beautiful but nonmagical.
zh_tw: 角色們離開神殿後，他們所做的任何事情都無法讓他們再次回到薩迦·恩巴扎面前。每次他們重新進入時，神殿都是一個荒涼的房間。無論他們進入時是什麼時候，下一次天亮時就是第二天的黎明。他們可以毫無困難地沿著金字形神塔下降，無論是否帶著蘭花和羽毛；蛇已經不見了，臺階穩固，一條清晰的路徑穿過植物和荊棘。當他們到達地面時，角色們會看到金字形神塔底部周圍開滿了藍色的鬱金香。這些鬱金香雖然美麗，但沒有魔法效果。

english: Port Castigliar
zh_tw: 卡斯蒂利亞港

english: Port Castigliar (pronounced kah-STEE-lee-ar) is a port in name only. In fact, it's nothing more than a stretch of beach with an abandoned supply depot, seven battered huts made of bamboo and thatch, and a defiled graveyard. Undead drove away the inhabitants long ago, and ghouls dug up the graves.
zh_tw: 卡斯蒂利亞爾港（發音為kah-STEE-lee-ar）名義上是一個港口。實際上，它不過是一個帶有廢棄補給站的海灘，由七個由竹子和茅草製成的破舊小屋，以及一個被褻瀆的墓地組成。不死生物很久以前就趕走了居民，食屍鬼挖開了墳墓。

english: Refuge Bay
zh_tw: 避難灣

english: Refuge Bay has a reputation for being a relatively safe place to make landfall. Many explorations of Chult have begun on its white sand beach, which stretches as far as the eye can see around the entire shore of the bay. A Chultan town called Ishau once stood at the head of the bay, but its foundations sank into the sea during the Spellplague. The town's buildings are still largely intact but they now lie more than a mile from dry land, and they're prowled by sharks, plesiosaurs, and sea hags.
zh_tw: 避風港以其相對安全的登陸點而聞名。許多對楚爾特的探險都是從它那白色沙灘開始的，沙灘沿著海灣的整個海岸線延伸，一眼望不到邊。曾經有一個叫伊紹的楚爾特城鎮位於海灣的頂端，但在魔法瘟疫期間，它的地基沉入了海中。城鎮的建築物仍然大體上完好無損，但它們現在位於遠離陸地一英里多的地方，並且被鯊魚、蛇頸龍和海巫巡遊。

english: River Olung
zh_tw: 奧倫河

english: Steaming-hot water from Lake Luo cools quickly as it tumbles down rapids and low cataracts. This river is recognized by guides and explorers as an important boundary. To the east is "normal" jungle; to the west is undead territory. For this reason alone, some expeditions choose to enter the peninsula through Refuge Bay.
zh_tw: 來自羅羅湖的滾燙熱水在傾瀉下急流和低瀑布時迅速冷卻。這條河流被嚮導和探險家認為是重要的分界線。東邊是"普通"的叢林；西邊是不死生物的領地。僅此原因，一些探險隊選擇透過避難灣進入半島。

english: River Soshenstar
zh_tw: 索申斯塔河

english: The Soshenstar flows north from the Aldani Basin to the Bay of Chult, tumbling down waterfalls every ten to fifteen miles.
zh_tw: 索申斯塔河從阿爾達尼盆地向北流入楚爾特灣，每十到十五英里就有一個瀑布。

english: River Tath
zh_tw: 塔斯河

english: This river springs from the Aldani Basin and meanders westward, passing over waterfalls and through the canyon of Ataaz Kahakla before washing into Jahaka Bay.
zh_tw: 這條河流源自阿爾達尼盆地，向西蜿蜒流過，經過阿塔茲·卡哈克拉的峽谷和瀑布，最終流入賈哈卡灣。

english: River Tiryki
zh_tw: 提爾基河

english: The Tiryki spills from the back of a mist-shrouded canyon and flows north toward the Bay of Chult, plunging over waterfalls every few miles. This makes it arduous to traverse by canoe upriver—everything must be laboriously portaged around the cataracts—and dangerous to travel downriver, lest a canoe gets caught in the current and swept over a waterfall or smashed in rapids. What's worse, jungle predators and undead prowl both riverbanks. Considering the pterafolk nesting at Firefinger and the grungs living above the gorge, it's easy to see why the Tiryki is considered the most dangerous river in Chult.
zh_tw: 提裡基河從一條被霧氣籠罩的峽谷後方湧出，向北流向楚爾特灣，每隔幾英里就會飛瀉過瀑布。這使得乘獨木舟逆流而上非常艱難——一切都必須辛苦地繞過瀑布搬運——順流而下也很危險，以免獨木舟被急流捲走，衝過瀑布或在激流中撞毀。更糟糕的是，叢林捕食者和不死生物在兩岸潛伏。考慮到在火指築巢的翼手獸和生活在峽谷上方的格隆人，很容易理解為什麼提裡基河被認為是楚爾特最危險的河流。

english: Shilku
zh_tw: 希爾庫

english: This abandoned coastal village was both destroyed and preserved by volcanic eruption. The silent streets are buried in ash, and the harbor is choked with cooled lava. Since Mezro is now largely "cleared out," {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} of Fort Beluarian is under pressure from her patrons in Baldur's Gate to begin exploring and excavating Shilku for the treasures that are undoubtedly entombed there. Such an undertaking would require building a new fort from scratch somewhere on the southwestern coast, and Liara has neither the hands nor the funds for that. She might try to enlist the player characters into making a voyage to scout possible locations for such a fort, if only so she can reassure her impatient superiors in Baldur's Gate that progress is being made.
zh_tw: 這個廢棄的沿海村莊既被火山爆發摧毀，也被其儲存。寂靜的街道被火山灰覆蓋，港口被冷卻的熔岩阻塞。由於梅茲羅現在大部分被"清理乾淨"，來自貝路利安堡的{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}受到她在博德之門的贊助人的壓力，開始探索和挖掘希爾庫，那裡無疑埋藏著寶藏。這樣的任務需要在西南海岸某處從頭開始建造一個新的堡壘，而萊拉既沒有人力也沒有資金。如果只是為了向她在博德之門不耐煩的上級保證正在取得進展，她可能會試圖招募玩家角色進行一次航行，去偵察這樣一個堡壘的可能位置。

english: Although devoid of human life, the city is far from dead. Mephits, firenewts, salamanders, and other heat-loving creatures prowl its ashen alleys and bore tunnels into cellars long sealed by volcanic stone.
zh_tw: 儘管沒有人類居住，這座城市遠非死寂。氣體元素生物、火蠑螈、火蜥蜴以及其他喜熱的生物在佈滿灰燼的小巷中潛行，並在長期被火山石封閉的地窖中挖掘隧道。

english: Shilku Bay
zh_tw: 希爾庫灣

english: Lava still erupts from the volcano that destroyed Shilku, and it flows like a glowing river down into this bay. The sulfurous water is poisonous, so most of the bay's sea life is dead and the surrounding shore is barren. Safe landing spots can still be found on the beaches along the western shore, but a sailing ship that cruises along the eastern shore near Shilku is likely to lose its sails—and possibly much more—to the red-hot stones that infrequently rain down from the sky or to the burning ash that drifts miles out into the bay before finally extinguishing itself in the stinking, hissing water.
zh_tw: 熔岩仍然從摧毀了希爾庫的火山爆發出來，並像一條發光的河流一樣流入這個海灣。硫磺水是有毒的，所以海灣的大部分海洋生物都已死亡，周圍的海岸也是貧瘠的。在西海岸的海灘上仍然可以找到安全的登陸點，但是一艘沿著希爾庫附近的東海岸航行的帆船很可能會失去它的帆——甚至可能更多——因為那些偶爾從天而降的熾熱石頭，或者是那些在海灣裡飄散數英里後才最終在惡臭、嘶嘶作響的水中熄滅的燃燒灰燼。

english: Snapping Turtle Bay
zh_tw: 咬合龜灣

english: This bay is beautiful beyond compare. Though the sky is dark with clouds of smoke and ash streaked with lightning, the white sand beaches, lush forests, bright coral reefs, and colorful wildlife make this a restful retreat from the horrors of Chult. The shore is not without its dangers, but even they are inviting and wondrous to behold. Tri-flower fronds, mantraps, and jaculis are common, as are the fierce and aggressive giant snapping turtles that give the bay its name. See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for more information on these creatures.
zh_tw: 這個海灣的美麗無與倫比。儘管天空被煙霧和灰燼的雲層遮蔽，閃電劃破天際，白色的沙灘、茂密的森林、鮮豔的珊瑚礁和多彩的野生動植物使這裡成為逃離楚特恐怖的寧靜避風港。海岸並非沒有危險，但即便危險也誘人且令人驚歎。三花株、捕人草和幻色蛇是常見的植物，同樣常見的還有兇猛好鬥的巨型巨鱷龜，它們賦予了海灣它的名字。有關這些生物的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: Cyclopes roam the shore and lair in mountain caves overlooking the bay. These simple creatures aren't inherently hostile, but they are suspicious and wary around newcomers. Any show of malicious intent on the part of strangers is enough to shift the cyclopes from cautious to hostile. They are experts at surviving the dangers of Snapping Turtle Bay, which makes them valuable allies if characters offer them something they want. The cyclopes always need metal tools (shortswords make dandy daggers), and they're delighted by whimsical magical trinkets. For generous inducements, cyclopes could even be hired to serve as bearers, guards, or guides for an expedition headed north into the immense jungle between the Peaks of Flame and the Valley of Dread.
zh_tw: 獨眼巨人在海岸上游蕩，並在俯瞰海灣的山洞中築巢。這些簡單的生物天生並不具有敵意，但他們對新來者持懷疑和警惕的態度。任何來自陌生人的惡意表現足以使獨眼巨人從謹慎變為敵對。他們是在龜裂灣生存危險的專家，這使他們成為有價值的盟友，如果角色們提供他們想要的東西。獨眼巨人總是需要金屬工具（短劍可以作為很好的匕首），他們對奇特的魔法小玩意感到高興。對於慷慨的激勵，獨眼巨人甚至可以被僱傭作為向北進入火焰峰和小恐懼谷之間巨大叢林的探險隊的搬運工、警衛或嚮導。

english: King Toba
zh_tw: 託巴國王

english: A {@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) of unusual size (120 hit points) likes to sun itself on the beaches during the day. Chultans refer to the beast as King Toba. Residual magic from the Spellplague has crystallized parts of its shell. The shell's magic grants King Toba advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
zh_tw: 一隻體型異常的{@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA|巨鱷龜}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），生命值為 120，喜歡在白天在海灘上曬太陽。楚爾特人將這個怪獸稱為託巴王。來自魔法瘟疫的殘餘魔法使它的部分殼體結晶化。殼體的魔法賦予託巴王在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定上獲得優勢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If the mighty turtle is defeated, sixty crystals can be broken off its shell and sold for 10 gp each.
zh_tw: 如果這隻強大的海龜被擊敗，可以從它的殼上敲下六十塊水晶，每塊可以賣10金幣。

english: Snout of Omgar
zh_tw: 奧姆加的鼻子

english: Once a mountainous peninsula, the Snout of Omgar was split apart by the sea during the upheaval of the Spellplague. A narrow strait allows passage between the mainland and what is now a large island. Mariners and cartographers consider this feature to mark the boundary between the shores of Chult and the shores of Samarach.
zh_tw: 曾經的多山半島，奧姆加爾的鼻部在魔法瘟疫的大動盪中被海水分割。一條狹窄的海峽允許在大陸和現在是一個大型島嶼之間通行。水手和製圖師認為這個特徵標誌著楚特海岸和薩馬拉奇海岸之間的邊界。

english: Valley of Dread
zh_tw: 恐懼之谷

english: Explorers entering Chult from the east are likely to trek through this passage, which is contained by the windworn Sky Lizard Mountains to the north and the jagged Sanrach Mountains to the south. The valley of dense jungle is well named; it's a stomping ground for dinosaurs of all kinds. It's also home to savage kingdoms of lizardfolk ruled by heartless lizard kings and queens.
zh_tw: 從東部進入楚爾特的探險家們很可能會穿越這個通道，通道北面是風化的天蜥山脈，南面是參差不齊的桑拉奇山脈。這個密集叢林的山谷名副其實；它是各種恐龍的棲息地。它還是由無情的蜥蜴王和女王統治的野蠻蜥蜴人王國的所在地。

english: Valley of Embers
zh_tw: 餘燼谷

english: This burned-out valley surrounds Lake Luo. Most of the vegetation around the southern and eastern shore of the lake has been wiped out by pyroclastic flows, rivers of lava, and drifting ash. Fiery embers belched from the Peaks of Flame drift across the sky and fall like rain onto a blackened wasteland. The marshland north of the lake is wet enough to survive, but the accumulation of ash atop the water has turned into an almost impassable expanse of knee-deep muck. Mud mephits and steam mephits abound.
zh_tw: 這個燒燬的山谷圍繞著羅烏湖。湖的南部和東部沿岸的大部分植被已被火山碎屑流、熔岩河流和漂浮的灰燼所摧毀。從火焰峰噴出的熾熱餘燼飄過天空，像雨一樣落在一片燒焦的荒地上。湖以北的沼澤地足夠溼潤得以倖存，但是灰燼在水面上的堆積已經變成了一片幾乎無法通行的、深至膝蓋的泥潭。泥魔蝠和蒸汽魔在這裡隨處可見。

english: Valley of Lost Honor
zh_tw: 失落榮譽谷

english: The undead hordes of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} wiped out a tribe of Chultans in this valley. The bones of the fallen Eshowe are gone, along with everything else—swallowed up by lava pouring out of the volcano west of Hrakhamar. Firenewts have taken over that old dwarven forge in the mountains, and their territorial claim extends the entire length of this valley. Firenewt warriors mounted on giant striders (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) enforce that claim, making the valley very dangerous for interlopers. Tzindelor, the young red dragon inhabiting Wyrmheart Mine, is the only creature whose might and authority the firenewts begrudgingly respect. Tzindelor and the firenewts leave each other alone for now, but both of them covet what the other has: Tzindelor would like to possess Hrakhamar, and the firenewts would profit from controlling the iron resources in Wyrmheart Mine.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的不死軍團在這個山谷中消滅了一個楚爾坦部落。倒下的埃肖韋人的骨頭已經消失了，和山谷中的其他一切一樣——被從赫拉卡馬爾西部的火山湧出的熔岩吞噬了。火蠑螈已經佔領了山中的那座古老的矮人鍛造廠，它們的領土主張延伸至整個山谷。騎在巨型步行者上的火蠑螈戰士（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）執行這一主張，使得山谷對入侵者非常危險。棲息在龍心礦的年輕紅龍辛德洛是唯一一個火蠑螈勉強尊重的力量和權威的生物。辛德洛和火蠑螈目前互不干涉，但雙方都覬覦對方所擁有的：辛德洛想要佔有赫拉卡馬爾，而火蠑螈則希望控制龍心礦中的鐵礦資源。

english: Vorn
zh_tw: 沃恩

english: Standing next to some rocks and ferns is an 8-foot-tall statue, humanoid in shape with bronze fists, iron joints, an adamantine breastplate, and an iron helm with slits for eyes. The rest of the statue is made of sculpted wood reinforced with bands and rivets of adamantine. Scattered around its feet are offerings of food, feathers, colored stones, and skulls.
zh_tw: 站在一些岩石和蕨類植物旁邊的是一座8尺高的雕像，人形，青銅拳頭，鐵關節，精金胸甲，以及一個有眼睛縫隙的鐵頭盔。雕像的其他部分是由雕刻的木頭製成，用精金的帶子和鉚釘加固。在它腳邊散落著食物、羽毛、彩色石頭和頭骨的供品。

english: The statue is actually a deactivated {@creature shield guardian} that once served as a wizard's bodyguard. The wizard died from extreme bad luck decades ago—he fell out of a tree during a particularly bad bout of blue mist fever, hit his head on a rock that knocked him {@condition unconscious}, and rolled into a puddle, where he drowned. The shield guardian has stood impassive and unmoving, awaiting orders, ever since. A character with proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill recognizes the shield guardian for what it is with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check.
zh_tw: 這座雕像實際上是一具已停用的 {@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}，曾經擔任一位法師的保鏢。這位法師幾十年前死於極端的厄運——他在一場嚴重的藍霧熱病發作期間從樹上摔下，頭部撞到一塊岩石導致他 {@condition unconscious||昏迷}，並滾入一灘水中，最終溺水身亡。從那以後，這盾衛守護者一直冷漠地站立不動，等待著命令。一個精通 {@skill Arcana||奧秘} 技能的角色透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定可以認出這盾衛守護者的真實身份。

english: A character who searches the area and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check finds footprints in the dirt—evidence of nomadic tribes of goblins, grungs, and vegepygmies that revere the construct as a lesser god. They trim back the jungle vines and creepers that would otherwise swallow the construct, and they leave offerings at its feet. The area around it for several miles is a "neutral zone" where these tribes allow each other to enter without triggering conflict.
zh_tw: 一個在區域內搜尋併成功透過{@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Survival||求生}檢定的人物，會發現泥土中的腳印——這些腳印是崇拜這座構裝體為次級神靈的哥布林、咕嚕和植物侏儒遊牧部落的證據。他們修剪了可能吞噬構裝體的叢林藤蔓和爬藤，並在其腳下留下供品。幾英里內的區域是一個"中立區"，這些部落允許彼此進入而不會引發衝突。

english: Anyone who finds the shield guardian's control amulet (see "{@area Yellyark|1ce|x}") can animate the construct and take control of it. Reactivating the construct and marching it away infuriates local goblin, grung, and vegepygmy tribes. Random encounters with such creatures are automatically hostile unless characters placate the tribes with treasure or convince them of Vorn's "wish" to be moved elsewhere.
zh_tw: 任何找到盾牌守衛控制護身符的人（見"{@area 葉利亞克|1ce|x}"）都可以啟用這個構裝生物並控制它。重新啟用構裝生物並將其移動會激怒當地的地精、格龍和植物侏儒部落。與這些生物的隨機遭遇將自動充滿敵意，除非角色們用財寶安撫部落，或說服他們沃恩"希望"被移到其他地方。

english: Wreck of the Narwhal
zh_tw: 獨角鯨號殘骸

english: Through some magical mishap, a seafaring galleon called the {@i Narwhal} ended up in the heart of the jungle. It lies upside down, its hull encrusted with barnacles and overgrown with ivy. The crew is gone without a trace, but the old ship still has occupants: a reclusive weretiger and a small tribe of vegepygmies share it. Since the weretiger kills more than he eats and leaves the surplus for the vegepygmies, the tiny community gets along fine. The vegepygmies thrive in the damp, dark area under the ship and in its hold, while the weretiger lives more elegantly in the airy, well-furnished (albeit upside down) captain's cabin.
zh_tw: 由於某種魔法事故，一艘名為{@i 獨角鯨}的海船最終落在了叢林中心。它倒扣著，船體上長滿了藤壺，爬滿了常春藤。船員們消失得無影無蹤，但這條舊船仍然有居民：一隻隱居的虎人和一個小型的蔬菜矮人部落共享它。由於虎人殺的比吃的多，並將剩餘的食物留給蔬菜矮人，這個小社群相處得很好。蔬菜矮人在船下陰暗潮溼的區域和貨艙裡茁壯成長，而虎人則更優雅地生活在通風良好、裝飾精美（儘管是倒置的）的船長艙室裡。

english: The vegepygmy tribe consists of a {@creature vegepygmy chief|VGM}, twelve {@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|vegepygmies}, and three {@creature Thorny|VGM|thornies} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for the vegepygmies' and thornies' statistics). The {@creature weretiger} (N male Chultan human) uses no name anymore, but he was called Bwayes O'tamu years ago. He is a cousin of {@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA} (see "{@area Merchant Princes|056|x}" ), and the two were quite close as children. The family resemblance is strong; characters who've met Wakanga see the similarity when the weretiger assumes human form. The weretiger speaks Common and Vegepygmy, though he's forgotten much of the former through disuse.
zh_tw: 這個植物侏儒部落由一個{@creature vegepygmy chief|VGM|孢子人領主}、十二個{@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|孢子人們}和三個{@creature Thorny|VGM|棘背獸}組成（關於植物侏儒和荊棘怪的具體數值，見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。這個{@creature weretiger||虎人}（N 男性楚爾特人類）不再使用名字了，但多年前他被稱為布瓦耶斯·歐塔姆。他是{@creature Wakanga O'tamu|ToA|瓦康嘎·歐塔姆}（見"{@area 商王|056|x}"，即"商王"）的表親，兩人小時候關係非常親密。家族相似性很強；見過瓦康嘎的角色在虎人變成人類形態時會看到這種相似性。虎人會說通用語和植物侏儒語，儘管由於長期不用，他已經忘記了前者的很多內容。

english: When characters enter the same hex as the {@i Narwhal}, roll any die. On an odd result, Bwayes is out hunting and automatically detects the characters' presence before they're aware of him; on an even result, Bwayes is resting at the hulk, meaning characters are likely to encounter the vegepygmies before the weretiger. If Bwayes detects the characters, he tracks them covertly, out of curiosity rather than bloodlust. He'd like to meet them and find out what they're after. He'll even bring them back to the ship and trade gems for wine, if they have any. Unless the characters are accompanied by Bwayes, the vegepygmies are hostile toward them.
zh_tw: 當角色進入與{@i 獨角鯨}相同的六邊形時，擲一個骰子。如果是奇數結果，布瓦耶斯正在狩獵，並且在角色意識到他之前自動檢測到他們的存在；如果是偶數結果，布瓦耶斯正在船骸上休息，這意味著角色很可能會先遇到植物侏儒而不是虎人。如果布瓦耶斯檢測到角色，他會出於好奇而不是嗜血而秘密跟蹤他們。他想見見他們，瞭解他們的目的。他甚至會帶他們回到船上，如果他們有的話，用寶石換酒。除非角色由布瓦耶斯陪同，否則植物侏儒對他們是敵對的。

english: If the characters befriend the weretiger and inquire about other places in Chult, he shares the following information:
zh_tw: 如果角色們與虎人成為朋友並詢問楚爾特其他地方的情況，他會分享以下資訊：

english: The bones of a great dragon lie in a grotto to the southwest. (Bwayes can lead characters to Needle's Bones if they ask him nicely.)
zh_tw: 一條偉大龍的骨骼位於西南方向的一個洞穴中。（如果角色們禮貌地詢問，布韋斯可以帶領他們去針骨之地。）

english: Between the River Olung and the Nsi Wastes lie the ruins of a once-beautiful garden palace said to contain treasure beyond compare. (Bwayes can lead the characters to Nangalore but won't explore it out of respect.)
zh_tw: 奧倫河與恩西荒地之間，有一座曾經美麗的花園宮殿遺址，據說藏有無與倫比的寶藏。（布瓦耶斯可以帶領角色們前往南加洛爾，但出於尊重，他不會去探索它。）

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The weretiger's cabin contains enough scavenged gear to create a set of {@item cartographer's tools|PHB} and a set of {@item leatherworker's tools|PHB}, as well as an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}.
