A battered wooden trunk near the weretiger's hammock holds an explorer's pack, a spyglass, a set of Three-Dragon Ante cards (the weretiger doesn't know how to play), a leather pouch containing four assorted gemstones (100 gp each), and two {@item Potion of Healing||potions of healing}.
zh_tw: 虎人的小屋裡收集了足夠多的零散裝備，可以製作一套{@item cartographer's tools|PHB|製圖工具}和一套{@item leatherworker's tools|PHB|皮匠工具}，還有一個{@item herbalism kit|PHB|草藥工具}。虎人吊床旁有個破舊的木箱，裡面裝著一個探險者揹包、一個望遠鏡、一套三龍牌（虎人不知道玩法）、裝有四顆雜色寶石（每顆價值100金幣）的皮袋，以及兩瓶{@item Potion of Healing||治療藥水}。

english: Wreck of the Star Goddess
zh_tw: 星辰女神號的殘骸

english: A wooden vessel is caught high in the tree branches, broken into three chunks. It resembles a ship, but there are differences that mark it clearly as not a seagoing vessel. The stern is the lowest piece, hanging precariously by its rigging about 50 feet above ground. The middle section appears to be 15 feet higher, and the bow section is firmly wedged into a nest of branches another 10 feet above that.
zh_tw: 一隻木製容器卡在高高的樹枝上，碎成了三塊。它看起來像一艘船，但有明顯的不同之處，清楚地表明它不是一艘海船。船尾是最低的部分，靠繩索勉強懸掛在離地面大約50尺的地方。中間部分看起來比船尾高出15尺，而船頭部分則牢牢地卡在比中間部分再高10尺的樹枝巢中。

english: A weak voice calls out, "Hallo, on the ground. Can you help us?"
zh_tw: 一個微弱的聲音呼喊道，"喂，在地上。你們能幫我們嗎？

english: The {@i Star Goddess} was a 90-foot skyship from Halruaa. It flew like a blimp, with the aid of an amazing lighter-than-air gasbag. A crew of Halruaan adventurers was using it to explore Chult from the air when it was attacked by a flock of pterafolk. The pterafolk slashed the airbag, and the vessel crashed into the jungle canopy. As shown in map 2.13, the wooden gondola broke into three pieces, which now hang precariously in the treetops at three different heights. The deflated balloon is tangled in the branches above. The crash could have occurred anytime within the past {@dice 3d10} days.
zh_tw: {@i 星辰女神}號是一艘來自哈魯阿的90尺天空船。它像飛艇一樣飛行，藉助一個神奇的比空氣輕的氣囊。一群哈魯阿冒險者正在使用它從空中探索楚爾特時，遭到了一群翼手獸的襲擊。翼手獸撕裂了氣囊，飛船墜毀在叢林樹冠上。如地圖2.13所示，木製的吊艙斷成了三截，現在搖搖欲墜地懸掛在三個不同高度的樹頂上。洩了氣的氣球纏繞在上方的樹枝中。墜毀可能發生在過去的{@dice 3d10}天內的任何時間。

english: Climbing up to the wreck is relatively easy, thanks to many vines in the trees and lines of rigging hanging from the ship. A successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is enough to reach the ship from the ground. The same check must be repeated to move from one section of the ship to another; alternatively, a character can jump down from a higher to a lower section with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check.
zh_tw: 攀爬到沉船處相對容易，這要歸功於樹上掛滿的藤蔓和船上的繩索。從地面成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定足以抵達船上。從一個部分移動到另一個部分需要重複同樣的檢定；或者，角色可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定從較高的部分跳到較低的部分。

english: Crash Survivors
zh_tw: 生還者

english: The voice calling to the party belongs to Thasselandra Bravewing, the ship's captain (NG female Halruaan human {@creature noble}). She explains the situation briefly before she weakens and her voice becomes too soft to hear from the ground. The other crash survivors include the ship's navigator, Ra-das (N male Halruaan human {@creature scout}); the master-of-arms, Falx Haranis (CN male Halruaan human {@creature veteran}); and three other crewmen named Brax, Nhar, and Veliod (N male Halruaan human {@creature Guard||guards}). Ra-das and Falx are in the stern section; the other NPCs are all in the midsection.
zh_tw: 向隊伍呼喊的是船長薩瑟蘭德拉·勇翼，一位中立善良的哈魯阿人類女性{@creature noble||貴族}。她簡短說明狀況後便虛弱下來，聲音小得無法從地面聽清。其他墜船生還者包括領航員拉達斯（絕對中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature scout||斥侯}）、軍械主管法爾克斯·哈拉尼斯（混亂中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature veteran||老兵}），以及布拉克斯、納爾、維利歐德三名船員（絕對中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature Guard||警衛}）。拉達斯與法爾克斯待在船尾部分，其餘 NPC 都在船身中段。

english: The ship was carrying supplies, but most of the cargo spilled to the ground when the gondola broke apart. The survivors can catch rainwater in buckets, but they've been without food for several days. As a result, all the NPCs have 4 levels of {@condition exhaustion} (see {@condition exhaustion||appendix A} of the {@i Player's Handbook} for effects) and are not strong enough to climb to the ground on their own.
zh_tw: 船隻攜帶了補給品，但當吊艙破裂時，大部分貨物都灑在了地上。生還者可以用桶接雨水，但他們已經幾天沒有食物了。因此，所有NPC都有4級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}（見{@condition exhaustion||附錄A}的{@i 玩家手冊}瞭解效果），他們沒有足夠的力量自己爬到地面上。

english: Map 2.13: Wreck of the Star Goddess
zh_tw: 地圖 2.13：星女神號的殘骸

english: Undead Scavengers
zh_tw: 不死生物清道夫

english: When characters first arrive on the scene, they see eight {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} lurking in the foliage below the wreck. Each ghoul has a small blue triangle tattooed on its forehead—the symbol of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. The ghouls have {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover} from trees, and they withdraw from the area temporarily if the situation gets too hot.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次到達現場時，他們看到八隻{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}潛伏在失事地點下方的灌木叢中。每隻食屍鬼的額頭上都紋有一個小的藍色三角形——這是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的象徵。這些食屍鬼從樹木那裡獲得了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，如果情況變得太危險，它們會暫時撤離該區域。

english: A few minutes after characters climb up to the wreck, it's attacked by three {@creature Girallon Zombie|ToA|girallon zombies} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). The monsters approach from the east, and because they have a climbing speed, they can move anywhere on the map as easily as on the ship. The NPCs fight back, but they aren't very effective given their {@condition exhaustion}. The girallon zombies aren't above grabbing enemies and tossing them off the ship; one or two of the NPC guards should die that way. A character who falls or is thrown off the ship can halve the falling damage with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, representing clutching at vines and branches on the way down.
zh_tw: 角色們爬上殘骸幾分鐘後，它遭到三隻 {@creature Girallon Zombie|ToA|四臂猿怪喪屍} 的攻擊（參見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。這些怪物從東邊接近，由於它們具有攀爬速度，它們可以在地圖上的任何地方像在船上一樣輕鬆移動。NPC 們會反擊，但由於他們的 {@condition exhaustion||力竭} 狀態，他們的反擊並不十分有效。吉拉倫殭屍毫不吝嗇地抓取敵人並將他們扔下船；一兩個 NPC 守衛應該會因此死亡。一個墜下或被扔下船的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定將墜落傷害減半，這代表他們在墜落過程中抓住了藤蔓和樹枝。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: There is no treasure aboard the {@i Star Goddess} or amid the debris under it, but characters can salvage weapons, clothing, and enough supplies to assemble one explorer's pack and one priest's pack.
zh_tw: {@i 星辰女神}號上或其殘骸中沒有寶藏，但角色們可以打撈到武器、衣物以及足夠組裝一個探險者揹包和一個牧師揹包的物資。

english: Wyrmheart Mine
zh_tw: 龍心礦井

english: A clan of shield dwarves operated this iron mine (map 2.14) up until forty years ago, when it was conquered by a young red dragon named Tzindelor. {@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA} (see "{@area Finding a Guide|094|x}") hopes to reclaim and reopen the mine, and he gladly enlists the characters to his aid (or ropes them in unwillingly, if he must).
zh_tw: 一個盾矮人部落在四十年前一直經營著這座鐵礦（地圖2.14），直到它被一條名叫辛德洛的年輕紅龍征服。{@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|休·哈金斯頓}（見"{@area 尋找嚮導|094|x}"，即"尋找嚮導"）希望重新奪回並重新開放這座礦井，他很高興地招募角色們幫助他（或者在必要時不情願地將他們捲入）。

english: Tzindelor has amassed a following of kobolds, who call her Tinder. She occasionally leaves to hunt but spends most of her time sleeping at the bottom of the mine. The kobolds rig their shared lair with numerous traps. Many parts of the mine still show signs of the dwarves' battle against Tinder, including the scattered and charred bones of those who died.
zh_tw: 辛德洛聚集了一群狗頭人跟隨她，狗頭人們稱她為火種。她偶爾會離開去狩獵，但大部分時間都在礦井底部睡覺。狗頭人們在他們共同的巢穴中佈置了許多陷阱。礦井的許多部分仍然顯示出矮人們對抗火種的戰鬥跡象，包括那些死去的人散落和燒焦的骨頭。

english: The dwarves left three ore carts in the mine, all in working order or repairable. The cart track circling the main shaft is quite steep; not as steep as stairs, but steeper than most ramps. The ore carts are built so that the downhill end (the front) is higher than the uphill end (the back). This allows them to sit level on the sloping track, but they look odd on level ground. A heavy draw rope and harness are hooked to the back of each cart so that a trained dinosaur could pull the heavy load up the track. A stout, lever-operated brake controls its descent.
zh_tw: 矮人們在礦井裡留下了三輛礦車，它們都處於工作狀態或可修理。環繞主井的礦車軌道相當陡峭；不如樓梯那麼陡，但比大多數坡道要陡。礦車的設計使得下坡端（前部）比上坡端（後部）高。這使得它們可以在傾斜的軌道上保持水平，但在平坦地面上看起來有些奇怪。每輛礦車的後部都配有一根沉重的牽引繩和馬具，以便訓練有素的恐龍能夠拉動過載上軌道。一個堅固的、透過槓桿操作的剎車控制著它的下降。

english: Carts can be shunted onto the side passages if the tracks are switched using a crowbar (one is stashed near each siding). When characters arrive, the tracks are set to bypass all the sidings and run straight through to the bottom.
zh_tw: 如果使用撬棍（每個側軌旁都藏有一根）來切換軌道，礦車可以被引導到側通道上。當角色們到達時，軌道設定為繞過所有側軌，直接通往底部。

english: Some carts' brakes are in better condition than others. If a brake fails, the cart races out of control round and round the pit until it smashes into the barrier at the bottom of the track. Everyone in the cart when it hits takes {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage per 20 vertical feet the cart descended. Those who bail out before the cart hits takes half damage, based on how far the cart descended before they jumped, but each creature must also succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or tumble over the edge of the track and plunge to the bottom of the shaft.
zh_tw: 一些礦車的剎車狀況比其他礦車更好。如果剎車失靈，礦車會失控地在坑道中一圈又一圈地飛馳，直到撞上軌道底部的障礙物。當礦車撞擊時，車內的每個人會因礦車每垂直下降20尺而受到{@dice 1d6}點鈍擊傷害。那些在礦車撞擊前跳車的人，根據礦車在他們跳車前的下降距離，會受到一半的傷害，但每個生物還必須成功透過一次{@dc 10}敏捷豁免檢定，否則會從軌道邊緣翻落，墜入坑道底部。

english: Map 2.14: Wyrmheart Mine
zh_tw: 地圖 2.14：龍心礦

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Office
zh_tw: 1. 辦公室

english: This building has walls made of closely fitted stone with large windows, and a wide, overhanging tile roof. It's now overgrown with vines and creepers, but the structure is still solid.
zh_tw: 這座建築的牆壁由緊密拼接的石頭構成，有大窗戶，以及一個寬闊的、突出的瓦屋頂。現在它被藤蔓和攀緣植物覆蓋，但結構仍然堅固。

english: The door is swollen shut and must be forced open with a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, but the windows can be climbed through easily. Startled lizards and birds flee through the windows when anyone enters.
zh_tw: 門因膨脹而緊閉，必須透過一次成功的 {@dc 12} 力量 ({@skill Athletics||運動}) 檢定才能強行開啟，但窗戶可以輕易爬過。當有人進入時，受驚的蜥蜴和鳥會從窗戶逃走。

english: The building's contents have all rotted. Ledgers mildewed into slime long ago. Tables and cabinets are covered with creepers, bird droppings, and the bones of small animals. Stools collapse if any weight is put on them. There's no information and nothing of use here.
zh_tw: 這座建築裡的內容物都已經腐爛。賬簿早已發黴變成黏液。桌子和櫃子上覆蓋著攀緣植物、鳥糞以及小動物的骨頭。任何重量放在凳子上都會導致它們倒塌。這裡沒有資訊，也沒有可用的東西。

english: 2. Supply Shed
zh_tw: 2. 供應棚

english: This building is made from closely fitted stones and has a tile roof, but no windows. Portions of the wall are crumbling where tree roots are pushing the stones apart. Gouges and scars show where someone tried to hack through the heavy door with axes but gave up after making little headway.
zh_tw: 這座建築由緊密拼接的石頭建成，並且有一個瓦屋頂，但沒有窗戶。在樹根將石頭推開的地方，牆壁的部分正在崩裂。斧頭砍擊的凹痕和劃痕表明有人試圖砍穿厚重的門，但在進展甚微後放棄了。

english: The axe marks are only a few feet off the ground (having been made by kobolds). The door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 斧頭的痕跡離地面只有幾尺（是由狗頭人造成的）。門可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。

english: Dozens of crates and barrels are stacked inside. Several have been toppled over by tree roots growing beneath them. Stored food and water is inedible, but the other supplies are mostly still usable, even if they won't be especially useful to adventurers. They consist of tools for mining, stone-working, and iron-working, shovels, lanterns and candles, miners' helmets, heavy gloves, spare wheels, axles, and brakes for ore carts, grease, thick rope, tar, brushes, brooms, and so forth.
zh_tw: 裡面堆放著幾十個板條箱和桶。幾個被它們下面生長的樹根推倒了。存放的食物和水已經不能食用，但其他物資大多仍然可以使用，即使它們對冒險者來說不是特別有用。它們包括用於採礦、石工和鐵工的工具、鏟子、燈籠和蠟燭、礦工頭盔、厚手套、備用輪子、軸和礦車制動器、油脂、粗繩、焦油、刷子、掃帚等等。

english: 3. Ore Cart
zh_tw: 3. 礦車

english: An ore cart sits on the tracks at the entrance to the mine, held in place by a block under the wheels.
zh_tw: 一輛礦車停在礦井入口的軌道上，輪子下面墊著一個木塊固定位置。

english: The cart's metal box is still solid, but one of the axles is broken and the other screeches horribly. The supply shed (area 3) contains the parts and grease to get it rolling again. The old brake looks solid, but each time it's used, it has a {@chance 10} chance to fail utterly. This risk is recognized by someone who inspects the brake and makes a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence check. The brake can be repaired with spare parts from the supply shed.
zh_tw: 馬車的金屬箱體依然堅固，但一根車軸已斷裂，另一根發出刺耳的摩擦聲。補給棚（區域3）內有修復所需的零件和潤滑油。舊剎車看似完好，但每次使用時都有{@chance 10}機率完全失靈。透過成功進行{@dc 10}智力檢定來檢查剎車的人能發現這個隱患。使用補給棚的備用零件可修復剎車。

english: 4. Upper Shaft
zh_tw: 4. 上層井道

english: Inside the mine, the cave opens into an enormous, 250-foot-deep pit. The dwarves left a stout stone column in the middle to support the roof, and they built a wooden walkway to span the pit from south to north. Despite many broken or missing planks, the walkway is fundamentally solid. Tracks for the ore carts descend around the walls of the pit in a clockwise fashion. Enough daylight filters through the mine opening to create dim illumination to the bottom of the shaft.
zh_tw: 在礦井內部，洞穴通向一個巨大的、深達250尺的深坑。矮人們在中間留下了一根堅固的石柱來支撐屋頂，並且他們建造了一條木製步道，從南到北橫跨整個坑洞。儘管許多木板已經破碎或缺失，步道基本上還是穩固的。礦車軌道沿著坑壁以順時針方向下降。足夠的日光透過礦井開口濾進來，為礦井底部提供微弱的照明。

english: The kobolds living in the mine believe (correctly) that this upper level is haunted by dwarven spirits. The kobolds avoid the upper level of the mine except when they must exit or enter. They use the wooden bridge exclusively and never walk along the cart track past {@area area 5|1b7|x}.
zh_tw: 居住在礦井中的狗頭人（正確地）相信這個上層區域被矮人的靈魂所困擾。狗頭人避免進入礦井的上層區域，除非他們必須離開或進入。他們專門使用木橋，從不走經過{@area 區域5|1b7|x}的礦車軌道。

english: 5. Haunted Forge
zh_tw: 5. 鬧鬼的鍛造間

english: This was the dwarves' forge and workshop. Many of the miners retreated here when Tinder attacked, but the dragon incinerated their barricades and then burned them out with her breath. The entire area from the bottom of the steps to the backs of the chambers is scorched and black. A dozen or more (it's difficult to sort them out) charred skeletons litter the chambers. One dwarf skeleton is more recent than the others (the body has been dead for three years) and not charred; it lies near the base of the steps, in a face-down, head-down position that implies the dwarf died while scrambling down the steps. This was a member of {@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|Hew Hackinstone's} expedition who fell victim to the haunted forge.
zh_tw: 這裡是矮人的鍛造場和工作室。當火種攻擊時，許多礦工撤退到這裡，但龍焚燒了他們的路障，然後用她的呼吸將他們燒死。從臺階底部到房間後面的整個區域都被燒焦並變黑。有十幾個或更多（很難分辨）燒焦的骷髏散落在房間裡。其中一個矮人骷髏比其他的更近（屍體已經死了三年），並且沒有燒焦；它躺在臺階底部，面朝下，頭朝下的位置暗示矮人在匆忙下臺階時死亡。這是{@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|休·哈金斯頓}探險隊的一名成員，他成為了這個鬧鬼的鍛造場的受害者。

english: Six {@creature Specter||specters} haunt the forge, three in each chamber. They are all that's left of the mine's dwarven defenders. The first character to enter either chamber is attacked by the specters in that chamber, and those from the adjoining chamber arrive 2 rounds later. The specters can't leave the forge.
zh_tw: 六個{@creature Specter||惡靈}出沒在鍛造場，每個房間有三個。它們是礦井中矮人守衛的殘餘。第一個進入任一房間的角色將受到該房間內幽靈的攻擊，而來自相鄰房間的幽靈將在兩輪後到達。幽靈不能離開鍛造場。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Most of the dwarves' possessions were burned or melted by dragon fire, but one skeleton wears a {@item mithral breastplate} that survived the flames.
zh_tw: 大部分矮人的財物被龍火燒燬或熔化了，但有一具骷髏身上穿著一個倖存下來的{@item mithral breastplate||秘銀胸甲}（秘銀胸甲）。

english: 6A. Ledge
zh_tw: 6A. 巖架

english: This platform is lit by a torch in a wall sconce and guarded by two {@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|kobold inventors} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). Rough-hewn steps descend to area 6B.
zh_tw: 這個平臺被牆上壁臺上的火把照亮，由兩個{@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|狗頭人發明家}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）守衛。粗糙的臺階通向區域6B。

english: 6B. Egg Nursery
zh_tw: 6B. 蛋孵化室

english: Seven small reptilian humanoids guard this room, the walls of which have niches carved into them. Each niche is lined with moss and holds a brown egg the size of a small orange.
zh_tw: 七個小型爬行類人形生物守衛著這個房間，房間的牆壁上雕刻有壁龕。每個壁龕內襯著苔蘚，裡面放著一個棕色的蛋，大小相當於一個小橙子。

english: Seven {@creature Kobold||kobolds} guard this room, which serves as the kobolds' egg nursery. These kobolds protect their eggs with flinty resolve. The mossy niches in the walls contain a total of thirty eggs.
zh_tw: 七個{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}守衛著這個房間，這裡作為狗頭人的蛋室。這些狗頭人懷著堅定的決心保護他們的蛋。牆壁上的苔蘚壁龕裡總共有三十個蛋。

english: 6C. Rolling Stone Trap
zh_tw: 6C. 滾動石陷阱

english: A tripwire stretches across the mouth of the tunnel where the lower passage joins the cart track. It can be spotted with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the tripwire is missed, each character who passes through the tunnel mouth has a {@chance 50} chance to trip it and trigger two mechanisms. The first mechanism is a spring-loaded wooden contraption resembling a claw that swings out from the wall of the mine shaft up-slope from this tunnel to snap across the tunnel mouth. Whoever triggered the trap must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity throw or take 7 ({@dice 2d6}) bludgeoning damage from the claw. One round later, the second mechanism releases a 5-foot-diameter stone sphere that drops into the cave (marked T on the map) and rolls into the wooden claw across the tunnel mouth, which is demolished by the sphere's impact—but not before diverting the sphere onto the cart tracks. The sphere careens down the tracks until it reaches {@area area 11|1c5|x}, where it derails and smashes into the urds' living quarters. (The urds easily hear it coming and get out of the way.) Everyone in the sphere's path must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Instead of being hit by the sphere, a character who fails the saving throw can opt to leap off the tracks and fall to the bottom of the shaft; this succeeds automatically. The sphere can't be slowed down by Strength checks because of the steep incline of the tracks.
zh_tw: 一條絆線橫跨在隧道口處，連線著下方的通道與礦車軌道。透過一次成功的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可以發現它。如果未能發現絆線，每個經過隧道口的角色都有{@chance 50}的機率觸發它並啟動兩個機關。第一個機關是一個彈簧驅動的木質裝置，形似爪子，從隧道上方的礦井壁彈出，橫掃隧道口。觸發陷阱者必須成功透過一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，否則將受到7（{@dice 2d6}）點鈍擊傷害。一回合後，第二個機關會釋放一個直徑5尺的石球，石球落入洞穴（地圖上標記為T）並滾向橫跨隧道口的木質爪子，爪子被石球撞擊摧毀——但在被摧毀前會將石球轉向礦車軌道。石球沿軌道疾馳直至抵達{@area 區域11|1c5|x}，在那裡脫軌並撞入烏爾德的居住區。（烏爾德們能輕易聽到它接近並躲開。）處於石球路徑上的所有人都必須成功透過一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，否則將受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點鈍擊傷害並被擊倒{@condition prone||伏地}。豁免失敗的角色可以選擇跳離軌道並跌落至礦井底部以避免被石球擊中；這一行為自動成功。由於軌道坡度陡峭，力量檢定無法使石球減速。

english: 7. Upper Landing
zh_tw: 7. 上層著陸點

english: Two {@creature Kobold||kobolds} stand guard near some old crates. One keeps an eye on the cart track, while the other watches the stairs to the south. If one kobold falls, the other flees down the stairs to warn its kin in {@area area 8|1bf|x}.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}在一些舊板條箱附近站崗。一個監視著礦車軌道，而另一個監視著通往南方的樓梯。如果一個狗頭人倒下，另一個會跑下樓梯去警告在{@area 區域8|1bf|x}的同夥。

english: Ore Cart
zh_tw: 礦車

english: The ore cart north of this area appears to be in working condition, though its brakes have a {@chance 10} chance to fail each time they're used.
zh_tw: 該區域北部的礦石車似乎處於可用狀態，但每次使用時其剎車有{@chance 10}的機率會失靈。

english: 8. Main Living Quarters
zh_tw: 8. 主要居住區

english: The north passage connecting this chamber to the cart track is trapped with a swinging log studded with spikes. A character moving through the passage has a {@chance 50} chance to trip the trigger wire, which can be spotted with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Each creature in the passage when the log swings through must make a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) piercing damage and be knocked {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 連線此房間與礦車軌道的北側通道設有一個佈滿尖刺的擺動原木陷阱。角色透過通道時有{@chance 50}機率觸發絆線（可透過成功的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現）。當原木擺動時，通道內的每個生物必須成功透過{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，否則受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點穿刺傷害並被擊倒{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: A fire smolders in a pit in the middle of the chamber, with lizards, bats, and quippers slowly roasting on sticks propped around it. The fire illuminates the cave's kobold occupants.
zh_tw: 在房間中央的一個坑裡，火勢微弱地燃燒著，蜥蜴、蝙蝠和食人魚慢慢地在支撐在周圍的棍子上烤著。火光照亮了洞穴中的狗頭人居住者。

english: During daytime, this room contains {@dice 2d6} {@creature Kobold||kobolds}; at night, that number swells to {@dice 6d6} {@creature Kobold||kobolds}. Day or night, half of the occupants are noncombatants. Unless some loud disturbance has awakened them, the kobolds sleep piled atop one another on mounds of reeds that are infested with small lizards and other vermin.
zh_tw: 在白天，這個房間內有{@dice 2d6}只{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}；到了夜晚，這個數字增加到{@dice 6d6}只{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}。無論是白天還是夜晚，一半的居住者是非戰鬥人員。除非有大聲的幹擾吵醒了它們，否則狗頭人們會相互堆疊著睡在長滿小蜥蜴和其他害蟲的蘆葦堆上。

english: Shrine
zh_tw: 聖壇

english: The chamber to the east is a shrine to Kurtulmak. It contains two empty barrels, atop one of which is a 3-foot-tall statue of the kobold deity assembled from bits of metal, glass, wood, and stone. Offerings of food are piled around the base. None of the statue's components are valuable, but it would be worth 10 gp to any curio collector in Port Nyanzaru. The statue weighs 15 pounds. Other than the statue of Kurtulmak, there is no treasure. Everything the kobolds find of value is surrendered to Tinder.
zh_tw: 東側的房間是供奉庫爾圖爾馬克的神龕。裡面有兩隻空桶，其中一隻上面是一個由金屬、玻璃、木頭和石頭碎片組成的3尺高的狗頭人神像。食物供品堆放在基座周圍。神像的任何組成部分都不值錢，但在南扎路港的任何古董收藏家那裡，它值10金幣。神像重15磅。除了庫爾圖爾馬克的神像外，這裡沒有寶藏。狗頭人發現的所有有價值的東西都交給了火種。

english: 9. Inventors' Quarters
zh_tw: 9. 發明家區

english: Old crates and barrels have been converted into sleeping hovels for the tribe's {@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|kobold inventors}, two of which are present (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). The other two are in {@area area 6A|1b9|x}.
zh_tw: 舊板條箱和桶被改造成了部落的{@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|狗頭人發明家}的簡陋睡鋪，現在有兩個在此（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。另外兩個在{@area 區域6A|1b9|x}。

english: 10. Big Smash
zh_tw: 10. 大破壞

english: A boulder is precariously balanced on a ledge above the cart track at this point. A rope tied round the boulder passes through an iron ring on the central pillar and through another near the kobolds' chambers. If the kobolds hear an ore cart rumbling down the tracks, four of them race out and prepare to yank this rope, timing it so the boulder smashes down on the cart. They make an attack roll ({@hit 4} to hit) against the cart's AC, which depends on its speed. Rolling at top speed (no brakes), the cart has AC 16. If occupants are using the brakes to control its speed, the cart has AC 8. If the cart's occupants engage or release the brake when they see the kobolds pulling the rope, to change the cart's speed, it has AC 12.
zh_tw: 一塊巨石危險地平衡在二輪貨車軌道上方的巖架上。一根繞在巨石上的繩索穿過中央支柱上的鐵環和狗頭人房間附近的另一個鐵環。如果狗頭人聽到礦車沿著軌道隆隆駛來，其中四個會衝出來準備猛拉這根繩索，時機把握得當就能讓巨石砸中礦車。它們對礦車進行一次攻擊檢定（命中加值為{@hit 4}），礦車的AC取決於其速度。全速行駛時（無剎車），礦車AC為16。如果有居住者使用剎車控制速度，礦車AC為8。如果礦車居住者在看到狗頭人拉繩時啟動或鬆開剎車以改變速度，則礦車AC為12。

english: If the boulder hits, every creature in the cart takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) bludgeoning damage. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine what happens to the cart and its occupants:
zh_tw: 如果巨石擊中，車上的每個生物都會受到5點（{@dice 1d10}）鈍擊傷害。擲一個{@dice d6}來決定車輛及其乘客會發生什麼：

english: {@b 1–2}. The cart continues down the track unhindered.
zh_tw: {@b 1–2}. 礦車繼續沿著軌道無阻礙地前進。

english: {@b 3–5}. The cart derails into {@area area 11|1c5|x}. Each creature in the cart is thrown out, lands {@condition prone}, and must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: {@b 3–5}. 馬車脫軌衝入 {@area 區域11|1c5|x}。車內的每個生物被丟擲，倒地 {@condition prone||伏地}，並且必須成功透過一個 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則受到 5（{@dice 1d10}）鈍擊傷害。

english: {@b 6}. The cart tumbles off the track and falls 125 feet to {@area area 12|1c7|x}. A creature in the cart can make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to leap out before the cart goes over the edge and falls. On a successful save, the creature lands {@condition prone} on the cart track. On a failed save, the creature goes over the edge with the cart and takes damage from the fall, as normal.
zh_tw: {@b 6}. 馬車翻出軌道，墜落到125尺深的{@area 區域12|1c7|x}。馬車內的生物可以進行一次{@dc 12}敏捷豁免，以在馬車墜下邊緣前跳出。豁免成功，生物將{@condition prone||伏地}在馬車軌道上。豁免失敗，生物將隨馬車一起墜下邊緣，並如常承受墜落傷害。

english: 11. Urds' Quarters
zh_tw: 11. 烏爾德區

english: Once used as a secondary work and storage area for the dwarven miners, this cave now serves as living quarters for eight urds ({@creature Winged Kobold||winged kobolds}). The urds don't mingle with their wingless kin and attack intruders on sight, fleeing up the shaft if half or more of them are killed.
zh_tw: 曾經作為矮人礦工的次要工作和儲藏區，這個洞穴現在被八個有翼的烏爾德（{@creature Winged Kobold||帶翼狗頭人}）用作居住區。這些有翼的烏爾德不與他們沒有翅膀的同類交往，並且會在看到入侵者時立即發動攻擊，如果他們中有一半或更多被殺，他們會逃到井道中。

english: Ore Cart
zh_tw: 礦車

english: The ore cart on the siding below this area appears to be in working order, but the brake handle will snap off the first time it's used.
zh_tw: 這個區域下方側線上的礦車看起來處於工作狀態，但剎車手柄在第一次使用時會斷裂。

english: 12. Bottom of the Shaft
zh_tw: 12. 井道底部

english: The floor at the bottom of the shaft is littered with charred dwarven skeletons. A 60-foot-high waterfall pours out of the north wall, forming a large pool about 10 feet deep. All you can hear is the sound of crashing water.
zh_tw: 井道底部的地面上散落著燒焦的矮人骷髏。一道60尺高的瀑布從北牆傾瀉而出，形成了一個大約10尺深的大型水池。你唯一能聽到的就是水花衝擊的聲音。

english: A dozen charred dwarven skeletons litter the floor. Eight of them are ancient and covered with calcium deposits, but four are fresher (they're from {@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA}'s ill-fated expedition three years ago). The kobolds stripped them of anything valuable.
zh_tw: 一打燒焦的矮人骷髏散落在地板上。其中八個是古老的，覆蓋著鈣沉積物，但有四個是較新的（它們來自三年前{@creature Hew Hackinstone|ToA|休·哈金斯頓}不幸的探險隊）。狗頭人剝去了他們身上所有有價值的東西。

english: An underground stream pours out of the north wall 35 feet above the cart track (60 feet above the floor) and plunges through the trestle before splashing into a pool on the mine floor. It's only a thin curtain of water, but it makes a lot of noise and it raises enough mist to keep the bottom of the shaft perpetually damp. The pool is home to {@dice 2d6} {@creature Quipper||quippers}. A fishing net is rolled up nearby.
zh_tw: 一條地下河流從北牆35尺高的地方湧出，高於礦車道（60尺高），然後穿過高架橋，最終濺入礦井地面上的一個水池。它只是一道薄薄的水簾，但聲音很大，並且產生的霧氣足以使井底永遠保持潮溼。水池是{@dice 2d6}只{@creature Quipper||食人魚}的家園。附近有一張捲起的漁網。

english: Passage to Hrakhamar
zh_tw: 通往赫拉卡馬爾的通道

english: An elevated cart track enters a tunnel in the north wall and continues northward (more or less) for 40 miles to the firenewt-infested smelter and forge of Hrakhamar. It's passable and the tracks are intact for the full length, but encounters with {@creature Kobold||kobolds} and other monsters are likely.
zh_tw: 一條高架礦車軌道進入北牆的隧道，繼續向北（或多或少）延伸40英里，通往赫拉卡馬爾，那裡有火蠑螈出沒的冶煉爐和鍛造場。這條路是通暢的，軌道完整，但很可能會遭遇{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}和其他怪物。

english: 13. Audience Chamber
zh_tw: 13. 接見室

english: This cave looks out over a much larger cave. Hanging from pegs at the back of the overlook are four ferocious-looking wooden masks and four capes made of scaly dinosaur hide dyed bright red.
zh_tw: 這個洞穴俯瞰著一個更大的洞穴。懸掛在俯瞰區後部的木栓上的是四個看起來兇猛的木製面具和四個用鮮紅色的鱗狀恐龍皮製成的披風。

english: When the kobolds have tribute for Tinder or need the dragon's advice or approval, they send their fawning, groveling emissaries to this ledge overlooking the dragon's lair. The kobolds don the ceremonial wooden masks and capes before addressing their overlord.
zh_tw: 當狗頭人需要向廷德支付貢品或需要龍的建議或批准時，他們會派遣他們諂媚、卑躬屈膝的使者到這個俯瞰龍巢的壁架。狗頭人在向他們的領主發表講話之前，會戴上儀式性的木製面具和披風。

english: If characters put on the masks and capes before peering into {@area area 14|1cc|x}, and they make themselves seem kobold-sized, they have a chance to fool the dragon into believing they're kobolds, but it's easy to slip up. First, the kobolds speak only Draconic to the dragon. Second, they fill their speech with flattery and overblown honorifics such as "your titanic, blazing majesty" and "thou unquenchable, unendurable furnace." Third, they never, ever question the dragon's proclamations or judgments. Whenever one of these precepts is broken, Tinder can make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check contested by the characters' Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks to see through the ruse. If additional characters are hiding on the overlook during a conversation with the dragon, each must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check (with advantage if they're completely out of sight from {@area area 14|1cc|x}) to evade notice.
zh_tw: 如果角色在窺視 {@area 區域14|1cc|x} 前戴上面具和披風，並使自己看起來像狗頭人大小，他們就有機會欺騙巨龍，讓它相信他們是狗頭人，但這很容易出錯。首先，狗頭人只對巨龍說龍語。其次，他們在言語中充滿了奉承和誇張的敬語，如"您那巨大的、熾熱的威嚴"和"您那無法熄滅、無法忍受的熔爐"。第三，他們從不，永遠不會質疑巨龍的宣告或判斷。每當這些準則被打破時，廷德爾可以進行一次感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，與角色的魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定對抗，以識破詭計。如果有額外的角色在與巨龍的對話期間藏匿在瞭望臺上，每個人都必須成功透過一次 {@dc 19} 敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定（如果他們完全不被 {@area 區域14|1cc|x} 看到，則具有優勢）以避免被發現。

english: 14. Tinder's Lair
zh_tw: 14. 廷德的巢穴

english: Tzindelor, a female {@creature young red dragon} better known as Tinder, spends most of her time here, dozing atop her treasure hoard. Otherwise, she's out hunting and terrorizing her neighbors. Characters have improved chances to sneak up on her from {@area area 12|1c7|x}, thanks to the loud waterfall there (either they have advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks or Tinder has disadvantage on {@skill Perception} checks, whichever is more appropriate to the situation). The dragon can't be {@status surprised} if kobolds triggered the boulder trap in {@area area 10|1c3|x}, and she can't miss the sound of an ore cart rolling down the tracks or a loud spell going off anywhere in the complex.
zh_tw: 辛德洛，一隻被稱為火種的雌性{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}，大部分時間都在這裡，躺在她的寶藏堆上打盹。否則，她就出去狩獵並恐嚇她的鄰居。角色們從{@area 區域12|1c7|x}悄悄接近她的機會有所提高，這多虧了那裡的大聲瀑布（他們要麼在{@skill Stealth||隱匿}檢定上有優勢，要麼火種在{@skill Perception||感知}檢定上處於劣勢，視情況而定）。如果狗頭人觸發了{@area 區域10|1c3|x}的巨石陷阱，龍就不能被{@status surprised||突襲}，她也不能錯過礦車沿著軌道滾動的聲音或在複雜結構中任何地方發出的響亮咒語。

english: The dragon is inclined to kill anyone she doesn't recognize but might converse with adventurers who have something interesting to say. Being young, she still has much to learn about the world. If flattered and offered a sufficient bribe (offerings worth at least 500 gp), she can even provide basic directions to any landmark within 100 miles of Wyrmheart Mine.
zh_tw: 這條龍傾向於殺死任何她不認識的人，但可能會與有有趣話題的冒險家交談。由於她還年輕，她仍然有很多關於這個世界的東西要學習。如果受到奉承並提供足夠的賄賂（價值至少500金幣的供品），她甚至可以提供到距離龍心礦井 100英里內任何地標的基本方向。

english: The dragon doesn't hold back when it comes to using her breath weapon; she loves watching her prey scream and burn in the flames. In a desperate situation, she's confident she can fly up the mine shaft and escape faster than any intruders can pursue.
zh_tw: 當涉及到使用她的吐息武器時，這條龍毫不保留；她喜歡看著她的獵物在火焰中尖叫和燃燒。在絕境情況下，她有信心可以飛上礦井井道，並且比任何入侵者追趕的速度更快地逃脫。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The dragon's hoard contains 3,300 gp, 15,000 sp, 45,000 cp, a gold-embroidered scabbard (25 gp), a dragon-shaped medal and chain fashioned from gold (50 gp), a copper mug with jade inlay (100 gp), and a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 龍的寶藏包括3300金幣，15000銀幣，45000銅幣，一個金色刺繡的劍鞘（25金幣），一個由金子製成的龍形獎章和鏈子（50金幣），一個鑲有翡翠的銅質杯子（100金幣），以及一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Old crates and barrels near the south wall contain {@dice 1d12} each of dwarf-made breastplates, helmets, shields, warhammers, and battleaxes. One of the dwarf-made battleaxes is actually a {@item +1 battleaxe} that floats on water and other liquids, and grants its bearer advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to swim. Etched into the haft of the battleaxe are Dethek (Dwarvish) runes that spell the weapon's name: Bob.
zh_tw: 靠南牆的老箱子和桶裡各有{@dice 1d12}件矮人制作的胸甲、頭盔、盾牌、戰錘和戰斧。其中一把矮人制作的戰斧實際上是一把{@item +1 battleaxe||+1 戰斧}，它能在水上和其他液體上漂浮，並且賦予持有者在進行力量（{@skill Athletics||運動})檢定時的優勢。戰斧的柄上刻有德特克（矮人語）符文，拼寫出武器的名字：鮑勃。

english: Yellyark
zh_tw: 葉利亞克

english: Yellyark (map 2.15) is home to the Biting Ant tribe of Batiri goblins. These goblins wear stylized wooden ant masks and mark the perimeter of their territory with the heads and skulls of their enemies (humanoids and beasts). In this context, "territory" refers to a single hex on {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA}'s map.
zh_tw: 葉利亞克（地圖2.15）是巴提里地精的咬蟻部落的家園。這些地精戴著風格化的木製螞蟻面具，並用敵人（類人生物和野獸）的頭和骷髏標記他們領土的邊界。在這種情況下，"領土"指的是{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}地圖上的一個六邊形區域。

english: To protect themselves against giant carnivores, the goblins built the important structures of the village atop a "net" of strong, supple tree branches bound together with vines. The net is rigged to a heavy tree, bent down like a giant spring. When a predator threatens to overrun the village, goblins cut the vine and the entire village is rolled into a ball and flung a thousand yards over the jungle! The huts inside are cushioned from impact by layers of leaves and moss; damage to the flexible structures can be repaired, and most of the village's precious totems, food, basketwork, and spare weapons are saved.
zh_tw: 為了保護自己免受巨型食肉動物的侵害，地精們在一棵像巨大彈簧一樣彎曲下來的大樹上，用藤蔓將堅固而柔韌的樹枝綁在一起，構建了村莊的重要建築。這個網被固定在一棵沉重的樹上。當有捕食者威脅要淹沒村莊時，地精們會切斷藤蔓，整個村莊就會捲成一個球，被拋到叢林上空一千碼遠！裡面的小屋由層層樹葉和苔蘚緩衝衝擊；柔性結構的損壞可以修復，村莊的大部分珍貴圖騰、食物、籃子和備用武器都可以儲存下來。

english: Forty goblins live in the village: Queen {@creature Grabstab|ToA} (a {@creature goblin boss}), twenty-four adult {@creature Goblin||goblins}, and fifteen noncombatant children. For more information on Batiri goblins and their tactics, see "{@area Races of Chult|022|x}."
zh_tw: 四十個地精居住在村莊裡：女王{@creature Grabstab|ToA|格拉布斯塔布}（一個{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}），二十四個成年{@creature Goblin||地精}，和十五個非戰鬥兒童。有關巴提里地精及其戰術的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 楚爾特的種族|022|x}"。

english: The tribe's survival depends on getting an early warning of approaching danger, so sentries are always posted around the village. They wear ponchos made of vines and leaves, which give them advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks while remaining perfectly still, but impose disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks when they move. The sentries also ring the village with tripwires attached to shells and skulls filled with pebbles. Characters who search for such things while approaching the village notice the tripwires with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check; otherwise, they're noticed by anyone with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 13 or higher. If approaching enemies are noticed by sentries or trigger a tripwire, the village goes on alert, making it impossible to sneak in.
zh_tw: 部落的生存依賴於對即將到來的危險提前預警，因此哨兵們總是被安排在村莊周圍。他們穿著由藤蔓和樹葉製成的斗篷，這使他們在保持完全靜止時在敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定上獲得優勢，但在移動時會使敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定處於劣勢。哨兵們還在村莊周圍佈置了絆索，上面掛滿了裝滿小石子的貝殼和頭骨。角色在接近村莊時如果搜尋這些東西，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現絆索；否則，任何被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）得分達到13或更高的角色都會注意到它們。如果接近的敵人被哨兵發現或觸發了絆索，村莊會進入警戒狀態，使得潛入變得不可能。

english: Map 2.15: Yellyark
zh_tw: 地圖 2.15: 葉利亞克

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Canoes
zh_tw: 1. 獨木舟

english: Three canoes are pulled up on the bank of the stream.
zh_tw: 三艘獨木舟被拉到了溪流的岸邊。

english: 2. Larder
zh_tw: 2. 食品儲藏室

english: The goblins store fresh meat, fish, and other perishable food in this hut. It doesn't get launched with the rest of the village; in case of attack, this food is left behind to keep carnivores occupied while the goblins escape.
zh_tw: 地精們在這個小屋儲存新鮮肉類、魚類和其他易腐食物。它不會與村莊的其他部分一起被髮射；在遭受攻擊的情況下，這些食物會被留下，以讓食肉動物忙於進食，而地精們則趁機逃跑。

english: 3. Queen Grabstab's Hut
zh_tw: 3. 格拉布斯塔布女王的小屋

english: The queen's hut is no larger than the others, but two {@creature Goblin||goblins} always stand guard outside. Queen {@creature Grabstab|ToA} (a {@creature goblin boss}) and four more {@creature Goblin||goblins} (her adult children and attendants) are inside, bickering with one another over matters that concern only them. One of the queen's attendants proudly wears the key to the wooden cage ({@area area 4|1d3|x}) on a loop of rope around its neck.
zh_tw: 女王的小屋並不比其他的小屋大，但總有兩隻{@creature Goblin||地精}在外面守衛。女王{@creature Grabstab|ToA|格拉布斯塔布}（一個{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}）和另外四個{@creature Goblin||地精}（她的成年子女和隨從）在裡面，為了只與他們有關的事情相互爭吵。女王的一個隨從驕傲地在它的脖子上掛著一根繩子，上面掛著木籠（{@area 區域4|1d3|x}）的鑰匙。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The queen wears a bronze and adamantine medallion that has the word "Vorn" etched into it. This is the control amulet for a shield guardian (see "{@area Vorn|1a6|x}"). None of the goblins have any notion the amulet is related to the object they venerate as a minor deity.
zh_tw: 女王佩戴著一枚刻有"沃恩"字樣的青銅和精金徽章。這是控制盾牌守衛者的護身符（見"{@area 沃恩|1a6|x}"）。所有地精都不知道這枚護身符與他們所崇拜的小神有關。

english: 4. Wooden Cage
zh_tw: 4. 木籠

english: This lashed-together bamboo cage can hold animals or prisoners, as the situation demands. Prisoners are seldom ransomed, since the Batiri have no use for coin. Usually, they're kept here until the goblins are ready to eat them. One of the goblins in {@area area 3|1d1|x} carries the key to the cage's crude padlock. A character with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 11} Dexterity check. The check is made with disadvantage if the character is trying to pick the lock from inside the cage.
zh_tw: 這個用竹子捆紮而成的籠子可以根據情況關押動物或囚犯。由於巴提裡部落對金幣毫無興趣，囚犯很少被用來勒索贖金。通常，他們會被關在這裡，直到地精們準備吃掉他們。{@area 區域3|1d1|x}中的一名地精攜帶著籠子粗糙掛鎖的鑰匙。擁有{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}的角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 11}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。如果角色試圖從籠子內部開鎖，則該檢定具有劣勢。

english: 5. Ant Hills
zh_tw: 5. 蟻丘

english: This particular Batiri tribe is skilled at ant husbandry, and the village is situated between three ant hills that are each 10 feet across at the base and stand 8 feet high. The three ant hills are joined together by tunnels.
zh_tw: 這個特別的巴提里部落擅長飼養螞蟻，村莊位於三座底部寬10尺、高8尺的蟻丘之間。這三座蟻丘透過隧道相連。

english: Damaging or destroying an ant hill causes six ant swarms ({@creature Swarm of Insects||swarms of insects}) to erupt from an underground nest. Two ant swarms emerge from each hill. The ants ignore the Batiri goblins and go after anything else they detect nearby.
zh_tw: 破壞或摧毀蟻丘會導致六個蟻群（{@creature Swarm of Insects||昆蟲叢集}）從地下巢穴中爆發出來。每個蟻丘湧出兩個蟻群。螞蟻會忽略巴蒂裡地精，轉而追逐它們在附近感知到的任何其他東西。

english: 6. Launch Mechanism
zh_tw: 6. 發射機制

english: The bent-down tree that launches the village is anchored at this point. The launch is triggered by cutting the thick vine, which has AC 15, 15 hit points, vulnerability to slashing damage, resistance to fire and piercing damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, psychic, and thunder damage. The entire mechanism is well camouflaged to prevent intruders from sneaking in and launching the village as a surprise attack. A character who gets a good look at the village in daylight and succeeds on a {@dc 18} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots the network of vines and the bent tree and recognizes them as a gigantic spring trap. Those with proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill have advantage on this check.
zh_tw: 將那村莊發射出去的彎曲大樹在此處固定。發射由切斷粗壯的藤蔓觸發，該藤蔓具有AC 15、15點生命值，對劈砍傷害易受，對火焰和穿刺傷害有抗性，且對鈍擊、毒素、心靈和雷電傷害免疫。整個機制被很好地偽裝，以防止入侵者潛入併發射村莊作為突襲。在白天仔細觀察村莊併成功透過{@dc 18}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會發現藤蔓網路和彎曲的大樹，並認出它們是一個巨大的彈簧陷阱。那些擁有{@skill Survival||求生}技能熟練度的角色在此檢定中具有優勢。

english: Goblins don't launch themselves in this contraption; it's too deadly. Anyone inside the net when the village is launched and hits the ground must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@dice 8d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 哥布林們不會自己使用這種裝置；它太致命了。當村子被髮射並撞擊地面時，任何在網內的人必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，檢定失敗將受到 28 ({@dice 8d6}) 點鈍擊傷害，檢定成功則僅受到一半的傷害。

english: Chapter 3: Dwellers of the Forbidden City
zh_tw: 第3章：禁城居民

english: Omu lies in a basin hidden in the depths of the rainforest, surrounded on all sides by sheer cliffs. The city is notoriously hard to find. Those who try must contend with miles of trackless jungle inhabited by natural predators, cannibals, and the remnants of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s undead army. Even skilled guides have difficulty threading their way through.
zh_tw: 奧穆位於雨林深處的一個盆地中，四周被陡峭的懸崖所環繞。這座城市出了名的難以找到。那些試圖尋找的人必須面對數英里的無跡可尋的叢林，那裡居住著天然捕食者、食人族和{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}不死軍團的殘餘。即使是熟練的嚮導也很難穿越。

english: To enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods, adventurers must tread cautiously, contend with the dwellers of the ruined city, and learn all they can about the nine trickster gods of Omu and their ancient rivalries.
zh_tw: 要想進入九神之墓，冒險者們必須小心行事，與這座廢墟城市的居住者鬥爭，並儘可能多地瞭解奧穆的九位詭神以及他們古老的敵對關係。

english: Omu
zh_tw: 奧穆

english: To the untrained eye, Omu appears abandoned, yet its raised streets and splintered plazas are far from uninhabited. If the characters reach a point where they can see the city in its entirety, either by flying above it or by looking down on it from a cliff's edge, give the players a copy of handout 12 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.
zh_tw: 在未經訓練的眼睛看來，奧穆似乎已被廢棄，然而它的高架街道和破碎的廣場遠非無人居住。如果角色們到達一個可以完整看到整個城市的地方，無論是從上方飛行還是從懸崖邊俯瞰，給玩家們一份附錄E中的手稿12副本（見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}）。

english: Approaching the City
zh_tw: 接近城市

english: Two main routes lead into Omu. To the northeast, a river snakes down from the foothills of the Peaks of Flame and flushes into the city through a canyon (see {@area area 17|274|x}). The second access point is a staircase to the southwest (see {@area area 1|1fb|x}).
zh_tw: 有兩條主要的路線通向奧穆。向東北方向，一條河流從火焰峰的山麓蜿蜒而下，透過一個峽谷湧入城市（見{@area 區域17|274|x}）。第二個入口點是西南方向的樓梯（見{@area 區域1|1fb|x}）。

english: Entering the City
zh_tw: 進入城市

english: When the characters see Omu for the first time, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次看到奧穆時，請閱讀：

english: The jungle parts to reveal a dead city enclosed by sheer cliffs. Ruined buildings and stone boulevards rise like ghosts from the floor of the misty basin. Colorful birds glide overhead.
zh_tw: 叢林分開，露出一個被陡峭懸崖環繞的死城。廢墟建築和石頭大道像霧濛濛的盆地中出現的幽靈一樣升起。五彩繽紛的鳥兒在頭頂滑翔。

english: A waterfall pours into the basin, creating a swollen river that floods much of the city before draining into a deep rift filled with molten lava. A ruined palace lies a few hundred feet from the edge of the steaming abyss.
zh_tw: 一道瀑布傾瀉進盆地，形成了一條洶湧的河流，它淹沒了城市的大部分，然後流入一個充滿熔岩的深裂縫中。一座破敗的宮殿坐落在冒著蒸汽的深淵邊緣幾百尺遠的地方。

english: The cliffs surrounding Omu are 100–150 feet high and composed of crumbling rock. Thick jungle hugs the clifftops, with ferns, orchids, and moss spilling over the edges. Every 100 feet or so, a {@creature gargoyle} perches on the brink of the precipice. When a character gets a good look at one of these creatures, read:
zh_tw: 環繞奧穆的懸崖高100至150尺，由破碎的岩石構成。茂密的叢林緊挨著懸崖頂端，蕨類植物、蘭花和苔蘚從邊緣溢位。大約每隔100尺，就有一隻{@creature gargoyle||石像鬼}（石像鬼）棲息在懸崖的邊緣。當一個角色仔細觀察這些生物時，請閱讀：

english: A vine-draped gargoyle perches on the clifftop, staring down at the ruined city. It has the face of a devil, with its mouth agape in a silent scream.
zh_tw: 一個被藤蔓覆蓋的石像鬼棲息在懸崖頂端，俯視著這座毀滅的城市。它有著魔鬼的面孔，嘴巴張開，無聲地尖叫。

english: The gargoyles attack anyone who flies over the city or tries to climb up or down the cliffs, but they ignore intruders who enter by the river or the ravine to the southwest. They serve {@creature Acererak|ToA} and take orders from his undead tomb custodian, {@creature Withers|ToA} (see {@area chapter 5|312|x}).
zh_tw: 石像鬼會攻擊任何飛越城市或試圖爬上爬下懸崖的人，但它們會忽略透過河流或西南方向的峽谷進入的入侵者。它們為{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}服務，並接受他的不死生物墓穴管理員{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的命令（見{@area 第五章|312|x}）。

english: History of Omu
zh_tw: 奧穆的歷史

english: The tragic history of Omu is written in its ruins. As the characters explore, use the information provided here to bring the city to life.
zh_tw: 奧穆的悲慘歷史鐫刻在它的廢墟之中。當角色們探索時，使用這裡提供的資訊讓這座城市栩栩如生。

english: Forbidden City
zh_tw: 禁城

english: Omu was once a jewel in Chult's crown. Built over rich mineral veins, the city garnered wealth in abundance. Omuan jewelry was coveted far and wide, and the city's merchants grew fat on commerce. To enter Omu, it was said, was to enter the gates of paradise itself. Such wealth brought greed. Omu's hunger for slaves made her rulers demand ever greater tribute from their neighbors. When their vassals couldn't pay in flesh, they paid in blood. Omu's feared legions marched across Chult.
zh_tw: 奧穆曾經是楚爾特王冠上的一顆寶石。這座城市建立在豐富的礦脈之上，因此積累了大量的財富。奧穆的珠寶在世界各地都備受追捧，城市的商人因貿易而變得富有。據說，進入奧穆就如同進入了天堂之門。這樣的財富帶來了貪婪。奧穆對奴隸的渴望使她的統治者向鄰居索要越來越多的貢品。當他們的附庸無法用肉體支付時，他們用鮮血支付。奧穆令人畏懼的軍團跨越了整個楚爾特。

english: The Omuans' greed and hubris angered the god Ubtao, causing him to turn his back on Omu two hundred years ago—long before he abandoned the rest of Chult. Omu's clerics lost their spells, and the city fell to sickness and disease. Slave uprisings wracked Omu, and its nobles fled in droves. Maps showing Omu's location were destroyed, and its coins were melted down and reminted. Fallen from grace, Omu became known as the Forbidden City.
zh_tw: 奧穆人的貪婪和傲慢激怒了神烏博塔奧，導致他在兩百年前就拋棄了奧穆——這比他放棄整個楚爾特地區還要早得多。奧穆的牧師們失去了他們的法術，城市陷入了疾病和疫情之中。奴隸起義使奧穆遭受重創，它的貴族們紛紛逃離。顯示奧穆位置的地圖被銷燬，它的硬幣被熔化並重新鑄造。失去恩典的奧穆成為了眾所周知的禁忌之城。

english: Nine Trickster Gods
zh_tw: 九位詭神

english: With Ubtao gone, primal spirits arose from the rainforest to bewitch the few remaining Omuans. They disguised themselves as jungle creatures and promised great power in return for devotion. Desperate for redemption, the Omuans tore down their temple to Ubtao and raised shrines to these nine trickster gods.
zh_tw: 隨著烏博塔奧的離去，原初精魂從雨林中出現，對剩下的奧穆人施加了魔法。他們偽裝成叢林生物，並承諾以虔誠換取巨大力量。奧穆人渴望救贖，於是他們拆毀了供奉烏博塔奧的神殿，併為這九位詭神建立了神龕。

english: The new deities were divisive and often cruel. Too weak to grant miracles to every follower, they concocted elaborate trials to winnow the clergy. On holy days, the mettle of aspirant priests was tested in their nine shrines, with deadly consequences for failure. The trials provided entertainment for the degenerate Omuans and fed their weakling gods with much-needed sacrifices.
zh_tw: 新的神祇具有分裂性，常常殘忍。由於力量太弱，無法為每個信徒賜予神蹟，他們精心設計了複雜的試煉來篩選神職人員。在聖日，有志成為祭司的人在他們的九個神龕中接受考驗，失敗則有致命後果。這些試煉為墮落的奧曼人提供了娛樂，併為他們軟弱的神祇提供了急需的犧牲。

english: For nine decades, the city folk lived by the mantras of their trickster gods. They built statues in their names and schemed against each other to assert their chosen god's dominance. Omu's glorious past was lost, but its people endured. Such mercy did not last long.
zh_tw: 九十年來，城市居民遵循著他們詭神的信條生活。他們以這些神的名義建造雕像，並相互策劃以確立他們所選神的統治地位。奧穆的輝煌過去已不復存在，但它的人民堅持了下來。這樣的仁慈並沒有持續太久。

english: Fall of Omu
zh_tw: 奧穆的陷落

english: Omu's bloody trials drew the attention of {@creature Acererak|ToA}, an archlich who wanders the cosmos in search of souls to harvest. {@creature Acererak|ToA}, who is fond of deathtraps, marveled at the trials concocted by the Omuans. They inspired him to create his own dungeon below the city.
zh_tw: 奧穆血腥的試煉吸引了{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的注意，他是一位在宇宙中漫遊尋找靈魂收割的巫妖。喜歡死亡陷阱的{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}對奧穆人設計的試煉感到驚奇。這些試煉激發了他在城市下方建造自己的地下城的靈感。

english: A little over a century ago, {@creature Acererak|ToA} entered Omu and slew all nine trickster gods. He then enslaved the Omuans and forced them to carve out a tomb for their defeated gods. When the tomb was complete, {@creature Acererak|ToA} murdered the Omuans and sealed them in the tomb with their false gods. The archlich resumed his odyssey across the planes, content that the dungeon would feed his phylactery with the souls of dead adventurers. The jungle reclaimed Omu, and it fell into ruin.
zh_tw: 一百多年前，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}進入了奧穆並殺死了所有九位詭神。然後他奴役了奧穆人，並強迫他們為他們被擊敗的神鵰刻一個墳墓。當墳墓完成後，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}殺害了奧穆人並將他們與他們的假神一起封在墳墓裡。巫妖繼續他在各個位面的奧德賽之旅，心滿意足地認為地下城會用死去冒險者的靈魂滋養他的魂器。叢林重新奪回了奧穆，它陷入了廢墟。

english: Rise of Ras Nsi
zh_tw: 拉茲·納斯的崛起

english: Fifty years ago, a brood of yuan-ti from Hisari (see {@area chapter 2|115|x}) slithered into Omu and made it their new home. They built an underground temple beneath the old palace and patiently waited for their god, Dendar the Night Serpent, to come forth and swallow the world. Earthquakes shook Omu and cracked it open like a fig, causing the river to burst its banks. Chance spared the yuan-ti temple from destruction, but scores of yuan-ti died, including their leader (a yuan-ti abomination).
zh_tw: 五十年前，一群來自希薩裡的蛇人（見{@area 第二章|115|x}）悄悄進入奧穆，並將其作為他們的新家園。他們在舊宮殿下建造了一座地下神廟，並耐心地等待他們的神，夜之蛇丹達爾，出現併吞噬世界。地震搖撼了奧穆，使其像無花果一樣裂開，導致河水氾濫。偶然的機會使蛇人神廟免於毀滅，但仍有許多蛇人死亡，包括他們的領袖（一位蛇人怪物）。

english: The evil warlord {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, who had raised an army of undead to wage war on the holy city of Mezro, only to suffer a terrible defeat, arrived in Omu shortly after the yuan-ti. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} wormed his way into the yuan-ti's favor and underwent a ritual to transform into a malison. Before long, he became their ruler. Today, beneath the cracked and broken streets of Omu, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} holds sway and plots to bring Dendar the Night Serpent into the world, sealing its doom.
zh_tw: 邪惡的軍閥{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}曾組建一支不死軍團，企圖徵戰聖城梅茲羅，卻遭受了可怕的失敗。在蛇人之後不久，他抵達了奧穆。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}巧妙地贏得了蛇人的好感，並經歷了一個儀式，將自己轉變為一個咒怨者。不久後，他成為了他們的統治者。如今，在奧穆破裂和破碎的街道下方，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}掌握著權力，並密謀將夜之蛇丹達爾帶入世界，封印其命運。

english: Legend of the Nine Gods
zh_tw: 九神傳說

english: Stories of Omu's nine trickster gods died with the Omuans who worshiped them. As characters explore the gods' shrines, the players piece together fragments of the following legend, which provides clues on how to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 關於奧穆的九位詭神的故事隨著崇拜他們的奧穆人的死亡而消失。當角色們探索這些神的神龕時，玩家們拼湊起以下傳說的片段，這些片段提供了如何進入九神之墓的線索。

english: Long ago, the god Ubtao hardened his heart and vowed to weep for the people of Omu no longer. The rains stopped, the jungle withered and died, and death swept through Omu.
zh_tw: 很久以前，神烏博塔奧堅定了他的心，發誓不再為奧穆的人民流淚。雨水停止了，叢林枯萎死去，死亡席捲了奧穆。

english: One morning, a wise zorbo emerged from her hollow tree and spoke to the dying Omuans. To convince Ubtao of their worth, she decided to cook him a stew made from all their good qualities. Catching such virtues wouldn't be easy, so she asked a wily almiraj to help her. The almiraj snuck recklessness in the pot, which she saw as a virtue, and Ubtao spat out the stew when he tasted it. From that day on, Obo'laka the zorbo and I'jin the almiraj became terrible enemies.
zh_tw: 一天早晨，一位智者佐博從她的空心樹中走出，向垂死的奧穆人講話。為了向烏博塔奧證明他們的價值，她決定為他煮一鍋用他們所有優秀品質製成的燉菜。捕捉這些美德並不容易，所以她請求一位狡猾的獨角兔幫助她。獨角兔偷偷地將魯莽放入鍋中，她認為這是一種美德，而烏博塔奧嚐到後吐出了燉菜。從那天起，佐博的奧博娜卡和獨角兔的艾金成為了可怕的敵人。

english: At noon, a brave kamadan hopped down from her rock. She saw the evil in the Omuans' hearts and decided to lance it like a troublesome boil. The kamadan fashioned a holy spear, but she left it by the riverbank and a crafty grung stole it. In her rage, Shagambi the kamadan forgot all about the Omuans and chased Nangnang the grung forever across the sky.
zh_tw: 在正午時分，一隻勇敢的六岐蛇豹從她的岩石上跳了下來。她看到了奧穆人心中的邪惡，並決定像處理一個麻煩的癤子一樣將其清除。六岐蛇豹製造了一支聖矛，但她把它留在了河邊，一個狡猾的格朗偷走了它。在她的憤怒中，六岐蛇豹的莎根比忘記了所有關於奧穆人的事，永遠地追逐著偷矛的格朗娜浪橫穿天空。

english: When evening came, a wily eblis stepped from his reed hut. He didn't like the Omuans, but without them he'd have no one to play his tricks on. The eblis sent a marsh frog to reason with Ubtao, but the frog was angry and decided to wrestle the god instead. This amused Ubtao, so he gave the frog tentacles to make it stronger. When Kubazan the froghemoth returned to Papazotl the eblis, he chased Papazotl into the swamp with his new tentacles.
zh_tw: 當傍晚來臨時，一個狡猾的魔王鶴從他的蘆葦屋中走了出來。他不喜歡奧穆人，但是沒有他們，他就沒有人可以捉弄了。魔王鶴派了一隻沼澤青蛙去說服烏博塔奧，但青蛙很生氣，決定與神摔跤。這讓烏博塔奧感到有趣，於是他給了青蛙觸手讓它變得更強大。當青蛙魔庫巴贊返回到魔王鶴帕帕扎圖時，他用他的新觸手將帕帕扎圖追進了沼澤。

english: That night, a su-monster broke into Ubtao's palace and stole a pail of water for the Omuans. When the god came running to find it, the su-monster hid the pail in a jaculi's burrow. Ubtao asked the jungle animals where his water was hidden, and Moa the jaculi was too honest to lie. When Wongo the su-monster found out how Moa had betrayed him, he vowed to catch the jaculi and eat him up.
zh_tw: 那天夜裡，一隻蘇怪闖入了烏博塔奧的宮殿，為奧穆人偷了一桶水。當神跑來尋找時，蘇怪把水桶藏在了投石機的洞穴裡。烏博塔奧詢問叢林中的動物他的水藏在哪裡，而投石機莫亞太誠實了，無法撒謊。當蘇怪望戈發現莫亞如何出賣了他時，他發誓要抓住投石機並吃掉他。

english: All the while, Unkh the flail snail lived deep under the earth. The noise of the other animals fighting made her slither up to the surface, and when day dawned over her shell, the light blinded Ubtao and made his eyes water. Life returned to Omu, and the people built shrines to honor the animals who'd saved them.
zh_tw: 與此同時，安珂這隻鏈鞭蝸牛深居地下。其他動物戰鬥的噪音讓她滑行到地面，當黎明的曙光照在她的殼上時，光線晃瞎了烏博塔奧的眼睛，使他的眼睛湧出了淚水。生命回到了奧穆，人們建造了神龕來紀念拯救了他們的動物。

english: City Inhabitants
zh_tw: 城市居民

english: Several factions dwell within Omu, including yuan-ti, grungs, vegepygmies, and kobolds. Explorers also come here in search of gold and glory. Presently, these include Red Wizards and three tabaxi hunters. Each of these groups can play as much of a role in the story as you desire. They could serve as enemies or as allies brought together by mutual interests.
zh_tw: 幾個派系居住在奧穆內部，包括蛇人、格朗人、植物侏儒和狗頭人。探險家們也來到這裡尋找黃金和榮耀。目前，這些包括紅袍法師和三名斑貓獵人。每組人都可以根據您的需要在故事中扮演同樣重要的角色。他們可以作為敵人，或者作為因共同利益而聯合起來的盟友。

english: Yuan-ti
zh_tw: 蛇人

english: Yuan-ti offer sacrifices to Dendar the Night Serpent in a sprawling underground temple beneath the ruins of Omu's royal palace ({@area area 20|292|x}); the temple is described in {@area chapter 4|298|x}. The yuan-ti guard the entrances to the city, patrol its streets, and send raiding parties into the surrounding jungle. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} rules over them, but traitorous priests plot his downfall.
zh_tw: 蛇人在奧穆王宮廢墟下方的龐大地下神廟中向夜之蛇丹達爾獻祭（見{@area 區域20|292|x}）；神廟在{@area 第四章|298|x}中有描述。蛇人守衛著城市的入口，巡邏其街道，並向周圍的叢林派出突擊隊。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}統治著他們，但背叛的祭司們正在策劃他的覆滅。

english: Salida's Treachery
zh_tw: 薩莉達的背叛

english: One of the guides presented in chapter 1 is {@creature Salida|ToA}, a pureblood yuan-ti loyal to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. If {@creature Salida|ToA} escorts the characters into the city, she'll surreptitiously use her {@item Sending Stones||sending stone} to contact {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} so that he can prepare an ambush. When night falls, {@creature Salida|ToA} uses a lantern to signal the yuan-ti attack. The attacking force consists of one type 3 {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malison} and two {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods} per party member. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is keen to capture the characters so he can question them about their mission.
zh_tw: 第1章中介紹的嚮導之一是{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}，一個忠於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的純血蛇人。如果{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}護送角色們進入城市，她會秘密地使用她的{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}聯絡{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，以便他可以準備伏擊。當夜幕降臨時，{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}使用一盞燈籠作為訊號，發起蛇人的攻擊。攻擊力量由每名隊伍成員對應一個3型的{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}和兩個{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}組成。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}渴望捕獲角色們，以便他可以詢問他們有關他們任務的資訊。

english: Grungs
zh_tw: 格龍蛙人們

english: A small colony of grungs lives on the rooftops around Nangnang's shrine ({@area area 18|277|x}). {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} regularly mounts raids on them to thin their numbers.
zh_tw: 一群小型的格朗族居住在娜浪神龕（{@area 區域18|277|x}）周圍的屋頂上。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}定期對他們發動襲擊以減少他們的人數。

english: The grungs worship Nangnang and view her shrine as holy ground for their chieftain and his elite guards. {@creature Yorb|ToA}, the mad grung chieftain, craves vengeance against {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} but hasn't yet found a worthy attack plan.
zh_tw: 格朗族崇拜娜浪，並將她的神龕視為他們酋長及其精英守衛的聖地。瘋狂的格朗族酋長{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}渴望對{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}進行復仇，但還沒有找到一個值得的攻擊計劃。

english: Vegepygmies
zh_tw: 孢子人們

english: Years ago, a meteorite fell from the heavens and created the city's Great Rift. Stardust rained over the ruins and formed patches of russet mold out of which vegepygmies arose. Their tribes prowl the flooded backstreets. Yuan-ti have learned to shun these areas and kill the "moldies" on sight.
zh_tw: 多年前，一顆隕石從天而降，形成了城市的巨大裂縫。星塵落在廢墟上，形成了一片片赤褐色的黴菌，從中誕生了植物侏儒。他們的部落在被洪水淹沒的小巷中徘徊。元提人已經學會避開這些地區，並且一見到"黴菌"就將其殺死。

english: Omu contains several small tribes of vegepygmies. They clash over territory and are unified only in their reverence of the Great Rift. Even if the vegepygmies could communicate with the characters, they have little desire to work with them. Their chiefs aren't clever, and the characters could trick the vegepygmies to unify against a common enemy.
zh_tw: 奧穆包含幾個小的植皮矮人部落。他們在領土上發生衝突，只有在對大裂谷的崇敬上才統一。即使植皮矮人能與角色們交流，他們也不太願意與他們合作。他們的首領並不聰明，角色們可以誘騙植皮矮人聯合起來對抗一個共同的敵人。

english: Kobolds
zh_tw: 狗頭人

english: Nine deadly shrines hold the secret to entering the Tomb of the Nine Gods. To maintain the shrines' traps, {@creature Acererak|ToA} recruited a tribe of kobolds to act as shrine menders. These creatures dwell in cellars beneath a ruined marketplace ({@area area 15|262|x}). {@creature Acererak|ToA} has promised to transform their sorcerer, Kakarol, into a dragon if the kobolds keep their end of their bargain. Too impatient to wait for his ascension, Kakarol has taken to sleeping on a small hoard of treasure and insists his underlings address him as Great Wyrm. If the characters cut a deal with the kobolds, the sorcerer's greed is easily manipulated.
zh_tw: 九個致命的神廟守護著進入九神之墓的秘密。為了維護神廟的陷阱，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}招募了一個狗頭人部落作為神廟的修理者。這些生物居住在一個被毀壞的市場下面的地窖裡({@area 區域15|262|x})。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}承諾如果狗頭人履行他們的協議，就會將他們的巫師卡卡羅爾變成一條龍。卡卡羅爾太不耐煩等待他的昇華，開始睡在一小堆寶藏上，並堅持讓他的下屬稱他為偉大的龍。如果角色們與狗頭人達成協議，巫師的貪婪很容易被操縱。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} hasn't told the kobolds about his alliance with {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. For their part, the yuan-ti are barely aware of the kobolds' existence.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 沒有告訴狗頭人他與 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 的聯盟。就他們而言，元提人幾乎不知道狗頭人的存在。

english: Red Wizards of Thay
zh_tw: 泰伊紅袍法師

english: A group of Red Wizards entered the city a couple of days prior to the characters' arrival. They camped in the ruined compound at {@area area 2|201|x}, but {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s forces nearly wiped them out in a night raid. Those who survived the attack continue to search the ruins for the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 一群紅袍法師在角色到來前幾天進入了城市。他們在{@area 區域2|201|x}的廢墟區域紮營，但在夜間突襲中，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的部隊幾乎將他們全部消滅。倖存者繼續在廢墟中尋找噬魂器。

english: The survivors include four Red Wizards (LE male and female Thayan human {@creature Mage||mages}) named Dyrax (male), Thazma (female), Yamoch (male), and Zagmira (female). Their red robes, shaved heads, and sallow complexions betray their allegiance to Thay. Eight mercenaries (LE male and female human {@creature Thug||thugs} of various ethnicities) escort the wizards. The highest ranking mage, Zagmira, appears just eighteen years old, yet one half of her face is wizened and old. This effect is a holdover from a terrible ritual she performed to inhabit the body of her own granddaughter. All four mages carry spellbooks that contain all their prepared spells.
zh_tw: 生還者包括四名紅袍法師（LE男性和女性泰雅人{@creature Mage||魔法師}）分別名為迪拉克斯（男性）、薩茲瑪（女性）、雅莫克（男性）和扎格米拉（女性）。他們穿著紅袍，剃光頭，面色蒼白，這些都表明他們忠於泰雅。八名僱傭兵（LE男性和女性人類{@creature Thug||暴徒}，各種族裔）護送這些法師。級別最高的法師扎格米拉看起來只有十八歲，然而她一半的臉卻是衰老的。這種效果是她為了佔據自己孫女的身體而進行的一個可怕儀式的後遺症。這四名法師都攜帶著包含他們所有準備法術的法術書。

english: Zagmira has seen the entrance to the Tomb of the Nine Gods ({@area area 14|261|x}) and believes the Soulmonger is held within. The Red Wizards have separated to find the puzzle cubes needed to unlock the tomb (see "{@area Puzzle Cubes|1eb|x}").
zh_tw: 扎格米拉見過九神之墓的入口（{@area 區域14|261|x}）並相信魂吸器被儲存在其中。紅袍法師們已經分開去尋找解鎖墓室所需的謎題立方體（見"{@area 謎題魔方|1eb|x}"）。

english: A man named Orvex (see {@area area 2|201|x}) serves the Red Wizards as a scribe and translator, but his loyalty to them is tenuous. The adventurers can easily befriend him.
zh_tw: 一個叫奧爾威克斯的男子（見{@area 區域2|201|x}）為紅袍法師們擔任抄寫員和翻譯，但他對他們的忠誠是不穩定的。冒險者們可以很容易地與他成為朋友。

english: Tabaxi Hunters
zh_tw: 斑貓獵人

english: In the twilight of their lives, venerable tabaxi sometimes leave their families and venture into the jungle to claim a hunter's death. A divine being known as the Cat Lord leads the bravest to Omu, where they spend their final days hunting dinosaurs and other jungle beasts.
zh_tw: 在他們生命的暮年，受人尊敬的斑貓人有時會離開他們的家庭，冒險進入叢林去尋求獵人的死亡。一位被稱為貓領主的神祇引領最勇敢的人到奧穆，在那裡他們度過最後的日子，狩獵恐龍和其他叢林野獸。

english: Three elderly {@creature Tabaxi Hunter|ToA|tabaxi hunters} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) stalk the city when the characters arrive. Their names are Hooded Lantern (male), {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} (male), and Copper Bell (female). The hunters know the city well, but care little for its history and keep clear of its shrines. They hunt alone and avoid contact with explorers. Rare weapons and hunting gear are the only items the characters could offer to gain their help.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，三位年長的{@creature Tabaxi Hunter|ToA|斑貓獵人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在城市中潛行。他們的名字是附蓋提燈（男性）、{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}（男性）和銅鈴（女性）。這些獵人對城市非常熟悉，但對它的歷史不感興趣，並且遠離它的神殿。他們獨自狩獵，避免與探險者接觸。稀有武器和狩獵裝備是角色們唯一可以提供以獲得他們幫助的物品。

english: Hooded Lantern has graying black fur, and cataracts cloud his left eye. He is preparing himself for a glorious death fighting the great tyrannosaurus rex known as the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} (see {@area area 13|259|x}). Copper Bell has speckled ginger fur and wears a torn blue cloth over her bony shoulders—the blanket used to comfort her cubs when they were infants. She retains much of her inquisitiveness and wry humor. {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} has gone mad and is described in {@area area 7|22c|x}.
zh_tw: 罩燈有灰黑色的毛髮，左眼因白內障而變得渾濁。他正在為與被稱為{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}的巨型霸王龍進行一場光榮的戰鬥而準備（見{@area 區域13|259|x}）。銅鈴有斑點狀的薑黃色毛髮，並在她瘦骨嶙峋的肩膀上披著一塊破爛的藍布——這是她用來安撫幼崽的毯子。她保留了大部分的求知慾和諷刺的幽默感。{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}已經瘋了，描述見{@area 區域7|22c|x}。

english: Old Omuan
zh_tw: 老奧姆安

english: The Omuans wrote in Old Omuan, a cuneiform script that bears little resemblance to any other alphabet. A character with the cloistered scholar or sage background can translate an inscription written in Old Omuan with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check, while a warlock with the Eyes of the Rune Keeper invocation can translate Old Omuan script without a check. If the characters recover the "queen's decree" from the chwinga cart at {@area area 11|24a|x}, they can use it to decode inscriptions written in Old Omuan. Without the queen's decree or a character with the appropriate background, the characters can translate Old Omuan writing only by using a {@spell comprehend languages} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 歐姆古人使用古歐姆古文書寫，這是一種與任何其他字母表都幾乎沒有相似之處的楔形文字。具有隱士學者或賢者背景的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定翻譯用古歐姆古文寫成的銘文，而擁有符文守護者之眼（符文守護者之眼）呼召的魔契師則無需檢定即可翻譯古歐姆古文。如果角色從 {@area 區域11|24a|x} 的奇溫加車（怯蘊阿靈二輪貨車）中找到了"女王的法令"，他們可以使用它來解碼用古歐姆古文寫成的銘文。如果沒有女王的法令或具有適當背景的角色，角色只能透過使用 {@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言} 法術或類似的魔法來翻譯古歐姆古文。

english: Puzzle Cubes
zh_tw: 謎題魔方

english: To unlock the Tomb of the Nine Gods, the characters must first recover nine puzzle cubes from shrines hidden throughout the city. The Red Wizards are already searching for the cubes, and {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} does what he must to prevent the Red Wizards or the characters from obtaining all of them.
zh_tw: 要解鎖九神之墓，角色們必須首先從遍佈城市各處的神龕中恢復九個謎題方塊。紅袍法師已經在尋找這些方塊，而 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 正在盡他所能阻止紅袍法師或角色們獲得全部方塊。

english: A puzzle cube is a stone cube 3 inches on a side and engraved with images of a specific trickster god. Each cube weighs half a pound. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of abjuration magic around each cube.
zh_tw: 一個謎題立方體是一個邊長3吋的石制立方體，上面刻有特定詭神的影象。每個立方體重半磅。使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果可以揭示每個立方體周圍的防護魔法光環。

english: The puzzle cubes can't be destroyed by any means. If they're discarded, buried, or taken more than a mile outside Omu, they teleport back to their resting places inside their respective shrines. If the characters return to a previously cleared shrine, there's a cumulative {@chance 20} chance per day that kobolds have reset its traps.
zh_tw: 這些謎題方塊無法以任何方式被摧毀。如果它們被丟棄、掩埋或被帶離奧穆超過一英里，它們會傳送回各自神殿內的原處。如果角色們返回之前清理過的神殿，每天有累計{@chance 20}的機率狗頭人會重置其中的陷阱。

english: Learning of the Shrines
zh_tw: 瞭解聖地

english: A few clues can point the players toward the shrines, including a lost journal found at a campsite ({@area area 9|23c|x}). Characters can also discover the shrines on their own or learn about them from {@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA} ({@area area 2|201|x}).
zh_tw: 一些線索可以引導玩家前往聖地，包括在營地發現的遺失日記（{@area 區域9|23c|x}）。角色也可以自己發現聖地，或者從{@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA|奧爾威克斯·歐誇瑪斯}（{@area 區域2|201|x}）那裡瞭解它們。

english: Race for the Puzzle Cubes
zh_tw: 爭奪謎題立方體

english: The characters need not explore all nine shrines. The Red Wizards find at least two of the puzzle cubes, and {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} always steps in to claim the final cube. Things play out differently if the players find a way to foil their enemies' plans—by killing them, for example.
zh_tw: 角色們無需探索全部九個聖地。紅袍法師至少找到了兩個謎題立方體，而{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}總是會介入來索取最後一個立方體。如果玩家找到一種方法破壞敵人的計劃——例如，透過殺死他們——事情會有不同的發展。

english: On the day the characters claim their first puzzle cube, the Red Wizards clear a separate shrine within the city. While the Red Wizards remain active, there's a cumulative {@chance 25} chance per day that they claim another puzzle cube from a random shrine. If the players arrive at a cleared shrine, they discover a scene of devastation: traps sprung, monsters slain, and the cube missing.
zh_tw: 在角色們獲得第一個謎題方塊的當天，紅袍法師們會清理城市內的另一座神殿。只要紅袍法師仍在活動，每天就有累計{@chance 25}的機率他們會從隨機神殿中奪取另一個謎題方塊。如果玩家們抵達一座已被清理的神殿，他們會發現一片狼藉的場景：陷阱觸發、怪物被殺、方塊失蹤。

english: Once five puzzle cubes have been taken from their shrines, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} begins to set ambushes. When the characters arrive at their next shrine, three type 1 {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} and six {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods} ambush them. Their orders are to capture characters and bring them to the Fane of the Night Serpent for interrogation.
zh_tw: 一旦有五個謎題立方體從它們的聖地被取走，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}開始設定伏擊。當角色們到達下一個聖地時，三個1型{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}和六個{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}伏擊他們。他們的命令是捕獲角色並將他們帶到夜蛇神殿進行審訊。

english: Once eight puzzle cubes have been claimed, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} steals the ninth cube for himself and leaves an obvious trail leading pursuers to the main entrance of his underground temple (see {@area area 20A|292|x}). The characters must infiltrate the temple and either take the puzzle cube by force or convince {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} to part with it. For more information on the temple and its inhabitants, see {@area chapter 4|298|x}.
zh_tw: 一旦八個謎題立方體被認領，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}就會為自己偷走第九個立方體，並留下一條明顯的蹤跡，引導追蹤者前往他的地下神廟的主入口（見{@area 區域20A|292|x}）。角色們必須潛入神廟，要麼透過武力奪取謎題立方體，要麼說服{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}放棄它。有關神廟及其居民的更多資訊，請參見{@area 第四章|298|x}。

english: An Uneasy Alliance
zh_tw: 一個不穩定的聯盟

english: The characters could form an alliance with the Red Wizards to recover the puzzle cube taken by the yuan-ti. If an accord is reached, Zagmira reveals that she has a spy in the yuan-ti temple: a yuan-ti pureblood named Ishmakahl (pronounced ISH-mah-kawl). Zagmira doesn't reveal that this spy is a doppelganger.
zh_tw: 角色們可以與紅袍法師結成聯盟，以取回被蛇人拿走的謎題立方體。如果達成協議，扎格米拉透露她在蛇人神廟裡有一個間諜：一個名為伊什瑪卡爾（發音為ISH-mah-kawl）的蛇人純血。扎格米拉沒有透露這個間諜是一個變形怪。

english: Zagmira encourages human characters to infiltrate the yuan-ti temple disguised as purebloods, with nonhuman characters posing as their slaves. If no human characters are present, Zagmira is willing to spend a 5th-level spell slot to cast {@spell invisibility} on up to four party members. If the characters recover the puzzle cube taken by {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, the Red Wizards turn against the characters and try to claim all the puzzle cubes for themselves once the characters emerge from the yuan-ti temple. If {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} is with the party, the Red Wizards also try to take the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} from him.
zh_tw: 扎格米拉鼓勵人類角色偽裝成純血潛入蛇人神廟，非人類角色則假扮成他們的奴隸。如果沒有人類角色在場，扎格米拉願意消耗一個5環法術位來施放{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術，使多達四名隊伍成員隱形。如果角色們取回了被{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}拿走的謎題立方體，紅袍法師會在角色們從蛇人神廟出來後轉而對抗他們，並試圖為自己奪取所有的謎題立方體。如果{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}與隊伍在一起，紅袍法師也會試圖從他那裡奪取{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。

english: If the Red Wizards obtain all nine puzzle cubes, they use them to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods and, one by one, fall prey to the tomb's insidious traps.
zh_tw: 如果紅袍法師獲得了全部九個謎題立方體，他們會使用它們進入九神之墓，並且一個接一個地落入墓中的險惡陷阱。

english: Navigation
zh_tw: 導航

english: The city basin is densely packed with ruined villas and overgrown courtyards. Buildings in Omu are shaped from limestone. Thick, broad-leaved vines engulf most structures, while ferns and thorny bushes choke the streets. Statues representing the trickster gods leer from many junctions.
zh_tw: 城市盆地裡密密麻麻地佈滿了破敗的別墅和雜草叢生的庭院。奧穆的建築物是由石灰石建造的。厚實的闊葉藤蔓吞噬了大部分建築，而蕨類植物和帶刺的灌木則阻塞了街道。代表詭神的雕像在許多路口陰險地凝視著。

english: Cautious characters can move through the city at a rate of 200 feet every 5 minutes. Even if they throw caution to the wind, the density of the undergrowth makes it tricky to move faster than 200 feet per minute. If the characters stop to search for treasure, each building takes 30 minutes to clear. Whenever the party searches a ruined building, roll percentile dice and consult the Ruin Interior table to see what, if anything, the building contains.
zh_tw: 謹慎的角色可以在城市中以每5分鐘200尺的速度移動。即使他們不顧一切地小心，雜草叢生的密度使得移動速度很難超過每分鐘200尺。如果角色停下來尋找寶藏，每棟建築需要30分鐘來清理。每當隊伍搜尋一棟廢墟建築時，擲百分率骰子並參考廢墟內部表，看看建築裡有什麼，如果有的話。

zh_tw: 坍塌的地板

english: As the characters explore this building, choose one character at random to make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the floor collapses and the character falls 20 feet into a lower level, taking damage from the fall as normal. Roll again on the Ruin Interior table to see if there's anything interesting in the lower level.
zh_tw: 當角色探索這座建築時，隨機選擇一個角色進行 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免檢定。若失敗，地板坍塌，角色墜落 20 尺到達下層，正常承受墜落傷害。再次在廢墟內部表中投擲，看看下層是否有任何有趣的東西。

english: Blue Mist
zh_tw: 藍色霧氣

english: A thin, odorless blue mist lingers inside the ruin. Characters who enter the building expose themselves to blue mist fever (see "{@area Diseases|0a3|x}"). Roll again on the Ruin Interior table to see if there's anything else in the building.
zh_tw: 廢墟內瀰漫著一層稀薄、無味的藍色霧氣。進入建築的角色會暴露在藍色霧氣熱病中（見"{@area 疾病|0a3|x}"）。再次在廢墟內部表上擲骰，看看建築內是否還有其他東西。

Any character damaged by a giant wasp must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw at the end of the encounter or become infected with shivering sickness (see "{@area Diseases|0a3|x}").
zh_tw: 建築物內已經有蟲害築巢。擲一個 {@dice d6} 並參考巢穴居住者表來確定巢穴的居民。任何被巨型黃蜂傷害的角色必須在遭遇結束時成功透過一個 {@dc 11} 體質豁免檢定，否則會感染顫抖病（參見 "{@area 疾病|0a3|x}"）。

zh_tw: 這座廢墟包含{@dice 1d6}個奧馬藝術品（玉戒指、彩繪陶器、鑲嵌銀的木製詭神小雕像、水晶花瓶等）。每件藝術品價值25金幣。

zh_tw: 孢子人們

english: Hiding in the ruin are {@dice 1d4} {@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|vegepygmies} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). They are not in a fighting mood and cower from interlopers. If attacked, they flee through cracks in the walls and attempt to hide in the surrounding marsh.
zh_tw: 隱藏在廢墟中的是{@dice 1d4}個{@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|孢子人們}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。它們並不處於戰鬥狀態，對入侵者感到害怕。如果被攻擊，它們會透過牆壁的裂縫逃走，並試圖隱藏在周圍的沼澤中。

english: 1. City Entrance

english: A guardhouse stands near the entrance to the city. Arrow slits are cut into its limestone walls, and a lopsided iron portcullis hangs over the gateway, beyond which you see an open plaza.
zh_tw: 一座警衛室位於城市入口附近。石灰石牆上刻有箭縫，一個歪斜的鐵製吊閘懸掛在門道上方，透過門道你可以看到一座開闊的廣場。

english: If the characters enter the guardhouse, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色進入警衛室，讀：

english: Much of the interior has collapsed into rubble. Creepers cling to the walls, and high grasses sprout between the flagstones amid evidence of long-dead campfires. One wall is covered with graffiti—some words painted, others etched.
zh_tw: 大部分內部已經坍塌成瓦礫。攀緣植物附著在牆上，高草在石板間生長，周圍有早已熄滅的篝火痕跡。一面牆上覆蓋著塗鴉——有些字是畫上去的，有些則是刻上去的。

english: The graffiti (written in Common) provides hints about the challenges that await:
zh_tw: 這些塗鴉（用通用語寫成）提供了關於即將面臨的挑戰的提示：

english: "Fear the fangs of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}!"
zh_tw: "畏懼{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的毒牙！"

english: "Erik, I've gone in search of the nine shrines. V."
zh_tw: "艾瑞克，我已經去尋找九個聖地了。V。"

english: "The puzzle cubes are the key."
zh_tw: "謎題立方體是關鍵。"

english: "Beware the frog monster!"
zh_tw: "小心青蛙怪物！"

english: "Who is Unkh?"
zh_tw: "安珂是誰？"

english: "All hail the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA}!"
zh_tw: "全體致敬{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}！"

english: "The snakes are not what they seem."
zh_tw: "這些蛇並非它們看起來那樣。"

english: "Kubazan = bravery. Shagambi = wisdom. Moa = ?"
zh_tw: "庫巴贊 = 勇敢。莎根比 = 感知。莫阿 = ？"

english: Ras Nsi's Scouts
zh_tw: 拉茲·納斯的偵察兵

english: Five {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} watch this entrance to the city from a small cave carved into the cliffside. A narrow goat track zigzags up the cliff to their hideout.
zh_tw: 五個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}從一個雕刻在懸崖上的小型洞穴中監視著這座城市的入口。一條狹窄的山羊小徑蜿蜒而上，通向他們的藏身之處。

english: The group consists of two type 1 malisons, two type 2 malisons, and one type 3 malison. They follow the characters into Omu and shadow them through the streets. Their goal is to ambush the characters and capture at least one of them. If they remain out of sight, the yuan-ti launch their attack when the characters try to take their first long or short rest in the city.
zh_tw: 這個小組由兩個1型惡咒蛇人、兩個2型惡咒蛇人和一個3型惡咒蛇人組成。他們跟隨角色進入奧穆，並在街道上跟蹤他們。他們的目標是伏擊角色並至少捕獲其中一個。如果他們保持隱蔽，蛇人將在角色嘗試在城市中進行第一次長休或短休時發動攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The type 3 malison's longbow is painted and carved like a serpent with tiny amber gemstones for eyes. The weapon is worth 250 gp as an art object.
zh_tw: 3型惡咒蛇人的長弓被漆成並雕刻成蛇形，用細小的琥珀色寶石作為眼睛。作為藝術品，這件武器價值250金幣。

english: 2. Walled Compound
zh_tw: 2. 圍牆大院

english: Smoke drifts lazily from a walled compound. The gate lies in splinters, and scorch marks deface the buildings. Near the center of the compound is a plaza littered with charred human corpses. One of the corpses is being torn apart by a pack of wild dogs.
zh_tw: 煙霧從有圍牆的院子中懶散地飄出。大門破碎不堪，建築物上佈滿了燒焦的痕跡。在院子中心的廣場上，散落著燒焦的人類屍體。其中一具屍體正被一群野狗撕扯。

english: The Red Wizards seized this compound as their base of operations in Omu, but yuan-ti attacked and nearly wiped them out. Thirty corpses are scattered across the compound—the remains of three Red Wizards, twenty human mercenaries, and seven bearers hired in Port Nyanzaru. The yuan-ti looted all the supplies they found and stole their enemies' weapons. Six wild dogs (use {@creature jackal} statistics) feed on one of the Red Wizards. The dogs pose no threat if the characters keep their distance.
zh_tw: 紅袍法師佔領了這個院子作為他們在奧穆的行動基地，但是蛇人發動了攻擊，幾乎將他們全殲。院子中散落著三十具屍體——三名紅袍法師、二十名人類僱傭兵和七名在南扎路港僱傭的搬運工的遺體。蛇人掠奪了他們發現的所有物資，並偷走了敵人的武器。六隻野狗（使用{@creature jackal||胡狼}的具體數值）正在啃食一名紅袍法師的屍體。如果角色保持距離，這些狗不會構成威脅。

english: Spirit Pole
zh_tw: 靈柱

english: The yuan-ti burned their dead comrades and arranged their bones into a spirit pole. Characters who explore the compound discover this effigy:
zh_tw: 元提人焚燒了他們的亡者同胞，並將他們的骨頭排列成一根靈柱。探索這個院落的角色們發現了這個雕像：

english: A glaive has been thrust into remains of a burned-out pyre. Charred snake skulls and blackened inhuman vertebrae are lashed to the spear. On a wall nearby, a symbol has been daubed in ash: a snake curled in a spiral, gripping a circle in its jaws.
zh_tw: 一把鐮戟被插在燒燬的火葬堆的殘骸中。燒焦的蛇頭和變黑的非人脊椎被綁在矛上。在附近的牆上，一個符號用灰燼塗抹而成：一條蛇盤成螺旋形，用它的顎咬著一個圓圈。

english: With a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check, a character recognizes the sigil on the wall as the symbol of Dendar the Night Serpent devouring the world.
zh_tw: 透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，角色可以識別出牆上的符號是吞噬世界的夜蛇恩達爾之標記。

english: Orvex Ocrammas
zh_tw: 奧爾威克斯·歐誇瑪斯

english: During the attack, an explosion buried a member of the Red Wizards' expedition under a fallen section of wall. {@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA|Orvex} is dying of thirst and {@condition exhaustion}. As characters search the compound, they hear him calling out for help from under the rubble. If the characters free Orvex, he begs to join their band until he finds sanctuary.
zh_tw: 在襲擊中，一次爆炸將紅袍法師探險隊的一名成員埋在了倒塌的牆下。{@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA|奧爾威克斯}因缺水而瀕臨死亡，並且處於{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態。當角色們搜尋院子時，他們聽到他在瓦礫下呼救。如果角色們解救了奧爾威克斯，他請求加入他們的隊伍，直到他找到避難所。

english: Orvex serves as scribe and translator for the Red Wizards. He's a pragmatic, balding human in his early forties who serves the Red Wizards because, as he puts it, they pay well. {@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA|Orvex} has the statistics of a {@creature spy}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 奧弗克斯作為紅袍法師的抄寫員和翻譯。他是一個實際的、禿頂的四十多歲人類，之所以為紅袍法師服務，正如他所說，是因為紅袍法師支付的報酬豐厚。{@creature Orvex Ocrammas|ToA|奧爾威克斯}具有{@creature spy||間諜}的具體數值，並有以下變化：

english: Orvex is neutral.
zh_tw: 奧弗克斯是中立的。

english: He has 3 hit points remaining and 3 levels of {@condition exhaustion} (see {@condition exhaustion||appendix A} of the {@i Player's Handbook} for {@condition exhaustion} effects).
zh_tw: 他還剩3點生命值，並處於3層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態（關於{@condition exhaustion||力竭}效果，請參閱{@i 玩家手冊}的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}）。

english: He speaks Common and Grung.
zh_tw: 他講通用語和格朗格語。

english: If the characters befriend Orvex, he can help them forge a truce with any surviving Red Wizards. Orvex can translate Old Omuan, and his studies of Omu's carvings taught him the legend of the nine trickster gods (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}"), which Orvex is happy to recount once he's fully healed and rested.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與奧弗克斯成為朋友，他可以幫助他們與任何倖存的紅袍法師達成停戰協議。奧弗克斯能夠翻譯古奧穆安語，他對奧穆的雕刻的研究教會了他關於九位騙子神的傳說（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"），一旦他完全康復和休息，奧弗克斯很樂意複述這個故事。

english: Despite the obvious risks, Orvex looks forward to exploring more of the city and unlocking its secrets. If he's still with the characters when they retrieve all nine puzzle cubes, he jumps at the chance to accompany them on their descent into the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 儘管存在明顯的風險，奧弗克斯仍然期待著更深入地探索這座城市並揭開它的秘密。如果他在角色們收集到全部九個謎題立方體時仍然與他們在一起，他會迫不及待地抓住機會陪同他們一起進入九神之墓。

english: 3. Kubazan's Shrine
zh_tw: 3. 庫巴贊的神龕

english: A rectangular pool of murky water stretches before this vine-draped shrine. Rope bridges that once spanned the water float on the surface, tangled with other debris. The shards of a toppled monolith form stepping stones to the middle of the pool, where a statue of a stone frog rises above the water.
zh_tw: 一個長方形的水池，池水渾濁，前方是這個藤蔓纏繞的聖地。曾經橫跨水面的繩橋現在漂浮在水面上，與其他雜物糾纏在一起。一座倒塌的石碑碎片形成了通往水池中央的墊腳石，那裡有一座石蛙雕像從水面升起。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Kubazan (represented as a {@creature froghemoth|VGM}) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神庫巴贊（表現為一個{@creature froghemoth|VGM|沼喉怪}）的聖地包含了進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題立方體之一。

english: 3A. Froghemoth Pool
zh_tw: 3A. 巨蛙池

english: This pool is 6 feet deep and clouded with mud and algae. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots the eyestalk of a {@creature froghemoth|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) sticking out of the pool. The froghemoth attacks anyone who disturbs the water or tries to reach the shrine, heaving itself from the pool to pursue prey.
zh_tw: 這個水池深6尺，渾濁不清，滿是泥土和藻類。一個成功透過{@dc 14}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的人物會發現水池中伸出一根{@creature froghemoth|VGM|沼喉怪}的眼梗（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。蛙魔會攻擊任何擾動水面或試圖接近祭壇的人，從水池中躍出追逐獵物。

english: The shattered monolith is slippery with moss, and the rotted rope bridges sink as soon as anyone steps on them. Any character who jumps across the stepping stones must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check to keep from falling in the pool.
zh_tw: 破碎的紀念碑上長滿了滑膩的青苔，腐爛的繩橋一旦有人踏上去就會下沉。任何試圖跳躍過墊腳石的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定，以避免掉入池中。

english: Stone Key
zh_tw: 石鑰匙

english: A character who examines the mouth of the frog statue spots a stone key set into an indentation on the statue's tongue. This key opens the locked gate at area 3B.
zh_tw: 一個檢查青蛙雕像嘴巴的角色會發現一個石鑰匙嵌入雕像舌頭上的一個凹槽裡。這把鑰匙可以開啟區域3B的鎖著的門。

english: 3B. Locked Gate
zh_tw: 3B. 上鎖的大門

english: Carved into the lintel above this locked gate is an inscription written in Old Omuan: "Kubazan urges us to tread without fear and to give back as much as we take." A character who heeds the words gains some insight into the trial that awaits in area 3C.
zh_tw: 這個鎖著的門上方的橫樑上刻著用古奧穆安語寫的銘文："庫巴贊敦促我們無畏前行，並給予我們所取的同樣多。"留意這些話的角色會獲得一些關於區域3C中等待的考驗的洞察。

english: To pick the lock, a character with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity check. Whether the check succeeds or fails, a {@spell glyph of warding} spell targets the character with a {@spell fear} spell (save {@dc 15}). The glyph doesn't trigger if the door is unlocked using the stone key from the froghemoth pool (area 3A).
zh_tw: 要撬開這把鎖，一名攜帶{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}的角色必須透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定。無論檢定成功與否，一道{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術都會以{@spell fear||恐懼術}（豁免{@dc 15}）鎖定該角色。若使用來自蛙魔池（區域3A）的石鑰匙開門，該刻紋不會觸發。

english: 3C. Chamber of Bravery
zh_tw: 3C. 勇敢之室
