english: Steps descend to a ledge overlooking a pit of sharpened stakes. An alcove on the far wall holds a pedestal with a stone cube resting on it. A relief carved into the back of the alcove shows a monstrous frog with tentacles fighting a crane. Wooden beams radiate from the walls at floor height, with four-foot gaps between them. Carved frog heads extrude from the walls above the beams.
zh_tw: 臺階向下通往一個俯瞰著佈滿鋒利木樁的坑洞的壁架。遠處牆上的凹室裡有一個基座，上面放著一個石制立方體。凹室背面上雕刻著一隻與鶴戰鬥的帶有觸手的怪物青蛙浮雕。木樑從牆面地板高度處輻射開來，木樑之間有四尺的間隔。牆上方的樑上方突出雕刻的青蛙頭。

english: The wall relief shows Kubazan (a {@creature froghemoth|VGM}) fighting Papazotl (an {@creature eblis|ToA}). An inscription written in Old Omuan tells how Kubazan earned his tentacles from the god Ubtao (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 牆上的浮雕展示了庫巴贊（一個 {@creature froghemoth|VGM|沼喉怪}）與帕帕扎圖（一個 {@creature eblis|ToA|魔王鶴}）戰鬥的場景。一段用古奧姆語寫的銘文講述了庫巴贊是如何從神烏巴託那裡獲得他的觸手（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。

english: Spiked Pit
zh_tw: 尖刺陷坑

english: The pit is 30 feet deep. A creature that falls into the pit takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall and must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, {@dice 1d4} stakes impale the creature for an additional {@dice 1d6} piercing damage per stake.
zh_tw: 這個坑深30尺。任何掉入坑中的生物會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）鈍擊傷害，並且必須進行一次{@dc 12}敏捷豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，{@dice 1d4}根木樁會刺穿該生物，每根木樁額外造成{@dice 1d6}穿刺傷害。

english: Wooden Beams
zh_tw: 木樑

english: A creature can move around the perimeter of the room by hopping from beam to beam. To hop onto a beam without falling, a creature must succeed on a Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, the DC of which is 5 + the distance (in feet) between the two beams. When weight is applied to and lifted from a beam, it retracts and becomes flush with the wall, preventing it from being used again. The beams reset to their original positions after all of them have retracted into the walls.
zh_tw: 生物可以透過從一個梁跳到另一個梁在房間的周邊移動。要跳上樑而不掉下來，生物必須在敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定上成功，檢定的難度等級是5加上（兩梁之間距離的尺數）。當重量施加到樑上並從樑上抬起時，梁會縮回並與牆面齊平，防止再次使用。所有梁都縮回牆面後，它們會重置到原始位置。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: If Kubazan's puzzle cube is removed from its pedestal, the gate in area 3B slams shut and locks. Checks made to pick the gate lock from within the shrine have disadvantage. At the same time, the carved frog heads on the walls open their mouths, belch forth enough poisonous gas to fill the shrine, and then close their mouths. Placing an object of equal weight to the puzzle cube (half a pound) on the pedestal prevents the gate closure and the release of gas.
zh_tw: 如果庫巴贊的謎題立方體從基座上移開，區域3B的門會猛然關閉並上鎖。在聖地內嘗試撬門鎖的檢定會有不利。同時，牆上雕刻的青蛙頭張開它們的嘴，吐出足以填滿聖地的有毒氣體，然後又閉上嘴。在基座上放置一個與謎題立方體重量相等的物體（半磅）可以防止門關閉和氣體釋放。

english: The gas fills the shrine for 1 minute, then dissipates. Any creature that starts its turn inside the shrine while the gas is present must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.
zh_tw: 氣體在神殿內持續存在1分鐘，然後消散。任何氣體存在時在神殿內開始其回合的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}體質豁免檢定，否則受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）毒素傷害。即使生物屏住呼吸或不需要呼吸，也會受到影響。

english: Map 3.2: Nine Shrines of Omu
zh_tw: 地圖3.2：奧穆的九個聖地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 4. Shagambi's Shrine
zh_tw: 4. 莎根比的神龕

english: A ruined shrine stands at the heart of this walled compound. Tall monoliths flank the entrance, decorated with images of a jaguar with six snakes sprouting from its shoulders. A stone door is set into the shrine beyond.
zh_tw: 在這個有圍牆的院子中心矗立著一座破敗的聖地。高大的石柱立在入口兩側，上面裝飾著一隻從肩膀上長出六條蛇的美洲豹的圖案。聖地內有一扇石門。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Shagambi (represented as a {@creature kamadan|ToA}) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神莎根比（表現為一個{@creature kamadan|ToA|六岐蛇豹}）的聖地包含了進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題立方體之一。

english: Two mated {@creature Kamadan|ToA|kamadans} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) use a cart at the back of the shrine as their lair. If they hear intruders approaching the shrine, the kamadans try to ambush them. The kamadans fight tooth and claw to protect their three young cubs. Kamadan cubs are noncombatants that look like baby leopards and grow to adult size within a year. The cubs' snakes won't sprout from their shoulders for another 6 months. Characters can capture the cubs and spend months trying to domesticate them, but the kamadans turn on their would-be masters once they reach adulthood in a year.
zh_tw: 兩隻配偶的{@creature Kamadan|ToA|六岐蛇豹}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）將聖地後面的一輛手推車作為他們的巢穴。如果他們聽到有入侵者接近聖地，六岐蛇豹會試圖伏擊他們。為了保護他們的三個幼崽，六岐蛇豹會用牙齒和爪子進行戰鬥。六岐蛇豹幼崽是非戰鬥人員，看起來像小豹子，並且在一年內長到成年大小。幼崽的蛇在另外6個月內不會從他們的肩膀上長出來。角色們可以捕獲幼崽，並花費數月時間嘗試馴養它們，但是一旦它們在一年後成年，六岐蛇豹會反抗那些想要成為它們主人的人。

english: 4A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 4A. 神殿入口

english: Flanking the entrance are two stone monoliths, each one 15 feet tall and draped in vines. Characters who examine the carvings uncover an inscription written in Old Omuan: "Shagambi teaches us to fight evil with honor." Reliefs on the monoliths show Shagambi overseeing Chultan warriors as they train with spears and swords.
zh_tw: 入口兩側各有兩座石碑，每座石碑高15尺，上面纏繞著藤蔓。檢查雕刻的角色會發現用古奧穆安語寫的銘文："莎根比教導我們用榮譽對抗邪惡。"石碑上的浮雕展示了莎根比監督楚爾特戰士們用矛和劍訓練的場景。

english: The door to the shrine is not locked, but it hangs heavy on its hinges. It weighs 600 pounds, so one or more characters must have a combined Strength score of 20 or higher to push it open.
zh_tw: 聖地的門沒有上鎖，但它沉重地懸掛在鉸鏈上。它重600磅，因此一個或多個角色必須具有總計20或更高的力量值才能將其推開。

english: 4B. Arena Gallery
zh_tw: 4B. 競技場長廊

english: When one or more characters enter the shrine, read:
zh_tw: 當一個或多個角色進入聖地時，閱讀：

english: Steps descend into a fifteen-foot-high, moss-covered room. Four statues of Omuan warriors stand in alcoves to either side, overlooking a barred gladiatorial pit in the floor. Each statue looks like it was meant to hold a spear, but its weapon is missing. On the far side of the chamber, a stone pedestal stands conspicuously bare. A relief on the wall behind it shows a monstrous jaguar with six snakes protruding from its shoulders, fighting off a squat, frog-like humanoid armed with a spear. To the left of the relief is a narrow tunnel with stairs leading down.
zh_tw: 臺階向下通往一個十五尺高、覆蓋著苔蘚的房間。四尊奧穆安戰士的雕像站在兩側的凹室中，俯瞰著地板上的一個有柵欄的角鬥場。每個雕像看起來都應該持有一支矛，但它的武器不見了。在房間的遠端，一個石制基座顯眼地空著。它後面的牆上的浮雕展示了一隻長有六條蛇從肩膀伸出的怪獸美洲豹，正在與一個手持矛的矮胖、類似青蛙的人形生物戰鬥。在浮雕的左側是一條帶有向下樓梯的狹窄隧道。

english: The statues can't be moved from their alcoves, and they are impervious to damage and spells. The tunnel in the north wall slopes down to the bottom of the gladiatorial pit (area 4D) and leads to a cellblock beyond (area 4C).
zh_tw: 這些雕像無法從它們的凹室中移動，它們對傷害和法術免疫。北牆上的隧道向下傾斜至角鬥場坑底（區域4D），並且通向另一邊的牢房區（區域4C）。

english: The wall relief depicts Shagambi (a kamadan) fighting Nangnang (a grung). Just below, an inscription written in Old Omuan tells the story of how Nangnang stole Shagambi's spear (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}"). With a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, a character notices tiny holes in the relief. Stuffing the holes with cloth or wax prevents the poison gas from penetrating through when the pedestal is disturbed (see below).
zh_tw: 牆壁浮雕描繪了莎根比（一種六岐蛇豹）與娜浪（一種格朗格）的戰鬥。正下方，一段用古歐姆語撰寫的銘文講述了娜浪如何偷走莎根比的矛的故事（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定，角色會注意到浮雕上微小的孔洞。用布料或蠟填塞這些孔洞可以防止平臺被擾動時毒氣滲透進來（見下文）。

english: Pedestal
zh_tw: 基座

english: The pedestal is a 4-foot-high stone cylinder that is impervious to damage and spells. Close inspection reveals a stone hatch in the top of it. Any physical attempt to force open the hatch releases a cloud of gas through the holes in the wall relief. The gas fills a 15-foot cube directly in front of the mural. Creatures in the area must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@dice 4d6}) poison damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The gas affects a creature even if it holds its breath or doesn't need to breathe. The gas doesn't linger.
zh_tw: 這個基座是一個4尺高的石柱，對傷害和法術免疫。仔細檢查會發現頂部有一個石制艙口。任何強行開啟艙口的物理嘗試都會透過壁雕上的孔釋放出一團氣體。這團氣體會填滿壁畫正前方15尺的立方體區域。區域內的生物必須進行一次{@dc 12}體質豁免，豁免失敗則受到14（{@dice 4d6}）點毒素傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。即使生物屏住呼吸或不需要呼吸，氣體仍會對其產生影響。氣體不會持續存在。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: To obtain Shagambi's puzzle cube, the characters must obtain the four bronze spears from the monsters in area 4C and place the weapons in the hands of the four warrior statues. Only by defeating the monsters in the gladiatorial pit can the spears be obtained. When all four spears are placed in the hands of the statues, read:
zh_tw: 為了獲得莎根比的謎題立方體，角色們必須從區域4C的怪物那裡獲得四支青銅長矛，並將這些武器放入四個戰士雕像的手中。只有擊敗角鬥場中的怪物，才能獲得長矛。當所有四支長矛都放入雕像手中時，閱讀：

english: The pedestal begins to turn on the spot, and an ornate stone cube corkscrews up from a hatch in its top.
zh_tw: 基座開始在原地旋轉，一個華麗的石制立方體從頂部的一個艙口螺旋上升起。

english: Once it rises up out of the pedestal, Shagambi's puzzle cube can be safely removed.
zh_tw: 一旦它從基座上升起，莎根比的謎題魔方就可以安全地移除。

english: 4C. Gladiator Cells
zh_tw: 4C. 角鬥士牢房

english: This hallway contains four cramped cells behind iron portcullises. The portcullises are locked in place and can be raised only with a {@spell knock} spell or by stepping on the pressure plate in area 4D. Each cell contains a {@creature Clay Gladiator|ToA|Chultan gladiator} made of painted clay. Each gladiator is a golem-like creature with a bronze spear in one hand and a wooden shield in the other. It has the statistics of a {@creature gladiator}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 這個走廊裡有四個狹小的牢房，後面是鐵製的吊閘門。吊閘門被固定在位，只能透過{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或者踩在區域4D的壓力板上才能升起。每個牢房裡都有一個由彩繪粘土製成的{@creature Clay Gladiator|ToA|楚爾特角鬥士}。每個角鬥士都是類似魔像的生物，一隻手拿著青銅長矛，另一隻手拿著木盾。它具有{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}的具體數值，並有以下變化：

english: The {@creature clay gladiator|ToA} is an unaligned construct with an Armor Class of 17 (natural, shield).
zh_tw: {@creature clay gladiator|ToA|粘土角鬥士}是一個無陣營的構裝生物，具有17（天生，盾牌）的護甲等級。

english: It has a climbing speed of 30 feet and can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
zh_tw: 它具有30尺的攀爬速度，並且能夠攀爬困難的表面，包括在天花板上倒掛著，無需進行屬性檢定。

english: It is immune to poison damage as well as the {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, and {@condition poisoned} conditions. It doesn't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe.
zh_tw: 它對毒素傷害以及{@condition charmed||魅惑}、{@condition frightened||恐懼}和{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態免疫。它不需要進食、飲水、睡眠或呼吸。

english: It doesn't speak.
zh_tw: 它不會說話。

english: It can't make ranged attacks, and it can't be disarmed.
zh_tw: 它不能進行遠端攻擊，也不能被解除武裝。

english: A {@creature clay gladiator|ToA} fights if attacked or when called to the gladiatorial pit (area 4D). If reduced to 0 hit points outside of the gladiatorial pit, the gladiator disappears along with its possessions, reappears in its cell at full health with spear and shield in hand, and returns to the gladiatorial pit if it can. If defeated in the gladiatorial pit, the gladiator leaves its spear behind before reforming in its cell. The spear can then be taken back to area 4B. If taken from the shrine, the spear disappears and reappears in the gladiator's hand.
zh_tw: 如果被攻擊或被召喚到角鬥場（區域4D），一個{@creature clay gladiator|ToA|粘土角鬥士}會進行戰鬥。如果在角鬥場之外減少到0生命值，角鬥士及其所有物會消失，並以滿生命值的狀態重新出現在其牢房中，手持長矛和盾牌，並儘可能返回到角鬥場。如果在角鬥場中被擊敗，角鬥士會留下長矛，然後在牢房中重新形成。然後，長矛可以被帶回區域4B。如果從聖地拿走，長矛會消失，並重新出現在角鬥士的手中。

english: The gladiators can go anywhere in the shrine but can't leave it. When the shrine has no other creatures inside it, the gladiators return to their cells, and the portcullises drop behind them.
zh_tw: 角鬥士可以在聖地的任何地方活動，但不能離開它。當聖地內沒有其他生物時，角鬥士會返回他們的牢房，吊閘門將在他們身後落下。

english: 4D. Gladiatorial Pit
zh_tw: 4D. 角鬥場坑

english: This pit is 20 feet deep, and its bars are spaced 2 feet apart. A Medium or smaller creature can easily slip between the bars, but the walls of the pit are too smooth to climb without the aid of climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 這個坑深20尺，其柵欄間隔2尺。一箇中等體型或更小的生物可以輕鬆地從柵欄之間溜過，但是沒有攀爬裝備或魔法的幫助，坑壁太光滑，無法攀爬。

english: Six-foot-high archways stand opposite one another at the bottom of the pit, the floor of which is one large pressure plate. Applying 50 pounds or more to the floor causes the portcullises in area 4C to rise with a loud clatter, whereupon the clay gladiators emerge from their cells and quickly make their way to the pit.
zh_tw: 在坑的底部，相對而立的是六尺高的拱門，坑底是一個大型壓力板。對地板施加50磅或更多的壓力會導致區域4C的吊閘門伴隨著巨大的噪音升起，隨後粘土角鬥士從他們的牢房中出現，並迅速前往坑。

english: 5. Great Rift
zh_tw: 5. 大裂谷

english: Tumbledown ruins cling to the lip of a rift overlooking a lake of bubbling lava.
zh_tw: 搖搖欲墜的廢墟緊貼在一個裂谷的邊緣，裂谷俯瞰著一個冒著氣泡的熔岩湖。

english: A creature that falls from the top of the cliff into the lava takes 70 ({@dice 20d6}) bludgeoning damage from the fall and 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage from the lava. A creature that starts its turn in the lava takes the fire damage again.
zh_tw: 從懸崖頂部掉入巖漿的生物會因為墜落受到70（{@dice 20d6}）點鈍擊傷害，並從巖漿中受到55（{@dice 10d10}）點火焰傷害。在巖漿中開始其回合的生物將再次受到火焰傷害。

english: Sacrifice of Fire
zh_tw: 火焰的獻祭

english: The first time the characters arrive, they encounter a small vegepygmy tribe preparing to sacrifice a {@creature grung|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) to the rift. The grung, Imbok, is bound with vines and {@condition restrained}. As the grung struggles, the vegepygmies encircle him and perform a strange, ritualistic dance. Unless the characters intervene, the vegepygmies roll their captive off the edge of the cliff. A couple of vegepygmies leap off after him, caught in the throes of devotion.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次到達時，他們遇到了一個小型蔬菜皮格米族群，正準備將一個{@creature grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）獻祭給裂谷。這個格朗格，名叫因博克，被藤蔓捆綁並處於{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態。當格朗格掙扎時，蔬菜皮格米人圍繞著他進行一種奇怪的儀式性舞蹈。除非角色們進行幹預，否則蔬菜皮格米人會將他們的俘虜滾下懸崖邊。幾個蔬菜皮格米人在奉獻的狂熱中也跟著跳了下去。

english: The tribe consists of one {@creature vegepygmy chief|VGM}, eight {@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|vegepygmies}, and the chief's {@creature thorny|VGM} pet. Statistics for all these creatures appear in {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}. Their grung captive is the beloved one hundred and eightieth son of the grung chieftain {@creature Yorb|ToA}. If the characters free Imbok, he grovels at their feet. He doesn't speak Common but promises to bury his benefactors in gold if they escort him back to his father's shrine ({@area area 18|277|x}). Imbok's promise is empty, but he has nothing else to offer his saviors.
zh_tw: 這個部落由一個{@creature vegepygmy chief|VGM|孢子人領主}、八個{@creature Vegepygmy|VGM|孢子人們}以及族長的{@creature thorny|VGM|荊棘獸}寵物組成。所有這些生物的具體數值出現在{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}中。他們的格朗格俘虜是格朗格酋長{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}深受愛戴的第一百八十個兒子。如果角色們釋放了因博克，他會跪在他們的腳邊。他不會說通用語，但承諾如果能護送他回到他父親的聖地({@area 區域18|277|x})，他會用金子將他的恩人埋葬。因博克的承諾是空洞的，但他沒有其他東西可以提供給他的救星。

english: 6. Moa's Shrine
zh_tw: 6. 莫阿的神殿

english: This shrine perches on a pinnacle of rock high above the great rift ({@area area 5|21a|x}).
zh_tw: 這個聖地位於高聳的大裂谷上方的岩石尖塔上（{@area 區域5|21a|x}）。

english: A column of rock rises 200 feet above the lava. A walled ruin overgrown with palms perches on the summit.
zh_tw: 一根岩石柱高聳在熔岩上方200尺。一座被棕櫚樹覆蓋的圍牆廢墟坐落在山頂。

english: At its narrowest point, the gulf between the shrine and the rest of the city is 60 feet wide. Characters with rope and grappling hooks can throw a line across the gap.
zh_tw: 在最狹窄的地方，神廟與城市其他部分之間的裂谷寬60尺。攜帶繩索和抓鉤的角色可以拋擲繩索越過這個缺口。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Moa (represented by a jaculi) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神莫阿（由一個幻色蛇代表）的神廟包含了進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題方塊之一。

english: 6A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 6A. 神龕入口

english: Palm trees grow in front of this squat building, and worn steps ascend to an archway that forms the entrance. Reliefs of coiled serpents flank the entrance.
zh_tw: 這座低矮的建築前生長著棕櫚樹，磨損的臺階通向一個形成入口的拱門。拱門兩側是盤繞的蛇形浮雕。

english: Four {@creature Jaculi|ToA|jaculis} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) lurk in the courtyard, using their camouflage to hide while coiled around tree trunks. If the characters enter the courtyard, the jaculis spring forth and attack.
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature Jaculi|ToA|幻色蛇}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）潛伏在庭院中，利用它們的偽裝能力在樹幹周圍盤旋隱藏。如果角色們進入庭院，幻色蛇就會突然出擊並攻擊。

english: 6B. Trapped Passage
zh_tw: 6B. 陷阱通道

english: The walls of this rubble-strewn corridor are carved with serpents, and arrow slits are spaced along them every 5 feet. Cobwebs fill the arrow slits and hang like drapes from the corridor ceiling. Above the entrance, a stone plaque bears a cuneiform message.
zh_tw: 這個佈滿碎石的走廊牆壁上雕刻著蛇形圖案，每隔5尺就有一個箭縫。蛛網填滿了箭縫，像窗簾一樣懸掛在走廊的天花板上。在入口上方，一塊石碑上刻有楔形文字的資訊。

english: The message on the plaque is written in Old Omuan and reads, "Moa teaches us that secrets hide the truth." Explorers must heed this message to find the shrine's puzzle cube.
zh_tw: 匾額上的文字是用古老的歐姆語寫成，上面寫著："莫阿教我們，秘密隱藏著真相。" 探險家必須注意這條資訊，才能找到神殿的謎題立方體。

english: The arrow slits are 6 inches wide, 2 feet tall, and 1 foot deep. A character who peers through an arrow slit after clearing out the cobwebs can see into the room beyond (area 6D), provided the character has a light source or can see in the dark.
zh_tw: 箭窗寬6吋，高2尺，深1尺。一個角色在清除掉蜘蛛網後透過箭窗窺視，可以看到隔壁房間（區域6D），前提是該角色有光源或者能在黑暗中視物。

english: Pits
zh_tw: 陷坑

english: Three covered pits are spaced along the corridor in the positions marked X on the shrine map. Their covers remain locked until the puzzle cube is moved from the pedestal in area 6C. Thereafter, a creature stepping on a pit cover causes it to swing open and falls in unless it succeeds on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. Each pit is 10 feet deep and has a patch of {@hazard green slime} (see {@hazard green slime||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) at the bottom of it.
zh_tw: 沿著走廊在神殿地圖上標記為X的位置分佈著三個隱蔽的陷坑。這些坑蓋會保持鎖定狀態，直到謎題方塊從6C區域的基座上移開。此後，任何生物踏上坑蓋都會使其擺動開啟並墜落其中，除非它成功透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免。每個陷坑深10尺，底部有一片{@hazard green slime||綠軟泥}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard green slime||第五章}）。

english: A character who searches the hallway floor for traps finds a pit trap with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The lids are cleverly constructed and can be jammed shut only by using magic such as an {@spell arcane lock} spell.
zh_tw: 一名在走廊地板上搜尋陷阱的角色，若成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，可發現一個陷坑陷阱。這些蓋子構造巧妙，只能透過使用如 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 等法術才能將其卡住關閉。

english: 6C. Chamber of Deception
zh_tw: 6C. 欺騙之室

english: In the middle of this room, a stone cube rests on a plain stone pedestal. Statues of twelve tribal warriors jut from the surrounding walls, aiming bows at the pedestal. The floor in front of the pedestal bears a mosaic depicting a monstrous serpent constricting a furious monkey. Moss obscures much of the detail.
zh_tw: 在這個房間的中央，一個石質立方體放置在一個普通的石質基座上。十二尊部落戰士的雕像從周圍的牆壁突出，弓箭瞄準著基座。基座前的地面上有一個描繪著一隻巨大的蛇纏繞著一隻憤怒的猴子的馬賽克。苔蘚遮蓋了大部分細節。

english: The mosaic shows Moa (a {@creature jaculi|ToA}) fighting Wongo (a {@creature su-monster|ToA}). If a character peels the moss aside, they uncover the following message written in Old Omuan: "Death rewards a thief deceived. Truth comes from the serpent's mouth." Another inscription encircles the floor and tells the story of how Moa upheld the truth to Ubtao and betrayed Wongo's trust (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 馬賽克描繪了莫阿（一個{@creature jaculi|ToA|幻色蛇}）與望戈（一個{@creature su-monster|ToA|蘇怪}）戰鬥的場景。如果一個角色把苔蘚剝開，他們會揭露用古老的歐姆語寫成的以下資訊：'死亡獎賞欺騙的小偷。真理來自蛇的口。'另一段銘文環繞著地板，講述了莫阿如何向烏布陶堅守真理並背叛瞭望戈的信任（見'{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}'）。

english: The puzzle cube on the pedestal is illusory, though it feels real to the touch. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of illusion magic around the cube. When taken from the shrine, it vanishes in a puff of green smoke. If a creature removes the puzzle cube from the pedestal or tries to damage one of the statues, the archers animate and open fire on all creatures in the room. The archers can detect the presence of creatures even if they are {@condition invisible}. Before they open fire, arrows magically appear in their bows. The archers remain animated for 1 hour, after which they revert to their inanimate state.
zh_tw: 基座上的謎題立方體是幻影，儘管觸控起來感覺很真實。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示立方體周圍的幻術魔法氣息。當它從神殿中被拿走時，它會在一團綠色的煙霧中消失。如果一個生物從基座上移除謎題立方體或試圖破壞其中一個雕像，弓箭手就會活化並朝房間裡的所有生物開火。弓箭手甚至能探測到{@condition invisible||隱形}生物的存在。在他們開火之前，箭矢會神奇地出現在他們的弓上。弓箭手保持活化狀態1小時，之後他們恢復到無生命的狀態。

english: The twelve archers act on initiative count 20. On its turn, a statue shoots one arrow ({@hit 6} to hit). A creature hit by an arrow takes 5 ({@dice 1d8 + 1}) piercing damage. Each statue is a Medium object with AC 17; 30 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 十二學會的弓箭手在先攻值20時行動。在它的回合，雕像射出一支箭（命中{@hit 6}）。被箭命中的生物受到5（{@dice 1d8 + 1}）穿刺傷害。每個雕像是AC 17的中型物體；30生命值；對來自非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫；並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Characters who search the walls for secret doors find one on each side of the entrance tunnel with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 在搜尋牆壁尋找秘密門的角色，如果成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，可以在入口隧道的每一側找到一扇秘密門。

english: 6D. Western Secret Room
zh_tw: 6D. 西側密室

english: A statue of a coiled serpent dominates this web-filled room. The statue is missing its head, which lies broken on the floor next to a stone cube.
zh_tw: 一個盤曲的蛇雕像主宰著這個佈滿蛛網的房間。雕像的頭部缺失，它碎裂在地板上，旁邊是一個石質立方體。

english: The statue is 7 feet tall without its head. The puzzle cube lying on the floor next to the head's shattered remains is fake and vanishes in a puff of green smoke when taken from the shrine. Bringing it into area 6C activates the statues there.
zh_tw: 雕像沒有頭部時高7尺。躺在頭部破碎殘骸旁邊的謎題立方體是假的，當它從神殿中被拿走時，會在一團綠色的煙霧中消失。將它帶到區域6C會啟用那裡的雕像。

english: 6E. Eastern Secret Room
zh_tw: 6E. 東部密室

english: A large statue of a coiled serpent dominates this web-filled room. Clutched in the statue's jaws is a stone cube.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的盤曲蛇雕像主宰著這個佈滿蛛網的房間。雕像的口中緊握著一個石質立方體。

english: The statue is 8 feet tall and harmless.
zh_tw: 雕像高8尺，並且無害。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: The cube is Moa's puzzle cube. It can be removed from the statue's jaws and the shrine safely.
zh_tw: 這個立方體是莫阿的謎題立方體。它可以安全地從雕像的口中移除。

english: 7. Fallen Tree
zh_tw: 7. 倒下的樹

english: A fallen tree bridges the river ahead. Its trunk is wider than a man and stretches more than 100 feet. On both banks lie ruined buildings.
zh_tw: 一棵倒下的樹橫跨前方的河流。它的樹幹比一個人還要寬，延伸超過100尺。河的兩岸都躺著廢墟建築。

english: An elderly tabaxi hunter named {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} ambushes the characters if they try to ford the river here.
zh_tw: 一個名叫{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}的老年斑貓獵人會在角色試圖在這裡涉水過河時伏擊他們。

english: The fallen trunk is wide enough for two Medium creatures to pass each other safely. Under the tree, the water churns toward the falls 200 feet downriver. A creature that tumbles into the river or tries to swim across it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to reach the bank. If the check fails, the current pulls the creature toward the falls at a speed of 50 feet per round.
zh_tw: 倒下的樹幹足夠寬，可以讓兩個中型生物安全地交錯透過。在樹下，河水向200尺下游的瀑布翻湧。一個掉入河中或試圖遊過河的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能到達岸邊。如果檢定失敗，水流會以每輪50尺的速度將生物拉向瀑布。

english: Bag of Nails
zh_tw: 釘包

english: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} yearns for a hunter's death. Senility has taken hold, and now he sees all creatures as his prey.
zh_tw: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}渴望得到一個獵人的死亡。衰老已經控制了他，現在他把所有生物都當作他的獵物。

english: When the characters arrive, {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} is hiding in a ruined building on the east bank of the river, 150 feet from the fallen tree. To spot him, a character must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. When a character crosses the bridge, {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} opens fire. After each shot, he leaps across the rooftops to a new firing position and tries to hide.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}藏在河東岸一棟廢墟建築中，距離倒下的樹150尺。要發現他，角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 22}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。當角色穿過橋樑時，{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}會開火。每次射擊後，他會躍過屋頂到一個新的射擊位置並嘗試躲藏。

english: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} is a tabaxi {@creature assassin}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}是一個斑貓人族的{@creature assassin||刺客}，有以下變化：

english: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} is chaotic neutral.
zh_tw: {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}是混亂中立。

english: He has a climbing speed of 20 feet and the Feline Agility trait (see below).
zh_tw: 他有20尺的攀爬速度和貓科動物敏捷特性（見下文）。

english: He has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 他具有達到60尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: He knows Common, Dwarvish, and thieves' cant.
zh_tw: 他懂得通用語、矮人語和盜賊暗語。

english: As an action, he can make a melee weapon attack with his claws ({@hit 3} to hit), dealing {@dice 1d4} slashing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，他可以用他的爪擊進行一次近戰武器攻擊（命中加值為{@hit 3}），命中時造成{@dice 1d4}揮砍傷害。

english: He carries a longbow instead of a crossbow (range 150/600 ft.).
zh_tw: 他攜帶的是長弓而不是弩（射程150/600尺）。

english: Feline Agility
zh_tw: 貓之迅捷

english: When the tabaxi moves on its turn in combat, it can double its speed until the end of the turn. Once it uses this trait, the tabaxi can't use it again until it moves 0 feet on one of its turns.
zh_tw: 當斑貓人（斑貓人）在其戰鬥回合中移動時，它可以將其速度加倍，直到回合結束。一旦使用了這一特性，斑貓人在之後的回合中不能再使用，直到它在某個回合中移動0尺。

english: If {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} drops to fewer than half his maximum hit points, he surrenders to his enemies, leads them to his lair (a ruined basement), and offers them stew in a show of friendship. While distributing bowls of stew, he explains that he came to Omu to find a fabled treasure called the Navel of the Moon (see {@area chapter 5|478|x}). He hoped to use its alleged powers to find his lost son, but he has long since given up hope of ever finding it. A successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check reveals that the tabaxi has no intention of letting the characters leave his domain alive. He laces the stew with {@item midnight tears||midnight tears (ingested)} (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}的生命值降至最大生命值的一半以下，他會向敵人投降，帶領他們前往他的巢穴（一個廢墟地下室），並以友誼的名義提供燉菜。在分發燉菜碗時，他解釋說，他來到奧穆是為了尋找傳說中的寶藏——月之臍（見{@area 第五章|478|x}）。他希望利用其傳說中的力量找到他失蹤的兒子，但他早已放棄了找到它的希望。成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Insight||洞悉}）檢定揭示，這個斑貓人無意讓角色們活著離開他的領地。他在燉菜中加入了{@item midnight tears||午夜之淚（攝入）}（見{@i 城主指南}第8章的"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who search through the tabaxi hunter's lair find five doses of {@item midnight tears||midnight tears (ingested)} in a hollow gourd and enough gear to make an explorer's pack.
zh_tw: 角色們在斑貓獵人的巢穴中搜尋時，會在一個空心葫蘆裡找到五劑{@item midnight tears||午夜之淚（攝入）}，以及足夠的裝備來製作一個探險家揹包。

english: 8. Unkh's Shrine
zh_tw: 8. 安珂的神龕

english: Swirly carvings decorate two obelisks at the entrance to this compound. An overgrown courtyard lies under the shade of tall palms. Stone doors seal the entrance to a windowless shrine, with a smaller ruin standing nearby.
zh_tw: 兩個方尖碑上裝飾著螺旋狀的雕刻，它們位於這個院落的入口處。一個雜草叢生的庭院位於高大的棕櫚樹蔭下。石門封閉著一個沒有窗戶的神殿入口，旁邊有一個較小的廢墟。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Unkh (represented by a flail snail) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神安珂（由一個鏈錘蝸牛代表）的神殿包含進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題立方體之一。

english: 8A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 8A. 神殿入口

english: Above the doors is written an inscription in Old Omuan: "Unkh urges us to contrast all options before acting." Unkh's priests were contemplative but prone to indecision. Their message is a clue to solving the shrine's puzzle. The doors to the shrine are not locked and hang heavy on their hinges. Each door weighs 600 pounds, so one or more characters need a combined Strength score of 20 or higher to heave them open.
zh_tw: 門上方用古老的歐姆語寫著一段銘文："安珂敦促我們在行動前對比所有選擇。"安珂的祭司們深思熟慮，但容易猶豫不決。他們的資訊是解決神殿謎題的線索。神殿的門沒有上鎖，懸掛在沉重的鉸鏈上。每扇門重600磅，因此一個或多個角色需要合計力量值20或更高才能把它們推開。

english: 8B. Ruined Workshop
zh_tw: 8B. 毀壞的工作室

english: The roof of this workshop collapsed long ago, and now a thick mass of plants grows from the rubble. Through the moss, you see hundreds of iron keys hanging from hooks on the wall. Some are bent and broken, while others are rusted beyond repair. The rest look serviceable.
zh_tw: 這個車間的屋頂很久以前就塌了，現在一堆濃密的植物從廢墟中生長出來。透過苔蘚，你看到牆上掛著數百把鐵鑰匙。有些彎曲破損，有些鏽蝕得無法修復。其餘的看起來還可以使用。

english: One of the keys unlocks the pedestal in area 8C. If the characters know which key to look for, they find it after a few minutes of searching.
zh_tw: 其中一把鑰匙可以開啟區域8C的基座。如果角色知道要找哪把鑰匙，他們在搜尋幾分鐘後就可以找到它。

english: 8C. Chamber of Contemplation
zh_tw: 8C. 沉思之室

english: A statue of a giant snail looms before you. In place of antennae, it has five pseudopods ending in rocky clubs. Along the walls, six iron keys hang in small niches above stone plinths. Behind the statue, a carved pedestal in a wide alcove has a keyhole set into its base.
zh_tw: 一尊巨大的蝸牛雕像矗立在你面前。它沒有觸角，而是有五個以岩石製成的棍棒末端的偽足。沿著牆壁，六個鐵鑰匙掛在石制底座上方的小壁龕中。在雕像後面，一個寬闊壁龕中的雕刻基座在其底部設有一個鑰匙孔。

english: The statue is 9 feet tall and represents the trickster god Unkh as a flail snail. Three {@creature Ghast||ghasts} (undead Chultan tribesfolk) hide behind it. Each ghast has {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s symbol—a small blue triangle—tattooed on its forehead. The ghasts leap out from behind the statue and attack as soon as the characters enter the room.
zh_tw: 雕像高9尺，代表著詭神安珂，形象是一隻鏈錘蝸牛。三個{@creature Ghast||妖鬼}（不死的楚爾特部落族人）藏在它後面。每個食屍鬼的額頭上都紋有{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的象徵——一個小型藍色三角形。角色一進入房間，食屍鬼就從雕像後面跳出來攻擊。

english: None of the keys in this room unlock the pedestal. However, they are all similar in size. If a character takes all six keys and overlaps them, their overlapping teeth form a particular pattern. A search of the ruined workshop (area 8B) yields a single key that matches this pattern. This key unlocks the pedestal.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡的鑰匙都不能開啟基座。然而，它們的大小都相似。如果一個角色拿走全部六把鑰匙並將它們重疊，它們的重疊部分形成了一個特定的圖案。在廢墟車間（區域8B）的搜尋會發現一把與這個圖案匹配的單一鑰匙。這把鑰匙可以開啟基座。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: Unkh's puzzle cube is hidden inside the pedestal. If a character inserts the correct key in the keyhole and turns the key a quarter turn clockwise, the puzzle cube emerges from a concealed hatch:
zh_tw: 安珂的謎題立方體隱藏在基座內。如果一個角色將正確的鑰匙插入鑰匙孔並向順時針方向轉動四分之一圈，謎題立方體就會從一個隱蔽的艙口出現：

english: The pedestal grinds around on the spot. As it turns, an ornate stone cube corkscrews up from a concealed hatch in its surface.
zh_tw: 基座在原地旋轉。隨著它的轉動，一個華麗的石質立方體從其表面的隱蔽艙口螺旋升起。

english: The puzzle cube can now be safely removed from its pedestal.
zh_tw: 現在可以安全地將謎題魔方從基座上取下來了。

english: Using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, a character can pick the lock on the pedestal with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity check. A character who fails the check by 5 or more accidentally triggers the trap.
zh_tw: 使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}，角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}敏捷檢定來撬開基座上的鎖。檢定失敗且差值達到5或更高的角色會意外觸發陷阱。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: If a character inserts the wrong key into the keyhole at the base of the pedestal or botches an attempt to pick the lock, the shell of the flail snail statue emits dazzling rays of light that fire in all directions. When this happens, each creature in the shrine must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. Any creature that fails the save is struck by a ray and takes 33 ({@dice 6d10}) radiant damage. The statue can't emit rays while wholly or partly contained with an {@spell antimagic field}.
zh_tw: 如果角色將錯誤的鑰匙插入基座底部的鑰匙孔中，或嘗試撬鎖失敗，鏈枷蝸牛雕像的外殼會發出炫目的光線，並向四面八方射出。當這種情況發生時，神殿內的每個生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 敏捷豁免。任何未能透過豁免的生物將被光線擊中，並受到 33 點 ({@dice 6d10}) 的光耀傷害。如果雕像完全或部分處於 {@spell antimagic field||反魔法場} 中，則無法發射光線。

english: 9. Adventurers' Camp
zh_tw: 9. 冒險者營地

english: Amid the ruins is an abandoned campsite. Torn backpacks and rotted gear litter the ground around the three moldering tents. At the center of the camp, a scrap of dirty yellow cloth hangs from a crude wooden flagpole.
zh_tw: 在廢墟中有一個廢棄的營地。撕裂的揹包和腐爛的裝備散落在三個發黴的帳篷周圍的地面上。在營地的中心，一塊髒兮兮的黃色布片懸掛在一個簡陋的木製旗杆上。

english: This camp was made by the Company of the Yellow Banner, a party of explorers that arrived in Omu over six months ago. All the explorers are now dead. For further details, see {@area chapter 5|305|x}.
zh_tw: 這個營地是由黃旗冒險團（黃旗冒險團）建立的，這是一群探險者，他們在六個月前抵達奧穆（奧穆）。現在所有的探險者都已經死亡。更多詳情，請參閱{@area 第五章|305|x}。

english: Characters who search the area discover a moldy parchment caught in the lining of one of the tents; give the players a copy of handout 13 (see {@area appendix E|545|x}). The leader of the company, Lord Brixton, left this letter behind for a missing comrade. The rest of the camp has since been looted.
zh_tw: 搜尋該區域的角色發現了一張發黴的羊皮紙，它夾在其中一個帳篷的襯裡中；給玩家一份手冊13的副本（見{@area 附錄 E|545|x}）。公司的領袖，布里克斯頓勳爵，為一個失蹤的同伴留下了這封信。營地的其餘部分已經被洗劫一空。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters stay at the camp for an hour or more, a randomly determined Red Wizard (see "{@area Red Wizards of Thay|1e8|x}") stumbles upon them. The Red Wizard is accompanied by two mercenaries and is searching for Omuan shrines. A battle is certain unless the party has struck up an alliance with Zagmira, in which case the Red Wizard offers to join forces with the party.
zh_tw: 如果角色在營地停留一個或多個小時，一個隨機確定的紅袍法師（見'{@area 泰伊紅袍法師|1e8|x}'）會偶然遇到他們。這位紅袍法師由兩名僱傭兵陪同，正在尋找歐姆的神殿。除非隊伍與扎格米拉結成了聯盟，否則一場戰鬥是不可避免的，在這種情況下，紅袍法師提出與隊伍聯手。

english: 10. I'jin's Shrine
zh_tw: 10. 艾金的神龕

english: Cracked monoliths flank the entrance to this ruin. Saw-edged ferns grow in the courtyard between broken flagstones. A pair of stone doors provide entry to a large, flat-roofed ruin.
zh_tw: 破裂的獨石柱守護著這處廢墟的入口。鋸齒狀的蕨類植物生長在破碎的石板之間的庭院裡。一對石門通向一個大型的平頂廢墟。

english: The shrine to the trickster god I'jin (represented by an almiraj) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神艾金（由一隻獨角兔代表）的神殿包含進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題立方體之一。

english: 10A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 10A. 神龕入口

english: A harmless {@creature almiraj|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) lives in a burrow underneath the courtyard and goes to ground as soon as it senses intruders. When a character approaches the door, read:
zh_tw: 一隻無害的{@creature almiraj|ToA|獨角兔}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）居住在庭院下面的洞穴裡，一感覺到入侵者就會躲藏起來。當一個角色接近門時，閱讀：

english: Sculptural reliefs decorate the doors of this shrine. The carvings show a horned rabbit charging a small, feral-looking bear with sharp claws. A cuneiform message is etched above the doors.
zh_tw: 這個神殿的門上裝飾著雕塑浮雕。雕刻顯示一隻帶角的兔子正在向一隻長著鋒利爪子的小型野生熊發起衝鋒。門上方刻著一段楔形文字資訊。

english: The message is written in Old Omuan and reads, "I'jin teaches us to take the path least expected." I'jin taught her followers to live unpredictable lives, always changing course and never sticking to a plan. Characters would do well to heed her message inside the shrine.
zh_tw: 這條資訊是用古奧曼語寫的，內容為：'艾金教導我們走最不尋常的道路。' 艾金教導她的追隨者過不可預測的生活，總是改變路線，從不堅持計劃。角色們在神殿內應該好好聽從她的資訊。

english: Smaller inscriptions hidden underneath the carvings tell the story of how I'jin (an almiraj) earned the ire of Obo'laka (a zorbo) by spoiling a stew prepared for the god Ubtao. For details, see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}."
zh_tw: 雕刻下方隱藏的較小銘文講述了艾金（一隻獨角兔）如何因為破壞了為神烏布陶準備的燉湯，而激怒了奧博娜卡（一隻佐博怪）。詳細資訊見'{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}'。

english: 10B. Puzzle Floor
zh_tw: 10B. 謎題地板

english: A ten-foot-wide hallway strikes off into the gloom. Carved tiles depicting various beasts decorate the hallway floor.
zh_tw: 一條十尺寬的走廊延伸進黑暗中。走廊地面上鋪著雕刻著各種野獸圖案的瓷磚。

english: Give the players a copy of handout 14 in {@area appendix E|546|x}.
zh_tw: 給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|546|x}中的講義14副本。

english: Thirty-two tiles cover a 20-foot-long, 10-foot-wide stretch of the hallway. Each tile is 5 feet square, and the tiles are arranged in eight rows of four. The beasts depicted on the tiles are almiraj (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), dragonflies, eagles, giraffes, monkeys, tigers, warthogs, and zebras.
zh_tw: 三十二塊瓷磚覆蓋了走廊中一段20尺長、10尺寬的區域。每塊瓷磚都是5尺見方，瓷磚按照八行四列排列。瓷磚上描繪的野獸包括獨角兔（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）、蜻蜓、鷹、長頸鹿、猴子、老虎、疣豬和斑馬。

english: Poison Darts
zh_tw: 毒鏢

english: To cross the hallway safely, a character must avoid stepping on the same animal more than once. If more than 20 pounds of pressure is exerted on the wrong picture tile, four poison darts shoot from holes in the walls. Each dart makes a ranged weapon attack ({@hit 5} to hit) against a random target within 10 feet of the triggering tile. A single creature can be attacked by multiple darts. A creature hit by a dart takes 2 ({@dice 1d4}) piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 7 ({@dice 2d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A character can spot the holes with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Stuffing the holes with cloth or wax prevents the darts from launching.
zh_tw: 要安全透過走廊，角色必須避免多次踩踏同一動物圖案。如果在錯誤的圖案地磚上施加超過20磅的壓力，四枚毒鏢會從牆壁的孔洞中射出。每枚飛鏢對觸發地磚10尺內的隨機目標進行一次遠端武器攻擊（命中加值{@hit 5}）。單個生物可能被多枚飛鏢攻擊。被飛鏢命中的生物受到2（{@dice 1d4}）點穿刺傷害，並且必須成功透過{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，失敗則受到7（{@dice 2d6}）點毒素傷害，成功則傷害減半。角色可以透過成功的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定發現孔洞。用布或蠟堵住孔洞可以防止飛鏢發射。

english: Characters can avoid the trap by flying or teleporting across the hallway, or by using {@spell spider climb} spells to crawl along the walls or ceiling. The walls are too smooth to climb otherwise.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過飛行或傳送穿過走廊來避開陷阱，或者使用{@spell spider climb||蛛行術}法術沿著牆壁或天花板爬行。否則牆壁太光滑，無法攀爬。

english: Almiraj Tiles
zh_tw: 獨角兔瓷磚

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of abjuration magic around each almiraj tile. A creature that steps on an almiraj tile gains {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points. Once a tile has bestowed this benefit, it loses its magic until the next dawn. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on a tile has the same effect.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了每個獨角兔瓷磚周圍的防護魔法光環。一個生物踩在獨角兔瓷磚上會獲得{@dice 2d10}點臨時生命值。一旦一個瓷磚賦予了這個好處，它就會失去魔法，直到下一個黎明。對一個瓷磚施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}有相同的效果。

english: 10C. Labyrinth
zh_tw: 10C. 迷宮

english: Traps are riddled throughout this dusty maze. Hidden pressure plates in the floor are located in the positions marked X on the shrine map. If more than 20 pounds of pressure is exerted on a pressure plate, a sharpened axe blade swings from a hidden compartment in the ceiling. The blade makes a melee attack ({@hit 6} to hit) against any creature standing on the pressure plate. On a hit, the target takes 8 ({@dice 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage. A character searching for traps spots a pressure plate and ceiling compartment with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Wedging an iron spike or other object under a plate prevents the trap from triggering. Using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, a character can dismantle an axe blade with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. If the check fails by 5 or more, the trap triggers and makes an attack against the character with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 這座佈滿灰塵的迷宮中遍佈陷阱。地板上的隱藏壓力板位於聖壇地圖上標記為X的位置。如果壓力板上施加超過20磅的壓力，一個鋒利的斧刃會從天花板的隱藏隔間中擺出。斧刃對站在壓力板上的任何生物進行一次近戰攻擊（命中{@hit 6}）。命中時，目標受到8（{@dice 1d8 + 4}）揮砍傷害。一個角色透過成功的{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可以發現壓力板和天花板隔間。用鐵釘或其他物件楔入壓力板下方可以阻止陷阱觸發。使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}，角色可以透過成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定拆除斧刃。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，陷阱會觸發並對該角色進行一次具有劣勢的攻擊。

english: 10D. Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 10D. 謎題立方體

english: The doors of this chamber are not locked or trapped.
zh_tw: 這個房間的門沒有上鎖也沒有陷阱。

english: A shaft of natural light spills from a tiny square hole in the ceiling onto a carved stone pedestal. An ornate stone cube rests on its surface.
zh_tw: 一束自然光線從天花板上的一個小方洞中灑落，照在一個雕刻的石質基座上。一個裝飾華麗的石質立方體放置在其表面。

english: The cube is I'jin's puzzle cube. It is not trapped and can be safely removed from the pedestal.
zh_tw: 這個立方體是艾金的謎題立方體。它沒有陷阱，並且可以安全地從基座上移除。

english: 11. Chwinga Wagon
zh_tw: 11. 怯蘊阿靈貨車

english: An overturned wagon lies on the street ahead. Rotting flower petals litter the ground around it, and bees nest in its broken wheels. A freshly cut garland of jungle flowers hangs from the wagon's tongue.
zh_tw: 前方街道上躺著一輛翻倒的馬車。腐爛的花瓣散落在周圍地面上，馬車的破碎輪子裡築有蜜蜂巢。一串新近割下的叢林花環懸掛在馬車的舌杆上。

english: The wagon is home to a {@creature chwinga|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). The vegepygmies in the area are afraid of the chwinga and bring it gifts of flowers to appease its wrath. In truth, the chwinga is harmless.
zh_tw: 這輛四輪貨車是一個{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}的家（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。該區域的孢子人們害怕這個怯蘊阿靈，並帶來花朵作為禮物以平息它的憤怒。實際上，這個怯蘊阿靈是無害的。

english: The chwinga uses its magic to hide in a mossy stone disk underneath the cart (see "Queen's Decree" below). Characters who approach the cart notice that the area is unusually lush and full of life. If they leave an offering, the chwinga timidly presents itself to them. If not, the chwinga's natural curiosity forces it to shadow the characters and spy on them.
zh_tw: 怯蘊阿靈使用它的魔法隱藏在馬車下的一塊長滿苔蘚的石盤上（見下文的'女王的法令'）。接近馬車的角色會注意到這個區域異常地鬱鬱蔥蔥，充滿生機。如果他們留下供品，怯蘊阿靈會膽怯地向他們展示自己。如果沒有，怯蘊阿靈的天然好奇心會驅使它跟隨角色並監視他們。

english: The scent of honey foreshadows the chwinga's appearance, and harmless bees follow it around. It has a fascination for humanoid hair and is likely to latch onto a bearded dwarf or a character with curly tresses. While the chwinga accompanies the party, any vegepygmies that encounter the group flee as soon as they discern the chwinga's presence. The chwinga's affinity for the natural world keeps it from following characters into shrines or dungeons.
zh_tw: 蜂蜜的香味預示著怯蘊阿靈的出現，無害的蜜蜂跟隨在它周圍。它對類人生物的頭髮很感興趣，很可能會附著在一個長著鬍鬚的矮人或一個有著捲曲髮絲的角色身上。當怯蘊阿靈陪伴隊伍時，任何遇到的植物侏儒一旦察覺到怯蘊阿靈的存在就會立即逃跑。怯蘊阿靈對自然世界的親近使它不會跟隨角色進入神殿或地牢。

english: Queen's Decree
zh_tw: 女王的法令

english: If the characters look under the wagon, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們檢視馬車下面，閱讀：

english: A moss-covered stone disk lies half-buried in the mud underneath the wagon. Concentric rings of inscriptions cover its surface—some written in Common and others etched in jagged cuneiform.
zh_tw: 一塊長滿苔蘚的石盤半埋在馬車下的泥裡。它的表面覆蓋著同心圓環的銘文——有些用通用語書寫，其他的則用鋸齒狀的楔形文字刻成。

english: The tablet is a proclamation from an Omuan queen to her rivals in Mezro. The Mezroans couldn't read the Omuans' native script, so the tablet contains the same message written both in Common and Old Omuan. It reads, "Queen Napaka proclaims that the free people of Omu fear nothing. Brave new gods protect us, as Ubtao did before but does no longer. Omu will rise again, and Napaka shall reclaim all that is hers by right of conquest."
zh_tw: 這塊石碑是奧穆女王對她在梅茲羅的對手的宣言。梅茲羅人無法讀懂奧穆人的本土文字，因此這塊石碑包含了用通用語和古老奧穆語寫成的相同資訊。它寫道：'女王娜帕卡宣佈，奧穆的自由人民無所畏懼。勇敢的新神保護著我們，就像烏布陶以前做的那樣，但現在不再如此。奧穆將再次崛起，娜帕卡將根據征服的權利奪回屬於她的一切。'

english: Using the tablet, the characters can translate any message written in Old Omuan. The tablet is 3 feet in diameter and weighs 200 pounds, but characters with ink and parchment can copy it or take a rubbing. If the characters move the tablet from the cart, they end up taking the chwinga with it.
zh_tw: 使用這塊石碑，角色們可以翻譯任何用古老歐姆語寫成的資訊。石碑直徑3尺，重200磅，但有墨水和羊皮紙的角色可以抄寫它或拓印。如果角色們將石碑從馬車上移開，他們最終會帶著怯蘊阿靈一起帶走。

english: 12. Wongo's Shrine
zh_tw: 12. 望戈的神龕

english: Carvings of monkeys hanging by their tails decorate two cracked obelisks that stand before a shrine enclosed by broken walls. Past the obelisks is a courtyard filled with horsetails and arum lilies. Five archways open into darkness at the base of the ruin. Mounted above the central arch is a stone plaque bearing a cuneiform inscription.
zh_tw: 雕刻著懸掛尾巴的猴子的兩個裂開的方尖碑裝飾著一座被破碎牆壁包圍的神殿。方尖碑之後是一個庭院，庭院裡長滿了馬尾草和海芋百合。五個拱門在廢墟的底部通向黑暗。中央拱門上方安裝著一塊刻有楔形文字銘文的石匾。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Wongo (represented by a su-monster) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods. The inscription above the central arch is written in Old Omuan and reads as follows: "Better to be Wongo's friend than his enemy."
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神望戈（由一隻蘇怪代表）的神殿包含進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題立方體之一。中央拱門上方的銘文用古老的歐姆語寫成，內容如下："成為望戈的朋友比成為他的敵人更好。"

english: Portcullises
zh_tw: 吊閘門

english: Portcullises are raised into the lintels above four of the five entrance corridors. When a character claims the puzzle cube from area 12B, the portcullises slam shut and seal off these corridors. Each portcullis weighs 600 pounds and can be lifted by one or more characters with a combined Strength score of at least 20. A character can prevent a portcullis from dropping by jamming it with at least two iron spikes.
zh_tw: 四個入口走廊中的五個吊閘被提升到上方的門楣裡。當一個角色從區域12B拿到謎題魔方時，吊閘猛然關閉並封鎖了這些走廊。每個吊閘重600磅，可以透過一個或多個角色合力，只要他們的總力量值至少達到20，就能將其抬起。一個角色可以透過至少兩個鐵釘阻止吊閘下降。

english: 12A. Cracked Obelisks
zh_tw: 12A. 破裂的方尖碑

english: Creatures that pass between these two obelisks hear in their heads a cacophony of shrieking monkeys. The sound fades once the creatures move elsewhere. The shrieks are annoying but harmless. The obelisks are not magical, and their effect can't be dispelled.
zh_tw: 生物穿過這兩座方尖碑時，會在它們的腦海中聽到一群尖叫的猴子的喧鬧聲。一旦這些生物移動到其他地方，聲音就會消失。尖叫聲令人討厭但無害。方尖碑本身沒有魔法，它們的效果也無法被驅散。

english: 12B. Test of Friendship
zh_tw: 12B. 友誼的考驗

english: A ten-foot-tall stone statue of an evil-looking monkey balances on its tail atop a stone dais in the middle of this twenty-foot-high chamber. The statue's limbs are splayed, with hands and feet cupped. On the wall behind, a sculpted relief shows a monkey-like creature tearing into a giant serpent. Cuneiform inscriptions are carved above and below the relief. Four masks of painted stone protrude from the walls; they depict the heads of a lion, a {@creature zebra|ToA}, a boar, and a vulture.
zh_tw: 在這個二十尺高的房間中央，一個十尺高的邪惡猴子模樣的石雕站在一個石臺上，靠尾巴保持平衡。雕像的四肢張開，手心和腳心都呈杯狀。在背後的牆上，一個浮雕展示了一個類似猴子的生物正在撕裂一條巨大的蛇。浮雕的上方和下方刻有楔形文字。四幅彩繪石面具從牆上突出；它們分別描繪了獅子、斑馬（{@creature zebra|ToA|斑馬}）、野豬和禿鷲的頭部。

english: The wall relief shows the trickster god Wongo (a su-monster) fighting his hated enemy, Moa (a jaculi). Inscriptions in Old Omuan explain how Moa betrayed Wongo to the god Ubtao (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 牆上的浮雕展示了詭神望戈（一種蘇怪）與他憎恨的敵人莫阿（一種幻色蛇）戰鬥。古奧曼語的銘文解釋了莫阿如何背叛望戈給神烏布塔奧（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。

english: Statue and Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 雕像和謎題立方體

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of conjuration magic around the statue, which is easy to climb. A character who searches the statue's base uncovers the following inscription written in Old Omuan: "Wongo's friend knows where to pour the water." Wongo's "friend" (the vulture) can be identified by figuring out the logic puzzle written above the masks in the viewing corridors (area 12C).
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了雕像周圍的召喚魔法氣息，雕像很容易攀爬。一個角色如果搜尋雕像的基座，會發現用古老的歐姆語寫成的以下銘文：'望戈的朋友知道在哪裡倒水。'望戈的'朋友'（禿鷲）可以透過解開觀看走廊（區域12C）上方的面具所寫的邏輯謎題來識別。

english: When a character pours a pint or more of water into the statue's right hand or one of its cupped feet, the liquid sizzles and transforms into {@dice 1d3} {@creature Steam Mephit||steam mephits} that fight until destroyed. The statue can create up to six steam mephits in this fashion, after which no more mephits can be created until the next dawn. A steam mephit reduced to 0 hit points loses its form and disappears.
zh_tw: 當一個角色向雕像的右手或其中一隻杯狀腳倒入一品脫或更多的水時，液體會發出嘶嘶聲並轉化為{@dice 1d3}個{@creature Steam Mephit||蒸汽魔蝠}，它們會戰鬥直到被摧毀。雕像可以以這種方式最多創造出六個蒸汽魔蝠，之後直到下一個黎明之前不能再創造出更多的魔蝠。一個降至0生命值的蒸汽魔蝠會失去其形態並消失。

english: When a pint or more of water is poured into the statue's cupped left hand, Wongo's puzzle cube appears by magic on the statue's head. When the puzzle cube appears, the character who poured the water hears a snarling, disembodied voice say, "Take the prize and curse your friends, or fight my children to claim it. What is your choice?" If a character takes the puzzle cube, the masks on the walls deliver their curses (see area 12C). If no character takes the cube immediately, the portcullises slam shut over the entrance corridors in area 12A as four {@creature Su-monster|ToA|su-monsters} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are teleported into the room, clinging to the statue like startled children to a protective parent. The su-monsters leap down and attack. Once the su-monsters appear, taking the puzzle cube doesn't trigger the masks' curses. The summoned su-monsters are real, and their bodies don't disappear when they die.
zh_tw: 當向雕像捧著的左手倒入一品脫或更多的水時，望戈的謎題立方體會透過魔法出現在雕像的頭上。當謎題立方體出現時，倒水的角色會聽到一個咆哮的、無實體的聲音說："拿走獎品並詛咒你的朋友，或者與我的孩子們戰鬥以索取它。你的選擇是什麼？"如果一個角色拿走了謎題立方體，牆上的面具就會發出它們的詛咒（見區域12C）。如果沒有角色立即拿走立方體，吊閘門將在區域12A的入口走廊猛然關閉，同時四個{@creature Su-monster|ToA|蘇怪}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）被傳送到房間內，像受驚的孩子一樣緊緊抓住雕像，尋求保護父母的庇護。蘇怪跳下來並攻擊。一旦蘇怪出現，拿走謎題立方體就不會觸發面具的詛咒了。召喚出的蘇怪是真實的，它們的身體在死亡時不會消失。

english: Masks
zh_tw: 面具

english: Characters who examine the stone masks on the walls see that their eyes are open holes, allowing one to peer into the adjoining corridors (area 12C). The masks are extensions of the walls and can't be removed without destroying them.
zh_tw: 檢查牆壁上的石質面具的角色會看到它們的眼睛是開放的洞，允許人窺視相鄰的走廊（區域12C）。這些面具是牆壁的延伸，如果不破壞它們就無法移除。

english: 12C. Viewing Corridors
zh_tw: 12C. 觀景走廊

english: Each of these four corridors ends in a molded stone mask that juts into area 12B. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation magic around each mask. Inscriptions in Old Omuan are carved into the walls above the masks on this side.
zh_tw: 這四個走廊的每個盡頭都有一個凸入區域12B的模製石質面具。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了每個面具周圍的變形魔法氣息。古老的歐姆語銘文刻在面具上方的牆壁上。

english: {@b Lion Mask (L}). The inscription above this mask reads, "I ate one of the boar's friends." A character who peers through the mask sees a ray of blue light falling from the ceiling onto the right hand of the statue in area 12B.
zh_tw: {@b 獅子面具（L）}。這個面具上方的銘文寫著："我吃了野豬的一個朋友。"一個透過面具窺視的角色會看到一束藍光從天花板上照射在區域12B的雕像的右手上。

english: {@b Boar Mask (B}). The inscription above this mask reads, "The vulture is lucky to be alive." Through this mask, a character sees a ray of blue light falling onto the left foot of the statue in area 12B.
zh_tw: {@b 野豬面具 (B}。這個面具上方的銘文寫著："禿鷲很幸運還活著。"透過這個面具，一個角色會看到一束藍光照射在區域12B的雕像的左腳上。

english: {@b Zebra Mask (Z}). The inscription above this mask reads, "My only friend starved to death." Through this mask, a character sees a ray of blue light falling onto the right foot of the statue in area 12B.
zh_tw: {@b 斑馬面具（Z）}。這個面具上方的銘文寫著："我唯一的朋友餓死了。"透過這個面具，一個角色會看到一束藍光照射在區域12B的雕像的右腳上。

english: {@b Vulture Mask (V}). The inscription above this mask reads, "One of the others has no friends." Through this mask, a character sees a ray of blue light falling onto the left hand of the statue in area 12B.
zh_tw: {@b 禿鷲面具 (V}。這個面具上方的銘文寫著，"其他人中的一個沒有朋友。"透過這個面具，角色看到一束藍光落在區域12B雕像的左手上。

english: When the masks deliver their curses (see area 12B), any character who has looked through a mask in the last hour must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or transform into the creature depicted on the last mask they looked through. This curse functions as a {@spell polymorph} spell and ends after 24 hours.
zh_tw: 當面具釋放其詛咒時（見區域 12B），任何在過去一小時內透過面具觀察的角色，必須成功進行一個{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，否則將變成他們最後一次觀察面具上所描繪的生物。該詛咒的效果如同{@spell polymorph||變形術}法術，並在24小時後結束。

english: A {@creature zebra|ToA} has the same statistics as a {@creature riding horse}. Statistics for the {@creature boar}, {@creature lion}, and {@creature vulture} also appear in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
zh_tw: {@creature zebra|ToA|斑馬}的具體數值與{@creature riding horse||乘用馬}相同。{@creature boar||野豬}、{@creature lion||雄獅}和{@creature vulture||禿鷲}的具體數值也出現在{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中。

english: 13. Amphitheater
zh_tw: 13. 露天劇場

english: A ruined amphitheater looms over the surrounding buildings. Vines cling to its steps, and animal statues line its stands. The muddy ground outside is stripped clean of vegetation. An eerie silence hangs over the area. No birds cry, no insects chirp, nothing stirs.
zh_tw: 一座廢墟的露天劇場高聳於周圍建築之上。藤蔓纏繞著它的臺階，動物雕像排列在座位上。外面的泥地上的植被被剝得一乾二淨。一種詭異的寂靜籠罩著這個區域。沒有鳥叫，沒有蟲鳴，沒有任何東西在動。

english: The amphitheater is the lair of the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA}, a powerful tyrannosaurus rex with magical abilities. As they approach the amphitheater, characters can't fail to notice giant clawed footprints in the mud. From toe to heel, each footprint spans over 5 feet. Closer to the ruin, they find long, slender feathers in scarlet, orange, and green hues, and heaps of dung large enough to bury a dwarf.
zh_tw: 這個露天劇場是{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}的巢穴，它是一隻擁有魔法能力的強大的暴龍。當角色們接近露天劇場時，他們無法不注意到泥地裡的巨大爪印。每個腳印從腳尖到腳跟超過5尺長。靠近廢墟時，他們發現了長而纖細的羽毛，顏色為鮮紅、橙色和綠色，還有一大堆足夠埋葬一個矮人的糞便。

english: The amphitheater is an open-air, semicircular structure with tiered seats overlooking a ruined stage. The Omuans used it for public debates and plays both comic and tragic. Narrow passages and rubble-strewn chambers spread beneath the grandstands. This darkened maze is home to five {@creature Deinonychus|VGM|deinonychuses} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). While the tyrannosaurus is out hunting, the deinonychuses leave their lair and prowl throughout the amphitheater, attacking other creatures on sight. Strewn about their lair are Omuan relics (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 這個露天劇場是一個露天的半圓形結構，有階梯式座位俯瞰著一個廢墟舞臺。歐姆人用它來進行公共辯論和演出，既有喜劇也有悲劇。狹窄的通道和散落著瓦礫的房間分佈在看臺下方。這個昏暗的迷宮是五隻{@creature Deinonychus|VGM|恐爪龍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的家園。當暴龍外出狩獵時，這群恐爪龍離開它們的巢穴，在露天劇場四處遊蕩，一旦發現其他生物就進行攻擊。在它們的巢穴周圍散佈著歐姆文物（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Hail to the King
zh_tw: 向國王致敬

english: During the day, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} rests in the amphitheater. At night, this chance decreases to 25 percent. If the beast is out hunting, there is a cumulative {@chance 20} chance per hour of it returning. The {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} is a feathered {@creature tyrannosaurus rex}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 白天，{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}有{@chance 50}的機率在圓形劇場休息。夜晚時，這個機率會降低至25%。如果這隻野獸外出狩獵，每小時有累計{@chance 20}的機率返回。{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}是一隻長有羽毛的{@creature tyrannosaurus rex||霸王龍}，並具有以下變化：

english: The {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} is a monstrosity with 200 hit points.
zh_tw: {@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}是一個擁有200生命值的怪物。

english: It can see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects as if they were visible.
zh_tw: 它能夠看到{@condition invisible||隱形}生物和物體，就像它們是可見的一樣。

english: It can innately cast {@spell misty step} at will, requiring no components. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom.
zh_tw: 它能夠天生施放{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}，無需任何材料。它的施法能力是感知。

english: It has the Legendary Resistance trait and the Summon Swarm action option (see below). It can't use the Summon Swarm action while it is grappling a creature with its jaws.
zh_tw: 它具有傳奇抗性特性和召喚蜂群行動選項（見下文）。當它用嘴巴抓住生物時，它不能使用召喚蜂群行動。

english: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
zh_tw: 傳奇抗性 (3/日)

english: If the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}豁免檢定失敗，它可以選擇成功。

english: Summon Swarm {@recharge 5}
zh_tw: 召喚蜂群 {@recharge 5}

english: The {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} exhales a {@creature Swarm of Wasps||swarm of insects (wasps)} that forms in a space within 20 feet of it. The swarm acts as an ally of the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} and takes its turn immediately after it. The swarm disperses after 1 minute.
zh_tw: {@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王} 撥出一群{@creature Swarm of Wasps||昆蟲叢集（黃蜂）}，它們在距離它20尺內的某個空間形成。這群昆蟲作為{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}的盟友，並且在它之後立即行動。這群昆蟲在1分鐘後散去。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A search of the rooms under the amphitheater uncovers an electrum platter inscribed with images of Chultan feasting rituals (25 gp), an Omuan death mask made of painted gold (250 gp), and a {@item helm of telepathy}.
zh_tw: 在露天劇場下的房間中搜尋，發現了一件刻有楚爾特宴會儀式影象的電氣石託盤（25金幣），一個用彩繪黃金製成的歐姆死亡面具（250金幣），以及一件{@item helm of telepathy||心靈感應頭盔}。

english: The King of Feathers
zh_tw: 翎羽之王

english: The monstrous tyrannosaurus known as the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} is the undisputed lord of Omu. Most other dwellers of the Forbidden City live in fear of its thunderous approach and steer well clear of the amphitheater, its lair.
zh_tw: 被稱為{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}的這隻怪物暴龍是奧穆無可爭議的統治者。大多數其他居住在禁忌之城的生物都害怕它雷鳴般的腳步聲，並且會遠遠避開它的巢穴——露天劇場。

english: The {@creature King of Feathers|ToA} can be encountered anywhere within Omu. At first, tease the characters with glimpses of it moving through distant fog or have them hear its roar echoing over the ruins. It might appear while the heroes are exploring the ruins or taking a rest. Alternatively, it might interrupt a fight that's going badly for the party (or is too easy).
zh_tw: {@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}可以在奧穆的任何地方被發現。起初，可以透過讓角色們瞥見它在遠處霧中移動的身影，或者讓他們聽到它的咆哮聲在廢墟上回蕩，來逗弄他們。它可能在英雄們探索廢墟或休息時出現。或者，它可能會在隊伍戰鬥不利（或者太容易）時打斷戰鬥。

english: 14. Tomb of the Nine Gods
zh_tw: 14. 九神之墓

english: A vine-draped obelisk marks the entrance to the Tomb of the Nine Gods. For full details, refer to {@area chapter 5|305|x}.
zh_tw: 一座被藤蔓覆蓋的方尖碑標誌著通往九神之墓的入口。完整細節請參考{@area 第五章|305|x}。

english: 15. Ruined Bazaar
zh_tw: 15. 廢墟市集

english: A derelict market hall stands on the street corner ahead. Frayed cloth awnings hang in tatters above a broad alley lined with stalls.
zh_tw: 前方街角處矗立著一座破敗的市場大廳。磨損的布質遮陽篷破爛不堪地懸掛在一條寬闊的小巷上方，小巷兩旁排列著攤位。

english: Kobolds live in hidden cellars underneath the ruined market hall and have set six traps throughout the bazaar. A character has a cumulative {@chance 20} chance of finding a trap for each minute spent searching the bazaar. When a trap is found, have the character make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the check succeeds, the character spots the trap (a hidden, spring-loaded catapult) and its triggering mechanism (a tripwire or pressure plate) without triggering it. Once spotted, the trap is easily disarmed or avoided (no check required). A failed check indicates that the character accidentally set off the trap, which duplicates the Weapon Invention attack of a {@creature kobold inventor|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}).
zh_tw: 狗頭人居住在廢棄市場大廳下方的隱蔽地窖中，並在整個集市設定了六個陷阱。角色每花費一分鐘搜尋集市，就有累計{@chance 20}的機率發現陷阱。當發現陷阱時，讓該角色進行一次{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。若檢定成功，角色能發現陷阱（一個隱藏的彈簧投石機）及其觸發裝置（絆索或壓力板）而不會觸發它。一旦被發現，該陷阱可以輕鬆解除或避開（無需檢定）。檢定失敗意味著角色意外觸發了陷阱，這將複製{@creature kobold inventor|VGM|狗頭人發明家}的武器發明攻擊（參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。

english: After the characters find three traps, they spot a {@creature kobold} disappearing down a well-hidden staircase on the outskirts of the bazaar. If they follow the creature, it leads them to the cellars under the marketplace.
zh_tw: 在角色找到三個陷阱後，他們看到一隻{@creature kobold||狗頭人}消失在一個集市邊緣隱蔽的樓梯上。如果他們跟隨這個生物，它會帶領他們到達市場下面的地下室。

english: Kobold Cellars
zh_tw: 狗頭人地窖

english: The kobolds live in cellars not shown on map 3.1. All but one of the staircases leading into their lair has been caved in or blocked with heaps of furniture. As the characters make their way through the cellars, read:
zh_tw: 狗頭人居住在地圖3.1上沒有顯示的地下室中。除了一個之外，通往它們巢穴的所有樓梯都被坍塌或用傢俱堆砌堵住了。當角色們穿過地下室時，請閱讀：

english: Guttering torches cast {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} under the arches of a wine cellar roughly 20 feet square. The cracked ceiling is 8 feet high. In an alcove on the far side of the room, a pile of treasure twinkles in the torchlight. Kobolds gather around it.
zh_tw: 搖曳的火把在約20尺見方的酒窖拱頂下投下{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。開裂的天花板高8尺。在房間遠端的凹室裡，一堆財寶在火光中閃爍。狗頭人正圍聚在周圍。

english: Kakarol, a {@creature kobold scale sorcerer|VGM}, rests on the pile of treasure. Two {@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|kobold inventors} and ten {@creature Kobold||kobolds} are also present. Statistics for the kobold scale sorcerer and kobold inventor appear in {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}.
zh_tw: 卡卡羅爾，一位{@creature kobold scale sorcerer|VGM|狗頭人鱗術士}，坐在寶藏堆上休息。還有兩位{@creature Kobold Inventor|VGM|狗頭人發明家}和十位{@creature Kobold||狗頭人}在場。狗頭人鱗甲術士和狗頭人發明家的資料出現在{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}中。

english: The kobolds rally to defend Kakarol. While they fight off intruders, Kakarol and his inventors make ranged attacks from the rear. If things look dire, Kakarol throws himself at the characters' mercy.
zh_tw: 狗頭人們團結起來保衛卡卡羅爾。當他們擊退入侵者時，卡卡羅爾和他的發明家從後方進行遠端攻擊。如果情況看起來不妙，卡卡羅爾會向角色們求饒。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Kakarol wears a torn, 6-foot-long tapestry of a macaw decorated with garnet beads (75 gp) as a cloak. His hoard contains 30 gp, 250 sp, 1,800 cp, a colored glass statuette of a dragonfly (25 gp), four bloodstones (50 gp each), and a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 卡卡羅爾身穿一件6尺長的、被撕裂的金剛鸚鵡掛毯，上面裝飾著石榴石珠子（75金幣）作為斗篷。他的寶藏包括30金幣，250銀幣，1800銅幣，一個蜻蜓形狀的彩色玻璃小雕像（25金幣），四顆血石（每顆50金幣），以及一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: Kakarol believes that {@creature Acererak|ToA} is going to transform him into a dragon. As such, the kobold is arrogant, greedy, and vain—traits that can be used against him. He knows nothing of {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s true aims, nor has he been told about the Soulmonger. Kakarol's kobolds spy on most other factions in the city. If gifted with enough treasure, he could become a useful early warning system for the adventurers.
zh_tw: 卡卡羅爾相信{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}會將他變成一條龍。因此，這個狗頭人表現得傲慢、貪婪和虛榮——這些特質可以被用來對付他。他對{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}真正的目的一無所知，也未被告知有關噬魂器的事情。卡卡羅爾的狗頭人監視著城市中大多數其他派系。如果贈予足夠的財寶，他可能成為冒險者們有用的預警系統。

english: 16. Papazotl's Shrine
zh_tw: 16. 帕帕扎圖的神龕

english: Crocodiles wallow in this muddy lake bed, from which rises a walled ruin. Two columns flank the entrance, carved with images of a long-legged bird with a needle-like beak. At the building's front, slimy steps ascend to an entry arch.
zh_tw: 鱷魚在這個泥濘的湖床上打滾，從湖床上升起一座有圍牆的廢墟。入口兩側有兩根柱子，上面雕刻著一隻長腿鳥，喙尖如針。在建築的正面，滑膩的臺階通向入口拱門。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Papazotl (represented by an eblis) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods. The water around the shrine is 2 feet deep.
zh_tw: 供奉給騙子神帕帕扎圖（由一個魔王鶴代表）的神龕包含了進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題方塊之一。神龕周圍的水深2尺。

english: 16A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 16A. 神殿入口

english: A plaque above the shrine entrance displays an inscription in Old Omuan: "Papazotl teaches us to bow before no one." Characters who remember the cult's motto gain an edge when they explore Papazotl's tomb in {@area chapter 5|38a|x}.
zh_tw: 神龕入口上方的牌匾上刻有古奧曼語的銘文："帕帕扎圖教導我們不向任何人鞠躬。" 記住該邪教座右銘的角色在探索帕帕扎圖的墳墓時（{@area 第五章|38a|x}）會獲得優勢。

english: Four hungry {@creature Crocodile||crocodiles} lurk in the shrine's flooded courtyard. These creatures are the offspring of a {@creature giant crocodile} that nests to the rear of the shrine. If the characters attack the crocodiles, their mother joins the fray 2 rounds later.
zh_tw: 四隻飢餓的{@creature Crocodile||鱷魚}潛伏在神殿被洪水淹沒的庭院中。這些生物是神殿後方築巢的{@creature giant crocodile||巨鱷}的後代。如果角色們攻擊這些鱷魚，它們的母親將在2輪後加入戰鬥。

english: 16B. Mosaic Floor
zh_tw: 16B. 馬賽克地板

english: Moss clings to the stonework throughout this hall. The mosaic floor depicts a tall bird using its long, pointy beak to pin a monstrous frog-like creature with tentacles sprouting from its shoulders. Set into the far wall is a set of heavy stone doors.
zh_tw: 整個大廳的石雕上都附著著苔蘚。鑲嵌的地面描繪了一隻高大的鳥，用它長長的尖喙固定住一隻從肩膀上長出觸手的類似青蛙的怪物。遠處的牆上鑲嵌著一扇沉重的石門。

english: The mosaic shows the trickster god Papazotl (an eblis) fighting his enemy, Kubazan (a froghemoth). Inscriptions in Old Omuan surround the mosaic. If the characters translate these, they learn the story of how Kubazan disobeyed Papazotl and was cursed (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 馬賽克展示了詭神帕帕扎圖（一個魔王鶴）與他的敵人庫巴贊（一個蛙獸）戰鬥的場景。馬賽克周圍刻有奧姆安古文的銘文。如果角色們翻譯這些銘文，他們會瞭解到庫巴贊如何違背帕帕扎圖並被詛咒的故事（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。

english: The doors are not locked but hang heavy on their hinges. Each door weighs 600 pounds, so one or more characters must have a combined Strength score of 20 or higher to force it open.
zh_tw: 門沒有上鎖，但掛在鉸鏈上非常沉重。每扇門重600磅，因此一個或多個角色必須擁有合計力量值20或更高才能將其強行開啟。

english: 16C. Chamber of Command
zh_tw: 16C. 指揮之室

english: An empty pedestal stands in the middle of this chamber. Six statues face it from alcoves on the walls. They depict bare-chested humans with the heads of different animals. From left to right, the heads resemble those of a lizard, a jaguar, a lobster, a toucan, a bat, and a frog.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央有一個空的基座。牆上的壁龕中有六尊雕像面向它。它們描繪的是裸露上身、頭部為不同動物的人類。從左到右，頭部分別類似於蜥蜴、美洲豹、龍蝦、巨嘴鳥、蝙蝠和青蛙。

english: A character who examines the pedestal finds a riddle inscribed on its base. (Give players a copy of handout 15 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}.) Unlike other inscriptions in the trial chambers, this riddle is etched in Common:
zh_tw: 檢查基座的角色會發現在其底座上刻有一道謎題。（給玩家提供附錄E中15號手冊的副本，參見{@adventure 附錄 E|ToA|10}。）與其他試驗室中的銘文不同，這道謎題是用通用語刻寫的：

english: Comes with sunshine
zh_tw: 隨陽光而來（Comes with sunshine）

english: Leaves with night
zh_tw: 隨夜晚而去（Leaves with night）

english: Hides in darkness
zh_tw: 藏身黑暗之中（Hides in darkness）

english: Does not bite
zh_tw: 不會咬人（Does not bite）

english: Always joined to its caster
zh_tw: 總與投下它的身影相連（Always joined to its caster）

english: Never strays from its master
zh_tw: 從不離開自己的主人（Never strays from its master）

english: The answer to the riddle ("a shadow") is a clue to finding the secret chamber (area 16D). If a character holds a light source close to the statue with the head of a bat, a crawlway appears in its shadow. The crawlway entrance is otherwise hidden behind an illusory wall that can be dispelled with a {@spell dispel magic} spell. The crawlway, which is 2 feet wide and 3 feet high, leads to area 16D.
zh_tw: 謎題的答案（"影子"）是找到秘密房間（區域16D）的線索。如果角色將光源靠近蝙蝠頭雕像，一個爬行通道就會在其影子中顯現。爬行通道的入口通常隱藏在一堵幻象牆後面，可以用一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術來解除。這個爬行通道寬2尺，高3尺，通向區域16D。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: If a character searches the pedestal, they discover the outline of a stone hatch on its upper surface. No matter how hard the characters try, they cannot pry the hatch open. Papazotl's puzzle cube within only emerges when all six statues are blindfolded (see area 16D). When this occurs, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色搜尋基座，他們會在其上表面發現一個石蓋的輪廓。無論角色們如何努力，他們都無法撬開這個蓋子。只有當所有六尊雕像都被蒙上眼睛時（見區域16D），帕帕扎圖的謎題魔方才會出現。當這種情況發生時，請閱讀：

english: The pedestal rotates, and an ornate stone cube emerges from a hatch on its surface.
zh_tw: 基座旋轉，一個裝飾精美的石質立方體從其表面的一個艙口出現。

english: The characters can now safely take the puzzle cube.
zh_tw: 角色們現在可以安全地拿走這個謎題魔方。

english: 16D. Hidden Room
zh_tw: 16D. 隱藏房間

english: A strange grid is etched into the far wall of this stone cell.
zh_tw: 這個石制牢房的遠牆上刻著一個奇怪的網格。

english: When a character enters this chamber, give the players a copy of handout 16 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}. This grid is a puzzle key. If the letters from the riddle in area 16C are entered into the grid (minus spaces), the letters in the darkened squares spell out "cover eyes." This phrase provides a clue to obtaining the puzzle cube in area 16C.
zh_tw: 角色進入這個房間時，將{@adventure 附錄E|ToA|10}的玩家講義16交給玩家。這個方格是解謎的關鍵：將區域16C謎詩的英文原文字母依序填入，略去空格，深色格子便會拼出「cover eyes」（遮住眼睛）。這句話提示了如何取得區域16C的謎題立方體。

english: 17. Waterfall
zh_tw: 17. 瀑布

english: A river courses through a rocky ravine before plunging 50 feet into a 30-foot-deep pool. A creature that goes over the waterfall must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 ({@dice 5d4}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one. There is no safe path from the top of the waterfall to the city below.
zh_tw: 一條河流蜿蜒穿過岩石峽谷，然後從50尺高處墜入一個30尺深的池塘。任何從瀑布上掉落的生物必須進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到12（{@dice 5d4}）點鈍擊傷害，若豁免成功則不受到傷害。從瀑布頂部到下方的城市沒有安全路徑。

english: Vision of Acererak
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的幻象

english: The first character to look out across the city from the clifftops near the waterfall sees a vision of Omu's fall:
zh_tw: 第一個從瀑布附近的懸崖上俯瞰城市的字元看到了奧穆的墜落幻象：

english: A city of magnificent, whitewashed buildings stretches out before you. Sunlight sparkles off of glass domes and windows, yet all is not well. Black smoke coils from fires across the city, corpses litter the streets, and wraiths circle the rooftops like vultures. A sphere of utter darkness grows out from the heart of the city, blotting out the light as it expands toward you. You turn away, and when you look back, the darkness is gone. The city is a half-flooded, overgrown ruin.
zh_tw: 一座宏偉的白色建築群展現在你眼前。陽光在玻璃穹頂和窗戶上閃爍，然而一切並不美好。城市各處的火災中冒出黑煙，街道上散落著屍體，幽靈像禿鷹一樣在屋頂盤旋。一個完全黑暗的球體從城市的中心向外擴散，它擴張向你時遮蔽了光線。你轉過頭去，當你再次回頭時，黑暗消失了。這座城市變成了半淹沒、雜草叢生的廢墟。

english: While in Omu, the character who saw the vision has the same dark dream whenever he or she takes a long rest. In the dream, the character is standing in the city during its fall and sees a skeletal figure walking alone through the dead streets. He wears tattered robes and holds a skull-tipped staff, and his sunken eyes contain points of dead light. With each dream, the figure ({@creature Acererak|ToA}) gets a little closer.
zh_tw: 在奧穆期間，看到幻象的角色在每次長休時都會做同一個黑暗的夢。在夢中，角色站在城市墜落時，看到一個骷髏般的身形獨自穿過死亡的街道。他穿著破爛的長袍，手持一個頭骨尖端的法杖，他深陷的眼睛中包含著死亡的光芒。每次夢境，這個身形（{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}）都會變得更近一些。

english: 18. Nangnang's Shrine
zh_tw: 18. 娜浪的神殿

english: Monoliths adorned with prancing, frog-like figures rise from the swamp. Beyond, a ruined edifice shaped like an arrowhead squats in the muddy water. Bushes and trees grow from its roof. At the pointed front of the building, steps ascend to a stone door caked in slime.
zh_tw: 裝飾有跳躍的、類似青蛙的雕像的獨石柱從沼澤中升起。遠處，一座形狀像箭頭的廢墟建築蹲伏在泥濘的水中。灌木和樹木從它的屋頂生長出來。在建築物尖銳的前部，臺階通向一扇沾滿黏液的石門。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Nangnang (represented by a grung) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods. The water around the shrine is 2 feet deep.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神娜浪（由一個格隆代表）的神祠包含進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題魔方之一。神祠周圍的水深2尺。

english: 18A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 18A. 神龕入口

english: The shrine is home to a gold-skinned {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM} named Chief {@creature Yorb|ToA}. Four orange-skinned {@creature Grung Elite Warrior|VGM|grung elite warriors} wallow in the flooded courtyard with {@creature Yorb|ToA} and his trained {@creature hadrosaurus|VGM} mount. One red-skinned {@creature grung wildling|VGM} and seven green-skinned {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} lurk on the shrine's 20-foot-high rooftop. See {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for these creatures' statistics.
zh_tw: 這座神殿是名為{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}首領的金色皮膚{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}的家園。四名橙色皮膚的{@creature Grung Elite Warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}與{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}及其馴養的{@creature hadrosaurus|VGM|鴨嘴龍}坐騎一起在積水的庭院中打滾。一名紅色皮膚的{@creature grung wildling|VGM|格龍蛙人蠻荒祭司}和七名綠色皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}潛伏在神殿20尺高的屋頂上。有關這些生物的統計資料，請參閱{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}。

english: The grungs on the roof unleash arrows to ward off intruders. If the intruders fight back, more green-skinned {@creature Grung|VGM|grungs} close in from nearby buildings, with {@dice 1d4} appearing at the end of each round until twenty have arrived.
zh_tw: 屋頂上的格朗族射箭以抵禦入侵者。如果入侵者反擊，更多綠皮膚的{@creature Grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}會從附近的建築物靠近，每輪結束時會有{@dice 1d4}個出現，直到有二十個到達。

english: The grungs are jumpy and distrustful of strangers. At first, {@creature Yorb|ToA} is more interested in scaring away intruders than he is talking with them. If the characters rescue his favored son in {@area area 5|21a|x} and have the means to communicate with the chief, {@creature Yorb|ToA} opens up to them. He currently has no idea his son is missing.
zh_tw: 格隆人對陌生人感到緊張且不信任。起初，{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}更感興趣的是嚇跑入侵者，而不是與他們交談。如果角色們在{@area 區域5|21a|x}中救出了他心愛的兒子，並且有辦法與首領溝通，{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}會對他們敞開心扉。他目前還不知道他的兒子失蹤了。

english: The grungs worship the dead trickster god Nangnang. If the characters enter into negotiations with {@creature Yorb|ToA}, he can recount the full legend of Omu's nine trickster gods (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 格隆族崇拜死去的騙子神娜浪。如果角色們與{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}進行談判，他可以講述奧穆的九個騙子神的全部傳說（見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。

english: Shrine Doors
zh_tw: 神祠門

english: The doors to the shrine stand ajar. If the tide of battle turns against Chief {@creature Yorb|ToA}, he retreats into the shrine with his elite guards and bars the doors. A character can force open the barred doors with a successful {@dc 25} Strength check.
zh_tw: 神殿的門半開著。如果戰鬥的形勢對首領 {@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯} 不利，他會與他的精英衛隊一起撤退到神殿內並閂上門。一個角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 25} 力量檢定強行開啟閂上的門。

english: 18B. Chamber of Greed
zh_tw: 18B. 貪婪之室

english: Torches shed light over rooms filled of treasure: chests heaped with coins, polished amphorae, strings of pearls, and ornate pieces of armor. Set into the floor in front of another double door is a mosaic depicting a frog-like humanoid beating a leopard that has snakes emerging from its shoulders. Cuneiform inscriptions are woven above and below the combatants.
zh_tw: 火把照亮了滿是寶藏的房間：堆滿硬幣的箱子、打磨過的雙耳瓶、成串的珍珠，以及裝飾華麗的盔甲。在另一扇雙門前的地面上，鑲嵌著一幅馬賽克，描繪了一個類似青蛙的人形生物正在擊敗一隻從肩膀上長出蛇的豹子。楔形文字的銘文交織在戰鬥者的上方和下方。

english: The inscriptions are written in Old Omuan. The one above the mosaic reads, "Nangnang teaches us to serve only ourselves." The inscriptions below tell how Nangnang (a grung) stole a spear belonging to Shagambi (a kamadan). For details, see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}."
zh_tw: 這些銘文是用古老的奧姆安文寫的。馬賽克上方的銘文寫著："娜浪教導我們只服務於我們自己。"下方的銘文講述了娜浪（一個格隆）如何偷走了莎根比（一個六岐蛇豹）的長矛。有關詳細資訊，請參閱"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"。

english: While the treasures remain in the shrine, they look and feel real. If a character removes a treasure from the shrine, the illusion drops and the treasure reverts to its true form: gold coins become disks of tin, silver decanters revert back to clay jugs, and glittering armor becomes rusty scrap metal. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the treasures radiate auras of illusion magic while in the shrine. None of these "treasures" are valuable.
zh_tw: 儘管這些寶藏仍然在神祠中，它們看起來和感覺都是真實的。如果一個角色從神祠中移除寶藏，幻象就會消失，寶藏會恢復其真實形態：金幣變成錫盤，銀色酒器變回陶罐，閃亮的盔甲變成生鏽的廢金屬。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了寶藏在神祠中時散發出幻象魔法的氣息。這些"寶藏"都沒有價值。

english: Locked Doors
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The stone doors to area 18C are locked, with neither keyhole nor handle. Above the double door, the following message is carved into the stonework in Old Omuan: "Whoever among you is the richest, bring me your gifts." To date, even Chief {@creature Yorb|ToA} hasn't learned what lies on the other side of the doors. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around the doors. The doors swing open if a creature approaches them while carrying one or more of the treasures found in the shrine. However, if another creature in the shrine is also carrying such treasure, the doors remains closed. A {@spell knock} spell also opens the doors.
zh_tw: 通往區域18C的石門被鎖上了，既沒有鑰匙孔也沒有把手。在雙門上方，用古老的奧姆安文在石雕上刻著以下資訊："你們中誰最富有，就給我帶來你們的禮物。"到目前為止，即使是首領{@creature Yorb|ToA|約伯}也不知道門後面是什麼。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了門周圍有占卜魔法的氣息。如果一個生物攜帶在神祠中發現的一個或多個寶藏接近門，門就會開啟。然而，如果神祠中的另一個生物也攜帶著這樣的寶藏，門就會保持關閉。一個{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術也能開啟門。

english: 18C. Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 18C. 謎題立方體

english: In the middle of this dusty room, a stone cube rests on a pedestal carved and painted to resemble a squat, humanoid frog.
zh_tw: 在這個塵土飛揚的房間中央，一個石質立方體安放在一個雕刻並畫著類似矮胖人形蛙的基座上。

english: Nangnang's puzzle cube can be safely removed from its pedestal.
zh_tw: 娜浪的謎題魔方可以安全地從其基座上移除。

english: 19. Obo'laka's Shrine
zh_tw: 19. 奧博娜卡的神殿

english: A pair of needlelike columns mark the entrance to a walled ruin. In the courtyard beyond, banyan roots envelop a squat building. The stone doors that seal the entrance are carved with images of snarling bears with long, sharp claws.
zh_tw: 一對針狀的柱子標誌著通往圍牆遺蹟的入口。在庭院的另一邊，榕樹的根鬚包裹著一座矮胖的建築。封閉入口的石門上雕刻著咆哮的熊，它們有著長長的鋒利爪子。

english: The shrine to the trickster god Obo'laka (represented by a zorbo) contains one of nine puzzle cubes needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 供奉給詭神奧博娜卡（由一個佐博怪代表）的神祠包含進入九神之墓所需的九個謎題魔方之一。

english: 19A. Shrine Entrance
zh_tw: 19A. 神龕入口

english: A plaque above the shrine's entrance bears the following message in Old Omuan: "Obo'laka teaches us to tread warily and stay in the light." This message sheds light on how to obtain Obo'laka's puzzle cube. The doors are slightly ajar and have rusty hinges that squeal loudly when the doors are opened.
zh_tw: 神龕入口上方的牌匾用古老的奧姆安語刻著以下資訊："奧博娜卡教導我們要謹慎行事，保持在光明之中。" 這條資訊揭示了如何獲得奧博娜卡的謎題魔方。門微微敞開，門鉸生鏽，開門時會發出尖銳的響聲。

english: When the characters arrive, four {@creature Zorbo|ToA|zorbos} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are lurking around the perimeter of the shrine. They investigate the sound of the squealing doors but won't attack large groups, preferring to pick off loners and stragglers.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，四個{@creature Zorbo|ToA|佐博怪}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）正潛伏在神祠周圍。它們會調查吱吱作響的門的聲音，但不會攻擊大群體，更傾向於攻擊落單者和掉隊者。

english: 19B. Gallery of Carvings
zh_tw: 19B. 雕刻長廊

english: The walls of this dark corridor are covered with painted reliefs showing Omuan people hunting, harvesting fruit, planting crops, crafting weapons, feasting, fighting, weaving, and skinning animals. Eight empty torch brackets protrude from the walls under the reliefs.
zh_tw: 這條昏暗走廊的牆壁上覆蓋著彩繪浮雕，展示了奧姆安人狩獵、收穫果實、種植莊稼、製作武器、宴請、戰鬥、編織和剝製動物皮的場景。八個空的火把支架從浮雕下方的牆壁上突出。

english: To disarm the puzzle cube trap in area 19E, the magic torches from that room must be placed in the brackets in this hall.
zh_tw: 要解除區域19E中的謎題魔方陷阱，必須將那個房間的魔法火把放置在這個走廊的支架上。

english: Barred Secret Door
zh_tw: 被閂住的秘密門

english: A character who searches the walls and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots a secret door just inside the entrance. The door is triple-barred from the west side. It can't be opened manually from this side, though three {@spell knock} spells will do the trick.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果搜尋牆壁並透過了 {@dc 17} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定，會發現入口內的一扇秘密門。這扇門從西側被三重閂住。從這一側無法手動開啟，但施展三次 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術可以解決問題。

english: 19C. Sun Pool
zh_tw: 19C. 日光池

english: A glorious sun is carved on the ceiling, directly above a pool of still water. The ceiling reflected in the pool doesn't show a sun carving, but rather a moon carving.
zh_tw: 天花板上雕刻著一個輝煌的太陽，正下方是一個靜止的水池。水池中反射的天花板並沒有顯示出太陽雕刻，而是顯示出一個月亮雕刻。

english: The pool is a magic portal that connects to the pool in area 19D. Characters who immerse themselves in the pool surface in area 19D.
zh_tw: 這個水池是一個魔法傳送門，連線到區域19D的水池。角色如果潛入這個水池，會在區域19D的水池中出現。

english: 19D. Moon Pool
zh_tw: 19D. 月池

english: If the characters enter this room via the pool, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色透過水池進入這個房間，請閱讀：

english: A full moon is carved on the ceiling here, directly above the pool. The walls are decorated with reliefs of the Omuan people carrying out daily chores.
zh_tw: 天花板上在這裡雕刻著一個滿月，正上方是水池。牆壁上裝飾著奧姆安人進行日常雜務的浮雕。

english: The ceiling reflected in the pool doesn't show a moon carving, but rather a sun carving. To travel back to area 19C, a character must duck under the pool's surface.
zh_tw: 水池中反射的天花板上沒有顯示月亮雕刻，而是顯示了一個太陽雕刻。要回到區域19C，角色必須潛入水池的表面下。

english: Locked Secret Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的秘密門

english: A secret door in the south wall requires a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check to spot. Even when found, there's no obvious way to open the door, although a {@spell knock} spell works.
zh_tw: 南牆上的一個密室門需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定才能發現。即使被發現，也沒有明顯的方法開啟這扇門，但 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術可以生效。

english: A character who studies the wall reliefs and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check observes that one of the figures on the wall is crafting a key. If the character pushes the key, the secret door pops open, revealing a dusty, web-filled tunnel (area 19F) beyond.
zh_tw: 一名研究牆壁浮雕的角色如果成功透過了 {@dc 10} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定，會觀察到牆上有一個身影正在製作一把鑰匙。如果角色推動這把鑰匙，暗門會彈開，露出後方佈滿灰塵和蛛網的隧道（區域 19F）。

english: 19E. Chamber of Sacraments
zh_tw: 19E. 聖禮之室

english: Eight torches illuminate this room. The light washes over a floor mosaic showing two creatures locked in combat: a small bear with sharp claws and a rabbit with a spiral horn on its forehead. In the middle of the room, a robed figure stands next to a waist-high pedestal, atop which rests a stone cube. The figure is bald and has one hand on the cube. It takes a moment to realize that the figure is a statue.
zh_tw: 八支火把照亮了這個房間。光線灑在地板上的馬賽克上，上面展示了兩個生物在戰鬥：一隻有著鋒利爪子的小熊和一隻額頭上有螺旋角的兔子。在房間的中央，一個穿著長袍的人物站在一個齊腰高的基座旁邊，基座上放著一個石立方體。這個人物是禿頂的，一隻手放在立方體上。過了一會兒才意識到這個人物是一個雕像。

english: The floor mosaic shows Obo'laka (a zorbo) fighting I'jin (an almiraj). Inscriptions in Old Omuan underneath the mosaic explain how I'jin ruined Obo'laka's attempt to placate Ubtao (see "{@area Legend of the Nine Gods|1e1|x}").
zh_tw: 地板上的馬賽克描繪了奧博娜卡（一隻澤波）與艾金（一隻獨角兔）的戰鬥。馬賽克下方的古老奧姆安文字解釋了艾金是如何破壞了奧博娜卡安撫烏布塔奧的企圖（參見"{@area 九神傳說|1e1|x}"）。

english: The statue is a {@condition petrified} Red Wizard (LE male Thayan human {@creature mage}) named Voj. He failed to disarm the puzzle cube trap before touching it, and its magic turned him to stone. If a {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic is cast on Voj, he reverts to flesh, realizes he's not alone, and attacks anyone who would deny him the cube.
