zh_tw: 雕像是一位名為沃傑的{@condition petrified||石化}紅袍法師（守序邪惡男性塞恩人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）。他在觸控之前未能解除魔方陷阱，其魔法將他變成了石頭。如果對沃傑施放{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}或類似的魔法，他會恢復肉身，意識到自己並非孤身一人，並攻擊任何試圖阻止他獲得魔方的人。

english: Voj takes orders from Zagmira and knows the legend of Obo'laka and I'jin. If the characters defeat him, they find some valuables on his person (see "Treasure" below) that aren't obtainable while Voj is {@condition petrified}.
zh_tw: 沃伊聽從扎格米拉的命令，並知道奧博娜卡和艾金的故事。如果角色們擊敗了他，他們會在他的身上找到一些貴重物品（見下方的"寶藏"），這些物品在沃伊被{@condition petrified||石化}時無法獲得。

english: Puzzle Cube
zh_tw: 謎題立方體

english: Any creature that touches the puzzle cube must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition petrified}. Even on a success, a creature holding the cube must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until the puzzle cube is removed from the shrine. When the torches in this room are inserted into the empty brackets in area 19B, Obo'laka's puzzle cube can be handled safely.
zh_tw: 任何觸碰謎題立方體的生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則將被 {@condition petrified||石化}。即使檢定成功，持有立方體的生物也必須在其每回合結束時重複豁免檢定，直到謎題立方體從神龕中移除。當此房間中的火把插入區域19B的空支架時，可以安全地處理奧博娜卡的謎題立方體。

english: Torches
zh_tw: 火把

english: Each torch burns with a flame that never wears its wood down. The torches can be extinguished, but they reignite every time they reenter this chamber. Relighting a torch by any other method proves impossible. If all eight torches are inserted into the empty brackets in area 19B, the puzzle cube can be handled safely.
zh_tw: 每支火把都燃燒著一種永遠不消耗木材的火焰。火把可以被熄滅，但每次重新進入這個房間時它們都會重新點燃。用任何其他方法重新點燃火把都是不可能的。如果所有八支火把都被插入到區域19B中的空托架裡，謎題魔方就可以安全地處理了。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Voj carries an {@item immovable rod}, a leather pouch containing three tiger eye gemstones (10 gp each), and a red, leather-bound spellbook, which contains all the spells he has prepared.
zh_tw: 沃伊攜帶一根{@item immovable rod||不動權杖}，一個裝有三顆虎眼寶石的皮袋（每顆10金幣），以及一本紅色皮革裝訂的魔法書，其中包含了他準備的所有法術。

english: 19F. Secret Passage
zh_tw: 19F. 秘密通道

english: This dark passage is choked with dust and webs. It's clear that no one has been through here in years.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗的通道被灰塵和蛛網堵塞。很明顯，這裡已經多年沒有人透過了。

english: Traversing this corridor is the easiest way to transport the torches in area 19E to area 19B without dousing their flames in the pools. The secret door leading to area 19B has three wooden bars across it. Once the bars are removed, the door pulls open easily.
zh_tw: 穿越這條走廊是從區域19E向區域19B運送火把而不會讓火焰在水池中熄滅的最便捷方式。通往區域19B的秘密門上有三根木條。一旦移除這些木條，門就可以輕鬆拉開。

english: 20. Royal Palace
zh_tw: 20. 王宮

english: Thousands of bats swirl above a great ruin. Behind a 15-foot-high circular wall, you see crumbling arcades, vine-choked statues, empty plazas, and buildings overgrown with banyan roots. Streets that aren't flooded are choked with rubble.
zh_tw: 成千上萬的蝙蝠在一座巨大的廢墟上空盤旋。在一個15尺高的圓形牆後面，你可以看到破碎的拱廊、被藤蔓纏繞的雕像、空曠的廣場，以及被榕樹根覆蓋的建築物。沒有被洪水淹沒的街道上堆滿了瓦礫。

english: The palace looks abandoned and has been looted of all treasure. Snakes slithering through the rubble are mostly harmless (but see area 20A and 20B below). The bats flying above the ruin are also harmless.
zh_tw: 宮殿看起來已被廢棄，並且所有的財寶都被盜掘一空。在瓦礫中蜿蜒穿行的蛇大多數是無害的（但見下文區域20A和20B）。在廢墟上空飛翔的蝙蝠也是無害的。

english: The Fane of the Night Serpent (see {@area chapter 4|298|x}) lies under the palace. There are two entrances: a large entrance to the north (area 20A) and a hidden entrance to the south (area 20B). Watching over each entrance are three type 1 {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} in snake form. They slither out of hiding, revert to their true forms, and attack anyone who isn't accompanied by yuan-ti.
zh_tw: 夜蛇神殿（見{@area 第四章|298|x}]位於宮殿之下。有兩個入口：北邊（區域20A）有一個大入口，南邊（區域20B）有一個隱藏入口。每個入口都有三個第一型態的{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}以蛇的形態守護。它們從隱藏處滑出，恢復到真實形態，攻擊任何沒有元帝族陪同的人。

english: 20A. Main Entrance to the Fane
zh_tw: 20A. 聖所主入口

english: The north entrance to the Fane of the Night Serpent is easy to find:
zh_tw: 夜蛇神殿的北入口很容易找到：

english: A worked tunnel descends into the earth here. Muddy cart-tracks wind back and forth from the entrance.
zh_tw: 一條人工挖掘的隧道在這裡向下延伸至地下。泥濘的馬車軌道從入口處來回蜿蜒。

english: The tunnel slopes down to {@area area 1|2ad|x} of the yuan-ti temple (see {@area chapter 4|2ad|x}).
zh_tw: 隧道向下傾斜通向蛇人神廟的{@area 區域1|2ad|x}（參見{@area 第四章|2ad|x}）。

english: 20B. Secret Entrance to the Fane
zh_tw: 20B. 神廟的秘密入口

english: The south entrance to the Fane of the Night Serpent is hidden behind palms and thorny bushes. Yuan-ti who pass through here always try to cover their tracks. To find the entrance, a character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check while searching the vicinity.
zh_tw: 夜蛇神殿的南入口隱藏在棕櫚樹和荊棘叢後。經過此處的蛇人總是試圖掩蓋他們的行蹤。要找到入口，角色必須在搜尋附近時成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）或感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定。

english: Lifting aside the palm fronds, you uncover a narrow, rough-hewn passage descending into the earth.
zh_tw: 移開棕櫚葉，你發現了一條狹窄、粗糙的通道，向下延伸進入地下。

english: This passage connects to {@area area 23|303|x} of the yuan-ti temple (see {@area chapter 4|303|x}).
zh_tw: 這段通道連線到蛇人神殿的{@area 區域23|303|x}（見{@area 第四章|303|x}）。

english: Chapter 4: Fane of the Night Serpent
zh_tw: 第4章：夜蛇神殿

english: Under the ruined palace of Omu lies a yuan-ti temple dedicated to an apocalyptic god known as Dendar the Night Serpent. The temple was originally part of the palace, but the yuan-ti have expanded and modified it to suit their needs over the years. When {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} steals one of Omu's puzzle cubes (see {@area chapter 3|1eb|x}), the characters must delve into the temple to recover it. Characters captured by yuan-ti also end up here.
zh_tw: 在奧穆的廢墟宮殿之下，有一個元帝族寺廟，專門供奉一位被稱為夜蛇神丹達爾的末日之神。這座寺廟最初是宮殿的一部分，但多年來元帝族已經擴充套件並修改了它以滿足他們的需求。當{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}偷走了奧穆的一個謎題魔方（見{@area 第三章|1eb|x}）時，角色們必須深入寺廟去取回它。被元帝族捕獲的角色最終也會來到這裡。

english: Schemes of the Yuan-ti
zh_tw: 玉蜓族的陰謀

english: Before running this chapter, review the information on yuan-ti in the Monster Manual. Additional information appears in {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|VGM}.
zh_tw: 在執行本章之前，請先查閱《怪物圖鑑》中關於蛇人的資訊。更多資訊可見於{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|VGM}。

english: Ras Nsi
zh_tw: 拉茲·納斯

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} leads the yuan-ti of Omu on a divine mission to usher forth Dendar the Night Serpent and trigger the end of the world (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9} for more information on {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and his evil plans). His version of the apocalypse is not imminent, since {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is distracted with fears of his own mortality. He has fallen victim to the death curse and is growing weaker by the day, and neither he nor his yuan-ti priests have been able to ascertain the cause or find a remedy. As {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s power wanes, his rivals are preparing to dispose of him and continue their holy mission.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}領導著奧穆的蛇人執行一項神聖使命，旨在召喚夜蛇丹達爾並引發世界末日（更多關於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}及其邪惡計劃的資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。他的末日預言尚未迫在眉睫，因為{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}正因對自己死亡恐懼而分心。他已成為死亡詛咒的受害者，日漸衰弱，而他和他的蛇人祭司們都無法確定其原因或找到解救之法。隨著{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}力量的減弱，他的對手們正準備好除掉他，繼續他們的神聖使命。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} promised to help the yuan-ti if they would guard the Tomb of the Nine Gods. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} doesn't know that {@creature Acererak|ToA} is playing him for a fool. If the characters convince {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} that {@creature Acererak|ToA} is a common enemy, he is of a mind not to stand in their way, provided that they vow to destroy the Soulmonger. Above all else, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} values his own life.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}承諾如果元帝族守衛九神之墓，他將幫助他們。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}不知道{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}正在愚弄他。如果角色們能說服{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}是一個共同的敵人，他願意不阻撓他們的道路，只要他們發誓要摧毀噬魂器。最重要的是，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}珍視自己的生命。

english: Fenthaza
zh_tw: 芬薩札

english: The cruel yuan-ti malison {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} is second in power only to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and serves as the temple's high priest. As one of Dendar's "nightmare speakers," she interprets the dream visions of the serpent god and pleases her with torture and sacrifice.
zh_tw: 殘忍的惡咒蛇人{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}在權力上僅次於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，擔任神廟的高階祭司。作為登達爾的"噩夢傳話者"之一，她解釋了蛇神的夢境幻象，並以折磨和犧牲來取悅她。

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} has long resented {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} for hanging onto the threads of his humanity. Now her visions portend ruin at {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s hands, and she actively plots against him. Her dreams have revealed a treasure called the Black Opal Crown, hidden deep within the Tomb of the Nine Gods. She's convinced that the crown is the key to unleashing Dendar the Night Serpent. {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} wants to murder {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and obtain the crown from the tomb. The priest is patient and cunning, and she won't take action against {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} unless the odds are stacked in her favor. Captive characters soon become cat's-paws in {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}'s coup.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}一直對{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}緊抓人性之線心存怨恨。現在她的幻象預示著{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}將帶來毀滅，她正積極策劃反對他。她的夢境揭示了一件名為黑蛋白石王冠的寶藏，深藏在九神之墓中。她確信這頂王冠是釋放夜蛇神丹達爾的關鍵。{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}想要謀殺{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}並從墓中獲得王冠。這位牧師既耐心又狡猾，除非勝算在她這邊，否則她不會對{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}採取行動。被捕的角色很快就會成為{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}政變中的棋子。

english: Temple Roster and Reinforcements
zh_tw: 神廟名單和增援

english: If the yuan-ti detect intruders inside the temple who aren't prisoners, they try to ring the loud gong in {@area area 9|2ca|x}. The Temple Roster table summarizes the positions of yuan-ti across the lair and indicates how they react when intruders are detected or the gong is struck.
zh_tw: 如果元提在神廟內發現入侵者且這些入侵者不是囚犯，他們會試圖在{@area 區域9|2ca|x}敲響大鑼。神廟名單表格總結了元提在巢穴中的位置，並指出當發現入侵者或鑼聲響起時他們的反應。

english: Once an alarm is raised, begin tracking how much time the characters spend in the temple. At the end of each hour, roll percentile dice and consult the Temple Reinforcements table to see what else arrives. Reinforcements enter the temple from {@area area 1|2ad|x} or {@area 23|303|x} and behave as you desire.
zh_tw: 一旦警報響起，開始追蹤角色在神廟中花費的時間。每到一個小時結束時，投擲百分骰並查閱神廟增援表格，看看還有什麼會到達。增援從{@area 區域1|2ad|x}或{@area 23|303|x}進入神廟，並按你的意願行動。

english: The temple is a living community. Outside combat, inhabitants move between chambers, feed, wash, rest, and engage in all the villainous deceptions of yuan-ti life. You can use the Temple Reinforcements table to simulate this.
zh_tw: 神廟是一個活躍的社群。在戰鬥之外，居民們在各個房間之間移動，進食，洗澡，休息，並參與元提生活中所有邪惡的欺騙行為。你可以使用神廟增援表格來模擬這一切。

english: Getting Inside
zh_tw: 進入內部

english: The two entrances to the yuan-ti temple are located amid the ruins of Omu's royal palace (see chapter 3, {@area area 20|292|x}). Map 4.1 provides an overview of the temple. The main entrance leads to {@area area 1|2ad|x} on the map, and the secret entrance leads to {@area area 23|303|x}.
zh_tw: 兩個通往元帝族寺廟的入口位於奧穆王宮的廢墟之中（見第3章，{@area 區域20|292|x}）。地圖4.1提供了寺廟的概覽。主入口通向地圖上的{@area 區域1|2ad|x}，而秘密入口通向{@area 區域23|303|x}。

english: Adventurers are most likely to enter the temple as infiltrators or captives. If they've forged an alliance with the Red Wizards in {@area chapter 3|1e8|x}, they'll be looking for Zagmira's spy in the temple harem ({@area area 10|2d5|x}).
zh_tw: 冒險者們最有可能以滲透者或俘虜的身份進入神廟。如果他們已經在{@area 第三章|1e8|x}中與紅袍法師達成了聯盟，他們將在神廟的後宮（{@area 區域10|2d5|x}）尋找扎格米拉的間諜。

english: Infiltrating the Temple
zh_tw: 潛入神廟

english: Human characters can pose as yuan-ti purebloods if they dress and act appropriately, and can even lead other characters into the temple as captives. They must bluff their way past the yuan-ti guards. Malisons are the easiest to fool: their inherent disdain for the lower strata of yuan-ti society means that they pay little heed to purebloods moving through the temple.
zh_tw: 人類角色如果穿著和行為得體，可以冒充元帝族純血，甚至可以將其他角色作為俘虜帶入寺廟。他們必須透過欺騙手段透過元帝族守衛。馬利森是最容易欺騙的：他們天生對元帝族社會下層的蔑視意味著他們不太關注純血在寺廟中的行動。

english: The temple denizens have racial tics that are difficult to mimic and they speak in a patois that combines the Common and Draconic tongues. To avoid drawing suspicion when talking, a human character pretending to be a yuan-ti pureblood must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check.
zh_tw: 神廟的居民有著難以模仿的種族特徵，他們使用一種混合了通用語和龍語的方言交談。為了避免在交談時引起懷疑，假裝為純血蛇人的人類角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定。

english: Nonhumans have a much harder time fooling the yuan-ti without the aid of magic. Nonhuman characters attempting to pose as yuan-ti purebloods have disadvantage on any ability checks made to act in disguise.
zh_tw: 非人類角色在沒有魔法幫助的情況下更難欺騙元提。試圖偽裝成元提純血的非人類角色在進行偽裝的屬性檢定時會有劣勢。

english: Captured by the Yuan-ti
zh_tw: 被元帝族捕獲

english: Characters captured by the yuan-ti are stripped of their gear, fitted with manacles (one set binding the wrists and another binding the ankles), and confined to the pits in {@area area 8|2c6|x}. Their gear is stored in {@area area 13|2e7|x} until it can be studied and inventoried by the storeroom's guardian, Azi Mas. If the characters don't escape within 1 hour, they are visited by the yuan-ti spymaster Yahru and his bodyguards (see {@area area 17|2f3|x}). Yahru asks questions about their mission. He and his bodyguards then escort the characters to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} or {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}.
zh_tw: 被元提捕獲的角色會被剝奪裝備，戴上手銬（一套繫結手腕，另一套繫結腳踝），並被關押在{@area 區域8|2c6|x}的坑中。他們的裝備被存放在{@area 區域13|2e7|x}，直到儲藏室的守護者阿茲·馬斯能夠研究並清點。如果角色們在1小時內無法逃脫，他們將被元提間諜大師亞魯和他的保鏢們（見{@area 區域17|2f3|x}）訪問。亞魯會詢問他們有關他們任務的問題。然後，他和他的保鏢們會護送角色們去見{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}或{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}。

english: Yahru enjoys political games and uses the characters to play {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} against one another. If the characters answered Yahru's questions angrily or arrogantly, they are taken to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. If they reacted in a calm, civil manner, they are brought to {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}.
zh_tw: 雅胡喜歡政治遊戲，利用角色來操縱{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}和{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}相互對立。如果角色對雅胡的問題回答時表現出憤怒或傲慢，他們將被帶到{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}那裡。如果他們以平靜、禮貌的方式作出反應，他們將被帶到{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}那裡。

english: Audience with Ras Nsi
zh_tw: 與拉茲·納斯會面

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} meets with prisoners in the throne room ({@area area 11|2da|x}). He wants to know why the characters invaded Omu. If he finds their answer unsatisfactory, he views them as dangerous and has them put to death immediately. If {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} learns that they've come to put an end to the death curse, he is intrigued. If they reveal that the cause lies in the Tomb of the Nine Gods, he releases them, gives them any remaining puzzle cubes they need to enter the tomb, and grants them safe passage out of Omu if they succeed in destroying the Soulmonger. He won't help them further, since that could incite a yuan-ti revolt.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}在王座廳（{@area 區域11|2da|x}）會見囚犯。他想知道角色們為何入侵奧穆。如果他發現他們的回答不滿意，他會認為他們很危險，並立即下令處死他們。如果{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}得知他們來是為了結束死亡詛咒，他會感興趣。如果他們透露原因在於九神之墓，他會釋放他們，給他們提供任何剩餘的謎題魔方，以便他們進入墓穴，並在他們成功摧毀噬魂器的情況下，允許他們安全離開奧穆。他不會進一步幫助他們，因為這可能會激起元帝族的反抗。

english: Audience with Fenthaza
zh_tw: 與芬薩札會面

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} meets with prisoners in her quarters ({@area area 5|2ba|x}). She sees the characters as pawns in her plot to overthrow {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. To determine whether they can be trusted, she assigns them to work as slaves under Slavemaster Issar ({@area area 19|2f7|x}). Issar assigns each character a labor, determined by rolling percentile dice and consulting the Slave Labors table. (More than one character can be given the same task.) As they perform labors, characters see how the temple functions and might find ways to escape.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}在她的住處（{@area 區域5|2ba|x}）會見囚犯。她視角色們為她篡奪{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}權力的棋子。為了確定他們是否值得信賴，她指派他們作為奴隸在奴隸主伊薩爾（{@area 區域19|2f7|x}）手下工作。伊薩爾根據擲百分骰並查閱奴隸勞動表格來為每個角色分配勞動（多個角色可以被賦予相同的任務）。在執行勞動時，角色們可以看到神廟的運作方式，並可能找到逃脫的方法。

english: If the characters perform their labors without incident or complaint for 1 day, they are brought before {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} once more. She promises them their freedom if they agree to overthrow {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. She also allows them to keep any puzzle cubes in {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s custody. If they agree, she gives them the armory passphrases (see {@area area 4|2b7|x}) and encourages them to carry out a slave uprising. She also offers to ritually transform human characters into yuan-ti purebloods so they can get closer to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} (see {@area area 9|2ca|x}). While the characters sow confusion, she assembles her guards and priests (see areas 6 and 7), ambushes {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, and attempts to kill him.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在1天內無事故或抱怨地完成他們的勞動，他們將再次被帶到{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}面前。她承諾如果他們同意推翻{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，就會給他們自由。她還允許他們保留在{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}監管下的任何謎題魔方。如果他們同意，她會給他們軍械庫的密碼（見{@area 區域4|2b7|x}），並鼓勵他們發起一場奴隸起義。她還提出將人類角色透過儀式轉變為元提純血，以便他們可以更接近{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}（見{@area 區域9|2ca|x}）。當角色們製造混亂時，她集結了她的守衛和祭司（見區域6和7），伏擊{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，並試圖殺死他。

english: If the coup is thwarted, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} and her confederates are put to death. If the coup succeeds, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} concludes that the characters have outlived their usefulness and tries to eliminate them. If the characters flee before she can betray them, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} sends her air elemental (see {@area area 5|2ba|x}) to hunt them down and kill them.
zh_tw: 如果政變被挫敗，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}和她的同謀將被處死。如果政變成功，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}會得出結論認為角色們已經失去了利用價值，並試圖除掉他們。如果角色們在她背叛之前逃跑，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}會派遣她的空氣元素（見{@area 區域5|2ba|x}）去追捕並殺死他們。

zh_tw: 4 {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）抬著一個轎子，上面坐著一個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)||第二型惡咒蛇人}。

english: 1 {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malison} returning to the temple. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine its type: 1–2, type 1; 3–4, type 2; 5–6, type 3.
zh_tw: 1 名{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}正在返回寺廟。擲一個{@dice d6}來確定其型別：1-2，型別1；3-4，型別2；5-6，型別3。

english: 1 {@creature yuan-ti abomination} arriving at the temple to challenge {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s leadership. If {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} is alive, she uses her influence to arrange a showdown between {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and the abomination in the fane ({@area area 9|2ca|x}). If {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} is {@condition incapacitated} or dead, the abomination bullies its way to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s throne room ({@area area 11|2da|x}), where it is killed.
zh_tw: 1 {@creature yuan-ti abomination||憎惡蛇人} 到達神廟挑戰{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的領導地位。如果{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}還活著，她會利用她的影響力安排在神廟（{@area 區域9|2ca|x}）中{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}和這個怪物之間的決鬥。如果{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}被{@condition incapacitated||無力}或死亡，這個怪物強行闖入{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的王座室（{@area 區域11|2da|x}），在那裡它被殺死。

english: {@dice 2d4} insane {@creature Cult Fanatic||cult fanatics} (NE male and female humans of mixed ethnicities) seeking an audience with {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, to pledge their devotion to Dendar the Night Serpent. The cult fanatics bring tribute in the form of treasure (roll once on the {@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG} table in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: {@dice 2d4}名瘋狂的{@creature Cult Fanatic||邪教狂信者}（中立邪惡的男女混血人類）請求覲見{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，以向夜蛇丹德爾宣誓效忠。這些狂信者以財寶作為貢品（在{@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG|庫藏寶藏：挑戰等級 0—4}表上擲骰一次，出自{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Random Treasure}{@i 城主指南}）。

english: {@dice 2d6} {@creature Tribal Warrior||tribal warriors} (N male and female Chultan humans) delivering tribute to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. This tribute consists of food, drink, and treasure (roll once on the {@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG} table in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Random Treasure} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6}名{@creature Tribal Warrior||部族武者}（中立陣營的楚爾特男女人類）向{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}進貢。貢品包括食物、飲品和財寶（在{@table Treasure Hoard: Challenge 0—4|DMG|庫藏寶藏：挑戰等級 0—4}表上擲一次，出自{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Random Treasure}{@i 城主指南}）。

english: Locations in the Temple
zh_tw: 神廟內的位置

english: Map 4.1 shows the layout of the entire temple. The following features are common throughout.
zh_tw: 地圖4.1展示了整個寺廟的佈局。以下特徵在整個寺廟中都是常見的。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Unless otherwise noted, chamber ceilings are 20 feet high and corridor ceilings are 10 feet high.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，房間的天花板高度為20尺，走廊的天花板高度為10尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Doors are made from worked stone, with 4-inch-wide holes spaced along their bottoms to allow Medium and smaller snakes to pass through. Doors are unlocked unless noted otherwise.
zh_tw: 門由加工過的石材製成，底部有4吋寬的孔洞，沿其間隔排列，以允許中型及更小的蛇透過。除非另有說明，否則門是未上鎖的。

english: Illumination
zh_tw: 照明

english: Oil lamps provide {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} throughout the complex. Each lamp burns with a tall green flame as bright as torchlight.
zh_tw: 油燈在整個建築群中提供{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。每盞燈燃燒著高高的綠色火焰，亮度與火炬相當。

english: Portcullises
zh_tw: 吊閘門

english: Iron portcullises secure certain areas of the temple. The bars of a portcullis are 1 inch thick and spaced 4 inches apart. A portcullis can be raised or lowered using an iron lever nearby. If the lever can't be reached, the portcullis can be forced up or down by characters with a combined Strength of 30 or more, but doing so breaks the mechanisms that keep the portcullis from dropping. A {@spell knock} spell also raises a closed portcullis.
zh_tw: 鐵製閘門保護著寺廟的某些區域。閘門的鐵條厚1吋，間隔4吋。閘門可以透過附近的鐵桿升起或降下。如果無法觸及鐵桿，總力量達到30或更高的角色可以強行將其抬起或按下，但這樣做會破壞防止閘門墜落的機制。{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術也可以將關閉的閘門抬起。

english: Ramps
zh_tw: 斜坡

english: In place of stairs, the temple has stone ramps, which snake-bodied yuan-ti find much easier to climb.
zh_tw: 寺廟沒有樓梯，而是有石制坡道，蛇身的元提發現它們更容易攀爬。

english: Teleporters
zh_tw: 傳送裝置

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} created five magical teleporters (in areas 8 through 12) that no one else is permitted to use. Each looks like a raised, faintly glowing stone disk with a serpentine glyph carved into the top of it. Each disk radiates an aura of conjuration magic under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 建立了五個魔法傳送器（位於區域8至12），其他人不得使用。每個傳送器看起來像是一個凸起的、微弱發光的石盤，上面刻有一個蛇形符文。在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術的仔細檢查下，每個盤子都散發出咒法魔法的氣息。

english: If {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} steps onto one of these disks, he can continue his movement from any other disk in the temple. A character with proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill can do the same thing by stepping onto the teleporter and succeeding on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. If the check succeeds but the character has no destination disk in mind, he or she appears atop a randomly determined one.
zh_tw: 如果 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 踏上其中一個圓盤，他可以從神廟中的任何其他圓盤繼續移動。一個精通 {@skill Arcana||奧秘} 技能的角色也可以透過踏上傳送器併成功透過一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定來做到同樣的事情。如果檢定成功但角色心中沒有目標圓盤，他或她將出現在隨機確定的一個圓盤上。

english: Map 4.1: Fane of the Night Serpent
zh_tw: 地圖4.1：夜蛇神殿

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 1. Main Gate
zh_tw: 1. 主門

english: If characters approach this area from the north, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色從北方接近這個區域，請閱讀：

english: A wide passage slopes down to a set of bronze doors. Coiled serpents decorate the metal, with a sliding hatch at head height. Four-inch-wide holes pierce the base of each door.
zh_tw: 一條寬闊的通道向下傾斜至一對青銅門。門上的金屬裝飾著盤繞的蛇形圖案，門的頭部高度處有一個滑動的小窗。每扇門的底部都有四吋寬的孔洞。

english: When opened, the bronze doors slide into wall niches to either side of the tunnel. To pull the doors apart, the yuan-ti broodguards under Nahth's command tug on heavy chains on the south side of the gate. To bypass the doors without opening them, yuan-ti malisons transform into snakes and slither through the holes at the bottom of the doors.
zh_tw: 當開啟時，青銅門滑入隧道兩側的壁龕中。要拉開這些門，納斯指揮下的元提守護者在門的南側拉動沉重的鏈條。要繞過這些門而不開啟它們，惡咒蛇人變身為蛇，從門底部的洞中滑過。

english: A {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||type 1 yuan-ti malison} named Nahth (pronounced NAWTH) and four {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) defend the main gate. Strangers are denied entry unless they are accompanied by one or more yuan-ti.
zh_tw: 一個名叫納斯（發音為NAWTH）的{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||型別1 惡咒蛇人}和四名{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）守衛著主門。除非由一個或多個元提陪同，否則不允許陌生人進入。

english: Nahth is greedy. After allowing characters to pass through the gate, he demands a bribe in the form of food (preferably meat) or treasure (minimum 10 gp). If the characters refuse to pay up, Nahth picks a fight with them. Combat here draws reinforcements from {@area area 2|2b1|x}.
zh_tw: 納斯非常貪婪。在允許角色透過大門後，他要求以食物（最好是肉類）或財寶（最少10金幣）的形式賄賂。如果角色拒絕支付，納斯會與他們發生衝突。在這裡進行戰鬥會從{@area 區域2|2b1|x}吸引援軍。

english: Snake Pits
zh_tw: 蛇坑

english: Beyond the main gate are three pits covered with iron grates. When enemies attack, the broodguards remove the grated covers and form up in a defensive line on the south side of the open pits. Each pit is 5 feet across, 10 feet deep, and filled with a {@creature swarm of poisonous snakes}. The walls of each pit are too smooth to climb without the aid of gear or magic. A creature can skirt around the edge of a pit with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check but falls if the check fails. A creature can also attempt to clear the pits with a standing jump or running jump (see the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} for jumping rules), provided there are no broodguards lined up along the far side.
zh_tw: 主門之外有三個被鐵柵覆蓋的坑。當敵人攻擊時，守衛們會移開柵欄蓋，並在敞開的坑的南側形成一道防禦線。每個坑寬5尺，深10尺，裡面充滿了{@creature swarm of poisonous snakes||毒蛇群}。每個坑的牆壁過於光滑，沒有裝備或魔法的幫助無法攀爬。一個生物可以透過成功進行{@dc 10}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定來繞過坑的邊緣，但如果檢定失敗則會掉入坑中。一個生物也可以嘗試透過原地跳躍或助跑跳躍來跨過坑（參見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的跳躍規則），前提是對面沒有守衛排成一列。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Nahth has a crocodile skin pouch containing 28 gp and wears gold ceremonial bracers sculpted to resemble bats (150 gp for the pair).
zh_tw: 納斯有一個鱷魚皮袋，裡面裝有28金幣，並佩戴著雕刻成蝙蝠形狀的金色儀式護腕（一對價值150金幣）。

english: 2. Hall of War
zh_tw: 2. 戰爭大廳

english: Four pillars carved with serpent reliefs support the 20-foot-high ceiling of this large room, in the middle of which is an 18-foot-high statue of a coiled cobra, facing north. Torches with green flames flicker on the walls, and the air reeks of dung. Two wagons are parked in one corner, and a triceratops is confined to a metal pen in another. To the west are a pair of dark alcoves, and to the south is a wide, pillared hall.
zh_tw: 這個大廳有20尺高的天花板，由四根雕刻著蛇形浮雕的柱子支撐著，大廳中央是一座18尺高的盤繞眼鏡蛇雕像，面向北方。牆上閃爍著綠色火焰的火把，空氣中瀰漫著糞便的臭味。兩輛馬車停在一個角落，另一角落則是一個金屬圍欄中關著的三角龍。向西是一對昏暗的凹室，向南則是一個寬闊的、有柱子的大廳。

english: Yuan-ti troops muster in this hall before heading into the city. Unless they have been drawn elsewhere, a {@creature yuan-ti pureblood} named Soakosh (pronounced SOH-kawsh) and four {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are stationed here. Two {@creature Basilisk||basilisks} chained to hooks in the western alcoves are trained not to look their yuan-ti masters in the eye. Chewed bits of stone (the remains of {@condition petrified} victims) litter the floor in the alcoves. The {@creature triceratops} confined to the metal pen in the northwest corner is docile until threatened. The yuan-ti use it to pull supply wagons.
zh_tw: 元提軍隊在進入城市之前在這座大廳集結。除非他們被吸引到其他地方，否則名為索科什（發音為SOH-kawsh）的一位{@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}和四位{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）駐紮在這裡。兩隻被鎖鏈拴在西邊壁龕的鉤子上的{@creature Basilisk||石化蜥蜴}被訓練成不直視他們的元提主人的眼睛。嚼碎的石頭碎片（{@condition petrified||石化}受害者的殘骸）散落在壁龕的地板上。被關在西北角金屬圍欄裡的{@creature triceratops||三角龍}在受到威脅之前都很溫順。元提用它來拉補給車。

english: Soakosh is fat and has a forked tongue. He's rarely seen without a bag of his favorite food at hand: candied grung eggs.
zh_tw: 索科什 很胖，舌頭分叉。他很少不帶他最喜歡的食物在身邊：糖漬格隆蛋。

english: If the alarm is raised, Soakosh commands the broodguards to unchain the basilisks from their hooks and lead them into battle like war hounds. If the alarm has not been raised but combat ensues here, one broodguard runs to sound the gong in {@area area 9|2ca|x}.
zh_tw: 如果警報響起，索科什命令育幼守衛從掛鉤上解開蛇怪並將它們像戰犬一樣帶入戰鬥。如果警報沒有響起但這裡發生了戰鬥，一名育幼守衛會跑去敲響{@area 區域9|2ca|x}的鑼。

english: If the triceratops is threatened with fire or injured by an attack, it smashes through the walls of its pen and heads toward {@area area 1|2ad|x}.
zh_tw: 如果三角龍受到火的威脅或被攻擊傷害，它會撞破圍欄的牆壁，朝{@area 區域1|2ad|x}方向前進。

english: Giant Cobra Statue
zh_tw: 巨型眼鏡蛇雕像

english: The statue is not dangerous. A character can climb it with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這座雕像並不危險。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來攀爬它。

english: Wagons
zh_tw: 四輪貨車

english: The supply wagons in the northeast corner are empty.
zh_tw: 東北角的補給馬車是空的。

english: 3. Hall of Serpents
zh_tw: 3. 蛇廳

english: The walls of this pillared hall bear reliefs of a giant serpent and its yuan-ti worshipers doing terrible things.
zh_tw: 這個有柱子的大廳的牆壁上刻有一條巨大蛇和它的元提崇拜者做可怕事情的浮雕。

english: The wall reliefs show the legend of Dendar the Night Serpent and the rise of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. Characters who examine them see the following tableaus:
zh_tw: 牆上的浮雕展示了夜蛇丹德爾的傳說和{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的崛起。角色們如果仔細檢視，會看到以下場景：

english: A giant serpent coils in the underworld, devouring the dreams of sleeping creatures.
zh_tw: 一條巨蛇在冥界盤旋，吞噬著睡眠生物的夢想。

english: Yuan-ti terrorize Chultans, feeding their nightmares to the great serpent.
zh_tw: 元提恐嚇楚爾特人，將他們的噩夢餵給那條巨大的蛇。

english: A yuan-ti malison ({@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}) wielding a flaming sword and wearing a gold crown set with a black opal leads the snake people to a great door to the underworld.
zh_tw: 一個惡咒蛇人（{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}），手持火焰劍，頭戴鑲有黑色蛋白石的金冠，帶領蛇族人走向通往冥界的大門。

english: The door to the underworld opens, releasing the serpent. It devours the sun and plunges the world into terror and darkness.
zh_tw: 通往冥界的門開啟了，釋放了那條蛇。它吞噬了太陽，使世界陷入恐怖和黑暗之中。

english: A character who searches the reliefs and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check discovers that the black opal in {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s crown is a stone button. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the character also sees tiny holes hidden among the scales of the Night Serpent carvings.
zh_tw: 一名角色若在浮雕中搜尋併成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會發現 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 王冠上的黑歐珀是一顆石制按鈕。如果檢定的結果比 DC 高 5 或更多，該角色還會看到在夜蛇雕刻的鱗片中隱藏的微小孔洞。

english: If a character presses the button in {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s crown, the carvings of the Night Serpent expel a soporific gas that fills the hallway and lingers for 1 minute. Any creature that moves into the gas or starts its turn inside it must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw. The gas has no effect on creatures that cannot be {@condition poisoned}, and creatures that fail the save fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour. Using cloth or wax, characters can plug the hundreds of holes and prevent the gas from flowing out.
zh_tw: 如果一個角色按下了 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 皇冠上的按鈕，夜蛇的雕刻會釋放出一種催眠氣體，充滿走廊並持續1分鐘。任何進入氣體或在其範圍內開始回合的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免。氣體對無法 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 的生物沒有影響，而那些豁免失敗的生物會陷入 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 狀態1小時。使用布或蠟，角色可以堵住數百個小孔，阻止氣體流出。

english: 4. Armory
zh_tw: 4. 軍械庫

english: The armory door has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it. Officially, only {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, {@creature Sekelok|ToA}, and {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} know the command phrase to bypass the spell ("white feather"). Speaking the command phrase while standing within 5 feet of the door suppresses its magic for 1 minute, during which time the door can be opened normally. The door can also be forced open with a {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 軍械庫的門被施放了 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 法術。官方來說，只有 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}、{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克} 和 {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 知道繞過該法術的指令短語（"白色羽毛"）。站在門5尺之內說出指令短語，可在1分鐘內壓制其魔法，在此期間門可以正常開啟。該門也可以透過 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或成功的 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。

english: When the characters peer inside, read:
zh_tw: 當角色向內看時，請閱讀：

english: Gleaming scimitars, serpent helms, and suits of scale armor cram the racks of this vault. Large bones and horned skulls litter the floor, and a shield made from the shell of a tortoise hangs on the far wall.
zh_tw: 這個金庫的架子上堆滿了閃亮的彎刀、蛇形頭盔和鱗甲。大骨頭和有角的頭骨散落在地板上，遠處的牆上掛著一個用龜殼製成的盾牌。

english: A large skeletal serpent slithers out from behind the racks, raises its head, and says in Common, "They will tell us the passphrase! So Ukurlahmu has spoken."
zh_tw: 一條巨大的骸骨巨蛇從架子後方滑出，抬起頭，以通用語說：「他們會告訴我們口令！烏庫拉穆如是說。」

english: A {@creature Bone Naga (Spirit)||bone naga} named Ukurlahmu (pronounced oo-ker-LAH-moo) has orders to protect the armory from thieves, but it struggles to remember faces. It only attacks creatures who fail to speak the correct passphrase. The current passphrase is "black mask." Characters are given three chances to utter the correct phrase before Ukurlahmu attacks. Before it attacks, the naga uses a bonus action to speak a magic command word that causes two {@creature Minotaur Skeleton||minotaur skeletons} to rise from the bones on the floor. The skeletons obey the naga.
zh_tw: 一個名叫烏庫拉穆（發音為oo-ker-LAH-moo）的{@creature Bone Naga (Spirit)||骸骨納迦}接到命令保護軍械庫不受小偷侵害，但它很難記住面孔。它只會攻擊那些沒有說出正確口令的生物。當前的口令是"黑色面具"。角色們有三次機會說出正確的短語，否則烏庫拉穆會攻擊。在攻擊之前，骸骨納迦會使用附贈動作說出一個魔法命令詞，使兩個{@creature Minotaur Skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}從地板上的骨頭中升起。這些骷髏服從骸骨納迦。

english: Ukurlahmu speaks strangely. When it asks a question or makes a demand, it prefaces every sentence with "It will..." or "They will..." (for example, "It will tell us why it is here and what it wants"). When it makes a statement or answers a question, it always ends its sentences with "... so Ukurlahmu has spoken."
zh_tw: 烏庫拉穆說話的方式很奇怪。每逢提問或下令，都以「它會……」或「他們會……」開頭，例如：「它會告訴我們，它為什麼來這裡，又想要什麼。」陳述事情或回答問題時，則一律以「……烏庫拉穆如是說」作結。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The armory contains ten suits of scale armor, fifty scimitars, twenty longbows, twenty shortbows, and fifty quivers containing twenty arrows each. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the shield hanging on the wall. The shield has a minor magical property: words spoken by the shield's bearer are amplified and sound ten times louder than normal.
zh_tw: 軍械庫包含十套鱗甲，五十把彎刀，二十張長弓，二十張短弓，以及五十個箭袋，每個箭袋含有二十支箭。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了掛在牆上的盾牌周圍的變形魔法光環。這個盾牌有一個輕微的魔法屬性：盾牌持有者說出的話會被放大，聽起來比正常聲音大十倍。

english: The tortoise-shell shield belongs to {@creature Sekelok|ToA}, and only he is allowed to touch it. If a character removes the shield from the wall, Ukurlahmu coldly demands that it be returned it to its hook, attacking if this instruction is ignored.
zh_tw: 龜殼盾牌屬於{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}，只有他被允許觸碰它。如果一個角色將盾牌從牆上取下，烏庫拉穆會冷靜地要求將其放回掛鉤，如果這個指示被忽視，它將發起攻擊。

english: 5. Fenthaza's Quarters
zh_tw: 5. 芬薩札的住處

english: Two {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)||type 2 yuan-ti malisons} stand guard in the corridor outside this room. Combat in the hallway alerts the yuan-ti broodguards in {@area area 6|2be|x}, which arrive in 1 round. The room can be described as follows:
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)||第二型惡咒蛇人}在房間外的走廊上站崗。走廊中的戰鬥會提醒{@area 區域6|2be|x}的元提守護者，它們將在1回合內到達。房間可以這樣描述：

english: A haze of incense lingers inside the chamber. Faded murals decorate the walls, and throw rugs and cushions lie scattered on the floor. An engraved chest rests in one corner next to a stone urn covered with snake carvings. A creature with the head and upper body of a dark-skinned woman and the lower body of a serpent coils in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 室內瀰漫著香菸的薄霧。牆壁上裝飾著褪色的壁畫，地板上散佈著拋擲地毯和靠墊。一個雕刻精細的箱子放在角落裡，旁邊是一個覆蓋著蛇形雕刻的石甕。一個生物盤繞在房間中央，它有著深色皮膚女性的頭部和上半身，以及蛇的下半身。

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}, a {@creature yuan-ti nightmare speaker|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), lairs here. If an alarm is raised, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} relies on her guards to protect her while she releases the creature trapped in the stone urn (see below). {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} tries to incapacitate interlopers and confine them to {@area area 8|2c6|x}. A particularly irksome foe might be shackled to the altar in {@area area 6|2be|x}, where she can torture it at her leisure.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}，一位{@creature yuan-ti nightmare speaker|VGM|蛇人夢魘語者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），在這裡潛伏。如果警報響起，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}依靠她的守衛來保護她，同時她釋放了困在石甕中的生物（見下文）。{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}試圖使入侵者失去行動能力，並將他們關押到{@area 區域8|2c6|x}。一個特別令人討厭的敵人可能會被銬在{@area 區域6|2be|x}的祭壇上，在那裡她可以隨意折磨它。

english: One of the more powerful figures in the temple, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} ruled the yuan-ti after their abomination leader died, and she performed the ritual that transformed {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} into a malison. Recently, her visions have led her to doubt {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s capabilities. In turn, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} has started to cede power to his champion, {@creature Sekelok|ToA} ({@area area 12|2e1|x}).
zh_tw: 作為神廟中較為強大的人物之一，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}在他們的怪物領袖死後統治了元提，並執行了將{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}轉變為咒詛者的儀式。最近，她的視覺幻象使她開始懷疑{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的能力。作為回應，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}開始將權力讓給他的冠軍，{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}（見{@area 區域12|2e1|x}）。

english: Stone Urn
zh_tw: 石甕

english: The stone urn stands 4 feet tall and weighs 250 pounds. Its stone lid weighs 25 pounds. Trapped within the urn is an {@creature air elemental} that obeys {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}. If the urn's lid is removed by someone other than {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}, the elemental flies out and attacks.
zh_tw: 這個石制骨灰甕高4尺，重250磅。它的石制蓋子重25磅。骨灰甕中困著一個{@creature air elemental||氣元素}，它服從於{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}。如果骨灰甕的蓋子被{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}以外的人開啟，風元素會飛出來並發動攻擊。

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} uses the elemental to hunt down and slay escaped prisoners. Once it has completed its task, the elemental always returns to its mistress.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 利用元素生物追捕並殺死逃脫的囚犯。一旦完成任務，元素生物總是返回其女主人那裡。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} carries a ring of keys that unlock the manacles and shackles worn by the prisoners in {@area area 8|2c6|x}. She wears a holy symbol of Dendar the Night Serpent (25 gp) around her neck.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 攜帶著一串鑰匙，可以開啟{@area 區域8|2c6|x}中囚犯所戴的手銬和腳鐐。她的脖子上掛著夜蛇丹德爾的聖徽（價值25金幣）。

english: The chest is unlocked and contains 200 gp, a black leather quiver embroidered with a quartz-studded star map (75 gp), and a ceremonial dagger in a gold scabbard embossed with a scene of stampeding jungle animals (25 gp).
zh_tw: 箱子沒有上鎖，裡面有200金幣，一個黑色皮製箭袋，上面繡有鑲嵌石英的星圖（75金幣），還有一把儀式用匕首，裝在金鞘中，上面浮雕著叢林動物奔騰的場景（25金幣）。

english: 6. Sacrificial Chamber
zh_tw: 6. 祭祀室

english: Unless they are lured to {@area area 5|2ba|x} by sounds of battle, four {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) stand guard in this chamber, one in each corner.
zh_tw: 除非被{@area 區域5|2ba|x}戰鬥的聲音吸引，否則四名{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在這個房間裡站崗，每個角落一個。

english: A bloodstained altar stands in the middle of this room. It has shackles bolted to its top and niches carved into its sides. Housed in each niche is a human skull. Grooves run down the altar to gutters on the floor, allowing spilled blood to drain into the walls. Clay urns overflow with wet bones and gore.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央有一個血跡斑斑的祭壇。祭壇頂部固定著鐐銬，兩側雕刻有壁龕。每個壁龕內都放著一個人頭骨。凹槽從祭壇延伸至地面的排水溝，使溢位的血液可以流入牆壁。陶甕裡溢位著溼骨和血肉。

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} routinely sacrifices prisoners on the altar. As they die, their blood drains into the pool in {@area area 9|2ca|x}. A captured character who insults or otherwise annoys {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} might end up here, shackled to the altar.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 經常在祭壇上獻祭囚犯。當他們死去時，他們的血會流入{@area 區域9|2ca|x}的池中。一個被俘的角色如果侮辱或以其他方式激怒{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}，最終可能會被銬在祭壇上。

english: Chanting Skulls
zh_tw: 吟唱頭骨

english: The altar has six niches (one at each end and two on each long side). The human skull in each niche radiates an aura of abjuration magic under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell. If combat ensues here, the skulls start to chant in Abyssal. The skulls stop chanting when they are removed from their niches or when combat ends. Each skull has AC 9, 1 hit point, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. As long as one or more skulls are chanting, all yuan-ti in the room gain the following benefits:
zh_tw: 祭壇有六個壁龕（每端一個，每長邊兩個）。在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術的檢查下，每個壁龕中的人頭骨散發出防護魔法的氣息。如果在這裡發生戰鬥，頭骨會開始用深淵語吟唱。當頭骨從它們的壁龕中移除或戰鬥結束時，頭骨會停止吟唱。每個頭骨的AC為9，1點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。只要有一個或多個頭骨在吟唱，房間裡的所有元提都會獲得以下好處：

english: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks
zh_tw: 對來自非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、刺穿和揮砍傷害具有抗性

english: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
zh_tw: 對法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定有優勢

english: Portcullis
zh_tw: 鐵閘

english: A portcullis seals the entrance to {@area area 8|2c6|x}. A bronze lever is set into the wall south of the gate, out of sight of {@area area 8|2c6|x}. Lifting the lever raises the portcullis, and pulling the lever down causes the portcullis to drop.
zh_tw: 一個吊閘封閉了通往{@area 區域8|2c6|x}的入口。一個青銅槓桿嵌入在門南側的牆壁上，從{@area 區域8|2c6|x}看不見。拉起槓桿會升起吊閘，拉下槓桿則會使吊閘落下。

english: 7. Evil Oracle
zh_tw: 7. 邪惡預言者

english: Steam rises from a stone basin filled with viscous black and purple liquid. Three serpentine creatures surround the pool. Each has the head and upper body of a dark-skinned woman and the lower body of a snake.
zh_tw: 蒸汽從一個裝滿粘性黑色和紫色液體的石盆中升起。三個蛇形生物圍繞著水池。每個生物都有深色皮膚女性的頭部和上半身，以及蛇的下半身。

english: {@creature Yuan-ti Priest|ToA|Yuan-ti priests} use the pool to commune with Dendar the Night Serpent. Three priests named Arakiti, Kultha, and Nyss are here at all times. They are loyal to {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} and are {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)||type 3 yuan-ti malisons}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Yuan-ti Priest|ToA|蛇人祭司}使用這個水池與夜蛇丹德爾交流。名叫阿拉基提、庫爾薩和尼絲的三位牧師始終在這裡。他們忠於{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}，並且是{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)||型別3惡咒蛇人}，有以下變化：

english: Add the following to the list of spells that the yuan-ti can innately cast at will: {@spell eldritch blast} (2 beams; {@hit 5} to hit; {@dice 1d10 + 3} force damage per beam), {@spell minor illusion}, and {@spell poison spray}.
zh_tw: 在蛇人可隨意施放的法術列表中新增以下法術：{@spell eldritch blast||魔能爆}（2束；{@hit 5}命中；每束{@dice 1d10 + 3}力場傷害）、{@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}和{@spell poison spray||毒氣噴湧}。

english: They don't carry longbows.
zh_tw: 它們沒有攜帶長弓。

english: Oracle Pool
zh_tw: 神諭池

english: The sludge within the pool conducts the reveries of Dendar the Night Serpent. A creature that enters the sludge or starts its turn in the pool takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 池中的汙泥傳導著夜蛇登達爾的幻象。進入汙泥或在其上開始回合的生物會受到5點（{@dice 1d10}）心靈傷害。

english: Any creature that gazes into the pool for more than a few seconds receives a brief, nightmarish vision. In this vision, the creature is being swallowed whole by a giant snake. When the vision ends, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) psychic damage and is afflicted with a random form of long-term madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 任何凝視池水超過數秒的生物都會接收到一段短暫的噩夢般的幻象。在這個幻象中，生物被一隻巨蛇整個吞下。幻象結束時，該生物必須進行一個{@dc 15}的感知豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，該生物受到5（{@dice 1d10}）點心靈傷害，並遭受一種隨機的長期瘋狂效果（詳見{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}，在{@i 城主指南}的第8章中）。

english: Prisoners of the Yuan-ti
zh_tw: 元提人的囚犯

english: Yuan-ti captives not put to work as slaves are imprisoned in cells until they can be sacrificed to Dendar the Night Serpent. Ten sample prisoners are described below, and you can create others. All prisoners wear manacles on their wrists and ankles (see {@area area 8|2c6|x} for details). They've been stripped of their armor and weapons unless noted otherwise. All seek to escape the temple and make their way back to their homes or return to civilization.
zh_tw: 元提的俘虜如果沒有被當作奴隸使用，就會被關在牢房裡，直到他們可以被獻祭給夜蛇丹德爾。下面描述了十個樣本囚犯，你可以創造其他囚犯。所有囚犯的手腕和腳踝上都戴著手銬（見{@area 區域8|2c6|x}瞭解詳細資訊）。除非另有說明，他們都被剝奪了盔甲和武器。所有人都尋求逃離寺廟，回到他們的家園或返回文明社會。

english: Tahvo, a ten-year-old boy (LG male Chultan human noncombatant with AC 10 and 2 hit points), wears a flower garland and prays constantly to Tymora.
zh_tw: 塔沃，一個十歲的男孩（LG男性楚爾特人非戰鬥人員，AC 10，2點生命值），戴著花環，不斷地向泰摩拉祈禱。

english: Sev, a {@creature yuan-ti pureblood} who looks human except for his forked tongue, is suffering the effects of blue mist fever (see "{@area Diseases|0a4|x}") and throws stones at illusory blue monkeys only he can see.
zh_tw: 塞夫，一個除了分叉的舌頭外看起來像人類的{@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}，正在遭受藍霧熱（見"{@area 疾病|0a4|x}"）的影響，並且向只有他能看到的虛幻藍猴子扔石頭。

english: Oloma Authdamar (CG female Turami human {@creature scout}) is a former crew member of the Star Goddess (see {@area chapter 2|1aa|x}). She leapt from a porthole as the ship crashed, and the yuan-ti captured her in the jungle. Oloma carries a concealed dagger.
zh_tw: 奧洛瑪·奧瑟達瑪（CG女性圖拉米人{@creature scout||斥侯}）是星女神號（見{@area 第二章|1aa|x}）的前船員。當船墜毀時，她從一個舷窗跳下，元提在叢林中捕獲了她。奧洛瑪攜帶了一把隱藏的匕首。

english: Pottery Shard, a {@creature tabaxi minstrel|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), was kidnapped while traveling from Port Nyanzaru to Fort Beluarian.
zh_tw: 陶器碎片，一個{@creature tabaxi minstrel|ToA|斑貓詩人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），在從南扎路港前往貝路利安堡的途中被綁架。

english: Gorvax, a {@creature firenewt warrior|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) is eager to escape and return to the Valley of Lost Honor.
zh_tw: 戈瓦克斯，一個{@creature firenewt warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）渴望逃脫並返回失落榮耀谷。

english: A Harper named Lomar Dral (LG male Turami human {@creature mage} with no spell slots remaining). While searching for {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru, he was drugged by the yuan-ti guide {@creature Salida|ToA} and woke up a prisoner in Omu.
zh_tw: 一位名叫洛瑪爾·德拉爾（守序善良男性圖拉米人人類{@creature mage||魔法師}且沒有剩餘法術位）的豎琴手。在南扎路港尋找{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}時，他被原體蛇人嚮導{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}下藥，醒來後成為了奧穆的囚犯。

english: Mung, a Batiri goblin, was caught by the yuan-ti while foraging in the jungle. He is malnourished and suffers from 3 levels of {@condition exhaustion} (see {@condition exhaustion||appendix A} of the Player's Handbook).
zh_tw: 芒格，一個巴提裡地精，在叢林中覓食時被元提捕獲。他營養不良，遭受著3級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}（見《玩家手冊》中的{@condition exhaustion||附錄A}）。

english: Kanush Natombe (N male Chultan human {@creature tribal warrior}) foolishly traveled to Omu to prove his worth to another man. Kanush is malnourished and suffers from 4 levels of {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 卡努什·納通貝（N男性楚爾特人{@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}）愚蠢地前往奧穆，向另一個人證明自己的價值。卡努什營養不良，遭受著4級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。

english: Zilla Atazi (LE female Chultan human {@creature bandit}) was a pirate aboard the Dragonfang. Captain {@creature Elok Jaharwon|ToA} threw Zilla overboard for insubordination. The yuan-ti captured her after she washed ashore.
zh_tw: 齊拉·阿塔齊（LE女性楚爾特人{@creature bandit||匪徒}）曾是龍牙號上的海盜。由於不服從命令，船長{@creature Elok Jaharwon|ToA|伊洛克·加哈望}將齊拉扔下了船。她在被衝上岸後被元提捕獲。

english: 8. Prisoner Pits
zh_tw: 8. 囚犯坑

english: An iron portcullis seals this chamber. The lever to raise it is located in {@area area 6|2be|x}.
zh_tw: 一個鐵製的格柵門封閉了這個房間。升起它的扳手位於{@area 區域6|2be|x}。

english: Characters captured by the yuan-ti are confined here. If this is how the characters first arrive, read:
zh_tw: 被元提捕獲的角色被關押在這裡。如果這是角色們首次到達的方式，請閱讀：

english: The stench of sweat fills the humid air. You are chained to the wall of a dank, partially flooded pit. Other prisoners whimper nearby, lit by faint torchlight from the hole above.
zh_tw: 汗水的惡臭瀰漫在潮溼的空氣中。你被鎖在陰暗、部分被水淹沒的坑洞牆壁上。附近的其他囚犯在微弱的火把光芒中嗚咽，這些火把來自上面的洞口。

english: If characters peer into this room through the portcullis, use this description instead:
zh_tw: 如果角色透過吊閘向這個房間內窺視，請使用以下描述：

english: Muffled sobs and moans rise from four pits with circular iron grates covering them. A chain hooked to each grate stretches over a pulley bolted to the ceiling and coils around an iron winch set into a nearby wall. Iron manacles dangle from hooks on the south wall. To the north, a faintly glowing stone disk covers the floor of an otherwise empty alcove, and carved into the top of the disk is a serpentine symbol.
zh_tw: 從四個覆蓋著圓形鐵格柵的坑中傳來壓抑的哭泣和呻吟聲。每個格柵上掛著的鏈條穿過固定在天花板上的滑輪，纏繞在一個嵌入附近牆壁的鐵絞盤上。南牆上掛著鐵手銬。向北，一個微弱發光的石盤覆蓋在一個空蕩蕩的壁龕的地面上，石盤頂部刻有一個蛇形符號。

english: The room contains four pits, each one a bell-shaped chamber 10 feet deep and 10 feet in diameter. The pits are flooded to a depth of 3 feet. Covering each pit is a 600-pound circular iron grate that requires one or more characters with a combined Strength score of at least 20 to lift. Alternatively, a character can use the iron winch near each pit to lift or lower its lid with a successful {@dc 12} Strength check. Climbing the slippery, sloped walls of a pit requires a {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 房間裡包含四個深坑，每個深坑都是一個鐘形的地下室，深10尺，直徑10尺。深坑被淹沒了3尺深。每個深坑上覆蓋著一個600磅重的圓形鐵柵欄，需要總力量值至少為20的一個或多個角色才能抬起。或者，一個角色可以使用每個深坑附近的鐵絞盤，透過成功的 {@dc 12} 力量檢定來升起或降下蓋子。攀爬深坑溼滑的斜坡牆壁需要 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: New prisoners are slapped in chains and dropped into a random pit. The yuan-ti strip all prisoners of their belongings, which are kept in the storeroom ({@area area 13|2e7|x}) until they are properly inventoried. If the yuan-ti need to get a prisoner out of the pit, they disconnect a hook from the lid and use it to hoist the prisoner out by the manacles.
zh_tw: 新囚犯被鎖鏈束縛並被隨意投入一個坑中。元提剝去所有囚犯的財物，這些財物被存放在儲藏室（{@area 區域13|2e7|x}）中，直到它們被適當地清點。如果元提需要將囚犯從坑中取出，他們會從蓋子上斷開一個鉤子，並用它透過手銬將囚犯吊起來。

english: Each pit contains {@dice 1d3} prisoners, and the "{@adventure Prisoners of the Yuan-ti|ToA|4|Prisoners of the Yuan-ti}" sidebar describes several. If a player character dies, you could introduce a replacement character here as a prisoner hoping to be rescued.
zh_tw: 每個坑裡關著{@dice 1d3}名囚犯，而"{@adventure 元提人的囚犯|ToA|4|Prisoners of the Yuan-ti}"邊欄描述了幾個。如果玩家角色死亡，你可以在這裡引入一個替代角色作為希望被救援的囚犯。

english: Prisoners are forced to wear manacles on their wrists and shackles on their ankles. The manacles impose disadvantage on ability checks made to climb or swim. The shackles reduce a prisoner's walking speed by half and impose disadvantage on ability checks made to jump. {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} (see {@area area 5|2ba|x}) carries the keys for these bindings. See "{@book Adventuring Gear|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}" in chapter 5 of the {@i Player's Handbook} for rules on breaking, escaping, and unlocking manacles (and shackles).
zh_tw: 囚犯被迫在手腕上戴上手銬，腳踝上戴上腳鐐。手銬會使攀爬或游泳的技能檢定處於劣勢。腳鐐會使囚犯的行走速度減半，並且跳躍的技能檢定處於劣勢。{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}（見{@area 區域5|2ba|x}）持有這些束縛的鑰匙。有關破壞、逃脫和開啟手銬（和腳鐐）的規則，請參見《{@i 玩家手冊}》第5章中的"{@book 冒險用品|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}"。

english: Teleporter
zh_tw: 傳送器

english: The engraved stone disk in the northern alcove is one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s magic teleporters (see "{@area Teleporters|2ac|x}").
zh_tw: 北邊壁龕中雕刻的石盤是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的魔法傳送器之一（見"{@area 傳送裝置|2ac|x}"）。

english: 9. The Fane
zh_tw: 9. 聖所

english: An underground cathedral opens before you. At one end, a sculptured balcony perches atop five rearing stone serpents. Blood dribbling from the serpents' jaws falls into a semicircular basin, and from there flows along a sloped trough into a wide stone bowl set into the floor. South of the bowl is a mezzanine, prominently situated atop which is a cauldron of steaming broth that exudes fleshy odors. To the west, a huge gong carved with snake patterns stands on a second balcony.
zh_tw: 一個地下大教堂展現在你們面前。在一端，一個雕塑陽臺坐落在五條昂首的石蛇之上。從蛇的下巴滴下的血滴落入一個半圓形的水池中，然後沿著一個傾斜的槽流進嵌入地板的一個寬闊的石碗中。在碗的南側是一個夾層，上面顯眼地放著一個冒著熱氣的大鍋，散發著肉味。在西側，一個雕刻著蛇形圖案的巨大鑼懸掛在第二個陽臺上。

english: During rituals, the fane swells with yuan-ti, but the room is unguarded otherwise. When struck, the gong can be heard throughout the temple complex. One strike announces the start of a serpent ritual: when sounded, all the yuan-ti within the temple complex arrive here within half an hour. Two or more strikes in quick succession signal an alarm: when sounded, yuan-ti throughout the temple converge on this location as quickly as possible (see the Temple Roster table).
zh_tw: 在儀式期間，神殿裡滿是元帝族，但其他時候房間無人守衛。敲擊時，鑼聲可以傳遍整個寺廟建築群。一聲鑼響宣佈蛇類儀式的開始：敲響時，寺廟建築群內的所有元帝族會在半小時內聚集到這裡。連續快速敲擊兩聲或更多聲則是警報訊號：敲響時，寺廟中的元帝族會儘可能快地聚集到這個位置（見寺廟人員名單表）。

english: Blood Pool
zh_tw: 血池

english: Blood spilled in {@area area 6|2be|x} is channeled into this room, and the central pool contains {@dice 3d6} inches of viscid, days-old blood from previous sacrifices. The yuan-ti wallow in the blood from time to time, and slaves are sometimes brought here to be eaten alive by crazed revelers or transformed into yuan-ti (see "{@area Yuan-ti Rituals|2d0|x}" below).
zh_tw: 在{@area 區域6|2be|x}中流淌的血液被匯入這個房間，中央的池子裡積有{@dice 3d6}吋粘稠、多日的血液，來自之前的祭祀。元蒂有時會在血液中打滾，有時奴隸們會被帶到這裡，被瘋狂的狂歡者活活吃掉，或者被轉化成元蒂（見下文"{@area 元提儀式|2d0|x}"）。

english: Cauldron
zh_tw: 吊掛大鍋

english: A stew made from boiled flesh sloshes inside the cauldron, which is heated by a volcanic vent in the floor underneath it. Upturning the cauldron is an action that requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength check. When the cauldron is tipped, each creature on the floor within a 15-foot cone of the cauldron must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 ({@dice 1d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 一鍋用煮熟的肉製成的燉菜在鍋中翻滾，鍋底下的火山噴口加熱著它。翻倒這口鍋需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量檢定。當鍋被推翻時，位於鍋周圍15尺錐形區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 12} 敏捷豁免，豁免失敗會受到 4 點 ({@dice 1d8}) 火焰傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。

english: North Balcony and Teleporter
zh_tw: 北陽臺和傳送器

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} use the north balcony to address underlings. To climb up, a character must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The balustrades around the balcony provide {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against ranged attacks originating from the room below.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 和 {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 使用北側陽臺對下屬發表講話。要爬上去，角色必須透過一個 {@dc 13} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。陽臺周圍的欄杆為來自下方房間的遠端攻擊提供了 {@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: Set into the back wall is an alcove with an engraved stone disk on the floor—one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s magic teleporters (see "{@area Teleporters|2ac|x}").
zh_tw: 後牆上嵌入了一個壁龕，壁龕內有一塊刻有圖案的石盤在地面上——這是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的魔法傳送器之一（見"{@area 傳送裝置|2ac|x}"）。

english: Portcullis
zh_tw: 鐵閘

english: A portcullis seals the entrance to {@area area 10|2d5|x}. A bronze lever is set into the wall north of the gate, out of sight of {@area area 10|2d5|x}. Lifting the lever raises the portcullis, and pulling the lever down causes the portcullis to drop.
zh_tw: 一個鐵柵門封閉了通往{@area 區域10|2d5|x}的入口。一個銅製扳手設定在門北邊的牆壁上，從{@area 區域10|2d5|x}看不見。拉起扳手會升起鐵柵門，拉下扳手則會使鐵柵門落下。

english: Yuan-ti Rituals
zh_tw: 元提儀式

english: Once every ten days, the yuan-ti gather in the fane for a depraved ritual. The ceremony takes place over the course of one night, with a skeleton crew guarding the rest of the temple complex during these periods.
zh_tw: 每十天一次，元提聚集在神廟進行一個墮落的儀式。儀式在一夜之間進行，期間只有少數守衛守護著寺廟的其他區域。

english: During the ritual, mesmerizing incense is burned in the wall sconces. (See {@area area 13|2e7|x} for more information on the incense.) {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} preaches to the congregation from the north balcony. As the ceremony reaches fever pitch, she joins the revelers in the blood pool to feast on the slaves before slithering back to her quarters. On occasion, human slaves are transformed into yuan-ti purebloods or broodguards during these rituals. To undergo the change, slaves must bathe with snakes in the blood of sacrificial victims while under the influence of temple drugs. The transformation leaves each slave with {@dice 1d6} levels of {@condition exhaustion}. Once they've shed their old skin, those who survive the process are taken to their new home in the yuan-ti nests ({@area area 18|2f5|x}) to recuperate. Those who die are fed to the hydra in {@area area 21|2ff|x}.
zh_tw: 在儀式期間，牆上的燭臺燃燒著迷人的薰香。（有關薰香的更多資訊，請見{@area 區域13|2e7|x}。）{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}從北陽臺向會眾宣講。當儀式達到高潮時，她加入血池中的狂歡者，享用奴隸，然後滑回她的住處。偶爾，人類奴隸在這些儀式中被轉變為眼魔族純血或後代守衛。要經歷這種變化，奴隸們必須在寺廟藥物的影響下，在犧牲者的血中與蛇一起沐浴。這種轉變使每個奴隸得到{@dice 1d6}級的{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態。一旦他們蛻去舊皮，那些在過程中倖存下來的人將被帶到眼魔族巢穴（{@area 區域18|2f5|x}）的新家中恢復。那些死去的人則被餵給{@area 區域21|2ff|x}中的多頭蛇。

english: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} can arrange for captured human characters to be transformed into yuan-ti purebloods so they can roam freely within the temple complex and get closer to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. The transformation can be undone only by a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention. Characters who survive it gain a random form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). A human that undergoes and survives the ritual retains its traits and gains the following yuan-ti racial traits.
zh_tw: {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}可以安排被捕獲的人類角色被轉變為元帝族純血，以便他們能夠在寺廟建築群內自由漫遊，並更接近{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}。這種轉變只能透過{@spell wish||祈願術}法術或神明的幹預來撤銷。經歷並倖存下來的角色會獲得一種隨機的不定性瘋狂（見《{@book 瘋狂|DMG|8|Madness}》第八章中的"瘋狂"部分，在《{@i 城主指南}》中）。經歷並倖存下來儀式的人類將保留其特徵，並獲得以下元帝族種族特徵。

english: Darkvision
zh_tw: 黑暗視覺

english: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
zh_tw: 你可以在60尺內將{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}視為{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}，將黑暗視為{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}。在黑暗中你無法分辨顏色，只能看到灰度陰影。

english: Innate Spellcasting
zh_tw: 天生施法

english: You know the {@spell poison spray} cantrip. You can cast {@spell animal friendship} an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast {@spell suggestion} with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
zh_tw: 你習得戲法{@spell poison spray||毒氣噴湧}。你可以透過此特質無限制地施放{@spell animal friendship||化獸為友}，但以此施放的法術目標只能是蛇。從3級開始，你還可以透過此特質施放{@spell suggestion||暗示術}。一旦你施放了它，在你完成一次長休前無法再次施放。魅力是你這些法術的施法屬性。

english: Magic Resistance
zh_tw: 魔法抗性

english: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
zh_tw: 你在對抗法術和其他魔法效果時進行的豁免檢定具有優勢。

english: Poison Immunity
zh_tw: 中毒免疫

english: You are immune to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.
zh_tw: 你免疫毒素傷害和{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

english: 10. Harem
zh_tw: 10. 後宮

english: An iron portcullis seals the entrance to this chamber. To raise it, a creature must lift a lever in {@area area 9|2ca|x}.
zh_tw: 一個鐵製吊閘封閉了這個房間的入口。要升起它，生物必須在{@area 區域9|2ca|x}拉起一個槓桿。

english: A fountain of cool water bubbles on the floor ahead. The scent of lilies fills the air, and silken drapes drift lazily in the heat. Archways open into shaded booths heaped with cushions and trays of sugared sweets. Lounging about are a dozen scantily clad humanoids with eyes like those of snakes and scaly patches on their arms, legs, necks, and backs. Watching over them are a pair of inhuman bipedal reptiles.
zh_tw: 前方地面上，一股涼爽的泉水在冒泡。空氣中瀰漫著百合花的香氣，絲綢帷幔在熱氣中懶洋洋地飄動。拱門通向陰涼的包廂，包廂裡堆滿了墊子和盛滿糖果的託盤。十幾個穿著暴露的人形生物懶散地躺在那裡，他們的眼睛像蛇一樣，手臂、腿、脖子和背部有鱗片斑塊。一對非人的雙足爬行動物在看守著他們。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s concubines live in luxury within these chambers. Eleven {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods} and a {@creature doppelganger} disguised as a pureblood comprise the harem. Two {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) watch over the harem at all hours.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的妃子們在這些房間裡過著奢侈的生活。十一個{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}和一個偽裝成純血的{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}組成了後宮。兩個{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）全天候看守後宮。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} used to spend much of his time here, sampling the harem's delights. Since the death curse took hold of him, he has cloistered himself elsewhere. The purebloods neither help nor hinder the characters, and they fear {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} enough not to betray him willingly. Despite {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s efforts to hide the effects of the death curse, the concubines know that he is sick and dying.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 過去常常在這裡消磨很多時間，享受後宮的愉悅。自從死亡詛咒降臨在他身上後，他就隱居在別處。純血族既不幫助也不阻礙角色們，他們害怕{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，所以不會自願背叛他。儘管{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}努力隱藏死亡詛咒的影響，但妃子們知道他生病了，快要死了。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s yuan-ti champion, {@creature Sekelok|ToA} ({@area area 11|2da|x}), is fascinated by the concubine Neema and courts disaster by visiting her in the dead of night. Neema browbeats the other concubines to cover up her affair.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的元提冠軍{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}（見{@area 區域11|2da|x}）對妃子尼瑪著迷，並在深夜拜訪她，這可能導致災難。尼瑪脅迫其他妃子掩蓋她的事情。

english: Doppelganger Spy
zh_tw: 變形怪間諜

english: The doppelganger infiltrated the temple by killing and assuming the form of a male yuan-ti pureblood named Ishmakahl (pronounced ISH-mah-kawl). It has been sent by Zagmira, a Red Wizard, to spy on {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. Unfortunately for its employers, the doppelganger has had little contact with {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} since arriving at the fane; however, it has learned a few things by eavesdropping on {@creature Sekelok|ToA} and Neema's intimate conversations.
zh_tw: 這個變形怪透過殺死並假扮一個名叫伊什瑪卡爾（發音為ISH-mah-kawl）的男性元提純血族，潛入了寺廟。它是由紅袍法師扎格米拉派來監視{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的。不幸的是，對於它的僱主來說，自從到達神廟以來，變形怪與{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}接觸甚少；然而，它透過偷聽{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}和尼瑪的親密對話，已經瞭解到了一些資訊。

english: Ishmakahl appears as a handsome Chultan man with eyes like a snake's. If the characters make contact with the doppelganger on behalf of the Red Wizards, it offers to help them steal any puzzle cubes from {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s lair ({@area area 12|2e1|x}). Ishmakahl knows the layout of the temple and knows there's a secret door somewhere in the throne room ({@area area 11|2da|x}) that leads to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s lair. The doppelganger also knows that {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s lair can be reached via the fane's teleporters, though it doesn't know how to activate them. It advises the characters to break into the lair when {@creature Sekelok|ToA} next visits the harem.
zh_tw: 伊什瑪卡爾 看起來是一個英俊的楚爾特男子，有著蛇一樣的眼睛。如果角色們代表紅袍法師與變形怪取得聯絡，它會提出幫助他們從{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的巢穴（{@area 區域12|2e1|x}）中偷取任何謎題魔方。伊什瑪卡爾 知道寺廟的佈局，並知道在王座廳（{@area 區域11|2da|x}）某個地方有一扇秘密門通向{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的巢穴。這個變形怪還知道可以透過神殿的傳送器到達{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的巢穴，儘管它不知道如何啟用它們。它建議角色們在{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}下次訪問後宮時闖入巢穴。

english: Ishmakahl is secretly contemplating a defection to the yuan-ti. If its plan shows any signs of backfiring, the doppelganger reveals itself to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} or {@creature Sekelok|ToA}, and warns him about the intruders.
zh_tw: 伊什瑪卡爾 正在秘密考慮投靠元提族。如果它的計劃有任何反效果的跡象，變形怪就會向{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}或{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}顯露真身，並警告他有關入侵者的事情。

english: Teleporter
zh_tw: 傳送器

english: The eastern booth contains an alcove, set into the floor of which is a faintly glowing stone disk engraved with a serpentine symbol. This is one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s magic teleporters (see "{@area Teleporters|2ac|x}").
zh_tw: 東側的包廂內有一個凹室，地面上嵌著一個微弱發光的石盤，上面刻有蛇形符號。這是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的魔法傳送器之一（見"{@area 傳送裝置|2ac|x}"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Characters who loot these chambers gain the following treasures: a white gold tiara made from two intertwined vipers with topaz eyes (750 gp), a jade trinket box shaped like a flytrap with curling golden leaves (250 gp), and two golden cobra candlesticks (75 gp each).
zh_tw: 角色們洗劫這些房間會獲得以下寶物：一頂由兩條交織在一起的蝰蛇形狀製成的白金頭冠，上面鑲嵌著託帕石眼睛（750金幣），一個翡翠製成的捕蠅草形狀的小飾品盒，周圍環繞著捲曲的金葉子（250金幣），以及一對金色眼鏡蛇形狀的燭臺（每個75金幣）。

english: 11. Throne Room
zh_tw: 11. 寶座室

english: Four pillars support the vaulted ceiling, and steps ascend to an iron throne carved in the likeness of a hydra. Painted on the wall behind it is a large blue triangle. To the south, an engraved stone disk is set into the floor of an alcove. A ten-foot-wide opening in the east wall leads to a flooded cave.
zh_tw: 四根柱子支撐著拱形天花板，臺階通向一個雕刻成多頭蛇形狀的鐵製寶座。寶座後面的牆上畫著一個巨大的藍色三角形。在南側，一個凹室的地面上嵌著一個雕刻的石盤。東牆上一個十尺寬的開口通向一個被水淹沒的洞穴。

english: Circumstances determine this room's occupants:
zh_tw: 這個房間的居住者由情況決定：

english: During the day, {@b Ras Nsi} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) "sits" in the throne while addressing two {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||type 1 yuan-ti malisons} who routinely advise him. Standing guard in the middle of the room is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s champion, {@creature Sekelok|ToA} (see below), and three {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). Hidden behind the throne are four {@creature Ghoul||ghouls} that obey {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s commands. Each ghoul has a blue triangle tattooed on its forehead.
zh_tw: 在白天，{@b 拉茲·納斯}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在寶座上"坐著"同時向兩個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||型別1惡咒蛇人}提供諮詢。站在房間中央的是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的冠軍{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}（見下文），以及三名{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。藏在寶座後面的是四個服從{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}命令的{@creature Ghoul||食屍鬼}。每個食屍鬼的額頭上都紋有一個藍色的三角形。

english: At night, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} retires to {@area area 12|2e1|x}, leaving the other yuan-ti (including {@creature Sekelok|ToA}) and the ghouls here. {@creature Sekelok|ToA} sometimes sneaks off to the harem ({@area area 10|2d5|x}).
zh_tw: 晚上，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}退居到{@area 區域12|2e1|x}，留下其他元帝族（包括{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}）和小食屍鬼在此。{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}有時會偷偷前往後宮（{@area 區域10|2d5|x}）。

english: If the gong in {@area area 9|2ca|x} is struck, {@creature Sekelok|ToA} and the other yuan-ti leave to investigate while the ghouls hide behind the throne and {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} withdraws to {@area area 12|2e1|x}.
zh_tw: 如果{@area 區域9|2ca|x}中的鑼被敲響，{@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}和其他元提人會離開去調查，而食屍鬼會藏在寶座後面，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}則撤退到{@area 區域12|2e1|x}。

english: Sekelok
zh_tw: 瑟克洛克

english: {@creature Sekelok|ToA} is a tall, muscular yuan-ti pureblood. He has the statistics of a {@creature champion|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}是一個高大、肌肉發達的元帝族純血。他的屬性為{@creature champion|VGM|勇士}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），有以下變化：

english: {@creature Sekelok|ToA} is neutral evil.
zh_tw: {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克} 是中立邪惡。

english: He wears no armor, but his scales are as hard as steel (AC 18).
zh_tw: 他不穿戴盔甲，但他的鱗片堅硬如鋼（AC 18）。

english: He is immune to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.
zh_tw: 他對毒素傷害和{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態免疫。

english: He has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
zh_tw: 他具有達到60尺範圍的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: He speaks Abyssal, Common, and Draconic.
zh_tw: 他講深淵語、通用語和龍語。

english: He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
zh_tw: 他在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定上具有優勢。

english: He has the Innate Spellcasting trait described below.
zh_tw: 他具有以下描述的天生施法特性。

english: Innate Spellcasting
zh_tw: 天生施法

english: {@creature Sekelok|ToA}'s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 13}). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
zh_tw: {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}的施法能力基於魅力（法術豁免 {@dc 13}）。他可以天生施放以下法術，且無需任何材料元件：

english: At will: {@spell animal friendship} (snakes only), {@spell poison spray}
zh_tw: 隨意：{@spell animal friendship||化獸為友}（僅限蛇類）、{@spell poison spray||毒氣噴湧}

english: 3/day: {@spell suggestion}
zh_tw: 每天3次：{@spell suggestion||暗示術}

english: {@creature Sekelok|ToA} is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s trusted bodyguard and takes grim pleasure in slaughtering his master's enemies. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} delights in forcing those who offend him to duel {@creature Sekelok|ToA}, either to the first cut or to the death.
zh_tw: {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克} 是 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 的信任保鏢，並且以屠殺主人的敵人為樂。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 喜歡強迫那些冒犯他的人與 {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克} 決鬥，要麼是第一次劃傷，要麼是至死。

english: {@creature Sekelok|ToA} has a secret affair with Neema, one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s concubines (see {@area area 10|2d5|x}). His motivations here are confused: while he remains staunchly loyal to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, the subterfuge fuels his ego. If {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} discovers the affair, he flays both parties alive for their betrayal and feeds them to his pet hydra (see {@area area 21|2ff|x}).
zh_tw: {@creature Sekelok|ToA|瑟克洛克}與尼瑪有秘密戀情，尼瑪是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的一位妃子（見{@area 區域10|2d5|x}）。他的動機很混亂：儘管他堅定地忠於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，但這種欺騙行為助長了他的自負。如果{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}發現這段戀情，他會活活剝皮背叛者，並將他們餵給他的寵物九頭蛇（見{@area 區域21|2ff|x}）。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the western corner of the north wall leads to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s lair ({@area area 12|2e1|x}). To locate the secret door, a character must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check while searching the walls. If the characters have been told about the secret door, they gain advantage on the skill check.
zh_tw: 北牆西角的一扇密門通往 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 的巢穴（{@area 區域12|2e1|x}）。要找到這扇密門，角色必須在搜尋牆壁時成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。如果角色被告知密門的存在，他們在該技能檢定上獲得優勢。

english: Teleporter
zh_tw: 傳送器

english: The engraved stone disk in the southern alcove is one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s magic teleporters (see "{@area Teleporters|2ac|x}").
zh_tw: 南邊壁龕中雕刻的石盤是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的魔法傳送器之一（見"{@area 傳送裝置|2ac|x}"）。

english: 12. Ras Nsi's Lair
zh_tw: 12. 拉茲·納斯的巢穴

english: Shadows dance over this opulent bedchamber. Cushions lie in one corner, and decorative shields line the walls. Treasures are heaped around the room: gold and silver coins; a gilded harp; a jeweled wine flask; pillows of silk; and fine clothes draped over wooden mannequins. To the east, an engraved stone disk is set into the floor of an alcove. To the west, a rectangular steel plate mounted on the wall is polished to a mirror-like sheen.
zh_tw: 在這個奢華的臥室裡，陰影在跳動。靠墊堆放在一個角落裡，裝飾性的盾牌排列在牆壁上。財寶堆積在房間各處：金幣和銀幣；鍍金的豎琴；鑲嵌寶石的酒瓶；絲質的枕頭；以及精緻的衣物隨意搭在木製人體模型上。向東，一個雕刻的石盤嵌在壁龕的地板上。向西，牆上安裝著一塊矩形的鋼板，擦得像鏡子一樣光亮。

english: At night, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) rests here, weakened by the death curse that is slowly consuming him. If enemies corner {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, shields leap from the walls to protect him (see "Flying Shields" below). During waking hours, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} returns here only if he's in danger.
zh_tw: 在夜晚，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）在此休息，正逐漸被死亡詛咒消耗著他的力量。如果敵人將{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}逼入絕境，盾牌會從牆壁飛出保護他（見下文的"飛行盾牌"）。在清醒的時候，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}只有在處於危險時才會返回這裡。

english: If the characters defeat {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} and question him, he reveals the following information to save his skin:
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}並審問他，為了自保，他會透露以下資訊：

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is slowly rotting to death. He doesn't know the cause of his affliction and has no way to cure it.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 正在慢慢地腐爛至死。他不知道這種痛苦的原因，也沒有辦法治癒它。

english: Before he dies, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} wants to bring forth Dendar the Night Serpent and destroy the world.
zh_tw: 在他死之前，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}想要召喚出夜蛇神丹達爾並毀滅世界。

english: The yuan-ti believe there's a locked gate somewhere under the Peaks of Flame that prevents the Dendar from entering the world. {@creature Acererak|ToA} has promised to help {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} unlock the gate and bring forth the Night Serpent. In return, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} defends the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 元帝族相信在火焰之峰的某個地方有一扇上鎖的門，阻止了丹達爾進入這個世界。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}承諾幫助{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}開啟這扇門，召喚出夜蛇。作為回報，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}守護著九神之墓。

english: Nine stone puzzle cubes are needed to enter the Tomb of the Nine Gods. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} doesn't know how to use the cubes to unlock the tomb.
zh_tw: 需要九個石質謎題魔方才能進入九神之墓。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}不知道如何使用這些魔方來解開墓穴的鎖。

english: The tomb entrance is marked with an obelisk. ({@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} can provide directions and/or an escort.)
zh_tw: 墓穴入口被一座方尖碑標記。（{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}可以提供方向和/或護送。）

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} slew the nine gods of Omu before enslaving the city's inhabitants, which he used to build his tomb.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}在奴役奧穆城的居民之前，先殺死了九位神明，他利用這些居民建造了自己的墓穴。

english: Flying Shields
zh_tw: 飛行盾牌

english: As a bonus action, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} can speak a command word ("Ssilum") that causes five shields to fly off the walls and levitate around him. While they're active, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} gains a +10 bonus to his AC. If an attack that would normally hit {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is blocked by the shields, one of the shields is struck and disabled as it falls to the floor, reducing {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s bonus to AC by 2. When there are no more active shields, the effect ends, and {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} can't use this power again until he finishes a long rest. A {@spell detect magic} or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the shields. Only {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} can activate the shields, and the effect is confined to this room.
zh_tw: 作為附贈動作，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}可以說出命令詞（"西勒姆"），這會讓五面盾牌從牆壁上飛出並圍繞他懸浮。當它們處於啟用狀態時，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的護甲等級（AC）獲得+10的加值。如果通常會擊中{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的攻擊被盾牌擋住，那麼一面盾牌會被擊中並失能，掉落到地面，使{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的AC加值減少2。當沒有更多的活躍盾牌時，效果結束，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}在完成一次長休之前不能再使用這個能力。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}或類似的效果會揭示盾牌周圍的變形魔法氣息。只有{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}能啟用這些盾牌，並且效果僅限於這個房間。

english: Teleporter
zh_tw: 傳送器

english: The engraved stone disk in the eastern alcove is one of {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s magic teleporters (see "{@area Teleporters|2ac|x}").
zh_tw: 東邊壁龕中雕刻的石盤是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的魔法傳送器之一（見"{@area 傳送裝置|2ac|x}"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} wields a {@item flame tongue} longsword and carries a {@item Sending Stones||sending stone}. The companion stone is in {@creature Salida|ToA|Salida's} possession (see "{@area Finding a Guide|098|x}").
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}揮舞一把{@item flame tongue||焰舌}長劍，並攜帶一塊{@item Sending Stones||短訊石}。伴生石在{@creature Salida|ToA|薩莉達}的手中（見"{@area 尋找嚮導|098|x}"）。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s lair contains treasures from distant lands. The collection includes a Sembian wine flask (50 gp), a bejeweled Amnian doublet with matching money pouch (75 gp), a fine Cormyrean cloak (100 gp), a gilded Moonshae harp (250 gp), and three large cushions covered in Turami silk (25 gp each). Hidden under one of the cushions is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s leather-bound spellbook, which contains all the spells he has prepared (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). In addition, his hoard contains thirty 50 gp gemstones in a clay urn, 150 pp in an unlocked wooden chest, 350 gp and 900 sp scattered on the floor, and a froghemoth statuette made of painted wood with three amethyst gemstones for eyes (100 gp each).
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的巢穴裡藏有來自遙遠之地的財寶。收藏品包括一個散提亞酒瓶（50金幣），一件鑲有寶石的安姆尼亞夾克配相同錢袋（75金幣），一件精緻的科米爾披風（100金幣），一把鍍金的月亮海豎琴（250金幣），以及三個覆蓋著圖拉米絲綢的大靠墊（每個25金幣）。在其中一個靠墊下隱藏著{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的皮革裝訂魔法書，其中包含了他準備的所有法術（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。除此之外，他的寶藏中還包括一個陶罐中裝有三十顆50金幣的寶石，一個未上鎖的木箱中有150白金幣，地板上散落著350金幣和900銀幣，以及一個用彩繪木頭製成的蛙獸小雕像，眼睛是用三顆紫水晶寶石製成的（每顆100金幣）。

english: Puzzle Cubes
zh_tw: 謎題魔方

english: If {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} has taken one or more puzzle cubes from the shrines of Omu, they can be found among the items in his hoard.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}從奧穆的神祠中拿走了一個或多個謎題魔方，它們可以在他寶藏中的物品裡找到。

english: 13. Storeroom
zh_tw: 13. 儲藏室

english: The southwest double door is locked. Using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, a character can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 西南側的雙扇門被鎖上了。使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}，角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。

english: Stacks of sturdy wood crates, bundles of cloth, and clay amphorae litter the floor.
zh_tw: 堅固的木箱堆、布包和陶土雙耳瓶散落在地板上。

english: Supplies gathered from the world above are stored in this chamber. An awakened {@creature giant constrictor snake} named Azi Mas serves as custodian for the provisions. When fresh goods arrive, Azi Mas personally checks them and mentally catalogs them. The rest of the time, he remains coiled in the shadows. The snake is bored and enjoys chatting with yuan-ti visitors. Should other creatures enter from the southwest, Azi Mas ambushes them and tries to take a hostage. If outmatched, he whines and pleads for mercy.
zh_tw: 從上界收集的物資儲存在這個房間裡。一隻名叫阿茲·瑪斯的{@creature giant constrictor snake||巨蟒蛇}擔任這些物資的保管員。當有新鮮的貨物到達時，阿茲·瑪斯會親自檢查它們並進行精神分類。其餘時間，他則會蜷縮在陰影中。這條蛇感到無聊並喜歡與來訪的蛇人聊天。如果其他生物從西南方進入，阿茲·瑪斯會伏擊他們並試圖挾持人質。如果處於劣勢，他會哀嚎並請求憐憫。

english: Long ago, a jungle druid used an {@spell awaken} spell on Azi Mas, giving him an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak Common. After serving him for the duration of the enchantment, the serpent slithered off and found its way to Omu. Azi Mas has a good memory; he can remember names and faces and is quick to warn his masters if yuan-ti pass through whom he hasn't seen before.
zh_tw: 很久以前，一位叢林德魯伊對阿茲·瑪斯使用了{@spell awaken||啟蒙術}法術，賦予了他10的智力值並能夠說通用語。在法術的持續時間內為他服務後，這條蛇蜿蜒前行，找到了通往奧穆的路。阿茲·瑪斯有很好的記憶力；他能記住名字和麵孔，並且如果看到不熟悉的元帝族透過，他會迅速警告他的主人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The storeroom contains fifty bolts of cloth; six crates of bronze bars; three barrels of salt and spices; and three chests containing rope, oil, lanterns, paper, and blankets. From the supplies, characters can assemble enough gear to make five explorer's packs.
zh_tw: 儲藏室裡有五十卷布；六箱青銅條；三桶鹽和香料；以及三個裝有繩索、油、燈籠、紙和毯子的箱子。從這些物資中，角色們可以組裝出足夠的裝備來製作五個探險者揹包。

english: Mesmerizing Incense
zh_tw: 迷人香

english: Also present is a sealed case containing ten blocks of temple incense. Lighting a block creates a hazy cloud that fills a 20-foot-diameter sphere and moves with the block. Any creature that starts its turn in the cloud and breathes the air must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or fall into a dreamlike stupor laced with nightmarish visions. Though it remains awake, the creature is {@condition poisoned}. Even yuan-ti are vulnerable to this effect, which lasts for 1 hour after a creature leaves the cloud, or until it receives a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 現場還有一個密封的盒子，裡面裝有十塊寺廟香。點燃一塊香會產生一團朦朧的煙霧，形成一個直徑20尺的球體，並隨著香的移動而移動。任何在煙霧中開始回合並呼吸空氣的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 體質豁免檢定，否則會陷入一種帶有噩夢般景象的夢幻恍惚狀態。儘管生物保持清醒，但它會 {@condition poisoned||中毒}。即使是蛇人也無法免疫這種效果，這種效果會在生物離開煙霧後持續1小時，或者直到它受到一個 {@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術} 或類似的魔法影響。

english: 14. Venom Distillery
zh_tw: 14. 毒液蒸餾廠

english: The south door is locked, and the lock contains a cleverly hidden poison needle trap. To pick the lock, a character with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity check. Finding the trap requires a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check; once found, it can be disabled with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check. A character who tries to pick the lock without first disabling the trap must make a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the character is pricked by the needle, takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) poison damage, and is {@condition blinded}. The blindness is permanent but can be cured with a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 南門被鎖住了，鎖具中隱藏著一個巧妙設計的毒針陷阱。要撬開這把鎖，持有{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}的角色必須透過一次{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。發現陷阱需要透過{@dc 20}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定；一旦發現，可以透過{@dc 12}敏捷檢定解除。若角色未解除陷阱就嘗試撬鎖，則必須進行{@dc 16}敏捷豁免。若豁免失敗，角色會被毒針刺中，受到5（{@dice 1d10}）點毒素傷害，並陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態。該目盲效果是永久性的，但可以透過{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}或類似魔法治癒。

english: The air in here is moist and sticky. Natural light spills from cracks in the ceiling, and mud coats the floor. Stone workbenches are laden with clay bottles of various shapes and sizes.
