Toadstools, snakeroot, and belladonna plants grow among the clutter, fed by water seeping from above. Standing near the plants is a hairless man with scaly skin and a bronze syringe. Lurking in the shadows around him are five slouching humans that reek of decay.
zh_tw: 這裡的空氣潮溼而粘稠。自然光線從天花板的裂縫中灑下，泥漿覆蓋著地面。石制工作臺上堆滿了各種形狀和大小的陶土瓶子。毒蠅傘、蛇根草和顛茄植物在雜物中生長，由上方滲出的水滋養。站在植物附近的是一個皮膚有鱗且沒有頭髮的男子，手持一個青銅注射器。潛伏在他周圍陰影中的是五個彎腰駝背、散發著腐爛氣味的人類。

english: Yuan-ti use this chamber to extract venom from snakes. Xopal (pronounced zoh-PAUL), a {@creature yuan-ti pureblood}, bottles and blends the venom to create deadly new strains. Five human {@creature Zombie||zombies} serve Xopal as laborers.
zh_tw: 元帝族使用這個房間從蛇中提取毒液。索帕爾（發音為zoh-PAUL），一個{@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}，裝瓶並混合毒液以創造出致命的新菌株。五個人類{@creature Zombie||喪屍}作為勞動力為索帕爾服務。

english: Xopal carries a bronze syringe containing three doses of a poison cocktail. As an action, he can make a melee weapon attack with the syringe ({@hit 3} to hit), which deals 1 piercing damage and injects one dose of poison on a hit. Any creature injected with a dose of poison must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, the creature is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour whether or not its save succeeds.
zh_tw: 索帕爾攜帶一個青銅注射器，內含三劑毒液雞尾酒。作為一個動作，他可以用注射器進行一次近戰武器攻擊（命中+{@hit 3}），命中時造成1點穿刺傷害並注入一劑毒液。任何被注入毒液的生物必須進行一次{@dc 14}的體質豁免檢定，豁免失敗時受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點毒素傷害，成功時則只受到一半傷害。此外，無論豁免是否成功，該生物都會陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態，持續1小時。

english: Xopal believes it's his destiny to transform into a much more powerful form of yuan-ti—a metamorphosis that will occur when he develops a poison so virulent that even innate immunity to poison can't withstand it. Xopal uses the zombies as test subjects; once he's overcome their immunity, he plans to conduct further tests on live yuan-ti.
zh_tw: 索帕爾相信他的命運是轉變成一個更強大的元帝族形態——這種蛻變將在他研製出一種如此劇毒的毒藥，以至於即使是天生的抗毒能力也無法抵擋時發生。索帕爾用殭屍作為實驗物件；一旦他克服了他們的免疫力，他計劃在活著的元帝族上進行進一步的測試。

english: Bottled Poisons
zh_tw: 瓶裝毒藥

english: The presence of so many poisons makes combat in this room hazardous. If a workbench is exposed to explosive force, such as that generated by a {@spell thunderwave} or {@spell fireball} spell, the bottles smash and create a 15-foot-radius sphere of poisonous vapors that lasts for 1 minute. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn within the sphere must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡存在著如此多的毒藥，使得在這裡的戰鬥變得極其危險。如果一個工作臺受到爆炸力的影響，比如由 {@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波} 或 {@spell fireball||火球術} 法術產生的爆炸力，瓶子會破碎並形成一個半徑15尺的有毒蒸氣球，持續1分鐘。任何在回合中首次進入該區域或在該區域內開始其回合的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免，豁免失敗則受到18（{@dice 4d8}）點毒素傷害。即使生物屏住呼吸或不需要呼吸，也會受到影響。

english: Among the poisons is a stoppered bronze jug used for fermenting jungle roots into soporific gas. Removing the stopper releases the gas, which fills a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the jug. See {@area area 3|2b5|x} for the effect of the soporific gas.
zh_tw: 在這些毒藥中，有一個塞住的銅壺，用來發酵叢林根莖成催眠氣體。移除塞子會釋放氣體，氣體會充滿以壺為中心的15尺半徑的球形區域。有關催眠氣體的效果，請參見{@area 區域3|2b5|x}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Xopal carries a brass key that unlocks the south door.
zh_tw: 索帕爾攜帶一把銅鑰匙，可以開啟南門。

english: Characters who search through the poisons can loot twenty doses of {@item serpent venom|DMG}, five doses of {@item essence of ether|DMG}, and five doses of torpor (see "{@book Poisons|DMG|8|Poisons}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 搜尋毒藥的玩家可以掠奪二十劑{@item serpent venom|DMG|蛇毒}、五劑{@item essence of ether|DMG|乙醚精}和五劑麻痺毒藥（詳見{@i 城主指南}第八章"{@book 毒藥|DMG|8|Poisons}"）。

english: 15. Snake Pit
zh_tw: 15. 蛇坑

english: A rickety wooden walkway threads around the walls of a deep pit. Foul odors waft up from below. Somewhere in the gloom beneath you, thousands of snakes writhe.
zh_tw: 一座搖搖欲墜的木製步道沿著一個深坑的牆壁蜿蜒而行。從下方傳來惡臭。在下方的陰暗處，成千上萬的蛇在扭動。

english: Despite appearances, the rickety wooden walkway is safe. The yuan-ti sometimes hurl disobedient slaves into the pit to be devoured by the serpents. The pit is 50 feet deep and filled with poisonous snakes. When a creature falls or sets foot in the pit, a {@creature swarm of poisonous snakes} forms around it and attacks. A virtually inexhaustible number of swarms can be created in this fashion. A swarm that has nothing to attack ceases to exist as its constituents slither apart.
zh_tw: 儘管看起來破舊，但這座搖搖欲墜的木製步道是安全的。元提有時會將不聽話的奴隸扔進坑中，讓它們被蛇群吞噬。這個坑深50尺，裡面充滿了有毒的蛇。當一個生物跌落或踏入坑中時，一群{@creature swarm of poisonous snakes||毒蛇群}會圍繞它形成併發起攻擊。以這種方式幾乎可以創造出無窮無盡的蛇群。當一個蛇群沒有目標可攻擊時，它的構成部分會四散開來，蛇群也就不復存在。

english: To climb the wet cavern walls, a character must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 為了攀爬溼滑的洞壁，角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: 16. Blood Baths
zh_tw: 16. 血浴

english: The iron stench of blood floods this chamber. Along one wall, a row of gore-filled pools sink into the floor. Blood trails and bloody footprints run between the pools.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了鐵鏽般的血腥味。沿著一面牆，一排充滿血跡的水池深入地面。血跡和血腳印在水池之間延伸。

english: When they awake each day, the yuan-ti ritually bathe in the blood of sacrifices. The blood is contained within these stone baths and heated by thermal vents underneath each pool. When the characters enter, four {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods} and two {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)||type 2 yuan-ti malisons} bathe in the warm pools. Five slaves in loincloths (male and female Chultan human {@creature Commoner||commoners} of various alignments) tend to their every need. Give names to slaves as needed (see the "{@area Chultan Names|020|x}" sidebar in the book's introduction).
zh_tw: 當他們每天醒來時，元提族會在祭品的血液中進行儀式性的沐浴。這些血液被存放在這些石制浴缸中，並透過每個水池下方的地熱通風口加熱。當角色們進入時，四個{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}和兩個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)||第二型惡咒蛇人}在溫暖的池中沐浴。五個穿著腰布的奴隸（男性和女性楚爾特人類{@creature Commoner||平民}，各種陣營）滿足他們的每一個需要。根據需要給奴隸命名（見書籍介紹中的"{@area 楚爾特名字|020|x}"側欄）。

english: The blood-drenched yuan-ti keep their weapons at the back of each alcove. If they hear the gong alarm sound, the yuan-ti command their slaves to remain here while they arm themselves and head quickly to {@area area 9|2ca|x}. If combat breaks out here, reinforcements from {@area area 17|2f3|x} arrive in {@dice 1d3} rounds.
zh_tw: 鮮血浸透的眼魔族將他們的武器放在每個壁龕的後面。如果他們聽到鑼的警報聲，眼魔族命令他們的奴隸留在此處，而他們自己去武裝起來，然後迅速前往{@area 區域9|2ca|x}。如果在這裡爆發戰鬥，來自{@area 區域17|2f3|x}的增援將在{@dice 1d3}回合內到達。

english: 17. Sauna
zh_tw: 17. 桑拿

english: Heat rises from an enormous oval stone set into the floor of this chamber. Discarded skins are heaped around it, and shelves underneath it are lined with jars. A snake-headed yuan-ti sheds his skin while two strong, bare-chested human men with spears look on.
zh_tw: 熱氣從一個巨大的橢圓形石頭上升起，這個石頭嵌在房間的地板上。四周堆滿了丟棄的蛇皮，石頭下面的架子上擺滿了罐子。一個蛇頭的袁提正在蛻皮，而兩個強壯的、赤裸上身的人類男子手持長矛在一旁觀看。

english: The oval stone is 8 feet tall and made of porous rock. Situated atop a volcanic vent, it transfers heat evenly throughout the room. The yuan-ti come here to shed their skins and polish their scales.
zh_tw: 這個橢圓形的石頭高8尺，由多孔岩石製成。它位於一個火山口上方，能夠均勻地將熱量傳遞到整個房間。袁提來到這裡蛻皮並打磨他們的鱗片。

english: Thirty jars line the shelves underneath the oval stone, and each one contains a scented ointment that yuan-ti use to keep their skin supple and to ease the shedding of their skin. The ointment is not valuable.
zh_tw: 三十個罐子排列在橢圓形石頭下面的架子上，每個罐子裡都裝有一種袁提用來保持皮膚柔軟並緩解蛻皮的香膏。這種香膏並不值錢。

english: Unless they have been fought and defeated elsewhere, two enslaved men (NE male Chultan human {@creature Gladiator||gladiators}) watch Yahru (pronounced YAH-roo), a {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||type 1 yuan-ti malison}, as he sheds his skin (a process that can take up to an hour). Yahru is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s spymaster, and he doesn't like to be disturbed. Characters passing themselves off as yuan-ti purebloods are instructed to leave the room at once. Enslaved characters are ordered to smear ointment on Yahru's skin to expedite the skin-shedding process.
zh_tw: 除非他們在其他地方已經被打敗，否則兩個被奴役的男人（NE男性楚爾特人類{@creature Gladiator||角鬥士}）會監視雅魯（發音為YAH-roo），一個{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||型別1 惡咒蛇人}，當他蛻皮（這個過程可能需要長達一小時）。雅魯是{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的間諜大師，他不喜歡被打擾。偽裝成蛇人純血的角色被指示立即離開房間。被奴役的角色被命令在雅魯的皮膚上塗抹藥膏以加快蛻皮過程。

english: Yahru abhors physical combat, and he values his bodyguards too much to risk their lives in a pointless battle. Unless the characters provoke a fight, he tries to find out more about them and learn any secrets they might possess, while providing as little information as possible. If Yahru obtains information that would clearly benefit {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} or {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}, he chooses which superior to bequeath it to. Yahru enjoys playing them off against each other.
zh_tw: 亞魯厭惡肉搏戰鬥，並且他非常珍視他的保鏢，不願意在一場毫無意義的戰鬥中冒險他們的生命。除非角色們挑起戰鬥，否則他試圖更多地瞭解他們並學習他們可能擁有的任何秘密，同時儘可能少地提供資訊。如果亞魯獲得了明顯有利於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}或{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}的資訊，他會選擇將資訊贈予哪位上級。亞魯喜歡讓他們相互競爭。

english: If his bodyguards are defeated and he is facing death, Yahru offers small bits of information for the promise of freedom. In addition to the layout and defenses of the temple, Yahru knows the following:
zh_tw: 如果他的保鏢被擊敗，他面臨死亡，亞魯會為了自由的承諾提供一些資訊片段。除了神廟的佈局和防禦，亞魯還知道以下內容：

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} commands the yuan-ti of Omu, but his command is tenuous. The high priest, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA}, is {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s chief rival.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 指揮著奧穆的元提，但他的指揮權是不穩定的。高階祭司 {@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札} 是 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 的主要對手。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is slowly being eaten away by a magical disease for which there is no known cure.
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 正慢慢被一種沒有已知治療方法的魔法疾病侵蝕。

english: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} has made a pact with a powerful lich named {@creature Acererak|ToA}, who conquered Omu long ago and built a tomb beneath the city. The tomb's entrance is marked with an obelisk. (Yahru can provide directions.)
zh_tw: {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 與一個名叫 {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 的強大巫妖達成了契約，他很久以前征服了奧穆並在城市下建造了一座墳墓。墳墓的入口被一個方尖碑標記。（亞魯可以提供方向。）

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} slew the nine gods of Omu before enslaving the city's human and minotaur inhabitants, which he used to build his tomb.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 殺死了奧穆的九位神靈，然後奴役了這座城市的人類和牛頭人居民，他利用他們建造了自己的陵墓。

english: 18. Yuan-ti Nests
zh_tw: 18. 遠地蛇巢

english: These dank catacombs have been converted into sleeping quarters. The walls are lined with alcoves that now serve as nests for yuan-ti.
zh_tw: 這些潮溼的地下墓穴已經被改造成了臥室。牆壁上排列著壁龕，現在用作袁提的巢穴。

english: When the characters arrive, twelve of the eighteen alcoves are occupied by six {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} (two each of types 1, 2, and 3) and six {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods}. The remaining six alcoves are currently not in use. Passing through the area without being spotted is impossible unless the characters use magic to hide themselves.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，十八個壁龕中有十二個被六隻{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}（第 1、2、3 型各兩隻）和六隻{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}佔據。剩下的六個壁龕目前沒有在使用中。除非角色們使用魔法來隱藏自己，否則不被察覺地穿過這個區域是不可能的。

english: If the gong in {@area area 9|2ca|x} is struck, all the yuan-ti in this room gather their weapons and investigate.
zh_tw: 如果 {@area 區域9|2ca|x} 中的鑼被敲響，這個房間裡的所有元提會拿起武器並進行調查。

english: 19. Slave Grotto
zh_tw: 19. 奴隸洞穴

english: A campfire casts warm light over this cavern. Heaps of dead grass and palm fronds are scattered about, and the muddy floor is pitted with footprints.
zh_tw: 篝火在這個洞穴中投射出溫暖的光線。成堆的枯草和棕櫚葉散佈四周，泥濘的地面佈滿了腳印。

english: When they're not working, {@dice 2d10} slaves ({@creature Commoner||commoners} of various races, alignments, and genders) dwell here. For slave names, see the "{@area Chultan Names|020|x}" sidebar in the book's introduction. Three {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) guard the slaves for Slavemaster Issar, a {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)||type 3 yuan-ti malison} wearing a red cloth headdress. Issar is more interested in gazing at his own reflection in a hand mirror than putting the slaves to work.
zh_tw: 當他們不工作的時候，{@dice 2d10}名奴隸（不同種族、陣營和性別的{@creature Commoner||平民}）住在這裡。關於奴隸的名字，請參閱書籍導言中的"{@area 楚爾特名字|020|x}"邊欄。三名{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）為奴隸主伊薩爾守衛奴隸，伊薩爾是一名戴著紅布頭飾的{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)||型別3惡咒蛇人}。伊薩爾更感興趣的是凝視手鏡中自己的倒影，而不是讓奴隸們工作。

english: Issar is too stately to speak to the "meat" under his command. Instead, he's chosen a Chultan slave boy named Khoti to translate his subtle, unspoken gestures. A twitch of the tail could be interpreted as an order to fetch water, or the flick of the tongue an approval. In truth, Khoti makes up most of what he sees. Issar couldn't care less either way, as long as the correct amount of deference is shown. If strangers appear before Issar, Khoti questions them on his master's behalf.
zh_tw: 伊薩爾自恃尊貴，不屑與手下的「肉食」交談。他挑了一名叫科蒂的楚爾特奴隸男孩，負責解讀那些細微、無聲的示意：尾巴一抽可能是命人取水，舌頭一吐可能表示認可。其實科蒂的解讀大半出於杜撰；只要對方表現得足夠恭敬，伊薩爾也毫不在意。有陌生人來見伊薩爾時，科蒂便代主人發問。

english: Slaves
zh_tw: 奴隸

english: Under Issar's supervision, the slaves are supposed to be widening these caverns to create new sleeping quarters for the yuan-ti. However, progress has been slow. The slaves wore down or broke most of their tools, and Issar is waiting for the delivery of new tools.
zh_tw: 在伊薩爾的監督下，奴隸們本應拓寬這些洞穴，為袁提創造新的睡眠區。然而，進展緩慢。奴隸們磨損或損壞了大部分工具，伊薩爾正在等待新工具的交付。

english: The slaves are physically healthy, but their wills have been broken by mental trauma and tranquilizing drugs. Their emotions surface only during rest, when the dreams of the Night Serpent wrench them screaming from their troubled sleep.
zh_tw: 這些奴隸身體上是健康的，但他們的意志已經被精神創傷和鎮靜藥物摧毀。他們的情感只在休息時才會浮現，當夜蛇的夢境將他們從不安的睡眠中尖叫著喚醒時。

english: The slaves are not chained. Presented with an opportunity to escape, most become {@condition paralyzed} with indecision. Breaking their fugue requires strong words and a successful {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion} or {@skill Intimidation}) check. Armed slaves who come to their senses try to slaughter as many yuan-ti as they can. They know the temple's defenses and general layout, except with regard to areas 11 and 12 (which they've never seen).
zh_tw: 奴隸們並未被鏈鎖。當有機會逃脫時，大多數人因猶豫而陷入{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}狀態。打破這種狀態需要強有力的話語和一次成功的{@dc 17}魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}或{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定。醒悟過來的武裝奴隸會儘可能多地殺死蛇人。他們知道寺廟的防禦和大致佈局，除了第11區和第12區（他們從未見過）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Issar carries an iron key that unlocks the double door to {@area area 13|2e7|x}. His red cloth headdress is sewn with malachite gemstones (250 gp), and he preens in a golden hand mirror (75 gp).
zh_tw: 伊薩爾攜帶一把鐵鑰匙，可以開啟通往 {@area 區域13|2e7|x} 的雙扇門。他的紅色布頭巾上縫有孔雀石寶石（250 gp），他還在一把金手鏡（75 gp）前打扮。

english: 20. Underground River
zh_tw: 20. 地下河

english: An underground river opens before you. Stalactites hang low over its surface, and dripping water echoes in the dark.
zh_tw: 一條地下河展現在您面前。鐘乳石低垂在河面上方，滴水聲在黑暗中迴響。

english: The river links various sections of the complex. The water varies between 5 and 30 feet deep, and the current isn't strong enough to present a hazard to swimmers. To the north and south, the river descends into submerged tunnels that spread for miles under the jungle.
zh_tw: 河流連線了建築群的各個部分。水深在5到30尺之間，水流不足以對游泳者構成危險。河流向北和向南延伸進入淹沒的隧道，這些隧道在叢林下延伸數英里。

english: Rowboats
zh_tw: 划艇

english: When the characters arrive, a pair of rowboats are pulled up on the shore near the tunnel to {@area area 23|303|x} (see {@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for more information on rowboats). A cowbell dangles from a hook at the prow of each boat. Ringing either bell summons the hydra in {@area area 21|2ff|x}, which arrives in {@dice 1d6} rounds.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，一對划艇被拉到了通往{@area 區域23|303|x}的隧道附近的岸邊（有關划艇的更多資訊，請參見{@i 城主指南}中的{@table Owning a Ship; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles||第五章}）。每艘船的船頭掛鉤上懸掛著一個牛鈴。敲擊任何一個鈴鐺都會召喚{@area 區域21|2ff|x}中的九頭蛇，它將在{@dice 1d6}輪內到達。

english: Yuan-ti Broodguards
zh_tw: 原體衛雛蛇人

english: Guarding the rowboats and watching the secret entrance ({@area area 23|303|x}) are four {@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|yuan-ti broodguards} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). If they detect intruders not disguised as yuan-ti, one broodguard runs to warn the yuan-ti stationed in {@area area 19|2f7|x} while the others attempt to repel the interlopers.
zh_tw: 守衛著小船並監視著秘密入口（{@area 區域23|303|x}）的是四名{@creature Yuan-ti Broodguard|VGM|衛雛蛇人}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。如果他們發現沒有偽裝成玉蛇族的入侵者，一名幼卵守衛會跑去警告駐紮在{@area 區域19|2f7|x}的玉蛇族，而其他人則試圖擊退入侵者。

english: The broodguards stop and question characters disguised as yuan-ti purebloods. To bluff their way past the guards, the characters must succeed on a group {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If the group check succeeds, the broodguards wave them inside without checking their story. If the group check fails, the broodguards march them to meet Slavemaster Issar in {@area area 19|2f7|x}.
zh_tw: 巢穴守衛會停下並盤問偽裝成純血蛇人的角色們。為了瞞過守衛，角色們必須成功透過一個團體 {@dc 10} 魅力（{@skill Deception||欺瞞}）檢定。如果團體檢定成功，巢穴守衛會揮手讓他們進入，而不核對他們的故事。如果團體檢定失敗，巢穴守衛會押送他們去見奴隸主伊薩爾，在 {@area 區域19|2f7|x} 處。

english: 21. Hydra's Lair
zh_tw: 21. 九頭蛇的巢穴

english: An underground river widens to form a flooded grotto. To the west, a pebble-strewn bank rises to a door recessed in the cavern wall. Near the middle of the lake, bones cling like a tide mark to a rocky pillar.
zh_tw: 一條地下河流拓寬形成了一個被水淹沒的巖洞。向西，一個佈滿卵石的河岸上升到洞穴壁上的一個凹進去的門。在湖的中間附近，骨頭像潮汐線一樣粘附在岩石柱上。

english: A {@creature hydra} lurks underwater in this vicinity. {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} treats the monster as his beloved pet and regularly feeds it slaves, prisoners, and subordinates who've defied him. The hydra's victims are bound and ferried on rowboats over the deepest part of the river. To call the monster, their captors sound the rowboat bell and hurl the hogtied victim (or victims) into the water.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature hydra||多頭蛇}潛伏在這片水域。{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}視這隻怪物為他的愛寵，並定期用奴隸、囚犯和違抗他的下屬餵養它。九頭蛇的受害者被捆綁並用划艇運到河流最深處的區域。為了召喚這隻怪物，抓捕者會敲響划艇的鈴鐺並將被捆住的受害者（或多位受害者）投入水中。

english: While it remains fed, the hydra avoids any boats that ply back and forth. When a rowboat bell is sounded, the hydra surfaces within {@dice 1d6} rounds. If it's not fed immediately, it attacks the boat. The hydra attacks any boats that venture north of {@area area 18|2f5|x}. Swimmers are also fair game.
zh_tw: 只要保持飽食，多頭蛇會避開來回穿梭的船隻。當划艇的鈴鐺響起時，多頭蛇會在{@dice 1d6}回合內浮出水面。如果它沒有立即被餵食，它就會攻擊船隻。多頭蛇會攻擊任何冒險進入{@area 區域18|2f5|x}以北的船隻。游泳者也是它的獵物。

english: 22. Fungi Cavern
zh_tw: 22. 真菌洞穴

english: The passage widens into a cavern filled with fungi. Toadstools, puffballs, and other tuberous growths cover the walls and floor. Against the far wall, a malformed skeleton lies buried under a patch of buttery mold. A brass key hangs around its neck.
zh_tw: 通道拓寬成一個充滿真菌的洞穴。毒蘑菇、馬勃菌和其他塊根狀生長物覆蓋了牆壁和地板。在遠處的牆壁上，一個畸形的骨架被埋在一塊黃油狀的黴菌下。一串黃銅鑰匙掛在它的脖子上。

english: A patch of {@hazard green slime} (see {@hazard green slime||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) clings to the ceiling above the entrance and drops on the first creature that passes underneath.
zh_tw: 一塊{@hazard green slime||綠軟泥}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard green slime||第五章}）附著在入口上方的天花板上，會落在第一個從下方經過的生物身上。

english: A patch of {@hazard yellow mold} (see {@hazard yellow mold||chapter 5} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}) covers the skeletal corpse. If a creature touches the mold, it ejects a cloud of deadly spores.
zh_tw: 一簇{@hazard yellow mold||黃黴菌}（參見{@i 城主指南}的{@hazard yellow mold||第五章}）覆蓋在骸骨上。若有生物觸碰黴菌，它會噴出致命的孢子云。

english: The corpse belongs to Kukuga, a yuan-ti pureblood who secretly worshiped Zuggtmoy (the demon queen of fungi). Kukuga concocted a fungal brew that would transform his body into a form closer to that of his demonic mistress. Instead, it led to his sudden and horrific death. Xopal ({@area area 14|2eb|x}) occasionally ventures into the cavern to harvest poisonous toadstools from his corpse.
zh_tw: 這具屍體屬於庫庫加，一個秘密崇拜祖格特莫伊（真菌的惡魔女王）的玉蛇族純血。庫庫加配製了一種真菌釀造物，希望能夠將自己的身體轉變為更接近他惡魔女主人的形式。然而，這導致了他突然而可怕的死亡。索帕爾（{@area 區域14|2eb|x}）偶爾會冒險進入洞穴，從他的屍體上採集有毒的毒蘑菇。

english: To remove the brass key without disturbing the mold, a character must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. The key unlocks the door to the venom distillery ({@area area 14|2eb|x}).
zh_tw: 為了在不破壞黴菌的情況下取出銅鑰匙，角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定。這把鑰匙可以開啟毒藥蒸餾室的門（{@area 區域14|2eb|x}）。

english: 23. Secret Entrance
zh_tw: 23. 秘密入口

english: If characters enter this tunnel from the surface, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色從地面進入這個隧道，請閱讀：

english: The passage winds into the bowels of the earth. The air is wet and sticky, and the walls are slick with moisture. Harmless centipedes crawl across the floor as you descend.
zh_tw: 通道蜿蜒進入大地的深處。空氣潮溼且粘稠，牆壁上滑溜溜的都是水分。無害的蜈蚣在你下降時在地板上爬行。

english: The tunnel is roughly 100 feet long. Characters who climb the tunnel toward the surface emerge amid the ruins of Omu's royal palace (see {@area chapter 3|292|x}, area 20B).
zh_tw: 隧道大約有100尺長。角色如果沿著隧道向地面爬升，會出現在奧穆皇家宮殿的廢墟中（見{@area 第三章|292|x}，區域20B）。

english: Chapter 5: Tomb of the Nine Gods
zh_tw: 第5章：九神之墓

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} built the Tomb of the Nine Gods not only to house the remains of Omu's trickster gods, but also to slay interlopers. However, few today even know the tomb exists, and thus it remains an enigma. Rare are the tavern tales that lure adventurers to its gates, and its horrors remain undocumented in the libraries of Candlekeep. The reason for this is simple: not one person who has entered the tomb has lived to tell the tale.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}建造九神之墓不僅是為了安置奧穆的詭神的遺骸，也是為了殺死入侵者。然而，今天很少有人知道這座墓穴的存在，因此它仍然是一個謎。很少有酒館的故事能吸引冒險家到它的門前，而它的秘密在燭堡的圖書館中也未被記錄。原因很簡單：沒有一個進入墓穴的人活著出來講述這個故事。

english: History of the Tomb
zh_tw: 陵墓的歷史

english: As the characters plumb the depths of the Tomb of the Nine Gods, they'll learn snippets of its grisly past.
zh_tw: 當角色們深入探索九神之墓的深處時，他們將瞭解到它可怕過去的片段。

english: Rise of the Tomb
zh_tw: 墓穴的崛起

english: After {@creature Acererak|ToA} murdered Omu's gods, he enslaved the Omuans and forced them to carve a grand tomb under one of the cliffs surrounding the city. The archlich devised brutal trials for each burial chamber, and sprinkled riddles and illusions throughout to deceive intruders. When the building work was done, he fed his slaves into the death trap to test its efficacy. The archlich turned some of his victims into undead and flesh golems, then locked them inside the tomb to serve as guardians. {@creature Acererak|ToA} then resumed his wanderings.
zh_tw: 在{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}謀殺了奧穆的神靈之後，他奴役了奧穆人，並強迫他們在城市周圍的懸崖下雕刻一座宏偉的墓穴。這個巫妖為每個墓室設計了殘酷的試煉，並在其中散佈了謎題和幻象來欺騙入侵者。當建築工程完成後，他將自己的奴隸送入死亡陷阱以測試其效力。巫妖將一些受害者變成了不死生物和血肉魔像，然後將它們鎖在墓穴中作為守護者。之後，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}繼續他的漫遊。

english: In {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s absence, the tomb snared adventurers from faraway lands and harvested their souls to feed the archlich's phylactery, which remained hidden on another plane. Every few decades, {@creature Acererak|ToA} returned to tinker with his dungeon's traps, add treasure to its vaults, and reap a bounty of hoarded souls. His planar wanderings have influenced the tomb's mishmash of architectural styles, and have populated it with strange and deadly monsters.
zh_tw: 在{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}離開期間，墓穴捕獲了來自遙遠土地的冒險家，並收割他們的靈魂來滋養巫妖的護符盒，這個護符盒一直隱藏在另一個位面上。每隔幾十年，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}就會返回來調整他的地下城陷阱，向其金庫中新增財寶，並收穫一批囤積的靈魂。他的位面漫遊影響了墓穴混合的建築風格，並用奇怪而致命的怪物填充了它。

english: Nourishing the Atropal
zh_tw: 滋養萎縮者爾

english: On one of his journeys through the cosmos, {@creature Acererak|ToA} stumbled upon an atropal (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). He brought it to Toril, ensconced it in the cradle of his tomb, and began feeding it necromantic energy, hoping to transform it into a deity: one able to claim dominion over death. Unleashed on Toril, the newborn death god would glut itself on life until none but the dead walked the world.
zh_tw: 在穿越宇宙的一次旅程中，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}偶然發現了一隻萎縮者爾（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。他將它帶到託瑞爾，安置在他的墓穴搖籃中，並開始用死靈能量滋養它，希望將其轉變為一個神：一個能夠宣稱對死亡的統治權的神。如果這個新生的死亡之神在託瑞爾被釋放，它將沉迷於生命，直到世界上只剩下死者行走。

english: To nurture the atropal, {@creature Acererak|ToA} needed an untold number of souls. The archlich made a bargain with the Sewn Sisters, a coven of night hags feared throughout the Lower Planes. Seduced by the prospect of a near-endless supply of souls, the hags joined {@creature Acererak|ToA} in his tomb. With their assistance, the archlich crafted the Soulmonger—a necromantic device that could reap the souls of the dying from across Toril and feed them to the atropal. Leaving the Sewn Sisters behind as nursemaids, {@creature Acererak|ToA} abandoned his tomb to watch the rise of the death god from afar.
zh_tw: 為了養育萎縮者爾，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}需要無數的靈魂。巫妖與縫合姐妹——一群在整個下層界都令人恐懼的夜巫婆——達成了交易。被近乎無盡的靈魂供應前景所誘惑，這些巫婆加入了{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的墓穴。在她們的幫助下，巫妖製造了噬魂器——一種死靈法術裝置，能夠從整個託瑞爾收割垂死者的靈魂並餵養給萎縮者爾。留下縫合姐妹作為看護者，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}放棄了他的墓穴，從遠處觀察死亡之神的崛起。

english: Exploring the Tomb
zh_tw: 探索墓穴

english: To survive the tomb's horrors, the player characters must call on every ounce of their cunning and willpower.
zh_tw: 為了在墓穴的恐怖中生存下來，玩家角色必須動用他們所有的智慧和意志力。

english: General Features
zh_tw: 通用特徵

english: The following features are common throughout the tomb. Some levels of the tomb have additional features that are described at the beginning of their respective sections.
zh_tw: 墓穴中普遍存在以下特點。墓穴的一些層次還有額外的特點，這些將在各自章節的開頭進行描述。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Unless specified otherwise, ceilings in the tomb are 8 feet high in corridors and 12 feet high in rooms.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，墓穴中走廊的天花板高度為8尺，房間的天花板高度為12尺。

english: Crawlways
zh_tw: 爬行道

english: Certain areas of the tomb are accessible only by way of narrow tunnels. These crawlways are 3 feet high and 2 feet wide.
zh_tw: 墓穴的某些區域只能透過狹窄的隧道進入。這些爬行道高度為3尺，寬度為2尺。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: All areas of the tomb are unlit unless noted otherwise.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，墓穴的所有區域都是未照明的。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Most secret doors within the tomb slide open on stone runners. The handles that unlock them are hidden within the features of relief carvings along the walls, including inside the jaws of many graven skulls.
zh_tw: 墓穴內大多數秘密門是透過石滑軌上滑開的。開啟它們的手柄隱藏在牆壁上的浮雕雕刻特徵中，包括許多雕刻的骷髏頭的顎部內部。

english: A secret door can be spotted by any character within 5 feet of it who has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 20 or higher, or with a search and a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 任何角色如果在秘密門的5尺範圍內，並且擁有20或更高的被動感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）值，或者透過搜尋併成功進行一次{@dc 20}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，都可以發現這扇門。

english: Staircases
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: Stairs in the tomb are carved out of the living rock, and each step is topped with a single slab of cut stone. The skulls and bones of dead Omuans fill niches along the walls of each staircase. Staircases run 25 feet between each level of the tomb.
zh_tw: 墓穴中的樓梯是從活岩石中雕刻出來的，每個臺階上都覆蓋著一塊切割好的石板。死去的奧穆人的頭骨和骨頭填滿了每個樓梯牆壁上的壁龕。墓穴中每個層次之間樓梯的跨度為25尺。

english: Tracks
zh_tw: 蹤跡

english: Explorers have broken into the tomb recently, and {@creature Withers|ToA} and his tomb dwarves make frequent patrols. Their trails crisscross back and forth, making other creatures in the tomb difficult to track. The freshest tracks belong to the {@creature Skeleton Key|ToA|skeleton keys} (see "Tomb Inhabitants" below). Any character who tries to follow a {@creature skeleton key|ToA}'s trail can do so with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check, finding the way to the nearest unexplored location marked with a skull symbol on the dungeon map.
zh_tw: 探索者們最近闖入了這座古墓，而{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}和他的墓穴矮人們頻繁巡邏。他們的足跡來回交錯，使得墓穴中的其他生物難以追蹤。最新的足跡屬於{@creature Skeleton Key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}（見下方的"墓穴居民"）。任何試圖追蹤{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}蹤跡的角色，可以透過成功的{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Survival||求生}）檢定來完成，找到通往最近未探索區域的路，該區域在地圖上標有骷髏符號。

english: Tomb Inhabitants
zh_tw: 墓穴居民

english: A grim pageant of monstrous residents lurks in the tomb, waiting to greet visitors.
zh_tw: 一群陰森的怪物居民潛伏在墓穴中，等待著迎接來訪者。

english: Withers and the Tomb Dwarves
zh_tw: 威瑟斯和墓穴矮人

english: {@creature Withers|ToA}, {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s undead custodian, oversees the undead maintenance crew that keeps the tomb's traps in working order. To assemble that team, {@creature Acererak|ToA} abducted dwarf miners and transformed them into wights to exploit their expertise at underground construction. {@creature Withers|ToA} acts as supervisor for the dwarves and serves as {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s adjunct when the archlich visits the tomb. Using his scrying pool at {@area area 25|39f|x}, {@creature Withers|ToA} can command Omu's gargoyles and speak to agents on the surface world.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的不死看守，監督著一群不死維護團隊，以確保墓穴的陷阱保持工作狀態。為了組建這個團隊，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}綁架了矮人礦工並將他們變成了惡靈，利用他們在地下建築方面的專業知識。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}作為矮人們的監督者，並在巫妖訪問墓穴時擔任{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的助手。使用他在{@area 區域25|39f|x}的水晶球，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}可以指揮奧穆的石像鬼並與地表世界的代理人交流。

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} and his crew use the staircase at {@area area 26|3a3|x} to roam unseen through the tomb's many levels. When their work is done, they retreat to their secret headquarters on level 2 of the tomb ({@area areas 27|3a5|x} and {@area 28|3aa|x}). {@creature Withers|ToA} avoids contact with the characters when possible, confident that {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s traps will defeat them.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}和他的船員使用位於{@area 區域26|3a3|x}的樓梯，在墓穴的許多層中無聲息地遊蕩。當他們的工作完成後，他們撤退到墓穴第二層的秘密總部（{@area 區域27|3a5|x}和{@area 28|3aa|x}）。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}儘可能避免與角色接觸，相信{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的陷阱會擊敗他們。

english: Legendary Monsters
zh_tw: 傳奇怪物

english: Two legendary monsters dwell in {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s tomb: a beholder guarding a treasure vault ({@area area 44|414|x}) and an aboleth lurking in an underground lake ({@area area 65|4b1|x}). These creatures can't use lair actions within the tomb, and the regional effects of each creature's lair are localized to the levels where they dwell.
zh_tw: 兩個傳奇怪物居住在 {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 的墳墓中：一個守衛著寶藏庫房的眼魔（{@area 區域44|414|x}）和一個潛伏在地下湖中的阿波羅斯（{@area 區域65|4b1|x}）。這些生物在墳墓內不能使用巢穴動作，每個生物巢穴的區域效果僅限於它們居住的層次。

english: Despite being the dungeon's creator, {@creature Acererak|ToA} doesn't count the Tomb of the Nine Gods as his lair. Consequently, no lair actions or regional effects are ascribed to the archlich in this adventure.
zh_tw: 儘管是地牢的創造者，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}並不將九神之墓視為他的巢穴。因此，在這次冒險中，沒有賦予巫妖任何巢穴行動或區域效果。

english: Skeleton Keys
zh_tw: 骷髏鑰匙

english: To unlock the final gate to the Soulmonger, the adventurers must acquire five skeleton keys—each the carved skull of an animated human skeleton that roams the tomb. The characters can capture and control these skeletons, or can simply snap a skull off its spine.
zh_tw: 為瞭解開通往噬魂器（噬魂器）的最終大門，冒險家們必須獲得五把骷髏鑰匙——每把都是一個漫遊墓穴的活化人類骷髏的雕刻頭骨。角色們可以捕獲並控制這些骷髏，或者簡單地從脊柱上折斷一個頭骨。

english: A {@creature skeleton key|ToA} has the statistics of a {@creature skeleton}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}具有{@creature skeleton||骷髏}的具體數值，並有以下變化：

english: The {@creature skeleton key|ToA} is unaligned.
zh_tw: {@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}是無陣營的。

english: It has a climbing speed of 30 feet and can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
zh_tw: 它具有30尺的攀爬速度，並且能夠攀爬困難的表面，包括在天花板上倒掛著，無需進行屬性檢定。

english: It wields a pair of daggers and can make two melee weapon attacks ({@hit 4} to hit) as an action. Each dagger attack deals 4 ({@dice 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 它持有一對匕首，可以作為一個動作進行兩次近戰武器攻擊（命中為 {@hit 4}）。每次匕首攻擊命中時造成4（{@dice 1d4 + 2}）點穿刺傷害。

english: When reduced to 0 hit points, a {@creature skeleton key|ToA} falls apart, though its skull and bones remain intact.
zh_tw: 當降至0生命值時，一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}會解體，儘管它的頭骨和骨頭仍然完好無損。

english: A {@creature skeleton key|ToA} does not trigger any trap placed in a room or on a door of the tomb.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}不會觸發放置在墓穴房間或門上的任何陷阱。

english: Each {@creature skeleton key|ToA} has a skull that extends into a carved key-like shape. These shapes match the keyholes of the skeleton gate in the lair of the Sewn Sisters ({@area area 71|4d8|x}). The Skeleton Keys table summarizes the location and shape of each key.
zh_tw: 每個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}都有一個延伸成雕刻鑰匙形狀的頭骨。這些形狀與縫合姐妹巢穴中（{@area 區域71|4d8|x}）骷髏門的鑰匙孔相匹配。骷髏鑰匙表總結了每把鑰匙的位置和形狀。

english: Finding a Skeleton Key
zh_tw: 尋找一個骷髏鑰匙

english: Each of the first five levels of the tomb has its own {@creature skeleton key|ToA}. A {@creature skeleton key|ToA} can be encountered in any of the locations marked with a skull symbol on the level map. You choose a {@creature skeleton key|ToA}'s location. You can also change your mind and relocate the {@creature skeleton key|ToA} to make it easier or harder to find.
zh_tw: 墓穴的前五個層次每個都有其自己的{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}。一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}可以出現在層次地圖上標記有骷髏符號的任何位置。你可以選擇一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}的位置。你也可以改變主意，重新定位{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}，使其更容易或更難找到。

english: Apart from unlocking the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x}, the skeleton keys perform no function. When the characters enter an area containing a {@creature skeleton key|ToA}, it might be standing in the middle of the room, standing in a corner, walking across the ceiling, or clinging to a wall. A {@creature skeleton key|ToA}'s primary goal is to avoid capture or destruction, so it flees if it can.
zh_tw: 除了解鎖位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門之外，骷髏鑰匙沒有其他功能。當角色進入包含{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}的區域時，它可能站在房間中央、站在角落、在天花板上行走，或者附著在牆上。{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}的主要目標是避免被捕獲或摧毀，因此如果可能的話它會逃跑。

zh_tw: 骷髏鑰匙

zh_tw: 鑰匙形狀

english: The Sewn Sisters
zh_tw: 縫合姐妹

english: In the lowest level of the tomb, a coven of night hags nurses the atropal to its apotheosis. See {@area area 71|4d8|x} and "The Sewn Sisters" sidebar near that section for more information on the hags.
zh_tw: 在墓穴的最底層，一群夜巫婆正在培養萎縮者達到其神化。有關巫婆的更多資訊，請參見{@area 區域71|4d8|x}和該部分附近的"縫合姐妹"邊欄。

english: Tomb Guardians
zh_tw: 墓穴守衛

english: Adventurers who have perished inside the tomb are stitched together by tomb dwarves and bolted into suits of armor. Once complete, these shambling golems are released into the tomb to hunt intruders.
zh_tw: 在墓穴中死去的冒險家被陵墓矮人縫合起來，並用螺栓固定進盔甲中。一旦完成，這些蹣跚的魔像就被放進墓穴去追捕入侵者。

english: A {@creature tomb guardian|ToA} is a {@creature flesh golem} clad in plate armor, giving it AC 17. One or two tomb guardians should appear whenever you feel the need for combat. As the characters delve deeper into the tomb, they should come to know these monsters well.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature tomb guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛} 是一個穿著板甲的 {@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}，使其護甲等級達到17。每當你覺得需要戰鬥時，應該出現一個或兩個墓穴守衛。隨著角色深入墓穴，他們應該逐漸熟悉這些怪物。

english: Trickster God Spirits
zh_tw: 詭神的靈魂

english: The spirits of the nine trickster gods of Omu haunt the tomb. Although they cannot escape it, these spirits can inhabit adventurers within the tomb (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}").
zh_tw: 奧穆九位詭神的靈魂在這座墓穴中徘徊。儘管它們無法逃脫，但這些靈魂可以寄居在墓穴內的冒險者身上（參見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。

english: Fabled Treasures
zh_tw: 傳說中的寶藏

english: Among the many treasures hidden in the tomb are four fabled art objects that hold special value. {@creature Acererak|ToA} uses them to lure adventurers to the tomb.
zh_tw: 隱藏在墓中的眾多寶藏中，有四個傳說中的藝術品，它們具有特殊價值。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 使用它們來吸引冒險家到墓中。

english: Any character with proficiency in the {@skill History} skill who lays eyes on one of these treasures can recall its lore with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check.
zh_tw: 任何熟練於{@skill History||歷史}技能的角色在看到這些寶物之一時，可以透過一次成功的{@dc 20}智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定回憶起其傳說。

english: Black Opal Crown
zh_tw: 黑歐珀皇冠

english: The Black Opal Crown was once worn by the archmage Sadamor of Netheril. Legend speaks of how Sadamor saw the depths of humanity's evil reflected in the opal of his crown. Heartbroken, he created a doomsday device—a {@item sphere of annihilation}—to swallow the world but was consumed by his own creation.
zh_tw: 黑蛋白石皇冠曾經是尼瑟瑞爾的大法師薩達莫爾所佩戴的。傳說中薩達莫爾如何在他的皇冠蛋白石中看到了人類邪惡的深淵。心碎之下，他創造了一個末日裝置——一個{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}——來吞噬世界，但最終被自己的創造物所吞噬。

english: The yuan-ti nightmare speaker {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} (see {@area chapter 4|2a1|x}) believes that the Black Opal Crown can awaken Dendar the Night Serpent. If the characters find the crown, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} tries to kill them before they escape Chult with it. The crown rests in the maze of death ({@area area 49|442|x}).
zh_tw: 玉蛇族噩夢使者{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}（見{@area 第四章|2a1|x}）相信黑歐珀皇冠可以喚醒夜蛇神登達爾。如果角色們找到了皇冠，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}會試圖在他們帶著它逃離楚爾特之前殺死他們。皇冠安放在死亡迷宮中（{@area 區域49|442|x}）。

english: Eye of Zaltec
zh_tw: 扎爾特克之眼

english: For centuries, this fist-sized ruby surmounted the Great Pyramid in Nexal, capital city of the Maztican Empire. The gem is a relic of the cult of Zaltec, and its dagger-like point was plunged into the hearts of countless sacrifices.
zh_tw: 幾個世紀以來，這顆拳頭大小的紅寶石一直鑲嵌在尼薩爾的大金字塔上，它是馬茲特克帝國首都的標誌性建築。這塊寶石是扎爾特克教派的聖物，其匕首狀的尖端曾被插入無數祭品的心臟中。

english: An adventuring band known as the Company of the Yellow Banner entered Omu to find the Eye of Zaltec and was never seen again. The Eye of Zaltec is guarded by a stone juggernaut ({@area area 62|49f|x}).
zh_tw: 一個被稱為黃旗冒險團的冒險團隊進入了奧穆尋找扎爾特克之眼，從此再也沒有被看到。扎爾特克之眼由一個岩石戰車守衛（{@area 區域62|49f|x}）。

english: Navel of the Moon
zh_tw: 月亮的肚臍

english: Said to be carved from a chunk of the moon, this polished egg-shaped stone was given as a gift by the ruling syl-pasha of Calimport to his sailor daughter. It is said that anyone who holds the stone can always find the way home to his or her loved ones.
zh_tw: 據說這是從月球上切下來的一塊，這個拋光的蛋形石頭是卡利姆港的統治者賽爾帕夏送給他水手女兒的禮物。據說任何持有這塊石頭的人都能找到回家的路，回到他或她所愛的人身邊。

english: The tabaxi hunter {@creature Bag of Nails|ToA} (see {@area chapter 3|22e|x}) came to Omu in search of the Navel of the Moon but failed to find it. The Navel of the Moon is set into the pendulum of a grandfather clock inside a secret room ({@area area 56|478|x}).
zh_tw: 斑貓獵人{@creature Bag of Nails|ToA|釘包}（見{@area 第三章|22e|x}）來到奧穆尋找月亮的肚臍，但未能找到它。月亮的肚臍被鑲嵌在一個秘密房間（{@area 區域56|478|x}）裡的大擺鐘的擺錘上。

english: Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare
zh_tw: 查加卡雷的骷髏聖盃

english: This jeweled goblet was crafted from the skull of a long-dead Omuan king and served as a symbol of office for the royal line of Omu. The legendary Chultan hero Ch'gakare (pronounced chuh-GAH-kah-ree) is said to have beheaded the king after escaping the Nine Hells on the back of a mastodon.
zh_tw: 這個鑲有寶石的高腳杯是用一個早已死去的奧穆國王的頭骨製成的，它是奧穆王室血統的象徵。傳說中的楚爾特英雄查加卡雷（發音為chuh-GAH-kah-ree）據說在騎上一頭乳齒象逃離九層地獄後斬首了國王。

english: Princess Mwaxanaré (see "{@area Kir Sabal|13f|x}," and {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) is keen to recover the Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare as part of her bid to reclaim the throne of Omu. To obtain it, characters must first survive the perils of the hall of the golden mastodon ({@area area 67|4bd|x}).
zh_tw: 姆瓦克絲娜瑞公主（見"{@area 基爾·薩巴爾|13f|x}"，以及{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）非常希望恢復查加卡雷的骷髏聖盃，作為她奪回奧穆王位的一部分。為了獲得它，角色們必須首先在黃金乳齒象大廳（{@area 區域67|4bd|x}）的危險中生存下來。

english: Spell Restrictions
zh_tw: 法術限制

english: Many spells have altered effects when cast in the Tomb of the Nine Gods, including spells cast from magic items or artifacts, and class abilities that duplicate the effects of spells. {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s magic and the magic of the {@item amulet of the black skull|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}) are unaffected.
zh_tw: 許多法術在九神之墓中施展時效果會有所改變，包括從魔法物品或神器中施展的法術，以及複製法術效果的職業能力。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的魔法和{@item amulet of the black skull|ToA|黑顱骨護符}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}）的魔法不受影響。

english: Spells that would normally allow creatures to transport into and out of the tomb either fail or deposit their recipients in {@area area 57|47d|x}. Spells that normally allow one to pass through stone fail, and divination spells cast within the tomb provide false readings. Spells designed to communicate over long distances are similarly foiled. These alterations are summarized in the Modified Spells table. Spells not included in the table might suffer similar alterations, at your discretion.

zh_tw: 這個替補角色幾個世紀前闖入了墓穴，但被囚禁在一個魔法雕刻中。當其他角色之一無意中靠在這個雕刻上時，替補角色被從囚禁中釋放出來。

english: The replacement character hails from another world (Athas, Krynn, Oerth, medieval Earth, or any other milieu of your choosing) and is trapped in stasis within the tomb as one of {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s trophies. If the character is touched, the archlich's binding magic ends.
zh_tw: 替代角色來自另一個世界（阿塔斯、克萊恩、奧斯、中古地球或你選擇的任何其他背景），並作為{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的戰利品之一，被困在墓穴的靜態中。如果角色被觸碰，大巫妖的束縛魔法將結束。

english: The replacement character is a clone of the fallen adventurer. The hags in {@area area 71|4d8|x} created and tortured the clone to gain information about the adventurers' presence in the tomb. Having escaped, the new character suffers from amnesia and has scant memory of the hags. The clone has gear scavenged from dead adventurers.
zh_tw: 替代角色是已故冒險家的克隆體。在{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的巫婆們創造了這個克隆體並對其進行折磨，以獲取有關冒險家在墓穴中存在的資訊。逃脫後，新角色患有失憶症，對巫婆們的記憶很少。克隆體擁有從死去的冒險家那裡收集的裝備。

english: The new character is the sole survivor of a doomed adventuring company that breached the tomb in order to find and destroy the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 新角色是一個註定要失敗的冒險團隊的唯一生還者，該團隊闖入墓穴是為了尋找並摧毀噬魂器。

english: Spiritual Inhabitation
zh_tw: 靈性居住

english: The spirits are bound inside magic items scattered throughout the tomb. When a creature of the humanoid type touches such an item, the trickster god bound within attempts to inhabit that creature. With a successful {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw, the creature resists the god's power, and that god can't attempt to inhabit the same creature for the remainder of the adventure. On a failed save—or if the creature chooses to forgo the save—the god's spirit inhabits the creature's body. The trickster gods can tell whether or not a creature is humanoid, and they have no interest in possessing other types of creatures.
zh_tw: 九位詭神的靈魂被束縛在散落墓中的魔法物品內。當類人生物型別的生物碰觸這些物品時，其中的詭神便會嘗試附身。該生物若透過{@dc 16}魅力豁免，便能抵抗神靈的力量；在本次冒險餘下的時間裡，這位詭神都無法再嘗試附身於同一生物。若豁免失敗，或該生物選擇放棄豁免，詭神的靈魂便進入其體內。詭神能辨別生物是否屬於類人生物，對附身於其他型別的生物沒有興趣。

english: While inhabiting a host body, a trickster god acts like an overbearing passenger. The host creature remains in control of its actions but inherits a flaw from the god, as well as a special power. When a trickster god inhabits a player character, give the player that {@deck Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|god's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). A character doesn't know what power and flaw are gained from a specific trickster god until that god inhabits the character for the first time. Both the flaw and the power end when the spirit leaves the host.
zh_tw: 附身後，詭神就像一位專橫的乘客。宿主仍能掌控自己的行動，卻會承襲該神的一項缺點，同時得到一項特殊能力。當詭神附身於玩家角色時，將那位{@deck Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|神靈的卡牌}交給玩家（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。角色第一次被某位詭神附身之前，並不知道會獲得什麼能力與缺點。神靈離開宿主時，缺點與能力都隨之消失。

english: Leaving a Host
zh_tw: 離開宿主

english: A trickster god never willingly leaves a host, but its spirit is forced out if a host dies or leaves the tomb, or if a host is targeted by the break enchantment function of the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. A trickster god can also be forced out by another trickster god (see "Fighting Over a Host" below).
zh_tw: 詭神絕不會自願離開宿主。不過，宿主死亡、離開墓穴，或受到{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}法術「破除魔法」功能的作用時，神靈便會被迫離開。另一位詭神也能將其逐出宿主體內，詳見下方「爭奪宿主」。

english: When the spirit of a trickster god is forced out of a host, it returns to the magic item to which it is bound and cannot inhabit that host again for the remainder of the adventure. If the item is destroyed or taken from the tomb, the trickster god's spirit finds another object within the tomb to inhabit. The spirits of the trickster gods can't be destroyed and can never leave the tomb.
zh_tw: 被逐出宿主後，詭神的靈魂會回到束縛它的魔法物品中，且在本次冒險餘下的時間內都不能再附身於同一宿主。若該物品遭到摧毀或被帶離墓穴，詭神便會另找墓內的一件物品棲身。這些靈魂無法被摧毀，也永遠無法離開墓穴。

english: Fighting Over a Host
zh_tw: 爭奪宿主

english: When the spirit of one trickster god inhabits a host that is already inhabited by a trickster god, the two gods battle for the right to remain in the host. Assign "even" to one god and "odd" to another, then roll any die. The result determines which god is victorious, with the losing god forced out of the host. The host has no influence over which god gets forced out.
zh_tw: 若一位詭神的靈魂進入已被另一位詭神附身的宿主體內，雙方便會爭奪留在宿主體內的權利。指定一位神為「偶數」、另一位為「奇數」，然後擲任意一顆骰子，以結果決定勝者；落敗的詭神會被逐出。宿主無法影響哪一位神被逐出。

english: Roleplaying the Spirits
zh_tw: 扮演神靈的角色

english: A trickster god can use the host character's senses and speak to the host's mind. The character retains his or her alignment and can think independently. However, if the character has a flaw that runs counter to the trickster god's flaw, the character's flaw is suppressed until the trickster god's spirit leaves the character's body.
zh_tw: 詭神可以透過宿主的感官知覺外界，也能直接對宿主的心靈說話。角色仍保有自己的陣營與獨立思考能力。不過，若角色原有的一項缺點與詭神的缺點相衝突，該角色的缺點便會受到壓抑，直到詭神的靈魂離開其身體。

english: You can roleplay the voices of the trickster gods in the characters' heads, but let the players roleplay their characters' inherited flaws. If a player neglects to roleplay a trickster god's flaw, have the inhabiting spirit attempt to goad the character into behaving more like it. You can award inspiration to a player who roleplays a trickster god's flaw particularly well.
zh_tw: 你可以扮演角色腦海中的詭神聲音，但應讓玩家自行扮演角色承襲的缺點。若玩家忽略這項缺點，可以讓附身的神靈慫恿角色，試著讓角色的舉止更接近它。玩家若將詭神的缺點扮演得格外出色，你可以給予靈感獎勵。

english: All the trickster gods are eager to get their revenge on {@creature Acererak|ToA}. They can offer only limited guidance regarding the tomb and its denizens, but they encourage the characters to seek out other trickster god spirits and offer supernatural assistance in the final battle against the archlich.
zh_tw: 所有詭神都急於向{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}復仇。牠們對墓穴及其中居民所能提供的指引有限，但會鼓勵角色尋找其他詭神的靈魂，並在對抗大巫妖的最終決戰中提供超自然的援助。

english: Each trickster god (except Unkh) has its own rival in the tomb that it would prefer to avoid. The Omuans dreamed up colorful stories to explain these antipathies, but in truth, the spirits simply represent conflicting points on the alignment axes. When rival spirits occupy different characters in the same group, they try to make their hosts bicker and defy each other whenever possible.
zh_tw: 除了安珂，每位詭神在墓中都有一位不願碰面的死對頭。奧穆人編造了繽紛的傳說，解釋牠們為何互相厭惡；其實，這些靈魂只是分別代表陣營軸上相互對立的位置。敵對詭神若附身於同一隊伍的不同角色，便會盡可能挑起宿主之間的爭吵與抗拒。

english: Level 1: Rotten Halls
zh_tw: 第一層：腐爛大廳

english: Map 5.1 shows this level of the dungeon. The air is stale and humid here. Moss covers the walls, which are decorated with screaming skulls and hung with rotting tree roots and dead vines.
zh_tw: 地圖5.1顯示了地牢的這一層。這裡的空氣陳舊而潮溼。牆壁上覆蓋著苔蘚，裝飾著尖叫的骷髏頭，並懸掛著腐爛的樹根和枯死的藤蔓。

english: Map 5.1: Rotten Halls
zh_tw: 地圖 5.1: 腐爛大廳

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Ceiling Cracks
zh_tw: 天花板裂縫

english: Thin shafts of daylight and moonlight spill through tiny rock fissures, forming pools of natural light as shown on map 5.1. A Tiny creature can use these narrow fissures to enter and leave the tomb.
zh_tw: 細小的日光和月光穿過微小的岩石裂縫，形成地圖 5.1 上顯示的自然光池。一個小型生物可以使用這些狹窄的裂縫進出墓穴。

english: Underground River
zh_tw: 地下河

english: Muddy rainwater seeps from the jungles above, flowing through the tomb as a sluggish underground river that is treated as {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The water is 3 feet deep, with the tunnel ceiling above it varying from 6 inches to 3 feet over the surface. The water is unfit for drinking.
zh_tw: 泥濘的雨水從上方的叢林中滲透進來，流經墓穴，形成一條緩慢的地下河流，被視作{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。水深3尺，隧道的天花板在水面上方的高度從6吋到3尺不等。這些水不適合飲用。

english: 1. Acererak's Warning
zh_tw: 1. 阿瑟瑞克的警告

english: Near the base of the cliffs, a fifteen-foot-tall obelisk of cracked stone is draped with vines and black moss. Behind it, you see a dark passageway obscured by withered creepers. A second, smaller tunnel burrows into the base of a cliff to the east.
zh_tw: 在懸崖底部附近，一座高十五尺的破裂石碑被藤蔓和黑色苔蘚覆蓋。在它後面，你看到一個被枯萎的爬藤植物遮擋的黑暗通道。另一個較小的隧道則通往東邊懸崖底部。

english: The tunnel leading to the tomb's true entrance ({@area area 4|334|x}) is obscured by vegetation and cannot be detected unless the characters search for it. However, any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check around the areas of the false entrance ({@area area 2|32f|x}) or the open gallery ({@area area 3|332|x}) notices something more:
zh_tw: 通往墓室真正入口的隧道（{@area 區域4|334|x}）被植被遮蔽，除非角色進行搜尋，否則無法被發現。然而，任何在假入口（{@area 區域2|32f|x}）或開放畫廊（{@area 區域3|332|x}）附近成功透過{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會注意到更多：

english: Three stone gargoyles watch you from narrow ledges carved into the cliff side. Each has the face of a bearded devil, its mouth agape in a silent scream.
zh_tw: 三個石像鬼從雕刻在懸崖邊上的狹窄壁架上注視著你。每個石像鬼都有一張須魔的臉，嘴巴張開，發出無聲的尖叫。

english: The three {@creature Gargoyle||gargoyles} are perched on the ledges overlooking the obelisk, at the points marked G on map 5.1. The ledges are 30 feet above the ground, 5 feet wide, 2 feet deep, and spaced 25 feet apart. The gargoyles swoop down and attack anyone who tries to topple or damage the obelisk, or who attacks them first.
zh_tw: 三隻{@creature Gargoyle||石像鬼}棲息在俯瞰石碑的壁架上，在地圖5.1上標記為G的點。壁架位於地面上方30尺，寬5尺，深2尺，間隔25尺。任何試圖推倒或損壞石碑的人，或者首先攻擊它們的任何人，都會遭到石像鬼的俯衝攻擊。

english: Obelisk
zh_tw: 方尖碑

english: The obelisk radiates a strong aura of abjuration magic under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic, and a paladin using Divine Sense can detect a fiendish presence within the obelisk. Clearing the vines and moss from the south face of the obelisk exposes a message carved into it in Common. (Give the players a copy of handout 17 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) The message reads as follows:
zh_tw: 方尖碑在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法的審視下散發出強烈的防護系魔法光環，使用聖潔感知的聖騎士可以察覺到方尖碑記憶體在著一股邪惡的存在。清除方尖碑南面的藤蔓和苔蘚後，可以看到上面用通用語刻著一則資訊。（給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中的講義 17。）資訊內容如下：

english: Fear the night when the forsaken one seizes death's mantle and the seas dry up and the dead rise and I, {@creature Acererak|ToA} the Eternal, reap the world of the living. Those who dare enter take heed: The enemies oppose.
zh_tw: 當被遺棄者奪取死亡的斗篷，當海洋乾涸，死者復活，而我，不死的{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}，收割生者的世界時，恐懼夜晚。敢於進入的人當心：敵人會反對。

english: One stands between them.
zh_tw: 他們之間站著一個人。

english: In darkness, it hides.
zh_tw: 它隱藏在黑暗中。

english: Don the mask or be seen.
zh_tw: 戴上面具，否則就會被發現。

english: Speak no truth to the doomed child.
zh_tw: 不要對註定的孩子說出真相。

english: The keys turn on the inside only.
zh_tw: 鑰匙只能從內部轉動。

english: The warnings {@creature Acererak|ToA} has placed on the obelisk and on the grand staircase ({@area area 7|345|x}) provide clues to overcoming some of the challenges of the tomb. The obelisk's clues pertain to features and locations on level 1, specifically the true entrance ({@area area 4|334|x}), the devil face (area 5B), Obo'laka's tomb ({@area area 10|356|x}), Moa's tomb ({@area area 14|364|x}), and Wongo's tomb ({@area area 16|36f|x}).
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}在方尖碑和宏偉樓梯（{@area 區域7|345|x}）上放置的警告提供了克服墳墓中一些挑戰的線索。方尖碑的線索涉及第一層的特徵和位置，特別是真正的入口（{@area 區域4|334|x}）、魔鬼面孔（區域 5B）、奧博娜卡的墳墓（{@area 區域10|356|x}）、莫阿的墳墓（{@area 區域14|364|x}）和望戈的墳墓（{@area 區域16|36f|x}）。

english: Characters with a combined Strength of 60 or more can topple the obelisk, breaking it off at the base. Breaking or destroying the obelisk releases a cloud of black smoke that coalesces into a {@creature nalfeshnee} demon. The demon appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the obelisk and attacks those responsible for the obelisk's desecration. After 1 minute, the demon disappears and returns to the Abyss.
zh_tw: 力量總和達到60或以上的角色可以推倒這座方尖碑，在底部將其折斷。破壞或摧毀方尖碑會釋放出一團黑煙，凝聚成一個{@creature nalfeshnee||判魂魔}惡魔。惡魔出現在方尖碑30尺範圍內的未被佔據的空間，並攻擊那些褻瀆方尖碑的人。1分鐘後，惡魔消失並返回到無底深淵。

english: The teleportation function of the ebon pool ({@area area 81|520|x}) returns characters to the obelisk even if it is toppled or destroyed.
zh_tw: 即使方尖碑被推倒或摧毀，烏木池（{@area 區域81|520|x}）的傳送功能也會將角色傳送回方尖碑處。

english: 2. Gallery of Tricksters
zh_tw: 2. 詭計長廊

english: Alcoves run the length of a narrow tunnel, each one featuring a bestial statue standing or squatting above a basin of oil.
zh_tw: 壁龕沿著一條狹窄的隧道延伸，每一個壁龕上方都有一個野獸雕像站立或蹲坐在油盆之上。

english: The statues depict the nine trickster gods, with each facing pair of alcoves dedicated to two trickster gods who oppose each other. Moving down the hall from west to east, the opposing statues depict Moa (jaculi) and Wongo (su-monster), I'jin (almiraj) and Obo'laka (zorbo), Papazotl (eblis) and Kubazan (froghemoth), and Nangnang (grung) and Shagambi (kamadan).
zh_tw: 這些雕像描繪了九位詭神，每對相對的壁龕都獻給了彼此對立的兩位詭神。從西向東沿著大廳移動，對立的雕像分別描繪了莫阿（幻色蛇）和望戈（蘇怪），艾金（獨角兔）和奧博娜卡（巨蜥），帕帕扎圖（魔王鶴）和庫巴贊（蛙獸），娜浪（樹精）和莎根比（六岐蛇豹）。

english: Each statue is 3 feet tall and can't be moved from its pedestal. When any character carrying a puzzle cube (see {@area chapter 3|1eb|x}) enters the tunnel, the oil basin matching the cube's trickster god bursts into flame. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of divination magic around the statues. The oil basins give off an aura of conjuration.
zh_tw: 每座雕像高3尺，不能從基座上移動。當任何攜帶謎題立方體的角色（見{@area 第三章|1eb|x}）進入隧道時，與立方體上的詭神相匹配的油盆會燃起火焰。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果會揭示雕像周圍的占卜魔法氣息。油盆散發出召喚魔法的氣息。

english: Only eight trickster gods are initially visible; the statue of Unkh (flail snail) is hidden behind a secret door at the end of the tunnel, though it functions the same as the others. Bringing Unkh's puzzle cube into the tunnel lights Unkh's brazier, giving characters advantage on ability checks made to find the secret door.
zh_tw: 最初只有八個騙子神是可見的；安珂（鏈枷蝸牛）的雕像被隱藏在隧道盡頭的秘密門後面，儘管它的功能與其他雕像相同。將安珂的謎題魔方帶入隧道會點亮安珂的火盆，給予角色在尋找秘密門的屬性檢定時的優勢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A golden pendant shaped like an eye hangs on the Unkh statue. It is worth 25 gp and radiates an aura of divination magic. If a character wearing the pendant passes within 10 feet of the obelisk at {@area area 1|32a|x}, the pendant tugs the character toward the hidden tomb entrance ({@area area 4|334|x}). The pendant is also of use in {@area area 79|512|x}.
zh_tw: 一個形狀像眼睛的金色吊墜掛在安珂雕像上。它價值25金幣，散發著占卜魔法的氣息。如果佩戴這個吊墜的角色進入{@area 區域1|32a|x}的方尖碑附近10尺範圍內，吊墜會拉著角色朝隱藏的墓穴入口（{@area 區域4|334|x}）移動。這個吊墜在{@area 區域79|512|x}也有用。

english: 3. False Entrance
zh_tw: 3. 假入口

english: After 20 feet, a puzzle door sealing off a small chamber beyond blocks this false entrance into the tomb.
zh_tw: 走過20尺後，一個謎題門封鎖了墓穴中一個小型房間的入口，這個入口是假的。

english: A short tunnel ends at a slab of worked stone, whose edges are marked by relief carvings of grinning skulls. Four lines engraved at the center of the slab cross one another to form a star, with both ends of each line marking the location of a cube-shaped cavity cut into the door—eight cavities in all.
zh_tw: 一條短隧道在一塊經過加工的石板上結束，石板邊緣刻有咧嘴笑的骷髏浮雕。四條線在石板中心相交形成一個星形，每條線的兩端都標記著一個切割在門上的立方體形狀的凹槽——總共八個凹槽。

english: Each cavity is sized to hold one of the puzzle cubes recovered from the shrines of Omu (see {@area chapter 3|1eb|x}). However, there are nine puzzle cubes in total and only eight cavities.
zh_tw: 每個空腔的大小都適合放置從奧穆神殿回收的一個謎題立方體（見{@area 第三章|1eb|x}）。然而，總共有九個謎題立方體，卻只有八個空腔。

english: If puzzle cubes representing every trickster god except Unkh are inserted into the cavities in such a way that the cubes of rival gods are opposite to one another, a stone block slowly descends over the tunnel entrance. Any character in the tunnel must decide whether to stay or to flee, which requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Characters who stay or who fail the check are trapped when the stone block seals off the tunnel. Once the tunnel is sealed, caustic gas billows out from the mouths of the relief-carved skulls. Any creature trapped in the tunnel must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 5 ({@dice 1d10}) poison damage and 5 ({@dice 1d10}) acid damage. While any affected creature remains in the tunnel, it must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. After 10 rounds, the gas valves close and the stone block rises back into the ceiling. Any puzzle cubes still in their cavities are pushed out, and the trap resets.
zh_tw: 如果代表除安珂之外的所有詭神的謎題方塊以敵對神的方塊彼此相對的方式插入凹槽中，一塊石磚會慢慢降下，封住隧道入口。任何在隧道中的角色必須決定是留下還是逃離，這需要透過一個成功的{@dc 10}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果角色選擇留下或檢定失敗，他們將被困在隧道中，當石磚封住隧道時被封鎖。一旦隧道被封住，腐蝕性氣體會從浮雕骷髏的口中湧出。任何被困在隧道中的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，否則會受到5（{@dice 1d10}）點毒素傷害和5（{@dice 1d10}）點酸蝕傷害。任何受影響的生物在隧道中每回合開始時必須重複進行豁免檢定。10回合後，氣體閥門關閉，石磚升回天花板。任何仍在凹槽中的謎題方塊會被彈出，陷阱重新設定。

english: Any character searching the tunnel for traps spots the raised stone block with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The weight of the block makes it impossible to hinder its descent. Any character who examines the puzzle door and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices holes in the mouths of the skulls. Stuffing the holes with cloth or wax prevents the gas from being released. Doing so while the trap is active is difficult, requiring six successful {@dc 10} Dexterity checks, each made as an action.
zh_tw: 任何角色在隧道中搜尋陷阱時，若成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定，會發現凸起的石塊。石塊的重量使其無法阻礙其下落。任何檢查謎題門並透過一次 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}檢定的角色會注意到骷髏嘴中的孔洞。用布或蠟塞住孔洞可以防止氣體釋放。當陷阱啟用時，這樣做很困難，需要進行六次成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷檢定，每次檢定都作為一個動作。

english: Beyond the false door is a gas-filled chamber. Any creature that starts its turn in this area takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) poison damage and 11 ({@dice 2d10}) acid damage.
zh_tw: 假門後面是一個充滿氣體的房間。任何生物在該區域內開始其回合時，將受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點毒素傷害和11（{@dice 2d10}）點強酸傷害。

english: 4. True Entrance
zh_tw: 4. 真正入口

english: Thick foliage conceals the true entrance to the Tomb of the Nine Gods. Any character searching the base of the cliff at this location finds the entrance with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 茂密的植被隱藏了九神之墓的真正入口。任何在此處懸崖底部進行搜尋的角色，透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定即可找到入口。

english: Pulling aside the heavy undergrowth, you uncover an archway in the cliff face. Stone skulls peer down from the lintel, and old bones litter the threshold. As light strikes the entrance, a swarm of bats screeches out from within.
zh_tw: 撥開厚重的灌木叢，你發現了懸崖上的一個拱門。石制的骷髏從門楣上俯視，古老的骨頭散落在門檻上。當光線照射到入口時，一群蝙蝠從內部尖叫著飛出。

english: The bats are harmless. Jungle predators use this tunnel as shelter, and the bones are a mix of grung and velociraptors. Any character who searches for tracks discovers boot prints leading into the tomb. The tracks are not recent and belong to the last group of treasure seekers to enter here.
zh_tw: 這些蝙蝠是無害的。叢林捕食者使用這條隧道作為庇護所，骨頭是樹精和迅猛龍的混合。任何搜尋痕跡的角色都會發現通往墓穴的靴子印跡。這些痕跡不是最近的，屬於最後一群進入這裡的尋寶者。

english: 4A. First Puzzle Door
zh_tw: 4A. 第一謎題門

english: A slab of worked stone blocks the overgrown tunnel some twenty feet from the entrance. Grinning skulls mark the edges of the slab, in the center of which are nine cube-shaped cavities arranged in three rows of three.
zh_tw: 一塊經過加工的石板阻擋了從入口大約二十尺處開始的雜草叢生的隧道。咧嘴笑的骷髏標記著石板的邊緣，在石板中心有九個立方體形狀的凹槽，排列成三行三列。

english: Give the players copies of the god symbols in handout 11 of {@area appendix E|537|x}. The individual squares can be cut out to be arranged by the players as they wish, or they can simply make notes on paper.
zh_tw: 給玩家分發位於{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中的手稿11上的神祇符號的副本。單個方格可以被剪下來，由玩家任意排列，或者他們可以簡單地在紙上做筆記。

english: To open the door, the characters must fill the cavities with all nine puzzle cubes retrieved from the shrines of Omu (see {@area chapter 3|1eb|x}), but in the proper configuration. The cubes representing the trickster gods must be placed so that each god is opposite its rival's cube on the grid, with Unkh (who is neutral and has no rivals) in the middle. For example, a puzzle cube inserted into a corner of the grid must have its rival in the diagonally opposite corner. Diagram 5.1 shows one possible configuration, though others will work as long as Unkh is situated between I'jin (CN) and Obo'laka (LN), between Kubazan (CG) and Papazotl (LE), between Moa (LG) and Wongo (CE), and between Nangnang (NE) and Shagambi (NG).
zh_tw: 要開啟門，角色們必須用從奧穆神廟中取得的九個謎題立方體填充凹槽（見{@area 第三章|1eb|x}），但必須按照正確的配置。代表詭神的立方體必須放置得使每個神都與對手的立方體在網格上相對，而安珂（中立，沒有對手）位於中間。例如，插入網格角落的謎題立方體必須讓其對手位於對角線相對的角落。圖5.1展示了一種可能的配置，儘管其他配置只要安珂位於艾金（混亂中立）和奧博娜卡（守序中立）之間，位於庫巴贊（守序善良）和帕帕扎圖（邪惡中立）之間，位於莫阿（守序善良）和望戈（混亂邪惡）之間，以及位於娜浪（中立邪惡）和莎根比（中立善良）之間，也可以工作。

english: If a puzzle cube is placed incorrectly, any previously placed cubes pop out. Electricity then erupts from the incorrectly placed cube, dealing 18 ({@dice 4d8}) lightning damage to any creature within 20 feet of the door. A {@spell mage hand} spell can be used to place the cubes from farther away and avoid this damage.
zh_tw: 如果拼圖魔方放置錯誤，之前放置的所有魔方都會彈出。然後電流會從放置錯誤的魔方中爆發出來，對門周圍20尺內的所有生物造成18點（{@dice 4d8}）閃電傷害。可以使用{@spell mage hand||法師之手}法術從更遠的地方放置魔方，以避免這種傷害。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of evocation magic around each of the cavities. If the characters place the cubes correctly, read:
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了每個空腔周圍的咒語魔法氣息。如果角色正確放置了立方體，請閱讀：

english: The nine cubes flare with light, then disappear. Growling like an angry beast, the slab begins to slide up into the ceiling.
zh_tw: 九個立方體發出光芒，然後消失了。石板像憤怒的野獸一樣咆哮著開始滑向天花板。

english: When the door opens, the puzzle cubes teleport back to their respective shrines in Omu. Once the door has fully risen, it remains open for 1 hour before slowly sinking back into place. Characters who are outside when the door closes must revisit the city to recover the cubes.
zh_tw: 當門開啟時，謎題立方體會傳送回奧穆各自對應的神廟。一旦門完全升起，它會保持開啟狀態1小時，然後慢慢下沉回到原位。當門關閉時在門外的角色必須重新訪問城市以回收立方體。

english: Diagram 5.1: Sample Puzzle Cube Configuration
zh_tw: 圖5.1：謎題立方體配置示例

english: 4B. Second Puzzle Door
zh_tw: 4B. 第二道謎題門

english: When the characters move past the first door, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們走過第一扇門時，請閱讀：

english: Another slab blocks the hallway twenty feet beyond the first door. An iron lever is set into the door's surface, with a graven stone skull leering down from above.
zh_tw: 另一塊石板在第一扇門後二十尺處阻擋了走廊。一個鐵製槓桿嵌入門板表面，上方有一個雕刻的石骷髏冷笑著俯視。

english: When a character reaches the midpoint of the hall, read:
zh_tw: 當一個角色到達走廊的中點時，閱讀：

english: The skull's jaws creak open, and a skeletal hand holding a crystal hourglass-style timer emerges from within. With a click, the timer rotates and sand starts to trickle into its lower globe.
zh_tw: 骷髏的下巴吱嘎作響地開啟，一隻持著水晶沙漏式計時器的骷髏手從裡面伸出。隨著一聲點選，計時器開始旋轉，沙子開始流入它的下半部球體。

english: Count down slowly from 10, and let the players tell you what, if anything, their characters do in that time. If the characters don't pull the lever by the time you've finished your countdown, the lever and the sand timer retract as the door sinks into the floor, revealing {@area area 5|33d|x} beyond. The sand timer can't be budged or damaged.
zh_tw: 從10開始慢慢倒數，並讓玩家告訴你，在這段時間裡，他們的角色會做什麼，如果有的話。如果角色們在你倒數結束之前沒有拉下槓桿，槓桿和沙漏會隨著門沉入地板而收回，揭示了{@area 區域5|33d|x}在另一邊。沙漏無法被移動或損壞。

english: After remaining open for 1 hour, the door slowly rises to seal off the passage once more. Characters can prevent the door from rising by jamming iron spikes into the surrounding floor seams. The lever resets when the door returns to its closed position. The door can't be opened from the north side.
zh_tw: 門保持開啟1小時後，會緩慢升起，再次封閉通道。角色們可以透過將鐵釘卡入周圍的地面縫隙來阻止門升起。門在回到關閉位置時重置。門無法從北側開啟。

english: Pit Trap
zh_tw: 陷坑陷阱

english: Pulling the lever causes the floor between the two doors to split open along a central seam. Each creature standing on the floor when the lever is pulled tumbles into a 20-foot-deep pit lined with poisoned spikes. With a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, the character who pulled the lever can avoid falling by hanging onto it. The pit remains open until the lever is reset to its original position.
zh_tw: 拉動槓桿會使兩扇門之間的地板沿著中央接縫裂開。當槓桿被拉動時，站在地板上的每個生物都會跌入一個20尺深的坑中，坑內佈滿了毒刺。如果拉動槓桿的角色成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的敏捷豁免檢定，他們可以透過抓住槓桿來避免掉入坑中。這個坑會一直保持開放狀態，直到槓桿被複位到原來的位置。

english: Each creature falling into the pit takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and is impaled on {@dice 1d4} spikes, each of which deals 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage and 5 ({@damage 1d10}) poison damage. Any creature that takes poison damage from one or more spikes is {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours, or until the condition is removed with a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 每個掉入坑中的生物會受到11（{@damage 2d10}）點鈍擊傷害，並被{@dice 1d4}根尖刺刺穿，每根尖刺造成3（{@damage 1d6}）點穿刺傷害和5（{@damage 1d10}）點毒素傷害。任何因一根或多根尖刺受到毒素傷害的生物將陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態24小時，或直到透過{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}法術或類似魔法解除該狀態。

english: Spotting the seam along the floor requires a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Characters can hammer spikes into the floor to prevent it from dropping, but at least ten spikes are needed because of the floor's size and weight.
zh_tw: 發現地板上的裂縫需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定。角色可以將尖釘錘入地板以防止其下陷，但由於地板的尺寸和重量，至少需要十根尖釘。

english: 5. Trapped Corridor
zh_tw: 5. 陷阱走廊

english: A moss-covered corridor extends beyond the second door. Tree roots hang from the sagging ceiling, and the air reeks of rot and damp. Ahead, a bas-relief carving of a bearded devil's face adorns the wall at a T-shaped intersection. The devil's open mouth is a well of utter darkness.
zh_tw: 一條覆蓋著苔蘚的走廊從第二扇門延伸出去。樹根從下垂的天花板上垂下，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛和潮溼的氣味。前方，在T字形的交叉口牆上，裝飾著一個須魔面孔的浮雕。魔鬼張開的嘴巴是一個完全黑暗的井。

english: 5A. Poison Darts
zh_tw: 5A. 毒鏢

english: Each X on the map marks a 5-foot-square pressure plate triggered by 20 pounds or more. When a plate is triggered, four poisoned darts shoot out from spring-loaded tubes in the walls. Each dart makes a ranged attack ({@hit 8} to hit) against a random target within 10 feet of the pressure plate. Any creature hit by a dart takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) piercing damage and must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 地圖上的每個X標記代表一個5尺見方的壓力板，觸發重量為20磅或以上。當壓力板被觸發時，四支毒鏢會從牆上的彈簧發射管中射出。每支毒鏢會對壓力板10尺範圍內的隨機目標進行一次遠端攻擊（命中加值{@hit 8}）。被毒鏢擊中的生物將受到2（{@damage 1d4}）點穿刺傷害，並且必須進行一次{@dc 15}體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到14（{@damage 4d6}）點毒素傷害，成功則傷害減半。

english: Moss obscures the tiny holes in the walls through which the darts are fired, but they can be spotted with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. With a careful inspection of the floor and a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, a character notes irregularities in the floor's tile patterns that reveal the pressure plates. Wedging an iron spike or similar object under a plate prevents that plate from being triggered. Stuffing the wall holes adjacent to a pressure plate with cloth or wax prevents the darts from being fired.
zh_tw: 苔蘚掩蓋了牆上發射飛鏢的小孔，但可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定發現它們。透過仔細檢查地面併成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定，角色可以注意到地磚圖案中的不規則之處，從而揭示壓力板的存在。在壓力板下方插入鐵釘或類似物品可以防止觸發該壓力板。用布或蠟堵住與壓力板相鄰的牆孔可以阻止飛鏢發射。

english: 5B. Devil Face
zh_tw: 5B. 魔鬼面孔

english: Magical darkness and a permanent {@spell silence} spell fills the mouth of the devil face and a large cavity behind it. The face is sculpted from stone and melds seamlessly with the surrounding wall, and its mouth is wide enough for a Medium or smaller creature to crawl through. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of illusion magic over the face.
zh_tw: 魔法黑暗和一個永久的{@spell silence||沉默術}法術充滿了魔鬼面孔的嘴巴以及其後的一個大型腔室。這張面孔是用石頭雕刻而成，與周圍牆壁無縫融合，它的嘴巴足夠寬敞，可以讓一箇中等大小或更小的生物爬過去。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示覆蓋在面孔上的幻術魔法氣息。

english: The cavity behind the devil's mouth is home to a {@creature shadow demon} that can see normally in the magical darkness. If any creature reaches into the mouth, the demon makes an attack against it with advantage, then continues attacking if any creature enters its abode.
zh_tw: 惡魔嘴巴後面的空腔是一隻{@creature shadow demon||幽影惡魔}的棲息地，它能夠在魔法黑暗中正常視物。如果有生物伸手進入嘴巴，惡魔會對其發起攻擊並獲得優勢，然後如果有任何生物進入它的領地，它會繼續攻擊。

english: A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 16}) cast on the demon's lair dispels the magical darkness and the silence. If the darkness is dispelled, the shadow demon emerges and attacks until reduced to half its hit points or fewer, at which point it flees to a darker area of the tomb.
zh_tw: 成功施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} ({@dc 16}) 於惡魔巢穴可驅散魔法黑暗與靜默。若黑暗被驅散，影魔將現身並攻擊，直至其生命值減半或更低，此時它將逃向陵墓中的黑暗區域。

english: 5C. Floor Hatch
zh_tw: 5C. 地板艙口

english: A rusted iron grate is set into the corridor floor. Through its bars, you see muddy water flowing slowly past.
zh_tw: 一個生鏽的鐵柵欄嵌入在走廊的地板上。透過柵欄的鐵條，你看到泥水緩慢流過。

english: The bars cannot be bent or broken, but they are spaced widely enough that a Small creature can squeeze through them. The grate can also be lifted by one or more creatures with a combined Strength score of 24 or more. Any creature that passes through the hatch drops into the sluggish underground river, which flows toward {@area area 17|377|x}.
zh_tw: 這些鐵柵欄不能彎曲或破壞，但它們之間的間隔足夠寬，以至於一個小型生物可以擠過去。這個柵門也可以被一個或多個總力量值達到24或更高的生物抬起。任何透過艙口的生物都會掉入緩慢流動的地下河中，河流流向{@area 區域17|377|x}。

english: 6. Crystal Window
zh_tw: 6. 水晶窗戶

english: Creepers and vines cling to the walls of this corridor, at the end of which is an arched crystal window, six feet wide and ten feet high. Through it, you can see a dark chamber.
zh_tw: 攀爬植物和藤蔓附著在這條走廊的牆壁上，走廊盡頭是一個拱形的水晶窗戶，六尺寬，十尺高。透過它，你可以看到一間黑暗的房間。

english: The crystal window peers into Obo'laka's tomb ({@area area 10|356|x}), cannot be opened, and blocks all sound between {@area area 6|343|x} and {@area area 10|356|x}. The window has AC 5, a damage threshold of 15, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 水晶窗戶可以窺視奧博娜卡的墓穴（{@area 區域10|356|x}），無法開啟，並且阻擋了{@area 區域6|343|x}和{@area 區域10|356|x}之間所有的聲音。窗戶有AC 5，傷害閾值為15，有10點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: When any character approaches the crystal window and peers through it, read the boxed text in {@area area 10|356|x}, omitting the last sentence about the window.
zh_tw: 當任何角色接近水晶窗戶並透過它窺視時，閱讀{@area 區域10|356|x}中的框內文字，省略關於窗戶的最後一句。

english: If the characters enter {@area area 10|356|x} through the broken window without taking appropriate steps to conceal themselves, the undead creatures in Obo'laka's tomb attack (see {@area area 10|356|x} for more information).
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過破碎的窗戶進入{@area 區域10|356|x}而沒有采取適當的措施來隱藏自己，奧博娜卡墓穴中的不死生物生物將會攻擊（更多資訊請見{@area 區域10|356|x}）。

english: 7. Grand Staircase
zh_tw: 7. 大樓梯

english: A grand chamber opens ahead, fifty feet across and plunging down into darkness below. A stone balcony winds around the walls to connect four archways. Other balcony levels are visible below, with corridors radiating off in all directions. To the north, a stone staircase descends to the lower levels.
zh_tw: 一個宏偉的大廳在前方展開，寬達五十尺，向下延伸至黑暗之中。一條石制陽臺沿著牆壁蜿蜒，連線著四座拱門。下方可見其他陽臺層，走廊向四面八方延伸。在北面，一段石階通往更低的層數。

english: The grand staircase connects the first four levels of the tomb, each of which is 25 feet below the level above. The balcony is 5 feet wide.
zh_tw: 宏偉的樓梯連線著墓穴的前四層，每層比上一層低25尺。陽臺寬5尺。

english: 7A. We Are Not Alone
zh_tw: 7A. 我們並不孤單

english: The first character to reach this point on the map glimpses a tomb dwarf on the level below:
zh_tw: 地圖上第一個到達這個點的角色瞥見下方樓層上有一個墓穴矮人：

english: A hunched figure glares up at you from the balcony below, wearing a mask that is a replica of the devil face at the tomb entrance. Without saying a word, the figure steps out of sight.
zh_tw: 一個彎腰的身影從下面的陽臺上怒視著你，戴著一個與墓穴入口處的魔鬼面孔相同的面具。那個身影沒有說一句話，就走出了視線。

english: If the characters take action at once, they can catch the tomb dwarf. The tomb dwarf uses the statistics of a {@creature wight}, except that it wields a battleaxe and a light crossbow. If it is not caught, the creature moves silently through the secret door to {@area area 25|39f|x}. To any character leaning over the balcony to see where the figure went, it appears to have vanished into thin air.
zh_tw: 如果角色們立即採取行動，他們可以抓住墓穴侏儒。墓穴侏儒使用{@creature wight||屍妖}的具體數值，除了它揮舞著戰斧和輕弩。如果沒有被抓住，這個生物會悄無聲息地透過秘密門移動到{@area 區域25|39f|x}。對於任何靠在陽臺上想看看這個身影去了哪裡的角色來說，它似乎已經消失得無影無蹤。

english: 7B. Acererak's Second Warning
zh_tw: 7B. 阿瑟瑞克的第二次警告

english: A bronze plaque is fixed to the east wall of the balcony on level 2, engraved with another of {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s cryptic warnings in Common. (Give the players a copy of handout 18 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) It reads as follows:
zh_tw: 東牆第二層陽臺固定著一塊青銅牌，上面鐫刻著{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的另一道用通用語寫成的神秘警示。（給玩家們發一份位於{@area 附錄 E|537|x}手稿18的內容。）內容如下：

english: The ring is a path to another tomb.
zh_tw: 這個環是通往另一個墓穴的路徑。

english: The dead abhor sunlight.
zh_tw: 死者厭惡陽光。

english: Only a jewel can tame the frog.
zh_tw: 只有寶石能馴服青蛙。

english: Bow as the dead god intoned.
zh_tw: 如死去的神所低吟的那樣鞠躬。

english: Into darkness descend.
zh_tw: 深入黑暗之中。

english: The clues on this plaque pertain to locations on level 2, specifically the gravity ring ({@area area 19|37d|x}), the false tomb ({@area area 20|383|x}), Nangnang's tomb ({@area area 24|398|x}), Papazotl's tomb ({@area area 22|38a|x}), and the devil pit ({@area area 18|37b|x}).
zh_tw: 這塊牌匾上的線索與第二層的地點有關，具體是重力環（{@area 區域19|37d|x}），假墓（{@area 區域20|383|x}），娜浪的墓穴（{@area 區域24|398|x}），帕帕扎圖的墓穴（{@area 區域22|38a|x}），以及魔鬼坑（{@area 區域18|37b|x}）。

english: 7C. Acererak's Third Warning
zh_tw: 7C. 阿瑟瑞克的第三次警告

english: Another bronze plaque appears on the north wall of the balcony on level 3. (Give the players a copy of handout 19 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) This warning reads as follows:
zh_tw: 第三層陽臺的北牆上出現了另一塊青銅牌匾。（給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中手冊19的副本。）這個警告內容如下：

english: Walk through water with weapon in hand.
zh_tw: 手持武器穿越水域。

english: Slake your shadow at the font.
zh_tw: 在聖洗盆處解渴你的影子。

english: The vulture is the first step.
zh_tw: 禿鷲是第一步。

english: Right the gods.
zh_tw: 糾正眾神。

english: The walls of history tell all.
zh_tw: 歷史的牆壁訴說一切。

english: The clues on this bronze plaque pertain to features and locations on level 3, specifically the reflected hall ({@area area 31|3ba|x}), the magic font ({@area area 33|3c9|x}), I'jin's tomb ({@area area 35|3d0|x}), the golem pit ({@area area 39|3f0|x}), and Kubazan's tomb ({@area area 42|3fc|x}).
zh_tw: 這塊青銅牌匾上的線索涉及第三層的特點和地點，具體包括反射大廳（{@area 區域31|3ba|x}），魔法聖洗盆（{@area 區域33|3c9|x}），艾金的墓穴（{@area 區域35|3d0|x}），魔像坑（{@area 區域39|3f0|x}），以及庫巴贊的墓穴（{@area 區域42|3fc|x}）。

english: 7D. Acererak's Fourth Warning
zh_tw: 7D. 阿瑟瑞克的第四次警告

english: The last warning is on a bronze plaque mounted to the west wall of the balcony on level 4. (Give the players a copy of handout 20 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.) It reads as follows:
zh_tw: 最後一條警告刻在第四層陽臺西牆上的青銅牌匾上。（給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中手冊20的副本。）內容如下：

english: Death to fire, dine or drown, precious air, and falling sand.
zh_tw: 死亡於火，或餐或溺，珍貴空氣，落沙。

english: The army sleeps in silence.
zh_tw: 軍隊在寂靜中沉睡。

english: The mirror holds twelve.
zh_tw: 鏡子裡有十二個。

english: Find the iron scepter's twin.
zh_tw: 找到鐵權杖的配對。

english: The maze holds the key.
zh_tw: 迷宮藏有鑰匙。

english: The clues on this bronze plaque pertain to features and locations on level 4, specifically the elemental traps ({@area area 47|425|x}), Shagambi's tomb ({@area area 48|438|x}), the {@item mirror of life trapping} ({@area area 50|44c|x}), the scepter in the crypt of the Sun Queen ({@area area 53|459|x}), and Unkh's tomb ({@area area 55|465|x}).
zh_tw: 這塊青銅牌匾上的線索與第四層的特徵和地點有關，特別是元素陷阱（{@area 區域47|425|x}）、莎根比的墓（{@area 區域48|438|x}）、生命陷阱之鏡（{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}）（{@area 區域50|44c|x}）、太陽女王墓穴中的權杖（{@area 區域53|459|x}）以及安珂的墓（{@area 區域55|465|x}）。

english: 8. Magical Attraction
zh_tw: 8. 魔法吸引

english: A rusting statue of a knight stands at the west end of this hall, gripping a large iron shield. Shards and flakes of rusted metal cover the floor around the statue's feet.
zh_tw: 一個生鏽的騎士雕像站在這個大廳的西端，緊握著一個大鐵盾。雕像腳周圍的地板上覆蓋著鏽蝕金屬的碎片和鱗片。

english: A magical field around the statue attracts metal objects of any kind (not just ferrous metal). Any metal object that comes into direct contact with the shield disintegrates, showering the floor with powdered rust. Artifacts are immune to this corrosion. Any metal object not being worn or carried that enters the room is instantly drawn to the shield if it weighs 150 pounds or less. Any creature wearing or carrying metal items that enters the room or starts its turn there can feel the pull of the statue and must succeed on a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to resist it. On a failed check, the creature loses its footing, flies across the chamber, and slams into the statue, taking {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it moved. If the character is wearing metal armor, the check is made with disadvantage. The shield disintegrates only metal objects that come into direct contact with it, so a metal object stored in a backpack would be protected from destruction by the pack's leather.
zh_tw: 雕像周圍的魔法力場會吸引任何型別的金屬物體（不僅僅是鐵質金屬）。任何直接接觸盾牌的金屬物體會立刻崩解，化成一片鏽粉散落在地。神器不受這種腐蝕的影響。任何未穿戴或攜帶的金屬物體進入房間時，如果重量在150磅或以下，會立即被吸向盾牌。任何穿戴或攜帶金屬物品的生物進入房間或在該處開始回合時，能感受到雕像的拉力，並且必須透過一次 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來抵抗。如果檢定失敗，生物會失去平衡，飛越房間並撞上雕像，每移動10尺受到 {@dice 1d6} 鈍擊傷害。如果角色穿戴金屬護甲，檢定將帶有劣勢。盾牌只會崩解與之直接接觸的金屬物體，因此存放在揹包中的金屬物體會被揹包的皮革保護而免於被摧毀。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic over the shield. The statue and shield are treated as a single Large object with AC 17; 40 hit points; immunity to piercing, bludgeoning, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If the statue and shield are destroyed, the trap is disabled. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 17}) cast on the statue shuts down the attractive field for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示出護盾上方環繞著變化魔法的光環。雕像和護盾被視為一個單一的大型物體，具有AC 17；40點生命值；對非魔法攻擊的穿刺、鈍擊和揮砍傷害免疫；並對毒性和精神傷害免疫。如果雕像和護盾被破壞，陷阱會被禁用。成功在雕像上施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 17}）會使吸引場關閉1小時。

english: 9. Magic Fountain
zh_tw: 9. 魔法噴泉

english: A large fountain crusted with moss rises in the middle of a circular room. Three marble maidens stand in the fountain, holding pitchers out of which water flows.
zh_tw: 一個覆蓋著苔蘚的大噴泉位於一個圓形房間的中央。三個大理石少女站在噴泉中，手持水壺，水從其中流出。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Obo'laka or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被奧博娜卡或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Cautious Obo'laka advises against anyone drinking from the fountain.
zh_tw: 謹慎的奧博娜卡建議任何人不要從噴泉中飲水。

english: Reckless Wongo encourages his host to drink from the fountain.
zh_tw: 魯莽的望戈鼓勵他的宿主從噴泉中飲水。

english: Magic Fountain
zh_tw: 魔法噴泉

english: Any creature that drinks from the fountain experiences a random magical effect, determined by rolling a {@dice d4} and consulting the Magic Fountain Effects table. Water removed from the fountain and stored in a container retains its magical properties, and a different effect occurs each time someone drinks from the container. Under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect, the fountain radiates an aura of transmutation magic.
zh_tw: 任何生物飲用噴泉中的水都會經歷一個隨機的魔法效果，這由擲一個{@dice d4}並查閱魔法噴泉效果表來決定。從噴泉中取出並儲存在容器中的水保留其魔法屬性，每次有人從容器中飲用時都會發生不同的效果。在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果的仔細檢查下，噴泉散發出變化魔法的氣息。

english: Magic Fountain Effects
zh_tw: 魔法噴泉效果

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: The creature drinking the water must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, it dies and turns to dust.
zh_tw: 飲用該水的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免，若豁免失敗則受到 44 ({@dice 8d10}) 點暗蝕傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。如果此傷害將該生物的生命值降至 0，該生物死亡並化為塵埃。

english: The creature drinking the water loses the ability to speak for 8 hours. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic ends this effect.
zh_tw: 飲用這水的生物將失去說話能力，持續8小時。一個{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}法術或類似的魔法可以結束這個效果。
