english: The creature drinking the water magically changes sex. A {@spell greater restoration} spell restores the creature's original sex, as does another drink from the fountain that yields this same result.
zh_tw: 飲用這水的生物會透過魔法改變性別。一個{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}法術可以恢復生物原來的性別，同樣，再次飲用這個噴泉的水也會產生相同的效果。

english: The creature drinking the water gains {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points.
zh_tw: 飲用這種水的生物獲得{@dice 2d10}點臨時生命值。

english: 10. Obo'laka's Tomb
zh_tw: 10. 奧博娜卡的墓

english: This vaulted tomb is overgrown with moss and creepers. A stone sarcophagus rests on a stepped dais in the middle of the floor. On the wall behind the sarcophagus, two large statues of bears grip a five-foot-diameter bronze disk embossed with a dozen glaring eyes. Six desiccated corpses slump on thrones in niches along the walls. Each corpse wears a black mask made of papier-mâché and feathers. An arched crystal window to the east offers a view of the tunnel beyond.
zh_tw: 這個拱形的墓室長滿了苔蘚和藤蔓。一個石棺安放在房間中央的臺階上。在石棺後面的牆上，兩座巨大的熊雕像抓住了一個直徑五尺的銅盤，上面浮雕著一打瞪眼。六個乾癟的屍體坐在沿牆的壁龕中的寶座上。每個屍體都戴著一個由紙漿和羽毛製成的黑色面具。東邊的一個拱形水晶窗戶可以看到隧道的另一邊。

english: See {@area area 6|343|x} for a description of the crystal window.
zh_tw: 見{@area 區域6|343|x}以獲取水晶窗戶的描述。

english: The corpses slumped on the thrones are six dormant {@creature Wight||wights}. If the eyes on the bronze disk spot intruders in the tomb (see "Disk of Eyes"), the wights rise and attack. The wights also attack if one or more of them takes any damage. They won't leave the chamber to pursue intruders. Once all intruders are dead or gone, the wights return to their thrones and fall dormant once more.
zh_tw: 癱坐在寶座上的屍體是六個休眠的{@creature Wight||屍妖}。如果青銅盤上的眼睛發現了墓穴中的入侵者（見"眼睛盤"），屍妖們會甦醒並攻擊。如果其中一個或多個屍妖受到任何傷害，它們也會攻擊。它們不會離開房間去追擊入侵者。一旦所有入侵者死亡或離開，屍妖們就會返回他們的寶座並再次進入休眠狀態。

english: Disk of Eyes
zh_tw: 眼睛盤

english: Any character who studies the disk notices that its eyes are moving, their bronzed pupils flicking back and forth to scan the tomb for intruders. These eyes have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 30 feet. If the eyes spot any humanoids inside the tomb, the wights awaken and attack. The disk of eyes can't perceive any humanoid that dons one of the papier-mâché masks worn by the wights, nor can it see in magical darkness or while covered with a blanket or similar object.
zh_tw: 任何研究這個盤子的角色都會注意到它的眼睛在移動，它們青銅色的瞳孔來回快速掃視墓穴以尋找入侵者。這些眼睛具有30尺範圍內的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。如果眼睛發現墓穴中有任何類人生物，屍妖就會甦醒並攻擊。眼睛盤無法感知任何戴上屍妖所佩戴的紙漿面具的類人生物，也不能在魔法黑暗中或被毯子或類似物體覆蓋時看到任何東西。

english: The bronze disk weighs 250 pounds. The bear statues grip the disk tightly in their stone paws, so that it can't be pried free without smashing the statues. Each statue is a Large object with AC 17; 45 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of divination magic around the disk.
zh_tw: 青銅盤重250磅。熊雕像用它們的石爪緊緊抓住盤子，所以如果不打碎雕像就無法撬動它。每個雕像是一個大型物體，具有17的AC；45點生命值；對非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫；以及對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示圍繞盤子的占卜魔法氣息。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: Any creature wearing one of the wights' papier-mâché masks can push aside the lid of the sarcophagus with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. To all other creatures, the lid is magically locked and cannot be opened without a {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
zh_tw: 任何戴著其中一個屍鬼的紙漿面具的生物，可以透過一次成功的{@dc 13}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定推開石棺的蓋子。對於其他所有生物而言，棺蓋被魔法鎖住，除非使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術，或由一名角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定，否則無法開啟。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Secret doors are set into the back walls of two alcoves—one to the north and the other to the south. The secret door to the south has edges made of flint. Opening this door creates sparks that ignite the gas in {@area area 11|35e|x} (see that area for details).
zh_tw: 兩個壁龕的後牆上都設有秘密門——一個在北邊，另一個在南邊。南邊的秘密門邊緣由燧石製成。開啟這扇門會產生火花，點燃{@area 區域11|35e|x}中的氣體（詳見該區域的描述）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The bones of a zorbo (Obo'laka's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) lie in a dusty pile within the sarcophagus. A {@item ring of protection} rests atop the pile. The ring turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 石棺內塵土飛揚的一堆中躺著一隻佐博（奧博娜卡的動物形態；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。一個{@item ring of protection||防護戒指}放在堆頂。如果這個戒指離開九神之墓（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"），它就會化為灰塵並被摧毀。

english: Obo'laka's Spirit
zh_tw: 奧博娜卡的靈魂

english: The spirit of Obo'laka tries to inhabit any character who touches the ring (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Obo'laka's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 奧博娜卡的靈魂試圖佔據任何觸碰戒指的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當奧博娜卡的靈魂顯現時，閱讀：

english: As you touch the ring, the dust swirls into the shape of a small, feral, bear-like creature that billows toward you with a ghostly roar.
zh_tw: 當你觸控戒指時，塵埃旋轉形成一個小巧、野性的熊狀生物，伴隨著幽靈般的咆哮向你撲來。

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Obo'laka|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Obo'laka's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the ring and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功佔據了角色，請給玩家{@card Obo'laka|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|奧博娜卡的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂將返回戒指並等待另一個角色觸碰它。

english: 11. Gas Pocket
zh_tw: 11. 氣體囊

english: This section of the underground river contains a buildup of flammable gas that has a rotten odor. If a torch, lantern, or other open flame is brought into the area, or if the secret door to {@area area 10|356|x} is opened, the gas explodes. Each creature in the area of the gas pocket or within 15 feet of it must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half damage on a successful one. The explosion burns away the gas, which builds up again after 8 hours.
zh_tw: 這條地下河流的這一段積聚了帶有腐爛氣味的易燃氣體。如果將火炬、燈籠或其他明火帶入該區域，或者通往 {@area 區域10|356|x} 的密門被開啟，氣體會爆炸。氣體囊袋區域或15尺範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免，失敗則受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）點火焰傷害，成功則只承受一半傷害。爆炸會燒盡氣體，8小時後氣體會再次積聚。

english: 12. Trapped Chest
zh_tw: 12. 陷阱寶箱

english: Water pours from cracks and seams in the rough walls of this cavern, whose floor is a muddy pool that flushes out into the tunnel beyond. Just above the pool's surface, a large treasure chest dangles from rusty chains embedded in the ceiling.
zh_tw: 水從這個洞穴粗糙牆壁的裂縫和接縫中湧出，洞穴的地板是一個泥濘的水潭，水流透過外面的隧道排出。就在水潭表面上方，一個大型寶箱懸掛在嵌入天花板的生鏽鏈條上。

english: The chest is 6 feet long, 3 feet wide, 3 feet high, and suspended 1 foot above the surface of the 5-foot-deep pool. A keyhole shaped like a cackling demon skull decorates the front of the lid. Encircling the keyhole, a tiny inscription in Common reads, "I devour all but the greatest thieves."
zh_tw: 箱子長6尺，寬3尺，高3尺，懸掛在5尺深水池上方1尺處。鎖孔裝飾成一個嘲笑的惡魔骷髏形狀。圍繞著鎖孔，用通用語寫的細小銘文是："我吞噬除了最偉大的盜賊之外的一切。"

english: The chest is locked and doesn't appear to be trapped. However, a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of evocation magic around it. Picking the lock requires a successful {@dc 22} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. This also disarms the lock's magical trap, allowing the chest to be opened safely.
zh_tw: 這個箱子被鎖上了，而且似乎沒有陷阱。然而，一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果會顯示它周圍環繞著塑能系魔法的靈光。撬開鎖需要進行一次成功的{@dc 22}敏捷檢定，需使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}。這樣做也會解除鎖上的魔法陷阱，使箱子能夠安全開啟。

english: If the check fails, the demon skull bites down on the {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and destroys them. If the check fails by 5 or more, the magical trap teleports the character making the check inside the locked chest, whereupon the character is {@condition restrained}. The chains holding the chest then release it into the water, where it sinks to the bottom of the pool. Even if the chest is removed from the water, a character trapped within runs out of air after 5 rounds (see "{@book Suffocating|PHB|8|Suffocating}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
zh_tw: 若檢定失敗，惡魔頭骨會咬住{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並將其摧毀。若檢定失敗且差值達到5或更高，魔法陷阱會將進行檢定的角色傳送到上鎖的寶箱內部，該角色將陷入{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態。固定寶箱的鎖鏈隨後會將其釋放入水，沉至池底。即使寶箱被移出水面，受困角色仍會在5輪後窒息（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 窒息|PHB|8|Suffocating}"）。

english: The chest is a Medium object with AC 13, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Any character who attempts to pick the lock or hit the chest with a melee or ranged attack while it's underwater does so with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 這個箱子是一箇中等大小的物體，具有13的AC，30點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。任何角色在水下嘗試撬鎖或用近戰或遠端攻擊擊中箱子時，都會處於不利狀態。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest interior is lined with lead and contains 300 gp, a gold tankard embossed with a sad face that smiles when the tankard is filled (250 gp), and a stoppered bone tube containing a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell remove curse}.
zh_tw: 箱子內部襯有鉛皮，內含300金幣，一個悲傷面孔的金質酒杯，當酒杯被倒滿時，它的臉會露出微笑（價值250金幣），以及一個塞著的骨筒，內含一張{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}，上面寫著{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術。

english: 13. Stone Skull
zh_tw: 13. 石骷髏

english: A giant stone skull crusted with moss juts out from the end of the passageway. A flame flickers within each of its eye sockets, and a view into a chamber beyond can be seen through its open jaws.
zh_tw: 一個巨大的石制骷髏頭覆蓋著苔蘚，從通道的盡頭突出。它的每個眼窩裡都有火焰閃爍，透過它張開的下巴可以看見一個裡面的房間。

english: Any character who peers through the skull can see into {@area area 14|364|x} (see the description below). The skull's jaws are opened wide enough to allow a Medium or smaller creature to climb though.
zh_tw: 任何透過骷髏頭窺視的角色都能看到{@area 區域14|364|x}（見下面的描述）。骷髏的下巴開得足夠寬，允許一箇中等大小或更小的生物爬過去。

english: Each time a creature climbs through the skull's jaws, one of the flames in its eye sockets snuffs out. The third time a creature climbs through, the jaws clamp shut, making a melee weapon attack with a +10 bonus. On a hit, the target creature takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}). While it remains {@condition grappled}, the creature takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. When that creature exits the jaws, the flames in the skull's eye sockets reignite, the jaws open, and the trap resets.
zh_tw: 每當一個生物爬過骷髏的下頜，其眼眶中的一團火焰便會熄滅。當生物第三次爬過時，下頜會猛然閉合，進行一次近戰武器攻擊，並獲得+10加值。命中時，目標生物受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）鈍擊傷害，並{@condition grappled||被擒}（逃脫{@dc 19}）。在{@condition grappled||被擒}期間，該生物在其每回合開始時受到5點（{@dice 1d10}）鈍擊傷害。當該生物離開下頜時，骷髏眼眶中的火焰重新點燃，下頜開啟，陷阱重置。

english: The flames within the eye sockets give off no heat or smoke, and they can't be extinguished except in the manner described above. Any character searching the skull and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notes that the lower jaw is hinged. A stout object jammed into the skull's jaw holds it open for as long as the object can withstand the damage. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the skull.
zh_tw: 眼窩中的火焰不產生熱量或煙霧，除了上述方法外無法被熄滅。任何角色在搜尋頭顱併成功透過一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時，會注意到下頜是鉸接的。一個堅固的物體卡在頭顱的下頜中，只要該物體能承受住傷害，就能保持開口狀態。{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果會揭示頭顱周圍存在變化魔法的靈光。

english: 14. Moa's Tomb
zh_tw: 14. 莫阿的墓

english: Skulls crusted with dried mud glower from niches cut into the walls of this tomb. A stone sarcophagus stands at the center of the chamber, its lid adorned with a coiled serpent carved in relief. Behind the sarcophagus, resting atop a marble pedestal, is an ornate crystal box with a small humanoid skull floating inside it.
zh_tw: 覆蓋著幹泥的骷髏從這個墓穴牆壁上鑿出的壁龕中怒視著。一個石制的石棺位於房間的中心，蓋子上雕刻著一條浮雕的盤曲蛇。在石棺後面，位於大理石基座上的是一個華麗的水晶盒，裡面有一個小小的人形骷髏在漂浮。

english: If the characters enter this tomb from the secret passage along the river, they see the concave inner surface of the stone skull at {@area area 13|362|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過沿著河流的秘密通道進入這個墓穴，他們會看到{@area 區域13|362|x}處石骷髏的凹面內側。

english: A maze of tiny passages is cut into the walls beyond the niches, and any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check can hear the faint yet grotesque scuttling of insects from within. Hundreds of tarantula-sized undead spiders crawl through these warrens.
zh_tw: 壁龕後面的牆壁上被切割出了許多細小的通道，任何成功透過 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定角色都可以聽到其中傳來的微弱而怪異的昆蟲爬行聲。數百隻狼蛛大小的不死蜘蛛在這些通道中爬行。

english: Nepartak's Skull
zh_tw: 尼帕塔克的頭骨

english: The skull in the crystal box belongs to {@creature Nepartak|ToA}, the 10-year-old granddaughter of Napaka, the last queen of Omu. The magic of the crystal box preserves her consciousness, but centuries of solitude and horror have caused her mind to blank out the details of her plight. The first character to enter the tomb hears {@creature Nepartak|ToA} call out telepathically:
zh_tw: 水晶盒中的頭骨屬於{@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}，她是奧穆最後一位女王納帕卡的10歲孫女。水晶盒的魔法儲存了她的意識，但幾個世紀的孤獨和恐懼使她忘記了自己困境的細節。第一個進入墓穴的角色聽到{@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}透過心靈感應呼喚：

english: The voice of a young girl echoes in your mind: "What's happening? Why can't I see?"
zh_tw: 一個小女孩的聲音在你的腦海中迴響："發生了什麼？為什麼我看不見？"

english: {@creature Nepartak|ToA} magically senses the presence of intruders, using telepathy to question all the characters. Roleplay her as a terrified child lost in the dark. In her panic, she might ask any of the following questions:
zh_tw: {@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}透過魔法感知到入侵者的存在，使用心靈感應向所有角色提問。將她扮演成一個在黑暗中迷失的受驚孩子。在她的恐慌中，她可能會問以下任何問題：

english: "Where am I? How did I get here?"
zh_tw: "我在哪裡？我是怎麼來到這裡的？"

english: "Why can't I see anything?"
zh_tw: "為什麼我看不見任何東西？"

english: "Are you friends of my father? Is he looking for me?"
zh_tw: "你們是我父親的的朋友嗎？他在找我嗎？"

english: To safely explore this area, the characters must calm {@creature Nepartak|ToA} without revealing her true predicament. Lying to her requires a successful {@dc 12} Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If the characters reveal that she's nothing more than a disembodied skull, if they fail three Charisma checks to deceive her, of if they simply ignore her, {@creature Nepartak|ToA} grows increasingly anxious, then flies into a murderous rage.
zh_tw: 為了安全地探索這個區域，角色們必須安撫{@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}，同時不揭露她的真實困境。欺騙她需要透過一個成功的{@dc 12}魅力({@skill Deception||欺瞞})檢定。如果角色們揭露她不過是一個無身的頭顱，如果他們三次欺騙她的魅力檢定失敗，或者如果他們直接無視她，{@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}會變得越來越焦慮，然後陷入狂暴的殺戮情緒。

english: The voice shrieks in horror as the skull's eye sockets flare with green flame. With a shattering crash, the crystal box explodes and the skull levitates into the air.
zh_tw: 當骷髏的眼窩中閃爍起綠色火焰時，聲音驚恐地尖叫。隨著一聲碎裂的巨響，水晶盒爆炸了，骷髏懸浮在空中。

english: {@creature Nepartak|ToA} has the statistics of a {@creature flameskull} but doesn't speak, instead communicating using telepathy out to a range of 30 feet. When she attacks, swarms of mummified spiders pour out from the niches at the start of the following round.
zh_tw: {@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}擁有{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}的具體數值，但不會說話，而是使用心靈感應在30尺範圍內進行交流。當她攻擊時，在下一輪開始時，成群的木乃伊蜘蛛會從壁龕中湧出。

english: Undead Spider Warrens
zh_tw: 不死生物蜘蛛巢穴

english: Six swarms of undead spiders inhabit the warrens within the walls of the tomb. They are treated as {@creature Swarm of Insects||swarms of insects (spiders)}, except that they are susceptible to effects that can target undead.
zh_tw: 六群不死生物蜘蛛居住在墓穴牆壁內的巢穴中。它們被視為{@creature Swarm of Insects||昆蟲叢集（蜘蛛）}，只不過它們對可以針對不死生物的效果敏感。

english: The warrens are too narrow for Medium and larger creatures to enter, and Small creatures must squeeze to traverse them (see "{@book Movement and Position|PHB|9|Movement and Position}" in chapter 9 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). Tiny creatures can move through the warrens freely. The swarms attack any creatures that enter the warrens or any creatures in Moa's tomb if {@creature Nepartak|ToA} becomes enraged.
zh_tw: 這些通道過於狹窄，中型或更大的生物無法進入，小型生物必須擠過才能透過（詳見{@book 移動和位置|PHB|9|Movement and Position}，選自{@i 玩家手冊}第9章）。微小生物可以自由穿過通道。如果{@creature Nepartak|ToA|妮博特}被激怒，蟲群會攻擊任何進入通道的生物或莫阿墓穴中的生物。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The stone sarcophagus isn't locked and can be opened with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Inside, a bundle of faded cloth holds the serpentine bones of a jaculi (the trickster god Moa's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). A {@item staff of the python} rests atop these remains. The staff turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 石棺並未上鎖，可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定開啟。內部，一捆褪色的布料中包裹著一條幻色蛇生物雅庫利（詭神莫阿的動物形態；參見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的骨骼。一根 {@item staff of the python||巨蟒法杖} 放置在這些遺骸上。如果這根法杖離開九神之墓，它將化為塵土並被摧毀（但參見 "{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"）。

english: Moa's Spirit
zh_tw: 莫阿的靈魂

english: The spirit of Moa tries to inhabit any character who touches the staff (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Moa's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 莫阿的靈魂試圖佔據任何觸碰法杖的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當莫阿的靈魂顯現時，閱讀：

english: Green smoke billows from the staff, coiling around you like a serpent. A sibilant voice whispers in your ear: "Let me help you! I promise to be good."
zh_tw: 綠色煙霧從法杖中滾滾而出，像蛇一樣纏繞著你。一個嘶嘶的聲音在你的耳邊低語：'讓我幫助你！我保證會乖乖的。'

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Moa|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Moa's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the staff and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功佔據了角色，請給玩家{@card Moa|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|莫阿的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂將返回法杖並等待另一個角色觸碰它。

english: 15. Wind Tunnel
zh_tw: 15. 風道

english: Carved birds soar across the walls of this corridor. Blocking the passage near its northern end is a large adamantine propeller with five sharp blades.
zh_tw: 雕刻的鳥兒在這條走廊的牆壁上翱翔。在其北端附近阻擋通道的是一個帶有五個鋒利刀片的大型金剛石螺旋槳。

english: With a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, a character discerns that the entire floor of the corridor is a single pressure plate. The adamantine propeller has AC 20, 30 hit points, and immunity to all damage except force damage. It thunders into motion whenever more than 20 pounds of pressure is placed on the corridor floor. Once activated, the propeller spins up to full speed in 6 seconds. If the weight is removed from the floor, the blades take a full minute to slow to a stop.
zh_tw: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，一名角色可以察覺到整個走廊的地板是一個單一的壓力板。這個精金螺旋槳的防禦等級為 20，擁有 30 點生命值，並且對所有傷害型別（除了力場傷害）免疫。當走廊地板承受超過 20 磅的壓力時，它會轟然啟動。一旦啟用，螺旋槳將在 6 秒內加速至全速運轉。如果地板上的重量被移除，螺旋槳的葉片將需要整整一分鐘才能減速至停止。

english: While the propeller is spinning up or slowing down, a creature can leap through a gap between two blades with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. On a failed check, the character takes 33 ({@dice 6d10}) slashing damage as it passes through the blades.
zh_tw: 當螺旋槳在加速或減速旋轉時，生物可以透過成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定從兩片葉片之間的空隙中躍過。如果檢定失敗，該角色在穿過葉片時受到 33（{@dice 6d10}）點揮砍傷害。

english: At full speed, the propeller deals 66 ({@dice 12d10}) slashing damage to any creature that passes through it, and the blades are turning too fast for a creature to leap between them. The rapidly spinning propeller also creates a wind tunnel effect, such that any creature that comes within 10 feet of the propeller or starts its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. A creature that fails the save is hurled northward into the pit in {@area area 16|36f|x}. If this forced movement causes the creature to pass through the propeller, the creature takes damage from the spinning blades.
zh_tw: 全速運轉時，螺旋槳對任何經過的生物造成66點（{@dice 12d10}）揮砍傷害，且葉片旋轉過快，生物無法在它們之間跳躍。快速旋轉的螺旋槳還會產生風洞效應，任何進入螺旋槳10尺內或在此開始其回合的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 15}力量豁免。未透過豁免的生物將被向北扔入{@area 區域16|36f|x}的坑中。如果這種強制移動使生物穿過螺旋槳，生物將受到旋轉葉片的傷害。

english: One can jam the propeller by fixing an {@item immovable rod} in place between two of the blades. Other magic items wedged between the blades are knocked aside as the propeller turns. The propeller destroys all nonmagical objects lodged between its spinning blades.
zh_tw: 可以透過在兩個葉片之間固定一個{@item immovable rod||不動權杖}來卡住螺旋槳。當螺旋槳轉動時，其他魔法物品會被擠到一邊。螺旋槳會摧毀所有夾在其旋轉葉片之間的非魔法物品。

english: While the propeller is motionless, a creature that isn't {@condition incapacitated} can jam the mechanism with its body. When the propeller begins to turn, the creature must make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. If the check succeeds, the propeller is jammed until the start of the creature's next turn, when it can use its action to repeat the check. A creature that fails the check or chooses to extricate itself takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) slashing damage and is ejected north of the propeller.
zh_tw: 當螺旋槳靜止時，一個未處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態的生物可以用身體卡住機制。當螺旋槳開始轉動時，該生物必須進行一次{@dc 20}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。如果檢定成功，螺旋槳將被卡住，直到該生物的下一個回合開始，屆時它可以利用其動作重複進行檢定。檢定失敗或選擇脫身的生物將受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點劈砍傷害，並被彈向螺旋槳的北側。

english: If the propeller is jammed for 3 consecutive rounds, it breaks down and becomes nonfunctional. At dawn the next day, {@creature Withers|ToA} sends tomb dwarves to repair the damage and return the trap to its operational state.
zh_tw: 如果螺旋槳連續3輪被卡住，它就會損壞並失去功能。第二天黎明時，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯} 會派遣墓穴矮人來修復損壞，並將陷阱恢復到工作狀態。

english: 16. Wongo's Tomb
zh_tw: 16. 望戈的墓

english: A deep pit opens up at the entrance to this tomb, with a stone sarcophagus resting at the bottom. A snarling monkey-like creature decorates the sarcophagus lid. Beyond the pit, three treasure chests sit on stone daises. The chest on the left is carved of black onyx, the middle chest is made of rusty iron, and the chest on the right is cast of silver and glistening with frost.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴的入口處有一個深坑，底部放著一個石棺。棺蓋上裝飾著一隻咆哮的猴形生物。越過深坑，三個寶箱放在石制的基座上。左邊的箱子是用黑色縞瑪瑙雕刻而成，中間的箱子由生鏽的鐵製成，右邊的箱子由銀鑄造而成，閃爍著霜凍的光芒。

english: The pit is 20 feet deep. To unlock Wongo's sarcophagus, the characters must turn three keys hidden inside the treasure chests.
zh_tw: 這個坑深20尺。要解鎖望戈的石棺，角色們必須從寶箱中找到並使用三把隱藏的鑰匙。

english: Treasure Chests
zh_tw: 寶箱

english: Each chest is 5 feet long, 3 feet wide, and 3 feet high. All three are unlocked and (for the most part) empty. The chests cannot be moved, and they are impervious to damage and spells.
zh_tw: 每個箱子長5尺，寬3尺，高3尺。這三個箱子都沒有上鎖，而且（大多數情況下）是空的。箱子不能移動，並且對傷害和法術免疫。

english: Opening any chest reveals a 3-inch-long gold key protruding from an adamantine keyhole set into the underside of the chest's lid. The key cannot be removed, and adamantine clamps prevent it from being turned while the chest is open. When the chest lid closes, a muffled click sounds from within the lid as the clamps around the key release. Any character who climbs inside a chest and closes its lid can turn its golden key with ease.
zh_tw: 開啟任何一個箱子都會發現一個3吋長的金鑰匙從箱子蓋子底部的金剛石鑰匙孔中伸出。鑰匙無法被移除，當箱子開啟時，金剛石夾具會阻止鑰匙轉動。當箱子蓋子關閉時，蓋子內部會發出一聲悶響，因為圍繞鑰匙的夾具鬆開了。任何爬進箱子並關閉蓋子的角色都可以輕鬆地轉動它的金鑰匙。

english: If a chest's key is turned while the chest is shut, the chest locks and the clamps snap shut on the key once more. Any character inside the chest when this happens is trapped. At the same time, a button magically appears on the lid of Wongo's sarcophagus.
zh_tw: 如果當箱子關閉時轉動箱子的鑰匙，箱子就會鎖定，夾具會再次緊緊夾住鑰匙。如果此時有角色在箱子內部，他們將被困住。與此同時，望戈石棺的蓋子上會神奇地出現一個按鈕。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: The sarcophagus lid is carved with a stylized image of Wongo in his su-monster form (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) and has been melded to the rest of the sarcophagus with powerful magic. Consequently, the lid cannot be removed. The stone sarcophagus is impervious to damage and spells.
zh_tw: 石棺的蓋子上雕刻著望戈的蘇怪形態（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的圖案，並且已經用強大的魔法與石棺的其餘部分融合在一起。因此，蓋子無法被移除。石制石棺對傷害和法術免疫。

english: Whenever one of the three chests is locked, a carved button magically appears on the sarcophagus lid above the monstrous image of Wongo. The material of each button matches its corresponding chest: onyx, rusty iron, or silver. Pressing the button simultaneously unlocks the associated chest and triggers a trap within it:
zh_tw: 每當其中一個寶箱被鎖定時，石棺蓋上就會神奇地出現一個雕刻的按鈕，位於望戈的怪物形象上方。每個按鈕的材料與其對應的寶箱相匹配：縞瑪瑙、生鏽的鐵或銀色。按下按鈕會同時解鎖相關的寶箱，並觸發其內部的陷阱：

english: Pushing the onyx button forces any creature inside the onyx chest to succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 75 ({@dice 10d6 + 40}) force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage turns to a pile of dust, leaving behind whatever gear it was holding or wearing.
zh_tw: 按下黑曜石按鈕會迫使黑曜石箱內的任何生物進行一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免，豁免失敗則受到 75 點 ({@dice 10d6 + 40}) 的力場傷害。任何因該傷害生命值降至 0 點的生物將化為一堆灰塵，留下其所持有或穿戴的所有裝備。

english: Pushing the rusty iron button causes any nonmagical metal objects inside the rusty iron chest (including objects carried or worn by a creature in the chest) to corrode into worthless piles of rust. Objects partly made of metal are ruined as their metal components decay.
zh_tw: 按下生鏽鐵製按鈕會導致生鏽鐵製寶箱內的任何非魔法金屬物體（包括寶箱中生物攜帶或穿戴的物品）腐蝕成一堆無價值的鏽跡。部分由金屬製成的物品會因為其金屬部分的腐蝕而損毀。

english: Pushing the silver button causes any creature inside the silver chest to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@dice 10d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 按下銀色按鈕會使銀色箱子內的任何生物進行一個 {@dc 15} 的體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 45 ({@dice 10d8}) 點寒冷傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Once all three buttons on the sarcophagus lid have been pressed, read:
zh_tw: 一旦石棺蓋上的所有三個按鈕都被按下，請閱讀：

english: The stone sarcophagus turns to transparent crystal, revealing a mummified monkey-like creature within. Clutched in its desiccated claws is a fearsome mace.
zh_tw: 石制的棺材變成了透明的水晶，露出了裡面木乃伊化的猴類生物。在其乾燥的爪子中緊握著一把可怕的釘頭錘。

english: When the sarcophagus turns crystalline, it becomes brittle, having AC 5, 10 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. It shatters if reduced to 0 hit points, whereupon the su-monster {@creature mummy} within animates and attacks. In its first round of combat, the mummy activates its {@item mace of terror} to unleash a wave of terror against the characters. Thereafter, it makes melee attacks using the mace or its rotting fists.
zh_tw: 當石棺變成晶體狀時，它變得脆弱，具有AC 5，10點生命值，易受鈍擊和雷鳴傷害，對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果生命值降至0點，石棺會破碎，裡面的蘇怪{@creature mummy||木乃伊}會活化並攻擊。在戰鬥的第一輪，木乃伊啟用它的{@item mace of terror||恐懼之錘}，對角色釋放一波恐怖波動。之後，它使用權杖或其腐爛的拳頭進行近戰攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Wongo's mummy clutches a {@item mace of terror}. The mace turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 望戈的木乃伊緊握著一把{@item mace of terror||恐懼之錘}。如果這把釘頭錘離開九神之墓（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"），它將化為塵土並被摧毀。

english: Wongo's Spirit
zh_tw: 望戈的靈

english: Wongo's spirit is bound to the mace. If the mace hits or otherwise comes into contact with any character, Wongo's spirit tries to inhabit that character (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Wongo's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 望戈的靈魂被束縛在釘頭錘上。如果釘頭錘擊中或以其他方式接觸到任何角色，望戈的靈魂會試圖佔據那個角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當望戈的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: Red smoke seethes from the head of the mace, forming the outline of a monkey with a long tail. With a roar, the smoky apparition leaps at you, screaming, "Let me in!"
zh_tw: 紅煙從釘頭錘的頭部沸騰而出，形成了一隻長尾巴猴子的輪廓。伴隨著一聲咆哮，這團煙霧幻象向你撲來，尖叫著說："讓我進去！"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Wongo|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Wongo's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the mace and waits for another character to come into contact with it. The mummy is friendly toward any character inhabited by Wongo's spirit, treating that character as an ally.
zh_tw: 如果靈成功附身於角色，請給玩家{@card Wongo|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|望戈的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈返回到釘頭錘中，並等待另一個角色與之接觸。木乃伊對任何被望戈的靈附身的角色表示友好，將該角色視為盟友。

english: 17. Underground Waterfall
zh_tw: 17. 地下瀑布

english: The underground river plunges down into a dark, rocky chasm. Cold air swirls up from below like the breath of some monstrous creature. Through the gloom, you spot an ornate treasure chest resting on a ledge opposite.
zh_tw: 地下河流直衝入一個黑暗、多岩石的峽谷。冷氣從下方旋轉升起，就像某種怪物的呼吸。透過昏暗，你發現一個華麗的寶箱放在對面的壁架上。

english: The treasure chest is a {@creature mimic} in disguise. If any creature touches it, the mimic attacks in object form.
zh_tw: 寶箱是一個偽裝成物品的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。如果任何生物觸碰它，擬身怪會以物品形態進行攻擊。

english: Ledge
zh_tw: 巖架

english: The ledge is 15 feet from the lip of the waterfall. A successful {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is required to climb around to the ledge.
zh_tw: 巖壁距離瀑布邊緣有15尺。需要一個成功的 {@dc 14} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來攀爬到巖壁。

english: The ledge is slippery and uneven. Any creature that takes damage while standing on the ledge must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall into the rift, plunging 100 feet into the water at {@area area 64|4af|x}. The fall deals 35 ({@dice 10d6}) bludgeoning damage, or no damage with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw.
zh_tw: 這條巖壁溼滑不平。任何站在巖壁上的生物受到傷害時，必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則會墜入裂縫，掉落到 {@area 區域64|4af|x} 的水中，墜落高度為 100 尺。墜落會造成 35（{@dice 10d6}）點鈍擊傷害，如果成功透過 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定則不會受到傷害。

english: Level 2: Dungeon of Deception
zh_tw: 第二層：欺騙之迷宮

english: Map 5.2 shows this level of the dungeon. Mocking devil faces are graven into the walls, and the air reeks of rotting flesh. With no light to nourish it, the vegetation that fills much of level 1 doesn't extend down here.
zh_tw: 地圖5.2展示了地牢的這一層。牆上刻有嘲笑的魔鬼面孔，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛肉體的惡臭。由於沒有光線滋養，填滿第一層的植被並沒有延伸到這裡。

english: Map 5.2: Dungeon of Deception
zh_tw: 地圖5.2：欺騙地牢

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 18. Devil Pit
zh_tw: 18. 魔鬼坑

english: The walls and floor of this fifteen-foot-square room are cracked and carved with images of terrified humanoids falling. Set into the middle of the floor is a stone bas-relief of a bearded devil face, painted green. Forlorn cries echo from the black void of its gaping maw.
zh_tw: 這個十五尺見方的房間的牆壁和地板都裂開了，上面刻著驚恐的人形生物墜落的影象。房間中央鑲嵌著一個石制的浮雕，上面是一個須魔面孔，塗成了綠色。從它張開的大嘴裡傳來了絕望的哭聲。

english: The devil face forms the mouth of a 5-foot-wide cylindrical shaft that descends 10 feet before opening up in the ceiling of {@area area 35|3d0|x}. Magical darkness fills the mouth and the shaft. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals auras of evocation and illusion magic within the shaft.
zh_tw: 魔鬼面孔形成了一個5尺寬的圓柱形豎井的入口，豎井下降10尺後在{@area 區域35|3d0|x}的天花板上開口。魔法黑暗充滿了入口和豎井。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了豎井內部的塑能和幻術魔法的氣息。

english: A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 16}) cast on the darkness dispels it. If the darkness is dispelled, its fading essence magically coalesces into a {@creature swarm of bats} that flies up out of the shaft and attacks any creatures in the room.
zh_tw: 成功施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} ({@dc 16}) 於黑暗上可驅散它。如果黑暗被驅散，其逐漸消逝的精華會魔法般地凝聚成一隻 {@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}，從豎井中飛出並攻擊房間內的任何生物。

english: 19. Gravity Ring
zh_tw: 19. 重力環

english: At a four-way intersection, the corridors to north and south curve upward and out of sight, but with no rails or steps to allow them to be climbed. The corpse of a half-human, half-goat creature in robes sprawls ten feet to the north. It grips a staff tipped with a bronze goat's head.
zh_tw: 在一個四路交叉路口，向北和向南的走廊向上彎曲並消失在視線之外，但沒有欄杆或臺階可以攀爬。一具半人半羊生物的屍體，身穿長袍，橫臥在北方十尺處。它緊握著一根頂端有青銅山羊頭的手杖。

english: The curving corridor forms a perfect circle, imbued with magical gravity that keeps creatures bound to the floor as they walk along it. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation within the corridor.
zh_tw: 彎曲的走廊形成一個完美的圓圈，被賦予了魔法重力，使得生物在沿著它行走時被束縛在地面上。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了走廊內的變形術光環。

english: The corpse belongs to Devlin Bashir, a Calishite wizard and member of the Company of the Yellow Banner. Devlin's goat-like features are the result of a curse, and he was killed by tomb dwarves after he became separated from his companions. Any inspection of his remains reveals that he was killed by wounds from axes and crossbow bolts. Devlin's ink-stained robes contain a journal that hints at the tomb's mysteries (see "Devlin's Journal" below). A search of the corpse also yields more valuable belongings (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 屍體屬於德夫林·巴希爾，一位來自卡利什的法師，也是黃旗冒險團的一員。德夫林的山羊般的特徵是因為一個詛咒，他在與同伴分開後被墓穴矮人殺害。任何對他的遺體的檢查都顯示他是被斧頭和弩箭的傷口殺死的。德夫林的墨跡斑斑的長袍裡藏有一本暗示著墓穴秘密的日誌（見下文的"德夫林的日誌"）。對屍體的搜尋還發現了一些更有價值的物品（見下文的"財寶"）。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Papazotl or Shagambi receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被帕帕扎圖或莎根比的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Bossy Papazotl urges his host to order another character to walk the length of the circular hall.
zh_tw: 專橫的帕帕扎圖敦促他的宿主命令另一個角色走過圓形大廳的全長。

english: Wise Shagambi warns her host that the staff held by the fallen wizard might be cursed.
zh_tw: 睿智的莎根比警告她的宿主，倒下的法師手中的法杖可能被詛咒了。

english: Mirror Tomb
zh_tw: 鏡之墓

english: The halfway point of the circular corridor, directly "opposite" the intersection, is an invisible planar gate that cannot be detected with magic. Any creature passing through this gate emerges into a parallel reality. Characters who walk the length of the circular corridor notice that Devlin's body is no longer present—nor are any companions who waited behind for them. If they step back through the gate, they return to their own world.
zh_tw: 圓形走廊的中點，直接位於交叉路口的"對面"，是一個看不見的位面門，無法用魔法檢測。任何生物穿過這個門都會進入一個平行現實。走過圓形走廊全長的角色會注意到德夫林的身體不再存在——那些在他們後面等待的同伴也不在了。如果他們透過門返回，他們將回到自己的世界。

english: To test his traps, {@creature Acererak|ToA} crafted a "mirror tomb" and hid it inside a demiplane. This mirror tomb is identical to the real tomb as it stood exactly one year ago. All objects and creatures encountered in the mirror tomb appear real, but they fade away if taken to the real world. The mirror tomb has the same magical defenses as the true tomb, and any character who dies in the demiplane is trapped by the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 為了測試他的陷阱，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}製造了一個"鏡之墓"並將其隱藏在一個半位面中。這個鏡之墓與一年前的真正墓穴完全相同。在鏡之墓中遇到的所有物體和生物看起來都是真實的，但如果被帶到真實世界，它們就會消失。鏡之墓擁有與真正墓穴相同的魔法防禦，任何在半位面中死亡的角色都會被噬魂器困住。

english: Each dawn, {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s magic replaces the mirror tomb with a fresh fabrication. Slain monsters reappear in their original locations, and moved objects teleport back to where they were found. When this occurs, characters inside the mirror tomb witness a strange distortion ripple through the air.
zh_tw: 每天黎明，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的魔法都會用新的構造物替換鏡之墓。被殺的怪物在其原始位置重新出現，移動的物體傳送回它們被發現的地方。當這種情況發生時，鏡之墓內的角色會目睹空氣中出現一種奇怪的扭曲波紋。

english: Devlin's Journal
zh_tw: 德夫林的日誌

english: When the characters find Devlin's journal, give the players a copy of handout 21 in {@area appendix E|54e|x}, showing the journal's final entry. Earlier entries chronicle the exploits of the Company of the Yellow Banner in Chult. The company made landfall at Kitcher's Inlet and followed the River Olung to Lake Luo before cutting southwest into the jungle toward Omu. The journal describes harrowing encounters, the adventurers' search for puzzle cubes in Omu, their brushes with the yuan-ti, and the discovery of the true tomb entrance. Only the final entry mentions their experiences in the tomb, but no mention is made of Devlin's staff (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 當角色們找到德文林的日記時，給玩家們一份位於{@area 附錄 E|54e|x}中的手稿21的副本，展示日記的最後一條記錄。早期的記錄記載了黃旗冒險團在楚爾特的事蹟。團隊在基切爾河口登陸，沿著奧倫河前往洛湖，然後向西南方向進入叢林，前往奧穆。日記描述了驚險的遭遇，冒險者在奧穆尋找謎題立方體的過程，他們與蛇人的交鋒，以及真正墓穴入口的發現。只有最後一條記錄提到了他們在墓穴中的經歷，但並未提及德文林的法杖（見下方的"寶藏"）。

english: Any character who spends 10 minutes poring over the journal can note a few brief mentions of the other company members: Lord Brixton (a Cormyrean knight), Bravus Boulderborn (a gold dwarf cleric of Moradin), Seward (a Chondathan human ranger), and Sephirius (a dragonborn paladin often referred to as "Seph").
zh_tw: 任何花費10分鐘仔細研究日誌的角色都可以注意到對其他冒險團成員的一些簡短提及：布里克斯頓爵士（一位科米爾騎士），布拉弗斯·巖生（一位摩拉丁的金矮人牧師），西沃德（一位瓊達斯人人類遊俠），以及塞菲裡烏斯（一位常被稱為「塞夫」的龍裔聖武士）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A search of Devlin's body also turns up an ink pot that never runs dry (100 gp) and a spellbook containing the following spells:
zh_tw: 對德夫林身體的搜尋還發現了一瓶永不耗盡的墨水（價值100金幣）和一本包含以下法術的咒語書：

english: 1st level: {@spell alarm}, {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell expeditious retreat}, {@spell identify}, {@spell illusory script}, {@spell sleep}, {@spell Tenser's floating disk}
zh_tw: 1環法術：{@spell alarm||警報術}, {@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}, {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}, {@spell expeditious retreat||腳底抹油}, {@spell identify||鑑定術}, {@spell illusory script||迷幻手稿}, {@spell sleep||睡眠術}, {@spell Tenser's floating disk||譚森浮碟術}

english: 2nd level: {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell cloud of daggers}, {@spell flaming sphere}, {@spell knock}
zh_tw: 2環法術：{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}, {@spell cloud of daggers||匕首之雲}, {@spell flaming sphere||熾焰法球}, {@spell knock||敲擊術}

english: 3rd level: {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell fireball}
zh_tw: 3環法術：{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}, {@spell fireball||火球術}

english: Devlin's staff is a {@item staff of striking}, but any character who attunes to it transforms into a goat-humanoid hybrid over the course of 3 days. Tieflings are immune to this curse. Throughout the first day, shaggy fur begins to grow all over the cursed character's body. After 24 hours, the character's eyes become goat-like, and stumpy horns sprout from the brow. On the last day, the character's fingers and toes meld into double digits, and the horns grow to full length. This transformation doesn't prevent the character from wielding weapons or casting spells. {@spell Remove curse}, {@spell greater restoration}, or any other effect that ends a curse restores the character's original appearance, but only a {@spell wish} spell can rid the staff of its power to transform those who attune to it.
zh_tw: 德夫林的法杖是一根{@item staff of striking||強襲法杖}，但任何與之共鳴的角色在3天內會變成山羊-人類混生體。提夫林對這種詛咒免疫。在第一天，粗糙的毛髮開始在被詛咒的角色全身生長。24小時後，角色的眼睛變得像山羊，額頭上長出短角。在最後一天，角色的手指和腳趾融合成雙位數，角長到全尺寸。這種轉變不會阻止角色使用武器或施放法術。{@spell Remove curse||移除詛咒}, {@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}，或任何其他結束詛咒的效果可以恢復角色的原始外觀，但只有{@spell wish||祈願術}法術可以消除法杖改變與之共鳴者的能力。

english: 20. False Tomb
zh_tw: 20. 假墓

english: Nested in the ceiling of the western tunnel is a stone block. A character who searches the tunnel spots the block with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The block is part of the room's trap (see "Trap" below).
zh_tw: 在西側隧道的天花板上嵌有一塊石頭。搜尋隧道的角色在進行一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定時會發現這塊石頭。這塊石頭是房間陷阱的一部分（見下文"陷阱"）。

english: This room smells of wine. On a checkerboard marble floor, a gilded coffin sparkles in sunlight streaming down from the chamber's vaulted ceiling, which arches twelve feet overhead. Four huge stone gargoyle heads, their mouths agape, protrude from the walls.
zh_tw: 這個房間散發著葡萄酒的香味。在一個棋盤格大理石地面上，一具鍍金的棺材在陽光下閃閃發光，陽光從房間的拱形天花板上流瀉下來，天花板高高在上十二尺。四個巨大的石像鬼頭，張開的嘴巴，從牆壁上突出。

english: Illusion magic generates the sunlight that shines on the coffin. This light is treated as real sunlight, and creatures averse to sunlight are affected by it. The gargoyle heads are 5 feet tall and 5 feet wide, with mouths that are 2 feet in diameter. Behind each head, an airtight stone valve blocks a crawlway. The valves remain closed until the room's trap activates, though a {@spell knock} spell or a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check can force open a valve. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on the illusory sunlight dispels it and prevents the trap from triggering.
zh_tw: 幻術魔法生成了照射在棺材上的陽光。這種光線被視為真實的陽光，對陽光敏感的生物會受到其影響。石像鬼頭雕像高5尺，寬5尺，嘴巴直徑為2尺。每個頭後面有一個氣密石閥，阻斷了進入的通道。閥門在房間的陷阱啟用前保持關閉，但可以透過{@spell knock||敲擊術}或一個成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。對幻象陽光施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}可以使其消失，並防止陷阱觸發。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Kubazan or Moa receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被庫巴贊或莫阿的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Spirited Kubazan tries to persuade his host to throw open the coffin lid and pummel whatever is inside.
zh_tw: 活潑的庫巴贊試圖說服他的宿主開啟棺材蓋並猛擊裡面的東西。

english: Truthful Moa points out that this tomb doesn't match the symbolism of any of his godly companions.
zh_tw: 誠實的莫阿指出這座墓穴與他的任何神性伴侶的象徵都不相符。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The closed coffin is stuck to the floor with {@item sovereign glue} and has a hinged lid. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of abjuration magic around the coffin. A wooden plaque inside the coffin reads "Drown your sorrows" in Common.
zh_tw: 這個封閉的棺材被{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}粘在地板上，並且有一個鉸鏈蓋。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了棺材周圍的防護魔法光環。棺材內的一塊木牌用通用語寫著"沉溺於悲傷"。

english: If the illusory sunlight falling from the ceiling strikes the plaque when the coffin is opened, the stone block in the corridor outside the room slowly descends, sealing the entrance in 6 seconds. A creature that wishes to enter or leave the tomb during this time can do so, moving up to its speed. If the creature ends its movement under the block, it must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. If the save succeeds, the creature manages to get out from under the block on the side it was moving toward. If the save fails, the creature takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage. If this damage reduces the creature's hit points to 0, it is crushed to a pulp; otherwise, the creature is shoved into the room. The block is impervious to damage and spells. When fully lowered, the block is air-tight and refuses to be budged.
zh_tw: 如果棺材開啟時從天花板落下的幻象陽光照射到銘牌上，房間外走廊的石塊會緩慢下降，並在6秒內封閉入口。在此期間，任何希望進入或離開墓穴的生物可以這樣做，移動至多其速度的距離。如果生物在石塊下結束其移動，它必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免。若豁免成功，生物成功從石塊下移向其移動方向的一側。若豁免失敗，生物受到55（{@dice 10d10}）點鈍擊傷害。如果此傷害將生物的生命值降至0，它被壓成肉醬；否則，生物被推入房間。石塊對傷害和法術免疫。當完全降下時，石塊氣密且無法被移動。

english: Four enormous cisterns filled with red wine are hidden in the walls behind the gargoyle heads. When the stone block seals off the entrance, the valves behind the heads open, causing the wine to pour from the gargoyles' mouths and nostrils. The wine floods the tomb at a rate of 1 foot per round. Trying to crawl into a gargoyle's mouth while wine is gushing out of it requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 四個裝滿紅酒的巨型蓄水池隱藏在石像鬼頭像後的牆壁中。當石塊封住入口時，頭像後的閥門會開啟，使得紅酒從石像鬼的嘴和鼻孔中湧出。酒水會以每輪1尺的速度淹沒墓室。在酒水湧出時試圖爬入石像鬼的嘴中，需要透過一次 {@dc 25} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。

english: As the wine begins pouring into the room, all creatures present must roll initiative. Track the passage of rounds:
zh_tw: 當紅酒開始湧入房間時，所有在場的生物必須進行先攻檢定。追蹤輪次的流逝：

english: At the start of round 3, three wine weirds (use {@creature water weird} statistics) flow into the tomb from the northwest, northeast, and southeast cisterns. The weirds attack anyone in the tomb and are {@condition invisible} while fully immersed in wine.
zh_tw: 在第三輪開始時，三個酒詭（使用{@creature water weird||水詭}的具體數值）從西北、東北和東南的儲水池流入墓穴。這些怪異攻擊墓穴中的任何人，並且在完全浸沒在紅酒中時是{@condition invisible||隱形}的。

english: After 12 rounds, the wine fills the tomb. Use the underwater combat rules in {@book chapter 9|PHB|9|Underwater Combat} of the {@i Player's Handbook} to handle fighting in these conditions. Visibility within the wine is limited to 5 feet.
zh_tw: 12輪後，葡萄酒會填滿墓室。使用{@book 第九章|PHB|9|Underwater Combat}（選自{@i 玩家手冊}）中的水下戰鬥規則來處理在這些條件下的戰鬥。葡萄酒中的視野僅限於5尺。

english: The ability to breathe water does not help a character drowning in wine. When 10 minutes have passed, the stone block sealing the tomb rises back up to its niche in the ceiling. The wine cascades down the west tunnel, pouring down the grand staircase ({@area area 7|345|x}). At dawn the next day, {@creature Withers|ToA} sends tomb dwarves to clean up the room and tunnel, after which the wine cisterns magically refill and the trap resets.
zh_tw: 在水中呼吸的能力並不能幫助在紅酒中溺水的角色。當10分鐘過去後，封閉墓穴的石塊升回到天花板上的凹槽中。紅酒沿著西隧道傾瀉而下，流下宏偉的樓梯（{@area 區域7|345|x}）。第二天黎明，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}派遣墓穴矮人清理房間和隧道，之後紅酒儲水池神奇地重新填滿，陷阱重置。

english: Escape Tunnel
zh_tw: 逃跑隧道

english: The southwest crawlway ascends to {@area area 24|398|x}. When the tomb floods with wine, the liquid reaches as far as the sloped section of the crawlway.
zh_tw: 西南爬行通道向上通往{@area 區域24|398|x}。當墓穴被紅酒淹沒時，液體會流到爬行通道的傾斜部分。

english: 21. Zombie Door
zh_tw: 21. 殭屍門

english: Adventurers on the balcony hear guttural moans coming from this door.
zh_tw: 站在陽臺上的冒險者聽到從這扇門裡傳來的咕噥呻吟聲。

english: Three oval holes are carved into a nine-foot-wide, nine-foot-high stone door at human head height. As you approach, three humanoid heads stick out of the holes, each covered in putrid flesh and gnashing on an iron bit bolted to a chain bridle.
zh_tw: 一扇九尺寬、九尺高的石門上雕刻著三個橢圓形的洞，位於人頭高度。當你接近時，三個類人生物的頭從洞中伸出，每個頭上都覆蓋著腐爛的肉，並且正咬著固定在鏈條馬勒上的鐵製嚼子。

english: The gnashing heads belong to three {@creature Zombie||zombies} that are chained to a pulley bolted to the ceiling on the south side of the door. The pulley is set up in such a way that when all three zombies move away from the door, they heave it open. The zombies won't move while fresh meat tempts them from the balcony, but if they are successfully turned, they raise the door as they flee toward the south.
zh_tw: 這些咬合的頭屬於三個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}，它們被鏈子拴在門南側天花板上的滑輪上。滑輪的設定是這樣的：當所有三個殭屍遠離門移動時，它們會將其抬起開啟。殭屍在新鮮肉從陽臺上引誘它們時不會移動，但如果它們被成功驅趕，它們會抬起門向南逃跑。

english: The door weighs 1,000 pounds. Characters with a combined Strength score of 33 or more can lift the door. The zombies attack any creatures they can reach. {@creature Withers|ToA} and his tomb dwarves replace destroyed zombies within 24 hours.
zh_tw: 這扇門重1000磅。力量值總和達到33或更多的角色可以抬起這扇門。殭屍會攻擊它們能夠觸及的任何生物。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}和他的墓穴矮人在24小時內會替換被摧毀的殭屍。

english: 22. Papazotl's Tomb
zh_tw: 22. 帕帕扎圖的墓

english: Six glass cauldrons brimming with humanoid bones line the walls of this tomb, at the center of which stands an ancient chariot bearing a bronze sarcophagus with treasure strewn atop it. Paintings on the chariot's body show a tall bird with a long, sharp beak. On the south wall, a bronze shield bears the embossed image of a Chultan warrior carrying a spear, below an inscription that reads, "Bow before no one." Four bronze statues stand on pedestals to either side of the shield. They depict Chultan warriors: one holding a sword, two with spears, and one missing its face.
zh_tw: 六個裝滿類人生物骨頭的玻璃大鍋排列在這個墓穴的牆壁上，墓穴中心是一個古老的戰車，上面放著一個銅製的石棺，上面散佈著財寶。戰車車身上的繪畫展示了一隻高大的鳥，有著長而鋒利的喙。在南牆上，一面銅盾牌上浮雕著一個手持長矛的楚爾特戰士的形象，上方的銘文寫著，"不向任何人鞠躬。"盾牌兩側的基座上各立著四尊銅像。它們描繪了楚爾特戰士：一個手持劍，兩個手持矛，還有一個失去了面部。

english: Papazotl's bones are contained within the sarcophagus, but they are well protected (see "Glass Cauldrons" and "Bronze Shield" below).
zh_tw: 帕帕扎圖的骨頭被安放在石棺內，但它們受到了很好的保護（見下文的"玻璃大鍋"和"銅盾牌"）。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Nangnang or Obo'laka receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被娜浪或奧博娜卡的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Greedy Nangnang encourages her host to grab some of the treasure from the chariot.
zh_tw: 貪婪的娜浪鼓勵她的宿主從戰車上抓取一些財寶。

english: Nervous Obo'laka warns its host that the cauldrons contain the bones of Papazotl's most zealous devotees who, even in death, might seek to protect him.
zh_tw: 緊張的奧博娜卡警告其宿主，大鍋包含著帕帕扎圖最狂熱信徒的骨頭，他們即使在死後也可能尋求保護他。

english: Glass Cauldrons
zh_tw: 玻璃大鍋

english: Disturbing the chariot, the sarcophagus, or the treasure lying atop it causes twelve {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} to crawl out of the glass cauldrons (two per cauldron). All the skeletons act on the same initiative count. A cauldron disgorges one additional {@creature skeleton} at the start of the skeletons' turn each round until the cauldron is destroyed or the tomb is cleared of interlopers. When no enemies remain, any remaining skeletons return to the cauldrons.
zh_tw: 擾亂戰車、石棺或上面散落的財寶會導致十二個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}從玻璃大鍋中爬出來（每個大鍋中兩個）。所有的骷髏在同一先攻計數上行動。在骷髏的回合開始時，每個大鍋會額外吐出一個{@creature skeleton||骷髏}，直到大鍋被摧毀或墓穴中的入侵者被清除。當沒有敵人剩餘時，任何剩餘的骷髏會返回大鍋。

english: Destroying the cauldrons stops the flow of skeletons, as does bowing before the faceless statue ("Bow before no one"). Each cauldron is a Large object with AC 15, 22 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of conjuration around the cauldrons. An empty cauldron weighs 500 pounds.
zh_tw: 摧毀大鍋會阻止骷髏的湧出，同樣，向無面雕像鞠躬（"不向任何人鞠躬"）也有此效果。每個大鍋是一個大型物體，具有AC 15，22生命值，易受鈍擊和雷鳴傷害，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示大鍋周圍的召喚光環。一個空的大鍋重500磅。

english: Bronze Shield
zh_tw: 銅盾牌

english: The bronze shield hangs from the wall on leather straps. It radiates conjuration magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect.
zh_tw: 銅盾牌懸掛在牆上，用皮帶固定。它對{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果發出了召喚魔法的輻射。

english: If the chariot, the sarcophagus, or the treasure is disturbed, or if the shield is removed from the wall, the hunter embossed on it animates. Each round on initiative count 20, it flings a magical spear of force at the nearest character it can see, ignoring any creature that has bowed before the faceless bronze statue. The hunter can't see any creature behind the front-facing side of the shield. When it hurls a spear at a creature, the hunter makes a ranged spell attack ({@hit 10} to hit) and deals 18 ({@dice 4d8}) force damage on a hit. A target reduced to 0 hit points by this attack is disintegrated and turns to dust.
zh_tw: 如果戰車、石棺或寶藏被驚動，或者盾牌從牆上被取下，上面浮雕的獵人就會活化。每輪在先攻值20時，它會向它所能看見的最近角色投擲一根魔法力場矛，忽略任何在無面青銅雕像前鞠躬的生物。獵人看不見盾牌前側後面的任何生物。當它向一個生物投擲矛時，獵人進行一次遠端法術攻擊（命中{@hit 10}），命中時造成18（{@dice 4d8}）力場傷害。被此攻擊將生命值降至0的目標會瓦解並化為粉塵。

english: To stop the shield's hunter from attacking, a character must blind it by draping something opaque over the shield (such as a sack or cloak) or turning the shield to face a wall. The shield can also be destroyed; it has AC 15, 10 hit points, and is immune to all damage except force damage. If taken from the room, the shield vanishes and reappears on the wall between the statues.
zh_tw: 要阻止盾牌的守衛攻擊，角色必須透過將不透明物品（如袋子或斗篷）覆蓋在盾牌上或將盾牌轉向牆壁來使其失明。盾牌也可以被摧毀；它有AC 15，10點生命值，並且對所有傷害免疫，除了力場傷害。如果從房間中拿走，盾牌會消失，並在雕像之間的牆壁上重新出現。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: The sarcophagus contains the brittle skull and bones of an eblis (Papazotl's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}).
zh_tw: 石棺內裝有一隻易碎的頭骨和骨頭，屬於一個魔王鶴（帕帕扎圖的動物形態；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The following treasures are strewn atop the sarcophagus: a gold torc (250 gp), three gold cups (75 gp each), five gold cloak pins (25 gp each), and an {@item amulet of health}. The amulet turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 石棺上散佈著以下財寶：一個金項圈（250金幣），三個金盃（每個75金幣），五個金斗篷別針（每個25金幣），以及一個{@item amulet of health||健康護符}。如果這個護身符離開九神之墓，它會變成灰塵並被摧毀（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"）。

english: Papazotl's Spirit
zh_tw: 帕帕扎圖的靈魂

english: The spirit of Papazotl tries to inhabit any character who touches the {@item amulet of health} (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Papazotl's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 帕帕扎圖的靈魂試圖佔據任何觸碰到{@item amulet of health||健康護符}的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當帕帕扎圖的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: Strange shadows shift across the walls, forming the outline of a long-legged bird. Its beak stabs at you as a voice echoes through your mind: "You will do as I command!"
zh_tw: 奇怪的陰影在牆壁上移動，形成了一隻長腿鳥的輪廓。它的喙向你刺來，一個聲音在你的腦海中迴響："你將按我的命令列事！"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Papazotl|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Papazotl's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the amulet and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功附身於角色，給玩家{@card Papazotl|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|帕帕扎圖的卡牌}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂返回到護身符中，並等待另一個角色觸控它。

english: 23. Bottled Genie
zh_tw: 23. 瓶中精靈

english: Ancient cobwebs fill this narrow corridor, whose midpoint features an arched alcove. Within the alcove, a dusty bottle stands on a table.
zh_tw: 古老的蛛網布滿這條狹窄的走廊，走廊的中點有一個拱形壁龕。壁龕內，一個滿是灰塵的瓶子放在桌上。

english: The bottle is stoppered and contains a {@creature dao} named Keshma al-Wazir, who was trapped centuries ago by {@creature Acererak|ToA}. Anyone examining the bottle spots the genie waving from within and hears her muffled voice calling out. Keshma speaks Terran only. At first, she orders the characters to release her. If they refuse, she tries to bargain with them (see "Roleplaying the Dao" below). While trapped inside the bottle, Keshma can't attack or cast spells. Once she's released, she can cast the {@spell tongues} spell to better communicate with her liberators.
zh_tw: 這個瓶子被塞住了，裡面裝有一個名叫凱什瑪·瓦齊爾的{@creature dao||土巨靈}，幾個世紀前被{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}困住。任何檢查瓶子的人都會看到瓶內的精靈揮手示意，並聽到她的聲音在呼救。凱什瑪只會說土族語語。起初，她命令角色們釋放她。如果他們拒絕，她會嘗試與他們討價還價（見下文的"扮演土巨靈的角色"）。在被困在瓶子裡時，凱什瑪不能攻擊或施放法術。一旦她被釋放，她可以施放{@spell tongues||巧言術}法術，以更好地與解放者溝通。

english: If the bottle is broken or unplugged, the dao emerges in a whirlwind of sand. She fulfills whatever promise she made to the characters in exchange for her freedom, then casts {@spell plane shift} in an effort to return to the Elemental Plane of Earth. (The attempt fails, naturally, and she winds up trapped in {@area area 57|47d|x}.)
zh_tw: 如果瓶子被打破或拔掉塞子，道就會出現在沙塵暴中。她履行了對角色們做出的任何承諾以換取自由，然後施展了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術，試圖返回元素位面的土元素界。（自然，嘗試失敗了，她最終被困在{@area 區域57|47d|x}。）

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Moa, Nangnang, or Papazotl receive advice when seeing the genie in the bottle:
zh_tw: 任何被莫阿、娜浪或帕帕扎圖靈魂附身的角色在看到瓶中的精靈時會收到建議：

english: Truthful Moa advises his host not to break any bargains made with the dao.
zh_tw: 真實的莫阿勸告他的宿主不要違背與道達成的任何協議。

english: Greedy Nangnang advises her host to cut deals with the dao that benefit only the host and her.
zh_tw: 貪婪的娜浪建議她的宿主與土巨靈達成只對宿主和她自己有利的交易。

english: Proud Papazotl encourages his host to treat the dao like a servile lickspittle.
zh_tw: 驕傲的帕帕扎圖鼓勵他的宿主像對待卑躬屈膝的奴才一樣對待土巨靈。

english: Roleplaying the Dao
zh_tw: 扮演土巨靈

english: Decades of imprisonment have done little to dent Keshma's imperious nature. As befits a dao, she regards the characters as lesser creatures and bargains with them only if they refuse her commands.
zh_tw: 數十年的囚禁幾乎沒有削弱凱什瑪的傲慢本性。作為一個道，她將角色視為低等生物，並且只有在他們拒絕她的命令時才會與他們交易。

english: At first, Keshma promises the characters riches in exchange for freedom—the sapphires coiled through her braided hair and the platinum armbands (see "Treasure" below). Such baubles mean little to the dao in the greater scheme of things, but she feigns anguish in surrendering them. If the characters press for more, Keshma promises to take them anywhere in the multiverse. Finally, she offers to travel with them through the tomb and aid them three times with her spells.
zh_tw: 起初，凱什瑪承諾以自由換取財富——她編織頭髮中的藍寶石和她手臂上的鉑金臂環（見下文的"財寶"）。在大局中，這些小玩意兒對土巨靈來說意義不大，但她在放棄它們時假裝痛苦。如果角色們要求更多，凱什瑪承諾將他們帶到多元宇宙的任何地方。最後，她提出要和他們一起穿越墓穴，並用她的法術幫助他們三次。

english: Once freed, Keshma remains true to her word. However, she won't tolerate any slight to her honor. If she feels insulted, she attacks the characters and attempts to enslave them.
zh_tw: 一旦獲得自由，凱什瑪會信守諾言。然而，她不會容忍對她榮譽的任何侮辱。如果她感到被侮辱，她會攻擊角色並試圖奴役他們。

english: The dao could become a thorn in the characters' side or a difficult ally. Her ignorance of the tomb's defenses confines her to {@area area 57|47d|x} if she casts {@spell plane shift}. If she escapes from {@area area 57|47d|x}, she expects the characters to help her find a safe way out of the tomb. When she learns of the trickster gods, Keshma encourages the characters to seek them out and use them to defeat {@creature Acererak|ToA}.
zh_tw: 土巨靈可能會成為角色們的棘手問題或一個難以相處的盟友。她對墓穴防禦的無知限制了她如果施放{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術時只能到達{@area 區域57|47d|x}區域。如果她從{@area 區域57|47d|x}逃脫，她期望角色們幫助她找到一個安全離開墓穴的路徑。當她瞭解到詭神時，凱什瑪鼓勵角色們尋找他們，並利用他們來擊敗{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The dao wears two sapphire cords (1,250 gp each), two platinum armbands engraved with dueling dragons (750 gp each), and a topaz belly-button gemstone (500 gp).
zh_tw: 道穿著兩條藍寶石繩索（每條價值1,250金幣），兩個雕刻有對龍的白金臂環（每個750金幣），以及一顆黃玉臍部寶石（價值500金幣）。

english: 24. Nangnang's Tomb
zh_tw: 24. 娜浪的墓

english: The air here reeks of sulfur and brimstone. On the floor of this chamber, a pentagram traced in salt surrounds an ornate sarcophagus, its lid covered with figurines of prancing frog-like humanoids.
zh_tw: 這裡的空氣中瀰漫著硫磺和瀝青的惡臭。在這個房間的地板上，一個用鹽畫的五角星圍繞著一個華麗的石棺，其蓋子上覆蓋著跳躍的蛙類人形生物的小雕像。

english: An {@condition invisible} {@creature gray slaad} paces inside the salt pentagram. Magical wards prevent the slaad from disturbing the salt or leaving the circle's confines. If another creature attacks the slaad, enters the area of the boundary circle, or breaks any part of the circle or pentagram by sweeping or brushing away the salt, the slaad is freed. Hungry for carnage, the creature vents its rage on the characters before leaving the room in search of its control gem, not knowing that it is kept in {@area area 28|3aa|x}.
zh_tw: 一隻{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature gray slaad||史拉灰蟾}在鹽制五角星內踱步。魔法結界防止了史拉蟾擾亂鹽分或離開圓圈的範圍。如果另一個生物攻擊史拉蟾，進入邊界圓圈的區域，或透過掃除或刷去鹽分破壞圓圈或五角星的任何部分，史拉蟾就會被釋放。渴望屠殺的生物將怒火發洩在角色們身上，然後離開房間去尋找它的控制寶石，卻不知道它被儲存在{@area 區域28|3aa|x}區域。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Obo'laka or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被奧博娜卡或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Cautious Obo'laka thinks the salt pentagram could use more salt and encourages her host to add to it, if any salt is available. (Doing so doesn't break the wards that trap the slaad.)
zh_tw: 謹慎的奧博娜卡認為鹽制的五角星陣可能需要更多的鹽，並鼓勵她的宿主如果有任何鹽的話新增進去。（這樣做不會破壞困住史拉蟾的結界。）

english: Reckless Wongo doesn't care much for salt pentagrams, and he urges his host to wreck the symbol and see what happens.
zh_tw: 魯莽的望戈不太在乎鹽制五角星，他敦促他的宿主破壞這個符號，看看會發生什麼。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: Arranged atop the sarcophagus are twelve painted wooden statuettes depicting grungs. They are cute but worthless. The lid of the sarcophagus can be lifted and pushed aside with a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Within is a varnished clay urn containing the skull and bones of a grung (Nangnang's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), as well as a number of valuables (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 石棺頂部排列著十二個描繪格朗格的彩繪木雕。它們很可愛但毫無價值。石棺的蓋子可以透過成功的{@dc 17}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定抬起並推開。裡面是一個塗過清漆的陶甕，裝著格朗格的頭骨和骨骼（娜浪的動物形態；參見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），以及一些貴重物品（參見下面的"寶藏"）。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of enchantment surrounding the clay urn. The first creature to touch the urn or disturb its contents must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by an {@spell Otto's irresistible dance} spell. Until the effect ends, the creature also takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns as discordant, percussive music overwhelms its mind. Any creature under the effect of a {@spell mind blank} spell or similar magic doesn't hear this music or suffer the psychic damage. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 18}) dismisses the effect on the urn, allowing it to be touched safely.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果會揭示出圍繞陶罐的附魔靈光。第一個觸控陶罐或擾亂其內容的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 21} 的感知豁免，否則將受到 {@spell Otto's irresistible dance||奧圖迷舞} 法術的影響。直到效果結束，該生物在每個回合結束時還會受到 11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害，因為不和諧的打擊樂聲淹沒了它的心智。任何處於 {@spell mind blank||心靈屏障} 法術或類似魔法效果下的生物不會聽到這音樂或受到心靈傷害。成功的 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 18}）可以驅散陶罐上的效果，使其可以被安全地觸控。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside the sarcophagus are a {@item potion of poison} disguised as a {@item potion of supreme healing} and a petrified grung egg that functions as a {@item pearl of power}. A spellcaster that attunes to the egg also gains resistance to poison damage. The egg turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 在石棺內有一個偽裝成{@item potion of poison||劇毒藥水}的{@item potion of supreme healing||極效治療藥水}，還有一個石化的格朗蛋，它的作用相當於一個{@item pearl of power||法力再生珍珠}。一個施法者如果與這個蛋同步，也會獲得對毒素傷害的抗性。如果蛋離開九神之墓（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"），它會變成灰塵並被摧毀。

english: Nangnang's Spirit
zh_tw: 娜浪的靈魂

english: The spirit of Nangnang tries to inhabit any character who touches the egg (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Nangnang's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 娜浪的靈魂試圖佔據任何觸碰到蛋的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當娜浪的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: As you touch the egg, a tendril of slime rises from its surface and transforms into a frog-like head that bobs toward you. A croaking voice sounds out in your mind: "Nangnang will help you now."
zh_tw: 當你觸控這個蛋時，一條粘液觸鬚從其表面升起並變成了一個蛙狀的頭部，向你搖擺而來。一個蛙鳴般的聲音在你的腦海中響起："娜浪現在會幫助你。"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Nangnang|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Nangnang's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the egg and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功附身於角色，給玩家{@card Nangnang|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|娜浪的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂返回到卵中並等待另一個角色觸控它。

english: 25. Scrying Pool
zh_tw: 25. 占卜池

english: Behind the secret door, water fills a carved stone font.
zh_tw: 秘密門後面，水充滿了一個雕刻的石質聖水池。

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} uses this font to speak to creatures outside the tomb and contact his {@creature tomb guardian|ToA}. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of divination over the water. When any character gazes into the font, read:
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯} 使用這種字型與墓外的生物交談，並聯系他的{@creature tomb guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛}。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了水上的占卜光環。當任何角色凝視這個水池時，請閱讀：

english: As the water begins to swirl, eerie light emanates from within the basin. Slowly, an image resolves on the water's surface.
zh_tw: 當水開始旋轉時，詭異的光線從盆中散發出來。慢慢地，在水面上顯現出一個影象。

english: Those gazing into the font can see through the eyes of a random tomb guardian as it patrols the dungeon. Pick a random level (or roll a {@dice d6}) and describe the guardian's path through it. The guardian relies on {@sense darkvision} to see, so images in the pool are in black and white. The images fade and the scrying effect ends if no character gazes into the water.
zh_tw: 凝視著聖水池的人可以透過一個隨機的墓穴守衛的眼睛看到它在地牢中巡邏。選擇一個隨機的樓層（或者擲一個{@dice d6}）並描述守衛穿過它的路徑。守衛依賴於{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}來看見，所以池中的影象是黑白的。如果沒有角色凝視水，影象就會消失，窺視效果也會結束。

english: Unless one of the characters gazing into the pool is wearing an {@item amulet of the black skull|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8} and {@area area 28|3aa|x}), the tomb guardian becomes aware of the party's scrying after 1 minute. When that happens, read:
zh_tw: 除非凝視水池的角色之一佩戴著{@item amulet of the black skull|ToA|黑顱骨護符}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}和{@area 區域28|3aa|x}），否則墓穴守衛在1分鐘後會察覺到這個窺探。當這種情況發生時，請閱讀：

english: The surface of the pool explodes, and a hulking figure wearing plate armor and a bucket helm heaves itself up from the font.
zh_tw: 水池表面爆炸，一個穿著板甲和桶形頭盔的龐大身影從水池中升起。

english: The {@creature tomb guardian|ToA} is a {@creature flesh golem} clad in plate armor (AC 17). As it emerges from the font, it attacks everyone in the chamber, fighting until destroyed. When the guardian appears, the pool loses its scrying power until the next dawn.
zh_tw: {@creature tomb guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛} 是一個穿著板甲的{@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}（AC 17）。當它從聖水池中出現時，它會攻擊房間裡的每個人，一直戰鬥到被摧毀。當守衛出現時，水池的窺視能力直到下一個黎明才會恢復。

english: 26. Spiral Staircase
zh_tw: 26. 螺旋樓梯

english: Three archways overlook a circular chamber where a spiral staircase descends into darkness. The staircase walls are lined with unlit torches in iron sconces and set with niches containing moldering humanoid skulls and bones.
zh_tw: 三個拱門俯瞰著一個圓形的房間，一個螺旋樓梯向下延伸進入黑暗。樓梯的牆壁上排列著未點燃的火把，裝在鐵製壁燈中，並設有壁龕，裡面裝有腐爛的人形頭骨和骨頭。

english: This staircase descends from level 2 to levels 3, 4, and 5, with each level 25 feet below the level above. The bones and skulls in the niches belong to dead Omuans whom {@creature Acererak|ToA} sacrificed to build the tomb. {@creature Withers|ToA} and his tomb dwarves use these stairs to move between levels.
zh_tw: 這段樓梯從2層下降到3層、4層和5層，每層比上一層低25尺。壁龕中的骨頭和頭骨屬於被{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}犧牲的死者奧穆人，他為了建造墓穴而犧牲了他們。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}和他的墓穴矮人使用這些樓梯在各層之間移動。

english: The torches can be removed from their brackets and taken elsewhere.
zh_tw: 火把可以從它們的支架上取下來並帶到其他地方。

english: 27. Forge of the Tomb Dwarves
zh_tw: 27. 墓穴矮人的鍛造場

english: Old wooden benches and shelves along the walls of this chamber are covered with gears, chains, trap components, and cages filled with rats. Lit iron braziers hang by chains from the ceiling. Along the north wall, a stepped dais is set with a bulky contraption: an iron maiden of sorts, attached to a network of steaming pistons, tubes, and bubbling vats of blood. Five masked dwarves operate the contraption.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上擺放著老舊的木凳和架子，上面佈滿了齒輪、鏈條、陷阱元件，以及裝滿老鼠的籠子。點燃的鐵製火盆透過鏈條懸掛在天花板上。在北牆邊，一個臺階狀的高臺上設定著一個笨重的裝置：一種鐵處女，連線著一個由蒸汽活塞、管子和冒泡的血池組成的網路。五個戴著面具的矮人正在操作這個裝置。

english: When the characters arrive, five tomb dwarves are working inside the chamber. Each one has the statistics of a {@creature wight}, except that it wields a battleaxe and a light crossbow. If the adventurers leave this area, there's a {@chance 50} chance that {@dice 1d4} of the other tomb dwarves prowling the dungeon are present when they return.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，五名墓穴矮人正在室內工作。每個矮人都擁有{@creature wight||屍妖}的屬性資料，但它們手持戰斧和輕型十字弩。如果冒險者離開此區域，當他們返回時有{@chance 50}的機率會遇到{@dice 1d4}名在墓穴中游蕩的其他墓穴矮人。

english: Any character who searches the forge uncovers enough gear to assemble two sets of {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, a set of {@item artisan's tools|PHB}, a set of {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, a set of {@item mason's tools|PHB}, and a set of {@item smith's tools|PHB}. The caged rats are used to test traps.
zh_tw: 任何搜尋該熔爐的角色都能發現足夠組裝兩套{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}、一套{@item artisan's tools|PHB|工匠工具}、一套{@item alchemist's supplies|PHB|鍊金工具}、一套{@item mason's tools|PHB|石匠工具}和一套{@item smith's tools|PHB|鐵匠工具}的裝備。籠中的老鼠被用來測試陷阱。

english: Iron Kiln
zh_tw: 鐵砧爐

english: The dwarves use the iron contraption on the dais to craft {@creature Tomb Guardian|ToA|tomb guardians} from the corpses of slain adventurers. As the characters arrive, the tomb dwarves are in the process of unleashing their newest creation.
zh_tw: 矮人們使用基座上的鐵製裝置從被殺冒險者的屍體中製造{@creature Tomb Guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛}。當角色們到達時，墓穴矮人們正在進行他們最新創造物的釋放過程。

english: The iron contraption shudders as it opens, releasing a hissing cloud of steam. Through the roiling vapor, an armored figure wearing a bucket helm stomps into view.
zh_tw: 鐵製裝置在開啟時震動著，釋放出一股嘶嘶作響的蒸汽。在翻滾的蒸汽中，一個戴著桶形頭盔的裝甲身影踏步進入視野。

english: The creature that emerges from the contraption is a {@creature tomb guardian|ToA}—a {@creature flesh golem} encased in plate armor (AC 17). This guardian was fashioned using the salvaged remains of Seward, an adventurer with the Company of the Yellow Banner, and a number of other unfortunate trespassers. Now a mindless undead, it attacks the characters on sight.
zh_tw: 從裝置中出現的生物是一個{@creature tomb guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛}——一個被板甲包裹的{@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}（AC 17）。這個守衛是用黃旗冒險團的冒險家西沃德的遺骸和其他一些不幸的入侵者的遺體製成的。現在它是一個沒有思想的不死生物，一看到角色就會攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Any character who searches the forge finds a {@item ghost lantern|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}) that once belonged to Seward. It lies on a bench next to some tools.
zh_tw: 任何搜尋鐵匠鋪的角色會發現一個{@item ghost lantern|ToA|幽魂燈籠}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}），它曾經屬於西沃德。它放在一張長椅上，旁邊有一些工具。

english: The spirit of a female moon elf warlock known as the Starfallen resides within the {@item ghost lantern|ToA}. If any character touches the lantern, the spirit can be seen within it. The spirit is insubstantial and can't be harmed, nor can it cause harm. It speaks and understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. If the lantern is destroyed, the spirit becomes trapped in the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 一位名為星隕的女性月精靈魔契師的靈魂居住在{@item ghost lantern|ToA|幽魂燈籠}內。如果任何角色觸碰燈籠，就能看到裡面的靈魂。這個靈魂是無實體的，不能受到傷害，也不能造成傷害。它說通用語、精靈語和森林語。如果燈籠被摧毀，靈魂將被困在噬魂器中。

english: The Starfallen was slain almost a thousand years ago by a fomorian. After her death, her soul inhabited the lantern. The Company of the Yellow Banner found the lantern and began questing for a way to return the Starfallen to life. The fabled Eye of Zaltec was said to possess the power to raise the ancient dead. The company tracked the jewel to the tomb and perished without ever finding it.
zh_tw: 星辰隕落者幾乎在一千年前被一位廢陋巨人殺死。她死後，她的靈魂寄居在燈籠裡。黃旗冒險團發現了燈籠，並開始尋找一種方法來使星辰隕落者復活。傳說中的扎爾特克之眼據說擁有復活古代死者的力量。黃旗冒險團追蹤寶石到了墓穴，但從未找到它就滅亡了。

english: The spirit of the Starfallen has weakened over time and grown forgetful. She remembers little of her past or her travels with the Company of the Yellow Banner, but certain things might jog her memory. If the players get stuck, you can use the Starfallen as a means to provide hints to keep the adventure on track.
zh_tw: 星隕的靈魂隨著時間的推移已經變得衰弱並開始健忘。她對自己過去的事情或與黃旗冒險團的旅行記憶甚少，但是某些事情可能會喚起她的記憶。如果玩家陷入困境，你可以利用星隕作為提供提示的手段，以保持冒險的正軌。

english: 28. Withers's Office
zh_tw: 28. 威瑟斯的辦公室

english: Candles dimly illuminate a cluttered office. A skeletal songbird rasps at you from a filthy cage in one corner. Other furnishing include a wooden writing desk and a tall-backed chair. Anatomical drawings sketched in charcoal hang on the wall behind the desk. Seated in the chair is the shriveled corpse of a humanoid wearing moldy robes and a bronze mask sculpted to look like a frowning visage. Around the figure's neck hangs a black skull-shaped amulet, and a number of severed hands crawl on the desk and floor around him.
zh_tw: 蠟燭昏暗地照亮了一個雜亂的辦公室。一隻骷髏般的鳴禽在角落裡的一個骯髒籠子裡對你嘶啞地叫著。其他的傢俱包括一個木製寫字檯和一把高背椅子。用木炭畫的解剖圖掛在桌子後面的牆上。坐在椅子裡的是一個乾癟的人形屍體，穿著發黴的長袍，戴著一個雕刻成皺眉表情的青銅面具。在這個人形的脖子上掛著一個黑色的骷髏形護身符，一些被切斷的手在他周圍的桌子和地板上爬行。

english: Before he was turned into an undead creature, {@creature Withers|ToA} was an Omuan engineer named Gorra. Like all of Omu's citizens, Gorra was enslaved and put to work constructing the tomb. When {@creature Acererak|ToA} sacrificed his workers to their own dungeon, Gorra's traps performed the best. This pleased the archlich enough that he transformed Gorra into a {@creature wight}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 在他變成不死生物之前，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯} 是一位名叫戈拉的奧穆工程師。像奧穆的所有公民一樣，戈拉被奴役並被迫建造墓穴。當{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 犧牲他的工人以建立自己的地牢時，戈拉的陷阱表現最佳。這足以讓大巫妖滿意，於是他將戈拉變成了一個{@creature wight||屍妖}，並有以下變化：

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} has an Intelligence of 16 (+3).
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的智力值為16（+3）。

english: He wears an {@item amulet of the black skull|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}) and doesn't carry a longbow.
zh_tw: 他佩戴著一個{@item amulet of the black skull|ToA|黑顱骨護符}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}），並且沒有攜帶長弓。

english: He has the Spellcasting feature described below.
zh_tw: 他具備以下描述的施法特性。

english: He has a challenge rating of 4 (1,100 XP).
zh_tw: 他的挑戰等級為4（1,100經驗值）。

english: Spellcasting
zh_tw: 施法

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 13}; {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯} 是一個9級施法者。他的施法屬性是智力（法術豁免 {@dc 13}；法術攻擊 {@hit 5}）。他準備了以下法師法術：

english: Cantrips (at will): {@spell acid splash}, {@spell mage hand}, {@spell minor illusion}, {@spell prestidigitation}
zh_tw: 隨意施展的戲法：{@spell acid splash||酸液飛濺}, {@spell mage hand||法師之手}, {@spell minor illusion||次級幻象}, {@spell prestidigitation||魔法伎倆}

english: 1st level (4 slots): {@spell detect magic}, {@spell expeditious retreat}, {@spell feather fall}, {@spell thunderwave}
zh_tw: 1環（4個法術位）：{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}, {@spell expeditious retreat||腳底抹油}, {@spell feather fall||羽落術}, {@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}

english: 2nd level (3 slots): {@spell darkness}, {@spell hold person}, {@spell rope trick}
zh_tw: 2環（3個法術位）：{@spell darkness||黑暗術}, {@spell hold person||定身類人}, {@spell rope trick||魔繩術}

english: 3rd level (3 slots): {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell lightning bolt}
zh_tw: 3環（3個法術位）：{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}, {@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}

english: 4th level (3 slots): {@spell blight}, {@spell wall of fire}
zh_tw: 4環（3個法術位）：{@spell blight||枯萎術}, {@spell wall of fire||火牆術}

english: 5th level (1 slot): {@spell telekinesis}
zh_tw: 5環法術（1個位）：{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}

english: When the characters arrive, {@creature Withers|ToA} is working at his desk. Seven {@creature Crawling Claw||crawling claws} follow him around and obey his commands.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯} 正在他的辦公桌前工作。七個{@creature Crawling Claw||蠕行之爪}跟隨著他並聽從他的命令。

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} is fiercely loyal to {@creature Acererak|ToA}. His passion for learning followed him into undeath, granting him a rare chance to study for eternity. The walls of his office are covered in papers on natural history and anatomy, and he uses the scrying pool in {@area area 25|39f|x} to study the natural world through the eyes of Omu's gargoyles.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}對{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}極其忠誠。他對學習的熱愛延續到了他的不死之身，賦予了他一個難得的機會，可以永遠地學習。他的辦公室牆壁上貼滿了自然歷史和解剖學的論文，他使用{@area 區域25|39f|x}區域的水晶球透過奧穆的石像鬼的眼睛研究自然世界。

english: When he encounters the characters, {@creature Withers|ToA} is keen to learn everything he can before killing them. He's particularly interested in current affairs in Chult and in the history of foreign lands. If the characters humor him, he behaves cordially while they answer his questions. Then with some regret, he finally announces that it's time for them to die. {@creature Withers|ToA} would rather escape than be destroyed or captured, so he uses his spells to retreat if the battle goes against him, saving {@spell wall of fire} to cut off pursuers when he flees.
zh_tw: 當他遇到角色們時，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}渴望在殺死他們之前儘可能多地瞭解一切。他對楚爾特當前的事務以及外國的歷史特別感興趣。如果角色們迎合他，他會在他們回答問題時表現得彬彬有禮。然後，帶著一些遺憾，他最終宣佈是時候讓他們死了。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}寧願逃跑也不願意被摧毀或被俘，因此如果戰鬥對他不利，他會使用他的法術撤退，並保留{@spell wall of fire||火牆術}法術來切斷追擊者的退路。

english: Journals
zh_tw: 日誌

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} is a diligent scribe. His moldy journals track the history of Omu and the Tomb of the Nine Gods, and detail the arrival of the atropal and the construction of the Soulmonger. Any character who spends 10 minutes flipping through the journals finds an entry that stands out. Give that character's player a copy of handout 22 in {@area appendix E|537|x}. To flesh out the journals further, refer to the "{@area History of Omu|1dc|x}" section in chapter 3 and "History of the Tomb" earlier in this chapter.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}是個勤奮的抄寫員。他發黴的日誌記錄了奧穆與九神之墓的歷史，也詳述萎縮者的到來和噬魂器的建造經過。任何花 10 分鐘翻閱日誌的角色，都會找到一則格外顯眼的紀錄。將{@area 附錄E|537|x}中的第 22 號講義交給該角色的玩家。若想進一步充實日誌內容，請參考第3章的「{@area 奧穆的歷史|1dc|x}」，以及本章前文的「墓穴的歷史」。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Withers|ToA} has enough equipment on his desk to assemble a scholar's pack. A {@item manual of golems} (clay) lies open on his desk next to a spellbook containing all the spells he has prepared. On the inside back cover of the spellbook is what appears to be a name: Khomara Blackfire. "Khomara" and "Blackfire" are actually the command words for the {@item mirror of life trapping} in {@area area 50|44c|x}.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的桌上有足夠的裝備，可湊成一套學者套組。一本{@item manual of golems||魔像手冊}（黏土）攤在桌上，旁邊的法術書記載了他準備的所有法術。法術書封底內側寫著看似姓名的字樣：Khomara Blackfire。其實「Khomara」與「Blackfire」是{@area 區域50|44c|x}那面{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}的口令。

english: The desk drawer contains a translucent, fist-sized gray stone that radiates an aura of enchantment to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. This stone is the control gem for the gray slaad in {@area area 24|398|x}. For more information on control gems, see the "Slaadi" entry in the {@i Monster Manual}.
zh_tw: 桌子的抽屜裡有一個半透明的、拳頭大小的灰色石頭，它向{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果散發出魔法的氣息。這塊石頭是{@area 區域24|398|x}區域灰色史拉蟾的控制寶石。有關控制寶石的更多資訊，請參見{@i 怪物圖鑑}中的"史拉蟾"條目。

english: {@creature Withers|ToA}'s skeletal songbird is tame but cantankerous. It can't fly, but it can be sold to a buyer in Port Nyanzaru for 75 gp. {@creature Withers|ToA}'s bronze mask is worth 25 gp.
zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的骷髏歌鳥被馴服但脾氣暴躁。它不能飛，但可以被賣給南扎路港的買家，售價為75金幣。{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的青銅面具價值25金幣。

english: Level 3: Vault of Reflection
zh_tw: 第三層：反思之庫

english: Map 5.3 shows this level of the dungeon, which an {@condition invisible} beholder named Belchorzh the Unseen (see {@area area 44|414|x}) claims as its home. It doesn't have access to lair actions and regional effects; instead, it has infected its home with weird alien growth.
zh_tw: 地圖5.3顯示了這個地牢的這一層次，一個名為「隱形者」貝爾科茲（不見的貝爾科茲，見{@area 區域44|414|x}）的{@condition invisible||隱形}巨眼獸聲稱這裡是它的家。它沒有巢穴動作和區域效果的使用權；相反，它用奇異的外星生長物感染了它的家園。

english: Map 5.3: Vault of Reflection
zh_tw: 地圖 5.3：反思之墓

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Alien Growth
zh_tw: 外星生長物

english: The beholder's aberrant influence permeates the stonework across this level of the tomb, causing purple mold to sprout from the floors, walls, and ceilings. The mold smells like rotting corpses and occasionally releases clouds of harmless spores. As characters move through areas with alien growth, tiny eyeballs emerge from the mold to scrutinize them. Belchorzh can see through these eyes and uses them to track the party's progress.
zh_tw: 邪眼怪的變異影響滲透了墓穴這一層次的石雕，導致紫色黴菌從地板、牆壁和天花板上生長出來。這種黴菌聞起來像腐爛的屍體，偶爾還會釋放出無害的孢子云。當角色穿過有異域生長的區域時，小小的眼球會從黴菌中浮現出來審視他們。貝爾克霍可以透過這些眼睛觀察，並利用它們追蹤隊伍的進展。

english: Any effect that deals fire, necrotic, or radiant damage destroys a patch of alien growth on contact. However, the beholder doesn't take kindly to the mold's destruction. When a patch of growth is destroyed, the next nearest patch sprouts a stubby eyestalk that shoots a randomly determined eye ray at the nearest character. (Roll a {@dice d10} and consult the {@creature beholder} stat block to determine which ray it produces.) After making this attack, the eyestalk quickly disappears back into the mold.
zh_tw: 任何造成火焰、死靈或光耀傷害的效果在接觸時都會摧毀一片異形生長物。然而，眼魔並不喜歡黴菌的破壞。當一片生長物被摧毀時，下一個最近的片會長出一根短粗的眼梗，射出一道隨機確定的眼睛射線攻擊最近的字元。（擲一個{@dice d10}並參考{@creature beholder||眼魔}的統計塊來確定它產生哪種射線。）發動這次攻擊後，眼梗迅速縮回黴菌中。

english: 29. Jackal Mask
zh_tw: 29. 豺狼面具

english: A huge carving of a snarling jackal's head protrudes from the wall at the end of this corridor. A chamber is visible through the gaps between its fangs.
zh_tw: 一隻咆哮的豺狼頭的巨大雕刻從走廊盡頭的牆壁上突出。透過它牙齒間的縫隙可以看到一個房間。

english: The gaps between the teeth are only 2 inches wide, but any character who looks through can see into {@area area 35|3d0|x}:
zh_tw: 牙齒間的縫隙只有2吋寬，但任何透過縫隙檢視的角色都能看到{@area 區域35|3d0|x}區域：

english: Four torches illuminate stone sphinxes crouched in the corners of this fifteen-foot-high room. The torches cast flickering light across hieroglyphs carved into the tiled floor. At the center of the room, a gold-inlaid funeral barge stands atop a three-foot-tall stone dais. Resting on the deck of the barge is a small golden sarcophagus decorated with horned rabbits. A dark shaft opens in the ceiling directly above the barge.
zh_tw: 四支火把照亮了蹲伏在這個十五尺高的房間角落的石制獅身人面像。火把在雕刻在瓷磚地板上的象形文字上投下閃爍的光芒。在房間的中心，一個鑲金的葬禮船隻矗立在一個三尺高的石制基座上。在船的甲板上休息著一個裝飾有角兔的小金棺。一個黑暗的豎井在船的正上方的天花板上開啟。

english: This view is a magical window into the past. Whoever looks through the jackal's jaws sees a vision of I'jin's tomb ({@area area 35|3d0|x}) as it was just before the last person entered it. After a few moments, the vision reveals a person entering the chamber.
zh_tw: 這個視角是一個通向過去的魔法視窗。任何透過豺狼的顎部看的人都能看到一個關於艾金的墓穴（{@area 區域35|3d0|x}）的幻象，就像最後一個人進入之前的樣子。過了一會兒，幻象揭示了一個人進入了房間。

english: A slab of wall suddenly grinds upward to the east, and a dwarf wearing a turban and chain mail creeps into the tomb. He brandishes a shield in front of him as he treads cautiously across the floor.
zh_tw: 一塊牆板突然向東向上磨動，一個戴著頭巾和鎖子甲的矮人悄悄進入墓穴。他揮舞著盾牌，小心翼翼地穿過地板。

english: The magic here records the last moments of Bravus Boulderborn, hero of the Company of the Yellow Banner. The dwarf ignores any attempts by the characters to communicate with him.
zh_tw: 這裡的魔法記錄了黃旗冒險團英雄布拉弗斯·鮑爾德伯恩的最後時刻。這位矮人忽視了角色們與他交流的任何嘗試。

english: A loud click sounds out as the dwarf steps onto one of the floor tiles. Then a deafening buzzing rises as locusts pour out from the mouths of the sphinx statues, quickly engulfing him. He tries to fight them off, to no avail. When the cloud of insects vanishes, nothing of the dwarf remains except its bones and gear.
