zh_tw: 當矮人踩上其中一塊地磚時，發出了一聲響亮的點選聲。隨後，隨著蝗蟲從斯芬克斯雕像的口中湧出，一陣震耳欲聾的嗡嗡聲響起，很快就將他吞沒了。他試圖反擊，但無濟於事。當昆蟲群消失後，除了骨頭和裝備外，矮人的一切都不見了。

english: If all the characters turn away, the vision resets. When any character next looks through the mask, the dwarf is seen entering I'jin's tomb once more.
zh_tw: 如果所有角色轉身離開，幻象將重置。當任何角色下次透過面具看時，會看到矮人再次進入艾金的墓穴。

english: The jackal mask radiates an aura of divination to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. If any character uses teleportation or other magic to bypass the teeth and enter the tomb, the dwarf's moldering skeleton is discovered in {@area area 35|3d0|x}.
zh_tw: 豺狼面具向{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果散發出占卜魔法的氣息。如果任何角色使用傳送或其他魔法繞過牙齒進入墓穴，將會在{@area 區域35|3d0|x}區域發現矮人的腐爛骨架。

english: 30. Iron Barrier
zh_tw: 30. 鐵製屏障

english: Ahead of you, the face of a snarling minotaur is etched into a sheet of iron that bisects the crawlway. Its eyes have been cut out, letting you see through the sheet, beyond which the tunnel continues onward.
zh_tw: 在你們前方，一張咆哮的牛頭人面孔被刻在一塊鐵板上，鐵板將爬行通道一分為二。它的眼睛被挖空了，讓你可以透過鐵板看到另一邊，隧道在那邊繼續延伸。

english: The minotaur face is etched into both sides of a 1-inch-thick, sharp-edged iron sheet that blocks the crawlway. The holes that form the eyes are 2 inches wide. The characters can use spells such as {@spell gaseous form} and {@spell misty step} to move past the iron sheet.
zh_tw: 牛頭怪的面孔被刻在一塊1吋厚、鋒利邊緣的鐵板上，鐵板阻擋了爬行通道。形成眼睛的洞孔寬2吋。角色們可以使用如{@spell gaseous form||氣化形體}和{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}這樣的法術來穿過鐵板。

english: Any character who examines the barrier discovers that it slides up into the ceiling. Coiled springs provide resistance, and a successful {@dc 17} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check is needed to lift the sheet. If the check succeeds, a hidden latch locks the sheet in place, allowing creatures to crawl underneath it. Unless it is wedged in place with an iron spike, a stout weapon, or a similar object, the barrier snaps down after 1 minute, sealing the crawlway once more. Any creature underneath the sheet when it snaps shut must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@dice 8d10}) slashing damage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is chopped in two.
zh_tw: 任何檢查這道屏障的角色都會發現它可以滑入天花板。卷簧提供了阻力，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定才能舉起這塊板。如果檢定成功，隱藏的閂鎖會將板固定住，允許生物從下方爬過。除非用鐵釘、堅固的武器或類似的物體將其楔住，否則屏障會在1分鐘後迅速落下，再次封住爬行通道。當屏障迅速關閉時，任何在板下方的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免，否則將受到44（{@dice 8d10}）點揮砍傷害。任何因此傷害降至0點生命值的生物將被切成兩半。

english: 31. Reflected Hall
zh_tw: 31. 反射大廳

english: A curtain of water separates two hallways that are basically mirror images of one another. When characters enter the first hall, read:
zh_tw: 一道水簾隔開了兩個基本上是彼此映象的走廊。當角色進入第一個走廊時，請閱讀：

english: Still puddles of water cover the floor of this fifteen-foot-wide hallway. The walls are slick with moisture and set with murals showing animal-headed humanoids in armor, most of which appear to brandish real weapons hanging on the walls. A three-foot-high crawlway in the east wall is flush with the floor. At the far end of the hall, a rippling, transparent curtain of water fills a stone archway. Beyond the curtain, you see another hallway that looks similar to the one in which you stand.
zh_tw: 這個十五尺寬的走廊地面上覆蓋著靜止的水坑。牆壁因潮溼而光滑，並裝飾著壁畫，壁畫上展示著戴有動物頭部的類人生物穿著盔甲，其中大部分似乎揮舞著掛在牆上的真正武器。東牆上有一個三尺高的爬行通道，與地面齊平。在大廳的遠端，一道波光粼粼的透明水簾填滿了一個石拱門。在水簾的另一邊，你看到另一個看起來和你所在的走廊相似的走廊。

english: The tarnished weapons hanging on the walls are in poor condition and are held in place with hooks to make it appear as though the painted warriors are holding them.
zh_tw: 掛在牆上的失去光澤的武器狀況很差，它們用鉤子固定，使得看起來像是畫中的戰士們拿著它們。

english: Twelve painted figures line each hall, six on the west wall and six on the east wall, directly across from one another. Figures on facing walls are perfect reflections of each other.
zh_tw: 每個走廊兩側各有十二個彩繪人物，西牆上六個，東牆上六個，彼此正對著。相對牆壁上的人物是彼此的完美映象。

english: South Hall
zh_tw: 南大廳

english: From south to north, the warriors and weapons in this hall are as follows:
zh_tw: 從南到北，這個大廳裡的戰士和武器如下所示：

english: Stork-headed males with handaxes (the figure on the east wall has the crawlway to {@area area 36|3dd|x} between its legs)
zh_tw: 鶴頭男性手持手斧（東牆上的雕像在兩腿之間有通往{@area 區域36|3dd|x}的爬行通道）

english: Lizard-headed females with maces
zh_tw: 長著蜥蜴頭的女性手持釘頭錘

english: Panther-headed males with blowguns
zh_tw: 豹頭男性手持吹箭

english: Unarmed hawk-headed females (the east mural is illusory; see area 31A)
zh_tw: 未武裝的鷹頭女性（東壁畫是幻象；見區域31A）

english: Goat-headed males with sickles
zh_tw: 長著山羊頭的男性手持鐮刀

english: Frog-headed females with tridents
zh_tw: 蛙頭女性手持三叉戟

english: North Hall
zh_tw: 北大廳

english: From south to north, the warriors and weapons in this hall are as follows:
zh_tw: 從南到北，這個大廳裡的戰士和武器如下所示：

english: Frog-headed females with tridents
zh_tw: 蛙頭女性手持三叉戟

english: Goat-headed males with sickles
zh_tw: 長著山羊頭的男性手持鐮刀

english: Unarmed hawk-headed females (the east mural is illusory; see area 31A)
zh_tw: 未武裝的鷹頭女性（東壁畫是幻象；見區域31A）

english: Panther-headed males with blowguns
zh_tw: 豹頭男性手持吹箭

english: Lizard-headed females with maces
zh_tw: 長著蜥蜴頭的女性手持釘頭錘

english: Stork-headed males with handaxes (the figure on the east wall has the crawlway to {@area area 32|3c2|x} between its legs)
zh_tw: 鶴頭男性手持手斧（東牆上的雕像在其雙腿之間有通往{@area 區域32|3c2|x}的爬行通道）

english: 31A. Hidden Alcoves
zh_tw: 31A. 隱藏凹室

english: Two alcoves are hidden behind 5-foot-wide, 8-foot-tall illusions of damp stone walls bearing paintings of hawk-headed female warriors. Touching the surface of either section of wall reveals that its stones and the images on them are illusions.
zh_tw: 兩個壁龕隱藏在5尺寬、8尺高的潮溼石牆幻象後面，牆上繪有鷹頭女戰士的畫。觸控任一部分牆面揭示了其石頭和上面的影象都是幻象。

english: Each alcove contains a plinth bearing a crystal eyeball 1 inch in diameter: a pale purple eyeball to the south and a bright green eyeball to the north.
zh_tw: 每個壁龕內都有一個基座，上面放置著一個直徑為1吋的水晶眼球：南邊是一個淡紫色的眼球，北邊是一個鮮綠色的眼球。

english: Crystal Eyes
zh_tw: 水晶之眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eyes are two of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這對非魔法水晶之眼是開啟邪眼怪金庫（{@area 區域44|414|x}）所需的十把鑰匙中的兩把。

english: 31B. Curtain of Water
zh_tw: 31B. 水簾

english: Clear water forms a 1-foot-thick, 7-foot-high, 10-foot-wide curtain between the two hallways, radiating an aura of conjuration magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 17}) cast on the curtain causes it to vanish, leaving the archway open. The curtain magically reappears after 1 hour.
zh_tw: 清澈的水在兩條走廊之間形成了一道1尺厚、7尺高、10尺寬的水幕，散發出一種咒法魔法的靈光，可以被{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果偵測到。成功地在水幕上施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} ({@dc 17}) 會使水幕消失，使拱門敞開。水幕在1小時後會魔法般地重新出現。

english: If any creature passes through the curtain of water carrying a trident, nothing happens. Any trident will do, not just the ones in the hallways.
zh_tw: 如果任何生物攜帶三叉戟穿過水幕，什麼也不會發生。任何三叉戟都可以，不僅僅是走廊裡的那些。

english: If any creature passes through the curtain without a trident, the water erupts as a fierce wave flowing north and south. Any creature in either hall is slammed by the water and must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 14 ({@dice 4d6}) bludgeoning damage and is swept to the end of the hall with such great force that it falls {@condition prone}. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes half damage and falls {@condition prone}, but is not swept away. The weapons hooked on the walls remain where they are.
zh_tw: 如果有任何生物在沒有三叉戟的情況下穿過簾幕，水會像猛烈的波浪般南北方向爆發。任何一個廳內的生物都會被水猛擊，必須進行一次{@dc 15}力量豁免。如果豁免失敗，該生物將受到14（{@dice 4d6}）點鈍擊傷害，並被巨大的力量掃到大廳盡頭，使其{@condition prone||伏地}。成功透過豁免的生物只受到一半傷害並{@condition prone||伏地}，但不會被掃走。掛在牆上的武器保持原位。

english: Water expelled by the curtain disappears before it can flow beyond the confines of the hallways. The water also does not enter either of the hidden alcoves (area 31A), so creatures there are safe from the waves' effect.
zh_tw: 水幕排出的水在流到走廊範圍之外前就消失了。水也不會進入兩個隱藏的壁龕（區域31A），因此那裡的生物不受波浪影響。

english: The water conjured by the curtain leaks out of the hall through tiny cracks in the floor, leaving puddles behind.
zh_tw: 由水幕召喚的水透過地板上的小裂縫滲漏出大廳，留下水坑。

english: 32. Rotating Crawlways
zh_tw: 32. 旋轉通道

english: Any character searching for traps or secret doors in this tunnel notices a narrow seam in the stonework with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. This seam marks one end of a 25-foot-long section of crawlway (marked "Tunnel A" on map 5.3) that rotates. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the character can deduce that the seam represents a point where two sections of tunnel can detach from one another.
zh_tw: 任何在這條隧道中搜尋陷阱或秘密門洞的角色，若成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定，會注意到石工中有一條狹窄的縫隙。這條縫隙標誌著25尺長的爬行道（在地圖5.3上標記為"隧道A"）的一個端點，該爬行道可以旋轉。如果檢定成功超過5或更多，角色可以推斷出這條縫隙表示隧道兩部分可以分離的點。

english: When 50 pounds or more of weight is applied to the floor at the midpoint of tunnel A, a mechanism causes the tunnel to quickly rotate 90 degrees clockwise and sink 5 feet as it turns. Both ends of the tunnel are immediately cut off, trapping creatures inside. At the same time, a second crawlway perpendicular to the first (marked "Tunnel B" on map 5.3) rotates 90 degrees clockwise and sinks into place, positioned where tunnel A used to be. Characters who are flying, in gaseous form, or otherwise effectively weightless do not trigger the trap and can move through the tunnel safely.
zh_tw: 當隧道A的中點施加了50磅或更多的重量時，一個機制會使隧道快速順時針旋轉90度並在轉動時下沉5尺。隧道的兩端立即被切斷，困住裡面的生物。同時，第二個與第一個垂直的爬行通道（在地圖5.3上標記為"隧道B"）順時針旋轉90度並下沉到位，位於隧道A原來的位置。飛行中的角色、處於氣態形態的，或者以其他方式有效無重量的角色不會觸發陷阱，可以安全地穿過隧道。

english: Rotating Tunnel
zh_tw: 旋轉隧道

english: Read the following text to players the first time their characters are caught in a rotating tunnel:
zh_tw: 當玩家的角色第一次被困在旋轉隧道中時，請向他們朗讀以下文字：

english: With a loud grinding noise, this section of crawlway begins to rotate, instantly cutting off the exits ahead and behind. You can feel the passage sink about five feet as it turns. After a few seconds, it comes to a stop and the grinding abates.
zh_tw: 隨著一聲刺耳的摩擦聲，這段爬行通道開始旋轉，立即切斷了前方和後方的出口。你可以感覺到通道在轉動時下沉了大約五尺。幾秒鐘後，它停止了轉動，摩擦聲也隨之消失。

english: When tunnel B connects to the rest of the crawlway, a new passage running north to south is formed. Tunnel B is trapped similarly to tunnel A, except that both tunnels ascend 5 feet as they rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise when the trap triggers. The only way to return tunnel A to its original position is to trigger the trap from tunnel B, and vice versa.
zh_tw: 當隧道B與其餘的爬行通道相連時，形成了一條新的南北向通道。隧道B的陷阱設定與隧道A類似，只是當觸發陷阱時，兩個隧道在逆時針旋轉90度的同時上升5尺。將隧道A恢復到原始位置的唯一方法是從隧道B觸發陷阱，反之亦然。

english: Characters trapped in a section of tunnel not connected to the rest of the crawlway have no clear means of escape. The tunnel is airtight. A single creature consumes the available air supply in 24 hours, with multiple creatures dividing that time up between them. For example, four creatures trapped in the tunnel could survive 6 hours before they begin to suffocate.
zh_tw: 被困在與爬行通道其餘部分不相連的隧道部分的角色沒有明顯的逃生方法。隧道是密封的。一個生物在24小時內會消耗掉可用的空氣供應，多個生物則按比例分配這個時間。例如，四個生物被困在隧道中，它們可以在開始窒息之前存活6小時。

english: Skeletal Remains
zh_tw: 遺骨殘骸

english: Any character who can see into tunnel B notices the body of an unlucky adventurer.
zh_tw: 任何能夠看到隧道B的角色都會注意到一個不幸的冒險者的屍體。

english: As a new tunnel rotates into place, you see a skeletal corpse lying on the floor of that tunnel, about ten feet away.
zh_tw: 當一個新的隧道旋轉到位時，你看到一具骸骨屍體躺在那個隧道的地板上，大約十尺遠。

english: The corpse belongs to Sephirius, dragonborn paladin of the Company of the Yellow Banner. Looting the body reveals several items of interest (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 這具屍體屬於黃旗冒險團的龍族聖武士賽菲利烏斯（塞菲里烏斯）。搜查屍體會發現幾件有趣的物品（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Sephirius wore no armor but carried a {@item +1 yklwa} (see "{@area Buying a Special Item|084|x}" in chapter 1 for more information on this weapon), a dungeoneer's pack, a pouch containing 8 gp, an ivory back scratcher shaped like a dinosaur claw (25 gp), a holy symbol of Bahamut (25 gp), and a red crystal eyeball measuring 1 inch in diameter.
zh_tw: 塞菲里烏斯沒有穿盔甲，但攜帶了一把{@item +1 yklwa||+1 伊庫瓦短矛}（見第1章中的"{@area 購買特殊物品|084|x}"以獲取有關這種武器的更多資訊），一個探險家揹包，一個包含8金幣的小袋，一個形狀像恐龍爪的象牙背刮器（25金幣），一個巴哈姆特的聖徽（25金幣），以及一個直徑1吋的紅色水晶眼球。

english: Crystal Eye
zh_tw: 水晶眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eye is one of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這個非魔法的水晶眼球是開啟邪眼怪金庫所需的十把鑰匙之一（{@area 區域44|414|x}）。

english: 33. Chamber of Opposition
zh_tw: 33. 對立之室

english: This chamber contains a stone font filled with a steaming green liquid. Beyond it, a shadowy figure stands at an open door on the far side of the room. The figure's back is toward you.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一個石盆，裡面裝滿了冒著熱氣的綠色液體。在石盆的另一邊，一個朦朧的身影站在房間遠處的一扇敞開的門前，背對著你。

english: The stone font is attached to the floor and can't be tipped over. It is also impervious to damage and spells. It appears to hold 40 pints (5 gallons) of hot soup, but the liquid is illusory. Tactile exploration reveals that the liquid has no substance and the font is dry.
zh_tw: 這個石制容器固定在地板上，無法傾倒。它也對傷害和法術免疫。它看起來可以裝40品脫（5加侖）的熱湯，但液體是虛幻的。觸覺探索揭示了液體沒有實質，容器是乾的。

english: The dark figure is a magical, illusory duplicate of whichever character opened the door to the room. It copies the character's movements, allowing a shrewd player to use the duplicate to dispense with the liquid in the font. The shadow duplicate has the statistics of a {@creature commoner} and is immune to poison damage. It perfectly matches the motions of the character who created it, always keeping its back to its creator as though it was a projected image 15 feet ahead.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗的身影是開啟房間門的角色的魔法幻影複製體。它模仿角色的動作，讓一個精明的玩家可以使用這個複製體來處理盆中的液體。這個影子複製體具有{@creature commoner||平民}的具體數值，並對毒素傷害免疫。它完美地模仿創造它的那個角色的動作，總是將其背對著創造者，就好像它是一個15尺前方的投影影象。

english: If the character who created the shadow duplicate moves backward, the duplicate moves toward the font. If the character then mimes drinking from the font, the duplicate slurps up the "soup" at a rate of 5 pints per round, draining the font in 8 rounds. Once the font is drained of illusory soup, a treasure appears in the font that wasn't there before (see "Treasure" below). Casting {@spell dispel magic} on the font causes the illusory soup to vanish, but the treasure does not appear. The illusory soup reappears 1 minute later.
zh_tw: 如果創造了影子複製體的角色向後移動，複製體會向盆移動。如果角色接著模擬從盆中喝水的動作，複製體會以每輪5品脫的速度吸食'湯'，在8輪內將盆吸空。一旦盆中的幻象湯被吸完，盆中會出現之前不存在的寶藏（見下文'寶藏'部分）。對盆施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}會導致幻象湯消失，但寶藏不會出現。幻象湯1分鐘後會重新出現。

english: The shadow duplicate can't exert pressure on objects and glides through any obstacles it encounters. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on the figure causes it to vanish. It doesn't react to taking damage but disappears if it drops to 0 hit points or is made to leave the chamber. Closing the door to the room and reopening it creates a new duplicate of whoever opened the door. There can be only one shadow duplicate at a time.
zh_tw: 影子複製體無法對物體施加壓力，並且可以滑過它遇到的任何障礙物。對這個角色施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}會使其消失。它不會對受到傷害做出反應，但如果降至0生命值或被迫離開房間就會消失。關閉房間的門再重新開啟會建立開門者的一個新的複製體。一次只能存在一個影子複製體。

english: The shadow duplicate has a terrible and deadly aspect. Any creature that looks upon its face sees a horrific visage locked in a silent scream and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or drop to 0 hit points. A creature that cannot be {@condition frightened} automatically succeeds on the saving throw.
zh_tw: 陰影複製體具有可怕而致命的外貌。任何生物看到它的臉時，會看到一個鎖定在無聲尖叫中的恐怖面容，並且必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，否則生命值將降至 0。無法被 {@condition frightened||恐懼} 的生物自動透過豁免檢定。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If a shadow duplicate drinks all the illusory soup in the font, a 1-inch-diameter eyeball made of incandescent orange crystal appears at the bottom of the font and can easily be removed. If the eye is taken from the font and later put back, it disappears and the illusory soup effect is reset.
zh_tw: 如果影子複製體喝光了盆中的幻象湯，一個由白熱橙色水晶製成的直徑1吋的眼球將出現在盆底，並且可以輕易取出。如果眼球從盆中取出後再放回去，它將消失，幻象湯的效果將被重置。

english: Crystal Eye
zh_tw: 水晶眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eye is one of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這個非魔法的水晶眼球是開啟邪眼怪金庫所需的十把鑰匙之一（{@area 區域44|414|x}）。

english: Empty Closet
zh_tw: 空衣櫃

english: East of the font is a dusty, empty room.
zh_tw: 盆的東側是一個佈滿灰塵的空房間。

english: 34. Peephole
zh_tw: 34. 窺視孔

english: If one or more characters approach this area from the south, read:
zh_tw: 如果有一名或多名角色從南方接近這個區域，請閱讀：

english: The corridor turns sharply to the left. At the corner just before the turn, a peephole is carved into the stone wall at a height of 6 feet.
zh_tw: 走廊在左邊急轉彎。在轉彎前的角落，一個窺視孔被雕刻在6尺高的石牆上。

english: The peephole forms one end of a 5-foot-long tube cut through the solid rock wall. Magnifying lenses set throughout the tube give anyone who peers through the hole a clear view of the gold medallion in area 35A and the hieroglyph visible on the dial behind it. In addition, a creature looking through the peephole can communicate telepathically with creatures in area 35B. Using the peephole, a character can identify the correct sequence of floor tiles to step on in area 35B and communicate that information to everyone in I'jin's tomb.
zh_tw: 窺視孔是穿過堅固巖壁的5尺長管道的一端。管道中設定的放大鏡片讓透過孔洞窺視的人可以清楚地看到35A區域中的金色獎章以及其背後轉盤上的象形文字。此外，透過窺視孔觀察的生物可以與35B區域的生物進行心靈感應溝通。利用窺視孔，角色可以識別出35B區域中正確的地磚順序，並將這些資訊傳達給艾金墓穴中的每個人。

english: 35. I'jin's Tomb
zh_tw: 35. 艾金的墓

english: Characters can reach this area via {@area area 18|37b|x}, by lowering the stone block in the east wall (area 35A), or by slipping between the teeth of the jackal visage at {@area area 29|3b3|x}.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過{@area 區域18|37b|x}到達這個區域，透過降低東牆（區域35A）的石塊，或者透過{@area 區域29|3b3|x}處的豺狼面具的牙齒間隙滑過來。

english: 35A. Stone Block
zh_tw: 35A. 石塊

english: A 5-foot-wide, 5-foot-thick, 12-foot-tall block of solid stone fills the doorway leading to I'jin's tomb (area 35B). The block is featureless on the side that faces the tomb, and it is impervious to damage and spells. If the characters approach the block from the east, read:
zh_tw: 一塊5尺寬、5尺厚、12尺高的實心石塊填滿了通往艾金墓穴（區域35B）的門口。石塊面向墓穴的一側沒有任何特徵，並且對傷害和法術免疫。如果角色從東側接近石塊，請閱讀：

english: The corridor ends at a block of stone on which is painted a seven-foot-tall jackal-headed humanoid with a circular gold medallion around its neck. All around the figure are carvings of locusts.
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭是一塊石頭，上面畫著一個七尺高的豺狼頭類人生物，它的脖子上掛著一個圓形的金色獎章。這個生物的四周都是蝗蟲的雕刻。

english: Close inspection reveals that one of the carved locusts is a button that can be pushed. When this happens, the stone block sinks into the floor, creating an open passage to the tomb (area 35B).
zh_tw: 仔細檢查會發現，其中一個雕刻的蝗蟲是一個可以按下的按鈕。當按下這個按鈕時，石塊會沉入地板，從而為通往墓穴（區域35B）的通道開啟一條通路。

english: The "medallion" worn by the jackal-headed painting is actually a 6-inch-diameter gold disk engraved with the face of a horned devil, its mouth agape. Lodged behind this disk is a clay dial etched with eight hieroglyphs. One hieroglyph (a vulture) is visible through a hole that forms the devil's gaping mouth, but the dial is locked in place and its remaining seven hieroglyphs are hidden from view behind the medallion.
zh_tw: 豺狼頭畫像所佩戴的'獎章'實際上是一個直徑6吋的金盤，上面雕刻著一個張嘴的角魔的面孔。在這個盤後面是一個粘土轉盤，上面刻有八個象形文字。其中一個象形文字（一個禿鷲）透過形成魔鬼張嘴的孔洞可見，但是轉盤被固定住了，其餘七個象形文字被獎章遮擋，看不見。

english: If any character steps on a vulture floor tile in area 35B, the dial turns, revealing a new hieroglyph: a serpent. One hieroglyph at a time, the dial reveals the correct sequence of floor tiles to stand on: vulture, serpent, door, reed, scarab, scepter, foot, and urn. Stepping on a floor tile that matches the hieroglyph on the dial causes the dial to turn, revealing the next symbol in the sequence.
zh_tw: 如果任何角色在區域35B踩到禿鷲地磚，轉盤會轉動，展示一個新的象形文字：一條蛇。轉盤會一次揭示一個正確的地磚順序：禿鷲、蛇、門、蘆葦、聖甲蟲、權杖、腳和骨灰甕。踩到與轉盤上象形文字匹配的地磚會導致轉盤轉動，展示序列中的下一個符號。

english: The gold medallion is attached to the stone block with {@item sovereign glue}, and removing it requires {@item universal solvent}. However, one can simply destroy the medallion to get at the dial underneath. Removing or destroying the medallion exposes the dial and its eight hieroglyphs.
zh_tw: 金色獎章是用{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}貼上在石塊上的，移除它需要{@item universal solvent||萬溶劑}。然而，也可以簡單地破壞獎章以到達下面的轉盤。移除或破壞獎章會暴露出轉盤及其八個象形文字。

english: Once the medallion is out of the way, the dial can be easily removed from its spoke inside the stone block. However, removing the dial releases a corrosive gas trapped within the block. The gas escapes through tiny holes hidden behind the dial and fills the 5-foot space directly east of the block. Any creature in this area when the gas is released must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A character who searches for traps can detect the holes hidden behind the dial with a {@dc 25} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check; once found, these holes can be plugged with wax before the dial is removed, preventing the gas from escaping.
zh_tw: 一旦徽章被移開，刻度盤就可以輕鬆從石塊內部的輻條上取下。然而，取下刻度盤會釋放出被困在石塊內的腐蝕性氣體。氣體透過隱藏在刻度盤後面的小孔逸出，並填滿石塊正東方向的5尺空間。當氣體釋放時，任何位於該區域的生物必須進行一次 {@dc 14} 體質豁免，若豁免失敗則受到44 ({@dice 8d10}) 點強酸傷害，若豁免成功則受到一半傷害。一個搜尋陷阱的角色可以透過 {@dc 25} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定來探測到隱藏在刻度盤後面的小孔；一旦發現這些小孔，可以在取下刻度盤之前用蠟將它們堵住，從而防止氣體逸出。

english: 35B. Tomb
zh_tw: 35B. 墓穴

english: Four torches illuminate stone sphinxes crouched in the corners of this fifteen-foot-high room. The torches cast flickering light across hieroglyphs carved into the tiled floor. At the center of the room, a gold-inlaid funeral barge stands atop a three-foot-tall stone dais. Resting on the deck of the barge is a small golden sarcophagus decorated with horned rabbits. A dark shaft opens in the ceiling directly above the barge, while to the south, a corridor is visible through a set of fangs carved into the wall.
zh_tw: 四支火把照亮了蹲伏在這個十五尺高的房間角落的石制獅身人面像。火把在雕刻在瓷磚地板上的象形文字上投下閃爍的光芒。在房間的中心，一個鑲金的葬禮船隻矗立在一個三尺高的石制基座上。在船的甲板上休息著一個裝飾有角兔的小金棺。一個黑暗的豎井在船的正上方的天花板上開啟，而往南邊，透過牆上雕刻的一組獠牙，可以看到一條走廊。

english: The skeleton of a dwarf sprawls on the floor east of the barge, clad in a tattered yellow turban and dusty chain mail, and clutching a bronze shield.
zh_tw: 一具矮人的骸骨橫臥在船隻東側的地板上，身穿破爛的黃色頭巾和沾滿灰塵的鎖子甲，並且緊握著一個銅盾。

english: To unlock I'jin's sarcophagus, eight floor tiles must be stepped on in the correct sequence (see "Hieroglyphic Floor" below and handout 23 in {@area appendix E|537|x}). Stepping on the tiles in the wrong order triggers a trap (see "Sphinx Statues" below).
zh_tw: 要解鎖艾金的石棺，必須按照正確的順序踩踏八塊地板磚（見下方的"象形文字地板"和{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中的附錄 23）。踩錯順序會觸發陷阱（見下方的"獅身人面像雕像"）。

english: The skeletal remains were once Bravus Boulderborn, a gold dwarf cleric of Moradin and former member of the Company of the Yellow Banner. Bravus died as a result of stepping on floor tiles in the wrong order, and his body lies atop a floor tile bearing the "foot" hieroglyph. A search of the body yields some valuables (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 這具骸骨曾經是布拉弗斯·鮑爾德伯恩，一位屬於摩拉丁的金矮人牧師，也是黃旗冒險團的前成員。布拉弗斯因為按錯順序踩踏地磚而死，他的屍體躺在帶有"足"象形文字的地磚上。對屍體的搜尋會發現一些貴重物品（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Four torches light the room. As long as they remain in their brackets, they never burn out. If a torch is removed from its bracket, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 四支火把照亮了這個房間。只要它們保持在支架上，就永遠不會燃盡。如果火把從支架上移除，它就會正常燃燒完。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Nangnang or Shagambi receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被娜浪或莎根比的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Skittish yet greedy Nangnang wants her host to loot the corpse of the dead dwarf before anyone else can.
zh_tw: 既膽怯又貪婪的娜浪希望她的宿主在別人之前去搜刮死去矮人的屍體。

english: Wise Shagambi suggests that there might be a clue nearby to suggest which floor tiles are safe to walk on.
zh_tw: 明智的莎根比建議附近可能有一個線索，可以提示哪些地磚是安全的行走區域。

english: Hieroglyphic Floor
zh_tw: 象形文字地板

english: The floor around the dais and the statues is covered with 5-foot-square stone tiles, each one etched with a hieroglyph. Give the players handout 23 in {@area appendix E|537|x}.
zh_tw: 高臺和雕像周圍的地面上鋪滿了5尺見方的石磚，每一塊石磚上都刻有一個象形文字。給玩家們分發{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中的第23號資料。

english: Characters can avoid triggering the floor tiles by flying or by climbing along the walls and ceiling. Climbing the walls requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Those who set foot on the tiles must traverse them in the proper sequence or suffer the consequences.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過飛行或沿著牆壁和天花板攀爬來避免觸發地磚。攀爬牆壁需要成功的 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。那些踏上地磚的人必須按照正確的順序穿越，否則將承受後果。

english: If any character steps onto a tile and the passage to the east is open, the stone block at area 35A rises to seal the tunnel. Any creature atop the block when it meets the ceiling must succeed on a {@dc 7} Dexterity saving throw to leap clear in one direction or the other. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is crushed to a pulp. Otherwise, the creature falls {@condition prone} inside the tomb.
zh_tw: 如果任何角色踏上地磚並且向東的通道是開放的，區域35A的石塊會上升以封堵隧道。當石塊與天花板接觸時，任何位於石塊上的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 7}敏捷豁免檢定，以便向一個方向或另一個方向跳開。如果豁免失敗，該生物將受到55（{@dice 10d10}）的鈍擊傷害。任何因這次傷害而生命值降至0的生物將被壓成肉泥。否則，該生物將{@condition prone||伏地}在墳墓內。

english: The correct sequence of floor tiles matches the order in which the hieroglyphs appear on the clay dial in area 35A: vulture, serpent, door, reed, scarab, scepter, foot, urn. Each time a character steps on a correct floor tile, a new hieroglyph clicks into view on the clay dial, with that view accessible by any character using the peephole in {@area area 34|3ce|x}. The dial rotates through all the hieroglyphs in the correct order. If any character steps on a hieroglyph out of order, the statues react as described in "Sphinx Statues." Stepping on the wrong tile does not reset the sequence.
zh_tw: 正確的地板瓷磚順序與區域35A中的黏土轉盤上的象形文字出現順序一致：禿鷲、蛇、門、蘆葦、甲蟲、權杖、腳、甕。每當一個角色踏上正確的瓷磚時，一個新的象形文字會在黏土轉盤上顯現，任何角色都可以透過{@area 區域34|3ce|x}的窺視孔看到這一景象。轉盤會按照正確的順序旋轉顯示所有象形文字。如果有角色踩錯了象形文字的順序，雕像會如"獅身人面像雕像"中描述的那樣做出反應。踩錯瓷磚不會重置順序。

english: When the final tile in the sequence is stepped on, the following things all happen at once:
zh_tw: 當順序中的最後一個地磚被踩到時，以下所有事情會同時發生：

english: I'jin's sarcophagus opens.
zh_tw: 艾金的金棺開啟了。

english: The stone block at area 35A sinks into the floor, creating an open passage to the east.
zh_tw: 區域35A的石塊沉入地板，形成了向東的開放通道。

english: Any locusts conjured by the sphinx statues are dispelled.
zh_tw: 由獅身人面像召喚的任何蝗蟲都被驅散了。

english: The hieroglyphic floor is disabled. After 24 hours, {@creature Withers|ToA} sends {@dice 1d4} tomb dwarves to reset the trap.
zh_tw: 象形文字地板已失效。24小時後，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}派遣{@dice 1d4}名墓穴矮人來重置陷阱。

english: Sphinx Statues
zh_tw: 獅身人面像雕像

english: Each of these statues depicts a life-size gynosphinx, and all four radiate auras of abjuration and conjuration to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. The statues are impervious to damage and spells.
zh_tw: 這些雕像中的每一個都描繪了一個等身大小的雌獅身人面像，並且全部四個都對{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果散發出防護和召喚的光環。這些雕像對傷害和法術免疫。

english: When any creature steps on an incorrect floor tile, all four statues yawn and masses of magically summoned locusts fly out of their mouths. The locusts form a single cloud that fills a 15-foot cube centered above the offending floor tile. Each creature in the cloud when it forms, as well as any creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, takes 44 ({@dice 8d10}) piercing damage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this trap is killed and eaten to the bone by the devouring locusts. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until another cloud of locusts is created.
zh_tw: 當任何生物踩到錯誤的地磚時，所有四座雕像都會張開嘴巴，大量透過魔法召喚的蝗蟲從它們的口中飛出。蝗蟲形成一片單獨的雲團，填充在違規地磚上方中心位置的15尺立方體中。在雲團形成時在其中的每個生物，以及在回合中首次進入雲團或在其回合開始時在那裡的任何生物，都會受到44點（{@dice 8d10}）點穿刺傷害。任何因這個陷阱而生命值降至0的生物將被吞噬蝗蟲殺死並啃食至骨。雲團持續1分鐘，或直到創造出另一片蝗蟲雲。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: I'jin's golden sarcophagus cannot be opened by any means other than stepping on eight floor tiles in the correct order. The sarcophagus is worth 7,500 gp intact but weighs 75 pounds. Removing it from the funeral barge causes four floor-to-ceiling walls of force (like those created by a {@spell wall of force} spell) to surround the dais on all four sides. The walls last until destroyed or until the sarcophagus is returned to the barge.
zh_tw: 艾金的金棺只能透過按正確順序踩踏八塊地磚來開啟。金棺完好無損時價值7500金幣，但重75磅。將其從葬禮船上移除會導致四面牆的力量牆（類似於由{@spell wall of force||力場牆}法術創造的）從地面到天花板圍繞基座。這些牆將持續存在，直到被摧毀或直到金棺被放回船上。

english: The sarcophagus contains the fragile bones of an almiraj (I'jin's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), as well as its spiral horn, which functions as a {@item wand of wonder}. The horn turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 金棺中包含著一隻獨角兔（艾金的動物形態；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的脆弱骨骼，以及它的螺旋角，該角充當一個{@item wand of wonder||驚異魔杖}。如果這個角離開九神之墓，它將化為塵土並被摧毀（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"）。

english: I'jin's Spirit
zh_tw: 艾金的靈魂

english: The spirit of I'jin tries to inhabit any character who touches the horn (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When I'jin's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 艾金的靈魂試圖附身於任何觸碰號角的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當艾金的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: Streamers of light emanate from the tip of the horn. As they swirl around you, they form into a spectral rabbit with a single horn on its brow. A female voice whispers, "Quick, quick, let me in! We must stop {@creature Acererak|ToA}!"
zh_tw: 光線從角的尖端散發出來。當它們在你周圍旋轉時，它們形成了一隻額頭上有一隻角的幽靈兔子。一個女聲低語："快，快，讓我進去！我們必須阻止{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}！"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card I'jin|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|I'jin's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the horn and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果這個靈魂成功附身於角色，給玩家{@card I'jin|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|艾金的卡牌}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，這個靈魂返回到角中並等待另一個角色觸碰它。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Bravus's yellow turban is set with a peridot gemstone (500 gp). A search of Bravus's corpse also yields a nonmagical shield and a belt pouch containing a 500 gp diamond (the material component of a {@spell raise dead} spell) and two 1-inch-diameter crystal eyeballs—one dark blue and one vibrant purple.
zh_tw: 布拉弗斯的黃色頭巾上鑲有一顆橄欖石寶石（500金幣）。對布拉弗斯屍體的搜尋還發現了一面非魔法盾牌和一個腰帶小包，包內含有一顆500金幣的鑽石（一個{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術的材料成分）以及兩個直徑為1吋的水晶眼球——一個深藍色和一個鮮紫色。

english: Crystal Eyes
zh_tw: 水晶之眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eyes are two of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這對非魔法水晶之眼是開啟邪眼怪金庫（{@area 區域44|414|x}）所需的十把鑰匙中的兩把。

english: 36. Chamber of Respite
zh_tw: 36. 休息之室

english: The tomb's keepers have all but forgotten this tiny room lodged between two crawlways. Characters who shelter here are rewarded with undisturbed rest.
zh_tw: 這座墓穴的守護者幾乎忘記了這個夾在兩個爬行通道之間的小房間。在這裡避難的角色將得到安靜休息的獎勵。

english: 37. Winds of Pandemonium
zh_tw: 37. 混亂之風

english: Two balconies face each other over a vast pit. Between the balconies hover five wooden platforms, each one a disk ten feet across. A single torch burns above each balcony. On the east balcony stands a rough-hewn, fifteen-foot-tall statue of a hulking fiend with furled wings and clenched fists. Set into the wall on the west balcony is a rusty lever in the up position.
zh_tw: 兩個陽臺隔開一個巨大的深坑相對而望。在陽臺之間懸浮著五個木製平臺，每個平臺都是直徑十尺的圓盤。每個陽臺上方都燃燒著一支火把。在東側陽臺上矗立著一個粗雕的、十五尺高的龐大惡魔雕像，它有著收起的翅膀和緊握的拳頭。在西側陽臺的牆上安裝著一個向上的生鏽槓桿。

english: Climbing the walls requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A crawlway is set into the northwest corner, at the same height as the balconies and floating platforms. Another crawlway extends off the east balcony. At the back of the west balcony, a staircase descends 10 feet to a landing and a secret door.
zh_tw: 攀爬牆壁需要透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。一個爬行通道設定在西北角，與陽臺和浮空平臺處於同一高度。另一個爬行通道從東陽臺延伸出去。在西陽臺的後方，一段樓梯向下延伸10尺，通往一個平臺和一扇秘密門。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of I'jin or Kubazan receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被艾金或庫巴贊靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Fickle I'jin urges her host to pull the lever. What harm could it do?
zh_tw: 多變的艾金敦促她的宿主拉動槓桿。這能有什麼害處呢？

english: Fearless Kubazan insists that his host jump to the platforms, even if others are better equipped to do so.
zh_tw: 無畏的庫巴贊堅持讓他的宿主跳到平臺上，即使其他人更適合這樣做。

english: Floating Platforms
zh_tw: 漂浮平臺

english: The circular wooden platforms are 10 feet in diameter and hover between 6 and 12 feet apart, as shown on map 5.3. They float at the same level as the balconies, 15 feet below the ceiling and 60 feet above the pit floor. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals auras of abjuration and transmutation around each platform. Each disk is wide enough that characters can move 10 feet before jumping (see "{@book Movement|PHB|8|Movement}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}). The platforms bob slightly when anything lands on them, as though they were floating on water. Any creature that falls from a platform to the pit floor takes 21 ({@dice 6d6}) bludgeoning damage. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on a platform causes it to fall.
zh_tw: 這些圓形的木製平臺直徑為10尺，懸浮在空中，彼此之間相距6至12尺，如地圖5.3所示。它們與陽臺處於同一高度，位於天花板下方15尺，坑底上方60尺。使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法可以揭示每個平臺周圍的防護系和變化系靈光。每個圓盤足夠寬，角色可以在跳躍前移動10尺（參見{@book 移動|PHB|8|Movement}第8章中的"{@i 玩家手冊}"）。當任何物體落在平臺上時，平臺會輕微上下浮動，彷彿漂浮在水面上。任何從平臺掉落到坑底的生物將受到21（{@dice 6d6}）點鈍擊傷害。對平臺施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}會導致它墜落。

english: Wailing Winds
zh_tw: 狂風呼嘯

english: If the lever on the west balcony is pulled, the fiendish statue unclenches its fists to reveal a marble-sized object in the palm of each hand (see "Treasure" below). Simultaneously, howling winds rise up and fill the room. Returning the lever to its original up position causes the winds to abate and the statue's fists to close.
zh_tw: 如果西陽臺上的操縱桿被拉動，惡魔雕像會鬆開拳頭，在每隻手掌中露出一個大理石大小的物體（見下文的"寶藏"）。同時，呼嘯的風聲升起並填滿了房間。將操縱桿恢復到原始的向上位置會使風聲平息，雕像的拳頭也會閉合。

english: Have all party members roll initiative whenever the winds begin to howl. While the winds are howling, any creature not standing on a floating platform that starts its turn in the room must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw, taking 16 ({@dice 3d10}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, the winds cause creatures in the room to suffer disadvantage on all Strength-based skill checks, including checks made to jump to and from the floating platforms and checks made to climb the walls.
zh_tw: 每當風聲開始呼嘯時，讓所有隊伍成員進行先攻擲骰。在風聲呼嘯期間，任何不在漂浮平臺上開始其回合的生物必須進行一次{@dc 20}感知豁免，若豁免失敗則受到16（{@dice 3d10}）點心靈傷害，若豁免成功則受到一半傷害。此外，風聲會使房間內的生物在進行所有基於力量的技能檢定時處於劣勢，包括跳向或離開漂浮平臺的檢定以及攀爬牆壁的檢定。

english: Statue
zh_tw: 雕像

english: Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check realizes that the statue depicts a nycaloth. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals auras of transmutation magic radiating from the statue's clenched fists.
zh_tw: 任何成功透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色都會意識到這座雕像描繪的是一隻尼卡洛斯。使用 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果可以察覺到雕像緊握的雙拳散發出變化系魔法的靈光。

english: The statue weighs 15,000 pounds and is impervious to damage and spells. Casting a {@spell knock} spell on the statue causes one of its fists to unclench for 1 round, during which time the object in that hand can be safely removed.
zh_tw: 這座雕像重15000磅，對傷害和法術免疫。對雕像施放{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術會使其一隻拳頭在1輪內鬆開，在此期間那隻手中的物品可以安全地移除。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The statue clutches a 1-inch-diameter pearly white crystal eyeball in its left hand and a similarly sized scarlet crystal eyeball in its right hand.
zh_tw: 雕像的左手緊握著一顆直徑1吋的珍珠白色水晶眼珠，右手則握著一個同樣大小的鮮紅色水晶眼珠。

english: Crystal Eyes
zh_tw: 水晶之眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eyes are two of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這對非魔法水晶之眼是開啟邪眼怪金庫（{@area 區域44|414|x}）所需的十把鑰匙中的兩把。

english: 38. Revolving Room Trap
zh_tw: 38. 旋轉房間陷阱

english: Three separate areas comprise this section of the tomb: a control room (area 38A), an access corridor (area 38B), and a revolving death trap (area 38C). Diagram 5.2 shows a side view of these areas.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴的這一部分由三個不同的區域組成：一個控制室（區域38A），一個通道走廊（區域38B），以及一個旋轉死亡陷阱（區域38C）。圖5.2展示了這些區域的側檢視。

english: Diagram 5.2: Revolving Room Trap
zh_tw: 圖5.2：旋轉房間陷阱

english: 38A. Control Room
zh_tw: 38A. 控制室

english: This room is dark and dusty. A hulking figure wearing a bucket helm stands to the west, with one hand on an iron lever set into the wall. The south wall is sloped and has a large rectangular window five feet wide by seven feet high. The window looks into a hallway, through a rectangular hole in the hallway floor, and farther down into a well-lit room shaped like a cylinder tipped on its side.
zh_tw: 這個房間昏暗且佈滿灰塵。一個高大的身影戴著水桶頭盔站在西側，一隻手搭在牆上的一個鐵製操縱桿上。南側的牆壁是傾斜的，有一個五尺寬七尺高的矩形大窗戶。窗戶望向一個走廊，透過走廊地板上的一個矩形洞口，還可以看到下面一個類似側放的圓柱形的明亮房間。

english: The helmed figure is a {@creature tomb guardian|ToA}: a {@creature flesh golem} clad in plate armor (AC 17). Its task is to pull the lever when it sees adventurers enter area 38C. The tomb guardian fights only in self-defense and has orders from {@creature Withers|ToA} to not leave the control room. If it goes berserk, it ignores these orders.
zh_tw: 戴頭盔的身影是一個{@creature tomb guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛}：一個穿著板甲（AC 17）的{@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}。它的任務是在看到冒險者進入區域38C時拉動槓桿。墓穴守衛只在自衛時戰鬥，並且接到{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的命令不得離開控制室。如果它失控，它會忽略這些命令。

english: Window
zh_tw: 視窗

english: The window in the south wall is stone magically rendered transparent from this side only. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 17}) cast on the stone causes it to lose its transparency. If the tomb guardian is prevented from seeing into areas 38B and 38C, it won't pull the lever.
zh_tw: 南牆上的窗戶由石頭製成，只有從這一側被魔法處理成透明。成功施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} ({@dc 17}) 會使石頭失去透明度。如果墓室守衛無法看到區域 38B 和 38C，它就不會拉動槓桿。

english: Iron Lever
zh_tw: 鐵質槓桿

english: The lever protrudes from a vertical slot cut into the northwest wall. It rests in the up position. Pulling the lever down activates the trap in area 38C.
zh_tw: 槓桿從西北牆上的一個垂直槽中伸出。它處於上升位置。將槓桿拉下會啟用區域38C的陷阱。

english: 38B. Access Tunnel
zh_tw: 38B. 通道

english: This hallway is 10 feet high and 5 feet wide. If the characters enter the hall through the crawlways from areas 30 or 37, read:
zh_tw: 這個走廊高10尺，寬5尺。如果角色透過來自區域30或37的爬行通道進入大廳，請閱讀：

english: The walls of this narrow tunnel slope inward as they approach the ten-foot-high ceiling. Patches of mold cling to the walls and floor in the eastern half of the hall. Cut into the floor at the west end of the corridor is a three-foot-wide, four-foot-long rectangular hole with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} spilling out of it.
zh_tw: 這條狹窄隧道的牆壁在接近十尺高的天花板時向內傾斜。大廳東半部分的牆壁和地板上附著著斑駁的黴菌。走廊西端的地面上鑿有一個三尺寬、四尺長的矩形洞口，{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}從中傾瀉而出。

english: Any character standing next to the hole can peer down into a cylindrical room (area 38C), the curved floor of which is 15 feet below the hole.
zh_tw: 任何站在洞口旁邊的角色都可以向下窺視一個圓柱形房間（區域38C），其彎曲的地面位於洞口下方15尺處。

english: The wall north of the hole acts as a one-way window, but it appears no different from the rest of the tunnel from this side. Creatures in area 38A can see into this tunnel, but creatures in the tunnel can't see into area 38A. Spells such as {@spell detect magic} and {@spell true seeing} do not reveal the window from this side.
zh_tw: 洞口北邊的牆壁充當單向窗戶，但從這一側看，它看起來與隧道的其他部分沒有區別。區域38A中的生物可以看到這個隧道，但隧道中的生物看不到區域38A。像{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}和{@spell true seeing||真知術}這樣的法術從這一側也無法揭示窗戶。

english: 38C. Revolving Drum
zh_tw: 38C. 旋轉鼓

english: The characters can enter this room through the rectangular hole in the ceiling (area 38B) or through a stone door in the south wall.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過天花板上的長方形洞口（區域38B）或透過南牆上的石門進入這個房間。

english: This room is shaped like a drum or cylinder lying on its side, with its south end tapering toward a small stone door. Carvings of demons decorate the stonework, with flickering flames in all their eyes.
zh_tw: 這個房間的形狀像是一個側臥的鼓或圓柱體，其南端逐漸變細，通向一扇小石門。石雕上裝飾著惡魔的圖案，它們的眼睛中閃爍著火焰。

english: The flickering flames were created by {@spell continual flame} spells, which fill the room with {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}.
zh_tw: 閃爍的火焰是由{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術創造的，這些法術使房間充滿了{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}。

english: When the lever in area 38A is pulled, three hidden locks seal the south door, a {@spell wall of stone} spell blocks the rectangular hole in the ceiling (cutting off escape to area 38B), and the room begins revolving. When that happens, all creatures present should roll initiative.
zh_tw: 當區域38A中的槓桿被拉動時，三個隱藏的鎖會封閉南門，一個{@spell wall of stone||石牆術}法術會阻擋天花板上的長方形洞口（切斷通往區域38B的逃生路線），並且房間開始旋轉。當這種情況發生時，所有在場的生物應該進行先攻判定。

english: Any creature that is not firmly attached to a wall, flying, or under the effect of a {@spell gaseous form} spell or similar magic is knocked about the revolving room. The creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw at the start of each of its turns, taking 11 ({@dice 2d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 任何沒有牢固固定在牆上、飛行中、或處於{@spell gaseous form||氣化形體}法術或類似魔法效果下的生物都會被旋轉的房間甩動。該生物在每回合開始時必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到11點（{@dice 2d10}）鈍擊傷害，若豁免成功則受到一半傷害。

english: Revolving Room Effects
zh_tw: 旋轉房間效果

english: Effect
zh_tw: 效應

english: The demon faces exhale jets of a soporific gas that dissipates quickly. Each creature in the room that is not immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious}. An {@condition unconscious} creature can repeat the saving throw each time it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 惡魔的面孔噴出令人昏睡的氣體，這些氣體迅速消散。房間內每個不對 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 狀態免疫的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則將陷入 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 狀態。處於 {@condition unconscious||昏迷} 狀態的生物每次受到傷害時可以重複豁免檢定，成功則結束該效果。

english: The demon faces exhale jets of sparkling dust, which blind any creature in the room that does not succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. A creature's blindness lasts until it is cured with a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 惡魔的面孔撥出閃爍的塵霧，任何在房間內未透過 {@dc 15} 感知豁免的生物都將被致盲。失明效果持續到其被 {@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術} 或類似的魔法治癒為止。

english: Stone spikes 6 inches long magically protrude from the walls. Any creature that takes damage from the room at the start of its turn takes an additional 11 ({@dice 2d10}) piercing damage from the spikes. The spikes retract when the next room effect is triggered.
zh_tw: 石制尖刺神奇地從牆壁中伸出，長度為6吋。任何在回合開始時因房間受到傷害的生物，還會額外受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點穿刺傷害來自這些尖刺。當下一個房間效果被觸發時，尖刺會縮回。

english: The demon faces spew jets of an incendiary gas that promptly ignites, filling the room with fire. Each creature in the room takes 45 ({@dice 10d8}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 惡魔面孔噴出一股易燃氣體，迅速點燃，使整個房間充滿火焰。房間裡的每個生物都會受到45點（{@dice 10d8}）火焰傷害。

english: While the room is revolving, an additional effect is triggered at the end of initiative count 10. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Revolving Room Effects table.
zh_tw: 當房間在旋轉時，在主動進攻計數10結束時會觸發一個額外的效果。擲一個{@dice d20}，並參考旋轉房間效果表。

english: The room stops tumbling if the lever in area 38A is raised, or if the south door is opened or destroyed. The door's locks are hidden in the walls and can't be picked with {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, and it takes three separate {@spell knock} spells to unlock them. The door can also be wrenched open with a successful {@dc 26} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check or attacked. It has AC 17; 50 hit points; and immunity to fire, piercing, poison, psychic, slashing, and thunder damage.
zh_tw: 如果38A區域的拉桿被拉起，或者南門被開啟或破壞，房間就會停止翻滾。門鎖隱藏在牆內，無法用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}撬開，需要三個獨立的{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術才能解鎖。也可以透過成功的{@dc 26}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟或攻擊該門。它具有AC 17；50點生命值；並且免疫火焰、穿刺、毒素、心靈、揮砍和雷鳴傷害。

english: 39. Golem Pit
zh_tw: 39. 魔像坑

english: A fifteen-foot-wide, fifteen-foot-deep pit dominates this chamber. At the bottom of the pit, an eight-foot-tall clay figure stands motionless beside a stone treasure chest. A silver key hangs from a cord around the figure's neck.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央有一個十五尺寬、十五尺深的大坑。在坑底，一個八尺高的陶土雕像靜靜地站在一個石制寶箱旁邊。一個銀色的鑰匙掛在雕像脖子上的繩索上。

english: Two nine-foot-tall stone statues stand atop plinths on either side of the pit. A third plinth against the south wall stands empty. One of the statues depicts a hooded and bearded male figure with his left hand held high, index finger pointed up. The other portrays an armored male knight with his gauntleted right hand extended, its palm facing inward toward the knight.
zh_tw: 兩個九尺高的石制雕像分別站在坑的兩側的基座上。南側牆壁前的第三個基座空著。其中一個雕像描繪的是一個戴兜帽、留著鬍鬚的男性，左手高舉，食指指向上方。另一個雕像刻畫的是一個身穿盔甲的男性騎士，右手戴著鐵手套伸出，掌心向內朝向騎士自己。

english: An invisible wall of force (as created by the {@spell wall of force} spell) covers the top of the pit, shielding the {@creature clay golem} and the chest below. By manipulating the statues, characters can teleport the golem up to their level, or send one of their own into the pit.
zh_tw: 一堵隱形的力場牆（由{@spell wall of force||力場牆}法術創造）覆蓋在坑頂，保護著下面的{@creature clay golem||粘土魔像}和寶箱。透過操縱雕像，角色們可以將魔像傳送到他們的層面，或者將他們中的一個送入坑中。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Moa or Papazotl receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被莫阿或帕帕扎圖靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Thoughtful Moa warns that adamantine or magic weapons are needed to harm a clay golem.
zh_tw: 深思熟慮的莫阿警告說，需要用精金或魔法武器才能傷害到一個粘土魔像。

english: Bossy Papazotl insists that someone stand on the third plinth. ("It must be empty for a reason!")
zh_tw: 專橫的帕帕扎圖堅持要有人站在第三個基座上。（"它空著肯定有原因！"）

english: God Statues
zh_tw: 神像

english: The two statues facing the pit represent Azuth (god of wizardry) and Torm (god of courage and self-sacrifice). Either can be identified with a successful {@dc 12} Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of abjuration magic around each statue.
zh_tw: 面對坑洞的兩座雕像分別代表阿祖斯（法術之神）和託姆（勇氣與自我犧牲之神）。透過成功的 {@dc 12} 智力（{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定可以辨認出它們。使用 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果會揭示每座雕像周圍的防護魔法靈光。

english: Any examination of the plinths reveals that each statue is set on a rotating, spring-loaded gear. If the statue of Azuth is rotated to the right, one creature inside the pit teleports onto the third plinth, forcing aside any other creature standing there. If multiple creatures are in the pit, randomly determine which creature is teleported. Rotating the statue of Torm to the right teleports anything on or above the third plinth into the pit. Even if nothing is there, a popping is heard as air rushes in to fill the empty space. When a statue that has been turned is released, it grinds back to its starting position.
zh_tw: 對基座的任何檢查都會發現，每尊雕像都安裝在一個旋轉的彈簧裝置上。如果將阿祖斯的雕像向右旋轉，坑內的一個生物會被傳送到第三個基座上，迫使那裡的任何其他生物讓位。如果坑內有多個生物，隨機決定哪個生物被傳送。將託姆的雕像向右旋轉會將任何在第三個基座上或上方的物體傳送到坑中。即使那裡什麼也沒有，也會聽到一聲爆裂聲，因為空氣湧入填補了空位。當一個已經轉動的雕像被釋放時，它會嘎吱嘎吱地回到起始位置。

english: The clay golem has orders to attack any creature that it sees and can reach. If the golem is destroyed, {@creature Withers|ToA} uses his {@item manual of golems} in {@area area 28|3aa|x} to create a new one after 30 days.
zh_tw: 粘土魔像接到命令，攻擊它看到並能夠觸及的任何生物。如果魔像被摧毀，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}會使用他在{@area 區域28|3aa|x}中的{@item manual of golems||魔像手冊}在30天后製造一個新的。

english: Stone Chest
zh_tw: 石質寶箱

english: The chest and its hinges are made of stone. The chest weighs 250 pounds and is fitted with a silver locking mechanism. Opening the lock requires the silver key that the golem wears around its neck. A {@spell mage hand} spell or similar magic can lift the key from around the golem's neck without causing the golem to attack. A character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. However, opening the chest by any means other than the silver key releases a cloud of gas that fills a 15-foot cube centered above the chest (filling the entire pit). The gas instantly corrodes and destroys all nonmagical metal that comes into contact with it, including armor and weapons. Metal objects sealed in containers are protected.
zh_tw: 這個箱子和它的鉸鏈都是由石頭製成的。箱子重250磅，並配有一個銀製的鎖具。開啟鎖需要構裝體脖子上掛著的銀鑰匙。使用{@spell mage hand||法師之手}法術或類似的魔法可以從構裝體脖子上取下鑰匙而不會引發其攻擊。使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}的角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。然而，用銀鑰匙以外的方式開啟箱子會釋放出一團氣體，充滿以箱子為中心15尺立方的區域（填滿整個坑）。這種氣體會立即腐蝕並摧毀所有與之接觸的非魔法金屬，包括盔甲和武器。密封在容器中的金屬物品則不受影響。

english: The chest is a Small object with AC 12, 10 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 這個箱子是一個小型物體，具有AC 12，10點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chest contains two 1-inch-diameter glass eyeballs resting on a red cushion. One eyeball is pale green and the other is pink.
zh_tw: 箱子裡有兩個直徑1吋的玻璃眼球，它們放置在紅色墊子上。一個眼球是淡綠色的，另一個是粉紅色的。

english: Crystal Eyes
zh_tw: 水晶之眼

english: The nonmagical crystal eyes are two of the ten keys needed to open the vault of the beholder ({@area area 44|414|x}).
zh_tw: 這對非魔法水晶之眼是開啟邪眼怪金庫（{@area 區域44|414|x}）所需的十把鑰匙中的兩把。

english: 40. Curse of the Golden Skull
zh_tw: 40. 黃金骷髏的詛咒

english: A golden skull rests on a pedestal in the middle of this small, dusty room.
zh_tw: 一個金色的骷髏頭放在這個小而多塵的房間中央的基座上。

english: This cursed human skull plated in gold is the remains of a fool named Yaka—an entertainer who once amused the royal family of Omu. If any character touches it, the skull levitates into the air and begins to follow that character everywhere. The skull never strays more than a few feet away, teleporting back to the character's side if it loses sight of him or her. As it hovers, Yaka's skull supplies a stream of deadpan banter in a mocking, hollow voice. Unless the skull is magically silenced, its inopportune comments cause the character to make all ability checks with disadvantage.
zh_tw: 這個被詛咒的人類骷髏頭，鍍了金，是一個名叫亞卡的傻瓜的遺骸——他曾是娛樂奧穆王室的藝人。如果任何角色觸控它，骷髏頭就會懸浮在空中，開始到處跟隨那個角色。骷髏頭永遠不會偏離幾尺遠，如果看不見他或她，它會瞬間傳送回角色的身邊。當它懸浮時，亞卡的骷髏頭以一種嘲諷、空洞的聲音提供一連串的冷笑話。除非骷髏頭被魔法沉默，否則它的不合時宜的評論會導致角色進行所有屬性檢定時處於不利狀態。

english: Roleplay the skull as cruel and cynical, with a dark sense of humor. It knows nothing of the tomb but pretends to know all. {@creature Acererak|ToA} has warded the skull with powerful magic, rendering it impervious to damage and spells. Its curse is too powerful to be broken with any spell other than {@spell wish}, which can be used either to destroy the skull or end the curse. If the curse ends but the skull survives, it teleports back to its pedestal and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 將頭骨角色扮演為殘忍且憤世嫉俗的角色，帶有黑色幽默感。它對陵墓一無所知，卻假裝無所不知。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 用強大的魔法為頭骨施加了防護，使其對傷害和法術免疫。其詛咒過於強大，只有{@spell wish||祈願術}才能打破，該法術可用於摧毀頭骨或結束詛咒。如果詛咒結束但頭骨仍存在，它會傳送回基座並等待下一個角色觸碰它。

english: The curse can also be ended by feeding gemstones to the skull, which it craves. The skull chews up and destroys any nonmagical gem fed to it, leaving no trace of the gem behind. Once it destroys 10,000 gp worth of gemstones, the skull teleports back to its pedestal and the curse ends for the affected character.
zh_tw: 詛咒也可以透過給骷髏餵食寶石來結束，它對此有強烈的渴望。骷髏咀嚼並摧毀任何餵食給它的非魔法寶石，不留下寶石的任何痕跡。一旦它摧毀了價值10,000金幣的寶石，骷髏就會傳送回基座，受影響角色的詛咒就會結束。

english: 41. Tomb Guardians
zh_tw: 41. 墓穴守衛

english: Two hulking figures stand in alcoves along this long hall, facing each other. Armor is bolted to their flesh, and they wear bucket helms and spiked gauntlets. Iron collars around their necks are connected by a spiked chain that stretches across the corridor.
zh_tw: 兩個高大的身影站在這條長廊的壁龕中，彼此相對。盔甲被固定在他們的肉體上，他們戴著桶形頭盔和帶刺的鐵手套。他們脖子上的鐵項圈透過一條穿過走廊的帶刺鏈條相連。

english: The {@creature Tomb Guardian|ToA|tomb guardians} in the alcoves attack any creature that attacks them or tries to move past them. They are {@creature Flesh Golem||flesh golems}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 在壁龕中的{@creature Tomb Guardian|ToA|陵墓守衛}會攻擊任何攻擊它們或試圖越過它們的生物。它們是{@creature Flesh Golem||血肉魔像}，但有以下變化：

english: The golems are clad in plate armor (AC 17).
zh_tw: 這些魔像是穿著板甲的（護甲等級17）。

english: With its spiked gauntlets, a tomb guardian deals 13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@dice 2d6}) piercing damage with each successful Slam attack.
zh_tw: 墓穴守護者使用其帶刺的鐵手套，在每次成功的猛擊攻擊中造成13點（{@dice 2d8 + 4}）鈍擊傷害外加7點（{@dice 2d6}）點穿刺傷害。

english: Each tomb guardian has a challenge rating of 6 (2,300 XP).
zh_tw: 每個墓穴守衛的挑戰等級為6（2300經驗值）。

english: Spiked Chain
zh_tw: 刺鏈

english: The magical spiked chain that binds the guardians together prevents them from moving more than 15 feet apart. Additionally, as long as the chain is intact, damage dealt to either guardian is divided evenly between them. The spiked chain can be attacked separately and has AC 18, a damage threshold of 10, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If the chain breaks, both tomb guardians instantly go berserk.
zh_tw: 將守衛們捆綁在一起的魔法帶刺鐵鏈使它們無法相距超過15尺。此外，只要鐵鏈完好無損，對任一守衛造成的傷害都會在它們之間平均分配。帶刺鐵鏈可以被單獨攻擊，具有AC 18，傷害閾值10，5點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果鐵鏈斷裂，兩個墓穴守衛會立即陷入狂暴狀態。

english: 42. Kubazan's Tomb
zh_tw: 42. 庫巴贊的墓

english: A four-columned portico juts out from the far wall, beneath which a stone sarcophagus rests in a wall recess. Four ceramic frog masks hang in niches around the sarcophagus. Beneath the masks, humanoid bones are strewn across the floor. To the east, a large carving of a tentacled frog-monster squats above a shrine. Offerings lie on a shelf before it. Four rectangular frescoes adorn the adjacent walls.
zh_tw: 一座四柱門廊從遠處的牆壁突出，其下有一個石制的石棺安放在壁龕中。四個陶瓷青蛙面具掛在石棺周圍的壁龕裡。面具下方，類人生物的骨頭散落在地板上。向東，一隻帶有觸手的青蛙怪物的大型雕刻蹲在神龕上方。供品擺放在它前面的架子上。四個長方形的壁畫裝飾著相鄰的牆壁。

english: To unlock sarcophagus, the characters must perform a simple ritual at the shrine while wearing the frog masks. The wall frescoes reveal what must be done.
zh_tw: 要開啟石棺，角色們必須在戴著青蛙面具的情況下，在神龕前進行一個簡單的儀式。牆壁上的壁畫揭示了必須做的事情。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Nangnang, Obo'laka, or Shagambi receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被娜浪、奧博娜卡或莎根比的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Greedy Nangnang urges her host to snatch up the gold coins on the wall shrine.
zh_tw: 貪婪的娜浪敦促她的宿主去搶奪牆上神龕的金幣。

english: Cautious Obo'laka warns against trying on the masks.
zh_tw: 謹慎的奧博娜卡警告不要嘗試戴上面具。

english: Wise Shagambi is convinced that the frescoes are clues to understanding the power of the wall shrine.
zh_tw: 睿智的莎根比確信這些壁畫是理解牆壁神龕力量的線索。

english: Frescoes
zh_tw: 壁畫

english: Four frescoes line the east wall of the tomb, two on each side of the shrine.
zh_tw: 四幅壁畫排列在墓穴的東牆上，神龕兩側各兩幅。

english: Fresco 1
zh_tw: 壁畫1

english: This fresco shows a time when Kubazan used his tentacles to help the Omuans cast down a statue of the god Ubtao:
zh_tw: 這幅壁畫展示了庫巴贊使用他的觸手幫助奧穆人推倒烏博神雕像的時代：

english: A frog-like behemoth uses its tentacles to help the Omuan people knock down a mighty statue. In the foreground, an old woman wearing a frog mask tosses five coins from her hand as though sowing seeds.
zh_tw: 一個類似青蛙的巨獸使用它的觸鬚幫助奧穆人推倒一座宏偉的雕像。在前景中，一位戴著青蛙面具的老婦人從手中丟擲五枚硬幣，就像播種一樣。

english: Fresco 2
zh_tw: 壁畫2

english: This fresco shows a time when Kubazan helped a group of Omuan hunters kill a giant crocodile that was threatening the city:
zh_tw: 這幅壁畫展示了庫巴贊幫助一群奧穆獵人殺死一隻威脅城市的巨型鱷魚的時代：

english: A frog-like behemoth wraps its tentacles around a giant crocodile as Omuan hunters stab the crocodile with their spears. In the foreground, an old man wearing a frog mask holds a bug up to his open mouth.
zh_tw: 一個類似青蛙的巨獸用它的觸鬚纏繞住一隻巨型鱷魚，同時奧穆獵人用長矛刺向鱷魚。在前景中，一個戴著青蛙面具的老人張開嘴，將一隻蟲子放到嘴邊。

english: Fresco 3
zh_tw: 壁畫3

english: This fresco shows a time when Kubazan helped the Omuans find a missing child in the jungle:
zh_tw: 這幅壁畫展示了庫巴贊幫助奧穆人在叢林中找到一名失蹤兒童的時代：

english: A frog-like behemoth with four Omuan hunters riding on its back finds a small boy in the jungle. The hunters seem elated. In the foreground, a young woman wearing a frog mask holds a knife in one hand and a headless chicken in the other.
zh_tw: 一個背上騎著四名奧穆獵人的類似青蛙的巨獸在叢林中找到了一個小男孩。獵人們看起來非常高興。在前景中，一位戴著青蛙面具的年輕女子一手拿著刀，另一手拿著一隻無頭雞。

english: Fresco 4
zh_tw: 壁畫4

english: This fresco shows a time when Kubazan got angry and the Omuans appeased him with treasure:
zh_tw: 這幅壁畫展示了一個時期，當時庫巴贊生氣了，奧曼人用財寶安撫他：

english: A frog-like behemoth wallows in a shallow pool as Omuans offer it urns of food and treasure as tribute. Cracks in the fresco obscure the head of the human figure in the foreground, but you can see that it grasps a lit candle.
zh_tw: 一隻類似青蛙的巨獸在淺水池中打滾，奧穆人向它獻上裝滿食物和財寶的甕作為貢品。壁畫上的裂縫遮住了前景中人物的頭部，但你可以看到它握著一支點燃的蠟燭。

english: A search of the wall shrine reveals several items:
zh_tw: 對牆邊神龕的搜尋揭示了幾件物品：

english: A 6-inch-tall stone statuette of a froghemoth (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), which weighs 5 pounds and has an inscription on its base in Old Omuan: "Give thanks to me as others have done since the dawn of time."
zh_tw: 一座6吋高的石制蛙類巨獸小雕像（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），重5磅，其底座上用古奧穆語刻有銘文："像自古以來的其他人一樣向我表示感謝。"

english: A copper bowl containing rat bones
zh_tw: 一個裝有老鼠骨頭的銅碗

english: Four dead cockroaches
zh_tw: 四隻死蟑螂

english: A green wax candle with a salvageable wick
zh_tw: 一支綠色蠟質的蠟燭，燭芯可以回收利用

english: 5 gp (loose)
zh_tw: 5金幣（散幣）

english: Performing the Ritual
zh_tw: 執行儀式

english: To open the sarcophagus, one or more characters must stand before the wall shrine and perform the following actions in no particular order:
zh_tw: 要開啟石棺，一個或多個角色必須站在牆邊神龕前，並按任意順序執行以下操作：

english: Donate at least 5 gp to the shrine while wearing a frog mask.
zh_tw: 在戴青蛙面具的同時向神龕捐獻至少5金幣。

english: Light a candle before the shrine while wearing a frog mask.
zh_tw: 在戴著青蛙面具的情況下，在神龕前點燃一支蠟燭。

english: Spill the blood of a living creature into the copper bowl while wearing a frog mask.
zh_tw: 在戴青蛙面具的同時，將一個活生生的生物的血倒入銅碗中。

english: Eat a bug (living or dead) while wearing a frog mask.
zh_tw: 在戴著青蛙面具的情況下吃一隻蟲子（活的或死的）。

english: If any of these actions are performed incorrectly, three {@creature Wraith||wraiths} rise from the bones on the floor. The wraiths attack until they are destroyed and pursue any characters who flee this area. When the wraiths appear, any character wearing one of the frog masks is polymorphed into a {@creature frog}, as though it had failed a saving throw against the {@i polymorph spell}.
zh_tw: 如果這些動作中有任何一項執行錯誤，三隻{@creature Wraith||邪靈}將從地板上的骨骸中升起。幽魂會攻擊直到被消滅，並追擊任何逃離此區域的角色。當幽魂出現時，任何佩戴青蛙面具的角色將被變形為一隻{@creature frog||青蛙}，彷彿他們在對抗{@i 變形術}的豁免檢定中失敗了一樣。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: Kubazan's sarcophagus is bereft of adornment, though a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals auras of abjuration and evocation magic around it.
zh_tw: 庫巴贊的石棺沒有裝飾，儘管一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果能揭示其周圍的防護和召喚魔法的光環。

english: When the ritual is performed correctly, the sarcophagus lid unlocks and slides open. It contains the bones of a froghemoth (Kubazan's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) as well as some valuable items (see "Treasure" below). The sarcophagus lid is otherwise sealed shut with an {@spell arcane lock} spell. It can be opened with a {@spell knock} spell or forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. However, if the sarcophagus is opened by any means other than the ritual, a {@spell prismatic spray} spell (save {@dc 19}) erupts from the wall behind the sarcophagus. All creatures in the room, as well as creatures in the narrow hallway to the south, become targets of the spell.
zh_tw: 當儀式正確執行時，石棺的蓋子會解鎖並滑開。裡面裝有一隻蛙魔怪（庫巴贊的動物形態，見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的骨頭以及一些有價值的物品（見下面的"寶藏"）。石棺的蓋子被{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術密封。它可以透過{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術開啟，或者透過成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟。然而，如果石棺透過任何非儀式方式開啟，一束{@spell prismatic spray||虹光噴射}法術（豁免{@dc 19}）將從石棺後面的牆壁中噴發出來。房間內的所有生物，以及南邊狹窄走廊中的生物，都將成為該法術的目標。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The sarcophagus contains a pair of {@item bracers of archery} and twenty brittle arrows in a rotting leather quiver. Each arrow shatters on impact and deals only 1 piercing damage on a hit. Carvings of froghemoths adorn the bracers, which keep the skin of any character attuned to them disturbingly moist. The bracers turn to dust and are destroyed if they leave the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 石棺內含有一對{@item bracers of archery||射手護腕}和二十支易碎的箭，這些箭放在一個腐爛的皮革箭袋中。每支箭在撞擊時會碎裂，並且只在擊中時造成1點穿刺傷害。護腕上裝飾有蛙類巨獸的雕刻，它們使任何與之協調的角色的皮膚保持令人不安的溼潤。如果護腕離開九神之墓（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"），它們會化為塵土並被摧毀。

english: Kubazan's Spirit
zh_tw: 庫巴贊的靈魂

english: The spirit of Kubazan tries to inhabit any character who touches either of the bracers (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Kubazan's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 庫巴贊的靈魂試圖附身於任何觸碰這對護腕的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當庫巴贊的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: The bracers glow as watery light ripples across the walls. A monstrous, tentacled shadow rises from the sarcophagus, and the air fills with the stench of a swamp. A rumbling voice echoes through the tomb: "You are brave to summon me. Together, we will crush the undying one!"
zh_tw: 護腕發出光芒，水波般的光線在牆壁上盪漾。一個帶有觸手的怪物般陰影從石棺中升起，空氣中瀰漫著沼澤的惡臭。一個隆隆的聲音在墓穴中迴響：'你們召喚我，真是勇敢。一起，我們將粉碎那個不死之物！'

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Kubazan|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Kubazan's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the bracers and waits for another character to touch one of them.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功附身於角色，給玩家{@card Kubazan|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|庫巴贊的卡牌}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂返回到護腕中，並等待另一個角色觸碰其中一個。

english: 43. Veils of Fear
zh_tw: 43. 恐懼之幕

english: This room lies beyond a double door, the outside of which is carved with leering and laughing skulls. The doors are neither locked nor trapped, and they swing inward on rusty hinges to reveal the room beyond.
zh_tw: 這個房間位於一扇雙門的另一邊，門的外側雕刻著嘲笑和嬉笑的骷髏頭。門既沒有上鎖也沒有陷阱，它們在生鏽的鉸鏈上向內擺動，揭示了門後的房間。

english: Ten feet from the doors, a thick tapestry curtain hangs from wall to wall. Its embroidery shows a scene of merriment: nobles feasting around a banquet table, a roast boar on a platter, and servants pouring wine.
zh_tw: 離門十尺處，一道厚實的掛毯從牆到牆懸掛著。它的刺繡展示了一幅歡樂的場景：貴族們圍坐在宴會桌旁盛宴，一個烤野豬在盤子上，僕人們在倒酒。

english: Two more curtains hang beyond the first, each showing the same image descending into horror. When the second curtain is revealed, read:
zh_tw: 在第一道簾子的另一邊，還掛著兩道簾子，每道簾子上都展示著同樣的影象，但逐漸變成了恐怖場景。當第二道簾子被揭開時，請閱讀：

english: Another curtain hangs behind the first, showing the same scene but descended into depravity. The nobles fight with each other, partake in carnal encounters on the table, or sprawl on the floor in puddles of vomit.
zh_tw: 第一道簾子後面掛著另一道簾子，展示了同樣的場景，但已經墮落成放蕩。貴族們互相爭鬥，在桌子上進行肉體接觸，或躺在地板上，周圍是嘔吐物的水坑。

english: Behind the second curtain is a third:
zh_tw: 第二道簾子後面是第三道：

english: A scene of horror confronts you: nobles feasting on servants, eating each other alive, and setting fire to the hall. The roast boar is alive and laughing on its platter.
zh_tw: 一幅恐怖的場景展現在你們面前：貴族們在享用僕人們，互相活吃，並且放火燒大廳。烤野豬在盤子上活著，並且正在笑。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of enchantment magic radiating from the third curtain. Any creature that looks at this curtain must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of it. A {@condition frightened} creature tries to leave the room as quickly as possible and cannot reenter. Once outside the room, a creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that saves against this effect is unaffected by the curtain thereafter and can reenter the room.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果會揭示從第三塊窗簾散發出的附魔魔法靈光。任何看到這塊窗簾的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 14} 感知豁免，否則將 {@condition frightened||恐懼} 它。一個 {@condition frightened||恐懼} 的生物會試圖儘快離開房間並且無法重新進入。一旦在房間外，生物可以在其每回合結束時重複進行豁免，成功則效果終止。一個成功抵禦此效果的生物之後將不受窗簾影響，並且可以重新進入房間。

english: Lord of the Feast
zh_tw: 饕餮之主

english: When the final tapestry curtain is pulled aside, the dreaded Lord of the Feast confronts the characters:
zh_tw: 當最後一幅掛毯簾子被拉開時，令人畏懼的宴會之主出現在角色們面前：

english: The rotting head of a giant boar is mounted to the wall behind the final curtain. Fresh blood and gore spatters its tusks, dribbling down the wall beneath it.
zh_tw: 一具腐爛的巨型野豬頭被安裝在最後一道簾子後的牆上。新鮮的血跡和殘骸濺在它的獠牙上，順著牆往下滴。

english: Any humanoid that can see the severed boar's head must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by it. On its turn, a {@condition charmed} creature does nothing except approach the severed head and put its own head in the boar's mouth. Only one head can fit in the mouth at a time. If the boar's mouth is already full, a {@condition charmed} creature waits patiently until the mouth is clear. Any creature that ends its turn with its head in the boar's mouth takes 22 ({@dice 4d10}) slashing damage as the boar's jaws clamp down. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, it is decapitated. A {@condition charmed} creature can repeat the saving throw each time it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once a creature successfully saves against this effect, it cannot be affected by the boar's head for 24 hours.
zh_tw: 任何能夠看到被砍下的野豬頭的人形生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 16} 的感知豁免檢定，否則將被其 {@condition charmed||魅惑}。在其回合中，被 {@condition charmed||魅惑} 的生物除了接近被砍下的頭顱並將自己的頭放入野豬口中外，不會做任何其他事情。野豬口中一次只能容納一個頭。如果野豬的嘴已經滿了，被 {@condition charmed||魅惑} 的生物會耐心等待，直到嘴巴空出來。任何在回合結束時將頭放在野豬口中的生物將受到 22（{@dice 4d10}）的揮砍傷害，因為野豬的下顎會咬合。如果此傷害將生物的生命值降至 0，則其被斬首。被 {@condition charmed||魅惑} 的生物每次受到傷害時都可以重複進行豁免檢定，成功則結束對其自身的效果。一旦生物成功豁免此效果，它在 24 小時內不會再受到野豬頭的影響。

english: Destroying the Lord of the Feast ends its charm effect on all creatures. The boar's head is a Medium object with AC 5 and 22 hit points.
zh_tw: 摧毀宴會之主會結束它對所有生物的魅惑效果。野豬頭是一箇中型物體，具有AC 5和22點生命值。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Destroying the boar's head reveals three items lodged between its teeth: a bent pair of gold spectacles (25 gp), a leather eye patch set with a bloodstone (50 gp), and a platinum hair pin (75 gp).
zh_tw: 摧毀野豬頭揭示了三件物品，它們卡在它的牙齒之間：一副彎曲的金邊眼鏡（25金幣），一個鑲有血石的皮革眼罩（50金幣），以及一枚鉑金髮夾（75金幣）。

english: 44. Vault of the Beholder
zh_tw: 44. 凝視者之庫

english: An {@condition invisible} beholder lairs in this circular chamber. To enter, adventurers must pass through a locked door.
zh_tw: 一隻{@condition invisible||隱形}隱形的巨眼魔（眼魔）在這個圓形的房間裡築巢。冒險者要進入，必須透過一扇上鎖的門。

english: 44A. Eyes of the Beholder
zh_tw: 44A. 凝視者之眼

english: The corridor ends in a large door with a round mirror set into its surface. Ten circular indentations, each about an inch across, surround the mirror.
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭是一扇大門，門上嵌著一個圓形的鏡子。鏡子周圍有十個圓形凹痕，每個大約一吋寬。

english: The door is sealed tight and can't be opened with ability checks or magic. To open the door, ten crystal eyes found elsewhere in the dungeon (see areas 31A, 32, 33, 35B, 37, and 39) must be inserted into the indentations. Each eye lights up as it clicks into place. With each eye that is inserted, the reflections of the characters in the mirror become progressively unhealthier—losing weight, hair, and teeth as they come to resemble undead.
zh_tw: 這扇門密封得很緊，不能用屬性檢定或魔法開啟。要開啟這扇門，必須將地牢（見區域31A、32、33、35B、37和39）其他地方找到的十個水晶眼插入凹痕中。每個眼睛插入時都會亮起併發出點選聲。隨著每個眼睛的插入，角色在鏡子中的反射會逐漸變得不健康——體重減輕、掉髮、掉牙，越來越像不死生物。

english: When all ten eyes are in place, they disappear and the door grinds open and remains open henceforth.
zh_tw: 當十個眼睛全部就位時，它們會消失，門會隨之轟鳴著開啟，並且從此保持開啟狀態。

english: 44B. Inside the Vault
zh_tw: 44B. 庫內

english: When the door opens, read:
zh_tw: 門開啟時，閱讀：

english: The vault door grinds upward, revealing a domed, candlelit room fifty feet high. The polished marble floor is so perfectly reflective that it creates the illusion of standing at the entrance to a sphere. Nine alcoves filled with glittering treasure open up along the walls. In the middle of the chamber, a large spherical object hovers under a black silk drape twenty feet above the floor.
zh_tw: 金庫門轟鳴著向上開啟，露出一個高五十尺的圓頂房間，裡面點著蠟燭。拋光的大理石地板反射得如此完美，以至於產生了站在一個球體入口處的錯覺。沿著牆壁有九個壁龕，裡面裝滿了閃閃發光的財寶。在房間中央，一個大型球體物體在離地面二十尺的黑色絲綢佈下懸浮著。

english: The {@creature beholder}, Belchorzh (pronounced BEL-korj), floats at the top of the room. {@creature Acererak|ToA} cast a {@spell wish} spell to render Belchorzh {@condition invisible}. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}) cast on the beholder or contact with an {@spell antimagic field} ends its invisibility. Belchorzh reacts to intruders as described in the "Beholder Tactics" section below.
zh_tw: 名為貝爾科茲（發音為BEL-korj）的{@creature beholder||眼魔}懸浮在房間的頂部。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}施展了{@spell wish||祈願術}，使貝爾科茲{@condition invisible||隱形}。成功對眼魔施展{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）或接觸{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}可使其隱形效果終止。貝爾科茲對入侵者的反應將在以下"眼魔戰術"部分中描述。

english: The hall contains one hundred lit candles. While the candles remain inside this vault, they burn indefinitely. If a candle is taken from the room, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 大廳裡有一百支點燃的蠟燭。當蠟燭保持在這座金庫內時，它們會無限期地燃燒。如果一支蠟燭從房間中拿走，它就會正常燃燒完。

english: The floor beneath the dome is magically slick. Any creature that steps onto or starts its turn on the floor must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. When an untethered creature is shoved or otherwise moved across the floor, it travels in one direction and does not stop until it comes into contact with a wall or other barrier.
zh_tw: 穹頂下方的地面被魔法變得滑膩。任何踏入或在此區域開始回合的生物都必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則將 {@condition prone||伏地}。當一個未固定的生物被推擠或以其他方式在地面上移動時，它會在一個方向上滑動，直到碰到牆壁或其他障礙物才會停止。

english: The alcoves contain treasure (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 壁龕內藏有寶藏（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Kubazan, Obo'laka, or Wongo receive the following advice:
zh_tw: 任何被庫巴贊、奧博娜卡或望戈的靈魂附身的角色將收到以下建議：

english: Impulsive Kubazan urges his host to attack whatever is hiding under the black drape, with no warning or negotiation.
zh_tw: 衝動的庫巴贊敦促他的宿主在沒有任何警告或談判的情況下攻擊黑色布幔下隱藏的東西。

english: Cautious Obo'laka thinks a beholder is hidden under the black drape and urges her host to flee at once.
zh_tw: 謹慎的奧博娜卡認為黑色布幔下隱藏著一隻巨眼魔，並敦促她的宿主立即逃離。

english: When he becomes aware of the beholder, reckless Wongo suggests that his host attack another party member, to trick the beholder into thinking it has an ally.
zh_tw: 當意識到巨眼魔的存在時，魯莽的望戈建議他的宿主攻擊另一個隊伍成員，以此欺騙巨眼魔認為它有一個盟友。

english: Black Drape, Iron Sphere
zh_tw: 黑色布幔，鐵球

english: The black drape conceals a magical sphere of iron, 6 feet in diameter and floating 20 feet above the floor. A {@spell Nystul's magic aura} spell placed on the sphere makes it seem like an evil aberration to features or magic that can sense such information.
zh_tw: 黑色布幔掩蓋著一個魔法鐵球，直徑6尺，懸浮在離地面20尺的高空。一個施加在鐵球上的{@spell Nystul's magic aura||涅斯圖魔法靈光}法術讓它看起來像是邪惡的異怪，對於能夠感知此類資訊的特徵或魔法來說。

english: The iron sphere is hollow and immobile, and it remains inert while the drape covers it. Belchorzh can use its telekinetic eye ray to remove the drape at any time, revealing the sphere and causing it to emit a magical magnetic field. Each creature in the room wearing metal armor is pulled to the sphere and becomes stuck to it, as does any metal weapon or object that isn't secured or being held. Any creature stuck to the sphere is {@condition restrained} until the magnetic field deactivates.
zh_tw: 鐵球是空心且固定的，當布幔覆蓋它時，它保持靜止狀態。貝爾喬茲可以隨時使用它的念力眼射線移開布幔，揭示鐵球並使其發出魔法磁場。房間裡任何穿戴金屬盔甲的生物都會被拉向鐵球並粘附在上面，任何未被固定或被持有的金屬武器或物品也會如此。任何粘附在鐵球上的生物都會被{@condition restrained||束縛}，直到磁場停用。

english: Any ranged attack made in the chamber that uses ammunition made wholly or partly from metal has disadvantage on the attack roll; if the attack misses, the ammunition becomes stuck to the sphere.
zh_tw: 在室內進行的任何遠端攻擊，如果使用完全或部分由金屬製成的彈藥，攻擊檢定將會有劣勢；如果攻擊未命中，彈藥就會粘附在鐵球上。

english: Throwing the black drape over the sphere renders it temporarily inert, with creatures and objects stuck to it falling to the floor. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 16}) cast on the sphere dispels the {@spell Nystul's magic aura} spell, permanently deactivates the magnetic field, and causes the sphere to crash to the floor. This sends a web of cracks through the marble, negating the floor's frictionless effect and allowing creatures to move across it normally. The sphere also deactivates and falls if it comes into contact with an {@spell antimagic field} or is destroyed.
zh_tw: 將黑色帷幕覆蓋在球體上會使其暫時失效，附著其上的生物和物體會掉落到地板上。在球體上成功施放 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 16}）會解除 {@spell Nystul's magic aura||涅斯圖魔法靈光} 法術，永久關閉磁場，並使球體墜落到地板上。這會導致大理石地板上出現裂紋網，消除了地面的無摩擦效果，使生物能夠正常移動。如果球體接觸到 {@spell antimagic field||反魔法場} 或被摧毀，它也會失效並墜落。

english: The sphere is a Large object with AC 20; 100 hit points; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and immunity to poison and psychic damage. It weighs 1,000 pounds. While the magnetic field is active, any attack made against the sphere with a metal weapon automatically hits, though the weapon becomes stuck to the sphere after impact.
zh_tw: 這個球體是一個大型物體，具有AC 20；100生命值；對來自非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害有抗性；並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。它的重量是1000磅。當磁場啟用時，任何用金屬武器對球體進行的攻擊都會自動命中，儘管武器在撞擊後會粘在球體上。

english: Beholder Tactics
zh_tw: 巨眼魔戰術

english: The Tomb of the Nine Gods is not truly the beholder's domain, so it can't use lair actions.
zh_tw: 九神之墓並不是巨眼魔真正的領地，所以它不能使用領地動作。

english: The {@condition invisible} beholder puts as much distance between itself and the adventurers as possible, while making sure to not catch the iron sphere in its Antimagic Cone.
zh_tw: 這隻{@condition invisible||隱形}隱形的巨眼魔會儘可能與冒險者保持距離，同時確保不讓自己進入鐵球的反魔法錐範圍內。

english: Belchorzh doesn't pursue intruders who flee its vault. However, if the adventurers steal even one copper piece from its trove, the beholder uses the alien growth throughout this level of the dungeon against them. Whenever the characters come near a patch of the growth, it sprouts an eyestalk and attacks (see "{@area Alien Growth|3b2|x}").
zh_tw: 貝爾科茲不會追趕逃離其金庫的入侵者。然而，如果冒險者從它的寶藏中偷走哪怕一枚銅幣，邪眼就會利用地牢這一層次的外星生長物來對付他們。每當角色們靠近一片生長物時，它就會長出一個眼柄並進行攻擊（見"{@area 外星生長物|3b2|x}"）。

english: The beholder knows Deep Speech and Undercommon, and it refers to itself in the third person. Haughty and defiant, it delights in the destruction of tomb robbers while refusing to yield. Any character who understands its words can translate a few of Belchorzh's choice sayings:
zh_tw: 巨眼怪懂得深淵語和下界語，並且它用第三人稱稱呼自己。它傲慢不屈，喜歡摧毀盜墓者，同時拒絕屈服。任何理解它話語的角色都可以翻譯出貝爾科茲的幾個經典語錄：

english: "You fight like flumphs!"
zh_tw: "你們戰鬥起來像一群呋嚕！"

english: "You are no match for Belchorzh the Unseen's terrible eye rays!"
zh_tw: "你們不是無形者貝爾科茲可怕眼球射線的對手！"

english: "What ugly, imperfect creatures you are."
zh_tw: "你們是多麼醜陋、不完美的生物啊。"

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The nine alcoves contain the following treasures:
zh_tw: 這九個壁龕包含以下寶藏：

english: A clay chameleon statuette covered in crystal beads that change colors (25 gp)
zh_tw: 一個覆蓋著會變色的水晶珠子的陶土變色龍小雕像（25金幣）

english: Three painted gold masks sized for children and shaped like the faces of a bat, a monkey, and a parrot, respectively (75 gp each)
zh_tw: 三個塗成金色的兒童面具，分別按照蝙蝠、猴子和鸚鵡的面孔形狀製作（每個75金幣）

english: A gold coronet shaped like an octopus with mother-of-pearl eyes (2,500 gp)
zh_tw: 一個形狀像章魚的金冠，上面鑲嵌著珍珠母的眼睛（2,500金幣）

english: A {@item potion of diminution}, a {@item bead of force}, and a bronze {@item +1 shield} shaped like a screaming devil's face
zh_tw: 一瓶{@item potion of diminution||縮小藥水}，一顆{@item bead of force||力場珠}，以及一面形狀像尖叫的魔鬼臉的青銅{@item +1 shield||+1 盾牌}

english: Level 4: Chambers of Horror
zh_tw: 第四層：恐怖之室

english: Map 5.4 shows this level of the dungeon. These corridors and chambers are choked with dust, their floors littered with rubble and the bones of dead Omuans.
zh_tw: 地圖5.4展示了地牢的這一層。這些走廊和房間充滿了灰塵，地面上散落著瓦礫和死去的奧穆人的骨頭。

english: Map 5.4: Chambers of Horror
zh_tw: 地圖5.4：恐怖之室

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 45. Gargoyle Guardians
zh_tw: 45. 石像鬼守衛

english: At the bottom of the grand staircase, a resonant mechanical rumbling emanates from a dark shaft opening up in the middle of this chamber's floor. Four cylindrical stone pedestals surround the shaft, each ten feet tall, five feet wide, and featuring a tiny slot in its side. Squatting atop each pedestal is a large four-armed gargoyle.
zh_tw: 在宏偉樓梯的底部，一個共鳴的機械隆隆聲從這個房間地板中央的一個黑暗豎井中傳出。四個圓柱形的石制基座圍繞著豎井，每個基座高十尺，寬五尺，並在其側面設有一個小槽口。每個基座上蹲著一個大型的四臂石像鬼。

english: Any character looking down on the room from one of the balconies above or another high vantage point notices something else:
zh_tw: 任何角色從上面的陽臺或另一個高處俯瞰房間時會注意到其他事情：

english: Each gargoyle is contained within a square made of metallic tiles embedded in the top of its pedestal. Starting with the northernmost pedestal and going clockwise, the tiles are copper, silver, gold, and platinum.
zh_tw: 每個石像鬼都被包含在由嵌入其基座頂部的金屬瓦片組成的正方形內。從最北邊的基座開始，按順時針方向，瓦片分別是銅的、銀的、金的和鉑的。

english: Four {@creature Giant Four-Armed Gargoyle|ToA|giant four-armed gargoyles} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are perched atop the pedestals, each one crouched within its square of tiled precious metal. The gargoyles remain motionless until they are provoked.
zh_tw: 四隻 {@creature Giant Four-Armed Gargoyle|ToA|四臂巨石像鬼}（見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）棲息在基座上，每一隻都蹲伏在它那塊鑲嵌著珍貴金屬的正方形內。這些石像鬼保持靜止，直到它們被激怒。

english: The slots in each pedestal are 4 feet above the floor and roughly the size of a standard coin. All humanoids must pay a tithe before leaving this room to avoid provoking the gargoyles' wrath. Specifically, each humanoid must insert a coin of the appropriate type into each pedestal (1 cp in the north pedestal, 1 sp in the east pedestal, 1 gp in the south pedestal, and 1 pp in the west pedestal). A gargoyle will always accept a more precious coin than the one required, so a character inserting a platinum coin into every pedestal could exit the room safely. A gargoyle will also accept a tithe of multiple coins of equal or greater value (10 cp instead of 1 sp in the east pedestal, for example). The pedestals have hollow cavities within them to store the coins (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 每個基座上的插槽離地面4尺，大致是標準硬幣的大小。所有類人生物在離開這個房間前都必須繳納什一稅，以避免激起石像鬼的憤怒。具體來說，每個類人生物必須將適當型別的硬幣插入每個基座（北基座1銅幣，東基座1銀幣，南基座1金幣，西基座1白金幣）。石像鬼總是會接受比所需更珍貴的硬幣，所以將每個基座插入一個白金硬幣的角色可以安全地離開房間。石像鬼也會接受多個等值或更高價值的硬幣作為什一稅（例如，東基座上用10銅幣代替1銀幣）。基座內有空心腔體來存放硬幣（見下面的"寶藏"）。

english: The gargoyles always know when they're being cheated. If any humanoid leaves the room without offering sufficient coin, any cheated gargoyles spring to life and attack the cheapskate. A gargoyle also springs to life and attacks if it or its pedestal is damaged in any way. The metallic tiles atop the pedestals can be pried loose, but they turn to dust if removed from this chamber.
zh_tw: 石像鬼總是知道何時被欺騙。如果任何類人生物在沒有提供足夠硬幣的情況下離開房間，任何被欺騙的石像鬼就會甦醒並攻擊吝嗇鬼。如果石像鬼或其底座以任何方式受到損壞，石像鬼也會甦醒並攻擊。底座上的金屬瓦片可以撬松，但如果從這個房間移除，它們就會變成灰塵。

english: Shaft
zh_tw: 豎井

english: The shaft in the floor is 10 feet wide and 15 feet deep. It opens into the ceiling of {@area area 58|484|x}. To scale the smooth walls of the shaft, a character needs climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 地面上的豎井寬10尺，深15尺。它通向{@area 區域58|484|x}的天花板。要爬上豎井光滑的牆壁，角色需要攀爬裝備或魔法。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each pedestal is a hollow stone cylinder with 6-inch-thick walls. Characters with appropriate tools can smash through the stone to get at the coins within each pedestal.
zh_tw: 每個底座是一個空心石制圓柱體，壁厚6吋。擁有適當工具的角色可以砸穿石頭，以獲取每個底座內的硬幣。

english: The north pedestal holds 5 sp and 100 cp. The east pedestal hides 1 gp, 120 sp, and 200 cp. The south pedestal conceals 2 pp, 90 gp, 350 sp, and 500 cp. The west pedestal holds 10 pp, 630 gp, 7,200 sp, 5,000 cp, and the skeletal remains of an Omuan engineer.
zh_tw: 北邊的底座有5個銀幣和100個銅幣。東邊的底座藏有1個金幣、120個銀幣和200個銅幣。南邊的底座隱藏著2個鉑金幣、90個金幣、350個銀幣和500個銅幣。西邊的底座有10個鉑金幣、630個金幣、7200個銀幣、5000個銅幣，以及一個歐曼工程師的骸骨。

english: 46. Lizard Den
zh_tw: 46. 蜥蜴巢穴

english: A six-foot-tall green devil face is carved into the far end of this hallway, its mouth agape. Painted murals on the walls show faceless humanoid figures doubled over in pain, clutching at their heads and ears.
zh_tw: 這個走廊的遠端雕刻著一個六尺高的綠色魔鬼面孔，它的嘴巴張開。牆上的壁畫展示了沒有面孔的人形生物，他們痛苦地彎腰，雙手緊抓頭部和耳朵。

english: Despite the ominous murals and the devil face carving, this hall is devoid of traps. Any character who searches the devil face finds a {@creature lizard} hiding in the carving's shallow mouth cavity. The recipient of an {@spell awaken} spell cast by a Chultan druid, the lizard has an Intelligence score of 10 and speaks Druidic.
