The Company of the Yellow Banner captured it in Omu and brought it to the tomb thinking it might be useful for setting off traps. The lizard escaped and wound up here. It doesn't know what became of its captors and helps the characters any way it can if they promise to return it to Omu.
zh_tw: 儘管有不祥的壁畫和魔鬼面孔雕刻，這個走廊沒有陷阱。任何檢查魔鬼面孔的角色會發現一隻{@creature lizard||蜥蜴}藏在雕刻的淺口中。這隻蜥蜴是由一位楚爾特德魯伊施放的{@spell awaken||啟蒙術}法術的接受者，智力得分為10，並且會說德魯伊語。黃旗冒險團在奧穆捕獲了它，並把它帶到墓穴，認為它可能對觸發陷阱有用。蜥蜴逃脫了，最終來到這裡。它不知道它的捕獲者發生了什麼，如果角色們承諾將其帶回奧穆，它會盡其所能地幫助角色。

english: 47. Elemental Cells
zh_tw: 47. 元素牢房

english: To reach Shagambi's tomb ({@area area 48|438|x}), the adventurers must pass through four cells thematically linked to fire, water, air, and earth. Unless the characters destroyed him, {@creature Withers|ToA} (see {@area area 28|3aa|x}) senses when the secret door to area 47A is opened and uses the scrying pool in {@area area 25|39f|x} to observe the adventurers as they contend with the cells.
zh_tw: 要到達莎根比的墓穴({@area 區域48|438|x})，冒險者必須穿過四個主題與火、水、空氣和土相關的牢房。除非角色們已經摧毀了他，{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}（見{@area 區域28|3aa|x}）會在秘密門通往47A區域被開啟時感知到，並使用{@area 區域25|39f|x}中的水晶球池觀察冒險者們如何應對這些牢房。

english: An {@spell antimagic field} fills each cell, rendering magic items useless, suppressing ongoing magical effects, and preventing all spellcasting. See the spell's description in the {@i Player's Handbook} for full information.
zh_tw: 每個牢房中都充填著{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}，使得魔法物品失效，壓制持續中的魔法效果，並阻止所有的法術施放。完整資訊請參見{@i 玩家手冊}中的法術描述。

english: 47A. Fire Cell
zh_tw: 47A. 火元素牢房

english: Waves of heat blast out of this cramped cell. The walls are scribed with relief carvings showing volcanoes setting cities ablaze. Rows of tiny holes are bored into the floor and the ten-foot-high ceiling. A human skeleton embedded in the opposite wall holds an iron sconce with a burning red candle in it.
zh_tw: 這個狹小的牢房中爆發出陣陣熱浪。牆壁上刻有浮雕，描繪著火山將城市燒成灰燼的場景。地板和十尺高的天花板上鑽有一排排小孔。對面的牆上嵌著一具人類骷髏，手持一個裝有燃燒的紅蠟燭的鐵燭臺。

english: The skeleton is all that remains of a dead Omuan engineer. As long as the candle remains in this cell, it burns indefinitely. If taken from the area, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 這具骷髏是已故歐曼工程師的遺骸。只要蠟燭留在這個牢房內，它就會無限期地燃燒。如果被拿走，它會正常燃燒完畢。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: If {@creature Withers|ToA} is watching, he tries to trap as many characters as he can in the cell by whispering a command word that causes the secret door in the south wall to slide shut and lock. No keyhole or visible opening mechanism can be found on the secret door. The secret door remains sealed until the characters escape from the cells or die trying. A wedge, spike, or similar object can be used to prevent the door from closing.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}正在監視，他會嘗試透過低聲說出一個命令詞來困住儘可能多的角色在牢房內，這個命令詞會導致南牆上的秘密門滑動關閉並上鎖。在秘密門上找不到鑰匙孔或可見的開啟機制。秘密門會保持密封狀態，直到角色們從牢房逃脫或嘗試逃脫時死亡。可以使用楔子、釘子或類似的物體來防止門關閉。

english: Lava Trap
zh_tw: 熔岩陷阱

english: Molten lava begins pouring from the tiny holes in the ceiling as soon as any character comes within 1 foot of the candle or removes it from the sconce. The lava rains down and magically drains away through the holes in the floor. Each creature in the cell when the lava begins to fall must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any creature that enters the cell for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must repeat the saving throw. Because of the cell's {@spell antimagic field}, magic items and spells that provide resistance to fire offer no protection here.
zh_tw: 當任何角色靠近蠟燭1尺範圍內或將其從燭臺取下時，天花板上的小孔開始湧出熔岩。熔岩如同雨點般落下，並透過地板上的孔神奇地流走。當熔岩開始落下時，房間內的每個生物都必須進行一次{@dc 20}敏捷豁免，若豁免失敗則受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）火焰傷害，若成功則只受一半傷害。任何在本回合首次進入房間或在此開始回合的生物必須重複進行豁免。由於房間內的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}，提供火焰抗性的魔法物品和法術在此無效。

english: Extinguishing the Candle
zh_tw: 熄滅蠟燭

english: If the candle is extinguished inside the cell, the {@spell antimagic field} is dispelled and all creatures in the cell are teleported to one of the other cells, as follows:
zh_tw: 如果蠟燭在牢房內被熄滅，{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}將被解除，並且牢房內的所有生物將被傳送到其他牢房之一，具體如下：

english: If the candle's flame is doused with water or some other liquid, creatures in the cell are teleported to the water cell (area 47B).
zh_tw: 如果蠟燭的火焰被水或其他液體熄滅，牢房內的生物將被傳送到水牢房（區域47B）。

english: If the candle's flame is blown out or smothered by a lack of oxygen (including being ground out against the wall or floor), creatures are teleported to the air cell (area 47C).
zh_tw: 如果蠟燭的火焰被吹滅或因缺乏氧氣而熄滅（包括在牆壁或地板上摩擦熄滅），生物將被傳送到空氣牢房（區域47C）。

english: 47B. Water Cell
zh_tw: 47B. 水元素牢房

english: You appear in a cell that smells moldy. Its damp walls are covered with living snails and oysters, and feature sculptural reliefs of tidal waves destroying coastal cities and ships. A merfolk skeleton embedded in one wall clutches an iron sconce fitted with a burning red candle. Suddenly, lukewarm water begins to pour into the cell through rows of tiny holes in the ten-foot-high ceiling.
zh_tw: 你出現在一個有黴味的牢房裡。潮溼的牆壁上覆蓋著活蝸牛和牡蠣，並有浮雕展示海嘯摧毀沿海城市和船隻。一具美人魚骷髏嵌在一面牆上，緊握著一個裝有燃燒的紅蠟燭的鐵燭臺。突然，微溫的水開始透過十尺高的天花板上的小孔流入牢房。

english: The candle is a distraction and offers no way out of the cell. As long as it remains in this cell, the candle burns indefinitely until extinguished. If taken from the area, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 這根蠟燭是一個幹擾物，並不能提供離開牢房的出路。只要它留在這個牢房內，蠟燭就會無限期地燃燒，直到被熄滅。如果被拿走，它會正常燃燒完畢。

english: Flood Trap
zh_tw: 洪水陷阱

english: The water fills the cell at a rate of 1 foot per round, taking 10 rounds to fill the room. If the candle is left in its sconce, the rising water extinguishes it on the fourth round. Trying to stuff or block the holes doesn't stop the water from pouring in. Because of the cell's {@spell antimagic field}, spells and magic items that enable characters to breathe underwater don't function here. Any character who runs out of air begins to suffocate (see "{@book The Environment|PHB|8|The Environment}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
zh_tw: 水以每輪1尺的速度填滿牢房，10輪後房間會被完全填滿。如果蠟燭留在燭臺上，上升的水將在第四輪將其熄滅。試圖堵塞或阻擋孔洞並不能阻止水湧入。由於牢房內的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}，使角色能夠在水下呼吸的法術和魔法物品在此處無法生效。任何空氣耗盡的角色將開始窒息（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 環境|PHB|8|The Environment}"）。

english: Snails and Oysters
zh_tw: 蝸牛和牡蠣

english: There are dozens of snails and oysters clinging to the walls. A character can use an action to remove an oyster or snail from a wall, crack it open, and eat it. The first time an oyster or snail is removed from a wall, the cell's {@spell antimagic field} is dispelled. Eating an oyster teleports a character (along with his or her possessions) to the air cell (area 47C), while eating a snail teleports a character (along with his or her possessions) to the earth cell (area 47D).
zh_tw: 牆上附著數十隻蝸牛和牡蠣。角色可以使用動作從牆上取下一個牡蠣或蝸牛，開啟它並吃掉。第一次從牆上取下牡蠣或蝸牛時，牢房的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}將被解除。吃牡蠣會將角色（連同他或她的物品）傳送到空氣牢房（區域47C），而吃蝸牛會將角色（連同他或她的物品）傳送到土牢房（區域47D）。

english: When the last character leaves the cell, rows of tiny holes open in the floor, allowing the water to drain out at a rate of 1 foot per round.
zh_tw: 當最後一個角色離開牢房時，地板上的小孔會開啟，使水以每輪1尺的速度排出。

english: 47C. Air Cell
zh_tw: 47C. 風元素牢房

english: You immediately begin to choke as you are teleported to a room with no light, no sound, and no air.
zh_tw: 當你被傳送到一個沒有光、沒有聲音、也沒有空氣的房間時，你立刻開始感到窒息。

english: The cell's {@spell antimagic field} douses magical lights, and nonmagical flames are snuffed out because of the lack of oxygen in the room. Creatures that can see in the dark can see the following:
zh_tw: 牢房的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}熄滅了魔法光源，而非魔法火焰因為房間內缺乏氧氣而熄滅。能在黑暗中視物的生物可以看到以下情景：

english: Sculptural reliefs on the walls of this dark cell show tornadoes uprooting trees and tearing cities apart. An aarakocra skeleton embedded in one wall holds an iron sconce bearing an unlit red candle.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗牢房的牆壁上有浮雕，展示著龍捲風拔起樹木並摧毀城市。一具鳥羽人骷髏嵌在一面牆上，手持一個裝有未點燃的紅蠟燭的鐵燭臺。

english: Any creature that requires air to breathe immediately begins to suffocate unless it took the precaution of holding its breath before teleporting here (see "{@book The Environment|PHB|8|The Environment}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Player's Handbook}).
zh_tw: 任何需要空氣呼吸的生物會立即開始窒息，除非它在傳送到這裡之前採取了屏息的預防措施（參見{@i 玩家手冊}第8章中的"{@book 環境|PHB|8|The Environment}"）。

english: Any character who cannot see can use an action to blindly search the cell by touch, then make a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. If the check succeeds, the character discerns one key feature of the room: either the wall carvings, the aarakocra skeleton, or the candle.
zh_tw: 任何無法看見的角色可以使用一個動作透過觸控盲目搜尋牢房，然後進行一次 {@dc 13} 感知 ({@skill Perception||感知}) 檢定。如果檢定成功，角色可以辨別出房間的一個關鍵特徵：要麼是牆上的雕刻，要麼是阿剌克瑞骨架，要麼是蠟燭。

english: Aarakocra Bones
zh_tw: 鳥羽人骨骼

english: The aarakocra skeleton embedded in the wall has hollow bones containing stale yet breathable air—each one essentially a tube sealed with wax. A character with a dagger or similar tool can use an action to pry a bone out of the wall, pierce the wax seal, and inhale the air within. The first time a bone is removed from a wall, the cell's {@spell antimagic field} is dispelled. Any character who inhales the air is teleported (along with his or her possessions) to {@area area 48|438|x}.
zh_tw: 嵌入牆壁中的鳥羽人骨骼擁有中空的骨骼，其中包含著陳舊但可呼吸的空氣——每一個骨骼本質上都是用蠟密封的管子。擁有匕首或類似工具的角色可以使用動作從牆上撬下骨骼，刺穿蠟封，並吸入裡面的空氣。第一次從牆上移除骨骼時，牢房的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}將被解除。任何吸入空氣的角色（連同他或她的物品）將被傳送到{@area 區域48|438|x}。

english: Unlit Candle
zh_tw: 未點燃的蠟燭

english: The candle can't be lit without air, but let characters waste time trying. The candle is not the means by which characters can escape the cell. If somehow lit, the candle burns indefinitely as long as it remains in this cell. If taken from the area, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 沒有空氣，蠟燭無法點燃，但這可以浪費角色們的時間嘗試。蠟燭並不是角色逃離牢房的手段。如果以某種方式點燃，只要它留在這個牢房內，蠟燭就會無限期地燃燒。如果被拿走，它會正常燃燒完畢。

english: 47D. Earth Cell
zh_tw: 47D. 土元素牢房

english: The walls of this stone cell are covered with reliefs showing desert sands swallowing the ruins of civilization. A bas-relief of a robed medusa dominates one wall. It wears a stone necklace with an obsidian pendant and clutches an iron sconce with a burning red candle in it. Sand begins to fall from tiny holes bored into the ten-foot-high ceiling, and you hear a rumbling noise under the floor.
zh_tw: 這個石制牢房的牆壁上覆蓋著浮雕，展示著沙漠吞噬文明廢墟的場景。一面牆上有一個身穿長袍的美杜莎的高浮雕。它戴著一個帶有黑曜石吊墜的石項鍊，並緊握著一個裝有燃燒的紅蠟燭的鐵燭臺。沙子開始從十尺高的天花板上的小孔中落下，你聽到地板下傳來隆隆的聲音。

english: The candle can be extinguished and relit, but is of no use to characters trying to escape the room. As long as it remains in this cell, the candle burns indefinitely. If taken from the area, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 蠟燭可以被熄滅並重新點燃，但對於試圖逃離房間的角色來說沒有用處。只要它留在這個牢房內，蠟燭就會無限期地燃燒。如果被拿走，它會正常燃燒完畢。

english: Any character who searches the cell and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices a seam running down the middle of the floor from north to south. The seam suggests the existence of a pit trap.
zh_tw: 任何搜尋牢房並透過一個{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定成功的角色，會注意到一個從北向南貫穿地板中間的接縫。這個接縫暗示可能存在一個陷阱坑。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: The falling sand fills the room at a rate of 6 inches per round, turning the floor into {@quickref difficult terrain||3} after 1 round. Any character who can reach the ceiling can use an action to stuff a number of holes with cloth or wax, slowing the sand by 1 inch per round. If the sand reaches a depth of 12 inches, the floor splits open along its seam. When the pit opens, half of the floor swings down to the west and the other half drops to the east, and the sand stops falling. A 6-inch-wide ledge surrounds the pit on all sides. Any creature standing on the floor when it opens must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw; those standing along the walls have advantage on the save. On a successful save, a creature finds purchase on the ledge. A creature that fails the save falls.
zh_tw: 下落的沙子以每輪6吋的速度填滿房間，1輪後地板變成{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。任何能夠到天花板的角色可以使用一個動作用布或蠟堵住一些洞，使沙子每輪減慢1吋。如果沙子達到12吋深，地板沿著接縫裂開。當陷坑開啟時，一半地板向西擺動，另一半向東下落，沙子停止下落。一個6吋寬的壁架環繞陷坑四周。任何在陷坑開啟時站在地板上的生物必須進行一個{@dc 15}敏捷豁免；那些靠牆站的生物在豁免檢定上有優勢。豁免成功的生物會抓住壁架。豁免失敗的生物將墜落。

english: The 10-foot-deep pit contains two giant stone rollers with interlocking stone teeth. Anything larger than a grain of sand gets chewed up between these rollers, taking 132 ({@dice 24d10}) force damage. Any creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is ground to a pulp. A creature that passes through the rollers with at least 1 hit point remaining lands on an iron grate 5 feet below the grinders. A stone button is set into one of the walls above the grate and is visible only to creatures under the rollers. When pressed, the button causes the rollers to stop turning and retract into the walls, allowing creatures that survived the horrid trap to climb out with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這個10尺深的坑內有兩個巨大的石制滾輪，滾輪上嵌有交錯的石齒。任何比沙粒大的物體都會被這些滾輪碾碎，造成132點（{@dice 24d10}）力場傷害。任何因該傷害而生命值降至0點的生物都會被碾成肉泥。任何一個生命值至少為1的生物透過滾輪後，會落在磨盤下方5尺處的鐵格柵上。鐵格柵上方的牆壁上嵌有一塊石制按鈕，只有滾輪下方的生物才能看到。按下按鈕後，滾輪會停止轉動並縮回牆壁內，讓倖存的生物透過一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定爬出去。

english: The pit is within the cell's {@spell antimagic field}, so spells and magical effects that might otherwise allow a character to survive the rollers or ascend the pit won't work.
zh_tw: 這個坑位於牢房的{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}內，因此法術和魔法效果，如果有的話，將無法讓角色在滾筒上生存或攀爬出坑。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who searches the medusa bas-relief and succeeds on a {@dc 11} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices seams around the carving, suggesting the presence of a secret door. A successful check also reveals that the medusa's obsidian pendant is a button. The button won't depress unless the pit is open. A character can try to unlock the button using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, doing so with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check. Pressing the unlocked pendant causes the secret door's lock to release with a dull clunk, after which the door can be swung open to reveal {@area area 48|438|x} beyond. The secret door has springs that cause it to close automatically unless it is held or wedged open. The door locks when it closes and can be opened only from within the cell.
zh_tw: 任何搜尋美杜莎浮雕並透過{@dc 11}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會注意到雕刻周圍的接縫，表明存在一扇密門。成功的檢定還會發現美杜莎的黑曜石吊墜是一個按鈕。除非陷坑開啟，否則按鈕無法按下。角色可以嘗試使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}解鎖按鈕，需透過{@dc 17}敏捷檢定。按下解鎖的吊墜會使密門鎖具發出沉悶的咔噠聲鬆開，之後可以推開門露出後面的{@area 區域48|438|x}。密門裝有彈簧，除非被固定或楔住，否則會自動關閉。門關閉時會鎖住，只能從牢房內部開啟。

english: 48. Shagambi's Tomb
zh_tw: 48. 莎根比的墓

english: Each character who teleports into this tomb from area 47C appears atop a randomly determined teleportation rune (see "Teleportation Runes" below). Characters can also enter the tomb through the secret door at area 47D.
zh_tw: 每個從區域47C傳送到這個墓室的角色都會出現在一個隨機確定的傳送符文上（見下文的"傳送符文"）。角色也可以透過區域47D的秘密門進入墓室。

english: This tomb is filled with {@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|terracotta warriors}, kneeling in neat ranks around a polished wooden coffin. Between the warriors, four aisles scattered with broken pottery lead up to the coffin, whose painted lid shows a leopard with serpents sprouting from its shoulders.
zh_tw: 這個墓室充滿了{@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|兵馬俑}，它們整齊地跪在拋光的木棺周圍。在戰士之間，四條散落著破碎陶器的通道通向棺材，棺材上畫著一個豹子，其肩膀上長著蛇。

english: If intruders are heard within the tomb, the terracotta warriors rise to defend it (see "Terracotta Warriors" below). To steal Shagambi's treasures, characters must move quietly.
zh_tw: 如果墓室內有入侵者的聲音，兵馬俑戰士會站起來保衛它（見下文的"兵馬俑戰士"）。要偷取莎根比的寶藏，角色們必須安靜地移動。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Unkh or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被安珂或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Nervous Unkh suggests that her host leave the tomb at once using one of the teleportation runes, though she can't decide which rune is best.
zh_tw: 緊張的安珂建議她的宿主立即使用其中一個傳送符文離開墓室，儘管她無法決定哪個符文最好。

english: Impulsive Wongo thinks it's a good idea to shatter as many terracotta warriors as possible, as quickly as possible.
zh_tw: 衝動的望戈認為儘可能快地破壞儘可能多的兵馬俑是個好主意。

english: Teleportation Runes
zh_tw: 傳送符文

english: Three teleportation runes are scribed on the floor along the north, east, and south walls of the tomb. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals that each rune has a different aura—strong, steady conjuration magic from the eastern rune; flickering conjuration magic from the northern rune; and a combination of conjuration and transmutation magic from the southern rune.
zh_tw: 墓室的北面、東面和南面牆上的地面上刻有三個傳送符文。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果顯示每個符文都有不同的氣息——來自東面符文的強大穩定的召喚魔法；來自北面符文的閃爍召喚魔法；以及來自南面符文的召喚和變化魔法的組合。

english: Whenever a creature teleports into the tomb, roll a {@dice d6} to determine which rune it arrives on: 1–2, north rune; 3–4, east rune; 5–6, south rune. If more than one creature is teleported to the same rune, the previous creature is pushed harmlessly off the rune when the new creature appears. Additionally, the north rune is malfunctioning, and any creature arriving there takes 18 ({@dice 4d8}) force damage.
zh_tw: 每當一個生物傳送到墓穴中時，擲一個{@dice d6}來確定它到達哪個符文上：1-2，北符文；3-4，東符文；5-6，南符文。如果多個生物被傳送到同一個符文上，當新生物出現時，之前的生物會被無害地推下符文。此外，北符文出現故障，任何到達那裡的生物都會受到18點（{@dice 4d8}）力場傷害。

english: Any creature that moves from outside a rune into its space is instantly teleported to {@area area 50|44c|x}. A creature that uses the south rune to teleport is also polymorphed into a random beast, as though it had failed its saving throw against the {@spell polymorph} spell. Roll a {@dice d4} to determine the new form: 1, {@creature baboon}; 2, {@creature bat}; 3, {@creature flying snake}; 4, {@creature quipper}.
zh_tw: 任何生物從符文外部移動到其空間內，會立即被傳送到{@area 區域50|44c|x}。使用南側符文進行傳送的生物還會被變化成一種隨機的野獸，就好像它未能透過對抗{@spell polymorph||變形術}法術的豁免檢定一樣。擲一個{@dice d4}來確定新形態：1，{@creature baboon||狒狒}；2，{@creature bat||蝙蝠}；3，{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}；4，{@creature quipper||食人魚}。

english: Terracotta Warriors
zh_tw: 兵馬俑戰士

english: Forty-eight {@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|terracotta warriors} guard the tomb. Use {@creature animated armor} statistics, with these changes:
zh_tw: 四十八名{@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|兵馬俑}守衛著墓室。使用{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的具體數值，並進行以下更改：

english: Each {@creature terracotta warrior|ToA} wields a shortsword. As an action, it can attack twice with the weapon ({@hit 4} to hit), dealing 5 ({@dice 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 每個{@creature terracotta warrior|ToA|兵馬俑}都手持一把短劍。作為一個動作，它可以用該武器攻擊兩次（命中{@hit 4}），每次命中造成5（{@dice 1d6 + 2}）點穿刺傷害。

english: If a critical hit is scored against a {@creature terracotta warrior|ToA}, it shatters and is destroyed.
zh_tw: 如果對{@creature terracotta warrior|ToA|兵馬俑}造成重擊，它將破碎並被摧毀。

english: The terracotta warriors remain perfectly still and pose no threat as long as the tomb remains relatively quiet. If any character talks loudly, steps on a piece of broken pottery, or makes any other equivalent noise while in the tomb, read:
zh_tw: 只要墓室保持相對安靜，兵馬俑戰士就會保持完全靜止，不構成威脅。如果任何角色在墓室內大聲說話、踩到破碎的陶器，或製造任何其他等效的噪音，請閱讀：

english: All the terracotta warriors turn their heads to face you. As one, they pull their swords a few inches from their scabbards.
zh_tw: 所有的兵馬俑戰士都轉過頭來面對你。它們齊刷刷地將劍從劍鞘中拔出幾吋。

english: After this single warning, the {@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|terracotta warriors} attack if they hear any other noise. Without the use of magic, any creature walking through the tomb must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to remain quiet. Moving through pottery shards imposes disadvantage on the check. Once roused into action, the terracotta warriors attack all the creatures in the tomb.
zh_tw: 在這一聲警告之後，如果聽到任何其他響動，{@creature Terracotta Warrior|ToA|兵馬俑}會發動攻擊。在不使用魔法的情況下，任何生物在穿過陵墓時都必須透過一個{@dc 12}的敏捷（{@skill Stealth||隱匿}）檢定以保持安靜。走過陶器碎片會使該檢定處於劣勢。一旦被喚醒進入戰鬥狀態，兵馬俑戰士會攻擊陵墓中的所有生物。

english: Coffin
zh_tw: 棺材

english: Shagambi's coffin is trapped but not locked. When its lid is opened, a music box inside the coffin is activated, rousing the terracotta warriors if they can hear its haunting melody (even if the adventurers have been silent up to that point). Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check while gently lifting the coffin lid spots the trap's trigger wire, which can then be cut with {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check. The music box is activated on a failed check.
zh_tw: 莎根比的棺材設有陷阱但未上鎖。當棺蓋被開啟時，內部的音樂盒會啟動，若能聽見其詭異旋律（即便冒險者此前一直保持安靜），將喚醒兵馬俑。任何角色在輕輕抬起棺蓋時透過{@dc 14}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可發現陷阱觸發線，隨後可用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過{@dc 12}敏捷檢定切斷。若檢定失敗則音樂盒啟動。

english: The bones of a kamadan (Shagambi's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) are bound in cloth inside the sarcophagus, along with valuables (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 六岐蛇豹（莎根比的動物形態；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的骨頭被綁在布中，放在石棺內，連同貴重物品（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The following treasures are heaped around Shagambi's bones: 200 gp, five moonstones (50 gp each), the fine music box activated by the trap (250 gp), and an {@item instrument of the bards} (Canaith mandolin). The instrument turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 以下寶物堆放在莎根比（莎根比）的遺骨周圍：200金幣、五顆月光石（每顆價值50金幣）、被陷阱觸發的精美音樂盒（價值250金幣）以及一件{@item instrument of the bards||吟遊詩人樂器}（卡奈斯卡曼陀林）。如果這件樂器離開九神之墓，它就會化為塵埃並被摧毀（但請參見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"）。

english: Shagambi's Spirit
zh_tw: 莎根比的靈魂

english: The spirit of Shagambi tries to inhabit any character who touches the mandolin (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Shagambi's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 莎根比的靈魂試圖附身於任何觸控曼陀林的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當莎根比的靈魂顯現時，請閱讀：

english: Six shadowy serpents slither out of the mandolin and coil around your body. You hear a purring voice in your mind say, "I am not your enemy."
zh_tw: 六條朦朧的蛇從曼陀林中滑出，纏繞在你的身體周圍。你聽到一個在你的腦海中低語的聲音說："我不是你的敵人。"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Shagambi|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Shagambi's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the mandolin and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功附身於角色，給玩家{@card Shagambi|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|莎根比的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂將返回到曼陀林中，並等待另一個角色觸控它。

english: 49. Maze of Death
zh_tw: 49. 死亡迷宮

english: Stone slabs seal off the entrances to this corner of the dungeon.
zh_tw: 石板封住了這個地牢角落的入口。

english: 49A. Stone Slabs
zh_tw: 49A. 石板

english: When the characters reach either entrance, read:
zh_tw: 當角色到達任一入口時，請閱讀：

english: A stone slab blocks the end of this corridor. Painted on the slab is the image of a gaunt male humanoid wearing a hooded cloak, its face a mask of stars. The figure's withered left hand is raised with palm extended.
zh_tw: 一塊石板堵住了這條走廊的盡頭。石板上畫著一個面容憔悴的男性類人生物，身穿帶兜帽的斗篷，其臉是星星構成的面具。這個人物枯萎的左手抬起，掌心向外。

english: The stone slabs are impervious to damage and spells, and they are fitted so snugly that even creatures in gaseous form can't slip past them. If any character stands in front of a slab and raises his or her left hand with palm extended, both slabs open at the same time, regardless of any efforts taken to prevent them from doing so. When this happens, read:
zh_tw: 這些石板對傷害和法術都是不可滲透的，它們緊密地安裝在一起，即使是氣態生物也無法穿過。如果任何角色站在石板前，伸出左手掌向上，兩塊石板會同時開啟，不管採取了什麼措施來阻止它們。當這種情況發生時，讀：

english: The slab sinks into the floor, revealing a dusty passageway beyond. Relief carvings on the walls depict crowds of humanoids fleeing a black star in the sky, with rays of light extending from it to turn those they strike to dust.
zh_tw: 石板沉入地板，露出了後面的塵土飛揚的通道。牆壁上的浮雕刻畫著一群類人生物逃離天空中的黑色星星，星星發出的光芒觸及到它們將它們變成塵土。

english: If the stone slabs are raised up to seal off the exits once more (see area 49C), characters within the maze see a second image on the inner surface of each slab:
zh_tw: 如果石板被再次升起以封住出口（見區域49C），迷宮內的角色會看到每塊石板內側的第二個影象：

english: Painted on the inside of the slab is a male humanoid wearing a hooded cloak, once again with stars where his face should be. The figure holds up his right arm, which is severed neatly at the elbow.
zh_tw: 石板內側畫著一個穿著帶兜帽斗篷的男性類人生物，他的臉上再次佈滿了星星。這個人物舉起了他整齊地切斷在肘部的右臂。

english: This image is visible only while the slabs are in their raised positions. From inside the maze, a character can make both slabs sink back down into the floor by standing in front of either slab while holding up his or her right arm—as long as that arm has been severed at the elbow. It doesn't matter how the arm is cut off, but sticking it in the {@item sphere of annihilation} in area 49B is one way to do it.
zh_tw: 這個影象只有在石板處於升起位置時才可見。從迷宮內部，一個角色可以透過站在任一石板前並舉起他的或她的右臂來使兩塊石板重新沉入地面——只要那隻手臂在肘部以下被切斷。手臂是如何被切斷的並不重要，但將其放入49B區域的{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}是一種方法。

english: 49B. Green Devil Face
zh_tw: 49B. 綠色魔鬼面孔

english: A green stone face of devilish countenance protrudes from the wall. The devil's mouth is agape and filled with darkness.
zh_tw: 一個綠色石制的魔鬼面孔從牆上突出。魔鬼的嘴巴張開，裡面充滿了黑暗。

english: The devil face is 6 feet tall, with a mouth 2 feet in diameter. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic on the face.
zh_tw: 這個魔鬼面孔高6尺，嘴巴直徑2尺。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了面孔上的變形魔法氣息。

english: The darkness within the mouth is a {@item sphere of annihilation}, which can't be controlled or moved. Any character who stands within 5 feet of the sphere can hear a faint whisper emanating from it. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check allows a character to make out words in Abyssal that translate as follows: "Darkness is coming for you. Your doom is at hand."
zh_tw: 口腔內的黑暗是一個{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}，它無法被控制或移動。任何站在距離球體5尺內的角色都能聽到從球體中傳出的微弱低語。成功透過{@dc 12}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色能夠辨認出深淵語中的話語，其翻譯如下："黑暗正朝你襲來。你的末日即將來臨。"

english: 49C. Black Opal Crown
zh_tw: 49C. 黑蛋白石皇冠

english: In this central open space, a gold crown topped with a glittering black opal rests on a marble pedestal.
zh_tw: 在這個中央開闊的空間裡，一個金色的王冠，頂部鑲嵌著一顆閃閃發光的黑色蛋白石，放置在大理石基座上。

english: If any creature removes the crown from the pedestal, two things happen simultaneously:
zh_tw: 如果任何生物從基座上移除皇冠，兩件事情會同時發生：

english: The stone slabs in area 49A rise up to seal off both exits from the maze.
zh_tw: 49A區域的石板升起，封閉了迷宮的兩個出口。

english: Two {@creature Bodak|VGM|bodaks} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) magically emerge from the {@item sphere of annihilation} in area 49B, seemingly unaffected by it, and begin scouring the maze for prey. Any creature killed by the bodaks is dragged back to the sphere and tossed into it. The bodaks crawl back into the sphere only if they're satisfied that there's nothing left in the maze to kill.
zh_tw: 兩個{@creature Bodak|VGM|波達屍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）神奇地從49B區域的{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}中出現，似乎不受其影響，並開始在迷宮中尋找獵物。被博達克殺死的任何生物都會被拖回球體並投入其中。只有在確信迷宮中沒有剩餘可殺之物時，博達克才會爬回球體。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The Black Opal Crown is worth 5,000 gp but can fetch up to four times that value if sold at auction in any major city. For more information on this item, see "{@area Fabled Treasures|31a|x}."
zh_tw: 黑蛋白石王冠價值5000金幣，但如果在任何大城市的拍賣中出售，其價值可能高達這個數字的四倍。關於這件物品的更多資訊，請見"{@area 傳說中的寶藏|31a|x}"。

english: 50. Mirror of Life Trapping
zh_tw: 50. 生命陷阱之鏡

english: Any creature teleported here from {@area area 48|438|x} appears in a random spot near the center of the room and facing west, much to its peril.
zh_tw: 任何從{@area 區域48|438|x}傳送到這裡的生物都會隨機出現在房間中心附近，並且面向西方，這對它來說非常危險。

english: This dusty room is fifteen feet square and empty except for an ornate, rectangular mirror mounted on the wall opposite the room's only exit.
zh_tw: 這個塵土飛揚的房間是一個15尺見方的正方形，除了牆上唯一出口對面掛著的一面裝飾華麗的矩形鏡子外，房間裡空無一物。

english: Attached to the west wall with {@item sovereign glue} is a {@item mirror of life trapping}. Any creature within 30 feet of the mirror that sees its reflection must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be imprisoned within one of the mirror's twelve extradimensional cells, along with anything it is wearing or carrying. Constructs automatically succeed on the saving throw.
zh_tw: 用{@item sovereign glue||至尊膠}附著在西牆上的是一面{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}。任何在鏡子30尺內看到自己倒影的生物必須透過一個{@dc 15}的魅力豁免檢定，否則將被囚禁在鏡子的十二個異次元牢房之一中，隨身攜帶的物品也會一同被囚禁。構裝體自動透過豁免檢定。

english: The mirror currently has three vacant cells. If the mirror traps a creature when its twelve cells are already occupied, it releases one trapped creature at random to accommodate the new prisoner. The Prisoners of the Mirror table lists the mirror's current prisoners and summarizes how they react if set free or spoken to. Otherwise, roleplay them as you see fit.
zh_tw: 鏡子目前有三個空單元。如果鏡子在其十二個單元已經被佔據時困住一個生物，它會隨機釋放一個被困的生物，以容納新的囚犯。鏡子的囚犯表格列出了鏡子目前的囚犯，並總結瞭如果釋放它們或與它們交談時它們的反應。否則，請根據你認為合適的方式進行角色扮演。

english: The mirror has two command words. Speaking the word "Khomara" while standing within 5 feet of the mirror deactivates or reactivates it. (The mirror can't trap creatures while deactivated.) Speaking the word "Blackfire" along with a cell number frees the creature trapped in that cell.
zh_tw: 鏡子有兩個口令。站在鏡子5尺內說出「Khomara」，便能關閉或重新啟動它；關閉時，鏡子無法困住生物。說出「Blackfire」並報出牢房編號，便能釋放該牢房中的生物。

english: Casting an {@spell identify} spell on the mirror reveals its command words and magical properties. The command words are also written in the spellbook found in {@area area 28|3aa|x}.
zh_tw: 對鏡子施放一個{@spell identify||鑑定術}法術可以揭示它的命令詞和魔法屬性。命令詞也寫在{@area 區域28|3aa|x}中找到的法術書中。

english: Destroying the Mirror
zh_tw: 摧毀鏡子

english: If the mirror is destroyed, all creatures trapped within it are released at once. (See {@book chapter 7|DMG|7} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} for the mirror's statistics.) Rather than running combat with so many creatures, assume that only the {@creature invisible stalker} and the troll attack the party initially. The other creatures react to their liberation by turning on one another or running away, as follows:
zh_tw: 如果鏡子被摧毀，所有被困在其中的生物將立即被釋放。（有關鏡子的統計資料，請參閱{@book 第七章|DMG|7}的{@i 城主指南}。）為了避免與如此多的生物進行戰鬥，可以假設只有{@creature invisible stalker||隱形追獵者}和巨魔最初會攻擊隊伍。其他生物在獲得自由後會互相攻擊或逃跑，具體如下：

english: Lukanu and Zaal attack the gargoyle, destroying it in 4 rounds, and then help the characters deal with the {@creature invisible stalker} and the troll.
zh_tw: 盧卡努和扎爾攻擊石像鬼，在4輪內將其摧毀，然後幫助角色們對付{@creature invisible stalker||隱形追獵者}和食人魔。

english: The stirge attacks A'tan, killing him in 1 round. After draining A'tan's blood, the stirge flies away to digest its meal.
zh_tw: 蝠翼魔攻擊了阿坦，在一個回合內將其殺死。吸取了阿坦的血液後，蝠翼魔飛走去消化它的獵物。

english: The doppelganger tries to flee but doesn't go far, hoping that the characters survive and returning to thank them if they prevail.
zh_tw: 變形怪試圖逃跑，但不會逃得太遠，希望角色們能夠倖存，並在他們勝利後回來感謝他們。

english: Tlad Xolbrys uses his magic to help the characters unless it looks like they're near defeat, whereupon the drow turns against them.
zh_tw: 特拉德·索爾布里斯使用他的魔法幫助角色們，除非看起來他們快要被擊敗，那時這個卓爾精靈會轉而對抗他們。

english: 51. Ghastly Door
zh_tw: 51. 恐怖之門

english: What appears to be a large stone door looms at the end of the hallway, but it bears no handles or hinges. Jutting from the wall on either side of the door are two matching bronze sculptures—each the head and neck of a serpent with fangs bared. On the lintel above the door is inscribed the following message in Common: "Warm like flame, cold for the cruel, still for the dead, gruel for the ghoul."
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭矗立著一扇看似巨大的石門，但它沒有把手或鉸鏈。門兩側的牆上各有一個相匹配的青銅雕塑——每個都是一條露出獠牙的蛇的頭部和頸部。門楣上用通用語刻著以下資訊："熱情如火焰，冷酷如殘酷，靜止如死亡，稀飯給食屍鬼。"

english: The stench of rotting flesh wafts from the bronze serpents. Close examination reveals dried blood in each statue's mouth and tiny tubes at the back of its neck. The tubes extend into secret rooms on either side of the door, where six {@creature Ghast||ghasts} are confined (three per room).
zh_tw: 腐爛肉體的惡臭從青銅蛇像中飄散出來。仔細檢查會發現每個雕像的嘴裡有乾涸的血跡，以及在它頸部後部的細小管子。這些管子延伸到門兩側的秘密房間裡，那裡關押著六隻{@creature Ghast||妖鬼}（每個房間三隻）。

english: The stone door opens when a pint or more of fresh blood is poured into the mouth of each bronze serpent. The blood drips into the chambers holding the ghasts, driving them into a slurping frenzy that can be heard through the serpents' open mouths. Once sated with blood, the ghasts yank chains to hoist the door open.
zh_tw: 當一品脫或更多的新鮮血液倒入每個青銅蛇的口中時，石門就會開啟。血液滴入容納食屍鬼的房間，使它們陷入一種可以透過蛇張開的嘴巴聽到的狂飲狂潮。一旦食屍鬼喝飽了血，它們就會拉動鏈條將門拉起開啟。

english: The door weighs 1,000 pounds and can be lifted by characters with a combined Strength of 33 or more. If the characters do so, secret doors on either side of the hallway behind the door unlock and slide open. This releases the hungry ghasts, which fight until turned or destroyed. Each locked secret door can be opened with a {@spell knock} spell or forced open by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check.
zh_tw: 這扇門重達1000磅，可以由總力量值達到33或更高的角色抬起。如果角色這樣做，門後走廊兩側的密門會解鎖並滑開。這會釋放出飢餓的食屍鬼，它們會戰鬥直到被驅逐或被消滅。每扇鎖住的密門可以透過施放{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或由角色成功透過一個{@dc 22}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定來強行開啟。

english: 52. Throne Room
zh_tw: 52. 王座廳

english: This vaulted chamber features a ten-foot-deep sunken floor surrounded by ledges without railings. Alcoves along the ledges hold painted wooden statues of hornet-headed humanoid warriors, each wearing a grass skirt and clutching a spear.
zh_tw: 這個拱形的房間有一個十尺深的下沉地面，周圍是不帶欄杆的壁架。壁架上的凹室裡擺放著帶有黃蜂頭部的人形戰士的彩繪木雕，每個戰士都穿著草裙，緊握著長矛。

english: A gruesome throne lashed together of bone and strips of skin stands atop the west ledge. A fearsome horned skull surmounts the throne, and small skulls are piled around it. The seat of the throne appears to be made of stretched skin and has a metal scepter resting on it.
zh_tw: 一個由骨頭和皮膚條綁紮而成的可怕寶座矗立在西側的懸崖上。一個可怕的帶角的頭骨位於寶座之上，周圍堆滿了小頭骨。寶座的座位似乎是用拉伸的皮膚製成的，上面放著一根金屬權杖。

english: Shuffling about the sunken portion of the room are three gaunt humanoid figures in dusty robes draped in cobwebs, their eyes and mouths stitched shut. Armed with brushes and clay pots of pigment, they paint the walls and pillars with grim, poorly rendered illustrations.
zh_tw: 在房間凹陷部分徘徊的是三個瘦削的人形身影，他們穿著滿是灰塵的長袍，身上披著蜘蛛網，眼睛和嘴巴都被縫了起來。他們手持刷子和裝有顏料的陶罐，用陰鬱、繪製粗糙的插圖來裝飾牆壁和柱子。

english: Four pillars support the ceiling, which is 15 feet above the ledges and 25 feet above the sunken floor. The wooden statues are harmless (their spears are merely decorative) and weigh 150 pounds each.
zh_tw: 四根柱子支撐著天花板，天花板距離壁架15尺，距離下沉地面25尺。木雕是無害的（他們的長矛只是裝飾性的），每個重150磅。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Obo'laka or Papazotl receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被奧博娜卡或帕帕扎圖靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Cautious Obo'laka advises her host to not disturb the throne or pick up the scepter, but admits not knowing for certain that either is harmful.
zh_tw: 謹慎的奧博娜卡建議她的宿主不要打擾寶座或拿起權杖，但她承認不確定這兩者是否真的有害。

english: Shrewd Papazotl realizes that the throne is made from the bones of dead Omuans and the skull of Omu's great minotaur champion, Karagos.
zh_tw: 精明的帕帕扎圖意識到寶座是由死去的奧穆人的骨頭和奧穆偉大的牛頭人冠軍卡拉戈斯的頭骨製成的。

english: Blind Artists
zh_tw: 盲人藝術家

english: The three creatures skulking about the room are undead servants of {@creature Acererak|ToA}. Despite their blindness, each has the magical ability to perceive and paint scenes of pain, carnage, and death that have occurred in the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 在房間裡潛伏的三個生物是{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的不死僕從。儘管它們失明，但每個生物都具有感知和描繪九神之墓中發生的疼痛、屠殺和死亡場景的魔法能力。

english: One of the artists is presently painting over scenes depicting the fall of the Company of the Yellow Banner. All that remains is an image of a human male (the late Lord Brixton, whose remains can be found in {@area area 63|4ac|x}) choking on poisonous gas. The other two artists are in the process of painting images that capture the player characters' harrowing exploits in the tomb thus far. (Choose memorable moments in which one or more party members were badly wounded or killed.)
zh_tw: 其中一位藝術家目前正在覆蓋描繪黃旗冒險團陷落的場景。唯一剩下的是已故的布里克斯頓勳爵（他的遺體可以在{@area 區域63|4ac|x}找到）被毒氣嗆到的影象。另外兩位藝術家正在繪製捕捉玩家角色迄今為止在墓穴中驚險經歷的影象。（選擇一個或多個隊伍成員受到嚴重傷害或死亡的難忘時刻。）

english: The undead artists have the statistics of {@creature Zombie||zombies}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 這些不死藝術傢俱有{@creature Zombie||喪屍}的具體數值，並有以下變化：

english: Instead of {@sense darkvision}, each artist has {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 30 feet. The artists are blind beyond this radius and immune to the {@condition blinded} condition.
zh_tw: 與{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}不同，每位藝術家擁有30尺範圍內的{@sense blindsight||盲視}。在這個半徑之外，藝術家們是失明的，並且對{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態免疫。

english: They have no effective attacks and are worth 0 XP.
zh_tw: 它們沒有有效的攻擊方式，並且價值0 XP。

english: If the characters turn or destroy any of the artists, a {@creature tyrannosaurus zombie|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) bursts up from a cavity beneath the floor and attacks, leaving a 20-foot diameter hole and shattered floor tiles behind. While it's too big to squeeze down any 5-foot-wide corridors, it can easily traverse the wider passageway to the east.
zh_tw: 如果角色們轉化或摧毀了任何一位藝術家，一隻{@creature tyrannosaurus zombie|ToA|暴龍喪屍}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）會從地板下的一個洞中衝出來攻擊，留下一個20尺直徑的洞和破碎的地板磚。雖然它太大無法擠過任何5尺寬的走廊，但它可以輕鬆穿越東邊的更寬的通道。

english: Throne of Acererak
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的寶座

english: The throne is made from the skin and bones of slain Omuan warriors, and the skulls of Omuan children are piled around it. The skull atop the throne once belonged to a minotaur guardian of Omu named Karagos. Any creature that touches the skull or sits in the throne must succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw or become cursed with the Rage of Karagos. When cursed, the creature gains 50 temporary hit points and goes berserk. Until the curse is lifted, the victim is forced to attack the nearest creature it can see with melee attacks. It can't make ranged attacks or cast spells, and if it can't see any creatures to attack, it does nothing. The curse ends if the berserk creature drops to 0 hit points, or if a {@spell greater restoration} or {@spell remove curse} spell is cast on it. When the curse ends, the temporary hit points granted by it disappear.
zh_tw: 王座由被殺死的奧穆戰士的皮膚和骨頭製成，周圍堆滿了奧穆兒童的顱骨。王座頂部的顱骨曾經屬於一位名叫卡拉戈斯的奧穆牛頭人守衛。任何觸碰顱骨或坐在王座上的生物都必須成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 魅力豁免檢定，否則將被詛咒，獲得卡拉戈斯的狂怒。被詛咒時，生物獲得50點臨時生命值並變得狂暴。在詛咒解除之前，受害者被迫用近戰攻擊攻擊它能看到的最接近的生物。它不能進行遠端攻擊或施法，如果看不到任何生物進行攻擊，它將什麼也不做。如果狂暴的生物生命值降至0，或者對其施放 {@spell greater restoration||高等復原術} 或 {@spell remove curse||移除詛咒} 法術，詛咒將結束。當詛咒結束時，由它賦予的臨時生命值也會消失。

english: Acererak's Scepter
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的權杖

english: The scepter on the throne is made of solid iron and has an adamantine head. It is nonmagical, weighs 12 pounds, and can be wielded as a mace. Its magical twin is hidden in {@area area 53|459|x}.
zh_tw: 寶座上的權杖由純鐵製成，頭部是精金。它是非魔法的，重12磅，可以作為釘頭錘使用。它的魔法雙胞胎藏在{@area 區域53|459|x}。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Behind the statue in the northwest alcove, a secret door leads to {@area area 53|459|x}. The door is slightly ajar, and any character who searches the alcove finds it.
zh_tw: 在西北壁龕的雕像後面，一扇秘密門通向{@area 區域53|459|x}。門微微開著，任何搜尋壁龕的角色都能找到它。

english: A properly closed secret door in the southeast corner of the room leads to a spiral staircase going up and down ({@area area 26|3a3|x}).
zh_tw: 東南角的一扇正確關閉的秘密門通向一個向上和向下的螺旋樓梯（{@area 區域26|3a3|x}）。

english: 53. Crypt of the Sun Queen
zh_tw: 53. 日之女王的墓穴

english: The walls of this room are adorned with tile mosaics of a jungle city intermingled with frescoes of flowering plants, birds, insects, and humans wearing gold skirts and carrying spears and ornate jugs. The ceiling is painted to look like a clear blue sky. A small bejeweled cockroach rests atop a sarcophagus of black basalt in the middle of the room. A two-foot-diameter orb hanging from a chain above the sarcophagus is made of hammered gold to resemble a smiling sun.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上裝飾著叢林城市的瓷磚馬賽克，與盛開的植物、鳥類、昆蟲以及穿著金色裙子、手持長矛和裝飾性罐子的人類的壁畫交織在一起。天花板被漆成看起來像清澈的藍天。一隻鑲嵌寶石的小蟑螂棲息在房間中央的黑色玄武岩製成的石棺上。一個兩尺直徑的球體懸掛在石棺上方的鏈子上，由錘打的黃金製成，看起來像一個微笑的太陽。

english: After {@creature Acererak|ToA} slew the trickster gods of Omu and enslaved the city, Napaka, the city's elderly queen, chose not to flee, and instead offered herself as a sacrifice in exchange for the release of her people. {@creature Acererak|ToA} was impressed by the queen's courage—not enough to spare her life or honor her request, but enough to place her in a special crypt.
zh_tw: 在{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}殺死了奧穆的詭神並奴役了這座城市之後，這座城市的年邁女王娜帕卡選擇不逃跑，而是自願作為犧牲品，以換取她人民的釋放。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}對女王的勇氣印象深刻——不足以饒她一命或尊重她的請求，但足以讓她被安置在一個特別的墓室中。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals auras of evocation magic around the golden sun and the bejeweled cockroach (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了金色太陽和鑲嵌寶石的蟑螂（見下面的"寶藏"）周圍的召喚魔法光環。

english: The lid of the black sarcophagus bears a name etched in Common: NAPAKA. The lid is sealed with strips of melted lead that can be easily pried away. Once the lead is removed, the lid can be pushed aside with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The interior of the sarcophagus is lined with lead and contains several treasures (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 黑色石棺的蓋子上刻有一個用通用語書寫的名字：納帕卡。蓋子由熔化的鉛條密封，可以輕易撬開。一旦鉛條被移除，成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定可以將蓋子推開。石棺內部襯有鉛，並包含幾件寶物（見下面的"寶物"）。

english: Golden Sun
zh_tw: 金色太陽

english: Whenever the sun or its chain are touched or damaged, the sun's smile fades to an inscrutable expression, and it emits tremendous heat in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on itself. Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage. This effect ends if all creatures leave the affected area.
zh_tw: 每當太陽或其鏈條被觸控或損壞時，太陽的微笑會變成一種難以捉摸的表情，並且在以自身為中心的20尺半徑球體內釋放出巨大的熱量。任何在其區域內開始回合的生物都會受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點火焰傷害。如果所有生物離開受影響的區域，這個效果就會結束。

english: The first time the queen's remains or any of her treasures are removed from the sarcophagus, the sun's expression turns angry as it emits rays of searing light. Each creature within 30 feet of the sun that doesn't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by a ray, which deals 42 ({@dice 12d6}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 當女王的遺骸或她的任何寶物首次從石棺中移出時，太陽的表情變得憤怒，並散發出灼熱的光線。在太陽周圍30尺範圍內且沒有對其有{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}的每個生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 14}的敏捷豁免檢定，否則將被光線擊中，造成42（{@dice 12d6}）點火焰傷害。

english: The sun and its chain are treated as a single Small object with AC 15; 22 hit points; and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. The sun loses its magical properties when it shoots its rays or is destroyed.
zh_tw: 太陽及其鏈條被視為一個單一的小物體，具有AC 15；22生命值；並對火焰、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。當太陽發射其光線或被摧毀時，它失去了魔法屬性。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The jewelry box and the sarcophagus contain treasure.
zh_tw: 首飾盒和石棺包含寶藏。

english: Jewelry Box
zh_tw: 珠寶盒

english: The cockroach-shaped jewelry box is made of gold, set with precious gems (including tiny black pearls for its eyes), and worth 1,500 gp. It weighs 5 pounds and contains two items: a small jade key shaped like a crocodile (designed to fit in the keyhole in area 62B) and a {@item necklace of fireballs} with eight beads remaining. {@creature Acererak|ToA} placed a curse on the necklace, which can be revealed by an {@spell identify} spell.
zh_tw: 這個蟑螂形狀的首飾盒由黃金製成，鑲嵌著珍貴的寶石（包括用作眼睛的小粒黑珍珠），價值1500金幣。它重5磅，並包含兩個物品：一把小玉製的鱷魚形狀的鑰匙（設計用於插入62B區域的鑰匙孔）和一條剩餘八個珠子的{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}。{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}對項鍊施加了詛咒，這可以透過{@spell identify||鑑定術}法術揭示。

english: When any creature dons the cursed necklace, all its beads detonate at once. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the exploding necklace must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 56 ({@dice 16d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The wearer of the necklace fails the saving throw automatically. A {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic removes the curse from the necklace.
zh_tw: 當任何生物戴上這條被詛咒的項鍊時，上面的所有珠子會同時爆炸。以爆炸的項鍊為中心，半徑20尺範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免檢定，若檢定失敗則受到56點{@dice 16d6}火焰傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。項鍊的佩戴者會自動豁免失敗。一個{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}法術或類似的魔法可以移除項鍊上的詛咒。

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: The sarcophagus contains the magically preserved remains of Queen Napaka. She wears the tattered remnants of a black gown and a hornet mask made of painted gold (250 gp).
zh_tw: 石棺內裝有透過魔法儲存的納帕卡女王的遺體。她穿著一件破爛的黑色禮服殘片和一個由彩繪金製成的黃蜂面具（價值250金幣）。

english: In her left hand, Napaka holds an iron scepter with an adamantine head, which is lighter than it appears (5 pounds). A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic around the scepter, which can be used to destroy the stone juggernaut in {@area area 62|49f|x}. Casting an {@spell identify}, {@spell legend lore}, or similar spell on the scepter reveals that its singular purpose is to destroy a construct named after Napaka.
zh_tw: 納帕卡的左手中握著一根鐵製權杖，頭部為精金製成，比看上去要輕（5磅）。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了權杖周圍的變形魔法光環，它可以用來摧毀{@area 區域62|49f|x}中的岩石戰車。對權杖施放{@spell identify||鑑定術}、{@spell legend lore||通曉傳奇}或類似的法術揭示了它的唯一目的是摧毀一個以納帕卡命名的構裝生物。

english: If the scepter is removed and not immediately replaced with its nonmagical twin from {@area area 52|452|x}, or if Napaka's remains are removed from their resting place, the queen's corpse opens its mouth in a wide yawn and exhales a baleful black gas that fills a 15-foot cube centered on it. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 45 ({@dice 7d12}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 如果權杖被移走且未立即從 {@area 區域52|452|x} 處用其非魔法的孿生品替換，或者如果納帕卡的遺骸從其安息地被移走，女王的屍體會張開嘴打哈欠，並撥出一團充滿惡意的黑色氣體，形成一個以她為中心的15尺立方區域。該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 體質豁免，豁免失敗者將受到45點（{@dice 7d12}）的暗蝕傷害，豁免成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: Questioning Napaka
zh_tw: 詢問納帕卡

english: Queen Napaka has been dead for more than a century. If a {@spell speak with dead} spell is cast on her corpse, the characters can ask it questions about Omu and receive honest answers. Napaka came to believe that the gods of Omu were not truly divine beings but rather trickster spirits that had fooled the Omuan people into worshiping them. The queen remembers {@creature Acererak|ToA} killing the trickster gods and enslaving the Omuans, but she knows nothing about the Tomb of the Nine Gods, which was built after her death. She knows that a few members of the royal family fled Omu, but she is unaware that the aarakocra are sheltering her great-grandchildren at Kir Sabal. Napaka knows that her grandmother, Zalkoré, languishes in the ruins of Nangalore.
zh_tw: 納帕卡女王已經去世一個多世紀了。如果在她的屍體上施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術，角色們可以向她詢問有關奧穆的問題並獲得誠實的答案。納帕卡開始相信奧穆的神並不是真正的神靈，而是由欺騙奧穆人民崇拜他們的詭神靈魂。女王記得{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}殺死了這些惡作劇的神靈並奴役了奧穆人，但她對九神之墓一無所知，因為它是在她死後建造的。她知道一些王室成員逃離了奧穆，但她不知道鳥羽人族正在基爾·薩巴爾庇護她的曾孫。納帕卡知道她的祖母，扎爾柯蕊，正在南加洛爾的廢墟中受苦。

english: Even in death, Napaka pines for Omu to be reborn and repopulated. However, what she desires above all is the destruction of {@creature Acererak|ToA}.
zh_tw: 即使在死後，納帕卡仍渴望奧穆能夠重生並重新有人居住。然而，她最渴望的還是摧毀{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}。

english: 54. Rolling Doom
zh_tw: 54. 滾動的厄運

english: After ten feet, this dusty corridor becomes a staircase that descends fifteen feet to a lower tunnel. Resting on the floor at the bottom of the staircase is an old treasure chest with a rusty built-in lock. Just beyond the chest, the tunnel opens up to a huge, dark chamber.
zh_tw: 走過十尺後，這條塵土飛揚的走廊變成了一段樓梯，下降十五尺到達下方的隧道。在樓梯底部的地面上，放著一個帶有生鏽內建鎖的古老寶箱。寶箱的正前方，隧道通向一個巨大、昏暗的房間。

english: The chest (area 54A) is the trigger for a trap. When the chest or its lid is lifted, a heavy stone ball (area 54B) tumbles down the stairs. Adventurers fleeing the stone ball stumble into a hidden pit (area 54C).
zh_tw: 箱子（區域54A）是一個陷阱的觸發器。當箱子或其蓋子被抬起時，一個沉重的石球（區域54B）會沿著樓梯滾下來。冒險家們在逃離石球時會絆進一個隱藏的陷坑（區域54C）。

english: 54A. Treasure Chest
zh_tw: 54A. 寶箱

english: The lock on the chest can be picked with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. Within the chest is an {@condition invisible} key, 3 inches long and made of brass. Any character who manually searches inside the chest feels the key, which unlocks the clock in {@area area 56|478|x}.
zh_tw: 箱子的鎖可以透過使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷檢定撬開。箱內有一把{@condition invisible||隱形}的鑰匙，3吋長，由黃銅製成。任何手動搜尋箱內的角色都能摸到這把鑰匙，它可以解鎖{@area 區域56|478|x}的時鐘。

english: If the chest is smashed by the granite ball (see below), the {@condition invisible} key is lost in the wreckage but can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 如果箱子被花崗巖球砸碎（見下文），{@condition invisible||隱形}鑰匙會遺失在廢墟中，但可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定找到。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect also reveals the presence of the key, either in the chest or among the wreckage. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 14}) cast on the key renders it visible.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果也會揭示鑰匙的存在，無論是在箱子中還是在殘骸中。成功地對鑰匙施展 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 14}）會使其顯現出來。

english: 54B. Granite Ball
zh_tw: 54B. 花崗巖球

english: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of solid granite balances within a secret compartment at the top of the stairs. Finding the compartment requires that a character search the tunnel ceiling and succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The hatch can be jammed with an iron spike or with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
zh_tw: 一個直徑5尺的實心花崗巖球體平衡地放置在樓梯頂部的暗格中。發現該暗格需要角色搜尋隧道頂部並透過一次{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定。可以用鐵釘卡住艙口，或透過使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定。

english: When released, the stone ball thunders down the stairs and tumbles into the pit at 54C. Any character on the stairs or in the tunnel below can stay ahead of the ball by running toward the pit. A character can also leap over the ball with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. Any character who fails the check or can't move out of the ball's way is struck for 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage and knocked {@condition prone}. The ball also flattens the treasure chest (54A) as it tumbles through.
zh_tw: 當被釋放時，石球轟隆隆地滾下樓梯並跌入54C處的坑中。任何在樓梯上或下方隧道中的角色都可以透過向坑中跑來避開石球。角色也可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定跳過石球。任何檢定失敗或無法避開石球的角色將受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點鈍擊傷害並被擊倒{@condition prone||伏地}。石球滾過時還會壓扁寶箱（54A）。

english: 54C. Acid Pit
zh_tw: 54C. 酸液坑

english: The walls of this 10-foot-deep pit are lined with thick glass, and the pit is filled with green acid to a depth of 5 feet. The pit's lid is crafted of interlocking stone tiles that fall apart beneath 100 pounds or more of weight. Any character who searches the floor notices the unusual stonework and smells the acid below with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 這個10尺深的坑的牆壁上鋪滿了厚厚的玻璃，坑內裝滿了綠色酸液，深度為5尺。坑的蓋子由相互連線的石板製成，當承重超過100磅時會坍塌。任何搜尋地面的角色都會注意到不尋常的石工，並透過一次成功的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定聞到下面的酸液。

english: A creature in the area of the pit when the floor collapses can avoid a fall and grab the edge of the pit with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. The saving throw is made with disadvantage if the character was unaware of the pit. Any creature that enters the acid for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 66 ({@dice 12d10}) acid damage. The walls of the pit are too smooth to climb without the aid of magic or climbing gear.
zh_tw: 當地板坍塌時，坑洞區域內的生物可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免來避免墜落並抓住坑洞邊緣。如果角色沒有察覺到坑洞的存在，此次豁免檢定將帶有劣勢。任何在回合中首次進入酸液區域或在酸液區域內開始其回合的生物將受到 66（{@dice 12d10}）點酸液傷害。坑洞的牆壁過於光滑，若無魔法或攀爬裝備的輔助，無法攀爬。

english: The pit's acid can be safely contained in glass vials if the characters have any at hand, and can then be used as the acid in chapter 5, "Equipment," of the {@i Player's Handbook}.
zh_tw: 如果角色手頭有玻璃瓶，可以安全地將坑中的酸液裝入其中，並可以用作{@i 玩家手冊}第5章"裝備"中的酸液。

english: 55. Unkh's Tomb
zh_tw: 55. 安珂的墓

english: Four marble columns support the ceiling of this grand tomb. Twin staircases ascend to an upper gallery, where a carving in the form of a giant maze adorns the wall. On the floor of the tomb stands an opaque crystal sarcophagus that is constantly changing color. Minotaur murals adorn the walls on the lower level of the tomb.
zh_tw: 四根大理石柱子支撐著這座宏偉墓室的天花板。兩對樓梯通向上層的走廊，走廊牆壁上裝飾著一個巨大的迷宮形狀的雕刻。墓室的地板上矗立著一個不透明的彩色水晶製成的石棺，它的顏色在不斷變化。牛頭人壁畫裝飾著墓室下層的牆壁。

english: The walls of the tomb are lined with secret doors that slide open to reveal chambers strewn with minotaur bones—ten chambers in all. One of these chambers has a hallway at the back of it leading to {@area area 56|478|x}.
zh_tw: 墓室的牆壁上排列著秘密門，這些門滑開後會露出散落著牛頭人骨頭的房間——總共有十個這樣的房間。其中一間房間的後部有一條走廊通往{@area 區域56|478|x}。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of I'jin or Kubazan receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被艾金或庫巴贊靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Fickle I'jin suggests waiting for the sarcophagus to turn gold before trying to open it. (Gold is I'jin's favorite color.)
zh_tw: 多變的艾金建議在嘗試開啟石棺之前等待它變成金色。（金色是艾金最喜歡的顏色。）

english: Brave Kubazan urges his host to inspect the maze carving and be the first one to touch it.
zh_tw: 勇敢的庫巴贊敦促他的宿主檢查迷宮雕刻，併成為第一個觸控它的人。

english: Maze
zh_tw: 迷宮術

english: When the wall carving is examined, read:
zh_tw: 當牆壁雕刻被檢查時，閱讀：

english: The intricate carving shifts before your eyes, its configuration ever-changing. The maze has no exits, and its corridors are lit by tiny torches and clouded by fog.
zh_tw: 錯綜複雜的雕刻在你眼前變化，其佈局不斷變化。迷宮沒有出口，其走廊被微小的火把照亮，被霧氣籠罩。

english: Any non-undead creature that touches the wall carving vanishes and reappears in a demiplanar maze, the configuration of which matches that of the carving. The first time this happens, all the secret doors slide open as the minotaur bones knit together, forming ten {@creature Minotaur Skeleton||minotaur skeletons} that emerge from their chambers and attack anyone in the tomb. All creatures present should roll initiative, including anyone trapped in the maze. The keys to open Unkh's sarcophagus are hidden in the maze.
zh_tw: 任何非不死生物觸碰牆壁雕刻時會消失，並在與之匹配的半位面迷宮中重新出現。當第一次發生這種情況時，所有秘密門都會滑開，牛頭人的骨頭結合在一起，形成十個{@creature Minotaur Skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}，它們從各自的房間中出現並攻擊墓室中的任何人。所有在場的生物都應該進行先攻骰，包括被困在迷宮中的任何人。開啟安珂石棺的鑰匙藏在迷宮中。

english: When a character arrives in the maze, describe it as follows:
zh_tw: 當一個角色進入迷宮時，可以這樣描述它：

english: You stand within a fifteen-foot-high passageway walled by smooth, featureless stone, which is lit by torches and shrouded by fog. There's no ceiling, and when you look up, you see a distorted view of the room you left behind.
zh_tw: 你站在一個十五尺高的通道內，四周是平滑無特徵的石牆，通道由火把照亮並被霧氣籠罩。這裡沒有天花板，當你抬頭看時，你會看到一個你離開的房間的扭曲景象。

english: Characters standing near the wall carving can see characters trapped in the maze but can't hear them. Similarly, characters in the maze can see giant, distorted versions of any creatures standing within 10 feet of the wall carving, but they can't hear anything outside the maze.
zh_tw: 站在牆壁雕刻附近的角色可以看到被困在迷宮中的角色，但聽不到他們的聲音。同樣，迷宮中的角色可以看到站在牆壁雕刻10尺範圍內的任何生物的巨大扭曲版本，但他們聽不到迷宮外的任何聲音。

english: The configuration of the maze constantly changes to ensure that characters within it remain separated and unable to find each other. Visibility within the maze is limited to 20 feet because of the churning fog. Spells that are altered within the tomb are similarly altered in the maze (see "{@area Spell Restrictions|31f|x}").
zh_tw: 迷宮的佈局不斷變化，以確保迷宮內的角色保持分離，無法找到彼此。由於翻滾的霧氣，迷宮內的視野被限制在20尺內。在墓室中改變的法術在迷宮中也會發生類似的改變（見"{@area 法術限制|31f|x}"）。

english: The walls of the maze can be climbed with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Any character who climbs to the top of the walls or flies beyond them is expelled from the maze, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) force damage and reappearing with a loud pop in an unoccupied space near the wall carving.
zh_tw: 迷宮的牆壁可以透過成功的{@dc 20}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定攀爬。任何攀爬到牆壁頂部或飛越牆壁的角色將被驅逐出迷宮，受到22點（{@dice 5d8}）力場傷害，並在牆壁雕刻附近的一個未被佔據的空間伴隨著一聲巨響重新出現。

english: Finding a Key
zh_tw: 尋找鑰匙

english: Any character in the maze can spend time exploring it. At the end of each turn spent exploring the maze, roll percentile dice and use the Maze Discoveries table to determine what, if anything, the character finds. Any character who finds a crystal key and picks it up is teleported to an unoccupied space next to Unkh's sarcophagus, along with all gear and possessions.
zh_tw: 迷宮中的任何角色都可以花費時間探索它。在每次探索迷宮的回合結束時，投擲百分率骰子，並使用迷宮發現表來確定角色找到了什麼，如果有的話。任何找到水晶鑰匙並撿起它的角色將被傳送到安珂石棺旁邊的一個空閒空間，連同所有的裝備和財產。

english: Maze Discoveries
zh_tw: 迷宮發現

english: Discovery
zh_tw: 發現

english: Nothing
zh_tw: 無

english: Skeletal remains of an Omuan child
zh_tw: 奧穆兒童的骸骨

english: {@creature Minotaur} that fights to the death
zh_tw: 戰鬥至死的{@creature Minotaur||牛頭人}

english: Blue crystal key
zh_tw: 藍色水晶鑰匙

english: Gold crystal key
zh_tw: 金色水晶鑰匙

english: Purple crystal key
zh_tw: 紫色水晶鑰匙

english: Green crystal key
zh_tw: 綠色水晶鑰匙

english: Red crystal key
zh_tw: 紅色水晶鑰匙

english: Black crystal key
zh_tw: 黑色水晶鑰匙

english: Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 石棺

english: Any character who examines the sarcophagus notices a tiny keyhole carved into its lid. The keyhole does not penetrate to the interior of the sarcophagus, and there are no mechanisms within it to pick or disarm. The sarcophagus is impervious to damage and spells.
zh_tw: 任何檢查石棺的角色都會注意到蓋子上雕刻著一個微小的鑰匙孔。鑰匙孔不穿透石棺的內部，裡面沒有任何機制可以撬開或解除。石棺對傷害和法術都是不可滲透的。

english: The crystal sarcophagus changes color every 6 seconds, shifting through the following repeating cycle: blue, gold, purple, green, red, black. If a crystal key claimed from the maze is inserted into the keyhole when the sarcophagus and the key are the same color, the sarcophagus lid disappears, and the contents of the sarcophagus are revealed (see "Treasure" below). At the same time, the character who retrieved the key from the maze receives a supernatural gift from a mysterious benefactor (see "{@creature Acererak|ToA}'s Gift" below).
zh_tw: 水晶石棺每6秒鐘改變一次顏色，按照以下迴圈順序變化：藍色、金色、紫色、綠色、紅色、黑色。如果從迷宮中取得的水晶鑰匙在石棺和鑰匙顏色相同時插入鑰匙孔，石棺蓋將消失，石棺的內容將被揭示（見下面的"寶藏"）。同時，從迷宮中取回鑰匙的角色將從一個神秘的施主那裡收到一個超自然的禮物（見下面的"{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的禮物"）。

english: If a crystal key is inserted when the sarcophagus and the key are not the same color, the key is teleported back to the maze and the sarcophagus remains sealed.
zh_tw: 如果當石棺和鑰匙顏色不同時插入水晶鑰匙，鑰匙將被傳送回迷宮，石棺保持封閉。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The sarcophagus is filled with salt, within which are buried ten opalescent bracelets (75 gp each) made from the shell of a flail snail (Unkh's animal form; see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) and a {@item robe of scintillating colors}. The robe turns to dust and is destroyed if it leaves the Tomb of the Nine Gods (but see "{@area Lost Treasures|525|x}").
zh_tw: 石棺內填滿了鹽，在其中埋藏著十個由鏈鞭蝸牛（安珂的動物形態；見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）的殼製成的蛋白石手鐲（每個75金幣）和一件{@item robe of scintillating colors||虹光法袍}。如果這件長袍離開九神之墓，它將化為塵土並被摧毀（但見"{@area 失落的寶藏|525|x}"）。

english: Unkh's Spirit
zh_tw: 安珂的靈魂

english: The spirit of Unkh tries to inhabit any character who touches the {@item robe of scintillating colors} (see "{@area Spirits of the Nine Trickster Gods|321|x}"). When Unkh's spirit manifests, read:
zh_tw: 安珂的靈魂試圖附身於任何觸控{@item robe of scintillating colors||虹光法袍}的角色（見"{@area 九詭神亡魂|321|x}"）。當安珂的靈魂顯現時，閱讀：

english: Slime pours from the folds of the scintillating robe to take the form of multiple flail-like pseudopods. A female voice echoes through the chamber: "I can help you. At least, I think that's what I'm supposed to do."
zh_tw: 粘液從閃爍長袍的褶皺中湧出，形成了多個鏈狀偽足的形狀。一個女聲在室內迴響："我可以幫助你。至少，我認為我應該這麼做。"

english: If the spirit successfully inhabits the character, give the player {@card Unkh|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|Unkh's card} (see {@adventure appendix F|ToA|11}). If the attempt fails, the spirit returns to the robe and waits for another character to touch it.
zh_tw: 如果靈魂成功附身於角色，給予玩家{@card Unkh|Trickster Gods of Omu|ToA|安珂的卡片}（見{@adventure 附錄F|ToA|11}）。如果嘗試失敗，靈魂將返回到長袍中並等待另一個角色觸控它。

english: Acererak's Gift
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的禮物

english: The character who retrieves the crystal key used to open Unkh's sarcophagus receives a supernatural gift from {@creature Acererak|ToA} that varies based on the key's color. The character becomes aware of the gift when {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s arcane sigil appears somewhere on his or her body. The source of the gift cannot be confirmed without consulting a higher power, but the mark can be removed with a {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic. These gifts otherwise follow the rules for charms in "{@book Other Rewards|DMG|7|Other Rewards}," chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}.
zh_tw: 獲取用於開啟安珂石棺的水晶鑰匙的角色會從{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}那裡獲得一個超自然的禮物，禮物的性質根據鑰匙的顏色而變化。當{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的奧術符號出現在他或她身體的某個位置時，角色就會意識到這個禮物的存在。如果不諮詢更高層次的力量，禮物的來源無法確認，但這個標記可以透過{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}或類似的魔法移除。這些禮物遵循"{@book 其他獎勵|DMG|7|Other Rewards}"（{@i 城主指南}第7章）中關於魅惑的規則。

english: Black Key
zh_tw: 黑色鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of nine lives|ToA}. When you drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, you can choose to drop to 1 hit point instead. Once used nine times, the charm goes away.
zh_tw: 獲得者獲得一個{@reward charm of nine lives|ToA|九命護咒}。當你因受到傷害而生命值降至0時，你可以選擇改為降至1點生命值。一旦使用了九次，魅惑效果就會消失。

english: Blue Key
zh_tw: 藍色鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of the crystal heart|ToA}. This charm grants you immunity to piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, but you gain vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. These effects last for 10 days, after which the charm vanishes from you.
zh_tw: 受贈者獲得一個{@reward charm of the crystal heart|ToA|水晶之心護咒}。這個魅惑物使你免疫來自非魔法攻擊的穿刺和揮砍傷害，但你會獲得對鈍擊傷害的易傷。這些效應持續10天，之後魅惑物會從你身上消失。

english: Gold Key
zh_tw: 金鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of treasure sense|ToA}. While this charm lasts, you can use an action to pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 30 feet of you. The effect lasts for 3 days, after which the charm vanishes from you.
zh_tw: 受贈者獲得一個{@reward charm of treasure sense|ToA|財寶感知護咒}。當此魅惑持續時，你可以用一個動作透過嗅覺精確定位30尺內貴金屬和寶石的位置，例如錢幣和寶石。此效應持續3天，之後魅惑將從你身上消失。

english: Green Key
zh_tw: 綠色鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of the swollen hag|ToA}. This charm allows you to spit up a {@creature frog} as an action. The frog understands you and obeys your commands. Once used three times, the charm goes away.
zh_tw: 獲得者將獲得一個{@reward charm of the swollen hag|ToA|腫脹鬼婆護咒}。這個護符允許你用一個動作噴吐出一隻{@creature frog||青蛙}。青蛙理解你且服從你的命令。一旦使用了三次，護符就會消失。

english: Purple Key
zh_tw: 紫色鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of the maimed|ToA}. This charm allows you to regrow a lost appendage or organ, such as an arm, a foot, or an eye. After it is used once, the charm goes away.
zh_tw: 獲得者將獲得一個{@reward charm of the maimed|ToA|重傷護咒}。這個魅惑允許你復生長一個迷失的附屬肢體或器官，例如手臂、腳或眼睛。使用一次後，魅惑就會消失。

english: Red Key
zh_tw: 紅鑰匙

english: The recipient gains a {@reward charm of the ghoul|ToA}. This charm allows you to use an action to eat a mouthful of flesh from a humanoid that has been dead no longer than 1 day. When you do, you regain {@dice 3d8 + 3} hit points. Once used three times, the charm goes away.
zh_tw: 接受者獲得一個{@reward charm of the ghoul|ToA|食屍鬼護咒}。這個魅惑允許你用一個動作吃掉一個死亡不超過1天的類人生物的血肉。當你這樣做時，你恢復{@dice 3d8 + 3}生命值。一旦使用了三次，魅惑就會消失。

english: 56. Grandfather Clock
zh_tw: 56. 祖父鍾

english: Any character approaching this room hears a rhythmic ticking sound from within.
zh_tw: 任何接近這個房間的角色都能聽到裡面發出的有節奏的滴答聲。

english: This room contains a wooden cabinet with a numbered dial at its top set with two ornate metal spokes. Beneath the dial, a pendulum swings inside an open compartment. An egg-shaped stone adorns the pendulum's tip.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含一個頂部設有編號錶盤的木製櫥櫃，錶盤兩側配有兩個華麗的金屬輻條。在錶盤下方，一個擺錘在一個開放的隔間內擺動。擺錘的尖端裝飾著一個蛋形的石頭。

english: This long-case clock radiates an aura of transmutation magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect.
zh_tw: 這座長箱鍾散發出變形魔法的氣息，可以被{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果探測到。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Unkh or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被安珂或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Indecisive Unkh is struck by the technological wonder of the clock and wants to stay and marvel at its beauty.
zh_tw: 猶豫不決的安珂被時鐘的技術奇觀所打動，想要留下來欣賞它的美麗。

english: Deranged Wongo finds the ticking of the clock oddly soothing and urges his host to stay for a while.
zh_tw: 瘋狂的望戈覺得時鐘的滴答聲出奇地令人安慰，並敦促他的宿主多待一會兒。

english: Clock
zh_tw: 時鐘

english: Bronze chimes within the clock ring at the top of each hour. Any creature within 30 feet of the clock when it strikes the top of the hour must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or age by ten years. The effect can be reversed by a {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring. When characters first arrive, assume the time is {@dice 5d10 + 5} minutes past the hour.
zh_tw: 每當整點時，鍾內的青銅鐘會響起。當鐘聲敲響時，任何在鍾周圍30尺內的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 體質豁免檢定，否則會衰老十歲。這種效果可以透過 {@spell greater restoration||高等復原術} 來逆轉，但僅限於事件發生後的24小時內。當角色首次到達時，假設時間為整點過 {@dice 5d10 + 5} 分鐘。

english: An invisible locked metal door shields the compartment containing the clock's pendulum. The invisibility effect on the door can't be dispelled, but the keyhole can be located by touch. The invisible key from the treasure chest in area 54A opens the lock, as does a {@spell knock} spell. To pick the lock, a character must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. If the character thinks to blow powdered chalk, dust, or a similar substance into the lock to highlight its gears, the check is made with advantage.
zh_tw: 一扇隱形的上鎖金屬門保護著時鐘擺輪的隔間。門上的隱形效果無法被解除，但可以透過觸控找到鑰匙孔。來自54A區域寶箱中的隱形鑰匙可以開啟鎖，{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術同樣有效。要撬開鎖，角色必須使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次{@dc 20}的敏捷檢定。如果角色想到向鎖內吹入粉筆灰、灰塵或類似物質以突出其齒輪，則該檢定具有優勢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The egg-shaped jewel fixed to the tip of the pendulum is the fabled Navel of the Moon. The fist-sized stone is worth 2,500 gp but can fetch up to three times that value if sold at auction in any major city. For more information on this item, see "{@area Fabled Treasures|31a|x}."
zh_tw: 固定在擺錘尖端的卵形寶石就是傳說中的月亮之臍。這塊拳頭大小的寶石價值2500金幣，但如果在任何主要城市拍賣，其價值可能高達三倍。有關這項物品的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 傳說中的寶藏|31a|x}"。

english: If the egg is removed from the pendulum, the clock loses its magical properties and stops working.
zh_tw: 如果把蛋從鐘擺上移除，時鐘就會失去它的魔法屬性並停止工作。

english: 57. Oubliette
zh_tw: 57. 遺忘之井

english: Any creature that tries to magically transport itself out of the tomb arrives here instead.
zh_tw: 任何試圖透過魔法傳送自己離開墳墓的生物都會來到這裡。

english: You arrive in a room half-filled with rotting corpses. Protruding from one wall is a large green devil's face, its flared nostrils set just above the putrescent mass. A sconce above the face holds a flickering torch.
zh_tw: 你進入一個房間，房間的一半堆滿了腐爛的屍體。從一面牆上突出的是一個巨大的綠色魔鬼面孔，其鼻孔張開正好位於腐爛的屍體上方。魔鬼面孔上方的壁燈上插著一支搖曳的火把。

english: The torch burns with a {@spell continual flame} spell, illuminating the humanoid corpses that fill the room to a depth of 6 feet and make the area {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. As needed, {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s magic draws new corpses here from graveyards across the world, all in various states of decay.
zh_tw: 火把被{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術點燃，照亮了填滿房間至6尺深的人形生物屍體，使這個區域成為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。根據需要，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的魔法從世界各地的墓地吸引新的屍體來到這裡，它們都處於不同程度的腐爛狀態。

english: An {@creature otyugh} feeds on the corpses and is presently buried under the heap in the southwest corner. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check spots the creature's eyestalk poking up above the reeking mass. The otyugh eagerly attacks a lone character but avoids confrontations with multiple enemies. Once killed, the otyugh is not replaced.
zh_tw: 一隻 {@creature otyugh||食腐獸} 以屍體為食，目前被埋在西南角的堆積物下。任何成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的人物會發現該生物的眼柄從惡臭的堆積物中伸出。奧圖格會急切地攻擊單獨的人物，但會避免與多個敵人正面衝突。一旦被殺死，奧圖格不會被替換。

english: Green Devil Face
zh_tw: 綠色魔鬼面具

english: The 8-foot-high devil face protrudes from the north wall. Any close inspection reveals that its nostrils contain hollow cavities, each one containing a stone lever. A pulled lever locks into place and can't be moved until it resets.
zh_tw: 這個8尺高的魔鬼面孔從北牆上突出。任何近距離的檢查都會發現它的鼻孔包含著空洞的腔室，每個腔室裡都裝有一個石制槓桿。拉動的槓桿鎖定到位，並且在重置之前不能移動。

english: Pulling the lever in the left nostril causes the mouth of the devil face to open wide, revealing a gullet filled with impenetrable darkness that pulls in everything in the room. Initiative should be rolled for all creatures in the area. Any creature that starts its turn in the room and isn't secured in some fashion must succeed on a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the gullet and destroyed. If a character fails the saving throw, another character within reach, or any character bound to the first character by a rope, can use his or her reaction to grab on and grant the first character a reroll. After 1 minute, the lever resets with an audible clunk. The gullet remains open until the lever resets. Magic has no effect on the gullet or the darkness within.
zh_tw: 拉動左鼻孔的槓桿會導致魔鬼面孔的嘴巴大大張開，露出一個充滿無法穿透的黑暗的食道，吸入房間內的一切。該區域內的所有生物都應進行先攻檢定。任何在房間內開始其回合且未以某種方式固定的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 11}敏捷豁免檢定，否則將被拉入食道並毀滅。如果某個角色未透過豁免檢定，可觸及範圍內的另一個角色，或任何透過繩索與第一個角色繫結的角色，可以使用其反應抓住並給予第一個角色重新擲骰的機會。1分鐘後，槓桿會以明顯的咔嗒聲重置。食道在槓桿重置前一直保持開啟狀態。魔法對食道或其中的黑暗無效。

english: Pulling the lever in the right nostril causes the devil's eyes to glow red as all living creatures in the room (including the otyugh, if it's still alive) are teleported in front of the devil face at area 5B, along with whatever they are wearing or carrying. The lever then resets.
zh_tw: 拉動右側鼻孔中的槓桿會導致魔鬼的眼睛發出紅色光芒，房間裡的所有生物（包括如果它還活著的食腐獸）都會被傳送到5B區域的魔鬼面孔前，連同他們所穿戴或攜帶的任何物品。然後槓桿重置。

english: If the characters return to this room at a later time, the effects of the levers are reversed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在以後的時間返回這個房間，槓桿的效果會被逆轉。

english: Level 5: Gears of Hate
zh_tw: 第五層：仇恨之齒輪

english: Map 5.5 shows this level of the dungeon. The Soulmonger draws power from the machinery on this level. The rumbling of that machinery echoes throughout all areas here, setting up tremors in the riveted metal panels that clad many of the walls, floors, and ceilings. The malign influence of an aboleth also pollutes this level.
zh_tw: 地圖5.5展示了地牢的這一層。噬魂器從這一層的機械中汲取力量。那機械的轟鳴聲在所有區域迴響，引起許多牆壁、地板和天花板上鉚接的金屬板震動。一個阿波羅斯的惡意影響也汙染了這一層。

english: Map 5.5: Gears of Hate
zh_tw: 地圖5.5：仇恨之齒輪

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Aboleth Slime
zh_tw: 阿波羅斯粘液

english: Puddles of viscid gray slime cover the floor in some areas, as marked on map 5.5. These areas are {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and any creature that starts its turn in a puddle of slime or comes into contact with it for the first time on a turn takes 5 ({@dice 1d10}) psychic damage. A slime puddle is destroyed if it takes any cold, radiant, or necrotic damage. It is immune to all other types of damage.
zh_tw: 在地圖 5.5 中標出的一些區域中，地板上覆蓋著黏稠的灰色粘液。這些區域是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，任何在粘液池中開始其回合的生物，或在該回閤中首次接觸粘液的生物，將受到 5（{@dice 1d10}）點心靈傷害。如果粘液池受到任何寒冷、光耀或死靈傷害，它將被摧毀。它對所有其他型別的傷害免疫。

english: Great Stone Gears
zh_tw: 巨石齒輪

english: Areas 58, 59, and 60 are constructed within giant stone gears. When the characters arrive on this level for the first time, the gear rooms are configured as shown on map 5.5. Thereafter, the rooms can be rotated using the controls in {@area area 61|494|x}. Their ceilings are disconnected from the walls, allowing the chambers to turn without reorienting the ceilings or the shaft in {@area area 58|484|x}.
zh_tw: 區域58、59 和 60 建造在巨大的石制齒輪中。當角色首次到達這一層時，齒輪房間的配置如地圖 5.5 所示。之後，可以透過{@area 區域51|494|x}中的控制裝置旋轉這些房間。它們的天花板與牆壁分離，使得房間可以在不重新定向天花板或{@area 區域58|484|x}中的軸的情況下旋轉。

english: 58. Cog of Rot
zh_tw: 58. 腐朽齒輪

english: A pungent stench fills this pentagonal room, the walls of which are covered with riveted sheets of iron. A wild garden full of sickly plants and rotting compost takes up most of the interior, and a narrow path hugs the walls between two exits. Jutting from the middle of the garden is a six-foot-tall rusty sprinkler. In the ceiling above the sprinkler, a ten-foot-wide shaft leads straight up.
zh_tw: 這個五邊形房間充滿了刺鼻的惡臭，牆壁上覆蓋著鉚接的鐵板。一個充滿病態植物和腐爛堆肥的野生花園佔據了大部分內部空間，一條狹窄的小徑沿著牆壁延伸，在兩個出口之間。一個六尺高的生鏽噴頭從花園中央突出。在噴頭上方的天花板上，一個十尺寬的豎井直通上方。

english: Whenever this room is rotated by the controls in {@area area 61|494|x}, the sprinkler draws water from the underground lake ({@area area 65|4b1|x}) to spray the plants in the room. Magic keeps the plants alive despite the lack of sunlight.
zh_tw: 每當這個房間透過{@area 區域51|494|x}中的控制裝置旋轉時，噴頭就會從地下湖({@area 區域65|4b1|x})抽取水來噴灑房間中的植物。儘管缺乏陽光，魔法仍然使這些植物保持生機。

english: If the cogs are turned so that one of the doorways lines up with {@area area 63|4ac|x} to the north, gas from that area billows into the garden and transforms random piles of compost into three {@creature Shambling Mound||shambling mounds}, which rise up and attack any other creatures in the room. After 1 hour, the shambling mounds revert to dead compost.
zh_tw: 如果齒輪被轉動，使得其中一個門與北邊的{@area 區域63|4ac|x}對齊，那個區域的氣體就會湧入花園，將隨機的堆肥堆變成三個{@creature Shambling Mound||蔓生怪}，它們會站起來攻擊房間裡的其他生物。1小時後，蔓生怪會恢復成死亡的堆肥。

english: The shaft in the ceiling ascends 15 feet to {@area area 45|41e|x}. To scale the smooth walls of the shaft, a character needs a climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 天花板上的豎井向上延伸15尺至{@area 區域45|41e|x}。要攀爬豎井的光滑牆壁，角色需要攀爬裝備或魔法。

english: 59. Cog of Acid
zh_tw: 59. 酸液齒輪

english: An acidic stench fills this pentagonal chamber, which has two exits. The walls are covered with riveted sheets of iron, and the pockmarked stone floor has a large puddle of gray slime in the middle of it. Friezes along each wall just beneath the ceiling depict five black dragons.
zh_tw: 這個五邊形的房間充滿了酸性的惡臭，有兩個出口。牆壁上覆蓋著鉚接的鐵板，佈滿坑窪的石地板中央有一大片灰色粘液。牆壁上靠近天花板的地方裝飾著五條黑龍的浮雕。

english: Gouts of acid are meant to rain down from the mouths of the dragon friezes whenever this room is rotated by the controls in {@area area 61|494|x}, but the acid compartments in the ceiling are currently empty. Consequently, nothing happens when the room turns. Any character who can get close enough to the ceiling to examine the friezes notices tiny holes in the dragons' mouths.
zh_tw: 當這個房間透過{@area 區域51|494|x}中的控制裝置旋轉時，本應從龍形浮雕的口中滴下酸性液體，但天花板上的酸液隔間目前是空的。因此，當房間轉動時，什麼也沒發生。任何能夠靠近天花板檢查浮雕的角色都會注意到龍的口中有微小的孔洞。

english: 60. Cog of Blood
zh_tw: 60. 血之齒輪

english: Five teak wardrobes stand against the ironclad walls of this chamber, each with a door bearing a carved image or scene. Puddles of gray slime cover parts of the floor. The room has two exits, including an adamantine portcullis blocking a passage to the north. Set into a metal plate above the portcullis is a row of five red crystals shaped like drops of blood.
zh_tw: 五個柚木衣櫃靠在這個房間的鐵壁上，每個門上都雕刻有影象或場景。灰色粘液覆蓋了地板的部分區域。房間有兩個出口，包括一個阻擋向北通道的精金柵欄。在柵欄上方的金屬板上鑲嵌著一排五個血滴形狀的紅色水晶。

english: The adamantine portcullis is impervious to damage and spells, and its bars are spaced 4 inches apart. A Tiny or gaseous creature can slip between the bars easily.
zh_tw: 精金柵欄對傷害和法術免疫，其柵欄條間隔4吋。一個細小或氣體生物可以輕鬆地從柵欄條之間滑過。

english: To raise the portcullis, monsters from all five wardrobes must be summoned and slain in this room. Only one wardrobe can be opened at a time, and until that wardrobe's monsters are defeated, all other wardrobes in the room are sealed and unopenable. When all of a wardrobe's monsters die, the wardrobe disappears and one of the red crystals above the portcullis lights up. When all five crystals are lit, the portcullis rises and remains up for 24 hours. Once this duration ends, the portcullis lowers back into place, the crystals go dark, and the wardrobes reappear with their doors closed.
zh_tw: 要升起這個柵欄，必須在這個房間裡召喚並消滅來自所有五個衣櫃的怪物。一次只能開啟一個衣櫃，而且直到那個衣櫃的怪物被擊敗，房間內所有其他衣櫃都是封閉的，無法開啟。當一個衣櫃的所有怪物死亡時，衣櫃就會消失，柵欄上方的一個紅色水晶就會亮起來。當所有五個水晶都亮起來時，柵欄升起並保持開啟狀態24小時。一旦這個時間結束，柵欄就會回到原位，水晶熄滅，衣櫃重新出現，門關閉。

english: Each wardrobe contains a one-way gate to another plane, which deactivates if the wardrobe is removed from this chamber or destroyed. Any creature attempting to pass through a wardrobe's gate from this side is forced back and cannot enter.
zh_tw: 每個衣櫃內都含有一個通往另一個位面的單向門，如果衣櫃從這個房間移走或被摧毀，門就會失效。任何生物嘗試從這一側穿過衣櫃的門都會被強制推回，無法進入。

english: Each wardrobe weighs 250 pounds, stands 6½ feet tall, and radiates an aura of conjuration magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. A wardrobe is a Medium object with AC 11, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 每個衣櫃重250磅，高6½尺，並且對{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果散發出一種召喚魔法的氣息。衣櫃是一箇中等大小的物體，具有11的護甲等級，30點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Acheron Wardrobe
zh_tw: 修羅場衣櫃

english: The scene on this door depicts an army of orcs clashing with an army of hobgoblins. When the door is opened, read:
zh_tw: 這扇門上的場景描繪了一支獸人大軍與一支大地精大軍的衝突。當門被開啟時，請閱讀：

english: Dust and smoke billow from the wardrobe, and the air around you sounds out with the roar of battle. Beyond the doors, armies fight under a blood-red sky that has an iron cube floating in it like a huge, distant moon. Clouds of ash suddenly fly out of the wardrobe, transforming into screaming orcs before your eyes.
zh_tw: 塵土和煙霧從衣櫃中滾滾而出，你周圍的空氣中充滿了戰鬥的轟鳴聲。在門的另一邊，軍隊在血紅色的天空下戰鬥，天空中有如巨大而遙遠的月亮般的鐵立方體漂浮著。突然，灰燼雲從衣櫃中飛出，在你的眼前變成了尖叫的獸人。

english: Opening the wardrobe summons an {@creature orc war chief} and seven {@creature Orc||orcs}. Their bodies, armor, and weapons remain in this chamber when they die.
zh_tw: 開啟這個衣櫃會召喚一個{@creature orc war chief||獸人軍官}和七個{@creature Orc||獸人}。他們死亡時，身體、盔甲和武器都會留在這個房間裡。

english: Gehenna Wardrobe
zh_tw: 焦炎火獄衣櫃

english: This door depicts a grinning night hag with a swaddled human infant in her arms. When it is opened, read:
zh_tw: 這扇門上描繪著一個咧嘴笑的夜巫婆，她懷裡抱著一個裹著襁褓的人類嬰兒。當門被開啟時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The door opens above the caldera of an active volcano. Shards of black rock float above the molten magma. Perched atop one shard are two man-sized creatures with insectoid features and four arms apiece.
zh_tw: 門開在一座活火山的火山口上方。黑色的岩石碎片漂浮在熔岩上方。一塊岩石上棲息著兩個體型與人類相當的生物，它們具有昆蟲般的特徵，每個都有四隻手臂。

english: Opening the wardrobe reveals two {@creature Mezzoloth||mezzoloths}, which teleport into the room and attack. When a mezzoloth dies, its body transforms into wisps of oily smoke, though its trident remains.
zh_tw: 開啟衣櫃揭示了兩個 {@creature Mezzoloth||毒蟲羅斯魔}，它們傳送進房間並進行攻擊。當一個毒蟲羅斯魔死亡時，它的身體會轉變成油膩煙霧的縷縷，儘管它的三叉戟仍然保留。

english: Mechanus Wardrobe
zh_tw: 機械境衣櫃

english: This door is carved to depict the face of an ornate clock. When the door is opened, read:
zh_tw: 這扇門雕刻著一個華麗時鐘的面孔。當門被開啟時，請閱讀：

english: Enormous interlocking gears and cogs stretch as far as you can see. Suddenly, a spherical construct with spindly legs and small wings tumbles through the open doorway.
zh_tw: 巨大的相互齧合的齒輪和齒條延伸到你能看到的最遠地方。突然，一個球形構裝生物，有著細長的腿和小小的翅膀，從開啟的門洞中滾落進來。

english: Opening the wardrobe summons a clueless, disoriented {@creature monodrone} that lands {@condition prone} at the characters' feet. It then tries to right itself and reenter the wardrobe, but is rebuffed by the wardrobe's magic. The modron fights only in self-defense and disintegrates if destroyed.
zh_tw: 開啟衣櫃會召喚一個困惑、迷失方向的{@creature monodrone||單元冢}，它在角色們的腳邊以{@condition prone||伏地}狀態著陸。然後它試圖站起來並重新進入衣櫃，但被衣櫃的魔法所阻止。這個魔冢只在自衛時戰鬥，如果被摧毀就會解體。

english: Nine Hells Wardrobe
zh_tw: 九層地獄衣櫃

english: The scene on this door depicts twisted, screaming humanoid faces wrapped in chains. When the door is opened, read:
zh_tw: 這扇門上的場景描繪了扭曲、尖叫的人形面孔，被鏈條纏繞。當門被開啟時，請閱讀：

english: Waves of heat assail you as the door opens, revealing an iron road leading to a basalt citadel surrounded by the charred remains of defeated armies. Prisoners scream from iron gibbets that festoon the citadel walls. Suddenly, a single glowing ember flies out of the wardrobe and transforms into a winged, bony fiend with a smiling, skull-like visage.
zh_tw: 當門開啟時，熱浪襲來，露出一條通往由被擊敗的軍隊焦黑殘骸環繞的玄武岩堡壘的鐵路。囚犯們在裝飾堡壘牆壁的鐵籠中尖叫。突然，一個發光的火星從衣櫃中飛出，變成了一個長著翅膀、骨瘦如柴的惡魔，臉上帶著微笑、骷髏般的面容。

english: Opening the wardrobe summons a {@creature bone devil}. When it dies, its body transforms into a pool of stinking ichor.
zh_tw: 開啟衣櫃會召喚一個{@creature bone devil||骨魔}。當它死去時，它的身體會轉變成一灘惡臭的粘液。

english: Shadowfell Wardrobe
zh_tw: 影域衣櫃

english: The scene on this door depicts ghouls gnawing on bones. When the door is opened, read:
zh_tw: 這扇門上的場景描繪了食屍鬼在啃食骨頭。當門被開啟時，請閱讀：
