english: You gaze out across an ancient cemetery, its canted tombstones shrouded in fog. Eerie, hungry shapes move among the graves in the distance. Suddenly, bright glowing balls of light appear in the room behind you.
zh_tw: 你凝視著一個古老的墓地，傾斜的墓碑被霧氣籠罩。遠處的墳墓間，詭異而飢餓的身影在移動。突然，明亮發光的光球出現在你身後的房間裡。

english: Opening the wardrobe summons four {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps}, which are {@condition invisible} until they attack. Nothing remains of them when they are destroyed.
zh_tw: 開啟衣櫃會召喚出四個 {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}，它們在攻擊前處於 {@condition invisible||隱形} 狀態。當它們被摧毀時，不會留下任何東西。

english: 61. Control Room
zh_tw: 61. 控制室

english: A four-foot-high, seven-foot-wide iron lectern in the middle of this rusty, iron-plated room is topped by a slanted control panel. Set into the control panel are a gold lever with a star-shaped handle, two dials in red and blue, and two buttons of the same colors. Wall engravings behind the control panel show five groups of circles, with a small crystal embedded in the wall under each one. The crystal under the configuration labeled "3" glows bright green. Three six-inch-diameter rusty iron pipes jut from the wall above the engravings.
zh_tw: 這個生鏽的鐵板房間中央有一個四尺高、七尺寬的鐵製講臺，上面是一個傾斜的控制面板。控制面板上設有一個帶有星形手柄的金制槓桿，兩個紅色和藍色的刻度盤，以及兩個同色的按鈕。控制面板後面的牆壁上刻有五組圓圈，每組圓圈下方的牆壁中嵌入了一個小水晶。標記為"3"的配置下方的水晶發出明亮的綠色光芒。三根直徑六吋的生鏽鐵管從上方的牆壁上突出。

english: When the characters reach this room, give the players a copy of handout 24 in {@area appendix E|537|x}. It shows the control panel atop the iron lectern, as well as the wall engravings and rusty pipes. Inspection of the pipes reveals traces of the same gray slime found in puddles throughout this level.
zh_tw: 當角色到達這個房間時，給玩家一份{@area 附錄 E|537|x}中的資料24副本。它展示了鐵講臺上的控制面板，以及牆上的雕刻和生鏽的管道。檢查管道可以發現與貫穿本層的坑窪中相同的灰色黏液痕跡。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Papazotl, Unkh, or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被帕帕扎圖、安珂或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Shrewd Papazotl asserts that the blue controls are helpful and the red controls are baleful. (This is pure guesswork on his part.)
zh_tw: 精明的帕帕扎圖堅稱藍色的控制裝置是有益的，紅色的控制裝置是有害的。（這是他自己的純粹猜測。）

english: Fretful Unkh thinks she can figure out what the controls do by studying them. If her host allows her an hour of study and contemplation, she concludes that the controls are a mystery and should be left alone.
zh_tw: 焦慮的安珂認為她可以透過研究這些控制裝置來弄清楚它們的功能。如果她的宿主允許她進行一個小時的研究和思考，她得出的結論是這些控制裝置是一個謎，應該保持不動。

english: Violent Wongo urges his host to smash the controls.
zh_tw: 暴力的望戈敦促他的宿主破壞控制裝置。

english: Concealed Crawlway
zh_tw: 隱蔽的爬行通道

english: A hidden crawlway runs from the underside of the lectern to {@area area 70|4cf|x}, but it cannot be accessed from inside this chamber. Any character who enters the crawlway from {@area area 70|4cf|x} discovers a stone lever in the wall at the south end of the crawlway. Pulling the lever slides the lectern aside to reveal an access point.
zh_tw: 一個隱藏的爬行通道從講臺的底部延伸至{@area 區域70|4cf|x}，但不能從這個房間內部進入。任何從{@area 區域70|4cf|x}進入爬行通道的角色都會在爬行通道南端的牆壁上發現一個石制槓桿。拉動槓桿會使講臺滑開，露出一個進入點。

english: Control Panel
zh_tw: 控制面板

english: The control panel is a Medium object with AC 15, a damage threshold of 10, 15 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying the panel disables the controls and causes arcs of lightning to momentarily erupt from the iron lectern. Each creature in the room must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by lightning, taking 11 ({@dice 2d10}) lightning damage.
zh_tw: 控制面板是一箇中型物體，具有AC 15，傷害閾值為10，15點生命值，並且對毒素和精神傷害免疫。摧毀面板會使控制裝置失效，並從鐵製講臺上瞬間爆發出閃電弧。房間內的每個生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 16}的敏捷豁免檢定，否則將被閃電擊中，受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點閃電傷害。

english: The controls atop the iron lectern have no labels, so their purpose must be discovered with experimentation.
zh_tw: 鐵製講臺上的控制裝置沒有任何標籤，因此它們的用途必須透過實驗來發現。

english: Blue Dial
zh_tw: 藍色刻度盤

english: This dial can be turned to the left or right, and it snaps back to center if released. The blue dial determines which wall crystal is lit. Currently, the crystal under configuration 3 is illuminated. If the dial is turned, the currently lit crystal goes out and the crystal to the left or right (the direction the dial is turned) lights up.
zh_tw: 這個刻度盤可以向左或向右旋轉，如果松開，它會彈回到中心位置。藍色刻度盤決定了哪個牆壁上的水晶被點亮。目前，配置3下的水晶是亮著的。如果轉動刻度盤，當前亮著的水晶會熄滅，而向左或向右（刻度盤旋轉的方向）的水晶會亮起來。

english: Blue Button
zh_tw: 藍色按鈕

english: Pushing the blue button orients the cog rooms (areas 58 through 60) to match whichever configuration has its crystal lit. The entire level trembles as the giant cogs rotate. If the blue button is pushed while the cog rooms are rotating or already in their proper configuration, nothing happens.
zh_tw: 按下藍色按鈕會使齒輪房間（58號至60號區域）與有水晶點亮的配置相匹配。整個層級在巨大的齒輪旋轉時震動。如果藍色按鈕在齒輪房間旋轉中或已經在正確的配置時被按下，什麼也不會發生。

english: Gold Lever
zh_tw: 金色槓桿

english: The lever begins in the up position. If pulled to the down position, the lever locks in place and aboleth slime (see "{@area Aboleth Slime|482|x}") begins to pour into the room through the iron pipes above the wall engraving. If the pipes are plugged with cloth before the lever is pulled, the slime is prevented from flowing into the room, but the pipes can't be stuffed while slime is pouring out of them.
zh_tw: 槓桿最初處於向上的位置。如果拉到向下的位置，槓桿將鎖定，並透過牆壁雕刻上方的鐵管開始倒入阿波羅斯粘液（見"{@area 阿波羅斯粘液|482|x}"）。如果在拉動槓桿之前用布塞住管道，可以阻止粘液流入房間，但如果粘液正在從管道中流出，則無法塞住管道。

english: The slime covers the floor to a depth of 1 inch per round. If the crawlway to {@area area 70|4cf|x} is exposed (see "Concealed Crawlway" above), the slime does not accumulate in the room and instead pours into the crawlspace.
zh_tw: 粘液以每輪1吋的深度覆蓋地板。如果通往{@area 區域70|4cf|x}的爬行通道被暴露（見上文的"隱蔽的爬行通道"），粘液不會在房間內積聚，而是流入爬行空間。

english: The lever's locking mechanism can be released with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. If released, the lever automatically shifts to the up position, shutting the valves in the pipes and stopping the flow of slime. The lever can be torn from the console with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, which has the same effect.
zh_tw: 槓桿的鎖定機制可以透過角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來解除。如果解除成功，槓桿會自動切換到上升位置，關閉管道中的閥門並停止粘液流動。也可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定將槓桿從控制檯上扯下，效果相同。

english: The gold lever has another function, which is revealed in {@area area 67|4bd|x}.
zh_tw: 金色槓桿還有另一個功能，這將在{@area 區域67|4bd|x}中揭示。

english: Red Button
zh_tw: 紅色按鈕

english: Pushing the red button causes a 6-inch-thick wall of iron to drop from the ceiling in the doorway, sealing off the east exit. Any creature in the doorway when the wall drops must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to one side of the barrier or the other (its choice). On a failed save, the creature is pinned under the wall, falls {@condition prone}, and takes 44 ({@dice 8d10}) bludgeoning damage. A pinned creature is {@condition restrained}, can't stand up, and takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns until it crawls out from under the door or another creature pulls it free, either of which requires an action and a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The iron wall remains locked in place for 1 hour, after which it rises back into the ceiling on its own. It can't be lifted or pried open, though a {@spell knock} spell causes it to retract into the ceiling. While the iron wall is down, pushing the red button has no effect.
zh_tw: 按下紅色按鈕會導致一堵6吋厚的鐵牆從門口的天花板落下，封鎖東出口。鐵牆落下時，任何位於門口的生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免。豁免成功時，生物會被推到屏障的一側或另一側（由其選擇）。豁免失敗時，生物會被壓到牆下，陷入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，並受到44（{@dice 8d10}）點鈍擊傷害。被壓住的生物會陷入{@condition restrained||束縛}狀態，無法站起來，並在其每回合開始時受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點鈍擊傷害，直到它從門下爬出或另一個生物將其拉出，這兩種情況都需要一個動作和一次成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。鐵牆會保持鎖閉狀態1小時，之後會自動升回天花板。鐵牆無法被舉起或撬開，不過{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術可以使其縮回天花板。當鐵牆降下時，按下紅色按鈕不會產生任何效果。

english: Red Dial
zh_tw: 紅色刻度盤

english: This dial can be turned to the left or right, and it snaps back to center if released. Turning the dial to the left establishes a two-way telepathic link between the creatures in this room and the aboleth in {@area area 65|4b1|x}. Turning the dial to the right ends the link. The telepathic link to the aboleth also ends for any creature that leaves the control room. Because the communication is telepathic, all participants can understand one another even if they don't speak the same language. Roleplay the aboleth using the information in {@area area 65|4b1|x}.
zh_tw: 這個刻度盤可以向左或向右旋轉，如果松開，它會彈回到中心位置。向左轉動刻度盤會在本房間的生物和{@area 區域65|4b1|x}中的阿波羅斯之間建立雙向心靈感應連線。向右轉動刻度盤會結束這個連線。任何離開控制室的生物也會結束與阿波羅斯的心靈感應連線。因為通訊是心靈感應的，即使他們不說同一種語言，所有參與者也能理解彼此。使用{@area 區域65|4b1|x}中的資訊來扮演阿波羅斯。

english: The aboleth is accustomed to speaking only with {@creature Withers|ToA} and refers to the wight by his original name of Gorra. If the characters activate the telepathic link, the first thought the aboleth sends is an exasperated, "What now, Gorra?" Once the aboleth realizes it's telepathically linked to strangers, it wants to know all about them for no reason other than to satisfy its curiosity.
zh_tw: 阿波羅斯習慣於只與{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}交談，並以他原來的名字戈拉稱呼屍妖。如果角色們啟用了心靈感應連線，阿波羅斯傳送的第一個想法是惱怒的，"現在又怎麼了，戈拉？"一旦阿波羅斯意識到它與陌生人建立了心靈感應連線，它就想要了解他們的一切，除了滿足它的好奇心之外沒有其他原因。

english: Cog Configurations
zh_tw: 齒輪配置

english: Handout 24 (see {@area appendix E|537|x}) shows the five different configurations for this level of the dungeon:
zh_tw: 資料24（見{@area 附錄 E|537|x}）展示了這個地牢層級的五種不同配置：

english: {@b Configuration 1}. Open doorways connect {@area area 58|484|x} to areas 60 and 63. Area 59 is cut off, as are exits to areas 61, 62, and 67.
zh_tw: {@b 配置1}. 開放的門道將{@area 區域58|484|x}連線到60號和63號區域。59號區域被切斷，同樣被切斷的還有通往61號、62號和67號區域的出口。

english: {@b Configuration 2}. An open doorway connects areas 58 and 63, but a doorway leading to {@area area 59|486|x} ends in a blank wall. Area 60 is also cut off, as are exits to areas 61, 62, 67, and 68.
zh_tw: {@b 配置2}. 一個開放的門道連線58號和63號區域，但通往{@area 區域59|486|x}的門道以一堵空白牆結束。60號區域也被切斷，同樣被切斷的還有通往61號、62號、67號和68號區域的出口。

english: {@b Configuration 3}. As shown on map 5.5.
zh_tw: {@b 配置3}. 如地圖5.5所示。

english: {@b Configuration 4}. An open doorway connects {@area area 58|484|x} to {@area area 62|49f|x}. Area 59 and {@area area 60|488|x} are cut off, as are exits to areas 61, 67, and 68.
zh_tw: {@b 配置4}. 一個開放的門道將{@area 區域58|484|x}連線到{@area 區域62|49f|x}。59號區域和{@area 區域60|488|x}被切斷，同樣被切斷的還有通往61號、67號和68號區域的出口。

english: {@b Configuration 5}. Open doorways connect areas 59 and 61, as well as areas 60 and 67. Area 58 is cut off, as are exits to areas 62 and 68.
zh_tw: {@b 配置5}. 開放的門道連線59號和61號區域，以及60號和67號區域。58號區域被切斷，同樣被切斷的還有通往62號和68號區域的出口。

english: 62. Stone Juggernaut
zh_tw: 62. 岩石戰車

english: This area is a dead end—in more ways than one.
zh_tw: 這個區域是一個死衚衕——在很多方面都是。

english: 62A. "Awaken Napaka!"
zh_tw: 62A. "喚醒納帕卡！"

english: This hall is choked with dust and cobwebs. Up ahead, flickering lights dimly illuminate a larger hall running perpendicular to this one. Where the two halls meet, words have been scrawled on the ceiling in dried blood.
zh_tw: 這個走廊裡滿是灰塵和蛛網。前方，閃爍的燈光微弱地照亮了一個與這條走廊垂直的更大的走廊。在兩條走廊交匯處，天花板上用乾涸的血跡潦草地寫著一些字。

english: A secret door in the west wall slides open to reveal a dark tunnel leading to areas 26 and 66. At the spot marked X on map 5.5, bloody words on the ceiling read, "AWAKEN NAPAKA!"
zh_tw: 西牆上的一扇暗門滑開，露出一條通往26號和66號區域的黑暗隧道。在地圖5.5上標記為X的地方，天花板上的血字寫著："喚醒納帕卡！"

english: 62B. Sloped Hall
zh_tw: 62B. 傾斜走廊

english: Large puddles of gray slime spread across the floor of this ten-foot-wide, gently sloping hallway. Candles flicker on riveted sconces, casting {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} across a sequence of sculpted reliefs depicting humanoids with bestial heads kneeling before a black star. At the lower end of the hall, a thick purple drape hangs wall to wall. At the upper end, the hallway terminates.
zh_tw: 大灘的灰色粘液散佈在這條十尺寬、緩緩傾斜的走廊地板上。鉚接壁架上的蠟燭搖曳閃爍，將{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}投射在一系列雕刻浮雕上，這些浮雕描繪了長著野獸頭顱的人形生物跪拜在一顆黑色星辰前的場景。在走廊低端，一道厚重的紫色帷幕從牆延伸到牆。在高階處，走廊戛然而止。

english: The hall slopes down toward area 62C. Area 62D lies to the west, behind a secret door that spans the entire wall (see that area for more information).
zh_tw: 走廊向下傾斜通向62C區域。62D區域位於西側，隱藏在一扇橫跨整面牆的秘密門後面（更多資訊請參見該區域）。

english: Candles
zh_tw: 蠟燭

english: Six magic candles are spaced 10 feet apart on alternate sides of the hallway. The candles don't burn down as long as they remain in this area.
zh_tw: 六根魔法蠟燭在走廊的兩側每隔10尺交替放置。只要它們保持在這個區域，蠟燭就不會燃燒。

english: Secret Crawlway
zh_tw: 秘密爬行通道

english: Hidden behind a bas-relief depicting a crocodile-headed humanoid holding up a trapezoidal chest, a crawlway leads to area 62D. Close inspection of the relief reveals that the chest's keyhole is real. The jade key found in {@area area 53|459|x} can be used to unlock the relief and swing it open, revealing the crawlway. The lock can also be picked with a successful {@dc 21} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. But if the check fails by 5 or more, the secret door in the west wall slides open to release the stone juggernaut (see "Napaka Awakens" in area 62D).
zh_tw: 隱藏在一幅描繪鱷魚頭人形生物託舉梯形箱子的淺浮雕後方，一條爬行通道通向區域62D。仔細觀察浮雕會發現箱子的鑰匙孔是真實的。在{@area 區域53|459|x}找到的翡翠鑰匙可用於解鎖浮雕並使其擺動開啟，露出爬行通道。鎖也可以透過角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 21}敏捷檢定來撬開。但如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，西牆的密門會滑開釋放出岩石戰車（參見區域62D的"納帕卡甦醒"）。

english: 62C. Broken Statue
zh_tw: 62C. 破碎的雕像

english: The hallway comes to a dead end 15 feet beyond the purple drape.
zh_tw: 走廊在紫色帷幕之外15尺處到達盡頭。

english: A six-foot-tall statue of a leering four-armed gargoyle stands against the back wall. One of its arms has broken off and lies on the floor in front of it, its hand curled into a tight fist. The other three arms have their clawed hands open in such a way as to suggest they're meant to hold something. Carved into the wall above the statue is a riddle:
zh_tw: 一尊六尺高的嘲笑四臂石像鬼雕像靠在後牆上。它的一隻手臂已經斷裂，躺在它前面的地板上，它的手緊握成拳。其他三隻手臂的爪子張開，似乎意味著它們應該拿著什麼東西。在雕像上方的牆上刻著一個謎語：

english: Three I need
zh_tw: 我需要三個

english: Then three more
zh_tw: 然後是三個更多

english: Three more still
zh_tw: 還是三個更多

english: Opens the door
zh_tw: 開啟門

english: The gargoyle statue is impervious to damage and spells, but its broken-off arm is not. If three gemstones are placed in the three open hands of the statue, the hands magically close into fists that crush the gemstones to powder. The statue's hands then open again. If this exercise is performed twice more, so that nine gemstones in total are crushed, the hand of the broken-off arm opens and a fist-sized ruby appears in it. The ruby is the Eye of Zaltec, which is teleported from area 62D by the sacrifice of the gems. If the ruby is plucked from the gargoyle's hand, the statue magically opens its mouth and exhales a cloud of soporific gas that fills the eastern 15 feet of the hall. At the same time, the secret door at the west end of the hallway slides open, and the stone juggernaut in area 62D rolls down the corridor.
zh_tw: 石像鬼雕像對傷害和法術免疫，但它斷裂的手臂不是。如果將三顆寶石放在雕像的三個張開的手中，這些手會神奇地合攏成拳頭，將寶石壓成粉末。然後雕像的手再次張開。如果這個動作再進行兩次，總共壓碎了九顆寶石，那麼斷裂的手臂的手就會張開，裡面出現了一個拳頭大小的紅寶石。這顆紅寶石是扎爾特克之眼，它透過犧牲寶石從62D區域傳送過來。如果從石像鬼的手中摘下紅寶石，雕像會神奇地張開嘴，撥出一團催眠氣體，填滿走廊東側的15尺。與此同時，走廊西端的秘密門滑開，62D區域的岩石戰車滾下走廊。

english: Each creature in the gas cloud that is not immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour. The effect ends on a creature that takes damage.
zh_tw: 在毒氣雲中每個對{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態不免疫的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 15}的體質豁免檢定，否則將陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態1小時。受到傷害的生物該效果將終止。

english: 62D. Secret Room
zh_tw: 62D. 秘密房間

english: The secret door to this room spans the entire wall and can't be opened by force or magic. It opens only when triggered by the characters' actions in area 62B or 62C.
zh_tw: 這個房間的秘密門橫跨整個牆面，不能透過力量或魔法開啟。它只有在62B或62C區域的角色的行為觸發時才會開啟。

english: Two-thirds of this room is taken up by {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s {@creature stone juggernaut|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}). The archlich named the juggernaut after Napaka, a dead Omuan queen (see {@area area 53|459|x}). If the characters enter the room through the crawlway and haven't yet awakened the juggernaut, it remains inert and does not attack unless it takes damage or the secret door slides open.
zh_tw: 這個房間的三分之二被{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的{@creature stone juggernaut|ToA|岩石戰車}佔據（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）。名為阿瑟瑞克的死靈法師以已故的烏曼女王娜帕卡的名字命名了這個岩石戰車（見{@area 區域53|459|x}）。如果角色們透過爬行通道進入房間，並且還沒有喚醒岩石戰車，它將保持靜止，除非受到傷害或秘密門滑開，否則不會攻擊。

english: Napaka Awakens
zh_tw: 納帕卡覺醒

english: When the stone juggernaut is activated, read:
zh_tw: 當岩石戰車被啟用時，請閱讀：

english: The wall at the west end of the hall slides back to reveal a stone juggernaut on rollers. The construct fills the height and width of the hall and barrels toward you at alarming speed.
zh_tw: 走廊西端的牆壁滑開，露出一個裝有滾輪的岩石戰車。這個構裝生物填滿了走廊的高度和寬度，以驚人的速度向你們衝來。

english: All creatures present must roll initiative. On its turn, the juggernaut rolls down the hallway, making a Slam attack against any creature standing in its way and using its Devastating Roll feature to crush small or {@condition prone} enemies. When no enemies are left alive, it returns to the secret room. The juggernaut can't fit into any space less than 10 feet wide, and it doesn't have room in the hallway to turn. It attacks by rolling forward and backward.
zh_tw: 所有在場的生物都必須進行先攻骰。在它的回合，石魔像沿著走廊滾動，對任何阻擋在它道路上的生物進行撞擊攻擊，並使用其毀滅性滾動特性來壓碎小型或{@condition prone||伏地}的敵人。當沒有敵人活著時，它返回到秘密房間。石魔像無法進入小於10尺寬的空間，並且在走廊裡沒有足夠的空間轉彎。它透過向前和向後滾動來進行攻擊。

english: Hidden in the tomb of the real Napaka ({@area area 53|459|x}) is a magic scepter, the adamantine head of which reduces the juggernaut to 0 hit points and turns it to dust on contact. While the juggernaut is inert, no attack roll is needed to strike it with the scepter. If the juggernaut has been awakened, a character can use the scepter to make a melee weapon attack against the juggernaut, reducing it to 0 hit points and turning it to dust on a hit.
zh_tw: 隱藏在那帕卡真墓（{@area 區域53|459|x}）中的是一根魔法權杖，其精金杖頭能將戰爭巨像的生命值降至0並使其化為塵埃。當戰爭巨像處於惰性狀態時，使用權杖攻擊無需進行攻擊檢定。如果戰爭巨像已被喚醒，角色可以使用權杖對戰爭巨像進行一次近戰武器攻擊，命中後將其生命值降至0並使其化為塵埃。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Unless it has been teleported to area 62C, a lustrous, spiked ruby as big as a human fist sits on a stone shelf that juts from the west wall of the room. This gemstone is the fabled Eye of Zaltec. It is worth 5,000 gp but can fetch up to five times that value if sold at auction in any major city. For more information on the Eye of Zaltec, see "{@area Fabled Treasures|31a|x}."
zh_tw: 除非它已經被傳送到62C區域，否則一顆光澤四射、帶刺的巨大紅寶石，大小如同人拳，放置在從房間西牆突出的石架上。這顆寶石就是傳說中的扎爾特克之眼。它價值5000金幣，但如果在任何主要城市的拍賣中出售，其價值可能高達五倍。有關扎爾特克之眼的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 傳說中的寶藏|31a|x}"。

english: If the Eye of Zaltec was teleported to area 62C, the shelf is bare.
zh_tw: 如果扎爾特克之眼被傳送到了62C區域，那麼架子上將空無一物。

english: 63. Gas-Filled Room
zh_tw: 63. 充滿氣體的房間

english: This chamber is closed off and inaccessible most of the time. The characters can reach this area by reorienting the cogs so that a doorway opens up to {@area area 58|484|x}.
zh_tw: 這個房間大部分時間是封閉且無法進入的。角色們可以透過重新調整齒輪，使門道向{@area 區域58|484|x}開啟，從而到達這個區域。

english: Thick green gas billows out of skull-shaped nozzles set into the walls of this cramped room. A rotting corpse clad in {@item studded leather armor|PHB} lies on the floor, mouth open and hands grasping its throat. Wrapped around one of its arms is a yellow band.
zh_tw: 濃密的綠色氣體從這間狹小房間牆壁上的骷髏形噴嘴中噴湧而出。一具腐爛的屍體穿著{@item studded leather armor|PHB|鑲釘皮甲}躺在地上，嘴巴大張，雙手緊抓喉嚨。它的一條手臂上纏著一條黃色帶子。

english: The green gas that fills this room fills {@area area 58|484|x} when the two rooms are open to each other, but the gas is too heavy to rise up the shaft into {@area area 45|41e|x}. The gas has two effects:
zh_tw: 這個房間中充滿的綠色氣體在兩個房間相互開放時會充滿 {@area 區域58|484|x}，但氣體太重，無法上升到豎井進入 {@area 區域45|41e|x}。這種氣體有兩種效果：

english: It transforms the dead vegetation in {@area area 58|484|x} into three shambling mounds (see that area for details).
zh_tw: 它將{@area 區域58|484|x}中的死亡植被轉變為三個蔓生怪（詳見該區域）。

english: It is poisonous to non-plants. Any creature susceptible to the gas that starts its turn in a gas-filled area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@dice 4d8}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature is affected even if it holds its breath or doesn't need to breathe.
zh_tw: 它對非植物有毒。任何容易受到毒氣影響的生物，如果在充滿毒氣的區域開始其回合，必須進行一次 {@dc 13} 體質豁免檢定，失敗則受到 18（{@dice 4d8}）點毒素傷害，成功則受到一半傷害。即使生物屏住呼吸或不需要呼吸，也會受到影響。

english: Stuffing the nozzles with cloth prevents more gas from spilling into the room. If the characters block the flow of gas, the lingering gas disperses after 1 minute.
zh_tw: 用布塞住噴嘴可以阻止更多的氣體湧入房間。如果角色們阻止了氣體流動，殘留的氣體將在1分鐘後散去。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The dead figure on the floor is Lord Brixton, the Cormyrean leader of the doomed Company of the Yellow Banner. He died when {@creature Withers|ToA} rotated the cogs from {@area area 61|494|x} and trapped him in this room.
zh_tw: 地板上的死者是布里克斯頓勳爵，科米爾的黃旗冒險團的領袖，這個黃旗冒險團註定要失敗。當{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}從{@area 區域51|494|x}轉動齒輪並將他困在這個房間裡時，他死去了。

english: The corpse wears {@item studded leather armor|PHB} and carries a sheathed longsword with a dragon-shaped hilt. The sword has a minor magical property: its bearer gains the ability to speak and understand the {@language Draconic|PHB} language.
zh_tw: 屍體穿著{@item studded leather armor|PHB|鑲釘皮甲}，攜帶一把收在鞘中的長劍，劍柄呈龍形。這把劍具有輕微的魔法特性：持有者獲得說和理解{@language Draconic|PHB|龍語}的能力。

english: Next to Lord Brixton's body is a dungeoneer's pack, tucked inside which is a pouch containing six carnelian gemstones (50 gp each).
zh_tw: 在布里克斯頓勳爵的屍體旁邊是一個探險者的揹包，裡面塞著一個包含六顆紅榴石寶石的小袋（每個50金幣）。

english: 64. Base of the Waterfall
zh_tw: 64. 瀑布底部

english: Anything that falls from {@area area 17|377|x} ends up here.
zh_tw: 從{@area 區域17|377|x}掉落的任何東西最終都會落到這裡。

english: The walls of this grotto are slick with slime, and the air reeks of decay. Filthy water tumbles down from a hole in the ceiling, then courses along a rough-hewn tunnel toward a murky lake. The din of machinery echoes from that direction.
zh_tw: 這個巖洞的牆壁上滑溜溜地覆蓋著粘液，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛的臭味。骯髒的水從天花板上的一個洞口傾瀉而下，然後沿著一條粗糙的隧道流向一個陰暗的湖泊。那邊傳來機器的轟鳴聲。

english: Climbing the slimy walls requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. The water here is 30 feet deep. Characters who allow themselves to be carried by the current are swept gently into {@area area 65|4b1|x}.
zh_tw: 爬上滑膩的牆壁需要透過一個 {@dc 15} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。這裡的水深30尺。允許自己被水流帶走的角色會被輕柔地衝入 {@area 區域65|4b1|x}。

english: 65. Underground Lake
zh_tw: 65. 地下湖

english: A dark underground lake opens up before you, its ceiling festooned with chains and gears—some of which appear to have dwarves dangling from them. A gigantic motionless stone cog rises from the water, with two matching cogs connected to it. Rusty metal conduits stretch from the cavern walls to the cogs. The water of the lake is slimy, with pinpricks of phosphorescent light twinkling in the murk.
zh_tw: 一個昏暗的地下湖展現在你的面前，它的天花板上掛滿了鏈條和齒輪——其中一些似乎有矮人懸掛在上面。一個巨大的靜止石制齒輪從水中升起，有兩個與之相匹配的齒輪與之連線。生鏽的金屬管道從洞壁延伸到齒輪上。湖水粘稠，湖中的泥濘中閃爍著點點熒光。

english: The cavern ceiling is 20 feet above the foul surface of the lake, which is 20 feet deep. Any creature that drinks the water is {@condition poisoned} until it regurgitates the liquid, which happens automatically in {@dice 1d4} minutes. The lights at the bottom of the lake are phosphorescent {@creature Crab||crabs} that feed on the muck. Each crab sheds {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} in a 5-foot radius but stops glowing 10 minutes after being removed from the water.
zh_tw: 洞穴的天花板距離汙濁的湖面20尺高，湖水深20尺。任何飲用湖水的生物將陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態，直到吐出液體為止（這會在{@dice 1d4}分鐘後自動發生）。湖底的光源是以淤泥為食的熒光{@creature Crab||蟹}。每隻螃蟹能在5尺半徑內發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}，但離開水面10分鐘後就會停止發光。

english: The three stone cogs of areas 58 to 60 are half-submerged in the water and rise 10 feet above its surface. Their uneven upper surfaces are {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, and their smooth outer walls can't be scaled without climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 區域58至60的三個石制齒輪半浸在水中，高出水面10尺。它們不平整的上表面是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，並且它們光滑的外牆無法在沒有攀爬裝備或魔法的情況下攀爬。

english: The Mechanus chain ({@area area 69|4c9|x}) drives the machinery in this cavern, feeding power to the Soulmonger and to the many traps and other mechanisms within the dungeon. At any given time, {@dice 1d4 + 1} tomb dwarves in leather harnesses dangle from the ceiling while performing routine maintenance on the gears and giant cogs. Each tomb dwarf has the statistics of a {@creature wight}, except that it wields a battleaxe and a light crossbow. The tomb dwarves ignore intruders unless they are attacked, in which case they defend themselves with their crossbows.
zh_tw: 機械境鏈條（{@area 區域69|4c9|x}）驅動這個洞穴中的機械，為噬魂器以及地牢內眾多的陷阱和其他機械提供動力。在任何給定時間，有{@dice 1d4 + 1}名穿著皮具的墓穴矮人懸掛在天花板上，對齒輪和巨大的齒輪進行例行維護。每個墓穴矮人擁有{@creature wight||屍妖}的具體數值，除了它們攜帶戰斧和輕型十字弓。墓穴矮人除非受到攻擊，否則會忽略入侵者，在受到攻擊時，他們會用十字弓自衛。

english: Lurker in the Lake
zh_tw: 湖中的潛伏者

english: An {@creature aboleth} named G'lyh'rul (guh-LEE-rool) lives in the lake. When {@creature Acererak|ToA} enslaved it, the aboleth lost its mind and developed a split personality. Its dominant aspect awaits the coming of the death god, which it believes heralds the fall of divinity. Until that day, the aboleth humbly obeys {@creature Withers|ToA} (whom the creature refers to by his original name of Gorra) and attacks anyone seeking to prevent the atropal's ascension. The aboleth's other personality is that of a humanoid child—harmless, gleeful, and insanely curious. In this state of mind, the aboleth poses no threat to anyone and flees if attacked. Roll any die to determine which personality is dominant at any given time. On an even result, the aboleth's childlike personality is dominant.
zh_tw: 一個名為格里魯爾（guh-LEE-rool）的{@creature aboleth||底棲魔魚}居住在湖中。當{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}奴役它時，這隻厄博洛斯失去了理智，並發展出了分裂人格。它的主導人格等待死神降臨，它相信這預示神性的衰落。直到那一天，厄博洛斯謙卑地服從{@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}（它稱呼他為原來的名字戈拉），並攻擊任何試圖阻止萎縮者昇天的人。厄博洛斯的另一人格是一個類人孩童——無害、歡快且極度好奇。在這種心態下，厄博洛斯不會對任何人構成威脅，如果受到攻擊則會逃跑。投擲任何骰子以確定在某一時刻哪個人格佔主導。若結果為偶數，則厄博洛斯的孩童人格佔主導。

english: If the characters explore the lake using the rowboats in {@area area 66|4b4|x}, the aboleth ignores them regardless of its current demeanor, unless they draw undue attention to themselves. In the event of combat, the aboleth is not the master of the lake and has no lair actions as a result.
zh_tw: 如果角色使用 {@area 區域66|4b4|x} 中的划艇探索湖泊，無論阿波里法斯當前的態度如何，它都會忽略他們，除非他們引起不必要的注意。在戰鬥中，阿波里法斯並非湖泊的主人，因此沒有巢穴行動。

english: Ancient beyond reckoning, G'lyh'rul has accumulated tens of thousands of years of knowledge. If the characters establish telepathic communication with the aboleth and it is inclined to speak to them, it can provide information as if the characters had cast a {@spell commune} spell. (Since they're not actually casting the spell, this effect is not subject to the restrictions on spellcasting within the Tomb of the Nine Gods.) After sharing this information, the aboleth grows bored and withdraws to a dark corner of the lake to dream of evil things.
zh_tw: 古老到無法估量，格利赫魯爾 已經積累了數萬年的知識。如果角色們與這個底棲魔魚建立了心靈感應，並且它願意與他們交談，它可以提供資訊，就像角色們施放了{@spell commune||通神術}法術一樣。（由於他們實際上並沒有施放法術，這個效果不受九神之墓內施法限制的約束。）在分享這些資訊之後，底棲魔魚感到無聊，並退回到湖的一個黑暗角落，做起了關於邪惡事物的夢。

english: 66. Door of Devouring
zh_tw: 66. 吞噬之門

english: If the characters approach this area by way of the spiral staircase ({@area area 26|3a3|x}), read the following when they reach the bottom of the stairs:
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過螺旋樓梯({@area 區域26|3a3|x})來到這個區域，請在他們到達樓梯底部時閱讀以下內容：

english: At the bottom of the staircase, a dark corridor leads south, while a stone door with iron hinges and a brass knob stands to the east.
zh_tw: 在樓梯底部，一條昏暗的走廊向南延伸，而一扇帶有鐵鉸鏈和黃銅把手的石門則位於東方。

english: If the characters approach this area from the lake, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們從湖的方向接近這個區域，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A worked stone column stretches from the bottom of the lake to the cavern roof and is attached to the nearby wall by a stone conduit. On one side of the column, steps of moss-covered stone climb from a stone dock to a landing whose stone door shows no handles or hinges. Ropes lash a pair of rowboats to a dock post, and a rusty iron cage wallows in the slime, held afloat by chain and winch. Phosphorescent crabs gather at the bottom of the lake below the cage.
zh_tw: 一根經過雕琢的石柱從湖底一直延伸到洞穴頂部，並透過一個石制管道連線到附近的牆壁上。在柱子的一側，覆蓋著苔蘚的石階從石制碼頭上升到一個沒有把手或鉸鏈的石門所在的平臺。繩索將一對小船綁在碼頭柱上，一個生鏽的鐵籠在泥濘中搖擺，由鏈條和絞車支撐著漂浮。熒光螃蟹聚集在籠子下方的湖底。

english: The stone door separating the mooring area from the spiral staircase ({@area area 26|3a3|x}) radiates auras of abjuration, conjuration, and illusion to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. The door can be opened easily from the west side simply by pulling on the brass knob. The door is much harder to open from the east side.
zh_tw: 分隔碼頭區域和螺旋樓梯({@area 區域26|3a3|x})的石門散發出防護、召喚和幻象的魔法氣息，可以被{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果探測到。從西側可以簡單地透過拉動黃銅把手輕鬆開啟這扇門。從東側開門則要困難得多。

english: Hungry Door
zh_tw: 飢餓之門

english: The mossy staircase that climbs up out of the lake and the landing at its top are strewn with bits of crab shell. If any character touches or inspects the door, read:
zh_tw: 從湖中攀升而上的苔蘚覆蓋的樓梯，以及其頂部的著陸平臺，散落著螃蟹殼的碎片。如果任何角色觸控或檢查門，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A monstrous mouth forms on the door's surface, calling out with a deep drawl: "I'm so hungry I could eat you alive, but I'll settle for somethin' else. Somethin' livin'. Somethin' light!"
zh_tw: 門上形成了一個怪物的嘴巴，用低沉的拖長聲音喊道："我餓得能把你活活吞下去，但我可以滿足於吃點別的東西。一些活著的東西。一些輕鬆的東西！"

english: The mouth is similar to that created by a {@spell magic mouth} spell, but more powerful. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}) cast on the door suppresses its magic for 10 minutes, preventing the mouth from forming. However, the door cannot be opened without the mouth except from the west side, not even with a {@spell knock} spell.
zh_tw: 這個嘴類似於由 {@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術} 法術創造的嘴，但更加強大。在門上施放成功的 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）會抑制其魔法 10 分鐘，阻止嘴的形成。然而，如果沒有這個嘴，除了從西側外，門無法被開啟，即使使用 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術也不行。

english: The mouth isn't programmed to say anything else, but its words (and the crab shells underfoot) provide the characters with a clue regarding how to open the door. If the mouth is offered a live phosphorescent crab, it opens wide, chomps down to consume the crab, then spits out its crushed shell. Once the mouth has been fed, it disappears and the door into {@area area 26|3a3|x} swings open. The door locks and the spell resets if the door is closed again.
zh_tw: 這張嘴沒有被設定說其他的話，但它的話語（以及腳下的蟹殼）為角色們提供了如何開啟門的線索。如果給這張嘴提供一個活的熒光蟹，它會張大嘴巴，咬碎蟹子以吞噬它，然後吐出壓碎的殼。一旦這張嘴被餵食，它就會消失，通向 {@area 區域26|3a3|x} 的門就會開啟。如果門再次關閉，門就會上鎖，法術也會重置。

english: If a character tosses anything into the mouth that isn't a phosphorescent crab, the mouth spits it out. If the character is within 10 feet of the door when this happens, the door wraps its tongue around the character and swallows the character whole. No attack roll or saving throw is required. A character "devoured" in this manner is teleported to {@area area 57|47d|x}.
zh_tw: 如果角色投入任何不是熒光蟹的東西到嘴裡，這張嘴會將其吐出來。如果角色在發生這種情況時距離門10尺以內，門會用舌頭捲起角色並將角色整個吞下。不需要進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定。以這種方式被'吞噬'的角色會被傳送到 {@area 區域57|47d|x}。

english: Diving Cage
zh_tw: 潛水籠

english: A rusty iron gate on the side of the cage provides ingress for two Medium or smaller creatures. The cage radiates transmutation magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect, and bestows the effect of a {@spell water breathing} spell on any creatures within it. The stout bars grant {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} against attacks originating from outside the cage.
zh_tw: 籠子側面的一扇生鏽的鐵門為兩個中等大小或更小的生物提供了入口。籠子散發出變化魔法，可以透過{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果來探測，並對籠子內的任何生物賦予{@spell water breathing||水下呼吸}法術的效果。堅固的鐵條為籠子內的生物提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，以抵禦來自籠子外的攻擊。

english: Using the winch, a character on the steps can lower the cage 20 feet to the lakebed, allowing characters in the cage to easily harvest {@dice 2d6} phosphorescent {@creature Crab||crabs} from the muck.
zh_tw: 使用絞車，臺階上的一個角色可以將籠子降到湖底20尺處，讓籠子裡的角色能夠輕鬆地從泥漿中收穫{@dice 2d6}只發光的{@creature Crab||蟹}。

english: The creaking descent of the cage draws the attention of the aboleth in {@area area 65|4b1|x}. If the aboleth's crueler personality is dominant, it attempts to enslave any characters in the cage. If it succeeds, it sends them back to the surface with orders to entice others down into the depths. If the aboleth's childlike personality is dominant, it swims over and uses its telepathy to strike up a friendly conversation with the divers.
zh_tw: 籠子的吱嘎聲吸引了{@area 區域65|4b1|x}中的奪心魔的注意。如果奪心魔的殘暴人格佔主導，它會試圖奴役籠子中的任何角色。如果成功，它會命令他們返回地表，引誘其他人深入深淵。如果奪心魔的孩子般人格佔主導，它會遊過來並利用其心靈感應與潛水者展開友好的對話。

english: Rowboats
zh_tw: 划艇

english: The two rowboats have the names {@i Predator} and {@i Prey} etched into their transoms. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of transmutation magic around each vessel. Each boat can hold up to four Small or Medium creatures and their gear, and each contains two oars, an empty wooden bucket, and a 50-foot-long coil of hempen rope.
zh_tw: 兩艘小船的船尾上刻有{@i 捕食者}和{@i 獵物}的名字。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了每個船隻周圍的變形魔法氣息。每艘船可以容納多達四個小型或中型生物及其裝備，每艘船都包含兩把槳、一個空木桶和一卷50尺長的麻繩。

english: Predator
zh_tw: 捕食者

english: Creatures aboard the {@i Predator} have advantage on attack rolls while the boat is in the water. A filled bullseye lantern hangs off the boat's bow.
zh_tw: 在{@i 捕食者}上的生物在船在水中時攻擊檢定時具有優勢。一盞裝滿油的牛眼燈籠懸掛在船頭。

english: Prey
zh_tw: 獵物

english: Creatures aboard the {@i Prey} have advantage on saving throws while the boat is in the water.
zh_tw: 在{@i 獵物}上的生物在船在水中時豁免檢定時具有優勢。

english: 67. Hall of the Golden Mastodon
zh_tw: 67. 金象大廳

english: A character who searches for traps in the tunnel approaching this room notices a block of stone lodged in the ceiling with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The block remains there until the room's trap is activated.
zh_tw: 一名在通往該房間的隧道中搜尋陷阱的角色，若成功透過 {@dc 20} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會注意到一塊石頭卡在天花板上。這塊石頭會一直位於此處，直到該房間的陷阱被觸發。

english: A life-size golden statue of a mastodon stands atop a one-foot-high stone cog at the center of this room. Jeweled tusks sweep from its jowls, and its trunk is raised in a roar. Inscriptions coil around the statue's body, and murals on the walls show a Chultan warrior riding a living mastodon through a series of hellish landscapes. In each scene, a different breed of devil assails them.
zh_tw: 這個房間中央有一個一尺高的石制齒輪上矗立著一尊真實大小的金色乳齒象雕像。寶石裝飾的獠牙從它的臉頰延伸出來，它的鼻子高舉，彷彿在咆哮。雕像身上纏繞著銘文，牆壁上的壁畫展示了一個楚爾特戰士騎著一頭活生生的乳齒象穿越一系列地獄般的景觀。在每個場景中，都有不同種類的魔鬼攻擊他們。

english: The murals on the walls tell the story of Ch'gakare (pronounced chuh-GAH-kah-ree), a Chultan warrior who stole his king's prized steed: a mastodon named Ghom. As punishment, the king's sorcerers banished Ch'gakare and Ghom to the Nine Hells, but the two fought their way back home. On his return, Ch'gakare chopped off the king's head and turned his skull into a jeweled chalice. Any character who studies the murals and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check recognizes the legend and can recount it. The murals show Ch'gakare and Ghom fighting spined devils, bearded devils, barbed devils, horned devils, and erinyes.
zh_tw: 牆上的壁畫講述了楚爾特勇士查加卡雷（發音為 chuh-GAH-kah-ree）的故事，他偷走了國王珍貴的坐騎：一頭名叫戈姆的乳齒象。作為懲罰，國王的巫師將查加卡雷和戈姆放逐到了九層地獄，但兩者一路戰鬥並回到了家鄉。歸來後，查加卡雷砍下了國王的頭顱，並將其頭骨製成了一隻珠寶杯。任何研究壁畫並透過 {@dc 15} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定成功的角色都能認出這個傳說並講述它。壁畫中展示了查加卡雷和戈姆與棘刺魔鬼、鬍鬚魔鬼、倒刺魔鬼、角魔和復仇魔鬼的戰鬥。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of I'jin, Obo'laka, or Shagambi receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被艾金、奧博娜卡或莎根比的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Unpredictable I'jin wants to ride the golden mastodon!
zh_tw: 不可預測的艾金想要騎上金色的乳齒象！

english: Nervous Obo'laka is afraid of the golden mastodon and urges her host to not provoke its anger.
zh_tw: 緊張的奧博娜卡害怕金色的乳齒象，她敦促她附身的宿主不要激怒它。

english: If the challenges faced by Ch'gakare and Ghom are recounted to her, wise Shagambi concludes that the hall was constructed to present similar challenges.
zh_tw: 如果向她複述了查加卡雷和戈姆所面臨的挑戰，明智的莎根比得出結論，這個大廳是為了呈現類似的挑戰而建造的。

english: Golden Mastodon
zh_tw: 金色乳齒象

english: When the characters first enter the room, the 10-foot-high mastodon statue is facing the entrance. The statue's lifelike qualities owe to the fact that this is Ghom, whose body was preserved in magical iron and covered with a thin layer of hammered gold, and whose tusks have been set with gems (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次進入房間時，這尊10尺高的乳齒象雕像正對著入口。雕像栩栩如生的品質歸功於這是戈姆，它的身體被儲存在魔法鐵中，並覆蓋著一層薄薄的錘打金子，它的獠牙上鑲嵌著寶石（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: The inscriptions on the statue are written in Old Omuan. They read as follows:
zh_tw: 雕像上的銘文是用古老的奧曼語寫的。內容如下：

english: Let your bones watch over my treasure, brave Ghom. As you carried me from the inferno, so shall I rise from death to defend my riches.
zh_tw: 願你的骨骼守護我的寶藏，勇敢的戈姆。正如你從地獄中帶我出來，我亦將從死亡中崛起，保衛我的財富。

english: Scratches on the floor beneath the stone cog indicate that it can rotate, yet no amount of pressure budges it. Any search of the top of the statue reveals a star-shaped indentation on the back of its head. Those who have seen the gold lever in {@area area 61|494|x} recognize the lever's star-shaped handle as a perfect match. If the lever is claimed and set head-first into the indentation, read:
zh_tw: 石制齒輪下方地板上的劃痕表明它可以旋轉，但無論施加多大的壓力都無法移動它。對雕像頂部的任何搜尋都會發現其頭部後部有一個星形的凹槽。那些在{@area 區域51|494|x}見過金質槓桿的人會認出槓桿的星形把手與這個凹槽完美匹配。如果槓桿被取回並頭朝下插入凹槽，閱讀以下內容：

english: A thunderous trumpeting sound erupts from the mastodon's trunk, causing a block of stone to seal off the room. The cog under the mastodon's feet then begins to revolve, letting the statue face each of the murals in turn.
zh_tw: 乳齒象的鼻子裡爆發出雷鳴般的吼叫聲，導致一塊石頭封住了房間。乳齒象腳下的齒輪隨後開始旋轉，讓雕像依次面對每一幅壁畫。

english: The block of stone fills the space in the hallway indicated on map 5.5. Any creature under the block when it falls must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the creature moves out of the block's way in whichever direction it prefers. On a failed save, the creature takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) bludgeoning damage. If this damage reduces the creature's hit points to 0, the creature is crushed to a pulp; otherwise, it is shoved into the room.
zh_tw: 這塊石塊填滿了地圖5.5上標示的走廊空間。當石塊落下時，任何位於石塊下方的生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免。若成功，生物可以按自己選擇的方向移出石塊的路徑。若豁免失敗，生物將受到55（{@dice 10d10}）點鈍擊傷害。如果這次傷害使生物的生命值降至0，生物將被壓成肉泥；否則，它將被推入房間。

english: When the mastodon statue begins to revolve, all creatures present should roll initiative. The statue turns counterclockwise and completes one 360-degree revolution on initiative count 0 of each round.
zh_tw: 當乳齒象雕像開始旋轉時，所有在場的生物應該進行先攻檢定。雕像逆時針旋轉，並在每輪的先攻計數0時完成一次360度的完整旋轉。

english: When the statue completes its first revolution, magical fire engulfs the floor and the cog, flaring up 6 feet high. Any creature that enters the fire for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 10 ({@dice 3d6}) fire damage. Any character perched on the golden mastodon is shielded from the flames. Up to six Medium creatures can perch on the mastodon at once—four on its back and one on each of its curved tusks.
zh_tw: 當雕像完成其第一次旋轉時，魔法火焰吞沒了地板和齒輪，火焰高達6尺。任何在回合中首次進入火焰的生物，或者在其上開始回合的生物，都會受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）火焰傷害。任何棲息在金色乳齒象上的角色都免受火焰傷害。一次最多可以有六隻中等體型的生物棲息在乳齒象上——四隻在其背上，每隻彎曲的長牙上各一隻。

english: Each time the statue turns to face north, one or more devils emerge from the murals and attack all other creatures in the room. Roll initiative for each group of new arrivals. Each magically summoned devil vanishes in a puff of smoke when it drops to 0 hit points or when there are no creatures left to attack. The devils appear in the following order, emerging from the walls wherever you see fit:
zh_tw: 每次雕像轉向北方時，一個或多個魔鬼從壁畫中出現並攻擊房間內的所有其他生物。為每組新到的魔鬼進行先攻檢定。每個透過魔法召喚的魔鬼在降至0生命值或沒有生物可攻擊時會在一陣煙霧中消失。魔鬼按照以下順序出現，從牆壁中出現，出現位置由你決定：

english: {@b Round 2}: Four {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils}
zh_tw: {@b 第2輪}: 四隻{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}

english: {@b Round 3}: Three {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}
zh_tw: {@b 第3輪}: 三隻{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}

english: {@b Round 4}: Two {@creature Barbed Devil||barbed devils}
zh_tw: {@b 第4輪}: 兩隻{@creature Barbed Devil||蝟魔}

english: {@b Round 5}: One {@creature horned devil}
zh_tw: {@b 第五回合}: 一隻{@creature horned devil||角魔}

english: {@b Round 6}: One {@creature erinyes}
zh_tw: {@b 第六輪}: 一隻{@creature erinyes||罪魔}

english: If the characters try to strike a bargain with the devils, only the erinyes is willing to engage them—but it demands the willing sacrifice of one character's soul. A character who offers his or her soul to the erinyes is destroyed by fire. The character's soul becomes trapped in the Soulmonger, the character's belongings are left behind, and all remaining devils in the room disappear in clouds of smoke.
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖與魔鬼們進行交易，只有罪魔願意與他們交涉——但它要求一個角色自願犧牲自己的靈魂。一個向罪魔提供自己靈魂的角色將被火焰毀滅。該角色的靈魂被困在噬魂器中，角色的財物被留下，房間裡所有剩餘的魔鬼在煙霧中消失。

english: Ch'gakare
zh_tw: 查加卡雷

english: When the last devil is defeated or when the party strikes a deal with the erinyes, the mastodon statue returns to its original north-facing position and stops revolving. When this happens, read:
zh_tw: 當最後一個魔鬼被擊敗，或者隊伍與罪魔達成協議時，乳齒象雕像會回到它最初的面向北方的位置並停止旋轉。當這種情況發生時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The fires go out, though smoke still hangs in the air. A warm wind blows through the hall, carrying the scent of jasmine, frankincense, and grave dust. The smoke coalesces into a decayed warrior wrapped in bandages. He holds up a gruesome chalice made from a human skull.
zh_tw: 火焰熄滅了，儘管煙霧仍然瀰漫在空氣中。一陣溫暖的風吹過大廳，帶來了茉莉、乳香和墳墓塵埃的氣息。煙霧凝聚成一個被繃帶包裹的腐爛戰士。他舉起一個由人頭骨製成的可怕的聖盃。

english: The undead warrior is Ch'gakare, barely recognizable as the man riding the mastodon in the wall murals. He has the statistics of a {@creature revenant}, but he can't be destroyed. If reduced to 0 hit points, Ch'gakare turns to smoke, vanishes, and reforms in his tomb somewhere in the distant jungle.
zh_tw: 這個不死戰士是查加卡雷，幾乎無法認出他就是壁畫中騎乳齒象的那個人。他擁有{@creature revenant||還魂鬼}的具體數值，但他不能被摧毀。如果生命值降至0，查加卡雷會變成煙霧，消失，並在遙遠叢林中的某個墳墓裡重新形成。

english: Ch'gakare does not speak but holds up the chalice in a manner that suggests he's offering it as a gift. If the chalice is taken from his hand, Ch'gakare turns to smoke and is gone. The stone block that seals off the room retracts into the ceiling when Ch'gakare disappears.
zh_tw: 查加卡雷不說話，而是舉起聖盃，以一種暗示他將其作為禮物的方式。如果聖盃從他手中被拿走，查加卡雷就會變成煙霧消失了。當查加卡雷消失時，封住房間的石塊會縮回天花板中。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: If stripped off, the mastodon's gold leaf is worth 2,500 gp, though it takes a character 30 hours to claim it all. Multiple characters working together can shorten the time proportionately. Fifty gemstones (100 gp each) can also be pried loose from the mastodon's tusks.
zh_tw: 如果剝離下來，乳齒象的金箔價值2500金幣，儘管需要一個角色花費30小時才能全部收集。多個角色合作可以相應縮短時間。還可以從乳齒象的獠牙上撬下五十顆寶石（每顆100金幣）。

english: Ch'gakare's gift is the fabled Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare. This item is worth 2,500 gp but can fetch up to four times that value if sold at auction in any major city. Alternatively, returning the chalice to Princess Mwaxanaré yields its promised reward (see "{@area Kir Sabal|13f|x}"). For more information on the chalice, see "{@area Fabled Treasures|31a|x}."
zh_tw: 查加卡雷的禮物是傳說中的查加卡雷的骷髏聖盃。這個物品價值2500金幣，但如果在任何主要城市的拍賣中出售，其價值可以達到這個數字的四倍。另外，將聖盃歸還給公主姆瓦克絲娜瑞將獲得其承諾的獎勵（見"{@area 基爾·薩巴爾|13f|x}"）。有關聖盃的更多資訊，請參見"{@area 傳說中的寶藏|31a|x}"。

english: 68. Hall of Decay
zh_tw: 68. 腐朽之廳

english: Graven images of rotting corpses decorate this hall, and the floor is littered with tarnished coins, pieces of armor, broken shields, axe heads, and other bits of scrap metal.
zh_tw: 這個大廳裝飾著腐爛屍體的雕刻影象，地板上散落著褪色的硬幣、盔甲碎片、破碎的盾牌、斧頭以及其他一些廢舊金屬碎片。

english: All nonmagical objects made of cloth, leather, wood, or metal that enter this corridor instantly decay or corrode to the point of being useless and worthless. Clothing and armor falls apart, shields and weapons become brittle and ineffective, and so forth. A {@spell mending} spell cannot repair an object damaged in this fashion.
zh_tw: 所有進入這條走廊的非魔法物品，如果是由布、皮革、木頭或金屬製成的，會立即腐爛或腐蝕到無用和無價值的程度。衣物和盔甲會破碎，盾牌和武器變得脆弱且無效，等等。一個{@spell mending||修復術}法術無法修復以這種方式損壞的物品。

english: An archway stands at the west end of the hall, through which characters can see into {@area area 69|4c9|x}.
zh_tw: 大廳的西端有一個拱門，角色們可以透過它看到 {@area 區域69|4c9|x}。

english: This yawning archway has a keystone adorned with an iron bull's skull, which bites down on an ivory ring.
zh_tw: 這個巨大的拱門有一個拱心石，上面裝飾著一個鐵製的公牛骷髏頭，它咬著一個象牙戒指。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of necromancy magic emanating from the ivory ring. If the ring is yanked from the skull's jaws, it disintegrates and the destructive effect in the hallway ends.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了從象牙戒指散發出的死靈魔法氣息。如果戒指被從骷髏的下巴上拽下來，它會解體，走廊中的破壞效果也會結束。

english: The staircase on the south side of the hallway descends 25 feet to {@area area 71|4d8|x} on level 6.
zh_tw: 走廊南側的樓梯下降25尺到達6層的{@area 區域71|4d8|x}區域。

english: 69. Mechanus Chain
zh_tw: 69. 機械境鏈

english: Hot wind tinged with the smell of burning oil blows down a forty-foot-diameter vertical shaft. Stone balconies protrude from the walls on opposite sides of this expanse, with the west balcony fifteen feet higher than the east one. Two thick chains rattle in the gulf between the balconies—one ascending two hundred feet before disappearing into a cloudy vortex lit by arcs of purple lightning; the other wrapping around an enormous metal gear floating one hundred feet below. Another hundred feet below the gear, a second vortex rages.
zh_tw: 帶有燃燒油氣味的熱風吹過一個四十尺直徑的垂直井道。石制陽臺從這個空間對面的牆壁上突出，西側的陽臺比東側的高出十五尺。兩條粗鏈在陽臺之間的鴻溝中發出嘩啦聲——一條上升兩百尺後消失在被紫色閃電弧照亮的雲霧漩渦中；另一條則纏繞在一個漂浮在下方一百尺的巨大金屬齒輪上。在齒輪下方再一百尺處，第二個漩渦肆虐。

english: To drive his infernal machinery, {@creature Acererak|ToA} contaminated a workforce of modrons from the plane of Mechanus. Under the stewardship of a corrupt pentadrone, the modrons rerouted one of their great chains into the tomb. The sections of the shaft above and below the balconies exist outside of normal space, preventing the shaft from intersecting with the tomb's other levels.
zh_tw: 為了驅動他的地獄機械，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}汙染了來自機械境的一群魔冢。在一個腐敗的五元冢的監督下，魔冢將他們的一條巨大鏈條重新路由進了墳墓。陽臺上方和下方的井道部分存在於正常空間之外，防止井道與墳墓的其他層次相交。

english: Modron Intervention
zh_tw: 魔冢幹預

english: The first time any character moves out onto a balcony, read:
zh_tw: 當任何角色第一次移動到陽臺上時，閱讀：

english: A rip forms in the vortex high above, and nine cube-shaped creatures with wings and shortbows fly through. They are quickly followed by a large crystal decahedron that holds a weird starfish-shaped creature.
zh_tw: 在高高的漩渦中出現一個裂縫，九個有翅膀和短弓的立方體形狀生物飛了出來。它們很快被一個巨大的水晶十二面體跟隨，水晶中有一個奇怪的海星形狀生物。

english: A {@creature pentadrone} leads a squad of nine {@creature Quadrone||quadrones} through the upper planar vortex, which allows safe passage into the shaft but not out of it. Knowing that they cannot return to Mechanus, the modrons fight until destroyed. Once these modrons are dealt with, the shaft becomes undefended. No other modrons are sent through the vortex.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature pentadrone||五元冢}帶領著一支由九個{@creature Quadrone||四元冢}組成的小隊穿過上層位面漩渦，這個漩渦允許安全地進入井道，但不允許離開。知道他們無法返回機械境，魔冢會戰鬥到被摧毀。一旦這些魔冢被處理掉，井道就變得沒有防禦。沒有其他魔冢透過漩渦被派送過來。

english: The pentadrone can't fly on its own, but it gains a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover while encased in the crystal decahedron, which grants its occupant {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks that originate outside the vehicle. The pentadrone can't make melee attacks through the decahedron, but it can use a bonus action to open a small hole in any of the decahedron's facets in order to spray creatures with its paralysis gas.
zh_tw: 五面體自身無法飛行，但當它被包裹在水晶十面體中時，它可以獲得30尺的飛行速度並能夠懸浮。這為其乘員提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，免受來自載具外部的攻擊。五面體無法透過十面體進行近戰攻擊，但它可以使用一個附贈動作在十面體的任何一個面上開啟一個小孔，以向生物噴射其麻痺氣體。

english: The decahedron has AC 16, 50 hit points, immunity to poison damage, resistance to piercing and slashing damage, and vulnerability to bludgeoning and thunder damage. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, the crystal decahedron shatters and the pentadrone falls.
zh_tw: 十二面體的護甲等級為16，有50生命值，對毒素傷害免疫，對穿刺和揮砍傷害有抗性，對鈍擊和雷鳴傷害有弱點。如果它的生命值降至0，水晶十二面體會破碎，五元冢將墜落。

english: The crystal decahedron has enough room to accommodate one Small or Medium creature in addition to the pentadrone if a character thinks to enter the vehicle using {@spell misty step}, {@spell dimension door}, or similar magic. Inside the vehicle, the pentadrone can attack as normal. When the pentadrone dies, the decahedron shatters.
zh_tw: 水晶十二面體有足夠的空間，除了五元冢外，還可以容納一隻小型或中型生物，如果一個角色想到使用{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}、{@spell dimension door||任意門}或類似的魔法進入載具。在載具內部，五元冢可以正常攻擊。當五元冢死亡時，十二面體會破碎。

english: Planar Lore
zh_tw: 位面知識

english: Characters with proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to determine what, if anything, they recall about planar vortices and Mechanus chains. With a successful check, a character learns the appropriate lore and all lore with a lower DC:
zh_tw: 精通{@skill Arcana||奧秘}技能的角色可以進行智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定，以確定他們是否記得關於位面漩渦和機械境鏈條的相關資訊。如果檢定成功，角色將學習到相應的知識，以及所有難度等級較低的知識：

english: {@b {@dc 10}}: Planar vortices are incredibly destructive. No one can expect to enter a vortex and survive.
zh_tw: {@b {@dc 10}}: 位面漩渦具有極大的破壞性。沒有人能夠指望進入漩渦後還能生還。

english: {@b {@dc 15}}: The chain is called a Mechanus chain. Such chains are crafted by modrons and used in conjunction with other machinery to keep the plane of Mechanus in working order.
zh_tw: {@b {@dc 15}}: 這條鎖鏈被稱為機械境鎖鏈。這種鎖鏈由模組製造，並與其他機械裝置配合使用，以保持機械境的運轉秩序。

english: {@b {@dc 20}}: This Mechanus chain has been repurposed for the tomb. One chain would be enough to keep the tomb's traps and other mechanisms in working order.
zh_tw: {@b {@dc 20}}：這條機械境的鏈條已被重新用於這座墓穴。一條鏈條就足以保持墓穴陷阱和其他機構的正常運作。

english: {@b {@dc 25}}: Destroying a Mechanus chain requires the casting of three {@spell wish} spells.
zh_tw: {@b {@dc 25}}: 摧毀一條機械境之鏈需要施放三個{@spell wish||祈願術}法術。

english: The Shaft
zh_tw: 井道

english: The shaft is 400 feet high in total and features deadly planar vortices at top and bottom. Any creature in the shaft that enters a planar vortex is torn apart, its body and possessions scattered across the multiverse.
zh_tw: 井道總高度為400尺，在頂部和底部都有致命的位面漩渦。井道中的任何生物如果進入位面漩渦將被撕裂，其身體和財物散落在多元宇宙中。

english: The Mechanus chain forms a loop in constant motion. One part of the chain descends at a rate of 50 feet per round, wrapping around the giant gear that floats 100 feet below the east balcony, while the other part of the chain climbs to enter the upper vortex at the same rate.
zh_tw: 機械境鏈條形成一個不斷運動的迴圈。鏈條的一部分以每輪50尺的速度下降，纏繞在漂浮在東側陽臺下方100尺的巨大齒輪上，而鏈條的另一部分以相同的速度上升，進入上方的漩渦。

english: The two balconies are separated by a 15-foot-wide gulf, through which jangling chain links rise and fall. Magic that allows characters to fly or to walk on walls makes it easy to cross from one balcony to the other. Any character who moves at least 10 feet beforehand can jump from the west balcony to the east balcony. Because the west balcony is 15 feet higher than its eastern counterpart, a character must either pole vault across the gap (using a 10-foot pole or similar item) or use magic. A character can also cross the expanse by leaping from one balcony to the nearest chain, from that chain to the other, and finally to the opposite balcony. Each of these jumps requires a successful {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. Any character who fails a check made to jump to a balcony or chain falls down the shaft and into the lower planar vortex unless somehow halted. A falling character can land on the floating gear 100 feet below with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw but takes falling damage as normal.
zh_tw: 兩個陽臺被一條15尺寬的鴻溝隔開，穿過其中，叮噹作響的鏈條上下起伏。允許角色飛行或行走在牆上的魔法使得從一個陽臺到另一個陽臺變得容易。任何事先移動至少10尺的角色可以從西陽臺跳到東陽臺。由於西陽臺比東陽臺高出15尺，角色必須使用撐杆跳越過缺口（使用10尺長的杆子或類似物品）或使用魔法。角色也可以透過從一個陽臺跳到最近的鏈條，從鏈條到另一個鏈條，最後跳到對面的陽臺來穿過這片區域。每次跳躍都需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。任何在跳向陽臺或鏈條時失敗的檢定者將掉入井中並進入下位面漩渦，除非有某種方式阻止。下落的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免落在100尺下方的浮空齒輪上，但仍會正常受到墜落傷害。

english: 70. Armillary Sphere
zh_tw: 70. 渾天儀

english: This chamber contains a bronze apparatus centered on a hinged arm. Slowly rotating within the arm is a 10-foot-diameter globe decorated by a topographic map of landforms and oceans. Concentric rings of brass constrain the device, all rotating and bearing their own lesser spheres. One of those spheres has sharp points and appears sunlike. Carvings of tall, headless humanoids decorate the walls of the room.
zh_tw: 這個房間包含一個位於鉸接臂中心的青銅裝置。一個直徑10尺的球體在臂內緩慢旋轉，上面裝飾著地形圖，包括地貌和海洋。黃銅的同心環限制著這個裝置，都在旋轉並承載著它們自己的較小球體。其中一個球體有尖銳的點，看起來像太陽。房間的牆壁上雕刻著高大無頭人形生物。

english: The armillary sphere depicts Toril, its moon, the sun, and other planetary bodies in Realmspace. Any character who has viewed large-scale maps of Faerûn will recognize certain geographical features on the globe.
zh_tw: 渾天儀描繪了託瑞爾、它的月亮、太陽以及國度晶壁系中的其他天體。任何觀看過費倫大尺度地圖的角色都會在球體上認出某些地理特徵。

english: Activating the Sphere
zh_tw: 啟用球體

english: The first time any creature moves within 5 feet of the central globe, read:
zh_tw: 當任何生物第一次移動到中心球體5尺範圍內時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The apparatus suddenly swings around, its rings rotating out of the way as the surface of the globe peels back to reveal a dark, hollow interior. Inside this cavity is a padded bronze chair with levers built into its armrests.
zh_tw: 裝置突然轉動，它的環圈旋轉開來，球體表面剝落，露出一個黑暗的空心內部。在這個空腔裡是一個帶有墊子的青銅椅子，椅子的扶手上裝有操縱桿。

english: When a creature sits on the armillary chair, the globe closes again. Any attempt to prevent that closing overloads the mechanism; until the blockage is removed, any creature within 5 feet of the armillary sphere that isn't seated on the chair takes 18 ({@dice 4d8}) lightning damage.
zh_tw: 當一個生物坐在渾天儀椅子上時，球體再次關閉。任何阻止關閉的嘗試都會使機制過載；在堵塞被移除之前，任何在渾天儀球體5尺範圍內且沒有坐在椅子上的生物都會受到18點（{@dice 4d8}）閃電傷害。

english: When the creature seated on the chair stands up, the globe's hatch opens, closing again only when another creature sits on the chair or when there are no creatures within 5 feet of the armillary sphere.
zh_tw: 當坐在椅子上的生物站起來時，球體的艙口會開啟，只有在另一個生物坐在椅子上或沒有生物在渾天儀5尺範圍內時，艙口才會再次關閉。

english: While the globe is sealed, the character sitting in the chair can see through the globe as if it were made of transparent glass. Pulling the levers at the end of each armrest causes the armillary sphere's rings to spin the representations of the sun, the moon, and other planetary bodies in one direction or the other.
zh_tw: 當球體封閉時，坐在椅子上的角色可以透過球體看到外面，就像它是由透明玻璃製成的一樣。拉動每個扶手末端的操縱桿會導致渾天儀的環圈使太陽、月亮和其他天體的代表物朝一個方向或另一個方向旋轉。

english: Monster in the Moon
zh_tw: 月亮中的怪物

english: A {@creature nycaloth} is crammed inside the bronze orb representing Toril's moon, Selûne. The first time a creature inside the armillary sphere reorients its rings and outer orbs, the nycaloth bursts out of the moon, shattering it. The nycaloth then tries to kill all other creatures in the room, pursuing fleeing enemies. It ignores creatures inside the globe but attacks any creature that exits it.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature nycaloth||征伐羅斯魔}被塞在代表託瑞爾月亮的青銅球體中，即塞露妮。當渾天儀內部的生物第一次重新調整其環和外球體時，尼卡洛斯會從月亮中衝出，將其粉碎。隨後，尼卡洛斯會試圖殺死房間內的所有其他生物，並追逐逃跑的敵人。它忽略球體內的生物，但會攻擊任何離開球體的生物。

english: When this nycaloth rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll made with its greataxe, it cuts off the target's head (or one of the target's heads, if it has more than one). If the target can't survive without the lost head, it dies. A target that is immune to slashing damage is immune to this effect. The target is also spared decapitation if it doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or if its head is too big to be cut off with the greataxe, though it still takes the damage from the weapon's critical hit.
zh_tw: 當這隻尼卡羅斯用它的巨斧進行攻擊骰，並擲出自然 20 時，它將砍下目標的頭（如果目標有多個頭，則砍下其中一個）。如果目標失去頭後無法存活，它就會死亡。對揮砍傷害免疫的目標對此效果免疫。如果目標沒有頭或不需要頭、擁有傳奇動作，或其頭太大而無法用巨斧砍下，目標也會免於被斬首，但依然會受到武器暴擊的傷害。

english: Critical Conjunction
zh_tw: 關鍵合相

english: If the rings are spun so that all the celestial bodies are lined up, roll on the Armillary Sphere Conjunction table to determine what happens. Once a conjunction effect occurs, the armillary sphere breaks down, causing the levers to lock in place and the hatch to lock shut.
zh_tw: 如果這些環被旋轉，使得所有的天體都排成一線，就在渾天儀合相表上擲骰以確定會發生什麼。一旦合相效果發生，渾天儀就會發生故障，導致操縱桿鎖定在原位，艙口也被鎖定關閉。

english: The locked hatch is a Large object with AC 11, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. As long as the outer rings and orbs aren't in motion, the hatch can be forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or opened with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}.
zh_tw: 上鎖的艙口是一個大型物體，具有AC 11、25點生命值，並且免疫毒素和心靈傷害。只要外環和球體沒有移動，艙口可以透過成功的{@dc 20}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟，或者由角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來開啟。

english: Armillary Sphere Conjunction
zh_tw: 渾天儀合相

english: Conjunction Effect
zh_tw: 合相效果

english: The armillary sphere and any creatures inside it disappear. The DM ultimately decides where they end up, if anywhere. Possibilities include Mechanus, the Vast Swamp on Oerth, Mount Nevermind on Krynn, a desert on Athas, Victorian London on Earth, or the sun.
zh_tw: 渾天儀和其中的所有生物都消失了。最終由DM決定它們是否會出現在哪裡，如果出現的話。可能性包括機械境（機械境）、奧爾瑟（奧斯）上的廣闊沼澤、克林（克萊恩）上的永不忘記山（無意山）、阿塔斯（阿塔斯）上的沙漠、地球上的維多利亞時代倫敦，或者是太陽。

english: The creature sitting in the armillary chair is touched by an unknown entity and suffers a radical personality change. Work with the player to determine an appropriate change.
zh_tw: 坐在渾天儀椅子上的生物被一個未知實體觸碰，並遭受了根本的性格改變。與玩家合作確定一個適當的改變。

english: A {@spell cloudkill} spell is cast within the globe.
zh_tw: 在球體內施放了{@spell cloudkill||死雲術}法術。

english: The sun-shaped orb splits open, spilling 5,000 gp onto the floor.
zh_tw: 太陽形狀的球體裂開，5000金幣灑落在地板上。

english: The creature sitting in the armillary chair gains a {@reward charm of heroism} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}).
zh_tw: 坐在渾天椅上的生物獲得一個{@reward charm of heroism||英勇護咒}（參見{@book 超自然贈禮|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}在{@i 城主指南}的第七章）。

english: Every creature within 20 feet of the armillary sphere regains 50 hit points. Creatures inside the globe do not gain this benefit.
zh_tw: 距離渾天儀20尺範圍內的所有生物恢復50生命值。球體內的生物不獲得此益處。

english: A {@item gem of brightness} appears on the lap of the creature seated in the armillary chair.
zh_tw: 一個{@item gem of brightness||光彩奪目寶石}出現在坐在渾天儀椅子上的生物的膝蓋上。

english: The Intelligence score of the creature seated in the armillary chair permanently increases by {@dice 1d4 + 1}, up to a maximum of 22.
zh_tw: 坐在渾天儀椅子上的生物的智力屬性得分永久增加{@dice 1d4 + 1}，最高不超過22。

english: The creature seated in the armillary chair is granted the ability to cast the {@spell wish} spell once.
zh_tw: 坐在渾天儀椅子上的生物被賦予了一次施放{@spell wish||祈願術}法術的能力。

english: Secret Crawlway
zh_tw: 秘密爬行通道

english: A secret door in the south wall conceals a crawlway that leads south and passes underneath the control room. See {@area area 61|494|x} for details.
zh_tw: 南牆上的一個暗門隱藏著一條通往南方並從控制室下方穿過的爬行通道。詳情請見 {@area 區域51|494|x}。

english: Level 6: Cradle of the Death God
zh_tw: 第六層：死亡之神的搖籃

english: Map 5.6 shows this level of the dungeon. Here, the dreaded Soulmonger nurses the atropal to godhood. A coven of hags called the Sewn Sisters guards the nursery, which remains sealed until five {@creature Skeleton Key|ToA|skeleton keys} are used to unlock it. If the characters failed to obtain all five skeleton keys from the upper levels, they won't get far on this level. If you want to keep the adventure moving forward rather than have the characters backtrack, place the remaining skeleton keys in {@area area 71|4d8|x} or somewhere else nearby.
zh_tw: 地圖5.6展示了地牢的這一層次。在這裡，令人畏懼的噬魂器培養著萎縮者成為神明。一個被稱為縫合姐妹的女巫團守衛著託兒所，它一直保持密封狀態，直到使用五個 {@creature Skeleton Key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏} 解鎖。如果角色們未能從上層獲得全部五個骷髏鑰匙，他們在這一層次上將無法取得進展。如果你想讓冒險繼續向前推進，而不是讓角色們返回，將剩餘的骷髏鑰匙放置在 {@area 區域71|4d8|x} 或附近其他地方。

english: Map 5.6: Cradle of the Death God
zh_tw: 地圖5.6：死神的搖籃

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: 71. Lair of the Sewn Sisters
zh_tw: 71. 縫補姐妹的巢穴

english: Green smoke billows out from a bronze cauldron in the middle of this twenty-foot-high vaulted hall. Barely visible through the haze are three rocking chairs, several work benches heaped with haberdashery, a spinning wheel, and a rusty iron cage containing a prisoner. Galleries stand ten feet above the floor to either side of the room.
zh_tw: 綠煙從一個位於這個二十尺高的拱形大廳中央的銅製大釜中滾滾而出。透過煙霧隱約可見的是三把搖椅、幾個堆滿服飾用品的工作臺、一個紡車，以及一個裝著囚犯的生鏽鐵籠。走廊在房間兩側離地面十尺高的地方。

english: The green smoke makes this chamber {@quickref Vision and Light||2||lightly obscured} and blocks the characters' view of a great green door to the south (see "Skeleton Gate" below). The iron cage and its prisoner are described in the "Cage" section.
zh_tw: 綠色煙霧使這個房間{@quickref Vision and Light||2||輕度遮蔽}，並阻擋了角色們對南方一扇巨大綠門的視線（見下方的"骷髏門"）。鐵籠及其囚犯的描述見"籠子"部分。

english: When the characters are in a position to get a better view of the upper galleries, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們處於一個可以更好地看到上層走廊的位置時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: Five wooden doors are set into the walls of the galleries, each carved with a geometric symbol: a triangle, a square, a pentagon, a hexagon, and an octagon.
zh_tw: 走廊的牆壁上設有五扇木門，每扇門上都雕刻著一個幾何符號：一個三角形、一個正方形、一個五邊形、一個六邊形和一個八邊形。

english: This chamber belongs to the Sewn Sisters, a coven of three {@creature Night Hag||night hags} loyal to {@creature Acererak|ToA}. Together, the hags mother the atropal and guard the Soulmonger. They eagerly await the atropal's apotheosis, when the downfall of civilization promises an abundance of souls to harvest. The Sewn Sisters spy on intruders from the Border Ethereal. Any character who can perceive creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane sees the hags as spectral figures huddled in the middle of the room. See "The Sewn Sisters" sidebar for more information.
zh_tw: 這個房間屬於縫合姐妹，一個由三個忠於 {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 的 {@creature Night Hag||夜鬼婆} 組成的女巫團。這些女巫一起撫養著萎縮者並守衛著噬魂器。她們熱切地等待著萎縮者的神化，屆時文明的崩潰預示著大量靈魂的豐收。縫合姐妹從邊界以太位面監視入侵者。任何能夠感知以太位面上的生物和物體的角色會看到這些女巫像幽靈般的人物聚集在房間中央。更多資訊請見"縫合姐妹"側邊欄。

english: Hag Dolls
zh_tw: 女巫玩偶

english: Each hag has created a cruel plaything: a doll brought to life through the implantation of a child's soul. When the adventurers arrive, these dolls scurry into view:
zh_tw: 每位女巫都創造了一個殘忍的玩物：一個透過植入兒童靈魂而賦予生命的娃娃。當冒險者到達時，這些娃娃突然進入視野：

english: Three tiny figures waddle toward you through the smoky haze: a straw doll with rusty pins sticking into its body, a faceless child molded from clay, and a stuffed monkey with the lower body of a unicycle. The straw doll says, "You need to run away! The Sewn Sisters will be back any moment now!"
zh_tw: 三個微小的身影穿過煙霧向你蹣跚走來：一個身上插著生鏽大頭針的稻草娃娃，一個由泥土塑造的無面兒童，以及一個下半身是獨輪車的填充猴子。稻草娃娃說：'你得逃跑！縫合姐妹隨時會回來！'

english: Each doll is a Tiny construct with AC 10, 1 hit point, a walking speed of 10 feet, immunity to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition, and no attacks. Destroying a doll causes the child's soul within it to become trapped in the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 每個娃娃都是一個小型構裝體，具有10點護甲等級，1點生命值，行走速度為10尺，對毒素傷害和{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態免疫，並且沒有攻擊能力。摧毀一個娃娃會導致娃娃內的孩子的靈魂被困在噬魂器中。

english: The straw doll, Strawbundle, usually speaks for the group. Clay No-Face can speak only if it molds a mouth onto its blank face, and Joho the monkey coughs on its stuffing when it tries to talk. Given a chance, the dolls share the following information:
zh_tw: 稻草娃娃，稻草包，通常代表團隊發言。泥土無面只有在其空白的臉上塑造出嘴巴時才能說話，而猴子霍霍在嘗試說話時會咳嗽出填充物。如果有機會，這些娃娃會分享以下資訊：

english: The Sewn Sisters are three night hags. The dolls refuse to mention the hags by name, lest the hags hear their names being uttered.
zh_tw: 縫合姐妹是三個夜巫婆。這些娃娃拒絕提及巫婆的名字，以免巫婆聽到它們的名字被說出。

english: The dolls were made from the souls of children and want to be free of the captors.
zh_tw: 這些娃娃是由孩子們的靈魂製成的，它們想要擺脫捕獲者的束縛。

english: The hags are nursing some kind of creature that lurks on the other side of the skeleton gate (the great green door), but the dolls don't know what the creature is.
zh_tw: 巫婆們正在照顧某種潛伏在骷髏門（綠色大門）另一側的生物，但這些娃娃不知道那生物是什麼。

english: To learn more about the adventurers, the hags have been torturing the "lookie-like" in the cage.
zh_tw: 為了瞭解更多關於冒險者的資訊，巫婆們一直在折磨籠子裡的"窺視者"。

english: If the characters take an interest in the skeleton gate, the dolls reveal what they know about it:
zh_tw: 如果角色們對骷髏門產生了興趣，這些娃娃會透露他們所知道的關於它的資訊：

english: Five skeleton keys are needed to unlock the skeleton gate. Each key looks like an animated skeleton with a skull that extends into a carved key-like shape.
zh_tw: 需要五把骷髏鑰匙來開啟骷髏門。每一把鑰匙看起來像是一個有骷髏頭的動畫骷髏，其頭骨延伸成雕刻成的鑰匙形狀。

english: The skeleton keys wander the upper levels of the tomb.
zh_tw: 骷髏鑰匙在墳墓的上層遊蕩。

english: Before the skeleton keys can be used, the skeleton gate's five keyholes must first be opened. The five adjoining rooms (areas 72 to 76) contain trials that can be overcome to open the five keyholes.
zh_tw: 在使用骷髏鑰匙之前，必須先開啟骷髏門上的五個鑰匙孔。相鄰的五個房間（區域72至76）包含可以克服的試煉，用以開啟五個鑰匙孔。

english: The dolls don't know the nature of the trials in areas 72 through 76, and they can't leave this chamber unless they are picked up and carried out.
zh_tw: 這些娃娃不知道72號到76號區域的試煉的性質，除非被撿起來並帶出去，否則它們無法離開這個房間。

english: If any character makes an effort to befriend one of the dolls, the soul of the child trapped inside the doll bestows a magical charm on that character. Each doll can bestow its charm once. These charms are similar to the ones described in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Other Rewards} of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide} and follow the same rules.
zh_tw: 如果有任何角色努力與其中一個玩偶交朋友，困在玩偶內的孩子的靈魂會賜予該角色一個魔法護符。每個玩偶只能賜予一次護符。這些護符類似於{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Other Rewards}中描述的護符（選自{@i 城主指南}），並遵循相同的規則。

english: Strawbundle's Charm
zh_tw: 草包的護咒

english: While you have Strawbundle in your possession, this charm allows you to cast the {@spell etherealness} spell as an action, no components required. After it is used three times, the charm vanishes.
zh_tw: 當你攜帶著草包時，該護咒使你可以使用一個動作施放法術{@spell etherealness||以太化}，無需任何法術成分。使用三遍後，該護咒從你身上消失。

english: Clay No-Face's Charm
zh_tw: 無臉粘土的護咒

english: While you have Clay No-Face in your possession, you don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. These benefits last for 30 days while the doll is in your possession, after which the charm vanishes from you.
zh_tw: 當你攜帶著無臉粘土時，你無需飲食和呼吸。攜帶該玩偶時，該增益持續 30 天。之後，該護咒從你身上消失。

english: Joho's Charm
zh_tw: 約霍的護咒

english: While you have Joho in your possession, it grants you the benefit of a {@item helm of comprehending languages}. This benefit lasts for 7 days while the doll is in your possession, after which the charm vanishes from you.
zh_tw: 當你攜帶著約霍時，它賦予你的增益使你如同戴著一頂{@item helm of comprehending languages||通曉語言頭盔}。攜帶該玩偶時，該增益持續 7 天。之後，該護咒從你身上消失。

english: The Sewn Sisters
zh_tw: 縫合姐妹

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} recruited three night hags for their expertise in stitching soul bags—a craft they adapted for the creation of the Soulmonger. The hags are a frightful lot:
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 招募了三個夜魔，利用她們在縫合靈魂袋方面的專長——她們將這項技藝改良用於創造噬魂器。這些女巫是一群可怕的存在：

english: {@b Widow Groat} has tarnished gold coins covering her eyes and ants nesting in her skull. The ants serve as her spies, and their presence often portends her arrival. She carries a heartstone, a soul bag, and an iron ring with eight keys. The keys unlock the shackles in {@area area 78|50d|x}.
zh_tw: {@b 寡婦格羅特} 用失去光澤的金幣覆蓋著她的眼睛，螞蟻在她頭骨中築巢。這些螞蟻充當她的間諜，它們的存在常常預示著她的到來。她攜帶著一顆心石、一個靈魂袋以及一個帶有八個鑰匙的鐵環。這些鑰匙可以開啟{@area 區域78|50d|x}中的鐐銬。

english: {@b Peggy Deadbells} wears a string of chattering children's teeth and thumps about on a heavy peg leg. When she laughs, yellow gas billows out of her nose and ears. Around her neck, she wears a pouch made from gnome skin, inside which is a heartstone and five lustrous black marbles (see {@area area 81|520|x}). Tied to Peggy's rope belt is a soul bag.
zh_tw: {@b 佩吉·迪德貝爾} 戴著一串喋喋不休的孩子們的牙齒，並且拖著一條沉重的木腿行走。當她笑時，黃色的氣體從她的鼻子和耳朵中湧出。她的脖子上掛著一個由侏儒皮膚製成的袋子，裡面有一個心石和五顆光亮的黑色大理石（見{@area 區域81|520|x}）。佩吉的繩帶腰帶上繫著一個靈魂袋。

english: {@b Baggy Nanna} has a squirming leather sack sewn over her head. The bag also contains a cockerel, a viper, and a terrier. One animal can emerge from the bag in place of her own head to speak on her behalf, and the animals become smoke when Baggy Nanna dies. In her pockets, she carries a heartstone, a soul bag, and three goblin fingers.
zh_tw: {@b 老婆婆巴基} 的頭上縫著一個蠕動的皮革袋。袋子裡還有一隻公雞、一條蝰蛇和一隻小獵犬。其中一個動物可以代替她自己的頭從袋子裡出來為她代言，當鬆垮娜娜死去時，這些動物會變成煙霧。她的口袋裡攜帶著一顆心石、一個靈魂袋和三個地精手指。

english: The night hags have a shared pool of spells (see the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the Monster Manual). The scarecrow {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} (see {@area area 74|4eb|x}) carries the coven's hag eye.
zh_tw: 夜巫婆們有一個共享的法術池（詳見《怪物手冊》中的"巫婆聯盟"側邊欄）。稻草人{@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生}（詳見{@area 區域74|4eb|x}）攜帶著聯盟的巫婆之眼。

english: For more information on heartstones and soul bags, see the "Night Hag Items" sidebar in the Monster Manual.
zh_tw: 有關心石和靈魂袋的更多資訊，請參閱《怪物手冊》中的"夜巫婆物品"側邊欄。

english: Cage
zh_tw: 籠子

english: A heavy padlock secures the gate of the rusted cage, inside which a naked figure cowers under a bloodstained blanket.
zh_tw: 一把沉重的掛鎖鎖住了生鏽的籠子，籠子裡一個赤裸的身影蜷縮在一條沾滿血跡的毯子下。

english: {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} (see {@area area 74|4eb|x}) carries the key to the padlock, which can otherwise be unlocked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. The lock can also be broken off easily enough.
zh_tw: {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生}（參見{@area 區域74|4eb|x}）攜帶著掛鎖的鑰匙，否則可以透過使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定解鎖。該鎖也可以被輕易砸開。

english: The cage's prisoner is a degenerate clone of one of the player characters and is instantly recognizable as such. It was created from blood or strands of hair obtained by one of the hags while the character slept. Characters had a slight chance of meeting the hag as a random wilderness encounter (see {@adventure appendix B|ToA|7}); however, when and where the theft occurred is up to you.
zh_tw: 籠子裡的囚犯是玩家角色之一的退化克隆體，可以立即被識別出來。它是透過巫婆在角色睡覺時獲得的血液或頭髮絲創造出來的。角色們有很小的機會在隨機的野外遭遇中遇到巫婆（詳見{@adventure 附錄 B|ToA|7}）；然而，盜竊發生的時間與地點由你決定。

english: The clone is not a perfect copy. It is shorter and scrawnier than the character after whom it's modeled, and it has deformities. Use the {@creature commoner} statistics to represent this creature, applying racial traits as appropriate.
zh_tw: 克隆體不是完美的複製品。它比它所模仿的角色更矮更瘦弱，並且有畸形。使用 {@creature commoner||平民} 的具體數值來代表這個生物，適當地應用種族特徵。

english: The clone has no name and no memory of having been created. However, the hags have forged a magical link between the clone and the character from which it was made. The clone knows everything the character knows, up to and including all present knowledge. The hags have been interrogating the clone to learn everything about the adventurers. Now that they have no more use for such information, the Sewn Sisters plan to kill and eat the clone.
zh_tw: 這個克隆體沒有名字，也沒有被創造出來的記憶。然而，巫婆們已經在這個克隆體和製造它的原始角色之間建立了一個魔法連結。克隆體知道角色所知道的一切，包括所有現有的知識。巫婆們一直在審問克隆體，以瞭解有關冒險者的一切。現在，既然她們不再需要這些資訊，縫合姐妹計劃殺死並吃掉克隆體。

english: Cauldron
zh_tw: 吊掛大鍋

english: A tarry greenish-black brew fills the bronze cauldron. Any creature that drinks the brew is {@condition stunned} for {@dice 1d10} minutes. While {@condition stunned}, the creature succumbs to seizures brought on by the dark dreams of the atropal.
zh_tw: 一個柏綠色的焦油狀液體填滿了銅製大鍋。任何飲用這種液體的生物將會被{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態影響，持續{@dice 1d10}分鐘。在{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態下，生物會因為萎縮者爾的黑暗夢境而遭受癲癇發作。

english: The bronze lid of the cauldron lies on the floor nearby. If the lid is placed on the cauldron, the green smoke that fills the room dissipates after 1 minute.
zh_tw: 大鍋的青銅蓋子放在附近的地板上。如果將蓋子放在大鍋上，充滿房間的綠色煙霧在1分鐘後會消散。

english: Skeleton Gate
zh_tw: 骷髏門

english: When the characters get close enough to make out the details of the green door, read:
zh_tw: 當角色靠近到足以分辨出綠色門的細節時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: This twelve-foot-high, ten-foot-wide door is made of green stone, its surface carved with grinning goblin skeletons. A belt of smooth stone spans the door at a height of four feet, set with five gold symbols in a row: a triangle, a square, a pentagon, a hexagon, and an octagon. Each symbol is engraved on a recessed circular seal.
zh_tw: 這扇門高十二尺，寬十尺，由綠色石頭製成，表面雕刻著咧嘴笑的地精骷髏。一條平滑的石帶橫貫門的四尺高處，上面並排鑲嵌著五個金色符號：一個三角形、一個正方形、一個五邊形、一個六邊形和一個八邊形。每個符號都雕刻在一個凹陷的圓形印章上。

english: The geometric symbols are 6 inches across, 1 foot apart, and set into stone disks 8 inches in diameter. Hidden behind the seals are five keyholes that conform in size and shape to the heads of the skeleton keys found on the other tomb levels (see "{@area Skeleton Keys|316|x}").
zh_tw: 這些幾何符號直徑為6吋，相互間隔1尺，並且鑲嵌在直徑8吋的石盤內。石盤背後的五個鑰匙孔的大小和形狀與在其他墓穴層級上找到的骷髏鑰匙的頭部相匹配（見"{@area 骷髏鑰匙|316|x}"）。

english: Each time the characters complete a trial in areas 72 through 76, one stone seal rolls aside, exposing the keyhole behind it. When a {@creature skeleton key|ToA} is inserted into its corresponding keyhole and turned clockwise, a tumbler inside the door unlocks. When all five tumblers unlock, the skeleton gate can be pulled open like a normal (albeit heavy) door, revealing a wide staircase that descends 20 feet to {@area area 77|4fa|x}. The door and its seals are impervious to damage and spells, and cannot be opened in a manner other than that which is prescribed above.
zh_tw: 每次角色完成區域72至76中的一個試煉，一個石制印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的鑰匙孔。當一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}插入對應的鑰匙孔並順時針轉動時，門內的鎖芯就會解開。當所有五個鎖芯都解開後，骷髏門就可以像一扇普通的（儘管很重的）門一樣被拉開，露出一條向下20尺通往{@area 區域77|4fa|x}的寬闊樓梯。門及其印章對傷害和法術免疫，不能以上述規定之外的任何方式開啟。

english: Facing the Night Hags
zh_tw: 面對夜巫婆

english: If the characters manage to open all five keyholes and have the requisite skeleton keys in their possession, the Sewn Sisters emerge from the Border Ethereal and attack them. The hags' goal is to seize one or more of the skeleton keys, thus preventing the characters from reaching the Soulmonger. If a hag obtains a {@creature skeleton key|ToA}, it cackles as it returns to the Border Ethereal with it.
zh_tw: 如果角色們設法開啟了所有的五個鑰匙孔，並且擁有所需的骷髏鑰匙，縫合姐妹將從邊界以太中出現並攻擊他們。巫婆們的目標是奪取一個或多個骷髏鑰匙，從而阻止角色們到達噬魂器。如果一個巫婆獲得了一個{@creature skeleton key|ToA|鑰匙骷髏}，它會在帶著它返回邊界以太時發出尖笑。

english: If two hags die, the third tries to bargain with the characters, offering useful information in exchange for her life. The hag makes the characters swear on their mortal souls not to harm her once her information is divulged. Any character who reneges on the agreement contracts slimy doom, as though he or she had failed a saving throw against the {@spell contagion} spell. The hag reveals the following information (and nothing more) once an agreement is reached:
zh_tw: 如果有兩名巫婆死亡，第三名巫婆會試圖與角色們討價還價，提供有用資訊以換取自己的生命。巫婆要求角色們以他們凡人的靈魂發誓，一旦她透露了資訊就不得傷害她。任何違背協議的角色將患上黏滑厄運，就好像他或她未能透過對抗{@spell contagion||疫病術}法術的豁免檢定一樣。一旦達成協議，巫婆會透露以下資訊（且不會透露更多）：

english: "Hidden on this level of the dungeon is a library of lost lore, guarded by an arcanaloth whose true name is Ygga Raxyg." (See {@area area 80|51c|x} for details.)
zh_tw: "在這個地牢層隱藏著一個失落知識圖書館，由一個名為伊加·拉希格的奧法羅斯魔守護。"（詳見{@area 區域80|51c|x}。）

english: "There is only one way to leave the dungeon: the ebon pool. Charred bones point the way." (See {@area area 81|520|x} for details on the ebon pool. "Charred bones" refers to the charred skeleton on the floor in {@area area 79|512|x}.)
zh_tw: "離開地牢只有一種方式：烏木池。焦骨指引著方向。"（詳見{@area 區域81|520|x}瞭解烏木池的詳情。"焦骨"指的是在{@area 區域79|512|x}地板上的焦黑骷髏。）

english: "The Red Trail leads to death." (See {@area area 79|512|x}.)
zh_tw: "紅徑通向死亡。"（詳見{@area 區域79|512|x}。）

english: 72. Trial of the Triangle
zh_tw: 72. 三角試煉

english: The door to this area has a triangle carved into it. When the characters open the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個區域的門上雕刻著一個三角形。當角色們開啟門時，請閱讀：

english: A five-foot-wide, floor-to-ceiling glass cylinder near the back wall of this room is filled with light, the source of which is not apparent. A tiny triangular hole is cut through the glass, five feet above the floor. Inside the cylinder, an iron lever is set into a metal plate on the floor.
zh_tw: 這個房間後牆附近的一個五尺寬、從地板到天花板的玻璃圓柱體內充滿了光線，光源並不明顯。玻璃上在五尺高的地方切有一個小三角形的洞。在圓柱體內，有一個鐵桿安裝在地板上的金屬板上。

english: To reach the lever, the characters must figure out a way to enter or bypass the cylinder. If the lever is pulled, the triangle seal on the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} rolls aside, revealing a triangular keyhole behind it.
zh_tw: 為了夠到拉桿，角色們必須想辦法進入或繞過這個圓柱體。如果拉動拉桿，位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門上的三角形印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的三角形鑰匙孔。

english: The cylinder is 5 feet in diameter, shaped of glass 2 inches thick. The triangular hole in the glass is 1 inch wide. The cylinder is normally impervious to damage and spells, and it can't be moved. A character in {@spell gaseous form} can enter the cylinder through the hole, while an ethereal character can pass through the glass. A character can also use {@spell misty step}, {@spell dimension door}, or similar magic to enter the cylinder. A magically summoned creature can appear inside the cylinder, as can an {@spell unseen servant}, either of which can be commanded to pull the lever. The lever is too heavy to be moved with a {@spell mage hand} spell but responds to a {@spell telekinesis} spell.
zh_tw: 這個圓柱體直徑為5尺，由2吋厚的玻璃製成。玻璃上的三角形洞口寬1吋。通常情況下，這個圓柱體對傷害和法術是免疫的，且無法移動。處於{@spell gaseous form||氣化形體}的角色可以透過洞口進入圓柱體內，而處於以太狀態的角色可以穿過玻璃。角色也可以使用{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}、{@spell dimension door||任意門}或類似的魔法進入圓柱體。一個被魔法召喚出來的生物可以出現在圓柱體內，同樣，一個{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}也可以，無論是哪一個都可以被命令去拉動拉桿。拉桿太重了，無法用{@spell mage hand||法師之手}法術移動，但會對{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}法術產生反應。

english: If three creatures stand around the glass cylinder, forming the points of a triangle around it, the cylinder turns brittle and can be shattered with any solid hit. Once the cylinder is destroyed, anyone can walk up to the lever and pull it.
zh_tw: 如果有三隻生物圍繞玻璃圓柱體站立，形成圍繞它的三角形的頂點，圓柱體就會變得脆弱，可以用任何實心打擊將其擊碎。一旦圓柱體被摧毀，任何人都可以走上前去拉動拉桿。

english: 73. Trial of the Square
zh_tw: 73. 正方形試煉

english: The door to this area has a square carved into it. When the characters open the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個區域的門上雕刻著一個正方形。當角色們開啟門時，請閱讀：

english: This room is filled with flying sheets of parchment, with writing on the pages visible as they flutter by. A metal plate bolted onto the far wall is set with a ghostly lever.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了飛舞的羊皮紙，隨著它們的飄動，頁面上的字跡清晰可見。遠牆上固定著一塊金屬板，上面裝有一個幽靈般的拉桿。

english: The flying pages are from a spellbook and are destroyed if they take any amount of fire damage. A character can use an action to grab a page as it flutters past with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check. Written on the page is a random spell; roll a {@dice d6} to determine the spell's level, then randomly choose a spell of that level from the wizard spell list.
zh_tw: 飛行的書頁來自一本法術書，如果受到任何火焰傷害就會被摧毀。一個角色可以使用一個動作，在書頁飄過時透過一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷檢定抓取一頁。書頁上寫著一個隨機法術；擲一個{@dice d6}來決定法術的等級，然後從法師法術列表中隨機選擇一個該等級的法術。

english: If more than three pages are taken, all the remaining pages in the room turn to dust, which coalesces into a hostile {@creature dust mephit} and three illusory duplicates created by a {@spell mirror image} spell. The mephit attacks all other creatures in the room, with its duplicates appearing to follow suit.
zh_tw: 如果取走超過三頁紙，房間裡剩下的所有紙張都會化為塵土，這些塵土聚整合一隻敵對的{@creature dust mephit||塵魔蝠}，以及由{@spell mirror image||鏡影術}法術創造的三個虛幻複製體。塵魔蝠攻擊房間裡的所有其他生物，其複製體似乎也在進行攻擊。

english: The mephit knows three command words: "bloatbug," "frogspittle," and "spindledash." While in this room, it can speak one command word as a bonus action on it turn, triggering the associated magical effect below. It can't speak the same command word two rounds in a row.
zh_tw: 這個魔蝠知道三個命令詞："膨脹蟲"，"青蛙唾沫"，和"紡錘衝刺"。在這個房間裡，它可以用一個附贈動作說出一個命令詞來觸發下面相關的魔法效果。它不能連續兩輪說出同一個命令詞。

english: {@b Bloatbug}: The mephit targets one creature within 30 feet of it that it can see, which immediately increases its weight by 50 percent. Any spell that ends a curse, such as {@spell greater restoration} or {@spell remove curse}, ends the effect and returns the creature to its normal weight.
zh_tw: {@b 膨脹蟲}：魔蝠指定一個它能看到的30尺範圍內的一個生物，該生物的重量立即增加50%。任何結束詛咒效果的法術，如{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}或{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}，都能結束這個效果並使生物恢復到正常重量。
