english: {@b Frogspittle}: Each creature in the room must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@dice 2d8}) poison damage. (The mephit is immune to poison damage.)
zh_tw: {@b 青蛙唾沫}：房間內的每個生物必須成功透過 {@dc 10} 體質豁免檢定，否則會受到 9 ({@dice 2d8}) 點毒素傷害。（小鬼免疫毒素傷害。）

english: {@b Spindledash}: The effect targets a random creature in the room. Have the players roll a {@dice d20} for each character in the room, and roll a {@dice d20} for the mephit and each other creature in the room. Whichever creatures roll the lowest take 21 ({@dice 6d6}) force damage.
zh_tw: {@b 蛛網疾行}: 效果隨機針對房間內的生物。讓玩家為房間裡的每個角色擲一個{@dice d20}，並且為魔蝠和其他每個生物擲一個{@dice d20}。擲得最低點數的生物會受到21（{@dice 6d6}）點力場傷害。

english: When the dust mephit dies, it collapses and transforms into a stick of black chalk.
zh_tw: 當塵魔蝠死亡時，它會崩潰並轉變成一根黑色的粉筆。

english: Phantom Lever
zh_tw: 幻影拉桿

english: The lever on the north wall is carved from bone but is insubstantial, such that a character's hand passes right through it. The lever appears solid to a creature on the Ethereal Plane, and an ethereal creature can pull it normally. {@spell Dispel magic} has no effect on the lever, which remains insubstantial even within the area of an {@spell antimagic field}. If any creature uses chalk to draw a square on the wall around the lever, the lever becomes solid. If the square is erased, the lever turns insubstantial again.
zh_tw: 北牆上的拉桿是用骨頭雕刻的，但是它是非物質的，以至於角色的手可以直接穿過它。對於位面以太界的生物來說，拉桿看起來是實體的，以太界的生物可以正常拉動它。{@spell Dispel magic||解除魔法}對拉桿沒有效果，即使在{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}的範圍內，拉桿仍然是非物質的。如果任何生物用粉筆畫一個正方形圍繞拉桿在牆上，拉桿就會變成實體。如果正方形被擦除，拉桿再次變得非物質。

english: If the lever is pulled, the square seal on the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} rolls aside, revealing a square keyhole behind it.
zh_tw: 如果拉動拉桿，位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門上的正方形印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的正方形鑰匙孔。

english: 74. Trial of the Pentagon
zh_tw: 74. 五邊形試煉

english: The door to this area has a pentagon carved into it. When the characters open the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個區域的門上雕刻著一個五邊形。當角色們開啟門時，請閱讀：

english: The delicious aroma of spiced meat greets you. At the end of a twenty-foot-long corridor, a room opens up with red tapestries covering the walls. A feast is spread out on three tables, consisting of roast boar, squash stew, and a tray of iced cakes. Flagons of frothy beer complete the banquet.
zh_tw: 香料烤肉的香味撲鼻而來。在一條二十尺長的走廊盡頭，一個房間展開，牆上掛著紅色的掛毯。三張桌子上擺滿了盛宴，包括烤野豬、南瓜燉菜和一盤冰鎮蛋糕。帶有泡沫的啤酒壺為宴會畫上了完美的句號。

english: A gaunt human male in a dusty black suit quietly arranges the items on the cake table, taking notice of your intrusion. Without a word, he gestures for you to come forward and sample the feast.
zh_tw: 一個面容憔悴的人類男性穿著一件沾滿灰塵的黑色西裝，正在安靜地整理蛋糕桌上的物品，注意到了你們的闖入。他沒有說話，示意你們走上前去品嚐這頓盛宴。

english: The gaunt gentleman is {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA}, the Sewn Sisters' manservant. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of illusion magic around him. A successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 16}) reveals his true form.
zh_tw: 那位瘦削的紳士是{@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生}，縫合姐妹的男僕。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果會揭示他周圍環繞著幻術魔法的靈光。成功的{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 16}）會揭示他的真實形態。

english: {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} is a {@creature scarecrow} disguised with magic to appear human. In a pocket, he carries the Sewn Sisters' {@i hag eye} (see the "Hags" entry in the {@i Monster Manual}) and one lustrous black marble (see {@area area 81|520|x}). {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} understands Common but can't speak. He communicates by nodding and shaking his head, or with gestures and facial expressions.
zh_tw: {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生} 是一個被魔法偽裝成人類的{@creature scarecrow||稻草人}。他的口袋裡攜帶著縫合姐妹的 {@i 鬼婆之眼}（見 {@i 怪物圖鑑}中的"巫婆"條目）和一顆光亮的黑色大理石（見 {@area 區域81|520|x}）。{@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生} 懂得通用語但無法說話。他透過點頭和搖頭，或者用手勢和面部表情來交流。

english: Warned of the adventurers' arrival, the hags prepared this magical feast and instructed {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} to lay it out. The scarecrow attacks the characters only if they attack first, or if the hags command him to.
zh_tw: 巫婆們得知冒險者的到來後，準備了這場魔法盛宴，並指示{@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生}佈置好。稻草人只有在被冒險者先攻擊，或者巫婆們命令他攻擊時才會攻擊角色。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Kubazan or Nangnang receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被庫巴贊或娜浪的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Wild Kubazan urges his host to try the roast boar.
zh_tw: 狂野的庫巴贊催促他的宿主嘗試烤野豬。

english: Greedy, skittish Nangnang urges her host to hoard all the iced cakes and shun the frothy beer.
zh_tw: 貪婪又容易受驚的娜浪催促她的宿主囤積所有的冰鎮蛋糕並避開泡沫啤酒。

english: Magical Feast
zh_tw: 魔法盛宴

english: The food is well prepared and delicious, and the beer is rich. Any character who partakes of the feast gains benefits and suffers detrimental effects based on what is consumed. Do not reveal detrimental effects to the players until those effects come into play.
zh_tw: 食物烹飪得當且美味，啤酒醇厚。享用這頓盛宴的任何角色會根據所食用的食物獲得益處，並遭受相應的不良影響。在這些不良影響生效之前，不要向玩家透露它們。

english: {@b Roast Boar}: The character feels stronger and has advantage on Strength checks, but has disadvantage on attack rolls made against Widow Groat. Both effects have a duration of 24 hours.
zh_tw: {@b 烤野豬}：角色感覺更強大，在力量檢定上有優勢，但在對寡婦格羅特進行的攻擊骰上有劣勢。這兩種效果持續時間為24小時。

english: {@b Squash Stew}: The character feels healthier and gains advantage on Constitution saving throws, but has disadvantage on attack rolls made against Peggy Deadbells. Both effects have a duration of 24 hours.
zh_tw: {@b 南瓜燉菜}：角色感覺更健康，在體質豁免檢定上獲得優勢，但在對佩吉·死鈴進行攻擊檢定時處於劣勢。兩種效果持續時間為24小時。

english: {@b Iced Cakes}: The character feels energized and gains {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points, but has disadvantage on attack rolls made against Baggy Nanna for the next 24 hours.
zh_tw: {@b 冰鎮蛋糕}：角色感到精力充沛並獲得{@dice 2d10}點臨時生命值，但在接下來的24小時內對老婆婆巴基進行攻擊檢定時會受到不利影響。

english: {@b Frothy Beer}: The character gains a special die: a {@dice d6}. Anytime in the next 24 hours, the character can roll this die once and add the result to a {@dice d20} roll he or she just made. Additionally, if the character is inhabited by the spirit of a trickster god, the power normally granted by the spirit is suppressed for 24 hours.
zh_tw: {@b 泡沫啤酒}：角色獲得一個特殊骰子：一個{@dice d6}。在接下來的24小時內，角色可以擲這個骰子一次，並將結果加到他或她剛剛進行的{@dice d20}擲骰結果上。此外，如果角色被詭神的靈魂附身，該靈魂通常賦予的能力將在24小時內被抑制。

english: Characters who enter the room but do not partake of the food or drink are cursed with crippling hunger as soon as they leave this area. The effect imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it can be ended on a character with {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell remove curse}, or similar magic.
zh_tw: 進入房間但不食用食物或飲料的角色一旦離開這個區域就會被詛咒，遭受極度飢餓的困擾。這個效果使攻擊檢定和屬性檢定處於劣勢，並且可以透過{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}、{@spell remove curse||移除詛咒}或類似的魔法來結束。

english: Tapestries
zh_tw: 掛毯

english: Five red tapestries hang from iron rods bolted to the walls. Each is made up of pentagonal patches stitched together. Any character who inspects the tapestry on the southwest wall and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check sees something more: a subliminal devil's face cleverly hidden in the design. The devil's open mouth forms a pentagon. A character can reach into the devil's mouth as though the fabric wasn't there, uncovering a small extradimensional compartment with a glass lever set into the back of it. The compartment can be accessed only from the front side of the tapestry, and only while the tapestry is hanging on the wall. If the tapestry is taken from the room or destroyed, a new one materializes on the wall in {@dice 4d6} hours.
zh_tw: 五塊紅色掛毯從固定在牆上的鐵桿上垂下。每塊掛毯由五邊形拼布縫製而成。任何仔細檢查西南牆上的掛毯並透過{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色會看到更多內容：一個巧妙隱藏在圖案中的潛意識魔鬼面孔。魔鬼的張開嘴巴形成一個五邊形。角色可以把手伸進魔鬼的嘴巴里，彷彿布料不存在一樣，發現一個小的異次元隔間，隔間的後部設有一個玻璃槓桿。隔間只能從掛毯的正面進入，並且只有在掛毯掛在牆上時才能進入。如果掛毯被從房間拿走或被摧毀，新的掛毯將在{@dice 4d6}小時後在牆上出現。

english: If the lever in the tapestry is pulled, the pentagon seal on the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} rolls aside, revealing a pentagonal keyhole behind it.
zh_tw: 如果拉動掛毯裡的拉桿，位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門上的五邊形印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的五邊形鑰匙孔。

english: 75. Trial of the Hexagon
zh_tw: 75. 六邊形試煉

english: Carved into the door of this room is a hexagon. When the characters open the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門上雕刻著一個六邊形。當角色們開啟門時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A large, cracked, six-sided mirror is mounted above a stone shelf protruding from the opposite wall. Five unlit candles stand on the shelf, each made of yellow wax and covered with tiny black sigils. Scrawled on the wall above the mirror in dried blood are the words "PIGGY PIGGY PIGGY."
zh_tw: 一面大的、有裂紋的六邊形鏡子安裝在對面牆上突出的石架上方。石架上放著五根未點燃的蠟燭，每根都是由黃色蠟製成，並覆蓋著細小的黑色符記。在鏡子上方的牆上用幹血潦草地寫著"PIGGY PIGGY PIGGY"。

english: A sixth candle, identical to the five in plain view, is tucked out of sight under the stone shelf. Any character who searches the shelf for traps or hidden compartments automatically finds the sixth candle. Both the mirror and the candles radiate auras of conjuration magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect.
zh_tw: 第六根蠟燭與明處的五根完全相同，被隱藏在石頭架下看不見的地方。任何搜尋架子以尋找陷阱或隱藏隔間的角色都會自動找到第六根蠟燭。鏡子和蠟燭都對 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果散發出召喚魔法的氣息。

english: Cracked Mirror
zh_tw: 破裂的鏡子

english: The cracked mirror can't be pried from the wall or damaged more than it already is.
zh_tw: 這面破裂的鏡子無法從牆上撬下來，也無法比現在更加損壞。

english: If all six candles are lit, a character who looks in the mirror and says the word "piggy" three times in a row sees the reflected candlelight reveal a wooden lever set into a metal panel on the north wall. If fewer than six candles are lit when the words are spoken, the lever appears on the south wall instead. These levers exist only in the mirror's reflection, not in reality.
zh_tw: 如果點燃所有六根蠟燭，一個角色在鏡子前連續三次說出"piggy"這個詞，就會看到反射的燭光揭示了北牆上一個嵌在金屬板上的木製拉桿。如果在說出這些詞時點燃的蠟燭少於六根，拉桿反而會出現在南牆上。這些拉桿只存在於鏡子的反射中，並不存在於現實中。

english: Only a character who can see a lever reflected in the mirror can pull it. As this likely puts the lever out of the character's reach, he or she can cast a {@spell mage hand} or {@spell telekinesis} spell, conjure an {@spell unseen servant}, lasso the lever with a rope, or undertake any suitably clever solution.
zh_tw: 只有能夠看到鏡子裡反射出的拉桿的角色才能拉動它。由於這很可能會將拉桿置於角色觸及範圍之外，他或她可以施放一個{@spell mage hand||法師之手}或者{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}法術，召喚一個{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}，用繩子套住拉桿，或者採取任何合適的巧妙解決方案。

english: True Lever
zh_tw: 真正的拉桿

english: If the north lever is pulled, the hexagon seal on the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} rolls aside, revealing a hexagonal keyhole behind it.
zh_tw: 如果拉動北邊的拉桿，位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門上的六邊形印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的六邊形鑰匙孔。

english: False Lever
zh_tw: 假拉桿

english: If the south lever is pulled, three insane {@creature Wereboar||wereboars} in hybrid form magically spring from the mirror, land in the middle of the room, and fight to the death. When the wereboars have nothing left in the room to fight, they join the night hags in {@area area 71|4d8|x}.
zh_tw: 如果拉動南邊的拉桿，三個瘋狂的處於混合形態的{@creature Wereboar||野豬人}會從鏡子中魔法般地跳出，落在房間中央，並戰鬥至死。當房間裡沒有東西可打時，它們會加入到{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的夜巫婆中。

english: The wereboars can be summoned only once. Pulling this lever again has no effect.
zh_tw: 野豬人只能被召喚一次。再次拉動這個拉桿沒有效果。

english: 76. Trial of the Octagon
zh_tw: 76. 八邊形試煉

english: Carved into the door of this room is an octagon. When the characters open the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門上雕刻著一個八邊形。當角色們開啟門時，請閱讀：

english: The ceiling of this plaster-walled room is fifteen feet high. A leather-backed tome rests open atop a wooden lectern bolted to the floor. Set into the wall behind the lectern are eight human skeletons, arranged so that they appear to be falling and screaming.
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁是石膏的，天花板高十五尺。一本皮革封面的大書攤開在固定於地面的木製講臺上。講臺後的牆壁內嵌著八具人類骷髏，排列得看起來像是在墜落和尖叫。

english: The skeletons are inanimate remains embedded into the plastered walls. The lectern is held in place by four bolts set deep into the floor and is impervious to damage, spells, and attempts to move it. The book's covers are secured to the lectern with {@i sovereign glue}, preventing it from being easily removed. The eight-page book contains an eight-line nursery rhyme written by the Sewn Sisters in Infernal, with each page bearing one line of the poem. The book is open to pages 4 and 5 when the characters first arrive.
zh_tw: 這些骷髏是嵌入石膏牆中的無生命遺骸。講臺由四顆深深固定在地板上的螺栓固定，對損害、法術和移動嘗試免疫。書本的封面用{@i 至尊膠}粘在講臺上，防止它被輕易移除。這本八頁的書包含了縫合姐妹用地獄語寫的八行兒歌，每頁承載一行詩。角色們第一次到達時，書是翻到第四和第五頁。

english: Hidden in the leg of the lectern, on the side facing the east wall, is a secret compartment that can be found with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
zh_tw: 隱藏在東牆講桌腿的一側，有一個可以透過成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定找到的暗格。

english: If the lines of the nursery rhyme (see below) are read aloud in reverse order, starting with the last line and ending on the first, the doors of the secret compartment open, revealing a brass lever inside. If the lever is pulled, the octagon seal on the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} rolls aside, revealing an octagonal keyhole behind it.
zh_tw: 如果將兒歌的詩句（見下文）倒序大聲朗讀，從最後一行開始，以第一行為結束，秘密隔間的門就會開啟，露出裡面的黃銅拉桿。如果拉動拉桿，位於{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門上的八邊形印章就會滾到一邊，露出背後的八邊形鑰匙孔。

english: The compartment can also be opened with a {@spell knock} spell, or with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}. Opening the compartment in either manner triggers the trap (see "Spider Fan Trap" below).
zh_tw: 這個隔間也可以用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術開啟，或者由一名角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來開啟。以任一方式開啟隔間都會觸發陷阱（見下方的"蜘蛛扇陷阱"）。

english: Nursery Rhyme Book
zh_tw: 兒歌書

english: Any character who understands the Infernal tongue can translate the hags' nursery rhyme as follows:
zh_tw: 任何懂得地獄語的角色都可以將巫婆的兒歌翻譯如下：

english: {@b Page 1}: Backward, backward, eight to one.
zh_tw: {@b 第1頁}：反向，反向，八歸一。

english: {@b Page 2}: Speak the rhyme until it's done.
zh_tw: {@b 第2頁}：唸完這首韻。

english: {@b Page 3}: Keep the spider locked away.
zh_tw: {@b 第3頁}：將蜘蛛鎖起來。

english: {@b Page 4}: See the lever, clear as day.
zh_tw: {@b 第4頁}：看見拉桿，清晰如白晝。

english: {@b Page 5}: Spin, spin, iron spider.
zh_tw: {@b 第5頁}：旋轉，旋轉，鐵蜘蛛。

english: {@b Page 6}: Turn their flesh and bones to cider.
zh_tw: {@b 第6頁}：將他們的肉體和骨頭變成蘋果酒。

english: {@b Page 7}: Speak the rhyme and meet your fate.
zh_tw: {@b 第7頁}：說出韻律，面對你的命運。

english: {@b Page 8}: Forward, forward, one to eight.
zh_tw: {@b 第8頁}：向前，向前，一至八。

english: Spider Fan Trap
zh_tw: 蜘蛛扇陷阱

english: Any character who inspects the floor of the room and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check notices thin seams along the floor's perimeter that suggest a pit below. The seams are meant to deceive adventurers and make them wary of the floor, which doesn't actually have a pit underneath it.
zh_tw: 任何檢查房間地板的角色，若成功透過一個{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，會注意到地板邊緣的細微縫隙，暗示下方有一個陷阱。這些縫隙旨在欺騙冒險者並讓他們對地板保持警惕，但實際上地板下方並沒有陷阱。

english: The real danger is the ceiling, which appears to be smooth-cut stone but is actually thin plaster. Five feet above the false plaster ceiling is the room's true ceiling, which has a bladed fan shaped like a giant iron spider mounted to it.
zh_tw: 真正的危險來自於天花板，它看起來是平滑切割的石頭，實際上是薄石膏。在假石膏天花板上方五尺是房間真正的天花板，上面安裝著一個刀片扇，形狀像一個巨大的鐵蜘蛛。

english: If a character in the room reads the entire nursery rhyme beginning with the first line on page 1 and ending with the last line on page 8, or if the compartment in the lectern is opened improperly, the ceiling fan begins to twirl as a {@spell reverse gravity} spell activates within the room. The lectern is the only fixed object in the room. Any creature within reach of it can, with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, grab the lectern and avoid falling upward. A creature that can't grab the lectern or isn't secured in some other way "falls" upward through the fake plaster ceiling into the rotating blades of the fan, taking 44 ({@dice 8d10}) slashing damage. The creature takes that damage again each time it starts its turn on the ceiling. The {@spell reverse gravity} effect lasts for 1 minute, after which creatures on the ceiling fall back down to the floor 20 feet below. Once the spell ends, the ceiling fan stops twirling. The trap does not reset.
zh_tw: 如果房間內的角色從第1頁的第一行開始閱讀至第8頁的最後一行讀完整個童謠，或者講臺上的隔間被不當開啟，天花板風扇會開始旋轉，同時房間內會啟用一個{@spell reverse gravity||反轉重力}法術。講臺是房間內唯一固定的物體。任何能夠觸及它的生物，透過成功的{@dc 17}敏捷豁免檢定，可以抓住講臺避免向上墜落。無法抓住講臺或以其他方式固定的生物會'墜落'透過假石膏天花板進入旋轉的風扇葉片，受到44點({@dice 8d10})的揮砍傷害。每當該生物在天花板上開始其回合時，會再次受到此傷害。{@spell reverse gravity||反轉重力}效果持續1分鐘，之後天花板上的生物會墜落回下方20尺的地板。法術結束後，天花板風扇停止旋轉。此陷阱不會重置。

english: 77. Death God's Nursery
zh_tw: 77. 死神的育嬰室

english: Opening the skeleton gate in {@area area 71|4d8|x} reveals a 10-foot-wide, 20-foot-long staircase of polished black marble that descends to this area. When the characters reach the bottom of the stairs, read:
zh_tw: 開啟{@area 區域71|4d8|x}的骷髏門，露出一個10尺寬、20尺長的拋光黑色大理石樓梯，通往這個區域。當角色們走到樓梯底部時，請閱讀：

english: Crumbling balconies overlook a pool of lava filling this triangular chamber, above which is suspended an enormous crystal cylinder held in place by three adamantine struts. Wraithlike forms swirl inside the cylinder, and otherworldly screams hang in the air. Four long, writhing tentacles sprout from the cylinder's cap. A shriveled monstrosity the size of an elephant floats near the cylinder. Its body is wet and malformed, its arms and legs are atrophied, and its oversized head drips black goo. The creature is attached to the cylinder by a twisted umbilical cord.
zh_tw: 搖搖欲墜的陽臺俯瞰著這個三角形房間中的熔岩池，其上方懸掛著一個巨大的水晶圓柱，由三個精金支架固定。水晶圓柱內有像幽靈般的形體旋轉，空氣中迴盪著異世界的尖叫聲。從圓柱的蓋子上伸出四條長長的、扭動的觸手。一個乾癟的怪物，大小如象，漂浮在圓柱附近。它的身體溼潤畸形，四肢萎縮，巨大的頭部滴著黑色的粘液。這個生物透過一根扭曲的臍帶與圓柱相連。

english: The cylindrical device is the Soulmonger. The malformed creature floating next to it is an {@creature atropal|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}), which feeds on the captured souls of the dead. The atropal attacks any creature that threatens it or tries to damage its food source. If the atropal dies, {@creature Acererak|ToA} arrives to take his revenge (see "{@area Acererak's Revenge|507|x}" below).
zh_tw: 這個圓柱形的裝置是噬魂器。旁邊漂浮的畸形生物是一個{@creature atropal|ToA|萎縮者}（詳見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），它以捕獲的死者靈魂為食。萎縮者會攻擊任何威脅它或試圖破壞其食物來源的生物。如果萎縮者死亡，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}會到來以報復（見下文"{@area 阿瑟瑞克的復仇|507|x}"）。

english: The ceiling of the vault is 30 feet high, and the walls along the north balcony are lined with alcoves containing piles of skulls and bones—the remains of Old Omuans and their minotaur protectors.
zh_tw: 這個拱頂的天花板高30尺，北陽臺的牆壁上排列著壁龕，壁龕裡堆滿了頭骨和骨頭——舊奧姆人及其牛頭人保護者的遺骸。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by trickster spirits receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被惡作劇靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Fickle I'jin encourages her host to investigate the mist-filled archway on the south balcony (see "Mist Gate" below).
zh_tw: 多變的艾金鼓勵她的宿主去調查南陽臺上充滿霧氣的拱門（見下文的"霧門"）。

english: Adventurous Kubazan expects his host to make the ultimate sacrifice and die in a blaze of glory.
zh_tw: 愛冒險的庫巴贊期望他的宿主做出最終的犧牲，在榮耀的火焰中死去。

english: Kind Moa wants to free the souls trapped inside the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 仁慈的莫阿想要解放困在噬魂器中的靈魂。

english: Greedy Nangnang urges her host to search the balconies and bone-filled alcoves for treasure.
zh_tw: 貪婪的娜浪敦促她的宿主搜查陽臺和充滿骨頭的壁龕尋找寶藏。

english: Nervous Obo'laka is concerned that the bones in the northern alcoves might rise up and attack.
zh_tw: 緊張的奧博娜卡擔心北邊壁龕裡的骨頭可能會站起來並發動攻擊。

english: Shrewd Papazotl suspects that the atropal might be vulnerable to radiant damage and that killing it might summon forth its evil master.
zh_tw: 精明的帕帕扎圖懷疑萎縮者可能對光耀傷害敏感，並且殺死它可能會召喚出它的邪惡主人。

english: Virtuous Shagambi recognizes that the atropal is unholy and orders her host to destroy it at once.
zh_tw: 高尚的莎根比認識到萎縮者是不神聖的，並命令她的宿主立即摧毀它。

english: Contemplative Unkh urges her host to communicate with the atropal. Perhaps the creature is just misunderstood.
zh_tw: 沉思的安珂敦促她的宿主與萎縮者溝通。也許這個生物只是被誤解了。

english: Deranged Wongo wants his host to attack the tentacles sprouting from the top of the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 瘋狂的望戈想要他的宿主攻擊從噬魂器頂部長出的觸手。

english: The Soulmonger
zh_tw: 噬魂器

english: The Soulmonger is an upright crystal cylinder 20 feet high and 10 feet in diameter. The adamantine struts that suspend it above the lava attach to an adamantine ring around the cylinder's midsection.
zh_tw: 噬魂器是一個直立的水晶圓柱體，高20尺，直徑10尺。將其懸掛在巖漿上方的精金支架連線在圓柱體中部的一個精金環上。

english: Under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect, the Soulmonger radiates an intense aura of necromantic magic. Destroying the Soulmonger not only ends the effects of the death curse (see the introduction to the adventure) but also frees all the souls trapped within the device. Freed souls travel to the afterlife, and any creature whose soul is set free can be brought back from the dead by magical means.
zh_tw: 在 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似效果的審查下，噬魂器散發出強烈的死靈魔法氣息。摧毀噬魂器不僅結束了死亡詛咒的效果（見冒險介紹），還釋放了困在該裝置中的所有靈魂。釋放出的靈魂會前往來世，任何靈魂被釋放的生物都可以透過魔法手段從死亡中帶回來。

english: The Soulmonger is an artifact of evil—a Huge object with AC 15; 200 hit points; vulnerability to radiant damage; and immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
zh_tw: 噬魂器是一件邪惡的神器——一個巨大的物體，具有AC（護甲等級）15；200生命值；對光耀傷害易損；並且對來自非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫。

english: Adamantine Struts
zh_tw: 精金支架

english: One way to destroy the Soulmonger is to break any of the three adamantine struts that suspend it above the lava. Each strut is a Large object with AC 20; 100 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and immunity to fire, poison, and psychic damage. When a strut drops to 0 hit points, it breaks and causes the other two struts to snap as the Soulmonger falls.
zh_tw: 摧毀噬魂器的一種方法是破壞將其懸掛在巖漿上方的三條精金支架中的任意一條。每條支架都被視為一個大型物體，具有AC 20；100生命值；對非魔法攻擊的鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害免疫；以及對火焰、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。當一條支架的生命值降至0時，它會斷裂，並導致其他兩條支架隨著噬魂器的墜落而斷裂。

english: The struts are wide enough that Medium or Small creatures can walk along them without difficulty. However, any creature that takes damage while standing on a strut must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall off it, plunging into the lava unless the creature is somehow secured.
zh_tw: 橫樑足夠寬，中型或小型生物可以毫無困難地行走。然而，任何站在橫樑上受到傷害的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 的敏捷豁免檢定，否則會從橫樑上跌落，墜入巖漿，除非該生物以某種方式被固定住。

english: Unless likewise secured, any creature standing on an adamantine strut when the strut breaks falls into the lava. If the creature is within reach of a balcony, it can leap onto the balcony and avoid the fall with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw.
zh_tw: 除非同樣被固定，任何站在精金支柱上的生物在支柱斷裂時會墜入熔岩。如果該生物在陽臺的觸及範圍內，它可以跳到陽臺上，並透過一次成功的{@dc 10}敏捷豁免來避免墜落。

english: Tentacles
zh_tw: 觸鬚

english: Once per turn, in response to any creature making a successful melee weapon attack against the cylinder or one of its struts, the Soulmonger attacks that creature with one of its 30-foot-long tentacles. The tentacle has a Strength score of 22 and makes one melee weapon attack against the creature: {@hit 7} to hit, 24 ({@dice 4d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, a tentacle can grapple its target (escape {@dc 16}). If the target weighs 330 pounds or less, the tentacle can also lift the {@condition grappled} creature and move it to any unoccupied space within its 30-foot reach, or drop it in the lava.
zh_tw: 每回合一次，當任意生物對柱狀體或其支柱成功進行近戰武器攻擊時，噬魂器會用其30尺長的觸鬚攻擊該生物。觸鬚的力量值為22，並對該生物進行一次近戰武器攻擊：{@hit 7}命中，24（{@dice 4d8 + 6}）鈍擊傷害。觸鬚也可以不造成傷害而擒抱其目標（逃脫{@dc 16}）。如果目標重量不超過330磅，觸鬚還能舉起{@condition grappled||被擒}的生物並將其移動到其30尺觸及範圍內的任意未佔據空間，或將其丟入熔岩中。

english: The tentacles can be attacked and destroyed. Each one is a Huge animated object with AC 15, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 觸手可以被攻擊並摧毀。每一個觸手都是一個巨大的活化物體，具有AC 15，30生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Destroying the Soulmonger
zh_tw: 摧毀噬魂器

english: When the Soulmonger drops to 0 hit points, read:
zh_tw: 當噬魂器的生命值降至0時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: The crystal cylinder shatters, and a myriad of tiny lights pour forth from within. These bright souls coil through the air like a tornado, blazing upward and then vanishing in a blinding, spectral flash.
zh_tw: 水晶圓柱體碎裂開來，無數微小的光芒從中湧出。這些明亮的靈魂像旋風一樣在空中盤旋，向上燃燒，然後以耀眼的幽靈閃光消失。

english: If the atropal has not been destroyed, it shrieks as the souls of the dead escape from the wreckage of the Soulmonger.
zh_tw: 如果萎縮者沒有被摧毀，它會在死者的靈魂從噬魂器的殘骸中逃脫時發出尖叫。

english: Lava Pit
zh_tw: 巖漿坑

english: The lava pit is 30 feet below the floor of the room and 100 feet deep. Any creature that falls into the lava or starts its turn there takes 55 ({@dice 10d10}) fire damage. Any object that falls into the lava takes damage on initial contact and once per round thereafter until it is removed from the lava or destroyed.
zh_tw: 熔岩坑位於房間地面下方30尺處，深100尺。任何生物如果掉入熔岩或在其上方開始回合，將受到55點（{@dice 10d10}）火焰傷害。任何物體如果掉入熔岩，在初次接觸時會受到傷害，並且每輪都會再次受到傷害，直到它從熔岩中移除或被摧毀。

english: Phylacteries
zh_tw: 符咒盒

english: Along the east and west walls of the chamber, two balconies stand 30 feet above the lava pit.
zh_tw: 在房間的東西兩側牆壁上，有兩個陽臺，它們位於巖漿坑上方30尺的位置。

english: Two facing balconies halfway along the room are littered by ornate glass bottles, fluted silver urns, ivory caskets, and other vessels—all of them inscribed with baleful sigils.
zh_tw: 房間中間相對的兩個陽臺上散落著裝飾華麗的玻璃瓶、有槽紋的銀質大罐、象牙寶箱以及其他容器——所有這些容器上都刻有惡毒的符號。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} has disciples scattered throughout the multiverse, including many liches that seek to become as powerful as him. He keeps their phylacteries here.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 在多元宇宙中有門徒散佈各處，包括許多力求變得和他一樣強大的巫妖。他將他們的護符放在這裡。

english: Each balcony has {@dice 2d6 + 5} lich phylacteries on it. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognizes the phylacteries for what they are. Destroying a phylactery is no simple task and often requires a special ritual, item, or weapon. The phylacteries here are all unique, and discovering the key to each one's destruction will require time and expensive research. There's a {@chance 10} chance that any one of these phylacteries would be destroyed by hurling it into the lava.
zh_tw: 每個陽臺上都有{@dice 2d6 + 5}個巫妖命匣。任何透過{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色都能認出這些命匣的真實本質。摧毀命匣並非易事，通常需要特殊儀式、物品或武器。這裡的命匣都是獨一無二的，要發現每個命匣的摧毀方法需要時間和昂貴的研究。將這些命匣投入熔岩有{@chance 10}的機率能摧毀其中任意一個。

english: Mist Gate
zh_tw: 迷霧之門

english: The balcony at the south end of the room holds the gateway to the final chambers of the Tomb of the Nine Gods.
zh_tw: 房間南端的陽臺上設有通往九神之墓最終廳室的門戶。

english: An ornate archway looms over this balcony. Grinning skulls are molded into its frame, and glowing mist swirls within.
zh_tw: 一個裝飾華麗的拱門籠罩在這個陽臺上。其框架上鑄有獰笑的骷髏，並且發光的霧氣在其中旋轉。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of conjuration magic around the gate. Any creature that steps into the archway emerges from a similar archway in {@area area 78|50d|x}, along with anything it is wearing or carrying.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了環繞在門周圍的召喚魔法光環。任何生物踏入拱門時，都會從{@area 區域78|50d|x}中的一個類似拱門中出現，包括它所穿戴或攜帶的任何物品。

english: Acererak's Revenge
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的復仇

english: If the characters kill the atropal, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們殺死了萎縮者，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A skeletal figure wrapped in moldering robes and clutching a skull-tipped staff appears on the south balcony. Hateful pinpricks of white light burn in its eye sockets, and a two-foot-diameter sphere of utter darkness floats in the air beside it.
zh_tw: 一個骷髏般的身形，裹著腐爛的長袍，緊握著一個頭骨尖端的法杖，出現在南陽臺上。它眼眶中燃燒著充滿惡意的白色針尖般的光芒，旁邊空中懸浮著一個兩尺直徑的絕對黑暗球體。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) rolls initiative and attacks with all his power, hoping to slay the intruders and reap their souls. The archlich carries the {@item Staff of the Forgotten One|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix C|ToA|8}) and is accompanied by a {@item sphere of annihilation}, which he controls using a {@item talisman of the sphere} worn about his neck. Because the Tomb of the Nine Gods is not {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s home, he has no access to lair actions during this battle.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）開始進行先攻判定，並全力以赴攻擊，希望殺死入侵者並收割他們的靈魂。這位死靈法師攜帶著{@item Staff of the Forgotten One|ToA|被遺忘者的法杖}（見{@adventure 附錄C|ToA|8}），並且伴隨著一個{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}，他透過佩戴在脖子上的{@item talisman of the sphere||法球護符}來控制它。因為九神之墓不是{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的家，所以在這場戰鬥中他沒有巢穴行動的許可權。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} speaks to the adventurers in condescending tones, referring to them as "puny mortals" as he sets out to destroy them.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 以居高臨下的口吻對冒險者們說話，稱他們為'微不足道的凡人'，同時他準備去摧毀他們。

english: Wrath of the Trickster Gods
zh_tw: 詭神的憤怒

english: When {@creature Acererak|ToA} appears, any character inhabited by the spirit of a trickster god hears that spirit cry out for vengeance. In addition to the power granted by his or her trickster god, the character gains the following benefits while he or she can see {@creature Acererak|ToA}:
zh_tw: 當{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}出現時，任何被詭神靈魂附身的角色都會聽到那個靈魂為了復仇而呼喊。除了他或她的詭神賦予的力量外，只要角色能看到{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}，他們還會獲得以下好處：

english: The character gains 50 temporary hit points at the start of each of his or her turns.
zh_tw: 角色在每個自己的回合開始時獲得50點臨時生命值。

english: When the character makes an attack roll against {@creature Acererak|ToA} and hits, the attack deals an extra {@dice 3d6} psychic damage.
zh_tw: 當角色對{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}進行攻擊檢定並命中時，攻擊會額外造成{@dice 3d6}點心靈傷害。

english: Acererak's Defeat
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的失敗

english: If {@creature Acererak|ToA} drops below 100 hit points, he casts {@spell teleport} on his next turn and flees. As he departs, read:
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的生命值降至100點以下，他會在下個回合施放{@spell teleport||傳送術}並逃跑。當他離開時，請閱讀以下內容：

english: "We'll meet again, fools!" says the lich. "And on that day, you will die!" With that, {@creature Acererak|ToA} raises his staff, utters some arcane syllables, and is gone.
zh_tw: "我們還會再見面的，傻瓜們！"巫妖說道。"到那時，你們將會死去！"說完，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}舉起他的法杖，念出一些神秘的音節，然後就消失了。

english: If the characters succeed in killing {@creature Acererak|ToA} before he has a chance to escape, read:
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}有機會逃跑之前成功殺死他，請閱讀以下內容：

english: A look of horror passes over the lich's face as his body turns to dust. His tattered robes fall to the ground, as do his staff and talisman.
zh_tw: 巫妖的臉上露出驚恐的表情，他的身體化為塵土。他破爛的長袍、法杖和護符都掉落在地上。

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s body reforms near his phylactery, which is hidden in some far-flung demiplane, but his possessions are left behind for the characters to pilfer. The {@item sphere of annihilation} remains stationary until someone takes control of it using the talisman. Because it's not a creature, the sphere is not teleported if it enters the mist gate (see "Mist Gate" above).
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的身體在他的聖物匣附近重新形成，聖物匣隱藏在某個遙遠的半位面中，但他的財物被遺留下來供角色們掠奪。{@item sphere of annihilation||湮滅法球}保持靜止，直到有人使用護符來控制它。因為它不是生物，如果它進入迷霧之門（見上文的"迷霧之門"），湮滅球不會被傳送。

english: 78. Chapel of Hate
zh_tw: 78. 仇恨禮拜堂

english: Any creature that passes through the mist gate in {@area area 77|4fa|x} emerges from a similar arch set into the south wall of this room. The gate also allows travel back to {@area area 77|4fa|x}.
zh_tw: 任何生物透過{@area 區域77|4fa|x}中的迷霧之門，都會從這個房間南牆上的類似拱門中出現。這個門也允許返回到{@area 區域77|4fa|x}。

english: You step out of the mist into an underground chapel with black basalt pillars and a polished obsidian altar. Resting on the altar is a leather bag the size and shape of a human body, and which appears to have been sewn shut. Beyond the altar, a heavy black drape hangs from an archway.
zh_tw: 你從霧中走出，來到一個地下禮拜堂，這裡有黑色的玄武岩柱子和一個拋光過的黑曜石祭壇。祭壇上放著一個皮革袋，大小和形狀像一個人的身體，看起來已經被縫上了。祭壇後面，從拱門上垂掛著一道沉重的黑色簾幕。

english: Eight emaciated, green-skinned creatures are shackled to the walls of the chapel, each one gazing toward you with a single baleful eye. The monsters begin to gibber and drool as they shake their manacles, eager to be set free.
zh_tw: 八個瘦弱的、皮膚呈綠色的生物被鎖在禮拜堂的牆壁上，每一個都用一隻充滿惡意的眼睛凝視著你。這些怪物開始發出尖聲尖叫和流口水，當它們搖晃著鐐銬時，渴望被釋放。

english: Once the atropal has fed on enough souls, {@creature Acererak|ToA} plans to baptize it in the blood of a worthy sacrifice. This chapel was built for that dark ceremony. The Sewn Sisters obtained an appropriate sacrifice and have stitched it inside the leather body bag that rests on the altar.
zh_tw: 一旦萎縮者吸取了足夠多的靈魂，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}計劃用一個值得的祭品的血來給它洗禮。這個禮拜堂就是為了那個黑暗的儀式而建造的。縫製姐妹獲得了一個合適的祭品，並將其縫製在祭壇上休息的皮革人體袋裡。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of Moa or Wongo receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被莫阿或望戈的靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Kind Moa suggests freeing the shackled creatures.
zh_tw: 仁慈的莫阿建議釋放被鎖鏈束縛的生物。

english: Violent Wongo urges his host to stab the body bag, making sure that whatever is inside it is dead.
zh_tw: 暴力的望戈敦促他的宿主刺破那個身體袋，確保裡面的任何東西都死了。

english: Body Bag
zh_tw: 身體袋

english: The leather body bag can be cut open to reveal an {@condition unconscious} prisoner, whose identity is yours to decide. It might be {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA}, {@creature Dragonbait|ToA}, Volothamp Geddarm, or some other NPC the characters never got the chance to meet. It could also be an NPC who became separated from the party in the course of the adventure.
zh_tw: 這個皮革身體袋可以被割開，露出一個{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的囚犯，其身份由你來決定。可能是{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}，{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}，沃洛塔姆·蓋達爾姆，或者是角色們從未有機會遇見的其他NPC。它也可能是在冒險過程中與隊伍失散的NPC。

english: If no suitable NPC springs to mind, use a captured member of the Order of the Gauntlet named Zalder Faelrond (LG male Tethyrian human {@creature knight} of Torm, with no armor or weapons). Zalder's story is that he was kidnapped by the Sewn Sisters while patrolling the jungle. If set free, he requests an escort back to Camp Vengeance (see {@area chapter 2|0cd|x}).
zh_tw: 如果沒有合適的NPC出現在腦海中，可以使用一個名為扎爾德·費爾隆德（LG男性特提裡安人類{@creature knight||騎士}，信仰託姆，沒有盔甲或武器）的被俘獲的鐵手套教團成員。扎爾德的故事是，他在叢林巡邏時被縫製姐妹綁架。如果被釋放，他請求護送他回到復仇營地（見{@area 第二章|0cd|x}）。

english: The night hags' magic keeps the prisoner alive and {@condition unconscious}. With a successful {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Religion}) check, a character determines that the effect can be ended only by splashing the prisoner with holy water.
zh_tw: 夜鬼婆的魔法使囚犯保持存活並{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。透過一次成功的{@dc 17}智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}或{@skill Religion||宗教}）檢定，角色可以確定只有給囚犯潑灑聖水才能結束該效果。

english: Devotees of Acererak
zh_tw: 阿瑟瑞克的信徒

english: The creatures shackled to the chapel walls are eight {@creature Nothic||nothics}—former disciples of {@creature Acererak|ToA} who lost their minds trying to learn their master's arcane secrets. The nothics are {@condition restrained} by the shackles and can't make melee attacks until they are set free. They speak Undercommon and demand to be released.
zh_tw: 鎖在禮拜堂牆上的生物是八隻{@creature Nothic||諾斯怪}，原本都是{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的門徒，卻在鑽研導師的奧術秘密時喪失理智。鐐銬使牠們陷入{@condition restrained||束縛}，在獲釋前無法進行近戰攻擊。牠們會說地底通用語，並要求眾人釋放牠們。

english: The night hag Widow Groat (see {@area area 71|4d8|x}) carries the keys to the nothics' shackles, which can also be picked with a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity check made by a character using {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, or sundered with a good, hard weapon strike.
zh_tw: 夜鬼婆寡婦格羅特（見{@area 區域71|4d8|x}）攜帶著諾提枷鎖的鑰匙，這些枷鎖也可以透過角色使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}成功透過{@dc 13}敏捷檢定撬開，或者用強力武器打擊破壞。

english: If the characters ignore the nothics' demands, the spiteful creatures attack them using their horrid Rotting Gaze. If the characters unshackle them, the nothics loiter in the chapel and leave the party alone. They also provide the following helpful information if their liberators question them:
zh_tw: 如果角色們忽視諾斯的要求，這些懷恨在心的生物將使用他們可怕的腐爛凝視攻擊他們。如果角色們釋放了他們，諾斯會在禮拜堂裡閒逛，並且不會打擾隊伍。如果解放者詢問他們，他們還會提供以下有用的資訊：

english: If the characters are searching for an exit to the tomb, one nothic hops over to the black curtain, pulls it aside, points down the tunnel to the north ({@area area 79|512|x}), and shouts (in Undercommon), "Mind the bones!"
zh_tw: 如果角色們正在尋找通往墓穴的出口，其中一個諾斯怪跳到黑色簾幕旁邊，拉開簾子，指向北方的隧道（{@area 區域79|512|x}），並喊道（用下界語）：'小心骨頭！'

english: If the characters are searching for treasure, another nothic performs the same actions as above, except it shouts, "Follow the purple trail!"
zh_tw: 如果角色們正在尋找寶藏，另一個諾斯怪執行與上述相同的動作，除了它喊道：'跟隨紫色的蹤跡！'

english: 79. Hall of Finality
zh_tw: 79. 最終之廳

english: Behind the curtain is a ten-foot-wide, forty-five-foot-long hallway set with four decorative archways that have blank walls within them. Three paths marked out in red, gold, and purple tile snake along the floor, each leading to one of three archways. A charred skeleton on the floor points to the fourth archway, which has no path leading to it.
zh_tw: 簾子後面是一條十尺寬、四十五尺長的走廊，設有四個裝飾性的拱門，拱門內是空白的牆壁。三條分別用紅色、金色和紫色瓷磚鋪成的小徑蜿蜒穿過地板，每條小徑通向其中一個拱門。地上有一具燒焦的骷髏指向第四個拱門，沒有路徑通向它。

english: A single torch burns in a wall sconce at the far end of the hall. Mounted below it is a bronze plaque that bears a warning in Common: "Behold the fate of those who defy me!"
zh_tw: 走廊盡頭的牆上有一個火把在燃燒。在其下方安裝著一塊銅牌，上面用通用語刻著警告：'看那些違抗我的人的命運！'

english: The torch remains lit and doesn't burn down as long as it remains in this corridor. If taken from the hall, it burns down normally.
zh_tw: 只要火把保持在這個走廊裡，它就會一直亮著並且不會燃燒完。如果從大廳拿走，它就會正常燃燒。

english: Advice from the Spirits
zh_tw: 來自靈魂的建議

english: Any characters inhabited by the spirits of I'jin or Shagambi receive advice when entering this area:
zh_tw: 任何被艾金或莎根比靈魂附身的角色在進入這個區域時會收到建議：

english: Fickle I'jin wants her host to follow the purple-tiled pathway to see where it leads. (Purple is I'jin's favorite color, at least for now.)
zh_tw: 善變的艾金希望她的宿主沿著鋪有紫色瓷磚的小徑走，看看它會通向哪裡。（紫色是艾金目前最喜歡的顏色。）

english: Wise Shagambi urges her host to not stray from the tiled pathways.
zh_tw: 睿智的莎根比敦促她的宿主不要偏離鋪瓷磚的小徑。

english: Charred Skeleton and Secret Door
zh_tw: 焦黑的骷髏和秘密門

english: The charred skeleton points to the arch containing a secret door that slides open to reveal {@area area 81|520|x} beyond.
zh_tw: 燒焦的骷髏指向一個隱藏著秘密門的拱門，門滑開後會顯露出{@area 區域81|520|x}。

english: Glyph of Warding
zh_tw: 守衛刻文

english: Opening the secret door triggers a {@spell glyph of warding} spell, which targets all creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the door. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The triggering glyph is at the bottom right corner of the door and can be found with a successful {@dc 24} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 開啟秘密門會觸發一個 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 法術，該法術以門為中心，針對半徑20尺範圍內的所有生物。該球形區域可以繞過角落擴散。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 24} 敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到22點（{@dice 5d8}）寒冷傷害，豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。觸發刻文位於門的右下角，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 24} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定發現。

english: Wall of Fire
zh_tw: 火牆術

english: When the {@spell glyph of warding} spell activates or is dispelled, a magical wall of fire springs up at the south end of the hallway, setting the black curtain ablaze if it still hangs there. The wall of fire spans the width and height of the hall. Any creature that enters the wall, starts its turn inside the wall, or starts its turn within 5 feet of the north side of the wall takes 22 ({@dice 5d8}) fire damage.
zh_tw: 當{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術被啟用或被解除時，一道魔法火牆會在走廊的南端突然出現，如果黑色的窗簾還掛在那裡，它也會被點燃。火牆橫跨整個大廳的寬度和高度。任何進入火牆的生物，在其內部開始回合的生物，或者在火牆北側5尺內開始回合的生物都會受到22（{@dice 5d8}）點火焰傷害。

english: When the wall of fire appears, all creatures present should roll initiative. Each round on initiative count 15, the wall moves 10 feet northward, stopping only when it reaches 5 feet from the north wall. The wall lasts until there are no creatures in the hallway, or until it is dispelled with a successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 14}).
zh_tw: 當火牆出現時，在場的所有生物都應進行先攻檢定。每輪在先攻值為15時，火牆向北移動10尺，僅在距離北牆5尺時停止。火牆持續存在，直到走廊中沒有生物，或成功使用{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 14}）解除。

english: Golden Trail and Secret Door
zh_tw: 金色小徑和秘密門

english: The trail of gold-colored tiles leads to the archway in the west wall that contains a secret door. Any character wearing the eye-shaped pendant found in {@area area 2|32f|x} can find the secret door without needing to make a check and can open the secret door without setting off the trap (see below). Behind the secret door is a dusty, web-filled hallway filled with sweet {@item dulcimer|PHB} music. The music gets louder as one approaches {@area area 80|51c|x}.
zh_tw: 金色瓷磚的路徑通向西牆上的拱門，那裡藏有一扇密門。任何佩戴在{@area 區域2|32f|x}找到的眼形護符的角色都能無需檢定就發現這扇密門，並且可以觸發陷阱（見下文）的情況下開啟它。密門後是一條佈滿灰塵和蛛網的走廊，裡面迴盪著甜美的{@item dulcimer|PHB|揚琴}樂聲。當接近{@area 區域80|51c|x}時，音樂聲會逐漸變大。

english: Glyph of Warding
zh_tw: 守衛刻文

english: Opening the secret door triggers a {@spell glyph of warding} spell, which targets all creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the door. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The triggering glyph is at the bottom right corner of the door and can be found with a successful {@dc 24} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check.
zh_tw: 開啟秘密門會觸發一個{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術，該法術以門為中心的20尺半徑球體內的所有生物為目標。該球體會繞過角落。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 24}敏捷豁免檢定，失敗則受到22（{@dice 5d8}）點雷鳴傷害，成功則受到一半的傷害。觸發刻文位於門的右下角，可以透過成功的{@dc 24}智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定發現。

english: Purple Trail
zh_tw: 紫色小徑

english: A trail of purple-colored tiles leads to the hall's northernmost arch. If a character walks along the trail without stepping off it, then touches the wall within the archway, the wall takes on the consistency of thick mud for 1 hour. While this effect lasts, any creature that passes through the wall, or any object pushed through the wall, emerges from the back wall of the alcove in {@area area 80|51c|x}.
zh_tw: 一條由紫色瓷磚鋪成的小徑通向大廳最北端的拱門。如果一個角色沿著小徑行走而不踏出界外，然後觸控拱門內的牆壁，牆壁就會變成厚泥狀，持續1小時。在這個效果持續期間，任何穿過牆壁的生物，或者被推進牆壁的物體，都會從{@area 區域80|51c|x}壁龕的後牆出現。

english: Red Trail
zh_tw: 紅色小徑

english: The short trail of red-colored tiles ends in front of the hallway's southernmost arch. A creature that walks along the red trail without ever stepping off of it, then touches the wall within the archway, is pulled into the wall and unceremoniously dumped into {@area area 57|47d|x}.
zh_tw: 紅磚鋪就的小徑在走廊最南端的拱門前結束。沿著紅磚小徑行走且從未離開過它的生物，一旦觸控拱門內的牆壁，就會被吸入牆壁，並被不客氣地扔進{@area 區域57|47d|x}。

english: 80. Red Library
zh_tw: 80. 紅圖書館

english: The characters might arrive here by way of the tunnel to the east, or through the alcove in the southwest corner if they activate the purple-trail archway in {@area area 79|512|x}.
zh_tw: 角色們可能透過東邊的隧道到達這裡，或者如果他們啟用了{@area 區域79|512|x}中的紫色小徑拱門，也可以透過西南角的壁龕來到這裡。

english: Soft {@item dulcimer|PHB} music fills this room, the walls of which are painted the color of dried blood. Bookcases draped in cobwebs and dust line the walls and stand four deep in the middle of the room. Hundreds of leather-bound tomes weigh down their sagging shelves. At one end of the room, a small study contains a padded leather chair, a footstool, and a small table—as well as three corpses dangling upside down from shackles and chains bolted to the ceiling near the north wall. A lantern-shaped device resting atop the table appears to be the source of the music. An old man lies asleep in the chair, his horn-rimmed spectacles slipping down to the end of his nose.
zh_tw: 輕柔的{@item dulcimer|PHB|揚琴}樂聲充滿了這個房間，牆壁被漆成乾涸血液的顏色。佈滿蛛網和灰塵的書架沿牆排列，房間中央還有四排書架。數百本皮革裝訂的典籍壓彎了它們下陷的架子。在房間的一端，一個小書房裡放著一張帶軟墊的皮椅、一個腳凳和一張小桌子——還有三具屍體倒吊在靠近北牆天花板的鐐銬和鎖鏈上。桌上放著一個燈籠形狀的裝置，似乎是音樂的來源。一位老人躺在椅子上睡著了，他的角質框眼鏡滑到了鼻尖。

english: The library contains the collected wisdom of a hundred sages, along with a few spellbooks and scrolls (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 圖書館收藏了一百位智者的感知，以及一些法術書和卷軸（見下文的"寶藏"部分）。

english: The corpses hanging along the north wall are the remains of three archmagi who tried to meddle in {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s affairs. A successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check confirms that all three died within the past month and that destructive spells were the cause of their demise.
zh_tw: 沿著北牆懸掛的屍體是三位試圖干涉 {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克} 事務的大法師的遺骸。一次成功的 {@dc 12} 感知（{@skill Medicine||醫療}）檢定可以確認這三個人都在過去一個月內死亡，而毀滅性法術是他們的死因。

english: The old man sleeping in the chair is an {@creature arcanaloth} under the effect of its {@spell alter self} spell. The fiend has one of the library's spellbooks lying open on its lap and pretends to be asleep. If approached, the man appears to wake and asks, "Why do you disturb me?" The creature won't reveal its true name, instead referring to itself as "Mr. Fox." The arcanaloth is bound to the library by {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s magic and can't leave, nor can it allow any of the library's books or scrolls to be removed.
zh_tw: 坐在椅子上睡覺的老人是一只受到其{@spell alter self||變身術}法術影響的{@creature arcanaloth||奧法羅斯魔}。這個惡魔的腿上攤開著圖書館的一本法術書，假裝在睡覺。如果有人接近，這個人似乎會醒來並問："你為什麼打擾我？"這個生物不會透露它的真實名字，而是自稱為"狐狸先生"。奧法羅斯魔被{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的魔法束縛在圖書館裡，不能離開，也不能允許圖書館的任何書籍或卷軸被拿走。

english: If any character speaks the arcanaloth's true name ("Ygga Raxyg"; see {@area area 71|4d8|x}) within earshot of the fiend, it is {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. Once the {@condition stunned} effect wears off, repeating the arcanaloth's name has no effect on it for the next 24 hours. If killed, the arcanaloth melts into a pool of ichor, leaving behind its robes and horn-rimmed spectacles (see "Treasure" below).
zh_tw: 如果任何角色在惡魔能聽到的範圍內說出了奧法羅斯魔的真實姓名（"伊加·拉希格"；見{@area 區域71|4d8|x}），它將被{@condition stunned||震懾}1分鐘。一旦{@condition stunned||震懾}效果消失，重複說出奧法羅斯魔的名字在接下來的24小時內對它沒有效果。如果被殺死，奧法羅斯魔會融化成一灘粘液，留下它的長袍和角框眼鏡（見下文的"寶藏"）。

english: Alcove
zh_tw: 壁龕

english: The alcove in the southwest corner of the room is empty. If the magic at the end of the purple trail is still active (see {@area area 79|512|x}), the back wall of the alcove has the consistency of thick mud. Any creature that passes through the wall, or any object pushed through the wall, emerges from the northernmost archway in {@area area 79|512|x}.
zh_tw: 房間西南角的壁龕是空的。如果紫色小徑盡頭的魔法仍然處於啟用狀態（見{@area 區域79|512|x}），壁龕的後牆具有濃稠泥漿的一致性。任何穿過牆壁的生物，或者任何被推過牆壁的物體，都會從{@area 區域79|512|x}的最北端拱門出現。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The arcanaloth's horn-rimmed spectacles aren't magical, but they are worth 250 gp. The spectacles are also a gate key that opens a portal in the planar city of Sigil. The portal is a two-way door to the plane of Arcadia. A {@spell legend lore} spell cast on the spectacles reveals this information and raises their potential value to 2,500 gp if they are sold to a wizard or sage.
zh_tw: 這個奧法羅斯魔的角框眼鏡沒有魔法，但它們價值250金幣。眼鏡也是一個門戶鑰匙，可以開啟位於位面城市西吉爾的傳送門。這個傳送門是通往世外桃源位面的雙向門。對眼鏡施放{@spell legend lore||通曉傳奇}法術可以揭示這些資訊，如果將它們賣給法師或賢者，它們的潛在價值可以提升到2500金幣。

english: The object on the table is a music box made of dark wood with gold filigree. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of conjuration magic around it. Each of its five sides is sculpted with the image of a horned woman playing a different {@item musical instrument|PHB}: a {@item dulcimer|PHB}, a {@item flute|PHB}, a harp, a {@item lyre|PHB}, and a {@item viol|PHB}. While touching the box, a creature can use an action to make it play music featuring one of the instruments shown, which can be heard up to 60 feet away. The character can also use an action to stop the music. The music box is worth 750 gp.
zh_tw: 桌上的物品是一個由深色木材與金絲鑲嵌製成的音樂盒。施展{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似效果會顯示其周圍環繞著咒法系魔法靈光。盒子的五個側面各雕刻著一位有角女性演奏不同{@item musical instrument|PHB|樂器}的圖案：分別是{@item dulcimer|PHB|揚琴}、{@item flute|PHB|長笛}、豎琴、{@item lyre|PHB|里拉琴}和{@item viol|PHB|提琴}。當生物接觸音樂盒時，可用一個動作使其演奏展示樂器之一的音樂聲（60尺內可聽聞），亦可用動作停止演奏。該音樂盒價值750金幣。

english: The library contains two hundred historical texts (50 gp each), sixty tomes of arcane lore (100 gp each), three dusty {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell create undead}, {@spell fabricate}, and {@spell resurrection}), and six spellbooks. The first three spellbooks contain {@dice 1d6} spells each of 1st through 3rd level. The fourth and fifth spellbooks contain {@dice 1d4} spells each of 4th through 6th level. The sixth spellbook has a title ({@i X the Mystic's Arcane Grimoire}) burned into its spine and contains {@dice 1d3} spells each of 7th through 9th level.
zh_tw: 這個圖書館包含兩百本歷史文字（每本50金幣），六十本奧術知識書籍（每本100金幣），三卷塵封的{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell create undead||喚起死靈}、{@spell fabricate||鬼斧神工}和{@spell resurrection||復生術}），以及六本法術書。前三本法術書每本包含{@dice 1d6}個1級到3級的法術。第四和第五本法術書每本包含{@dice 1d4}個4級到6級的法術。第六本法術書的書脊上烙有標題（{@i 神秘者X的奧術魔典}），包含{@dice 1d3}個7級到9級的法術。

english: 81. Ebon Pool
zh_tw: 81. 烏木池

english: A pool of jet-black ooze glistens inside this silent chamber, whose walls are decorated with relief carvings depicting black stars.
zh_tw: 這個寂靜的房間內，一池漆黑的軟泥在閃爍，牆壁上裝飾著浮雕雕刻，描繪著黑色的星星。

english: The pool radiates an aura of conjuration magic to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect. Creatures that come into contact with the ooze are unharmed. Any object that isn't being worn or carried by a creature disappears if submerged in the black ooze. Such items are permanently lost, having been transported to a secret demiplane whose location cannot be divined. Any amount of ooze that is removed from the pool disappears instantly.
zh_tw: 這個水池散發出一種召喚魔法的光環，可以透過{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果檢測到。接觸到軟泥的生物不會受到傷害。任何沒有被生物穿戴或攜帶的物品，如果被浸入黑色軟泥中，就會消失。這些物品被永久性地丟失了，因為它們被傳送到了一個秘密的半位面，其位置無法被探測到。從池中移除的任何數量的軟泥會立即消失。

english: Activating the Pool
zh_tw: 啟用水池

english: Peggy Deadbells (in {@area area 71|4d8|x}) and {@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA} (in {@area area 74|4eb|x}) have black marbles in their possession that can be used to activate the pool. If one of these black marbles is tossed into the pool, read:
zh_tw: 佩吉·死鈴（在{@area 區域71|4d8|x}）和{@creature Mister Threadneedle|ToA|針線先生}（在{@area 區域74|4eb|x}）擁有可以用來啟用水池的黑色大理石。如果將這些黑色大理石之一扔進水池，閱讀：

english: The black marble sinks into the ooze, which rises up suddenly to form a four-foot-tall black obelisk—a miniature version of the obelisk that stood outside the tomb entrance.
zh_tw: 黑色大理石沉入軟泥中，軟泥突然升起形成一個四尺高的黑色方尖碑——這是墳墓入口外矗立的方尖碑的微型版本。

english: Any creature that touches the ooze obelisk is teleported, along with all objects it is wearing and carrying, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the obelisk outside the tomb entrance ({@area area 1|32a|x}). This effect is not subject to the magical wards that prevent teleportation spells from functioning within the tomb.
zh_tw: 任何觸控到軟泥方尖碑的生物，連同它穿戴和攜帶的所有物品，都會被傳送到墓穴入口外10尺範圍內的一個未被佔據的空間內（{@area 區域1|32a|x}）。這種效果不受阻止墓穴內傳送法術運作的魔法結界的影響。

english: The ooze obelisk sinks back into the pool and disappears after 1 minute. Tossing another black marble into the pool causes the obelisk to reform.
zh_tw: 軟泥方尖碑在1分鐘後重新沉入水池並消失。再扔一顆黑色大理石到水池中會導致方尖碑重新形成。

english: Conclusion
zh_tw: 結局

english: Destroying the Soulmonger frees the souls trapped inside it and ends {@creature Acererak|ToA}'s death curse. Characters who accomplish this goal will have saved many lives, and if word spreads of their heroism, wealthy and influential NPCs come forward bearing gifts of thanks. These gifts can take many forms, including parcels of land and special favors (see "{@book Marks of Prestige|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}" in chapter 7 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). If the characters allow the atropal to survive in the depths of the tomb, it eventually attracts nihilistic devotees of {@creature Acererak|ToA} who feed it their own dark souls as nourishment.
zh_tw: 摧毀靈魂收割器將釋放其中被困住的靈魂，並結束{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的死亡詛咒。完成這一目標的角色將拯救許多生命，如果他們的英雄事蹟傳播開來，富裕且有影響力的NPC將帶著感謝的禮物前來。這些禮物可以採取多種形式，包括土地和特殊恩惠（見{@book 名望的標誌|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}，位於{@i 城主指南}的第7章）。如果角色們允許萎縮者在墓穴深處存活，它最終將吸引{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}的虛無主義追隨者，他們將用自己的黑暗靈魂餵養它作為養分。

english: Lost Treasures
zh_tw: 失落的寶藏

english: As they explore the tomb, characters are likely to find one or more fabled treasures as well as magic items inhabited by the spirits of Omu's dead trickster gods. What happens to these items when the characters leave the tomb is discussed below.
zh_tw: 當角色探索墓穴時，他們很可能會找到一件或多件傳說中的寶藏，以及被奧穆死去的詭神所居住的魔法物品。當角色離開墓穴時，這些物品會發生什麼情況在下文中討論。

english: Relics of the Past
zh_tw: 過去的聖物

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} placed four treasures in the tomb as lures: the Black Opal Crown, the Eye of Zaltec, the Navel of the Moon, and the Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare. These items can be kept, sold to interested buyers, or returned to their rightful owners.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}在墓穴中放置了四件寶藏作為誘餌：黑蛋白石王冠、扎爾特克之眼、月亮的肚臍和奇加克雷的骷髏聖盃。這些物品可以保留、出售給有興趣的買家，或歸還給它們的合法所有者。

english: Black Opal Crown (Area 49)
zh_tw: 黑蛋白石皇冠（區域49）

english: The yuan-ti of Omu are after this treasure. If they can't wrest it from the characters, they attempt to buy or steal the crown from the individual to whom the characters sell it. Whether the crown has the power to set loose Dendar the Night Serpent is up to you. Should the crown fall into the wrong hands, characters might need to venture into the caverns below the Peaks of Flame to retrieve it before the world ends.
zh_tw: 奧穆的元提族正在尋找這件寶藏。如果他們不能從角色們手中奪走它，他們會試圖從角色們出售給的個人那裡購買或偷走皇冠。皇冠是否擁有釋放夜蛇鄧達爾的力量由你決定。如果皇冠落入錯誤之手，角色們可能需要冒險進入火焰峰下的洞穴，在世界末日之前取回它。

english: Eye of Zaltec (Area 62)
zh_tw: 扎爾特克之眼（區域62）

english: The Company of the Yellow Banner was vanquished trying to obtain this lost jewel, which is rumored to have the power to resurrect the ancient dead. If the Eye of Zaltec indeed has such power, it requires a great many sacrifices to function. Tabaxi thieves might try to steal the jewel and bear it safely back to Maztica, perhaps trading it for the release of enslaved loved ones. Conversely, a villain might buy the jewel and use it to resurrect a dead tyrant, an evil archmage, or some even greater threat.
zh_tw: 黃旗冒險團在試圖獲取這顆失落的寶石時被擊敗，傳說它擁有復活古代死者的力量。如果扎爾特克之眼確實擁有這樣的力量，它需要大量的犧牲才能發揮作用。斑貓人小偷可能會試圖偷走這顆寶石，並安全地帶回馬茲提卡，或許用它交換被奴役的親人的釋放。相反，一個惡棍可能會購買這顆寶石，並用它來復活一個死去的暴君、邪惡的大法師，或者某個更大的威脅。

english: Navel of the Moon (Area 56)
zh_tw: 月亮的肚臍（區域56）

english: If the characters try to sell this stone in Baldur's Gate, Port Nyanzaru, or some other city, word of the sale quickly reaches the spies of wealthy Calishite merchants. A bidding war might ensue, or assassins might be sent to retrieve the stone and quietly dispose of its new owner. Whether the stone has its purported power to reunite families separated by time and fate is entirely up to you.
zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖在博德之門、南扎路港或其它城市出售這塊石頭，有關銷售的訊息很快就會傳到富有的卡利什商人的間諜耳中。可能會引發一場競購戰，或者派出刺客去取回石頭，並悄無聲息地處理掉它的新主人。這塊石頭是否具有傳說中讓時間和命運分離的家庭重聚的力量，完全取決於你。

english: Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare (Area 67)
zh_tw: 奇加克雷的骷髏聖盃（區域67）

english: Princess Mwaxanaré can't afford to pay characters what this treasure is worth, and she will despise them for selling it to someone else. Three of Port Nyanzaru's merchant princes express interest in buying the chalice: {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} wants to add it to his private collection of Chultan relics, Kwayothé wants to melt it down, and {@creature Zhanthi|ToA} wants it for sentimental reasons. Denying any one of them would be a grave mistake on the characters' part and might result in them receiving an ominous Ytepka Society token.
zh_tw: 姆瓦克絲娜瑞公主無法支付這些寶藏的價值，並且如果角色將其出售給別人，她會對他們心生怨恨。南扎路港的三位商王對購買這個聖盃表示興趣：{@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}想將其新增到他的楚爾特文物私人收藏中，克薇歐澤想將其熔化，而{@creature Zhanthi|ToA|絳則}出於情感原因想要它。拒絕他們的任何一人對角色來說都將是一個嚴重的錯誤，並可能導致他們收到一個不祥的伊特帕卡社會令牌。

english: Magic Items of the Trickster Gods
zh_tw: 詭神的魔法物品

english: Certain magic items—specifically those in which the spirits of the nine trickster gods reside—turn to dust and are destroyed as soon as they exit the tomb. These items include Obo'laka's {@item ring of protection} ({@area area 10|356|x}), Moa's {@item staff of the python} ({@area area 14|364|x}), Wongo's {@item mace of terror} ({@area area 16|36f|x}), Papazotl's {@item amulet of health} ({@area area 22|38a|x}), Nangnang's egg-shaped {@item pearl of power} ({@area area 24|398|x}), I'jin's horn-shaped {@item wand of wonder} ({@area area 35|3d0|x}), Kubazan's {@item bracers of archery} ({@area area 42|3fc|x}), Shagambi's {@item instrument of the bards} ({@area area 48|438|x}), and Unkh's {@item robe of scintillating colors} ({@area area 55|465|x}).
zh_tw: 某些魔法物品——特別是那些居住著九位詭神靈魂的物品——一旦離開墳墓就會化為灰燼並被摧毀。這些物品包括奧博娜卡的 {@item ring of protection||防護戒指} ({@area 區域10|356|x})，莫阿的 {@item staff of the python||巨蟒法杖} ({@area 區域14|364|x})，望戈的 {@item mace of terror||恐懼之錘} ({@area 區域16|36f|x})，帕帕扎圖的 {@item amulet of health||健康護符} ({@area 區域22|38a|x})，娜浪的蛋形 {@item pearl of power||法力再生珍珠} ({@area 區域24|398|x})，艾金號形的 {@item wand of wonder||驚異魔杖} ({@area 區域35|3d0|x})，庫巴贊的 {@item bracers of archery||射手護腕} ({@area 區域42|3fc|x})，莎根比的 {@item instrument of the bards||吟遊詩人樂器} ({@area 區域48|438|x})，以及安珂的 {@item robe of scintillating colors||虹光法袍} ({@area 區域55|465|x})。

english: If, in your estimation, a player did an extraordinary job roleplaying a trickster god's flaw, the god's spirit might reward that player's character by allowing its magic item to exist outside the tomb, provided that character is attuned to the item when it leaves the tomb.
zh_tw: 如果您認為，某位玩家在扮演詭神的缺陷方面做得非常出色，這位神明的靈魂可能會獎勵該玩家的角色，允許它的魔法物品存在於墓穴之外，前提是當角色離開墓穴時，他與物品已經調諧。

english: Syndra's Fate
zh_tw: 辛德拉的命運

english: Characters who survive the Tomb of the Nine Gods won't know the fate of {@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA} until they return to Port Nyanzaru, use a spell such as {@spell scrying} to spy on her, or reach out to her with a {@spell sending} spell or similar magic. If the characters destroy the Soulmonger and Syndra is still alive, priests quickly restore her to full health, and the characters can collect their promised reward. If Syndra dies but her soul is saved before the atropal devours it, she is raised from the dead within a tenday of the Soulmonger's destruction and honors her agreement with the party. In the event that Syndra dies and her soul is devoured, her body lies in state pending a funeral and proper burial.
zh_tw: 倖存於九神之墓的角色們在返回南扎路港、使用如{@spell scrying||探知術}法術監視她，或透過{@spell sending||短訊術}法術或類似魔法與她聯絡之前，不會知道{@creature Syndra Silvane|ToA|辛德拉·席爾瓦因}的命運。如果角色們摧毀了噬魂器而辛德拉還活著，祭司們會迅速恢復她的健康，角色們可以領取他們承諾的獎勵。如果辛德拉死了，但她的靈魂在萎縮者吞噬之前被救出，她會在噬魂器被摧毀後的十天內復活，並履行她與隊伍的協議。如果辛德拉死了，她的靈魂被吞噬，她的遺體將等待葬禮和適當的安葬。

english: Artus and the Ring of Winter
zh_tw: 阿圖斯和寒冬之戒

english: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} is unwilling to part with {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. He is justifiably concerned that the ring would dominate and control any other owner. Furthermore, Artus would begin to age as a normal human without the ring, and he wants to live forever with his beloved Alisanda.
zh_tw: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾} 不願意放棄 {@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。他有理由擔心這枚戒指會支配和控制任何其他擁有者。此外，如果沒有戒指，阿圖斯將作為一個正常人類開始衰老，他希望與他心愛的阿莉桑德拉永生。

english: {@creature Xandala|ToA}, the Harpers, the Zhentarim, and frost giants loyal to Jarl Storvald won't stop searching for the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. If the characters make their way back to civilization with Artus in tow, they should encounter one or more of these groups along the way. {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} and the Red Wizards of Thay also won't pass up a chance to take the ring by force.
zh_tw: {@creature Xandala|ToA|藏妲拉}、豎琴手聯盟、忠於領主 斯托瓦爾德的霜巨人以及散塔林會不會停止尋找{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。如果角色們帶著阿圖斯回到文明世界，他們應該在路上遇到這些團體中的一個或多個。{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}和賽爾的紅袍法師也不會錯過用武力奪取戒指的機會。

english: With or without the ring, {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} continues to await Mezro's return while searching for the means to reach or summon the displaced city. Nothing matters to him more than reuniting with his wife. Characters interested in helping Artus can use divination spells or downtime to conduct research. They might also consult with the Harpers, who have access to lore that might assist Artus in his quest, but they demand the ring in exchange for their assistance. Forced to choose between the Harpers' assistance and the ring, Artus chooses the latter. Alternatively, a portal to Mezro's demiplane might be hidden somewhere in Chult, creating the seeds of a wonderful new adventure.
zh_tw: 無論是否擁有戒指，{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾} 繼續等待梅茲羅的歸來，同時尋找到達或召喚這個流離失所城市的方法。沒有什麼比與他的妻子團聚更重要了。有興趣幫助阿圖斯的角色可以使用占卜法術或在閒暇時間進行研究。他們也可以與豎琴手聯盟協商，豎琴手聯盟可以接觸到可能幫助阿圖斯完成任務的傳說，但他們要求以戒指作為交換。在豎琴手聯盟的幫助和戒指之間做出選擇時，阿圖斯選擇了後者。或者，通往梅茲羅半位面的傳送門可能隱藏在楚爾特的某個地方，為一個精彩的新冒險播下了種子。

english: Dragonbait
zh_tw: 龍餌

english: If he's with the characters when they escape from the Tomb of the Nine Gods, {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} is eager to put Omu and this adventure behind him. As long as {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} is alive, {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} remains committed to helping his friend find the displaced city of Mezro. If Artus is dead and there's no hope of raising him, {@creature Dragonbait|ToA} opts to return to Port Nyanzaru, where he drowns his sorrows in a few casks of tej before enjoying some downtime. The saurial gives off the scent of roses as he waves farewell to the party. He eventually crosses paths with Volothamp Geddarm, and the two explorers embark on numerous adventures together.
zh_tw: 如果他和角色們一起從九神之墓逃脫，{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}渴望把奧穆和這次冒險拋在身後。只要{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}還活著，{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}就仍然致力於幫助他的朋友找到流離失所的梅茲羅城。如果阿圖斯死了，沒有復活的希望，{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}選擇返回南扎路港，在那裡他先在幾桶特吉酒中沉溺於悲傷，然後享受一些休息時間。這位蜥蜴人揮別隊伍時散發出玫瑰的香味。他最終與沃洛桑普·格達爾姆相遇，兩位探險家一起踏上了無數次的冒險之旅。

english: Omu
zh_tw: 奧穆

english: Unless the characters cleared out the Fane of the Night Serpent, Omu remains in the clutches of the yuan-ti. If {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} is still alive, he has no further use for the characters once the death curse is ended. Believing they know too much for their own good, he sends a party of yuan-ti to capture or kill them before they leave the city. If the party obtained the Black Opal Crown, they can trade the item for their lives.
zh_tw: 除非角色們清除了夜蛇神殿，否則奧穆仍然處於元提族的控制之下。如果{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}仍然活著，一旦死亡詛咒結束，他對角色們就再也沒有用處了。他認為角色們知道得太多，對他們自己沒有好處，於是派遣一隊元提族去捕捉或殺死他們，阻止他們離開城市。如果隊伍獲得了黑蛋白石皇冠，他們可以用這件物品來換取他們的生命。

english: If {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} lives, {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} makes the mistake of putting her in charge of the team sent to kill the characters, and she offers the party a deal instead. If the characters agree to kill {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}, they can go free and keep whatever treasure they take from the fane except for the Black Opal Crown, which {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} insists be given to her at once. If the characters defeat {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} handily, {@creature Fenthaza|ToA} honors her end of the deal. If they emerge from the fane weakened, she tries to destroy them.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}還活著，{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}犯了一個錯誤，讓她負責帶領團隊去殺死角色們，而她反而向隊伍提出了一個交易。如果角色們同意殺死{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，他們可以自由離開，並保留他們從神殿中拿走的任何寶藏，除了黑蛋白石王冠，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}堅持要求立即交給她。如果角色們輕易擊敗了{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}，{@creature Fenthaza|ToA|芬薩札}會履行她的交易承諾。如果他們從神殿中虛弱地出現，她會嘗試摧毀他們。

english: Princess Mwaxanaré wants to restore Omu to its former glory and build a new kingdom there. With the Skull Chalice of Ch'gakare in her possession, she can win the support of Chultans eager to return to the old ways. However, the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru aren't willing to back her claim, and the yuan-ti won't give up Omu without a fight. It could take years for Mwaxanaré's dream to come true, if it ever does.
zh_tw: 公主姆瓦克絲娜瑞希望恢復奧穆的昔日輝煌，並在那裡建立一個新的王國。擁有查加卡雷的骷髏杯，她可以贏得渴望迴歸舊日方式的楚爾特人的支援。然而，南扎路港的商王並不願意支援她的主張，元提族也不會不戰而放棄奧穆。姆瓦克絲娜瑞的夢想可能需要多年才能實現，如果真能實現的話。

english: Red Wizards of Thay
zh_tw: 泰伊紅袍法師

english: News of the Soulmonger's destruction annoys {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA}. Using her {@spell teleportation circle}, she returns to Thay and informs Szass Tam that her mission in Chult has failed. Angered by the party's interference, Szass Tam sends new operatives and powerful undead to spy on the characters, learn their weaknesses, and (eventually) dispose of them. If the characters have friendly ties to the Harpers or the Zhentarim, spies working for one faction or the other learn of the Red Wizard plot and can warn the characters.
zh_tw: 噬魂器的毀滅讓{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}感到惱怒。她使用她的{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}返回泰雅，並通知薩扎斯坦她在楚爾特的任務失敗了。薩扎斯坦因隊伍的幹預而憤怒，派遣新的特工和強大的不死生物去監視角色們，瞭解他們的弱點，並（最終）除掉他們。如果角色們與豎琴手聯盟或散塔林會有友好關係，為其中一個派系工作的間諜會瞭解到紅袍法師的陰謀，並可以警告角色們。

english: Acererak the Eternal
zh_tw: 永恆之阿瑟瑞克

english: {@creature Acererak|ToA} keeps his phylactery hidden, and neither gods nor spells can divine its location. If his physical body is destroyed, {@creature Acererak|ToA} reforms next to his phylactery in {@dice 1d10} days. The archlich isn't quick to avenge his defeat. He prefers to let time—his most powerful ally—slay the adventurers. Once they're dead and gone, he sets out to make life miserable for their descendants.
zh_tw: {@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}將自己的護身符隱藏起來，無論是神明還是法術都無法探知其位置。如果他的物理身體被摧毀，{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}將在{@dice 1d10}天后在他的護身符旁重新形成。這位巫妖並不急於報復失敗。他更願意讓時間——他最強大的盟友——來消滅冒險者。一旦他們死去並消失，他就會出發讓他的後代生活變得痛苦。

english: More Adventures
zh_tw: 更多冒險

english: This concludes {@i Tomb of Annihilation}. Space limitations preclude us from exploring Chult in its entirety, but you can create your own Chult-based adventures and publish them at the Dungeon Masters Guild ({@link www.dmsguild.com|https://www.dmsguild.com}).
zh_tw: 這標誌著《{@i 湮滅之墓}》的結束。由於篇幅限制，我們無法完整探索楚爾特，但您可以建立自己的基於楚爾特的冒險，並在地下城主公會（{@link www.dmsguild.com|https://www.dmsguild.com}）上釋出。

zh_tw: 附錄A：角色背景

zh_tw: 在建立角色時，玩家可以在您的批准下為他們的角色選擇以下背景。這些背景適用於與發現和探索異國文化和失落文明相關的任何角色或戰役。

english: Appendix B: Random Encounters
zh_tw: 附錄B：隨機遭遇

english: Random encounters can occur in Port Nyanzaru, in the wilds of Chult, and in Omu. Such encounters add mystery and atmosphere to the adventure, even as they increase tension by winnowing away at the party's resources. Random encounters are best used whenever there's a lull in the game session or when your players seem restless. No more than one or two per session is recommended, since overusing random encounters can bog down the adventure and cause the players to lose track of the story.
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇可能發生在南扎路港、楚爾特的荒野以及奧穆。這些遭遇為冒險增添了神秘感和氛圍，同時透過減少隊伍的資源，增加了緊張感。當遊戲會話中出現空檔或玩家顯得焦躁不安時，使用隨機遭遇最為合適。建議每場遊戲會話中不要超過一兩次隨機遭遇，因為過度使用隨機遭遇可能會拖慢冒險節奏，導致玩家失去對故事的跟蹤。

english: Port Nyanzaru Encounters
zh_tw: 南扎路港遭遇

english: Port Nyanzaru has a lot going on even without random encounters, but if the characters spend time exploring the city, a few random incidents can help bring that experience to life. Roll a {@dice d20} three times per day of game time, checking for encounters each morning, afternoon, and evening or night. An encounter occurs on a roll of 16 or higher. Roll a {@dice d20} and check the {@table Port Nyanzaru Encounters|ToA} table to determine what the characters encounter, or simply choose an encounter you like.
zh_tw: 南扎路港即使沒有隨機遭遇也充滿活力，但如果角色們花時間探索這座城市，一些隨機事件能讓體驗更加生動。每遊戲日投擲{@dice d20}三次（分別對應早晨、下午和傍晚/夜晚時段），當骰值為16或更高時觸發遭遇。投擲{@dice d20}並查閱{@table Port Nyanzaru Encounters|ToA|南扎路港遭遇}決定遭遇內容，或直接選擇你喜歡的遭遇。

english: Port Nyanzaru Encounters
zh_tw: 南扎路港遭遇

english: Encounter
zh_tw: 遭遇

english: A parrot poops on a random character's head.
zh_tw: 一隻鸚鵡在隨機角色的頭上拉屎。

english: Near the harbor, an {@creature ankylosaurus} that tows boats through the warehouse canals goes on a rampage and must be calmed, restrained, or killed.
zh_tw: 在港口附近，一隻牽引船隻穿過倉庫運河的{@creature ankylosaurus||甲龍}開始發狂，必須被平息、控制或殺死。

english: A merchant shouts, "Stop! Thief!" as a furtive youngster ({@creature commoner}) rushes past the characters. If the thief is caught, the grateful merchant can introduce characters to a merchant prince or provide them one other favor.
zh_tw: 一位商人大喊："停下！小偷！"一個偷偷摸摸的年輕人（{@creature commoner||平民}）從角色們身邊衝過。如果小偷被抓住，感激的商人可以向角色們介紹一位商王或為他們提供另一個幫助。

english: A drunk foreign sailor (unarmored {@creature veteran}) is loudly trying to pick a fight with three local {@creature commoner||commoners}, who are clearly no match for the lout. If the characters intervene, the grateful locals become a reliable source of information about Port Nyanzaru, but the sailor and his shipmates ambush the characters elsewhere in the city later on.
zh_tw: 一個醉酒的外國水手（未穿戴盔甲的{@creature veteran||老兵}）正在大聲挑釁三個當地{@creature commoner||平民}，他們顯然不是這個惡棍的對手。如果角色們介入，感激的當地人將成為關於南扎路港的可靠資訊來源，但水手和他的船員們稍後會在城市的其他地方伏擊角色們。

english: A beggar ({@creature commoner}) grabs a character by the arm and shouts, "The ancient one beneath the Forbidden City gives birth to a terrible new god! The snake-men know! They know!" Then he stumbles away into the crowd. Passersby tell the adventurers to ignore the beggar, and that his predictions are wrong most of the time.
zh_tw: 一個乞丐（{@creature commoner||平民}）抓住一個角色的手臂並大喊："禁城下古老的存在生下了一個可怕的新神！蛇人知道！他們知道！"然後他跌跌撞撞地走進人群。路人告訴冒險者們忽略這個乞丐，他大部分時間的預言都是錯誤的。

english: Alarm horns declare that undead are attacking Malar's Throat. Mercenaries keep the monsters out of the city proper, but people are trapped in the temple of Tymora and besieged by {@dice 2d6} {@creature zombie||zombies} and {@dice 2d6} {@creature skeleton||skeletons} led by a {@creature ghoul}. If the characters defeat the undead, the temple rewards them with 5 gallons of tej and a {@item potion of healing}.
zh_tw: 警報號角宣告不死生物正在攻擊瑪拉之喉。僱傭兵阻止怪物進入城市中心，但人們被困在泰摩拉的神殿中，並遭到由一隻{@creature ghoul||食屍鬼}帶領的{@dice 2d6}只{@creature zombie||喪屍}和{@dice 2d6}只{@creature skeleton||骷髏}圍攻。如果角色們擊敗了不死生物，神殿將獎勵他們5加侖的蜂蜜酒和一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}。

english: Shouts of "Look out!" give a character a brief warning as a water barrel, building stone, or other heavy weight crashes down. The character must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or be struck, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) bludgeoning damage. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check spots a disguised {@creature yuan-ti pureblood} slinking away from the scene.
zh_tw: 當水桶、建築石材或其他重物墜落時，"小心！"的喊聲會給角色一個短暫警告。該角色必須透過一次{@dc 12}敏捷豁免，否則將被擊中並受到14（{@damage 4d6}）點鈍擊傷害。任何透過{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定的角色會發現一名偽裝的{@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}正從現場溜走。

english: A {@creature tabaxi minstrel|ToA} asks one of the characters for a gold piece to stake her for gambling, promising to pay it back. If the character agrees, the tabaxi makes good on her promise the next day, returning a pouch containing 10 gp.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature tabaxi minstrel|ToA|斑貓詩人}向角色之一請求一枚金幣作為賭博的本金，並承諾會償還。如果角色同意，斑貓人第二天會履行她的承諾，歸還一個裝有10金幣的小袋。

english: A thief ({@creature spy}) tries to pick the pocket of one of the characters.
zh_tw: 一個小偷（{@creature spy||間諜}）試圖扒竊其中一名角色的口袋。

english: The characters run into {@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|Volothamp Geddarm}, who is delivering a copy of his new book to one of the city's merchant princes. There is a {@chance 50} chance that Volo is drunk.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|瓦羅贊普·格達姆}，他正在向城市的一位商王遞送他的新書。有{@chance 50}的機率沃羅是喝醉的。

english: The characters meet an NPC with a side quest
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一個帶有支線任務的NPC

english: Wilderness Encounters
zh_tw: 野外遭遇

english: While the characters are exploring or camping in the wilderness, roll a {@dice d20} three times per day of game time, checking for encounters each morning, afternoon, and evening or night. An encounter occurs on a roll of 16 or higher. Roll percentile dice and check the {@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA} table for the terrain appropriate to where the characters are. After determining what the characters encounter, you can use the information presented later in this appendix to bring the encounter to life.
zh_tw: 當角色們在荒野中探索或露營時，每個遊戲日需投擲{@dice d20}三次，分別檢查早晨、下午和傍晚或夜晚是否遭遇事件。擲出16或更高時即發生遭遇。隨後投擲百分骰並參照{@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA|野外遭遇}中與角色所處地形相符的表格。確定遭遇內容後，你可使用本附錄後續提供的資訊來生動呈現這次遭遇。

english: The maps of Chult have regions marked as undead territory (lesser or greater). The {@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA} table has separate columns you should use when determining encounters in these undead-infested regions, or in regions with no undead.
zh_tw: 楚爾特的地圖上標有亡靈領地（較小或較大）。{@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA|野外遭遇}表格中有單獨的列，用於在這些亡靈肆虐的區域或無亡靈區域中確定遭遇。

english: If your players tire of random encounters, make such encounters less common by having them occur on a roll of 18 or higher, or only 20. You can also let the players narrate their way through avoiding easy encounters, or you can increase the difficulty of easy encounters to keep them exciting. One way to make an encounter more challenging is to have it trigger a second random encounter. For example, a fight with goblins might attract a nearby pack of ghouls or dinosaurs. You can also shorten encounters by having monsters flee when they lose the tactical advantage or most of their hit points.
zh_tw: 如果您的玩家對隨機遭遇感到厭煩，可以透過讓它們在18或更高點數時出現，或者僅在20點時出現，使這類遭遇變得不那麼常見。您也可以讓玩家透過敘述他們如何避免簡單的遭遇，或者您可以增加簡單遭遇的難度以保持它們的興奮性。使遭遇更具挑戰性的一種方法是讓它觸發第二個隨機遭遇。例如，與地精的戰鬥可能會吸引附近的一群食屍鬼或恐龍。當怪物失去戰術優勢或大部分生命值時，您也可以透過讓它們逃跑來縮短遭遇。

english: Random encounters aren't tailored to characters of a particular level. If the characters encounter hostile creatures beyond their ability to defeat, give them opportunities to run, hide, negotiate, or otherwise avoid certain death. You can also have other creatures arrive and provide a distraction that the characters can use to make their escape. For example, if a character needs to make a crucial ability check or saving throw, you can have a {@creature chwinga|ToA} appear, cast {@spell guidance} or {@spell resistance} on the character, and then disappear on its next turn.
zh_tw: 隨機遭遇並不針對特定等級的角色量身定製。如果角色們遇到了他們無法擊敗的敵對生物，給他們機會逃跑、隱藏、談判或以其他方式避免必死無疑。你也可以讓其他生物到達並提供一個分心，角色們可以利用這個分心來逃脫。例如，如果一個角色需要進行關鍵的屬性檢定或豁免檢定，你可以讓一個{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}出現，在角色身上施放{@spell guidance||神導術}或{@spell resistance||抗性}，然後在它的下一個回合消失。

english: Aarakocra
zh_tw: 鳥羽人

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 15 or higher spots {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature aarakocra} flying overhead. These creatures are scouts from Kir Sabal or another aerie. They observe the party from a safe distance but don't approach unless the characters demonstrate peaceful intentions. The bird folk are friendly and can point characters in the direction of nearby landmarks.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到15或更高的角色會發現{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature aarakocra||鳥羽人}從頭頂飛過。這些生物是來自基爾薩巴爾或其他鷹巢的偵察兵。它們會保持安全距離觀察隊伍，除非角色表現出和平意圖，否則不會靠近。這些鳥人族很友好，可以為角色指引附近地標的方向。

english: Albino Dwarves
zh_tw: 白矮人

english: The characters are ambushed by {@dice 1d4 + 3} {@creature albino dwarf warrior|ToA|albino dwarf warriors} that attack from hidden burrows. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 13 or higher spots the dwarves, but all others are {@status surprised}. The dwarves knock characters out rather than killing them, stealing food, water, and gear from those rendered {@condition unconscious}. They break off their attack if any character speaks {@language Dwarvish|PHB} to them or demonstrates peaceful intentions.
zh_tw: 角色們遭到{@dice 1d4 + 3}個{@creature albino dwarf warrior|ToA|白矮人武者}的伏擊，這些敵人從隱蔽的地洞發起攻擊。被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到13或更高的角色能發現這些矮人，其餘角色則陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。矮人們會擊暈而非殺死角色，並從那些陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態的受害者身上偷取食物、飲水和裝備。若有角色用{@language Dwarvish|PHB|矮人語}與他們交談或表現出和平意圖，矮人就會停止攻擊。

english: Aldani
zh_tw: 龍蝦人

english: The characters are shadowed by {@dice 1d4} {@creature Aldani (Lobsterfolk)|ToA|aldani}, which are noticed by any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher. The aldani don't communicate with others unless they must, and they won't fight unless the characters refuse to take a bribe to leave the area. The aldani will aid the characters only if they're offered something of great value in return—for example, an offer to drive off a pack of predatory dinosaurs encroaching on their territory.
zh_tw: 角色們被{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Aldani (Lobsterfolk)|ToA|龍蝦人}跟蹤，任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高的角色都會注意到它們。除非迫不得已，阿爾達尼不會與他人交流，而且除非角色們拒絕接受賄賂離開該區域，否則它們不會戰鬥。只有角色們提供極具價值的回報時——例如承諾驅趕一群侵入它們領地的掠食性恐龍——阿爾達尼才會幫助角色們。

english: Almiraj
zh_tw: 獨角兔

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher spots {@dice 1d6} {@creature almiraj|ToA} 60 feet away. The almiraj run from any creature that they can see within 30 feet of them. Any character who successfully traps an almiraj can use an action to make a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|PHB}) check. If the check succeeds, the almiraj becomes calm and doesn't attack the character or run away unless it feels threatened or is harmed.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高的角色可以發現60尺外的{@dice 1d6}只{@creature almiraj|ToA|獨角兔}。這些獨角兔會從任何它們能看到的30尺範圍內的生物身邊逃跑。任何成功捕獲獨角兔的角色可以用一個動作進行一次{@dc 14}感知（{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}）檢定。若檢定成功，獨角兔會變得平靜，不會攻擊該角色或逃跑，除非它感到受威脅或受到傷害。

english: Apes
zh_tw: 猿

english: The characters stumble upon {@dice 2d4} {@creature ape||apes} enjoying some excellent fruit. The apes feel threatened and show signs of defending their food. If the characters immediately back away slowly, the apes do nothing but make threatening displays. Otherwise, they attack.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現 {@dice 2d4} 只 {@creature ape||猿} 正在享用美味的水果。這些猿類感到受到威脅，並表現出保護食物的跡象。如果角色們立即緩慢後退，猿類只會做出威脅姿態而不採取行動。否則，它們會發動攻擊。

english: Artus Cimber
zh_tw: 阿圖斯·辛貝爾

english: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} (with or without his saurial traveling companion, {@creature Dragonbait|ToA}) can be encountered almost anywhere. See appendix D for more information on these NPCs. The characters might stumble into Artus's camp in the evening, or he might walk into theirs. They could find him at the camp of another group of explorers, or telling a story to {@creature Dragonbait|ToA}. He could appear out of nowhere and use the powers of the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA} to help characters caught up in a tough encounter.
zh_tw: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}（無論是否與他的蜥蜴類旅行伴侶，{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}一起）幾乎可以在任何地方遇到。有關這些NPC的更多資訊，請參見附錄D。角色們可能會在晚上偶然發現阿圖斯的營地，或者他可能會走進他們的營地。他們可能在另一群探險者的營地中找到他，或者看到他在給{@creature Dragonbait|ToA|龍餌}講故事。他可能會突然出現，並使用{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}的力量幫助陷入困境的角色。

english: Assassin Vines
zh_tw: 刺客藤蔓

english: The characters unwittingly enter the hunting grounds of {@dice 1d3} {@creature assassin vine|ToA|assassin vines}. The vines are indistinguishable from normal plants and can't be spotted with Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) checks. However, they draw carrion to their roots, so characters might smell a dead body nearby. Because assassin vines can move, an encounter in the evening or at night might involve the vines creeping into the characters' camp and strangling them as they sleep.
zh_tw: 角色們無意間闖入了{@dice 1d3}株{@creature assassin vine|ToA|刺客藤}的獵場。這些藤蔓與普通植物難以區分，無法透過感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定發現。但它們會將腐肉吸引至根部，因此角色們可能會聞到附近有屍體。由於刺客藤能夠移動，在傍晚或夜間遭遇時，藤蔓可能會潛入角色們的營地，在他們熟睡時將其勒斃。

english: Axe Beaks
zh_tw: 斧嘴鳥們

english: A flock of {@dice 1d6 + 3} {@creature axe beak||axe beaks} stampede through the characters. The characters can hear the birds charging toward them but can't see anything through the thick undergrowth until the axe beaks burst forth and attack, slashing at anyone they can reach.
zh_tw: 一群數量為{@dice 1d6 + 3}的{@creature axe beak||斧嘴鳥}從角色中踐踏而過。角色們能聽到這些鳥類向他們衝來的聲音，但由於茂密的灌木叢遮擋視線，直到斧喙鳥突然出現併發起攻擊時才能看見它們，它們會劈砍任何能夠觸及的目標。

english: Baboons
zh_tw: 狒狒

english: A pack of {@dice 3d6} {@creature baboon||baboons} take umbrage at the characters' intrusion. The baboons can be distracted by tossing each of them a day's supply of food. Otherwise, they attack.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 3d6}只{@creature baboon||狒狒}對角色們的闖入感到憤怒。可以透過給每隻狒狒投餵一天的食物來分散它們的注意力，否則它們會發動攻擊。

english: Cache
zh_tw: 儲藏處

english: The party finds a cache of supplies left behind by other explorers. There's no way to tell from the cache whether those who left it are still alive and coming back for it, or dead. Roll a {@dice d20} and consult the {@table Caches|ToA} table to determine what the characters find.
zh_tw: 隊伍發現了其他探險者留下的物資儲備。從這些物資無法判斷留下它們的人是仍然活著並會回來取，還是已經死亡。擲一次{@dice d20}並查閱{@table Caches|ToA|貯藏}來決定角色們發現了什麼。
