english: Chultan cannibals prowl the jungles in small groups, killing and eating zombies while avoiding faster, more dangerous undead. Abandoned by their gods, the cannibals have turned to the worship of Dendar the Night Serpent and pay tribute to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA} in exchange for his favor and protection. They paint a blue triangle ({@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s symbol) on their foreheads as proof of their devotion and are known to venture into Omu to hunt and deliver tribute.
zh_tw: 楚爾特食人族在小團體中徘徊在叢林中，殺害並吃掉殭屍，同時避開更快、更危險的不死生物。被他們的神明拋棄後，這些食人族轉而崇拜夜蛇登達爾，並以朝拜 {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 來換取他的寵愛和保護。他們將藍色三角形（{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯} 的象徵）塗在額頭上作為他們忠誠的證明，並且眾所周知會冒險進入奧穆狩獵並獻上貢品。

english: If this encounter occurs during the day, the characters spot {@dice 3d6} {@creature tribal warrior||tribal warriors} feeding on the rotting remains of a dismembered zombie. If the characters remain quiet and keep their distance, they can move away without being noticed by the cannibals.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在白天，角色們會發現{@dice 3d6}名{@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}正在啃食一具被肢解殭屍的腐爛殘骸。如果角色保持安靜並保持距離，他們可以悄悄離開而不被這些食人族發現。

english: If this encounter occurs at night, {@dice 3d6} {@creature tribal warrior||tribal warriors} try to sneak into the adventurers' camp and murder them. Any character on guard is warned of the attack with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在夜晚，{@dice 3d6}名{@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}會試圖潛入冒險者的營地並殺害他們。任何站崗的角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定來獲得襲擊警告。

english: Chwinga
zh_tw: 怯蘊阿靈

english: A {@creature chwinga|ToA} takes an interest in the characters. It attempts to steal something valuable from an unguarded pack or canoe, but is noticed by any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 17 or higher. The chwinga always leaves something else in exchange: a pretty shell, a handful of nuts, or an uncut gemstone (10 gp).
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature chwinga|ToA|怯蘊阿靈}對角色們產生了興趣。它試圖從無人看管的揹包或獨木舟中偷走一件貴重物品，但會被任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到17或更高的角色發現。怯蘊阿靈總會留下其他東西作為交換：一個漂亮的貝殼、一把堅果或一顆未切割的寶石（價值10金幣）。

english: Crocodiles
zh_tw: 鱷魚

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher sees and hears {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature crocodile||crocodiles} moments before they attack; all other characters are {@status surprised}. A crocodile can capsize a canoe and throw its occupants into the water by using its action and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）值達到12或更高的角色會在{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature crocodile||鱷魚}發動攻擊前發現它們；其他所有角色將陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。鱷魚可以用它的動作並透過一次{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics|PHB|運動}）檢定來掀翻獨木舟，將乘員拋入水中。

english: Cyclops
zh_tw: 獨眼巨人

english: A {@creature cyclops} is journeying toward its home near Snapping Turtle Bay. It isn't looking for a fight, but any sudden moves or hostility from the characters might trigger one. The cyclops knows the region around Lake Luo and the western end of the Valley of Dread quite well, and it's never seen anything like Omu in those areas.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature cyclops||獨眼巨人}正在前往位於快咬龜灣附近的家。它並不在尋找戰鬥，但是角色們的任何突然舉動或敵意都可能引發戰鬥。這個獨眼巨人對羅湖周圍的地區以及恐懼之谷西端非常熟悉，它從未在那些地區見過像奧穆這樣的東西。

english: Roll twice on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to see what treasure, if any, the cyclops has.
zh_tw: 在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表格上擲骰兩次，以確定獨眼巨人擁有什麼寶藏（如果有的話）。

english: Treasure Drops
zh_tw: 寶藏掉落

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: None
zh_tw: 無

english: A crude map drawn on a scrap of tanned dinosaur hide, showing a route to Port Nyanzaru and the location of a randomly determined landmark or lair (250 gp)
zh_tw: 一張粗糙的地圖，畫在一塊曬黑的恐龍皮的碎片上，顯示了通往南扎路港的路線以及一個隨機確定的地標或巢穴的位置（價值250金幣）。

english: {@dice 1d4} gemstones (10 gp each) in a small pouch
zh_tw: {@dice 1d4} 寶石（每顆10金幣）裝在一個小袋子裡

english: A malachite ring inlaid with electrum (50 gp)
zh_tw: 一枚鑲嵌著電氣石（50金幣）的孔雀石戒指

english: An empty corked vial made from an aarakocra's engraved wing bone (5 gp)
zh_tw: 一個由鳥羽人的雕刻翼骨製成的空瓶塞小瓶（5金幣）

english: A rotting quiver containing {@dice 1d10} {@item Silvered Arrow|PHB|silvered arrows}
zh_tw: 一個腐爛的箭袋，內有{@dice 1d10}支{@item Silvered Arrow|PHB|鍍銀箭}

english: A gold nugget the size of a dwarf's fist (50 gp)
zh_tw: 一塊大小相當於矮人拳頭的金塊（50金幣）

english: A stoppered vial of {@item Serpent Venom}
zh_tw: 一個裝有{@item Serpent Venom||蛇毒}的塞子小瓶

english: An engraved ivory smoking pipe (25 gp)
zh_tw: 一個雕刻精美的象牙菸鬥（25金幣）

english: Case containing {@dice 2d12} {@item Insect Repellent (block of incense)|ToA|blocks of insect repellent incense}
zh_tw: 裝有{@dice 2d12}份{@item Insect Repellent (block of incense)|ToA|驅蟲香塊}的盒子

english: An iron token bearing the symbol of a triceratops (the sign of the Ytepka Society), worth 50 gp in Port Nyanzaru
zh_tw: 一個鐵製令牌，上面刻有三角龍的象徵（伊特帕卡協會的標誌），在南扎路港口價值50金幣

english: {@item Potion of Animal Friendship}
zh_tw: {@item Potion of Animal Friendship||化獸為友藥水}

english: {@item Potion of Vitality}
zh_tw: {@item Potion of Vitality||活力藥水}

english: {@item Spell scroll (1st Level)}
zh_tw: {@item Spell scroll (1st Level)||法術卷軸(1環)}

english: A stoppered vial of {@item Wyvern poison}
zh_tw: 一個裝有{@item Wyvern poison||飛龍毒液}的塞子小瓶

english: An obsidian knife (25 gp)
zh_tw: 一把黑曜石刀（25金幣）

english: A stoppered, wooden tube containing {@dice 1d4} gemstones (50 gp each)
zh_tw: 一個塞住的木管，內含{@dice 1d4}顆寶石（每顆50金幣）

english: A small onyx orb with maze-like patterns carved into its surface (75 gp), usable as an {@item Arcane Focus|PHB|arcane} or {@item druidic focus|PHB}
zh_tw: 一個表面刻有迷宮紋路的小型縞瑪瑙球體（75金幣），可作為{@item Arcane Focus|PHB|奧術}或{@item druidic focus|PHB|德魯伊法器}使用

english: A Batiri goblin mask made of painted wood, set with nine gemstones (10 gp each)
zh_tw: 一個由彩繪木頭製成的巴提裡地精面具，鑲嵌有九顆寶石（每顆10金幣）

english: A {@item spyglass|PHB} (1,000 gp)
zh_tw: 一個{@item spyglass|PHB|望遠鏡}（1000金幣）

english: A {@item lute|PHB} (35 gp) with one broken string
zh_tw: 一把{@item lute|PHB|魯特琴}（35金幣），斷了一根弦

english: A set of {@item thieves' tools|PHB} (25 gp)
zh_tw: 一套{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}（25金幣）

english: An excellent {@item lock|PHB} (50 gp) that requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check to pick using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} (the lock's key is missing)
zh_tw: 一把優質的{@item lock|PHB|鎖}（50金幣），需要使用{@item thieves' tools|PHB|盜賊工具}並透過一次{@dc 20}敏捷檢定才能撬開（該鎖的鑰匙已丟失）

english: Jar of {@item Keoghtom's ointment}
zh_tw: 一瓶{@item Keoghtom's ointment||卡夫統靈藥}

english: {@item Horn of blasting}
zh_tw: {@item Horn of blasting||音爆號角}

english: {@item Wand of secrets}
zh_tw: {@item Wand of secrets||探秘魔杖}

english: Dinosaurs
zh_tw: 恐龍

english: Encounters with "honkers" are common in Chult, though not all such creatures are hostile.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特，與"鳴叫者"的遭遇很常見，儘管並非所有這類生物都是敵對的。

english: Allosaurus
zh_tw: 異特龍

english: The party's scent attracts {@dice 1d3} {@creature Allosaurus||allosauruses}, which appear 100 yards away when the characters first notice them. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival|PHB}) check can find a safe refuge (a high branch, a small crevice, a hollow log, and so forth) that the predators can't reach or enter.
zh_tw: 隊伍的氣味吸引了{@dice 1d3}只{@creature Allosaurus||異特龍}，當角色首次注意到它們時，這些生物出現在100碼外。任何成功透過{@dc 15}感知（{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}）檢定的角色都能找到安全的避難所（高處的樹枝、小裂縫、空心原木等），這些掠食者無法觸及或進入。

english: Ankylosaurus
zh_tw: 甲龍

english: An ornery {@creature ankylosaurus} is gorging on plants, but it attacks any characters who disturb it.
zh_tw: 一隻脾氣暴躁的{@creature ankylosaurus||甲龍}正在大嚼植物，但它會攻擊任何打擾它的角色。

english: Brontosaurus
zh_tw: 雷龍

english: A lone {@creature brontosaurus|VGM} lumbers toward the characters, oblivious to their presence. Though it might step on characters who don't get out of its way, it fights only in self-defense.
zh_tw: 一頭孤獨的{@creature brontosaurus|VGM|雷龍}緩慢地向角色們移動，完全沒有注意到他們的存在。雖然它可能會踩到沒有讓路的角色，但它僅在自衛時才會戰鬥。

english: Deinonychus
zh_tw: 恐爪龍

english: A wild {@creature boar} races across the party's path, followed closely by a hunting pack of {@dice 1d4 + 2} {@creature Deinonychus|VGM|deinonychuses}. The predators decide the characters are more interesting prey.
zh_tw: 一頭野生的{@creature boar||野豬}從隊伍前方疾馳而過，緊跟著一群由{@dice 1d4 + 2}只{@creature Deinonychus|VGM|恐爪龍}組成的狩獵小隊。這些掠食者認為冒險者們是更有趣的獵物。

english: Dimetrodon
zh_tw: 異齒龍

english: A pack of {@dice 2d6} {@creature dimetrodon|VGM|dimetrodons} are spotted along a sunny riverbank or on rocks above the water. Roll any die. On an odd result, the dimetrodons take no notice of the characters; on an even result, they're hungry and attack at the slightest provocation, or if the characters approach within 100 feet of them.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 2d6}頭{@creature dimetrodon|VGM|異齒龍}出現在陽光明媚的河岸或水邊的岩石上。投擲任意骰子——若結果為奇數，異齒龍不會注意到角色；若結果為偶數，它們處於飢餓狀態，會因最輕微的挑釁而攻擊，或當角色接近至100尺範圍內時發動襲擊。

english: Hadrosaurus
zh_tw: 鴨嘴龍

english: A herd of {@dice 3d6} {@creature Hadrosaurus|VGM|hadrosauruses} are grazing nearby, with {@dice 1d6} noncombatant young among them. The adults don't attack unless they're attacked or antagonized. The young are Small beasts that can be sold to {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru for 50 gp each, or for 100 gp if a character succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check to negotiate the price. The young dinosaurs are easy to handle if separated from their parents, but the adults fight if their young are captured.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 3d6}只{@creature Hadrosaurus|VGM|鴨嘴龍}正在附近吃草，其中有{@dice 1d6}只非戰鬥幼崽。成年龍除非被攻擊或挑釁否則不會主動進攻。幼崽是小型野獸，可以每隻50金幣的價格賣給南扎路港的{@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}，若透過{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion|PHB|說服}）檢定協商價格可提升至100金幣。幼崽若與父母分離則易於馴養，但若幼崽被捕獲成年龍會發起攻擊。

english: Plesiosaurus
zh_tw: 蛇頸龍

english: Two {@creature Plesiosaurus||plesiosauruses} are fighting over a dead giant octopus. If the characters are on a river, the creatures are spotted at a distance of 300 feet, whereupon they bellow menacingly and move to attack the party. To paddle a {@item canoe|ToA} to a safe spot along the riverbank, one character in the {@item canoe|ToA} must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check, with other characters in the {@item canoe|ToA} using the {@action Help|PHB} action. Canoes that don't reach the bank are flipped and demolished by the reptiles, which then attack swimmers in the water.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature Plesiosaurus||蛇頸龍}正在爭奪一隻死亡的巨型章魚。如果角色們在河流上，這些生物會在300尺外被發現，隨後它們發出威脅性的吼叫並向隊伍發起攻擊。要將{@item canoe|ToA|獨木舟}劃到河岸邊的安全地點，{@item canoe|ToA|獨木舟}中的一名角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 13}力量（{@skill Athletics|PHB|運動}）檢定，同時{@item canoe|ToA|獨木舟}中的其他角色需使用{@action Help|PHB|協助}動作。未能到達岸邊的獨木舟會被這些爬行動物掀翻並摧毀，然後它們會攻擊水中的游泳者。

english: Pteranodon
zh_tw: 翼龍

english: A flock of {@dice 2d6} {@creature pteranodon||pteranodons} is spotted overhead. They keep their distance and attack only if threatened.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 2d6}只{@creature pteranodon||翼龍}在頭頂盤旋。它們保持距離，只在受到威脅時攻擊。

english: Quetzalcoatlus
zh_tw: 風神翼龍

english: A flight of {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature Quetzalcoatlus|VGM|quetzalcoatluses} is spotted overhead. They keep their distance and attack only if threatened.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature Quetzalcoatlus|VGM|風神翼龍}從頭頂飛過。它們保持距離，只在受到威脅時才會攻擊。

english: Stegosaurus
zh_tw: 劍龍

english: This lone {@creature stegosaurus|VGM} is in a genial mood. It approaches the characters out of curiosity, but anyone who touches it triggers a swipe from its tail.
zh_tw: 這隻孤獨的{@creature stegosaurus|VGM|劍龍}心情友好。它出於好奇靠近角色，但任何觸碰它的人都會引發它尾巴的揮舞。

english: Triceratops
zh_tw: 三角龍

english: A {@creature triceratops} that appears to be grazing alone is actually a mother with a nearby nest containing one noncombatant hatchling and two unhatched eggs. The mother eyes the characters suspiciously but doesn't attack unless they position themselves between her and the nest. {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru offers 50 gp for an intact triceratops egg or hatchling, or a character can talk him up to 150 gp with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 一隻看似獨自進食的{@creature triceratops||三角龍}實際上是一位母親，它的巢穴就在附近，裡面有一隻非戰鬥狀態的幼崽和兩枚未孵化的蛋。母親會警惕地注視著角色們，但不會主動攻擊，除非角色們擋在它與巢穴之間。{@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}在南扎路港出價50金幣收購完好的三角龍蛋或幼崽，若角色透過一次{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion|PHB|說服}）檢定，可將價格談到150金幣。

english: Tyrannosaurus
zh_tw: 霸王龍

english: The characters spot a {@creature tyrannosaurus rex} 300 yards away. There's a {@chance 50} chance that the hungry behemoth is fighting either a {@creature stegosaurus|VGM}, a {@creature triceratops}, a pair of {@creature Giant Constrictor Snake|MM|giant constrictor snakes}, a {@creature giant ape}, or a mob of {@creature ghoul|MM|ghouls} and {@creature zombie|MM|zombies}. None of these creatures will voluntarily team up with the party, but their presence might weaken the tyrannosaurus to the point where the characters have a chance of slaying it.
zh_tw: 角色們發現300碼外有一隻{@creature tyrannosaurus rex||霸王龍}。這隻飢餓的巨獸有{@chance 50}的機率正在與以下生物之一戰鬥：{@creature stegosaurus|VGM|劍龍}、{@creature triceratops||三角龍}、一對{@creature Giant Constrictor Snake|MM|巨蟒蛇}、{@creature giant ape||巨猿}，或是一群{@creature ghoul|MM|食屍鬼}和{@creature zombie|MM|喪屍}。這些生物都不會自願與隊伍合作，但它們的存在可能會削弱暴龍，使角色們有機會將其擊殺。

english: Characters can avoid an encounter with the tyrannosaurus if they keep their distance and succeed on a {@dc 15} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check. If any character is trained in the {@skill Survival|PHB} skill, all the characters' checks are made with advantage.
zh_tw: 如果角色保持距離併成功透過一次{@dc 15}群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth|PHB|隱匿}）檢定，他們可以避免與暴龍遭遇。若有任一角色受訓於{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}技能，則全體角色檢定均具有優勢。

english: Velociraptor
zh_tw: 伶盜龍

english: A pack of {@dice 3d6} {@creature velociraptor|VGM|velociraptors} burst out from behind cover and attack. Make a single Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check for the dinosaurs, with advantage. Any character whose passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score equals or exceeds the velociraptors' check result is not {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 一群{@dice 3d6}只{@creature velociraptor|VGM|伶盜龍}從掩體後衝出併發起攻擊。為這些恐龍進行一次具有優勢的敏捷（{@skill Stealth|PHB|隱匿}）檢定。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）數值等於或超過迅猛龍檢定結果的角色不會陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: Dragon, Faerie
zh_tw: 仙女龍

english: An {@condition invisible} {@creature Faerie Dragon (Green)|MM|green faerie dragon} takes an interest in the adventurers and follows them for a while. If the characters are in good spirits, the tiny dragon plays harmless pranks on them during the party's next short or long rest. If the characters are not angered by this trickery, the dragon appears and truthfully answers three of their questions before bidding the party farewell. If the characters seem dour or mean, or if the faerie dragon's pranks sour them, it flutters off without providing any sort of aid.
zh_tw: 一隻{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature Faerie Dragon (Green)|MM|綠妖精龍}對冒險者們產生了興趣，並跟隨他們一段時間。如果角色們情緒良好，這隻小龍會在隊伍下次短休或長休時對他們玩些無害的惡作劇。如果角色們沒有因這些把戲而生氣，小龍會現身並如實回答他們三個問題，然後與隊伍告別。如果角色們看起來陰鬱或刻薄，或者小妖精龍的惡作劇讓他們不悅，它就會不作任何幫助地飛走。

english: The faerie dragon visited Omu recently and knows about the evil gargoyles and "snake people" that watch over the city. It also knows things about other nearby landmarks or locations, as you determine.
zh_tw: 妖精龍最近訪問了奧穆，並且知道那些守護城市的邪惡石像鬼和"蛇人"。它還知道其他附近地標或位置的事情，由你決定。

english: Dragon, Red
zh_tw: 紅龍

english: If the characters are within 50 miles of Wyrmheart Mine (see chapter 2), they see the {@creature young red dragon} known as Tzindelor or Tinder circling over that location. If they're farther away, they see her flying in the direction of the mine. The dragon ignores the characters unless they do something to attract her attention.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在距離龍心礦井（見第2章）50英里以內，他們會看到被稱為辛德洛或火種的{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}在那個地點上空盤旋。如果他們距離更遠，他們會看到她朝著礦井的方向飛行。除非角色們做了什麼吸引她的注意，否則紅龍會忽略他們。

english: Eblis
zh_tw: 魔王鶴

english: If the characters are on the move when this encounter occurs, they stumble across {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature eblis|ToA} living in reed huts built on stilts above a swampy marsh or pond. The eblis attack wounded or weak-looking characters but offer to trade information for precious gemstones if faced with a strong, well-armed group. For 50 gp worth of gems, they point the adventurers in the direction of nearby landmarks. If the characters follow these directions, they have advantage on checks made to reach those landmarks (see {@i "Navigation"}). If the characters defeat the eblis and search the huts, roll three times on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, the eblis have stashed in their homes.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在移動時遭遇此事件，他們會偶然發現{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature eblis|ToA|魔王鶴}居住在沼澤或池塘上方高腳蘆葦屋中。這些魔王鶴會攻擊受傷或看似虛弱的角色，但若遇到裝備精良的強大隊伍，則會提議用情報交換珍貴寶石。用價值50金幣的寶石，它們會為冒險者指明附近地標的方向。若角色遵循這些指引，在前往該地標時進行檢定時具有優勢（參見{@i "導航"}）。如果角色擊敗魔王鶴並搜查小屋，需在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上投擲三次，以確定魔王鶴家中藏有何種物品（如果有的話）。

english: If this encounter occurs while the party is camped, the eblis sneak into the camp and try to drag one character away.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在隊伍紮營時，魔王鶴會潛入營地並試圖拖走一個角色。

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: The characters encounter a band of Emerald Enclave scouts or stumble upon one of their outposts. Choose whichever encounter works best for the circumstances and location.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了一群翡翠聯盟的偵察兵，或者偶然發現他們的一個前哨站。根據情況和地點選擇最合適的遭遇。

english: Enclave Scouts
zh_tw: 聯盟偵察兵

english: The party meets {@dice 1d4 + 1} members of the Emerald Enclave working to rid the jungle of its undead menace. The group works with a {@creature priest} of Mielikki, but all other members are {@creature scout||scouts}. If one of the adventurers has died recently, you can use this encounter to introduce a new character—either a member of the Emerald Enclave, someone the scouts have rescued, or a character who hired the scouts as guides.
zh_tw: 隊伍遇到了{@dice 1d4 + 1}名翡翠結社成員，他們正致力於清除叢林中的不死生物威脅。該小組與一位梅麗凱的{@creature priest||祭司}合作，其餘成員均為{@creature scout||斥侯}。若近期有冒險者死亡，可用此遭遇引入新角色——可以是翡翠結社成員、偵察兵們救下的某人，或是僱傭偵察兵作為嚮導的角色。

english: The scouts are willing to trade information on an equal basis with a non-evil party. Characters can also convince the scouts to join their party for up to 3 days by succeeding on a {@dc 12} group Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check. The Emerald Enclave scouts have enough food and water to nourish themselves, and each scout has an {@item explorer's pack|PHB}. The priest carries a {@item priest's pack|PHB}.
zh_tw: 偵察隊願意與非邪惡陣營的隊伍平等交換情報。角色們也可以透過成功進行一次{@dc 12}群體魅力（{@skill Persuasion|PHB|說服}）檢定，說服偵察隊加入他們的隊伍長達3天。翠綠閒庭的偵察隊員攜帶了足夠的食物和水，每名偵察兵都有一個{@item explorer's pack|PHB|探索套組}。其中牧師攜帶的是{@item priest's pack|PHB|祭司套組}。

english: Enclave Outpost
zh_tw: 聯盟前哨站

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 13 or higher spots a wooden platform in a tree. The platform is {@dice 2d6 × 5} feet above ground, and a successful {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|PHB}) check is required to climb the tree. The platform is 10 feet square and sturdy enough to support six characters and their gear.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到13或更高的角色都會發現樹上有個木製平臺。該平臺位於地面{@dice 2d6 × 5}尺高處，需要透過一個{@dc 12}力量（{@skill Athletics|PHB|運動}）檢定才能爬上樹。平臺為10尺見方，足夠堅固以支撐六名角色及其裝備。

english: Explorer, Dead
zh_tw: 死去的探險家

english: Chult is strewn with the corpses and bones of those who have fallen victim to its terrors. When the characters discover one such victim, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the {@table Dead Explorers|ToA} table to determine what they find. Then roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to see what, if anything, can be found on or near the remains.
zh_tw: 楚爾特遍佈著那些曾命喪其恐怖之下的亡者屍骸與枯骨。當角色們發現這樣一具遇難者遺體時，擲一次{@dice d20}並查閱{@table Dead Explorers|ToA|死去的探險家}表格以判定他們發現了什麼。接著在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表格上擲一次，看看遺骸上或附近能否找到物品（若有的話）。

english: Dead Explorers
zh_tw: 死去的探險家

english: Remains
zh_tw: 遺骸

english: The bloated corpse of a dead halfling, riddled with tiny arrows and dangling from a tree vine. (The halfling trespassed on grung sacred ground, and the corpse was hung here as a warning.)
zh_tw: 一個腫脹的半身人屍體，身上佈滿了小箭，懸掛在樹藤上。（這個半身人侵犯了格龍族的聖地，屍體被掛在這裡作為警告。）

english: The bones of an unarmored humanoid, lashed to a tree by vines. (This explorer was captured by Batiri goblins, doused in honey, and left to be devoured by hungry insects.)
zh_tw: 一個未穿盔甲的人形生物的骨頭，被藤蔓綁在樹上。（這個探險家被巴提裡地精捕獲，淋上蜂蜜，然後被留下供飢餓的昆蟲吞噬。）

english: The crushed remains of an unarmored dwarf, showing signs that she was stomped to death by a rampaging dinosaur.
zh_tw: 一個未穿盔甲的矮人的壓碎遺骸，顯示出她是被一隻暴走的恐龍踩死的。

english: The gnawed and charred bones of a humanoid. (This unfortunate was murdered and cannibalized by his starving, fever-crazed companions.)
zh_tw: 一個人形生物的啃咬和燒焦的骨頭。（這個不幸的人被他的飢餓、發燒瘋狂的同伴謀殺並被同類相食。）

english: The mangled body of a half-elf, seemingly bludgeoned to death. (She was dropped from high altitude by pterafolk.)
zh_tw: 一個半精靈的殘破屍體，看似被毆打致死。（她被翼手獸從高空丟下。）

english: The scattered bones of a dwarf, torn to pieces before being devoured. (A hunting pack of velociraptors did the dwarf in.)
zh_tw: 一個矮人的散落骨頭，被撕成碎片後才被吞噬。（一群迅猛龍狩獵隊捕殺了這個矮人。）

english: The swollen, purple corpse of an elf, dead only a few days ago from the bite of a poisonous snake.
zh_tw: 一個精靈的腫脹、紫色的屍體，幾天前因被毒蛇咬傷而死亡。

english: A fresh human corpse stuffed into a hollow tree. (Girallons plan to return and devour it later.)
zh_tw: 一具新鮮的人類屍體被塞進一個空心樹中。（巨人計劃稍後回來吞食它。）

english: The skeleton of a humanoid seated on a folding camp stool, clutching a knife and fork in its bony hands.
zh_tw: 一個人形生物的骨架坐在一個摺疊露營凳上，骨手中緊握著刀叉。

english: The desiccated husk of a gnome, cocooned in giant spider webs.
zh_tw: 一個乾枯的侏儒外殼，被包裹在巨大的蜘蛛網中。

english: The body of a human—from the waist up. Signs show that the explorer crawled a considerable distance after being bitten in half by a tyrannosaurus. (A Flaming Fist charter found on the corpse identifies it as Lord Onovan IV, of the Dales.)
zh_tw: 一具人類的上半身。種種跡象表明，這位探險者在被霸王龍咬成兩段後，還爬行了相當長一段距離。（在屍體上發現的一張焰拳憲章確認其身份為谷地領主奧諾萬四世。）

english: A charred elf's skeleton inside a charred constrictor snake's skeleton. (Both were killed by a {@spell lightning bolt|PHB} spell.)
zh_tw: 一具燒焦的精靈骨架蜷縮在一條燒焦的蟒蛇骨架內。（兩者均死於{@spell lightning bolt|PHB|閃電束}法術。）

english: The rotting body of a giant frog with the blade of a shortsword poking out its back. (If the frog is cut open, the partially digested body of a halfling is found inside.)
zh_tw: 一隻腐爛的巨蛙身體，一把短劍的刀刃從它的背部伸出。（如果將青蛙切開，會發現裡面部分消化的半身人屍體。）

english: A tabaxi spread-eagled on the ground, but with its limbs and head severed from its torso and crudely stitched back on in the wrong arrangement.
zh_tw: 一個斑貓人四肢和頭部從軀幹上被割下，然後被粗略地縫回錯誤的排列。

english: A half-orc spiked to an enormous tree by the broken-off horn of a triceratops.
zh_tw: 一個半獸人在一棵巨大的樹上被三角龍斷裂的角釘住。

english: A gnome, spitted over a burned-out fire pit and thoroughly overcooked, but not eaten. (Goblin weapons and tools are scattered around amid velociraptor tracks.)
zh_tw: 一個侏儒，被穿在熄滅的火坑上徹底烤焦，但沒有被吃掉。（地精的武器和工具散落在迅猛龍的足跡之間。）

english: A headless humanoid, hung upside down from a tree and with six Batiri goblin spears thrust symmetrically through the body. (It was a Red Wizard, judging by the robes. The head is nowhere to be found.)
zh_tw: 一個無頭人形生物，被倒掛在樹上，身體上對稱地插著六支巴提裡地精長矛。（根據長袍判斷，這是一個紅袍法師。頭部無處可尋。）

english: An elf, balanced on a tree branch 40 feet above the ground, arms and legs dangling downward. (A note pressed between the body and the branch explains that the elf climbed the tree to get away from a prowling allosaurus and was too terrified to come down.)
zh_tw: 一個精靈，平衡在離地面40尺高的樹梢上，手臂和腿向下懸掛。（夾在身體和樹枝之間的一張紙條解釋說，精靈爬上樹是為了躲避一隻徘徊的異特龍，太害怕而不敢下來。）

english: The moldering remains of a human wearing a Flaming Fist-style helmet, his legs broken. (He succumbed to a faerie dragon's euphoria breath weapon and stepped off a cliff. A companion tried to carry him back to Fort Beluarian, but the warrior died en route.)
zh_tw: 一個穿著焰拳風格的頭盔，雙腿骨折的人類的腐爛遺骸。（他因妖精龍的狂喜氣息武器而屈服，從懸崖上走了下去。一個同伴試圖把他帶回貝路利安堡，但這位戰士在途中死亡。）

english: A dwarf with six large holes piercing her armor and chest. (A stegosaurus caught her squarely with a swipe of its tail.)
zh_tw: 一個矮人，她的盔甲和胸部被六個大洞穿透。（一隻劍龍用尾巴的一掃準確地擊中了她。）

english: Explorers
zh_tw: 探險家

english: The party runs into another band of explorers, consisting of a {@creature mage}, a {@creature priest}, a {@creature scout}, and {@dice 1d6} {@creature tribal warrior||tribal warriors}. Roll a {@dice d6} to determine the group's situation.
zh_tw: 隊伍遇到了另一群探險者，包括一名{@creature mage||魔法師}、一名{@creature priest||祭司}、一名{@creature scout||斥侯}和{@dice 1d6}名{@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}。投擲{@dice d6}來決定該隊伍的遭遇狀況。

english: The explorers are lost and hungry.
zh_tw: 探險家們迷路了，而且很餓。

english: The explorers are in good shape but are actively hunted by {@area firenewts|5c3|x}, {@area ghouls|5f0|x}, {@area goblins|5d1|x}, or {@area grungs|5d2|x} (see the appropriate entry in this appendix).
zh_tw: 探險者們狀態良好，但正被{@area 熔螈|5c3|x}、{@area 食屍鬼們|5f0|x}、{@area 地精|5d1|x}或{@area 格龍蛙人們|5d2|x}（參見本附錄中的相應條目）積極追獵。

english: The explorers are healthy and headed toward the nearest landmark, intent on exploring it.
zh_tw: 探險家們身體健康，正朝著最近的地標前進，打算探索它。

english: The explorers are healthy and heading back to Port Nyanzaru for rest and supplies.
zh_tw: 探險家們身體健康，正返回南扎路港進行休息和補給。

english: Firenewts
zh_tw: 熔螈

english: A light firenewt patrol consists of {@dice 1d4} {@creature firenewt warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} mounted on {@creature giant strider|VGM|giant striders}. A heavy patrol consists of {@dice 2d4} {@creature firenewt warrior|VGM|firenewt warriors} and a {@creature firenewt warlock of Imix|VGM}, all mounted on {@creature giant strider|VGM|giant striders}. Statistics for all these creatures appear in appendix D. The firenewts always strike their final blows with the intention of knocking out enemies, who are then taken back to the creatures' cave lair to be tortured and eaten.
zh_tw: 一支輕型火蜥蜴巡邏隊由{@dice 1d4}名{@creature firenewt warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}騎著{@creature giant strider|VGM|闊步鳥}組成。重型巡邏隊則由{@dice 2d4}名{@creature firenewt warrior|VGM|火蠑螈武者}和一名{@creature firenewt warlock of Imix|VGM|熔螈·伊米希魔契師}組成，全員都騎著{@creature giant strider|VGM|闊步鳥}。這些生物的資料詳見附錄D。火蜥蜴們總是以擊倒敵人為目的發動最後一擊，然後將俘虜帶回洞穴巢穴折磨並食用。

english: Flail Snail
zh_tw: 鏈枷蝸牛

english: Characters spot the slimy trail of a {@creature flail snail|VGM}. If they wish to follow it, a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Survival|PHB}) check correctly deduces which direction the snail was traveling.
zh_tw: 角色們發現了一條{@creature flail snail|VGM|鏈枷蝸牛}留下的粘液痕跡。如果他們想要追蹤，一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}）檢定可以正確推斷出蝸牛行進的方向。

english: Flaming Fist
zh_tw: 焰拳

english: The soldiers of the Flaming Fist know the dangers of Chult better than most, and they don't take the wilderness lightly. A typical patrol is made up of a {@creature knight} or {@creature veteran} leading an {@creature acolyte}, a {@creature scout}, and {@dice 2d6} {@creature guard||guards}—and is sometimes accompanied by {@dice 1d4} {@creature Deinonychus|VGM|deinonychuses} trained to fight and hunt alongside their handlers. The Flaming Fist is friendly and helpful toward adventurers possessing a charter of exploration issued by Commander {@creature Liara Portyr|ToA} of Fort Beluarian. If the party has no such document, the patrol tries to confiscate the adventurers' critical gear and advises them to replace it at Fort Beluarian—and to obtain a proper charter while they're at it.
zh_tw: 焰拳傭兵團的士兵們比大多數人更瞭解楚爾特的危險，他們不會輕視荒野。一個典型的巡邏隊由一名{@creature knight||騎士}或{@creature veteran||老兵}帶領，包括一名{@creature acolyte||侍僧}、一名{@creature scout||斥侯}和{@dice 2d6}名{@creature guard||警衛}——有時還會伴隨{@dice 1d4}只{@creature Deinonychus|VGM|恐爪龍}，這些恐龍經過訓練能與馴獸師並肩作戰和狩獵。焰拳對持有貝路利安堡指揮官{@creature Liara Portyr|ToA|莉爾阿·波提爾}簽發的探索許可證的冒險者態度友善且樂於助人。如果隊伍沒有此類檔案，巡邏隊會試圖沒收冒險者的關鍵裝備，並建議他們去貝路利安堡更換裝備——同時順便取得正規的探索許可證。

english: Flying Monkeys
zh_tw: 飛猴

english: The sound of wings heralds the arrival of {@dice 3d6} {@creature flying monkey|ToA|flying monkeys}, which swoop through the adventurers in a wave of grasping hands and feet. Each character must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or lose a useful piece of gear to the furry thieves. If this encounter occurs near Mbala (see chapter 2), the monkeys are servants of the green hag {@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA}.
zh_tw: 翅膀的聲音預示著{@dice 3d6}只{@creature flying monkey|ToA|飛猴}的到來，它們以一陣抓握的手腳浪潮俯衝穿過冒險者。每個角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 12}敏捷豁免檢定，否則就會被這些毛茸茸的小偷搶走一件有用的裝備。如果這次遭遇發生在姆巴拉附近（見第2章），這些猴子是綠鬼婆{@creature Nanny Pu'pu|ToA|普普奶奶}的僕從。

english: These sociable creatures are curious about humanoids and have little fear of them. A flying monkey that is successfully {@condition grappled}, caught in a {@item net|PHB}, or otherwise prevented from escaping can be trained to perform simple tricks by a character with proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|PHB} who spends a few hours a day working with the monkey. At the end of 1 week, the character makes a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|PHB}) check. On a success, the flying monkey learns to perform a simple trick on command (such as fetching a specific object or dancing to music). An individual monkey can learn a maximum {@dice 1d6} tricks and can be taught one trick per week.
zh_tw: 這些社交性生物對人類充滿好奇且幾乎不畏懼。一隻被成功{@condition grappled||被擒}、被{@item net|PHB|捕網}困住或無法逃脫的飛猴，可由具備{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}技能的角色透過每天數小時訓練來學會簡單把戲。一週結束時，該角色需進行{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}）檢定。若成功，飛猴將學會按指令表演簡單把戲（如取回特定物品或隨音樂起舞）。單隻飛猴最多可學會{@dice 1d6}個把戲，每週僅能學習一個。

english: Flying Snakes
zh_tw: 飛蛇

english: {@dice d20|Roll a die}. On an even result, the party encounters a single {@creature flying snake}. On an odd result, the characters encounter {@dice 2d6} {@creature flying snake||flying snakes}. These snakes attack only when threatened. A {@creature flying snake} that is successfully {@condition grappled} can be stuffed in a sack or other soft container. After 1 hour of confinement, the snake settles down. A character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|PHB}) check can remove a calm snake from the container without causing it to attack or fly away.
zh_tw: {@dice d20|擲骰子}。若結果為偶數，隊伍會遇到一隻{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}。若結果為奇數，角色們會遇到{@dice 2d6}只{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}。這些蛇只會在受到威脅時攻擊。成功{@condition grappled||被擒}的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}可被裝入麻袋或其他柔軟容器中。經過1小時的拘禁後，蛇會安靜下來。成功透過{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Animal Handling|PHB|馴獸}）檢定的角色可以從容器中取出平靜的蛇，而不會導致其攻擊或飛走。

english: Characters can sell captured {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} to {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru. He offers 25 gp for each snake, but a character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check can talk him up to 50 gp.
zh_tw: 角色可以將捕獲的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}賣給南扎路港的{@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}。每條蛇他出價25金幣，但若角色透過一個{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion|PHB|說服}）檢定，可以說服他將價格提高到50金幣。

english: Frost Giants
zh_tw: 霜巨人

english: The characters hear the sound of huge creatures stomping through the wilderness. If they follow the noise, they encounter a search party of three {@creature frost giant||frost giants} accompanied by {@dice 1d2} {@creature winter wolf||winter wolves}. For each such encounter, there is a {@chance 20} chance that this is {@creature Drufi|ToA}'s search party (see {@i "Hvalspyd"}).
zh_tw: 角色們聽到巨大生物在荒野中穿行的腳步聲。如果他們循聲而去，會遇到由三隻{@creature frost giant||霜巨人}和{@dice 1d2}只{@creature winter wolf||冬狼}組成的搜尋隊。每次遭遇時，有{@chance 20}機率這是{@creature Drufi|ToA|德魯菲}的搜尋隊（參見{@i "鯨魚矛"}）。

english: The frost giants are concerned chiefly with locating the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}, and they might help characters who can provide useful information. They immediately attack characters who withhold information, or who threaten to reveal the giants' presence to the Flaming Fist. The frost giants carry no treasure with them while they hunt.
zh_tw: 霜巨人主要關心的是找到{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}，並且他們可能會幫助那些能提供有用資訊的角色。如果角色隱瞞資訊，或者威脅要向焰拳透露巨人的存在，霜巨人會立即攻擊他們。霜巨人在狩獵時沒有攜帶任何財寶。

english: Giant Boars
zh_tw: 鉅野豬

english: The characters see and hear {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature giant boar||giant boars} foraging ahead of them. Skirting around the boars to prevent them from charging requires a successful {@dc 12} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 角色們看到並聽到前方有{@dice 1d4 + 1}頭{@creature giant boar||鉅野豬}正在覓食。要繞過這些野豬避免它們衝鋒，需要進行一次成功的{@dc 12}群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth|PHB|隱匿}）檢定。

english: Giant Crocodile
zh_tw: 巨鱷

english: Before it rises out of the water, make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check for the {@creature giant crocodile}. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score less than the check result is {@status surprised} when the monstrous creature attacks.
zh_tw: 在它從水中躍出之前，為{@creature giant crocodile||巨鱷}進行一次敏捷（{@skill Stealth|PHB|隱匿}）檢定。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）數值低於檢定結果的角色，在這頭龐然大物發動攻擊時會陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: Giant Frogs
zh_tw: 巨蛙

english: These {@dice 2d6} {@creature giant frog||giant frogs} have come together in hunger and try to eat everything that crosses their path. The characters have plenty of warning as the amphibians hop noisily toward them.
zh_tw: 這些{@dice 2d6}只{@creature giant frog||巨蛙}因飢餓而聚集，試圖吃掉路上遇到的一切。當這些兩棲動物吵鬧地跳向角色們時，他們會有充分的預警。

english: Giant Lizards
zh_tw: 巨蜥

english: The characters encounter {@dice 1d6} {@creature giant lizard||giant lizards} sunning themselves on warm rocks. The lizards pose no threat unless they're attacked, and they're too set in their ways to be trained as pack animals.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@dice 1d6}只{@creature giant lizard||巨蜥}在溫暖的岩石上曬太陽。這些蜥蜴不會構成威脅，除非它們受到攻擊，而且它們習性頑固，無法被訓練成馱獸。

english: Giant Scorpions
zh_tw: 巨蠍

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 11 or higher spots {@dice 1d3} {@creature giant scorpion||giant scorpions} moments before they emerge from hiding and attack. At the end of the encounter, any character damaged by a giant scorpion must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with {@disease shivering sickness|ToA} (see {@i "Diseases"}).
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到11或更高的角色會在{@creature giant scorpion||巨蠍}從藏身處現身並發動攻擊前發現{@dice 1d3}只。遭遇結束後，任何被巨蠍傷害的角色必須成功透過{@dc 11}體質豁免，否則會感染{@disease shivering sickness|ToA|寒顫病}（參見{@i "疾病"}章節）。

english: Giant Snapping Turtle
zh_tw: 巨鱷龜

english: The characters spot a {@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA} sunning itself on the shore. The turtle attacks any character it can see within 30 feet of it.
zh_tw: 角色們發現一隻{@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA|巨鱷龜}在岸邊曬太陽。這隻龜會攻擊它能看到的所有30尺內的角色。

english: Giant Wasps
zh_tw: 巨黃蜂

english: A droning sound announces the presence of {@dice 1d6} {@creature giant wasp||giant wasps} before the characters see them. The wasps attack at once, ignoring heavily armored targets in favor of those with little or no defensive protection. At the end of the encounter, any character damaged by a giant wasp must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with {@disease shivering sickness|ToA} (see {@i "Diseases"}).
zh_tw: 一陣嗡嗡聲預示著{@dice 1d6}只{@creature giant wasp||巨黃蜂}的出現，比角色們目視發現更早。黃蜂會立即發動攻擊，忽略重甲目標，優先襲擊幾乎沒有防護的目標。遭遇結束後，任何被巨黃蜂傷害的角色必須成功透過{@dc 11}體質豁免檢定，否則將感染{@disease shivering sickness|ToA|寒顫病}（參見{@i "疾病"}章節）。

english: Girallons
zh_tw: 四臂猿怪

english: Two {@creature girallon|VGM|girallons} hang in the trees, perch atop rocks, or lumber between crumbling, vine-covered ruins. The characters spot them automatically and can avoid a hostile encounter if they withdraw and succeed on a {@dc 13} group Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature girallon|VGM|四臂猿怪}懸掛在樹上，棲息在岩石頂部，或在藤蔓覆蓋的廢墟間蹣跚而行。角色們會自動發現它們，如果撤退並透過{@dc 13}群體敏捷（{@skill Stealth|PHB|隱匿}）檢定，則可以避免敵對遭遇。

english: If the characters defeat the girallons or frighten them away, a search of the area reveals a hidden cache, determined by rolling on the {@table Caches|ToA} table. The girallons might also have some treasure hidden near the cache; roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, is found after a search of the area.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗或嚇跑了吉拉猿，搜尋該區域會發現一個隱藏的儲藏處，具體內容透過投擲{@table Caches|ToA|貯藏}表格決定。吉拉猿們可能在儲藏處附近還藏有一些財寶；投擲一次{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表格來決定搜尋該區域後發現什麼（如果有的話）。

english: Goblins
zh_tw: 地精

english: A typical Batiri patrol or hunting party consists of a {@creature goblin boss} leading {@dice 2d6 + 3} {@creature goblin||goblins}, all wearing painted wooden masks. They move quietly through familiar areas and seldom range outside their home territory. Batiri prefer to hunt at night and lay low in ambush positions during the day.
zh_tw: 一支典型的巴提裡巡邏隊或狩獵小隊由一名{@creature goblin boss||地精頭目}帶領{@dice 2d6 + 3}名{@creature goblin||地精}組成，所有成員都戴著彩繪木製面具。他們在熟悉區域安靜行動，很少離開家園領地。巴提裡更喜歡在夜間狩獵，白天則潛伏在伏擊點。

english: A night encounter with Batiri goblins involves an attack on the characters' camp. Each party member standing watch must attempt a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check, made with disadvantage because of the noise of the jungle at night. On a success, a character detects the goblins moving into attack positions and can rouse the rest of the party. If no one on watch succeeds on the check, all the characters are {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 與巴提裡地精的夜間遭遇涉及對角色營地的襲擊。每位守夜的隊伍成員必須嘗試進行一次{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定，由於夜間叢林的噪音，該檢定具有劣勢。若成功，角色會察覺到地精進入攻擊位置，並能喚醒其他隊員。如果所有守夜者檢定均未成功，所有角色將處於{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: If this encounter occurs while the characters are traveling during the day, have each party member make a {@dc 16} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB} or {@skill Survival|PHB}) check to spot the telltale signs of an ambush: disadvantageous terrain coupled with an eerie silence not normal for the jungle.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在角色們白天旅行時，讓每位隊員進行一次{@dc 16}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}或{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}）檢定來發現伏擊的跡象：不利地形加上叢林裡不正常的詭異寂靜。

english: Goblins bargain for their lives if captured. If the characters can force or coerce a vow of cooperation from goblin prisoners, the Batiri will serve as guides. They have the following additional skill: {@skill Survival|PHB} {@skillCheck survival 1}.
zh_tw: 地精被俘時會為活命討價還價。如果角色能迫使或脅迫地精俘虜立下合作誓言，巴提裡族將充當嚮導。他們擁有以下額外技能：{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}{@skillCheck survival 1|+1|求生}。

english: Grungs
zh_tw: 格龍蛙人們

english: A grung hunting party consists of {@dice 2d6} {@creature grung|VGM|grungs} led by a {@creature grung elite warrior|VGM} (see appendix D for both). If this encounter occurs while the characters are traveling, the grungs have set up an ambush in the trees. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 14 or higher spots them just in time. All other characters are {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 一支格朗狩獵隊由{@dice 2d6}只{@creature grung|VGM|格龍蛙人}組成，由一名{@creature grung elite warrior|VGM|格龍蛙人精英戰士}帶領（兩者均見附錄D）。如果這次遭遇發生在角色旅行途中，格朗們會在樹上設下埋伏。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到14或更高的角色能及時發現它們。其他所有角色都會陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: If this encounter occurs while the party is camped, the grungs spotted the characters earlier in the day and have shadowed them unseen. Each character standing watch must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check, made with disadvantage because of the noise of the jungle at night. On a success, a character detects the encroaching grungs and can rouse the rest of the party. If no one on watch succeeds on the check, all the characters are {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在隊伍紮營時，則格朗格人已在白天發現了角色們並一直暗中尾隨。每位守夜的角色必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定，且因夜晚叢林的噪音而具有劣勢。若檢定成功，該角色會察覺到逼近的格朗格人並可以喚醒其他隊員。若所有守夜者檢定失敗，則所有角色將陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: If the characters capture one or more grungs, the frogfolk offer to lead the characters to treasure in exchange for a promise of freedom. The "treasure" is a half-mile away from the party's present location and consists of a cache, which you can randomly determine by rolling on the {@table Caches|ToA} table.
zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲了一隻或多隻蛙人，這些蛙類生物會提出帶領角色們前往寶藏以換取自由的承諾。所謂的"寶藏"距離隊伍當前位置半英里遠，是一個藏匿點，你可以透過投擲{@table Caches|ToA|貯藏}表格隨機決定其內容。

english: Jaculis
zh_tw: 幻色蛇

english: Without warning, {@dice 1d6} {@creature jaculi|ToA|jaculis} launch themselves at the party from the trees. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 14 or higher is able to react, but all others are {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 毫無預警地，{@dice 1d6}只{@creature jaculi|ToA|幻色蛇}從樹上向隊伍發起突襲。被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到14或更高的角色能夠及時反應，其餘所有人將陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。

english: Kamadans
zh_tw: 六岐蛇豹人

english: The party is ambushed by {@dice 1d2} {@creature kamadan|ToA|kamadans} (see appendix D). Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 16 or higher gets a warning of the attack, but all others are {@status surprised}. Characters who prevail against the kamadans can search the area for their lair, finding it with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival|PHB}) check.
zh_tw: 隊伍遭到 {@dice 1d2} 只 {@creature kamadan|ToA|六岐蛇豹}（見附錄D）伏擊。被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到16或更高的角色會獲得襲擊預警，其餘角色將陷入{@status surprised||突襲}狀態。擊敗卡瑪達的隊伍可搜尋其巢穴，透過一次難度{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}）檢定即可發現。

english: A kamadan lair has a {@chance 25} chance of containing {@dice 1d3} noncombatant young the size of house cats. With their snakes not yet grown out, they look like leopard cubs. {@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA} in Port Nyanzaru will pay 150 gp for a live kamadan cub, but a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|PHB}) check talks him up to 300 gp.
zh_tw: 六岐蛇豹巢穴有{@chance 25}機率存在{@dice 1d3}只家貓大小的非戰鬥幼崽。它們尚未長出蛇發，看起來像幼豹。南扎路港的{@creature Ifan Talro'a|ToA|伊方·塔若阿}會為活體六岐蛇豹幼崽支付150金幣，但成功的{@dc 15}魅力（{@skill Persuasion|PHB|說服}）檢定可將價格談到300金幣。

english: Lizardfolk
zh_tw: 蜥蜴人

english: The characters encounter {@dice 2d4} {@creature lizardfolk} and a {@creature lizardfolk shaman}. These lizardfolk belong to a tribe or kingdom in the Valley of Dread and can be appeased with food (one day's supply per lizardfolk in the group). Otherwise they attack.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@dice 2d4}只{@creature lizardfolk||蜥蜴人}和一名{@creature lizardfolk shaman||蜥蜴人薩滿}。這些蜥蜴人屬於恐懼谷中的一個部落或王國，可以用食物安撫（每隻蜥蜴人需要一天的食物供應）。否則他們會發起攻擊。

english: Blue Mist
zh_tw: 藍色霧氣

english: A bank of blue mist drifts toward the party, covering an area of {@dice 1d6} 20-foot squares. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 13 or higher notices the mist and can warn others of its approach. If the encounter occurs while the party is camped, the mist drifts through the camp at a speed of 5 feet per round. Characters who come into contact with the mist are exposed to {@disease blue mist fever|ToA} (see {@i "Diseases"}).
zh_tw: 一團藍色霧靄向隊伍飄來，覆蓋{@dice 1d6}個20尺方格區域。被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到13或更高的角色會注意到霧靄並警告隊友。若遭遇發生在營地休整時，霧靄會以每輪5尺速度漫過營地。接觸霧靄者將感染{@disease blue mist fever|ToA|藍霧熱}（參見{@i "疾病"}章節）。

english: Magmins
zh_tw: 火童

english: The characters are attacked by {@dice 2d6} {@creature magmin||magmins}, which flee if reduced to fewer than half their starting number.
zh_tw: 角色們遭到{@dice 2d6}只{@creature magmin||火童}的攻擊，當數量減少至初始一半以下時它們會逃跑。

english: Mantraps
zh_tw: 捕人草

english: The characters blunder into a patch of {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature mantrap|ToA|mantraps}, which are undetectable until they attack. The plants are 10 feet apart, so that only one plant attacks on the first round. The others must wait until characters maneuver within 5 feet of them.
zh_tw: 角色們不慎踏入一片{@dice 1d4 + 1}株{@creature mantrap|ToA|捕人草}的區域，這些植物在發動攻擊前無法被察覺。這些植物彼此間隔10尺，因此第一輪只有一株會發動攻擊。其餘的必須等待角色移動到其5尺範圍內才會行動。

english: Mephits
zh_tw: 魔蝠

english: The characters might encounter {@creature magma mephit||magma mephits}, {@creature mud mephit||mud mephits}, {@creature smoke mephit||smoke mephits}, or {@creature steam mephit||steam mephits} (each appearing as a group of {@dice 2d6}). The mephits don't attack unless they outnumber the characters two to one, but they're reluctant to be helpful unless they themselves are outnumbered.
zh_tw: 角色們可能會遇到{@creature magma mephit||熔岩魔蝠}、{@creature mud mephit||泥魔蝠}、{@creature smoke mephit||煙魔蝠}或{@creature steam mephit||蒸汽魔蝠}（每組出現數量為{@dice 2d6}）。這些魔蝠不會主動攻擊，除非它們數量是角色的兩倍，但除非它們自己被數量壓制，否則也不願意提供幫助。

english: Night Hag
zh_tw: 夜鬼婆

english: One of the Sewn Sisters (see chapter 5) shadows the party while staying in the Border Ethereal. During the party's next long rest, the {@creature night hag} materializes and snatches some blood or hair from a random character before returning to the Ethereal Plane.
zh_tw: 縫合姐妹之一（見第5章）在邊界以太中跟蹤隊伍。在隊伍的下一個長休期間，{@creature night hag||夜鬼婆}實體化並從隨機角色身上抓取一些血液或頭髮，然後返回以太位面。

english: Pterafolk
zh_tw: 翼手獸

english: Looming in the sky, {@dice 1d4 + 2} {@creature pterafolk|ToA} watch the characters' every move and wait until they blunder into danger. The next time a random encounter occurs, the pterafolk take advantage of the distraction and attack from the air, launching javelin attacks at wounded characters while staying out of melee. If they meet firm resistance, the pterafolk fly away, but they might regroup for a follow-up attack at your discretion.
zh_tw: 天空中隱約可見{@dice 1d4 + 2}只{@creature pterafolk|ToA|翼手獸}，它們監視著角色們的一舉一動，等待他們陷入危險。下次隨機遭遇發生時，翼手獸會利用混亂從空中發動攻擊，向受傷的角色投擲標槍並保持近戰距離。若遭遇頑強抵抗，翼手獸會飛離，但根據你的判斷它們可能會重組發動後續攻擊。

english: Rare Plant(s)
zh_tw: 稀有植物

english: The characters find one or more unusual plants, determined by rolling a {@dice d6}:
zh_tw: 角色們發現了一種或多種不尋常的植物，透過投擲{@dice d6}決定：

english: {@dice 2d6} {@item Dancing Monkey fruit|ToA} growing on a tree
zh_tw: {@dice 2d6} {@item Dancing Monkey fruit|ToA|猴舞果} 生長在樹上

english: Menga bush with {@dice 2d6} {@item Menga leaves (1 ounce)|ToA|ounces of leaves}
zh_tw: 夢加灌木叢附帶{@dice 2d6}{@item Menga leaves (1 ounce)|ToA|盎司的葉子}

english: {@dice 1d4} {@item Ryath Root|ToA|ryath roots} growing in the ground
zh_tw: 生長在地面上的{@dice 1d4}株{@item Ryath Root|ToA|雷亞斯根莖}

english: {@dice 4d6} {@item Sinda berries (10)|ToA|sinda berries} growing on a bush
zh_tw: 生長在灌木上的{@dice 4d6}顆{@item Sinda berries (10)|ToA|辛達莓果}

english: Wukka tree with {@dice 2d6} {@item Wukka Nut|ToA|wukka nuts}
zh_tw: 烏卡樹結有{@dice 2d6}顆{@item Wukka Nut|ToA|嗚咔堅果}

english: {@dice 1d6} {@item zabou|ToA} growing on a dead tree
zh_tw: {@dice 1d6} {@item zabou|ToA|扎孢菇} 生長在一棵枯樹上

english: Red Wizard
zh_tw: 紅袍巫師會

english: This group consists of a Red Wizard (LE male or female Thayan human {@creature mage}), {@dice 1d6} {@creature guard||guards}, and {@dice 1d6} {@creature skeleton||skeletons}, all answerable to {@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA} (see "Heart of Ubtao,"). If this encounter occurs outside of Omu, these reinforcements are on their way to the city. If the encounter takes place in Omu, the Red Wizard is searching the city for shrines (see chapter 3). The Thayans aren't spoiling for a fight; if defeat seems inevitable, the Red Wizard surrenders and offers a crude map of Chult marking the regions occupied by undead (see {@area map 2.1|159|x}). The characters can use the map to steer clear of these regions.
zh_tw: 這個團體由一名紅袍法師（守序邪惡，男性或女性，塞恩人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）、{@dice 1d6}名{@creature guard||警衛}和{@dice 1d6}具{@creature skeleton||骷髏}組成，全部聽命於{@creature Valindra Shadowmantle|ToA|瓦琳朵拉·暗影斗篷}（見"烏塔歐之心"）。如果這次遭遇發生在奧穆城外，這些增援正在前往該城的路上。若遭遇發生在奧穆城內，紅袍法師正在城中搜尋神殿（見第3章）。塞恩人並不渴望戰鬥；如果敗局已定，紅袍法師會投降並提供一份標記著不死生物佔據區域的粗製楚爾特地圖（見{@area 地圖 2.1|159|x}）。角色們可以利用該地圖避開這些區域。

english: Salamander
zh_tw: 火蜥蜴

english: {@note It is not possible to roll this result on the {@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA} table.}
zh_tw: {@note 無法在{@table Wilderness Encounters|ToA|野外遭遇}表格上擲出此結果。}

english: The characters see a {@creature salamander} tending a nest of {@dice 1d6} {@creature fire snake||fire snakes}. The salamander has no interest in fighting and attacks only to protect itself and the snakes.
zh_tw: 角色們看到一隻{@creature salamander||火蜥蜴}正在照料一窩{@dice 1d6}條{@creature fire snake||火蛇}。這隻火蜥蜴無意戰鬥，只有在保護自己和這些火蛇時才會發動攻擊。

english: Sea Hags
zh_tw: 海鬼婆

english: The characters encounter three {@creature sea hag||sea hags} that comprise a coven. Their favorite trick is to pull a damaged or abandoned {@item canoe|ToA} onto a riverbank and pretend to be stranded or wounded explorers in need of rescue.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了三名{@creature sea hag||海鬼婆}組成的巫團。她們最愛的把戲是將一艘損壞或被遺棄的{@item canoe|ToA|獨木舟}拖到河岸上，假裝成需要救援的遇難或受傷的探險者。

english: If the characters defeat the sea hags and search the area, roll three times on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, they find. Whatever treasure the hags have is stowed inside a rotted wooden chest.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了海鬼婆並搜尋了該區域，則在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上擲骰三次以確定他們能找到什麼（如果有的話）。鬼婆們擁有的任何寶藏都存放在一個腐爛的木箱中。

english: Shambling Mound
zh_tw: 蔓生怪

english: Roll any die when a {@creature shambling mound} encounter occurs. On an even result, the characters hear the creature trudging through the muck before it attacks them. On an odd result, the shambling mound lurks within a mass of vegetation, where it can be noticed by any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 15 or higher.
zh_tw: 當遭遇{@creature shambling mound||蔓生怪}時，投擲任意骰子。若結果為偶數，角色們會在怪物發動攻擊前聽到它在泥沼中跋涉的聲音。若結果為奇數，蹣跚怪會潛伏在植被叢中，被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到15或更高的角色可以察覺到它。

english: Snake, Constrictor
zh_tw: 蟒蛇，絞殺者

english: A {@creature constrictor snake} attacks a random party member from hiding. The character targeted by the snake is {@status surprised} unless he or she has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher.
zh_tw: 一條{@creature constrictor snake||蟒蛇}從隱蔽處隨機攻擊一名隊員。被巨蟒選中的角色將{@status surprised||突襲}，除非其被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高。

english: Snake, Giant Constrictor
zh_tw: 巨蟒，絞殺者

english: A {@creature giant constrictor snake} attacks from hiding in the same manner as a constrictor snake.
zh_tw: 一條{@creature giant constrictor snake||巨蟒蛇}以與蟒蛇相同的方式從隱藏處發動攻擊。

english: Snake, Giant Poisonous
zh_tw: 巨蛇，有毒

english: A {@creature giant poisonous snake} shoots out from the undergrowth to attack a random character. The character targeted by the snake is {@status surprised} unless he or she has a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 14 or higher.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature giant poisonous snake||巨毒蛇}從灌木叢中竄出攻擊隨機角色。被蛇選中的角色將{@status surprised||突襲}，除非其被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到14或更高。

english: Spiders
zh_tw: 蜘蛛

english: Giant spider webs are easily concealed in Chult's dense jungles and swamps. Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 13 or higher spots the webs in time to alert the other characters to an encounter with {@dice 1d6} {@creature giant spider||giant spiders}. Otherwise, the spiders attack with {@status surprised||surprise} when the lead party member blunders into a sticky web and becomes {@condition grappled} by it (escape {@dc 12}). Hundreds of baby giant spiders crawl through the webs, but they are harmless.
zh_tw: 在楚爾特茂密的叢林和沼澤中，巨型蜘蛛網很容易被隱藏。任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到13或更高的角色都能及時發現這些蛛網，警告其他同伴即將遭遇{@dice 1d6}只{@creature giant spider||巨蜘蛛}。否則當領隊成員誤入粘性蛛網並{@condition grappled||被擒}時（逃脫{@dc 12}），蜘蛛們將獲得{@status surprised||驚訝}優勢發起攻擊。數百隻幼年巨型蜘蛛在蛛網中爬行，但它們並無威脅。

english: Statue of Ubtao
zh_tw: 烏巴奧雕像

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher spots a 10-foot-tall statue overgrown with vines. The statue depicts a stylized Chultan king—a representation of Ubtao. Roll a {@dice d4} to determine what's special about the statue:
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高的角色都會發現一尊10尺高、爬滿藤蔓的雕像。雕像刻畫了一位風格化的楚爾特國王——這是烏塔歐的象徵。擲一次{@dice d4}來決定雕像的特殊之處：

english: Treasure lies at the foot of the statue, left there as tribute by some jungle creature. Roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what treasure is found. If the roll indicates no treasure, the characters find worthless pieces of bone jewelry instead.
zh_tw: 寶藏位於雕像腳下，是某種叢林生物留下的貢品。擲一次{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表格來決定發現的寶藏。如果擲骰結果顯示沒有寶藏，角色們會發現一些毫無價值的骨制首飾。

english: Goblin, grung, and su-monster skulls are piled around the statue's base.
zh_tw: 地精、蛙人和蘇怪的顱骨堆積在雕像基座周圍。

english: A {@spell glyph of warding} is inscribed on the statue. To spot the glyph, a character searching the statue must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|PHB}) check. If any creature touches the statue, the glyph erupts with magical energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the statue. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The thunderous noise has a {@chance 75} chance of attracting stirges or a troll lurking nearby (see "{@area Stirges|5e6|x}" and "{@area Troll|5ee|x}" below).
zh_tw: 雕像上刻有一個{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}。要發現這個刻文，搜查雕像的角色必須透過一次{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Investigation|PHB|調查}）檢定。如果有生物觸碰雕像，刻文會以雕像為中心爆發20尺半徑的魔法能量。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 14}敏捷豁免，失敗則受到22（{@damage 5d8}）點雷鳴傷害，成功則傷害減半。雷鳴般的響聲有{@chance 75}機率吸引附近的吸血蝙蝠或潛伏的巨魔（見下方"{@area 蚊蝠們|5e6|x}"和"{@area 巨魔|5ee|x}"）。

english: The statue has grooves carved into its stomach that form a maze. Any character who studies the grooves and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence check sees a clear pathway through the labyrinth. That character is then bestowed with the power to cast the {@spell find the path} spell as an action, no components required, by tracing the same path with his or her finger. Once used, this ability goes away. Once the statue has granted this benefit, it can't do so again until the next dawn.
zh_tw: 雕像的腹部刻有溝槽，形成了一座迷宮。任何研究這些溝槽並透過{@dc 10}智力檢定的角色，都能看到一條穿越迷宮的清晰路徑。隨後該角色將獲得施放{@spell find the path||尋路術}法術的能力——只需用手指描摹相同路徑即可作為動作施放，無需任何法術成分。該能力使用一次後即消失。當雕像賦予此增益後，需至次日黎明才能再次生效。

english: Stirges
zh_tw: 蚊蝠們

english: Chult is rich in caves, ruins, and hollow logs in which stirges can hide. By day, the characters disturb {@dice 2d6} {@creature stirge||stirges} as they move through the jungle. At night, the same number of stirges descend on the party's camp.
zh_tw: 楚爾特遍佈洞穴、廢墟和中空的樹幹，吸血蝙蝠可藏身其中。白天，角色們在叢林中穿行時會驚動 {@dice 2d6} {@creature stirge||蚊蝠}。夜晚，同等數量的吸血蝙蝠會襲擊隊伍營地。

english: Su-monsters
zh_tw: 蘇怪

english: The party comes across {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature su-monster|ToA|su-monsters}. The su-monsters approach cautiously, feigning curiosity. If allowed to get close, each su-monster uses its Psychic Crush in the hope of stunning an adventurer before attacking with its bite and claws. The su-monsters flee to their treetop lairs if the fight goes against them.
zh_tw: 隊伍遭遇了{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature su-monster|ToA|蘇怪}。這些蘇怪獸佯裝好奇地謹慎靠近。若被允許接近，每隻蘇怪獸會先使用心靈粉碎試圖擊暈冒險者，再用撕咬和利爪攻擊。若戰況不利，蘇怪獸會逃回樹頂巢穴。

english: The su-monsters might have treasure stashed in one of their trees; roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, a search of the tree yields.
zh_tw: 蘇怪可能將財寶藏於某棵樹上；擲一次{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表格以確定搜尋該樹時能發現什麼（如果有的話）。

english: Swarms of Bats
zh_tw: 蝙蝠群

english: Ruins, hollow trees, and hidden caverns can all be homes to bats. This encounter sees the characters disturb {@dice 1d4} {@creature swarm of bats||swarms of bats} that have become unnaturally aggressive from feeding on undead flesh.
zh_tw: 廢墟、空心樹木和隱蔽洞穴都可能成為蝙蝠的棲息地。這次遭遇中，角色們驚擾了{@dice 1d4}{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}，這些蝙蝠因以不死生物的血肉為食而變得異常兇暴。

english: Swarms of Insects
zh_tw: 昆蟲叢集

english: The characters are beset by {@dice 1d4} {@creature swarm of centipedes||swarm of insects (centipedes)}. At the end of the encounter, any character damaged by a swarm must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with {@disease shivering sickness|ToA} (see {@i "Diseases"}).
zh_tw: 角色們被 {@dice 1d4} {@creature swarm of centipedes||蟲群（蜈蚣）}圍攻。在戰鬥結束時，任何被蜈蚣群傷害的角色必須進行一次 {@dc 11} 體質豁免檢定，若未能透過，則會感染 {@disease shivering sickness|ToA|寒顫病}（參見 {@i "疾病"}）。

english: Swarms of Quippers
zh_tw: 食人魚群

english: This encounter indicates that {@dice 1d4} {@creature swarm of quippers||swarms of quippers} catch sight of the party, but these creatures are dangerous only if the characters are in the water with them. Creatures on the shore or in canoes are safe, but in both cases, the swarms follow the characters until they're out of sight and away from the water.
zh_tw: 此遭遇表示有{@dice 1d4}群{@creature swarm of quippers||食人魚群}發現了隊伍，但這些生物僅在角色與它們同處水中時構成威脅。岸上或獨木舟中的角色是安全的，但無論哪種情況，魚群都會跟隨角色直到離開視線並遠離水域。

english: Tabaxi Hunter
zh_tw: 斑貓獵人

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 15 or higher spots a {@creature tabaxi hunter|ToA} watching the party from a vantage point 300 feet away. If the tabaxi goes unseen, it might shadow the characters for a while, then suddenly appear to help them fight off a tough encounter or warn them of danger in the vicinity.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到15或更高的角色，都能發現一隻{@creature tabaxi hunter|ToA|斑貓獵人}在300尺外的制高點監視著隊伍。如果斑貓人未被發現，它可能會暗中跟隨角色一段時間，然後突然現身幫助他們擊退強敵或警告他們附近有危險。

english: If this encounter takes place in Omu, see chapter 3 for more information on the tabaxi hunters found there.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在奧穆，請參閱第3章以獲取那裡發現的斑貓獵人的更多資訊。

english: Tiger
zh_tw: 虎

english: A {@creature tiger} lies in wait for the party but is noticed by any character whose passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score is 16 or higher. If not detected, the tiger pounces at a character who comes within 40 feet of it. The tiger retreats if it loses more than half its hit points.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature tiger||虎}正埋伏等待隊伍，但任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到16或更高的角色都會發現它。如果未被察覺，老虎會撲向進入其40尺範圍內的角色。若失去超過一半生命值，老虎會撤退。

english: Tri-flower Frond
zh_tw: 三花株

english: If this encounter occurs while the characters are traveling, they wander into a patch of {@dice 1d4} {@creature tri-flower frond|ToA|tri-flower fronds} which seem like ordinary plants until they strike. If the encounter occurs while the party is camped, the plants try to infiltrate the camp, anesthetize characters with their orange blossoms, then slay them with their yellow and red blossoms.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在角色旅行途中，他們會誤入一片{@dice 1d4}株{@creature tri-flower frond|ToA|三花株}，這些植物在發動攻擊前看起來與普通植物無異。若遭遇發生在隊伍紮營時，這些植物會試圖潛入營地，用橙色花朵麻醉角色，再用紅色和黃色花朵殺死他們。

english: Troll
zh_tw: 巨魔

english: A hungry {@creature troll} comes crashing out of the jungle, intent on eating the characters.
zh_tw: 一隻飢餓的{@creature troll||巨魔}從叢林中衝出來，打算吃掉角色們。

english: Undead
zh_tw: 亡靈

english: Undead are spreading through the jungles of Chult like a plague. The Emerald Enclave, the Order of the Gauntlet, and the Flaming Fist are all taking steps to contain this menace, but their efforts to date have fallen short.
zh_tw: 不死生物正在像瘟疫一樣蔓延楚爾特的叢林。翡翠聯盟、戰錘團和焰拳都在採取措施遏制這一威脅，但他們迄今為止的努力都未能成功。

english: Ghouls
zh_tw: 食屍鬼們

english: Any character with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher hears and smells a ghoul pack approaching, consisting of {@dice 2d6} {@creature ghoul||ghouls} led by a {@creature ghast}. The ghast has a blue triangle tattooed on its forehead—an indicator that it once served {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}.
zh_tw: 任何被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高的角色都能聽到並聞到一群食屍鬼正在接近，這群食屍鬼由{@dice 2d6}只{@creature ghoul||食屍鬼}和一隻{@creature ghast||妖鬼}帶領。這隻妖鬼額頭上紋有一個藍色三角形標記——表明它曾效忠於{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}。

english: Skeletons
zh_tw: 骷髏們

english: The characters come across {@dice 3d6} {@creature skeleton||skeletons}. If the encounter occurs while the party is traveling, the skeletons are either lying on the ground or buried under it, ready to spring up when wayward explorers pass by. If the party is camped, the skeletons wander into the camp and attack.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了{@dice 3d6}個{@creature skeleton||骷髏}。若遭遇發生在隊伍行進途中，這些骷髏要麼躺在地上要麼埋在土裡，隨時準備在迷途的探索者經過時暴起發難。若隊伍正在紮營，骷髏會遊蕩進營地發動攻擊。

english: Specter
zh_tw: 惡靈

english: The evil remnant of a dead explorer has become a {@creature specter} that attacks the party. The explorer's body can be found with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Survival|PHB}) check. If the characters locate the body, see "Explorer, Dead" earlier in this section to determine what they find.
zh_tw: 一名已故探險家的邪惡殘餘變成了攻擊隊伍的{@creature specter||惡靈}。透過一次成功的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Survival|PHB|求生}）檢定可以找到探險家的屍體。如果角色們找到了屍體，請參閱本節前面的"已故探險家"來確定他們發現了什麼。

english: Wight
zh_tw: 屍妖

english: The characters encounter a {@creature wight} that has lurked in the Chultan jungle since before the Spellplague. It harbors an eternal hatred for Chultans and everything related to Ubtao. If the party includes any Chultans or any character wearing the holy symbol of Ubtao, the wight attacks those characters in preference to other targets.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了一個{@creature wight||屍妖}，它自魔疫之災前就潛伏在楚爾特的叢林中。這隻幽魂對楚爾特人及任何與烏伯託有關的事物懷有永恆的仇恨。如果隊伍中有楚爾特人或佩戴烏伯託聖徽的角色，幽魂將優先攻擊這些目標。

english: Zombies
zh_tw: 喪屍們

english: Characters catch the scent of death on the air and hear the undead lumbering through the jungle.
zh_tw: 角色們在空中嗅到了死亡的氣息，並聽到了不死生物在叢林中笨重移動的聲音。

english: Roll a {@dice d10} to determine what appears:
zh_tw: 擲一個{@dice d10}來決定出現什麼：

english: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Zombie||Zombies}
zh_tw: {@dice 3d6} {@creature Zombie||喪屍}

english: Vegepygmies
zh_tw: 孢子人們

english: The characters cross paths with {@dice 1d4} {@creature vegepygmy|VGM|vegepygmies}, each one mounted on a {@creature thorny|VGM} (see appendix D for both). These vegepygmy hunters have wandered far from their tribe. They flee if outnumbered; otherwise, they attack.
zh_tw: 角色們遭遇了{@dice 1d4}只{@creature vegepygmy|VGM|孢子人們}，每隻都騎乘著一隻{@creature thorny|VGM|荊棘獸}（兩者皆見附錄D）。這些植物侏儒獵手已遠離自己的部落遊蕩。若人數處於劣勢它們就會逃跑，否則就會發動攻擊。

english: Wereboar
zh_tw: 野豬人

english: A {@creature wereboar} masquerading as a Chultan priest takes a dim view of explorers encroaching on its territory and demands that the characters turn back. Around its neck, it wears a wooden holy symbol of Ubtao (a labyrinthine pattern carved into a circular disk). The wereboar might be guarding a shrine to Ubtao, a grove of wukka trees, or a cave it uses as a lair. The creature might also have treasure in its lair; roll three times on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, a search of the wereboar's lair yields.
zh_tw: 一隻偽裝成楚爾特祭司的{@creature wereboar||野豬人}對侵入其領地的探險者持敵視態度，並要求角色們立即折返。它脖子上懸掛著烏波塔奧的木製聖徽（一個刻在圓盤上的迷宮圖案）。這隻野豬人可能守護著一座烏波塔奧神龕、一片烏卡樹林，或是作為巢穴的洞穴。其巢穴中可能藏有財寶；在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上投擲三次，以確定搜尋野豬人巢穴可能獲得的物品（如果有的話）。

english: Weretiger
zh_tw: 虎人

english: A {@creature weretiger} in human form offers to escort the party through a particularly dangerous stretch of wilderness. It has no ulterior motive and doesn't ask for payment. If the characters accept its assistance, they have no hostile random encounters while the weretiger is with them. It leaves after accompanying the party for 24 hours or when it reaches a location it does not wish to explore, including Omu, Nangalore, or Orolunga.
zh_tw: 一隻以人類形態出現的{@creature weretiger||虎人}提出要護送隊伍透過一段特別危險的荒野。它沒有不可告人的動機，也不要求支付費用。如果角色們接受了它的幫助，那麼在虎人與他們在一起的時候，他們不會有敵對的隨機遭遇。它在陪伴隊伍24小時後離開，或者當它到達一個它不想探索的地點時也會離開，包括奧穆、南加洛爾或奧羅倫加。

english: Winterscape
zh_tw: 冬日景象

english: The characters stumble into a wondrous sight: a 120-foot-radius sphere of winter weather. To drive off some monsters, {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} created the sphere using the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. All plants and surfaces within the sphere are covered with glittering ice and frost, and the temperature within the sphere is a biting −30 degrees Fahrenheit. The effect was created by an artifact and can't be dispelled.
zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現了一幅奇景：一個半徑120尺的寒冬領域球體。為了驅趕某些怪物，{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}使用{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}創造了這個球體。球體內所有植物和表面都覆蓋著閃亮的冰霜，內部溫度低至華氏 −30 度。該效果由一件神器創造，無法被驅散。

english: Yellow Musk Creeper and Zombies
zh_tw: 黃迷香爬藤和殭屍

english: The characters pass close to a ruin inhabited by {@dice 3d6} {@creature yellow musk zombie|ToA|yellow musk zombies}. The zombies might be spread across the area or bunched together, depending on the terrain. In the heart of the ruin, a {@creature yellow musk creeper|ToA} clings to a crumbling archway, statue, or polluted well.
zh_tw: 角色們經過一處被{@dice 3d6}只{@creature yellow musk zombie|ToA|黃迷香喪屍}佔據的廢墟。這些殭屍可能分散在區域各處或聚集在一起，取決於地形。在廢墟中心，一株{@creature yellow musk creeper|ToA|黃迷香爬藤}攀附在一處搖搖欲墜的拱門、雕像或被汙染的井上。

english: If this encounter occurs while the party is camped, the zombies emerge from a nearby ruin to attack the camp and attempt to knock characters {@condition unconscious}. They then drag those characters back to the yellow musk creeper.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在隊伍紮營時，殭屍會從附近的廢墟中出現並襲擊營地，試圖將角色擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。然後它們會將那些角色拖回黃迷香爬藤那裡。

english: Yuan-Ti
zh_tw: 蛇人

english: Yuan-ti patrols consist of {@dice 1d6 + 1} {@creature yuan-ti pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods}, which keep their distance as they try to gather information to take back to {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}. The yuan-ti are camouflaged, but any character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check made with disadvantage catches sight of the serpent folk as they withdraw.
zh_tw: 蛇人巡邏隊由{@dice 1d6 + 1}名{@creature yuan-ti pureblood||純血原體蛇人}組成，它們會保持距離並試圖收集情報帶回給{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}。這些蛇人經過偽裝，但任何角色若在以劣勢進行的{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定中成功，就能在它們撤退時發現這些蛇人。

english: If this encounter occurs within 25 miles of Omu, the patrol is instead made up of {@dice 1d4} {@creature yuan-ti malison (type 1)||yuan-ti malisons}, and it takes a {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) check to spot them. If the characters chase after the malisons, they transform into snakes and vanish into the jungle.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在奧穆25英里範圍內，巡邏隊將由{@dice 1d4}名{@creature yuan-ti malison (type 1)||惡咒蛇人}組成，需要透過{@dc 14}的感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）檢定才能發現它們。如果角色們追趕這些魔裔，它們會變成蛇並消失在叢林中。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: A Zhent {@creature assassin} with a {@creature flying snake} pet leads a {@creature priest}, {@dice 2d6} {@creature thug||thugs}, and {@dice 1d6} {@creature tribal warrior||tribal warriors} through the wilderness in search of {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} and the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. If Artus is with the characters, the Zhents demand the ring and attack if they don't receive it quickly. Otherwise, they show little interest in the characters.
zh_tw: 一名帶著{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}寵物的{@creature assassin||刺客}正率領著一位{@creature priest||祭司}、{@dice 2d6}名{@creature thug||暴徒}以及{@dice 1d6}名{@creature tribal warrior||部族武者}在荒野中搜尋{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}和{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}。若阿圖斯與玩家同行，散塔林會成員會索要戒指，若未迅速得手便會發動攻擊。否則他們對玩家興趣寥寥。

english: Roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what treasure, if any, the Zhents carry.
zh_tw: 擲一次{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表來決定贊斯成員攜帶的寶藏（如果有的話）。

english: Zorbos
zh_tw: 佐博怪

english: If this encounter occurs while the characters are traveling, they spot {@dice 2d6} {@creature zorbo|ToA|zorbos} in wukka trees. The creatures growl and bare their teeth if any characters approach them. If the characters act in a threatening manner, the zorbos attack.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在角色們旅行途中，他們會發現{@dice 2d6}只{@creature zorbo|ToA|佐博怪}棲息在烏卡樹上。若有角色靠近，這些生物會齜牙低吼。如果角色們表現出威脅行為，佐波們將會發動攻擊。

english: If this encounter occurs while the party is camped, the hungry zorbos drop from the surrounding trees and attack.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在隊伍紮營時，飢餓的佐博斯從周圍的樹上跳下並發動攻擊。

english: Omu Encounters
zh_tw: 奧穆遭遇

english: Random encounters in Omu can take place in ruined buildings and streets, in the fetid swamps around the buildings, and in the ruined royal palace. Roll a {@dice d20} three times per day of game time, checking for encounters each morning, afternoon, and evening or night. An encounter occurs on a roll of 18 or higher. Roll percentile dice and check the {@table Omu Encounters|ToA} table for the appropriate terrain to see what the characters encounter.
zh_tw: 在奧穆的隨機遭遇可能發生在廢墟建築與街道、建築周圍惡臭的沼澤以及破敗的皇家宮殿中。每個遊戲日需投擲{@dice d20}三次，分別於清晨、午後和傍晚或夜間進行遭遇檢定。當擲出18或更高時遭遇生效。投擲百分骰並參照{@table Omu Encounters|ToA|奧穆遭遇}中對應地形的條目，以確定角色遭遇的內容。

english: Four random encounters that occur only in Omu are described below.
zh_tw: 下面描述了只在奧穆發生的四起隨機遭遇。

english: Gargoyles
zh_tw: 石像鬼

english: Perched on a cliff are {@dice 2d4} {@creature gargoyle||gargoyles} that swoop down to attack. Two of them carry a net between them. As an action, either gargoyle can use the net to make a melee weapon attack ({@hit 4} to hit) against one Small or Medium creature. If the attack hits, the gargoyles hoist the character into the air and fly off with their catch. It takes both gargoyles to lift the net if it has a creature caught in it. The gargoyles flee if reduced to half their number.
zh_tw: 懸崖上棲息著{@dice 2d4}只{@creature gargoyle||石像鬼}，它們會俯衝下來攻擊。其中兩隻石像鬼共同攜帶著一張網。作為一個動作，任一隻石像鬼都可以用這張網對一個小型或中型生物發動近戰武器攻擊（命中加值{@hit 4}）。若攻擊命中，石像鬼會將角色吊到空中並帶著獵物飛走。若網中困有生物，則需要兩隻石像鬼共同才能抬起網。當石像鬼數量減半時它們會逃跑。

english: Giant Wolf Spiders
zh_tw: 巨狼蛛

english: The characters are attacked by {@dice 1d6} {@creature giant wolf spider||giant wolf spiders} living in hidey-holes in the nearby ruins. A search of the spiders' lair might yield treasure; roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, is found.
zh_tw: 角色們遭到{@dice 1d6}只{@creature giant wolf spider||巨狼蛛}的襲擊，這些生物棲息在附近廢墟的隱蔽洞穴中。搜尋蜘蛛巢穴可能發現財寶；在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上擲骰一次以確定發現了什麼（如果有的話）。

english: King of Feathers
zh_tw: 翎羽之王

english: The characters encounter the tyrannosaurus rex known as the {@creature King of Feathers|ToA}. See chapter 3 for more information on this unique beast.
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了被稱為{@creature King of Feathers|ToA|翎羽之王}的霸王龍。有關這頭獨特生物的更多資訊，請參見第3章。

english: Kobolds
zh_tw: 狗頭人

english: Moving through the city or palace ruins are {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@creature kobold||kobolds} led by a {@creature kobold inventor|VGM}. Characters with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|PHB}) score of 12 or higher spot the kobolds, which flee if approached or attacked. The kobolds serve the kobold scale sorcerer Kakarol (see chapter 3). They might be on their way to one of the city's shrines to reset its traps, or they might be returning to their lair with a recently discovered treasure. Roll once on the {@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|Treasure Drops} table to determine what, if anything, the kobolds found.
zh_tw: 在城市或宮殿廢墟中穿行時，會遇到由{@creature kobold inventor|VGM|狗頭人發明家}帶領的{@dice 1d4 + 1}只{@creature kobold||狗頭人}。被動感知（{@skill Perception|PHB|感知}）達到12或更高的角色會發現這些狗頭人，它們在被接近或攻擊時會逃跑。這些狗頭人為狗頭人鱗甲術士卡卡洛爾效力（見第3章）。它們可能正前往城市中的某個神殿重置陷阱，或者帶著新發現的寶物返回巢穴。在{@table Cyclops; Treasure Drops|ToA|寶藏掉落}表上擲一次骰，以確定狗頭人發現了什麼（如果有的話）。

zh_tw: 附錄C：發現

english: Chult is a land filled with untold wonders and lost treasures. Adventurers will discover this for themselves as they explore the peninsula's uncharted wilderness.
zh_tw: 楚爾特是一片充滿未知奇蹟和遺失寶藏的土地。冒險家們將在探索這片半島未被測繪的荒野時自行發現這一點。

english: Flora and Fauna
zh_tw: 動植物分佈

english: This section describes unusual wildlife native to Chult. Any character with proficiency in the {@skill Nature|PHB} skill recognizes one of these plants or creatures on sight, and can recall its properties with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature|PHB}) check. If the character is a native of Chult, this check is made with advantage.
zh_tw: 本節描述了楚爾特特有的奇特野生動植物。任何擁有{@skill Nature|PHB|自然}技能熟練項的角色都能在目擊時認出這些植物或生物，並透過一次成功的{@dc 15}智力（{@skill Nature|PHB|自然}）檢定來回憶其特性。若該角色是楚爾特原住民，則此檢定具有優勢。

english: The wildlife described here can be bought and sold in Port Nyanzaru and other settlements for the amounts listed in the Flora and Fauna table.
zh_tw: 這裡描述的野生動物可以在南扎路港和其他定居點以《植物與動物》表中列出的金額購買和出售。

english: Some of these things inflict the {@condition poisoned} condition on a creature for an hour or more. Remember that {@spell lesser restoration} and similar magic can end that condition.
zh_tw: 其中一些事物會使生物陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態一小時或更長時間。請記住，{@spell lesser restoration||次等復原術}及類似法術可以終止該狀態。

english: Dancing Monkey Fruit
zh_tw: 猴舞果

english: This rare magical fruit produces enough juice to fill a vial. Any humanoid that eats a {@item dancing monkey fruit|ToA} or drinks its juice must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or begin a comic dance that lasts for 1 minute. Humanoids that can't be {@condition poisoned} are immune to this magical effect.
zh_tw: 這種稀有的魔法果實能產出足以裝滿一小瓶的果汁。任何人形生物若食用了一顆{@item dancing monkey fruit|ToA|猴舞果}或飲用了其果汁，必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}的體質豁免檢定，否則會開始一段持續1分鐘的滑稽舞蹈。無法被{@condition poisoned||中毒}的人形生物對此魔法效果免疫。

english: The dancer must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. Each time it takes damage, the dancer can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. When the dancing effect ends, the humanoid suffers the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 舞者必須耗盡他的移動力在原地跳舞，其攻擊檢定和敏捷豁免均具劣勢。對他發動的攻擊檢定具優勢。每次受到傷害時，舞者可以再次進行該豁免，豁免成功則結束舞蹈效果。當舞蹈效果結束時，該類人生物陷入一小時的{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態中。

english: Menga Leaves
zh_tw: 曼加葉

english: The dried leaves of a menga bush can be ground, dissolved in a liquid, heated, and ingested. A creature that ingests 1 ounce of menga leaves in this fashion regains 1 hit point. A creature that ingests more than 5 ounces of menga leaves in a 24-hour period gains no additional benefit and must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour. The {@condition unconscious} creature awakens if it takes at least 5 damage on one turn.
zh_tw: 曼加叢的幹葉可以磨碎泡水，然後加熱服下。以這種方式服下一盎司曼加葉的生物會恢復 1 點生命值。24 小時內攝入超過 5盎司曼加葉的生物不會再獲得增益，並且必須進行 {@dc 11} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則{@condition unconscious||昏迷} 1 小時。在一輪承受至少 5 點傷害的情況下，陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的生物才會醒來。

english: A healthy menga bush usually has {@dice 2d6} ounces of leaves. Once picked, the leaves require 1 day to dry out before they can confer any benefit.
zh_tw: 狀況良好的曼加叢通常有 {@dice 2d6} 盎司的葉片。一旦被摘取，這些葉片在能夠產生任何有益效果之前，需要 1 天時間進行脫水乾燥。

english: Ryath Root
zh_tw: 雷亞斯根莖

english: Any creature that ingests a ryath root gains {@dice 2d4} temporary hit points. A creature that consumes more than one ryath root in a 24-hour period must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer the {@condition poisoned} condition for 1 hour.
zh_tw: 吃下雷亞斯根莖的任何生物都會獲得 {@dice 2d4} 點臨時生命值。在 24小時內服用超過一塊雷亞斯根莖的生物需要進行一個 {@dc 13} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則陷入持續一小時的{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

english: Sinda Berries
zh_tw: 辛達莓果

english: These berries are dark brown and bitter. A full-grown sinda berry bush has {@dice 4d6} berries growing on it. A bush plucked of all its berries grows new berries in {@dice 1d4} months. Picked berries lose their freshness and efficacy after 24 hours.
zh_tw: 這些莓果呈暗褐色，帶苦味。完全成熟的辛達莓叢生長有 {@dice 4d6} 顆莓果。被摘盡果實的莓叢需要 {@dice 1d4} 個月才能重新長出所有新莓果。摘下的莓果會在 24 小時後不再新鮮並失去特殊效果。

english: Fresh sinda berries can be eaten raw or crushed and added to a drink to dull the bitterness. A creature that consumes at least ten fresh sinda berries gains advantage on saving throws against disease and poison for the next 24 hours.
zh_tw: 新鮮的辛達莓果可以生吃，也可以加入飲品中以沖淡苦味。吃下至少 10 顆新鮮的辛達莓果的生物在接下來的 24 小時內為了抵抗疾病和毒素而進行的豁免檢定具優勢。

english: Wildroot
zh_tw: 荒根

english: Introducing the juice of a wildroot into a {@condition poisoned} creature's bloodstream (for example, by rubbing it on an open wound) rids the creature of the {@condition poisoned} condition. Once used in this way, a wildroot loses this property.
zh_tw: 讓荒根的汁液流入一個{@condition poisoned||中毒}生物的血流中（比如用它摩擦裸露的傷口）能夠讓該生物擺脫{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。一條荒根只要被這麼用過一次，就會失去它的功效。

english: Wukka Nuts
zh_tw: 嗚咔堅果

english: These fist-sized nuts grow on wukka trees, which are popular haunts for jaculi, su-monsters, and zorbos. A wukka nut rattles when shaken, causing its shell to shed {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} in a 10-foot radius and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 10 feet. This magical light fades after 1 minute, but shaking the nut again causes the light to reappear. If the shell of the nut is cracked open, it loses its magic.
zh_tw: 這些拳頭大小的堅果生長在烏卡樹上，而烏卡樹是幻色蛇、蘇怪和佐波獸偏愛的棲息地。搖晃烏卡果時會發出咔嗒聲，其果殼會散發出{@quickref Vision and Light||2||明亮光照}覆蓋10尺半徑，併產生{@quickref Vision and Light||2||微光光照}再延伸10尺。這種魔法光芒會在1分鐘後消退，但再次搖晃堅果可使光芒重現。若堅果外殼破裂，則會失去魔力。

english: Yahcha
zh_tw: 亞查甲蟲

english: A yahcha (pronounced YAH-chah) is a harmless, meaty beetle about the size of a human hand, which feeds on worms and maggots. It moves slowly (walking speed 10 feet) and is easy to catch. A creature with {@disease blue mist fever|ToA} that eats a raw or cooked yahcha can immediately make a saving throw with advantage against that disease (see {@adventure "Diseases,"|ToA|2|Diseases} page 40).
zh_tw: 亞查甲蟲（發音為YAH-chah）是一種無害的肉質甲蟲，體型約有人類手掌大小，以蠕蟲和蛆蟲為食。它移動緩慢（步行速度10尺）且容易捕獲。患有{@disease blue mist fever|ToA|藍霧熱}的生物若生食或熟食一隻亞查甲蟲，可立即對該疾病進行一次具有優勢的豁免檢定（參見{@adventure "疾病"|ToA|2|Diseases}第40頁）。

english: Zabou
zh_tw: 扎孢菇

english: Zabou mushrooms feed on offal and the rotting wood of dead trees. If handled carefully, a zabou can be picked or uprooted without causing it to release its spores. If crushed or struck, a zabou releases its spores in a 10-foot-radius sphere. A zabou can also be hurled up to 30 feet away or dropped like a grenade, releasing its cloud of spores on impact. Any creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The {@condition poisoned} creature's skin itches for the duration. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
zh_tw: 扎孢菇靠攝取內臟和枯樹的腐木的營養為生。謹慎處理的情況下，可以將扎孢菇採摘或拔除並使其不釋放孢子。一旦受到擠壓或是遭到打擊，扎孢菇就會釋放出孢子，覆蓋半徑 10 尺的球形範圍。扎孢菇也可以像手雷一樣被丟出最多 30 尺遠或者原地丟下，在受到衝擊時釋放它的孢子云。位於這片區域內的生物必須進行 {@dc 10} 的體質豁免，豁免失敗則{@condition poisoned||中毒}一分鐘。生物在{@condition poisoned||中毒}期間會持續發癢。中毒生物在其每回合結束時可以重複該豁免，豁免成功則結束該狀態。
